name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_mem_support
statement: lemma start_mem_support (p : GraphPath G) : p.start ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [support, Walk.start_mem_support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.finish_mem_support
statement: lemma finish_mem_support (p : GraphPath G) : p.finish ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [support, Walk.end_mem_support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_nonempty
statement: lemma support_nonempty (p : GraphPath G) : p.support.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨p.start, p.start_mem_support⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_singleton (v : V) : (singleton (G := G) v).support = {v}
proof:
:= by
  simp [singleton, support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_reverse (p : GraphPath G) : p.reverse.support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [reverse, support, Walk.support_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.not_mem_list_support
statement:
lemma not_mem_list_support {x : V} {p : GraphPath G} (hx : x ∉ p.support) :
    x ∉ p.walk.support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [support] using hx

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_consAdj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_consAdj {x : V} (p : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj x p.start)
    (hx : x ∉ p.support) :
    (p.consAdj h hx).support = insert x p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [consAdj, support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_concatAdj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_concatAdj {x : V} (p : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish x)
    (hx : x ∉ p.support) :
    (p.concatAdj h hx).support = insert x p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [concatAdj, support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchStarts_start
statement:
lemma switchStarts_start (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.start q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (switchStarts p q h hd).start = p.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchStarts_finish
statement:
lemma switchStarts_finish (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.start q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (switchStarts p q h hd).finish = q.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchStarts_support
statement:
lemma switchStarts_support (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.start q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (switchStarts p q h hd).support = p.support ∪ q.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [switchStarts, splice, reverse, GraphPath.support, Walk.support_append,
    Walk.support_cons, Walk.support_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse, union_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchStarts_edges
proof:
:= by
  have hrev : p.walk.reverse.edges.toFinset = p.edges := by
    simp [edges, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  simp [edges, switchStarts, splice, reverse, Walk.edges_append, Walk.edges_cons,
    List.toFinset_append, List.toFinset_cons, hrev, union_comm, union_left_comm,
    union_assoc]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchEnds_start
statement:
lemma switchEnds_start (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.finish)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (switchEnds p q h hd).start = p.start
proof:
:= by
  simp [switchEnds, switchStarts_start, reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchEnds_finish
statement:
lemma switchEnds_finish (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.finish)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (switchEnds p q h hd).finish = q.start
proof:
:= by
  simp [switchEnds, switchStarts_finish, reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchEnds_support
statement:
lemma switchEnds_support (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.finish)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (switchEnds p q h hd).support = p.support ∪ q.support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [switchEnds, support_reverse] using
    switchStarts_support p.reverse q.reverse (by simpa [reverse] using h)
      (by simpa [support_reverse] using hd)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchEnds_edges
proof:
:= by
  have hrevp : p.reverse.edges = p.edges := by
    simp [edges, reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  have hrevq : q.reverse.edges = q.edges := by
    simp [edges, reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  rw [switchEnds, switchStarts_edges, hrevp, hrevq]
  simp [reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchStarts_AIncident
statement:
theorem switchStarts_AIncident (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.start q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) {A : Finset V}
    (hp : p.start ∉ A) (hq : q.start ∉ A) :
    (switchStarts p q h hd).AIncident A = p.AIncident A ∪ q.AIncident A
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_AIncident_iff, switchStarts_edges, mem_union, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    rcases hmem with (h | h) | rfl
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    · rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hbe with hb | hb
      · exact (hp (hb ▸ hbA)).elim
      · exact (hq (hb ▸ hbA)).elim
  · rintro (⟨he, hA⟩ | ⟨he, hA⟩)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl he), hA⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr he), hA⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchEnds_AIncident
statement:
theorem switchEnds_AIncident (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.finish)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) {A : Finset V}
    (hp : p.finish ∉ A) (hq : q.finish ∉ A) :
    (switchEnds p q h hd).AIncident A = p.AIncident A ∪ q.AIncident A
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p.reverse.start ∉ A := by simpa [reverse] using hp
  have hq' : q.reverse.start ∉ A := by simpa [reverse] using hq
  have hrevp : p.reverse.AIncident A = p.AIncident A := by
    simp [AIncident, edges, reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  have hrevq : q.reverse.AIncident A = q.AIncident A := by
    simp [AIncident, edges, reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  simpa [switchEnds, hrevp, hrevq] using
    switchStarts_AIncident p.reverse q.reverse (by simpa [reverse] using h)
      (by simpa [support_reverse] using hd) hp' hq'

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.mem_walk_support_of_mem
statement:
lemma mem_walk_support_of_mem {c : GraphCycle G} {u : V}
    (hu : u ∈ c.support) : u ∈ c.walk.support
proof:
:=
  List.mem_toFinset.mp (by simpa [support] using hu)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.support_rotateTo
statement:
lemma support_rotateTo (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).support = c.support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [rotateTo, support, List.mem_toFinset]
  exact Walk.mem_support_rotate_iff (w := x) c.walk u (mem_walk_support_of_mem hu)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.start_rotateTo
statement:
lemma start_rotateTo (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).start = u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.edges_rotateTo
statement:
lemma edges_rotateTo (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).walk.edges.toFinset = c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp [rotateTo, List.mem_toFinset]
  exact (c.walk.rotate_edges u (mem_walk_support_of_mem hu)).perm.mem_iff

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.adj_succAt
statement:
lemma adj_succAt (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    G.Adj u (c.succAt hu)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (c.rotateTo hu).walk.length := by
    simpa [rotateTo, Walk.length_rotate] using
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) c.three_le_length)
  simpa [succAt, rotateTo, Walk.getVert_zero] using
    (c.rotateTo hu).walk.adj_getVert_succ hpos

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support
statement:
lemma succAt_mem_support (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    c.succAt hu ∈ c.support
proof:
:= by
  have : c.succAt hu ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).support := by
    simp [succAt, support, List.mem_toFinset, Walk.getVert_mem_support]
  simpa [support_rotateTo] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.succAt_ne
statement:
lemma succAt_ne (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    c.succAt hu ≠ u
proof:
:=
  (c.adj_succAt hu).ne.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.rotateTo_eq_cons
statement:
lemma rotateTo_eq_cons (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ (w : V) (rest : G.Walk w (c.rotateTo hu).start)
      (h : G.Adj (c.rotateTo hu).start w),
      w = c.succAt hu ∧ (c.rotateTo hu).walk = Walk.cons h rest ∧ rest.IsPath
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.Nil := (c.rotateTo hu).isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, rest, hcons⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff).1 hnil
  refine ⟨w, rest, hadj, ?_, hcons, ?_⟩
  · change w = (c.rotateTo hu).walk.getVert 1
    rw [hcons]
    simp [Walk.getVert_cons_succ, Walk.getVert_zero]
  · exact ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff rest hadj).1
      (by simpa [hcons] using (c.rotateTo hu).isCycle)).1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff
statement:
lemma mem_edges_iff {c : GraphCycle G} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ c.edges ↔ e ∈ c.walk.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [edges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.edges_reverse
statement: lemma edges_reverse (c : GraphCycle G) : c.reverse.edges = c.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [edges, reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.edges_rotateTo_eq
statement:
lemma edges_rotateTo_eq (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).edges = c.edges
proof:
:=
  c.edges_rotateTo hu

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff
statement:
lemma mem_incidentEdges_iff {c : GraphCycle G} {v : V} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ c.incidentEdges v ↔ e ∈ c.edges ∧ v ∈ e
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidentEdges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.incidentEdges_rotateTo
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_rotateTo (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support)
    (v : V) : (c.rotateTo hu).incidentEdges v = c.incidentEdges v
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidentEdges, c.edges_rotateTo_eq hu]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.incidentEdges_reverse
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_reverse (c : GraphCycle G) (v : V) :
    c.reverse.incidentEdges v = c.incidentEdges v
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidentEdges, c.edges_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.rotateTo_not_nil
statement:
lemma rotateTo_not_nil (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    ¬ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.Nil
proof:
:=
  (c.rotateTo hu).isCycle.not_nil

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.succAt_eq_snd
statement:
lemma succAt_eq_snd (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    c.succAt hu = (c.rotateTo hu).walk.snd
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.openAt_start
statement:
lemma openAt_start (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).start = c.succAt hu
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.openAt_finish
statement:
lemma openAt_finish (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).finish = u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.openAt_start_ne_finish
statement:
lemma openAt_start_ne_finish (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).start ≠ (c.openAt hu).finish
proof:
:=
  c.succAt_ne hu

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.rotateTo_cons_eq
statement:
lemma rotateTo_cons_eq (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).walk =
      Walk.cons ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.adj_snd (c.rotateTo_not_nil hu))
        (c.openAt hu).walk
proof:
:=
  ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.cons_tail_eq (c.rotateTo_not_nil hu)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.openAt_length
statement:
lemma openAt_length (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).walk.length = (c.rotateTo hu).walk.length - 1
proof:
:=
  Walk.length_tail (c.rotateTo hu).walk

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.two_le_openAt_length
statement:
lemma two_le_openAt_length (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    2 ≤ (c.openAt hu).walk.length
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : 3 ≤ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.length := (c.rotateTo hu).three_le_length
  have := c.openAt_length hu
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.openAt_not_nil
statement:
lemma openAt_not_nil (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    ¬ (c.openAt hu).walk.Nil
proof:
:=
  Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.2
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) (c.two_le_openAt_length hu))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.three_le_openAt_card
statement:
lemma three_le_openAt_card (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    3 ≤ (c.openAt hu).support.card
proof:
:= by
  have : 2 ≤ (c.openAt hu).walk.length := c.two_le_openAt_length hu
  simpa [GraphPath.card_support] using Nat.add_le_add_right this 1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.first_cycle_edge_mem
statement:
lemma first_cycle_edge_mem (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    s(u, c.succAt hu) ∈ c.edges
proof:
:= by
  have hnil := c.rotateTo_not_nil hu
  have hrot : s(u, c.succAt hu) ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).edges := by
    simpa [edges, start_rotateTo, succAt_eq_snd] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2 ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.mk_start_snd_mem_edges hnil)
  simpa [c.edges_rotateTo_eq hu] using hrot

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.first_not_mem_openAt
statement:
lemma first_not_mem_openAt (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    s(u, c.succAt hu) ∉ (c.openAt hu).edges
proof:
:= by
  have hnil := c.rotateTo_not_nil hu
  have hcons := (c.rotateTo hu).walk.cons_tail_eq hnil
  have hcycle : (Walk.cons ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.adj_snd hnil)
      ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail)).IsCycle := by
    convert (c.rotateTo hu).isCycle
  have hnin := (Walk.cons_isCycle_iff ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail)
      ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.adj_snd hnil)).1 hcycle |>.2
  simp [GraphPath.edges, openAt, start_rotateTo, succAt_eq_snd, List.mem_toFinset]
  exact hnin

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.edges_eq_insert_openAt
statement:
lemma edges_eq_insert_openAt (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    c.edges = insert s(u, c.succAt hu) (c.openAt hu).edges
proof:
:= by
  have hnil := c.rotateTo_not_nil hu
  have hcons := (c.rotateTo hu).walk.cons_tail_eq hnil
  have hedges : (c.rotateTo hu).walk.edges =
      s((c.rotateTo hu).start, (c.rotateTo hu).walk.snd) ::
        (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail.edges :=
    (congrArg Walk.edges hcons.symm).trans
      (Walk.edges_cons ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.adj_snd hnil)
        ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail))
  have hrot : (c.rotateTo hu).edges =
      insert s((c.rotateTo hu).start, (c.rotateTo hu).walk.snd)
        (c.openAt hu).edges := by
    simp only [edges, GraphPath.edges, openAt]
    rw [hedges, List.toFinset_cons]
    rfl
  have heq : s((c.rotateTo hu).start, (c.rotateTo hu).walk.snd) =
      s(u, c.succAt hu) := by
    simp [start_rotateTo, succAt_eq_snd]
  rw [heq] at hrot
  simpa [c.edges_rotateTo_eq hu] using hrot

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil
statement:
lemma penultimate_cons_of_not_nil {u v w : V} (h : G.Adj u v) (q : G.Walk v w)
    (hq : ¬ q.Nil) : (Walk.cons h q).penultimate = q.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < q.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hq
  simp only [Walk.penultimate, Walk.length_cons]
  have : q.length + 1 - 1 = q.length := by omega
  rw [this]
  have hsucc : q.length = q.length - 1 + 1 := by omega
  rw [hsucc, Walk.getVert_cons_succ]
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.penultimate_rotateTo
statement:
lemma penultimate_rotateTo (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).walk.penultimate = (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  have hnil := c.rotateTo_not_nil hu
  have h := penultimate_cons_of_not_nil
    ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.adj_snd hnil) (c.openAt hu).walk (c.openAt_not_nil hu)
  exact (congrArg Walk.penultimate (c.rotateTo_cons_eq hu)).trans h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.pred_edge_mem
statement:
lemma pred_edge_mem (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    s((c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate, u) ∈ c.edges
proof:
:= by
  have hlast := GraphPath.last_edge_mem (c.openAt hu) (c.openAt_not_nil hu)
  have : s((c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate, u) ∈ (c.openAt hu).edges := by
    simpa [openAt_finish] using hlast
  rw [c.edges_eq_insert_openAt hu]
  exact mem_insert_of_mem this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.succ_ne_pred
statement:
lemma succ_ne_pred (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    c.succAt hu ≠ (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  have h := (c.rotateTo hu).isCycle.snd_ne_penultimate
  simpa [succAt_eq_snd, c.penultimate_rotateTo hu] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.first_ne_pred_edge
statement:
lemma first_ne_pred_edge (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    s(u, c.succAt hu) ≠ s((c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate, u)
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq) with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
  · exact (c.succAt_ne hu) h2
  · exact (c.succ_ne_pred hu) h2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.incidentEdges_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hopen :=
    GraphPath.incidentEdges_finish (c.openAt hv) (c.openAt_not_nil hv)
  have hfin : (c.openAt hv).finish = v := c.openAt_finish hv
  have hopen' : (c.openAt hv).incidentEdges v =
      {s((c.openAt hv).walk.penultimate, v)} := by
    simpa [hfin] using hopen
  ext e
  simp only [mem_incidentEdges_iff, c.edges_eq_insert_openAt hv, mem_insert,
    mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hve⟩
    rcases hmem with rfl | hrest
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · have : e ∈ (c.openAt hv).incidentEdges v :=
        GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨hrest, hve⟩
      have : e = s((c.openAt hv).walk.penultimate, v) :=
        mem_singleton.1 (by simpa [hopen'] using this)
      exact Or.inr this
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, by simp⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, by simp⟩
      simpa [hfin] using GraphPath.last_edge_mem (c.openAt hv) (c.openAt_not_nil hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.incidentEdges_card
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_card (c : GraphCycle G) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ c.support) :
    (c.incidentEdges v).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.incidentEdges_eq hv]
  exact card_pair (c.first_ne_pred_edge hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.incidentEdges_subset_edges
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_subset_edges (c : GraphCycle G) (v : V) :
    c.incidentEdges v ⊆ c.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact (c.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he).1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt.reverse_cycle
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt.reverse_cycle {p : GraphPath G} {c : GraphCycle G}
    {A : Finset V} : p.ProtectedAt c.reverse A ↔ p.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  simp [ProtectedAt, GraphCycle.reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt.incidentEdges_subset_cycle
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have heA : e ∈ p.AIncident A := p.incidentEdges_subset_AIncident hv he
  exact GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨h heA, (mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he).2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected
proof:
:= by
  have hvU : v ∈ p.support := hA hvA
  have hvC : v ∈ c.support := by simpa [hsup] using hvU
  have h2p : (p.incidentEdges v).card = 2 :=
    p.incidentEdges_card_internal hvU hs hf
  have h2c : (c.incidentEdges v).card = 2 := c.incidentEdges_card hvC
  have hsub : p.incidentEdges v ⊆ c.incidentEdges v :=
    hP.incidentEdges_subset_cycle hvA
  exact eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_card_endpoint_protected
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 3 ≤ p.support.card := by simpa [hsup] using c.three_le_card_support
  have h2 : 2 ≤ p.support.card := le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3
  have hcard : (p.incidentEdges v).card = 1 := by
    rcases hE with rfl | rfl
    · exact p.incidentEdges_card_start h2
    · exact p.incidentEdges_card_finish h2
  refine ⟨hcard, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  exact hP (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨(mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he).1,
    ⟨v, hvA, (mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he).2⟩⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.protected_exact_of_rotate
statement:
theorem protected_exact_of_rotate {p : GraphPath G} {a x : V}
    (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {A : Finset V}
    (hsup : p.support = c.support) (hA : A ⊆ p.support)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A ∧
      (F.rotate hyx).start = a ∧
        (F.rotate hyx).start ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish ∧
          (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges a = p.incidentEdges a \ {s(a, x)} ∧
            (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ a →
              (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b) ∧
              (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ a → b ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish →
                (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges b = c.incidentEdges b) ∧
                ((F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges a).card = 1 ∧
                  (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges a ⊆ c.edges
proof:
:= by
  set q := F.rotate hyx
  have hqProt : q.ProtectedAt c A :=
    F.protectedAt_rotate hyx haA hyA hxA hP
  have hqst : q.start = a := F.rotate_start hyx
  have hqfin : q.finish = p.finish := F.rotate_finish hyx
  have hne : q.start ≠ q.finish := F.rotate_start_ne_finish hyx
  have hat : q.incidentEdges a = p.incidentEdges a \ {s(a, x)} :=
    F.incidentEdges_rotate_at_a hyx haA hyA hxA
  have hother : ∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ a → q.incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b :=
    fun b hbA hba => F.incidentEdges_rotate_of_mem_A hyx hbA haA hyA hxA hba
  have hsupq : q.support = c.support :=
    (F.rotate_support hyx).trans hsup
  have hAq : A ⊆ q.support := by
    rw [show q.support = p.support from F.rotate_support hyx]
    exact hA
  have haEnd : (q.incidentEdges a).card = 1 ∧ q.incidentEdges a ⊆ c.edges :=
    incidentEdges_card_endpoint_protected q c hsupq hAq hqProt haA (Or.inl hqst)
  refine ⟨hqProt, hqst, hne, hat, hother, ?_, haEnd.1, haEnd.2⟩
  intro b hbA hba hbf
  have hbeq : q.incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b := hother b hbA hba
  have hs : b ≠ p.start := fun h => hyA (h ▸ hbA)
  have hf : b ≠ p.finish := by
    intro h
    apply hbf
    simpa [hqfin] using h
  have : p.incidentEdges b = c.incidentEdges b :=
    incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected p c hsup hA hP hbA hs hf
  exact hbeq.trans this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.two_le_card_support_of_ne_ends
statement:
lemma two_le_card_support_of_ne_ends {p : GraphPath G}
    (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) : 2 ≤ p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ p.walk.Nil := fun h => hne (p.isPath.nil_iff_eq.1 h)
  have hpos : 0 < p.walk.length := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    exact hnil (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.1 h0)
  have hcard := p.card_support
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.three_le_card_insert_of_ne_ends
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := two_le_card_support_of_ne_ends hne
  have hcard : (insert x p.support).card = p.support.card + 1 :=
    card_insert_of_notMem hx
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_insertVertexCycle
statement:
lemma support_insertVertexCycle (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hs : G.Adj x p.start) (hf : G.Adj p.finish x)
    (hx : x ∉ p.support) (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    (p.insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne).support = insert x p.support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [insertVertexCycle, support_consAdj] using
    support_toCycle (p.consAdj hs hx) hf
      (by simpa [support_consAdj] using three_le_card_insert_of_ne_ends hx hne)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.three_le_card_support_insertVertexCycle
statement:
lemma three_le_card_support_insertVertexCycle (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hs : G.Adj x p.start) (hf : G.Adj p.finish x)
    (hx : x ∉ p.support) (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    3 ≤ (p.insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne).support.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_insertVertexCycle]
  exact three_le_card_insert_of_ne_ends hx hne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.card_support_insertVertexCycle
statement:
lemma card_support_insertVertexCycle (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hs : G.Adj x p.start) (hf : G.Adj p.finish x)
    (hx : x ∉ p.support) (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    (p.insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne).support.card = p.support.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_insertVertexCycle, card_insert_of_notMem hx]

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_graphCycle_insert
statement:
theorem exists_graphCycle_insert (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hs : G.Adj x p.start) (hf : G.Adj p.finish x)
    (hx : x ∉ p.support) (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G,
      c.support = insert x p.support ∧
        3 ≤ c.support.card ∧
        c.support.card = p.support.card + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨p.insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne,
    p.support_insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne,
    p.three_le_card_support_insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne,
    p.card_support_insertVertexCycle hs hf hx hne⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_spanning_graphCycle_insert
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_graphCycle_insert (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hp : p.support = univ.erase x)
    (hs : G.Adj x p.start) (hf : G.Adj p.finish x)
    (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∉ p.support := by simp [hp]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, _h3, _hcard⟩ := exists_graphCycle_insert p hs hf hx hne
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  simpa [hp, insert_erase (mem_univ x)] using hc

name: Nikoghosyan.factorPort_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma factorPort_eq_of_mem (F : CycleFactor G) {i : Fin F.card} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support) :
    factorPort F x =
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support x
proof:
:= by
  have hi : F.partition.index x = i := F.partition.index_eq hx
  unfold factorPort
  rw [hi]

name: Nikoghosyan.factorPort_eq_of_mem_block
statement:
lemma factorPort_eq_of_mem_block (F : CycleFactor G) {i : Fin F.card} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ F.partition.blocks i) :
    factorPort F x =
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support x
proof:
:=
  factorPort_eq_of_mem F (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_oriented_spanning_of_compatible
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, p, hp, hends⟩ := h
  rcases hends with hxy | hyx
  · exact ⟨p, hxy.1, hxy.2, hp⟩
  · refine ⟨p.reverse, ?_, ?_, by simp [hp]⟩
    · simp [GraphPath.reverse, hyx.2]
    · simp [GraphPath.reverse, hyx.1]

name: Nikoghosyan.factor_block_balanced
statement:
lemma factor_block_balanced (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (i : Fin F.card) :
    Cograph.IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:=
  (Cograph.hamiltonian_cograph_port_canonical (hcog i) (F.getCycle i) rfl).2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_spanning_of_factor_ports
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_of_factor_ports (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {i : Fin F.card} {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support) (hy : y ∈ (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hp : factorPort F x ≠ factorPort F y) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.start = x ∧ p.finish = y ∧ p.support = (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:= by
  have hxQ := factorPort_eq_of_mem F hx
  have hyQ := factorPort_eq_of_mem F hy
  have hne :
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support x ≠
        Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support y := by
    simpa [hxQ, hyQ] using hp
  have hR :
      SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support x y :=
    Cograph.spanningPath_of_distinct_classes
      (factor_block_balanced F hcog i) hx hy hne
  exact exists_oriented_spanning_of_compatible hR

name: Nikoghosyan.globalPortData_port_eq
statement:
lemma globalPortData_port_eq (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    (globalPortData_of_cograph_factor F hcog).port = factorPort F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.factor_block_partCut
statement:
lemma factor_block_partCut (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {i : Fin F.card} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support) :
    componentCount G
        ((F.getCycle i).support \ factorPort F x) =
      (factorPort F x).card
proof:
:= by
  have hbal := factor_block_balanced F hcog i
  have hcut := Cograph.partCut_of_balanced (G := G) hbal hx
  simpa [factorPort_eq_of_mem F hx] using hcut

name: Nikoghosyan.factorPort_mem_self
statement:
lemma factorPort_mem_self (F : CycleFactor G) {x : V} :
    x ∈ factorPort F x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ (F.getCycle (F.partition.index x)).support := by
    simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using F.partition.mem_index x
  simpa [factorPort] using
    Cograph.mem_rNonadjClass_self (G := G) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.factorPort_subset_block
proof:
:= by
  simpa [factorPort_eq_of_mem F hx] using
    Cograph.rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support x

name: Nikoghosyan.openAlong_start
statement:
lemma openAlong_start (c : GraphCycle G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ c.support) (hv : v ∈ c.support)
    (hedge : c.succAt hu = v ∨ c.succAt hv = u) :
    (openAlong c hu hv hedge).start = u
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c.succAt hu = v
  · simp [openAlong, h, GraphPath.reverse]
    exact GraphCycle.openAt_finish c hu
  · have : c.succAt hv = u := hedge.resolve_left h
    simp [openAlong, h]
    exact (GraphCycle.openAt_start c hv).trans this

name: Nikoghosyan.openAlong_finish
statement:
lemma openAlong_finish (c : GraphCycle G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ c.support) (hv : v ∈ c.support)
    (hedge : c.succAt hu = v ∨ c.succAt hv = u) :
    (openAlong c hu hv hedge).finish = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c.succAt hu = v
  · simp [openAlong, h, GraphPath.reverse]
    exact (GraphCycle.openAt_start c hu).trans h
  · simp [openAlong, h]
    exact GraphCycle.openAt_finish c hv

name: Nikoghosyan.openAlong_support
statement:
lemma openAlong_support (c : GraphCycle G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ c.support) (hv : v ∈ c.support)
    (hedge : c.succAt hu = v ∨ c.succAt hv = u) :
    (openAlong c hu hv hedge).support = c.support
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c.succAt hu = v
  · simpa [openAlong, h, GraphPath.support_reverse] using c.openAt_support hu
  · simpa [openAlong, h] using c.openAt_support hv

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_of_four_block_path
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_four_block_path
    (cH cD cX cZ : GraphCycle G)
    (_hHD : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support cX.support)
    (hHZ : Disjoint cH.support cZ.support)
    (hDX : Disjoint cD.support cX.support)
    (hDZ : Disjoint cD.support cZ.support)
    (hXZ : Disjoint cX.support cZ.support)
    {x x' z z' : V}
    (hx : x ∈ cX.support) (hx' : x' ∈ cX.support)
    (hz : z ∈ cZ.support) (hz' : z' ∈ cZ.support)
    (hedgeX : cX.succAt hx = x' ∨ cX.succAt hx' = x)
    (hedgeZ : cZ.succAt hz = z' ∨ cZ.succAt hz' = z)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z)
    (P : GraphPath G)
    (hp : P.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    (_hsH : P.start ∈ cH.support) (_hfH : P.finish ∈ cH.support)
    (hs : G.Adj x' P.start) (hf : G.Adj P.finish z') :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support =
        cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ cX.support ∪ cZ.support
proof:
:= by
  let Qx := openAlong cX hx hx' hedgeX
  let Qz := openAlong cZ hz' hz (Or.symm hedgeZ)
  have hQxst : Qx.start = x := openAlong_start cX hx hx' hedgeX
  have hQxfn : Qx.finish = x' := openAlong_finish cX hx hx' hedgeX
  have hQxsup : Qx.support = cX.support :=
    openAlong_support cX hx hx' hedgeX
  have hQzst : Qz.start = z' := openAlong_start cZ hz' hz (Or.symm hedgeZ)
  have hQzfn : Qz.finish = z := openAlong_finish cZ hz' hz (Or.symm hedgeZ)
  have hQzsup : Qz.support = cZ.support :=
    openAlong_support cZ hz' hz (Or.symm hedgeZ)
  have hadj1 : G.Adj Qx.finish P.start := by
    rw [hQxfn]
    exact hs
  have hadj2 : G.Adj P.finish Qz.start := by
    rw [hQzst]
    exact hf
  have hd1 : Disjoint Qx.support P.support := by
    rw [hQxsup, hp]
    exact disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨hHX.symm, hDX.symm⟩
  have hd2 : Disjoint (Qx.support ∪ P.support) Qz.support := by
    rw [hQxsup, hp, hQzsup]
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro a ha haZ
    rcases mem_union.1 ha with haX | haP
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hXZ haX haZ
    · rcases mem_union.1 haP with haH | haD
      · exact disjoint_left.1 hHZ haH haZ
      · exact disjoint_left.1 hDZ haD haZ
  obtain ⟨R, hRsup, hRst, hRfn⟩ :=
    exists_splice_three Qx P Qz hadj1 hadj2 hd1 hd2
  have hRstart : R.start = x := hRst.trans hQxst
  have hRfinish : R.finish = z := hRfn.trans hQzfn
  have hadjClose : G.Adj R.finish R.start := by
    rw [hRfinish, hRstart]
    exact hxz.symm
  have h3 : 3 ≤ R.support.card := by
    have hxcard := cX.three_le_card_support
    have : cX.support ⊆ R.support := by
      intro a ha
      rw [hRsup, hQxsup]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)))
    exact le_trans hxcard (card_le_card this)
  refine ⟨R.toCycle hadjClose h3, ?_⟩
  rw [GraphPath.support_toCycle, hRsup, hQxsup, hp, hQzsup]
  ac_rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_edges_iff
statement:
lemma mem_edges_iff {p : GraphPath G} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ p.edges ↔ e ∈ p.walk.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [edges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_subset_edgeSet
statement: lemma edges_subset_edgeSet (p : GraphPath G) : ∀ e ∈ p.edges, e ∈ G.edgeSet
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact p.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (mem_edges_iff.1 he)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff
statement:
lemma mem_incidentEdges_iff {p : GraphPath G} {b : V} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ p.incidentEdges b ↔ e ∈ p.edges ∧ b ∈ e
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidentEdges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_AIncident_iff
statement:
lemma mem_AIncident_iff {p : GraphPath G} {A : Finset V} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ p.AIncident A ↔ e ∈ p.edges ∧ ∃ b ∈ A, b ∈ e
proof:
:= by
  simp [AIncident]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.prefix_isPath
statement: lemma prefix_isPath (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) : F.preWalk.IsPath
proof:
:=
  Walk.IsPath.of_append_left (q := Walk.cons F.oldAdj F.sufWalk)
    (by simpa [F.factor] using p.isPath)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.suffix_cons_isPath
statement:
lemma suffix_cons_isPath (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    (Walk.cons F.oldAdj F.sufWalk).IsPath
proof:
:=
  Walk.IsPath.of_append_right (p := F.preWalk)
    (by simpa [F.factor] using p.isPath)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.suffix_isPath
statement: lemma suffix_isPath (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) : F.sufWalk.IsPath
proof:
:=
  ((Walk.cons_isPath_iff F.oldAdj F.sufWalk).1 F.suffix_cons_isPath).1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.a_not_mem_suffix_support
statement:
lemma a_not_mem_suffix_support (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    a ∉ F.sufWalk.support
proof:
:=
  ((Walk.cons_isPath_iff F.oldAdj F.sufWalk).1 F.suffix_cons_isPath).2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.support_append_eq
statement:
lemma support_append_eq (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    p.walk.support = F.preWalk.support ++ F.sufWalk.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [F.factor, Walk.support_append, Walk.support_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.nodup_prefix_append_suffix
statement:
lemma nodup_prefix_append_suffix (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    (F.preWalk.support ++ F.sufWalk.support).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  simpa [F.support_append_eq] using p.support_nodup

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.disjoint_prefix_suffix_list
statement:
lemma disjoint_prefix_suffix_list (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    {v : V} (hvP : v ∈ F.preWalk.support) : v ∉ F.sufWalk.support
proof:
:= by
  intro hvS
  exact (List.nodup_append.1 F.nodup_prefix_append_suffix).2.2 v hvP v hvS rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.disjoint_prefix_suffix
statement:
lemma disjoint_prefix_suffix (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    Disjoint F.preWalk.support.toFinset F.sufWalk.support.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro v hvP hvS
  exact F.disjoint_prefix_suffix_list (List.mem_toFinset.1 hvP)
    (List.mem_toFinset.1 hvS)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.x_not_mem_prefix_support
statement:
lemma x_not_mem_prefix_support (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    x ∉ F.preWalk.support
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  exact F.disjoint_prefix_suffix_list hx (Walk.start_mem_support F.sufWalk)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.start_mem_prefix
statement:
lemma start_mem_prefix (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    p.start ∈ F.preWalk.support
proof:
:=
  Walk.start_mem_support F.preWalk

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.a_mem_prefix
statement:
lemma a_mem_prefix (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :

  Walk.end_mem_support F.preWalk

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.x_mem_suffix

lemma x_mem_suffix (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.finish_mem_suffix

lemma finish_mem_suffix (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.prefix_nil_iff

lemma prefix_nil_iff (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.a_ne_start_of_prefix_not_nil

lemma a_ne_start_of_prefix_not_nil (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.a_ne_finish
statement: lemma a_ne_finish (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) : a ≠ p.finish

:= by
  intro h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.a_ne_x
statement: lemma a_ne_x (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) : a ≠ x

:=
  F.oldAdj.ne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.start_ne_x
statement: lemma start_ne_x (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) : p.start ≠ x

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.support_prefixPath
statement:
lemma support_prefixPath (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    F.prefixPath.support = F.preWalk.support.toFinset
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.support_suffixPath
statement:
lemma support_suffixPath (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    F.suffixPath.support = F.sufWalk.support.toFinset
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.disjoint_prefixPath_suffixPath
statement:
lemma disjoint_prefixPath_suffixPath (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    Disjoint F.prefixPath.support F.suffixPath.support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [support_prefixPath, support_suffixPath] using F.disjoint_prefix_suffix

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.support_eq_union
statement:
lemma support_eq_union (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    p.support = F.prefixPath.support ∪ F.suffixPath.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphPath.support, prefixPath, suffixPath, F.support_append_eq,
    List.toFinset_append]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.edges_eq
statement:
lemma edges_eq (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    p.walk.edges = F.preWalk.edges ++ s(a, x) :: F.sufWalk.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [F.factor, Walk.edges_append, Walk.edges_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.edges_nodup
statement:
lemma edges_nodup (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    (F.preWalk.edges ++ s(a, x) :: F.sufWalk.edges).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  simpa [F.edges_eq] using p.isPath.isTrail.edges_nodup

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.old_not_mem_prefix_edges
statement:
lemma old_not_mem_prefix_edges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    s(a, x) ∉ F.preWalk.edges
proof:
:= by
  have h := List.nodup_append.1 F.edges_nodup
  intro he
  exact h.2.2 _ he _ (by simp) rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.old_not_mem_suffix_edges
statement:
lemma old_not_mem_suffix_edges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    s(a, x) ∉ F.sufWalk.edges
proof:
:= by
  have h := List.nodup_append.1 F.edges_nodup
  have hcons := List.nodup_cons.1 h.2.1
  exact hcons.1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.old_mem_edges
statement:
lemma old_mem_edges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    s(a, x) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [edges, F.edges_eq]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.edges_toFinset_eq
statement:
lemma edges_toFinset_eq (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    p.edges = F.preWalk.edges.toFinset ∪ insert s(a, x) F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp [edges, F.edges_eq, List.toFinset_append, List.toFinset_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.erase_old_eq
statement:
lemma erase_old_eq (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) :
    p.edges.erase s(a, x) =
      F.preWalk.edges.toFinset ∪ F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hP : s(a, x) ∉ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := by
    simpa using F.old_not_mem_prefix_edges
  have hS : s(a, x) ∉ F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := by
    simpa using F.old_not_mem_suffix_edges
  rw [F.edges_toFinset_eq, erase_union_distrib, erase_insert hS, erase_eq_of_notMem hP]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_start
statement:
lemma rotate_start (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).start = a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_finish
statement:
lemma rotate_finish (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_support
statement:
lemma rotate_support (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [rotate, splice, GraphPath.support, GraphPath.reverse, prefixPath, suffixPath,
    Walk.support_append, Walk.support_cons, Walk.support_reverse, F.support_append_eq,
    List.toFinset_append, List.toFinset_reverse, union_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_walk_eq
statement:
lemma rotate_walk_eq (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).walk =
      F.preWalk.reverse.append (Walk.cons hyx F.sufWalk)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_edges_list
statement:
lemma rotate_edges_list (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).walk.edges =
      F.preWalk.reverse.edges ++ s(p.start, x) :: F.sufWalk.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [rotate, splice, prefixPath, suffixPath, GraphPath.reverse,
    Walk.edges_append, Walk.edges_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_edges
statement:
theorem rotate_edges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).edges = p.edges.erase s(a, x) ∪ {s(p.start, x)}
proof:
:= by
  have hrev : F.preWalk.reverse.edges.toFinset = F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := by
    simp [Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  have hrot :
      (F.rotate hyx).edges =
        F.preWalk.edges.toFinset ∪ insert s(p.start, x) F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := by
    simp [edges, F.rotate_edges_list, List.toFinset_append, List.toFinset_cons, hrev]
  rw [hrot, F.erase_old_eq, insert_eq]
  simp [union_comm, union_left_comm, union_assoc]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_edges_subset_edgeSet
statement:
lemma rotate_edges_subset_edgeSet (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    ∀ e ∈ (F.rotate hyx).edges, e ∈ G.edgeSet
proof:
:=
  edges_subset_edgeSet (F.rotate hyx)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.new_edge_mem_rotate
statement:
lemma new_edge_mem_rotate (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    s(p.start, x) ∈ (F.rotate hyx).edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [F.rotate_edges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.old_not_mem_rotate_of_ne
statement:
lemma old_not_mem_rotate_of_ne (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) (hne : s(a, x) ≠ s(p.start, x)) :
    s(a, x) ∉ (F.rotate hyx).edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [F.rotate_edges, hne, F.old_not_mem_prefix_edges, F.old_not_mem_suffix_edges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.not_mem_old_of_ne
statement:
lemma not_mem_old_of_ne {b : V} (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hba : b ≠ a) (hbx : b ≠ x) : b ∉ (s(a, x) : Sym2 V)
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hb with h | h
  · exact hba h
  · exact hbx h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.not_mem_new_of_ne
statement:
lemma not_mem_new_of_ne {b : V} (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hby : b ≠ p.start) (hbx : b ≠ x) : b ∉ (s(p.start, x) : Sym2 V)
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hb with h | h
  · exact hby h
  · exact hbx h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.incidentEdges_rotate_of_mem_A
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_rotate_of_mem_A (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) {A : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hbA : b ∈ A) (_haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    (hba : b ≠ a) :
    (F.rotate hyx).incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b
proof:
:= by
  have hby : b ≠ p.start := fun h => hyA (h ▸ hbA)
  have hbx : b ≠ x := fun h => hxA (h ▸ hbA)
  ext e
  simp only [mem_incidentEdges_iff, F.rotate_edges, mem_union, mem_erase, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hbe⟩
    rcases hmem with h | rfl
    · exact ⟨h.2, hbe⟩
    · exact (F.not_mem_new_of_ne hby hbx hbe).elim
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hbe⟩
    refine ⟨Or.inl ⟨?_, hmem⟩, hbe⟩
    intro heq
    subst heq
    exact F.not_mem_old_of_ne hba hbx hbe

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.incidentEdges_rotate_at_a
proof:
:= by
  have hay : a ≠ p.start := fun h => hyA (h ▸ haA)
  have hax : a ≠ x := F.a_ne_x
  ext e
  simp only [mem_incidentEdges_iff, F.rotate_edges, mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_erase,
    mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hae⟩
    rcases hmem with h | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨h.2, hae⟩, h.1⟩
    · exact (F.not_mem_new_of_ne hay hax hae).elim
  · rintro ⟨⟨hmem, hae⟩, hne⟩
    exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨hne, hmem⟩, hae⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.new_not_AIncident
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hbe with h | h
  · exact hyA (h ▸ hbA)
  · exact hxA (h ▸ hbA)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.AIncident_rotate
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_AIncident_iff, F.rotate_edges, mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_erase,
    mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    rcases hmem with h | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨h.2, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩, h.1⟩
    · exact (F.new_not_AIncident hyA hxA ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩).elim
  · rintro ⟨⟨hmem, hA⟩, hne⟩
    exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨hne, hmem⟩, hA⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.protectedAt_rotate
statement:
theorem protectedAt_rotate (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) {c : GraphCycle G} {A : Finset V}
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have he' : e ∈ p.AIncident A \ {s(a, x)} := by
    simpa [F.AIncident_rotate hyx haA hyA hxA] using he
  exact hP (mem_sdiff.1 he').1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_start_mem_A
statement:
lemma rotate_start_mem_A {A : Finset V} (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) (haA : a ∈ A) :
    (F.rotate hyx).start ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  simpa [F.rotate_start] using haA

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_finish_eq
statement:
lemma rotate_finish_eq (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish
proof:
:=
  F.rotate_finish hyx

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.a_internal_of_prefix_not_nil
statement:
lemma a_internal_of_prefix_not_nil (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (h : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) :
    a ≠ p.start ∧ a ≠ p.finish
proof:
:=
  ⟨F.a_ne_start_of_prefix_not_nil h, F.a_ne_finish⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_start_ne_finish
statement:
lemma rotate_start_ne_finish (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).start ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish
proof:
:= by
  simpa [F.rotate_start, F.rotate_finish] using F.a_ne_finish

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_not_nil
statement:
lemma dropUntil_not_nil (p : GraphPath G) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ p.support)
    (hne : a ≠ p.finish) : ¬ (p.dropUntil ha).walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hne ((dropUntil_nil_iff p ha).1 h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_cons_dropUntil
statement:
lemma exists_cons_dropUntil (p : GraphPath G) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ p.support)
    (hne : a ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ (h : G.Adj a (p.pathSucc ha hne)) (q : G.Walk (p.pathSucc ha hne) p.finish),
      (p.dropUntil ha).walk = Walk.cons h q
proof:
:= by
  have hnil := p.dropUntil_not_nil ha hne
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hcons⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff).1 hnil
  have hw : w = p.pathSucc ha hne := by
    simp [pathSucc, hcons, Walk.snd]
  subst hw
  exact ⟨hadj, q, hcons⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_factor_of_pathSucc
statement:
theorem exists_factor_of_pathSucc (p : GraphPath G) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ p.support)
    (hne : a ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a (p.pathSucc ha hne), True
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hadj, q, hcons⟩ := p.exists_cons_dropUntil ha hne
  have hx := mem_walk_support (p := p) (x := a)
  refine ⟨⟨p.walk.takeUntil a (hx.1 ha), q, hadj, ?_⟩, trivial⟩
  have hspec := Walk.take_spec p.walk (hx.1 ha)
  have hdrop :
      (p.dropUntil ha).walk = p.walk.dropUntil a (hx.1 ha) := rfl
  rw [← hdrop, hcons] at hspec
  exact hspec.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.getVert_injective_of_le_length
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < p.walk.support.length := by
    rw [Walk.length_support]
    omega
  have hj' : j < p.walk.support.length := by
    rw [Walk.length_support]
    omega
  have hiE := Walk.getVert_eq_support_getElem p.walk hi
  have hjE := Walk.getVert_eq_support_getElem p.walk hj
  have hinj := (Walk.isPath_iff_injective_get_support p.walk).1 p.isPath
  have : p.walk.support.get ⟨i, hi'⟩ = p.walk.support.get ⟨j, hj'⟩ := by
    rw [List.get_eq_getElem, List.get_eq_getElem, ← hiE, ← hjE, heq]
  exact congrArg Fin.val (hinj this)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.getVert_ne_finish_of_lt
statement:
lemma getVert_ne_finish_of_lt (p : GraphPath G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < p.walk.length) : p.walk.getVert i ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hfin : p.walk.getVert p.walk.length = p.finish := Walk.getVert_length p.walk
  have : i = p.walk.length :=
    p.getVert_injective_of_le_length (le_of_lt hi) le_rfl (h.trans hfin.symm)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.idxOf_getVert
statement:
lemma idxOf_getVert (p : GraphPath G) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ p.walk.length) :
    p.walk.support.idxOf (p.walk.getVert i) = i
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : i < p.walk.support.length := by
    rw [Walk.length_support]
    omega
  have hget : p.walk.support.get ⟨i, hlt⟩ = p.walk.getVert i := by
    simp [List.get_eq_getElem, Walk.getVert_eq_support_getElem p.walk hi]
  rw [← hget]
  exact List.get_idxOf p.support_nodup ⟨i, hlt⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.getVert_mem_path_support
statement:
lemma getVert_mem_path_support (p : GraphPath G) (i : ℕ) :
    p.walk.getVert i ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.getVert_mem_support p.walk i)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_factorAtIndex
statement:
theorem exists_factorAtIndex (p : GraphPath G) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < p.walk.length) :
    ∃ F : PrefixEdgeFactor p (p.walk.getVert i) (p.walk.getVert (i + 1)), True
proof:
:= by
  set a := p.walk.getVert i
  have ha : a ∈ p.support := p.getVert_mem_path_support i
  have hne : a ≠ p.finish := p.getVert_ne_finish_of_lt hi
  obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := p.exists_factor_of_pathSucc ha hne
  have hsnd : p.pathSucc ha hne = p.walk.getVert (i + 1) := by
    have hx := mem_walk_support (p := p) (x := a)
    have hspec := Walk.take_spec p.walk (hx.1 ha)
    have hlen : (p.walk.takeUntil a (hx.1 ha)).length = i := by
      rw [Walk.length_takeUntil]
      exact p.idxOf_getVert (le_of_lt hi)
    have happ := Walk.getVert_append (p.walk.takeUntil a (hx.1 ha))
      (p.walk.dropUntil a (hx.1 ha)) (i + 1)
    rw [hspec] at happ
    have hnot : ¬ i + 1 < (p.walk.takeUntil a (hx.1 ha)).length := by omega
    rw [ite_eq_right (by exact hnot)] at happ
    have hsub : i + 1 - (p.walk.takeUntil a (hx.1 ha)).length = 1 := by omega
    rw [hsub] at happ
    simpa [pathSucc, dropUntil, Walk.snd] using happ.symm
  refine ⟨?_, trivial⟩
  convert F
  exact hsnd.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_factor_of_getVert_edge
statement:
theorem exists_factor_of_getVert_edge (p : GraphPath G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < p.walk.length) :
    ∃ F : PrefixEdgeFactor p (p.walk.getVert i) (p.walk.getVert (i + 1)),
      s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := p.exists_factorAtIndex hi
  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
  simpa using F.old_mem_edges

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.reverseFactor_rotate
statement:
lemma reverseFactor_rotate {p : GraphPath G} {a x : V}
    (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (hxy : G.Adj p.finish a) :
    ((reverseFactor F).rotate (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hxy)).start = x ∧
      ((reverseFactor F).rotate (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hxy)).finish = p.start ∧
        ((reverseFactor F).rotate (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hxy)).support =
          p.support
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using
    (reverseFactor F).rotate_support (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hxy)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.rotateAfterReorient_start
proof:
:=
  F.rotate_start _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.rotateAfterReorient_finish
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotateAfterReorient]
  exact F.rotate_finish (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hyx)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.rotateAfterReorient_support
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotateAfterReorient]
  simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using
    F.rotate_support (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hyx)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.rotateAfterReorient_edges
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotateAfterReorient]
  have h := F.rotate_edges (by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hyx)
  have hedges : p.reverse.edges = p.edges := by
    simp [edges, GraphPath.reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
  rw [h, hedges]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.profileEndedSpanningPath_proved
statement: theorem profileEndedSpanningPath_proved : ProfileEndedSpanningPath G
proof:
:= by
  intro c x hx hJ hK
  have hAne := rowProfile_nonempty_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ
  have hstrict := strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ hK
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hf, _hne, _hP⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_strict_of_canonical c rfl
      (rowProfile_subset (G := G) c.support x) hAne hK hstrict
  exact ⟨p, hp, hs, hf⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_cycle_of_vertex_insertion
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_vertex_insertion
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support))
    (hK : IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = insert x c.support ∧ 3 ≤ γ.support.card
proof:
:=
  exists_inserted_cycle_of_profileEndedSpanningPath profileEndedSpanningPath_proved
    c hx hJ hK

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_cycle_of_hamiltonian_prefix
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_hamiltonian_prefix
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v))
    (hOn : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (c.support ∪ r.support)) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G, γ.support = c.support ∪ r.support
proof:
:=
  exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath profileEndedSpanningPath_proved
    c r hdisj hrow hOn

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_cycle_of_hamiltonian_prefix_of_global
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_hamiltonian_prefix_of_global
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v))
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G, γ.support = c.support ∪ r.support
proof:
:=
  exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath_of_global
    profileEndedSpanningPath_proved c r hdisj hrow hpat

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_univ_cycle_of_deleted_vertex_cycle
statement:
theorem exists_original_univ_cycle_of_deleted_vertex_cycle
    (hT : OneTough G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) (x : V) (hc : c.support = univ.erase x) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G, γ.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∉ c.support := by simp [hc]
  have hins : insert x c.support = univ := by
    rw [hc]
    exact insert_erase (mem_univ x)
  have hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support) := by
    rw [hins]
    exact OneToughOn.univ_iff.2 hT
  have hK : IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) :=
    isCograph_current_remainder c hx
      (NoInducedP4UnionP1On.of_global hpat (insert x c.support))
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, _⟩ := exists_original_cycle_of_vertex_insertion c hx hJ hK
  exact ⟨γ, hγ.trans hins⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.three_le_length
statement: lemma three_le_length (c : GraphCycle G) : 3 ≤ c.walk.length
proof:
:=
  c.isCycle.three_le_length

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.start_mem_support
statement: lemma start_mem_support (c : GraphCycle G) : c.start ∈ c.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [support, Walk.start_mem_support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.support_nonempty
statement: lemma support_nonempty (c : GraphCycle G) : c.support.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨c.start, c.start_mem_support⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.card_support
statement: lemma card_support (c : GraphCycle G) : c.support.card = c.walk.length
proof:
:= by
  have htail := c.isCycle.support_nodup
  have hstart : c.start ∈ c.walk.support.tail :=
    c.walk.end_mem_tail_support c.isCycle.not_nil
  cases hcwalk : c.walk with
  | nil =>
    exact (c.isCycle.not_nil (by simp [hcwalk])).elim
  | cons h q =>
    have hs : c.walk.support = c.start :: q.support := by
      simp [hcwalk]
    have hlen : q.support.length = c.walk.length := by
      simp [hcwalk, Walk.length_support, Walk.length_cons]
    have htail' : q.support.Nodup := by
      simpa [hcwalk] using htail
    have hstart' : c.start ∈ q.support := by
      simpa [hcwalk] using hstart
    have heq : c.walk.support.toFinset = q.support.toFinset := by
      simp [hs, insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart')]
    have hcard : q.support.toFinset.card = q.support.length :=
      List.toFinset_card_of_nodup htail'
    simp [support, heq, hcard, hlen, hcwalk]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.three_le_card_support
statement: lemma three_le_card_support (c : GraphCycle G) : 3 ≤ c.support.card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [c.card_support] using c.three_le_length

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.support_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_reverse (c : GraphCycle G) : c.reverse.support = c.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [reverse, support, Walk.support_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.exists_hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one
statement:
lemma exists_hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one (F : CycleFactor G) (hF : F.card = 1) :
    ∃ (a : V) (w : G.Walk a a), w.IsCycle ∧ w.support.toFinset = univ ∧
      3 ≤ Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  cases hcs : F.cycles with
  | nil =>
    simp [card, hcs] at hF
  | cons c rest =>
    have hrest : rest = [] := by
      simp [card, hcs] at hF
      cases rest with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons _ _ => simp at hF
    subst hrest
    have hmem : ∀ x : V, x ∈ c.support := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hx⟩ := F.mem_iff x
      have : d = c := by
        have : d ∈ [c] := by simpa [hcs] using hd
        simpa using this
      simpa [this] using hx
    have hsupp : c.support = univ := eq_univ_of_forall hmem
    refine ⟨c.start, c.walk, c.isCycle, hsupp, ?_⟩
    have := c.three_le_card_support
    simpa [hsupp] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.exists_min_of_exists
statement:
lemma exists_min_of_exists (F0 : CycleFactor G) :
    ∃ F : CycleFactor G,
      F.card ≤ F0.card ∧ ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set ℕ := {n | ∃ F : CycleFactor G, F.card = n}
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨F0.card, F0, rfl⟩
  have hmem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hF ▸ Nat.sInf_le (s := S) ⟨F0, rfl⟩
  · intro F'
    exact hF ▸ Nat.sInf_le (s := S) ⟨F', rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.ofTwo_card
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.ofTwo_card (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    (CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).card = 2
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.ofTwo_zero_lt
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.ofTwo_zero_lt (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    0 < (CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [CycleFactor.ofTwo_card]; exact Nat.zero_lt_two

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.ofTwo_one_lt
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.ofTwo_one_lt (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    1 < (CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).card
proof:
:= by

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.ofTwo_getCycle_zero
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.ofTwo_getCycle_zero (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    (CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).getCycle
      ⟨0, CycleFactor.ofTwo_zero_lt cH cD hdisj hspan⟩ = cH
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.ofTwo_getCycle_one
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.ofTwo_getCycle_one (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    (CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).getCycle
      ⟨1, CycleFactor.ofTwo_one_lt cH cD hdisj hspan⟩ = cD
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.one_le_card
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.one_le_card (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) : 1 ≤ F.card
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card V := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨c, hc, _⟩ := F.mem_iff x
  exact List.length_pos_of_mem hc

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.isHamiltonian_of_card_one
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.isHamiltonian_of_card_one (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hF : F.card = 1) : G.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, w, hw, hsupp, _⟩ := F.exists_hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one hF
  exact (⟨a, w, hw⟩ : GraphCycle G).isHamiltonian_of_support_eq_univ hsupp

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.two_cycle_is_min
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.two_cycle_is_min (F : CycleFactor G) (hF : F.card = 2)
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card
proof:
:= by
  intro F'
  have h1 : 1 ≤ F'.card := F'.one_le_card hord
  by_contra hlt
  have hF1 : F'.card = 1 := by omega
  exact hNonHam (F'.isHamiltonian_of_card_one hF1)

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.ofTwo_isCograph_getCycle
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.ofTwo_isCograph_getCycle (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ)
    (hH : IsCograph G cH.support) (hD : IsCograph G cD.support)
    (i : Fin (CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).card) :
    IsCograph G ((CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan).getCycle i).support
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.1 < 2 := by
    have := i.2
    simpa [CycleFactor.ofTwo_card] using this
  have h01 : i.1 = 0 ∨ i.1 = 1 := by omega
  rcases h01 with h0 | h1
  · have hi0 : i = ⟨0, CycleFactor.ofTwo_zero_lt cH cD hdisj hspan⟩ := Fin.ext h0
    simpa [hi0, CycleFactor.ofTwo_getCycle_zero] using hH
  · have hi1 : i = ⟨1, CycleFactor.ofTwo_one_lt cH cD hdisj hspan⟩ := Fin.ext h1
    simpa [hi1, CycleFactor.ofTwo_getCycle_one] using hD

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles_of_noncograph_host
statement:
theorem exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles_of_noncograph_host
    (hT : OneTough G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hstrict, _⟩ :=
    strict_profiles_of_spanning_two_cycles cH cD hdisj hspan hH hpat hT hNonHam
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _⟩ := exists_path_open_succ cD cD.start_mem_support
  have hdisj' : Disjoint cH.support r.support := by simpa [hr] using hdisj
  have hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G cH.support (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hvD : v ∈ cD.support := by simpa [hr] using hv
    obtain ⟨hAne, _hcog, hlt⟩ := hstrict v hvD
    refine ⟨hAne, ?_⟩
    exact (noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover_of_host
      cH r hdisj' hv hAne hpat).2 hlt
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
    exists_original_cycle_of_hamiltonian_prefix_of_global
      cH r hdisj' hrow hpat
  refine ⟨γ, hγ.trans ?_⟩
  simpa [hr] using hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles
statement:
theorem exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hHam : G.IsHamiltonian
  · exact (isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).1 hHam
  let F := CycleFactor.ofTwo cH cD hdisj hspan
  have hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card :=
    F.two_cycle_is_min (CycleFactor.ofTwo_card cH cD hdisj hspan) hord hHam
  by_cases hHcog : IsCograph G cH.support
  · by_cases hDcog : IsCograph G cD.support
    · exact all_cograph_hamiltonian hT hord hpat F hmin
        (CycleFactor.ofTwo_isCograph_getCycle cH cD hdisj hspan hHcog hDcog)
    · exact exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles_of_noncograph_host
        hT hpat cD cH hdisj.symm (by simpa [union_comm] using hspan) hDcog hHam
  · exact exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles_of_noncograph_host
      hT hpat cH cD hdisj hspan hHcog hHam

name: Nikoghosyan.two_cycles_isHamiltonian
statement:
theorem two_cycles_isHamiltonian
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hspan : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ) :
    G.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:=
  (isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).2
    (exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles hT hord hpat cH cD hdisj hspan)

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.support_union_of_card_two
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.support_union_of_card_two (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hF : F.card = 2) :
    (F.getCycle ⟨0, by simp [hF]⟩).support ∪
      (F.getCycle ⟨1, by simp [hF]⟩).support = univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro; exact mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ := F.mem_iff x
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (List.mem_iff_get).1 hc
    have hlen : F.cycles.length = 2 := hF
    have hi : i.1 < 2 := by
      have := i.2
      omega
    have h01 : i.1 = 0 ∨ i.1 = 1 := by omega
    have hx' : x ∈ (F.cycles.get i).support := hx
    rcases h01 with h0 | h1
    · have : F.getCycle ⟨0, by simp [hF]⟩ = F.cycles.get i := by
        simp [getCycle, h0]
      simpa [this] using Or.inl hx'
    · have : F.getCycle ⟨1, by simp [hF]⟩ = F.cycles.get i := by
        simp [getCycle, h1]
      simpa [this] using Or.inr hx'

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.disjoint_zero_one_of_card_two
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.disjoint_zero_one_of_card_two (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hF : F.card = 2) :
    Disjoint (F.getCycle ⟨0, by simp [hF]⟩).support
      (F.getCycle ⟨1, by simp [hF]⟩).support
proof:
:=
  F.disjoint_getCycle (by
    intro h
    have : (0 : ℕ) = 1 := congrArg Fin.val h
    cases this)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycle_factor
statement:
theorem exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycle_factor
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G) (hF : F.card = 2) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:=
  exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles hT hord hpat
    (F.getCycle ⟨0, by simp [hF]⟩) (F.getCycle ⟨1, by simp [hF]⟩)
    (F.disjoint_zero_one_of_card_two hF)
    (F.support_union_of_card_two hF)

name: Nikoghosyan.two_cycle_factor_isHamiltonian
statement:
theorem two_cycle_factor_isHamiltonian
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G) (hF : F.card = 2) :
    G.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:=
  (isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).2
    (exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycle_factor hT hord hpat F hF)

name: Nikoghosyan.induce_adj
statement:
lemma induce_adj {J : Finset V} {a b : VertexSet J} :
    (G.induce (J : Set V)).Adj a b ↔ G.Adj a.val b.val
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.subtype_carrier_hadj
statement:
lemma subtype_carrier_hadj (J : Finset V) :
    ∀ u v : VertexSet J,
      G.Adj ((Embedding.subtype (J : Set V)) u)
          ((Embedding.subtype (J : Set V)) v) ↔
        (G.induce (J : Set V)).Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  intro u v
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.support_subset_range_subtype
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨⟨x, h (by exact hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange_mem_support_iff
statement:
lemma GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange_mem_support_iff
    {V' W' : Type u} [Fintype V'] [DecidableEq V'] [Fintype W'] [DecidableEq W']
    {G' : SimpleGraph V'} {H : SimpleGraph W'} (f : V' ↪ W')
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V', H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G'.Adj u v)
    (c : GraphCycle H)
    (hsup : (c.support : Set W') ⊆ Set.range (f : V' → W')) {y : V'} :
    y ∈ (GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange (G := G') (H := H) f hadj c hsup).support ↔
      f y ∈ c.support
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V' := nonempty_of_mem_range f (hsup c.start_mem_support)
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have : y ∈ (c.walk.support.map (invFun (⇑f))).toFinset := by
      simpa [GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange, GraphCycle.support,
        walkOfCarrierRange_support] using hy
    rcases List.mem_map.1 (List.mem_toFinset.1 this) with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ Set.range (f : V' → W') :=
      cycle_support_subset_range_of_finset (f := f) hsup x hx
    have : f (invFun (⇑f) x) = x := invFun_eq hx'
    simpa [GraphCycle.support, this] using List.mem_toFinset.2 hx
  · intro hy
    have hyw : f y ∈ c.walk.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 hy
    have : invFun (⇑f) (f y) = y := leftInverse_invFun_carrier f y
    simpa [GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange, GraphCycle.support,
      walkOfCarrierRange_support] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2 ⟨f y, hyw, this⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.inducedP4_induce_iff
statement:
lemma inducedP4_induce_iff {J : Finset V} {a b c d : VertexSet J} :
    InducedP4 (G.induce (J : Set V)) a b c d ↔
      InducedP4 G a.val b.val c.val d.val
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨nab, nac, nad, nbc, nbd, ncd, eab, ebc, ecd, nac', nad', nbd'⟩
    exact ⟨mt Subtype.ext nab, mt Subtype.ext nac, mt Subtype.ext nad,
      mt Subtype.ext nbc, mt Subtype.ext nbd, mt Subtype.ext ncd,
      eab, ebc, ecd, nac', nad', nbd'⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨nab, nac, nad, nbc, nbd, ncd, eab, ebc, ecd, nac', nad', nbd'⟩
    exact ⟨mt (congrArg Subtype.val) nab, mt (congrArg Subtype.val) nac,
      mt (congrArg Subtype.val) nad, mt (congrArg Subtype.val) nbc,
      mt (congrArg Subtype.val) nbd, mt (congrArg Subtype.val) ncd,
      eab, ebc, ecd, nac', nad', nbd'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.NoInducedP4UnionP1_induce_of
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d x hp hxa hxb hxc hxd
  have hpG : InducedP4 G a.val b.val c.val d.val :=
    (inducedP4_induce_iff (G := G) (J := J)).1 hp
  have hxa' : x.val ≠ a.val := mt Subtype.ext hxa
  have hxb' : x.val ≠ b.val := mt Subtype.ext hxb
  have hxc' : x.val ≠ c.val := mt Subtype.ext hxc
  have hxd' : x.val ≠ d.val := mt Subtype.ext hxd
  have := h a.property b.property c.property d.property x.property
    hpG hxa' hxb' hxc' hxd'
  simpa [induce_adj] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.three_le_card_vertexSet_of_cycle
statement:
lemma three_le_card_vertexSet_of_cycle {J : Finset V} (c : GraphCycle G)
    (h : c.support ⊆ J) : 3 ≤ Fintype.card (VertexSet J)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : 3 ≤ J.card := c.three_le_card_support.trans (card_le_card h)
  simpa [Fintype.card_coe] using hJ

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_cycle_of_two_cycles_on
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_two_cycles_on
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hOn : OneToughOn G (cH.support ∪ cD.support))
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support
proof:
:= by
  set J := cH.support ∪ cD.support
  let G' := G.induce (J : Set V)
  let f : VertexSet J ↪ V := Embedding.subtype (J : Set V)
  have hadj := subtype_carrier_hadj (G := G) J
  have hsupH : (cH.support : Set V) ⊆ Set.range (f : VertexSet J → V) :=
    support_subset_range_subtype (J := J) subset_union_left
  have hsupD : (cD.support : Set V) ⊆ Set.range (f : VertexSet J → V) :=
    support_subset_range_subtype (J := J) subset_union_right
  let cH' : GraphCycle G' :=
    GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange (G := G') (H := G) f hadj cH hsupH
  let cD' : GraphCycle G' :=
    GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange (G := G') (H := G) f hadj cD hsupD
  have hdisj' : Disjoint cH'.support cD'.support := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro y hyH hyD
    have hyH' : f y ∈ cH.support :=
      (GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange_mem_support_iff (G' := G') (H := G) f hadj cH hsupH).1 hyH
    have hyD' : f y ∈ cD.support :=
      (GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange_mem_support_iff (G' := G') (H := G) f hadj cD hsupD).1 hyD
    exact disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyH' hyD'
  have hspan' : cH'.support ∪ cD'.support = (univ : Finset (VertexSet J)) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro; exact mem_univ y
    · intro _
      have hyJ : y.val ∈ J := y.property
      rcases mem_union.1 hyJ with hH | hD
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
        exact (GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange_mem_support_iff
          (G' := G') (H := G) f hadj cH hsupH).2 hH
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)
        exact (GraphCycle.ofCarrierRange_mem_support_iff
          (G' := G') (H := G) f hadj cD hsupD).2 hD
  have hT' : OneTough G' := (OneToughOn_iff_OneTough_induce J).1 hOn
  have hpat' : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G' :=
    NoInducedP4UnionP1_induce_of (NoInducedP4UnionP1On.of_global hpat J)
  have hord' : 3 ≤ Fintype.card (VertexSet J) :=
    three_le_card_vertexSet_of_cycle cH subset_union_left
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'⟩ :=
    exists_univ_cycle_of_two_cycles (G := G') hT' hord' hpat' cH' cD' hdisj' hspan'
  let γ : GraphCycle G := γ'.mapCarrier (H := G) f hadj
  refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
  have himg : γ.support = γ'.support.image f :=
    GraphCycle.mapCarrier_support (G := G') (H := G) f hadj γ'
  have huniv : (univ : Finset (VertexSet J)).image f = J := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
      exact y.property
    · intro hx
      exact mem_image.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  simpa [himg, hγ', huniv]

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_cycle_of_two_noncograph_cycles
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_two_noncograph_cycles
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hD : ¬ IsCograph G cD.support) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support
proof:
:=
  exists_original_cycle_of_two_cycles_on cH cD hdisj
    (oneToughOn_of_two_noncograph_cycles cH cD hdisj hpat hH hD) hpat

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support
statement:
lemma AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support (q : GraphPath G) {A : Finset V}
    (hd : Disjoint q.support A) : q.AIncident A = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨heE, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
    exact (disjoint_left.1 hd (mem_support_of_mem_edge heE hbe) hbA).elim
  · intro he
    exact (notMem_empty e he).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_of_splice_block

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.not_nil
statement: lemma not_nil (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v) : ¬ p.walk.Nil
proof:

  intro h

  have hu : u ∈ ({p.start} : Finset V) := by simpa [hsing] using F.u_mem_support
  have hv : v ∈ ({p.start} : Finset V) := by simpa [hsing] using F.v_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.insertBlock_start_ne_finish

lemma insertBlock_start_ne_finish (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v) (q : GraphPath G)

    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).start ≠ (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).finish
proof:
:= by

  have : p.start = p.finish := by
    simpa [F.insertBlock_start q hd hs hf, F.insertBlock_finish q hd hs hf] using heq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.insertBlock_support
statement:
theorem insertBlock_support (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).support = p.support ∪ q.support
proof:
:= by
  have hmid := support_splice (F.insertMid q hd hs) F.suffixPath hf
    (F.disjoint_insertMid_suffix q hd hs)
  simpa [insertBlock, F.insertMid_support q hd hs, F.support_eq_union,
    union_comm, union_assoc] using hmid

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.block_support_subset_insertBlock
statement:
lemma block_support_subset_insertBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)
    (q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v) :
    q.support ⊆ (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.insertBlock_support q hd hs hf]
  exact subset_union_right

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.insertBlock_edges_union
statement:
lemma insertBlock_edges_union (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).edges =
      (F.insertMid q hd hs).edges ∪ F.suffixPath.edges ∪ {s(q.finish, v)}
proof:
:= by
  simpa [insertBlock, suffixPath, F.insertMid_finish q hd hs] using
    edges_of_splice_block (F.insertMid q hd hs) F.suffixPath hf
      (F.disjoint_insertMid_suffix q hd hs)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.insertBlock_edges
statement:
theorem insertBlock_edges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).edges =
      p.edges.erase s(u, v) ∪ q.edges ∪ {s(u, q.start), s(q.finish, v)}
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : F.prefixPath.edges = F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := rfl
  have hsuf : F.suffixPath.edges = F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := rfl
  rw [F.insertBlock_edges_union q hd hs hf, F.insertMid_edges q hd hs, hpre, hsuf,
    F.erase_old_eq]
  ext e
  simp [edges, mem_union, mem_insert, mem_erase, or_left_comm, or_assoc, or_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.insertBlock_edges_subset_edgeSet
statement:
lemma insertBlock_edges_subset_edgeSet (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)

    ∀ e ∈ (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).edges, e ∈ G.edgeSet
proof:
:=
  edges_subset_edgeSet (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.not_mem_old_of_outside_A

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.start_seam_not_AIncident
proof:
:= by

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.finish_seam_not_AIncident

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.old_not_AIncident
statement:
lemma old_not_AIncident {A : Finset V} (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.incidentEdges_insertBlock
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_insertBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)
    (q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v) {A : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hbA : b ∈ A) (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A)
    (hAq : Disjoint q.support A) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_incidentEdges_iff, F.insertBlock_edges q hd hs hf, mem_union,
    mem_erase, mem_insert, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hbe⟩
    rcases hmem with (h | hq) | hseam
    · exact ⟨h.2, hbe⟩
    · exact (disjoint_left.1 hAq (mem_support_of_mem_edge hq hbe) hbA).elim
    · rcases hseam with rfl | rfl
      · exact (not_mem_start_seam_of_A hAq hbA huA hbe).elim
      · exact (not_mem_finish_seam_of_A hAq hbA hvA hbe).elim
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hbe⟩
    refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨?_, hmem⟩), hbe⟩
    intro heq
    subst heq
    exact not_mem_old_of_outside_A hbA huA hvA hbe

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.AIncident_insertBlock
statement:
theorem AIncident_insertBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)
    (q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v) {A : Finset V}
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAq : Disjoint q.support A) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).AIncident A = p.AIncident A
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_AIncident_iff, F.insertBlock_edges q hd hs hf, mem_union,
