    mem_erase, mem_insert, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hA⟩
    rcases hmem with (h | hq) | hseam
    · exact ⟨h.2, hA⟩
    · rcases hA with ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩
      exact (disjoint_left.1 hAq (mem_support_of_mem_edge hq hbe) hbA).elim
    · rcases hseam with rfl | rfl
      · exact (start_seam_not_AIncident hAq huA hA).elim
      · exact (finish_seam_not_AIncident hAq hvA hA).elim
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hA⟩
    refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨?_, hmem⟩), hA⟩
    intro heq
    subst heq
    exact old_not_AIncident huA hvA hA

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.protectedAt_insertBlock
statement:
theorem protectedAt_insertBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)
    (q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v)
    {c : GraphCycle G} {A : Finset V}
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAq : Disjoint q.support A)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have he' : e ∈ p.AIncident A := by
    simpa [F.AIncident_insertBlock q hd hs hf huA hvA hAq] using he
  exact hP he'

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.protected_exact_of_insertBlock
statement:
theorem protected_exact_of_insertBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p u v)
    (q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish v)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {A : Finset V}
    (hsup : (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).support = c.support)
    (hA : A ⊆ (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).support)
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAq : Disjoint q.support A)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).ProtectedAt c A ∧
      (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).start = p.start ∧
        (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).finish = p.finish ∧
          (∀ b ∈ A,
            (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b) ∧
            (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ p.start → b ≠ p.finish →
              (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b =
                c.incidentEdges b) ∧
              (p.start ∈ A →
                ((F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.start).card = 1 ∧
                  (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.start ⊆
                    c.edges) ∧
                (p.finish ∈ A →
                  ((F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.finish).card = 1 ∧
                    (F.insertBlock q hd hs hf).incidentEdges p.finish ⊆
                      c.edges)
proof:
:= by
  set r := F.insertBlock q hd hs hf
  have hrProt : r.ProtectedAt c A :=
    F.protectedAt_insertBlock q hd hs hf huA hvA hAq hP
  have hst : r.start = p.start := F.insertBlock_start q hd hs hf
  have hfin : r.finish = p.finish := F.insertBlock_finish q hd hs hf
  have hinc : ∀ b ∈ A, r.incidentEdges b = p.incidentEdges b :=
    fun b hbA => F.incidentEdges_insertBlock q hd hs hf hbA huA hvA hAq
  have hinter : ∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ p.start → b ≠ p.finish →
      r.incidentEdges b = c.incidentEdges b := by
    intro b hbA hs hf
    have hs' : b ≠ r.start := by simpa [hst] using hs
    have hf' : b ≠ r.finish := by simpa [hfin] using hf
    have : r.incidentEdges b = c.incidentEdges b :=
      incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected r c hsup hA hrProt hbA hs' hf'
    exact this
  refine ⟨hrProt, hst, hfin, hinc, hinter, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hsA
    simpa [hst] using
      incidentEdges_card_endpoint_protected r c hsup hA hrProt hsA (Or.inl hst)
  · intro hfA
    simpa [hfin] using
      incidentEdges_card_endpoint_protected r c hsup hA hrProt hfA (Or.inr hfin)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_insertBlock_of_pathSucc
statement:
theorem exists_insertBlock_of_pathSucc (p : GraphPath G) {a : V}
    (ha : a ∈ p.support) (hne : a ≠ p.finish) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj a q.start) (hf : G.Adj q.finish (p.pathSucc ha hne)) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = p.start ∧
        r.finish = p.finish ∧
          r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∧
            r.edges =
              p.edges.erase s(a, p.pathSucc ha hne) ∪ q.edges ∪
                {s(a, q.start), s(q.finish, p.pathSucc ha hne)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := p.exists_factor_of_pathSucc ha hne
  refine ⟨F.insertBlock q hd hs hf, F.insertBlock_start q hd hs hf,
    F.insertBlock_finish q hd hs hf, F.insertBlock_support q hd hs hf,
    F.insertBlock_edges q hd hs hf⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_insertBlock_of_index
statement:
theorem exists_insertBlock_of_index (p : GraphPath G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < p.walk.length) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint q.support p.support)
    (hs : G.Adj (p.walk.getVert i) q.start)
    (hf : G.Adj q.finish (p.walk.getVert (i + 1))) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = p.start ∧
        r.finish = p.finish ∧
          r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∧
            r.edges =
              p.edges.erase s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∪
                q.edges ∪
                  {s(p.walk.getVert i, q.start),
                    s(q.finish, p.walk.getVert (i + 1))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := p.exists_factorAtIndex hi
  refine ⟨F.insertBlock q hd hs hf, F.insertBlock_start q hd hs hf,
    F.insertBlock_finish q hd hs hf, F.insertBlock_support q hd hs hf,
    F.insertBlock_edges q hd hs hf⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_noncore_index
statement: lemma exists_noncore_index : ∃ j : Fin F.card, j ≠ N.core
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : 1 < Fintype.card (Fin F.card) := by
    simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : ℕ) < 3) N.hThree)
  exact Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card hlt N.core

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_own_extendedHost
statement:
lemma disjoint_own_extendedHost {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    Disjoint (ownSupport N hj) (extendedHost N hj)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨(disjoint_core_own N hj).symm,
    disjoint_ownSupport_foreignSupport N hj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.partition_host_own
statement:
lemma partition_host_own {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    extendedHost N hj ∪ ownSupport N hj = univ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [extendedHost, union_comm, union_assoc, union_left_comm] using
    (partition_core_own_foreign N hj)

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_own_cut
proof:
:=
  Disjoint.mono_right hTsub (disjoint_own_extendedHost N hj)

name: Nikoghosyan.no_adj_own_sdiff_cut
statement:
lemma no_adj_own_sdiff_cut {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) {T : Finset V}
    (_hTsub : T ⊆ extendedHost N hj)
    (hrows : ∀ z ∈ ownSupport N hj, rowAt N z ⊆ T)
    {b q : V} (hb : b ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    (hq : q ∈ extendedHost N hj \ T) :
    ¬ G.Adj b q
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  have hqQ : q ∈ extendedHost N hj := (mem_sdiff.1 hq).1
  have hqT : q ∉ T := (mem_sdiff.1 hq).2
  rcases mem_union.1 hqQ with hqH | hqR
  · have hqA : q ∈ rowAt N b :=
      (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hqH, hadj⟩
    exact hqT (hrows b hb hqA)
  · exact anticomplete_own_foreign N hj hb hqR hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.univ_sdiff_cut_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hpart := partition_host_own N hj
  have hdisj := disjoint_own_cut N hj hTsub
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hvT : v ∉ T := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2
    have hvQR : v ∈ extendedHost N hj ∪ ownSupport N hj :=
      hpart ▸ mem_univ v
    rcases mem_union.1 hvQR with hvQ | hvB
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvQ, hvT⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hvB)
  · intro hv
    rcases mem_union.1 hv with hvQ | hvB
    · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ v, (mem_sdiff.1 hvQ).2⟩
    · refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ v, ?_⟩
      intro hvT
      exact disjoint_left.1 hdisj hvB hvT

name: Nikoghosyan.oneTough_false_of_host_cut_containing_all_own_rows
statement:
lemma oneTough_false_of_host_cut_containing_all_own_rows
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hTough : OneTough G)
    {T : Finset V} (hTsub : T ⊆ extendedHost N hj)
    (hrows : ∀ z ∈ ownSupport N hj, rowAt N z ⊆ T)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {δ : ℤ}
    (hatt : (componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) = δ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hBne : (ownSupport N hj).Nonempty := ownSupport_nonempty N hj
  have hAne : (rowAt N x).Nonempty := rowAt_nonempty N hj hx
  have hAsub : rowAt N x ⊆ T := hrows x hx
  have hTpos : 1 ≤ T.card :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.2 (card_pos.2 (hAne.mono hAsub))
  have hnocross :
      ∀ a ∈ extendedHost N hj \ T, ∀ b ∈ ownSupport N hj, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact no_adj_own_sdiff_cut N hj hTsub hrows hb ha hab.symm
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint (extendedHost N hj \ T) (ownSupport N hj) :=
    Disjoint.mono_left sdiff_subset (disjoint_own_extendedHost N hj).symm
  have hadd :=
    Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisjRem hnocross
  have hGeq : componentCount G (univ \ T) =
      componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ T) +
        componentCount G (ownSupport N hj) := by
    rw [univ_sdiff_cut_eq N hj hTsub, hadd]
  have hcB : 1 ≤ componentCount G (ownSupport N hj) :=
    one_le_componentCount_of_nonempty hBne
  have hcQ_ge : (T.card : ℤ) ≤
      (componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ T) : ℤ) := by
    omega
  have hcQnat : T.card ≤ componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ T) :=
    Int.ofNat_le.mp hcQ_ge
  have hcQpos : 1 ≤ componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ T) :=
    le_trans hTpos hcQnat
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ T) := by
    rw [hGeq]
    omega
  have hle := hTough T h2
  have hgt : T.card < componentCount G (univ \ T) := by
    rw [hGeq]
    omega
  exact (not_le_of_gt hgt hle).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.all_own_rows_subset_ownCut
statement:
lemma all_own_rows_subset_ownCut
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    ∀ z ∈ ownSupport N hj, rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  by_cases hadj : G.Adj x z
  · have hEq := cuts_eq_of_own_adj N hj hpat hmin hx hz hadj
    have hsub : rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj z := rowAt_subset_ownCut N hj z
    simpa [hEq.2] using hsub
  · exact nonadjacent_rows_subset_ownCut N hj hpat hmin hx hz hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.remaining_min_factor_not_hamiltonian
statement:
theorem remaining_min_factor_not_hamiltonian
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N⟩ := exists_canonical_normal_form hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_noncore_index (N := N)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ownSupport_nonempty N hj
  refine oneTough_false_of_host_cut_containing_all_own_rows (N := N) hj hT
    (ownCut_subset_host N hj x)
    (all_own_rows_subset_ownCut N hj hpat hmin hx) hx
    (ownCut_attains N hj hpat hx)
    (cutDelta_nonneg N hj hpat hmin hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_eq_one_of_OneToughOn
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (J : Set V) := ⟨⟨hJ.choose, hJ.choose_spec⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty (G.induce (J : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  have hpos : 0 < componentCount G J := Nat.card_pos
  have hle : componentCount G J ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hlt
    have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G J := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hlt)
    have hbound := h ∅ (empty_subset J) (by simpa using h2)
    have : componentCount G J ≤ 0 := by simpa using hbound
    omega
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_insert_of_no_cross
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint U {x} := disjoint_singleton_right.2 hx
  have hnc : ∀ a ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ ({x} : Finset V), ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have hb' : b = x := mem_singleton.mp hb
    subst hb'
    exact hnocross a ha hadj.symm
  have hunion : insert x U = U ∪ {x} := by
    rw [insert_eq, union_comm]
  rw [hunion, Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisj hnc,
    componentCount_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.insert_sdiff_eq_union_singleton
proof:
:= by
  have hxS : x ∉ S := fun h => hx (hS h)
  rw [insert_sdiff_of_notMem (s := H) hxS, insert_eq, union_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.not_adj_sdiff_of_rowProfile_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy hadj
  have hyH : y ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).1
  have hyA : y ∈ rowProfile (G := G) H x :=
    (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hyH, hadj⟩
  exact (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2 (hAS hyA)

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_host_remainder_eq_add_one
statement:
lemma componentCount_host_remainder_eq_add_one {H S : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ H) (hS : S ⊆ H)
    (hnocross : ∀ y ∈ H \ S, ¬ G.Adj x y) :
    componentCount G (insert x H \ S) = componentCount G (H \ S) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrem := insert_sdiff_eq_union_singleton (H := H) (S := S) hx hS
  have hdisj : Disjoint (H \ S) {x} := by
    refine disjoint_singleton_right.2 ?_
    intro hxS
    exact hx (mem_sdiff.1 hxS).1
  have hnc : ∀ a ∈ H \ S, ∀ b ∈ ({x} : Finset V), ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have hb' : b = x := mem_singleton.mp hb
    subst hb'
    exact hnocross a ha hadj.symm
  rw [hrem, Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisj hnc,
    componentCount_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.rowProfile_nonempty_of_oneToughOn_cycle
statement:
lemma rowProfile_nonempty_of_oneToughOn_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support)) :
    (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hA
  have hAempty : rowProfile (G := G) c.support x = ∅ :=
    not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hA
  have hnocross : ∀ u ∈ c.support, ¬ G.Adj x u := by
    intro u hu hadj
    have : u ∈ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x :=
      (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hu, hadj⟩
    rw [hAempty] at this
    exact (notMem_empty u this)
  have hcount := componentCount_insert_of_no_cross hx hnocross
  have hH : componentCount G c.support = 1 := componentCount_cycle_eq_one c
  have hJne : (insert x c.support).Nonempty := ⟨x, mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  have h1 := componentCount_eq_one_of_OneToughOn hJ hJne
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.not_tight_container_of_oneToughOn_cycle
statement:
lemma not_tight_container_of_oneToughOn_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    {S : Finset V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support))
    (hS : S ⊆ c.support)
    (hAS : rowProfile (G := G) c.support x ⊆ S) :
    componentCount G (c.support \ S) ≠ S.card
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hAne := rowProfile_nonempty_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := hAne.mono hAS
  have hnocross := not_adj_sdiff_of_rowProfile_subset (G := G) hAS
  have hcount :=
    componentCount_host_remainder_eq_add_one hx hS hnocross
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (insert x c.support \ S) := by
    have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hSne)
    omega
  have hTsub : S ⊆ insert x c.support := hS.trans (subset_insert x c.support)
  have hle := hJ S hTsub h2
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.noTightContainer_of_oneToughOn_cycle
statement:
theorem noTightContainer_of_oneToughOn_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support)) :
    NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS heq hAS
  exact not_tight_container_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ hS hAS heq

name: Nikoghosyan.two_le_card_rowProfile_of_oneToughOn_cycle
statement:
lemma two_le_card_rowProfile_of_oneToughOn_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support)) :
    2 ≤ (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card
proof:
:= by
  have hAne := rowProfile_nonempty_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ
  have hpos : 1 ≤ (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hAne)
  by_contra hlt
  have h1 : (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨w, hwA⟩ := card_eq_one.1 h1
  have hAS : rowProfile (G := G) c.support x ⊆ {w} := by
    intro y hy
    simpa [hwA] using hy
  have hwAmem : w ∈ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x := by
    rw [hwA]
    exact mem_singleton_self w
  have hwH : w ∈ c.support := ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hwAmem).1
  have hS : ({w} : Finset V) ⊆ c.support := singleton_subset_iff.2 hwH
  have hwcard : ({w} : Finset V).card = 1 := card_singleton w
  have hcycle := componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le c hS (singleton_nonempty w)
  have hremne : (c.support \ {w}).Nonempty := by
    rw [sdiff_nonempty]
    intro hsub
    have : c.support.card ≤ ({w} : Finset V).card := card_le_card hsub
    have h3 := c.three_le_card_support
    omega
  haveI : Nonempty ((c.support \ {w} : Finset V) : Set V) :=
    ⟨⟨hremne.choose, hremne.choose_spec⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty
      (G.induce ((c.support \ {w} : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hpos' : 0 < componentCount G (c.support \ {w}) := Nat.card_pos
  have heq : componentCount G (c.support \ {w}) = 1 := by omega
  exact not_tight_container_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ hS hAS heq

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle
statement:
theorem strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support))
    (hK : IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)) :
    pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card
proof:
:= by
  set H := c.support
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) c.support x
  have hAne := rowProfile_nonempty_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ
  have hAsub : A ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H x
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) ≤ A.card :=
    Cograph.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_card_of_cycle c rfl hAsub hAne
  by_contra hnot
  have hSat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) H A :=
    le_antisymm hle (le_of_not_gt hnot)
  have hiff :=
    Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_of_canonical (G := G) c rfl hAsub hAne hK
  obtain ⟨S, hT, hAS⟩ := hiff.2 hSat
  exact not_tight_container_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ hT.1 hAS hT.2

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_insert
statement:
lemma isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_insert (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hOn : ∀ ⦃a b c' d y : V⦄,
      a ∈ insert x c.support →
        b ∈ insert x c.support →
          c' ∈ insert x c.support →
            d ∈ insert x c.support →
              y ∈ insert x c.support →
      InducedP4 G a b c' d →
      y ≠ a → y ≠ b → y ≠ c' → y ≠ d →
        G.Adj y a ∨ G.Adj y b ∨ G.Adj y c' ∨ G.Adj y d) :
    IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint c.support ({x} : Finset V) :=
    disjoint_singleton_right.2 hx
  refine isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile (H := c.support) (R := {x}) hdisj
    (mem_singleton_self x) ?_
  intro a b c' d y ha hb hc hd hy hp hya hyb hyc hyd
  have hconv : c.support ∪ {x} = insert x c.support := by
    rw [insert_eq, union_comm]
  rw [hconv] at ha hb hc hd hy
  exact hOn ha hb hc hd hy hp hya hyb hyc hyd

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle_of_host
statement:
theorem strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle_of_host
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support))
    (hOn : ∀ ⦃a b c' d y : V⦄,
      a ∈ insert x c.support →
        b ∈ insert x c.support →
          c' ∈ insert x c.support →
            d ∈ insert x c.support →
              y ∈ insert x c.support →
      InducedP4 G a b c' d →
      y ≠ a → y ≠ b → y ≠ c' → y ≠ d →
        G.Adj y a ∨ G.Adj y b ∨ G.Adj y c' ∨ G.Adj y d) :
    pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card
proof:
:=
  strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ
    (isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_insert c hx hOn)

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle_of_NoInducedP4UnionP1
statement:
theorem strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle_of_NoInducedP4UnionP1
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support))
    (hG : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card
proof:
:=
  strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle_of_host c hx hJ
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp hya hyb hyc hyd =>
      hG hp hya hyb hyc hyd)

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_pathCover_of_oneTough_erase
statement:
theorem strict_pathCover_of_oneTough_erase (hG : OneTough G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hc : c.support = univ.erase x)
    (hK : IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)) :
    pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∉ c.support := by simp [hc]
  have hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support) := by
    have : insert x c.support = univ := by simp [hc]
    rw [this]
    exact OneToughOn.univ_iff.2 hG
  exact strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle c hx hJ hK

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_rowProfile_eq_antineighbors
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hyH : y ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).1
    have hyA : y ∉ rowProfile (G := G) H x := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2
    have hyx : y ≠ x := by
      intro h
      subst h
      simp [hH] at hyH
    have hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y := by
      intro hadj
      exact hyA ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hyH, hadj⟩)
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, ⟨hyx, hnadj⟩⟩
  · intro hy
    have hy' := mem_filter.1 hy
    have hyx : y ≠ x := hy'.2.1
    have hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x y := hy'.2.2
    have hyH : y ∈ H := by
      simp [hH, hyx]
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyH, ?_⟩
    intro hyA
    exact hnadj ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hyA).2

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_pathCover_of_oneTough_erase_of_NoInducedP4UnionP1
statement:
theorem strict_pathCover_of_oneTough_erase_of_NoInducedP4UnionP1
    (hG : OneTough G) (hNP : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hc : c.support = univ.erase x) :
    pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support x).card
proof:
:= by
  have hK : IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x) := by
    rw [sdiff_rowProfile_eq_antineighbors c.support hc]
    exact NoInducedP4UnionP1.isCograph_antineighbors (G := G) hNP x
  exact strict_pathCover_of_oneTough_erase hG c hc hK

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_inserted_cycle_of_profile_ends
statement:
theorem exists_inserted_cycle_of_profile_ends (p : GraphPath G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hp : p.support = c.support) (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hs : p.start ∈ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)
    (hf : p.finish ∈ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)
    (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = insert x c.support ∧ 3 ≤ γ.support.card
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : G.Adj x p.start := ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hs).2
  have hf' : G.Adj p.finish x :=
    ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hf).2.symm
  have hx' : x ∉ p.support := by simpa [hp] using hx
  obtain ⟨γ, hsupp, h3, _⟩ := exists_graphCycle_insert p hs' hf' hx' hne
  refine ⟨γ, ?_, h3⟩
  simpa [hp] using hsupp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.supportUnion_triple
statement:
lemma GraphPath.supportUnion_triple (p q r : GraphPath G) :
    GraphPath.supportUnion [p, q, r] =
      p.support ∪ (q.support ∪ r.support)
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphPath.supportUnion_cons, GraphPath.supportUnion_nil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_assemble_three
statement:
lemma GraphPath.exists_assemble_three (p q r : GraphPath G)
    (hdpq : Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hdpr : Disjoint p.support r.support)
    (hdqr : Disjoint q.support r.support)
    (h1 : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (h2 : G.Adj q.finish r.start)
    (h3e : G.Adj r.finish p.start)
    (hcard : 3 ≤ (p.support ∪ (q.support ∪ r.support)).card) :
    ∃ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support = p.support ∪ (q.support ∪ r.support)
proof:
:= by
  let ps : List (GraphPath G) := [p, q, r]
  have h2len : 2 ≤ ps.length := by simp [ps]
  have hne : ps ≠ [] := by intro h; simp [ps] at h
  have hdisj : ps.Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint a.support b.support := by
    refine List.pairwise_cons.2 ⟨?_, List.pairwise_cons.2 ⟨?_, by simp⟩⟩
    · intro b hb
      simp [ps] at hb
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl
      · exact hdpq
      · exact hdpr
    · intro b hb
      simp [ps] at hb
      subst hb
      exact hdqr
  have hedges : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < ps.length),
      G.Adj (ps.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        (ps.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i + 1 < 3 := by simpa [ps] using hi
    have h01 : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
    rcases h01 with rfl | rfl
    · simpa [ps] using h1
    · simpa [ps] using h2
  have hclose : G.Adj (ps.getLast hne).finish (ps.head hne).start := by
    simpa [ps] using h3e
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (GraphPath.supportUnion ps).card := by
    simpa [ps, GraphPath.supportUnion_triple] using hcard
  refine ⟨GraphPath.assembleCycle ps h2len hdisj hedges hclose h3, ?_⟩
  simpa [ps, GraphPath.support_assembleCycle, GraphPath.supportUnion_triple]

name: Nikoghosyan.card_selected_triple
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i ∉ ({j, k} : Finset (Fin F.card)) := by simp [hij, hik]
  have hjmem : j ∉ ({k} : Finset (Fin F.card)) := by simp [hjk]
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi, card_insert_of_notMem hjmem, card_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.selectedSupport_triple
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.selectedSupport_triple (F : CycleFactor G)
    {i j k : Fin F.card} :
    F.selectedSupport {i, j, k} =
      (F.getCycle i).support ∪
        ((F.getCycle j).support ∪ (F.getCycle k).support)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hx
    have ht' : t = i ∨ t = j ∨ t = k := by simpa using ht
    rcases ht' with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxt)
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxt)))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxt)))
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_selectedSupport]
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with h | h
    · exact ⟨i, by simp, h⟩
    · rcases mem_union.1 h with h' | h'
      · exact ⟨j, by simp, h'⟩
      · exact ⟨k, by simp, h'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.satelliteGate_spec
statement:
lemma satelliteGate_spec
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core j : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    (hj : j ≠ core) :
    let S := satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
    Cograph.Tight (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support S ∧
      S ⊂ (F.getCycle core).support ∧
        S.Nonempty ∧
          (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
            (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support v).Nonempty ∧
              IsCograph G
                  ((F.getCycle core).support \
                    rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support v) ∧
                Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support
                  (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support v) ∧
                  Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G)
                      (F.getCycle core).support
                      (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support v) =
                    S ∧
                    rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support v ⊆ S) ∧
            (∀ x ∈ (F.getCycle core).support, ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
              G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hT, hproper, hrows, hatt⟩ :=
    satellite_saturated_common_gate_of_min hpat F hmin hj.symm hcore
  have hstart := hrows (F.getCycle j).start (F.getCycle j).start_mem_support
  have hgate : satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj = S := hstart.2.2.2.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hgate] using hT
  · simpa [hgate] using hproper
  · have hA := hstart.1
    have hsub := hstart.2.2.2.2
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := hA.mono hsub
    simpa [hgate] using hSne
  · intro v hv
    simpa [hgate] using hrows v hv
  · simpa [hgate] using hatt

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_core_spanning_of_distinct_gates
statement:
lemma exists_core_spanning_of_distinct_gates
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core j k : Fin F.card}
    (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    (hj : j ≠ core) (hk : k ≠ core) (_hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hgate : satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj ≠
      satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hk)
    {u' v' : V}
    (hu' : u' ∈ (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hv' : v' ∈ (F.getCycle k).support) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = (F.getCycle core).support ∧
        p.start ∈ rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support u' ∧
          p.finish ∈ rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support v'
proof:
:= by
  set cH := F.getCycle core
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u'
  set B := rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v'
  have hjS := satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj
  have hkS := satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hk
  obtain ⟨hAne, hKA, hSatA, hcontA, _⟩ := hjS.2.2.2.1 u' hu'
  obtain ⟨hBne, hKB, hSatB, hcontB, _⟩ := hkS.2.2.2.1 v' hv'
  have hU : cH.support = cH.support := rfl
  have hAsub := rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support u'
  have hBsub := rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support v'
  have hdiff : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support A ≠
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support B := by
    intro heq
    apply hgate
    calc
      satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj =
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support A := hcontA.symm
      _ = Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support B := heq
      _ = satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hk := hcontB
  have hsome :
      ∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ B, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) cH.support a b := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hinc :=
      Cograph.incompatible_saturated_profiles (G := G) cH hU hAsub hAne hKA
        hBsub hBne hKB (Or.inl hSatA) (by
          intro a ha b hb hR
          exact hnone ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hR⟩)
    exact hdiff hinc.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hne, p, hp, hends⟩ := hsome
  rcases hends with hdir | hdir
  · exact ⟨p, hp, by simpa [hdir.1] using ha, by simpa [hdir.2] using hb⟩
  · refine ⟨p.reverse, by simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse, hdir.2] using ha
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse, hdir.1] using hb

name: Nikoghosyan.distinct_gate_satellites_anticomplete
statement:
theorem distinct_gate_satellites_anticomplete
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core j k : Fin F.card}
    (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    (hj : j ≠ core) (hk : k ≠ core) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hgate : satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj ≠
      satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hk)
    {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hv : v ∈ (F.getCycle k).support) :
    ¬ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  set cH := F.getCycle core
  set cJ := F.getCycle j
  set cK := F.getCycle k
  obtain ⟨qJ, hqJ, hqJst, hqJfin⟩ := exists_path_open_succ cJ hu
  obtain ⟨qK, hqK, hqKst, hqKfin⟩ := exists_path_open_succ cK hv
  have hu' : cJ.succAt hu ∈ cJ.support := cJ.succAt_mem_support hu
  have hv' : cK.succAt hv ∈ cK.support := cK.succAt_mem_support hv
  obtain ⟨p, hp, ha, hb⟩ :=
    exists_core_spanning_of_distinct_gates hpat F hmin hcore hk hj hjk.symm
      (Ne.symm hgate) hv' hu'
  have hdpq : Disjoint qJ.support qK.reverse.support := by
    simpa [hqJ, hqK, GraphPath.support_reverse] using F.disjoint_getCycle hjk
  have hdpr : Disjoint qJ.support p.support := by
    simpa [hqJ, hp] using F.disjoint_getCycle hj
  have hdqr : Disjoint qK.reverse.support p.support := by
    simpa [hqK, GraphPath.support_reverse, hp] using F.disjoint_getCycle hk
  have h1 : G.Adj qJ.finish qK.reverse.start := by
    simpa [hqJfin, GraphPath.reverse, hqKfin] using hadj
  have h2 : G.Adj qK.reverse.finish p.start := by
    have : p.start ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cK.succAt hv) := ha
    have hmem := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 this
    simpa [GraphPath.reverse, hqKst] using hmem.2
  have h3e : G.Adj p.finish qJ.start := by
    have : p.finish ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cJ.succAt hu) := hb
    have hmem := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 this
    simpa [hqJst] using hmem.2.symm
  have hcard : 3 ≤ (qJ.support ∪ (qK.reverse.support ∪ p.support)).card := by
    have hj3 := cJ.three_le_card_support
    have hk3 := cK.three_le_card_support
    have hh3 := cH.three_le_card_support
    have hJ : qJ.support.card = cJ.support.card := by rw [hqJ]
    have hK : qK.reverse.support.card = cK.support.card := by
      simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using congrArg Finset.card hqK
    have hH : p.support.card = cH.support.card := by rw [hp]
    have hKP : Disjoint qK.reverse.support p.support := hdqr
    have hKPcard : (qK.reverse.support ∪ p.support).card =
        qK.reverse.support.card + p.support.card :=
      card_union_of_disjoint hKP
    have hdisj' : Disjoint qJ.support (qK.reverse.support ∪ p.support) :=
      disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨hdpq, hdpr⟩
    have hU : (qJ.support ∪ (qK.reverse.support ∪ p.support)).card =
        qJ.support.card + (qK.reverse.support ∪ p.support).card :=
      card_union_of_disjoint hdisj'
    omega
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    GraphPath.exists_assemble_three qJ qK.reverse p hdpq hdpr hdqr h1 h2 h3e hcard
  have hspan : C.support = F.selectedSupport ({core, j, k} : Finset (Fin F.card)) := by
    have hsel := F.selectedSupport_triple (i := core) (j := j) (k := k)
    calc
      C.support = qJ.support ∪ (qK.reverse.support ∪ p.support) := hC
      _ = cJ.support ∪ (cK.support ∪ cH.support) := by
        simp [hqJ, hqK, GraphPath.support_reverse, hp, cH]
      _ = cH.support ∪ (cJ.support ∪ cK.support) := by
        ac_rfl
      _ = F.selectedSupport {core, j, k} := by
        simpa [cH, cJ, cK] using hsel.symm
  have h2s : 2 ≤ ({core, j, k} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card := by
    have h3c := card_selected_triple (F := F) hj.symm hk.symm hjk
    omega
  exact F.not_exists_merge_of_min hmin {core, j, k} h2s C hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.selectedSupport_erase_core
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.selectedSupport_erase_core (F : CycleFactor G)
    (core : Fin F.card) :
    F.selectedSupport (univ.erase core) = univ \ (F.getCycle core).support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hx
    have hj' : j ≠ core := (mem_erase.1 hj).1
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ x, disjoint_left.1 (F.disjoint_getCycle hj') hxj⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxU : x ∈ (univ : Finset V) := mem_univ x
    have hxcore : x ∉ (F.getCycle core).support := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩ := F.mem_iff x
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := List.get_of_mem hc
    let t : Fin F.card := ⟨n.1, by simpa [CycleFactor.card] using n.2⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support := by
      have hget : F.getCycle t = c := by
        simpa [CycleFactor.getCycle, t] using hn
      simpa [hget] using hxc
    have ht : t ≠ core := by
      intro heq
      have : x ∈ (F.getCycle core).support := by simpa [heq] using hx'
      exact hxcore this
    exact (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨t, mem_erase.2 ⟨ht, mem_univ t⟩, hx'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.one_le_componentCount_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma one_le_componentCount_of_nonempty {U : Finset V} (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    1 ≤ componentCount G U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hU
  have : Nonempty (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  exact Nat.succ_le_iff.2 Nat.card_pos

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_distinct_gate_satellite
statement:
theorem exists_distinct_gate_satellite
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian)
    {core : Fin F.card}
    (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    ∃ (k : Fin F.card) (hk : k ≠ core),
      k ≠ j ∧
        satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hk ≠
          satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hnone' : ∀ (k : Fin F.card) (hk : k ≠ core),
      k = j ∨
        satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hk =
          satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj := by
    intro k hk
    have h := not_exists.1 (not_exists.1 hnone k) hk
    rw [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · exact Or.inl hkj
    · exact Or.inr (h hkj)
  have h3 := three_le_card_of_min_nonHamiltonian hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
  have hjS := satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj
  set S := satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
  have hTgt : Cograph.Tight (G := G) (F.getCycle core).support S := hjS.1
  have hproper : S ⊂ (F.getCycle core).support := hjS.2.1
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := hjS.2.2.1
  have hatt : ∀ t : Fin F.card, t ≠ core →
      ∀ x ∈ (F.getCycle core).support, ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support,
        G.Adj x y → x ∈ S := by
    intro t ht
    have hteq : satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore ht = S := by
      rcases hnone' t ht with rfl | heq
      · rfl
      · exact heq
    have hspec := satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore ht
    simpa [hteq] using hspec.2.2.2.2
  set H := (F.getCycle core).support
  set D := F.selectedSupport (univ.erase core)
  have hDH : D = univ \ H := F.selectedSupport_erase_core core
  have hSsub : S ⊆ H := hTgt.1
  have hdisj : Disjoint (H \ S) D := by
    have : Disjoint H D := by
      rw [hDH]
      exact disjoint_left.2 fun x hxH hxD => (mem_sdiff.1 hxD).2 hxH
    exact this.mono_left sdiff_subset
  have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ H \ S, ∀ b ∈ D, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hbt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hb
    have ht' : t ≠ core := (mem_erase.1 ht).1
    have haH : a ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1
    have haS : a ∈ S := hatt t ht' a haH b hbt hadj
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 ha).2 haS
  have hrem : univ \ S = (H \ S) ∪ D := by
    have hDS : Disjoint D S := by
      have : Disjoint D H := by
        rw [hDH]
        exact disjoint_left.2 fun x hxD hxH => (mem_sdiff.1 hxD).2 hxH
      exact this.mono_right hSsub
    have hD : D \ S = D := sdiff_eq_self_iff_disjoint.2 hDS
    calc
      univ \ S = (H ∪ D) \ S := by
        have : H ∪ D = univ := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro; exact mem_univ x
          · intro _
            by_cases hxH : x ∈ H
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxH)
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (by
                simpa [hDH] using mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ x, hxH⟩))
        rw [this]
      _ = (H \ S) ∪ (D \ S) := union_sdiff_distrib _ _ _
      _ = (H \ S) ∪ D := by rw [hD]
  have hcount :
      componentCount G ((H \ S) ∪ D) =
        componentCount G (H \ S) + componentCount G D :=
    Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisj hnocross
  have hTight : componentCount G (H \ S) = S.card := hTgt.2
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := by
    have : 1 ≤ F.card := F.one_le_card hord
    have h2 : 2 ≤ F.card := by omega
    have hex : (univ.erase core).Nonempty := by
      have : 1 ≤ (univ.erase core).card := by
        have : (univ.erase core).card = F.card - 1 := by
          simp [card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ core), card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        omega
      exact card_pos.1 this
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
    exact ⟨(F.getCycle t).start, (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2
      ⟨t, ht, (F.getCycle t).start_mem_support⟩⟩
  have hDpos : 1 ≤ componentCount G D :=
    one_le_componentCount_of_nonempty hDne
  have hEq : componentCount G (univ \ S) =
      S.card + componentCount G D := by
    rw [hrem, hcount, hTight]
  have h2c : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ S) := by
    have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hSne)
    have : S.card + 1 ≤ S.card + componentCount G D :=
      Nat.add_le_add_left hDpos _
    omega
  have hle : componentCount G (univ \ S) ≤ S.card := hT S h2c
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_ownSatellites
statement:
lemma mem_ownSatellites
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j t : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    t ∈ ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj ↔
      ∃ ht : t ≠ core,
        satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore ht =
          satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htO
    have hif := (mem_filter.mp htO).2
    have ht : t ≠ core := by
      intro hc
      simp [hc] at hif
    refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
    simpa [dif_neg ht] using hif
  · intro ⟨ht, heq⟩
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ t, ?_⟩
    simpa [dif_neg ht] using heq

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_foreignSatellites
statement:
lemma mem_foreignSatellites
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j t : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    t ∈ foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj ↔
      ∃ ht : t ≠ core,
        satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore ht ≠
          satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htO
    have hif := (mem_filter.mp htO).2
    have ht : t ≠ core := by
      intro hc
      simp [hc] at hif
    refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
    simpa [dif_neg ht] using hif
  · intro ⟨ht, hne⟩
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ t, ?_⟩
    simpa [dif_neg ht] using hne

name: Nikoghosyan.self_mem_ownSatellites
statement:
lemma self_mem_ownSatellites
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    j ∈ ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj
proof:
:=
  (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := j)).2 ⟨hj, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.core_not_mem_ownSatellites
statement:
lemma core_not_mem_ownSatellites
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    core ∉ ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hc, _⟩ := (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := core)).1 h
  exact hc rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.ownSatellites_nonempty
statement:
lemma ownSatellites_nonempty
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨j, self_mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.foreignSatellites_nonempty_of_distinct
statement:
lemma foreignSatellites_nonempty_of_distinct
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian)
    {core : Fin F.card}
    (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, _hkj, hgate⟩ :=
    exists_distinct_gate_satellite hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam hcore hj
  exact ⟨k, (mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := k)).2 ⟨hk, hgate⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_own_foreign
statement:
lemma disjoint_own_foreign
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    Disjoint (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj)
      (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj)
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro t htO htF
  obtain ⟨ht, heq⟩ := (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := t)).1 htO
  obtain ⟨_, hne⟩ := (mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := t)).1 htF
  exact hne heq

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_core_own_support
statement:
lemma disjoint_core_own_support
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    Disjoint (F.getCycle core).support
      (F.selectedSupport (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj))
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxH hxB
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hxB
  obtain ⟨htc, _⟩ := (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := t)).1 ht
  exact disjoint_left.1 (F.disjoint_getCycle htc.symm) hxH hxt

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_core_foreign_support
statement:
lemma disjoint_core_foreign_support
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    Disjoint (F.getCycle core).support
      (F.selectedSupport (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj))
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxH hxR
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hxR
  obtain ⟨htc, _⟩ := (mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := t)).1 ht
  exact disjoint_left.1 (F.disjoint_getCycle htc.symm) hxH hxt

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_own_foreign_support
statement:
lemma disjoint_own_foreign_support
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    Disjoint (F.selectedSupport (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj))
      (F.selectedSupport (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj))
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxB hxR
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hxB
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hxs⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hxR
  obtain ⟨htc, _⟩ := (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := t)).1 ht
  obtain ⟨hsc, _⟩ := (mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := s)).1 hs
  have hts : t ≠ s := by
    intro heq
    subst heq
    exact disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_own_foreign hpat F hmin hcore hj) ht hs
  exact disjoint_left.1 (F.disjoint_getCycle hts) hxt hxs

name: Nikoghosyan.own_foreign_partition_univ
statement:
lemma own_foreign_partition_univ
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    (F.getCycle core).support ∪
        F.selectedSupport (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj) ∪
          F.selectedSupport (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj) =
      univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro; exact mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩ := F.mem_iff x
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := List.get_of_mem hc
    let t' : Fin F.card := ⟨n.1, by simpa [CycleFactor.card] using n.2⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ (F.getCycle t').support := by
      have hget : F.getCycle t' = c := by
        simpa [CycleFactor.getCycle, t'] using hn
      simpa [hget] using hxc
    by_cases htcore : t' = core
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by simpa [htcore] using hx'))))
    · by_cases hgate :
          satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore htcore =
            satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)))
        exact (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2
          ⟨t', (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj).2 ⟨htcore, hgate⟩, hx'⟩
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)
        exact (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2
          ⟨t', (mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj).2 ⟨htcore, hgate⟩, hx'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.own_anticomplete_foreign
statement:
lemma own_anticomplete_foreign
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {core : Fin F.card} (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core)
    {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ F.selectedSupport (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj))
    (hv : v ∈ F.selectedSupport (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj)) :
    ¬ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hut⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hu
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hvs⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hv
  obtain ⟨htc, heq⟩ := (mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := t)).1 ht
  obtain ⟨hsc, hne⟩ := (mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj (t := s)).1 hs
  have hts : t ≠ s := by
    intro h
    subst h
    exact hne heq
  have hgate : satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore htc ≠
      satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hsc := by
    simpa [heq] using hne.symm
  exact distinct_gate_satellites_anticomplete hpat F hmin hcore htc hsc hts
    hgate hut hvs

name: Nikoghosyan.own_group_isCograph
statement:
theorem own_group_isCograph
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian)
    {core : Fin F.card}
    (hcore : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle core).support)
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ core) :
    IsCograph G (F.selectedSupport (ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    foreignSatellites_nonempty_of_distinct hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam hcore hj
  let x := (F.getCycle k).start
  have hxR : x ∈ F.selectedSupport (foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj) :=
    (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨k, hk, (F.getCycle k).start_mem_support⟩
  have hdisjBR := disjoint_own_foreign_support hpat F hmin hcore hj
  have hxne : x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b ∧ x ≠ c ∧ x ≠ d := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h; subst h; exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjBR ha hxR
    · intro h; subst h; exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjBR hb hxR
    · intro h; subst h; exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjBR hc hxR
    · intro h; subst h; exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjBR hd hxR
  have hno : ¬ G.Adj x a ∧ ¬ G.Adj x b ∧ ¬ G.Adj x c ∧ ¬ G.Adj x d := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hxa
      exact own_anticomplete_foreign (u := a) (v := x) hpat F hmin hcore hj ha hxR
        (SimpleGraph.Adj.symm hxa)
    · intro hxb
      exact own_anticomplete_foreign (u := b) (v := x) hpat F hmin hcore hj hb hxR
        (SimpleGraph.Adj.symm hxb)
    · intro hxc
      exact own_anticomplete_foreign (u := c) (v := x) hpat F hmin hcore hj hc hxR
        (SimpleGraph.Adj.symm hxc)
    · intro hxd
      exact own_anticomplete_foreign (u := d) (v := x) hpat F hmin hcore hj hd hxR
        (SimpleGraph.Adj.symm hxd)
  have hpat' := hpat hp hxne.1 hxne.2.1 hxne.2.2.1 hxne.2.2.2
  rcases hpat' with h | h | h | h
  · exact hno.1 h
  · exact hno.2.1 h
  · exact hno.2.2.1 h
  · exact hno.2.2.2 h

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_canonical_normal_form
statement:
theorem exists_canonical_normal_form
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    Nonempty (CanonicalNormalForm F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨core, hcore, huniq⟩ :=
    existsUnique_noncograph_block_of_min hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
  refine ⟨{
    core := core
    hCoreNoncog := hcore
    hSatCog := fun j hj => by
      by_contra hnc
      exact hj (huniq j hnc)
    hThree := three_le_card_of_min_nonHamiltonian hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
    gateOf := fun j hj => satelliteGate hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hGateTight := fun j hj => (satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj).1
    hGateProper := fun j hj => (satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj).2.1
    hGateNonempty := fun j hj => (satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj).2.2.1
    hGateRows := fun j hj => (satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj).2.2.2.1
    hGateAttach := fun j hj => (satelliteGate_spec hpat F hmin hcore hj).2.2.2.2
    own := fun j hj => ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj
    foreign := fun j hj => foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hOwnMem := fun j hj t => mem_ownSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hForeignMem := fun j hj t => mem_foreignSatellites hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hOwnNe := fun j hj => ownSatellites_nonempty hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hForeignNe := fun j hj =>
      foreignSatellites_nonempty_of_distinct hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam hcore hj
    hDisjHB := fun j hj => disjoint_core_own_support hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hDisjHR := fun j hj => disjoint_core_foreign_support hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hDisjBR := fun j hj => disjoint_own_foreign_support hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hPartition := fun j hj => own_foreign_partition_univ hpat F hmin hcore hj
    hAnticompleteBR := fun j hj _u _v hu hv =>
      own_anticomplete_foreign hpat F hmin hcore hj hu hv
    hOwnCograph := fun j hj =>
      own_group_isCograph hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam hcore hj
  }⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_splice
statement:
lemma start_splice (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (p.splice q h hd).start = p.start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.finish_splice
statement:
lemma finish_splice (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (p.splice q h hd).finish = q.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.supportUnion_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma supportUnion_nil : supportUnion (G := G) [] = ∅
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.supportUnion_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma supportUnion_cons (p : GraphPath G) (ps : List (GraphPath G)) :
    supportUnion (p :: ps) = p.support ∪ supportUnion ps
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_supportUnion
statement:
lemma mem_supportUnion {ps : List (GraphPath G)} {x : V} :
    x ∈ supportUnion ps ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, x ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp [supportUnion]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [supportUnion_cons, mem_union] at hx
      rcases hx with hxp | hxps
      · exact ⟨p, List.mem_cons_self, hxp⟩
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := ih.1 hxps
        exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq, hxq⟩
    · intro ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
      rw [supportUnion_cons, mem_union]
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq'
      · exact Or.inl hxq
      · exact Or.inr (ih.2 ⟨q, hq', hxq⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_assembleTwo
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_assembleTwo (p q : GraphPath G)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hfwd : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hback : G.Adj q.finish p.start)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ (p.support ∪ q.support).card) :
    (assembleTwo p q hd hfwd hback h3).support = p.support ∪ q.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [assembleTwo, support_toCycle, support_splice]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_spliceAcc
statement:
lemma exists_spliceAcc (acc : GraphPath G) (rest : List (GraphPath G))
    (hdisj : ∀ q ∈ rest, Disjoint acc.support q.support)
    (hpw : rest.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hfirst : ∀ (hne : rest ≠ []),
      G.Adj acc.finish (rest.head hne).start)
    (htail : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < rest.length),
      G.Adj (rest.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        (rest.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = acc.start ∧
        r.finish =
          (if hne : rest ≠ [] then (rest.getLast hne).finish else acc.finish) ∧
        r.support = acc.support ∪ supportUnion rest
proof:
:= by
  induction rest generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
    exact ⟨acc, rfl, by simp, by simp [supportUnion]⟩
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have hadj : G.Adj acc.finish q.start :=
      hfirst (List.cons_ne_nil q qs)
    have hd : Disjoint acc.support q.support := hdisj q (by simp)
    let acc' := acc.splice q hadj hd
    have hdisj' : ∀ r ∈ qs, Disjoint acc'.support r.support := by
      intro r hr
      have hd1 : Disjoint acc.support r.support := hdisj r (by simp [hr])
      have hd2 : Disjoint q.support r.support :=
        (List.pairwise_cons.1 hpw).1 r hr
      simpa [acc', support_splice] using disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hd1, hd2⟩
    have hpw' : qs.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support :=
      (List.pairwise_cons.1 hpw).2
    have hfirst' : ∀ (hne : qs ≠ []),
        G.Adj acc'.finish (qs.head hne).start := by
      intro hne
      have hi : 0 + 1 < (q :: qs).length := by
        cases qs with
        | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
        | cons _ _ => simp
      have h := htail 0 hi
      have hhead : qs.head hne = qs.get ⟨0, by
        cases qs with
        | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
        | cons _ _ => simp⟩ := by
        cases qs with
        | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
        | cons _ _ => rfl
      simpa [acc', finish_splice, hhead, List.get] using h
    have htail' : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < qs.length),
        G.Adj (qs.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
          (qs.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start := by
      intro i hi
      have hi' : (i + 1) + 1 < (q :: qs).length := by
        simpa [List.length_cons] using Nat.succ_lt_succ hi
      have h := htail (i + 1) hi'
      simpa [List.get] using h
    obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := ih acc' hdisj' hpw' hfirst' htail'
    refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [acc', start_splice] using hr1
    · cases qs with
      | nil =>
        simp [acc', finish_splice] at hr2 ⊢
        exact hr2
      | cons _ _ =>
        simpa [List.getLast_cons] using hr2
    · simpa [acc', support_splice, supportUnion, union_assoc] using hr3

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_spliceChain
statement:
lemma exists_spliceChain (ps : List (GraphPath G)) (hne : ps ≠ [])
    (hdisj : ps.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hedges : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < ps.length),
      G.Adj (ps.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        (ps.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = (ps.head hne).start ∧
        r.finish = (ps.getLast hne).finish ∧
        r.support = supportUnion ps
proof:
:= by
  match ps, hne with
  | [], h => exact (h rfl).elim
  | p :: rest, hne' =>
    have hdisj' : ∀ q ∈ rest, Disjoint p.support q.support :=
      fun q hq => (List.pairwise_cons.1 hdisj).1 q hq
    have hpw : rest.Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint a.support b.support :=
      (List.pairwise_cons.1 hdisj).2
    have hfirst : ∀ (hr : rest ≠ []), G.Adj p.finish (rest.head hr).start := by
      intro hr
      have hi : 0 + 1 < (p :: rest).length := by
        cases rest with
        | nil => exact (hr rfl).elim
        | cons _ _ => simp
      have hhead : rest.head hr = rest.get ⟨0, by
        cases rest with
        | nil => exact (hr rfl).elim
        | cons _ _ => simp⟩ := by
        cases rest with
        | nil => exact (hr rfl).elim
        | cons _ _ => rfl
      simpa [hhead, List.get] using hedges 0 hi
    have htail : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < rest.length),
        G.Adj (rest.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
          (rest.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start := by
      intro i hi
      have hi' : (i + 1) + 1 < (p :: rest).length := by
        simpa [List.length_cons] using Nat.succ_lt_succ hi
      simpa [List.get] using hedges (i + 1) hi'
    obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := exists_spliceAcc p rest hdisj' hpw hfirst htail
    refine ⟨r, by simpa [List.head] using hr1, ?_, by simpa [supportUnion] using hr3⟩
    cases rest with
    | nil => simpa [List.getLast] using hr2
    | cons _ _ => simpa [List.getLast_cons] using hr2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_assembleCycle
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_assembleCycle (ps : List (GraphPath G))
    (h2 : 2 ≤ ps.length)
    (hdisj : ps.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hedges : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < ps.length),
      G.Adj (ps.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        (ps.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start)
    (hclose : G.Adj
      (ps.getLast (by intro h; simp [h] at h2)).finish
      (ps.head (by intro h; simp [h] at h2)).start)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ (supportUnion ps).card) :
    (assembleCycle ps h2 hdisj hedges hclose h3).support = supportUnion ps
proof:
:= by
  simp [assembleCycle, support_toCycle]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_spliceChain ps (by intro h; simp [h] at h2)
    hdisj hedges)).2.2

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.getCycle_mem
statement:
lemma getCycle_mem (F : CycleFactor G) (i : Fin F.card) :
    F.getCycle i ∈ F.cycles
proof:
:=
  List.get_mem _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.disjoint_getCycle
statement:
lemma disjoint_getCycle (F : CycleFactor G) {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle j).support
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i.1 < F.cycles.length := by simpa [CycleFactor.card] using i.2
  have hj : j.1 < F.cycles.length := by simpa [CycleFactor.card] using j.2
  wlog hlt : i.1 < j.1
  · have hle : j.1 ≤ i.1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hlt
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt' | heq
    · exact (this F hij.symm hj hi hlt').symm
    · exact (hij (Fin.ext heq.symm)).elim
  have hpw :=
    (List.pairwise_iff_get (R := fun c d : GraphCycle G =>
      Disjoint c.support d.support)).1 F.disjoint
      ⟨i.1, hi⟩ ⟨j.1, hj⟩ hlt
  simpa [getCycle] using hpw

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport
statement:
lemma mem_selectedSupport {F : CycleFactor G} {s : Finset (Fin F.card)} {x : V} :
    x ∈ F.selectedSupport s ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:= by
  simp [selectedSupport]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.length_keptCycles
statement:
lemma length_keptCycles (F : CycleFactor G) (s : Finset (Fin F.card)) :
    (F.keptCycles s).length = F.card - s.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [keptCycles, List.length_map, Finset.length_toList, card_sdiff,
    card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.pairwise_keptCycles
statement:
lemma pairwise_keptCycles (F : CycleFactor G) (s : Finset (Fin F.card)) :
    (F.keptCycles s).Pairwise fun c d => Disjoint c.support d.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [keptCycles, List.pairwise_map]
  refine List.Pairwise.imp ?_ (univ (α := Fin F.card) \ s).nodup_toList
  intro i j hij
  exact F.disjoint_getCycle hij

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.mem_keptCycles
proof:
:= by
  simp [keptCycles, mem_sdiff]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.disjoint_kept_selected
statement:
lemma disjoint_kept_selected (F : CycleFactor G) (s : Finset (Fin F.card))
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.selectedSupport s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hxS
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := (mem_selectedSupport (F := F) (s := s) (x := x)).1 hxS
  have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hi (h ▸ hj)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (F.disjoint_getCycle hij) hx hxj

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.card_replaceGroup
statement:
lemma card_replaceGroup (F : CycleFactor G) (s : Finset (Fin F.card))
    (C : GraphCycle G) (hspan : C.support = F.selectedSupport s) :
    (F.replaceGroup s C hspan).card = F.card - s.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [replaceGroup, card, List.length_append, length_keptCycles]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.card_replaceGroup_lt
statement:
lemma card_replaceGroup_lt (F : CycleFactor G) {s : Finset (Fin F.card)}
    (C : GraphCycle G) (hspan : C.support = F.selectedSupport s)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ s.card) :
    (F.replaceGroup s C hspan).card < F.card
proof:
:= by
  have hsle : s.card ≤ F.card := by
    simpa [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using card_le_card (subset_univ s)
  have hcard := F.card_replaceGroup s C hspan
  have : F.card - s.card + 1 < F.card := by omega
  exact hcard ▸ this

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.not_exists_merge_of_min
statement:
lemma not_exists_merge_of_min (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (s : Finset (Fin F.card)) (h2 : 2 ≤ s.card)
    (C : GraphCycle G) (hspan : C.support = F.selectedSupport s) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hlt := F.card_replaceGroup_lt C hspan h2
  have hle := hmin (F.replaceGroup s C hspan)
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hle

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.exists_assemble_two_blocks
statement:
lemma exists_assemble_two_blocks (F : CycleFactor G)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (p q : GraphPath G)
    (hp : p.support = (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hq : q.support = (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hfwd : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hback : G.Adj q.finish p.start) :
    ∃ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support = (F.getCycle i).support ∪ (F.getCycle j).support
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Disjoint p.support q.support := by
    simpa [hp, hq] using F.disjoint_getCycle hij
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (p.support ∪ q.support).card := by
    have hi := (F.getCycle i).three_le_card_support
    have hj := (F.getCycle j).three_le_card_support
    have hcup : (p.support ∪ q.support).card = p.support.card + q.support.card :=
      card_union_of_disjoint hd
    have hpcard : p.support.card = (F.getCycle i).support.card := by rw [hp]
    have hqcard : q.support.card = (F.getCycle j).support.card := by rw [hq]
    omega
  refine ⟨GraphPath.assembleTwo p q hd hfwd hback h3, ?_⟩
  simp [GraphPath.support_assembleTwo, hp, hq]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.selectedSupport_pair
statement:
lemma selectedSupport_pair (F : CycleFactor G) {i j : Fin F.card} :
    F.selectedSupport {i, j} =
      (F.getCycle i).support ∪ (F.getCycle j).support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩ := (mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hx
    have hk' : k = i ∨ k = j := by simpa using hk
    rcases hk' with rfl | rfl
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxk)
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxk)
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_union] at hx
    rw [mem_selectedSupport]
    rcases hx with hxi | hxj
    · exact ⟨i, by simp, hxi⟩
    · exact ⟨j, by simp, hxj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.card_replaceTwo
statement:
lemma card_replaceTwo (F : CycleFactor G)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (p q : GraphPath G)
    (hp : p.support = (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hq : q.support = (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hfwd : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hback : G.Adj q.finish p.start) :
    (F.replaceTwo hij p q hp hq hfwd hback).card = F.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hspan :
      (Classical.choose (F.exists_assemble_two_blocks hij p q hp hq hfwd hback)).support =
        F.selectedSupport {i, j} := by
    have hC := Classical.choose_spec
      (F.exists_assemble_two_blocks hij p q hp hq hfwd hback)
    exact hC.trans (F.selectedSupport_pair).symm
  have hcard := F.card_replaceGroup ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card))
    (Classical.choose (F.exists_assemble_two_blocks hij p q hp hq hfwd hback)) hspan
  have hpair : ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card = 2 := card_pair hij
  have hsle : 2 ≤ F.card := by
    have : ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card ≤ F.card := by
      simpa [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
        card_le_card (subset_univ ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)))
    simpa [hpair] using this
  calc
    (F.replaceTwo hij p q hp hq hfwd hback).card
        = F.card - ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card + 1 := hcard
    _ = F.card - 2 + 1 := by simp [hpair]
    _ = F.card - 1 := by omega

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.not_exists_two_block_merge_of_min
statement:
lemma not_exists_two_block_merge_of_min (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (p q : GraphPath G)
    (hp : p.support = (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hq : q.support = (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hfwd : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hback : G.Adj q.finish p.start) : False
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 ≤ F.card := by
    have : ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card ≤ F.card := by
      simpa [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
        card_le_card (subset_univ ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)))
    simpa [card_pair hij] using this
  have hlt : (F.replaceTwo hij p q hp hq hfwd hback).card < F.card := by
    have hcard := F.card_replaceTwo hij p q hp hq hfwd hback
    omega
  have hle := hmin (F.replaceTwo hij p q hp hq hfwd hback)
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hle

name: Nikoghosyan.OneTough.not_isBridge
statement:
lemma OneTough.not_isBridge (h : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) : ¬ G.IsBridge s(a, b)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbr
  have hdeg := OneTough.two_le_ncard_neighborSet (G := G) h hord a
  have : ∃ u, G.Adj a u ∧ u ≠ b := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hsub : G.neighborSet a ⊆ ({b} : Set V) := by
      intro x hx
      have hadj : G.Adj a x := by simpa [mem_neighborSet] using hx
      have : x = b := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hnone ⟨x, hadj, hne⟩
      simp [this]
    have hcard : (G.neighborSet a).ncard ≤ 1 := by
      have := Set.ncard_le_ncard (s := G.neighborSet a) (t := ({b} : Set V))
        hsub (Set.toFinite _)
      simpa using this
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, hau, hne_ub⟩ := this
  have hua : u ≠ a := hau.ne.symm
  have hba : b ≠ a := hab.ne.symm
  let S : Finset V := {a}
  let U : Finset V := univ \ S
  have huU : u ∈ U := by simp [U, S, hua]
  have hbU : b ∈ U := by simp [U, S, hba]
  have hnr : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable ⟨u, huU⟩ ⟨b, hbU⟩ := by
    intro hR
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hR
    let pG : G.Walk u b := p.map (induceVal (s := (U : Set V)))
    have hab_not_pG : s(a, b) ∉ pG.edges := by
      intro he
      have ha_mem : a ∈ pG.support := pG.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges he
      have ha_mem' : a ∈ (p.map (induceVal (s := (U : Set V)))).support := ha_mem
      rw [Walk.support_map, List.mem_map] at ha_mem'
      obtain ⟨z, -, hza⟩ := ha_mem'
      have haU : a ∈ U := by
        have : z.1 = a := by
          simpa [induceVal] using hza
        simpa [this] using z.property
      simp [U, S] at haU
    have hab_not : s(a, b) ∉ (Walk.cons hau pG).edges := by
      intro he
      rw [Walk.edges_cons, List.mem_cons] at he
      rcases he with hfirst | hrest
      · have : u = b := by
          obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ := Sym2.eq_iff.mp hfirst
          · exact h2.symm
          · exact (hau.ne h1).elim
        exact hne_ub this
      · exact hab_not_pG hrest
    have hreach : (G.deleteEdges {s(a, b)}).Reachable a b :=
      (reachable_deleteEdges_iff_exists_walk).2 ⟨Walk.cons hau pG, hab_not⟩
    exact (isBridge_iff.1 hbr) hreach
  have hnt : Nontrivial (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨u, huU⟩,
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hbU⟩,
      fun hC => hnr (ConnectedComponent.exact hC)⟩⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G U := by
    haveI : Nonempty (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
    haveI : Finite (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
    have hpos : 0 < componentCount G U := Nat.card_pos
    have hne1 : componentCount G U ≠ 1 := by
      intro h1
      have : Subsingleton (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
        (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 h1).1
      exact (not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial).2 hnt this
    omega
  have hbound := h S (by simpa [U, S] using h2)
  have : componentCount G U ≤ 1 := by simpa [S] using hbound
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_walk_support
statement:
lemma mem_walk_support {p : GraphPath G} {x : V} :
    x ∈ p.support ↔ x ∈ p.walk.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_nil_iff
statement:
lemma takeUntil_nil_iff (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil ↔ x = p.start
proof:
:= by
  rw [takeUntil, Walk.nil_takeUntil, eq_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_nil_iff
statement:
lemma dropUntil_nil_iff :
    ∀ (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support),
      (p.dropUntil hx).walk.Nil ↔ x = p.finish
proof:
:= by
  intro p x hx
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact Walk.Nil.eq h
  · intro h
    subst h
    exact (Walk.isPath_iff_nil).1 (p.dropUntil hx).isPath

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil
statement:
lemma support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := mem_walk_support.1 hx
  ext y
  simp [support, takeUntil, dropUntil, List.mem_toFinset]
  have happ :=
    Walk.mem_support_append_iff (t := y) (p.walk.takeUntil x hx') (p.walk.dropUntil x hx')
  have hspec := Walk.take_spec p.walk hx'
  simpa [hspec] using happ.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish
statement:
lemma nil_iff_start_eq_finish (p : GraphPath G) :
    p.walk.Nil ↔ p.start = p.finish
proof:
:=
  p.isPath.nil_iff_eq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil
statement:
lemma support_eq_singleton_of_nil (p : GraphPath G) (h : p.walk.Nil) :
    p.support = {p.start}
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : p.walk.length = 0 := (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff).2 h
  have hcard : p.support.card = 1 := by
    rw [card_support, hlen]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := card_eq_one.mp hcard
  have : z = p.start := by
    have hmem := p.start_mem_support
    rw [hz] at hmem
    exact (mem_singleton.1 hmem).symm
  simp [hz, this]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_trimStart
statement:
lemma support_trimStart (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).support = p.support.erase p.start
proof:
:= by
  have htail : p.walk.tail.support = p.walk.support.tail :=
    Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil p.walk h
  have hcons : p.start :: p.walk.support.tail = p.walk.support := by
    simpa [htail] using Walk.cons_support_tail (p := p.walk) h
  have hnin : p.start ∉ p.walk.support.tail := by
    have hnodup := p.support_nodup
    rw [← hcons] at hnodup
    exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnodup).1
  ext y
  simp [trimStart, support, htail, mem_erase, List.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨fun hxy => hnin (hxy ▸ hy), List.mem_of_mem_tail hy⟩
  · intro ⟨hyne, hy⟩
    have : y ∈ p.start :: p.walk.support.tail := by simpa [hcons] using hy
    exact (List.mem_cons.1 this).resolve_left hyne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_trimFinish
statement:
lemma support_trimFinish (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimFinish h).support = p.support.erase p.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hdl : p.walk.dropLast.support = p.walk.support.dropLast :=
    Walk.support_dropLast (p := p.walk) h
  have hcat : p.walk.support.dropLast ++ [p.finish] = p.walk.support := by
    simpa [hdl] using Walk.support_dropLast_concat (p := p.walk) h
  have hnin : p.finish ∉ p.walk.support.dropLast := by
    intro hmem
    have hnodup := p.support_nodup
    rw [← hcat] at hnodup
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ (p.walk.support.dropLast ++ [p.finish]).count p.finish := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ p.walk.support.dropLast.count p.finish :=
        List.count_pos_iff.mpr hmem
      have h2 : ([p.finish] : List V).count p.finish = 1 := by simp
      rw [List.count_append, h2]
      omega
    have : (p.walk.support.dropLast ++ [p.finish]).count p.finish = 1 :=
      List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnodup (by simp)
    omega
  ext y
  simp [trimFinish, support, hdl, mem_erase, List.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨fun hxy => hnin (hxy ▸ hy), ?_⟩
    have : y ∈ p.walk.support.dropLast ++ [p.finish] := List.mem_append_left _ hy
    simpa [hcat] using this
  · intro ⟨hyne, hy⟩
    have : y ∈ p.walk.support.dropLast ++ [p.finish] := by simpa [hcat] using hy
    exact (List.mem_append.1 this).resolve_right (by simp [hyne])

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimStart_finish
statement:
lemma trimStart_finish (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).finish = p.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimFinish_start
statement:
lemma trimFinish_start (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimFinish h).start = p.start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_le
statement:
lemma length_deleteVertex_le (p : GraphPath G) (x : V) :
    (p.deleteVertex x).length ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold deleteVertex
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_one_of_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  simp [deleteVertex, hx]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_le_one_of_endpoint
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · simp [deleteVertex, h, start_mem_support]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · simp [deleteVertex, h, finish_mem_support]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.not_nil_of_internal
statement:
lemma not_nil_of_internal {p : GraphPath G} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hs : x ≠ p.start) : ¬ p.walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : x = p.start := by
    simpa [support_eq_singleton_of_nil p h] using hx
  exact hs this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_two_of_internal
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ p.walk.Nil := not_nil_of_internal hx hs
  simp [deleteVertex, hx, hnil, hs, hf]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hx' := mem_walk_support.1 hx
  have hyL : y ∈ (p.walk.takeUntil x hx').support := by
    simpa [takeUntil, support, List.mem_toFinset] using (mem_inter.1 hy).1
  have hyR : y ∈ (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support := by
    simpa [dropUntil, support, List.mem_toFinset] using (mem_inter.1 hy).2
  by_cases hnilR : (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').Nil
  · have : (p.dropUntil hx).support = {x} := by
      have := support_eq_singleton_of_nil (p.dropUntil hx) (by simpa [dropUntil] using hnilR)
      simpa [dropUntil] using this
    have : y = x := by
      have hyR' := (mem_inter.1 hy).2
      simpa [this] using hyR'
    simp [this]
  · have htail :
        (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').tail.support = (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support.tail :=
      Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil _ hnilR
    have hcons :
        x :: (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support.tail = (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support := by
      simpa [htail] using Walk.cons_support_tail (p := p.walk.dropUntil x hx') hnilR
    have happend :
        (p.walk.takeUntil x hx').support ++ (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support.tail =
          p.walk.support := by
      rw [← Walk.support_append, Walk.take_spec]
    by_cases hyx : y = x
    · simp [hyx]
    · have hyTail : y ∈ (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support.tail := by
        have : y ∈ x :: (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support.tail := by
          simpa [hcons] using hyR
        exact (List.mem_cons.1 this).resolve_left hyx
      have hyP : y ∈ p.walk.support := by
        rw [← happend]
        exact List.mem_append.2 (.inl hyL)
      have hcnt : p.walk.support.count y = 1 :=
        List.count_eq_one_of_mem p.support_nodup hyP
      rw [← happend, List.count_append] at hcnt
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (p.walk.takeUntil x hx').support.count y :=
        List.count_pos_iff.mpr hyL
      have h2 : 1 ≤ (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').support.tail.count y :=
        List.count_pos_iff.mpr hyTail
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_internal_pieces
statement:
lemma disjoint_internal_pieces (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support)
    (hs : x ≠ p.start) (hf : x ≠ p.finish) :
    Disjoint
      ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
        (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support
      ((p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
        (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hnil =>
    hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil)
  have hR : ¬ (p.dropUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hnil =>
    hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil)
  rw [support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hL, support_trimStart (p.dropUntil hx) hR]
  change Disjoint ((p.takeUntil hx).support.erase x) ((p.dropUntil hx).support.erase x)
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  ext y
  simp [mem_erase]
  intro hyA hyx hyB
  have hy : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_inter.2 ⟨hyA, hyB⟩
  have : y ∈ ({x} : Finset V) :=
    inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset p hx hy
  exact hyx (mem_singleton.1 this)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.union_internal_pieces
statement:
lemma union_internal_pieces (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support)
    (hs : x ≠ p.start) (hf : x ≠ p.finish) :
    ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
        (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support ∪
      ((p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
