        (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support =
      p.support.erase x
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hnil =>
    hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil)
  have hR : ¬ (p.dropUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hnil =>
    hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil)
  rw [support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hL, support_trimStart (p.dropUntil hx) hR]
  change (p.takeUntil hx).support.erase x ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support.erase x =
    p.support.erase x
  rw [← erase_union_distrib, support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_deleteVertex_support_iff
statement:
lemma mem_deleteVertex_support_iff (p : GraphPath G) (x y : V) :
    (∃ q ∈ p.deleteVertex x, y ∈ q.support) ↔ y ∈ p.support.erase x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨q, hq, hy⟩
    unfold deleteVertex at hq
    split_ifs at hq with hx hnil hs hf
    · cases hq
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq
      subst hq
      simpa [support_trimStart, hs] using hy
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq
      subst hq
      simpa [support_trimFinish, hf] using hy
    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hq
      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
      · have thisEq := union_internal_pieces p hx hs hf
        have hy' :
            y ∈ ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
              (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support ∪
              ((p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
                (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support :=
          mem_union.2 (.inl hy)
        simpa [thisEq] using hy'
      · have thisEq := union_internal_pieces p hx hs hf
        have hy' :
            y ∈ ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
              (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support ∪
              ((p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
                (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support :=
          mem_union.2 (.inr hy)
        simpa [thisEq] using hy'
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq
      subst hq
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hxy => hx (hxy ▸ hy), hy⟩
  · intro hy
    unfold deleteVertex
    split_ifs with hx hnil hs hf
    · have : p.support = {x} := by
        have := support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
        have hx' : x = p.start := by simpa [this] using hx
        simp [this, hx']
      rw [this] at hy
      simp at hy
    · refine ⟨p.trimStart hnil, by simp, ?_⟩
      simpa [support_trimStart, hs, mem_erase] using hy
    · refine ⟨p.trimFinish hnil, by simp, ?_⟩
      simpa [support_trimFinish, hf, mem_erase] using hy
    · have hL := union_internal_pieces p hx hs hf
      have : y ∈
          ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
            (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support ∪
          ((p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
            (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).support := by
        simpa [hL] using hy
      rcases mem_union.1 this with h | h
      · exact ⟨_, by simp, h⟩
      · exact ⟨_, by simp, h⟩
    · refine ⟨p, by simp, ?_⟩
      exact (mem_erase.1 hy).2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex
statement:
lemma support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex {p : GraphPath G} {x : V} {q : GraphPath G}
    (hq : q ∈ p.deleteVertex x) : q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : y ∈ p.support.erase x := (mem_deleteVertex_support_iff p x y).1 ⟨q, hq, hy⟩
  exact mem_of_mem_erase this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pairwise_deleteVertex
statement:
lemma pairwise_deleteVertex (p : GraphPath G) (x : V) :
    (p.deleteVertex x).Pairwise fun q r => Disjoint q.support r.support
proof:
:= by
  unfold deleteVertex
  split_ifs with hx hnil hs hf
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp [List.pairwise_cons, disjoint_internal_pieces p hx hs hf]
  · simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_mem_deleteVertex_endpoint
proof:
:= by
  unfold deleteVertex
  split_ifs with hx hnil hs hf
  · have hy' : y = p.start := by
      have heq : p.start = p.finish := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 hnil
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact hy
      · exact hy.trans heq.symm
    have hx' : x = p.start := by
      simpa [support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil] using hx
    exact (hne (hy'.trans hx'.symm)).elim
  · refine ⟨p.trimStart hnil, by simp, ?_⟩
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact (hne (hy.trans hs.symm)).elim
    · exact .inr (hy.trans (trimStart_finish p hnil).symm)
  · refine ⟨p.trimFinish hnil, by simp, ?_⟩
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact .inl (hy.trans (trimFinish_start p hnil).symm)
    · exact (hne (hy.trans hf.symm)).elim
  · rcases hy with hy | hy
    · refine ⟨(p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
        (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil)), by simp, ?_⟩
      exact .inl (hy.trans (trimFinish_start (p.takeUntil hx)
        (fun hnil => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).symm)
    · refine ⟨(p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
        (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil)), by simp, ?_⟩
      exact .inr (hy.trans (trimStart_finish (p.dropUntil hx)
        (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hnil))).symm)
  · exact ⟨p, by simp, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.distinctPathGraph_eq_bot_of_pathCoverNumber_le_one
statement:
lemma distinctPathGraph_eq_bot_of_pathCoverNumber_le_one {U : Finset V}
    (h : pathCoverNumber G U ≤ 1) : distinctPathGraph (G := G) U = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  constructor
  · intro hAdj
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, q, hq, hne, _, _⟩ := hAdj.2
    have hlen : pc.paths.length ≤ 1 := by
      have : pc.card ≤ 1 := hpc ▸ h
      simpa [PathCover.card] using this
    have : p = q := by
      match hps : pc.paths with
      | [] =>
        simp [hps] at hp
      | [r] =>
        simp [hps] at hp hq
        simp [hp, hq]
      | r₁ :: r₂ :: rest =>
        have : pc.paths.length ≥ 2 := by simp [hps]
        omega
    exact (hne this).elim
  · intro hAdj
    cases hAdj

name: Nikoghosyan.spanningPathGraph_eq_bot_of_card_le_one
statement:
lemma spanningPathGraph_eq_bot_of_card_le_one {U : Finset V} (hU : U.card ≤ 1) :
    spanningPathGraph (G := G) U = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  constructor
  · intro hAdj
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hends⟩ := hAdj.2
    have hsf : p.start ≠ p.finish := by
      rcases hends with ⟨hs, hf⟩ | ⟨hs, hf⟩
      · rw [hs, hf]; exact hAdj.1
      · rw [hs, hf]; exact hAdj.1.symm
    have h2 : 2 ≤ p.support.card := by
      have hs : p.start ∈ p.support := p.start_mem_support
      have hf : p.finish ∈ p.support := p.finish_mem_support
      have : ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V) ⊆ p.support := by
        intro z hz
        simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hz
        rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
      have hcard : ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
        simp [card_insert_of_notMem, hsf]
      exact hcard.symm.trans_le (card_le_card this)
    have : 2 ≤ U.card := by simpa [hp] using h2
    omega
  · intro hAdj
    cases hAdj

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_le_pathCover_card
statement:
lemma componentCount_le_pathCover_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    componentCount G U ≤ pc.card
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin pc.paths.length → (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := fun i =>
    (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨(pc.paths.get i).start,
        pc.support_subset (List.mem_iff_get.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩) (pc.paths.get i).start_mem_support⟩
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x.1).1 x.2
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.1 hp
    refine ⟨i, ConnectedComponent.sound ?_⟩
    have hsupp : p.support ⊆ U := pc.support_subset hp
    have hxsup : x.1 ∈ p.walk.support := GraphPath.mem_walk_support.1 hxp
    let w := p.walk.takeUntil x.1 hxsup
    have hwU : ∀ a ∈ w.support, a ∈ (U : Set V) := fun a ha =>
      hsupp (List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.support_takeUntil_subset_support p.walk hxsup ha))
    have hR : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨p.start, hsupp p.start_mem_support⟩ x :=
      ⟨w.induce (U : Set V) hwU⟩
    have heq :
        (⟨(pc.paths.get i).start,
            pc.support_subset (List.mem_iff_get.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
              (pc.paths.get i).start_mem_support⟩ : (U : Set V)) =
          ⟨p.start, hsupp p.start_mem_support⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (congrArg GraphPath.start hi)
    rw [heq]
    exact hR
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  simpa [componentCount, PathCover.card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] using
    Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber
statement:
lemma componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber (U : Finset V) :
    componentCount G U ≤ pathCoverNumber G U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
  simpa [hpc] using componentCount_le_pathCover_card pc

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem
statement:
lemma pairwise_disjoint_of_mem {l : List (GraphPath G)}
    (h : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ l) (hq : q ∈ l) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    Disjoint p.support q.support
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => cases hp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hp hq
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · rcases hq with rfl | hq
      · exact (hne rfl).elim
      · exact h'.1 q hq
    · rcases hq with rfl | hq
      · exact (h'.1 p hp).symm
      · exact ih h'.2 hp hq

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_of_forall_not_mem
statement:
lemma length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_of_forall_not_mem
    (l : List (GraphPath G)) (x : V)
    (h : ∀ p ∈ l, x ∉ p.support) :
    (l.flatMap fun p => p.deleteVertex x).length = l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp : x ∉ p.support := h p (by simp)
    have hps : ∀ q ∈ ps, x ∉ q.support := fun q hq =>
      h q (by simp [hq])
    simp [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, Nat.add_comm,
      GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_one_of_not_mem p hp, ih hps]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_flatMap_deleteVertex_le
statement:
lemma length_flatMap_deleteVertex_le {l : List (GraphPath G)} (x : V)
    (h : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (l.flatMap fun p => p.deleteVertex x).length ≤ l.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ p.support
    · have hps : ∀ q ∈ ps, x ∉ q.support := by
        intro q hq hxq
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (h'.1 q hq) hx hxq).elim
      have hpslen :
          (ps.flatMap fun q => q.deleteVertex x).length = ps.length :=
        length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_of_forall_not_mem ps x hps
      have : (p.deleteVertex x).length ≤ 2 := GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_le p x
      omega
    · have hp : (p.deleteVertex x).length = 1 :=
        GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_one_of_not_mem p hx
      have : (ps.flatMap fun q => q.deleteVertex x).length ≤ ps.length + 1 :=
        ih h'.2
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_flatMap_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint
statement:
lemma length_flatMap_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint {l : List (GraphPath G)} {x : V}
    (h : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hep : ∃ p ∈ l, x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish) :
    (l.flatMap fun p => p.deleteVertex x).length ≤ l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    rcases hep with ⟨_, hnil, _⟩
    cases hnil
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    rcases hep with ⟨q, hq, hxend⟩
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hq
    rcases hq with hqp | hq
    · have hlen : (q.deleteVertex x).length ≤ 1 :=
        GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_le_one_of_endpoint q hxend
      have hxsup : x ∈ p.support := by
        rcases hxend with hxs | hxf
        · simpa [hqp, hxs] using q.start_mem_support
        · simpa [hqp, hxf] using q.finish_mem_support
      have hps : ∀ r ∈ ps, x ∉ r.support := by
        intro r hr hxr
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (h'.1 r hr) hxsup hxr).elim
      have hpslen :
          (ps.flatMap fun r => r.deleteVertex x).length = ps.length :=
        length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_of_forall_not_mem ps x hps
      have : (p.deleteVertex x).length ≤ 1 := by simpa [hqp] using hlen
      omega
    · have hxnp : x ∉ p.support := by
        intro hxp
        have hxq : x ∈ q.support := by
          rcases hxend with rfl | rfl
          · exact q.start_mem_support
          · exact q.finish_mem_support
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (h'.1 q hq) hxp hxq).elim
      have hp : (p.deleteVertex x).length = 1 :=
        GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_one_of_not_mem p hxnp
      have : (ps.flatMap fun r => r.deleteVertex x).length ≤ ps.length :=
        ih h'.2 ⟨q, hq, hxend⟩
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.pairwise_flatMap_deleteVertex
statement:
lemma pairwise_flatMap_deleteVertex {l : List (GraphPath G)} (x : V)
    (h : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (l.flatMap fun p => p.deleteVertex x).Pairwise
      fun a b => Disjoint a.support b.support
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rw [List.flatMap_cons]
    refine List.pairwise_append.mpr ⟨GraphPath.pairwise_deleteVertex p x, ih h'.2, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hbq⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hb
    have da := GraphPath.support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex ha
    have db := GraphPath.support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex hbq
    exact (h'.1 q hq).mono da db

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_deleteVertex_le
statement:
lemma card_deleteVertex_le {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) (x : V) :
    (pc.deleteVertex x).card ≤ pc.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [deleteVertex, card] using length_flatMap_deleteVertex_le x pc.disjoint

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint
statement:
lemma card_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {x : V} (h : pc.IsEndpoint x) :
    (pc.deleteVertex x).card ≤ pc.card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [deleteVertex, card] using
    length_flatMap_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint pc.disjoint h

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_add_one_of_internal
statement:
lemma length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_add_one_of_internal
    {l : List (GraphPath G)} {x : V}
    (h : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ l)
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hs : x ≠ p.start) (hf : x ≠ p.finish) :
    (l.flatMap fun q => GraphPath.deleteVertex q x).length = l.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => cases hp
  | cons a ps ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hp
    rcases hp with hap | hp
    · have hlen : (GraphPath.deleteVertex a x).length = 2 := by
        simpa [hap] using GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_two_of_internal p hx hs hf
      have hps : ∀ r ∈ ps, x ∉ r.support := by
        intro r hr hxr
        have hxsup : x ∈ a.support := by simpa [hap] using hx
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (h'.1 r hr) hxsup hxr).elim
      have hpslen :
          (ps.flatMap fun r => GraphPath.deleteVertex r x).length = ps.length :=
        length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_of_forall_not_mem ps x hps
      omega
    · have hxna : x ∉ a.support := by
        intro hxa
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (h'.1 p hp) hxa hx).elim
      have ha : (GraphPath.deleteVertex a x).length = 1 :=
        GraphPath.length_deleteVertex_eq_one_of_not_mem a hxna
      have : (ps.flatMap fun r => GraphPath.deleteVertex r x).length =
          ps.length + 1 := ih h'.2 hp
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_deleteVertex_eq_add_one_of_internal
statement:
lemma card_deleteVertex_eq_add_one_of_internal {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (h : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, x ≠ p.start ∧ x ≠ p.finish) :
    (pc.deleteVertex x).card = pc.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
  have hs := (h p hp).1
  have hf := (h p hp).2
  simpa [deleteVertex, card] using
    length_flatMap_deleteVertex_eq_add_one_of_internal pc.disjoint hp hxp hs hf

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.IsEndpoint_deleteVertex
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hyend⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqend⟩ := GraphPath.exists_mem_deleteVertex_endpoint p hyend hne
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hqend⟩
  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨p, hp, hq⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.ofPath_card
statement: lemma ofPath_card (p : GraphPath G) : (ofPath p).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofPath, card]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_erase_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_erase_le (U : Finset V) (x : V) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U.erase x) ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (pc.deleteVertex x)
  have hcard := pc.card_deleteVertex_le x
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_erase_le_of_eligible
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, hx⟩ := h
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (pc.deleteVertex x)
  have hcard := pc.card_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint ⟨p, hp, hx⟩
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le (U X : Finset V) (hX : X ⊆ U) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U \ X) ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + X.card
proof:
:= by
  induction X using Finset.induction generalizing U with
  | empty =>
    simp
  | insert x X hx ih =>
    have hxU : x ∈ U := hX (mem_insert_self x X)
    have hXsub : X ⊆ U.erase x := by
      intro y hy
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hxy => hx (hxy ▸ hy), hX (mem_insert_of_mem hy)⟩
    have hEq : U \ insert x X = U.erase x \ X := by
      rw [sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_distrib, erase_eq_of_notMem hx]
    rw [hEq]
    have h1 := ih (U := U.erase x) hXsub
    have h2 := pathCoverNumber_erase_le (G := G) U x
    have hcard : (insert x X).card = X.card + 1 := card_insert_of_notMem hx
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_of_eligible
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_of_eligible {U X : Finset V} (hX : X ⊆ U)
    {x : V} (hxX : x ∈ X) (hE : Eligible G U x) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U \ X) ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + X.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : U \ X = U.erase x \ X.erase x := by
    have : x ∉ U \ X := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 h).2 hxX
    rw [← erase_sdiff_distrib, erase_eq_of_notMem this]
  rw [hEq]
  have hsub : X.erase x ⊆ U.erase x := by
    intro y hy
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hy).1, hX (mem_of_mem_erase hy)⟩
  have h1 := pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le (G := G) (U.erase x) (X.erase x) hsub
  have h2 := pathCoverNumber_erase_le_of_eligible (G := G) hE
  have hcard : (X.erase x).card = X.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hxX
  have hpos : 1 ≤ X.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hxX⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_sdiff_le
statement:
lemma componentCount_sdiff_le (U X : Finset V) (hX : X ⊆ U) :
    componentCount G (U \ X) ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + X.card
proof:
:=
  (componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber (U \ X)).trans
    (pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le U X hX)

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_erase_le
statement:
lemma componentCount_erase_le (U : Finset V) (x : V) :
    componentCount G (U.erase x) ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · simpa [sdiff_singleton_eq_erase] using
      componentCount_sdiff_le U {x} (singleton_subset_iff.2 hx)
  · have : U.erase x = U := erase_eq_of_notMem hx
    have h := componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber (G := G) U
    simpa [this] using h.trans (Nat.le_succ _)

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible
statement:
lemma componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible {U X : Finset V} (hX : X ⊆ U)
    {x : V} (hxX : x ∈ X) (hE : Eligible G U x) :
    componentCount G (U \ X) ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + X.card - 1
proof:
:=
  (componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber (U \ X)).trans
    (pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_of_eligible hX hxX hE)

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_erase_le_of_eligible
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ U := hE.mem
  have h := componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible (singleton_subset_iff.2 hx)
    (mem_singleton_self x) hE
  simpa [sdiff_singleton_eq_erase, card_singleton] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible
statement:
lemma eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible {U X : Finset V} (hX : X ⊆ U)
    (heq : componentCount G (U \ X) = pathCoverNumber G U + X.card) :
    X ⊆ ineligibleSet G U
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).mpr ⟨hX hx, ?_⟩
  intro hE
  have hle := componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible hX hx hE
  have hpos : 1 ≤ X.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hx⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.eq_cut_bound_singleton_imp_ineligible
statement:
lemma eq_cut_bound_singleton_imp_ineligible {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U)
    (heq : componentCount G (U.erase x) = pathCoverNumber G U + 1) :
    x ∈ ineligibleSet G U
proof:
:= by
  have := eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible (singleton_subset_iff.2 hx)
    (by simpa [sdiff_singleton_eq_erase, card_singleton] using heq)
  simpa using this

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff (U : Finset V) :
    pathCoverNumber G U = 0 ↔ U = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
    have hlen : pc.paths.length = 0 := by
      simpa [PathCover.card] using hpc.trans h
    have hp : pc.paths = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hlen
    ext z
    simp [pc.mem_iff, hp]
  · intro h
    subst h
    exact pathCoverNumber_empty (G := G)

name: Nikoghosyan.one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty {U : Finset V} (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G U
proof:
:= by
  have : pathCoverNumber G U ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hU.ne_empty ((pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff (G := G) U).1 h)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.SpanningPathCompatible.eligible_left
statement:
lemma SpanningPathCompatible.eligible_left {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (h : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y) : Eligible G U x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_hne, p, hp, hends⟩ := h
  subst hp
  have hxend : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish := by
    rcases hends with h | h
    · exact .inl h.1.symm
    · exact .inr h.2.symm
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G p.support ≤ 1 := by
    simpa [PathCover.ofPath_card] using
      pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (PathCover.ofPath p)
  have hpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G p.support := by
    refine one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty ⟨x, ?_⟩
    rcases hxend with rfl | rfl
    · exact p.start_mem_support
    · exact p.finish_mem_support
  refine ⟨PathCover.ofPath p, ?_, p, List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl, hxend⟩
  rw [PathCover.ofPath_card, le_antisymm hle hpos]

name: Nikoghosyan.SpanningPathCompatible.eligible_right

name: Nikoghosyan.three_le_card_of_min_nonHamiltonian
statement:
theorem three_le_card_of_min_nonHamiltonian
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (_hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    3 ≤ F.card
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ F.card := F.one_le_card hord
  have hne1 : F.card ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hNonHam (F.isHamiltonian_of_card_one h)
  have hne2 : F.card ≠ 2 := by
    intro h
    exact hNonHam (two_cycle_factor_isHamiltonian hT hord hpat F h)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_noncograph_block_of_min
statement:
theorem exists_noncograph_block_of_min
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    ∃ i : Fin F.card, ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support := by
    intro i
    by_contra hi
    exact hnone ⟨i, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := all_cograph_hamiltonian hT hord hpat F hmin hcog
  exact hNonHam ((isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).2 ⟨c, hc⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.not_two_noncograph_of_min
statement:
theorem not_two_noncograph_of_min
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hD : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle j).support) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    exists_original_cycle_of_two_noncograph_cycles
      (F.getCycle i) (F.getCycle j) (F.disjoint_getCycle hij) hpat hH hD
  exact not_exists_union_cycle_of_min F hmin hij C hC

name: Nikoghosyan.existsUnique_noncograph_block_of_min
statement:
theorem existsUnique_noncograph_block_of_min
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    ∃! i : Fin F.card, ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_noncograph_block_of_min hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  by_contra hne
  exact not_two_noncograph_of_min hpat F hmin (Ne.symm hne) hi hj

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_of_ne_unique_core
statement:
theorem isCograph_of_ne_unique_core
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian)
    {i j : Fin F.card}
    (hi : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    IsCograph G (F.getCycle j).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, huniq⟩ :=
    existsUnique_noncograph_block_of_min hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
  have hik : i = k := huniq i hi
  by_contra hj
  have hjk : j = k := huniq j hj
  exact hij (hik.trans hjk.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.satellite_not_allstrict_of_min
statement:
theorem satellite_not_allstrict_of_min
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (_hH : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hstrict : ∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
          IsCograph G
              ((F.getCycle i).support \
                rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
            pathCoverNumber G
                ((F.getCycle i).support \
                  rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) <
              (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).card) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  set cH := F.getCycle i
  set cD := F.getCycle j
  have hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support := F.disjoint_getCycle hij
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _⟩ := exists_path_open_succ cD cD.start_mem_support
  have hdisj' : Disjoint cH.support r.support := by simpa [hr] using hdisj
  have hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G cH.support (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hvD : v ∈ cD.support := by simpa [hr] using hv
    obtain ⟨hAne, _hcog, hlt⟩ := hstrict v hvD
    refine ⟨hAne, ?_⟩
    exact (noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover_of_host
      cH r hdisj' hv hAne hpat).2 hlt
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
    exists_original_cycle_of_hamiltonian_prefix_of_global
      cH r hdisj' hrow hpat
  have hspan : γ.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support := by simpa [hr] using hγ
  exact not_exists_union_cycle_of_min F hmin hij γ hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.satellite_saturated_common_gate_of_min
statement:
theorem satellite_saturated_common_gate_of_min
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    ∃ S : Finset V,
      Cograph.Tight (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support S ∧
        S ⊂ (F.getCycle i).support ∧
          (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
            (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
              IsCograph G
                  ((F.getCycle i).support \
                    rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
                  (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                  Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G)
                      (F.getCycle i).support
                      (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) =
                    S ∧
                    rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v ⊆ S) ∧
            (∀ x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support, ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
              G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  rcases pair_profile_dichotomy_of_min F hmin hpat hij hH with hstrict | hsat
  · exact (satellite_not_allstrict_of_min hpat F hmin hij hH hstrict).elim
  · exact hsat

name: Nikoghosyan.satellite_adjacent_rows_incompatible_of_min
statement:
theorem satellite_adjacent_rows_incompatible_of_min
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {u : V} (hu : u ∈ (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hSat :
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
          (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support u) ∨
        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
          (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
            ((F.getCycle j).succAt hu))) :
    Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support u) ∧
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
          ((F.getCycle j).succAt hu)) ∧
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
          (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support u) =
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
          (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
            ((F.getCycle j).succAt hu))
proof:
:=
  adjacent_rows_incompatible (F.getCycle i) (F.getCycle j)
    (F.disjoint_getCycle hij) hH hpat
    (fun C hC => not_exists_union_cycle_of_min F hmin hij C hC) hu hSat

name: Nikoghosyan.min_factor_normal_form_core
statement:
theorem min_factor_normal_form_core
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    3 ≤ F.card ∧
      ∃ i : Fin F.card,
        (¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) ∧
          (∀ j : Fin F.card, j ≠ i →
            IsCograph G (F.getCycle j).support) ∧
          ∀ j : Fin F.card, j ≠ i →
            ∃ S : Finset V,
              Cograph.Tight (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support S ∧
                S ⊂ (F.getCycle i).support ∧
                  (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
                    (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
                      IsCograph G
                          ((F.getCycle i).support \
                            rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
                          (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G)
                              (F.getCycle i).support
                              (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) =
                            S ∧
                            rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v ⊆ S) ∧
                    (∀ x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support,
                      ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle j).support, G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨three_le_card_of_min_nonHamiltonian hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, huniq⟩ :=
    existsUnique_noncograph_block_of_min hT hord hpat F hmin hNonHam
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    by_contra hnc
    exact hj (huniq j hnc)
  · intro j hj
    exact satellite_saturated_common_gate_of_min hpat F hmin (Ne.symm hj) hi

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.length_eq_one_of_mem_edges_start_finish
statement:
lemma length_eq_one_of_mem_edges_start_finish :
    ∀ (p : GraphPath G), s(p.start, p.finish) ∈ p.walk.edges → p.walk.length = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro p he
  rcases p with ⟨start, finish, walk, isPath⟩
  change s(start, finish) ∈ walk.edges at he
  have hneSF : start ≠ finish := by
    intro heq
    subst heq
    have : walk.Nil := (Walk.isPath_iff_nil).1 isPath
    cases this
    simp at he
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hp⟩ := Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hneSF walk
  subst hp
  have hq : q.IsPath ∧ start ∉ q.support := (Walk.cons_isPath_iff hadj q).1 isPath
  have he' : s(start, finish) = s(start, w) ∨ s(start, finish) ∈ q.edges :=
    List.mem_cons.1 he
  rcases he' with hfirst | hrest
  · have hfin : w = finish := by
      obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩ := Sym2.eq_iff.mp hfirst
      · exact h2.symm
      · exact (hneSF h2.symm).elim
    subst hfin
    have hlen0 : q.length = 0 :=
      Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.2 ((Walk.isPath_iff_nil).1 hq.1)
    simp [hlen0]
  · exact (hq.2 (q.mem_support_of_mem_edges hrest (by simp))).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.isHamiltonianCycle_of_support_eq_univ

  refine ⟨c.isCycle, ?_⟩
  have hlen : c.walk.length = c.support.card := c.card_support.symm
  have hcard : c.support.card = Fintype.card V := by simp [h]

name: Nikoghosyan.isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle

  constructor
  · intro hH
    have hne : Fintype.card V ≠ 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨a, w, hw⟩ := hH hne
    refine ⟨⟨a, w, hw.isCycle⟩, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp [GraphCycle.support, hw.mem_support x]
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact c.isHamiltonian_of_support_eq_univ hc

name: Nikoghosyan.connectedComponent_disjoint_supp
statement:
lemma connectedComponent_disjoint_supp {c d : G.ConnectedComponent} (h : c ≠ d) :
    Disjoint c.supp d.supp
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
  intro x hx
  apply h
  simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hx
  rw [← hx.1, hx.2]

name: Nikoghosyan.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem
statement:
lemma pairwise_disjoint_of_mem {α} {s : α → Finset V} {l : List α}
    (h : l.Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint (s a) (s b))
    {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ l) (hb : b ∈ l) (hne : a ≠ b) :
    Disjoint (s a) (s b)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a b with
  | nil => cases ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.1 h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha' <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb'
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · exact h'.1 b hb'
    · exact (h'.1 a ha').symm
    · exact ih h'.2 ha' hb' hne

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_graphCycle_of_component
statement:
lemma exists_graphCycle_of_component (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v : V, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2)
    (c : F.spanningCoe.ConnectedComponent) :
    ∃ cy : GraphCycle G, (cy.support : Set V) = c.supp
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := connectedComponent_supp_nonempty (G := F.spanningCoe) c
  have hn : (F.spanningCoe.neighborSet v).Nonempty := by
    simpa [spanningCoe_neighborSet] using neighborSet_nonempty_of_degree_two hdeg v
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hverts⟩ :=
    (isCycles_of_degree_two hdeg).exists_cycle_toSubgraph_verts_eq_connectedComponentSupp hv hn
  refine ⟨⟨v, p.mapLe F.spanningCoe_le, (Walk.isCycle_mapLe F.spanningCoe_le).2 hp⟩, ?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x ∈ p.support := by
      simpa [GraphCycle.support, Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support] using hx
    have : x ∈ p.toSubgraph.verts := (Walk.mem_verts_toSubgraph p).2 hx'
    exact hverts ▸ this
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ p.toSubgraph.verts := hverts ▸ hx
    have hx' : x ∈ p.support := (Walk.mem_verts_toSubgraph p).1 this
    simpa [GraphCycle.support, Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support] using hx'

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_graphCycleOfComponent_support
statement:
lemma mem_graphCycleOfComponent_support (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v : V, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2)
    (c : F.spanningCoe.ConnectedComponent) {x : V} :
    x ∈ (graphCycleOfComponent F hdeg c).support ↔ x ∈ c.supp
proof:
:= by
  have h := Classical.choose_spec (exists_graphCycle_of_component F hdeg c)
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ ((graphCycleOfComponent F hdeg c).support : Set V) := hx
    exact h ▸ this
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ ((graphCycleOfComponent F hdeg c).support : Set V) := h ▸ hx
    exact this

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.eq_of_mem_support
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have : Disjoint c.support d.support :=
    pairwise_disjoint_of_mem (s := fun c : GraphCycle G => c.support) F.disjoint hc hd hne
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 this hxc hxd

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.toSubgraph_isSpanning
statement: lemma toSubgraph_isSpanning (F : CycleFactor G) : F.toSubgraph.IsSpanning
proof:
:=
  fun _ => trivial

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.toSubgraph_ncard_eq_two
statement:
lemma toSubgraph_ncard_eq_two (F : CycleFactor G) (x : V) :
    (F.toSubgraph.neighborSet x).ncard = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ := F.mem_iff x
  have hxL : x ∈ c.walk.support := by simpa [GraphCycle.support] using hx
  have hneigh :
      F.toSubgraph.neighborSet x = c.walk.toSubgraph.neighborSet x := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hadj⟩ := hy
      have hxD : x ∈ d.support := by
        have : x ∈ d.walk.toSubgraph.verts := d.walk.toSubgraph.edge_vert hadj
        simpa [GraphCycle.support, List.mem_toFinset, Walk.mem_verts_toSubgraph] using this
      have : d = c := F.eq_of_mem_support hd hc hxD hx
      subst this
      exact hadj
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨c, hc, hy⟩
  rw [hneigh]
  exact Walk.IsCycle.ncard_neighborSet_toSubgraph_eq_two c.isCycle hxL

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.toSubgraph_isSpanningDegreeTwo
statement:
lemma toSubgraph_isSpanningDegreeTwo (F : CycleFactor G) :
    IsSpanningDegreeTwo F.toSubgraph
proof:
:=
  ⟨F.toSubgraph_isSpanning, F.toSubgraph_ncard_eq_two⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycleFactor_iff_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
lemma exists_cycleFactor_iff_spanningDegreeTwo :
    Nonempty (CycleFactor G) ↔ ∃ F : G.Subgraph, IsSpanningDegreeTwo F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨CF⟩
    exact ⟨CF.toSubgraph, CF.toSubgraph_isSpanningDegreeTwo⟩
  · intro ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact ⟨CycleFactor.ofSpanningDegreeTwo hF⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycleFactor_of_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
lemma exists_cycleFactor_of_spanningDegreeTwo {F : G.Subgraph}

:=
  ⟨CycleFactor.ofSpanningDegreeTwo hF⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.nil_iff_card_support_eq_one
statement:
lemma nil_iff_card_support_eq_one (p : GraphPath G) :
    p.walk.Nil ↔ p.support.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [support_eq_singleton_of_nil p h] using (card_singleton p.start)
  · intro h
    have hlen : p.walk.length + 1 = 1 := by simpa [card_support] using h
    exact (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff).1 (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.two_le_card_support_iff
statement:
lemma two_le_card_support_iff (p : GraphPath G) :
    2 ≤ p.support.card ↔ ¬ p.walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hn
    have : p.support.card = 1 := (nil_iff_card_support_eq_one p).1 hn
    omega
  · intro h
    have hpos : 0 < p.walk.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 h
    have : 2 ≤ p.walk.length + 1 := by omega
    simpa [card_support] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_ne_finish_of_two_le_card_incidences
statement:
lemma start_ne_finish_of_two_le_card_incidences (p : GraphPath G) (h : 2 ≤ p.support.card) :
    p.start ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  exact (two_le_card_support_iff p).1 h ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).2 heq)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.two_le_card_of_start_ne_finish
statement:
lemma two_le_card_of_start_ne_finish (p : GraphPath G) (h : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    2 ≤ p.support.card
proof:
:=
  (two_le_card_support_iff p).2 fun hn => h ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 hn)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_support_of_mem_edge
statement:
lemma mem_support_of_mem_edge {p : GraphPath G} {e : Sym2 V} {v : V}
    (he : e ∈ p.edges) (hv : v ∈ e) : v ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  List.mem_toFinset.2 (p.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (mem_edges_iff.1 he) hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_subset_edges
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_subset_edges (p : GraphPath G) (v : V) :
    p.incidentEdges v ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_subset_AIncident
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_subset_AIncident (p : GraphPath G) {A : Finset V} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ A) : p.incidentEdges v ⊆ p.AIncident A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨(mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he).1,

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.first_edge_mem_incidences
statement:
lemma first_edge_mem_incidences (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    s(p.start, p.walk.snd) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:=
  mem_edges_iff.2 (p.walk.mk_start_snd_mem_edges h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.last_edge_mem
statement:
lemma last_edge_mem (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    s(p.walk.penultimate, p.finish) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:=
  mem_edges_iff.2 (p.walk.mk_penultimate_end_mem_edges h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_start
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_start (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.incidentEdges p.start = {s(p.start, p.walk.snd)}
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨heE, hse⟩ := mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he
    have heq : e = s(p.start, Sym2.Mem.other' hse) := (Sym2.other_spec' hse).symm
    have hw : Sym2.Mem.other' hse = p.walk.snd :=
      p.isPath.eq_snd_of_mem_edges (by
        rw [← heq]
        exact mem_edges_iff.1 heE)
    rw [heq, hw]
    exact mem_singleton_self _
  · intro he
    rw [mem_singleton] at he
    subst he
    exact mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨p.first_edge_mem_incidences h, by simp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_finish
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_finish (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.incidentEdges p.finish = {s(p.walk.penultimate, p.finish)}
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨heE, hse⟩ := mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 he
    have heq : e = s(p.finish, Sym2.Mem.other' hse) := (Sym2.other_spec' hse).symm
    have hw : Sym2.Mem.other' hse = p.walk.penultimate :=
      p.isPath.eq_penultimate_of_mem_edges (by
        rw [← heq]
        exact mem_edges_iff.1 heE)
    rw [heq, hw]
    simp
  · intro he
    rw [mem_singleton] at he
    subst he
    exact mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨p.last_edge_mem h, by simp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_card_start
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_card_start (p : GraphPath G) (h : 2 ≤ p.support.card) :
    (p.incidentEdges p.start).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.incidentEdges_start ((two_le_card_support_iff p).1 h), card_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_card_finish
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_card_finish (p : GraphPath G) (h : 2 ≤ p.support.card) :

proof:

  rw [p.incidentEdges_finish ((two_le_card_support_iff p).1 h), card_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_not_nil
statement:
lemma takeUntil_not_nil {p : GraphPath G} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support)
    (hne : x ≠ p.start) : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.walk_eq_take_append_drop_incidences
statement:
lemma walk_eq_take_append_drop_incidences (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    p.walk = (p.takeUntil hx).walk.append (p.dropUntil hx).walk
proof:
:= by
  simpa [takeUntil, dropUntil] using
    (Walk.take_spec p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hx)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_eq_takeUntil_union_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := mem_walk_support.1 hx
  have hspec := Walk.take_spec p.walk hx'
  have hedges : p.walk.edges =
      (p.walk.takeUntil x hx').edges ++ (p.walk.dropUntil x hx').edges :=
    (congrArg Walk.edges hspec.symm).trans
      (Walk.edges_append (p.walk.takeUntil x hx') (p.walk.dropUntil x hx'))
  simp [edges, takeUntil, dropUntil, hedges, List.toFinset_append]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_takeUntil_dropUntil_edges
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    p.isPath.isTrail.disjoint_edges_takeUntil_dropUntil (mem_walk_support.1 hx)
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro e heT heD
  exact h (mem_edges_iff.1 heT) (mem_edges_iff.1 heD)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_eq_take_union_drop
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_eq_take_union_drop (p : GraphPath G) {x v : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    p.incidentEdges v =
      (p.takeUntil hx).incidentEdges v ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).incidentEdges v
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidentEdges, p.edges_eq_takeUntil_union_dropUntil hx, filter_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_finish
statement:
lemma takeUntil_finish {p : GraphPath G} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :

proof:
:=

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_start
statement:
lemma dropUntil_start {p : GraphPath G} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :

proof:
:=

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_internal
proof:
:= by
  have hTnil := p.takeUntil_not_nil hv hs
  have hDnil := p.dropUntil_not_nil hv hf
  have hT := (p.takeUntil hv).incidentEdges_finish hTnil
  have hD := (p.dropUntil hv).incidentEdges_start hDnil
  have hU := p.incidentEdges_eq_take_union_drop (x := v) (v := v) hv
  have hTf : (p.takeUntil hv).finish = v := p.takeUntil_finish hv
  have hDs : (p.dropUntil hv).start = v := p.dropUntil_start hv
  have hT' : (p.takeUntil hv).incidentEdges v =
      {s((p.takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate, v)} := by
    simpa [hTf] using hT
  have hD' : (p.dropUntil hv).incidentEdges v =
      {s(v, (p.dropUntil hv).walk.snd)} := by
    simpa [hDs] using hD
  rw [hU, hT', hD']
  simp [singleton_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_card_internal
proof:
:= by
  have hTnil := p.takeUntil_not_nil hv hs
  have hDnil := p.dropUntil_not_nil hv hf
  have he1 : s((p.takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate, v) ∈ (p.takeUntil hv).edges := by
    simpa [p.takeUntil_finish hv] using (p.takeUntil hv).last_edge_mem hTnil
  have he2 : s(v, (p.dropUntil hv).walk.snd) ∈ (p.dropUntil hv).edges := by
    simpa [p.dropUntil_start hv] using (p.dropUntil hv).first_edge_mem_incidences hDnil
  have hne :
      s((p.takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate, v) ≠
        s(v, (p.dropUntil hv).walk.snd) := by
    intro heq
    exact (disjoint_left.1 (p.disjoint_takeUntil_dropUntil_edges hv) he1)
      (by simpa [heq] using he2)
  rw [p.incidentEdges_internal hv hs hf]
  exact card_pair hne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_card
statement:
theorem incidentEdges_card (p : GraphPath G) (h : 2 ≤ p.support.card) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    if v = p.start ∨ v = p.finish then (p.incidentEdges v).card = 1
    else (p.incidentEdges v).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : v = p.start
  · simp [hs, p.incidentEdges_card_start h]
  · by_cases hf : v = p.finish
    · simp [hf, p.incidentEdges_card_finish h]
    · simp [hs, hf, p.incidentEdges_card_internal hv hs hf]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pathSucc_eq_snd_dropUntil

lemma pathSucc_eq_snd_dropUntil (p : GraphPath G) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ p.support)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_internal_succ
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.incidentEdges_internal hv hs hf
  have : s(v, p.pathSucc hv hf) =
      s(v, (p.dropUntil hv).walk.snd) := by
    simp [pathSucc_eq_snd_dropUntil]
  rw [h, this]
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isSubwalk_trimStart_incidences
statement:
lemma isSubwalk_trimStart_incidences (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :

:= by
  rw [Walk.isSubwalk_iff_support_isInfix]
  have ht : (p.trimStart h).walk.support = p.walk.support.tail := by
    simp [trimStart, Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil p.walk h]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isSubwalk_trimFinish_incidences

    Walk.support_dropLast (p := p.walk) h
  rw [hdl]
  exact (List.dropLast_prefix p.walk.support).isInfix

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_empty
statement: lemma componentCount_empty : componentCount G ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [componentCount]

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_singleton
statement: lemma componentCount_singleton (v : V) : componentCount G {v} = 1
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set V := ({v} : Finset V)
  haveI : Unique s :=
    { default := ⟨v, mem_singleton_self v⟩
      uniq := by
        intro y
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [s] using y.property }
  haveI : Unique (G.induce s).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  simp [componentCount, s]

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_univ
statement:
lemma componentCount_univ :
    componentCount G univ = Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentCount, Finset.coe_univ]
  exact Nat.card_congr G.induceUnivIso.connectedComponentEquiv

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_union_le
statement:
lemma componentCount_union_le (A B : Finset V) :
    componentCount G (A ∪ B) ≤ componentCount G A + componentCount G B
proof:
:= by
  let f : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
        (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent
    | .inl C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))
    | .inr C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A)))
  have hf : Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun x => ?_
    rcases mem_union.mp x.property with hA | hB
    · refine ⟨.inl ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x.val, hA⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
    · refine ⟨.inr ((G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x.val, hB⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
  haveI : Fintype (A : Set V) := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (B : Set V) := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V) := inferInstance
  haveI : DecidableRel (G.induce (A : Set V)).Adj := inferInstance
  haveI : DecidableRel (G.induce (B : Set V)).Adj := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_insert_le
statement:
lemma componentCount_insert_le (U : Finset V) (u : V) :
    componentCount G (insert u U) ≤ componentCount G U + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [insert_eq]
  have h := componentCount_union_le G {u} U
  have hs := componentCount_singleton G u
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_insert_of_adj
proof:
:= by
  let f : (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((insert u U : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    fun C => C.map (induceIncl G (Finset.subset_insert u U))
  have hf : Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun x => ?_
    by_cases hx : x.val = u
    · refine ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
      apply ConnectedComponent.sound
      change (G.induce ((insert u U : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
          (induceIncl G (Finset.subset_insert u U) ⟨w, hw⟩) x
      have hw' :
          induceIncl G (Finset.subset_insert u U) ⟨w, hw⟩ =
            ⟨w, mem_insert_of_mem hw⟩ := rfl
      rw [hw']
      have hx' : (⟨u, mem_insert_self u U⟩ : ((insert u U : Finset V) : Set V)) = x :=
        Subtype.ext hx.symm
      rw [← hx']
      exact Adj.reachable <| by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj.symm
    · have hxU : x.val ∈ U := (mem_insert.mp x.property).resolve_left hx
      refine ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x.val, hxU⟩, ?_⟩
      apply ConnectedComponent.sound
      have : induceIncl G (Finset.subset_insert u U) ⟨x.val, hxU⟩ = x :=
        Subtype.ext rfl
      simpa [this] using Reachable.rfl
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCograph.subset
statement:
lemma IsCograph.subset {U W : Finset V} (hW : IsCograph G W) (hUW : U ⊆ W) :
    IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd
  exact hW (hUW ha) (hUW hb) (hUW hc) (hUW hd)

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCograph.empty
statement: lemma IsCograph.empty : IsCograph G ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ _ _ ha
  exact (notMem_empty a ha).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.NoInducedP4UnionP1.isCograph_antineighbors
statement:
lemma NoInducedP4UnionP1.isCograph_antineighbors
    (h : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (v : V) :
    IsCograph G (antineighbors G v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have ha' := mem_filter.mp ha
  have hb' := mem_filter.mp hb
  have hc' := mem_filter.mp hc
  have hd' := mem_filter.mp hd
  have hx :
      ¬ (G.Adj v a ∨ G.Adj v b ∨ G.Adj v c ∨ G.Adj v d) := by
    simp [ha'.2.2, hb'.2.2, hc'.2.2, hd'.2.2]
  exact hx <| h hp ha'.2.1.symm hb'.2.1.symm hc'.2.1.symm hd'.2.1.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.NoInducedP4UnionP1.isCograph_componentFinset
statement:
lemma NoInducedP4UnionP1.isCograph_componentFinset
    (h : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {U : Finset V}
    (hdc : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (C : (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    IsCograph G (componentFinset G U C)
proof:
:= by
  have hVne : Nonempty (U : Set V) := C.ind fun x => ⟨x⟩
  have hpre : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Preconnected := by
    intro hp
    exact hdc ((connected_iff _).2 ⟨hp, hVne⟩)
  have hnt : Nontrivial (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := by
    rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]
    intro hsub
    exact hpre fun x y => ConnectedComponent.exact (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_ne C
  obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxD⟩ :
      ∃ (x : V) (hxU : x ∈ U),
        (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxU⟩ = D := by
    refine D.ind fun z => ?_
    exact ⟨z.1, z.2, rfl⟩
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have haU : a ∈ U := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
  have hbU : b ∈ U := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
  have hcU : c ∈ U := (mem_filter.mp hc).1
  have hdU : d ∈ U := (mem_filter.mp hd).1
  have haC : (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨a, haU⟩ = C := by
    obtain ⟨_, hC⟩ := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    exact hC
  have hbC : (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hbU⟩ = C := by
    obtain ⟨_, hC⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    exact hC
  have hcC : (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨c, hcU⟩ = C := by
    obtain ⟨_, hC⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hc).2
    exact hC
  have hdC : (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨d, hdU⟩ = C := by
    obtain ⟨_, hC⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hd).2
    exact hC
  have hxne {y : V} {hyU : y ∈ U}
      (hyC : (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hyU⟩ = C) : x ≠ y := by
    intro hxy
    apply hD
    subst hxy
    exact hxD.symm.trans hyC
  have nAdj {y : V} {hyU : y ∈ U}
      (hyC : (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hyU⟩ = C) :
      ¬ G.Adj x y := by
    intro hadj
    have hmk :
        (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxU⟩ =
          (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hyU⟩ :=
      ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj (by
        simpa [induce_adj] using hadj)
    exact hD (hxD.symm.trans (hmk.trans hyC))
  have : ¬ (G.Adj x a ∨ G.Adj x b ∨ G.Adj x c ∨ G.Adj x d) := by
    simp [nAdj haC, nAdj hbC, nAdj hcC, nAdj hdC]
  exact this <| h hp (hxne haC) (hxne hbC) (hxne hcC) (hxne hdC)

name: Nikoghosyan.OneTough.connected
statement: lemma OneTough.connected [Nonempty V] (h : OneTough G) : G.Connected
proof:
:= by
  have hle : componentCount G univ ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hlt
    have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G univ := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hlt)
    have hbound := h ∅ (by simpa using h2)
    have : componentCount G univ ≤ 0 := by simpa using hbound
    omega
  haveI : Nonempty (G.induce ((univ : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨(G.induce _).connectedComponentMk ⟨Classical.choice ‹Nonempty V›, mem_univ _⟩⟩
  have hpos : 0 < componentCount G univ := Nat.card_pos
  have heq : componentCount G univ = 1 := le_antisymm hle (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos)
  have hsub : Subsingleton (G.induce ((univ : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 heq).1
  have heqG : Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent = 1 := by
    rwa [← componentCount_univ]
  haveI : Subsingleton G.ConnectedComponent :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 heqG).1
  refine (connected_iff G).2 ⟨?_, ‹Nonempty V›⟩
  intro u v
  exact ConnectedComponent.exact
    (Subsingleton.elim (G.connectedComponentMk u) (G.connectedComponentMk v))

name: Nikoghosyan.OneTough.not_ncard_neighborSet_eq_one
statement:
lemma OneTough.not_ncard_neighborSet_eq_one
    (h : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) (v : V) :
    (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hdeg
  obtain ⟨w, hwN⟩ := (Set.ncard_eq_one).1 hdeg
  have hadj : G.Adj v w := by
    have : w ∈ G.neighborSet v := by simp [hwN]
    simpa [mem_neighborSet] using this
  have hvw : v ≠ w := hadj.ne
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, z ∈ (univ \ ({v, w} : Finset V)) := by
    have hpair : ({v, w} : Finset V).card = 2 := card_pair hvw
    have : (univ \ {v, w} : Finset V).Nonempty := by
      rw [sdiff_nonempty]
      intro hsub
      have : Fintype.card V ≤ 2 := by
        simpa [hpair] using card_le_card hsub
      omega
    exact this
  have hzv : z ≠ v := by
    have := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    simp at this
    exact this.1
  have hzw : z ≠ w := by
    have := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    simp at this
    exact this.2
  let S : Finset V := {w}
  let U : Finset V := univ \ S
  have hvU : v ∈ U := by simp [U, S, hvw]
  have hzU : z ∈ U := by simp [U, S, hzw]
  have hnr : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable ⟨v, hvU⟩ ⟨z, hzU⟩ := by
    rintro ⟨p⟩
    have hne : (⟨v, hvU⟩ : (U : Set V)) ≠ ⟨z, hzU⟩ := by
      intro hEq
      exact hzv ((congrArg Subtype.val hEq).symm)
    have hnn : ¬ p.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
    obtain ⟨y, -, hyadj⟩ := adj_of_mem_walk_support p hnn p.start_mem_support
    have : G.Adj v y.1 := by simpa [induce_adj] using hyadj
    have hyw : y.1 = w := by
      have : y.1 ∈ G.neighborSet v := this
      simpa [hwN] using this
    have : y.1 ∈ U := y.property
    simp [U, S, hyw] at this
  have hnt : Nontrivial (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvU⟩,
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z, hzU⟩,
      fun hC => hnr (ConnectedComponent.exact hC)⟩⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G U := by
    haveI : Nonempty (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
    haveI : Finite (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
    have hpos : 0 < componentCount G U := Nat.card_pos
    have hne1 : componentCount G U ≠ 1 := by
      intro h1
      have : Subsingleton (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
        (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 h1).1
      exact (not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial).2 hnt this
    omega
  have hbound := h S (by simpa [U, S] using h2)
  have : componentCount G U ≤ 1 := by simpa [S] using hbound
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.OneTough.two_le_ncard_neighborSet
statement:
lemma OneTough.two_le_ncard_neighborSet
    (h : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) (v : V) :
    2 ≤ (G.neighborSet v).ncard
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  haveI : Nontrivial V :=
    Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  have hc := h.connected
  have hne : (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hempty : G.neighborSet v = ∅ := (Set.ncard_eq_zero).1 h0
    obtain ⟨w, hvw⟩ := exists_ne v
    have : G.Reachable v w := hc.preconnected v w
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := this
    cases p with
    | nil => exact hvw rfl
    | cons hx _ =>
      have : _ ∈ G.neighborSet v := hx
      simp [hempty] at this
  have hnot1 := OneTough.not_ncard_neighborSet_eq_one (G := G) h hord v
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.NoInducedP4UnionP1On.mono
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd hx hp hxa hxb hxc hxd =>
    h (hJK ha) (hJK hb) (hJK hc) (hJK hd) (hJK hx) hp hxa hxb hxc hxd

name: Nikoghosyan.NoInducedP4UnionP1On.of_global
statement:
lemma NoInducedP4UnionP1On.of_global (h : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (J : Finset V) :
    NoInducedP4UnionP1On G J
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp hxa hxb hxc hxd => h hp hxa hxb hxc hxd

name: Nikoghosyan.rowProfile_subset_of_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hx
  exact (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨h hx'.1, hx'.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.insert_union_right
statement:
lemma insert_union_right {x : V} {s t : Finset V} :
    insert x (s ∪ t) = s ∪ insert x t
proof:
:= by
