  simp [mem_insert, mem_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_prefixTake_subset
statement:
lemma support_prefixTake_subset (p : GraphPath G) (n : ℕ) :
    (p.prefixTake n).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hy' : y ∈ (p.walk.take n).support := by
    simpa [prefixTake, GraphPath.support] using hy
  have : (p.walk.take n).support ⊆ p.walk.support := by
    simpa [Walk.support_take] using List.take_subset (n + 1) p.walk.support
  exact List.mem_toFinset.2 (this hy')

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.length_prefixTake_of_le
proof:
:= by
  simp [prefixTake, Walk.take_length, hn]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.finish_prefixTake
statement:
lemma finish_prefixTake (p : GraphPath G) (n : ℕ) :
    (p.prefixTake n).finish = p.walk.getVert n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_prefixTake
statement:
lemma start_prefixTake (p : GraphPath G) (n : ℕ) :
    (p.prefixTake n).start = p.start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_support_prefixTake
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hy' : y ∈ (p.walk.take n).support := by
      simpa [prefixTake, GraphPath.support] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, hiEq, hiLen⟩ :=
      (Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert (p := p.walk.take n)).1 hy'
    have hi' : i ≤ n := by
      have : i ≤ (p.walk.take n).length := hiLen
      simpa [Walk.take_length, hn] using this
    refine ⟨i, hi', ?_⟩
    have hget : (p.walk.take n).getVert i = p.walk.getVert i := by
      simp [Walk.take_getVert, inf_eq_right.2 hi']
    exact hget.symm.trans hiEq
  · intro ⟨i, hi, hiy⟩
    have hget : (p.walk.take n).getVert i = p.walk.getVert i := by
      simp [Walk.take_getVert, inf_eq_right.2 hi]
    have hmem : (p.walk.take n).getVert i ∈ (p.walk.take n).support :=
      Walk.getVert_mem_support (p.walk.take n) i
    have : y ∈ (p.walk.take n).support := by
      rw [← hiy, ← hget]
      exact hmem
    simpa [prefixTake, GraphPath.support] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_prefixTake_zero
statement:
lemma support_prefixTake_zero (p : GraphPath G) :
    (p.prefixTake 0).support = {p.start}
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (p.mem_support_prefixTake (Nat.zero_le _)).1 hy
    have : i = 0 := Nat.le_zero.1 hi
    subst this
    simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
  · intro hy
    have : y = p.start := mem_singleton.1 hy
    subst this
    exact (p.mem_support_prefixTake (Nat.zero_le _)).2
      ⟨0, le_rfl, Walk.getVert_zero p.walk⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_prefixTake_length
statement:
lemma support_prefixTake_length (p : GraphPath G) :
    (p.prefixTake p.walk.length).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact p.support_prefixTake_subset p.walk.length hy
  · intro hy
    have hy' : y ∈ p.walk.support := by simpa [support] using hy
    obtain ⟨i, rfl, hi⟩ := (Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert).1 hy'
    exact (p.mem_support_prefixTake le_rfl).2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.next_not_mem_prefixTake
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := (p.mem_support_prefixTake (le_of_lt hn)).1 hmem
  have hieq : i = n + 1 :=
    p.getVert_injective_of_le_length (hi.trans (le_of_lt hn))
      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn) heq
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_prefixTake_succ
statement:
lemma support_prefixTake_succ (p : GraphPath G) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n < p.walk.length) :
    (p.prefixTake (n + 1)).support =
      insert (p.walk.getVert (n + 1)) (p.prefixTake n).support
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ p.walk.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn
  have hn0 : n ≤ p.walk.length := le_of_lt hn
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (p.mem_support_prefixTake hn1).1 hy
    rcases Nat.le_succ_iff.1 hi with hle | rfl
    · exact mem_insert_of_mem ((p.mem_support_prefixTake hn0).2 ⟨i, hle, rfl⟩)
    · exact mem_insert_self _ _
  · intro hy
    rcases mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy'
    · exact (p.mem_support_prefixTake hn1).2 ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (p.mem_support_prefixTake hn0).1 hy'
      exact (p.mem_support_prefixTake hn1).2 ⟨i, hi.trans (Nat.le_succ n), rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.start_ne_finish_of_three_le_card
statement:
lemma start_ne_finish_of_three_le_card (p : GraphPath G)
    (h : 3 ≤ p.support.card) : p.start ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hnil : p.walk.Nil := (p.nil_iff_start_eq_finish).2 heq
  have h1 : p.support.card = 1 := by
    rw [p.support_eq_singleton_of_nil hnil]
    exact card_singleton _
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_of_prefixTake
statement:
lemma oneToughOn_of_prefixTake (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v))
    {n : ℕ} (_hn : n ≤ r.walk.length) :
    OneToughOn G (c.support ∪ (r.prefixTake n).support)
proof:
:=
  oneToughOn_of_traceable_extension c (r.prefixTake n)
    (hdisj.mono_right (r.support_prefixTake_subset n))
    (fun v hv => hrow v (r.support_prefixTake_subset n hv))

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_current_remainder
statement:
lemma isCograph_current_remainder (γ : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ γ.support)
    (hOn : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (insert x γ.support)) :
    IsCograph G (γ.support \ rowProfile (G := G) γ.support x)
proof:
:=
  isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_insert γ hx hOn

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_pathCover_of_current_remainder
statement:
theorem strict_pathCover_of_current_remainder (γ : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ γ.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x γ.support))
    (hOn : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (insert x γ.support)) :
    pathCoverNumber G (γ.support \ rowProfile (G := G) γ.support x) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) γ.support x).card
proof:
:=
  strict_pathCover_of_oneToughOn_cycle_of_host γ hx hJ hOn

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_inserted_cycle_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
statement:
theorem exists_inserted_cycle_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
    (hRule : ProfileEndedSpanningPath G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ c.support)
    (hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x c.support))
    (hK : IsCograph G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support x)) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = insert x c.support ∧ 3 ≤ γ.support.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hf⟩ := hRule c x hx hJ hK
  have hne : p.start ≠ p.finish := by
    have h3 := c.three_le_card_support
    rw [← hp] at h3
    exact start_ne_finish_of_three_le_card p h3
  exact exists_inserted_cycle_of_profile_ends p c hp hx hs hf hne

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_of_prefixTake_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_prefixTake_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
    (hRule : ProfileEndedSpanningPath G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v))
    (hOn : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (c.support ∪ r.support))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ r.walk.length) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = c.support ∪ (r.prefixTake n).support
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hx : r.start ∉ c.support :=
      disjoint_right.1 hdisj r.start_mem_support
    have hsupp0 : (r.prefixTake 0).support = {r.start} :=
      r.support_prefixTake_zero
    have hJ : OneToughOn G (insert r.start c.support) := by
      have hunion : insert r.start c.support =
          c.support ∪ (r.prefixTake 0).support := by
        rw [hsupp0, insert_eq, union_comm]
      rw [hunion]
      exact oneToughOn_of_prefixTake c r hdisj hrow (Nat.zero_le _)
    have hOn0 : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (insert r.start c.support) := by
      have hsub : insert r.start c.support ⊆ c.support ∪ r.support := by
        intro y hy
        rcases mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy'
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr r.start_mem_support)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hy')
      exact hOn.mono hsub
    have hK : IsCograph G
        (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support r.start) :=
      isCograph_current_remainder c hx hOn0
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, _⟩ :=
      exists_inserted_cycle_of_profileEndedSpanningPath hRule c hx hJ hK
    refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
    rw [hγ, hsupp0, insert_eq, union_comm]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn0 : n ≤ r.walk.length := Nat.le_of_succ_le hn
    have hnlt : n < r.walk.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hn
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := ih hn0
    set x := r.walk.getVert (n + 1)
    have hxR : x ∈ r.support := r.getVert_mem_path_support (n + 1)
    have hxC : x ∉ c.support := disjoint_right.1 hdisj hxR
    have hxP : x ∉ (r.prefixTake n).support :=
      r.next_not_mem_prefixTake hnlt
    have hx : x ∉ γ.support := by
      rw [hγ]
      exact fun h => (mem_union.1 h).elim hxC hxP
    have hinsert :
        insert x γ.support = c.support ∪ (r.prefixTake (n + 1)).support := by
      rw [hγ, insert_union_right, r.support_prefixTake_succ hnlt]
    have hJ : OneToughOn G (insert x γ.support) := by
      rw [hinsert]
      exact oneToughOn_of_prefixTake c r hdisj hrow hn
    have hOnx : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (insert x γ.support) := by
      have hsub : insert x γ.support ⊆ c.support ∪ r.support := by
        rw [hinsert]
        intro y hy
        rcases mem_union.1 hy with hyH | hyP
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hyH)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (r.support_prefixTake_subset (n + 1) hyP))
      exact hOn.mono hsub
    have hK : IsCograph G
        (γ.support \ rowProfile (G := G) γ.support x) :=
      isCograph_current_remainder γ hx hOnx
    obtain ⟨γ', hγ', _⟩ :=
      exists_inserted_cycle_of_profileEndedSpanningPath hRule γ hx hJ hK
    refine ⟨γ', ?_⟩
    simpa [hinsert] using hγ'

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
    (hRule : ProfileEndedSpanningPath G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v))
    (hOn : NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (c.support ∪ r.support)) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G, γ.support = c.support ∪ r.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
    exists_cycle_of_prefixTake_of_profileEndedSpanningPath
      hRule c r hdisj hrow hOn r.walk.length le_rfl
  refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
  simpa [r.support_prefixTake_length] using hγ

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath_of_global
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath_of_global
    (hRule : ProfileEndedSpanningPath G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v))
    (hG : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G, γ.support = c.support ∪ r.support
proof:
:=
  exists_cycle_union_of_profileEndedSpanningPath hRule c r hdisj hrow
    (NoInducedP4UnionP1On.of_global hG _)

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.pathOf_start
statement:
lemma pathOf_start (E : ExtractedPC F R) (t : Fin E.k) :
    (E.pathOf t).start = E.xs t
proof:
:=
  (R.realizedPath_spec (E.blocks t)
    (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using E.hxs t)
    (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using E.hys t)
    (E.hport t)).1

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.pathOf_finish
statement:
lemma pathOf_finish (E : ExtractedPC F R) (t : Fin E.k) :
    (E.pathOf t).finish = E.ys t
proof:
:=
  (R.realizedPath_spec (E.blocks t)
    (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using E.hxs t)
    (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using E.hys t)
    (E.hport t)).2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.pathOf_support
statement:
lemma pathOf_support (E : ExtractedPC F R) (t : Fin E.k) :
    (E.pathOf t).support = (F.getCycle (E.blocks t)).support
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathOf
  simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using
    (R.realizedPath_spec (E.blocks t)
      (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using E.hxs t)
      (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using E.hys t)
      (E.hport t)).2.2

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.length_pathList
statement: lemma length_pathList (E : ExtractedPC F R) : E.pathList.length = E.k
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathList]

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.pathList_get
statement:
lemma pathList_get (E : ExtractedPC F R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < E.pathList.length) :
    E.pathList.get ⟨i, hi⟩ =
      E.pathOf ⟨i, by simpa [length_pathList] using hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathList, List.get_ofFn]

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.pairwise_pathList
statement:
lemma pairwise_pathList (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    E.pathList.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.pairwise_iff_get]
  intro a b hab
  have ha : a.1 < E.k := by simpa [length_pathList] using a.2
  have hb : b.1 < E.k := by simpa [length_pathList] using b.2
  have hne : (⟨a.1, ha⟩ : Fin E.k) ≠ ⟨b.1, hb⟩ := by
    intro h
    exact Nat.ne_of_lt hab (Fin.mk.inj_iff.mp h)
  have hblocks : E.blocks ⟨a.1, ha⟩ ≠ E.blocks ⟨b.1, hb⟩ := fun h =>
    hne (E.blocks_inj h)
  have hd := F.disjoint_getCycle hblocks
  have ha' : a.1 < E.pathList.length := a.2
  have hb' : b.1 < E.pathList.length := b.2
  rw [E.pathList_get ha', E.pathList_get hb', E.pathOf_support, E.pathOf_support]
  exact hd

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.hedges_pathList
statement:
lemma hedges_pathList (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < E.pathList.length),
      G.Adj (E.pathList.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        (E.pathList.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i + 1 < E.k := by simpa [length_pathList] using hi
  have hi0 : i < E.k := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi'
  have hsucc :
      pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) E.hk) ⟨i, hi0⟩ =
        ⟨i + 1, hi'⟩ := by
    ext
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi'
  have hadj := E.hseams ⟨i, hi0⟩
  rw [hsucc] at hadj
  rw [E.pathList_get, E.pathList_get, E.pathOf_finish, E.pathOf_start]
  exact hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.pathList_ne_nil
statement: lemma pathList_ne_nil (E : ExtractedPC F R) : E.pathList ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlen := E.length_pathList
  have hk := E.hk
  have hz : E.pathList.length = 0 := by simp [h]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.hclose_pathList
statement:
lemma hclose_pathList (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    G.Adj (E.pathList.getLast E.pathList_ne_nil).finish
      (E.pathList.head E.pathList_ne_nil).start
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := E.length_pathList
  have hk := E.hk
  have hne := E.pathList_ne_nil
  have hlastIdx : E.k - 1 < E.k := by omega
  have hlast : E.pathList.getLast hne = E.pathOf ⟨E.k - 1, hlastIdx⟩ := by
    rw [List.getLast_eq_getElem hne]
    have : E.pathList.length - 1 = E.k - 1 := by omega
    simp [pathList, this]
  have hhead : E.pathList.head hne = E.pathOf ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [List.head_eq_getElem_zero hne]
    simp [pathList]
  have hsucc :
      pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) E.hk) ⟨E.k - 1, hlastIdx⟩ =
        ⟨0, by omega⟩ :=
    pcSucc_last E.hk
  have hadj := E.hseams ⟨E.k - 1, hlastIdx⟩
  rw [hsucc] at hadj
  rw [hlast, hhead, E.pathOf_finish, E.pathOf_start]
  exact hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.three_le_supportUnion
statement:
lemma three_le_supportUnion (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    3 ≤ (GraphPath.supportUnion E.pathList).card
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : (0 : ℕ) < E.k := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) E.hk
  let t0 : Fin E.k := ⟨0, ht0⟩
  have h3 := (F.getCycle (E.blocks t0)).three_le_card_support
  have hmem : E.pathOf t0 ∈ E.pathList := List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨t0, rfl⟩
  have hle : (E.pathOf t0).support.card ≤ (GraphPath.supportUnion E.pathList).card := by
    refine card_le_card ?_
    intro x hx
    exact GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2 ⟨E.pathOf t0, hmem, hx⟩
  have hcard :
      (E.pathOf t0).support.card = (F.getCycle (E.blocks t0)).support.card :=
    congrArg Finset.card (E.pathOf_support t0)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.support_assembled
statement:
lemma support_assembled (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    E.assembled.support = GraphPath.supportUnion E.pathList
proof:
:=
  GraphPath.support_assembleCycle E.pathList
    (by simpa [length_pathList] using E.hk)
    E.pairwise_pathList E.hedges_pathList E.hclose_pathList
    E.three_le_supportUnion

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.selected_card
statement: lemma selected_card (E : ExtractedPC F R) : E.selected.card = E.k
proof:
:= by
  simp [selected, card_image_of_injective _ E.blocks_inj, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.two_le_selected
statement: lemma two_le_selected (E : ExtractedPC F R) : 2 ≤ E.selected.card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [selected_card] using E.hk

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.supportUnion_eq_selectedSupport
statement:
lemma supportUnion_eq_selectedSupport (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    GraphPath.supportUnion E.pathList = F.selectedSupport E.selected
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.1 hx
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hp
    have hxB : x ∈ (F.getCycle (E.blocks t)).support := by
      simpa [pathOf_support] using hxp
    exact (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2
      ⟨E.blocks t, by simp [selected], hxB⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hx
    obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hi
    refine GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2 ⟨E.pathOf t, List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨t, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [pathOf_support] using hxi

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.assembled_selectedSupport
statement:
lemma assembled_selectedSupport (E : ExtractedPC F R) :
    E.assembled.support = F.selectedSupport E.selected
proof:
:=
  E.support_assembled.trans E.supportUnion_eq_selectedSupport

name: Nikoghosyan.ExtractedPC.not_of_min
statement:
lemma not_of_min (E : ExtractedPC F R)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card) : False
proof:
:=
  F.not_exists_merge_of_min hmin E.selected E.two_le_selected
    E.assembled E.assembled_selectedSupport

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_extracted_of_blockStart
statement:
lemma exists_extracted_of_blockStart {i : Fin F.card}
    (w : (aux (G := G) F.partition).Walk (.inl i) (.inl i))
    (hpc : Yeo.IsProperlyColored w (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition R.port)) :
    Nonempty (ExtractedPC F R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : w.IsCycle := hpc.1
  have hEven : Even w.length := aux_cycle_even_length hc
  have h4 : 4 ≤ w.length := aux_cycle_four_le hc
  let k := w.length / 2
  have hk : 2 ≤ k := two_le_half hEven h4
  have hLk : 2 * k = w.length := two_mul_half hEven
  have hpos : 0 < k := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk
  let blocks : Fin k → Fin F.card := fun t =>
    Classical.choose
      (aux_getVert_even_inl (w := w)
        (hn := Nat.le_of_lt (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2))
        (he := even_two_mul t.1))
  let seams : Fin k → PhysEdge (G := G) F.partition := fun t =>
    Classical.choose
      (aux_getVert_odd_inr (w := w)
        (hn := Nat.le_of_lt (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2))
        (ho := odd_two_mul_add_one t.1))
  have hBspec (t : Fin k) :
      w.getVert (2 * t.1) = .inl (blocks t) :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (aux_getVert_even_inl (w := w)
        (hn := Nat.le_of_lt (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2))
        (he := even_two_mul t.1))
  have hSspec (t : Fin k) :
      w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 1) = .inr (seams t) :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (aux_getVert_odd_inr (w := w)
        (hn := Nat.le_of_lt (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2))
        (ho := odd_two_mul_add_one t.1))
  have hBinj : Function.Injective blocks := by
    intro a b hab
    have : w.getVert (2 * a.1) = w.getVert (2 * b.1) := by
      rw [hBspec a, hBspec b, hab]
    exact Fin.ext (by
      have := cycle_getVert_inj hc (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven a.2)
        (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven b.2) this
      omega)
  have hinc_out (t : Fin k) :
      (aux (G := G) F.partition).Adj (.inl (blocks t)) (.inr (seams t)) := by
    have hadj := w.adj_getVert_succ (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2)
    simpa [hBspec t, hSspec t] using hadj
  have hsuccB (t : Fin k) :
      w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 2) = .inl (blocks (pcSucc hpos t)) := by
    have hle := two_mul_add_two_le_of_div hEven t.2
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hle with hEq | hlt
    · have ht : t.1 = k - 1 := by omega
      have htF : t = ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext ht
      have h0 : pcSucc hpos t = ⟨0, hpos⟩ := by
        rw [htF]
        exact pcSucc_last hk
      have : w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 2) = w.getVert 0 := by
        have : 2 * t.1 + 2 = w.length := by omega
        rw [this, closed_getVert_zero_eq_length]
      have hstart : w.getVert 0 = .inl (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩) :=
        hBspec ⟨0, hpos⟩
      simpa [h0] using this.trans hstart
    · have ht' : t.1 + 1 < k := by omega
      have hts : pcSucc hpos t = ⟨t.1 + 1, ht'⟩ := pcSucc_of_lt hpos ht'
      have hB := hBspec ⟨t.1 + 1, ht'⟩
      have : 2 * (t.1 + 1) = 2 * t.1 + 2 := by omega
      simpa [hts, this] using hB
  have hinc_in (t : Fin k) :
      (aux (G := G) F.partition).Adj (.inr (seams t))
        (.inl (blocks (pcSucc hpos t))) := by
    have hadj := w.adj_getVert_succ (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2)
    simpa [hSspec t, hsuccB t] using hadj
  have hinc_in_pred (t : Fin k) :
      (aux (G := G) F.partition).Adj (.inr (seams (pcPred hpos t)))
        (.inl (blocks t)) := by
    have := hinc_in (pcPred hpos t)
    simpa [pcPred_succ hpos t] using this
  let ys : Fin k → V := fun t =>
    endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t)
      (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
  let xs : Fin k → V := fun t =>
    endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams (pcPred hpos t))
      (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred t))
  have hxs : ∀ t, xs t ∈ (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support := by
    intro t
    change endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams (pcPred hpos t))
        (hinc_in_pred t) ∈ (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support
    simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using
      endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) F.partition (blocks t)
        (seams (pcPred hpos t)) (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred t))
  have hys : ∀ t, ys t ∈ (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support := by
    intro t
    change endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t) (hinc_out t) ∈
      (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support
    simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using
      endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t)
        (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
  have hport : ∀ t, R.port (xs t) ≠ R.port (ys t) := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht0 : t.1 = 0
    · have hnil : ¬ w.Nil := hc.not_nil
      have hlenpos : 0 < w.length := (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length).1 hnil
      have ht : t = ⟨0, hpos⟩ := Fin.ext ht0
      subst ht
      have hL0 : w.getVert 0 = .inl (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩) := hBspec ⟨0, hpos⟩
      have hL1 : w.getVert 1 = .inr (seams ⟨0, hpos⟩) := hSspec ⟨0, hpos⟩
      have hLm : w.getVert (w.length - 1) = .inr (seams ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) := by
        have : 2 * (k - 1) + 1 = w.length - 1 := by omega
        simpa [this] using hSspec ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
      have hLL : w.getVert w.length = .inl (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩) := by
        simpa [Walk.getVert_length] using hL0
      have cfirst :=
        dartColor_getVert (P := F.partition) R.port w (n := 0) hlenpos
      have clast :=
        dartColor_getVert (P := F.partition) R.port w (n := w.length - 1)
          (by omega)
      have hf := Walk.firstDart_eq (p := w) hnil
        (by simpa [Walk.length_darts] using hlenpos)
      have hl := Walk.lastDart_eq (p := w) hnil
        (by simpa [Walk.length_darts] using hlenpos)
      have hne := hpc.2.2 hnil
      have hpred : pcPred hpos ⟨0, hpos⟩ = ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ := pcPred_zero hk
      obtain ⟨hincF, hfirst⟩ :=
        auxColor_of_inl_inr (P := F.partition) R.port
          (w.adj_getVert_succ hlenpos) hL0 hL1
      obtain ⟨hincL, hlastC⟩ :=
        auxColor_of_inr_inl (P := F.partition) R.port
          (w.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : w.length - 1 < w.length))
          hLm (by
            have : (w.length - 1) + 1 = w.length := by omega
            simpa [this] using hLL)
      have hyseq :
          endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩) (seams ⟨0, hpos⟩)
              hincF = ys ⟨0, hpos⟩ :=
        endpointOf_proof_irrel hincF (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out ⟨0, hpos⟩))
      have hxseq :
          endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩)
              (seams ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) hincL = xs ⟨0, hpos⟩ := by
        have hincP :
            incident (G := G) F.partition (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩)
              (seams ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) := by
          convert incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred ⟨0, hpos⟩)
          exact congrArg Fin.val hpred.symm
        apply Eq.trans (endpointOf_proof_irrel hincL hincP)
        simp [xs, hpred]
      have hneProd :
          ((blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩, R.port (ys ⟨0, hpos⟩)) :
              Fin F.card × Port) ≠
            (blocks ⟨0, hpos⟩, R.port (xs ⟨0, hpos⟩)) := by
        have hne' := hne
        have hdl : w.darts.length = w.length := Walk.length_darts w
        rw [hf] at hne'
        rw [hl] at hne'
        simp only [hdl] at hne'
        rw [cfirst, clast, hfirst, hlastC, hyseq, hxseq] at hne'
        exact hne'
      intro hp
      exact ports_ne_of_prod (Ne.symm hneProd) hp
    · have htpos : 0 < t.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ht0
      have hn : 2 * t.1 < w.length := two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2
      have halt := hpc.2.1 (i := 2 * t.1 - 1)
        (by simpa [Walk.length_darts] using
          (by omega : 2 * t.1 - 1 + 1 < w.length))
      have hL : w.getVert (2 * t.1) = .inl (blocks t) := hBspec t
      have hR : w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 1) = .inr (seams t) := hSspec t
      have hLm : w.getVert (2 * t.1 - 1) = .inr (seams (pcPred hpos t)) := by
        have hv : (pcPred hpos t).1 = t.1 - 1 := pcPred_val_pos hpos htpos
        have : 2 * (pcPred hpos t).1 + 1 = 2 * t.1 - 1 := by omega
        simpa [this] using hSspec (pcPred hpos t)
      have cin :=
        dartColor_getVert (P := F.partition) R.port w
          (n := 2 * t.1 - 1) (by omega)
      have cout :=
        dartColor_getVert (P := F.partition) R.port w hn
      obtain ⟨hincIn, hcin⟩ :=
        auxColor_of_inr_inl (P := F.partition) R.port
          (w.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : 2 * t.1 - 1 < w.length))
          hLm (by
            have : 2 * t.1 - 1 + 1 = 2 * t.1 := by omega
            simpa [this] using hL)
      obtain ⟨hincOut, hcout⟩ :=
        auxColor_of_inl_inr (P := F.partition) R.port
          (w.adj_getVert_succ hn) hL hR
      have hxseq :
          endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams (pcPred hpos t))
              hincIn = xs t :=
        endpointOf_proof_irrel hincIn (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred t))
      have hyseq :
          endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t) hincOut =
            ys t :=
        endpointOf_proof_irrel hincOut (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
      have hneProd :
          ((blocks t, R.port (xs t)) : Fin F.card × Port) ≠
            (blocks t, R.port (ys t)) := by
        have halt' := halt
        have hidx : (2 * t.1 - 1 + 1 : ℕ) = 2 * t.1 := by omega
        simp only [hidx] at halt'
        rw [cin, hcin, hxseq, cout, hcout, hyseq] at halt'
        exact halt'
      exact ports_ne_of_prod hneProd
  have hseams : ∀ t, G.Adj (ys t)
      (xs (pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk) t)) := by
    intro t
    have hsucc :
        pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk) t = pcSucc hpos t :=
      rfl
    have hadj :=
      adj_of_endpoints (G := G) F.partition
        (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
        (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in t)) (fun h =>
          (pcSucc_ne hk t) (hBinj h))
    have hxsucc :
        xs (pcSucc hpos t) =
          endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks (pcSucc hpos t)) (seams t)
            (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in t)) := by
      change endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks (pcSucc hpos t))
          (seams (pcPred hpos (pcSucc hpos t)))
          (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred (pcSucc hpos t))) = _
      refine (endpointOf_congr (congrArg seams (pcSucc_pred hpos t)) _).trans ?_
      exact endpointOf_proof_irrel _ (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in t))
    rw [hsucc, hxsucc]
    exact hadj
  exact ⟨{
    k := k
    hk := hk
    blocks := blocks
    seams := seams
    blocks_inj := hBinj
    xs := xs
    ys := ys
    hxs := hxs
    hys := hys
    hport := hport
    hseams := hseams
  }⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_extracted_of_physStart
statement:
lemma exists_extracted_of_physStart {e : PhysEdge (G := G) F.partition}
    (w : (aux (G := G) F.partition).Walk (.inr e) (.inr e))
    (hpc : Yeo.IsProperlyColored w (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition R.port)) :
    Nonempty (ExtractedPC F R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : w.IsCycle := hpc.1
  have hEven : Even w.length := aux_cycle_even_length_any hc
  have h4 : 4 ≤ w.length := aux_cycle_four_le_any hc
  let k := w.length / 2
  have hk : 2 ≤ k := two_le_half hEven h4
  have hLk : 2 * k = w.length := two_mul_half hEven
  have hpos : 0 < k := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk
  let blocks : Fin k → Fin F.card := fun t =>
    Classical.choose
      (aux_getVert_odd_inl_of_phys (w := w)
        (hn := Nat.le_of_lt (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2))
        (ho := odd_two_mul_add_one t.1))
  let seams : Fin k → PhysEdge (G := G) F.partition := fun t =>
    Classical.choose
      (aux_getVert_even_inr_of_phys (w := w)
        (hn := two_mul_add_two_le_of_div hEven t.2)
        (he := even_two_mul_add_two t.1))
  have hBspec (t : Fin k) :
      w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 1) = .inl (blocks t) :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (aux_getVert_odd_inl_of_phys (w := w)
        (hn := Nat.le_of_lt (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2))
        (ho := odd_two_mul_add_one t.1))
  have hSspec (t : Fin k) :
      w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 2) = .inr (seams t) :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (aux_getVert_even_inr_of_phys (w := w)
        (hn := two_mul_add_two_le_of_div hEven t.2)
        (he := even_two_mul_add_two t.1))
  have hBinj : Function.Injective blocks := by
    intro a b hab
    have : w.getVert (2 * a.1 + 1) = w.getVert (2 * b.1 + 1) := by
      rw [hBspec a, hBspec b, hab]
    exact Fin.ext (by
      have := cycle_getVert_inj hc (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven a.2)
        (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven b.2) this
      omega)
  have hinc_out (t : Fin k) :
      (aux (G := G) F.partition).Adj (.inl (blocks t)) (.inr (seams t)) := by
    have hadj := w.adj_getVert_succ (two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2)
    simpa [hBspec t, hSspec t] using hadj
  have hpredS (t : Fin k) :
      w.getVert (2 * t.1) = .inr (seams (pcPred hpos t)) := by
    by_cases ht0 : t.1 = 0
    · have ht : t = ⟨0, hpos⟩ := Fin.ext ht0
      subst ht
      have hpred : pcPred hpos ⟨0, hpos⟩ = ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ := pcPred_zero hk
      have hS : w.getVert (2 * (k - 1) + 2) = .inr (seams ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) :=
        hSspec ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
      have hidx : 2 * (k - 1) + 2 = w.length := by omega
      have hstart : w.getVert 0 = w.getVert w.length :=
        closed_getVert_zero_eq_length w
      have : w.getVert 0 = .inr (seams ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) :=
        hstart.trans (by simpa [hidx] using hS)
      simpa [hpred] using this
    · have htpos : 0 < t.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ht0
      have hv : (pcPred hpos t).1 = t.1 - 1 := pcPred_val_pos hpos htpos
      have : 2 * (pcPred hpos t).1 + 2 = 2 * t.1 := by omega
      simpa [this] using hSspec (pcPred hpos t)
  have hinc_in_pred (t : Fin k) :
      (aux (G := G) F.partition).Adj (.inr (seams (pcPred hpos t)))
        (.inl (blocks t)) := by
    have hn : 2 * t.1 < w.length := two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2
    have hadj := w.adj_getVert_succ hn
    simpa [hpredS t, hBspec t] using hadj
  have hinc_in (t : Fin k) :
      (aux (G := G) F.partition).Adj (.inr (seams t))
        (.inl (blocks (pcSucc hpos t))) := by
    simpa [pcPred_succ hpos (pcSucc hpos t), pcSucc_pred hpos t] using
      hinc_in_pred (pcSucc hpos t)
  let ys : Fin k → V := fun t =>
    endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t)
      (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
  let xs : Fin k → V := fun t =>
    endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams (pcPred hpos t))
      (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred t))
  have hxs : ∀ t, xs t ∈ (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support := by
    intro t
    change endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams (pcPred hpos t))
        (hinc_in_pred t) ∈ (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support
    simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using
      endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) F.partition (blocks t)
        (seams (pcPred hpos t)) (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred t))
  have hys : ∀ t, ys t ∈ (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support := by
    intro t
    change endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t) (hinc_out t) ∈
      (F.getCycle (blocks t)).support
    simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using
      endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t)
        (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
  have hport : ∀ t, R.port (xs t) ≠ R.port (ys t) := by
    intro t
    have hn : 2 * t.1 + 1 < w.length := two_mul_add_one_lt_of_div hEven t.2
    have halt := hpc.2.1 (i := 2 * t.1)
      (by simpa [Walk.length_darts] using hn)
    have hL : w.getVert (2 * t.1) = .inr (seams (pcPred hpos t)) := hpredS t
    have hM : w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 1) = .inl (blocks t) := hBspec t
    have hR : w.getVert (2 * t.1 + 2) = .inr (seams t) := hSspec t
    have cin :=
      dartColor_getVert (P := F.partition) R.port w
        (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2)
    have cout :=
      dartColor_getVert (P := F.partition) R.port w hn
    obtain ⟨hincIn, hcin⟩ :=
      auxColor_of_inr_inl (P := F.partition) R.port
        (w.adj_getVert_succ (two_mul_lt_of_div hEven t.2)) hL hM
    obtain ⟨hincOut, hcout⟩ :=
      auxColor_of_inl_inr (P := F.partition) R.port
        (w.adj_getVert_succ hn) hM hR
    have hxseq :
        endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams (pcPred hpos t))
            hincIn = xs t :=
      endpointOf_proof_irrel hincIn (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred t))
    have hyseq :
        endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks t) (seams t) hincOut = ys t :=
      endpointOf_proof_irrel hincOut (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
    have hneProd :
        ((blocks t, R.port (xs t)) : Fin F.card × Port) ≠
          (blocks t, R.port (ys t)) := by
      have halt' := halt
      rw [cin, hcin, hxseq, cout, hcout, hyseq] at halt'
      exact halt'
    exact ports_ne_of_prod hneProd
  have hseams : ∀ t, G.Adj (ys t)
      (xs (pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk) t)) := by
    intro t
    have hsucc :
        pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk) t = pcSucc hpos t :=
      rfl
    have hadj :=
      adj_of_endpoints (G := G) F.partition
        (incident_of_adj_inl_inr (hinc_out t))
        (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in t)) (fun h =>
          (pcSucc_ne hk t) (hBinj h))
    have hxsucc :
        xs (pcSucc hpos t) =
          endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks (pcSucc hpos t)) (seams t)
            (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in t)) := by
      change endpointOf (G := G) F.partition (blocks (pcSucc hpos t))
          (seams (pcPred hpos (pcSucc hpos t)))
          (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in_pred (pcSucc hpos t))) = _
      refine (endpointOf_congr (congrArg seams (pcSucc_pred hpos t)) _).trans ?_
      exact endpointOf_proof_irrel _ (incident_of_adj_inr_inl (hinc_in t))
    rw [hsucc, hxsucc]
    exact hadj
  exact ⟨{
    k := k
    hk := hk
    blocks := blocks
    seams := seams
    blocks_inj := hBinj
    xs := xs
    ys := ys
    hxs := hxs
    hys := hys
    hport := hport
    hseams := hseams
  }⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_extracted_of_pc
statement:
lemma exists_extracted_of_pc
    {u : Fin F.card ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) F.partition}
    (w : (aux (G := G) F.partition).Walk u u)
    (hpc : Yeo.IsProperlyColored w (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition R.port)) :
    Nonempty (ExtractedPC F R)
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | inl i => exact exists_extracted_of_blockStart w hpc
  | inr e => exact exists_extracted_of_physStart w hpc

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_extracted_of_hasPC
statement:
lemma exists_extracted_of_hasPC
    (h : Yeo.HasProperlyColoredCycle
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition R.port)) :
    Nonempty (ExtractedPC F R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, w, hw⟩ := h
  exact exists_extracted_of_pc w hw

name: Nikoghosyan.minFactor_not_hasProperlyColoredCycle
statement:
lemma minFactor_not_hasProperlyColoredCycle
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (R : GlobalPortData (G := G) F.partition Port) :
    ¬ Yeo.HasProperlyColoredCycle
        (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition R.port)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := exists_extracted_of_hasPC (R := R) h
  exact E.not_of_min hmin

name: Nikoghosyan.minFactor_not_hasProperlyColoredCycle_cograph
statement:
lemma minFactor_not_hasProperlyColoredCycle_cograph
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    ¬ Yeo.HasProperlyColoredCycle
        (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F))
proof:
:=
  minFactor_not_hasProperlyColoredCycle hmin
    (globalPortData_of_cograph_factor F hcog)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_block_splitter_of_min_cograph
statement:
lemma exists_block_splitter_of_min_cograph
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ i : Fin F.card,
      Yeo.SplittingVertex
        (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin F.card) := BlockPartition.nonempty_index F.partition
  exact exists_block_splitter (P := F.partition) (factorPort F) hT hord
    (minFactor_not_hasProperlyColoredCycle_cograph hmin hcog)

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_union_foreign_cycle_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_union_foreign_cycle_le {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) :
    pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) ≤
      pathCoverNumber G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_union_cycle_le F.getCycle (localityHyp_at N hj hpat hx) hi

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_union_foreign_cycle_eq
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_union_foreign_cycle_eq {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) :
    pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) =
      (rowAt N x).card
proof:
:= by
  have hpL := pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_union_foreign_cycle_le N hj hpat hx hi
  have hle' : pathCoverNumber G
      ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) ≤
    (rowAt N x).card := by simpa [hpL] using hle
  refine le_antisymm hle' ?_
  by_contra hlt
  exact not_strict_saving_located_foreign N hj hpat hmin hx hi
    (lt_of_not_ge hlt)

name: Nikoghosyan.foreign_index_ne_core
statement:
lemma foreign_index_ne_core {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) :
    i ≠ N.core
proof:
:=
  ((N.hForeignMem j hj i).1 hi).1

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_core_foreign_cycle
statement:
lemma disjoint_core_foreign_cycle {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) :
    Disjoint (coreSupport N) (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:=
  F.disjoint_getCycle (foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_core_union_cycle_sdiff_gate
statement:
lemma componentCount_core_union_cycle_sdiff_gate {j : Fin F.card}
    (hj : j ≠ N.core) {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) :
    componentCount G
        ((coreSupport N ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) \
          N.gateOf i (foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi)) =
      (N.gateOf i (foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi)).card + 1
proof:
:= by
  set TD := N.gateOf i (foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi)
  have hT : Cograph.Tight (G := G) (coreSupport N) TD := by
    simpa [coreSupport, TD] using N.hGateTight i (foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi)
  have hTsub : TD ⊆ coreSupport N := hT.1
  have hdisj : Disjoint (coreSupport N) (F.getCycle i).support :=
    disjoint_core_foreign_cycle N hj hi
  have hEq :
      (coreSupport N ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) \ TD =
        (coreSupport N \ TD) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hzU : z ∈ coreSupport N ∪ (F.getCycle i).support := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hzT : z ∉ TD := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      rcases mem_union.1 hzU with hzH | hzD
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzH, hzT⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzD)
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzH | hzD
      · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.1 hzH).1),
          (mem_sdiff.1 hzH).2⟩
      · refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzD), ?_⟩
        intro hzT
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hTsub hzT) hzD
  have hnocross :
      ∀ a ∈ coreSupport N \ TD, ∀ b ∈ (F.getCycle i).support, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have haH : a ∈ coreSupport N := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1
    have haT : a ∉ TD := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).2
    have : a ∈ TD := by
      simpa [TD, coreSupport] using
        N.hGateAttach i (foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi) a
          (by simpa [coreSupport] using haH) b hb hab
    exact haT this
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint (coreSupport N \ TD) (F.getCycle i).support :=
    Disjoint.mono_left sdiff_subset hdisj
  rw [hEq, Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross hdisjRem hnocross,
    Cograph.Tight.eq_card (G := G) hT, componentCount_cycle_eq_one (F.getCycle i)]

name: Nikoghosyan.released_old_misses_foreign_cycle
statement:
lemma released_old_misses_foreign_cycle {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x r : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj)
    (hrF : r ∈ ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x))
    (hrE : r ∈ eligibleSet G
      ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support)) :
    ∀ d ∈ (F.getCycle i).support, ¬ G.Adj r d
proof:
:= by
  set H := coreSupport N
  set A := rowAt N x
  set D := (F.getCycle i).support
  set L := H \ A
  have hi0 : i ≠ N.core := foreign_index_ne_core N hj hi
  set TD := N.gateOf i hi0
  have hdisjHD : Disjoint H D := disjoint_core_foreign_cycle N hj hi
  have hA : A ⊆ H := rowAt_subset_core N x
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := rowAt_nonempty N hj hx
  have hK0c : IsCograph G L := isCograph_old_remainder N hj hx
  have hKc : IsCograph G (L ∪ D) :=
    isCograph_remainder_union_foreign N hj hpat hx hi
  have hpK0 : pathCoverNumber G L = A.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx
  have hpK : pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) = A.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_union_foreign_cycle_eq N hj hpat hmin hx hi
  obtain ⟨p, hpsup, hstartA, hfin, hne, _hprot⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_released_absorption (F.getCycle N.core) (F.getCycle i)
      (by simp [H, coreSupport]) (by simp [D])
      hdisjHD hA hAne hK0c hpK0 hKc hpK hrF hrE
  have hT : Cograph.Tight (G := G) H TD := by
    simpa [H, TD, coreSupport] using N.hGateTight i hi0
  have hTsubH : TD ⊆ H := hT.1
  have hTsub' : TD ⊆ p.support := by
    intro t ht
    have htH : t ∈ H := hTsubH ht
    have : t ∈ H ∪ D := mem_union.2 (Or.inl htH)
    simpa [hpsup] using this
  have hc := componentCount_core_union_cycle_sdiff_gate N hj hi
  have hcount :
      componentCount G (p.support \ TD) = TD.card + 1 := by
    simpa [hpsup, H, D, TD] using hc
  have hnotend : ¬ (p.start ∈ TD ∨ p.finish ∈ TD) := by
    intro hends
    rcases hends with hs | hf
    · have hle :=
        componentCount_path_sdiff_le_of_endpoint p hTsub' hs (Or.inl rfl)
      have hle' : TD.card + 1 ≤ TD.card := by simpa [hcount] using hle
      exact Nat.not_succ_le_self TD.card hle'
    · have hle :=
        componentCount_path_sdiff_le_of_endpoint p hTsub' hf (Or.inr rfl)
      have hle' : TD.card + 1 ≤ TD.card := by simpa [hcount] using hle
      exact Nat.not_succ_le_self TD.card hle'
  have hrH : r ∈ H := by
    have hrL : r ∈ L := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hrF |>.1
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hrL).1
  have hrnT : r ∉ TD := by
    intro hrT
    exact hnotend (Or.inr (by simpa [hfin] using hrT))
  intro d hd hadj
  have : r ∈ TD := by
    simpa [TD, H, coreSupport] using
      N.hGateAttach i hi0 r (by simpa [H, coreSupport] using hrH) d hd hadj
  exact hrnT this

name: Nikoghosyan.Eligible.union_disjoint_no_cross
statement:
lemma Eligible.union_disjoint_no_cross {A B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x : V} (hxA : x ∈ A) (hE : Eligible G A x) :
    Eligible G (A ∪ B) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pcA, hmin, p, hp, hend⟩ := hE
  obtain ⟨pcB, hB⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) B
  let pc := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcA pcB
  have hcard : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    rw [Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisj pcA pcB, hmin, hB,
      Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union hdisj hnocross]
  refine ⟨pc, hcard, p, ?_, hend⟩
  exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Eligible.of_union_disjoint_no_cross_left
statement:
lemma Eligible.of_union_disjoint_no_cross_left {A B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x : V} (hxA : x ∈ A) (hE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x) :
    Eligible G A x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hmin, p, hp, hend⟩ := hE
  have hsupp : p.support ⊆ A ∪ B := pc.support_subset hp
  have hstartAB : p.start ∈ A ∨ p.start ∈ B := by
    have : p.start ∈ A ∪ B := hsupp p.start_mem_support
    simpa [mem_union] using this
  have hstartA : p.start ∈ A := by
    rcases hstartAB with hA | hB
    · exact hA
    · have : p.support ⊆ B :=
        Cograph.GraphPath.support_subset_of_no_cross'
          (A := A) (B := B) hnocross p hB hsupp
      have hxB : x ∈ B := by
        rcases hend with rfl | rfl
        · exact this p.start_mem_support
        · exact this p.finish_mem_support
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA hxB).elim
  have hpA : p ∈ (Cograph.PathCover.splitLeft hdisj hnocross pc).paths :=
    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, decide_eq_true hstartA⟩
  have hcardA :
      (Cograph.PathCover.splitLeft hdisj hnocross pc).card =
        pathCoverNumber G A :=
    Cograph.splitLeft_card_eq_of_min hdisj hnocross pc hmin
  exact ⟨Cograph.PathCover.splitLeft hdisj hnocross pc, hcardA, p, hpA, hend⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_middle_of_connected_cograph
statement:
lemma exists_middle_of_connected_cograph {U : Finset V} {h d : V}
    (_hUne : U.Nonempty)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (hCog : IsCograph G U)
    (hh : h ∈ U) (hd : d ∈ U) (hne : h ≠ d) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj h d) :
    ∃ u, u ∈ U ∧ G.Adj h u ∧ G.Adj u d
proof:
:= by
  have hOn : Cograph.IsCographOn G (U : Set V) :=
    (Cograph.isCographOn_iff_isCograph (G := G)).2 (Cograph.isCograph_iff.mpr hCog)
  have hCG : Cograph.IsCographGraph (G.induce (U : Set V)) :=
    (Cograph.isCographOn_iff_isCographGraph_induce (s := (U : Set V))).1 hOn
  let h' : (U : Set V) := ⟨h, hh⟩
  let d' : (U : Set V) := ⟨d, hd⟩
  have hdist := Cograph.dist_le_two_of_connected_cograph hconn hCG h' d'
  have hne' : h' ≠ d' := fun hst => hne (congrArg Subtype.val hst)
  have hnadj' : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Adj h' d' := by
    simpa [induce_adj] using hnadj
  have hR : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable h' d' := hconn h' d'
  obtain ⟨p, _hpPath, hpLen⟩ := hR.exists_path_of_dist
  have hlen_le : p.length ≤ 2 := by
    simpa [hpLen] using hdist
  have hpos : 0 < p.length := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro hz
    have : h' = d' := by
      have h0 : p.getVert 0 = p.getVert p.length := by
        simp [hz, Walk.getVert_zero, Walk.getVert_length]
      simpa [Walk.getVert_zero, Walk.getVert_length] using h0
    exact hne' this
  have hne1 : p.length ≠ 1 := by
    intro h1
    have hlt : 0 < p.length := by omega
    have hadj := p.adj_getVert_succ hlt
    have : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Adj h' d' := by
      have h0 : p.getVert 0 = h' := by simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
      have hlen1 : p.getVert p.length = d' := Walk.getVert_length p
      have h1v : p.getVert 1 = d' := by simpa [h1] using hlen1
      simpa [h0, h1v] using hadj
    exact hnadj' this
  have h2 : p.length = 2 := by omega
  have hlt0 : 0 < p.length := by omega
  have hlt1 : 1 < p.length := by omega
  have hadj01 := p.adj_getVert_succ hlt0
  have hadj12 := p.adj_getVert_succ hlt1
  refine ⟨(p.getVert 1).1, (p.getVert 1).2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : p.getVert 0 = h' := by simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
    simpa [induce_adj, h0] using hadj01
  · have hlen2 : p.getVert p.length = d' := Walk.getVert_length p
    have h2v : p.getVert 2 = d' := by simpa [h2] using hlen2
    simpa [induce_adj, h2v] using hadj12

name: Nikoghosyan.false_of_nonadjacent_sees_single_foreign_release
statement:
lemma false_of_nonadjacent_sees_single_foreign_release
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x z h : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz' : z ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x z) (hxz : x ≠ z)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj)
    (hhAz : h ∈ rowAt N z)
    (hhF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x))
    (hhE : h ∈ eligibleSet G
      ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  set H := coreSupport N
  set A := rowAt N x
  set D := (F.getCycle i).support
  set L := H \ A
  set J := L ∪ D
  have hmiss : ∀ d ∈ D, ¬ G.Adj h d :=
    released_old_misses_foreign_cycle N hj hpat hmin hx hi hhF hhE
  have hhL : h ∈ L := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hhF |>.1
  have hhH : h ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hhL).1
  have hhA : h ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hhL).2
  have hCsubL : (ineligibleSet G L ∩ ineligibleSet G J) ⊆ ineligibleSet G L :=
    inter_subset_left
  have hCsubJ : (ineligibleSet G L ∩ ineligibleSet G J) ⊆ ineligibleSet G J :=
    inter_subset_right
  set C := ineligibleSet G L ∩ ineligibleSet G J
  have hKc : IsCograph G J :=
    isCograph_remainder_union_foreign N hj hpat hx hi
  have hK0c : IsCograph G L := isCograph_old_remainder N hj hx
  have hdelJ := Cograph.ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_canonical (G := G) hKc hCsubJ
  have hdelL := Cograph.ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_canonical (G := G) hK0c hCsubL
  have hhEJ : h ∈ eligibleSet G J := hhE
  have hhC : h ∉ C := by
    intro hC
    have : h ∈ ineligibleSet G J := (mem_inter.1 hC).2
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) J)
      hhEJ this
  have hhJC : h ∈ J \ C := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hhL), hhC⟩
  have hDsub : D ⊆ J := subset_union_right
  have hDC : Disjoint D C := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro d hd hdC
    have hdL : d ∈ L :=
      ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) L ((mem_inter.1 hdC).1)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
      (disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle N hj hi x) hdL hd
  have hDJC : D ⊆ J \ C := by
    intro d hd
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hDsub hd, fun hC => (disjoint_left.1 hDC) hd hC⟩
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := (F.getCycle i).support_nonempty
  have hDconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected := by
    simpa [D] using Cograph.connected_of_cycle (F.getCycle i)
  obtain ⟨U, hUsub, hDU, hUne, hUconn, hnocrossU⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_block_containing (K := J \ C) hDJC hDne hDconn
  have hUCog : IsCograph G U :=
    Cograph.isCograph_iff.mp
      (Cograph.isCograph_mono
        (Cograph.isCograph_mono (Cograph.isCograph_iff.mpr hKc) sdiff_subset)
        hUsub)
  have hhU : h ∈ U := by
    by_contra hhU
    have hhW : h ∈ (J \ C) \ U := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hhJC, hhU⟩
    set W := (J \ C) \ U
    have hdisjUW : Disjoint U W := disjoint_sdiff
    have hcover : U ∪ W = J \ C := union_sdiff_of_subset hUsub
    have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj a b := hnocrossU
    have hhEJC : Eligible G (J \ C) h := by
      have : h ∈ eligibleSet G (J \ C) := by
        have hEq := hdelJ.2.1
        simpa [hEq] using hhEJ
      exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this |>.2
    have hEW : Eligible G W h :=
      Eligible.of_union_disjoint_no_cross_left (A := W) (B := U)
        (Disjoint.symm (by simpa [W] using hdisjUW))
        (fun a ha b hb hab => hnocrossU b hb a ha hab.symm)
        (by simpa [W] using hhW)
        (by simpa [hcover, Finset.union_comm] using hhEJC)
    
    obtain ⟨d0, hd0⟩ := hDne
    have hd0R : d0 ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hd0⟩
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0E, hadj0⟩ := foreign_meets_old_eligible N hj hpat hx hd0R
    have hu0L : u0 ∈ L := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hu0E |>.1
    have hu0C : u0 ∉ C := by
      intro huC
      have : u0 ∈ ineligibleSet G L := (mem_inter.1 huC).1
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) L)
        hu0E this
    have hu0JC : u0 ∈ J \ C :=
      mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hu0L), hu0C⟩
    have hu0U : u0 ∈ U := by
      by_contra hu0nU
      have hu0W : u0 ∈ W := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hu0JC, hu0nU⟩
      exact hnocrossU d0 (hDU hd0) u0 hu0W hadj0
    have hUL : U ∩ (L \ C) = U \ D := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hyU : y ∈ U := (mem_inter.1 hy).1
        have hyL : y ∈ L \ C := (mem_inter.1 hy).2
        have hyD : y ∉ D := by
          intro hyD
          exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
            (disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle N hj hi x)
            (mem_sdiff.1 hyL).1 hyD
        exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyU, hyD⟩
      · intro hy
        have hyU : y ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).1
        have hyD : y ∉ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2
        have hyJC : y ∈ J \ C := hUsub hyU
        have hyJ : y ∈ J := (mem_sdiff.1 hyJC).1
        have hyC : y ∉ C := (mem_sdiff.1 hyJC).2
        have hyL : y ∈ L := (mem_union.1 hyJ).resolve_right hyD
        exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hyU, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyL, hyC⟩⟩
    have hLsplit : (U \ D) ∪ W = L \ C := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        rcases mem_union.1 hy with hyU | hyW
        · have hy' : y ∈ U ∩ (L \ C) := by
            simpa [hUL] using hyU
          exact (mem_inter.1 hy').2
        · have hyJC : y ∈ J \ C := (mem_sdiff.1 hyW).1
          have hyU : y ∉ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hyW).2
          have hyJ : y ∈ J := (mem_sdiff.1 hyJC).1
          have hyC : y ∉ C := (mem_sdiff.1 hyJC).2
          have hyD : y ∉ D := by
            intro hyD
            exact hyU (hDU hyD)
          exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_union.1 hyJ).resolve_right hyD, hyC⟩
      · intro hy
        have hyL : y ∈ L := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).1
        have hyC : y ∉ C := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2
        have hyJC : y ∈ J \ C :=
          mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hyL), hyC⟩
        by_cases hyU : y ∈ U
        · have hyD : y ∉ D := by
            intro hyD
            exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
              (disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle N hj hi x) hyL hyD
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyU, hyD⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyJC, hyU⟩))
    have hdisjLW : Disjoint (U \ D) W :=
      Disjoint.mono_left sdiff_subset (by simpa [W] using hdisjUW)
    have hnocrossLW : ∀ a ∈ U \ D, ∀ b ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
      fun a ha b hb => hnocrossU a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 b hb
    have hELC : Eligible G (L \ C) h := by
      have hE' :
          Eligible G (W ∪ (U \ D)) h :=
        Eligible.union_disjoint_no_cross (A := W) (B := U \ D)
          (Disjoint.symm hdisjLW)
          (fun a ha b hb hab => hnocrossLW b hb a ha hab.symm)
          (by simpa [W] using hhW) hEW
      have hEq : W ∪ (U \ D) = L \ C := by
        rw [union_comm]
        exact hLsplit
      simpa [hEq] using hE'
    have hEL : h ∈ eligibleSet G L := by
      have hEq := hdelL.2.1
      have : h ∈ eligibleSet G (L \ C) :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hhL, hhC⟩, hELC⟩
      simpa [hEq] using this
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) L)
      hEL hhF
  obtain ⟨d, hdD⟩ := hDne
  have hdU : d ∈ U := hDU hdD
  have hne_hd : h ≠ d := by
    intro hhd
    have hdL : d ∈ L := by simpa [hhd] using hhL
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
      (disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle N hj hi x) hdL hdD
  have hnadj_hd : ¬ G.Adj h d := hmiss d hdD
  obtain ⟨u, huU, hadj_hu, hadj_ud⟩ :=
    exists_middle_of_connected_cograph hUne hUconn hUCog hhU hdU hne_hd hnadj_hd
  have huD : u ∉ D := by
    intro huD
    exact hmiss u huD hadj_hu
  have huJC : u ∈ J \ C := hUsub huU
  have huJ : u ∈ J := (mem_sdiff.1 huJC).1
  have huC : u ∉ C := (mem_sdiff.1 huJC).2
  have huL : u ∈ L := (mem_union.1 huJ).resolve_right huD
  have huE : u ∈ eligibleSet G L := by
    by_contra huF
    have huIn : u ∈ ineligibleSet G L :=
      (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨huL, fun hE =>
        huF ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨huL, hE⟩)⟩
    have huEJ : u ∈ eligibleSet G J := by
      by_contra huFJ
      have : u ∈ ineligibleSet G J :=
        (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨huJ, fun hE =>
          huFJ ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨huJ, hE⟩)⟩
      exact huC (mem_inter.2 ⟨huIn, this⟩)
    exact released_old_misses_foreign_cycle N hj hpat hmin hx hi
      huIn huEJ d hdD hadj_ud
  have huS : u ∉
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) H A := by
    have huEL : Eligible G L u := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 huE |>.2
    intro huCan
    have : u ∈ A ∪ ineligibleSet G L := by
      simpa [Cograph.canonicalContainer_eq, H, A, L] using huCan
    rcases mem_union.1 this with huA | huF
    · exact (mem_sdiff.1 huL).2 huA
    · exact ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 huF).2 huEL
  have hnadj_zu : ¬ G.Adj z u := by
    intro hzu
    have hzH : u ∈ rowAt N z :=
      (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨(mem_sdiff.1 huL).1, hzu⟩
    have : u ∈ Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) H A :=
      same_own_row_subset_old_canonical N hj hx hz' hzH
    exact huS this
  have hnadj_zd : ¬ G.Adj z d := by
    intro hzd
    have hzR : d ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hdD⟩
    exact anticomplete_own_foreign N hj hz' hzR hzd
  have hadj_zh : G.Adj z h := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hhAz |>.2
  have hne_zh : z ≠ h := hadj_zh.ne
  have hne_hu : h ≠ u := hadj_hu.ne
  have hne_ud : u ≠ d := hadj_ud.ne
  have hne_zu : z ≠ u := by
    intro hzu
    have : u ∈ ownSupport N hj := by simpa [hzu] using hz'
    exact not_mem_core_of_own N hj this (mem_sdiff.1 huL).1
  have hne_zd : z ≠ d := by
    intro hzd
    have : d ∈ ownSupport N hj := by simpa [hzd] using hz'
    have hdR : d ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hdD⟩
    exact not_mem_foreign_of_own N hj this hdR
  have hp4 : InducedP4 G z h u d :=
    ⟨hne_zh, hne_zu, hne_zd, hne_hu, hne_hd, hne_ud,
      hadj_zh, hadj_hu, hadj_ud, hnadj_zu, hnadj_zd, hnadj_hd⟩
  have hxH : x ∉ H := not_mem_core_of_own N hj hx
  have hne_xh : x ≠ h := fun hxh => hxH (by simpa [hxh] using hhH)
  have hne_xu : x ≠ u := fun hxu => hxH (by simpa [hxu] using (mem_sdiff.1 huL).1)
  have hne_xd : x ≠ d := by
    intro hxd
    have hdR : d ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hdD⟩
    exact not_mem_foreign_of_own N hj (by simpa [hxd] using hx) hdR
  have hnadj_xh : ¬ G.Adj x h := by
    intro hxh
    exact hhA ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hhH, hxh⟩)
  have hnadj_xu : ¬ G.Adj x u := by
    intro hxu
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 huL).2 ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2
      ⟨(mem_sdiff.1 huL).1, hxu⟩)
  have hnadj_xd : ¬ G.Adj x d := by
    intro hxd
    have hdR : d ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hdD⟩
    exact anticomplete_own_foreign N hj hx hdR hxd
  have hmeet := hpat hp4 hxz hne_xh hne_xu hne_xd
  rcases hmeet with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
  · exact hnadj h1
  · exact hnadj_xh h2
  · exact hnadj_xu h3
  · exact hnadj_xd h4

name: Nikoghosyan.nonadjacent_rows_subset_ownCut
statement:
theorem nonadjacent_rows_subset_ownCut
    {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x z : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj x z) :
    rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxz : x = z
  · subst hxz
    exact rowAt_subset_ownCut N hj x
  rcases same_own_row_subset_or_escape N hj hx hz with hsub | hexc
  · exact hsub
  · obtain ⟨h, hhAz, hhF, hhE⟩ := hexc
    have hhE' : h ∈ eligibleSet G
        (unionJ (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) F.getCycle (N.foreign j hj)) := by
      simpa [unionJ_eq_host_remainder N hj x] using hhE
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hw⟩ :=
      exists_single_release_eq F.getCycle (localityHyp_at N hj hpat hx) hhF hhE'
    have hpL := pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx
    rcases hw with hstrict | ⟨_, hhEi⟩
    · exact (not_strict_saving_located_foreign N hj hpat hmin hx hi
        (by simpa [hpL] using hstrict)).elim
    · exact (false_of_nonadjacent_sees_single_foreign_release N hj hpat hmin
        hx hz hnadj hxz hi hhAz hhF hhEi).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.faceFinish_support
statement:
lemma GraphPath.faceFinish_support (p : GraphPath G) (b : Bool) :
    (p.faceFinish b).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.faceFinish
  cases b <;> simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.faceStart_support
statement:
lemma GraphPath.faceStart_support (p : GraphPath G) (b : Bool) :

proof:

  unfold GraphPath.faceStart
  cases b <;> simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.faceFinish_deficit
statement:
lemma GraphPath.faceFinish_deficit (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G) (b : Bool) :
    (p.faceFinish b).endpointDeficit B = p.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.faceFinish
  cases b <;> simp [GraphPath.endpointDeficit_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.faceStart_deficit
statement:
lemma GraphPath.faceStart_deficit (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G) (b : Bool) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.faceFinish_ends_mem
statement:
lemma GraphPath.faceFinish_ends_mem {P : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) (b : Bool)
    (hs : p.start ∈ P) (hf : p.finish ∈ P) :
    (p.faceFinish b).start ∈ P ∧ (p.faceFinish b).finish ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.faceFinish
  cases b <;> simp [GraphPath.reverse, hs, hf]

lemma GraphPath.faceStart_ends_mem {P : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) (b : Bool)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.selectedDeficit_le
statement:
lemma GraphPath.selectedDeficit_le (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G)
    (b : Bool) :
    p.selectedDeficit B b ≤ p.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.selectedDeficit GraphPath.endpointDeficit
  cases b <;> split_ifs <;> simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.faceFinish_finish_selected
statement:
lemma GraphPath.faceFinish_finish_selected (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G)
    (b : Bool) :
    (if (p.faceFinish b).finish ∈ B then 0 else 1) = p.selectedDeficit B b
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.faceFinish GraphPath.selectedDeficit
  cases b <;> simp [GraphPath.reverse]

lemma GraphPath.faceStart_start_selected (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G)
