name: Nikoghosyan.ownSupport_nonempty
statement:
lemma ownSupport_nonempty {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    (ownSupport N hj).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := N.hOwnNe j hj
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (F.getCycle t).support_nonempty
  exact ⟨y, (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨t, ht, hy⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.foreignSupport_nonempty
statement:
lemma foreignSupport_nonempty {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    (foreignSupport N hj).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := N.hForeignNe j hj
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (F.getCycle t).support_nonempty
  exact ⟨y, (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨t, ht, hy⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_core_own
statement:
lemma disjoint_core_own {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    Disjoint (coreSupport N) (ownSupport N hj)
proof:
:=
  N.hDisjHB j hj

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_core_foreign
statement:
lemma disjoint_core_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    Disjoint (coreSupport N) (foreignSupport N hj)
proof:
:=
  N.hDisjHR j hj

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_ownSupport_foreignSupport
statement:
lemma disjoint_ownSupport_foreignSupport {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    Disjoint (ownSupport N hj) (foreignSupport N hj)
proof:
:=
  N.hDisjBR j hj

name: Nikoghosyan.partition_core_own_foreign
statement:
lemma partition_core_own_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    coreSupport N ∪ ownSupport N hj ∪ foreignSupport N hj = univ
proof:
:=
  N.hPartition j hj

name: Nikoghosyan.anticomplete_own_foreign
statement:
lemma anticomplete_own_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hv : v ∈ foreignSupport N hj) :
    ¬ G.Adj u v
proof:
:=
  N.hAnticompleteBR j hj hu hv

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_core
statement: lemma rowAt_subset_core (x : V) : rowAt N x ⊆ coreSupport N
proof:
:=
  rowProfile_subset (G := G) (coreSupport N) x

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_host
statement:
lemma rowAt_subset_host {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) (x : V) :
    rowAt N x ⊆ extendedHost N hj
proof:
:=
  (rowAt_subset_core N x).trans subset_union_left

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_own_index
statement:
lemma exists_own_index {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    ∃ t, ∃ ht : t ≠ N.core,
      t ∈ N.own j hj ∧ x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support ∧
        N.gateOf t ht = N.gateOf j hj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htOwn, hxt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hx
  obtain ⟨ht, heq⟩ := (N.hOwnMem j hj t).1 htOwn
  exact ⟨t, ht, htOwn, hxt, heq⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_foreign_index
statement:
lemma exists_foreign_index {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) {y : V}
    (hy : y ∈ foreignSupport N hj) :
    ∃ t, ∃ ht : t ≠ N.core,
      t ∈ N.foreign j hj ∧ y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support ∧
        N.gateOf t ht ≠ N.gateOf j hj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htFor, hyt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hy
  obtain ⟨ht, hne⟩ := (N.hForeignMem j hj t).1 htFor
  exact ⟨t, ht, htFor, hyt, hne⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.own_index_ne_foreign
statement:
lemma own_index_ne_foreign {j t i : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj) (hiFor : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) : t ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  subst h
  obtain ⟨ht, heq⟩ := (N.hOwnMem j hj t).1 htOwn
  obtain ⟨hi, hne⟩ := (N.hForeignMem j hj t).1 hiFor
  have hproof : ht = hi := Subsingleton.elim ht hi
  exact hne (hproof ▸ heq)

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_ssubset_core
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hxt, _hgate⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  have hAS : rowAt N x ⊆ N.gateOf t ht := by
    simpa [rowAt, coreSupport] using (N.hGateRows t ht x hxt).2.2.2.2
  have hS : N.gateOf t ht ⊂ coreSupport N := by
    simpa [coreSupport] using N.hGateProper t ht
  exact Finset.ssubset_of_subset_of_ssubset hAS hS

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hxt, _⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  simpa [rowAt, coreSupport] using (N.hGateRows t ht x hxt).1

name: Nikoghosyan.saturated_rowAt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hxt, _⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  simpa [rowAt, coreSupport] using (N.hGateRows t ht x hxt).2.2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.canonicalContainer_rowAt
statement:
lemma canonicalContainer_rowAt {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (coreSupport N) (rowAt N x) =
      N.gateOf j hj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hxt, hgate⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  have hC :
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (coreSupport N) (rowAt N x) =
        N.gateOf t ht := by
    simpa [rowAt, coreSupport] using (N.hGateRows t ht x hxt).2.2.2.1
  exact hC.trans hgate

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_host_eq_remainder_union_foreign
statement:
lemma sdiff_host_eq_remainder_union_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (x : V) :
    extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x =
      (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ foreignSupport N hj
proof:
:= by
  have hAsub : rowAt N x ⊆ coreSupport N := rowAt_subset_core N x
  have hdisj : Disjoint (rowAt N x) (foreignSupport N hj) :=
    Disjoint.mono_left hAsub (disjoint_core_foreign N hj)
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzQ : z ∈ coreSupport N ∪ foreignSupport N hj := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzA : z ∉ rowAt N x := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    rcases mem_union.1 hzQ with hzH | hzR
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzH, hzA⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzR)
  · intro hz
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzH | hzR
    · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.1 hzH).1),
        (mem_sdiff.1 hzH).2⟩
    · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzR),
        fun hA => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj) hA hzR⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_mem_core_of_own
statement:
lemma not_mem_core_of_own {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) : x ∉ coreSupport N
proof:
:=
  disjoint_right.1 (disjoint_core_own N hj) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.not_mem_foreign_of_own
statement:
lemma not_mem_foreign_of_own {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) : x ∉ foreignSupport N hj
proof:
:=
  disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_ownSupport_foreignSupport N hj) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_host_remainder
statement:
lemma isCograph_host_remainder {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    IsCograph G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  have hanti : ∀ d ∈ foreignSupport N hj, ¬ G.Adj x d := fun d hd =>
    anticomplete_own_foreign N hj hx hd
  have hK :=
    isCograph_K_of_anticomplete_x (G := G) hpat
      (not_mem_core_of_own N hj hx) (not_mem_foreign_of_own N hj hx) hanti
  rw [sdiff_host_eq_remainder_union_foreign]
  simpa [rowAt] using hK

name: Nikoghosyan.host_remainder_nonempty
statement:
lemma host_remainder_nonempty {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) (x : V) :
    (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := foreignSupport_nonempty N hj
  have hyA : y ∉ rowAt N x := by
    intro hA
    exact (disjoint_left.1
      (Disjoint.mono_left (rowAt_subset_core N x) (disjoint_core_foreign N hj)))
      hA hy
  exact ⟨y, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hy), hyA⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.foreign_meets_old_eligible
statement:
lemma foreign_meets_old_eligible {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hy : y ∈ foreignSupport N hj) :
    ∃ u ∈ eligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x), G.Adj y u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, _, hyi, hneGate⟩ := exists_foreign_index N hj hy
  have hST : N.gateOf j hj ≠ N.gateOf i hi := by
    intro h
    exact hneGate (h.symm)
  have hXsat :
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support x) := by
    simpa [coreSupport, rowAt] using saturated_rowAt N hj hx
  have hXgate :
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
          (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support x) =
        N.gateOf j hj := by
    simpa [coreSupport, rowAt] using canonicalContainer_rowAt N hj hx
  have hDrow :
      (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support y).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G ((F.getCycle N.core).support \
          rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support y) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
            (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support y) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
                (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support y) =
              N.gateOf i hi := by
    have hrow := N.hGateRows i hi y hyi
    exact ⟨hrow.1, hrow.2.1, hrow.2.2.1, hrow.2.2.2.1⟩
  have hmeet :=
    drow_meets_eligible_of_distinct_gates hpat (F.getCycle N.core)
      (disjoint_core_own N hj) N.hCoreNoncog hDrow hx hXsat hXgate hST
  simpa [coreSupport, rowAt] using hmeet

name: Nikoghosyan.ownCut_subset_host
statement:
lemma ownCut_subset_host {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) (x : V) :
    ownCut N hj x ⊆ extendedHost N hj
proof:
:=
  Cograph.profileContainer_subset (G := G) (rowAt_subset_host N hj x)

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_ownCut
statement:
lemma rowAt_subset_ownCut {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) (x : V) :
    rowAt N x ⊆ ownCut N hj x
proof:
:=
  subset_union_left

name: Nikoghosyan.ownCut_attains
statement:
lemma ownCut_attains {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    (componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ ownCut N hj x) : ℤ) -
      ((ownCut N hj x).card : ℤ) =
        cutDelta N hj x
proof:
:= by
  have hK : IsCograph G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) :=
    isCograph_host_remainder N hj hpat hx
  simpa [ownCut, cutDelta] using
    Cograph.profileContainer_attains_of_canonical (G := G)
      (rowAt_subset_host N hj x) hK (host_remainder_nonempty N hj x)

name: Nikoghosyan.cutDelta_le_of_row_subset_cut
statement:
lemma cutDelta_le_of_row_subset_cut {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x z : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hAz : rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x) :
    cutDelta N hj x ≤ cutDelta N hj z
proof:
:= by
  have hatt := ownCut_attains N hj hpat hx
  have hbound :=
    Cograph.profileDelta_le_of_nested (G := G) (U := extendedHost N hj)
      (A := rowAt N z) (T := ownCut N hj x) hAz (ownCut_subset_host N hj x)
  exact hatt ▸ hbound

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_mutual_row_containment
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_mutual_row_containment {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x z : V}
    (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    (hAz : rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x)
    (hAx : rowAt N x ⊆ ownCut N hj z) :
    cutDelta N hj x = cutDelta N hj z ∧ ownCut N hj x = ownCut N hj z
proof:
:= by
  have hxz := cutDelta_le_of_row_subset_cut N hj hpat hx hAz
  have hzx := cutDelta_le_of_row_subset_cut N hj hpat hz hAx
  have hδ : cutDelta N hj x = cutDelta N hj z := le_antisymm hxz hzx
  have hKx : IsCograph G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) :=
    isCograph_host_remainder N hj hpat hx
  have hKz : IsCograph G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N z) :=
    isCograph_host_remainder N hj hpat hz
  have hattx := ownCut_attains N hj hpat hx
  have hattz := ownCut_attains N hj hpat hz
  have hx_in_z := hattx.trans hδ
  have hz_in_x := hattz.trans hδ.symm
  have hsubxz : ownCut N hj x ⊆ ownCut N hj z :=
    Cograph.profile_maximizer_subset_container_of_canonical (G := G)
      (U := extendedHost N hj) (A := rowAt N z) (T := ownCut N hj x)
      hAz (ownCut_subset_host N hj x) hKz (by simpa [ownCut, cutDelta] using hx_in_z)
  have hsubzx : ownCut N hj z ⊆ ownCut N hj x :=
    Cograph.profile_maximizer_subset_container_of_canonical (G := G)
      (U := extendedHost N hj) (A := rowAt N x) (T := ownCut N hj z)
      hAx (ownCut_subset_host N hj z) hKx (by simpa [ownCut, cutDelta] using hz_in_x)
  exact ⟨hδ, subset_antisymm hsubxz hsubzx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.support_union_eq_selected_triple
statement:
lemma support_union_eq_selected_triple {i k t : Fin F.card} (C : GraphCycle G)
    (hC : C.support =
      (F.getCycle i).support ∪ (F.getCycle k).support ∪ (F.getCycle t).support) :
    C.support = F.selectedSupport ({i, k, t} : Finset (Fin F.card))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hC, Finset.union_assoc, CycleFactor.selectedSupport_triple]

name: Nikoghosyan.gateRows_as_Drows
statement:
lemma gateRows_as_Drows {t : Fin F.card} (ht : t ≠ N.core) :
    ∀ d ∈ (F.getCycle t).support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support d).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G ((F.getCycle N.core).support \
          rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support d) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
            (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support d) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
                (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support d) =
              N.gateOf t ht
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  have hrow := N.hGateRows t ht d hd
  exact ⟨hrow.1, hrow.2.1, hrow.2.2.1, hrow.2.2.2.1⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.gateRows_as_Xsat
statement:
lemma gateRows_as_Xsat {t : Fin F.card} (ht : t ≠ N.core) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : N.gateOf t ht = S) :
    ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support,
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support y) ∧
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support
            (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support y) = S
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hrow := N.hGateRows t ht y hy
  exact ⟨hrow.2.2.1, hrow.2.2.2.1.trans hS⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_strict_saving_located_foreign
statement:
lemma not_strict_saving_located_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hiFor : i ∈ N.foreign j hj)
    (hsave : pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) <
      (rowAt N x).card) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htOwn, hxt, hgate⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  obtain ⟨hi, hneGate⟩ := (N.hForeignMem j hj i).1 hiFor
  have hti : t ≠ i := own_index_ne_foreign N hj htOwn hiFor
  have htc : t ≠ N.core := ht
  have hic : i ≠ N.core := hi
  have hST : N.gateOf j hj ≠ N.gateOf i hi := hneGate.symm
  have hHD : Disjoint (F.getCycle N.core).support (F.getCycle i).support :=
    F.disjoint_getCycle hic.symm
  have hHX : Disjoint (F.getCycle N.core).support (F.getCycle t).support :=
    F.disjoint_getCycle htc.symm
  have hDX : Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle t).support :=
    F.disjoint_getCycle hti.symm
  have hanti : ∀ d ∈ (F.getCycle i).support, ¬ G.Adj x d := by
    intro d hd
    have hdR : d ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hiFor, hd⟩
    exact anticomplete_own_foreign N hj hx hdR
  have hpK : pathCoverNumber G
      (((F.getCycle N.core).support \
          rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support x) ∪
        (F.getCycle i).support) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle N.core).support x).card := by
    simpa [coreSupport, rowAt] using hsave
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
    exists_cycle_of_strict_merger hpat (F.getCycle N.core) (F.getCycle i)
      (F.getCycle t) hHD hHX hDX N.hCoreNoncog
      (gateRows_as_Drows N hi) (gateRows_as_Xsat N ht hgate) hST hxt hanti hpK
  have hspan :
      γ.support = F.selectedSupport ({N.core, i, t} : Finset (Fin F.card)) :=
    support_union_eq_selected_triple (i := N.core) (k := i) (t := t) γ hγ
  have h3 : 2 ≤ ({N.core, i, t} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card := by
    have hcard := card_selected_triple (i := N.core) (j := i) (k := t)
      hic.symm htc.symm hti.symm
    omega
  exact CycleFactor.not_exists_merge_of_min F hmin
    ({N.core, i, t} : Finset (Fin F.card)) h3 γ hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.remainder_old_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyH, hyA⟩ := exists_of_ssubset (rowAt_ssubset_core N hj hx)
  exact ⟨y, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyH, hyA⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    pathCoverNumber G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) = (rowAt N x).card
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_k0_of_saturated (saturated_rowAt N hj hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.foreign_cycles_disjoint
statement:
lemma foreign_cycles_disjoint {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {i k : Fin F.card} (_hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) (_hk : k ∈ N.foreign j hj)
    (hik : i ≠ k) :
    Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle k).support
proof:
:=
  F.disjoint_getCycle hik

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle
statement:
lemma disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) (x : V) :
    Disjoint (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) (F.getCycle i).support
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i ≠ N.core := ((N.hForeignMem j hj i).1 hi).1
  exact Disjoint.mono_left sdiff_subset (F.disjoint_getCycle hi'.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.neg_cutDelta_is_global_saving
statement:
lemma neg_cutDelta_is_global_saving {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hneg : cutDelta N hj x < 0) :
    pathCoverNumber G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) <
      pathCoverNumber G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  have hpL := pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx
  have hneg' :
      (pathCoverNumber G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) : ℤ) -
        ((rowAt N x).card : ℤ) < 0 := by
    simpa [cutDelta, Cograph.profileDelta] using hneg
  have : pathCoverNumber G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) <
      (rowAt N x).card := Int.ofNat_lt.mp (by omega)
  simpa [hpL] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.locality_family_data
statement:
lemma locality_family_data {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    (N.foreign j hj).Nonempty ∧
      (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x).Nonempty ∧
        (∀ i ∈ N.foreign j hj,
          Disjoint (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) (F.getCycle i).support) ∧
          (∀ i ∈ N.foreign j hj, ∀ k ∈ N.foreign j hj, i ≠ k →
            Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle k).support) ∧
            IsCograph G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) ∧
              (∀ i ∈ N.foreign j hj, ∀ d ∈ (F.getCycle i).support,
                ∃ u ∈ eligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x), G.Adj d u)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨N.hForeignNe j hj, remainder_old_nonempty N hj hx, ?_, ?_,
    isCograph_host_remainder N hj hpat hx, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact disjoint_remainder_foreign_cycle N hj hi x
  · intro i hi k hk hik
    exact foreign_cycles_disjoint N hj hi hk hik
  · intro i hi d hd
    have hdR : d ∈ foreignSupport N hj :=
      (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hd⟩
    exact foreign_meets_old_eligible N hj hpat hx hdR

name: Nikoghosyan.selectedSupport_eq_foreign
statement:
lemma selectedSupport_eq_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) :
    selectedSupport (c := F.getCycle) (N.foreign j hj) = foreignSupport N hj
proof:
:= by
  simp [selectedSupport, foreignSupport, CycleFactor.selectedSupport]

name: Nikoghosyan.unionJ_eq_host_remainder
statement:
lemma unionJ_eq_host_remainder {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) (x : V) :
    unionJ (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) F.getCycle (N.foreign j hj) =
      extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x
proof:
:= by
  unfold unionJ
  rw [selectedSupport_eq_foreign, sdiff_host_eq_remainder_union_foreign]

name: Nikoghosyan.localityHyp_at
statement:
lemma localityHyp_at {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    LocalityHyp F.getCycle (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) (N.foreign j hj)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hI, hL, hdisj, hpair, hcog, hsees⟩ := locality_family_data N hj hpat hx
  refine ⟨hI, hL, hdisj, hpair, ?_, hsees⟩
  simpa [unionJ_eq_host_remainder N hj x] using hcog

name: Nikoghosyan.cutDelta_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutDelta_nonneg {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    0 ≤ cutDelta N hj x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hneg0
  have hneg : cutDelta N hj x < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hneg0
  have hglob := neg_cutDelta_is_global_saving N hj hx hneg
  have Hloc := localityHyp_at N hj hpat hx
  have hsave :
      pathCoverNumber G
          (unionJ (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) F.getCycle (N.foreign j hj)) <
        pathCoverNumber G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) := by
    simpa [unionJ_eq_host_remainder N hj x] using hglob
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hsi⟩ := exists_single_saving F.getCycle Hloc hsave
  have hpL := pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx
  have hsi' : pathCoverNumber G
      ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) <
        (rowAt N x).card := by
    simpa [hpL] using hsi
  exact not_strict_saving_located_foreign N hj hpat hmin hx hi hsi'

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_own_gate
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hxt, hgate⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  have hsub : rowAt N x ⊆ N.gateOf t ht := by
    simpa [rowAt, coreSupport] using (N.hGateRows t ht x hxt).2.2.2.2
  exact hsub.trans (hgate ▸ Subset.rfl)

name: Nikoghosyan.same_own_row_subset_old_canonical
statement:
lemma same_own_row_subset_old_canonical {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {x z : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    rowAt N z ⊆
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (coreSupport N) (rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  have hgate := rowAt_subset_own_gate N hj hz
  simpa [canonicalContainer_rowAt N hj hx] using hgate

name: Nikoghosyan.ownCut_eq_row_union_new_ineligible
statement:
lemma ownCut_eq_row_union_new_ineligible {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (x : V) :
    ownCut N hj x =
      rowAt N x ∪ ineligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_host_ownCut
statement:
lemma sdiff_host_ownCut {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core) (x : V) :
    extendedHost N hj \ ownCut N hj x =
      (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) \
        ineligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:=
  Cograph.sdiff_profileContainer (G := G) (rowAt_subset_host N hj x)

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_host_ownCut_eq_new_eligible
statement:
lemma sdiff_host_ownCut_eq_new_eligible {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (x : V) :
    extendedHost N hj \ ownCut N hj x =
      eligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sdiff_host_ownCut]
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzK : z ∈ extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzF : z ∉ ineligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) :=
      (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    refine (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzK, ?_⟩
    by_contra hnot
    exact hzF ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzK, hnot⟩)
  · intro hz
    have hzK : z ∈ extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x :=
      ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hz).1
    have hE : Eligible G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) z :=
      ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hz).2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzK, ?_⟩
    intro hzF
    exact ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hzF).2 hE

name: Nikoghosyan.escape_row_subset_old_ineligible
statement:
lemma escape_row_subset_old_ineligible {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {x z : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    rowAt N z \ ownCut N hj x ⊆
      ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hvAz : v ∈ rowAt N z := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hvT : v ∉ ownCut N hj x := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2
  have hvS : v ∈
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) (coreSupport N) (rowAt N x) :=
    same_own_row_subset_old_canonical N hj hx hz hvAz
  have hvAF :
      v ∈ rowAt N x ∪ ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) := by
    simpa [Cograph.canonicalContainer_eq] using hvS
  rcases mem_union.1 hvAF with hvA | hvF
  · exact (hvT (rowAt_subset_ownCut N hj x hvA)).elim
  · exact hvF

name: Nikoghosyan.escape_row_subset_new_eligible
statement:
lemma escape_row_subset_new_eligible {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {x z : V} (_hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    rowAt N z \ ownCut N hj x ⊆
      eligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hvAz : v ∈ rowAt N z := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hvT : v ∉ ownCut N hj x := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2
  have hvQ : v ∈ extendedHost N hj := rowAt_subset_host N hj z hvAz
  have hvrem : v ∈ extendedHost N hj \ ownCut N hj x :=
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvQ, hvT⟩
  simpa [sdiff_host_ownCut_eq_new_eligible N hj x] using hvrem

name: Nikoghosyan.same_own_row_subset_or_escape
statement:
lemma same_own_row_subset_or_escape {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {x z : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x ∨
      ∃ v, v ∈ rowAt N z ∧
        v ∈ ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∧
          v ∈ eligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsub : rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x
  · exact Or.inl hsub
  · have hne : (rowAt N z \ ownCut N hj x).Nonempty :=
      (nonempty_iff_ne_empty).2 fun hemp =>
        hsub ((sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset).1 hemp)
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hne
    exact Or.inr ⟨v, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1,
      escape_row_subset_old_ineligible N hj hx hz hv,
      escape_row_subset_new_eligible N hj hz hv⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_old_remainder
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hxt, _⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  simpa [coreSupport, rowAt] using (N.hGateRows t ht x hxt).2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.remainder_union_foreign_cycle_subset
statement:
lemma remainder_union_foreign_cycle_subset {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) (x : V) :
    (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support ⊆
      extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sdiff_host_eq_remainder_union_foreign]
  intro v hv
  rcases mem_union.1 hv with hL | hD
  · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hL)
  · exact mem_union.2
      (Or.inr ((CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨i, hi, hD⟩))

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_remainder_union_foreign
statement:
lemma isCograph_remainder_union_foreign {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {i : Fin F.card} (hi : i ∈ N.foreign j hj) :
    IsCograph G
      ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : IsCograph G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) :=
    isCograph_host_remainder N hj hpat hx
  have hQ' := Cograph.isCograph_iff.2 hQ
  exact Cograph.isCograph_iff.1
    (Cograph.IsCograph.subset hQ'
      (remainder_union_foreign_cycle_subset N hj hi x))

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_of_mem_rowAt
statement: lemma adj_of_mem_rowAt (x a : V) (ha : a ∈ rowAt N x) : G.Adj x a
proof:
:=
  ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 (by simpa [rowAt] using ha)).2

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle
statement:
lemma mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle {j t : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj) {y : V} (hy : y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) :
    y ∈ ownSupport N hj
proof:
:=
  (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).2 ⟨t, htOwn, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_escape_of_own_cycle_edge
statement:
lemma not_escape_of_own_cycle_edge {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    {x z : V} (hxC : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hzC : z ∈ (F.getCycle t).support)
    (hedge : (F.getCycle t).succAt hxC = z ∨ (F.getCycle t).succAt hzC = x)
    {v : V} (hvAz : v ∈ rowAt N z) (hvT : v ∉ ownCut N hj x) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hxC
  have hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hzC
  have hvF : v ∈ ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) :=
    escape_row_subset_old_ineligible N hj hx hz (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvAz, hvT⟩)
  have hvE : v ∈ eligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x) :=
    escape_row_subset_new_eligible N hj hz (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvAz, hvT⟩)
  have Hloc := localityHyp_at N hj hpat hx
  have hvE' : v ∈ eligibleSet G
      (unionJ (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) F.getCycle (N.foreign j hj)) := by
    simpa [unionJ_eq_host_remainder N hj x] using hvE
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hw⟩ :=
    exists_single_release_eq F.getCycle Hloc hvF hvE'
  have hpL := pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx
  rcases hw with hstrict | ⟨heq, hvEi⟩
  · have hsi : pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) <
          (rowAt N x).card := by
      simpa [hpL] using hstrict
    exact not_strict_saving_located_foreign N hj hpat hmin hx hi hsi
  · obtain ⟨ht, hgate⟩ := (N.hOwnMem j hj t).1 htOwn
    have hi' : i ≠ N.core := ((N.hForeignMem j hj i).1 hi).1
    have hti : t ≠ i := own_index_ne_foreign N hj htOwn hi
    have hHD : Disjoint (coreSupport N) (F.getCycle i).support := by
      simpa [coreSupport] using F.disjoint_getCycle hi'.symm
    have hHQ : Disjoint (coreSupport N) (F.getCycle t).support := by
      simpa [coreSupport] using F.disjoint_getCycle ht.symm
    have hDQ : Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle t).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle hti.symm
    have hAsub : rowAt N x ⊆ coreSupport N := rowAt_subset_core N x
    have hAne : (rowAt N x).Nonempty := rowAt_nonempty N hj hx
    have hAx : ∀ a ∈ rowAt N x, G.Adj a x :=
      fun a ha => (adj_of_mem_rowAt N x a ha).symm
    have hK0 : IsCograph G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) :=
      isCograph_old_remainder N hj hx
    have hpK0 : pathCoverNumber G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) = (rowAt N x).card :=
      hpL
    have hJ : IsCograph G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) :=
      isCograph_remainder_union_foreign N hj hpat hx hi
    have hpJ : pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x) ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) =
          (rowAt N x).card := by
      simpa [hpL] using heq
    have hzh : G.Adj z v := adj_of_mem_rowAt N z v hvAz
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
      Cograph.exists_released_three_cycle
        (F.getCycle N.core) (F.getCycle i) (F.getCycle t)
        (by simp [coreSupport]) rfl rfl hHD hHQ hDQ hAsub hAne hxC hzC hAx
        hK0 hpK0 hJ hpJ hvF hvEi hzh hxC hzC hedge
    have hspan :
        γ.support = F.selectedSupport ({N.core, i, t} : Finset (Fin F.card)) :=
      support_union_eq_selected_triple (i := N.core) (k := i) (t := t) γ
        (by simpa [coreSupport] using hγ)
    have h3 : 2 ≤ ({N.core, i, t} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card := by
      have hcard := card_selected_triple (i := N.core) (j := i) (k := t)
        hi'.symm ht.symm hti.symm
      omega
    exact CycleFactor.not_exists_merge_of_min F hmin
      ({N.core, i, t} : Finset (Fin F.card)) h3 γ hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cycle_edge
statement:
lemma rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cycle_edge {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    {x z : V} (hxC : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hzC : z ∈ (F.getCycle t).support)
    (hedge : (F.getCycle t).succAt hxC = z ∨ (F.getCycle t).succAt hzC = x) :
    rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  by_contra hvT
  exact not_escape_of_own_cycle_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hxC hzC hedge hv hvT

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_own_cycle_edge
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_own_cycle_edge {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    {x z : V} (hxC : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hzC : z ∈ (F.getCycle t).support)
    (hedge : (F.getCycle t).succAt hxC = z ∨ (F.getCycle t).succAt hzC = x) :
    cutDelta N hj x = cutDelta N hj z ∧ ownCut N hj x = ownCut N hj z
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hxC
  have hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hzC
  have hAz : rowAt N z ⊆ ownCut N hj x :=
    rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cycle_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hxC hzC hedge
  have hAx : rowAt N x ⊆ ownCut N hj z :=
    rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cycle_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hzC hxC (Or.symm hedge)
  exact cuts_eq_of_mutual_row_containment N hj hpat hx hz hAz hAx

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_getVert_from_start
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_getVert_from_start {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < (F.getCycle t).walk.length) :
    cutDelta N hj (F.getCycle t).start =
      cutDelta N hj ((F.getCycle t).walk.getVert k) ∧
        ownCut N hj (F.getCycle t).start =
          ownCut N hj ((F.getCycle t).walk.getVert k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk' : k < (F.getCycle t).walk.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk
    have ⟨hδ, hT⟩ := ih hk'
    have hedge :
        (F.getCycle t).succAt (getVert_mem_cycle_support (F.getCycle t) k) =
          (F.getCycle t).walk.getVert (k + 1) :=
      succAt_eq_getVert_succ (F.getCycle t) hk'
    have ⟨hδ2, hT2⟩ :=
      cuts_eq_of_own_cycle_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn
        (getVert_mem_cycle_support (F.getCycle t) k)
        (getVert_mem_cycle_support (F.getCycle t) (k + 1))
        (Or.inl hedge)
    exact ⟨hδ.trans hδ2, hT.trans hT2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_mem_own_cycle
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_mem_own_cycle {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hy : y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) :
    cutDelta N hj x = cutDelta N hj y ∧ ownCut N hj x = ownCut N hj y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ix, hix, hixEq⟩ := exists_getVert_lt_length_of_mem_support (F.getCycle t) hx
  obtain ⟨iy, hiy, hiyEq⟩ := exists_getVert_lt_length_of_mem_support (F.getCycle t) hy
  have hx0 := cuts_eq_of_getVert_from_start N hj hpat hmin htOwn hix
  have hy0 := cuts_eq_of_getVert_from_start N hj hpat hmin htOwn hiy
  rw [hixEq] at hx0
  rw [hiyEq] at hy0
  exact ⟨hx0.1.symm.trans hy0.1, hx0.2.symm.trans hy0.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_mem_own_cycle
statement:
lemma rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_mem_own_cycle {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hy : y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) :
    rowAt N y ⊆ ownCut N hj x
proof:
:= by
  have hz : y ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hy
  have hTy : rowAt N y ⊆ ownCut N hj y := rowAt_subset_ownCut N hj y
  have hEq := cuts_eq_of_mem_own_cycle N hj hpat hmin htOwn hx hy
  simpa [hEq.2] using hTy

name: Nikoghosyan.extendedCuts_on_own_cycle
statement:
theorem extendedCuts_on_own_cycle {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    {t : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj)
    (hxt : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) :
    0 ≤ cutDelta N hj x ∧
      ownCut N hj x ⊆ extendedHost N hj ∧
        ((componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ ownCut N hj x) : ℤ) -
          ((ownCut N hj x).card : ℤ) = cutDelta N hj x) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle t).support,
            cutDelta N hj y = cutDelta N hj x ∧
              ownCut N hj y = ownCut N hj x ∧
                rowAt N y ⊆ ownCut N hj x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cutDelta_nonneg N hj hpat hmin hx, ownCut_subset_host N hj x,
    ownCut_attains N hj hpat hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hEq := cuts_eq_of_mem_own_cycle N hj hpat hmin htOwn hxt hy
  exact ⟨hEq.1.symm, hEq.2.symm,
    rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_mem_own_cycle N hj hpat hmin htOwn hxt hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.card_selected_quad
statement:
lemma card_selected_quad {i j k l : Fin F.card}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hil : i ≠ l)
    (hjk : j ≠ k) (hjl : j ≠ l) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    ({i, j, k, l} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i ∉ ({j, k, l} : Finset (Fin F.card)) := by simp [hij, hik, hil]
  have hj : j ∉ ({k, l} : Finset (Fin F.card)) := by simp [hjk, hjl]
  have hk : k ∉ ({l} : Finset (Fin F.card)) := by simp [hkl]
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi, card_insert_of_notMem hj, card_insert_of_notMem hk,
    card_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.CycleFactor.selectedSupport_quad
statement:
lemma CycleFactor.selectedSupport_quad (i j k l : Fin F.card) :
    F.selectedSupport {i, j, k, l} =
      (F.getCycle i).support ∪ (F.getCycle j).support ∪
        (F.getCycle k).support ∪ (F.getCycle l).support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport (F := F)).1 hx
    have ht' : t = i ∨ t = j ∨ t = k ∨ t = l := by simpa using ht
    rcases ht' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxt)))))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxt)))))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxt)))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxt)
  · intro hx
    rw [CycleFactor.mem_selectedSupport]
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with h | hl
    · rcases mem_union.1 h with h' | hk
      · rcases mem_union.1 h' with hi | hj
        · exact ⟨i, by simp, hi⟩
        · exact ⟨j, by simp, hj⟩
      · exact ⟨k, by simp, hk⟩
    · exact ⟨l, by simp, hl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.support_union_eq_selected_quad
statement:
lemma support_union_eq_selected_quad {i j k l : Fin F.card} (C : GraphCycle G)
    (hC : C.support =
      (F.getCycle i).support ∪ (F.getCycle j).support ∪
        (F.getCycle k).support ∪ (F.getCycle l).support) :
    C.support = F.selectedSupport ({i, j, k, l} : Finset (Fin F.card))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hC, CycleFactor.selectedSupport_quad]

name: Nikoghosyan.not_escape_of_own_cross_edge
statement:
lemma not_escape_of_own_cross_edge {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t s : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj) (hsOwn : s ∈ N.own j hj)
    (hts : t ≠ s)
    {x z : V} (hxC : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hzC : z ∈ (F.getCycle s).support)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z)
    {v : V}
    (hvAz' : v ∈ rowAt N ((F.getCycle s).succAt hzC))
    (hvT : v ∉ ownCut N hj ((F.getCycle t).succAt hxC)) : False
proof:
:= by
  set x' := (F.getCycle t).succAt hxC
  set z' := (F.getCycle s).succAt hzC
  have hx'C : x' ∈ (F.getCycle t).support :=
    GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support (F.getCycle t) hxC
  have hz'C : z' ∈ (F.getCycle s).support :=
    GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support (F.getCycle s) hzC
  have hx' : x' ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hx'C
  have hz' : z' ∈ ownSupport N hj := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj hsOwn hz'C
  have hvF : v ∈ ineligibleSet G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x') :=
    escape_row_subset_old_ineligible N hj hx' hz' (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvAz', hvT⟩)
  have hvE : v ∈ eligibleSet G (extendedHost N hj \ rowAt N x') :=
    escape_row_subset_new_eligible N hj hz' (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvAz', hvT⟩)
  have Hloc := localityHyp_at N hj hpat hx'
  have hvE' : v ∈ eligibleSet G
      (unionJ (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x') F.getCycle (N.foreign j hj)) := by
    simpa [unionJ_eq_host_remainder N hj x'] using hvE
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hw⟩ :=
    exists_single_release_eq F.getCycle Hloc hvF hvE'
  have hpL := pathCoverNumber_remainder_eq_row N hj hx'
  rcases hw with hstrict | ⟨heq, hvEi⟩
  · have hsi : pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x') ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) <
          (rowAt N x').card := by
      simpa [hpL] using hstrict
    exact not_strict_saving_located_foreign N hj hpat hmin hx' hi hsi
  · have ht : t ≠ N.core := ((N.hOwnMem j hj t).1 htOwn).1
    have hs : s ≠ N.core := ((N.hOwnMem j hj s).1 hsOwn).1
    have hi' : i ≠ N.core := ((N.hForeignMem j hj i).1 hi).1
    have hti : t ≠ i := own_index_ne_foreign N hj htOwn hi
    have hsi : s ≠ i := own_index_ne_foreign N hj hsOwn hi
    have hHD : Disjoint (F.getCycle N.core).support (F.getCycle i).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle hi'.symm
    have hHX : Disjoint (F.getCycle N.core).support (F.getCycle t).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle ht.symm
    have hHZ : Disjoint (F.getCycle N.core).support (F.getCycle s).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle hs.symm
    have hDX : Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle t).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle hti.symm
    have hDZ : Disjoint (F.getCycle i).support (F.getCycle s).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle hsi.symm
    have hXZ : Disjoint (F.getCycle t).support (F.getCycle s).support :=
      F.disjoint_getCycle hts
    have hAsub : rowAt N x' ⊆ coreSupport N := rowAt_subset_core N x'
    have hAne : (rowAt N x').Nonempty := rowAt_nonempty N hj hx'
    have hK0 : IsCograph G (coreSupport N \ rowAt N x') :=
      isCograph_old_remainder N hj hx'
    have hJ : IsCograph G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x') ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) :=
      isCograph_remainder_union_foreign N hj hpat hx' hi
    have hpJ : pathCoverNumber G
        ((coreSupport N \ rowAt N x') ∪ (F.getCycle i).support) =
          (rowAt N x').card := by
      simpa [hpL] using heq
    obtain ⟨P, hPsup, hPst, hPfin, _, _⟩ :=
      Cograph.exists_released_absorption
        (F.getCycle N.core) (F.getCycle i)
        (by simp [coreSupport]) rfl hHD hAsub hAne hK0 hpL hJ hpJ hvF hvEi
    have hsP : G.Adj x' P.start := adj_of_mem_rowAt N x' P.start hPst
    have hfP : G.Adj P.finish z' := by
      have : P.finish = v := hPfin
      simpa [this] using (adj_of_mem_rowAt N z' v hvAz').symm
    have hsH : P.start ∈ (F.getCycle N.core).support := by
      have : P.start ∈ rowAt N x' := hPst
      simpa [coreSupport] using rowAt_subset_core N x' this
    have hfH : P.finish ∈ (F.getCycle N.core).support := by
      have hvK : v ∈ coreSupport N \ rowAt N x' :=
        ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) _ hvF
      simpa [hPfin, coreSupport] using (mem_sdiff.1 hvK).1
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
      exists_cycle_of_four_block_path
        (F.getCycle N.core) (F.getCycle i) (F.getCycle t) (F.getCycle s)
        hHD hHX hHZ hDX hDZ hXZ hxC hx'C hzC hz'C
        (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inl rfl) hxz P
        (by simpa [coreSupport] using hPsup) hsH hfH hsP hfP
    have hspan :
        γ.support =
          F.selectedSupport ({N.core, i, t, s} : Finset (Fin F.card)) :=
      support_union_eq_selected_quad (i := N.core) (j := i) (k := t) (l := s) γ
        (by simpa [coreSupport] using hγ)
    have h4 : 2 ≤ ({N.core, i, t, s} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card := by
      have hcard := card_selected_quad
        (i := N.core) (j := i) (k := t) (l := s)
        hi'.symm ht.symm hs.symm hti.symm hsi.symm hts
      omega
    exact CycleFactor.not_exists_merge_of_min F hmin
      ({N.core, i, t, s} : Finset (Fin F.card)) h4 γ hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cross_edge
statement:
lemma rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cross_edge {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t s : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj) (hsOwn : s ∈ N.own j hj)
    (hts : t ≠ s)
    {x z : V} (hxC : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hzC : z ∈ (F.getCycle s).support)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z) :
    rowAt N ((F.getCycle s).succAt hzC) ⊆
      ownCut N hj ((F.getCycle t).succAt hxC)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  by_contra hvT
  exact not_escape_of_own_cross_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hsOwn hts hxC hzC hxz hv hvT

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_own_cross_edge
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_own_cross_edge {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {t s : Fin F.card} (htOwn : t ∈ N.own j hj) (hsOwn : s ∈ N.own j hj)
    (hts : t ≠ s)
    {x z : V} (hxC : x ∈ (F.getCycle t).support) (hzC : z ∈ (F.getCycle s).support)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z) :
    cutDelta N hj ((F.getCycle t).succAt hxC) =
      cutDelta N hj ((F.getCycle s).succAt hzC) ∧
        ownCut N hj ((F.getCycle t).succAt hxC) =
          ownCut N hj ((F.getCycle s).succAt hzC)
proof:
:= by
  have hx'C := GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support (F.getCycle t) hxC
  have hz'C := GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support (F.getCycle s) hzC
  have hx' := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj htOwn hx'C
  have hz' := mem_ownSupport_of_own_cycle N hj hsOwn hz'C
  have hAz :=
    rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cross_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hsOwn hts hxC hzC hxz
  have hAx :=
    rowAt_subset_ownCut_of_own_cross_edge N hj hpat hmin hsOwn htOwn hts.symm
      hzC hxC hxz.symm
  exact cuts_eq_of_mutual_row_containment N hj hpat hx' hz' hAz hAx

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_own_adj
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_own_adj {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x z : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) (hz : z ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z) :
    cutDelta N hj x = cutDelta N hj z ∧ ownCut N hj x = ownCut N hj z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htOwn, hxt, _⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsOwn, hzs, _⟩ := exists_own_index N hj hz
  by_cases hts : t = s
  · subst hts
    exact cuts_eq_of_mem_own_cycle N hj hpat hmin htOwn hxt hzs
  · have hx'C := GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support (F.getCycle t) hxt
    have hz'C := GraphCycle.succAt_mem_support (F.getCycle s) hzs
    have hxx' :=
      cuts_eq_of_own_cycle_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hxt hx'C (Or.inl rfl)
    have hzz' :=
      cuts_eq_of_own_cycle_edge N hj hpat hmin hsOwn hzs hz'C (Or.inl rfl)
    have hx'z' :=
      cuts_eq_of_own_cross_edge N hj hpat hmin htOwn hsOwn hts hxt hzs hxz
    exact ⟨hxx'.1.trans (hx'z'.1.trans hzz'.1.symm),
      hxx'.2.trans (hx'z'.2.trans hzz'.2.symm)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.cuts_eq_of_own_walk
statement:
lemma cuts_eq_of_own_walk {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hsupp : ∀ v ∈ p.support, v ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    cutDelta N hj x = cutDelta N hj y ∧ ownCut N hj x = ownCut N hj y
proof:
:= by
  refine p.rec (motive := fun u w q =>
      u ∈ ownSupport N hj →
        (∀ v ∈ q.support, v ∈ ownSupport N hj) →
          cutDelta N hj u = cutDelta N hj w ∧
            ownCut N hj u = ownCut N hj w) ?_ ?_ hx hsupp
  · intro u hu _hs
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro u v w hadj q ih hu hsupp'
    have hv : v ∈ ownSupport N hj :=
      hsupp' v (by
        have : v ∈ q.support := by
          simpa [Walk.getVert_zero] using Walk.getVert_mem_support q 0
        simpa [Walk.support_cons] using Or.inr this)
    have hxz := cuts_eq_of_own_adj N hj hpat hmin hu hv hadj
    have htail : ∀ z ∈ q.support, z ∈ ownSupport N hj := fun z hz =>
      hsupp' z (by
        simp [Walk.support_cons]
        exact Or.inr hz)
    have hy := ih hv htail
    exact ⟨hxz.1.trans hy.1, hxz.2.trans hy.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.extendedCuts
statement:
theorem extendedCuts {j : Fin F.card} (hj : j ≠ N.core)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ownSupport N hj) :
    0 ≤ cutDelta N hj x ∧
      ownCut N hj x ⊆ extendedHost N hj ∧
        ((componentCount G (extendedHost N hj \ ownCut N hj x) : ℤ) -
          ((ownCut N hj x).card : ℤ) = cutDelta N hj x) ∧
          (∀ y, y ∈ ownSupport N hj →
            (∃ p : G.Walk x y, ∀ v ∈ p.support, v ∈ ownSupport N hj) →
              cutDelta N hj y = cutDelta N hj x ∧
                ownCut N hj y = ownCut N hj x ∧
                  rowAt N y ⊆ ownCut N hj x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cutDelta_nonneg N hj hpat hmin hx, ownCut_subset_host N hj x,
    ownCut_attains N hj hpat hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hEq := cuts_eq_of_own_walk N hj hpat hmin hx p hp
  exact ⟨hEq.1.symm, hEq.2.symm, by
    have : rowAt N y ⊆ ownCut N hj y := rowAt_subset_ownCut N hj y
    simpa [hEq.2] using this⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.appendDisjoint_card
statement:
lemma appendDisjoint_card {A B : Finset V} (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (pcA : PathCover G A) (pcB : PathCover G B) :
    (appendDisjoint hdisj pcA pcB).card = pcA.card + pcB.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [appendDisjoint, PathCover.card, List.length_append]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.appendDisjoint_mem_iff
statement:
lemma appendDisjoint_mem_iff {A B : Finset V} (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (pcA : PathCover G A) (pcB : PathCover G B) {p : GraphPath G} :
    p ∈ (appendDisjoint hdisj pcA pcB).paths ↔
      p ∈ pcA.paths ∨ p ∈ pcB.paths
proof:
:= by
  simp [appendDisjoint, List.mem_append]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.endpoints_mem
statement:
lemma endpoints_mem {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) {p : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) : p.start ∈ U ∧ p.finish ∈ U
proof:
:=
  ⟨pc.support_subset hp p.start_mem_support,
    pc.support_subset hp p.finish_mem_support⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.vertexAt_mem
statement: lemma vertexAt_mem (A : Finset V) (i : Fin A.card) : vertexAt A i ∈ A
proof:
:=
  mem_toList.1 (List.get_mem _ _)

name: Nikoghosyan.vertexAt_injective
statement: lemma vertexAt_injective (A : Finset V) : Injective (vertexAt (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have hnd : A.toList.Nodup := A.nodup_toList
  have hi : i.1 < A.toList.length := by simpa [A.length_toList] using i.2
  have hj : j.1 < A.toList.length := by simpa [A.length_toList] using j.2
  have hget :
      A.toList.get ⟨i.1, hi⟩ = A.toList.get ⟨j.1, hj⟩ := by
    simpa [vertexAt] using h
  have hij : (⟨i.1, hi⟩ : Fin A.toList.length) = ⟨j.1, hj⟩ :=
    (List.Nodup.get_inj_iff hnd).1 hget
  have hval : i.1 = j.1 := congrArg (fun t : Fin A.toList.length => t.1) hij
  exact Fin.ext hval

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_vertexAt
statement:
lemma exists_vertexAt {A : Finset V} {a : V} (ha : a ∈ A) :
    ∃ i : Fin A.card, vertexAt A i = a
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : a ∈ A.toList := mem_toList.2 ha
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.get_of_mem hmem
  refine ⟨⟨i.1, by simpa [A.length_toList] using i.2⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [vertexAt]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathAt_mem
statement:
lemma pathAt_mem {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K) (i : Fin pc.card) :
    pathAt pc i ∈ pc.paths
proof:
:=
  List.get_mem _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.pathAt_support_subset
statement:
lemma pathAt_support_subset {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (i : Fin pc.card) : (pathAt pc i).support ⊆ K
proof:
:=
  pc.support_subset (pathAt_mem pc i)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_pathAt
statement:
lemma exists_pathAt {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K) {p : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) : ∃ i : Fin pc.card, pathAt pc i = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.get_of_mem hp
  refine ⟨⟨i.1, by simpa [PathCover.card] using i.2⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [pathAt]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathAt_disjoint
statement:
lemma pathAt_disjoint {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    {i j : Fin pc.card} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (pathAt pc i).support (pathAt pc j).support
proof:
:= by
  have hpw :=
    (List.pairwise_iff_get (R := fun p q : GraphPath G =>
      Disjoint p.support q.support)).1 pc.disjoint
  have hi : i.1 < pc.paths.length := by simpa [PathCover.card] using i.2
  have hj : j.1 < pc.paths.length := by simpa [PathCover.card] using j.2
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i.1 j.1 with hlt | heq | hgt
  · simpa [pathAt] using hpw ⟨i.1, hi⟩ ⟨j.1, hj⟩ hlt
  · exact (hij (Fin.ext heq)).elim
  · simpa [pathAt] using (hpw ⟨j.1, hj⟩ ⟨i.1, hi⟩ hgt).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.card_supportUnion_ge_length
proof:
:= by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hpw := List.pairwise_cons.1 hdisj
    have ih' := ih hpw.2
    have hd : Disjoint p.support (GraphPath.supportUnion ps) := by
      rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.1 (mem_inter.1 hx).2
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (hpw.1 q hq) (mem_inter.1 hx).1 hxq).elim
      · intro h
        exact (notMem_empty x h).elim
    have hcard := card_union_of_disjoint hd
    have hpos : 1 ≤ p.support.card := card_pos.2 p.support_nonempty
    rw [GraphPath.supportUnion_cons, hcard, List.length_cons]
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.supportUnion_eq
statement:
lemma PathCover.supportUnion_eq {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    GraphPath.supportUnion pc.paths = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.1 hx
    exact (pc.mem_iff x).2 ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
    exact GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2 ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_le_card
statement:
lemma PathCover.card_le_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    pc.card ≤ U.card
proof:
:= by
  have hge := card_supportUnion_ge_length pc.disjoint
  simpa [PathCover.card, pc.supportUnion_eq] using hge

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_supportUnion_ofFn
statement:
lemma mem_supportUnion_ofFn {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → GraphPath G) {x : V} :
    x ∈ GraphPath.supportUnion (List.ofFn f) ↔
      ∃ i : Fin n, x ∈ (f i).support
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.1 hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hp
    exact ⟨i, hxp⟩
  · intro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2 ⟨f i, List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩, hxi⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.start_attachFinish
statement:
lemma start_attachFinish (p : GraphPath G) (a : V) (hadj : G.Adj p.finish a)
    (ha : a ∉ p.support) : (attachFinish p a hadj ha).start = p.start
proof:
:=
  GraphPath.start_splice p (GraphPath.singleton (G := G) a) hadj _

name: Nikoghosyan.finish_attachFinish
statement:
lemma finish_attachFinish (p : GraphPath G) (a : V) (hadj : G.Adj p.finish a)
    (ha : a ∉ p.support) : (attachFinish p a hadj ha).finish = a
proof:
:=
  GraphPath.finish_splice p (GraphPath.singleton (G := G) a) hadj _

name: Nikoghosyan.support_attachFinish
proof:
:= by
  simpa [attachFinish, GraphPath.support_singleton] using
    GraphPath.support_splice p (GraphPath.singleton (G := G) a) hadj _

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.not_mem_path_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma not_mem_path_of_disjoint (hAK : Disjoint A K) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ A)
    {p : GraphPath G} {pc : PathCover G K} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) :
    a ∉ p.support
proof:
:=
  fun h => disjoint_left.1 hAK ha (pc.support_subset hp h)

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.seamPath_start
statement:
lemma seamPath_start (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (i : Fin A.card) :
    (seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams i).start =
      (pathAt pc (i.cast hcard)).start
proof:
:= by
  simp [seamPath, start_attachFinish]

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.seamPath_finish
statement:
lemma seamPath_finish (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (i : Fin A.card) :
    (seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams i).finish = vertexAt A i
proof:
:= by
  simp [seamPath, finish_attachFinish]

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.seamPath_support
statement:
lemma seamPath_support (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (i : Fin A.card) :
    (seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams i).support =
      (pathAt pc (i.cast hcard)).support ∪ {vertexAt A i}
proof:
:= by
  simp [seamPath, support_attachFinish]

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.length_seamList
statement:
lemma length_seamList (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish) :
    (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).length = A.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [seamList]

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.seamList_get
statement:
lemma seamList_get (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).length) :
    (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).get ⟨i, hi⟩ =
      seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams ⟨i, by simpa [length_seamList] using hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [seamList, List.get_ofFn]

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.pairwise_seamList
statement:
lemma pairwise_seamList (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish) :
    (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).Pairwise
      fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.pairwise_iff_get]
  intro i j hij
  have hi : i.1 < A.card := by simpa [length_seamList] using i.2
  have hj : j.1 < A.card := by simpa [length_seamList] using j.2
  have hne : (⟨i.1, hi⟩ : Fin A.card) ≠ ⟨j.1, hj⟩ := by
    intro h
    exact Nat.ne_of_lt hij (Fin.mk.inj_iff.mp h)
  have hcast :
      ((⟨i.1, hi⟩ : Fin A.card).cast hcard) ≠
        ((⟨j.1, hj⟩ : Fin A.card).cast hcard) := by
    intro h
    exact hne (Fin.ext (by simpa [Fin.cast] using congrArg Fin.val h))
  have hp := pathAt_disjoint pc hcast
  have ha :
      vertexAt A ⟨i.1, hi⟩ ≠ vertexAt A ⟨j.1, hj⟩ :=
    fun h => hne (vertexAt_injective A h)
  have haiK : vertexAt A ⟨i.1, hi⟩ ∉
      (pathAt pc ((⟨j.1, hj⟩ : Fin A.card).cast hcard)).support :=
    not_mem_path_of_disjoint hAK (vertexAt_mem A _) (pathAt_mem pc _)
  have hajK : vertexAt A ⟨j.1, hj⟩ ∉
      (pathAt pc ((⟨i.1, hi⟩ : Fin A.card).cast hcard)).support :=
    not_mem_path_of_disjoint hAK (vertexAt_mem A _) (pathAt_mem pc _)
  rw [seamList_get, seamList_get, seamPath_support, seamPath_support]
  refine disjoint_union_left.2
    ⟨disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨hp, disjoint_singleton_right.2 hajK⟩,
      disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨disjoint_singleton_left.2 haiK,
        disjoint_singleton_left.2 (mt mem_singleton.1 ha)⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.hedges_seamList
statement:
lemma hedges_seamList (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish) :
    ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).length),
      G.Adj
        ((seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        ((seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i + 1 < A.card := by simpa [length_seamList] using hi
  have hi0 : i < A.card := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi'
  rw [seamList_get, seamList_get, seamPath_finish, seamPath_start]
  exact (hseams (vertexAt A ⟨i, hi0⟩) (vertexAt_mem A _)
    (pathAt pc ((⟨i + 1, hi'⟩ : Fin A.card).cast hcard))
    (pathAt_mem pc _)).1

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.seamList_ne_nil
statement:
lemma seamList_ne_nil (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (hm : 2 ≤ A.card) : seamList pc hcard hAK hseams ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlen := length_seamList pc hcard hAK hseams
  simp [h] at hlen
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.hclose_seamList
statement:
lemma hclose_seamList (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (hm : 2 ≤ A.card) :
    G.Adj
      ((seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).getLast
        (seamList_ne_nil pc hcard hAK hseams hm)).finish
      ((seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).head
        (seamList_ne_nil pc hcard hAK hseams hm)).start
proof:
:= by
  have hne := seamList_ne_nil pc hcard hAK hseams hm
  have hlen := length_seamList pc hcard hAK hseams
  have hlastIdx : A.card - 1 < A.card := by omega
  have hlast :
      (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).getLast hne =
        seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams ⟨A.card - 1, hlastIdx⟩ := by
    rw [List.getLast_eq_getElem hne]
    have : (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).length - 1 = A.card - 1 := by omega
    simp [seamList, this]
  have hhead :
      (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams).head hne =
        seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [List.head_eq_getElem_zero hne]
    simp [seamList]
  rw [hlast, hhead, seamPath_finish, seamPath_start]
  exact (hseams (vertexAt A ⟨A.card - 1, hlastIdx⟩) (vertexAt_mem A _)
    (pathAt pc ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin A.card).cast hcard))
    (pathAt_mem pc _)).1

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.supportUnion_seamList
statement:
lemma supportUnion_seamList (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish) :
    GraphPath.supportUnion (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams) = A ∪ K
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := (mem_supportUnion_ofFn (seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams)).1
      (by simpa [seamList] using hx)
    rw [seamPath_support] at hxi
    rcases mem_union.1 hxi with hp | ha
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (pathAt_support_subset pc _ hp))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by
        rw [mem_singleton.1 ha]
        exact vertexAt_mem A i))
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxA | hxK
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := exists_vertexAt hxA
      refine GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2
        ⟨seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams i,
          by simp [seamList, List.mem_ofFn], ?_⟩
      rw [seamPath_support]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton_self _))
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hxK
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := exists_pathAt pc hp
      let i : Fin A.card := ⟨j.1, by simpa [hcard] using j.2⟩
      have hj : j = i.cast hcard := Fin.ext (by simp [i, Fin.cast])
      refine GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2
        ⟨seamPath pc hcard hAK hseams i,
          by simp [seamList, List.mem_ofFn], ?_⟩
      rw [seamPath_support, ← hj]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxp)

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.three_le_supportUnion_seamList
statement:
lemma three_le_supportUnion_seamList (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (hm : 2 ≤ A.card) :
    3 ≤ (GraphPath.supportUnion (seamList pc hcard hAK hseams)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hK : pc.card ≤ K.card := pc.card_le_card
  have hAU : (A ∪ K).card = A.card + K.card := card_union_of_disjoint hAK
  have hge : 2 * A.card ≤ (A ∪ K).card := by
    have : A.card + A.card ≤ A.card + K.card := Nat.add_le_add_left
      (hcard ▸ hK) _
    simpa [two_mul, hAU] using this
  have : 4 ≤ (A ∪ K).card := by
    have : 2 * 2 ≤ 2 * A.card := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hm
    omega
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (A ∪ K).card := Nat.le_trans (by decide : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 4) this
  simpa [supportUnion_seamList pc hcard hAK hseams] using h3

name: Nikoghosyan.EndpointSeam.support_assembledCycle
statement:
lemma support_assembledCycle (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (hm : 2 ≤ A.card) :
    (assembledCycle pc hcard hAK hseams hm).support = A ∪ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [assembledCycle, GraphPath.support_assembleCycle,
    supportUnion_seamList]

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_original_cycle_of_endpoint_seams
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_endpoint_seams
    {A K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hcard : A.card = pc.card) (hAK : Disjoint A K)
    (hseams : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish)
    (hm : 2 ≤ A.card) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = A ∪ K
proof:
:=
  ⟨EndpointSeam.assembledCycle pc hcard hAK hseams hm,
    EndpointSeam.support_assembledCycle pc hcard hAK hseams hm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.coe_carrierEmbedding
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_carrierEmbedding (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) :
    ⇑(carrierEmbedding (G := G) (H := H) f hadj) = ⇑f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.coe_carrierHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_carrierHom (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) :
    ⇑(carrierEmbedding (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).toHom = ⇑f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.carrierEmbedding_injective
statement:
lemma carrierEmbedding_injective (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) :
    Injective (carrierEmbedding (G := G) (H := H) f hadj)
proof:
:=
  (carrierEmbedding (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).injective

name: Nikoghosyan.carrierAdj_iff
statement:
lemma carrierAdj_iff (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) {u v : V} :
    H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v
proof:
:=
  hadj u v

name: Nikoghosyan.carrier_mem_edgeSet
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet, hadj] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.carrierRangeIso_apply
statement:
lemma carrierRangeIso_apply (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) (u : V) :
    ((carrierRangeIso (G := G) (H := H) f hadj u : W) = f u)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.carrierRangeIso_symm_coe
statement:
lemma carrierRangeIso_symm_coe (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    (x : W) (hx : x ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) :
    f ((carrierRangeIso (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).symm ⟨x, hx⟩) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := (carrierRangeIso (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Nikoghosyan.nonempty_of_mem_range
statement:
lemma nonempty_of_mem_range (f : V ↪ W) {x : W}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) : Nonempty V
proof:
:=
  ⟨Classical.choose hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.leftInverse_invFun_carrier
statement:
lemma leftInverse_invFun_carrier [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W) :
    LeftInverse (invFun (⇑f)) (⇑f)
proof:
:=
  leftInverse_invFun f.injective

name: Nikoghosyan.invFun_carrier_eq
statement:
lemma invFun_carrier_eq [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W) {x : W}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) : f (invFun (⇑f) x) = x
proof:
:=
  invFun_eq hx

name: Nikoghosyan.support_subset_range_of_finset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hsup (List.mem_toFinset.2 hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.cycle_support_subset_range_of_finset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hsup (List.mem_toFinset.2 hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_nil
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_nil [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) {x : W}
    (hw : ∀ z ∈ (Walk.nil : H.Walk x x).support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) :
    walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj Walk.nil hw = Walk.nil
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_support
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_support [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) :
    ∀ {x y : W} (w : H.Walk x y)
      (hw : ∀ z ∈ w.support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)),
      (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).support =
        w.support.map (invFun (⇑f))
proof:
| _, _, Walk.nil, hw => by simp [walkOfCarrierRange]
  | _, _, Walk.cons h p, hw => by
    simp [walkOfCarrierRange, walkOfCarrierRange_support f hadj p]

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_edges
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_edges [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) :
    ∀ {x y : W} (w : H.Walk x y)
      (hw : ∀ z ∈ w.support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)),
      (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).edges =
        w.edges.map (Sym2.map (invFun (⇑f)))
proof:
| _, _, Walk.nil, hw => by simp [walkOfCarrierRange]
  | _, _, Walk.cons h p, hw => by
    simp [walkOfCarrierRange, walkOfCarrierRange_edges f hadj p]

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_nil_iff
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_nil_iff [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) :
    ∀ {x y : W} (w : H.Walk x y)
      (hw : ∀ z ∈ w.support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)),
      (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).Nil ↔ w.Nil
proof:
| _, _, Walk.nil, hw => by simp [walkOfCarrierRange]
  | _, _, Walk.cons h p, hw => by simp [walkOfCarrierRange]

name: Nikoghosyan.nodup_map_invFun_on_range
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have hnd' := List.nodup_cons.1 hnd
    refine List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨?_, ih (fun x hx => hl x (by simp [hx])) hnd'.2⟩
    intro hmem
    rcases List.mem_map.1 hmem with ⟨b, hb, hinv⟩
    have ha : a ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) := hl a (by simp)
    have hb' : b ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) := hl b (by simp [hb])
    have : a = b := by
      have h := congrArg (⇑f) hinv
      simpa [invFun_eq ha, invFun_eq hb'] using h.symm
    subst this
    exact hnd'.1 hb

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_isPath
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_isPath [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    {x y : W} {w : H.Walk x y}
    (hw : ∀ z ∈ w.support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) (hp : w.IsPath) :
    (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isPath_def, walkOfCarrierRange_support]
  exact nodup_map_invFun_on_range f hw ((Walk.isPath_def w).1 hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.sym2_map_invFun_cancel
proof:
:= by
  revert hends
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun a b hends => ?_)
  have ha : a ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) := hends a (by simp)
  have hb : b ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) := hends b (by simp)
  simp [Sym2.map_mk, invFun_eq ha, invFun_eq hb]

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_isTrail
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_isTrail [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    {x y : W} {w : H.Walk x y}
    (hw : ∀ z ∈ w.support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) (ht : w.IsTrail) :
    (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).IsTrail
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isTrail_def, walkOfCarrierRange_edges]
  refine ht.edges_nodup.map_on ?_
  intro e he e' he' hmap
  have hends : ∀ x ∈ e, x ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) := fun x hx =>
    hw x (w.mem_support_of_mem_edges he hx)
  have hends' : ∀ x ∈ e', x ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) := fun x hx =>
    hw x (w.mem_support_of_mem_edges he' hx)
  have h := congrArg (Sym2.map (⇑f)) hmap
  simpa [sym2_map_invFun_cancel f hends, sym2_map_invFun_cancel f hends'] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.walkOfCarrierRange_isCycle
statement:
lemma walkOfCarrierRange_isCycle [Nonempty V] (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    {x : W} {w : H.Walk x x}
    (hw : ∀ z ∈ w.support, z ∈ Set.range (f : V → W)) (hc : w.IsCycle) :
    (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨walkOfCarrierRange_isTrail (G := G) (H := H) f hadj hw hc.isTrail, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro hnil
    have : (walkOfCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).Nil := by
      simp [hnil]
    exact hc.not_nil ((walkOfCarrierRange_nil_iff (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw).1 this)
  · have hsup := walkOfCarrierRange_support (G := G) (H := H) f hadj w hw
    have : (w.support.map (invFun (⇑f))).tail.Nodup := by
      rw [← Walk.cons_tail_support w, List.map_cons, List.tail_cons]
      refine nodup_map_invFun_on_range f ?_ hc.support_nodup
      intro z hz
      exact hw z (by
        rw [← Walk.cons_tail_support w]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)
    simpa [hsup] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mapCarrier_start
statement:
lemma mapCarrier_start (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) (p : GraphPath G) :

lemma mapCarrier_edges_subset_edgeSet (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) (p : GraphPath G) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mapCarrier_mem_edge_iff
statement:
lemma mapCarrier_mem_edge_iff (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) (p : GraphPath G)
    {u v : V} :
    s(f u, f v) ∈ (p.mapCarrier f hadj).edges ↔ s(u, v) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Injective (Sym2.map (⇑f)) := Sym2.map.injective f.injective
  constructor
  · intro he
    have himg : s(f u, f v) ∈ p.edges.image (Sym2.map ⇑f) := by
      simpa [mapCarrier_edges] using he
    rcases mem_image.1 himg with ⟨e, hee, hmap⟩
    have : e = s(u, v) :=
      hinj (by simpa [Sym2.map_mk] using hmap)
    simpa [this] using hee
  · intro he
    have : (Sym2.map ⇑f) s(u, v) ∈ p.edges.image (Sym2.map ⇑f) :=
      mem_image_of_mem _ he
    simpa [mapCarrier_edges, Sym2.map_mk] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_mapCarrier_support
statement:
lemma disjoint_mapCarrier_support (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    Disjoint (p.mapCarrier f hadj).support (q.mapCarrier f hadj).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapCarrier_support, mapCarrier_support]
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hx hy
  rcases mem_image.1 hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rcases mem_image.1 hy with ⟨b, hb, hba⟩
  have : a = b := f.injective hba.symm
  subst this
  exact disjoint_left.1 hd ha hb

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ofCarrierRange_start_spec
statement:
lemma ofCarrierRange_start_spec (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    (p : GraphPath H) (hsup : (p.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W)) :
    f (ofCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup).start = p.start
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V := nonempty_of_mem_range f (hsup p.start_mem_support)
  exact invFun_eq (hsup p.start_mem_support)

statement:

    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    (p : GraphPath H) (hsup : (p.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W)) :

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_ofCarrierRange_support_iff
statement:
lemma mem_ofCarrierRange_support_iff (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    (p : GraphPath H) (hsup : (p.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W))
    {y : V} :
    y ∈ (ofCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup).support ↔
      f y ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V := nonempty_of_mem_range f (hsup p.start_mem_support)
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have : y ∈ (p.walk.support.map (invFun (⇑f))).toFinset := by
      simpa [ofCarrierRange, support, walkOfCarrierRange_support] using hy
    rcases List.mem_map.1 (List.mem_toFinset.1 this) with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ Set.range (f : V → W) :=
      support_subset_range_of_finset (f := f) hsup x hx
    have : f (invFun (⇑f) x) = x := invFun_eq hx'
    simpa [support, this] using List.mem_toFinset.2 hx
  · intro hy
    have hyw : f y ∈ p.walk.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 hy
    have : invFun (⇑f) (f y) = y := leftInverse_invFun_carrier f y
    simpa [ofCarrierRange, support, walkOfCarrierRange_support] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2 ⟨f y, hyw, this⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ofCarrierRange_support_image
statement:
lemma ofCarrierRange_support_image (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    (p : GraphPath H) (hsup : (p.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W)) :
    (ofCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup).support.image f = p.support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_image.1 hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_ofCarrierRange_support_iff (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup).1 hy
  · intro hx
    rcases hsup hx with ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact mem_image_of_mem _
      ((mem_ofCarrierRange_support_iff (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup).2 hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ofCarrierRange_support_card
statement:
lemma ofCarrierRange_support_card (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    (p : GraphPath H) (hsup : (p.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W)) :
    (ofCarrierRange (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup).support.card = p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ f.injective,
    ofCarrierRange_support_image (G := G) (H := H) f hadj p hsup]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.carrierRange_surviving_edge
statement:
theorem carrierRange_surviving_edge (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    {p : GraphPath H} (hsup : (p.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W))
    {x y : W} (he : s(x, y) ∈ p.edges) :
    ∃ u v : V, x = f u ∧ y = f v ∧ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ p.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp)
  have hy : y ∈ p.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp)
  rcases hsup hx with ⟨u, rfl⟩
  rcases hsup hy with ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hadjH : H.Adj (f u) (f v) := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using p.edges_subset_edgeSet _ he
  exact ⟨u, v, rfl, rfl, (hadj u v).1 hadjH⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.carrierRange_surviving_edge
statement:
theorem carrierRange_surviving_edge (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v)
    {c : GraphCycle H} (hsup : (c.support : Set W) ⊆ Set.range (f : V → W))
    {x y : W} (he : s(x, y) ∈ c.edges) :
    ∃ u v : V, x = f u ∧ y = f v ∧ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ c.support := by
    simpa [support] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2
        (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (mem_edges_iff.1 he) (by simp))
  have hy : y ∈ c.support := by
    simpa [support] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2
        (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (mem_edges_iff.1 he) (by simp))
  rcases hsup hx with ⟨u, rfl⟩
  rcases hsup hy with ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hadjH : H.Adj (f u) (f v) := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using
      c.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (mem_edges_iff.1 he)
  exact ⟨u, v, rfl, rfl, (hadj u v).1 hadjH⟩
