lemma mem_range_sumInl {x : V ⊕ α} :
    x ∈ Set.range (Sum.inl : V → V ⊕ α) ↔ ∃ u : V, x = .inl u
proof:
:= by
  simp [Set.mem_range, eq_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.endsStraddle_iff
statement:
lemma endsStraddle_iff {a b : V} {U0 : Finset V} :
    endsStraddle s(a, b) U0 ↔ ((a ∈ U0) ≠ (b ∈ U0))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx, hxU⟩, ⟨y, hy, hyU⟩⟩
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hx with rfl | rfl
    · rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact (hyU hxU).elim
      · intro heq
        exact hyU ((iff_of_eq heq).mp hxU)
    · rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hy with rfl | rfl
      · intro heq
        exact hyU ((iff_of_eq heq).mpr hxU)
      · exact (hyU hxU).elim
  · intro hne
    by_cases ha : a ∈ U0
    · refine ⟨⟨a, by simp, ha⟩, ⟨b, by simp, ?_⟩⟩
      intro hb
      exact hne (propext ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩)
    · have hb : b ∈ U0 := by
        by_contra hb
        exact hne (propext ⟨fun h => (ha h).elim, fun h => (hb h).elim⟩)
      exact ⟨⟨b, by simp, hb⟩, ⟨a, by simp, ha⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.endsStraddle_of_outside_inside
statement:
lemma endsStraddle_of_outside_inside {a b : V} {U0 : Finset V}
    (ha : a ∉ U0) (hb : b ∈ U0) : endsStraddle s(a, b) U0
proof:
:=
  endsStraddle_iff.2 (fun heq => ha ((iff_of_eq heq).mpr hb))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.not_endsStraddle_of_both
statement:
lemma not_endsStraddle_of_both {a b : V} {U0 : Finset V}
    (ha : a ∈ U0) (hb : b ∈ U0) : ¬ endsStraddle s(a, b) U0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact (endsStraddle_iff.1 h) (propext ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.not_endsStraddle_of_neither
statement:
lemma not_endsStraddle_of_neither {a b : V} {U0 : Finset V}
    (ha : a ∉ U0) (hb : b ∉ U0) : ¬ endsStraddle s(a, b) U0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact (endsStraddle_iff.1 h)
    (propext ⟨fun h' => (ha h').elim, fun h' => (hb h').elim⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff
statement:
lemma mem_boundaryEdges_iff {p : GraphPath G} {U0 : Finset V} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ p.boundaryEdges U0 ↔ e ∈ p.edges ∧ endsStraddle e U0
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundaryEdges]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.boundaryEdges_subset_edges
statement:
lemma boundaryEdges_subset_edges (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V) :
    p.boundaryEdges U0 ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_crossingIndexSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_crossingIndexSet_iff {p : GraphPath G} {U0 : Finset V} {i : ℕ} :
    i ∈ p.crossingIndexSet U0 ↔
      i < p.walk.length ∧
        ((p.walk.getVert i ∈ U0) ≠ (p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0))
proof:
:= by
  simp [crossingIndexSet, mem_range]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.crossingEdge_mem_edges
proof:
:= by
  have hiE : i < p.walk.edges.length := by simpa [Walk.length_edges] using hi
  exact mem_edges_iff.2 (List.mem_iff_getElem.2 ⟨i, hiE, Walk.getElem_edges hiE⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.injOn_crossingEdge
statement:
lemma injOn_crossingEdge (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V) :
    Set.InjOn (fun i => s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1)))
      (p.crossingIndexSet U0)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj heq
  have hiL : i < p.walk.length := (mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.1 hi).1
  have hjL : j < p.walk.length := (mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.1 hj).1
  have hiE : i < p.walk.edges.length := by simpa [Walk.length_edges] using hiL
  have hjE : j < p.walk.edges.length := by simpa [Walk.length_edges] using hjL
  have hnod := p.isPath.isTrail.edges_nodup
  have hidx : p.walk.edges[i] = p.walk.edges[j] := by
    rw [Walk.getElem_edges (p := p.walk) hiE, Walk.getElem_edges (p := p.walk) hjE]
    exact heq
  have hinj := List.nodup_iff_injective_getElem.1 hnod
  have hij : (⟨i, hiE⟩ : Fin p.walk.edges.length) = ⟨j, hjE⟩ :=
    hinj hidx
  exact Fin.val_eq_of_eq hij

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.image_crossingIndexSet
statement:
lemma image_crossingIndexSet (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V) :
    (p.crossingIndexSet U0).image
        (fun i => s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1))) =
      p.boundaryEdges U0
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 he
    obtain ⟨hiL, hxor⟩ := mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.1 hi
    exact mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2
      ⟨p.crossingEdge_mem_edges hiL, endsStraddle_iff.2 hxor⟩
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨heE, hstr⟩ := mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he
    obtain ⟨i, hiE, hie⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 (mem_edges_iff.1 heE)
    have hiL : i < p.walk.length := by simpa [Walk.length_edges] using hiE
    have hpair : e = s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by
      rw [← Walk.getElem_edges hiE, hie]
    have hxor : (p.walk.getVert i ∈ U0) ≠ (p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0) := by
      have : endsStraddle s(p.walk.getVert i, p.walk.getVert (i + 1)) U0 := by
        simpa [hpair] using hstr
      exact endsStraddle_iff.1 this
    refine mem_image.2 ⟨i, mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.2 ⟨hiL, hxor⟩, hpair.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.card_crossingIndexSet
statement:
theorem card_crossingIndexSet (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V) :
    (p.crossingIndexSet U0).card = (p.boundaryEdges U0).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← p.image_crossingIndexSet U0]
  exact (Finset.card_image_of_injOn (p.injOn_crossingEdge U0)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.no_entering_imp_succ_not_mem
statement:
lemma no_entering_imp_succ_not_mem {p : GraphPath G} {U0 : Finset V}
    (hno : ∀ i < p.walk.length,
      ¬ (p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < p.walk.length) (hj0 : p.walk.getVert j ∉ U0) :
    p.walk.getVert (j + 1) ∉ U0
proof:
:= by
  intro hj1
  exact hno j hj ⟨hj0, hj1⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.getVert_not_mem_U0_of_ge
statement:
lemma getVert_not_mem_U0_of_ge {p : GraphPath G} {U0 : Finset V} {i k : ℕ}
    (hno : ∀ j < p.walk.length,
      ¬ (p.walk.getVert j ∉ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (j + 1) ∈ U0))
    (_hi : i < p.walk.length) (hnot : p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ U0)
    (hik : i + 1 ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ p.walk.length) :
    p.walk.getVert k ∉ U0
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∀ t, i + 1 + t ≤ p.walk.length →
      p.walk.getVert (i + 1 + t) ∉ U0 := by
    intro t ht
    induction t with
    | zero => exact hnot
    | succ t ih =>
      have hlt : i + 1 + t < p.walk.length := by omega
      exact no_entering_imp_succ_not_mem (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hlt
        (ih (by omega))
  have ht : k = i + 1 + (k - (i + 1)) := by omega
  rw [ht]
  exact hshift (k - (i + 1)) (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.crossing_subset_leaving_of_no_entering
statement:
lemma crossing_subset_leaving_of_no_entering {p : GraphPath G} {U0 : Finset V}
    (hno : ∀ i < p.walk.length,
      ¬ (p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ∈ p.crossingIndexSet U0) :
    p.walk.getVert i ∈ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ U0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hiL, hxor⟩ := mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.1 hi
  by_cases hin : p.walk.getVert i ∈ U0
  · refine ⟨hin, ?_⟩
    intro hsucc
    exact hxor (propext ⟨fun _ => hsucc, fun _ => hin⟩)
  · have hsucc : p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ U0 :=
      no_entering_imp_succ_not_mem (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hiL hin
    exact (hxor (propext ⟨fun h => (hin h).elim, fun h => (hsucc h).elim⟩)).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.card_crossingIndexSet_le_one_of_no_entering
statement:
theorem card_crossingIndexSet_le_one_of_no_entering (p : GraphPath G)
    (U0 : Finset V) (_hs : p.start ∈ U0)
    (hno : ∀ i < p.walk.length,
      ¬ (p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0)) :
    (p.crossingIndexSet U0).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_le_one.2 ?_
  intro i hi j hj
  obtain ⟨hiL, _⟩ := mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.1 hi
  obtain ⟨hjL, _⟩ := mem_crossingIndexSet_iff.1 hj
  obtain ⟨hiIn, hiOut⟩ :=
    crossing_subset_leaving_of_no_entering (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hi
  obtain ⟨hjIn, _⟩ :=
    crossing_subset_leaving_of_no_entering (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hj
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | rfl | hlt
  · have : p.walk.getVert j ∉ U0 :=
      getVert_not_mem_U0_of_ge (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hiL hiOut
        (by omega) (le_of_lt hjL)
    exact (this hjIn).elim
  · rfl
  · have : p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 :=
      getVert_not_mem_U0_of_ge (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hjL
        (crossing_subset_leaving_of_no_entering (p := p) (U0 := U0) hno hj).2
        (by omega) (le_of_lt hiL)
    exact (this hiIn).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_enteringIndex
statement:
theorem exists_enteringIndex (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hs : p.start ∈ U0) (h2 : 2 ≤ (p.boundaryEdges U0).card) :
    ∃ i, i < p.walk.length ∧
      p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hno : ∀ i < p.walk.length,
      ¬ (p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧ p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0) := by
    intro i hi ⟨h0, h1⟩
    exact h ⟨i, hi, h0, h1⟩
  have hle : (p.boundaryEdges U0).card ≤ 1 := by
    simpa [p.card_crossingIndexSet U0] using
      p.card_crossingIndexSet_le_one_of_no_entering U0 hs hno
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.entering_ne_start
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  rw [heq] at hi0
  exact hi0 hs

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.entering_ne_finish
proof:
:=
  p.getVert_ne_finish_of_lt hi

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_enteringFactor
statement:
theorem exists_enteringFactor (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hs : p.start ∈ U0) (h2 : 2 ≤ (p.boundaryEdges U0).card) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p (p.walk.getVert i) (p.walk.getVert (i + 1))),
      i < p.walk.length ∧
        p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧
          p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 ∧
            p.walk.getVert i ≠ p.start ∧
              p.walk.getVert i ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, h0, h1⟩ := p.exists_enteringIndex U0 hs h2
  obtain ⟨F, _hT⟩ := p.exists_factorAtIndex hi
  exact ⟨i, F, hi, h0, h1, p.entering_ne_start (U0 := U0) hs h0,
    p.entering_ne_finish hi⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.old_mem_boundaryEdges
statement:
lemma old_mem_boundaryEdges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (U0 : Finset V)
    (ha : a ∉ U0) (hx : x ∈ U0) :
    s(a, x) ∈ p.boundaryEdges U0
proof:
:=
  mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨F.old_mem_edges, endsStraddle_of_outside_inside ha hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.new_not_mem_boundaryEdges
statement:
lemma new_not_mem_boundaryEdges (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) (hy : p.start ∈ U0) (hx : x ∈ U0) :
    s(p.start, x) ∉ (F.rotate hyx).boundaryEdges U0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact not_endsStraddle_of_both hy hx (mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 h).2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.boundaryEdges_rotate
statement:
theorem boundaryEdges_rotate (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) (_ha : a ∉ U0) (hx : x ∈ U0) (hy : p.start ∈ U0) :
    (F.rotate hyx).boundaryEdges U0 = (p.boundaryEdges U0).erase s(a, x)
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_boundaryEdges_iff, F.rotate_edges, mem_erase, mem_union,
    mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hstr⟩
    rcases hmem with h | rfl
    · exact ⟨h.1, ⟨h.2, hstr⟩⟩
    · exact (not_endsStraddle_of_both hy hx hstr).elim
  · rintro ⟨hne, ⟨hmem, hstr⟩⟩
    exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨hne, hmem⟩, hstr⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_start_eq_tail
statement:
lemma rotate_start_eq_tail (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).start = a
proof:
:=
  F.rotate_start hyx

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.rotate_finish_eq_old
statement:
lemma rotate_finish_eq_old (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) :
    (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish
proof:
:=
  F.rotate_finish hyx

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.new_edge_internalU0
statement:
lemma new_edge_internalU0 (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hyx : G.Adj p.start x) (hy : p.start ∈ U0) (hx : x ∈ U0) :
    p.start ∈ U0 ∧ x ∈ U0 ∧ s(p.start, x) ∈ (F.rotate hyx).edges
proof:
:=
  ⟨hy, hx, F.new_edge_mem_rotate hyx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.returnRotate_spec
statement:
theorem returnRotate_spec (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    {U0 A : Finset V} (hyx : G.Adj p.start x)
    (haU : a ∉ U0) (hxU : x ∈ U0) (hyU : p.start ∈ U0)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    {c : GraphCycle G} (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (F.rotate hyx).start = a ∧
      (F.rotate hyx).start ∈ A ∧
        (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish ∧
          (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support ∧
            (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A ∧
              (F.rotate hyx).boundaryEdges U0 =
                (p.boundaryEdges U0).erase s(a, x) ∧
                s(p.start, x) ∈ (F.rotate hyx).edges ∧
                  ¬ endsStraddle s(p.start, x) U0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨F.rotate_start hyx, by simpa [F.rotate_start] using haA,
    F.rotate_finish hyx, F.rotate_support hyx,
    F.protectedAt_rotate hyx haA hyA hxA hP,
    F.boundaryEdges_rotate U0 hyx haU hxU hyU,
    F.new_edge_mem_rotate hyx, not_endsStraddle_of_both hyU hxU⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.PrefixEdgeFactor.returnRotate_of_completeJoin
statement:
theorem returnRotate_of_completeJoin (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p a x)
    {U0 A X Y : Finset V}
    (hyY : p.start ∈ Y) (hxX : x ∈ X)
    (hjoin : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ X, G.Adj y z)
    (haU : a ∉ U0) (hxU : x ∈ U0) (hyU : p.start ∈ U0)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hyA : p.start ∉ A) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    {c : GraphCycle G} (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A) :
    let hyx := hjoin p.start hyY x hxX
    (F.rotate hyx).start = a ∧
      (F.rotate hyx).finish = p.finish ∧
        (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support ∧
          (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A ∧
            (F.rotate hyx).boundaryEdges U0 =
              (p.boundaryEdges U0).erase s(a, x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hyx
  obtain ⟨hst, _, hfin, hsup, hProt, hbd, _, _⟩ :=
    F.returnRotate_spec (U0 := U0) (A := A) hyx haU hxU hyU haA hyA hxA hP
  exact ⟨hst, hfin, hsup, hProt, hbd⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_returnRotate
statement:
theorem exists_returnRotate (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V)
    (hs : p.start ∈ U0) (h2 : 2 ≤ (p.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {A X Y : Finset V} {c : GraphCycle G}
    (hjoin : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ X, G.Adj y z)
    (hyY : p.start ∈ Y)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A)
    (hAout : Disjoint A U0)
    (hYU : Y ⊆ U0) (hXU : X ⊆ U0)
    (henterX : ∀ i, i < p.walk.length → p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 →
      p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 → p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X)
    (henterA : ∀ i, i < p.walk.length → p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 →
      p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 → p.walk.getVert i ∈ A) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p (p.walk.getVert i) (p.walk.getVert (i + 1)))
      (hyx : G.Adj p.start (p.walk.getVert (i + 1))),
      i < p.walk.length ∧
        p.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∧
          p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 ∧
            p.walk.getVert i ∈ A ∧
              p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X ∧
                (F.rotate hyx).start = p.walk.getVert i ∧
                  (F.rotate hyx).support = p.support ∧
                    (F.rotate hyx).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, F, hi, h0, h1, _, _⟩ := p.exists_enteringFactor U0 hs h2
  have hxX : p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X := henterX i hi h0 h1
  have haA : p.walk.getVert i ∈ A := henterA i hi h0 h1
  have hyA : p.start ∉ A := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hAout h) (hYU hyY)
  have hxA : p.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ A :=
    fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hAout h) (hXU hxX)
  have hyx : G.Adj p.start (p.walk.getVert (i + 1)) := hjoin p.start hyY _ hxX
  obtain ⟨hst, hfin, hsup, hProt, _⟩ :=
    F.returnRotate_of_completeJoin (U0 := U0) (A := A) (X := X) (Y := Y)
      hyY hxX hjoin h0 h1 hs haA hyA hxA hP
  exact ⟨i, F, hyx, hi, h0, h1, haA, hxX, hst, hsup, hProt⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.OneToughOn.empty
statement: lemma OneToughOn.empty : OneToughOn G (∅ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS h2
  have hSempty : S = ∅ := subset_empty.1 hS
  subst hSempty
  simp [componentCount_empty] at h2

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_eq_one_of_connected
proof:
:= by
  have hneU : Nonempty (U : Set V) := hU.to_subtype
  have hne : Nonempty (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨hU.choose, hU.choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hss : Subsingleton (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    hc.preconnected.subsingleton_connectedComponent
  exact Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨hss, hne⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_connected_of_two_le_componentCount
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hne : U.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hempty
    have : U = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
    have h0 : componentCount G U = 0 := by simp [this, componentCount_empty]
    omega
  have h1 := componentCount_eq_one_of_connected (G := G) hne hc
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.induceIncl_apply
statement:
lemma induceIncl_apply {A B : Finset V} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x : (A : Set V)) :
    induceIncl G hAB x = ⟨x.1, hAB x.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_of_induce_subset
statement:
lemma reachable_of_induce_subset {A B : Finset V} (hAB : A ⊆ B) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ A) (hy : y ∈ A)
    (h : (G.induce (A : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    (G.induce (B : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x, hAB hx⟩ ⟨y, hAB hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  convert h.map (induceIncl G hAB) <;> rw [induceIncl_apply]

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_of_componentCount_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hss : Subsingleton (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 h).1
  exact ConnectedComponent.exact (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_componentFinset_iff
statement:
lemma mem_componentFinset_iff {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    {C : (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent} :
    x ∈ componentFinset G U C ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ U, (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx⟩ = C
proof:
:= by
  simp [componentFinset]

name: Nikoghosyan.cycle_support_subset_componentFinset
statement:
lemma cycle_support_subset_componentFinset (c : GraphCycle G) {U : Finset V}
    (hsub : c.support ⊆ U) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ c.support) :
    c.support ⊆
      componentFinset G U
        ((G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hsub hx⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine (mem_componentFinset_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hsub hy, ?_⟩
  apply ConnectedComponent.sound
  exact (reachable_of_induce_subset hsub hx hy
    (reachable_of_componentCount_eq_one (componentCount_cycle_eq_one c) hx hy)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_biUnion_le
statement:
lemma componentCount_biUnion_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Finset V) :
    componentCount G (s.biUnion f) ≤ s.sum fun i => componentCount G (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp [componentCount_empty]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [biUnion_insert, sum_insert ha]
    exact (componentCount_union_le G (f a) (s.biUnion f)).trans
      (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)

name: Nikoghosyan.biUnion_sdiff
statement:
lemma biUnion_sdiff {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Finset V) (S : Finset V) :
    s.biUnion f \ S = s.biUnion fun i => f i \ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨i, hi, hxf⟩, hxS⟩
    exact ⟨i, hi, hxf, hxS⟩
  · intro ⟨i, hi, hxf, hxS⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi, hxf⟩, hxS⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter_noncograph_union
statement:
lemma sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter_noncograph_union (A S : Finset V) :
    A \ S = A \ (S ∩ A)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_sdiff]

name: Nikoghosyan.eq_biUnion_inter
statement:
lemma eq_biUnion_inter {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Finset V) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : S ⊆ s.biUnion f) :
    S = s.biUnion fun i => S ∩ f i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxf⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 (hS hx)
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, hi, mem_inter.2 ⟨hx, hxf⟩⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, hx'⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 hx
    exact (mem_inter.1 hx').1

name: Nikoghosyan.pairwiseDisjoint_inter_of_pairwise
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_inter_of_pairwise {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {c : ι → GraphCycle G}
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (c i).support (c j).support)
    (I : Finset ι) (S : Finset V) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint (I : Set ι) fun i => S ∩ (c i).support
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj hij
  exact (hdisj hij).mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right

name: Nikoghosyan.card_sum_inter_cycle_family
statement:
lemma card_sum_inter_cycle_family {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ι → GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (c i).support (c j).support)
    (I : Finset ι) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : S ⊆ I.biUnion fun i => (c i).support) :
    (I.sum fun i => (S ∩ (c i).support).card) = S.card
proof:
:= by
  have hunion : S = I.biUnion fun i => S ∩ (c i).support :=
    eq_biUnion_inter I (fun i => (c i).support) hS
  have hd := pairwiseDisjoint_inter_of_pairwise (c := c) hdisj I S
  rw [← card_biUnion hd, ← hunion]

name: Nikoghosyan.selected_cycle_meets_cut
statement:
lemma selected_cycle_meets_cut {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ι → GraphCycle G)
    (I : Finset ι) (hcof : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnc : ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ IsCograph G (c i).support)
    {S : Finset V}
    (_hS : S ⊆ I.biUnion fun i => (c i).support)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G ((I.biUnion fun i => (c i).support) \ S))
    {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ I) :
    (S ∩ (c i).support).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hdis
  have hmiss : Disjoint S (c i).support :=
    disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.2 (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hdis)
  set J := I.biUnion fun j => (c j).support
  set U := J \ S
  have hCsubJ : (c i).support ⊆ J :=
    subset_biUnion_of_mem (fun j => (c j).support) hi
  have hCsubU : (c i).support ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hCsubJ hx, fun hxS =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 hmiss hxS hx⟩
  have hdc : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected :=
    not_connected_of_two_le_componentCount (G := G) h2
  have hx : (c i).start ∈ (c i).support := (c i).start_mem_support
  let C :=
    (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨(c i).start, hCsubU hx⟩
  have hcog : IsCograph G (componentFinset G U C) :=
    NoInducedP4UnionP1.isCograph_componentFinset (G := G) hcof hdc C
  have hsub :=
    cycle_support_subset_componentFinset (c i) hCsubU hx
  exact hnc i hi (IsCograph.subset (G := G) hcog hsub)

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_of_noncograph_cycle_family
statement:
theorem oneToughOn_of_noncograph_cycle_family
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ι → GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (c i).support (c j).support)
    (I : Finset ι) (hcof : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnc : ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ IsCograph G (c i).support) :
    OneToughOn G (I.biUnion fun i => (c i).support)
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS h2
  set J := I.biUnion fun i => (c i).support
  have hmeet : ∀ i ∈ I, (S ∩ (c i).support).Nonempty :=
    fun i hi => selected_cycle_meets_cut (c := c) I hcof hnc hS h2 hi
  have hrem : J \ S = I.biUnion fun i => (c i).support \ S :=
    biUnion_sdiff I (fun i => (c i).support) S
  rw [hrem]
  have hblock :
      ∀ i ∈ I,
        componentCount G ((c i).support \ S) ≤ (S ∩ (c i).support).card := by
    intro i hi
    have hSi : S ∩ (c i).support ⊆ (c i).support := inter_subset_right
    have hne := hmeet i hi
    have hrew : (c i).support \ S = (c i).support \ (S ∩ (c i).support) :=
      sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter_noncograph_union _ _
    rw [hrew]
    exact componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le (c i) hSi hne
  have hunion :=
    componentCount_biUnion_le (G := G) I fun i => (c i).support \ S
  have hsum :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum hblock
  have hcard := card_sum_inter_cycle_family (c := c) hdisj I hS
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_selectedSupport_of_noncograph
statement:
theorem oneToughOn_selectedSupport_of_noncograph
    (F : CycleFactor G) (I : Finset (Fin F.card))
    (hcof : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnc : ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    OneToughOn G (F.selectedSupport I)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [CycleFactor.selectedSupport] using
    oneToughOn_of_noncograph_cycle_family (c := F.getCycle)
      (fun i j hij => F.disjoint_getCycle hij) I hcof hnc

name: Nikoghosyan.oneTough_induce_of_selected_noncograph
statement:
theorem oneTough_induce_of_selected_noncograph
    (F : CycleFactor G) (I : Finset (Fin F.card))
    (hcof : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnc : ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    OneTough (G.induce ((F.selectedSupport I : Finset V) : Set V))
proof:
:=
  (OneToughOn_iff_OneTough_induce (F.selectedSupport I)).1
    (oneToughOn_selectedSupport_of_noncograph F I hcof hnc)

name: Nikoghosyan.twoCycleBlocks_pairwise
statement:
lemma twoCycleBlocks_pairwise
    {cH cD : GraphCycle G} (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support) :
    Pairwise fun i j =>
      Disjoint (twoCycleBlocks cH cD i).support
        (twoCycleBlocks cH cD j).support
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [twoCycleBlocks] at hij ⊢
  · exact hdisj.symm
  · exact hdisj

name: Nikoghosyan.twoCycleBlocks_support
statement:
lemma twoCycleBlocks_support (cH cD : GraphCycle G) :
    (univ : Finset Bool).biUnion (fun b => (twoCycleBlocks cH cD b).support) =
      cH.support ∪ cD.support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [twoCycleBlocks, mem_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.twoCycleBlocks_noncograph
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  cases b
  · simpa [twoCycleBlocks] using hD
  · simpa [twoCycleBlocks] using hH

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_of_two_noncograph_cycles
statement:
theorem oneToughOn_of_two_noncograph_cycles
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hcof : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hD : ¬ IsCograph G cD.support) :
    OneToughOn G (cH.support ∪ cD.support)
proof:
:= by
  have hnc : ∀ b ∈ (univ : Finset Bool),
      ¬ IsCograph G (twoCycleBlocks cH cD b).support :=
    fun b _ => twoCycleBlocks_noncograph hH hD b
  convert oneToughOn_of_noncograph_cycle_family (twoCycleBlocks cH cD)
      (twoCycleBlocks_pairwise hdisj) (univ : Finset Bool) hcof hnc using 1
  exact (twoCycleBlocks_support cH cD).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.oneTough_induce_of_two_noncograph_cycles
statement:
theorem oneTough_induce_of_two_noncograph_cycles
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hcof : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hD : ¬ IsCograph G cD.support) :
    OneTough (G.induce ((cH.support ∪ cD.support : Finset V) : Set V))
proof:
:=
  (OneToughOn_iff_OneTough_induce (cH.support ∪ cD.support)).1
    (oneToughOn_of_two_noncograph_cycles cH cD hdisj hcof hH hD)

    (Q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint Q.support r.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u Q.start) (hf : G.Adj Q.finish v)
    {c : GraphCycle G} {A : Finset V}
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAQ : Disjoint Q.support A)
    (hP : r.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:=
  F.protectedAt_insertBlock Q hd hs hf huA hvA hAQ hP

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.protected_exact_of_insertOmittedBlock
statement:
theorem protected_exact_of_insertOmittedBlock (F : PrefixEdgeFactor r u v)
    (Q : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint Q.support r.support)
    (hs : G.Adj u Q.start) (hf : G.Adj Q.finish v)
    (c : GraphCycle G) {A : Finset V}
    (hsup : (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).support = c.support)
    (hA : A ⊆ (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).support)
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hAQ : Disjoint Q.support A)
    (hP : r.ProtectedAt c A) :
    (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).ProtectedAt c A ∧
      (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).start = r.start ∧
        (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).finish = r.finish ∧
          (∀ b ∈ A,
            (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b =
              r.incidentEdges b) ∧
            (∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ r.start → b ≠ r.finish →
              (insertOmittedBlock F Q hd hs hf).incidentEdges b =
                c.incidentEdges b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hProt, hst, hfin, hinc, hinter, _, _⟩ :=
    F.protected_exact_of_insertBlock Q hd hs hf c hsup hA huA hvA hAQ hP
  exact ⟨hProt, hst, hfin, hinc, hinter⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.bothEndsOutside_iff
statement:
lemma bothEndsOutside_iff {a b : V} {S : Finset V} :
    bothEndsOutside s(a, b) S ↔ a ∉ S ∧ b ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h a (by simp), h b (by simp)⟩
  · intro ⟨ha, hb⟩ x hx
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact ha
    · exact hb

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.bothEndsOutside_of_support
proof:
:= by

    (he : e ∈ Q.edges) : ¬ bothEndsOutside e Q.support
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun a b he h => ?_) he h
  exact h a (by simp) (mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.support_cons_not_nil
statement:
lemma support_cons_not_nil {u v : V} {w : G.Walk u v} (h : ¬ w.Nil) :
    w.support = u :: w.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  have ht := Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil w h
  simpa [ht] using (Walk.cons_support_tail (p := w) h).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim
statement:
lemma disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hsuf : ¬ F.sufWalk.Nil) :
    Disjoint (F.prefixTrim hpre).support (F.suffixTrim hsuf).support
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxP hxS
  have hxpre : x ∈ F.preWalk.support := by
    have : x ∈ F.preWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.start := by
      simpa [F.support_prefixTrim hpre] using hxP
    exact List.mem_toFinset.1 (mem_erase.1 this).2
  have hxneS : x ≠ Q.start := by
    have : x ∈ F.preWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.start := by
      simpa [F.support_prefixTrim hpre] using hxP
    exact (mem_erase.1 this).1
  have hxsuf : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support := by
    have : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish := by
      simpa [F.support_suffixTrim hsuf] using hxS
    exact List.mem_toFinset.1 (mem_erase.1 this).2
  have hxneF : x ≠ Q.finish := by
    have : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish := by
      simpa [F.support_suffixTrim hsuf] using hxS
    exact (mem_erase.1 this).1
  have hcons := support_cons_not_nil (w := F.sufWalk) hsuf
  have htail : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support.tail :=
    (List.mem_cons.1 (by rw [hcons] at hxsuf; exact hxsuf)).resolve_left hxneF
  have hcat := F.support_cat
  have hxG : x ∈ p.walk.support := by
    rw [hcat]
    exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hxpre)))
  have hcnt : 2 ≤ p.walk.support.count x := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ F.preWalk.support.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hxpre
    have h2 : 1 ≤ F.sufWalk.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htail
    rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
    omega
  have : p.walk.support.count x = 1 :=
    List.count_eq_one_of_mem p.support_nodup hxG
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil) :
    F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose = F.prefixTrim hpre
proof:
:= by
  simp [omitRunComplement, hsuf]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hsuf : ¬ F.sufWalk.Nil) :
    F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose =
      (F.suffixTrim hsuf).splice (F.prefixTrim hpre)
        (by simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose)
        (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
proof:
:= by
  simp [omitRunComplement, hsuf]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_start
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_start (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start =
      if F.sufWalk.Nil then p.start else F.sufWalk.snd
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · simp [F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf,
      F.prefixTrim_start, hsuf]
  · simp [F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf,
      suffixTrim, pathOfWalk, trimStart, splice, hsuf]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_finish
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_finish (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).finish = F.preWalk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · rw [F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf,
      F.prefixTrim_finish]
  · rw [F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf]
    rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_adj_left
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_adj_left (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    G.Adj (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).finish Q.start
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.omitRunComplement_finish hpre hclose]
  exact F.prefixTrim_adj hpre

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_adj_right
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_adj_right (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    G.Adj Q.finish (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hsuf
    have hst : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start = p.start := by
      simp [F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf,
        F.prefixTrim_start]
    simpa [hst, hf] using hclose
  · have hst : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start =
        (F.suffixTrim hsuf).start := by
      simp [F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf, splice]
    rw [hst]
    exact F.suffixTrim_adj hsuf

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_start_mem_A
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_start_mem_A (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    {A : Finset V} (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hsufA : F.sufWalk.Nil ∨ F.sufWalk.snd ∈ A) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · have hst : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start = p.start := by
      simp [F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf,
        F.prefixTrim_start]
    simpa [hst] using hs
  · have hst : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start =
        (F.suffixTrim hsuf).start := by
      simp [F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf, splice]
    rw [hst, F.suffixTrim_start]
    exact hsufA.resolve_left hsuf

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_finish_mem_A
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_finish_mem_A (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    {A : Finset V} (hpreA : F.preWalk.penultimate ∈ A) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).finish ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.omitRunComplement_finish hpre hclose]
  exact hpreA

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.edges_eq_dropLast_concat_last
statement:
lemma edges_eq_dropLast_concat_last (q : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ q.walk.Nil) :
    q.walk.edges =
      q.walk.edges.dropLast ++ [s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish)]
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 h
  have hlen : 0 < q.walk.edges.length := by simp [Walk.length_edges]; omega
  have hne : q.walk.edges ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos hlen
  have hcat := List.dropLast_append_getLast hne
  have hi : q.walk.length - 1 < q.walk.edges.length := by
    simp [Walk.length_edges]; omega
  have hlast : q.walk.edges.getLast hne = s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish) := by
    have : q.walk.edges.getLast hne = q.walk.edges[q.walk.length - 1] := by
      simp [List.getLast_eq_getElem, Walk.length_edges]
    rw [this, Walk.getElem_edges hi]
    have hlen' : q.walk.length - 1 + 1 = q.walk.length := by omega
    simp [Walk.penultimate, hlen', Walk.getVert_length]
  conv_lhs => rw [← hcat]
  rw [hlast]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.edges_trimFinish_erase
statement:
lemma edges_trimFinish_erase (q : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ q.walk.Nil) :
    (q.trimFinish h).edges =
      q.edges.erase s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish)
proof:
:= by
  have hedges := edges_eq_dropLast_concat_last q h
  have hnod := q.isPath.isTrail.edges_nodup
  have hnin : s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish) ∉ q.walk.edges.dropLast := by
    intro hmem
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ q.walk.edges.count s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish) := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ q.walk.edges.dropLast.count s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish) :=
        List.count_pos_iff.mpr hmem
      rw [hedges, List.count_append]
      simp
      omega
    have : q.walk.edges.count s(q.walk.penultimate, q.finish) = 1 :=
      List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnod (by rw [hedges]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (by simp))
    omega
  simp only [edges, trimFinish, Walk.edges_dropLast]
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    have heL : e ∈ q.walk.edges.dropLast := List.mem_toFinset.1 he
    refine mem_erase.2 ⟨fun heq => hnin (heq ▸ heL), List.mem_toFinset.2 ?_⟩
    rw [hedges]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ heL
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨hne, heq⟩ := mem_erase.1 he
    have heL : e ∈ q.walk.edges := List.mem_toFinset.1 heq
    rw [hedges] at heL
    exact List.mem_toFinset.2
      ((List.mem_append.1 heL).resolve_right (by simp [hne]))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.edges_eq_cons_tail
statement:
lemma edges_eq_cons_tail (q : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ q.walk.Nil) :
    q.walk.edges = s(q.start, q.walk.snd) :: q.walk.edges.tail
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 h
  have hlen : 0 < q.walk.edges.length := by simp [Walk.length_edges]; omega
  have hne : q.walk.edges ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos hlen
  have hcons := List.cons_head_tail hne
  have h0 : 0 < q.walk.edges.length := hlen
  have hhead : q.walk.edges.head hne = s(q.start, q.walk.snd) := by
    have : q.walk.edges.head hne = q.walk.edges[0] := List.head_eq_getElem hne
    rw [this, Walk.getElem_edges h0]
    simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
  rw [← hcons, hhead]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.edges_trimStart_erase
statement:
lemma edges_trimStart_erase (q : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ q.walk.Nil) :
    (q.trimStart h).edges = q.edges.erase s(q.start, q.walk.snd)
proof:
:= by
  have hedges := edges_eq_cons_tail q h
  have hnod := q.isPath.isTrail.edges_nodup
  have hnin : s(q.start, q.walk.snd) ∉ q.walk.edges.tail := by
    have hnod' : (s(q.start, q.walk.snd) :: q.walk.edges.tail).Nodup := by
      rwa [← hedges]
    exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnod').1
  simp only [edges, trimStart, Walk.edges_tail]
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    have heL : e ∈ q.walk.edges.tail := List.mem_toFinset.1 he
    refine mem_erase.2 ⟨fun heq => hnin (heq ▸ heL), List.mem_toFinset.2 ?_⟩
    rw [hedges]
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ heL
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨hne, heq⟩ := mem_erase.1 he
    have heL : e ∈ q.walk.edges := List.mem_toFinset.1 heq
    rw [hedges] at heL
    exact List.mem_toFinset.2 ((List.mem_cons.1 heL).resolve_left hne)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.edges_prefixTrim
statement:
lemma edges_prefixTrim (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) :
    (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges =
      F.preWalk.edges.toFinset.erase s(F.preWalk.penultimate, Q.start)
proof:
:=
  edges_trimFinish_erase (pathOfWalk F.preWalk F.preWalk_isPath) hpre

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.edges_suffixTrim
statement:
lemma edges_suffixTrim (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hsuf : ¬ F.sufWalk.Nil) :
    (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges =
      F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset.erase s(Q.finish, F.sufWalk.snd)
proof:
:=
  edges_trimStart_erase (pathOfWalk F.sufWalk F.sufWalk_isPath) hsuf

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.suf_nil_edges
statement:
lemma suf_nil_edges (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q) (hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil) :
    F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : F.sufWalk.length = 0 := (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff).2 hsuf
  have hlen : F.sufWalk.edges.length = 0 := by simp [Walk.length_edges, h0]
  simp [List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 hlen]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.inter_pre_Q
statement:
lemma inter_pre_Q (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q) :
    F.preWalk.support.toFinset ∩ Q.support ⊆ {Q.start}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxpre : x ∈ F.preWalk.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  have hxQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support] using (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  by_cases hxe : x = Q.start
  · simp [hxe]
  · have hnilQ : ¬ Q.walk.Nil := by
      intro hnil
      have : Q.walk.support = [Q.start] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hnil
      exact hxe (by simpa [this] using hxQ)
    have hcons := support_cons_not_nil (w := Q.walk) hnilQ
    have htail : x ∈ Q.walk.support.tail :=
      (List.mem_cons.1 (by rw [hcons] at hxQ; exact hxQ)).resolve_left hxe
    have hcat := F.support_cat
    have hxG : x ∈ p.walk.support := by
      rw [hcat]
      exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hxpre)))
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ p.walk.support.count x := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ F.preWalk.support.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hxpre
      have h2 : 1 ≤ Q.walk.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htail
      rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
      omega
    have : p.walk.support.count x = 1 :=
      List.count_eq_one_of_mem p.support_nodup hxG
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.inter_suf_Q
statement:
lemma inter_suf_Q (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q) :
    F.sufWalk.support.toFinset ∩ Q.support ⊆ {Q.finish}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxsuf : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  have hxQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support] using (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  by_cases hxe : x = Q.finish
  · simp [hxe]
  · have hsuf : ¬ F.sufWalk.Nil := by
      intro hnil
      have : F.sufWalk.support = [Q.finish] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hnil
      exact hxe (by simpa [this] using hxsuf)
    have hcons := support_cons_not_nil (w := F.sufWalk) hsuf
    have htail : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support.tail :=
      (List.mem_cons.1 (by rw [hcons] at hxsuf; exact hxsuf)).resolve_left hxe
    have hcat := F.support_cat
    have hxG : x ∈ p.walk.support := by
      rw [hcat]
      exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr htail)
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ p.walk.support.count x := by
      have h2 : 1 ≤ F.sufWalk.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htail
      by_cases hxs : x = Q.start
      · subst hxs
        have h1 : 1 ≤ F.preWalk.support.count Q.start :=
          List.count_pos_iff.mpr (Walk.end_mem_support F.preWalk)
        rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
        omega
      · have hnilQ : ¬ Q.walk.Nil := by
          intro hnil
          have : Q.walk.support = [Q.start] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hnil
          exact hxs (by simpa [this] using hxQ)
        have hconsQ := support_cons_not_nil (w := Q.walk) hnilQ
        have htailQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support.tail :=
          (List.mem_cons.1 (by rw [hconsQ] at hxQ; exact hxQ)).resolve_left hxs
        have h1 : 1 ≤ Q.walk.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htailQ
        rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
        omega
    have : p.walk.support.count x = 1 :=
      List.count_eq_one_of_mem p.support_nodup hxG
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.start_not_mem_Q_of_pre_not_nil
statement:
lemma start_not_mem_Q_of_pre_not_nil (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) : p.start ∉ Q.support
proof:
:= by
  intro hQ
  have hne : p.start ≠ Q.start := fun heq =>
    hpre ((F.preWalk_isPath.nil_iff_eq).2 heq)
  have hxS : p.start ∈ ({Q.start} : Finset V) :=
    F.inter_pre_Q (mem_inter.2
      ⟨List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.start_mem_support F.preWalk), hQ⟩)
  exact hne (mem_singleton.1 hxS)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.finish_not_mem_Q_of_suf_not_nil
statement:
lemma finish_not_mem_Q_of_suf_not_nil (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hsuf : ¬ F.sufWalk.Nil) : p.finish ∉ Q.support
proof:
:= by
  intro hQ
  have hne : p.finish ≠ Q.finish := fun heq =>
    hsuf ((F.sufWalk_isPath.nil_iff_eq).2 heq.symm)
  have hxS : p.finish ∈ ({Q.finish} : Finset V) :=
    F.inter_suf_Q (mem_inter.2
      ⟨List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.end_mem_support F.sufWalk), hQ⟩)
  exact hne (mem_singleton.1 hxS)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support
proof:
:= by
  have hxQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support := by simpa [GraphPath.support] using hx
  by_cases hnil : Q.walk.Nil
  · have : x = Q.start := by
      have : Q.walk.support = [Q.start] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hnil
      simpa [this] using hxQ
    subst this
    exact List.mem_append.2
      (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (Walk.end_mem_support F.preWalk))))
  · have hcons := support_cons_not_nil (w := Q.walk) hnil
    have : x = Q.start ∨ x ∈ Q.walk.support.tail := by
      rw [hcons] at hxQ
      exact List.mem_cons.1 hxQ
    rcases this with rfl | htail
    · exact List.mem_append.2
        (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (Walk.end_mem_support F.preWalk))))
    · exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr htail)))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.support_union_of_factor
statement:
lemma support_union_of_factor (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q) :
    p.support = F.preWalk.support.toFinset ∪ Q.support ∪
      F.sufWalk.support.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hcat := F.support_cat
  ext x
  simp only [GraphPath.support, mem_union, List.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x ∈ F.preWalk.support ++ Q.walk.support.tail ++
        F.sufWalk.support.tail := by
      simpa [hcat] using hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx' with h | hrv
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 h with hru | hQt
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hru)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_of_mem_tail hQt))
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_of_mem_tail hrv)
  · intro hx
    have hcat' : x ∈ F.preWalk.support ++ Q.walk.support.tail ++
        F.sufWalk.support.tail → x ∈ p.walk.support := fun h => by
      simpa [hcat] using h
    rcases hx with h | hrv
    · rcases h with hru | hQ
      · exact hcat' (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hru))))
      · exact hcat' (F.mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support (by simpa [GraphPath.support] using hQ))
    · have hxR : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support := hrv
      by_cases hnilR : F.sufWalk.Nil
      · have : x = Q.finish := by
          have : F.sufWalk.support = [Q.finish] :=
            (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hnilR
          simpa [this] using hxR
        subst this
        exact hcat' (F.mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support Q.finish_mem_support)
      · have hcons := support_cons_not_nil (w := F.sufWalk) hnilR
        have : x = Q.finish ∨ x ∈ F.sufWalk.support.tail := by
          rw [hcons] at hxR
          exact List.mem_cons.1 hxR
        rcases this with rfl | htail
        · exact hcat' (F.mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support Q.finish_mem_support)
        · exact hcat' (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr htail))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.Q_support_subset
statement: lemma Q_support_subset (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q) : Q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [F.support_union_of_factor]
  exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hx)))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRun_sdiff_eq_prefix_suffix
statement:
lemma omitRun_sdiff_eq_prefix_suffix (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q) :
    p.support \ Q.support =
      F.preWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.start ∪
        F.sufWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hU := F.support_union_of_factor
  have hruQ := F.inter_pre_Q
  have hrvQ := F.inter_suf_Q
  ext x
  simp only [hU, mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨hx, hxQ⟩
    rcases hx with h | hrv
    · rcases h with hru | hQ
      · exact Or.inl ⟨fun hxe => hxQ (hxe ▸ Q.start_mem_support), hru⟩
      · exact (hxQ hQ).elim
    · exact Or.inr ⟨fun hxe => hxQ (hxe ▸ Q.finish_mem_support), hrv⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hne, hru⟩ | ⟨hne, hrv⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hru), ?_⟩
      intro hQ
      have : x ∈ ({Q.start} : Finset V) :=
        hruQ (mem_inter.2 ⟨hru, hQ⟩)
      exact hne (mem_singleton.1 this)
    · refine ⟨Or.inr hrv, ?_⟩
      intro hQ
      have : x ∈ ({Q.finish} : Finset V) :=
        hrvQ (mem_inter.2 ⟨hrv, hQ⟩)
      exact hne (mem_singleton.1 this)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.erase_end_of_nil
statement:
lemma erase_end_of_nil {u v : V} {w : G.Walk u v} (h : w.Nil) :
    w.support.toFinset.erase v = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have : w.support = [u] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 h
  have hv : v = u := (Walk.Nil.eq h).symm
  simp [this, hv]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_support
statement:
theorem omitRunComplement_support (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support = p.support \ Q.support
proof:
:= by
  have hsd := F.omitRun_sdiff_eq_prefix_suffix
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf
    have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hsuf
    have hR : F.sufWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish = ∅ := by
      simpa [hf] using erase_end_of_nil hsuf
    have hsd' : p.support \ Q.support =
        F.preWalk.support.toFinset.erase Q.start := by
      rw [hsd, hR, union_empty]
    rw [hr, F.support_prefixTrim hpre]
    exact hsd'.symm
  · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf
    have hdisj := (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
    have hcl : G.Adj (F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish (F.prefixTrim hpre).start := by
      simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose
    have hsup :
        ((F.suffixTrim hsuf).splice (F.prefixTrim hpre) hcl hdisj).support =
          (F.suffixTrim hsuf).support ∪ (F.prefixTrim hpre).support :=
      support_splice (F.suffixTrim hsuf) (F.prefixTrim hpre) hcl hdisj
    rw [hr, hsup, F.support_suffixTrim hsuf, F.support_prefixTrim hpre,
      union_comm]
    exact hsd.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_disjoint_block
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_disjoint_block (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    Disjoint Q.support (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose]
  exact Finset.disjoint_sdiff

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_subset_host
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_subset_host (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose]
  exact sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_support_singleton
statement:
theorem omitRunComplement_support_singleton (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hcard : (p.support \ Q.support).card = 1) :
    ∃ v, (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support = {v} ∧
      p.support \ Q.support = {v}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hcard
  refine ⟨v, ?_, hv⟩
  rw [F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose, hv]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_start_mem_support_sdiff
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_start_mem_support_sdiff (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start ∈ p.support \ Q.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose]
  exact start_mem_support _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_finish_mem_support_sdiff
statement:
lemma omitRunComplement_finish_mem_support_sdiff (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).finish ∈ p.support \ Q.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose]
  exact finish_mem_support _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_edges_subset_closed
statement:
theorem omitRunComplement_edges_subset_closed (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges ⊆ closedEdges p hclose
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf
    have heP : e ∈ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges := by simpa [hr] using he
    have hePre : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := by
      have := F.edges_prefixTrim hpre
      rw [this] at heP
      exact (mem_erase.1 heP).2
    refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
    have : e ∈ p.edges := by
      simp [F.edges_union, hePre]
    exact this
  · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf
    have hdisj := (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
    have hcl : G.Adj (F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish (F.prefixTrim hpre).start := by
      simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose
    have he' : e ∈ (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges ∪ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges ∪
        {s((F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish, (F.prefixTrim hpre).start)} := by
      simpa [hr, edges_of_splice_block _ _ hcl hdisj] using he
    rcases mem_union.1 he' with h | hse
    · rcases mem_union.1 h with hsE | hpE
      · have heS : e ∈ F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := by
          have := F.edges_suffixTrim hsuf
          rw [this] at hsE
          exact (mem_erase.1 hsE).2
        refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
        simp [F.edges_union, heS]
      · have heP : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := by
          have := F.edges_prefixTrim hpre
          rw [this] at hpE
          exact (mem_erase.1 hpE).2
        refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
        simp [F.edges_union, heP]
    · have : e = s(p.finish, p.start) := by
        simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using
          (mem_singleton.1 hse)
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton.2 this))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.prefixTrim_bothOutside
statement:
lemma prefixTrim_bothOutside (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) {e : Sym2 V}
    (he : e ∈ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges) :
    bothEndsOutside e Q.support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxQ
  have heP : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := by
    have := F.edges_prefixTrim hpre
    rw [this] at he
    exact (mem_erase.1 he).2
  have hxpre : x ∈ F.preWalk.support :=
    F.preWalk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (List.mem_toFinset.1 heP) hx
  have hxeq : x = Q.start := mem_singleton.1
    (F.inter_pre_Q (mem_inter.2 ⟨List.mem_toFinset.2 hxpre, hxQ⟩))
  subst hxeq
  have heI :
      e ∈ (pathOfWalk F.preWalk F.preWalk_isPath).incidentEdges
        (pathOfWalk F.preWalk F.preWalk_isPath).finish :=
    mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨by simpa [edges, pathOfWalk] using heP, hx⟩
  have hinc := (pathOfWalk F.preWalk F.preWalk_isPath).incidentEdges_finish hpre
  have heq : e = s(F.preWalk.penultimate, Q.start) := by
    have : e ∈ ({s((pathOfWalk F.preWalk F.preWalk_isPath).walk.penultimate,
        (pathOfWalk F.preWalk F.preWalk_isPath).finish)} : Finset (Sym2 V)) := by
      rw [← hinc]
      exact heI
    simpa [pathOfWalk] using mem_singleton.1 this
  have := F.edges_prefixTrim hpre
  rw [this] at he
  exact (mem_erase.1 he).1 heq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.suffixTrim_bothOutside
statement:
lemma suffixTrim_bothOutside (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hsuf : ¬ F.sufWalk.Nil) {e : Sym2 V}
    (he : e ∈ (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges) :
    bothEndsOutside e Q.support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxQ
  have heS : e ∈ F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := by
    have := F.edges_suffixTrim hsuf
    rw [this] at he
    exact (mem_erase.1 he).2
  have hxsuf : x ∈ F.sufWalk.support :=
    F.sufWalk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (List.mem_toFinset.1 heS) hx
  have hxeq : x = Q.finish := mem_singleton.1
    (F.inter_suf_Q (mem_inter.2 ⟨List.mem_toFinset.2 hxsuf, hxQ⟩))
  subst hxeq
  have heI :
      e ∈ (pathOfWalk F.sufWalk F.sufWalk_isPath).incidentEdges
        (pathOfWalk F.sufWalk F.sufWalk_isPath).start :=
    mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨by simpa [edges, pathOfWalk] using heS, hx⟩
  have hinc := (pathOfWalk F.sufWalk F.sufWalk_isPath).incidentEdges_start hsuf
  have heq : e = s(Q.finish, F.sufWalk.snd) := by
    have : e ∈ ({s((pathOfWalk F.sufWalk F.sufWalk_isPath).start,
        (pathOfWalk F.sufWalk F.sufWalk_isPath).walk.snd)} : Finset (Sym2 V)) := by
      rw [← hinc]
      exact heI
    simpa [pathOfWalk] using mem_singleton.1 this
  have := F.edges_suffixTrim hsuf
  rw [this] at he
  exact (mem_erase.1 he).1 heq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_bothOutside
statement:
theorem omitRunComplement_bothOutside (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges) :
    bothEndsOutside e Q.support
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
  · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf
    exact F.prefixTrim_bothOutside hpre (by simpa [hr] using he)
  · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf
    have hdisj := (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
    have hcl : G.Adj (F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish (F.prefixTrim hpre).start := by
      simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose
    have he' : e ∈ (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges ∪ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges ∪
        {s((F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish, (F.prefixTrim hpre).start)} := by
      simpa [hr, edges_of_splice_block _ _ hcl hdisj] using he
    rcases mem_union.1 he' with h | hse
    · rcases mem_union.1 h with hsE | hpE
      · exact F.suffixTrim_bothOutside hsuf hsE
      · exact F.prefixTrim_bothOutside hpre hpE
    · have heq : e = s(p.finish, p.start) := by
        simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using
          (mem_singleton.1 hse)
      rw [heq]
      exact bothEndsOutside_iff.2
        ⟨F.finish_not_mem_Q_of_suf_not_nil hsuf,
          F.start_not_mem_Q_of_pre_not_nil hpre⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.omitRunComplement_edges
statement:
theorem omitRunComplement_edges (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges =
      retainedClosedEdges p Q.support hclose
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    exact mem_filter.2
      ⟨F.omitRunComplement_edges_subset_closed hpre hclose he,
        F.omitRunComplement_bothOutside hpre hclose he⟩
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨hmem, hout⟩ := mem_filter.1 he
    rcases mem_union.1 hmem with hp | hc
    · have hp' : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset ∪ Q.edges ∪
          F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := by simpa [F.edges_union] using hp
      rcases mem_union.1 hp' with hmid | hsE
      · rcases mem_union.1 hmid with hP | hQ
        · have hne : e ≠ s(F.preWalk.penultimate, Q.start) := by
            intro heq
            subst heq
            exact hout Q.start (by simp) Q.start_mem_support
          have hePre : e ∈ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges := by
            rw [F.edges_prefixTrim hpre]
            exact mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, hP⟩
          by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
          · simpa [F.omitRunComplement_eq_prefix_of_nil hpre hclose hsuf] using hePre
          · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf
            have hdisj := (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
            have hcl : G.Adj (F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish (F.prefixTrim hpre).start := by
              simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose
            have : e ∈ (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges ∪ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges ∪
                {s((F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish, (F.prefixTrim hpre).start)} :=
              mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hePre)))
            simpa [hr, edges_of_splice_block _ _ hcl hdisj] using this
        · exact (not_bothEndsOutside_of_mem_edges hQ hout).elim
      · by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
        · have : F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset = ∅ := F.suf_nil_edges hsuf
          exact (notMem_empty e (this ▸ hsE)).elim
        · have hne : e ≠ s(Q.finish, F.sufWalk.snd) := by
            intro heq
            subst heq
            exact hout Q.finish (by simp) Q.finish_mem_support
          have heSuf : e ∈ (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges := by
            rw [F.edges_suffixTrim hsuf]
            exact mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, hsE⟩
          have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf
          have hdisj := (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
          have hcl : G.Adj (F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish (F.prefixTrim hpre).start := by
            simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose
          have : e ∈ (F.suffixTrim hsuf).edges ∪ (F.prefixTrim hpre).edges ∪
              {s((F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish, (F.prefixTrim hpre).start)} :=
            mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl heSuf)))
          simpa [hr, edges_of_splice_block _ _ hcl hdisj] using this
    · have heq : e = s(p.finish, p.start) := mem_singleton.1 hc
      by_cases hsuf : F.sufWalk.Nil
      · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hsuf
        subst heq
        exact (bothEndsOutside_iff.1 hout).1 (hf ▸ Q.finish_mem_support) |>.elim
      · have hr := F.omitRunComplement_eq_splice_of_not_nil hpre hclose hsuf
        have hdisj := (F.disjoint_prefixTrim_suffixTrim hpre hsuf).symm
        have hcl : G.Adj (F.suffixTrim hsuf).finish (F.prefixTrim hpre).start := by
          simpa [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre] using hclose
        rw [hr, edges_of_splice_block _ _ hcl hdisj, heq]
        simp [F.suffixTrim_finish hsuf, F.prefixTrim_start hpre]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.mem_omitRunComplement_of_disjoint_run
statement:
theorem mem_omitRunComplement_of_disjoint_run
    (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (R : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint R.support Q.support)
    (hsub : R.edges ⊆ p.edges) :
    R.edges ⊆ (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have heP : e ∈ p.edges := hsub he
  have hout : bothEndsOutside e Q.support := bothEndsOutside_of_support he hd
  have : e ∈ retainedClosedEdges p Q.support hclose :=
    mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl heP), hout⟩
  simpa [F.omitRunComplement_edges hpre hclose] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.exists_factor_of_retained_run_edge
statement:
theorem exists_factor_of_retained_run_edge
    (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (R : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint R.support Q.support)
    (hsub : R.edges ⊆ p.edges) {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ R.edges) :
    ∃ i, i < (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.length ∧
      s((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i,
          (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)) = e
proof:
:= by
  have heR : e ∈ (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges :=
    F.mem_omitRunComplement_of_disjoint_run hpre hclose R hd hsub he
  obtain ⟨i, hiE, hie⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 (mem_edges_iff.1 heR)
  have hiL : i < (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.length := by
    simpa [Walk.length_edges] using hiE
  refine ⟨i, hiL, ?_⟩
  exact (Walk.getElem_edges hiE).symm.trans hie

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.exists_PrefixEdgeFactor_of_retained_run_edge
statement:
theorem exists_PrefixEdgeFactor_of_retained_run_edge
    (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (R : GraphPath G) (hd : Disjoint R.support Q.support)
    (hsub : R.edges ⊆ p.edges) {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ R.edges) :
    ∃ i, i < (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.length ∧
      s((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i,
          (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)) = e ∧
        Nonempty (PrefixEdgeFactor (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose)
          ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i)
          ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hpair⟩ :=
    F.exists_factor_of_retained_run_edge hpre hclose R hd hsub he
  obtain ⟨Fac, _⟩ := (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).exists_factorAtIndex hi
  exact ⟨i, hi, hpair, ⟨Fac⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.OriginalSubwalkFactor.insertBlock_support_of_omitRunComplement
statement:
theorem insertBlock_support_of_omitRunComplement
    (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    {u v : V} (Fac : PrefixEdgeFactor (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose) u v)
    (hs : G.Adj u Q.start) (hf : G.Adj Q.finish v) :
    (Fac.insertBlock Q (F.omitRunComplement_disjoint_block hpre hclose) hs hf).support =
      p.support
proof:
:= by
  have hunion :=
    Fac.insertBlock_support Q (F.omitRunComplement_disjoint_block hpre hclose) hs hf
  have hr : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support = p.support \ Q.support :=
    F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose
  have hQ : Q.support ⊆ p.support := F.Q_support_subset
  rw [hunion, hr, sdiff_union_self_eq_union, union_eq_left.2 hQ]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.omitRunComplement_eq_cycle_filter
statement:
theorem omitRunComplement_eq_cycle_filter
    {p Q : GraphPath G} (F : OriginalSubwalkFactor p Q)
    (hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil) {c : GraphCycle G}
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hc : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.edges) :
    (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges =
      c.edges.filter fun e => bothEndsOutside e Q.support
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.omitRunComplement_edges hpre hclose
  simpa [OriginalSubwalkFactor.retainedClosedEdges,
    OriginalSubwalkFactor.closedEdges, hc] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_cycle_even_length_any
proof:
:= by
  have hL : w.getVert w.length = u := Walk.getVert_length w
  have hiff := aux_getVert_isBlock w w.length le_rfl
  by_cases hblock : ∃ i : ι, u = .inl i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hblock
    have : ∃ j, w.getVert w.length = .inl j := ⟨i, hL.trans hi⟩
    exact (hiff.mp this).mp ⟨i, hi⟩
  · have hend : ¬ ∃ j, w.getVert w.length = .inl j := by
      intro ⟨j, hj⟩
      exact hblock ⟨j, hL.symm.trans hj⟩
    have hneg := hiff.not.mp hend
    simpa [iff_false_left hblock, not_not] using hneg

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_cycle_four_le_any
proof:

  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := even_iff_exists_two_mul.mp he
  have : 2 ≤ m := by omega
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_getVert_odd_inr
proof:
:= by
  have hiff := aux_getVert_isBlock w n hn
  have hnot : ¬ ∃ j, w.getVert n = .inl j := by
    intro hex
    have heven : Even n := (hiff.mp hex).mp ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ho heven
  generalize hgv : w.getVert n = x at hnot ⊢
  cases x with
  | inl j => exact (hnot ⟨j, rfl⟩).elim
  | inr e => exact ⟨e, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_getVert_odd_inl_of_phys
proof:
:= by
  have hiff := aux_getVert_isBlock w n hn
  refine hiff.mpr ?_
  have hstart : ¬ ∃ j, (Sum.inr e : ι ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) P) = .inl j := by
    rintro ⟨j, h⟩
    cases h
  simpa [iff_false_left hstart] using (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ho)

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_getVert_even_inr_of_phys
proof:
:= by
  have hiff := aux_getVert_isBlock w n hn
  have hnot : ¬ ∃ j, w.getVert n = .inl j := by
    intro hex
    have hR : (∃ j, (Sum.inr e : ι ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) P) = .inl j) ↔ Even n :=
      hiff.mp hex
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hR.mpr he
    cases hj
  generalize hgv : w.getVert n = x at hnot ⊢
  cases x with
  | inl j => exact (hnot ⟨j, rfl⟩).elim
  | inr f => exact ⟨f, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pcSucc_ne
statement:
lemma pcSucc_ne {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (t : Fin k) :
    t ≠ pcSucc (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk) t
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv : t.1 = (t.1 + 1) % k := by
    simpa [pcSucc] using congrArg Fin.val h
  have ht : t.1 < k := t.2
  by_cases hlt : t.1 + 1 < k
  · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] at hv
    exact Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self t.1) hv
  · have hEq : t.1 + 1 = k := by omega
    have : (t.1 + 1) % k = 0 := by simp [hEq]
    have : k = 1 := by omega
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pcPred_succ
statement:
lemma pcPred_succ {k : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < k) (t : Fin k) :
    pcSucc hpos (pcPred hpos t) = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  by_cases ht0 : t.1 = 0
  · have hk1 : k - 1 < k := Nat.sub_lt hpos (by decide)
    have hpred : (0 + k - 1) % k = k - 1 := by
      have : 0 + k - 1 = k - 1 := by omega
      rw [this, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk1]
    change ((t.1 + k - 1) % k + 1) % k = t.1
    simp [ht0]
    have : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    simp [this]
  · have htlt : t.1 < k := t.2
    have hlt : t.1 - 1 < k := by omega
    have hrew : t.1 + k - 1 = t.1 - 1 + k := by omega
    have hpred : (t.1 + k - 1) % k = t.1 - 1 := by
      rw [hrew, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
    change ((t.1 + k - 1) % k + 1) % k = t.1
    rw [hpred]
    have : t.1 - 1 + 1 = t.1 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt htlt]

name: Nikoghosyan.pcSucc_pred
statement:
lemma pcSucc_pred {k : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < k) (t : Fin k) :
    pcPred hpos (pcSucc hpos t) = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  have ht : t.1 < k := t.2
  by_cases hlt : t.1 + 1 < k
  · have hmod : (t.1 + 1) % k = t.1 + 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
    change ((t.1 + 1) % k + k - 1) % k = t.1
    rw [hmod]
    have hrew : t.1 + 1 + k - 1 = t.1 + k := by omega
    rw [hrew, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ht]
  · have hEq : t.1 + 1 = k := by omega
    have hmod0 : (t.1 + 1) % k = 0 := by rw [hEq, Nat.mod_self]
    change ((t.1 + 1) % k + k - 1) % k = t.1
    rw [hmod0]
    have hrew : 0 + k - 1 = k - 1 := by omega
    have hk1 : k - 1 < k := Nat.sub_lt hpos (by decide)
    rw [hrew, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk1]
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pcPred_val_pos
statement:
lemma pcPred_val_pos {k : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < k) {t : Fin k} (ht : 0 < t.1) :
    (pcPred hpos t).1 = t.1 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : t.1 - 1 < k := by omega
  have hrew : t.1 + k - 1 = t.1 - 1 + k := by omega
  change (t.1 + k - 1) % k = t.1 - 1
  rw [hrew, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]

name: Nikoghosyan.pcPred_zero
statement:
lemma pcPred_zero {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    pcPred (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hk) ⟨0, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (0 + k - 1) % k = k - 1
  have hk1 : k - 1 < k := by omega
  have hrew : 0 + k - 1 = k - 1 := by omega
  rw [hrew, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk1]

name: Nikoghosyan.pcSucc_last

      ⟨0, by omega⟩
proof:

  ext
  simp [pcSucc]
  have : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega

      a ∈ J → b ∈ J → c ∈ J → d ∈ J → x ∈ J →

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile
statement:
lemma isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile {H R : Finset V} {v : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint H R) (hv : v ∈ R)
    (hOn : ∀ ⦃a b c d x : V⦄,
      a ∈ H ∪ R → b ∈ H ∪ R → c ∈ H ∪ R → d ∈ H ∪ R → x ∈ H ∪ R →
      InducedP4 G a b c d →
      x ≠ a → x ≠ b → x ≠ c → x ≠ d →
        G.Adj x a ∨ G.Adj x b ∨ G.Adj x c ∨ G.Adj x d) :
    IsCograph G (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have hA : a ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1
  have hB : b ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
  have hC : c ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hc).1
  have hD : d ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hd).1
  have nAdj {y : V} (hy : y ∈ H \ rowProfile (G := G) H v) : ¬ G.Adj v y := by
    have : y ∉ rowProfile (G := G) H v := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2
    intro hadj
    exact this ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨(mem_sdiff.1 hy).1, hadj⟩)
  have hvH : v ∉ H := disjoint_right.1 hdisj hv
  have hne {y : V} (hyH : y ∈ H) : v ≠ y := fun h => hvH (h ▸ hyH)
  have : ¬ (G.Adj v a ∨ G.Adj v b ∨ G.Adj v c ∨ G.Adj v d) := by
    simp [nAdj ha, nAdj hb, nAdj hc, nAdj hd]
  exact this <|
    hOn (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hA)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hB))
      (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hC)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hD))
      (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hv)) hp (hne hA) (hne hB) (hne hC) (hne hD)

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxS⟩ := hSne
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, _hadj⟩ := Cograph.exists_spanning_path_from c (hS hxS)
  have hE : Eligible G c.support x := by
    have hends := Cograph.Eligible_of_support_ends p hp
    simpa [hs] using hends.1
  have hpU : pathCoverNumber G c.support = 1 :=
    Cograph.pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p hp
  have hle := componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible (G := G) hS hxS hE
  have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hxS⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_of_traceable_extension
statement:
theorem oneToughOn_of_traceable_extension
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v)) :
    OneToughOn G (c.support ∪ r.support)
proof:
:= by
  intro ST hST h2
  set H := c.support
  set R := r.support
  set S := ST ∩ H
  set T := ST ∩ R
  have hS : S ⊆ H := inter_subset_right
  have hT : T ⊆ R := inter_subset_right
  have hcard : ST.card = S.card + T.card := card_cut_split hdisj hST
  have hrem : (H ∪ R) \ ST = (H \ S) ∪ (R \ T) := by
    nth_rw 1 [inter_union_eq_of_subset_union hST]
    exact union_sdiff_of_disjoint hdisj hS hT
  rw [hrem] at h2 ⊢
  have hpath : componentCount G (R \ T) ≤ T.card + 1 :=
    componentCount_path_sdiff_le r hT
  by_cases hSempty : S = ∅
  · have hHS : H \ S = H := by simp [hSempty]
    rw [hHS] at h2 ⊢
    have hH : componentCount G H = 1 := componentCount_cycle_eq_one c
    have hatt : ∀ w ∈ R \ T, ∃ u ∈ H, G.Adj w u := by
      intro w hw
      have hwR : w ∈ R := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hrow w hwR).1
      exact ⟨u, (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hu⟩
    have hle : componentCount G (H ∪ (R \ T)) ≤ 1 :=
      (componentCount_union_le_of_adj hatt).trans hH.le
    omega
  · have hSne : S.Nonempty := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hSempty
    have hcycle : componentCount G (H \ S) ≤ S.card :=
      componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le c hS hSne
    by_cases hSeq : S = H
    · have hHS : H \ S = ∅ := by simp [hSeq]
      have hrem' : (H \ S) ∪ (R \ T) = R \ T := by simp [hHS]
      have hScard : 3 ≤ S.card := by
        have h3 : 3 ≤ H.card := c.three_le_card_support
        simpa [hSeq] using h3
      rw [hrem'] at h2 ⊢
      omega
    · by_cases hstrict : componentCount G (H \ S) < S.card
      · have hunion := componentCount_union_le G (H \ S) (R \ T)
        omega
      · have heq : componentCount G (H \ S) = S.card := by omega
        have hatt : ∀ w ∈ R \ T, ∃ u ∈ H \ S, G.Adj w u := by
          intro w hw
          have hwR : w ∈ R := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
          obtain ⟨_, hnt⟩ := hrow w hwR
          have hnot : ¬ rowProfile (G := G) H w ⊆ S := hnt S hS heq
          obtain ⟨u, huA, huS⟩ := not_subset.1 hnot
          have huH : u ∈ H := ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 huA).1
          have hadj : G.Adj w u := ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 huA).2
          exact ⟨u, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨huH, huS⟩, hadj⟩
        have hle : componentCount G ((H \ S) ∪ (R \ T)) ≤
            componentCount G (H \ S) :=
          componentCount_union_le_of_adj hatt
        omega

name: Nikoghosyan.oneTough_induce_of_traceable_extension
statement:
theorem oneTough_induce_of_traceable_extension
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support)
    (hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v)) :
    OneTough (G.induce ((c.support ∪ r.support : Finset V) : Set V))
proof:
:=
  (OneToughOn_iff_OneTough_induce (c.support ∪ r.support)).1
    (oneToughOn_of_traceable_extension c r hdisj hrow)

name: Nikoghosyan.noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover
statement:
theorem noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G) {v : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support) (hv : v ∈ r.support)
    (hAne : (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty)
    (hJ : ∀ ⦃a b c' d x : V⦄,
      a ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
        b ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
          c' ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
            d ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
              x ∈ c.support ∪ r.support →
      InducedP4 G a b c' d →
      x ≠ a → x ≠ b → x ≠ c' → x ≠ d →
        G.Adj x a ∨ G.Adj x b ∨ G.Adj x c' ∨ G.Adj x d) :
    NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v) ↔
      pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support v) <
        (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).card
proof:
:= by
  set H := c.support
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) c.support v
  have hAsub : A ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H v
  have hK : IsCograph G (H \ A) :=
    isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile (H := H) (R := r.support) hdisj hv hJ
  have hiff :=
    Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_of_canonical (G := G) c rfl hAsub hAne hK
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) ≤ A.card :=
    Cograph.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_card_of_cycle c rfl hAsub hAne
  constructor
  · intro hnt
    have hnotSat : ¬ Cograph.Saturated (G := G) H A := by
      intro hSat
      exact hnt.not_exists (hiff.2 hSat)
    have hne : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) ≠ A.card := by
      intro h
      exact hnotSat h
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
  · intro hlt S hS heq hAS
    have hSat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) H A :=
      hiff.1 ⟨S, ⟨hS, heq⟩, hAS⟩
    have heq' : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card := hSat
    have hlt' : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) < A.card := hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl _ (heq' ▸ hlt'))

name: Nikoghosyan.noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover_of_host
statement:
theorem noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover_of_host
    (c : GraphCycle G) (r : GraphPath G) {v : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint c.support r.support) (hv : v ∈ r.support)
    (hAne : (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).Nonempty)
    (hG : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    NoTightContainer G c.support (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v) ↔
      pathCoverNumber G (c.support \ rowProfile (G := G) c.support v) <
        (rowProfile (G := G) c.support v).card
proof:
:=
  noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover c r hdisj hv hAne
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp hxa hxb hxc hxd => hG hp hxa hxb hxc hxd)

  intro e he

  have ha : a ∈ p.support := GraphPath.mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp)
  have hb : b ∈ p.support := GraphPath.mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp)

name: Nikoghosyan.cycle_edges_subset_suppressInternal_of_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun a b he => ?_) he
  have ha : a ∈ c.support := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.support] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2
        (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 he) (by simp))
  have hb : b ∈ c.support := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.support] using
      List.mem_toFinset.2
        (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 he) (by simp))
  have ha' : a ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hd ha
  have hb' : b ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hd hb
  have hadj : G.Adj a b := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using
      c.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 he)
  exact mem_edgeSet_suppressInternal G hadj ha' hb'
