name: Nikoghosyan.IsCograph_suppressInternal
statement:
theorem IsCograph_suppressInternal {U A' : Finset V} (hU : Disjoint U A') :
    IsCograph (suppressInternal G A') U ↔ IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    have ha' : a ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU ha
    have hb' : b ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU hb
    have hc' : c ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU hc
    have hd' : d ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU hd
    exact h ha hb hc hd ((InducedP4_suppressInternal G ha' hb' hc' hd').2 hp)
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    have ha' : a ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU ha
    have hb' : b ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU hb
    have hc' : c ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU hc
    have hd' : d ∉ A' := disjoint_left.1 hU hd
    exact h ha hb hc hd ((InducedP4_suppressInternal G ha' hb' hc' hd').1 hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one
statement:
lemma hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one (F : CycleFactor G) (hF : F.card = 1) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  cases hcs : F.cycles with
  | nil =>
    simp [CycleFactor.card, hcs] at hF
  | cons c rest =>
    have hrest : rest = [] := by
      simp [CycleFactor.card, hcs] at hF
      cases rest with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons _ _ => simp at hF
    subst hrest
    refine ⟨c, eq_univ_of_forall ?_⟩
    intro x
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hx⟩ := F.mem_iff x
    have : d = c := by
      have : d ∈ ([c] : List (GraphCycle G)) := by simpa [hcs] using hd
      simpa using this
    simpa [this] using hx

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_support_iff_index
statement:
lemma mem_support_iff_index (F : CycleFactor G) {i : Fin F.card} {x : V} :
    x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support ↔ F.partition.index x = i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact F.partition.index_eq (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using hx)
  · intro hx
    have hmem := F.partition.mem_index x
    rw [hx] at hmem
    simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using hmem

name: Nikoghosyan.otherIndex_ne
statement: lemma otherIndex_ne {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) : i ≠ otherIndex i h2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hval : i.1 = (otherIndex i h2).1 := congrArg Fin.val h
  by_cases hi0 : i.1 = 0 <;> simp [otherIndex, hi0] at hval

name: Nikoghosyan.outside_nonempty_of_two_le_card
statement:
lemma outside_nonempty_of_two_le_card (F : CycleFactor G) {i : Fin F.card}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ F.card) : (univ \ (F.getCycle i).support).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let j := otherIndex i h2
  have hij : i ≠ j := otherIndex_ne i h2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (F.getCycle j).support_nonempty
  have hxj : F.partition.index x = j := (mem_support_iff_index F).1 hx
  refine ⟨x, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ x, ?_⟩⟩
  intro hxH
  have hxi : F.partition.index x = i := (mem_support_iff_index F).1 hxH
  exact hij (hxi.symm.trans hxj)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_boundary_of_walk
statement:
lemma exists_boundary_of_walk (F : CycleFactor G) {i : Fin F.card} :
    ∀ {x a : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) (ha : F.partition.index a = i)
      (w : G.Walk x a),
      ∃ y b, ∃ hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i,
        F.partition.index b = i ∧ G.Adj y b ∧
          (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
proof:
| _, _, hx, ha, Walk.nil => (hx ha).elim
  | x, a, hx, ha, Walk.cons (v := v) hadj p => by
    by_cases hv : F.partition.index v = i
    · exact ⟨x, v, hx, hv, hadj, Reachable.rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, b, hy, hb, hadjyb, hreach⟩ :=
        exists_boundary_of_walk (F := F) (i := i) hv ha p
      refine ⟨y, b, hy, hb, hadjyb, ?_⟩
      have hadjI :
          (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Adj ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩ := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.induce_adj] using hadj
      exact hadjI.reachable.trans hreach

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_attachment_of_connected
statement:
lemma exists_attachment_of_connected (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {i : Fin F.card} {x : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) :
    ∃ y a, ∃ hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i,
      a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support ∧ G.Adj y a ∧
        (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  have hconn : G.Connected := hT.connected
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (F.getCycle i).support_nonempty
  have hai : F.partition.index a = i := (mem_support_iff_index F).1 ha
  have hR : G.Reachable x a := hconn.1 x a
  obtain ⟨w⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨y, b, hy, hb, hadj, hreach⟩ := exists_boundary_of_walk F hx hai w
  exact ⟨y, b, hy, (mem_support_iff_index F).2 hb, hadj, hreach⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_comp_attachment
statement:
lemma exists_comp_attachment (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {i : Fin F.card} {x : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) :
    ∃ a, CompAttaches F i x hx a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, a, hy, ha, hadj, hreach⟩ :=
    exists_attachment_of_connected (F := F) hT hord hx
  exact ⟨a, ha, y, hy, hadj, hreach⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.comp_attachment_port_eq
statement:
lemma comp_attachment_port_eq (F : CycleFactor G)
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    {x : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) {a b : V}
    (ha : CompAttaches F i x hx a) (hb : CompAttaches F i x hx b) :
    factorPort F a = factorPort F b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨haH, y, hy, hya, hxy⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨hbH, z, hz, hzb, hxz⟩ := hb
  have hai : F.partition.index a = i := (mem_support_iff_index F).1 haH
  have hbi : F.partition.index b = i := (mem_support_iff_index F).1 hbH
  have hyz :
      (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨y, hy⟩ ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
    hxy.symm.trans hxz
  exact attachment_factorPort_eq (F := F) hsplit hy hz hai hbi hya hzb hyz

name: Nikoghosyan.usedPort_eq_of_attachment
statement:
lemma usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    {x : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) {a : V}
    (ha : CompAttaches F i x hx a) :
    usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = factorPort F a
proof:
:=
  comp_attachment_port_eq (F := F) hsplit hx
    (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx).2 ha

name: Nikoghosyan.usedPort_eq_of_reachable
statement:
lemma usedPort_eq_of_reachable (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    {x y : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) (hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i)
    (hR : (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy
proof:
:= by
  let a := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hy).1
  have ha : CompAttaches F i y hy a := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hy).2
  have ha' : CompAttaches F i x hx a := by
    obtain ⟨haH, z, hz, hadj, hzy⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨haH, z, hz, hadj, hR.trans hzy⟩
  have h1 := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hx ha'
  have h2 := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hy ha
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.two_le_usedPort
statement:
lemma two_le_usedPort (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    {x : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) :
    2 ≤ (usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx).card
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  have hcard : (usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx).card ≤ 1 := Nat.not_lt.1 (mt Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hlt)
  let a := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx).1
  have ha : CompAttaches F i x hx a := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx).2
  have haP : a ∈ usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx := by
    have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = factorPort F a := rfl
    simpa [this] using factorPort_mem_self (F := F) (x := a)
  have hpos : 1 ≤ (usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx).card :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (card_pos.mpr ⟨a, haP⟩)
  have h1 : (usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx).card = 1 := le_antisymm hcard hpos
  obtain ⟨p, hpEq⟩ := card_eq_one.1 h1
  have hp : p ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := by
    have hpP : p ∈ usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx := by simp [hpEq]
    have hsub : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx ⊆ (F.getCycle i).support := by
      have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = factorPort F a := rfl
      simpa [this] using factorPort_subset_block F ha.1
    exact hsub hpP
  refine not_component_singleton_attachment (F := F) hT hp hx ?_
  intro y b hy hbH hadj hreach
  have hbAtt : CompAttaches F i x hx b := ⟨hbH, y, hy, hadj, hreach⟩
  have hport := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hx hbAtt
  have hbP : b ∈ usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx := by
    have : b ∈ factorPort F b := factorPort_mem_self (F := F) (x := b)
    simpa [hport] using this
  have : b ∈ ({p} : Finset V) := by simpa [hpEq] using hbP
  exact mem_singleton.1 this

name: Nikoghosyan.not_all_usedPorts_eq
statement:
lemma not_all_usedPorts_eq (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    (h2 : 2 ≤ F.card) :
    ∃ (x y : V) (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) (hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i),
      usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx ≠ usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0s⟩ := outside_nonempty_of_two_le_card F (i := i) h2
  have hOutside : (univ \ (F.getCycle i).support).Nonempty := ⟨x0, hx0s⟩
  have hx0 : F.partition.index x0 ≠ i := by
    intro h
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hx0s).2 ((mem_support_iff_index F).2 h)
  by_contra hsame
  have hsame' :
      ∀ (x y : V) (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) (hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i),
        usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy := by
    intro x y hx hy
    by_contra hne
    exact hsame ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hne⟩
  let a := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx0).1
  have ha : CompAttaches F i x0 hx0 a := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx0).2
  have haH : a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := ha.1
  refine original_common_port_cut (F := F) hT hcog haH hOutside ?_
  intro z b hbH hzW hadj
  have hz : F.partition.index z ≠ i := by
    intro h
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hzW).2 ((mem_support_iff_index F).2 h)
  have hbAtt : CompAttaches F i z hz b := ⟨hbH, z, hz, hadj, Reachable.rfl⟩
  have hportz := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hz hbAtt
  have hports := hsame' z x0 hz hx0
  have hport0 : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx0 = factorPort F a := rfl
  have : factorPort F b = factorPort F a :=
    hportz.symm.trans (hports.trans hport0)
  have hbP : b ∈ factorPort F b := factorPort_mem_self (F := F) (x := b)
  simpa [this] using hbP

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_adjacent_pred
statement:
lemma exists_adjacent_pred {S : Set V} {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (P : V → Prop)
    (hPx : P x) (hnPy : ¬ P y)
    (w : (G.induce S).Walk ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    ∃ u v, ∃ hu : u ∈ S, ∃ hv : v ∈ S,
      P u ∧ ¬ P v ∧ G.Adj u v ∧
        (G.induce S).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨u, hu⟩ ∧
          (G.induce S).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : ℕ → Prop := fun n => n ≤ w.length ∧ ¬ P (w.getVert n).1
  have hQ : ∃ n, Q n :=
    ⟨w.length, le_rfl, by simpa [Walk.getVert_length] using hnPy⟩
  let n := Nat.find hQ
  have hn : Q n := Nat.find_spec hQ
  have npos : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hle
    have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hle
    have : ¬ P (w.getVert 0).1 := by
      simpa [hn0, Walk.getVert_zero] using hn.2
    exact this (by simpa [Walk.getVert_zero] using hPx)
  have hn1_lt : n - 1 < n := Nat.sub_lt npos (by decide)
  have hnot : ¬ Q (n - 1) := Nat.find_min hQ hn1_lt
  have hn1_le : n - 1 ≤ w.length :=
    le_trans (Nat.sub_le n 1) hn.1
  have hPn1 : P (w.getVert (n - 1)).1 := by
    have : ¬ ((n - 1) ≤ w.length ∧ ¬ P (w.getVert (n - 1)).1) := hnot
    have : n - 1 ≤ w.length → P (w.getVert (n - 1)).1 := by
      intro hle
      by_contra hnP
      exact this ⟨hle, hnP⟩
    exact this hn1_le
  have hn1_len : n - 1 < w.length := by omega
  have hadj := w.adj_getVert_succ hn1_len
  have hsucc : n - 1 + 1 = n := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos npos
  have hadjG : G.Adj (w.getVert (n - 1)).1 (w.getVert (n - 1 + 1)).1 := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.induce_adj] using hadj
  refine ⟨(w.getVert (n - 1)).1, (w.getVert n).1,
    (w.getVert (n - 1)).property, (w.getVert n).property,
    hPn1, hn.2, ?_, ⟨w.take (n - 1)⟩, ⟨w.take n⟩⟩
  simpa [hsucc] using hadjG

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_of_isolated
statement:
lemma isCograph_of_isolated (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {U : Finset V} {w : V} (hw : w ∉ U)
    (hanti : ∀ x ∈ U, ¬ G.Adj w x) : IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have hwa : w ≠ a := fun h => hw (h ▸ ha)
  have hwb : w ≠ b := fun h => hw (h ▸ hb)
  have hwc : w ≠ c := fun h => hw (h ▸ hc)
  have hwd : w ≠ d := fun h => hw (h ▸ hd)
  have hmeet := hpat hp hwa hwb hwc hwd
  rcases hmeet with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
  · exact hanti a ha h1
  · exact hanti b hb h2
  · exact hanti c hc h3
  · exact hanti d hd h4

name: Nikoghosyan.inducedP4_a0_b_a1_u
statement:
lemma inducedP4_a0_b_a1_u
    {A B U : Finset V} {a0 b a1 u : V}
    (hdisjAU : Disjoint A U) (hdisjBU : Disjoint B U)
    (hAind : Independent (G := G) A)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hUantiB : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj u b)
    (ha0 : a0 ∈ A) (ha1 : a1 ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hu : u ∈ U)
    (h0 : ¬ G.Adj u a0) (h1 : G.Adj u a1) :
    InducedP4 G a0 b a1 u
proof:
:= by
  have hABdisj : Disjoint A B := disjoint_of_completeBetween (G := G) hAB
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hAB ha0 hb, (hAB ha1 hb).symm, h1.symm,
    hAind ha0 ha1, fun h => h0 h.symm, fun h => hUantiB u hu b hb h.symm⟩
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hABdisj ha0 (h ▸ hb)).elim
  · exact fun h => h0 (by simpa [h] using h1)
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAU ha0 (h ▸ hu)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hABdisj ha1 (h.symm ▸ hb)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjBU hb (h ▸ hu)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAU ha1 (h ▸ hu)).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.inducedP4_b_a_u1_u0
statement:
lemma inducedP4_b_a_u1_u0
    {A B U : Finset V} {b a u1 u0 : V}
    (hdisjAU : Disjoint A U) (hdisjBU : Disjoint B U)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hUantiB : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj u b)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hu1 : u1 ∈ U) (hu0 : u0 ∈ U)
    (hcomplete : G.Adj u1 a) (hanti : ¬ G.Adj u0 a) (hadj : G.Adj u1 u0) :
    InducedP4 G b a u1 u0
proof:
:= by
  have hABdisj : Disjoint A B := disjoint_of_completeBetween (G := G) hAB
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, (hAB ha hb).symm, hcomplete.symm, hadj,
    fun h => hUantiB u1 hu1 b hb h.symm, fun h => hUantiB u0 hu0 b hb h.symm,
    fun h => hanti h.symm⟩
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hABdisj ha (h.symm ▸ hb)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjBU hb (h ▸ hu1)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjBU hb (h ▸ hu0)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAU ha (h ▸ hu1)).elim
  · exact fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAU ha (h ▸ hu0)).elim
  · exact fun h => hanti (by simpa [h] using hcomplete)

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_b_of_isolated_W
statement:
lemma adj_b_of_isolated_W
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {A B U W : Finset V} {a0 b a1 u w : V}
    (hdisjAW : Disjoint A W) (hdisjBW : Disjoint B W) (hdisjUW : Disjoint U W)
    (hWantiA : ∀ w ∈ W, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj w a)
    (hUantiW : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj u w)
    (ha0 : a0 ∈ A) (ha1 : a1 ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hu : u ∈ U) (hw : w ∈ W)
    (hp4 : InducedP4 G a0 b a1 u) : G.Adj w b
proof:
:= by
  have hwA0 : w ≠ a0 := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAW ha0 (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hwB : w ≠ b := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjBW hb (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hwA1 : w ≠ a1 := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAW ha1 (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hwU : w ≠ u := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjUW hu (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hmeet := hpat hp4 hwA0 hwB hwA1 hwU
  have nA0 : ¬ G.Adj w a0 := hWantiA w hw a0 ha0
  have nA1 : ¬ G.Adj w a1 := hWantiA w hw a1 ha1
  have nU : ¬ G.Adj w u := fun h => hUantiW u hu w hw h.symm
  rcases hmeet with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
  · exact (nA0 h1).elim
  · exact h2
  · exact (nA1 h3).elim
  · exact (nU h4).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_b_of_isolated_W_path
statement:
lemma adj_b_of_isolated_W_path
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {A B U W : Finset V} {b a u1 u0 w : V}
    (hdisjAW : Disjoint A W) (hdisjBW : Disjoint B W) (hdisjUW : Disjoint U W)
    (hWantiA : ∀ w ∈ W, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj w a)
    (hUantiW : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj u w)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hu1 : u1 ∈ U) (hu0 : u0 ∈ U) (hw : w ∈ W)
    (hp4 : InducedP4 G b a u1 u0) : G.Adj w b
proof:
:= by
  have hwB : w ≠ b := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjBW hb (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hwA : w ≠ a := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAW ha (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hw1 : w ≠ u1 := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjUW hu1 (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hw0 : w ≠ u0 := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisjUW hu0 (h ▸ hw)).elim
  have hmeet := hpat hp4 hwB hwA hw1 hw0
  have nA : ¬ G.Adj w a := hWantiA w hw a ha
  have n1 : ¬ G.Adj w u1 := fun h => hUantiW u1 hu1 w hw h.symm
  have n0 : ¬ G.Adj w u0 := fun h => hUantiW u0 hu0 w hw h.symm
  rcases hmeet with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
  · exact h1
  · exact (nA h2).elim
  · exact (n1 h3).elim
  · exact (n0 h4).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_allCographSides_of_two_le_card
statement:
lemma exists_allCographSides_of_two_le_card
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ F.card) : Nonempty (AllCographSides G)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  obtain ⟨i, hsplit⟩ := exists_block_splitter_of_min_cograph (F := F) hmin hcog hT hord
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy⟩ :=
    not_all_usedPorts_eq (F := F) hT hord hcog hsplit h2
  have hx2 := two_le_usedPort (F := F) hT hord hsplit hx
  have hy2 := two_le_usedPort (F := F) hT hord hsplit hy
  let ax := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx).1
  let ay := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hy).1
  have hax : CompAttaches F i x hx ax := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hx).2
  have hay : CompAttaches F i y hy ay := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hy).2
  have haxH : ax ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := hax.1
  have hayH : ay ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := hay.1
  have hportx : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = factorPort F ax := rfl
  have hporty : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy = factorPort F ay := rfl
  have hPx : factorPort F ax =
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ax :=
    factorPort_eq_of_mem F haxH
  have hPy : factorPort F ay =
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ay :=
    factorPort_eq_of_mem F hayH
  have hneClass :
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ax ≠
        Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ay := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    simp [hportx, hporty, hPx, hPy, h]
  have hPx2 : 2 ≤ (Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ax).card := by
    simpa [hportx, hPx] using hx2
  have hPy2 : 2 ≤ (Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ay).card := by
    simpa [hporty, hPy] using hy2
  obtain ⟨A, B, hunion, hdisjAB, hcardAB, hm, hnoA, hnoB, hAB, hAeq, hBeq, hall⟩ :=
    Cograph.large_port_classification (Cograph.isCograph_iff.2 (hcog i))
      (F.getCycle i) rfl haxH hayH
      hPx2 hPy2 hneClass
  have hAH : A ⊆ (F.getCycle i).support := by
    intro z hz
    have : z ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz)
    simpa [hunion] using this
  have hBH : B ⊆ (F.getCycle i).support := by
    intro z hz
    have : z ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hz)
    simpa [hunion] using this
  have husedx : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = A := by
    simp [hportx, hPx, hAeq]
  have husedy : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy = B := by
    simp [hporty, hPy, hBeq]
  have hport_or (z : V) (hz : F.partition.index z ≠ i) :
      usedPort (F := F) hT hord hz = A ∨ usedPort (F := F) hT hord hz = B := by
    let az := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hz).1
    have haz : CompAttaches F i z hz az := (usedPort_aux (F := F) hT hord hz).2
    have hazH : az ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := haz.1
    have hPaz : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hz =
        Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support az := by
      have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hz = factorPort F az := rfl
      simpa [this] using factorPort_eq_of_mem F hazH
    rcases hall az hazH with hA | hB
    · exact Or.inl (hPaz.trans hA)
    · exact Or.inr (hPaz.trans hB)
  let U : Finset V := univ.filter fun z =>
    ∃ hz : F.partition.index z ≠ i, usedPort (F := F) hT hord hz = A
  let W : Finset V := univ.filter fun z =>
    ∃ hz : F.partition.index z ≠ i, usedPort (F := F) hT hord hz = B
  have hxU : x ∈ U := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ x, ⟨hx, husedx⟩⟩
  have hyW : y ∈ W := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ y, ⟨hy, husedy⟩⟩
  have hUne : U.Nonempty := ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have hWne : W.Nonempty := ⟨y, hyW⟩
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hm)
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
    have : 2 ≤ B.card := by simpa [hcardAB] using hm
    exact card_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) this)
  have hUout : U ⊆ univ \ (F.getCycle i).support := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzidx, _⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hz).2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ z, fun hH => hzidx ((mem_support_iff_index F).1 hH)⟩
  have hWout : W ⊆ univ \ (F.getCycle i).support := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzidx, _⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hz).2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ z, fun hH => hzidx ((mem_support_iff_index F).1 hH)⟩
  have hdisjAU : Disjoint A U := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzA hzU
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hUout hzU)).2 (hAH hzA)
  have hdisjBU : Disjoint B U := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzB hzU
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hUout hzU)).2 (hBH hzB)
  have hdisjAW : Disjoint A W := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzA hzW
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hWout hzW)).2 (hAH hzA)
  have hdisjBW : Disjoint B W := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzB hzW
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hWout hzW)).2 (hBH hzB)
  have hdisjUW : Disjoint U W := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzU hzW
    obtain ⟨hzi, hzA⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hzU).2
    obtain ⟨hzi', hzB⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hzW).2
    have hAB : A = B := by
      have hirr := Subsingleton.elim hzi hzi'
      subst hirr
      exact hzA.symm.trans hzB
    have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy := by
      simp [husedx, husedy, hAB]
    exact hxy this
  have hUantiB : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj u b := by
    intro u hu b hb hadj
    obtain ⟨hui, huA⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hu).2
    have hbH : b ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := hBH hb
    have hbAtt : CompAttaches F i u hui b := ⟨hbH, u, hui, hadj, Reachable.rfl⟩
    have hport := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hui hbAtt
    have hbB : Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support b = B := by
      have hbBmem : b ∈ Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ay := by
        simpa [hBeq] using hb
      exact ((factor_block_balanced F hcog i).2.2 hayH hbH).2 hbBmem |>.symm.trans hBeq
    have : A = B := by
      have hPb : factorPort F b =
          Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support b :=
        factorPort_eq_of_mem F hbH
      calc
        A = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hui := huA.symm
        _ = factorPort F b := hport
        _ = Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support b := hPb
        _ = B := hbB
    have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy := by
      simp [husedx, husedy, this]
    exact hxy this
  have hWantiA : ∀ w ∈ W, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj w a := by
    intro w hw a ha hadj
    obtain ⟨hwi, hwB⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hw).2
    have haH : a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := hAH ha
    have haAtt : CompAttaches F i w hwi a := ⟨haH, w, hwi, hadj, Reachable.rfl⟩
    have hport := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hwi haAtt
    have haA : Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support a = A := by
      have hamem : a ∈ Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support ax := by
        simpa [hAeq] using ha
      exact ((factor_block_balanced F hcog i).2.2 haxH haH).2 hamem |>.symm.trans hAeq
    have hEq : B = A := by
      have hPa : factorPort F a =
          Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support a :=
        factorPort_eq_of_mem F haH
      calc
        B = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hwi := hwB.symm
        _ = factorPort F a := hport
        _ = Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support a := hPa
        _ = A := haA
    have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy := by
      simp [husedx, husedy, hEq.symm]
    exact hxy this
  have hUantiW : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj u w := by
    intro u hu w hw hadj
    obtain ⟨hui, huA⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hu).2
    obtain ⟨hwi, hwB⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hw).2
    have hadjI :
        (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Adj ⟨u, hui⟩ ⟨w, hwi⟩ := by
      simpa [SimpleGraph.induce_adj] using hadj
    have hports :=
      usedPort_eq_of_reachable (F := F) hT hord hsplit hui hwi hadjI.reachable
    have : A = B := huA.symm.trans (hports.trans hwB)
    have : usedPort (F := F) hT hord hx = usedPort (F := F) hT hord hy := by
      simp [husedx, husedy, this]
    exact hxy this
  have hAind : Independent (G := G) A := fun x y hx hy => hnoA x hx y hy
  have hBind : Independent (G := G) B := fun x y hx hy => hnoB x hx y hy
  have hcover : A ∪ B ∪ U ∪ W = univ := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro _hz
      exact mem_univ z
    · intro _hz
      by_cases hzi : F.partition.index z = i
      · have hzH : z ∈ (F.getCycle i).support := (mem_support_iff_index F).2 hzi
        have : z ∈ A ∪ B := by simpa [hunion] using hzH
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hA)))))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hB)))))
      · rcases hport_or z hzi with hA | hB
        · have : z ∈ U := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ z, ⟨hzi, hA⟩⟩
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr this)))
        · have : z ∈ W := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ z, ⟨hzi, hB⟩⟩
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr this)
  have hy_not_AU : y ∉ A ∪ U := by
    intro hy'
    rcases mem_union.1 hy' with hA | hU
    · exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hWout hyW)).2 (hAH hA)
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjUW hU hyW
  have hAUcog : IsCograph G (A ∪ U) :=
    isCograph_of_isolated hpat hy_not_AU (by
      intro t ht
      rcases mem_union.1 ht with hA | hU
      · exact hWantiA y hyW t hA
      · exact fun hadj => hUantiW t hU y hyW hadj.symm)
  have hx_not_BW : x ∉ B ∪ W := by
    intro hx'
    rcases mem_union.1 hx' with hB | hW
    · exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hUout hxU)).2 (hBH hB)
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjUW hxU hW
  have hBWcog : IsCograph G (B ∪ W) :=
    isCograph_of_isolated hpat hx_not_BW (by
      intro t ht
      rcases mem_union.1 ht with hB | hW
      · exact hUantiB x hxU t hB
      · exact fun hadj => hUantiW x hxU t hW hadj)
  have hUcog : IsCograph G U :=
    IsCograph.subset (G := G) hAUcog subset_union_right
  have hWcog : IsCograph G W :=
    IsCograph.subset (G := G) hBWcog subset_union_right
  have hcomplete :
      G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (U : Set V) ∨
        G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (W : Set V) := by
    by_cases hAU : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (U : Set V)
    · exact Or.inl hAU
    · right
      intro b hb w hw
      have hex : ∃ u ∈ U, ∃ a0 ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj u a0 := by
        by_contra hnone
        apply hAU
        intro a ha u hu
        by_contra hn
        exact hnone ⟨u, hu, a, ha, fun h => hn h.symm⟩
      obtain ⟨u0, hu0, a0, ha0, h0⟩ := hex
      by_cases hmix : ∃ u ∈ U, ∃ a1 ∈ A, G.Adj u a1 ∧ ∃ a0' ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj u a0'
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, a1, ha1, h1, a0', ha0', h0'⟩ := hmix
        have hp4 :=
          inducedP4_a0_b_a1_u hdisjAU hdisjBU hAind hAB hUantiB
            ha0' ha1 hb hu h0' h1
        exact (adj_b_of_isolated_W hpat hdisjAW hdisjBW hdisjUW hWantiA hUantiW
          ha0' ha1 hb hu hw hp4).symm
      · have hdich : ∀ u ∈ U, (∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj u a) ∨ (∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj u a) := by
          intro u hu
          by_cases hc : ∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj u a
          · exact Or.inl hc
          · right
            intro a ha hadj
            apply hmix
            refine ⟨u, hu, a, ha, hadj, ?_⟩
            by_contra hall
            exact hc fun a' ha' => by
              by_contra hn
              exact hall ⟨a', ha', hn⟩
        have hanti0 : ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj u0 a := by
          rcases hdich u0 hu0 with hc | ha
          · exact (h0 (hc a0 ha0)).elim
          · exact ha
        obtain ⟨hui0, hu0A⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hu0).2
        obtain ⟨a1, haAtt⟩ := exists_comp_attachment (F := F) hT hord hui0
        have hport := usedPort_eq_of_attachment (F := F) hT hord hsplit hui0 haAtt
        obtain ⟨ha1H, u1, hu1i, hadj1, hreach1⟩ := haAtt
        have hfa : factorPort F a1 = A := hport.symm.trans hu0A
        have ha1A : a1 ∈ A := by
          have : a1 ∈ factorPort F a1 := factorPort_mem_self (F := F) (x := a1)
          simpa [hfa] using this
        have hu1U : u1 ∈ U :=
          mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ u1,
            ⟨hu1i, (usedPort_eq_of_reachable (F := F) hT hord hsplit hui0 hu1i
              hreach1).symm.trans hu0A⟩⟩
        have hu1comp : ∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj u1 a := by
          rcases hdich u1 hu1U with hc | ha
          · exact hc
          · exact (ha a1 ha1A hadj1).elim
        obtain ⟨wInd⟩ := hreach1.symm
        have hncomp0 : ¬ ∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj u0 a := fun hc => h0 (hc a0 ha0)
        obtain ⟨p, q, hpS, hqS, hP, hnP, hadjpq, hRp, hRq⟩ :=
          exists_adjacent_pred (S := {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i})
            hu1i hui0 (fun z => ∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj z a) hu1comp hncomp0 wInd
        have hpU : p ∈ U :=
          mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ p, ⟨hpS,
            (usedPort_eq_of_reachable (F := F) hT hord hsplit hu1i hpS hRp).symm.trans
              (mem_filter.1 hu1U).2.2⟩⟩
        have hqU : q ∈ U :=
          mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ q, ⟨hqS,
            (usedPort_eq_of_reachable (F := F) hT hord hsplit hu1i hqS hRq).symm.trans
              (mem_filter.1 hu1U).2.2⟩⟩
        have hantiq : ¬ G.Adj q a1 := by
          have : ¬ ∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj q a := hnP
          rcases hdich q hqU with hc | ha
          · exact (this hc).elim
          · exact ha a1 ha1A
        have hp4 :=
          inducedP4_b_a_u1_u0 hdisjAU hdisjBU hAB hUantiB ha1A hb hpU hqU
            (hP a1 ha1A) hantiq hadjpq
        exact (adj_b_of_isolated_W_path hpat hdisjAW hdisjBW hdisjUW hWantiA
          hUantiW ha1A hb hpU hqU hw hp4).symm
  rcases hcomplete with hAU | hBW
  · exact ⟨{
      A := A, B := B, U := U, W := W, m := A.card
      hAind := hAind, hBind := hBind
      hAcard := rfl, hBcard := hcardAB.symm, hm := hm
      hAB := hAB, hAU := hAU
      hUantiB := hUantiB, hUantiW := hUantiW, hWantiA := hWantiA
      hUne := hUne, hWne := hWne
      hUcog := hUcog, hKcog := hBWcog
      hdisjAU := hdisjAU, hdisjAW := hdisjAW
      hdisjBU := hdisjBU, hdisjBW := hdisjBW, hdisjUW := hdisjUW
      hcover := hcover }⟩
  · exact ⟨{
      A := B, B := A, U := W, W := U, m := B.card
      hAind := hBind, hBind := hAind
      hAcard := rfl
      hBcard := by simpa [hcardAB]
      hm := by simpa [hcardAB] using hm
      hAB := fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
      hAU := hBW
      hUantiB := fun w hw a ha => hWantiA w hw a ha
      hUantiW := fun w hw u hu => fun h => hUantiW u hu w hw h.symm
      hWantiA := fun u hu b hb => hUantiB u hu b hb
      hUne := hWne, hWne := hUne
      hUcog := hWcog, hKcog := hAUcog
      hdisjAU := hdisjBW, hdisjAW := hdisjBU
      hdisjBU := hdisjAW, hdisjBW := hdisjAU
      hdisjUW := hdisjUW.symm
      hcover := by
        simpa [union_comm, union_left_comm, union_assoc] using hcover }⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.min_all_cograph_hamiltonian_or_sides
statement:
lemma min_all_cograph_hamiltonian_or_sides
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    (∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ) ∨ Nonempty (AllCographSides G)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  by_cases h1 : F.card = 1
  · exact Or.inl (hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one F h1)
  · have h2 : 2 ≤ F.card := by
      haveI : Nonempty (Fin F.card) := BlockPartition.nonempty_index F.partition
      have hpos : 0 < F.card := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mpr ‹Nonempty (Fin F.card)›
      omega
    exact Or.inr
      (exists_allCographSides_of_two_le_card hT hord hpat F hmin hcog h2)

name: Nikoghosyan.two_le_card_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma two_le_card_of_mem_ne {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    2 ≤ pc.card
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : q ∈ pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p) :=
    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, decide_eq_true hne.symm⟩
  have hpos : 0 < (pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p)).length :=
    List.length_pos_of_mem hq'
  have hlen := length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := p) (l := pc.paths) hp pc.nodup_paths
  simp [PathCover.card]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.replaceTwo_card
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := length_filter_ne_two (a := p) (b := q) hp hq hne pc.nodup_paths
  have h2 : 2 ≤ pc.paths.length := by
    simpa [PathCover.card] using two_le_card_of_mem_ne pc hp hq hne
  simp only [replaceTwo, PathCover.card, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
    List.length_nil]
  rw [hlen]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.not_adj_distinct_cover_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  let p' := p.faceToFinish hx
  let q' := q.faceToStart hy
  have hp's : p'.support = p.support := p.faceToFinish_support hx
  have hq's : q'.support = q.support := q.faceToStart_support hy
  have hdisjpq : Disjoint p.support q.support :=
    pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne
  have hdisj' : Disjoint p'.support q'.support := by
    simpa [hp's, hq's] using hdisjpq
  have hadj' : G.Adj p'.finish q'.start := by
    rw [p.faceToFinish_finish hx, q.faceToStart_start hy]
    exact hadj
  let r := p'.splice q' hadj' hdisj'
  have hr : r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∪ (∅ : Finset V) := by
    simp [r, GraphPath.support_splice, hp's, hq's]
  have hdisjE : Disjoint U (∅ : Finset V) := disjoint_empty_right _
  let pc' := pc.replaceTwo hdisjE hp hq hne hr
  have hcard : pc'.card = pc.card - 1 :=
    pc.replaceTwo_card hdisjE hp hq hne hr
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G U ≤ pc'.card := by
    have hUW : U ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = U := union_empty U
    exact (pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (pc'.cast hUW)).trans_eq
      (by simp [PathCover.cast_card, hcard])
  have hpos := two_le_card_of_mem_ne pc hp hq hne
  omega

lemma mem_restrictIndex {c : ι → GraphCycle G} {I : Finset ι} {A : Finset V}

statement:
lemma unionJ_single_subset (L : Finset V) (c : ι → GraphCycle G) {I : Finset ι}

name: Nikoghosyan.selectedSupport_restrict_subset
statement:
lemma selectedSupport_restrict_subset (c : ι → GraphCycle G) (I : Finset ι)
    (A : Finset V) : selectedSupport c (restrictIndex c I A) ⊆ A
proof:
:= by

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.support_subset_of_no_cross
statement:
lemma GraphCycle.support_subset_of_no_cross {A B : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hsupp : c.support ⊆ A ∪ B) :
    c.support ⊆ A ∨ c.support ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  have hstart : c.start ∈ A ∪ B := hsupp c.start_mem_support
  have hwalk : ∀ y ∈ c.walk.support, y ∈ (A : Set V) ∨ y ∈ (B : Set V) := by
    intro y hy
    have : y ∈ c.support := by simpa [GraphCycle.support] using hy
    simpa [mem_union] using hsupp this
  rcases mem_union.mp hstart with hA | hB
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ c.walk.support := by simpa [GraphCycle.support] using hx
    exact Cograph.walk_support_subset_of_no_cross
      (A := (A : Set V)) (B := (B : Set V))
      (fun a ha b hb => hnocross a ha b hb) c.walk hA hwalk x hxW
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ c.walk.support := by simpa [GraphCycle.support] using hx
    exact Cograph.walk_support_subset_of_no_cross'
      (A := (A : Set V)) (B := (B : Set V))
      (fun a ha b hb => hnocross a ha b hb) c.walk hB hwalk x hxW

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_splice_three
statement:
lemma exists_splice_three (left mid right : GraphPath G)
    (h1 : G.Adj left.finish mid.start) (h2 : G.Adj mid.finish right.start)
    (hd1 : Disjoint left.support mid.support)
    (hd2 : Disjoint (left.support ∪ mid.support) right.support) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = left.support ∪ mid.support ∪ right.support ∧
        r.start = left.start ∧ r.finish = right.finish
proof:
:= by
  let m := left.splice mid h1 hd1
  have hd2' : Disjoint m.support right.support := by
    simpa [m, GraphPath.support_splice] using hd2
  have h2' : G.Adj m.finish right.start := h2
  refine ⟨m.splice right h2' hd2', ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  simp [m, GraphPath.support_splice, union_assoc]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_union_cycle_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_union_cycle_le
    (c : ι → GraphCycle G) {L : Finset V} {I : Finset ι}
    (H : LocalityHyp c L I) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ I) :
    pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ (c i).support) ≤ pathCoverNumber G L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (c i).support_nonempty
  obtain ⟨u, huE, hadj⟩ := H.sees i hi d hd
  have hEl : Eligible G L u := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 huE |>.2
  obtain ⟨pc, hmin, p, hp, huend⟩ := hEl
  let p' := p.faceToFinish huend
  have hp's : p'.support = p.support := p.faceToFinish_support huend
  have hf' : p'.finish = u := p.faceToFinish_finish huend
  let pc' := pc.replacePath_sat hp p' hp's
  have hmin' : pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G L :=
    (replacePath_sat_card pc hp p' hp's).trans hmin
  have hp'mem : p' ∈ pc'.paths := replacePath_sat_self_mem pc hp p' hp's
  obtain ⟨r0, hr0, hst, _hadjD⟩ := Cograph.exists_spanning_path_from (c i) hd
  have hrst : r0.start = d := hst
  have hdisjLD : Disjoint L (c i).support := H.disjL i hi
  have hdisjpr : Disjoint p'.support r0.support := by
    have : Disjoint p.support (c i).support :=
      hdisjLD.mono_left (pc.support_subset hp)
    simpa [hp's, hr0] using this
  have hadj' : G.Adj p'.finish r0.start := by
    rw [hf', hrst]
    exact hadj.symm
  let s := p'.splice r0 hadj' hdisjpr
  have hs : s.support = p.support ∪ (c i).support := by
    simp [s, GraphPath.support_splice, hp's, hr0]
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint (L \ p.support) (p.support ∪ (c i).support) := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxL hxR
    have hxnp : x ∉ p.support := (mem_sdiff.1 hxL).2
    rcases mem_union.1 hxR with hxp | hxD
    · exact hxnp hxp
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjLD (mem_sdiff.1 hxL).1 hxD
  have hcastRem : L \ p'.support = L \ p.support := by rw [hp's]
  let pcRem' := (pc'.erasePath hp'mem).cast hcastRem
  let pcNew' : PathCover G (p.support ∪ (c i).support) :=
    (PathCover.ofPath s).cast hs
  let pcU := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisjRem pcRem' pcNew'
  have hcard : pcU.card = pc.card := by
    have h3 : pcU.card = pcRem'.card + pcNew'.card :=
      Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisjRem pcRem' pcNew'
    have h4 : pcRem'.card = pc'.card - 1 := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      exact PathCover.erasePath_card pc' hp'mem
    have h5 : pcNew'.card = 1 := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      exact PathCover.ofPath_card s
    have h6 : pc'.card = pc.card := replacePath_sat_card pc hp p' hp's
    have hpos : 1 ≤ pc'.card := by
      simpa [PathCover.card] using
        (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.length_pos_of_mem hp'mem))
    rw [h3, h4, h5, h6]
    omega
  have hUeq : (L \ p.support) ∪ (p.support ∪ (c i).support) =
      L ∪ (c i).support := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxL | hxR
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.1 hxL).1)
      · rcases mem_union.1 hxR with hxp | hxD
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((pc.mem_iff x).2 ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxD)
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hL | hD
      · by_cases hxp : x ∈ p.support
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxp)))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hL, hxp⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hD)))
  let pcJ := pcU.cast hUeq
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcJ
  have hcardJ : pcJ.card = pc.card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card]
    exact hcard
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.endpoints_aligned_of_join
statement:
lemma endpoints_aligned_of_join {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hLsub : L ⊆ X ∪ Y)
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    (hq : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    {p0 : GraphPath G} (hp0 : p0 ∈ pc.paths)
    (hXend : p0.start ∈ X ∨ p0.finish ∈ X) :
    ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ X ∧ p.finish ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  have hend_in (p : GraphPath G) (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) {z : V}
      (hz : z = p.start ∨ z = p.finish) : z ∈ X ∪ Y :=
    hLsub (pc.support_subset hp (by
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl
      · exact p.start_mem_support
      · exact p.finish_mem_support))
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0, hz0X⟩ : ∃ z, (z = p0.start ∨ z = p0.finish) ∧ z ∈ X := by
    rcases hXend with h | h
    · exact ⟨p0.start, Or.inl rfl, h⟩
    · exact ⟨p0.finish, Or.inr rfl, h⟩
  have hother : ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, q ≠ p0 → q.start ∈ X ∧ q.finish ∈ X := by
    intro q hq hne
    have hsX : q.start ∈ X := by
      have hAB := hend_in q hq (Or.inl rfl)
      rcases mem_union.1 hAB with hX | hY
      · exact hX
      · exact (not_adj_distinct_cover_endpoints pc hmin hp0 hq (Ne.symm hne)
          hz0 (Or.inl rfl) (hXY hz0X hY)).elim
    have hfX : q.finish ∈ X := by
      have hAB := hend_in q hq (Or.inr rfl)
      rcases mem_union.1 hAB with hX | hY
      · exact hX
      · exact (not_adj_distinct_cover_endpoints pc hmin hp0 hq (Ne.symm hne)
          hz0 (Or.inr rfl) (hXY hz0X hY)).elim
    exact ⟨hsX, hfX⟩
  have hex : ∃ q, q ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ≠ p0 := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hne⟩ := PathCover.exists_two_distinct pc hq
    by_cases h : a = p0
    · refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
      intro hba
      exact hne (h.trans hba.symm)
    · exact ⟨a, ha, h⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hne⟩ := hex
  have hqX := hother q hq hne
  have hp0' : p0.start ∈ X ∧ p0.finish ∈ X := by
    have hsX : p0.start ∈ X := by
      have hAB := hend_in p0 hp0 (Or.inl rfl)
      rcases mem_union.1 hAB with hX | hY
      · exact hX
      · exact (not_adj_distinct_cover_endpoints pc hmin hp0 hq hne.symm
          (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inl rfl) (hXY hqX.1 hY).symm).elim
    have hfX : p0.finish ∈ X := by
      have hAB := hend_in p0 hp0 (Or.inr rfl)
      rcases mem_union.1 hAB with hX | hY
      · exact hX
      · exact (not_adj_distinct_cover_endpoints pc hmin hp0 hq hne.symm
          (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inl rfl) (hXY hqX.1 hY).symm).elim
    exact ⟨hsX, hfX⟩
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpe : p = p0
  · simpa [hpe] using hp0'
  · exact hother p hp hpe

name: Nikoghosyan.unionJ_restrict_eq
statement:
lemma unionJ_restrict_eq {c : ι → GraphCycle G} {L A B : Finset V} {I : Finset ι}
    (H : LocalityHyp c L I)
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hunion : A ∪ B = unionJ L c I)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    unionJ (L ∩ A) c (restrictIndex c I A) = A
proof:
:= by
  have hLsub : L ⊆ A ∪ B := by
    rw [hunion]; exact subset_union_left
  have hsel : selectedSupport c I ⊆ A ∪ B := by
    rw [hunion]; exact subset_union_right
  have hcycle : ∀ i ∈ I, (c i).support ⊆ A ∨ (c i).support ⊆ B := by
    intro i hi
    exact GraphCycle.support_subset_of_no_cross hnocross (c i)
      ((cycle_support_subset_selected hi).trans hsel)
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxL | hxS
    · exact (mem_inter.1 hxL).2
    · exact selectedSupport_restrict_subset c I A hxS
  · intro hxA
    have hxJ : x ∈ unionJ L c I := by
      rw [← hunion]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)
    rcases mem_union.1 hxJ with hxL | hxS
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hxL, hxA⟩))
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 hxS
      have hsub := hcycle i hi
      have hiA : (c i).support ⊆ A := by
        rcases hsub with hA | hB
        · exact hA
        · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA (hB hxi)).elim
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_biUnion.2
        ⟨i, mem_restrictIndex.2 ⟨hi, hiA⟩, hxi⟩))

name: Nikoghosyan.LocalityHyp.restrict_side
statement:
lemma LocalityHyp.restrict_side (c : ι → GraphCycle G) {L A B : Finset V}
    {I : Finset ι} (H : LocalityHyp c L I)
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hunion : A ∪ B = unionJ L c I)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hIA : (restrictIndex c I A).Nonempty)
    (hLA : (L ∩ A).Nonempty) :
    LocalityHyp c (L ∩ A) (restrictIndex c I A) where
  I_nonempty
proof:
:= hIA
  L_nonempty := hLA
  disjL := by
    intro i hi
    have hiI := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hi |>.1
    exact (H.disjL i hiI).mono_left inter_subset_left
  pairwise := by
    intro i hi j hj hne
    have hiI := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hi |>.1
    have hjI := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hj |>.1
    exact H.pairwise i hiI j hjI hne
  cog := by
    have hJ : unionJ (L ∩ A) c (restrictIndex c I A) = A :=
      unionJ_restrict_eq H hdisj hunion hnocross
    have hAsub : A ⊆ unionJ L c I := by
      rw [← hunion]
      exact subset_union_left
    have hAcog : IsCograph G A := IsCograph.subset (G := G) H.cog hAsub
    simpa [hJ] using hAcog
  sees := by
    intro i hi d hd
    have hiI := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hi |>.1
    have hsubA := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hi |>.2
    obtain ⟨u, huE, hadj⟩ := H.sees i hiI d hd
    have huL : u ∈ L := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) L huE
    have huA : u ∈ A := by
      have huAB : u ∈ A ∪ B := by
        have : u ∈ unionJ L c I := mem_union.2 (Or.inl huL)
        rw [← hunion] at this
        exact this
      rcases mem_union.1 huAB with hA | hB
      · exact hA
      · exact (hnocross d (hsubA hd) u hB hadj).elim
    have hLsplit : L = (L ∩ A) ∪ (L ∩ B) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := by
          have : z ∈ unionJ L c I := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz)
          rw [← hunion] at this
          exact this
        rcases mem_union.1 hzAB with hA | hB
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hA⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hB⟩))
      · intro hz
        rcases mem_union.1 hz with h | h
        · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
        · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
    have hnocrossL : ∀ a ∈ L ∩ A, ∀ b ∈ L ∩ B, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
      fun a ha b hb => hnocross a (mem_inter.1 ha).2 b (mem_inter.1 hb).2
    have hdisjL : Disjoint (L ∩ A) (L ∩ B) :=
      disjoint_of_subset_left inter_subset_right
        (disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_right hdisj)
    have hE := Cograph.eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisjL hnocrossL
    have huE' : u ∈ eligibleSet G ((L ∩ A) ∪ (L ∩ B)) := by
      rwa [← hLsplit]
    have huEA : u ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∩ A) := by
      have hunionE : u ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∩ A) ∪ eligibleSet G (L ∩ B) := by
        rwa [← hE]
      rcases mem_union.1 hunionE with h | h
      · exact h
      · have huB : u ∈ L ∩ B := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) (L ∩ B) h
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjL (mem_inter.2 ⟨huL, huA⟩) huB).elim
    exact ⟨u, huEA, hadj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_lt_of_YY_opening
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_lt_of_YY_opening {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hpX : p.start ∈ X ∧ p.finish ∈ X)
    (hqX : q.start ∈ X ∧ q.finish ∈ X)
    (rD : GraphPath G) (hYs : rD.start ∈ Y) (hYf : rD.finish ∈ Y)
    {D : Finset V} (hrD : rD.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint L D) :
    pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) < pathCoverNumber G L
proof:
:= by
  let p' := p.faceToFinish (Or.inl rfl)
  let q' := q.faceToStart (Or.inl rfl)
  have hp's : p'.support = p.support := p.faceToFinish_support (Or.inl rfl)
  have hq's : q'.support = q.support := q.faceToStart_support (Or.inl rfl)
  have hdisjmidL : Disjoint p'.support rD.support := by
    have : Disjoint p.support D := hdisj.mono_left (pc.support_subset hp)
    rw [hp's, hrD]
    exact this
  have hdisjmidR : Disjoint (p'.support ∪ rD.support) q'.support := by
    have hdisjpq : Disjoint p.support q.support :=
      pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne
    have hdisjqD : Disjoint D q.support :=
      (hdisj.mono_left (pc.support_subset hq)).symm
    rw [hp's, hq's, hrD]
    exact disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjpq, hdisjqD⟩
  have hadj1 : G.Adj p'.finish rD.start := by
    have : p'.finish ∈ X := by
      rw [p.faceToFinish_finish (Or.inl rfl)]; exact hpX.1
    exact hXY this hYs
  have hadj2 : G.Adj rD.finish q'.start := by
    have : q'.start ∈ X := by
      rw [q.faceToStart_start (Or.inl rfl)]; exact hqX.1
    exact (hXY this hYf).symm
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_splice_three p' rD q' hadj1 hadj2 hdisjmidL hdisjmidR
  have hr' : r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∪ D := by
    rw [hr, hp's, hq's, hrD]
    ac_rfl
  let pcN := pc.replaceTwo hdisj hp hq hne hr'
  have hNcard := pc.replaceTwo_card hdisj hp hq hne hr'
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcN
  have h2 := two_le_card_of_mem_ne pc hp hq hne
  have hle' : pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) ≤ pc.card - 1 := hle.trans_eq hNcard
  have hpos : 1 ≤ pc.card := le_trans (by decide : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2) h2
  have hlt : pc.card - 1 < pathCoverNumber G L := by
    rw [← hmin]
    exact Nat.sub_lt (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hpos) (by decide)
  exact hle'.trans_lt hlt

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_single_saving_of_singleton
statement:
lemma exists_single_saving_of_singleton (c : ι → GraphCycle G)
    (L : Finset V) (I : Finset ι) (_H : LocalityHyp c L I)
    (hsing : ∃ i, I = {i})
    (hsave : pathCoverNumber G (unionJ L c I) < pathCoverNumber G L) :
    ∃ i ∈ I, pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ (c i).support) < pathCoverNumber G L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hI⟩ := hsing
  refine ⟨i, by simp [hI], ?_⟩
  have hunion : unionJ L c I = L ∪ (c i).support := by
    simp [unionJ, selectedSupport, hI]
  simpa [hunion] using hsave

name: Nikoghosyan.eligible_on_selected_cycle
statement:
lemma eligible_on_selected_cycle (c : ι → GraphCycle G)

    (_hi : i ∈ I) (hh : h ∈ (c i).support) :
    h ∈ L ∪ (c i).support
proof:
:=
  mem_union.2 (Or.inr hh)

name: Nikoghosyan.shortening_of_YY_split
statement:
lemma shortening_of_YY_split {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hqX : q.start ∈ X ∧ q.finish ∈ X)
    {left right : GraphPath G}
    (hst : left.start = p.start) (hfin : right.finish = p.finish)
    (hadjLR : G.Adj left.finish right.start)
    (hYl : left.finish ∈ Y) (hYr : right.start ∈ Y)
    (hdisjLR : Disjoint left.support right.support)
    (hU : left.support ∪ right.support = p.support) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hdisjpq : Disjoint p.support q.support :=
    pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne
  let q' := q.faceToStart (Or.inl rfl)
  have hq's : q'.support = q.support := q.faceToStart_support (Or.inl rfl)
  have hdisjLq : Disjoint left.support q'.support := by
    have : Disjoint left.support q.support :=
      hdisjpq.mono_left (hU ▸ subset_union_left)
    exact hq's.symm ▸ this
  have hdisjRq : Disjoint (left.support ∪ q'.support) right.support := by
    have hdisjRq0 : Disjoint q.support right.support :=
      hdisjpq.symm.mono_right (hU ▸ subset_union_right)
    refine disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjLR, ?_⟩
    exact hq's.symm ▸ hdisjRq0
  have hadj1 : G.Adj left.finish q'.start := by
    have : q'.start ∈ X := by
      rw [q.faceToStart_start (Or.inl rfl)]; exact hqX.1
    exact (hXY this hYl).symm
  have hadj2 : G.Adj q'.finish right.start := by
    have hf : q'.finish ∈ X := by
      change (q.faceToStart (Or.inl rfl)).finish ∈ X
      unfold GraphPath.faceToStart
      split_ifs
      · exact hqX.2
      · simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hqX.1
    exact hXY hf hYr
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_splice_three left q' right hadj1 hadj2 hdisjLq hdisjRq
  have hr' : r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∪ (∅ : Finset V) := by
    rw [hr, hq's, ← hU]
    simp [union_comm, union_left_comm, union_assoc]
  have hdisjE : Disjoint L (∅ : Finset V) := disjoint_empty_right _
  let pc' := pc.replaceTwo hdisjE hp hq hne hr'
  have hcard : pc'.card = pc.card - 1 :=
    pc.replaceTwo_card hdisjE hp hq hne hr'
  have hUW : L ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = L := union_empty L
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G L ≤ pc'.card :=
    (pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (pc'.cast hUW)).trans_eq
      (by simp [PathCover.cast_card, hcard])
  have h2 := two_le_card_of_mem_ne pc hp hq hne
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.no_Y_predecessor_of_aligned
statement:
lemma no_Y_predecessor_of_aligned {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    (hXend : ∀ r ∈ pc.paths, r.start ∈ X ∧ r.finish ∈ X)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) {y : V}
    (hy : y ∈ p.support) (hs : y ≠ p.start) (hyY : y ∈ Y) :
    ((p.takeUntil hy).trimFinish
        (fun hnil => hs ((GraphPath.takeUntil_nil_iff p hy).1 hnil))).finish ∉ Y
proof:
:= by
  intro hYpred
  obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hne⟩ : ∃ q, q ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ≠ p := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hne⟩ := PathCover.exists_two_distinct pc h2
    by_cases h : a = p
    · exact ⟨b, hb, fun hba => hne (h.trans hba.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨a, ha, h⟩
  have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hy).walk.Nil :=
    fun hnil => hs ((GraphPath.takeUntil_nil_iff p hy).1 hnil)
  let left := (p.takeUntil hy).trimFinish hnn
  let right := p.dropUntil hy
  have hst : left.start = p.start := trimFinish_start (p.takeUntil hy) hnn
  have hfin : right.finish = p.finish := rfl
  have hstR : right.start = y := p.dropUntil_start hy
  have hadjLR : G.Adj left.finish right.start := by
    rw [hstR]
    exact GraphPath.adj_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hy) hnn
  have hYr : right.start ∈ Y := by
    rwa [hstR]
  have hdisjLR : Disjoint left.support right.support := by
    have hL : left.support = (p.takeUntil hy).support.erase y :=
      support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hy) hnn
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxL hxR
    have hxL' : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hy).support.erase y := by rwa [hL] at hxL
    have hxT : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hy).support := (mem_erase.1 hxL').2
    have hxI := inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset p hy
      (mem_inter.2 ⟨hxT, hxR⟩)
    have hyx : x = y := mem_singleton.1 hxI
    exact (mem_erase.1 hxL').1 hyx
  have hU : left.support ∪ right.support = p.support := by
    have hL : left.support = (p.takeUntil hy).support.erase y :=
      support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hy) hnn
    have hU0 : (p.takeUntil hy).support ∪ right.support = p.support :=
      support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hy
    rw [hL]
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxe | hxR
      · have hxT : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hy).support := (mem_erase.1 hxe).2
        have : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hy).support ∪ right.support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxT)
        rwa [hU0] at this
      · have : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hy).support ∪ right.support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxR)
        rwa [hU0] at this
    · intro hx
      have hxU : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hy).support ∪ right.support :=
        hU0.symm ▸ hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxT | hxR
      · by_cases hxy : x = y
        · subst hxy
          refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)
          rw [← hstR]
          exact right.start_mem_support
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_erase.2 ⟨hxy, hxT⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxR)
  exact shortening_of_YY_split hXY pc hmin hp hqmem hne.symm (hXend q hqmem)
    hst hfin hadjLR hYpred hYr hdisjLR hU

name: Nikoghosyan.no_Y_successor_of_aligned
statement:
lemma no_Y_successor_of_aligned {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    (hXend : ∀ r ∈ pc.paths, r.start ∈ X ∧ r.finish ∈ X)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) {y : V}
    (hy : y ∈ p.support) (hf : y ≠ p.finish) (hyY : y ∈ Y) :
    ((p.dropUntil hy).trimStart
        (fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hy).1 hnil))).start ∉ Y
proof:
:= by
  intro hYsucc
  obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hne⟩ : ∃ q, q ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ≠ p := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hne⟩ := PathCover.exists_two_distinct pc h2
    by_cases h : a = p
    · exact ⟨b, hb, fun hba => hne (h.trans hba.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨a, ha, h⟩
  have hnn : ¬ (p.dropUntil hy).walk.Nil :=
    fun hnil => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hy).1 hnil)
  let left := p.takeUntil hy
  let right := (p.dropUntil hy).trimStart hnn
  have hst : left.start = p.start := rfl
  have hfin : right.finish = p.finish := trimStart_finish (p.dropUntil hy) hnn
  have hstL : left.finish = y := p.takeUntil_finish hy
  have hadjLR : G.Adj left.finish right.start := by
    rw [hstL]
    exact GraphPath.adj_trimStart (p.dropUntil hy) hnn
  have hYl : left.finish ∈ Y := by
    rwa [hstL]
  have hdisjLR : Disjoint left.support right.support := by
    have hR : right.support = (p.dropUntil hy).support.erase y :=
      support_trimStart (p.dropUntil hy) hnn
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxL hxR
    have hxR' : x ∈ (p.dropUntil hy).support.erase y := by rwa [hR] at hxR
    have hxD : x ∈ (p.dropUntil hy).support := (mem_erase.1 hxR').2
    have hxI := inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset p hy
      (mem_inter.2 ⟨hxL, hxD⟩)
    have hyx : x = y := mem_singleton.1 hxI
    exact (mem_erase.1 hxR').1 hyx
  have hU : left.support ∪ right.support = p.support := by
    have hR : right.support = (p.dropUntil hy).support.erase y :=
      support_trimStart (p.dropUntil hy) hnn
    have hU0 : left.support ∪ (p.dropUntil hy).support = p.support :=
      support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hy
    rw [hR]
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxL | hxe
      · have : x ∈ left.support ∪ (p.dropUntil hy).support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxL)
        rwa [hU0] at this
      · have hxD : x ∈ (p.dropUntil hy).support := (mem_erase.1 hxe).2
        have : x ∈ left.support ∪ (p.dropUntil hy).support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxD)
        rwa [hU0] at this
    · intro hx
      have hxU : x ∈ left.support ∪ (p.dropUntil hy).support := hU0.symm ▸ hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxL | hxD
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxL)
      · by_cases hxy : x = y
        · subst hxy
          refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
          rw [← hstL]
          exact left.finish_mem_support
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_erase.2 ⟨hxy, hxD⟩))
  exact shortening_of_YY_split hXY pc hmin hp hqmem hne.symm (hXend q hqmem)
    hst hfin hadjLR hYl hYsucc hdisjLR hU

name: Nikoghosyan.L_split_of_cover
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ A ∪ B := by
      rw [hunion]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hx)
    rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hx, hA⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hx, hB⟩))
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with h | h
    · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
    · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1

name: Nikoghosyan.restrictIndex_union
statement:
lemma restrictIndex_union {c : ι → GraphCycle G} {L A B : Finset V} {I : Finset ι}
    (hunion : A ∪ B = unionJ L c I)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    I = restrictIndex c I A ∪ restrictIndex c I B
proof:
:= by
  have hsel : selectedSupport c I ⊆ A ∪ B := by
    rw [hunion]; exact subset_union_right
  ext i
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have hsub := GraphCycle.support_subset_of_no_cross hnocross (c i)
      ((cycle_support_subset_selected hi).trans hsel)
    rcases hsub with hA | hB
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_restrictIndex.2 ⟨hi, hA⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_restrictIndex.2 ⟨hi, hB⟩))
  · intro hi
    rcases mem_union.1 hi with h | h
    · exact (mem_restrictIndex.1 h).1
    · exact (mem_restrictIndex.1 h).1

name: Nikoghosyan.old_side_nonempty_of_no_cross
statement:
lemma old_side_nonempty_of_no_cross {c : ι → GraphCycle G} {L A B : Finset V}
    {I : Finset ι} (H : LocalityHyp c L I)
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hunion : A ∪ B = unionJ L c I)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) :
    (L ∩ A).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAne
  have haJ : a ∈ unionJ L c I := by
    rw [← hunion]
    exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)
  rcases mem_union.1 haJ with haL | haSel
  · exact ⟨a, mem_inter.2 ⟨haL, ha⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 haSel
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (c i).support_nonempty
    obtain ⟨u, huE, hadj⟩ := H.sees i hi d hd
    have huL : u ∈ L := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) L huE
    have hsub := GraphCycle.support_subset_of_no_cross hnocross (c i)
      ((cycle_support_subset_selected hi).trans (by
        rw [hunion]; exact subset_union_right))
    have hdA : d ∈ A := by
      rcases hsub with hA | hB
      · exact hA hd
      · have : a ∈ B := hB hia
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj ha this).elim
    have huA : u ∈ A := by
      have huAB : u ∈ A ∪ B := by
        have : u ∈ unionJ L c I := mem_union.2 (Or.inl huL)
        rwa [← hunion] at this
      rcases mem_union.1 huAB with hA | hB
      · exact hA
      · exact (hnocross d hdA u hB hadj).elim
    exact ⟨u, mem_inter.2 ⟨huL, huA⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_edges_of_not_nil
statement:
lemma GraphPath.mem_edges_of_not_nil (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ p.edges) :
    e = s(p.start, p.walk.snd) ∨ e ∈ (p.trimStart h).edges
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v, walk, isPath⟩
  cases walk with
  | nil => exact (h Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons hadj q =>
    have he' : e ∈ (Walk.cons hadj q).edges := by
      simpa [GraphPath.edges] using he
    rw [Walk.edges_cons] at he'
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 he' with h1 | h2
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      simpa [Walk.snd_cons] using h1
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      simpa [trimStart, GraphPath.edges] using h2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.not_nil_of_mem_edges
statement:
lemma GraphPath.not_nil_of_mem_edges (p : GraphPath G) {e : Sym2 V}
    (he : e ∈ p.edges) : ¬ p.walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro hnil
  have hlen : p.walk.length = 0 := (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff).2 hnil
  have hedges : p.walk.edges.length = 0 := by
    simpa [Walk.length_edges] using hlen
  have hempty : p.walk.edges = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hedges
  simp [GraphPath.edges, hempty] at he

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimStart_support_subset
statement:
lemma GraphPath.trimStart_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_trimStart]
  exact erase_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_eq_self_of_start
statement:
lemma GraphPath.dropUntil_eq_self_of_start (p : GraphPath G) :
    p.dropUntil p.start_mem_support = p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v, walk, isPath⟩
  simp [dropUntil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.snd_eq_trimStart_start
statement:
lemma GraphPath.snd_eq_trimStart_start (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.walk.snd = (p.trimStart h).start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_walk_eq_trimStart
statement:
lemma GraphPath.dropUntil_walk_eq_trimStart (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil)
    {y : V} (hy : y ∈ (p.trimStart h).support) :
    (p.dropUntil (p.trimStart_support_subset h hy)).walk =
      ((p.trimStart h).dropUntil hy).walk
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v, walk, isPath⟩
  cases walk with
  | nil => exact (h Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons hadj q =>
    have hyq : y ∈ q.support.toFinset := by
      simpa [trimStart, GraphPath.support] using hy
    have hnotin : u ∉ q.support := ((Walk.cons_isPath_iff hadj q).1 isPath).2
    have hyne : y ≠ u := by
      intro hyu
      subst hyu
      exact hnotin (List.mem_toFinset.1 hyq)
    simp [GraphPath.dropUntil, GraphPath.trimStart, Walk.dropUntil,
      dite_eq_right (Ne.symm hyne)]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_YY_succ_pair
statement:
lemma GraphPath.exists_YY_succ_pair (p : GraphPath G) {Y : Finset V}
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ p.edges) (hb : bothEndsIn e Y) :
    (∃ y z, y ∈ p.support ∧ z ∈ p.support ∧ y ∈ Y ∧ z ∈ Y ∧
      y ≠ p.finish ∧
        ∃ (hy : y ∈ p.support), (p.dropUntil hy).walk.snd = z)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.walk.length = n →
        ∀ (e : Sym2 V), e ∈ p.edges → bothEndsIn e Y →
          (∃ y z, y ∈ p.support ∧ z ∈ p.support ∧ y ∈ Y ∧ z ∈ Y ∧
            y ≠ p.finish ∧
              ∃ (hy : y ∈ p.support), (p.dropUntil hy).walk.snd = z))
    p.walk.length ?_ p rfl e he hb
  intro n ih p hn e he hb
  have hnn := GraphPath.not_nil_of_mem_edges p he
  rcases GraphPath.mem_edges_of_not_nil p hnn he with hfirst | hrest
  · have hb' : bothEndsIn s(p.start, p.walk.snd) Y := by
      simpa [hfirst] using hb
    have hsY : p.start ∈ Y := (bothEndsIn_iff.1 hb').1
    have hzY : p.walk.snd ∈ Y := (bothEndsIn_iff.1 hb').2
    have hyne : p.start ≠ p.finish :=
      fun hsf => hnn ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).2 hsf)
    refine ⟨p.start, p.walk.snd, p.start_mem_support, ?_, hsY, hzY, hyne, ?_⟩
    · have : p.walk.snd = (p.trimStart hnn).start := rfl
      rw [this]
      exact (p.trimStart_support_subset hnn) (p.trimStart hnn).start_mem_support
    · refine ⟨p.start_mem_support, ?_⟩
      simp [GraphPath.dropUntil, Walk.dropUntil_first]
  · let q := p.trimStart hnn
    have hlt : q.walk.length < n := by
      have : q.walk.length + 1 = p.walk.length := by
        simpa [q, trimStart] using Walk.length_tail_add_one hnn
      omega
    obtain ⟨y, z, _hyq, hzq, hyY, hzY, hyne, hy, hsucc⟩ :=
      ih q.walk.length hlt q rfl e hrest hb
    have hqfin : q.finish = p.finish := trimStart_finish p hnn
    have hyneP : y ≠ p.finish := hqfin ▸ hyne
    refine ⟨y, z, p.trimStart_support_subset hnn hy,
        p.trimStart_support_subset hnn hzq, hyY, hzY, hyneP,
        ⟨p.trimStart_support_subset hnn hy, ?_⟩⟩
    have hw := GraphPath.dropUntil_walk_eq_trimStart p hnn hy
    have hsnd := congrArg Walk.snd hw
    have hqq : ((p.trimStart hnn).dropUntil hy).walk.snd =
        (q.dropUntil hy).walk.snd := by
      simp [q]
    exact hsnd.trans (hqq.trans hsucc)

name: Nikoghosyan.NoConsecutive_of_aligned
statement:
lemma NoConsecutive_of_aligned {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    (hXend : ∀ r ∈ pc.paths, r.start ∈ X ∧ r.finish ∈ X)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) :
    NoConsecutive Y p
proof:
:= by
  intro e he hb
  obtain ⟨y, z, _, _, hyY, hzY, hyne, hy, hsucc⟩ :=
    GraphPath.exists_YY_succ_pair (Y := Y) p he hb
  have hnn : ¬ (p.dropUntil hy).walk.Nil :=
    fun hnil => hyne ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hy).1 hnil)
  have hz : ((p.dropUntil hy).trimStart hnn).start ∈ Y := by
    have : ((p.dropUntil hy).trimStart hnn).start = z := hsucc
    exact this ▸ hzY
  exact (no_Y_successor_of_aligned hXY pc hmin hXend h2 hp hy hyne hyY) hz

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverCover_card_of_ends_outside
statement:
lemma leftoverCover_card_of_ends_outside {K B : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G K) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hends : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∉ B ∧ p.finish ∉ B)
    (hno : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, NoConsecutive B p) :
    (pc.leftoverCover (B := B)).card = pc.card + B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hlenp : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths,
      (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card + 1 := by
    intro p hp
    exact leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_ends_not_mem
      (hends p hp).1 (hends p hp).2 (hno p hp)
  have hflat : (pc.leftoverCover (B := B)).card =
      (pc.paths.map fun p => (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length).sum := by
    simp [PathCover.leftoverCover, PathCover.card, List.length_flatMap]
  have hmap :
      ∀ {l : List (GraphPath G)},
        (∀ p ∈ l,
            (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card + 1) →
          (l.map fun p => (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length).sum =
            (l.map fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card + 1).sum := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro; simp
    | cons p ps ih =>
      intro h
      simp [h p List.mem_cons_self,
        ih (fun q hq => h q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))]
  have hadd : ∀ l : List (GraphPath G),
      (l.map fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card + 1).sum =
        (l.map fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card).sum + l.length := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons p ps ih =>
      simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]
  have hsum :=
    sum_map_eq_sum_toFinset pc.nodup_paths fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card
  have hinter := pc.sum_support_inter_card hBK
  calc (pc.leftoverCover (B := B)).card
      = (pc.paths.map fun p => (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length).sum := hflat
    _ = (pc.paths.map fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card + 1).sum := hmap hlenp
    _ = (pc.paths.map fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card).sum + pc.paths.length :=
        hadd _
    _ = B.card + pc.card := by
        rw [hsum, hinter, PathCover.card]
    _ = pc.card + B.card := Nat.add_comm _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_le_card_locality
statement:
lemma PathCover.card_le_card_locality {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    pc.card ≤ U.card
proof:
:= by
  let starts := pc.paths.map (fun p => p.start)
  have hsub : starts.toFinset ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 (List.mem_toFinset.1 hx)
    exact pc.support_subset hp p.start_mem_support
  have hnodup : starts.Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on (PathCover.nodup_paths pc)]
    intro p hp q hq heq
    by_contra hne
    exact (disjoint_left.1
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem_refinement pc.disjoint hp hq hne)
      p.start_mem_support (heq ▸ q.start_mem_support)).elim
  have hlen : starts.toFinset.card = starts.length :=
    List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hle : starts.toFinset.card ≤ U.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  simpa [PathCover.card, starts, List.length_map, hlen] using hle

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_inter_right_eq_inter_left
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzL : z ∈ L := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzY : z ∉ L ∩ Y := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    have hzXY : z ∈ X ∪ Y := hL hzL
    rcases mem_union.1 hzXY with hX | hY
    · exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hX⟩
    · exact (hzY (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hY⟩)).elim
  · intro hz
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_inter.1 hz).1, fun h =>
      (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (mem_inter.1 hz).2 (mem_inter.1 h).2).elim⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.old_complete_join_profile
statement:
lemma old_complete_join_profile {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hLsub : L ⊆ X ∪ Y)
    (hX0ne : (L ∩ X).Nonempty) (hY0ne : (L ∩ Y).Nonempty)
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hXend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ X ∧ p.finish ∈ X) :
    pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) = pc.card + (L ∩ Y).card ∧
      eligibleSet G L = eligibleSet G (L ∩ X)
proof:
:= by
  have hdisjXY := disjoint_of_completeBetween hXY
  have hX0Y0 : G.IsCompleteBetween ↑(L ∩ X) ↑(L ∩ Y) := by
    intro v1 hv1 v2 hv2
    have hv1' : v1 ∈ L ∩ X := hv1
    have hv2' : v2 ∈ L ∩ Y := hv2
    exact hXY (mem_inter.1 hv1').2 (mem_inter.1 hv2').2
  have hLsplit : L = (L ∩ X) ∪ (L ∩ Y) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have := hLsub hz
      rcases mem_union.1 this with hX | hY
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hX⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hY⟩))
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with h | h
      · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
      · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
  have hY0L : L ∩ Y ⊆ L := inter_subset_left
  have hends : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∉ L ∩ Y ∧ p.finish ∉ L ∩ Y := by
    intro p hp
    have hsX := (hXend p hp).1
    have hfX := (hXend p hp).2
    exact ⟨fun h => disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY hsX (mem_inter.1 h).2,
      fun h => disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY hfX (mem_inter.1 h).2⟩
  have hno : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, NoConsecutive (L ∩ Y) p := by
    intro p hp e he hb
    have hbY : bothEndsIn e Y := by
      intro x hx
      exact (mem_inter.1 (hb x hx)).2
    exact NoConsecutive_of_aligned hXY pc hmin hXend h2 hp e he hbY
  have hcard := leftoverCover_card_of_ends_outside pc hY0L hends hno
  have hcast : L \ (L ∩ Y) = L ∩ X := sdiff_inter_right_eq_inter_left hdisjXY hLsub
  let pcX := (pc.leftoverCover (B := L ∩ Y)).cast hcast
  have hpcX : pcX.card = pc.card + (L ∩ Y).card := by
    simpa [pcX, PathCover.cast_card] using hcard
  have hleX := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcX
  have hpX_le : pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) ≤ pc.card + (L ∩ Y).card :=
    hleX.trans_eq hpcX
  have hgeX : pc.card + (L ∩ Y).card ≤ (L ∩ X).card := by
    have := pcX.card_le_card_locality
    omega
  have hpY : pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ Y) ≤ (L ∩ Y).card :=
    pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) (L ∩ Y)
  have hjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hX0ne hY0ne hX0Y0
  have hLunion : (L ∩ X) ∪ (L ∩ Y) = L := hLsplit.symm
  have hYex : pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ Y) - (L ∩ X).card = 0 := by
    have : pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ Y) ≤ (L ∩ X).card := by
      have hle : (L ∩ Y).card ≤ (L ∩ X).card :=
        (Nat.le_add_left (L ∩ Y).card pc.card).trans hgeX
      exact hpY.trans hle
    exact Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le this
  have hform :
      pathCoverNumber G L =
        max 1 (pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) - (L ∩ Y).card) := by
    have h1 := hjoin
    rw [hLunion, hYex] at h1
    simpa [max_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)] using h1
  have h2pos : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G L := by simpa [hmin] using h2
  have hsubpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) - (L ∩ Y).card := by
    by_contra h
    have h0 : pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) - (L ∩ Y).card = 0 := by omega
    have : pathCoverNumber G L = 1 := by
      rw [hform, h0]
      simp
    omega
  have hsub :
      pathCoverNumber G L =
        pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) - (L ∩ Y).card := by
    rwa [max_eq_right hsubpos] at hform
  have hleY : (L ∩ Y).card ≤ pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) :=
    Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_sub_pos (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hsubpos))
  have hpX : pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) = pc.card + (L ∩ Y).card := by
    have hsum := congrArg (fun n => n + (L ∩ Y).card) hsub
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hleY, ← hmin] at hsum
    exact hsum.symm
  have hdom : (L ∩ Y).card < pathCoverNumber G (L ∩ X) :=
    Nat.lt_of_sub_pos (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hsubpos)
  have hE := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hX0ne hY0ne hX0Y0 hdom
  refine ⟨hpX, ?_⟩
  have hEL : eligibleSet G L = eligibleSet G ((L ∩ X) ∪ (L ∩ Y)) :=
    congrArg (eligibleSet G) hLsplit
  exact hEL.trans hE

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.openAt_support
statement:
lemma GraphCycle.openAt_support (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).support = c.support
proof:
:= by
  have hnn := c.rotateTo_not_nil hu
  have hcons := (c.rotateTo hu).walk.cons_tail_eq hnn
  have hsup : (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support =
      (c.rotateTo hu).start :: (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail.support := by
    rw [← hcons]; simp [Walk.support_cons]
  have hwalk : (c.openAt hu).walk = (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail := rfl
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxL : x ∈ (c.openAt hu).walk.support :=
      (mem_walk_support (p := c.openAt hu)).1 hx
    have hxT : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support.tail :=
      (Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil (c.rotateTo hu).walk hnn) ▸ hxL
    have hxR : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support := List.mem_of_mem_tail hxT
    have : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).support := List.mem_toFinset.2 hxR
    simpa [c.support_rotateTo hu] using this
  · intro hx
    have hx0 : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).support := by
      simpa [c.support_rotateTo hu] using hx
    have hxW : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 hx0
    have hxL : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).start :: (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail.support := by
      simpa [hsup] using hxW
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hxL with h | h
    · have hxu : x = u := h.trans (start_rotateTo c hu)
      simpa [hxu, c.openAt_finish hu] using (c.openAt hu).finish_mem_support
    · exact (mem_walk_support (p := c.openAt hu)).2 (hwalk ▸ h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_leaving_edge
statement:
lemma GraphPath.exists_leaving_edge {A : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G)
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hf : p.finish ∉ A) :
    ∃ x y, x ∈ A ∧ y ∉ A ∧ s(x, y) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.walk.length = n →
        p.start ∈ A → p.finish ∉ A →
          ∃ x y, x ∈ A ∧ y ∉ A ∧ s(x, y) ∈ p.edges)
    p.walk.length ?_ p rfl hs hf
  intro n ih p hn hs' hf'
  have hnn : ¬ p.walk.Nil := fun h =>
    hf' (((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 h) ▸ hs')
  have hfirst : s(p.start, p.walk.snd) ∈ p.edges := first_edge_mem p hnn
  by_cases hsnd : p.walk.snd ∈ A
  · let q := p.trimStart hnn
    have hlt : q.walk.length < n := by
      have : q.walk.length + 1 = p.walk.length := by
        simpa [q, trimStart] using Walk.length_tail_add_one hnn
      omega
    have hqs : q.start ∈ A := by simpa [q, trimStart] using hsnd
    have hqf : q.finish ∉ A := by simpa [q, trimStart_finish p hnn] using hf'
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hedge⟩ := ih q.walk.length hlt q rfl hqs hqf
    exact ⟨x, y, hx, hy, (edges_trimStart_subset p hnn) hedge⟩
  · exact ⟨p.start, p.walk.snd, hs', hsnd, hfirst⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_lt_of_crossing
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_lt_of_crossing {L X Y : Finset V}
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G L) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G L)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    {u : V} (hu : u = p.start ∨ u = p.finish)
    (hqX : q.start ∈ X ∧ q.finish ∈ X)
    (rD : GraphPath G) (hXs : rD.start ∈ X) (hYf : rD.finish ∈ Y)
    (hadj_ud : G.Adj u rD.start)
    {D : Finset V} (hrD : rD.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint L D) :
    pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) < pathCoverNumber G L
proof:
:= by
  let p' := p.faceToFinish hu
  let q' := q.faceToStart (Or.inl rfl)
  have hp's : p'.support = p.support := p.faceToFinish_support hu
  have hq's : q'.support = q.support := q.faceToStart_support (Or.inl rfl)
  have hdisjmidL : Disjoint p'.support rD.support := by
    have : Disjoint p.support D := hdisj.mono_left (pc.support_subset hp)
    rw [hp's, hrD]
    exact this
  have hdisjmidR : Disjoint (p'.support ∪ rD.support) q'.support := by
    have hdisjpq : Disjoint p.support q.support :=
      pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne
    have hdisjqD : Disjoint D q.support :=
      (hdisj.mono_left (pc.support_subset hq)).symm
    rw [hp's, hq's, hrD]
    exact disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjpq, hdisjqD⟩
  have hadj1 : G.Adj p'.finish rD.start := by
    have : p'.finish = u := p.faceToFinish_finish hu
    simpa [this] using hadj_ud
  have hadj2 : G.Adj rD.finish q'.start := by
    have : q'.start ∈ X := by
      rw [q.faceToStart_start (Or.inl rfl)]; exact hqX.1
    exact (hXY this hYf).symm
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_splice_three p' rD q' hadj1 hadj2 hdisjmidL hdisjmidR
  have hr' : r.support = p.support ∪ q.support ∪ D := by
    rw [hr, hp's, hq's, hrD]
    ac_rfl
