            have h3 : 3 ≤ (((L ∩ X) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ Y).card := by
              have hDi3 : 3 ≤ (c i).support.card :=
                (c i).three_le_card_support
              exact hDi3.trans (card_le_card cycle_support_subset_extension)
            by_cases hle : pathCoverNumber G ((L ∩ X) ∪ (c i).support) ≤
                Y.card
            · have helig :=
                eligible_of_join_extension hZne hYne hZY hle hpY h3
                  (by simpa [hU'] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hhL))
              exact Or.inr (by simpa [hU'] using helig)
            · have hdomZ : Y.card <
                  pathCoverNumber G ((L ∩ X) ∪ (c i).support) :=
                Nat.not_le.mp hle
              have hEjoin :=
                eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hZne hYne hZY hdomZ
              have hreli' : h ∈ eligibleSet G
                  (((L ∩ X) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ Y) := by
                rwa [hEjoin]
              exact Or.inr (by simpa [hU'] using hreli')
  · have hJne : (unionJ L c I).Nonempty := H.L_nonempty.mono subset_union_left
    obtain ⟨A, B, hAsub, hBsub, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hunion, hnocross, hAlt, hBlt⟩ :=
      Cograph.exists_disjoint_union_on (U := unionJ L c I) hconn hJne
    have hLA := old_side_nonempty_of_no_cross H hdisj hunion hnocross hAne
    have hLB := old_side_nonempty_of_no_cross (A := B) (B := A) H hdisj.symm
      (by rw [union_comm]; exact hunion)
      (fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm) hBne
    have hLsplit : L = L ∩ A ∪ L ∩ B := L_split_of_cover hunion
    have hdisjL : Disjoint (L ∩ A) (L ∩ B) :=
      disjoint_of_subset_left inter_subset_right
        (disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_right hdisj)
    have hnocrossL : ∀ a ∈ L ∩ A, ∀ b ∈ L ∩ B, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
      fun a ha b hb => hnocross a (mem_inter.1 ha).2 b (mem_inter.1 hb).2
    have hhAB : h ∈ A ∪ B := by
      rw [hunion]
      exact hhJ
    have hEsplit :=
      Cograph.eligibleSet_disjoint_union hdisj hnocross
    rcases mem_union.1 hhAB with hhA | hhB
    · have hIA : (restrictIndex c I A).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hempty
        have hAeqL : unionJ (L ∩ A) c (restrictIndex c I A) = A :=
          unionJ_restrict_eq H hdisj hunion hnocross
        have hIempty : restrictIndex c I A = ∅ :=
          Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
        have : unionJ (L ∩ A) c ∅ = L ∩ A := by
          simp [unionJ, selectedSupport]
        have hAeq : A = L ∩ A := by
          simpa [hIempty, this] using hAeqL.symm
        have hEA : h ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
          have : h ∈ eligibleSet G A ∪ eligibleSet G B := by
            have hEJ' : h ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
              simpa [hunion] using hEJ
            simpa [hEsplit] using hEJ'
          rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
          · exact hA
          · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hhA
              (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hB)).elim
        have hELA : Eligible G (L ∩ A) h := by
          have hEA' : Eligible G A h :=
            ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hEA).2
          exact hAeq ▸ hEA'
        have hEL : Eligible G L h := by
          have hiff := Cograph.eligible_disjoint_union_iff (x := h) hdisjL hnocrossL
          have hEunion : Eligible G ((L ∩ A) ∪ (L ∩ B)) h :=
            hiff.2 (Or.inl hELA)
          exact hLsplit ▸ hEunion
        exact hnotEL hEL
      have HA : LocalityHyp c (L ∩ A) (restrictIndex c I A) :=
        H.restrict_side c hdisj hunion hnocross hIA hLA
      have hAeq : unionJ (L ∩ A) c (restrictIndex c I A) = A :=
        unionJ_restrict_eq H hdisj hunion hnocross
      have hFA : h ∈ ineligibleSet G (L ∩ A) := by
        have hiff := Cograph.eligible_disjoint_union_iff (x := h) hdisjL hnocrossL
        have : ¬ (Eligible G (L ∩ A) h ∨ Eligible G (L ∩ B) h) := by
          intro hOr
          have hEunion : Eligible G ((L ∩ A) ∪ (L ∩ B)) h := hiff.2 hOr
          exact hnotEL (hLsplit ▸ hEunion)
        have hnotA : ¬ Eligible G (L ∩ A) h := fun hA => this (Or.inl hA)
        exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
          ⟨mem_inter.2 ⟨hhL, hhA⟩, hnotA⟩
      have hEA : h ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
        have : h ∈ eligibleSet G A ∪ eligibleSet G B := by
          have hEJ' : h ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
            simpa [hunion] using hEJ
          simpa [hEsplit] using hEJ'
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
        · exact hA
        · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hhA
            (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hB)).elim
      have hEA' : h ∈ eligibleSet G
          (unionJ (L ∩ A) c (restrictIndex c I A)) := by
        simpa [hAeq] using hEA
      have hAcard : (unionJ (L ∩ A) c (restrictIndex c I A)).card = A.card := by
        rw [hAeq]
      have hlt : A.card < n := by
        rw [← hcard]
        exact hAlt
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hret⟩ :=
        ih A.card hlt (L ∩ A) (restrictIndex c I A) hAcard HA hFA hEA'
      have hiI : i ∈ I := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hi |>.1
      have hDiA : (c i).support ⊆ A :=
        (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := A)).1 hi |>.2
      refine ⟨i, hiI, ?_⟩
      have hdisjNew : Disjoint ((L ∩ A) ∪ (c i).support) (L ∩ B) := by
        refine disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjL, ?_⟩
        exact disjoint_of_subset_left hDiA
          (disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_right hdisj)
      have hnocrossNew :
          ∀ a ∈ (L ∩ A) ∪ (c i).support, ∀ b ∈ L ∩ B, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
        intro a ha b hb
        have haA : a ∈ A := by
          rcases mem_union.1 ha with hLA' | hD
          · exact (mem_inter.1 hLA').2
          · exact hDiA hD
        exact hnocross a haA b (mem_inter.1 hb).2
      rcases hret with hsavei | hreli
      · have hreatt :=
          pathCoverNumber_lt_of_disjoint_reattach hdisjNew hnocrossNew hdisjL
            hnocrossL hsavei
        have hU : L ∩ A ∪ L ∩ B ∪ (c i).support = L ∪ (c i).support := by
          rw [← hLsplit]
        exact Or.inl
          (lt_of_eq_of_lt (congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hU.symm)
            (lt_of_lt_of_eq hreatt
              (congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hLsplit.symm)))
      · have hEiff :=
          Cograph.eligible_disjoint_union_iff (x := h) hdisjNew hnocrossNew
        have hEU : Eligible G (((L ∩ A) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ (L ∩ B)) h :=
          hEiff.2 (Or.inl ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hreli).2)
        have hU : ((L ∩ A) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ (L ∩ B) =
            L ∪ (c i).support := by
          ext x
          simp only [mem_union]
          constructor
          · intro hx
            rcases hx with (hA | hD) | hB
            · exact Or.inl (mem_inter.1 hA).1
            · exact Or.inr hD
            · exact Or.inl (mem_inter.1 hB).1
          · intro hx
            rcases hx with hLx | hD
            · have hxL : x ∈ L ∩ A ∪ L ∩ B := by
                rw [← hLsplit]
                exact hLx
              rcases mem_union.1 hxL with hA | hB
              · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hA)
              · exact Or.inr hB
            · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hD)
        have hhmem : h ∈ ((L ∩ A) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ (L ∩ B) :=
          hU.symm ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inl hhL)
        exact Or.inr ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
          ⟨hU ▸ hhmem, hU ▸ hEU⟩)
    · have hIA : (restrictIndex c I B).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hempty
        have hBeqL : unionJ (L ∩ B) c (restrictIndex c I B) = B :=
          unionJ_restrict_eq (A := B) (B := A) H hdisj.symm
            (by rw [union_comm]; exact hunion)
            (fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm)
        have hIempty : restrictIndex c I B = ∅ :=
          Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
        have : unionJ (L ∩ B) c ∅ = L ∩ B := by
          simp [unionJ, selectedSupport]
        have hBeq : B = L ∩ B := by
          simpa [hIempty, this] using hBeqL.symm
        have hEB : h ∈ eligibleSet G B := by
          have : h ∈ eligibleSet G A ∪ eligibleSet G B := by
            have hEJ' : h ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
              simpa [hunion] using hEJ
            simpa [hEsplit] using hEJ'
          rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
          · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
              (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hA) hhB).elim
          · exact hB
        have hELB : Eligible G (L ∩ B) h := by
          have hEB' : Eligible G B h :=
            ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hEB).2
          exact hBeq ▸ hEB'
        have hEL : Eligible G L h := by
          have hiff := Cograph.eligible_disjoint_union_iff (x := h) hdisjL hnocrossL
          have hEunion : Eligible G ((L ∩ A) ∪ (L ∩ B)) h :=
            hiff.2 (Or.inr hELB)
          exact hLsplit ▸ hEunion
        exact hnotEL hEL
      have HB : LocalityHyp c (L ∩ B) (restrictIndex c I B) :=
        H.restrict_side (A := B) (B := A) c hdisj.symm
          (by rw [union_comm]; exact hunion)
          (fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm) hIA hLB
      have hBeq : unionJ (L ∩ B) c (restrictIndex c I B) = B :=
        unionJ_restrict_eq (A := B) (B := A) H hdisj.symm
          (by rw [union_comm]; exact hunion)
          (fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm)
      have hFB : h ∈ ineligibleSet G (L ∩ B) := by
        have hiff := Cograph.eligible_disjoint_union_iff (x := h) hdisjL hnocrossL
        have : ¬ (Eligible G (L ∩ A) h ∨ Eligible G (L ∩ B) h) := by
          intro hOr
          have hEunion : Eligible G ((L ∩ A) ∪ (L ∩ B)) h := hiff.2 hOr
          exact hnotEL (hLsplit ▸ hEunion)
        have hnotB : ¬ Eligible G (L ∩ B) h := fun hB => this (Or.inr hB)
        exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
          ⟨mem_inter.2 ⟨hhL, hhB⟩, hnotB⟩
      have hEB : h ∈ eligibleSet G B := by
        have : h ∈ eligibleSet G A ∪ eligibleSet G B := by
          have hEJ' : h ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
            simpa [hunion] using hEJ
          simpa [hEsplit] using hEJ'
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
        · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
            (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hA) hhB).elim
        · exact hB
      have hEB' : h ∈ eligibleSet G
          (unionJ (L ∩ B) c (restrictIndex c I B)) := by
        simpa [hBeq] using hEB
      have hBcard : (unionJ (L ∩ B) c (restrictIndex c I B)).card = B.card := by
        rw [hBeq]
      have hlt : B.card < n := by
        rw [← hcard]
        exact hBlt
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hret⟩ :=
        ih B.card hlt (L ∩ B) (restrictIndex c I B) hBcard HB hFB hEB'
      have hiI : i ∈ I := (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := B)).1 hi |>.1
      have hDiB : (c i).support ⊆ B :=
        (mem_restrictIndex (c := c) (I := I) (A := B)).1 hi |>.2
      refine ⟨i, hiI, ?_⟩
      have hdisjNew : Disjoint ((L ∩ B) ∪ (c i).support) (L ∩ A) := by
        refine disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjL.symm, ?_⟩
        exact disjoint_of_subset_left hDiB
          (disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_right hdisj.symm)
      have hnocrossNew :
          ∀ a ∈ (L ∩ B) ∪ (c i).support, ∀ b ∈ L ∩ A, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
        intro a ha b hb
        have haB : a ∈ B := by
          rcases mem_union.1 ha with hLB' | hD
          · exact (mem_inter.1 hLB').2
          · exact hDiB hD
        exact mt Adj.symm (hnocross b (mem_inter.1 hb).2 a haB)
      have hdisjL' : Disjoint (L ∩ B) (L ∩ A) := hdisjL.symm
      have hnocrossL' : ∀ a ∈ L ∩ B, ∀ b ∈ L ∩ A, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
        fun a ha b hb => mt Adj.symm (hnocrossL b hb a ha)
      rcases hret with hsavei | hreli
      · have hreatt :=
          pathCoverNumber_lt_of_disjoint_reattach hdisjNew hnocrossNew hdisjL'
            hnocrossL' hsavei
        have hU : L ∩ B ∪ L ∩ A ∪ (c i).support = L ∪ (c i).support := by
          rw [union_comm (L ∩ B), ← hLsplit]
        exact Or.inl
          (lt_of_eq_of_lt (congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hU.symm)
            (lt_of_lt_of_eq hreatt
              (congrArg (pathCoverNumber G)
                ((union_comm (L ∩ B) (L ∩ A)).trans hLsplit.symm))))
      · have hEiff :=
          Cograph.eligible_disjoint_union_iff (x := h) hdisjNew hnocrossNew
        have hEU : Eligible G (((L ∩ B) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ (L ∩ A)) h :=
          hEiff.2 (Or.inl ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hreli).2)
        have hU : ((L ∩ B) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ (L ∩ A) =
            L ∪ (c i).support := by
          ext x
          simp only [mem_union]
          constructor
          · intro hx
            rcases hx with (hB | hD) | hA
            · exact Or.inl (mem_inter.1 hB).1
            · exact Or.inr hD
            · exact Or.inl (mem_inter.1 hA).1
          · intro hx
            rcases hx with hLx | hD
            · have hxL : x ∈ L ∩ A ∪ L ∩ B := by
                rw [← hLsplit]
                exact hLx
              rcases mem_union.1 hxL with hA | hB
              · exact Or.inr hA
              · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hB)
            · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hD)
        have hhmem : h ∈ ((L ∩ B) ∪ (c i).support) ∪ (L ∩ A) :=
          hU.symm ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inl hhL)
        exact Or.inr ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
          ⟨hU ▸ hhmem, hU ▸ hEU⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_single_release
statement:
lemma exists_single_release (c : ι → GraphCycle G) {L : Finset V} {I : Finset ι}
    {h : V} (H : LocalityHyp c L I)
    (hF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G L)
    (hE : h ∈ eligibleSet G (unionJ L c I)) :
    ∃ i ∈ I,
      pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ (c i).support) < pathCoverNumber G L ∨
        h ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∪ (c i).support)
proof:
:=
  exists_single_release_of_card c (unionJ L c I).card L I rfl H hF hE

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_single_release_eq
statement:
lemma exists_single_release_eq (c : ι → GraphCycle G) {L : Finset V} {I : Finset ι}
    {h : V} (H : LocalityHyp c L I)
    (hF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G L)
    (hE : h ∈ eligibleSet G (unionJ L c I)) :
    ∃ i ∈ I,
      pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ (c i).support) < pathCoverNumber G L ∨
        (pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ (c i).support) = pathCoverNumber G L ∧
          h ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∪ (c i).support))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hw⟩ := exists_single_release c H hF hE
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
  rcases hw with hs | he
  · exact Or.inl hs
  · by_cases hs : pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ (c i).support) < pathCoverNumber G L
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · exact Or.inr ⟨le_antisymm (pathCoverNumber_union_cycle_le c H hi)
        (Nat.le_of_not_gt hs), he⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.minFactor_not_twoBlock_fourEdge_cograph
statement:
lemma minFactor_not_twoBlock_fourEdge_cograph
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {xi yi xj yj : V}
    (hxi : xi ∈ (F.getCycle i).support) (hyi : yi ∈ (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hxj : xj ∈ (F.getCycle j).support) (hyj : yj ∈ (F.getCycle j).support)
    (hpi : factorPort F xi ≠ factorPort F yi)
    (hpj : factorPort F xj ≠ factorPort F yj)
    (hxy : G.Adj yi xj) (hyx : G.Adj yj xi) : False

name: Nikoghosyan.attachment_factorPort_eq
statement:
lemma attachment_factorPort_eq
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    {x y a b : V}
    (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) (hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i)
    (ha : F.partition.index a = i) (hb : F.partition.index b = i)
    (hxa : G.Adj x a) (hyb : G.Adj y b)
    (hW : (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    factorPort F a = factorPort F b
proof:
:=
  attachment_port_eq (G := G) (P := F.partition) (factorPort F)
    hsplit hx hy ha hb hxa hyb hW

name: Nikoghosyan.attachment_same_rClass
statement:
lemma attachment_same_rClass
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {i : Fin F.card}
    (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex
      (auxColoring (G := G) F.partition (factorPort F)) (.inl i))
    {x y a b : V}
    (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i) (hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i)
    (ha : a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support) (hb : b ∈ (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hxa : G.Adj x a) (hyb : G.Adj y b)
    (hW : (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    factorPort F a = factorPort F b ∧
      b ∈ Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support a
proof:
:= by
  have hai : F.partition.index a = i := F.partition.index_eq
    (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using ha)
  have hbi : F.partition.index b = i := F.partition.index_eq
    (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using hb)
  have heq :=
    attachment_factorPort_eq (F := F) hsplit hx hy hai hbi hxa hyb hW
  have hbal := factor_block_balanced F hcog i
  have hclass := hbal.2.2 ha hb
  have hEq :
      Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support a =
        Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support b := by
    simpa [factorPort_eq_of_mem F ha, factorPort_eq_of_mem F hb] using heq
  exact ⟨heq, hclass.mp hEq⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_component_singleton_attachment
statement:
lemma not_component_singleton_attachment
    (hT : OneTough G)
    {i : Fin F.card} {p : V}
    (hp : p ∈ (F.getCycle i).support)
    {x : V} (hx : F.partition.index x ≠ i)
    (hatt : ∀ {y a : V} (hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i)
      (ha : a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support),
      G.Adj y a →
        (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ →
          a = p) : False
proof:
:= by
  let H := (F.getCycle i).support
  let W : Finset V := univ.filter fun z => F.partition.index z ≠ i
  have hxW : x ∈ W := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ x, hx⟩
  let D : Finset V := W.filter fun y =>
    ∃ hy : F.partition.index y ≠ i,
      (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hxD : x ∈ D := mem_filter.2 ⟨hxW, ⟨hx, Reachable.rfl⟩⟩
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := ⟨x, hxD⟩
  have hH3 : 3 ≤ (F.getCycle i).support.card :=
    (F.getCycle i).three_le_card_support
  have hAHne : ((F.getCycle i).support.erase p).Nonempty := by
    have hcard : ((F.getCycle i).support.erase p).card =
        (F.getCycle i).support.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hp
    have : 0 < ((F.getCycle i).support.erase p).card := by omega
    exact card_pos.mp this
  let A := D
  let B := univ.erase p \ A
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := hDne
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
    refine hAHne.mono ?_
    intro z hz
    have hzH : z ∈ H := mem_of_mem_erase hz
    have hzp : z ≠ p := ne_of_mem_erase hz
    have hzidx : F.partition.index z = i := F.partition.index_eq
      (by simpa [CycleFactor.partition] using hzH)
    have hzW : z ∉ W := by
      intro hW
      exact (mem_filter.1 hW).2 hzidx
    have hzA : z ∉ A := by
      intro hA
      exact hzW (mem_filter.1 hA).1
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hzp, mem_univ z⟩, hzA⟩
  have hU : A ∪ B = univ.erase p := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hA | hB
      · have hai : F.partition.index z ≠ i := (mem_filter.1 (mem_filter.1 hA).1).2
        have hzp : z ≠ p := by
          intro heq
          have : F.partition.index z = i := F.partition.index_eq
            (by simpa [heq, CycleFactor.partition] using hp)
          exact hai this
        exact mem_erase.2 ⟨hzp, mem_univ z⟩
      · exact (mem_sdiff.1 hB).1
    · intro hz
      by_cases hA : z ∈ A
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hA)
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz, hA⟩))
  have hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have hai : F.partition.index a ≠ i :=
      (mem_filter.1 (mem_filter.1 ha).1).2
    have hbp : b ≠ p := (mem_erase.1 (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1).1
    have hbA : b ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
    have hreachA :
        (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨a, hai⟩ :=
      (mem_filter.1 ha).2.2
    by_cases hbH : b ∈ H
    · have := hatt (y := a) (a := b) hai hbH hadj hreachA
      exact hbp this
    · have hbi : F.partition.index b ≠ i := by
        intro hbi
        have : b ∈ H := by
          have hbmem := F.partition.mem_index b
          rw [hbi] at hbmem
          simpa [H, CycleFactor.partition] using hbmem
        exact hbH this
      have hbW : b ∈ W := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ b, hbi⟩
      have hadjI :
          (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Adj ⟨a, hai⟩ ⟨b, hbi⟩ := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.induce_adj] using hadj
      have hreachB :
          (G.induce {z | F.partition.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨b, hbi⟩ :=
        hreachA.trans hadjI.reachable
      have : b ∈ A := mem_filter.2 ⟨hbW, ⟨hbi, hreachB⟩⟩
      exact hbA this
  have hxA : hAne.choose ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union_left _ hAne.choose_spec
  have hyB : hBne.choose ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union_right _ hBne.choose_spec
  have hnr :
      ¬ (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨hAne.choose, hxA⟩ ⟨hBne.choose, hyB⟩ := by
    intro hR
    obtain ⟨w⟩ := hR
    have hyA : hBne.choose ∈ A :=
      induce_walk_stays_left (G := G) hno hAne.choose_spec hxA hyB w
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hBne.choose_spec).2 hyA
  have h2 := two_le_componentCount_of_not_reachable (G := G) hxA hyB hnr
  have hEq : univ \ ({p} : Finset V) = A ∪ B := by
    simp [hU, sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
  have h2' : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ ({p} : Finset V)) := by
    simpa [hEq] using h2
  have hle := hT {p} h2'
  have : ({p} : Finset V).card = 1 := by simp
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.original_common_port_cut
statement:
lemma original_common_port_cut
    (hT : OneTough G)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    {i : Fin F.card} {p : V}
    (hp : p ∈ (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hW : (univ \ (F.getCycle i).support).Nonempty)
    (hatt : ∀ {x a : V},
      a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support →
      x ∈ univ \ (F.getCycle i).support →
      G.Adj x a → a ∈ factorPort F p) : False
proof:
:= by
  let H := (F.getCycle i).support
  let W := univ \ H
  let P := factorPort F p
  have hPsub : P ⊆ H := factorPort_subset_block F hp
  have hpP : p ∈ P := by
    simpa [P, factorPort_eq_of_mem F hp] using
      Cograph.mem_rNonadjClass_self (G := G) hp
  have hcut := factor_block_partCut F hcog hp
  have hdisj : Disjoint (H \ P) W := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzHP hzW
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hzW).2 (mem_sdiff.1 hzHP).1
  have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ H \ P, ∀ b ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have haH : a ∈ H := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1
    have haP : a ∉ P := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).2
    have : a ∈ P := hatt haH hb hadj.symm
    exact haP this
  have hunion : (H \ P) ∪ W = univ \ P := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hHP | hWz
      · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ z, (mem_sdiff.1 hHP).2⟩
      · have hzH : z ∉ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hWz).2
        exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ z, fun hP => hzH (hPsub hP)⟩
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨_, hzP⟩ := mem_sdiff.1 hz
      by_cases hzH : z ∈ H
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzH, hzP⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ z, hzH⟩))
  have hadd :=
    Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisj hnocross
  have hWpos : 1 ≤ componentCount G W := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hW
    haveI : Nonempty (W : Set V) := ⟨⟨z, by simpa [W] using hz⟩⟩
    have : 0 < Nat.card (G.induce (W : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      exact Fintype.card_pos
    exact Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr this
  have hcount :
      componentCount G (univ \ factorPort F p) =
        (factorPort F p).card + componentCount G W := by
    have h1 : univ \ factorPort F p = (H \ P) ∪ W := hunion.symm
    have h2 : componentCount G ((H \ P) ∪ W) =
        componentCount G (H \ P) + componentCount G W := hadd
    have h3 : componentCount G (H \ P) = (factorPort F p).card := hcut
    simp [h1, h2, h3]
  have hPpos : 1 ≤ (factorPort F p).card :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (card_pos.mpr ⟨p, hpP⟩)
  have hsum : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ factorPort F p) := by
    rw [hcount]
    omega
  have hle := hT (factorPort F p) hsum
  have hcontr :
      (factorPort F p).card + componentCount G W ≤ (factorPort F p).card := by
    rw [← hcount]
    exact hle
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_spanning_graphCycle_of_min_card_one
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_graphCycle_of_min_card_one
    (F : CycleFactor G) (hF : F.card = 1) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, w, hw, hs, _hord⟩ :=
    CycleFactor.exists_hamiltonian_cycle_of_card_one F hF
  exact ⟨⟨a, w, hw⟩, hs⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cycleFactor_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
statement:
lemma exists_min_cycleFactor_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hT : OneTough G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    ∃ F : CycleFactor G, ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card
proof:
:= by
  letI : DecidableRel G.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  obtain ⟨F0⟩ :=
    TwoFactor.exists_cycleFactor_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1 hord hT hpat
  obtain ⟨F, _hle, hmin⟩ := CycleFactor.exists_min_of_exists F0
  exact ⟨F, hmin⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_spanning_graphCycle_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_graphCycle_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hT : OneTough G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hmin⟩ :=
    exists_min_cycleFactor_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1 hord hT hpat
  by_cases h1 : F.card = 1
  · exact exists_spanning_graphCycle_of_min_card_one F h1
  · by_cases hHam : G.IsHamiltonian
    · exact (isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).1 hHam
    · exact (remaining_min_factor_not_hamiltonian hT hord hpat F hmin hHam).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.isHamiltonian_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
statement:
theorem isHamiltonian_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hT : OneTough G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    G.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:=
  (isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).2
    (exists_spanning_graphCycle_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1 hord hT hpat)

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.disjoint_A_UK
statement: lemma disjoint_A_UK : Disjoint P.A (P.U ∪ (P.B ∪ P.W))
proof:
:=
  disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨P.hdisjAU, P.disjoint_A_K⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.cover_A_UK
statement: lemma cover_A_UK : P.A ∪ (P.U ∪ (P.B ∪ P.W)) = univ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [union_assoc, union_left_comm, union_comm] using P.hcover

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.seams_of_U_cover
statement:
lemma seams_of_U_cover (pcU : PathCover G P.U) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ P.A)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pcU.paths) :
    G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hend := PathCover.endpoints_mem pcU hp
  exact ⟨P.hAU ha hend.1, P.hAU ha hend.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.seams_of_K_cover
statement:
lemma seams_of_K_cover (pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W))
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pcK) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ P.A)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pcK.paths) :
    G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish
proof:
:= by
  have ht := hterm p hp
  exact ⟨P.hAB ha ht.1, P.hAB ha ht.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.joinedCover_card
statement:
lemma joinedCover_card (pcU : PathCover G P.U)
    (pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W)) :
    (P.joinedCover pcU pcK).card = pcU.card + pcK.card
proof:
:=
  PathCover.appendDisjoint_card P.disjoint_U_K pcU pcK

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.seams_of_joinedCover
statement:
lemma seams_of_joinedCover (pcU : PathCover G P.U)
    (pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W))
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pcK) {a : V} (ha : a ∈ P.A)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ (P.joinedCover pcU pcK).paths) :
    G.Adj a p.start ∧ G.Adj a p.finish
proof:
:= by
  rcases (PathCover.appendDisjoint_mem_iff P.disjoint_U_K pcU pcK).1 hp with hU | hK
  · exact P.seams_of_U_cover pcU ha hU
  · exact P.seams_of_K_cover pcK hterm ha hK

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.exists_original_cycle_of_endpoint_covers
statement:
theorem exists_original_cycle_of_endpoint_covers
    (pcU : PathCover G P.U) (pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W))
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pcK)
    (hsum : pcU.card + pcK.card = P.m) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = (univ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : P.A.card = (P.joinedCover pcU pcK).card := by
    rw [P.hAcard, P.joinedCover_card, hsum]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    exists_original_cycle_of_endpoint_seams (A := P.A)
      (K := P.U ∪ (P.B ∪ P.W)) (P.joinedCover pcU pcK) hcard P.disjoint_A_UK
      (fun a ha p hp => P.seams_of_joinedCover pcU pcK hterm ha hp)
      (by simpa [P.hAcard] using P.hm)
  refine ⟨c, hc.trans P.cover_A_UK⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.chosenQ_le_m
statement: lemma chosenQ_le_m (hT : OneTough G) : P.chosenQ ≤ P.m
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := pathCoverNumber_add_le_m P hT
  have hpK : pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ P.m := by omega
  have hrest : P.m - P.U.card ≤ P.m := Nat.sub_le _ _
  exact max_le hpK hrest

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.chosenQ_ge_pathCover_K
statement: lemma chosenQ_ge_pathCover_K : pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ P.chosenQ
proof:
:=
  le_max_left _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.chosenK_add_chosenQ
statement: lemma chosenK_add_chosenQ (hT : OneTough G) : P.chosenK + P.chosenQ = P.m
proof:
:=
  Nat.sub_add_cancel (P.chosenQ_le_m hT)

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.chosenK_le_card_U
statement: lemma chosenK_le_card_U : P.chosenK ≤ P.U.card
proof:
:= by
  have hrest : P.m - P.U.card ≤ P.chosenQ := le_max_right _ _
  have hgoal : P.m ≤ P.chosenQ + P.U.card := Nat.le_add_of_sub_le hrest
  simpa [chosenK] using Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add'.2 hgoal

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.chosenK_ge_pathCover_U
statement:
lemma chosenK_ge_pathCover_U (hT : OneTough G) :
    pathCoverNumber G P.U ≤ P.chosenK
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := pathCoverNumber_add_le_m P hT
  have hq : pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ P.chosenQ := P.chosenQ_ge_pathCover_K
  have hqm : P.chosenQ ≤ P.m := P.chosenQ_le_m hT
  have hU : pathCoverNumber G P.U ≤ P.U.card := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) P.U
  unfold chosenK chosenQ at *
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.exists_U_cover_of_chosen
statement:
lemma exists_U_cover_of_chosen (hT : OneTough G) :
    ∃ pcU : PathCover G P.U, pcU.card = P.chosenK
proof:
:=
  exists_pathCover_card (G := G) P.U (P.chosenK_ge_pathCover_U hT)
    P.chosenK_le_card_U

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.exists_univ_cycle_of_chosen_terminal_cover
statement:
theorem exists_univ_cycle_of_chosen_terminal_cover (hT : OneTough G)
    (pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W))
    (hcard : pcK.card = P.chosenQ)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pcK) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = (univ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pcU, hU⟩ := P.exists_U_cover_of_chosen hT
  have hsum : pcU.card + pcK.card = P.m := by
    rw [hU, hcard, P.chosenK_add_chosenQ hT]
  exact P.exists_original_cycle_of_endpoint_covers pcU pcK hterm hsum

name: Nikoghosyan.min_all_cograph_hamiltonian_of_chosen_terminal_cover
statement:
theorem min_all_cograph_hamiltonian_of_chosen_terminal_cover
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hspec : ∀ P : AllCographSides G,
      ∃ pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
        pcK.card = P.chosenQ ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pcK) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:= by
  rcases min_all_cograph_hamiltonian_or_sides hT hord hpat F hmin hcog with h | hP
  · exact h
  · obtain ⟨P⟩ := hP
    obtain ⟨pcK, hcard, hterm⟩ := hspec P
    exact P.exists_univ_cycle_of_chosen_terminal_cover hT pcK hcard hterm

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.support_subset_range_of_image
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have : x ∈ U.image f := pc.support_subset hp hx
  rcases mem_image.1 this with ⟨u, _, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨u, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.mapCarrier_card
statement:
lemma mapCarrier_card (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) :
    (pc.mapCarrier (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).card = pc.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapCarrier, card]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.ofCarrierImage_card
statement:
lemma ofCarrierImage_card (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover H (U.image f)) :
    (pc.ofCarrierImage (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).card = pc.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofCarrierImage, card]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_mapCarrier
statement:
theorem pathCoverNumber_mapCarrier (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) (U : Finset V) :
    pathCoverNumber H (U.image f) = pathCoverNumber G U
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
    have := pathCoverNumber_le (G := H)
      (pc.mapCarrier (G := G) (H := H) f hadj)
    simpa [PathCover.mapCarrier_card, hpc] using this
  · obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := H) (U.image f)
    have := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G)
      (pc.ofCarrierImage (G := G) (H := H) f hadj)
    simpa [PathCover.ofCarrierImage_card, hpc] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.InducedP4_mapCarrier
statement:
lemma InducedP4_mapCarrier (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) {a b c d : V} :
    InducedP4 H (f a) (f b) (f c) (f d) ↔ InducedP4 G a b c d
proof:
:= by
  simp [InducedP4, f.injective.eq_iff, hadj]

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCograph_mapCarrier
statement:
theorem IsCograph_mapCarrier (f : V ↪ W)
    (hadj : ∀ u v : V, H.Adj (f u) (f v) ↔ G.Adj u v) (U : Finset V) :
    IsCograph H (U.image f) ↔ IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact h (mem_image_of_mem f ha) (mem_image_of_mem f hb)
      (mem_image_of_mem f hc) (mem_image_of_mem f hd)
      ((InducedP4_mapCarrier (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).2 hp)
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    rcases mem_image.1 ha with ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 hb with ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 hc with ⟨c', hc', rfl⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 hd with ⟨d', hd', rfl⟩
    exact h ha' hb' hc' hd'
      ((InducedP4_mapCarrier (G := G) (H := H) f hadj).1 hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_mapCarrier_inl
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_mapCarrier (G := G) (H := H) Embedding.inl hadj U

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCograph_mapCarrier_inl
proof:
:=
  IsCograph_mapCarrier (G := G) (H := H) Embedding.inl hadj U

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_support_eq_rec
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.support_inl_rec
statement:
lemma support_inl_rec {P : BlockPartition V ι} {i j k : ι} (h : i = j)
    (w : (aux (G := G) P).Walk (.inl j) (.inl k))
    (x : ι ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) P) :
    x ∈ (h ▸ w : (aux (G := G) P).Walk (.inl i) (.inl k)).support ↔
      x ∈ w.support
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.toPhys_val
statement:
lemma toPhys_val (P : BlockPartition V ι) {a b : V} (h : G.Adj a b)
    (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b) :
    (toPhys (G := G) P h hne).1 = s(a, b)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.toPhys_eq_of_val
statement:
lemma toPhys_eq_of_val (P : BlockPartition V ι) {a b : V} (h : G.Adj a b)
    (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b) {e : PhysEdge (G := G) P}
    (he : e.1 = s(a, b)) :
    toPhys (G := G) P h hne = e
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [toPhys, he]

name: Nikoghosyan.PhysEdge.eq_toPhys
statement:
lemma PhysEdge.eq_toPhys {P : BlockPartition V ι} (e : PhysEdge (G := G) P) :
    ∃ (a b : V) (h : G.Adj a b) (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b),
      e = toPhys (G := G) P h hne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, he, hadj, hne⟩ := PhysEdge.eq_mk (G := G) e
  exact ⟨a, b, hadj, hne, (toPhys_eq_of_val P hadj hne he).symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.deleteEdges_not_mem_edges
statement:
lemma deleteEdges_not_mem_edges {e : Sym2 V} {u v : V}
    (w : (G.deleteEdges {e}).Walk u v) : e ∉ w.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have : e ∈ (G.deleteEdges {e}).edgeSet := w.edges_subset_edgeSet he
  simp [SimpleGraph.edgeSet_deleteEdges] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.inr_mem_mapWalk_imp_edges
statement:
lemma inr_mem_mapWalk_imp_edges (P : BlockPartition V ι) :
    ∀ {u v : V} (w : G.Walk u v) (e : PhysEdge (G := G) P),
      Sum.inr e ∈ (mapWalk (G := G) P w).support → e.1 ∈ w.edges
proof:
| _, _, Walk.nil, e, h => by
    simp [mapWalk] at h
  | u, _, Walk.cons (v := w) hadj p, e, hmem => by
    have ih := inr_mem_mapWalk_imp_edges P p
    by_cases hEq : P.index u = P.index w
    · rw [mapWalk, dif_pos hEq] at hmem
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _
        (ih e ((support_inl_rec hEq (mapWalk (G := G) P p) (Sum.inr e)).1 hmem))
    · rw [mapWalk, dif_neg hEq] at hmem
      simp only [Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hmem
      rcases hmem with h0 | h1 | hrest
      · cases h0
      · have heq : e = toPhys (G := G) P hadj hEq := Sum.inr.inj h1
        subst heq
        simp [toPhys, Walk.edges_cons]
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih e hrest)

name: Nikoghosyan.mapWalk_not_mem_deleted
statement:
lemma mapWalk_not_mem_deleted (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    {u v : V} {e : PhysEdge (G := G) P}
    (w : (G.deleteEdges {e.1}).Walk u v) :
    Sum.inr e ∉ (mapWalk (G := G) P (w.mapLe (G.deleteEdges_le {e.1}))).support
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hedge :
      e.1 ∈ (w.mapLe (G.deleteEdges_le {e.1})).edges :=
    inr_mem_mapWalk_imp_edges P _ e hmem
  have hedge' : e.1 ∈ w.edges := by
    simpa [Walk.edges_mapLe_eq_edges] using hedge
  exact deleteEdges_not_mem_edges (e := e.1) w hedge'

name: Nikoghosyan.sum_inl_ne_inr
statement:
lemma sum_inl_ne_inr (i : ι) (e : PhysEdge (G := G) P) :
    Sum.inl i ≠ Sum.inr e
proof:
:=
  fun h => (Sum.inr_ne_inl h.symm).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_blocks_of_deleteEdges
statement:
lemma reachable_blocks_of_deleteEdges (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    {u v : V} {e : PhysEdge (G := G) P}
    (h : (G.deleteEdges {e.1}).Reachable u v) :
    (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P) (Sum.inr e)).Reachable
      ⟨Sum.inl (P.index u), sum_inl_ne_inr (P.index u) e⟩
      ⟨Sum.inl (P.index v), sum_inl_ne_inr (P.index v) e⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w⟩ := h
  exact ⟨mapWalkDelete P w⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_endpoint_blocks_of_oneTough
statement:
lemma reachable_endpoint_blocks_of_oneTough (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b) :
    (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P)
        (Sum.inr (toPhys (G := G) P hab hne))).Reachable
      ⟨Sum.inl (P.index a), by intro h; cases h⟩
      ⟨Sum.inl (P.index b), by intro h; cases h⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hconn := deleteEdges_connected_of_oneTough (G := G) hT hord hab
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  have hR := hconn.preconnected a b
  simpa [toPhys_val] using
    reachable_blocks_of_deleteEdges P (e := toPhys (G := G) P hab hne) hR

name: Nikoghosyan.not_splittingVertex_phys_of_oneTough
statement:
lemma not_splittingVertex_phys_of_oneTough (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    (port : V → Port) (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b) :
    ¬ Yeo.SplittingVertex (auxColoring (G := G) P port)
        (Sum.inr (toPhys (G := G) P hab hne))
proof:
:=
  not_splittingVertex_phys (G := G) P port hab hne
    (reachable_endpoint_blocks_of_oneTough P hT hord hab hne)

name: Nikoghosyan.not_splittingVertex_physEdge_of_oneTough
statement:
lemma not_splittingVertex_physEdge_of_oneTough (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    (port : V → Port) (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (e : PhysEdge (G := G) P) :
    ¬ Yeo.SplittingVertex (auxColoring (G := G) P port) (Sum.inr e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hne, rfl⟩ := PhysEdge.eq_toPhys e
  exact not_splittingVertex_phys_of_oneTough P port hT hord hab hne

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_all_blocks_deletePhys
statement:
lemma reachable_all_blocks_deletePhys (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b) (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b)
    (i j : ι) :
    (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P)
        (Sum.inr (toPhys (G := G) P hab hne))).Reachable
      ⟨Sum.inl i, by intro h; cases h⟩
      ⟨Sum.inl j, by intro h; cases h⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ui, hui⟩ := P.nonempty i
  obtain ⟨uj, huj⟩ := P.nonempty j
  have hi : P.index ui = i := P.index_eq hui
  have hj : P.index uj = j := P.index_eq huj
  have hconn := deleteEdges_connected_of_oneTough (G := G) hT hord hab
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hord)
  have hR := hconn.preconnected ui uj
  have hmap :=
    reachable_blocks_of_deleteEdges P
      (e := toPhys (G := G) P hab hne) hR
  simpa [toPhys_val, hi, hj] using hmap

name: Nikoghosyan.endpointOf_eq_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 := endpointOf_mem_edge (G := G) P i e h
  have hy2 := endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) P i e h
  obtain ⟨a, b, he, _, hne⟩ := PhysEdge.eq_mk (G := G) e
  have hx : x = a ∨ x = b := by
    simpa [he] using hx1
  have hy : endpointOf (G := G) P i e h = a ∨
      endpointOf (G := G) P i e h = b := by
    simpa [he] using hy1
  have not_both :
      ¬ (a ∈ P.blocks i ∧ b ∈ P.blocks i) := by
    intro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    exact hne ((P.index_eq ha).trans (P.index_eq hb).symm)
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl
  · rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact hy
    · exact (not_both ⟨hx2, by simpa [hy] using hy2⟩).elim
  · rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact (not_both ⟨by simpa [hy] using hy2, hx2⟩).elim
    · exact hy

name: Nikoghosyan.endpointOf_toPhys_left
statement:
lemma endpointOf_toPhys_left (P : BlockPartition V ι) {a b : V}
    (h : G.Adj a b) (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b) :
    endpointOf (G := G) P (P.index a) (toPhys (G := G) P h hne)
      (toPhys_incident_left (G := G) P h hne) = a
proof:
:=
  endpointOf_eq_of_mem P _ (by simp [toPhys]) (P.mem_index a)

name: Nikoghosyan.endpointOf_toPhys_right
statement:
lemma endpointOf_toPhys_right (P : BlockPartition V ι) {a b : V}
    (h : G.Adj a b) (hne : P.index a ≠ P.index b) :
    endpointOf (G := G) P (P.index b) (toPhys (G := G) P h hne)
      (toPhys_incident_right (G := G) P h hne) = b
proof:
:=
  endpointOf_eq_of_mem P _ (by simp [toPhys]) (P.mem_index b)

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_of_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, he, hadj, hne⟩ := PhysEdge.eq_mk (G := G) e
  have hxi := endpointOf_mem_edge (G := G) P i e hi
  have hxj := endpointOf_mem_edge (G := G) P j e hj
  have hyi := endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) P i e hi
  have hyj := endpointOf_mem_block (G := G) P j e hj
  have hiab : endpointOf (G := G) P i e hi = a ∨
      endpointOf (G := G) P i e hi = b := by
    simpa [he] using hxi
  have hjab : endpointOf (G := G) P j e hj = a ∨
      endpointOf (G := G) P j e hj = b := by
    simpa [he] using hxj
  have hab_ne : a ≠ b := by
    intro h
    subst h
    simp at hne
  have not_same :
      endpointOf (G := G) P i e hi ≠ endpointOf (G := G) P j e hj := by
    intro h
    have : i = j :=
      (P.index_eq hyi).symm.trans (by simp [h, P.index_eq hyj])
    exact hij this
  rcases hiab with hi' | hi' <;> rcases hjab with hj' | hj'
  · exact (not_same (hi'.trans hj'.symm)).elim
  · simpa [hi', hj'] using hadj
  · simpa [hi', hj'] using hadj.symm
  · exact (not_same (hi'.trans hj'.symm)).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GlobalPortData.realizedPath_spec
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (R.realize i hx hy hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_adj_sum
statement:
lemma aux_adj_sum {P : BlockPartition V ι}
    {u v : ι ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) P} (h : (aux (G := G) P).Adj u v) :
    (∃ i e, u = .inl i ∧ v = .inr e) ∨
      (∃ i e, u = .inr e ∧ v = .inl i)
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | inl i =>
    cases v with
    | inl j => exact (aux_not_adj_inl (G := G) i j h).elim
    | inr e => exact Or.inl ⟨i, e, rfl, rfl⟩
  | inr e =>
    cases v with
    | inl i => exact Or.inr ⟨i, e, rfl, rfl⟩
    | inr f => exact (aux_not_adj_inr (G := G) e f h).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_getVert_isBlock
statement:
lemma aux_getVert_isBlock {P : BlockPartition V ι} :
    ∀ {u v : ι ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) P} (w : (aux (G := G) P).Walk u v)
      (n : ℕ), n ≤ w.length →
      ((∃ i, w.getVert n = .inl i) ↔ ((∃ i, u = .inl i) ↔ Even n))
proof:
| _, _, Walk.nil, n, hn => by
    have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hn
    subst hn0
    simp [Walk.getVert]
  | u, _, Walk.cons (v := w) hadj p, n, hn => by
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp [Walk.getVert]
    | succ n' =>
      have hn' : n' ≤ p.length := by
        simpa [Walk.length_cons] using Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hn
      have hopp : (∃ i, w = .inl i) ↔ ¬ ∃ i, u = .inl i := by
        rcases aux_adj_sum hadj with ⟨j, e, hu, hv⟩ | ⟨j, e, hu, hv⟩
        · subst hu
          subst hv
          simp
        · subst hu
          subst hv
          simp
      have hgv : (Walk.cons hadj p).getVert (n' + 1) = p.getVert n' := rfl
      rw [show (∃ i, (Walk.cons hadj p).getVert (n' + 1) = .inl i) ↔
            (∃ i, p.getVert n' = .inl i) by simp [hgv]]
      rw [aux_getVert_isBlock p n' hn']
      rw [hopp, Nat.even_add_one]
      exact not_iff_comm.trans Iff.comm

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_getVert_even_inl
proof:
:= by
  refine (aux_getVert_isBlock w n hn).mpr ?_
  simp [he]

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_cycle_even_length
proof:
:= by
  have hend : w.getVert w.length = .inl i := Walk.getVert_length w
  have : ∃ j, w.getVert w.length = .inl j := ⟨i, hend⟩
  exact ((aux_getVert_isBlock w w.length le_rfl).mp this).mp ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.aux_cycle_four_le
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 3 ≤ w.length := hc.three_le_length
  have he : Even w.length := aux_cycle_even_length hc
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := even_iff_exists_two_mul.mp he
  have : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_block_splitter
statement:
lemma exists_block_splitter [Nonempty ι] (P : BlockPartition V ι)
    (port : V → Port) (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpc : ¬ Yeo.HasProperlyColoredCycle (auxColoring (G := G) P port)) :
    ∃ i : ι, Yeo.SplittingVertex (auxColoring (G := G) P port) (.inl i)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (ι ⊕ PhysEdge (G := G) P) :=
    ⟨.inl (Classical.arbitrary ι)⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
    Yeo.yeo_separator (c := auxColoring (G := G) P port) hpc
  cases v with
  | inl i => exact ⟨i, hv⟩
  | inr e =>
    exact (not_splittingVertex_physEdge_of_oneTough P port hT hord e hv).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.mapWalk_not_mem_block
statement:
lemma mapWalk_not_mem_block {P : BlockPartition V ι} :
    ∀ {u v : V} (w : G.Walk u v) {i : ι}
      (hidx : ∀ x ∈ w.support, P.index x ≠ i),
      Sum.inl i ∉ (mapWalk (G := G) P w).support
proof:
| _, _, Walk.nil, i, hidx, hmem => by
    simp [mapWalk] at hmem
    exact hidx _ (by simp [Walk.support]) (hmem.symm)
  | u, _, Walk.cons (v := w) hadj p, i, hidx, hmem => by
    have hidxp : ∀ x ∈ p.support, P.index x ≠ i := by
      intro x hx
      exact hidx x (by simp [Walk.support_cons, hx])
    by_cases hEq : P.index u = P.index w
    · rw [mapWalk, dif_pos hEq] at hmem
      exact mapWalk_not_mem_block p hidxp
        ((support_inl_rec hEq (mapWalk (G := G) P p) _).1 hmem)
    · rw [mapWalk, dif_neg hEq] at hmem
      simp only [Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hmem
      rcases hmem with h0 | h1 | hrest
      · exact hidx u (by simp) (by cases h0; rfl)
      · cases h1
      · exact mapWalk_not_mem_block p hidxp hrest

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_aux_delete_block
statement:
lemma reachable_aux_delete_block {P : BlockPartition V ι} {i : ι}
    {x y : V} (hx : P.index x ≠ i) (hy : P.index y ≠ i)
    (h : (G.induce {z | P.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P) (.inl i)).Reachable
      ⟨.inl (P.index x), by intro h'; cases h'; exact hx rfl⟩
      ⟨.inl (P.index y), by intro h'; cases h'; exact hy rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨wInd⟩ := h
  let wG : G.Walk x y :=
    wInd.map (Embedding.induce {z | P.index z ≠ i}).toHom
  have hidx : ∀ z ∈ wG.support, P.index z ≠ i := by
    intro z hz
    rw [show wG.support = wInd.support.map
        (Embedding.induce {z | P.index z ≠ i}).toHom from Walk.support_map _ _] at hz
    obtain ⟨sz, _, hval⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz
    have hcoe :
        (Embedding.induce (G := G) {z | P.index z ≠ i}).toHom sz = sz.val :=
      rfl
    have hzval : z = sz.val := hval.symm.trans hcoe
    rw [hzval]
    exact sz.property
  have havoid : ∀ t ∈ (mapWalk (G := G) P wG).support,
      t ∈ Yeo.deleteSet (.inl i) := by
    intro t ht ht'
    subst ht'
    exact mapWalk_not_mem_block wG hidx ht
  exact ⟨(mapWalk (G := G) P wG).induce (Yeo.deleteSet (.inl i)) havoid |>.copy
    (Subtype.ext rfl) (Subtype.ext rfl)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.attachment_port_eq
statement:
lemma attachment_port_eq {P : BlockPartition V ι} (port : V → Port)
    {i : ι} (hsplit : Yeo.SplittingVertex (auxColoring (G := G) P port) (.inl i))
    {x y a b : V}
    (hx : P.index x ≠ i) (hy : P.index y ≠ i)
    (ha : P.index a = i) (hb : P.index b = i)
    (hxa : G.Adj x a) (hyb : G.Adj y b)
    (hW : (G.induce {z | P.index z ≠ i}).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    port a = port b
proof:
:= by
  have hne_xa : P.index x ≠ P.index a := by simpa [ha] using hx
  have hne_yb : P.index y ≠ P.index b := by simpa [hb] using hy
  let ex := toPhys (G := G) P hxa hne_xa
  let ey := toPhys (G := G) P hyb hne_yb
  have hadx : (aux (G := G) P).Adj (.inl (P.index x)) (.inr ex) :=
    toPhys_incident_left (G := G) P hxa hne_xa
  have hady : (aux (G := G) P).Adj (.inl (P.index y)) (.inr ey) :=
    toPhys_incident_left (G := G) P hyb hne_yb
  have hada : (aux (G := G) P).Adj (.inl i) (.inr ex) := by
    simpa [ha] using toPhys_incident_right (G := G) P hxa hne_xa
  have hadb : (aux (G := G) P).Adj (.inl i) (.inr ey) := by
    simpa [hb] using toPhys_incident_right (G := G) P hyb hne_yb
  have hreach_xy := reachable_aux_delete_block hx hy hW
  have hx_e : (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P) (.inl i)).Adj
      ⟨.inl (P.index x), by intro h'; cases h'; exact hx rfl⟩
      ⟨.inr ex, by intro h'; cases h'⟩ := hadx
  have hy_e : (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P) (.inl i)).Adj
      ⟨.inl (P.index y), by intro h'; cases h'; exact hy rfl⟩
      ⟨.inr ey, by intro h'; cases h'⟩ := hady
  have hconn :
      (Yeo.deleteGraph (aux (G := G) P) (.inl i)).Reachable
        ⟨.inr ex, by intro h'; cases h'⟩
        ⟨.inr ey, by intro h'; cases h'⟩ :=
    (hx_e.reachable.symm.trans hreach_xy).trans hy_e.reachable
  have hcol :=
    hsplit ⟨.inr ex, by intro h'; cases h'⟩ ⟨.inr ey, by intro h'; cases h'⟩
      hada hadb hconn
  have enda : endpointOf (G := G) P i ex hada = a := by
    have hi : i = P.index a := ha.symm
    subst hi
    exact endpointOf_toPhys_right P hxa hne_xa
  have endb : endpointOf (G := G) P i ey hadb = b := by
    have hi : i = P.index b := hb.symm
    subst hi
    exact endpointOf_toPhys_right P hyb hne_yb
  have ca : (auxColor (G := G) P port hada).2 = port a := by
    simp [auxColor, enda]
  have cb : (auxColor (G := G) P port hadb).2 = port b := by
    simp [auxColor, endb]
  have hcol2 : (auxColor (G := G) P port hada).2 =
      (auxColor (G := G) P port hadb).2 :=
    congrArg Prod.snd (by simpa [auxColoring] using hcol)
  rw [ca, cb] at hcol2
  exact hcol2

name: Nikoghosyan.two_le_componentCount_of_not_reachable
statement:
lemma two_le_componentCount_of_not_reachable {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (h : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    2 ≤ componentCount G U
proof:
:= by
  let cx := (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx⟩
  let cy := (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hne : cx ≠ cy := by
    intro hxy
    exact h (ConnectedComponent.eq.1 hxy)
  haveI : Nontrivial (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := ⟨cx, cy, hne⟩
  have hlt : 1 < Fintype.card (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    Fintype.one_lt_card
  have : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt
  simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.induce_walk_stays_left
statement:
lemma induce_walk_stays_left {A B : Finset V}
    (hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ A) (hxy : x ∈ A ∪ B) (hy : y ∈ A ∪ B)
    (w : (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Walk ⟨x, hxy⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    y ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  have hvert : ∀ n, n ≤ w.length → (w.getVert n).1 ∈ A := by
    intro n hn
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simpa [Walk.getVert_zero] using hx
    | succ n ih =>
      have hn' : n < w.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hn
      have hadj := w.adj_getVert_succ hn'
      have hAdjG : G.Adj (w.getVert n).1 (w.getVert (n + 1)).1 := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.induce_adj] using hadj
      have hA : (w.getVert n).1 ∈ A := ih (Nat.le_of_lt hn')
      have hneib : (w.getVert (n + 1)).1 ∈ A ∪ B := (w.getVert (n + 1)).property
      rcases mem_union.1 hneib with hA' | hB
      · exact hA'
      · exact (hno _ hA _ hB hAdjG).elim
  simpa [Walk.getVert_length] using hvert w.length le_rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.not_singleton_attachment
statement:
lemma not_singleton_attachment (hT : OneTough G) (_hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : CycleFactor G) {i : Fin F.card} {p : V}
    (hp : p ∈ (F.getCycle i).support)
    (hWne : (univ \ (F.getCycle i).support).Nonempty)
    (hatt : ∀ {x a : V}, a ∈ (F.getCycle i).support →
      x ∈ univ \ (F.getCycle i).support → G.Adj x a → a = p) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hpU : p ∈ (univ : Finset V) := mem_univ p
  let H := (F.getCycle i).support
  let A := H.erase p
  let B := univ \ H
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
    have h3 : 3 ≤ H.card := (F.getCycle i).three_le_card_support
    have hcard : A.card = H.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hp
    have : 0 < A.card := by
      have : 2 ≤ H.card - 1 := Nat.le_sub_of_add_le (by omega)
      omega
    exact card_pos.mp this
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := hWne
  have hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have haH : a ∈ H := mem_of_mem_erase ha
    have hap : a ≠ p := ne_of_mem_erase ha
    have : a = p := hatt (a := a) (x := b) haH (by simpa [B] using hb) hadj.symm
    exact hap this
  have hAU : A ∪ B = univ.erase p := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rw [mem_union] at hz
      rcases hz with hzA | hzB
      · exact mem_erase.2 ⟨ne_of_mem_erase hzA, mem_univ z⟩
      · have hzH : z ∉ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hzB).2
        exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hzp => hzH (hzp ▸ hp), mem_univ z⟩
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨hzp, _⟩ := mem_erase.1 hz
      by_cases hzH : z ∈ H
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_erase.2 ⟨hzp, hzH⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ z, hzH⟩))
  have hxA : hAne.choose ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union_left _ hAne.choose_spec
  have hyB : hBne.choose ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union_right _ hBne.choose_spec
  have hnr :
      ¬ (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨hAne.choose, hxA⟩ ⟨hBne.choose, hyB⟩ := by
    intro hR
    obtain ⟨w⟩ := hR
    have hyA : hBne.choose ∈ A :=
      induce_walk_stays_left hno hAne.choose_spec hxA hyB w
    have hyB' : hBne.choose ∈ B := hBne.choose_spec
    have : hBne.choose ∈ H := mem_of_mem_erase hyA
    have : hBne.choose ∉ H := (mem_sdiff.1 hyB').2
    exact this ‹_ ∈ H›
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (A ∪ B) :=
    two_le_componentCount_of_not_reachable hxA hyB hnr
  have hEq : univ \ {p} = A ∪ B := by
    simp [hAU, sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
  have h2' : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ {p}) := by
    simpa [hEq] using h2
  have hle := hT {p} h2'
  simp at hle
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.OneToughOn.univ_iff
statement: lemma OneToughOn.univ_iff : OneToughOn G univ ↔ OneTough G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h S h2
    simpa using h S (subset_univ S) (by simpa using h2)
  · intro h S _hS h2
    simpa using h S (by simpa using h2)

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_image_subtype_iff
statement:
lemma mem_image_subtype_iff {J : Finset V} {S : Finset (VertexSet J)} {x : V} :
    x ∈ S.image Subtype.val ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ (J : Set V), (⟨x, hx⟩ : VertexSet J) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_image]

name: Nikoghosyan.card_image_subtype
statement:
lemma card_image_subtype (J : Finset V) (S : Finset (VertexSet J)) :
    (S.image Subtype.val).card = S.card
proof:
:=
  card_image_of_injective S Subtype.val_injective

name: Nikoghosyan.image_subtype_subset
statement:
lemma image_subtype_subset (J : Finset V) (S : Finset (VertexSet J)) :
    S.image Subtype.val ⊆ J
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
  exact y.property

name: Nikoghosyan.filter_subtype_image
statement:
lemma filter_subtype_image {J T : Finset V} (hT : T ⊆ J) :
    ((univ : Finset (VertexSet J)).filter fun x => x.val ∈ T).image Subtype.val = T
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
    exact (mem_filter.1 hy).2
  · intro hx
    have hxJ : x ∈ J := hT hx
    refine mem_image.2 ⟨⟨x, hxJ⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.card_filter_subtype
statement:
lemma card_filter_subtype {J T : Finset V} (hT : T ⊆ J) :
    ((univ : Finset (VertexSet J)).filter fun x => x.val ∈ T).card = T.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_image_subtype J, filter_subtype_image hT]

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_cutIso
statement:
lemma componentCount_cutIso (J : Finset V) (S : Finset (VertexSet J)) :
    componentCount (G.induce (J : Set V)) ((univ : Finset (VertexSet J)) \ S) =
      componentCount G (J \ S.image Subtype.val)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [componentCount] using
    Nat.card_congr (cutIso (G := G) J S).connectedComponentEquiv

name: Nikoghosyan.OneToughOn_iff_OneTough_induce
statement:
lemma OneToughOn_iff_OneTough_induce (J : Finset V) :
    OneToughOn G J ↔ OneTough (G.induce (J : Set V))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h S h2
    have hTsub : S.image Subtype.val ⊆ J := image_subtype_subset J S
    have hcount := componentCount_cutIso (G := G) J S
    have h2' : 2 ≤ componentCount G (J \ S.image Subtype.val) := by
      rw [← hcount]
      exact h2
    have hle := h (S.image Subtype.val) hTsub h2'
    rw [← hcount, card_image_subtype] at hle
    exact hle
  · intro h T hT h2
    let S : Finset (VertexSet J) :=
      (univ : Finset (VertexSet J)).filter fun x => x.val ∈ T
    have himg : S.image Subtype.val = T := filter_subtype_image hT
    have hcount := componentCount_cutIso (G := G) J S
    have h2' : 2 ≤ componentCount (G.induce (J : Set V)) (univ \ S) := by
      rw [hcount, himg]
      exact h2
    have hle := h S h2'
    rw [hcount, himg, card_filter_subtype hT] at hle
    exact hle

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_union_le_of_adj
proof:
:= by
  let f : (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((U ∪ W : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    fun C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := U) (s₂ := W)))
  have hf : Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun x => ?_
    rcases mem_union.mp x.property with hxU | hxW
    · refine ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x.val, hxU⟩, ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
    · obtain ⟨u, huU, hadj⟩ := h x.val hxW
      refine ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨u, huU⟩, ?_⟩
      apply ConnectedComponent.sound
      have hu' :
          induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := U) (s₂ := W)) ⟨u, huU⟩ =
            ⟨u, mem_union.2 (Or.inl huU)⟩ := rfl
      rw [hu']
      exact Adj.reachable <| by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj.symm
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce ((U ∪ W : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf

name: Nikoghosyan.union_sdiff_of_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨hxHR, hxST⟩
    rcases hxHR with hxH | hxR
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hxH, fun hxS => hxST (Or.inl hxS)⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxR, fun hxT => hxST (Or.inr hxT)⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hxH, hxS⟩ | ⟨hxR, hxT⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hxH, ?_⟩
      intro hST
      rcases hST with hxS' | hxT'
      · exact hxS hxS'
      · exact (disjoint_left.1 hHR hxH (hT hxT')).elim
    · refine ⟨Or.inr hxR, ?_⟩
      intro hST
      rcases hST with hxS' | hxT'
      · exact (disjoint_right.1 hHR hxR (hS hxS')).elim
      · exact hxT hxT'

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_sdiff_of_disjoint
proof:
:=
  hHR.mono sdiff_subset sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.inter_union_eq_of_subset_union
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_inter]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 (hST hx) with hH | hR
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, hH⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, hR⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with h | h
    · exact h.1
    · exact h.1

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_inter_of_disjoint
proof:
:=
  hHR.mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right

name: Nikoghosyan.card_cut_split
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [inter_union_eq_of_subset_union hST]
  exact card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_inter_of_disjoint hHR)

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_path
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_path (p : GraphPath G) :
    pathCoverNumber G p.support = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G p.support ≤ 1 := by
    simpa [PathCover.ofPath_card] using
      pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (PathCover.ofPath p)
  have hge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) p.support_nonempty
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_eq_one_of_path
statement:
lemma componentCount_eq_one_of_path (p : GraphPath G) :
    componentCount G p.support = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := componentCount_le_pathCover_card (PathCover.ofPath p)
  have hcard : (PathCover.ofPath p).card = 1 := PathCover.ofPath_card p
  haveI : Nonempty (p.support : Set V) := ⟨⟨p.start, p.start_mem_support⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty (G.induce (p.support : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hpos : 0 < componentCount G p.support := Nat.card_pos
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Eligible_of_path_ends
statement:
lemma Eligible_of_path_ends (p : GraphPath G) :
    Eligible G p.support p.start ∧ Eligible G p.support p.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : (PathCover.ofPath p).card = pathCoverNumber G p.support := by
    rw [PathCover.ofPath_card, pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_path p]
  exact ⟨⟨PathCover.ofPath p, hmin, p, List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩,
    ⟨PathCover.ofPath p, hmin, p, List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_path_sdiff_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G) p.support T hT
  have hp := pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_path p
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_path_sdiff_le_of_endpoint
proof:
:= by
  have hE : Eligible G p.support x := by
    rcases hxend with rfl | rfl
    · exact (Eligible_of_path_ends p).1
    · exact (Eligible_of_path_ends p).2
  have h := componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible (G := G) hT hxT hE
  have hp := pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_path p
  have hpos : 1 ≤ T.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hxT⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.k0_cograph_of_xrow
statement:
lemma k0_cograph_of_xrow
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {H X : Finset V} (hHX : Disjoint H X) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ X) :
    IsCograph G (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H x)
proof:
:=
  xrow_cograph_complement_of_host hpat hHX hx

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_k0_of_saturated
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_k0_of_saturated {H : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hSat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) H (rowProfile (G := G) H x)) :
    pathCoverNumber G (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H x) =
      (rowProfile (G := G) H x).card
proof:
:=
  hSat

name: Nikoghosyan.eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_canonicalContainer
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hz' := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hz
    have hzU : z ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hz'.1).1
    have hzA : z ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hz'.1).2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzU, ?_⟩
    intro hzS
    have hzAF : z ∈ A ∪ ineligibleSet G (U \ A) := by
      simpa [Cograph.canonicalContainer_eq] using hzS
    rcases mem_union.1 hzAF with hzA' | hzF
    · exact hzA hzA'
    · exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hzF |>.2 hz'.2
  · intro hz
    have hzU : z ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzS : z ∉ Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) U A :=
      (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    have hzA : z ∉ A := fun h =>
      hzS (Cograph.mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A h)
    have hzK : z ∈ U \ A := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzU, hzA⟩
    have hE : Eligible G (U \ A) z := by
      by_contra hnot
      exact hzS (by
        simpa [Cograph.canonicalContainer_eq] using
          mem_union.2 (Or.inr ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzK, hnot⟩)))
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzK, hE⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.drow_not_subset_S
statement:
lemma drow_not_subset_S
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH : GraphCycle G) {X : Finset V}
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support X)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V} {d x : V}
    (hDrow : (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
      IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hx : x ∈ X)
    (hXsat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x))
    (hXgate : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T) :
    ¬ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  intro hsub
  set H := cH.support
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) H x
  set C := rowProfile (G := G) H d
  have hAne := xrow_nonempty_of_noncograph_host hpat hHX hHnc hx
  have hKA := xrow_cograph_complement_of_host hpat hHX hx
  have hCne := hDrow.1
  have hKC := hDrow.2.1
  have hSatC := hDrow.2.2.1
  have hgateC := hDrow.2.2.2
  have hAsub : A ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H x
  have hCsub : C ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H d
  have hTgt : Cograph.Tight (G := G) H S := by
    have :=
      (Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical
        (G := G) hAsub hAne hKA hXsat).1
    simpa [hXgate] using this
  have hAS : A ⊆ S := by
    intro z hz
    have hzS :=
      Cograph.mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A (G := G) (U := H) (A := A) hz
    simpa [hXgate] using hzS
  have hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ C, ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) H a b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    exact no_spanning_both_in_tight cH rfl hTgt (hAS ha) (hsub hb)
  have hinc :=
    Cograph.incompatible_saturated_profiles (G := G) cH rfl hAsub hAne hKA
      hCsub hCne hKC (Or.inl hXsat) hno
  have heq : S = T := hXgate.symm.trans (hinc.2.2.2.trans hgateC)
  exact hST heq

name: Nikoghosyan.drow_meets_eligible_of_distinct_gates
statement:
lemma drow_meets_eligible_of_distinct_gates
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH : GraphCycle G) {X : Finset V}
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support X)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V} {d x : V}
    (hDrow : (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
      IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hx : x ∈ X)
    (hXsat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x))
    (hXgate : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T) :
    ∃ u ∈ eligibleSet G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x),
      G.Adj d u
proof:
:= by
  have hnot :=
    drow_not_subset_S hpat cH hHX hHnc hDrow hx hXsat hXgate hST
  obtain ⟨u, huC, huS⟩ : ∃ u ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d, u ∉ S := by
    by_contra hnone
    apply hnot
    intro z hz
    by_contra hzS
    exact hnone ⟨z, hz, hzS⟩
  have hu' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 huC
  have hAsub : rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x ⊆ cH.support :=
    rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support x
  have huE : u ∈ eligibleSet G
      (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x) := by
    have : u ∈
        cH.support \
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x) :=
      mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hu'.1, by simpa [hXgate] using huS⟩
    simpa [eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_canonicalContainer hAsub] using this
  exact ⟨u, huE, hu'.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_K_of_anticomplete_x
statement:
lemma isCograph_K_of_anticomplete_x
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {H D : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hxH : x ∉ H) (hxD : x ∉ D)
    (hanti : ∀ d ∈ D, ¬ G.Adj x d) :
    IsCograph G ((H \ rowProfile (G := G) H x) ∪ D)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have nAdj {z : V}
      (hz : z ∈ (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H x) ∪ D) : ¬ G.Adj x z := by
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzH | hzD
    · have hzrow : z ∉ rowProfile (G := G) H x := (mem_sdiff.1 hzH).2
      intro hadj
      exact hzrow ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨(mem_sdiff.1 hzH).1, hadj⟩)
    · exact hanti z hzD
  have hne {z : V}
      (hz : z ∈ (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H x) ∪ D) : x ≠ z := by
    intro h
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzH | hzD
    · exact hxH (h ▸ (mem_sdiff.1 hzH).1)
    · exact hxD (h ▸ hzD)
  have : ¬ (G.Adj x a ∨ G.Adj x b ∨ G.Adj x c ∨ G.Adj x d) := by
    simp [nAdj ha, nAdj hb, nAdj hc, nAdj hd]
  exact this <|
    hpat hp (hne ha) (hne hb) (hne hc) (hne hd)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_of_strict_merger_of_AA_path
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_strict_merger_of_AA_path
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD cX : GraphCycle G)
    (hHD : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support cX.support)
    (hDX : Disjoint cD.support cX.support)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V}
    (hDrows : ∀ d ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hXsat : ∀ y ∈ cX.support,
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) ∧
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ cX.support)
    (_hanti : ∀ d ∈ cD.support, ¬ G.Adj x d)
    (p : GraphPath G)
    (hp : p.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    (hs : p.start ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x)
    (hf : p.finish ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x)
    (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ cX.support
proof:
:= by
  have hxH : x ∉ cH.support := disjoint_right.1 hHX hx
  have hxD : x ∉ cD.support := disjoint_right.1 hDX hx
  have hxP : x ∉ p.support := by
    intro hx'
    have hxQ : x ∈ cH.support ∪ cD.support := by simpa [hp] using hx'
    exact (mem_union.1 hxQ).elim hxH hxD
  have hadjs : G.Adj x p.start := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hs |>.2
  have hadjf : G.Adj p.finish x :=
    ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hf |>.2).symm
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_graphCycle_insert p hadjs hadjf hxP hne
  have hc0' : c0.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ {x} := by
    rw [hc0, hp, insert_eq, union_comm, union_assoc]
  exact exists_cycle_of_rooted_prefix_restoration hpat cH cD cX
    hHD hHX hDX hHnc hDrows hXsat hST c0 hx hc0'

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_of_strict_merger
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_strict_merger
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD cX : GraphCycle G)
    (hHD : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support cX.support)
    (hDX : Disjoint cD.support cX.support)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V}
    (hDrows : ∀ d ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hXsat : ∀ y ∈ cX.support,
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) ∧
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ cX.support)
    (hanti : ∀ d ∈ cD.support, ¬ G.Adj x d)
    (hpK : pathCoverNumber G
        ((cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x) ∪ cD.support) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support x).card) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ cX.support
proof:
:= by
  set H := cH.support
  set D := cD.support
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) H x
  have hAsub : A ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H x
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    xrow_nonempty_of_noncograph_host hpat hHX hHnc hx
  have hK0 : IsCograph G (H \ A) := k0_cograph_of_xrow hpat hHX hx
  have hpK0 : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_k0_of_saturated (hXsat x hx).1
  have hxH : x ∉ H := disjoint_right.1 hHX hx
  have hxD : x ∉ D := disjoint_right.1 hDX hx
  have hK : IsCograph G ((H \ A) ∪ D) :=
    isCograph_K_of_anticomplete_x hpat hxH hxD hanti
  have hE : ∀ d ∈ D, ∃ u ∈ eligibleSet G (H \ A), G.Adj d u := by
    intro d hd
    exact drow_meets_eligible_of_distinct_gates hpat cH hHX hHnc
      (hDrows d hd) hx (hXsat x hx).1 (hXsat x hx).2 hST
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hf, hne, _⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_strict_absorption (H := H) (D := D) (A := A)
      cH cD rfl rfl hHD hAsub hAne hK0 hpK0 hK hE hpK
  exact exists_cycle_of_strict_merger_of_AA_path hpat cH cD cX
    hHD hHX hDX hHnc hDrows hXsat hST hx hanti p hp hs hf hne

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_adj
proof:
:= by
  let f : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
        (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent
    | .inl C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))
    | .inr C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A)))
  have hf : Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun z => ?_
    rcases mem_union.mp z.property with hA | hB
    · refine ⟨.inl ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z.val, hA⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
    · refine ⟨.inr ((G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z.val, hB⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
  have hnotinj : ¬ Injective f := by
    intro hinj
    let Ca := (G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨a, ha⟩
    let Cb := (G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hmap : f (.inl Ca) = f (.inr Cb) := by
      apply ConnectedComponent.sound
      have ha' :
          induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := B)) ⟨a, ha⟩ =
            ⟨a, mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)⟩ := rfl
      have hb' :
          induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A) (s₂ := B)) ⟨b, hb⟩ =
            ⟨b, mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb)⟩ := rfl
      refine Adj.reachable ?_
      rw [ha', hb']
      exact (SimpleGraph.induce_adj (G := G)).2 hadj
    exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (hinj hmap)
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hlt :
      Fintype.card ((G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) <
        Fintype.card
          ((G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
            (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.card_lt_of_surjective_not_injective f hf hnotinj
  simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_mem
statement:
lemma componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_mem {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hxA : x ∈ A) (hxB : x ∈ B) :
    componentCount G (A ∪ B) + 1 ≤
      componentCount G A + componentCount G B
proof:
:= by
  let f : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
        (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent
    | .inl C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))
    | .inr C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A)))
  have hf : Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun z => ?_
    rcases mem_union.mp z.property with hA | hB
    · refine ⟨.inl ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z.val, hA⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
    · refine ⟨.inr ((G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z.val, hB⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
  have hnotinj : ¬ Injective f := by
    intro hinj
    let Ca := (G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxA⟩
    let Cb := (G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxB⟩
    have hmap : f (.inl Ca) = f (.inr Cb) := by
      apply ConnectedComponent.sound
      exact Reachable.rfl
    exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (hinj hmap)
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hlt :
      Fintype.card ((G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) <
        Fintype.card
          ((G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
            (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.card_lt_of_surjective_not_injective f hf hnotinj
  simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt

name: Nikoghosyan.OneToughOn_of_cycle
statement: lemma OneToughOn_of_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) : OneToughOn G c.support
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS h2
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hempty
    have hSemp : S = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
    have : componentCount G (c.support \ S) = 1 := by
      simpa [hSemp] using componentCount_cycle_eq_one c
    omega
  exact componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le c hS hSne

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_union_cycles_of_row
statement:
lemma componentCount_union_cycles_of_row {cH cD : GraphCycle G}
    (hrow : ∀ d ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty) :
    componentCount G (cH.support ∪ cD.support) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hadj : ∀ d ∈ cD.support, ∃ u ∈ cH.support, G.Adj d u := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hrow d hd
    have hu' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hu
    exact ⟨u, hu'.1, hu'.2⟩
  have hle :=
    componentCount_union_le_of_adj (U := cH.support) (W := cD.support) hadj
  haveI : Nonempty ((cH.support ∪ cD.support : Finset V) : Set V) :=
    ⟨⟨cH.start, mem_union.2 (Or.inl cH.start_mem_support)⟩⟩
  have hpos : 0 < componentCount G (cH.support ∪ cD.support) := Nat.card_pos
  have hH : componentCount G cH.support = 1 := componentCount_cycle_eq_one cH
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.xrow_nonempty_of_noncograph_host
statement:
lemma xrow_nonempty_of_noncograph_host
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {H X : Finset V} (hHX : Disjoint H X)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G H) {y : V} (hy : y ∈ X) :
    (rowProfile (G := G) H y).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hempty
  have hnone : ∀ h ∈ H, ¬ G.Adj y h := by
    intro h hh hadj
    exact hempty ⟨h, (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hh, hadj⟩⟩
  have hHnc' : ∃ a b c d : V,
      a ∈ H ∧ b ∈ H ∧ c ∈ H ∧ d ∈ H ∧ InducedP4 G a b c d := by
    by_contra hnone'
    apply hHnc
    intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact hnone' ⟨a, b, c, d, ha, hb, hc, hd, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, ha, hb, hc, hd, hp⟩ := hHnc'
  have hyH : y ∉ H := disjoint_right.1 hHX hy
  have hne {z : V} (hz : z ∈ H) : y ≠ z := fun h => hyH (h ▸ hz)
  have := hpat hp (hne ha) (hne hb) (hne hc) (hne hd)
  rcases this with h | h | h | h
  · exact hnone a ha h
  · exact hnone b hb h
  · exact hnone c hc h
  · exact hnone d hd h

name: Nikoghosyan.xrow_cograph_complement_of_host
statement:
lemma xrow_cograph_complement_of_host
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
