    {H X : Finset V} (hHX : Disjoint H X) {y : V} (hy : y ∈ X) :
    IsCograph G (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H y)
proof:
:=
  isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile (H := H) (R := X) hHX hy
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp hxa hxb hxc hxd =>
      hpat hp hxa hxb hxc hxd)

name: Nikoghosyan.no_spanning_both_in_tight
proof:
:= by
  intro hR
  have hS : T ⊆ U := hT.1
  have hxy : a ≠ b := hR.1
  have hle :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_le_of_both_endpoints (G := G) (U := U)
      (S := T) hS ha hb hxy (by simpa [hc] using hR)
  have hpos : 1 ≤ T.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨a, ha⟩)
  have heq : componentCount G (U \ T) = T.card := hT.2
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.drow_subset_gate
statement:
lemma drow_subset_gate {H : Finset V} {d : V} {T : Finset V}
    (hCsub : rowProfile (G := G) H d ⊆ H)
    (hCne : (rowProfile (G := G) H d).Nonempty)
    (hKC : IsCograph G (H \ rowProfile (G := G) H d))
    (hSatC : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) H (rowProfile (G := G) H d))
    (hgateC : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) H
        (rowProfile (G := G) H d) = T) :
    rowProfile (G := G) H d ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have : z ∈ Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) H
      (rowProfile (G := G) H d) :=
    Cograph.mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A (U := H)
      (A := rowProfile (G := G) H d) hz
  simpa [hgateC] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.xrow_not_subset_T
statement:
lemma xrow_not_subset_T
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH : GraphCycle G) {X : Finset V}
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support X)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V} {d y : V}
    (hDrow : (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
      IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hy : y ∈ X)
    (hXsat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y))
    (hXgate : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T) :
    ¬ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  intro hsub
  set H := cH.support
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) H y
  set C := rowProfile (G := G) H d
  have hAne := xrow_nonempty_of_noncograph_host hpat hHX hHnc hy
  have hKA := xrow_cograph_complement_of_host hpat hHX hy
  have hCne := hDrow.1
  have hKC := hDrow.2.1
  have hSatC := hDrow.2.2.1
  have hgateC := hDrow.2.2.2
  have hAsub : A ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H y
  have hCsub : C ⊆ H := rowProfile_subset (G := G) H d
  have hTgt : Cograph.Tight (G := G) H T := by
    have :=
      (Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical
        (G := G) hCsub hCne hKC hSatC).1
    simpa [hgateC] using this
  have hCT : C ⊆ T :=
    drow_subset_gate hCsub hCne hKC hSatC hgateC
  have hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ C, ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) H a b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    exact no_spanning_both_in_tight cH rfl hTgt (hsub ha) (hCT hb)
  have hinc :=
    Cograph.incompatible_saturated_profiles (G := G) cH rfl hAsub hAne hKA
      hCsub hCne hKC (Or.inr hSatC) hno
  have heq : S = T :=
    hXgate.symm.trans (hinc.2.2.2.trans hgateC)
  exact hST heq

name: Nikoghosyan.xrow_meets_H_sdiff_T
statement:
lemma xrow_meets_H_sdiff_T
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH : GraphCycle G) {X : Finset V}
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support X)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V} {d y : V}
    (hDrow : (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
      IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hy : y ∈ X)
    (hXsat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y))
    (hXgate : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T) :
    ∃ u ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y, u ∉ T
proof:
:= by
  have hnot :=
    xrow_not_subset_T hpat cH hHX hHnc hDrow hy hXsat hXgate hST
  by_contra hnone
  apply hnot
  intro z hz
  by_contra hzT
  exact hnone ⟨z, hz, hzT⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_Q_union_prefix
statement:
lemma oneToughOn_Q_union_prefix
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD cX : GraphCycle G)
    (hHD : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support cX.support)
    (hDX : Disjoint cD.support cX.support)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V}
    (hDrows : ∀ d ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hXsat : ∀ y ∈ cX.support,
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) ∧
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T)
    (c0 : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ cX.support)
    (hc0 : c0.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ {x})
    (r : GraphPath G) (hr : r.support = cX.support) (hst : r.start = x)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ r.walk.length) :
    OneToughOn G
      (cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ (r.prefixTake n).support)
proof:
:= by
  intro ST hST' h2
  set H := cH.support
  set D := cD.support
  set Q := H ∪ D
  set R := (r.prefixTake n).support
  set U := ST ∩ Q
  set W := ST ∩ R
  have hQR : Disjoint Q R := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro z hzQ hzR
    have hzX : z ∈ cX.support := by
      simpa [hr] using r.support_prefixTake_subset n hzR
    rcases mem_union.1 hzQ with hzH | hzD
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hHX hzH hzX
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hDX hzD hzX
  have hU : U ⊆ Q := inter_subset_right
  have hW : W ⊆ R := inter_subset_right
  have hcard : ST.card = U.card + W.card := by
    have hSTQ : ST ⊆ Q ∪ R := by
      intro z hz
      have := hST' hz
      simpa [union_assoc] using this
    simpa [U, W] using card_cut_split hQR hSTQ
  have hrem : (Q ∪ R) \ ST = (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) := by
    have hSTQ : ST ⊆ Q ∪ R := by
      intro z hz
      have := hST' hz
      simpa [union_assoc] using this
    nth_rw 1 [inter_union_eq_of_subset_union hSTQ]
    exact union_sdiff_of_disjoint hQR hU hW
  have hJ : Q ∪ R = H ∪ D ∪ R := by simp [Q, union_assoc]
  rw [← hJ, hrem] at h2 ⊢
  rw [hcard]
  have hxQ : x ∉ Q := by
    intro hxQ'
    rcases mem_union.1 hxQ' with hxH | hxD
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hHX hxH hx
    · exact disjoint_left.1 hDX hxD hx
  have hxR : x ∈ R := by
    have hst' : (r.prefixTake n).start = x :=
      (GraphPath.start_prefixTake r n).trans hst
    simpa [hst'] using (r.prefixTake n).start_mem_support
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := cD.support_nonempty
  obtain ⟨d0, hd0⟩ := hDne
  have hDrow0 := hDrows d0 hd0
  have hXrow : ∀ y ∈ R,
      (rowProfile (G := G) H y).Nonempty ∧
        ∃ u ∈ rowProfile (G := G) H y, u ∉ T := by
    intro y hy
    have hyX : y ∈ cX.support := by
      simpa [hr] using r.support_prefixTake_subset n hy
    have hsat := hXsat y hyX
    refine ⟨xrow_nonempty_of_noncograph_host hpat hHX hHnc hyX, ?_⟩
    exact xrow_meets_H_sdiff_T hpat cH hHX hHnc hDrow0 hyX hsat.1 hsat.2 hST
  have hQconn : componentCount G Q = 1 :=
    componentCount_union_cycles_of_row (cH := cH) (cD := cD)
      (fun d hd => (hDrows d hd).1)
  have hRpath : R = (r.prefixTake n).support := rfl
  by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
  · have hWne : W.Nonempty := ⟨x, hxW⟩
    have hpath : componentCount G (R \ W) ≤ W.card :=
      componentCount_path_sdiff_le_of_endpoint (r.prefixTake n) hW
        (x := x) hxW
        (Or.inl ((hst.symm).trans (GraphPath.start_prefixTake r n).symm))
    set UH := U ∩ H
    set UD := U ∩ D
    have hUcard : U.card = UH.card + UD.card := by
      have hUD : Disjoint H D := hHD
      have hUsub : U ⊆ H ∪ D := hU
      simpa [UH, UD, Q] using card_cut_split hUD (by
        intro z hz; simpa [Q] using hU hz)
    have hQrem : Q \ U = (H \ UH) ∪ (D \ UD) := by
      have : U = UH ∪ UD := by
        simpa [UH, UD, Q] using
          inter_union_eq_of_subset_union (H := H) (R := D) (ST := U)
            (by intro z hz; simpa [Q] using hU hz)
      have hdisj : Disjoint H D := hHD
      have hUH : UH ⊆ H := inter_subset_right
      have hUD' : UD ⊆ D := inter_subset_right
      simpa [this] using
        union_sdiff_of_disjoint (H := H) (R := D) (S := UH) (T := UD)
          hdisj hUH hUD'
    by_cases hUHne : UH.Nonempty
    · by_cases hUDne : UD.Nonempty
      · have hHle : componentCount G (H \ UH) ≤ UH.card :=
          componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le cH (inter_subset_right) hUHne
        have hDle : componentCount G (D \ UD) ≤ UD.card :=
          componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le cD (inter_subset_right) hUDne
        have hbase :=
          componentCount_union_le (G := G) (H \ UH) (D \ UD)
        have htot :=
          componentCount_union_le (G := G) ((H \ UH) ∪ (D \ UD)) (R \ W)
        have : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = ((H \ UH) ∪ (D \ UD)) ∪ (R \ W) := by
          simp [hQrem]
        rw [this]
        omega
      · 
        have hUDemp : UD = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hUDne
        have hUsubH : U ⊆ H := by
          intro z hz
          have hzQ : z ∈ Q := hU hz
          rcases mem_union.1 hzQ with hzH | hzD
          · exact hzH
          · have : z ∈ UD := mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hzD⟩
            simp [hUDemp] at this
        have hUHU : UH = U := by
          ext z
          constructor
          · intro hz; exact (mem_inter.1 hz).1
          · intro hz; exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hUsubH hz⟩
        have hHle : componentCount G (H \ UH) ≤ UH.card :=
          componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le cH (by simpa [hUHU] using hUsubH)
            (by simpa [hUHU] using hUHne)
        have hD1 : componentCount G D = 1 := componentCount_cycle_eq_one cD
        by_cases hex : ∃ a ∈ H \ UH, ∃ b ∈ D, G.Adj a b
        · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hadj⟩ := hex
          have hdisjHD : Disjoint (H \ UH) D :=
            hHD.mono sdiff_subset Subset.rfl
          have hbase : componentCount G ((H \ UH) ∪ D) ≤ UH.card := by
            have hle :=
              componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_adj hdisjHD ha hb hadj
            omega
          have htot :=
            componentCount_union_le (G := G) ((H \ UH) ∪ D) (R \ W)
          have : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = ((H \ UH) ∪ D) ∪ (R \ W) := by
            simp [hQrem, hUDemp]
          rw [this]
          omega
        · 
          push Not at hex
          have hCrow : rowProfile (G := G) H d0 ⊆ UH := by
            intro z hz
            have hzH : z ∈ H := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hz |>.1
            have hadj : G.Adj d0 z := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hz |>.2
            by_contra hzU
            exact hex z (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzH, hzU⟩) d0 hd0 hadj.symm
          have hbase :
              componentCount G ((H \ UH) ∪ D) ≤ UH.card + 1 := by
            have hsum := componentCount_union_le (G := G) (H \ UH) D
            omega
          by_cases htight : componentCount G (H \ UH) = UH.card
          · have hTgtU : Cograph.Tight (G := G) H UH :=
              ⟨by simpa [hUHU] using hUsubH, htight⟩
            have hCsub : rowProfile (G := G) H d0 ⊆ H :=
              rowProfile_subset (G := G) H d0
            have hspec :=
              Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical
                (G := G) hCsub hDrow0.1 hDrow0.2.1 hDrow0.2.2.1
            have hUsubT : UH ⊆ T := by
              have hle := hspec.2.2 UH hTgtU (fun z hz => hCrow hz)
              simpa [H, hDrow0.2.2.2] using hle
            have hadjR : ∀ z ∈ R \ W, ∃ u ∈ H \ UH, G.Adj z u := by
              intro z hz
              obtain ⟨_, ⟨u, hu, huT⟩⟩ := hXrow z (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
              have hu' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hu
              have huU : u ∉ UH := fun h => huT (hUsubT h)
              exact ⟨u, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hu'.1, huU⟩, hu'.2⟩
            have hpref :
                componentCount G (((H \ UH) ∪ D) ∪ (R \ W)) ≤
                  componentCount G ((H \ UH) ∪ D) :=
              componentCount_union_le_of_adj
                (U := (H \ UH) ∪ D) (W := R \ W)
                (fun z hz => by
                  obtain ⟨u, hu, hadj⟩ := hadjR z hz
                  exact ⟨u, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hu), hadj⟩)
            have : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = ((H \ UH) ∪ D) ∪ (R \ W) := by
              simp [hQrem, hUDemp]
            rw [this]
            have hWpos : 1 ≤ W.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hWne)
            omega
          · have hlt : componentCount G (H \ UH) + 1 ≤ UH.card := by omega
            have hsum := componentCount_union_le (G := G) (H \ UH) D
            have hbase' : componentCount G ((H \ UH) ∪ D) ≤ UH.card := by
              omega
            have htot :=
              componentCount_union_le (G := G) ((H \ UH) ∪ D) (R \ W)
            have : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = ((H \ UH) ∪ D) ∪ (R \ W) := by
              simp [hQrem, hUDemp]
            rw [this]
            omega

    · 
      have hUHemp : UH = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hUHne
      have hHrem : H \ UH = H := by simp [hUHemp]
      have hadjD : ∀ z ∈ D \ UD, ∃ u ∈ H, G.Adj z u := by
        intro z hz
        have hzD : z ∈ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hDrows z hzD).1
        have hu' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hu
        exact ⟨u, hu'.1, hu'.2⟩
      have hadjR : ∀ z ∈ R \ W, ∃ u ∈ H, G.Adj z u := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hAne, ⟨u, hu, _⟩⟩ := hXrow z (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
        have hu' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hu
        exact ⟨u, hu'.1, hu'.2⟩
      have hbase : componentCount G (H ∪ (D \ UD)) ≤ 1 := by
        have hH1 : componentCount G H = 1 := componentCount_cycle_eq_one cH
        exact (componentCount_union_le_of_adj (U := H) (W := D \ UD) hadjD).trans
          (le_of_eq hH1)
      have htot :
          componentCount G (H ∪ ((D \ UD) ∪ (R \ W))) ≤ 1 := by
        have hadj :
            ∀ z ∈ (D \ UD) ∪ (R \ W), ∃ u ∈ H, G.Adj z u := by
          intro z hz
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hD' | hR'
          · exact hadjD z hD'
          · exact hadjR z hR'
        have hH1 : componentCount G H = 1 := componentCount_cycle_eq_one cH
        exact (componentCount_union_le_of_adj
            (U := H) (W := (D \ UD) ∪ (R \ W)) hadj).trans (le_of_eq hH1)
      have hrest : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = H ∪ ((D \ UD) ∪ (R \ W)) := by
        simp [hQrem, hHrem, union_assoc]
      have : componentCount G ((Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W)) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [hrest]
        exact htot
      omega
  · 
    have hxPref : x ∈ R \ W := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxR, hxW⟩
    by_cases hUemp : U = ∅
    · have hQU : Q \ U = Q := by simp [hUemp]
      have hadjR : ∀ z ∈ R \ W, ∃ u ∈ Q, G.Adj z u := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hAne, ⟨u, hu, _⟩⟩ := hXrow z (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
        have hu' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hu
        exact ⟨u, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hu'.1), hu'.2⟩
      have hle :=
        componentCount_union_le_of_adj (U := Q) (W := R \ W) hadjR
      have hQUeq : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = Q ∪ (R \ W) := by simp [hQU]
      have : componentCount G ((Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W)) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [hQUeq]
        exact hle.trans (le_of_eq hQconn)
      omega
    · have hUne : U.Nonempty := (nonempty_iff_ne_empty (s := U)).2 hUemp
      have hxU : x ∉ U := fun hxU => hxQ (hU hxU)
      have hUsub : U ⊆ c0.support := by
        intro z hz
        have hzQ : z ∈ Q := hU hz
        have : z ∈ Q ∪ {x} := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzQ)
        simpa [hc0] using this
      have hcle : componentCount G (c0.support \ U) ≤ U.card :=
        componentCount_cycle_sdiff_le c0 hUsub hUne
      have hBase : c0.support \ U = (Q \ U) ∪ {x} := by
        have hsup : c0.support = insert x Q := by
          rw [hc0, insert_eq, union_comm]
        have hxU' : x ∉ U := hxU
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          have hz' := mem_sdiff.1 hz
          have hzins : z ∈ insert x Q := by simpa [hsup] using hz'.1
          rcases mem_insert.1 hzins with hzx | hzQ
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (by simpa [hzx] using mem_singleton_self z))
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzQ, hz'.2⟩))
        · intro hz
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hQU | hxsing
          · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨by
              have : z ∈ insert x Q :=
                mem_insert_of_mem (mem_sdiff.1 hQU).1
              simpa [hsup] using this, (mem_sdiff.1 hQU).2⟩
          · have hzX : z = x := mem_singleton.1 hxsing
            subst hzX
            exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨by
              simpa [hsup] using mem_insert_self x Q, hxU'⟩
      have hxBase : x ∈ c0.support \ U := by
        simp [hBase]
      have hpath : componentCount G (R \ W) ≤ W.card + 1 :=
        componentCount_path_sdiff_le (r.prefixTake n) hW
      have hinter : x ∈ (c0.support \ U) ∩ (R \ W) :=
        mem_inter.2 ⟨hxBase, hxPref⟩
      have hmerge :=
        componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_mem (G := G)
          (A := c0.support \ U) (B := R \ W) (x := x)
          hxBase hxPref
      have hcup : (Q \ U) ∪ (R \ W) = (c0.support \ U) ∪ (R \ W) := by
        rw [hBase, union_assoc]
        have : ({x} : Finset V) ∪ (R \ W) = R \ W :=
          union_eq_right.2 (singleton_subset_iff.2 hxPref)
        rw [this]
      rw [hcup]
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_of_rooted_prefixTake
statement:
lemma exists_cycle_of_rooted_prefixTake
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD cX : GraphCycle G)
    (hHD : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support cX.support)
    (hDX : Disjoint cD.support cX.support)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V}
    (hDrows : ∀ d ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hXsat : ∀ y ∈ cX.support,
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) ∧
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T)
    (c0 : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ cX.support)
    (hc0 : c0.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ {x})
    (r : GraphPath G) (hr : r.support = cX.support) (hst : r.start = x)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ r.walk.length) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ (r.prefixTake n).support
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨c0, ?_⟩
    rw [hc0, r.support_prefixTake_zero, hst]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn0 : n ≤ r.walk.length := Nat.le_of_succ_le hn
    have hnlt : n < r.walk.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hn
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := ih hn0
    set y := r.walk.getVert (n + 1)
    have hyX : y ∈ cX.support := by
      simpa [hr] using r.getVert_mem_path_support (n + 1)
    have hyH : y ∉ cH.support := disjoint_right.1 hHX hyX
    have hyD : y ∉ cD.support := disjoint_right.1 hDX hyX
    have hyQ : y ∉ cH.support ∪ cD.support := fun h =>
      (mem_union.1 h).elim hyH hyD
    have hyP : y ∉ (r.prefixTake n).support :=
      r.next_not_mem_prefixTake hnlt
    have hy : y ∉ γ.support := by
      rw [hγ]
      exact fun h => (mem_union.1 h).elim hyQ hyP
    have hinsert :
        insert y γ.support =
          cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ (r.prefixTake (n + 1)).support := by
      rw [hγ, insert_union_right, r.support_prefixTake_succ hnlt]
    have hJ : OneToughOn G (insert y γ.support) := by
      rw [hinsert]
      exact oneToughOn_Q_union_prefix hpat cH cD cX hHD hHX hDX hHnc
        hDrows hXsat hST c0 hx hc0 r hr hst hn
    have hOn :
        NoInducedP4UnionP1On G (insert y γ.support) :=
      NoInducedP4UnionP1On.of_global hpat _
    have hK : IsCograph G
        (γ.support \ rowProfile (G := G) γ.support y) :=
      isCograph_current_remainder γ hy hOn
    obtain ⟨γ', hγ', _⟩ :=
      exists_original_cycle_of_vertex_insertion γ hy hJ hK
    refine ⟨γ', ?_⟩
    simpa [hinsert] using hγ'

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cycle_of_rooted_prefix_restoration
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_rooted_prefix_restoration
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (cH cD cX : GraphCycle G)
    (hHD : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHX : Disjoint cH.support cX.support)
    (hDX : Disjoint cD.support cX.support)
    (hHnc : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    {T S : Finset V}
    (hDrows : ∀ d ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
          Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) ∧
            Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support d) = T)
    (hXsat : ∀ y ∈ cX.support,
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) ∧
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S)
    (hST : S ≠ T)
    (c0 : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ cX.support)
    (hc0 : c0.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ {x}) :
    ∃ γ : GraphCycle G,
      γ.support = cH.support ∪ cD.support ∪ cX.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hst, _⟩ := Cograph.exists_spanning_path_from cX hx
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ :=
    exists_cycle_of_rooted_prefixTake hpat cH cD cX hHD hHX hDX hHnc
      hDrows hXsat hST c0 hx hc0 r hr hst r.walk.length le_rfl
  refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
  simpa [hr, r.support_prefixTake_length] using hγ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.trimStart_start
statement:
lemma trimStart_start (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).start = p.walk.snd
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.length_walk_trimStart
statement:
lemma length_walk_trimStart (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).walk.length + 1 = p.walk.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hadj, q, hq⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 h
  simp [trimStart, hq]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.snd_mem_support_of_not_nil
statement:
lemma snd_mem_support_of_not_nil (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.walk.snd ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  have : (p.trimStart h).start ∈ (p.trimStart h).support :=
    (p.trimStart h).start_mem_support
  have hsub : (p.trimStart h).support ⊆ p.support := by
    intro y hy
    have : y ∈ p.support.erase p.start := by
      simpa [support_trimStart p h] using hy
    exact (mem_erase.1 this).2
  simpa [trimStart_start] using hsub this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_inter_trimStart_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_trimStart]
  have hmem : p.start ∈ p.support ∩ S :=
    mem_inter.2 ⟨p.start_mem_support, hs⟩
  have hEq : p.support.erase p.start ∩ S = (p.support ∩ S).erase p.start := by
    ext y
    simp [mem_erase, mem_inter]
  rw [hEq, card_erase_of_mem hmem]
  have : 0 < (p.support ∩ S).card := card_pos.2 ⟨p.start, hmem⟩
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_inter_trimStart_of_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_trimStart, erase_inter]
  have hne : p.start ∉ p.support ∩ S := fun hmem =>
    hs (mem_inter.1 hmem).2
  rw [erase_eq_of_notMem hne]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_X_ge_succ_card_Y_of_ended_noYY
statement:
lemma card_X_ge_succ_card_Y_of_ended_noYY {X Y : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (hdisj : Disjoint X Y) (hcover : p.support ⊆ X ∪ Y)
    (hs : p.start ∈ X) (hf : p.finish ∈ X) (hno : NoConsecutive Y p) :
    (p.support ∩ Y).card + 1 ≤ (p.support ∩ X).card
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.walk.length = n →
        p.support ⊆ X ∪ Y → p.start ∈ X → p.finish ∈ X → NoConsecutive Y p →
          (p.support ∩ Y).card + 1 ≤ (p.support ∩ X).card)
    p.walk.length ?_ p rfl hcover hs hf hno
  intro n ih p hn hcover hs hf hno
  have hsY : p.start ∉ Y := fun hY => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hs hY)
  by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
  · have hsing : p.support = {p.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
    have hX : p.support ∩ X = {p.start} := by
      simp [hsing, hs]
    have hYint : p.support ∩ Y = ∅ := by
      simp [hsing, hsY]
    simp [hX, hYint]
  · have hsndP : p.walk.snd ∈ p.support := snd_mem_support_of_not_nil p hnil
    have hsndXY : p.walk.snd ∈ X ∪ Y := hcover hsndP
    have hlen' : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.length < n := by
      have hEq := length_walk_trimStart p hnil
      omega
    have hcover' : (p.trimStart hnil).support ⊆ X ∪ Y :=
      (support_trimStart p hnil).symm ▸
        ((erase_subset p.start p.support).trans hcover)
    have hno' : NoConsecutive Y (p.trimStart hnil) :=
      NoConsecutive_of_edges_subset (edges_trimStart_subset p hnil) hno
    have hf' : (p.trimStart hnil).finish ∈ X := by
      simpa [trimStart_finish] using hf
    by_cases hsndY : p.walk.snd ∈ Y
    · have hnn' : ¬ (p.trimStart hnil).walk.Nil := by
        intro hn'
        have hst : (p.trimStart hnil).start = (p.trimStart hnil).finish :=
          (nil_iff_start_eq_finish _).1 hn'
        have hsnd_eq : p.walk.snd = p.finish := by
          simpa [trimStart_start, trimStart_finish] using hst
        have hfY : p.finish ∉ Y := fun hY => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hf hY)
        exact hfY (by simpa [hsnd_eq] using hsndY)
      have hsndX : p.walk.snd ∉ X := fun hX =>
        (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hX hsndY)
      have hstart' : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∈ Y := by
        simpa [trimStart_start] using hsndY
      have hsnd2 : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.snd ∉ Y :=
        snd_not_mem_of_NoConsecutive hnn' hstart' hno'
      have hsnd2P : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.snd ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).support :=
        snd_mem_support_of_not_nil (p.trimStart hnil) hnn'
      have hsnd2XY : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.snd ∈ X ∪ Y := hcover' hsnd2P
      have hsnd2X : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.snd ∈ X := by
        rcases mem_union.1 hsnd2XY with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact (hsnd2 h).elim
      have hlen'' : ((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn').walk.length < n := by
        have hEq := length_walk_trimStart (p.trimStart hnil) hnn'
        omega
      have hcover'' : ((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn').support ⊆ X ∪ Y :=
        (support_trimStart (p.trimStart hnil) hnn').symm ▸
          ((erase_subset _ _).trans hcover')
      have hno'' : NoConsecutive Y ((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn') :=
        NoConsecutive_of_edges_subset
          (edges_trimStart_subset (p.trimStart hnil) hnn') hno'
      have hf'' : ((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn').finish ∈ X := by
        simpa [trimStart_finish] using hf'
      have hs'' : ((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn').start ∈ X := by
        simpa [trimStart_start] using hsnd2X
      have ih'' :=
        ih _ hlen'' ((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn') rfl hcover'' hs'' hf'' hno''
      have hXeq :
          (p.support ∩ X).card =
            (((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn').support ∩ X).card + 1 := by
        have hX1 := card_inter_trimStart_of_mem (S := X) hnil hs
        have hX2 := card_inter_trimStart_of_not_mem (S := X) hnn'
          (by simpa [trimStart_start] using hsndX)
        omega
      have hYeq :
          (p.support ∩ Y).card =
            (((p.trimStart hnil).trimStart hnn').support ∩ Y).card + 1 := by
        have hY1 := card_inter_trimStart_of_not_mem (S := Y) hnil hsY
        have hY2 := card_inter_trimStart_of_mem (S := Y) hnn'
          (by simpa [trimStart_start] using hsndY)
        omega
      omega
    · have hsndX : p.walk.snd ∈ X := by
        rcases mem_union.1 hsndXY with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact (hsndY h).elim
      have hs' : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∈ X := by
        simpa [trimStart_start] using hsndX
      have ih' := ih _ hlen' (p.trimStart hnil) rfl hcover' hs' hf' hno'
      have hXeq := card_inter_trimStart_of_mem (S := X) hnil hs
      have hYeq := card_inter_trimStart_of_not_mem (S := Y) hnil hsY
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_foldr_support_union
statement:
lemma mem_foldr_support_union {x : V} :
    ∀ l : List (GraphPath G),
      x ∈ l.foldr (fun p acc => p.support ∪ acc) ∅ ↔ ∃ p ∈ l, x ∈ p.support
proof:
| [] => by simp
  | p :: ps => by
    simp [mem_foldr_support_union (l := ps), mem_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sum_inter_card_of_pairwise
statement:
lemma sum_inter_card_of_pairwise {S : Finset V} :
    ∀ l : List (GraphPath G),
      l.Pairwise (fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support) →
        (l.map (fun p => (p.support ∩ S).card)).sum =
          (l.foldr (fun p acc => p.support ∪ acc) ∅ ∩ S).card
proof:
| [] => fun _ => by simp
  | p :: ps => fun hl => by
    have hpw := List.pairwise_cons.mp hl
    have ih := sum_inter_card_of_pairwise (S := S) ps hpw.2
    have hEq : ((p :: ps).foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅ ∩ S) =
        (p.support ∩ S) ∪ (ps.foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅ ∩ S) := by
      ext y
      simp [mem_union, mem_inter]
      tauto
    have hdisj :
        Disjoint (p.support ∩ S)
          (ps.foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅ ∩ S) := by
      refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro y hyP hyR
      have hyps : y ∈ ps.foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅ :=
        (mem_inter.1 hyR).1
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩ := (mem_foldr_support_union (x := y) ps).1 hyps
      have hdisj := hpw.1 q hq
      exact disjoint_left.1 hdisj (mem_inter.1 hyP).1 hyq
    have hcard := card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
    change (p.support ∩ S).card +
        (ps.map (fun q => (q.support ∩ S).card)).sum =
      ((p.support ∪ ps.foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅) ∩ S).card
    have hfold : (p :: ps).foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅ =
        p.support ∪ ps.foldr (fun q acc => q.support ∪ acc) ∅ := rfl
    rw [ih, ← hfold, hEq, hcard]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCover_foldr_support
statement:
lemma pathCover_foldr_support {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    pc.paths.foldr (fun p acc => p.support ∪ acc) ∅ = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (mem_foldr_support_union (x := x) pc.paths).1 hx
    exact (pc.mem_iff x).2 ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
    exact (mem_foldr_support_union (x := x) pc.paths).2 ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sum_inter_card_pathCover
statement:
lemma sum_inter_card_pathCover {U S : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    (pc.paths.map (fun p => (p.support ∩ S).card)).sum = (U ∩ S).card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pathCover_foldr_support pc] using
    sum_inter_card_of_pairwise (S := S) pc.paths pc.disjoint

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.map_sum_le_of_forall
statement:
lemma map_sum_le_of_forall {α} (l : List α) (f g : α → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ l, f a ≤ g a) : (l.map f).sum ≤ (l.map g).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have ha : f a ≤ g a := h a (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
    have hl : ∀ b ∈ l, f b ≤ g b := fun b hb =>
      h b (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hb))
    have := ih hl
    simpa [List.map_cons] using Nat.add_le_add ha this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.map_add_one_sum
statement:
lemma map_add_one_sum {α} (l : List α) (f : α → ℕ) :
    (l.map (fun a => f a + 1)).sum = (l.map f).sum + l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have h1 : ((a :: l).map (fun x => f x + 1)).sum =
        (f a + 1) + (l.map (fun x => f x + 1)).sum := by
      simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have h2 : ((a :: l).map f).sum = f a + (l.map f).sum := by
      simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    simp [h1, h2, ih]
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_X_ge_add_of_X_ended_cover
statement:
lemma card_X_ge_add_of_X_ended_cover {X Y U0 : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint X Y) (hU0 : U0 = X ∪ Y) (hXU : X ⊆ U0) (hYU : Y ⊆ U0)
    (pc : PathCover G U0)
    (hends : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ X ∧ p.finish ∈ X)
    (hno : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, NoConsecutive Y p) :
    pc.card + Y.card ≤ X.card
proof:
:= by
  have hsumX := sum_inter_card_pathCover (S := X) pc
  have hsumY := sum_inter_card_pathCover (S := Y) pc
  have hXU' : U0 ∩ X = X := inter_eq_right.2 hXU
  have hYU' : U0 ∩ Y = Y := inter_eq_right.2 hYU
  have hle :=
    map_sum_le_of_forall pc.paths
      (fun p => (p.support ∩ Y).card + 1) (fun p => (p.support ∩ X).card)
      (fun p hp => by
        have hsup : p.support ⊆ X ∪ Y := by
          intro z hz
          have hzU : z ∈ U0 := pc.support_subset hp hz
          simpa [hU0] using hzU
        exact card_X_ge_succ_card_Y_of_ended_noYY hdisj hsup (hends p hp).1
          (hends p hp).2 (hno p hp))
  have hsumY1 := map_add_one_sum pc.paths (fun p => (p.support ∩ Y).card)
  have : Y.card + pc.card ≤ X.card := by
    simpa [hsumX, hsumY, hXU', hYU', PathCover.card, hsumY1] using hle
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_X_eq_add_card_Y
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_X_eq_add_card_Y {X Y U0 : Finset V}
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    (hU0 : U0 = X ∪ Y)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hpU0 : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G U0)
    (hcard : pathCoverNumber G U0 + Y.card ≤ X.card) :
    pathCoverNumber G X = pathCoverNumber G U0 + Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have hj := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hXne hYne hjoin
  have hU0eq : pathCoverNumber G U0 =
      max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G X - Y.card)
        (pathCoverNumber G Y - X.card)) := by
    simpa [hU0] using hj
  have hpY : pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ Y.card := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) Y
  have hother : pathCoverNumber G Y - X.card = 0 := by
    have : pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ X.card :=
      hpY.trans (le_trans (Nat.le_add_left Y.card _) hcard)
    exact Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le this
  have hU0' : pathCoverNumber G U0 = max 1 (pathCoverNumber G X - Y.card) := by
    simpa [hother] using hU0eq
  have hsub_pos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G X - Y.card := by
    by_contra h
    have h0 : pathCoverNumber G X - Y.card = 0 := by omega
    have : pathCoverNumber G U0 = 1 := by simpa [hU0', h0]
    omega
  have hsub : pathCoverNumber G U0 = pathCoverNumber G X - Y.card := by
    rwa [max_eq_right hsub_pos] at hU0'
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G X ≤ pathCoverNumber G U0 + Y.card := by
    have hXeq : U0 \ Y = X := by
      rw [hU0, union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint hdisj]
    have hYsub : Y ⊆ U0 := by
      rw [hU0]; exact subset_union_right
    have := pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le (G := G) U0 Y hYsub
    simpa [hXeq] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_Y_eq_add_of_nocross_join
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_sdiff_Y_eq_add_of_nocross_join
    {W U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ W) (hX : X ⊆ U0) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hpU0 : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G U0)
    (hcard : pathCoverNumber G U0 + Y.card ≤ X.card) :
    pathCoverNumber G (W \ Y) = pathCoverNumber G W + Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have hXY : U0 = X ∪ Y := hcover.symm
  have hpX := pathCoverNumber_X_eq_add_card_Y (U0 := U0) hXne hYne hdisj hXY
    hjoin hpU0 hcard
  have hdisjU : Disjoint U0 (W \ U0) := disjoint_sdiff
  have hW : U0 ∪ (W \ U0) = W := union_sdiff_of_subset hU0
  have hpW :
      pathCoverNumber G W =
        pathCoverNumber G U0 + pathCoverNumber G (W \ U0) := by
    simpa [hW] using pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisjU hnocross
  have hXeq : U0 \ Y = X := by
    rw [hXY, union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint hdisj]
  have hWY : W \ Y = X ∪ (W \ U0) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hzW : z ∈ W := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hzY : z ∉ Y := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      by_cases hzU : z ∈ U0
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
        simpa [hXeq] using (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzU, hzY⟩ : z ∈ U0 \ Y)
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzW, hzU⟩))
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzX | hzR
      · have hzU : z ∈ U0 := hX hzX
        have hzY : z ∉ Y := fun h => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzX h)
        exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hU0 hzU, hzY⟩
      · have hzW : z ∈ W := (mem_sdiff.1 hzR).1
        have hzU : z ∉ U0 := (mem_sdiff.1 hzR).2
        exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzW, fun hzY => hzU (hY hzY)⟩
  have hncX : ∀ a ∈ X, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b := fun a ha =>
    hnocross a (hX ha)
  have hdisjX : Disjoint X (W \ U0) :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left hX disjoint_sdiff
  have hpWY :
      pathCoverNumber G (W \ Y) =
        pathCoverNumber G X + pathCoverNumber G (W \ U0) := by
    simpa [hWY] using pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisjX hncX
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftoverCountIn_eq_pathCoverNumber_of_min_nocross
statement:
lemma leftoverCountIn_eq_pathCoverNumber_of_min_nocross
    {W U0 : Finset V} (hU0 : U0 ⊆ W)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (pc : PathCover G W) (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G W) :
    leftoverCountIn pc U0 = pathCoverNumber G U0
proof:
:= by
  have hunion : U0 ∪ (W \ U0) = W := union_sdiff_of_subset hU0
  let pc' : PathCover G (U0 ∪ (W \ U0)) := pc.cast hunion.symm
  have hmin' : pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G (U0 ∪ (W \ U0)) := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hunion]
    exact hmin
  have hsplit :=
    splitLeft_card_eq_of_min (disjoint_sdiff : Disjoint U0 (W \ U0))
      hnocross pc' hmin'
  have hfilt : leftoverCountIn pc U0 = (PathCover.splitLeft
      (disjoint_sdiff : Disjoint U0 (W \ U0)) hnocross pc').card := by
    have hp : pc'.paths = pc.paths := PathCover.cast_paths pc hunion.symm
    simp [leftoverCountIn, PathCover.splitLeft, PathCover.card, hp]
  exact hfilt.trans hsplit

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.retained_seams_subset_W_boundary
statement:
lemma retained_seams_subset_W_boundary {H D U0 : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    (_hU0 : U0 ⊆ H) {p : GraphPath G} :
    c.boundaryEdges U0 ∩ p.edges ⊆ p.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D)
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨heS, heP⟩ := mem_inter.1 he
  obtain ⟨heC, hstr⟩ := GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 heS
  refine GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨heP, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hxe, hxU⟩, ⟨y, hye, hyU⟩⟩ := hstr
  have hyH : y ∈ H := by
    have : y ∈ c.support := by
      simpa [GraphCycle.support] using
        List.mem_toFinset.2
          (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 heC) hye)
    simpa [hc] using this
  have hyD : y ∉ D := fun hD => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyH hD)
  have hxW : x ∈ U0 ∪ D := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxU)
  have hyW : y ∉ U0 ∪ D := by
    intro h
    rcases mem_union.1 h with hU | hD
    · exact hyU hU
    · exact hyD hD
  exact ⟨⟨x, hxe, hxW⟩, ⟨y, hye, hyW⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_boundary_U0_eq_W
statement:
lemma cycle_boundary_U0_eq_W {H D U0 : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    (_hU0 : U0 ⊆ H) :
    c.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D) = c.boundaryEdges U0
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨heC, hstr⟩
    refine ⟨heC, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨x, hxe, hxW⟩, ⟨y, hye, hyW⟩⟩ := hstr
    have hxH : x ∈ H := by
      have : x ∈ c.support := by
        simpa [GraphCycle.support] using
          List.mem_toFinset.2
            (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 heC) hxe)
      simpa [hc] using this
    have hxD : x ∉ D := fun hD => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxH hD)
    have hxU : x ∈ U0 := by
      rcases mem_union.1 hxW with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact (hxD h).elim
    have hyU : y ∉ U0 := fun h => hyW (mem_union.2 (Or.inl h))
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxe, hxU⟩, ⟨y, hye, hyU⟩⟩
  · intro ⟨heC, hstr⟩
    refine ⟨heC, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨x, hxe, hxU⟩, ⟨y, hye, hyU⟩⟩ := hstr
    have hyH : y ∈ H := by
      have : y ∈ c.support := by
        simpa [GraphCycle.support] using
          List.mem_toFinset.2
            (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 heC) hye)
      simpa [hc] using this
    have hyD : y ∉ D := fun hD => (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyH hD)
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxe, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxU)⟩,
      ⟨y, hye, fun h => (mem_union.1 h).elim hyU hyD⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_suppressInternal
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_suppressInternal {U A' : Finset V} (hU : Disjoint U A') :
    eligibleSet (suppressInternal G A') U = eligibleSet G U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_eligibleSet_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, hend⟩ := hx.2
    refine (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨PathCover.ofSuppressInternal (G := G) pc, ?_,
      GraphPath.ofSuppressInternal (G := G) p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [PathCover.ofSuppressInternal_card,
        pathCoverNumber_suppressInternal (G := G) hU] using hpc
    · exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.ofSuppressInternal_start,
        GraphPath.ofSuppressInternal_finish] using hend
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_eligibleSet_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, hend⟩ := hx.2
    have hd : Disjoint p.support A' :=
      disjoint_of_subset_left (pc.support_subset hp) hU
    refine (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := suppressInternal G A')).2 ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨pc.toSuppressInternal (G := G) hU, ?_,
      p.toSuppressInternal (G := G) hd, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [PathCover.toSuppressInternal_card,
        pathCoverNumber_suppressInternal (G := G) hU] using hpc
    · change p.transferEdges _ ∈ (pc.transferEdges _).paths
      exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, List.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.toSuppressInternal_start,
        GraphPath.toSuppressInternal_finish] using hend

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.completeJoin_adj_suppressInternal_W
statement:
lemma completeJoin_adj_suppressInternal_W {H D A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0 ∪ D)
    (hdisjXY : Disjoint X Y) (hdisjHD : Disjoint H D)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    {y x : V} (hy : y ∈ Y) (hx : x ∈ X) :
    (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)).Adj y x
proof:
:=
  (adj_suppressInternal_iff (G := G) (A' := A ∪ Y)).2
    ⟨(hjoin hx hy).symm, fun hboth => by
      have hxAY : x ∈ A ∪ Y := hboth.2
      rcases mem_union.1 hxAY with hxA | hxY
      · have hxH : x ∈ H := hA hxA
        have hxD : x ∉ D := fun hD => disjoint_left.1 hdisjHD hxH hD
        have hxU0 : x ∈ U0 := by
          rcases mem_union.1 (hX hx) with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact (hxD h).elim
        exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 hxU0)).2 hxA
      · exact disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY hx hxY⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.path_boundary_W_outside_end_mem_A
statement:
lemma path_boundary_W_outside_end_mem_A {H D A U0 : Finset V}
    {G' : SimpleGraph V} (hLE : G' ≤ G)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hdisjHD : Disjoint H D)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hnorestD : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {p' : GraphPath G'} (hp' : p'.support = H ∪ D)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ p'.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D)) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, a ∈ e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨heP, hstr⟩ := GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he
  obtain ⟨x, hxe, hxW, _⟩ := existsUnique_U0_end hstr
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun u v heP hstr hxe hxW => ?_) heP hstr hxe hxW
  have hadj : G.Adj u v := hLE <| by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using p'.edges_subset_edgeSet _ heP
  have huP : u ∈ p'.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge heP (by simp)
  have hvP : v ∈ p'.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge heP (by simp)
  have huHD : u ∈ H ∪ D := by simpa [hp'] using huP
  have hvHD : v ∈ H ∪ D := by simpa [hp'] using hvP
  have hrest {z : V} (hzHD : z ∈ H ∪ D) (hzW : z ∉ U0 ∪ D) :
      z ∈ (H \ A) \ U0 ∨ z ∈ A := by
    have hzD : z ∉ D := fun h => hzW (mem_union.2 (Or.inr h))
    have hzH : z ∈ H := by
      rcases mem_union.1 hzHD with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact (hzD h).elim
    have hzU0 : z ∉ U0 := fun h => hzW (mem_union.2 (Or.inl h))
    by_cases hzA : z ∈ A
    · exact Or.inr hzA
    · exact Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzH, hzA⟩, hzU0⟩)
  rcases (show u = x ∨ v = x from by
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hxe with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl) with rfl | rfl
  · have hvW : v ∉ U0 ∪ D := fun hvW =>
      (endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr) (propext ⟨fun _ => hvW, fun _ => hxW⟩)
    rcases hrest hvHD hvW with hvK | hvA
    · rcases mem_union.1 hxW with hxU | hxD
      · exact (hnocross u hxU v hvK hadj).elim
      · exact (hnorestD u hxD v hvK hadj).elim
    · exact ⟨v, hvA, by simp⟩
  · have huW : u ∉ U0 ∪ D := fun huW =>
      (endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr) (propext ⟨fun _ => hxW, fun _ => huW⟩)
    rcases hrest huHD huW with huK | huA
    · rcases mem_union.1 hxW with hxU | hxD
      · exact (hnocross v hxU u huK hadj.symm).elim
      · exact (hnorestD v hxD u huK hadj.symm).elim
    · exact ⟨u, huA, by simp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_one_return_rotate_W
statement:
lemma exists_one_return_rotate_W {H D A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0 ∪ D) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hdisjXY : Disjoint X Y) (hdisjHD : Disjoint H D)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hnorestD : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {pH : GraphPath G} (hpH : pH.support = H) (hsH : pH.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {p' : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    {c' : GraphCycle (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    (hp' : p'.support = H ∪ D) (hc' : c'.support = H)
    (hP : p'.ProtectedAt c' A) (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges)
    (hsY : p'.start ∈ Y) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)),
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish = p'.finish ∧
        q.start ≠ q.finish ∧ q.ProtectedAt c' A
proof:
:= by
  let G' := suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)
  have hLE : G' ≤ G := suppressInternal_le G (A ∪ Y)
  have hdisjAY : Disjoint A Y := disjoint_of_subset_right hY (disjoint_A_U0 hU0)
  have hAH : A ⊆ (p'.ofLE hLE).support := by
    intro a ha
    simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_support, hp'] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hA ha))
  have hPG : (p'.ofLE hLE).ProtectedAt c A :=
    ProtectedAt_ofLE_edges hLE hedges' hP
  have h2p : 2 ≤ (p'.ofLE hLE).support.card := by
    have h3 : 3 ≤ H.card := by simpa [hc] using c.three_le_card_support
    have : H ⊆ (p'.ofLE hLE).support := by
      intro z hz
      simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_support, hp'] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz)
    exact (le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3).trans (card_le_card this)
  have h3ret :=
    three_le_retained_cycle_seams (c := c) hc hA hU0 hY hnocross hdisjAY
      hAH hPG (by simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_start] using hsY) h4 h2p
  have hsub :=
    retained_seams_subset_W_boundary (c := c) hc hdisjHD
      (hU0.trans sdiff_subset) (p := p'.ofLE hLE)
  have h3W : 3 ≤ ((p'.ofLE hLE).boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D)).card :=
    h3ret.trans (card_le_card hsub)
  have h2 : 2 ≤ (p'.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D)).card := by
    have : (p'.ofLE hLE).boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D) = p'.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D) := by
      simp [GraphPath.boundaryEdges, GraphPath.ofLE_edges]
    simpa [this] using le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3W
  have hsW : p'.start ∈ U0 ∪ D := mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hY hsY))
  have hAout : Disjoint A (U0 ∪ D) := by
    refine disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨disjoint_A_U0 hU0, ?_⟩
    exact disjoint_of_subset_left hA hdisjHD
  have hYU : Y ⊆ U0 ∪ D := hY.trans subset_union_left
  have hjoin' : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ X, G'.Adj y z := fun y hy z hx =>
    completeJoin_adj_suppressInternal_W hA hU0 hX hdisjXY hdisjHD hjoin hy hx
  have henterX : ∀ i, i < p'.walk.length → p'.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∪ D →
      p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 ∪ D → p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X := by
    intro i hi h0 h1
    have he : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ p'.edges :=
      p'.crossingEdge_mem_edges hi
    have hbd : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈
        p'.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D) :=
      GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he, endsStraddle_of_outside_inside h0 h1⟩
    obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
      path_boundary_W_outside_end_mem_A (G := G) hLE hA hU0 hdisjHD hnocross
        hnorestD hp' hbd
    have heA : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ p'.AIncident A :=
      mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨he, a, haA, hae⟩
    have heC : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ c.edges := by
      have : _ ∈ c'.edges := hP heA
      simpa [hedges'] using this
    have haW : a ∉ U0 ∪ D := disjoint_left.1 hAout haA
    have heq := cycle_boundary_eq_ax
      (endsStraddle_of_outside_inside (U0 := U0 ∪ D) h0 h1) hae haW
      (by simp) h1
    have hxU0 : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 := by
      have hxH : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ H := by
        have : a ∈ c.support := by
          simpa [hc] using hA haA
        
        have hmem : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ s(a, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by simp
        have : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ c.support := by
          have heq' : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) = s(a, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) := heq
          have : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by simp
          have hC : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ c.support := by
            simpa [GraphCycle.support, hc] using
              List.mem_toFinset.2
                (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges
                  (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 heC) (by
                    simpa [heq] using this))
          exact hC
        simpa [hc] using this
      have hxD : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ D := fun hD =>
        disjoint_left.1 hdisjHD hxH hD
      rcases mem_union.1 h1 with hU | hD
      · exact hU
      · exact (hxD hD).elim
    have hstrU0 : endsStraddle s(a, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) U0 :=
      endsStraddle_of_outside_inside
        (fun h => (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_A_U0 hU0) haA h)) hxU0
    have heCU0 : s(a, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 :=
      GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨by simpa [heq] using heC, hstrU0⟩
    exact cycle_boundary_U0_end_mem_X (Y := Y) c hc hU0 hpH hsH hedges hnocross
      hstay hstartX hfinX heCU0 (by simp) hxU0
  have henterA : ∀ i, i < p'.walk.length → p'.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 ∪ D →
      p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 ∪ D → p'.walk.getVert i ∈ A := by
    intro i hi h0 h1
    have he : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ p'.edges :=
      p'.crossingEdge_mem_edges hi
    have hbd : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈
        p'.boundaryEdges (U0 ∪ D) :=
      GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he, endsStraddle_of_outside_inside h0 h1⟩
    obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
      path_boundary_W_outside_end_mem_A (G := G) hLE hA hU0 hdisjHD hnocross
        hnorestD hp' hbd
    have haW : a ∉ U0 ∪ D := disjoint_left.1 hAout haA
    have heq := cycle_boundary_eq_ax
      (endsStraddle_of_outside_inside (U0 := U0 ∪ D) h0 h1) hae haW
      (by simp) h1
    rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq) with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨hvu, _⟩
    · exact haA
    · exact (h0 (by simpa [hvu] using h1)).elim
  obtain ⟨i, F, hyx, hi, h0, h1, haA, hxX, hst, hsup, hProt⟩ :=
    exists_returnRotate (p := p') (U0 := U0 ∪ D) hsW h2 (A := A) (X := X)
      (Y := Y) (c := c') hjoin' hsY hP hAout hYU hX henterX henterA
  have hne : (F.rotate hyx).start ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish :=
    F.rotate_start_ne_finish hyx
  refine ⟨F.rotate hyx, by simpa [hsup] using hp', ?_, ?_, hne, hProt⟩
  · simpa [hst] using haA
  · simpa [F.rotate_finish hyx]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_restore_A_ends_W
statement:
lemma exists_restore_A_ends_W {H D A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0 ∪ D) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hdisjXY : Disjoint X Y) (hdisjHD : Disjoint H D) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hnorestD : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {pH : GraphPath G} (hpH : pH.support = H) (hsH : pH.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {p' : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    {c' : GraphCycle (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    (hp' : p'.support = H ∪ D) (hc' : c'.support = H)
    (hs' : p'.start ∈ A ∪ Y) (hf' : p'.finish ∈ A ∪ Y)
    (hne' : p'.start ≠ p'.finish)
    (hP' : p'.ProtectedAt c' (A ∪ Y))
    (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)),
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧
        q.start ≠ q.finish ∧ q.ProtectedAt c' A
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : A ⊆ A ∪ Y := subset_union_left
  have hP : p'.ProtectedAt c' A := hP'.mono_set hsub
  by_cases hboth : p'.start ∈ A ∧ p'.finish ∈ A
  · exact ⟨p', hp', hboth.1, hboth.2, hne', hP⟩
  have hYend : p'.start ∈ Y ∨ p'.finish ∈ Y := by
    have hst : p'.start ∈ A ∨ p'.start ∈ Y := mem_union.1 hs'
    have hfn : p'.finish ∈ A ∨ p'.finish ∈ Y := mem_union.1 hf'
    rcases hst with hstA | hstY
    · rcases hfn with hfnA | hfnY
      · exact (hboth ⟨hstA, hfnA⟩).elim
      · exact Or.inr hfnY
    · exact Or.inl hstY
  let q0 : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)) :=
    if h : p'.start ∈ Y then p' else p'.reverse
  have hq0sup : q0.support = H ∪ D := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h] using hp'
    · simpa [q0, h, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp'
  have hq0stY : q0.start ∈ Y := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h]
    · have hfY : p'.finish ∈ Y := hYend.resolve_left h
      simpa [q0, h, GraphPath.reverse] using hfY
  have hq0P : q0.ProtectedAt c' A := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h] using hP
    · simpa [q0, h, ProtectedAt_reverse] using hP
  have hq0fin_mem : q0.finish ∈ A ∪ Y := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h] using hf'
    · simpa [q0, h, GraphPath.reverse] using hs'
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1sup, hq1st, hq1fin, hq1ne, hq1P⟩ :=
    exists_one_return_rotate_W (Y := Y) c hc hA hU0 hX hY hdisjXY hdisjHD
      hjoin hnocross hnorestD hpH hsH hedges hstay hstartX hfinX h4 hq0sup hc'
      hq0P hedges' hq0stY
  by_cases hfA : q1.finish ∈ A
  · exact ⟨q1, hq1sup, hq1st, hfA, hq1ne, hq1P⟩
  have hfY : q1.finish ∈ Y := by
    have : q1.finish ∈ A ∪ Y := by simpa [hq1fin] using hq0fin_mem
    exact (mem_union.1 this).resolve_left hfA
  let qR := q1.reverse
  have hRsup : qR.support = H ∪ D := by
    simpa [qR, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hq1sup
  have hRstY : qR.start ∈ Y := by simpa [qR, GraphPath.reverse] using hfY
  have hRP : qR.ProtectedAt c' A := (ProtectedAt_reverse q1 c' A).2 hq1P
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2sup, hq2st, hq2fin, hq2ne, hq2P⟩ :=
    exists_one_return_rotate_W (Y := Y) c hc hA hU0 hX hY hdisjXY hdisjHD
      hjoin hnocross hnorestD hpH hsH hedges hstay hstartX hfinX h4 hRsup hc'
      hRP hedges' hRstY
  refine ⟨q2, hq2sup, hq2st, ?_, hq2ne, hq2P⟩
  simpa [hq2fin, qR, GraphPath.reverse] using hq1st

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_lift_restored_W
statement:
lemma exists_lift_restored_W {H D A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0 ∪ D) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hdisjXY : Disjoint X Y) (hdisjHD : Disjoint H D) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hnorestD : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {pH : GraphPath G} (hpH : pH.support = H) (hsH : pH.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {p' : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    {c' : GraphCycle (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    (hp' : p'.support = H ∪ D) (hc' : c'.support = H)
    (hs' : p'.start ∈ A ∪ Y) (hf' : p'.finish ∈ A ∪ Y)
    (hne' : p'.start ≠ p'.finish)
    (hP' : p'.ProtectedAt c' (A ∪ Y))
    (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧
        q.start ≠ q.finish ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hrsup, hrst, hrfin, hrne, hrP⟩ :=
    exists_restore_A_ends_W (Y := Y) c hc hA hU0 hX hY hdisjXY hdisjHD hYne
      hjoin hnocross hnorestD hpH hsH hedges hstay hstartX hfinX h4 hp' hc'
      hs' hf' hne' hP' hedges'
  let hLE := suppressInternal_le G (A ∪ Y)
  refine ⟨r.ofLE hLE, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ProtectedAt_ofLE_edges hLE hedges' hrP⟩
  · simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_support] using hrsup
  · simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_start] using hrst
  · simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_finish] using hrfin
  · simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_start, GraphPath.ofLE_finish] using hrne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected_weak
proof:
:= by
  have h2p : (p.incidentEdges v).card = 2 :=
    p.incidentEdges_card_internal hvP hs hf
  have h2c : (c.incidentEdges v).card = 2 := c.incidentEdges_card hvC
  have hsub : p.incidentEdges v ⊆ c.incidentEdges v :=
    hP.incidentEdges_subset_cycle hvA
  exact eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.splice_AIncident
statement:
lemma splice_AIncident (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) {A : Finset V}
    (hp : p.finish ∉ A) (hq : q.start ∉ A) :
    (p.splice q h hd).AIncident A = p.AIncident A ∪ q.AIncident A
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [mem_AIncident_iff, edges_splice p q h hd, mem_union, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    rcases hmem with (h | h) | rfl
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
    · rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hbe with hb | hb
      · exact (hp (hb ▸ hbA)).elim
      · exact (hq (hb ▸ hbA)).elim
  · rintro (⟨he, hA⟩ | ⟨he, hA⟩)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl he), hA⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr he), hA⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support'
proof:
:=
  AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support q hd

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieceAfter_support_subset
statement:
lemma pieceAfter_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have : x ∈ (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support ∪
      (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).support := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hx)
  rwa [support_pieces_union p hu hclose hne hv hnv] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieceBefore_support_subset
statement:
lemma pieceBefore_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have : x ∈ (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support ∪
      (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).support := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hx)
  rwa [support_pieces_union p hu hclose hne hv hnv] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_r_pieceAfter
statement:
lemma disjoint_r_pieceAfter (p r : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) (hd : Disjoint r.support p.support) :
    Disjoint r.support (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).support
proof:
:=
  Disjoint.mono_right (pieceAfter_support_subset p hu hclose hne hv hnv) hd

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_pieceBefore_mid
statement:
lemma disjoint_pieceBefore_mid (p r : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) (hd : Disjoint r.support p.support)
    (hfv : G.Adj r.finish v) :
    Disjoint (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support
      (r.splice (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv) hfv
        (disjoint_r_pieceAfter p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd)).support
proof:
:= by
  have hdAfter := disjoint_r_pieceAfter p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd
  have hdisjPieces := disjoint_pieces p hu hclose hne hv hnv
  have hdB : Disjoint (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support r.support :=
    Disjoint.mono_left (pieceBefore_support_subset p hu hclose hne hv hnv)
      (Disjoint.symm hd)
  rw [GraphPath.support_splice r (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv) hfv hdAfter]
  exact disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨hdB, hdisjPieces⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStartsThrough_support
statement:
lemma switchOpenStartsThrough_support (p r : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) (hd : Disjoint r.support p.support)
    (hsu : G.Adj u r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish v) :
    (switchOpenStartsThrough p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd hsu hfv).support =
      p.support ∪ r.support
proof:
:= by
  unfold switchOpenStartsThrough
  rw [switchStarts_support,
    GraphPath.support_splice r (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv)
      hfv (disjoint_r_pieceAfter p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd)]
  rw [union_comm r.support, ← union_assoc,
    support_pieces_union p hu hclose hne hv hnv]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStartsThrough_ProtectedAt
statement:
lemma switchOpenStartsThrough_ProtectedAt (p r : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) (hd : Disjoint r.support p.support)
    (hsu : G.Adj u r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish v)
    {A : Finset V} (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A)
    (hrA : Disjoint r.support A)
    {c : GraphCycle G}
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset) :
    (switchOpenStartsThrough p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd hsu hfv).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  let pb := pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv
  let pa := pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv
  have hdAfter := disjoint_r_pieceAfter p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd
  have hdBefore := disjoint_pieceBefore_mid p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd hfv
  have hsu' : G.Adj pb.start
      (r.splice pa hfv hdAfter).start := by
    have hst : pb.start = u := pieceBefore_start p hu hclose hne hv hnv
    have hsp : (r.splice pa hfv hdAfter).start = r.start := rfl
    simpa [hst, hsp] using hsu
  have hrFinA : r.finish ∉ A := disjoint_left.1 hrA r.finish_mem_support
  have hpaStA : pa.start ∉ A := by
    have : pa.start = v := pieceAfter_start p hu hclose hne hv
    simpa [this] using hvA
  have hmidA : (r.splice pa hfv hdAfter).start ∉ A :=
    disjoint_left.1 hrA r.start_mem_support
  have hpbStA : pb.start ∉ A := by
    have : pb.start = u := pieceBefore_start p hu hclose hne hv hnv
    simpa [this] using huA
  intro e he
  have hAI := switchStarts_AIncident pb (r.splice pa hfv hdAfter)
    hsu' hdBefore hpbStA hmidA
  have he' : e ∈ pb.AIncident A ∪ (r.splice pa hfv hdAfter).AIncident A := by
    change e ∈
        (switchStarts pb (r.splice pa hfv hdAfter) hsu' hdBefore).AIncident A
      at he
    simpa [hAI] using he
  have hmidAI := splice_AIncident r pa hfv hdAfter hrFinA hpaStA
  have hrAI : r.AIncident A = ∅ :=
    AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support r hrA
  have hsub := pieces_edges_subset_open p hu hclose hne hv hnv
  have hopen := openAtStart_edges_subset_cycle p hu hclose hne hedges
  rcases mem_union.1 he' with h | h
  · exact hopen (hsub.1 (mem_AIncident_iff.1 h).1)
  · have : e ∈ r.AIncident A ∪ pa.AIncident A := by
      simpa [hmidAI] using h
    rcases mem_union.1 this with hr | hpa
    · exact (notMem_empty e (by simpa [hrAI] using hr)).elim
    · exact hopen (hsub.2 (mem_AIncident_iff.1 hpa).1)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStartsThrough_start
statement:
lemma switchOpenStartsThrough_start (p r : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) (hd : Disjoint r.support p.support)
    (hsu : G.Adj u r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish v) :
    (switchOpenStartsThrough p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd hsu hfv).start =
      ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  simp [switchOpenStartsThrough, switchStarts_start, pieceBefore_finish]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStartsThrough_finish
statement:
lemma switchOpenStartsThrough_finish (p r : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support)
    (hnv : v ≠ u) (hd : Disjoint r.support p.support)
    (hsu : G.Adj u r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish v) :
    (switchOpenStartsThrough p r hu hclose hne hv hnv hd hsu hfv).finish =
      (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  unfold switchOpenStartsThrough
  rw [switchStarts_finish]
  exact pieceAfter_finish p hu hclose hne hv

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.connected_of_cycle
statement:
lemma connected_of_cycle (c : GraphCycle G) :
    (G.induce (c.support : Set V)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine (SimpleGraph.connected_iff (G.induce (c.support : Set V))).2 ?_
  refine ⟨fun x y =>
    reachable_of_componentCount_eq_one (G := G)
      (componentCount_cycle_eq_one c) x.2 y.2, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨⟨c.start, c.start_mem_support⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.walkOfInduce_support_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hmap :=
    Walk.support_map (f := (Embedding.induce (s := s) (G := G)).toHom) w
  have hz' : z ∈ w.support.map (Embedding.induce (s := s) (G := G)).toHom :=
    hmap ▸ hz
  obtain ⟨z', _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz'
  exact z'.2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.subset_left_or_right_of_connected
statement:
lemma subset_left_or_right_of_connected {A B D : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hcover : D ⊆ A ∪ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hDconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected) :
    D ⊆ A ∨ D ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  obtain ⟨x, hxD, hxA⟩ := not_subset.1 h.1
  obtain ⟨y, hyD, hyB⟩ := not_subset.1 h.2
  have hxB : x ∈ B := (mem_union.1 (hcover hxD)).resolve_left hxA
  have hyA : y ∈ A := (mem_union.1 (hcover hyD)).resolve_right hyB
  have hR : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x, hxD⟩ ⟨y, hyD⟩ :=
    hDconn.preconnected _ _
  obtain ⟨w⟩ := hR
  let wG := walkOfInduce w
  have hsupp : ∀ z ∈ wG.support, z ∈ (B : Set V) ∨ z ∈ (A : Set V) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzD : z ∈ (D : Set V) := walkOfInduce_support_subset w z hz
    have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := hcover hzD
    rcases mem_union.1 hzAB with hA | hB
    · exact Or.inr hA
    · exact Or.inl hB
  have hnocrossBA : ∀ b ∈ (B : Set V), ∀ a ∈ (A : Set V), ¬ G.Adj b a :=
    fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm
  have hyB' : y ∈ (B : Set V) :=
    walk_support_subset_of_no_cross (A := (B : Set V)) (B := (A : Set V))
      hnocrossBA wG hxB hsupp y (by
        simpa [wG, walkOfInduce] using Walk.end_mem_support wG)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyA hyB'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_block_containing
statement:
lemma exists_block_containing {K D : Finset V}
    (hD : D ⊆ K) (hDne : D.Nonempty)
    (hDconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected) :
    ∃ U : Finset V,
      U ⊆ K ∧ D ⊆ U ∧ U.Nonempty ∧
        (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected ∧
          (∀ a ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ K \ U, ¬ G.Adj a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (K D : Finset V), K.card = n → D ⊆ K → D.Nonempty →
        (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected →
          ∃ U : Finset V,
            U ⊆ K ∧ D ⊆ U ∧ U.Nonempty ∧
              (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected ∧
                (∀ a ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ K \ U, ¬ G.Adj a b))
    K.card ?_ K D rfl hD hDne hDconn
  intro n ih K D hn hDK hDne hDconn
  by_cases hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected
  · exact ⟨K, subset_rfl, hDK, hDne.mono hDK, hconn, fun a _ b hb =>
      (notMem_empty b (by simpa using hb)).elim⟩
  · have hKne : K.Nonempty := hDne.mono hDK
    obtain ⟨A, B, hAsub, hBsub, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hcover, hnocross,
        hAcard, hBcard⟩ :=
      exists_disjoint_union_on (G := G) (U := K) hconn hKne
    have hEq : A ∪ B = K := hcover
    have hDsplit : D ⊆ A ∨ D ⊆ B :=
      subset_left_or_right_of_connected hdisj (hDK.trans (hEq.symm.subset))
        hnocross hDconn
    have hltA : A.card < n := by simpa [hn] using hAcard
    have hltB : B.card < n := by simpa [hn] using hBcard
    rcases hDsplit with hDA | hDB
    · obtain ⟨U, hU, hDU, hUne, hUconn, hnc⟩ :=
        ih A.card hltA A D rfl hDA hDne hDconn
      refine ⟨U, hU.trans hAsub, hDU, hUne, hUconn, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      have hbK : b ∈ (A ∪ B) \ U := by simpa [hEq] using hb
      have hb' : b ∈ A \ U ∨ b ∈ B := by
        have : b ∈ A ∪ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hbK).1
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
        · exact Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hA, (mem_sdiff.1 hbK).2⟩)
        · exact Or.inr hB
      rcases hb' with hbA | hbB
      · exact hnc a ha b hbA
      · exact hnocross a (hU ha) b hbB
    · obtain ⟨U, hU, hDU, hUne, hUconn, hnc⟩ :=
        ih B.card hltB B D rfl hDB hDne hDconn
      refine ⟨U, hU.trans hBsub, hDU, hUne, hUconn, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      have hbK : b ∈ (A ∪ B) \ U := by simpa [hEq] using hb
      have hnocrossBA : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj b a :=
        fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm
      have hb' : b ∈ B \ U ∨ b ∈ A := by
        have : b ∈ A ∪ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hbK).1
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
        · exact Or.inr hA
        · exact Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hB, (mem_sdiff.1 hbK).2⟩)
      rcases hb' with hbB | hbA
      · exact hnc a ha b hbB
      · exact hnocrossBA a (hU ha) b hbA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.three_le_retained_cycle_seams
statement:
lemma three_le_retained_cycle_seams {H A U0 Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hdisjAY : Disjoint A Y)
    {p : GraphPath G}
    (hAH : A ⊆ p.support)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A)
    (hsY : p.start ∈ Y)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    (h2p : 2 ≤ p.support.card) :
    3 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0 ∩ p.edges).card
proof:
:= by
  let S := c.boundaryEdges U0
  change 4 ≤ S.card at h4
  have hmiss : (S \ p.edges).card ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hfA : p.finish ∈ A
    · have hfC : p.finish ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA hfA
      have h2c : (c.incidentEdges p.finish).card = 2 := c.incidentEdges_card hfC
      have h1p : (p.incidentEdges p.finish).card = 1 :=
        p.incidentEdges_card_finish h2p
      have hsubI : p.incidentEdges p.finish ⊆ c.incidentEdges p.finish :=
        hP.incidentEdges_subset_cycle hfA
      have hmissF :
          (c.incidentEdges p.finish \ p.incidentEdges p.finish).card ≤ 1 := by
        have : (p.incidentEdges p.finish ∪
            (c.incidentEdges p.finish \ p.incidentEdges p.finish)).card =
            (c.incidentEdges p.finish).card := by
          rw [union_sdiff_of_subset hsubI]
        have hdisj :
            Disjoint (p.incidentEdges p.finish)
              (c.incidentEdges p.finish \ p.incidentEdges p.finish) :=
          disjoint_sdiff
        have := card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
        omega
      have hsubMiss : S \ p.edges ⊆
          c.incidentEdges p.finish \ p.incidentEdges p.finish := by
        intro e he
        have ⟨heS, hneP⟩ := mem_sdiff.1 he
        obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
          boundary_outside_end_mem_A (c := c) hc hU0 hnocross heS
        have haP : a ∈ p.support := hAH haA
        have haC : a ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA haA
        have hsA : a ≠ p.start := fun h =>
          (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAY (h ▸ haA) hsY)
        have haFin : a = p.finish := by
          by_contra hne
          have heqI :=
            incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected_weak p c hP
              haA haP haC hsA hne
          have heC : e ∈ c.incidentEdges a :=
            (GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff (c := c) (v := a)).2
              ⟨((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).1,
                hae⟩
          have : e ∈ p.incidentEdges a := by simpa [heqI] using heC
          exact hneP (GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 this).1
        have heC : e ∈ c.incidentEdges p.finish :=
          (GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff (c := c) (v := p.finish)).2
            ⟨((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).1,
              by simpa [haFin] using hae⟩
        have hnotP : e ∉ p.incidentEdges p.finish := fun hin =>
          hneP (GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 hin).1
        exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨heC, hnotP⟩
      exact (card_le_card hsubMiss).trans hmissF
    · have hnone : S \ p.edges = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
        intro e he
        obtain ⟨heS, hneP⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 he
        obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
          boundary_outside_end_mem_A (c := c) hc hU0 hnocross heS
        have haP : a ∈ p.support := hAH haA
        have haC : a ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA haA
        have hsA : a ≠ p.start := fun h =>
          (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAY (h ▸ haA) hsY)
        have hfA' : a ≠ p.finish := fun h => hfA (by simpa [h] using haA)
        have heqI :=
          incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected_weak p c hP
            haA haP haC hsA hfA'
        have heC : e ∈ c.incidentEdges a :=
          (GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff (c := c) (v := a)).2
            ⟨((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).1,
              hae⟩
        have : e ∈ p.incidentEdges a := by simpa [heqI] using heC
        exact hneP (GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 this).1
      simp [hnone]
  have hinter : 3 ≤ (S ∩ p.edges).card := by
    have hd : Disjoint (S ∩ p.edges) (S \ p.edges) := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
      intro e heI heD
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 heD).2 (Finset.mem_inter.1 heI).2
    have hdecomp : S = (S ∩ p.edges) ∪ (S \ p.edges) := by
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
      tauto
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hdecomp
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd] at hcard
    omega
  exact hinter

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.three_le_path_boundary_weak
statement:
lemma three_le_path_boundary_weak {H A U0 Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = H)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ H \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (H \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hdisjAY : Disjoint A Y)
    {p : GraphPath G}
    (hAH : A ⊆ p.support)
    (hP : p.ProtectedAt c A)
    (hsY : p.start ∈ Y)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    (h2p : 2 ≤ p.support.card) :
    3 ≤ (p.boundaryEdges U0).card
proof:
:= by
  let S := c.boundaryEdges U0
  have hSsub : S ∩ p.edges ⊆ p.boundaryEdges U0 := by
    intro e he
    have ⟨heS, heP⟩ := mem_inter.1 he
    exact GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2
      ⟨heP, ((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).2⟩
  have hinter :=
    three_le_retained_cycle_seams (c := c) hc hA hU0 hY hnocross hdisjAY
      hAH hP hsY h4 h2p
  exact le_trans hinter (card_le_card hSsub)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchThrough_leftover_starts
statement:
lemma exists_switchThrough_leftover_starts {H A D : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (hcH : cH.support = H)
    (hA : A ⊆ H)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = H) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {r : GraphPath G} (hr : r.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.start ≠ R.start)
    (hsu : G.Adj Q.start r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish R.start) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.ProtectedAt cH A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Q.start ∈ p.support := leftoverPieces_start_mem hQ
  have hne : Q.start ≠ p.start := leftoverPieces_start_ne hs hQ
  have huA : Q.start ∉ A := leftover_start_not_mem hQ
  have hvA : R.start ∉ A := leftover_start_not_mem hR
  have hvOpen : R.start ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support := by
    rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]
    exact leftoverPieces_start_mem hR
  have hd : Disjoint r.support p.support := by
    simpa [hr, hp] using hdisj.symm
  have hrA : Disjoint r.support A := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxR hxA
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hA hxA) (by simpa [hr] using hxR)
  let q := switchOpenStartsThrough p r hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hd hsu hfv
  have hqU : q.support = H ∪ D := by
    simpa [q, hp, hr] using
      switchOpenStartsThrough_support p r hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hd hsu hfv
  refine ⟨q, hqU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact switchOpenStartsThrough_ProtectedAt p r hu hclose hne hvOpen
      hneQR.symm hd hsu hfv huA hvA hrA hedges
  · have hst := switchOpenStartsThrough_start p r hu hclose hne hvOpen
      hneQR.symm hd hsu hfv
    have hpred := leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem hs hQ hR hclose hneQR
    simpa [q, hst] using hpred
  · have hfin := switchOpenStartsThrough_finish p r hu hclose hne hvOpen
      hneQR.symm hd hsu hfv
    have hpred := leftoverPred_start_predecessor_mem hs hQ
    simpa [q, hfin] using hpred
  · intro hst
    have hnil : q.walk.Nil := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish q).2 hst
    have hsing : q.support = {q.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil q hnil
    have hcard : q.support.card = 1 := by simp [hsing]
    have h3 : 3 ≤ H.card := by simpa [hcH] using cH.three_le_card_support
    have : 3 ≤ q.support.card := by
      have : H ⊆ q.support := by
        intro x hx
        simpa [hqU] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hx)
      exact h3.trans (card_le_card this)
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchThrough_of_preds
statement:
lemma exists_switchThrough_of_preds {H A D : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (hcH : cH.support = H) (hA : A ⊆ H)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = H)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {r : GraphPath G} (hr : r.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ p.support) (hneuv : u ≠ v)
    (hsu : G.Adj u r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish v)
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A)
    (hfinA : (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate ∈ A)
    (hstartA :
      ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
        (by rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate ∈
          A) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.ProtectedAt cH A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hvOpen : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support := by
    rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv
  have hd : Disjoint r.support p.support := by
    simpa [hr, hp] using hdisj.symm
  have hrA : Disjoint r.support A := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxR hxA
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hA hxA) (by simpa [hr] using hxR)
  let q := switchOpenStartsThrough p r hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hd hsu hfv
  have hqU : q.support = H ∪ D := by
    simpa [q, hp, hr] using
