      switchOpenStartsThrough_support p r hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hd hsu hfv
  refine ⟨q, hqU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact switchOpenStartsThrough_ProtectedAt p r hu hclose hne hvOpen
      hneuv.symm hd hsu hfv huA hvA hrA hedges
  · have hst := switchOpenStartsThrough_start p r hu hclose hne hvOpen
      hneuv.symm hd hsu hfv
    simpa [q, hst] using hstartA
  · have hfin := switchOpenStartsThrough_finish p r hu hclose hne hvOpen
      hneuv.symm hd hsu hfv
    simpa [q, hfin] using hfinA
  · intro hst
    have hnil : q.walk.Nil := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish q).2 hst
    have hsing : q.support = {q.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil q hnil
    have hcard : q.support.card = 1 := by simp [hsing]
    have h3 : 3 ≤ H.card := by simpa [hcH] using cH.three_le_card_support
    have : 3 ≤ q.support.card := by
      have : H ⊆ q.support := by
        intro x hx
        simpa [hqU] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hx)
      exact h3.trans (card_le_card this)
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchThrough_leftover_finishes_of_ne_finish
statement:
lemma exists_switchThrough_leftover_finishes_of_ne_finish {H A D : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (hcH : cH.support = H) (hA : A ⊆ H)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = H) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {r : GraphPath G} (hr : r.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.finish ≠ R.finish) (hneFin : Q.finish ≠ p.finish)
    (hsu : G.Adj Q.finish r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish R.finish) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.ProtectedAt cH A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  let pr := GraphPath.reverse p
  have hpR : pr.support = H := by
    simpa [pr, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp
  have hcloseR : G.Adj pr.finish pr.start := by
    change G.Adj p.start p.finish
    exact hclose.symm
  have hedgesR : pr.edges ∪ {s(pr.finish, pr.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset := by
    rw [leftoverPred_reverse_edges p]
    change p.edges ∪ {s(p.start, p.finish)} = _
    rw [show s(p.start, p.finish) = s(p.finish, p.start) from Sym2.eq_swap]
    exact hedges
  have hu : Q.finish ∈ pr.support := by
    simpa [pr, GraphPath.support_reverse] using leftoverPieces_finish_mem hQ
  have hv : R.finish ∈ pr.support := by
    simpa [pr, GraphPath.support_reverse] using leftoverPieces_finish_mem hR
  have hne : Q.finish ≠ pr.start := by
    change Q.finish ≠ p.finish
    exact hneFin
  have huA : Q.finish ∉ A := leftover_finish_not_mem hQ
  have hvA : R.finish ∉ A := leftover_finish_not_mem hR
  have hfinA : (pr.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate ∈ A := by
    simpa [pr] using leftoverPred_reverse_finish_predecessor_mem hQ hneFin
  have hstartA :
      ((openAtStart pr hu hcloseR hne).takeUntil
        (by rw [openAtStart_support pr hu hcloseR hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate ∈
          A :=
    leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem_of_pred (A := A) pr hu hv
      hcloseR hne hneQR
      (fun hvs =>
        leftoverPred_reverse_finish_predecessor_mem hR
          (show R.finish ≠ p.finish from hvs))
      (fun _ => by
        change p.start ∈ A
        exact hs)
  exact exists_switchThrough_of_preds (cH := cH) hcH hA hpR hcloseR hedgesR
    hr hdisj hu hne hv hneQR hsu hfv huA hvA hfinA hstartA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchThrough_leftover_finishes
statement:
lemma exists_switchThrough_leftover_finishes {H A D : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (hcH : cH.support = H) (hA : A ⊆ H)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = H) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {r : GraphPath G} (hr : r.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.finish ≠ R.finish)
    (hsu : G.Adj Q.finish r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish R.finish) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.ProtectedAt cH A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hneFin : Q.finish = p.finish
  · have hRfin : R.finish ≠ p.finish := fun h =>
      hneQR (hneFin.trans h.symm)
    let r' := GraphPath.reverse r
    have hr' : r'.support = D := by
      simpa [r', GraphPath.support_reverse] using hr
    have hsu' : G.Adj R.finish r'.start := by
      change G.Adj R.finish r.finish
      exact hfv.symm
    have hfv' : G.Adj r'.finish Q.finish := by
      change G.Adj r.start Q.finish
      exact hsu.symm
    exact exists_switchThrough_leftover_finishes_of_ne_finish (cH := cH) hcH hA
      hp hs hclose hedges hr' hdisj hR hQ hneQR.symm hRfin hsu' hfv'
  · exact exists_switchThrough_leftover_finishes_of_ne_finish (cH := cH) hcH hA
      hp hs hclose hedges hr hdisj hQ hR hneQR hneFin hsu hfv

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_on_leftover_of_eligible_K0
statement:
lemma eligible_on_leftover_of_eligible_K0 {H A : Finset V}
    (hK0 : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (H \ A))
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = H)
    {pc : PathCover G (H \ A)}
    (hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (H \ A))
    (hpaths : pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p)
    {Q : GraphPath G} (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    {u : V} (huE : u ∈ eligibleSet G (H \ A)) (huQ : u ∈ Q.support) :
    Eligible G Q.support u
proof:
:= by
  let P : GraphPath G → Bool := fun q => decide (q.start = Q.start)
  have hPtrue : P Q = true := by simp [P]
  have hfilter : pc.paths.filter P = [Q] := by
    rw [hpaths]
    have hx : Q ∈ (leftoverPieces A p).filter P :=
      List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hQ, hPtrue⟩
    have huniq : ∀ R ∈ (leftoverPieces A p).filter P, R = Q := by
      intro R hR
      obtain ⟨hRmem, hPR⟩ := List.mem_filter.1 hR
      have hst : R.start = Q.start := of_decide_eq_true (by simpa [P] using hPR)
      by_cases hne : R = Q
      · exact hne
      · have hd : Disjoint R.support Q.support :=
          PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem
            (leftoverPieces_pairwise (B := A) p) hRmem hQ hne
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hd R.start_mem_support
          (by simpa [hst] using Q.start_mem_support)).elim
    have hnodF : ((leftoverPieces A p).filter P).Nodup :=
      (leftoverPieces_nodup (B := A) p).filter _
    match hf : (leftoverPieces A p).filter P with
    | [] =>
      have : Q ∈ ([] : List (GraphPath G)) := by simpa [hf] using hx
      cases this
    | [z] =>
      have : z = Q := huniq z (by simp [hf])
      simpa [hf, this]
    | z :: w :: rest =>
      have hz : z = Q := huniq z (by simp [hf])
      have hw : w = Q := huniq w (by simp [hf])
      have hnod' : (z :: w :: rest).Nodup := by simpa [hf] using hnodF
      have hzw : z = w := hz.trans hw.symm
      exact False.elim ((List.nodup_cons.1 hnod').1 (by simp [hzw]))
  have hunion : supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) = Q.support := by
    rw [hfilter]
    simp [supportUnion]
  have hrest :=
    restriction_eq_of_min_cover_of_canonical (U := H \ A) hK0 pc hmin P
  have huL : u ∈ eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) := by
    have : u ∈ eligibleSet G (H \ A) ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) :=
      mem_inter.2 ⟨huE, by
        rw [hunion]; exact huQ⟩
    simpa [hrest.2.1] using this
  have hEl : Eligible G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) u :=
    ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 huL).2
  simpa [hunion] using hEl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_H_from_eligible_leftover
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_H_from_eligible_leftover {H A : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (hcH : cH.support = H)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = H) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q : GraphPath G} (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    {u : V} (huQ : u ∈ Q.support)
    (h2Q : 2 ≤ Q.support.card)
    (hcog : IsCograph G Q.support)
    (huE : Eligible G Q.support u) :
    ∃ p0 : GraphPath G,
      p0.support = H ∧ p0.start = u ∧ p0.finish ∈ A ∧ p0.ProtectedAt cH A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rC, hrC, hrs, hrf, hadjS, hadjF, hsubE, hseamS, hseamF⟩ :=
    exists_complement_of_leftover_edges (A := A) hs hQ hclose
  have hQsub : Q.support ⊆ p.support := leftoverPieces_support_subset p Q hQ
  have hdisjQC : Disjoint Q.support rC.support := by
    rw [hrC]
    exact disjoint_left.2 fun x hxQ hxR => (mem_sdiff.1 hxR).2 hxQ
  have hQA : Disjoint Q.support A := leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p Q hQ
  rcases exists_compatible_old_end (Q := Q) (b := u) h2Q hcog huE huQ with hToS | hToF
  · obtain ⟨_hne, Qi, hQi, hends⟩ := hToS
    have hnorm :
        ∃ Qi' : GraphPath G,
          Qi'.support = Q.support ∧ Qi'.start = u ∧ Qi'.finish = Q.start := by
      rcases hends with ⟨hs', hf'⟩ | ⟨hs', hf'⟩
      · exact ⟨Qi, hQi, hs', hf'⟩
      · refine ⟨GraphPath.reverse Qi,
          by simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hQi, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change Qi.finish = u; exact hf'
        · change Qi.start = Q.start; exact hs'
    obtain ⟨Qi', hsup', hst', hfin'⟩ := hnorm
    have hstR : (GraphPath.reverse rC).start = rC.finish := rfl
    have hadj : G.Adj Qi'.finish (GraphPath.reverse rC).start := by
      simpa [hfin', hstR] using hadjS.symm
    have hd : Disjoint Qi'.support (GraphPath.reverse rC).support := by
      simpa [hsup', GraphPath.support_reverse] using hdisjQC
    let p0 := Qi'.splice (GraphPath.reverse rC) hadj hd
    have hQsubH : Q.support ⊆ H := by simpa [hp] using hQsub
    have hsup0 : p0.support = H := by
      rw [GraphPath.support_splice, hsup', GraphPath.support_reverse, hrC, hp]
      exact union_sdiff_of_subset hQsubH
    refine ⟨p0, hsup0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change Qi'.start = u; exact hst'
    · change (GraphPath.reverse rC).finish ∈ A
      change rC.start ∈ A
      exact hrs
    · intro e he
      obtain ⟨heE, b, hbA, hbe⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
      have hse :
          p0.edges =
            Qi'.edges ∪ (GraphPath.reverse rC).edges ∪
              {s(Qi'.finish, (GraphPath.reverse rC).start)} :=
        edges_splice Qi' (GraphPath.reverse rC) hadj hd
      have heE' : e ∈
          Qi'.edges ∪ (GraphPath.reverse rC).edges ∪
            {s(Qi'.finish, (GraphPath.reverse rC).start)} := by
        rwa [hse] at heE
      rcases mem_union.1 heE' with h | hseam
      · rcases mem_union.1 h with hQiE | hrE
        · have hempty : Qi'.AIncident A = ∅ :=
            AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support Qi' (by simpa [hsup'] using hQA)
          exact (notMem_empty e (by
            have : e ∈ Qi'.AIncident A := mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hQiE, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
            simpa [hempty] using this)).elim
        · have hrE' : e ∈ rC.edges := by
            simpa [GraphPath.edges_reverse] using hrE
          simpa [hedges] using hsubE hrE'
      · have heq : e = s(Q.start, rC.finish) := by
          have := mem_singleton.1 hseam
          simpa [hfin', hstR] using this
        have : e ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := by
          simpa [heq, Sym2.eq_swap] using hseamS
        simpa [hedges] using this
  · obtain ⟨_hne, Qi, hQi, hends⟩ := hToF
    have hnorm :
        ∃ Qi' : GraphPath G,
          Qi'.support = Q.support ∧ Qi'.start = u ∧ Qi'.finish = Q.finish := by
      rcases hends with ⟨hs', hf'⟩ | ⟨hs', hf'⟩
      · exact ⟨Qi, hQi, hs', hf'⟩
      · refine ⟨GraphPath.reverse Qi,
          by simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hQi, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change Qi.finish = u; exact hf'
        · change Qi.start = Q.finish; exact hs'
    obtain ⟨Qi', hsup', hst', hfin'⟩ := hnorm
    have hadj : G.Adj Qi'.finish rC.start := by simpa [hfin'] using hadjF
    have hd : Disjoint Qi'.support rC.support := by simpa [hsup'] using hdisjQC
    let p0 := Qi'.splice rC hadj hd
    have hQsubH : Q.support ⊆ H := by simpa [hp] using hQsub
    have hsup0 : p0.support = H := by
      rw [GraphPath.support_splice, hsup', hrC, hp]
      exact union_sdiff_of_subset hQsubH
    refine ⟨p0, hsup0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change Qi'.start = u; exact hst'
    · change rC.finish ∈ A; exact hrf
    · intro e he
      obtain ⟨heE, b, hbA, hbe⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
      have hse : p0.edges = Qi'.edges ∪ rC.edges ∪ {s(Qi'.finish, rC.start)} :=
        edges_splice Qi' rC hadj hd
      have heE' : e ∈ Qi'.edges ∪ rC.edges ∪ {s(Qi'.finish, rC.start)} := by
        rwa [hse] at heE
      rcases mem_union.1 heE' with h | hseam
      · rcases mem_union.1 h with hQiE | hrE
        · have hempty : Qi'.AIncident A = ∅ :=
            AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support Qi' (by simpa [hsup'] using hQA)
          exact (notMem_empty e (by
            have : e ∈ Qi'.AIncident A := mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hQiE, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
            simpa [hempty] using this)).elim
        · simpa [hedges] using hsubE hrE
      · have heq : e = s(Q.finish, rC.start) := by
          have := mem_singleton.1 hseam
          simpa [hfin'] using this
        have : e ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := by
          simpa [heq] using hseamF
        simpa [hedges] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil
statement:
lemma disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hne : x ≠ p.start) :
    Disjoint
      ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish (takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hx hne)).support
      (p.dropUntil hx).support
proof:
:= by
  have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hx hne
  have hU := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hx
  have hlen := takeUntil_dropUntil_length_add p hx
  have hcardT := GraphPath.card_support (p.takeUntil hx)
  have hcardD := GraphPath.card_support (p.dropUntil hx)
  have hcardP := GraphPath.card_support p
  have hsum :
      (p.takeUntil hx).support.card + (p.dropUntil hx).support.card =
        p.support.card + 1 := by omega
  have hinter :
      ((p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support).card = 1 := by
    have hcu :=
      card_union_add_card_inter (p.takeUntil hx).support (p.dropUntil hx).support
    have : ((p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support).card =
        p.support.card := by simp [hU]
    omega
  have hxI : x ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_inter.2 ⟨by
        have : (p.takeUntil hx).finish = x := rfl
        simpa [this] using (p.takeUntil hx).finish_mem_support,
      by
        have : (p.dropUntil hx).start = x := rfl
        simpa [this] using (p.dropUntil hx).start_mem_support⟩
  have hinters :
      (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support = {x} := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hinter
    have : x = w := mem_singleton.1 (by simpa [hw] using hxI)
    simpa [this] using hw
  rw [support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hnn]
  have hfin : (p.takeUntil hx).finish = x := rfl
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro z hz hzD
  have hz' : z ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support.erase x := by simpa [hfin] using hz
  obtain ⟨hzne, hzT⟩ := mem_erase.1 hz'
  have : z ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_inter.2 ⟨hzT, hzD⟩
  exact hzne (by simpa [hinters] using this)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_insert_D_across_A_dart
statement:
lemma exists_insert_D_across_A_dart {H A D : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (_hcH : cH.support = H) (hA : A ⊆ H)
    {p0 r : GraphPath G} {a x : V}
    (hp0 : p0.support = H) (huA : p0.start ∉ A) (hfA : p0.finish ∈ A)
    (hP : p0.ProtectedAt cH A)
    (hr : r.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    (hsu : G.Adj p0.start r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish x)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hx : x ∈ p0.support) (hxA : x ∉ A)
    (hneux : x ≠ p0.start)
    (hpen : (p0.takeUntil hx).walk.penultimate = a) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.ProtectedAt cH A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hxneS : x ≠ p0.start := hneux
  have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hx hxneS
  let pre := (p0.takeUntil hx).trimFinish hnn
  have hpreSt : pre.start = p0.start := trimFinish_start (p0.takeUntil hx) hnn
  have hpreFin : pre.finish = a := hpen
  have hdPR : Disjoint pre.support r.support := by
    rw [hr]
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro z hzP hzD
    have hzH : z ∈ H := by
      have hzT : z ∈ (p0.takeUntil hx).support := by
        have := support_trimFinish (p0.takeUntil hx) hnn
        have hfin : (p0.takeUntil hx).finish = x := rfl
        have : z ∈ (p0.takeUntil hx).support.erase x := by
          simpa [this, hfin, pre] using hzP
        exact (mem_erase.1 this).2
      have : z ∈ p0.support := leftoverPred_takeUntil_support_subset p0 hx hzT
      simpa [hp0] using this
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzH hzD
  have hrA : Disjoint r.support A :=
    disjoint_left.2 fun z hzR hzA =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hA hzA) (by simpa [hr] using hzR)
  have huD : p0.start ∉ r.support := by
    intro h
    have : p0.start ∈ H := by simpa [hp0] using p0.start_mem_support
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj this (by simpa [hr] using h)
  have hxD : x ∉ r.support := by
    intro h
    have : x ∈ H := by simpa [hp0] using hx
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj this (by simpa [hr] using h)
  have hrstartA : r.start ∉ A := disjoint_left.1 hrA r.start_mem_support
  have hrfinA : r.finish ∉ A := disjoint_left.1 hrA r.finish_mem_support
  have hadjUR : G.Adj pre.reverse.finish r.start := by
    have : pre.reverse.finish = pre.start := rfl
    simpa [this, hpreSt] using hsu
  have hdRev : Disjoint pre.reverse.support r.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hdPR
  let q1 := pre.reverse.splice r hadjUR hdRev
  have hdisjSuf : Disjoint q1.support (p0.dropUntil hx).support := by
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_reverse]
    refine disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [pre] using
        disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil p0 hx hxneS
    · refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro z hzR hzS
      have hzH : z ∈ H := by
        have hU := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p0 hx
        have : z ∈ (p0.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p0.dropUntil hx).support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzS)
        have : z ∈ p0.support := by simpa [hU] using this
        simpa [hp0] using this
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzH (by simpa [hr] using hzR)
  have hadjXS : G.Adj q1.finish (p0.dropUntil hx).start := by
    change G.Adj r.finish x
    exact hfv
  let q := q1.splice (p0.dropUntil hx) hadjXS hdisjSuf
  have hqU : q.support = H ∪ D := by
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_reverse]
    have hU :=
      support_trimFinish_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p0 hx hxneS
    have hassoc : pre.support ∪ r.support ∪ (p0.dropUntil hx).support =
        (pre.support ∪ (p0.dropUntil hx).support) ∪ r.support := by
      ac_rfl
    rw [hassoc]
    have hHD : pre.support ∪ (p0.dropUntil hx).support = H := by
      simpa [pre, hp0] using hU
    rw [hHD, hr]
  refine ⟨q, hqU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨heE, b, hbA, hbe⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
    have hse :
        q.edges = q1.edges ∪ (p0.dropUntil hx).edges ∪
          {s(q1.finish, (p0.dropUntil hx).start)} :=
      edges_splice q1 (p0.dropUntil hx) hadjXS hdisjSuf
    have heE' : e ∈ q1.edges ∪ (p0.dropUntil hx).edges ∪
        {s(q1.finish, (p0.dropUntil hx).start)} := by
      rwa [hse] at heE
    have hse1 :
        q1.edges = pre.reverse.edges ∪ r.edges ∪
          {s(pre.reverse.finish, r.start)} :=
      edges_splice pre.reverse r hadjUR hdRev
    rcases mem_union.1 heE' with h | hseam
    · rcases mem_union.1 h with hq1E | hD
      · have hq1E' : e ∈ pre.reverse.edges ∪ r.edges ∪
            {s(pre.reverse.finish, r.start)} := by
          rwa [hse1] at hq1E
        rcases mem_union.1 hq1E' with h' | hseam1
        · rcases mem_union.1 h' with hpreE | hrE
          · have hpreE' : e ∈ pre.edges := by
              simpa [GraphPath.edges_reverse] using hpreE
            have hsub : pre.edges ⊆ p0.edges :=
              (edges_trimFinish_subset (p0.takeUntil hx) hnn).trans
                (edges_takeUntil_subset p0 hx)
            exact hP (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hsub hpreE', ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩)
          · have : e ∈ r.AIncident A := mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hrE, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
            have hempty : r.AIncident A = ∅ :=
              AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support r hrA
            exact (notMem_empty e (by simpa [hempty] using this)).elim
        · have heq : e = s(p0.start, r.start) := by
            have h1 := mem_singleton.1 hseam1
            have h2 : pre.reverse.finish = pre.start := rfl
            simpa [h2, hpreSt] using h1
          rcases (show ∃ t, t ∈ e ∧ t ∈ A from ⟨b, hbe, hbA⟩) with ⟨t, hte, htA⟩
          have htends : t = p0.start ∨ t = r.start := by
            have : t ∈ s(p0.start, r.start) := by simpa [heq] using hte
            exact Sym2.mem_iff.1 this
          rcases htends with ht | ht
          · exact (huA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
          · exact (hrstartA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
      · have hsub : (p0.dropUntil hx).edges ⊆ p0.edges :=
          edges_dropUntil_subset p0 hx
        exact hP (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hsub hD, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩)
    · have heq : e = s(r.finish, x) := by
        have h1 := mem_singleton.1 hseam
        have h2 : q1.finish = r.finish := rfl
        have h3 : (p0.dropUntil hx).start = x := rfl
        simpa [h2, h3] using h1
      rcases (show ∃ t, t ∈ e ∧ t ∈ A from ⟨b, hbe, hbA⟩) with ⟨t, hte, htA⟩
      have htends : t = r.finish ∨ t = x := by
        have : t ∈ s(r.finish, x) := by simpa [heq] using hte
        exact Sym2.mem_iff.1 this
      rcases htends with ht | ht
      · exact (hrfinA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
      · exact (hxA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
  · have hstq : q.start = a := by
      change pre.reverse.start = a
      change pre.finish = a
      exact hpreFin
    simpa [hstq] using haA
  · have hfinq : q.finish = p0.finish := rfl
    simpa [hfinq] using hfA
  · intro hst
    have hnil : q.walk.Nil := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish q).2 hst
    have hsing : q.support = {q.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil q hnil
    have hcard : q.support.card = 1 := by simp [hsing]
    have h2 : 2 ≤ H.card := by
      have hne : p0.start ≠ p0.finish := fun h => huA (h ▸ hfA)
      have hnnP : ¬ p0.walk.Nil := fun hn =>
        hne ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p0).1 hn)
      have hpos : 0 < p0.walk.length := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 =>
        hnnP (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.1 h0)
      have hcardp := GraphPath.card_support p0
      have : 2 ≤ p0.support.card := by omega
      simpa [hp0] using this
    have : 2 ≤ q.support.card := by
      have : H ⊆ q.support := by
        intro z hz
        simpa [hqU] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz)
      exact h2.trans (card_le_card this)
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_insert_D_across_factor
statement:
lemma exists_insert_D_across_factor {H A D : Finset V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (_hcH : cH.support = H) (hA : A ⊆ H)
    {p0 r : GraphPath G} {a x : V}
    (hp0 : p0.support = H) (huA : p0.start ∉ A) (hfA : p0.finish ∈ A)
    (hP : p0.ProtectedAt cH A)
    (hr : r.support = D) (hdisj : Disjoint H D)
    (hsu : G.Adj p0.start r.start) (hfv : G.Adj r.finish x)
    (F : PrefixEdgeFactor p0 a x)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hxA : x ∉ A) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = H ∪ D ∧ q.ProtectedAt cH A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  let pre := F.prefixPath
  let suf := F.suffixPath
  have hpreSt : pre.start = p0.start := rfl
  have hpreFin : pre.finish = a := rfl
  have hsufSt : suf.start = x := rfl
  have haPre : a ≠ p0.start := fun h => huA (h ▸ haA)
  have hpreNN : ¬ pre.walk.Nil := fun hn =>
    haPre ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish pre).1 hn).symm
  have hdPR : Disjoint pre.support r.support := by
    rw [hr]
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro z hzP hzD
    have hzH : z ∈ H := by
      have hU := F.support_eq_union
      have hzPS : z ∈ F.prefixPath.support ∪ F.suffixPath.support :=
        mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by simpa [pre] using hzP))
      have hzP0 : z ∈ p0.support := by rwa [hU]
      rwa [hp0] at hzP0
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzH hzD
  have hrA : Disjoint r.support A :=
    disjoint_left.2 fun z hzR hzA =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hA hzA) (by simpa [hr] using hzR)
  have hrstartA : r.start ∉ A := disjoint_left.1 hrA r.start_mem_support
  have hrfinA : r.finish ∉ A := disjoint_left.1 hrA r.finish_mem_support
  have hadjUR : G.Adj pre.reverse.finish r.start := by
    have : pre.reverse.finish = pre.start := rfl
    simpa [this, hpreSt] using hsu
  have hdRev : Disjoint pre.reverse.support r.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hdPR
  let q1 := pre.reverse.splice r hadjUR hdRev
  have hdisjSuf : Disjoint q1.support suf.support := by
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_reverse]
    refine disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [pre, suf] using F.disjoint_prefixPath_suffixPath
    · refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro z hzR hzS
      have hzH : z ∈ H := by
        have hU := F.support_eq_union
        have hzPS : z ∈ F.prefixPath.support ∪ F.suffixPath.support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inr (by simpa [suf] using hzS))
        have hzP0 : z ∈ p0.support := by rwa [hU]
        rwa [hp0] at hzP0
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzH (by simpa [hr] using hzR)
  have hadjXS : G.Adj q1.finish suf.start := by
    change G.Adj r.finish x
    exact hfv
  let q := q1.splice suf hadjXS hdisjSuf
  have hqU : q.support = H ∪ D := by
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_reverse]
    have hassoc : pre.support ∪ r.support ∪ suf.support =
        (pre.support ∪ suf.support) ∪ r.support := by
      ac_rfl
    rw [hassoc, hr]
    have hHD : pre.support ∪ suf.support = H := by
      simpa [pre, suf, hp0] using F.support_eq_union.symm
    rw [hHD]
  refine ⟨q, hqU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨heE, b, hbA, hbe⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
    have hse :
        q.edges = q1.edges ∪ suf.edges ∪ {s(q1.finish, suf.start)} :=
      edges_splice q1 suf hadjXS hdisjSuf
    have heE' : e ∈ q1.edges ∪ suf.edges ∪ {s(q1.finish, suf.start)} := by
      rwa [hse] at heE
    have hse1 :
        q1.edges = pre.reverse.edges ∪ r.edges ∪
          {s(pre.reverse.finish, r.start)} :=
      edges_splice pre.reverse r hadjUR hdRev
    have hpreSub : pre.edges ⊆ p0.edges := by
      intro e heP
      have hdecomp := F.edges_toFinset_eq
      have heP' : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset := by
        change e ∈ pre.walk.edges.toFinset at heP
        simpa [pre, PrefixEdgeFactor.prefixPath, GraphPath.edges] using heP
      have : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset ∪ insert s(a, x) F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset :=
        mem_union.2 (Or.inl heP')
      simpa [hdecomp] using this
    have hsufSub : suf.edges ⊆ p0.edges := by
      intro e heS
      have hdecomp := F.edges_toFinset_eq
      have heS' : e ∈ F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset := by
        change e ∈ suf.walk.edges.toFinset at heS
        simpa [suf, PrefixEdgeFactor.suffixPath, GraphPath.edges] using heS
      have : e ∈ F.preWalk.edges.toFinset ∪ insert s(a, x) F.sufWalk.edges.toFinset :=
        mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_insert.2 (Or.inr heS')))
      simpa [hdecomp] using this
    rcases mem_union.1 heE' with h | hseam
    · rcases mem_union.1 h with hq1E | hS
      · have hq1E' : e ∈ pre.reverse.edges ∪ r.edges ∪
            {s(pre.reverse.finish, r.start)} := by
          rwa [hse1] at hq1E
        rcases mem_union.1 hq1E' with h' | hseam1
        · rcases mem_union.1 h' with hpreE | hrE
          · have hpreE' : e ∈ pre.edges := by
              simpa [GraphPath.edges_reverse] using hpreE
            exact hP (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hpreSub hpreE', ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩)
          · have : e ∈ r.AIncident A := mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hrE, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩
            have hempty : r.AIncident A = ∅ :=
              AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support r hrA
            exact (notMem_empty e (by simpa [hempty] using this)).elim
        · have heq : e = s(p0.start, r.start) := by
            have h1 := mem_singleton.1 hseam1
            have h2 : pre.reverse.finish = pre.start := rfl
            simpa [h2, hpreSt] using h1
          rcases (show ∃ t, t ∈ e ∧ t ∈ A from ⟨b, hbe, hbA⟩) with ⟨t, hte, htA⟩
          have htends : t = p0.start ∨ t = r.start := by
            have : t ∈ s(p0.start, r.start) := by simpa [heq] using hte
            exact Sym2.mem_iff.1 this
          rcases htends with ht | ht
          · exact (huA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
          · exact (hrstartA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
      · exact hP (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hsufSub hS, ⟨b, hbA, hbe⟩⟩)
    · have heq : e = s(r.finish, x) := by
        have h1 := mem_singleton.1 hseam
        have h2 : q1.finish = r.finish := rfl
        have h3 : suf.start = x := hsufSt
        simpa [h2, h3] using h1
      rcases (show ∃ t, t ∈ e ∧ t ∈ A from ⟨b, hbe, hbA⟩) with ⟨t, hte, htA⟩
      have htends : t = r.finish ∨ t = x := by
        have : t ∈ s(r.finish, x) := by simpa [heq] using hte
        exact Sym2.mem_iff.1 this
      rcases htends with ht | ht
      · exact (hrfinA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
      · exact (hxA (ht ▸ htA)).elim
  · have hstq : q.start = a := by
      change pre.reverse.start = a
      change pre.finish = a
      exact hpreFin
    simpa [hstq] using haA
  · have hfinq : q.finish = p0.finish := by
      change suf.finish = p0.finish
      rfl
    simpa [hfinq] using hfA
  · intro hst
    have hnil : q.walk.Nil := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish q).2 hst
    have hsing : q.support = {q.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil q hnil
    have hcard : q.support.card = 1 := by simp [hsing]
    have h2 : 2 ≤ H.card := by
      have hne : p0.start ≠ p0.finish := fun h => huA (h ▸ hfA)
      have hnnP : ¬ p0.walk.Nil := fun hn =>
        hne ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p0).1 hn)
      have hpos : 0 < p0.walk.length := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 =>
        hnnP (Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.1 h0)
      have hcardp := GraphPath.card_support p0
      have : 2 ≤ p0.support.card := by omega
      simpa [hp0] using this
    have : 2 ≤ q.support.card := by
      have : H ⊆ q.support := by
        intro z hz
        simpa [hqU] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz)
      exact h2.trans (card_le_card this)
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_strict_absorption
statement:
theorem exists_strict_absorption {H D A : Finset V}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (cH : GraphCycle G) (cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hcH : cH.support = H) (hcD : cD.support = D)
    (hdisj : Disjoint H D) (hA : A ⊆ H) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK0 : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (H \ A))
    (hpK0 : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G ((H \ A) ∪ D))
    (hE : ∀ d ∈ D, ∃ u ∈ eligibleSet G (H \ A), G.Adj d u)
    (hpK : pathCoverNumber G ((H \ A) ∪ D) < A.card) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = H ∪ D ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt cH A
proof:
:= by
  let motive : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
    ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V) (H D A : Finset V)
      (cH : GraphCycle G) (cD : GraphCycle G),
      ((H \ A) ∪ D).card = n →
        cH.support = H → cD.support = D → Disjoint H D →
          A ⊆ H → A.Nonempty →
            Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (H \ A) →
              pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card →
                Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G ((H \ A) ∪ D) →
                  (∀ d ∈ D, ∃ u ∈ eligibleSet G (H \ A), G.Adj d u) →
                    pathCoverNumber G ((H \ A) ∪ D) < A.card →
                      ∃ p : GraphPath G,
                        p.support = H ∪ D ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
                          p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt cH A
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := motive) ((H \ A) ∪ D).card ?_ G H D A cH cD
    rfl hcH hcD hdisj hA hAne hK0 hpK0 hK hE hpK
  intro n ih Gind Hind Dind Aind cHind cDind hcard hcHind hcDind hdisjind
    hAind hAneind hK0ind hpK0ind hKind hEind hpKind
  have hK0c : IsCograph Gind (Hind \ Aind) := isCograph_iff.2 hK0ind
  have hKc : IsCograph Gind ((Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) := isCograph_iff.2 hKind
  have hSat : Saturated (G := Gind) Hind Aind := hpK0ind
  
  have hnoAAPath : ¬ ∃ q : GraphPath Gind,
      q.support = Hind ∧ q.start ∈ Aind ∧ q.finish ∈ Aind := by
    intro ⟨q, hq, hs, hf⟩
    have := pathCoverNumber_lt_of_spanning_AA (U := Hind) (A := Aind)
      hAind hAneind hq hs hf
    omega
  by_cases hAA : ∃ a ∈ Aind, ∃ hu : a ∈ cHind.support,
      cHind.succAt hu ∈ Aind ∨ (cHind.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∈ Aind
  · obtain ⟨a, haA, hu, hneigh⟩ := hAA
    obtain ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin, hne, hP⟩ :=
      exists_protectedAt_of_cycle_neighbour_A cHind hcHind haA hu hneigh
    exact (hnoAAPath ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin⟩).elim
  have hnoAA : ∀ a ∈ Aind, ∀ hu : a ∈ cHind.support,
      cHind.succAt hu ∉ Aind ∧ (cHind.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∉ Aind := by
    intro a haA hu
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact hAA ⟨a, haA, hu, Or.inl h⟩
    · intro h
      exact hAA ⟨a, haA, hu, Or.inr h⟩
  obtain ⟨pH, pc0, hpH, hsH, hcloseH, hedgesH, hmin0, hpaths0, _⟩ :=
    cycle_leftover_cover_min_of_saturated (c := cHind) hcHind hAind hAneind hSat
  have hno : NoConsecutive Aind pH :=
    NoConsecutive_of_no_AA_cycle (c := cHind) hcHind hAind hedgesH hnoAA
  
  by_cases hAdjS : ∃ Q ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH, ∃ R ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH,
      Q.start ≠ R.start ∧ Gind.Adj Q.start R.start
  · obtain ⟨Q, hQ, R, hR, hneQR, hadj⟩ := hAdjS
    obtain ⟨q, hsup, hProt, hst, hfin, hne⟩ :=
      exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_starts (c := cHind) hcHind hpH hsH
        hcloseH hedgesH hQ hR hneQR hadj
    exact (hnoAAPath ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin⟩).elim
  by_cases hAdjF : ∃ Q ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH, ∃ R ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH,
      Q.finish ≠ R.finish ∧ Gind.Adj Q.finish R.finish
  · obtain ⟨Q, hQ, R, hR, hneQR, hadj⟩ := hAdjF
    obtain ⟨q, hsup, hProt, hst, hfin, hne⟩ :=
      exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_ends (c := cHind) hcHind hpH hsH
        hcloseH hedgesH hQ hR hneQR hadj
    exact (hnoAAPath ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin⟩).elim
  have hDne : Dind.Nonempty := ⟨cDind.start, by simpa [hcDind] using
      cDind.start_mem_support⟩
  have hDconn := connected_of_cycle cDind
  have hDconn' : (Gind.induce (Dind : Set V)).Connected := hcDind ▸ hDconn
  have hDK : Dind ⊆ (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind := subset_union_right
  obtain ⟨U, hUK, hDU, hUne, hUconn, hUnc⟩ :=
    exists_block_containing (K := (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) (D := Dind)
      hDK hDne hDconn'
  let U0 := U ∩ (Hind \ Aind)
  have hU0 : U0 ⊆ Hind \ Aind := inter_subset_right
  have hU0ne : U0.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨d, hdD⟩ := hDne
    obtain ⟨u, huE, hadj⟩ := hEind d hdD
    have huK0 : u ∈ Hind \ Aind :=
      (eligibleSet_subset (G := Gind) (Hind \ Aind)) huE
    have huK : u ∈ (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind := mem_union.2 (Or.inl huK0)
    have hdU : d ∈ U := hDU hdD
    have huU : u ∈ U := by
      by_contra hnu
      exact hUnc d hdU u (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨huK, hnu⟩) hadj
    exact ⟨u, mem_inter.2 ⟨huU, huK0⟩⟩
  have hK0cog : IsCograph Gind U0 := hK0c.subset hU0
  have hnocrossU0 : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0, ¬ Gind.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have haU : a ∈ U := (mem_inter.1 ha).1
    have hbK0 : b ∈ Hind \ Aind := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
    have hbU : b ∉ U0 := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
    have hbnotU : b ∉ U := by
      intro hbinU
      exact hbU (mem_inter.2 ⟨hbinU, hbK0⟩)
    exact hUnc a haU b
      (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hbK0), hbnotU⟩) hadj
  have hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0 := by
    intro Q hQ hsU0 x hxQ
    have hxK0 : x ∈ Hind \ Aind := by
      have hxH : x ∈ Hind := by simpa [hpH] using
        leftoverPieces_support_subset pH Q hQ hxQ
      have hxA : x ∉ Aind :=
        Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B pH Q hQ) hxQ
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxH, hxA⟩
    by_contra hxU0
    have hxout : x ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0 := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxK0, hxU0⟩
    have hQs : Q.start ∈ Q.support := Q.start_mem_support
    have hsK0 : Q.start ∈ Hind \ Aind := (mem_inter.1 hsU0).2
    have hQconn : (Gind.induce (Q.support : Set V)).Connected :=
      connected_of_spanning_path Q rfl
    have hcross := subset_left_or_right_of_connected
      (A := U0) (B := (Hind \ Aind) \ U0) (D := Q.support)
      Finset.disjoint_sdiff (fun y hy => by
        have hyH : y ∈ Hind := by simpa [hpH] using
          leftoverPieces_support_subset pH Q hQ hy
        have hyA : y ∉ Aind :=
          Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B pH Q hQ) hy
        have hyK0 : y ∈ Hind \ Aind := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyH, hyA⟩
        by_cases hyU : y ∈ U0
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hyU)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyK0, hyU⟩)))
      hnocrossU0 hQconn
    rcases hcross with hQ0 | hQout
    · exact hxU0 (hQ0 hxQ)
    · exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hQout hQs)).2 hsU0
  have h2 : 2 ≤
      (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces Aind pH)).length := by
    have hq0 : pc0.card = Aind.card := by simpa [hpK0ind] using hmin0
    have hpaths : pc0.paths = leftoverPieces Aind pH := hpaths0
    
    
    have hUcard : 2 ≤ U.card := by

              have hEKA :
                  eligibleSet Gind (Hind \ Aind) =
                    eligibleSet Gind U0 ∪
                      eligibleSet Gind ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) := by
                simpa [union_sdiff_of_subset hU0] using
                  eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := Gind) hdisjRest hnocrossU0
              have hdisjYrest : Disjoint Y0 ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) :=
                disjoint_of_subset_left hY0sub disjoint_sdiff
              have hncYrest : ∀ a ∈ Y0, ∀ b ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0, ¬ Gind.Adj a b :=
                fun a ha => hnocrossU0 a (hY0sub ha)
              have hEKX :
                  eligibleSet Gind (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) =
                    eligibleSet Gind Y0 ∪
                      eligibleSet Gind ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) := by
                have hW : Y0 ∪ ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) = Hind \ (Aind ∪ X) := by
                  rw [hEqAX]
                  ext z
                  constructor
                  · intro hz
                    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzY | hzR
                    · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hU0 (mem_inter.1 hzY).2, fun hx =>
                        disjoint_left.1 hdisjY0X hzY hx⟩
                    · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_sdiff.1 hzR).1, fun hx =>
                        (mem_sdiff.1 hzR).2 (hXold hx)⟩
                  · intro hz
                    have hz0 : z ∈ Hind \ Aind := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
                    have hzX : z ∉ X := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
                    by_cases hzU : z ∈ U0
                    · have hzYX : z ∈ Y0 ∪ X := by simpa [hY0X] using hzU
                      rcases mem_union.1 hzYX with h | h
                      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl h)
                      · exact (hzX h).elim
                    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz0, hzU⟩))
                simpa [hW] using
                  eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := Gind) hdisjYrest hncYrest
              have hEeq : eligibleSet Gind (Hind \ Aind) =
                  eligibleSet Gind (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) := by
                rw [hEKA, hEKX, hEU0]
              have hEsup : eligibleSet G' (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) =
                  eligibleSet Gind (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) :=
                eligibleSet_suppressInternal (G := Gind)
                  (Finset.disjoint_sdiff).symm
              intro d hd
              obtain ⟨u, huE, hadj⟩ := hEind d hd
              have hu' : u ∈ eligibleSet G' (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) := by
                have : u ∈ eligibleSet Gind (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) := by
                  simpa [hEeq] using huE
                simpa [hEsup] using this
              have huA' : u ∉ Aind ∪ X :=
                disjoint_left.1 (Finset.disjoint_sdiff.symm)
                  ((eligibleSet_subset (G := G') (Hind \ (Aind ∪ X))) hu')
              have hdA' : d ∉ Aind ∪ X := disjoint_left.1 hdisjDA' hd
              exact ⟨u, hu', (adj_eq_on_carrier (G := Gind) hdA' huA').2 hadj⟩
            have hlt : ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) ∪ Dind).card < n := by
              have hsubX : X ⊆ Hind \ Aind := hXold.trans hU0
              have hpos : 0 < X.card := card_pos.2 hXne
              have hdisjD : Disjoint (Hind \ Aind) Dind :=
                disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset hdisjind
              have hdisjD' : Disjoint ((Hind \ Aind) \ X) Dind :=
                disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset hdisjD
              have hn : n = (Hind \ Aind).card + Dind.card := by
                rw [← hcard, card_union_of_disjoint hdisjD]
              have hnew : ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) ∪ Dind).card =
                  ((Hind \ Aind) \ X).card + Dind.card := by
                rw [hEqAX, card_union_of_disjoint hdisjD']
              have hXle : X.card ≤ (Hind \ Aind).card := card_le_card hsubX
              rw [hnew, card_sdiff_of_subset hsubX, hn]
              omega
            have hYW : Y ⊆ U0 ∪ Dind := by
              intro z hz
              have hzU : z ∈ U := by
                have hzXY : z ∈ X ∪ Y := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hz)
                simpa [hcover] using hzXY
              have : U ⊆ U0 ∪ Dind := by
                intro w hw
                by_cases hwD : w ∈ Dind
                · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hwD)
                · have hwK : w ∈ Hind \ Aind := by
                    rcases mem_union.1 (hUK hw) with h | h
                    · exact h
                    · exact (hwD h).elim
                  exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hw, hwK⟩))
              exact this hzU
            have hnorestD : ∀ a ∈ Dind, ∀ b ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0, ¬ Gind.Adj a b := by
              intro a ha b hb hadj
              have haU : a ∈ U := hDU ha
              exact hUnc a haU b (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1),
                fun hU => (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2 (mem_inter.2 ⟨hU, (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1⟩)⟩) hadj
            obtain ⟨q', hq'sup, hq'st, hq'fin, hq'ne, hq'P⟩ :=
              ih ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ X)) ∪ Dind).card hlt G' Hind Dind (Aind ∪ X)
                cH' cD' rfl hcH' hcD' hdisjind hA'sub hAne' hK0ind' hpK0'
                hKind' hE' hpK'
            obtain ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin, hne, hP⟩ :=
              exists_lift_restored_W (X := Y) (Y := X) (c := cHind) hcHind hAind
                hU0 hYW hXold hdisjYX hdisjind hXne hjoinYX hnocrossU0 hnorestD
                hpH hsH hedgesH hstay hstartYU0 hfinY h4 hq'sup hcH' hq'st hq'fin
                hq'ne hq'P hedges'
            exact ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin, hne, hP⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt_of_disjoint_A
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt_of_disjoint_A (p : GraphPath G) (c : GraphCycle G)
    {A : Finset V} (hd : Disjoint p.support A) : p.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have : e ∈ (∅ : Finset (Sym2 V)) := by
    simpa [AIncident_eq_empty_of_disjoint_support p hd] using he
  exact (notMem_empty e this).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt_of_edges_subset
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt_of_edges_subset (p : GraphPath G) (c : GraphCycle G)
    {A : Finset V} (hsub : p.edges ⊆ c.walk.edges.toFinset) :
    p.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact hsub (mem_AIncident_iff.1 he).1

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.AIncident_splice_subset
statement:
lemma AIncident_splice_subset (p q : GraphPath G) (h : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) (A : Finset V) :
    (p.splice q h hd).AIncident A ⊆
      p.AIncident A ∪ q.AIncident A ∪ {s(p.finish, q.start)}
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have ⟨heE, hb⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
  have hE : e ∈ p.edges ∪ q.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, q.start)} := by
    simpa [edges_splice p q h hd] using heE
  rcases mem_union.1 hE with h' | hsing
  · rcases mem_union.1 h' with hp | hq
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hp, hb⟩))))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨hq, hb⟩))))
  · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hsing)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt_splice_seam
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt_splice_seam (p q : GraphPath G) (c : GraphCycle G)
    {A : Finset V} (h : G.Adj p.finish q.start)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hp : p.ProtectedAt c A) (hq : q.ProtectedAt c A)
    (hseam : s(p.finish, q.start) ∈ c.walk.edges.toFinset) :
    (p.splice q h hd).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have hsub := AIncident_splice_subset p q h hd A he
  rcases mem_union.1 hsub with h' | hsing
  · rcases mem_union.1 h' with hpE | hqE
    · exact hp hpE
    · exact hq hqE
  · simpa [mem_singleton.1 hsing] using hseam

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_released_absorption_q1
statement:
lemma exists_released_absorption_q1 {H D A L : Finset V} {h : V}
    (cH : GraphCycle G) (cD : GraphCycle G)
    (pH Q r : GraphPath G)
    (hcH : cH.support = H) (hcD : cD.support = D)
    (hHD : Disjoint H D) (hA : A ⊆ H) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hLcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G L)
    (hUcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (L ∪ D))
    (hpL : pathCoverNumber G L = 1)
    (hpU : pathCoverNumber G L = pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D))
    (hhF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G L)
    (hhE : h ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∪ D))
    (hpH : pH.support = H) (hsH : pH.start ∈ A)
    (hcloseH : G.Adj pH.finish pH.start)
    (hedgesH : pH.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} =
      cH.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A pH) (hQsup : Q.support = L)
    (hr : r.support = H \ Q.support)
    (hrs : r.start ∈ A) (hrf : r.finish ∈ A)
    (hpred : G.Adj r.finish Q.start) (hsucc : G.Adj Q.finish r.start)
    (hrE : r.edges ⊆ pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)})
    (hseamS : s(r.finish, Q.start) ∈ pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)})
    (hseamF : s(Q.finish, r.start) ∈ pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)})
    (hLD : Disjoint L D) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = H ∪ D ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish = h ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt cH A
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨hrel, _⟩ :=
    traceable_release (G := G) (L := L) (D := D) (h := h)
      (u := Q.start) (v := Q.finish) cD Q hLD hcD hUcog hLcog hpU hpL
      hhF hhE hQsup rfl rfl
  have hLsubH : L ⊆ H := by
    intro z hz
    simpa [hpH] using leftoverPieces_support_subset pH Q hQ (by simpa [hQsup] using hz)
  have hLA : Disjoint L A := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzL
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B pH Q hQ)
      (by simpa [hQsup] using hzL)
  have hRAdisj : Disjoint (L ∪ D) A :=
    disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hLA, disjoint_of_subset_right hA hHD.symm⟩
  have hcycle :
      pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} = cH.walk.edges.toFinset := hedgesH
  have hrC : r.ProtectedAt cH A :=
    ProtectedAt_of_edges_subset r cH (by
      intro e he
      have : e ∈ pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} := hrE he
      rwa [hcycle] at this)
  have hrevC : r.reverse.ProtectedAt cH A := (ProtectedAt_reverse r cH A).2 hrC
  have hdRL : Disjoint (L ∪ D) r.support := by
    rw [hr, hQsup]
    exact disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨disjoint_sdiff,
      disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset hHD.symm⟩
  have hsup_eq : (L ∪ D) ∪ (H \ L) = H ∪ D := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_union, mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · rintro ((hL | hD) | ⟨hH, _⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (hLsubH hL)
      · exact Or.inr hD
      · exact Or.inl hH
    · rintro (hH | hD)
      · by_cases hzL : z ∈ L
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hzL)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hH, hzL⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hD)
  rcases hrel with ⟨R, hRsup, hRst, hRfin⟩ | ⟨R, hRsup, hRst, hRfin⟩
  · have hRA : R.ProtectedAt cH A :=
      ProtectedAt_of_disjoint_A R cH (by simpa [hRsup] using hRAdisj)
    have hadj : G.Adj R.finish r.reverse.start := by
      simpa [hRfin, GraphPath.reverse] using hpred.symm
    have hd : Disjoint R.support r.reverse.support := by
      simpa [hRsup, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hdRL
    let S := R.splice r.reverse hadj hd
    have hseam : s(R.finish, r.reverse.start) ∈ cH.walk.edges.toFinset := by
      have hmem : s(r.finish, Q.start) ∈
          pH.edges ∪ {s(pH.finish, pH.start)} := hseamS
      have : s(R.finish, r.reverse.start) = s(r.finish, Q.start) := by
        rw [hRfin]
        simp [GraphPath.reverse, Sym2.eq_swap]
      rw [this]
      exact hcycle ▸ hmem
    have hProtS : S.ProtectedAt cH A :=
      ProtectedAt_splice_seam R r.reverse cH hadj hd hRA hrevC hseam
    have hsupS : S.support = H ∪ D := by
      rw [support_splice, hRsup, GraphPath.support_reverse, hr, hQsup, hsup_eq]
    refine ⟨S.reverse, by rw [GraphPath.support_reverse, hsupS], ?_, ?_, ?_,
      (ProtectedAt_reverse S cH A).2 hProtS⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice] using hrs
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice, hRst]
    · intro heq
      have hstA : S.reverse.start ∈ A := by simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice] using hrs
      have hfin : S.reverse.finish = h := by simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice, hRst]
      have hhA : h ∈ A := by rw [← hfin, ← heq]; exact hstA
      have hin : h ∈ L ∪ D := by
        have : R.start ∈ R.support := R.start_mem_support
        simpa [hRsup, hRst] using this
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hRAdisj hin hhA).elim
  · have hRA : R.ProtectedAt cH A :=
      ProtectedAt_of_disjoint_A R cH (by simpa [hRsup] using hRAdisj)
    have hadj : G.Adj R.finish r.start := by simpa [hRfin] using hsucc
    have hd : Disjoint R.support r.support := by simpa [hRsup] using hdRL
    let S := R.splice r hadj hd
    have hseam : s(R.finish, r.start) ∈ cH.walk.edges.toFinset := by
      have heqE : s(R.finish, r.start) = s(Q.finish, r.start) := by rw [hRfin]
      rw [heqE, ← hcycle]
      exact hseamF
    have hProtS : S.ProtectedAt cH A :=
      ProtectedAt_splice_seam R r cH hadj hd hRA hrC hseam
    have hsupS : S.support = H ∪ D := by
      rw [support_splice, hRsup, hr, hQsup, hsup_eq]
    refine ⟨S.reverse, by rw [GraphPath.support_reverse, hsupS], ?_, ?_, ?_,
      (ProtectedAt_reverse S cH A).2 hProtS⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice] using hrf
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice, hRst]
    · intro heq
      have hstA : S.reverse.start ∈ A := by simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice] using hrf
      have hfin : S.reverse.finish = h := by simpa [GraphPath.reverse, S, splice, hRst]
      have hhA : h ∈ A := by rw [← hfin, ← heq]; exact hstA
      have hin : h ∈ L ∪ D := by
        have : R.start ∈ R.support := R.start_mem_support
        simpa [hRsup, hRst] using this
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hRAdisj hin hhA).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_suppressInternal
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_suppressInternal {U A' : Finset V} (hU : Disjoint U A') :
    ineligibleSet (suppressInternal G A') U = ineligibleSet G U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := suppressInternal G A')).1 hx
    refine (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hx'.1, ?_⟩
    intro hE
    have hxE : x ∈ eligibleSet G U := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hx'.1, hE⟩
    have hxE' : x ∈ eligibleSet (suppressInternal G A') U := by
      simpa [eligibleSet_suppressInternal (G := G) hU] using hxE
    exact hx'.2 ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := suppressInternal G A')).1 hxE').2
  · intro hx
    have hx' := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hx
    refine (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := suppressInternal G A')).2 ⟨hx'.1, ?_⟩
    intro hE
    have hxE' : x ∈ eligibleSet (suppressInternal G A') U :=
      (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := suppressInternal G A')).2 ⟨hx'.1, hE⟩
    have hxE : x ∈ eligibleSet G U := by
      simpa [eligibleSet_suppressInternal (G := G) hU] using hxE'
    exact hx'.2 ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hxE).2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.one_side_dominant_of_join
statement:
lemma one_side_dominant_of_join {X Y : Finset V}
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y)) :
    Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X ∨ X.card < pathCoverNumber G Y
proof:
:= by
  have hpjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hXne hYne hjoin
  by_cases hXd : Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X
  · exact Or.inl hXd
  · have hXle : pathCoverNumber G X ≤ Y.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hXd
    refine Or.inr ?_
    by_cases hYle : pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ X.card
    · have : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) = 1 := by
        rw [hpjoin]
        simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hXle, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hYle]
      omega
    · exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge hYle

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_released_absorption
statement:
theorem exists_released_absorption {H D A : Finset V} {h : V}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (cH : GraphCycle G) (cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hcH : cH.support = H) (hcD : cD.support = D)
    (hdisj : Disjoint H D) (hA : A ⊆ H) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK0 : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (H \ A))
    (hpK0 : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G ((H \ A) ∪ D))
    (hpK : pathCoverNumber G ((H \ A) ∪ D) = A.card)
    (hhF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G (H \ A))
    (hhE : h ∈ eligibleSet G ((H \ A) ∪ D)) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = H ∪ D ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish = h ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt cH A
proof:
:= by
  let motive : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
    ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V) (H D A : Finset V) (h : V)
      (cH : GraphCycle G) (cD : GraphCycle G),
      ((H \ A) ∪ D).card = n →
        cH.support = H → cD.support = D → Disjoint H D →
          A ⊆ H → A.Nonempty →
            Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (H \ A) →
              pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card →
                Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G ((H \ A) ∪ D) →
                  pathCoverNumber G ((H \ A) ∪ D) = A.card →
                    h ∈ ineligibleSet G (H \ A) →
                      h ∈ eligibleSet G ((H \ A) ∪ D) →
                        ∃ p : GraphPath G,
                          p.support = H ∪ D ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish = h ∧
                            p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt cH A
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := motive) ((H \ A) ∪ D).card ?_ G H D A h cH cD
    rfl hcH hcD hdisj hA hAne hK0 hpK0 hK hpK hhF hhE
  intro n ih Gind Hind Dind Aind hind cHind cDind hcard hcHind hcDind hdisjind
    hAind hAneind hK0ind hpK0ind hKind hpKind hhFind hhEind
  have hK0c : IsCograph Gind (Hind \ Aind) := isCograph_iff.2 hK0ind
  have hKc : IsCograph Gind ((Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) := isCograph_iff.2 hKind
  have hSat : Saturated (G := Gind) Hind Aind := hpK0ind
  have hnoAAPath : ¬ ∃ q : GraphPath Gind,
      q.support = Hind ∧ q.start ∈ Aind ∧ q.finish ∈ Aind := by
    intro ⟨q, hq, hs, hf⟩
    have := pathCoverNumber_lt_of_spanning_AA (U := Hind) (A := Aind)
      hAind hAneind hq hs hf
    omega
  by_cases hAA : ∃ a ∈ Aind, ∃ hu : a ∈ cHind.support,
      cHind.succAt hu ∈ Aind ∨ (cHind.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∈ Aind
  · obtain ⟨a, haA, hu, hneigh⟩ := hAA
    obtain ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin, hne, hP⟩ :=
      exists_protectedAt_of_cycle_neighbour_A cHind hcHind haA hu hneigh
    exact (hnoAAPath ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin⟩).elim
  have hnoAA : ∀ a ∈ Aind, ∀ hu : a ∈ cHind.support,
      cHind.succAt hu ∉ Aind ∧ (cHind.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∉ Aind := by
    intro a haA hu
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact hAA ⟨a, haA, hu, Or.inl h⟩
    · intro h
      exact hAA ⟨a, haA, hu, Or.inr h⟩
  obtain ⟨pH, pc0, hpH, hsH, hcloseH, hedgesH, hmin0, hpaths0, _⟩ :=
    cycle_leftover_cover_min_of_saturated (c := cHind) hcHind hAind hAneind hSat
  have hDne : Dind.Nonempty := ⟨cDind.start, by simpa [hcDind] using
      cDind.start_mem_support⟩
  have hDconn := connected_of_cycle cDind
  have hDconn' : (Gind.induce (Dind : Set V)).Connected := hcDind ▸ hDconn
  have hDK : Dind ⊆ (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind := subset_union_right
  obtain ⟨U, hUK, hDU, hUne, hUconn, hUnc⟩ :=
    exists_block_containing (K := (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) (D := Dind)
      hDK hDne hDconn'
  let U0 := U ∩ (Hind \ Aind)
  have hU0 : U0 ⊆ Hind \ Aind := inter_subset_right

      intro Q hQ hs
      exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hstay Q hQ hs Q.finish_mem_support, hfinX Q hQ hs⟩
    by_cases hYY : ∃ Q ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH, Q.start ∈ U0 ∧
        ∃ u ∈ Y, ∃ v ∈ Y, s(u, v) ∈ Q.edges
    · obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hsQ, u, huY, v, hvY, huvQ⟩ := hYY
      have hadjuv : Gind.Adj u v := by

      obtain ⟨q, hsup, hProt, hst, hfin, hne⟩ :=
        exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY_of_saving (c := cHind) hcHind
          hU0 hLXY hLsplit hpH hsH hcloseH hedgesH hstay h2len hfinLX hstartLX
          hQ hsQ huY hvY hadjuv huvQ
      exact (hnoAAPath ⟨q, hsup, hst, hfin⟩).elim
    have hnoYY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces Aind pH, Q.start ∈ U0 →
        ∀ u ∈ Y, ∀ v ∈ Y, s(u, v) ∉ Q.edges := by
      intro Q hQ hs u hu v hv he

    have h4 : 4 ≤ (cHind.boundaryEdges U0).card :=
      four_le_card_cycle_boundary_U0 (c := cHind) hcHind hU0 hpH hsH

    have hsurv :=
      cycle_edges_mem_suppressInternal_noYY (c := cHind) hcHind hU0
        hYold hdisjXY hpH hsH hedgesH hnoAA hnocrossU0 hstay
        hstartX hfinX hnoYY
    have hdisjDA' : Disjoint Dind (Aind ∪ Y) := by
      refine disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨hdisjind.symm.mono_right hAind, ?_⟩
      exact disjoint_of_subset_right (hYold.trans (hU0.trans sdiff_subset))
        hdisjind.symm
    have hsurvD :
        ∀ e ∈ cDind.edges, e ∈ (suppressInternal Gind (Aind ∪ Y)).edgeSet :=
      cycle_edges_subset_suppressInternal_of_disjoint (G := Gind)
        cDind (by simpa [hcDind] using hdisjDA')
    let G' := suppressInternal Gind (Aind ∪ Y)
    let cH' := cHind.transferEdges hsurv
    let cD' := cDind.transferEdges hsurvD
    have hcH' : cH'.support = Hind :=
      (GraphCycle.transferEdges_support cHind hsurv).trans hcHind
    have hcD' : cD'.support = Dind :=
      (GraphCycle.transferEdges_support cDind hsurvD).trans hcDind
    have hedges' : cH'.edges = cHind.edges :=

    have hA'sub : Aind ∪ Y ⊆ Hind := by

      · exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 (hYold h))).1
    have hAne' : (Aind ∪ Y).Nonempty := hAneind.mono subset_union_left
    have hdisjAY : Disjoint Aind Y :=

    have hEqAY : Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y) = (Hind \ Aind) \ Y :=

    have hcardLX : pathCoverNumber Gind U0 + Y.card ≤ LX.card := by
      have hle := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := Gind) LX

    have hpK0Y :
        pathCoverNumber Gind ((Hind \ Aind) \ Y) =

      pathCoverNumber_sdiff_Y_eq_add_of_nocross_join
        (W := Hind \ Aind) (U0 := U0) (X := LX) (Y := Y)

    have hcardX : pathCoverNumber Gind U + Y.card ≤ X.card := by

    have hpJY :

      pathCoverNumber_sdiff_Y_eq_add_of_nocross_join
        (W := (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) (U0 := U) (X := X) (Y := Y)

    have hKsY :
        ((Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) \ Y = (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have hzKY : z ∈ (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
        have hzY : z ∉ Y := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2

        · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)

      · intro hz

        · have hz' : z ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ Y := by simpa [hEqAY] using hz0

        · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzD), fun hy =>
            disjoint_left.1 hdisjind

    have hK0ind' : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G' (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) :=
      isCograph_iff.1
        (isCograph_suppressInternal (Finset.disjoint_sdiff).symm
          (isCograph_sdiff_union_Y (U := Hind) (A := Aind) (Y := Y) hK0c))
    have hKind' : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G'
        ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) := by
      have hdisjCar : Disjoint ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) (Aind ∪ Y) :=
        disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨Finset.disjoint_sdiff.symm, hdisjDA'⟩
      have hsub : (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind ⊆
          (Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind := by
        intro z hz

        · have hz' : z ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ Y := by simpa [hEqAY] using h

    have hpK0' :
        pathCoverNumber G' (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) = (Aind ∪ Y).card := by
      have hdisjCar : Disjoint (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) (Aind ∪ Y) :=
        Finset.disjoint_sdiff.symm
      have hp := pathCoverNumber_suppressInternal (G := Gind) hdisjCar
      have hAY : (Aind ∪ Y).card = Aind.card + Y.card :=
        card_union_of_disjoint hdisjAY
      have hpG : pathCoverNumber Gind (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) =
          (Aind ∪ Y).card := by
        simpa [hEqAY, hpK0ind, hAY] using hpK0Y
      exact hp.trans hpG
    have hpK' :
        pathCoverNumber G' ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) = (Aind ∪ Y).card := by
      have hdisjCar : Disjoint ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) (Aind ∪ Y) :=
        disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨Finset.disjoint_sdiff.symm, hdisjDA'⟩
      have hpEq := pathCoverNumber_suppressInternal (G := Gind) hdisjCar
      have hAY : (Aind ∪ Y).card = Aind.card + Y.card :=
        card_union_of_disjoint hdisjAY
      have hpG : pathCoverNumber Gind ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) =

        have : pathCoverNumber Gind (((Hind \ Aind) ∪ Dind) \ Y) =
            Aind.card + Y.card := by
          simpa [hpKind] using hpJY
        simpa [hKsY, hAY] using this

    have hWold : LX ∪ ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) = (Hind \ Aind) \ Y := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz

        · have hzU0 : z ∈ U0 := (mem_inter.1 hzL).1

    have hncLX : ∀ a ∈ LX, ∀ b ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0, ¬ Gind.Adj a b :=

    have hdisjLXRest : Disjoint LX ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) :=

    have hhFold : hind ∈ ineligibleSet Gind (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) := by

    have hhF' : hind ∈ ineligibleSet G' (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) := by
      have hdisjCar : Disjoint (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) (Aind ∪ Y) :=
        Finset.disjoint_sdiff.symm

      simpa [this] using hhFold
    have hncXrest : ∀ a ∈ X, ∀ b ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0, ¬ Gind.Adj a b := by
      intro a ha b hb hadj
      have haU : a ∈ U := hXsub ha

      have hbU0 : b ∉ U0 := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2

    have hdisjXrest : Disjoint X ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]

    have hWnew : X ∪ ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) = (Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind := by
      ext z
      constructor

        · have hzLD : z ∈ LX ∪ Dind := by simpa [hXeq'] using hzX
          rcases mem_union.1 hzLD with hzL | hzD
          · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
            have hzKY : z ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ Y := by
              have : z ∈ LX ∪ ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
              simpa [hWold] using this

          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzD)

        · have hzKY : z ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ Y := by simpa [hEqAY] using hz0
          have hzsplit : z ∈ LX ∪ ((Hind \ Aind) \ U0) := by
            simpa [hWold] using hzKY
          rcases mem_union.1 hzsplit with hzL | hzR
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((inter_subset_right (s₁ := U0)) hzL))

        eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := Gind) hdisjXrest hncXrest
    have hhEnew : hind ∈ eligibleSet Gind ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) := by

        mem_union.2 (Or.inl hhEX)
      simpa [hEnew] using this
    have hhE' : hind ∈ eligibleSet G' ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) := by
      have hdisjCar : Disjoint ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind) (Aind ∪ Y) :=
        disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨Finset.disjoint_sdiff.symm, hdisjDA'⟩

    have hlt : ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind).card < n := by

      have hdisjD' : Disjoint ((Hind \ Aind) \ Y) Dind :=

      have hYle : Y.card ≤ (Hind \ Aind).card := card_le_card hsubY

      intro z hz

      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((inter_subset_left (s₁ := U0)) hzL))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzD)
    have hnorestD : ∀ a ∈ Dind, ∀ b ∈ (Hind \ Aind) \ U0, ¬ Gind.Adj a b := by
      intro a ha b hb hadj

      have hbU0 : b ∉ U0 := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      have hbU : b ∉ U := fun hU => hbU0 (mem_inter.2 ⟨hU, hb0⟩)

    obtain ⟨q', hq'sup, hq'st, hq'fin, hq'ne, hq'P⟩ :=
      ih ((Hind \ (Aind ∪ Y)) ∪ Dind).card hlt G' Hind Dind (Aind ∪ Y) hind

        hKind' hpK' hhF' hhE'
    have hLE := suppressInternal_le Gind (Aind ∪ Y)
    by_cases hstA : q'.start ∈ Aind
    · refine ⟨q'.ofLE hLE, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,

      · simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_support] using hq'sup
      · simpa [GraphPath.ofLE_start] using hstA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_released_three_cycle
statement:
theorem exists_released_three_cycle {H D Qset A : Finset V} {x z h : V}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (cH : GraphCycle G) (cD : GraphCycle G)
    (cQ : GraphCycle G)
    (hcH : cH.support = H) (hcD : cD.support = D) (hcQ : cQ.support = Qset)
    (hHD : Disjoint H D) (hHQ : Disjoint H Qset) (hDQ : Disjoint D Qset)
    (hA : A ⊆ H) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hxQ : x ∈ Qset) (hzQ : z ∈ Qset)
    (hAx : ∀ a ∈ A, G.Adj a x)
    (hK0 : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (H \ A))
    (hpK0 : pathCoverNumber G (H \ A) = A.card)
    (hJ : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G ((H \ A) ∪ D))
    (hpJ : pathCoverNumber G ((H \ A) ∪ D) = A.card)
    (hhF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G (H \ A))
    (hhE : h ∈ eligibleSet G ((H \ A) ∪ D))
    (hzh : G.Adj z h)
    (hxC : x ∈ cQ.support) (hzC : z ∈ cQ.support)
    (hxz : cQ.succAt hxC = z ∨ cQ.succAt hzC = x) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = H ∪ D ∪ Qset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hPsup, hPst, hPfin, hPne, _⟩ :=
    exists_released_absorption (G := G) (H := H) (D := D) (A := A) (h := h)
      cH cD hcH hcD hHD hA hAne hK0 hpK0 hJ hpJ hhF hhE
  have hPnn : ¬ P.walk.Nil := fun hn =>
    hPne ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish P).1 hn)
  let Qxz : GraphPath G :=
    if hs : cQ.succAt hxC = z then
      (cQ.openAt hxC).reverse
    else
      cQ.openAt hzC
  have hQst : Qxz.start = x := by
    by_cases hs : cQ.succAt hxC = z
    · simp [Qxz, hs, GraphPath.reverse, openAt_finish]
    · have hsucc : cQ.succAt hzC = x := hxz.resolve_left hs
      simpa [Qxz, hs, openAt_start] using hsucc
  have hQfn : Qxz.finish = z := by
    by_cases hs : cQ.succAt hxC = z
    · simp [Qxz, hs, GraphPath.reverse, openAt_start]
    · simp [Qxz, hs, openAt_finish]
  have hQsup : Qxz.support = Qset := by
    by_cases hs : cQ.succAt hxC = z
    · simpa [Qxz, hs, GraphPath.support_reverse, openAt_support, hcQ]
    · simpa [Qxz, hs, openAt_support, hcQ]
  have hhQ : h ∉ Qset := by
    have hhK : h ∈ H \ A := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) _ hhF
    exact fun hzQ => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hHQ (mem_sdiff.1 hhK).1 hzQ
  have hhQxz : h ∉ Qxz.support := by simpa [hQsup] using hhQ
  have hadjzh : G.Adj Qxz.finish h := by simpa [hQfn] using hzh
  let T := Qxz.concatAdj hadjzh hhQxz
  have hTst : T.start = x := by simp [T, concatAdj, hQst]
  have hTfn : T.finish = h := by simp [T, concatAdj]
  have hTsup : T.support = insert h Qset := by
    simpa [T, support_concatAdj, hQsup]
  have hPnnR : ¬ P.reverse.walk.Nil := by simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hPnn
  let Utail := P.reverse.trimStart hPnnR
  have hUst : Utail.start = P.reverse.walk.snd := by simp [Utail, trimStart]
  have hUfn : Utail.finish = P.start := by simp [Utail, trimStart, GraphPath.reverse]
  have hrevst : P.reverse.start = h := by simp [GraphPath.reverse, hPfin]
  have hUsup : Utail.support = P.support.erase h := by
    simpa [Utail, GraphPath.support_reverse, hrevst] using
      support_trimStart P.reverse hPnnR
  have hadjTU : G.Adj T.finish Utail.start := by
    have hf : T.finish = P.reverse.start := by
      simp [T, concatAdj, hrevst]
    have hs : Utail.start = P.reverse.walk.snd := hUst
    simpa [hf, hs] using P.reverse.walk.adj_snd hPnnR
  have hdTU : Disjoint T.support Utail.support := by
    rw [hTsup, hUsup]
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro w hwT hwU
    have hwP : w ∈ P.support := (mem_erase.1 hwU).2
    have hwHD : w ∈ H ∪ D := by simpa [hPsup] using hwP
    have hneh : w ≠ h := (mem_erase.1 hwU).1
    rcases mem_insert.1 hwT with rfl | hwQ
    · exact hneh rfl
    · rcases mem_union.1 hwHD with hwH | hwD
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hHQ hwH hwQ
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hDQ hwD hwQ
  let R := T.splice Utail hadjTU hdTU
  have hRst : R.start = x := by simp [R, splice, hTst]
  have hRfn : R.finish = P.start := by simp [R, splice, hUfn]
  have hRsup : R.support = H ∪ D ∪ Qset := by
    rw [support_splice, hTsup, hUsup, hPsup]
    ext z
    simp only [mem_union, mem_insert, mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases hz with (rfl | hzQ) | ⟨_, hzHD⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.1 (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) _ hhF)).1)
      · exact Or.inr hzQ
      · exact Or.inl hzHD
    · intro hz
      rcases hz with (hzH | hzD) | hzQ
      · by_cases heq : z = h
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl heq)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨heq, Or.inl hzH⟩
      · by_cases heq : z = h
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl heq)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨heq, Or.inr hzD⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hzQ)
  have h3 : 3 ≤ R.support.card := by
    have hQ3 : 3 ≤ Qset.card := by simpa [hcQ] using cQ.three_le_card_support
    have hsub : Qset ⊆ R.support := by
      intro w hw
      have : w ∈ (H ∪ D) ∪ Qset := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hw)
      simpa [hRsup] using this
    exact hQ3.trans (card_le_card hsub)
  have hclose : G.Adj R.finish R.start := by
    simpa [hRfn, hRst] using hAx P.start hPst
  refine ⟨R.toCycle hclose h3, ?_⟩
  simpa [support_toCycle] using hRsup

name: List.zip_tail_append
statement:
theorem zip_tail_append :
    ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List α) (h₁ : l₁ ≠ []) (h₂ : l₂ ≠ []),
      (l₁ ++ l₂).zip (l₁ ++ l₂).tail =
        l₁.zip l₁.tail ++ [(l₁.getLast h₁, l₂.head h₂)] ++ l₂.zip l₂.tail
proof:
| [], _, h₁, _ => (h₁ rfl).elim
  | _ :: _, [], _, h₂ => (h₂ rfl).elim
  | [x], y :: ys, _, _ => by simp
  | x :: x' :: xs, l₂, h₁, h₂ => by
      have ih := zip_tail_append (x' :: xs) l₂ (cons_ne_nil _ _) h₂
      calc
        (x :: x' :: xs ++ l₂).zip (x :: x' :: xs ++ l₂).tail
            = (x :: (x' :: xs ++ l₂)).zip (x' :: xs ++ l₂) := by simp
        _ = (x, x') :: (x' :: xs ++ l₂).zip (x' :: xs ++ l₂).tail := by
            simp [zip_cons_cons]
        _ = (x, x') ::
              ((x' :: xs).zip (x' :: xs).tail ++
                [((x' :: xs).getLast (cons_ne_nil _ _), l₂.head h₂)] ++
                  l₂.zip l₂.tail) := by
            rw [ih]
        _ = (x :: x' :: xs).zip (x' :: xs) ++
              [((x :: x' :: xs).getLast h₁, l₂.head h₂)] ++
                l₂.zip l₂.tail := by
            simp [zip_cons_cons, getLast_cons]

name: List.mem_zip_tail_append_left
statement:
theorem mem_zip_tail_append_left {l₁ l₂ : List α} {a : α × α}
    (h₁ : l₁ ≠ []) (h₂ : l₂ ≠ [])
    (ha : a ∈ l₁.zip l₁.tail) :
    a ∈ (l₁ ++ l₂).zip (l₁ ++ l₂).tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [zip_tail_append l₁ l₂ h₁ h₂]
  simp [ha]

name: List.mem_zip_tail_append_right
statement:
theorem mem_zip_tail_append_right {l₁ l₂ : List α} {a : α × α}
    (h₁ : l₁ ≠ []) (h₂ : l₂ ≠ [])
    (ha : a ∈ l₂.zip l₂.tail) :
    a ∈ (l₁ ++ l₂).zip (l₁ ++ l₂).tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [zip_tail_append l₁ l₂ h₁ h₂]
  simp [ha]

name: List.zip_tail_subset_of_prefix
statement:
theorem zip_tail_subset_of_prefix {l m : List α} (h : l <+: m) :
    l.zip l.tail ⊆ m.zip m.tail
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h
  intro a ha
  match l, t with
  | [], _ => simp at ha
  | _ :: _, [] => simpa using ha
  | x :: xs, y :: ys =>
    exact mem_zip_tail_append_left (cons_ne_nil _ _) (cons_ne_nil _ _) ha

name: List.zip_tail_subset_of_suffix
statement:
theorem zip_tail_subset_of_suffix {l m : List α} (h : l <:+ m) :
    l.zip l.tail ⊆ m.zip m.tail
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h
  intro a ha
  match t, l with
  | [], _ => simpa using ha
  | _ :: _, [] => simp at ha
  | y :: ys, x :: xs =>
    exact mem_zip_tail_append_right (cons_ne_nil _ _) (cons_ne_nil _ _) ha

name: List.zip_tail_reverse
statement:
theorem zip_tail_reverse :
    ∀ l : List α,
      l.reverse.zip l.reverse.tail = (l.zip l.tail).reverse.map Prod.swap
proof:
| [] => by simp
  | [a] => by simp
  | a :: b :: l => by
      have ih := zip_tail_reverse (b :: l)
      have hrev : (b :: l).reverse ≠ [] := by simp
      have ha : [a] ≠ [] := cons_ne_nil _ _
      rw [reverse_cons, zip_tail_append (b :: l).reverse [a] hrev ha, ih]
      simp [zip_cons_cons, reverse_cons, map_append, Prod.swap]

name: List.zip_tail_map
statement:
theorem zip_tail_map {β : Type*} (f : α → β) :
    ∀ l : List α,
      (l.map f).zip (l.map f).tail = (l.zip l.tail).map (Prod.map f f)
proof:
| [] => by simp
  | [a] => by simp
  | a :: b :: l => by
      have ih := zip_tail_map f (b :: l)
      simpa [zip_cons_cons, Prod.map] using
        congrArg (fun t => (f a, f b) :: t) ih

name: List.head_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem head_eq_of_eq {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ = l₂) {h₁ : l₁ ≠ []} {h₂ : l₂ ≠ []} :
    l₁.head h₁ = l₂.head h₂
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: List.getLast_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem getLast_eq_of_eq {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ = l₂) {h₁ : l₁ ≠ []} {h₂ : l₂ ≠ []} :
    l₁.getLast h₁ = l₂.getLast h₂
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.isPath_append
statement:
lemma isPath_append {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hdisj : ∀ x ∈ q.support.tail, x ∉ p.support) :
    (p.append q).IsPath
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isPath_def, Walk.support_append]
  refine List.Nodup.append hp.support_nodup hq.support_nodup.tail ?_
  intro x hxP hxQ
  exact hdisj x hxQ hxP

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_nil_append_right
statement:
lemma not_nil_append_right {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    (hq : ¬ q.Nil) : ¬ (p.append q).Nil
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | nil => exact (hq Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons h q' =>
    cases p <;> simp

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.firstDart_append_of_not_nil_left
proof:
:= by
  apply Dart.ext
  cases p with
  | nil => exact (hp Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons hadj p' =>
    simp [Walk.firstDart]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.penultimate_append_of_not_nil_right
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < q.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hq
  simp [Walk.penultimate, Walk.getVert_append, Walk.length_append]
  split_ifs with hlt
  · omega
  · congr 1
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.lastDart_append_of_not_nil_right
proof:
:= by
  apply Dart.ext
  simp [Walk.lastDart, penultimate_append_of_not_nil_right hq]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.darts_ne_nil
statement: lemma darts_ne_nil {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (h : ¬ p.Nil) : p.darts ≠ []
proof:
:=
  Walk.darts_eq_nil.not.mpr h

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.firstDart_proof
statement:
lemma firstDart_proof {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (h h' : ¬ p.Nil) :
    p.firstDart h = p.firstDart h'
proof:
:= by
  apply Dart.ext
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.lastDart_proof
statement:
lemma lastDart_proof {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (h h' : ¬ p.Nil) :
    p.lastDart h = p.lastDart h'
proof:
:= by
  apply Dart.ext
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.length_zip_tail
statement:
lemma length_zip_tail {α : Type*} (l : List α) :
    (l.zip l.tail).length = l.length - 1
proof:
:= by
  cases l <;> simp [List.length_zip]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.getElem_tail_eq
statement:
lemma getElem_tail_eq {α : Type*} (l : List α) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i + 1 < l.length) :
    l.tail[i]'(by simp [List.length_tail]; omega) = l[i + 1]'hi
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons a as => rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.getElem_mem_zip_tail
statement:
lemma getElem_mem_zip_tail {α : Type*} (l : List α) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i + 1 < l.length) :
    (l[i]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi), l[i + 1]'hi) ∈ l.zip l.tail
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : i < (l.zip l.tail).length := by
    rw [length_zip_tail]
    omega
  have hget : (l.zip l.tail)[i] = (l[i]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi), l[i + 1]'hi) := by
    rw [List.getElem_zip]
    congr 1
    exact getElem_tail_eq l i hi
  exact hget ▸ List.getElem_mem _

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.isAlternating_iff_internalCuspCount_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro halt
    unfold internalCuspCount IsAlternating at *
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff, List.filter_eq_nil_iff]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hq
    have hlen : i + 1 < w.darts.length := by
      have : i < w.darts.length - 1 := by
        simpa [length_zip_tail] using hi
      omega
    have hpair :
        (w.darts.zip w.darts.tail)[i] =
          (w.darts[i]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hlen), w.darts[i + 1]'hlen) := by
      rw [List.getElem_zip]
      congr 1
      exact getElem_tail_eq w.darts i hlen
    have := halt i hlen
    simpa [hpair] using this
  · intro h0 i hi
    unfold internalCuspCount at h0
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff, List.filter_eq_nil_iff] at h0
    have := h0 _ (getElem_mem_zip_tail w.darts i hi)
    simpa using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.internalCuspCount_eq_zero_of_darts_prefix
statement:
lemma internalCuspCount_eq_zero_of_darts_prefix {u v u' v' : V}
    {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk u' v'} (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (h : p.darts <+: q.darts) (hq : internalCuspCount q c = 0) :
    internalCuspCount p c = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold internalCuspCount at *
  rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff, List.filter_eq_nil_iff] at hq ⊢
  intro pair hp
  exact hq pair (List.zip_tail_subset_of_prefix h hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.internalCuspCount_eq_zero_of_darts_suffix
statement:
lemma internalCuspCount_eq_zero_of_darts_suffix {u v u' v' : V}
    {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk u' v'} (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (h : p.darts <:+ q.darts) (hq : internalCuspCount q c = 0) :
    internalCuspCount p c = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold internalCuspCount at *
  rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff, List.filter_eq_nil_iff] at hq ⊢
  intro pair hp
  exact hq pair (List.zip_tail_subset_of_suffix h hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.internalCuspCount_takeUntil
statement:
lemma internalCuspCount_takeUntil {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hw : w ∈ p.support)
    (hp : internalCuspCount p c = 0) :
    internalCuspCount (p.takeUntil w hw) c = 0
proof:
:=
  internalCuspCount_eq_zero_of_darts_prefix c
    (Walk.darts_takeUntil_prefix_darts p hw) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.internalCuspCount_dropUntil
statement:
lemma internalCuspCount_dropUntil {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hw : w ∈ p.support)
    (hp : internalCuspCount p c = 0) :
    internalCuspCount (p.dropUntil w hw) c = 0
proof:
:=
  internalCuspCount_eq_zero_of_darts_suffix c
    (Walk.darts_dropUntil_suffix_darts p hw) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.firstDart_of_darts_prefix
statement:
lemma firstDart_of_darts_prefix {u v u' v' : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    {q : G.Walk u' v'} (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (hq : ¬ q.Nil)
    (h : p.darts <+: q.darts) :
    p.firstDart hp = q.firstDart hq
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.firstDart_eq_head_darts, Walk.firstDart_eq_head_darts]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
  have hp' := darts_ne_nil hp
  have hq' := darts_ne_nil hq
  have : q.darts.head hq' = (p.darts ++ t).head (by simp [hp']) :=
    List.head_eq_of_eq ht.symm
  rw [this, List.head_append_of_ne_nil hp']

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_nil_of_not_nil_takeUntil
statement:
lemma not_nil_of_not_nil_takeUntil {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    {hw : w ∈ p.support} (h : ¬ (p.takeUntil w hw).Nil) : ¬ p.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  cases p with
  | nil =>
    simp only [Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] at hw
    subst w
    exact h (by simp)
  | cons _ _ =>
    exact (Walk.not_nil_cons hp).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.firstDart_takeUntil
statement:
lemma firstDart_takeUntil {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hw : w ∈ p.support) (h : ¬ (p.takeUntil w hw).Nil) :
    (p.takeUntil w hw).firstDart h =
      p.firstDart (not_nil_of_not_nil_takeUntil h)
proof:
:=
  firstDart_of_darts_prefix h _ (Walk.darts_takeUntil_prefix_darts p hw)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.lastDart_of_darts_suffix
statement:
lemma lastDart_of_darts_suffix {u v u' v' : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    {q : G.Walk u' v'} (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (hq : ¬ q.Nil)
    (h : p.darts <:+ q.darts) :
    p.lastDart hp = q.lastDart hq
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.lastDart_eq_getLast_darts, Walk.lastDart_eq_getLast_darts]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
  have hp' := darts_ne_nil hp
  have hq' := darts_ne_nil hq
  have : q.darts.getLast hq' = (t ++ p.darts).getLast (by simp [hp']) :=
    List.getLast_eq_of_eq ht.symm
  rw [this, List.getLast_append_of_ne_nil (l := t) (by simp [hp']) hp']

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_nil_of_not_nil_dropUntil
statement:
lemma not_nil_of_not_nil_dropUntil {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    {hw : w ∈ p.support} (h : ¬ (p.dropUntil w hw).Nil) : ¬ p.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  cases p with
  | nil =>
    simp only [Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] at hw
    subst w
    exact h (by simp)
  | cons _ _ =>
    exact (Walk.not_nil_cons hp).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.lastDart_dropUntil
statement:
lemma lastDart_dropUntil {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hw : w ∈ p.support) (h : ¬ (p.dropUntil w hw).Nil) :
    (p.dropUntil w hw).lastDart h =
      p.lastDart (not_nil_of_not_nil_dropUntil h)
proof:
:=
