        (remain_path_getVert_val_inj hpPath (by omega) (by omega) h)
    have hne1end : (p.getVert 1).val ≠ d2 := by
      intro h
      have := remain_path_getVert_val_inj hpPath (by omega) le_rfl (h.trans hend.symm)
      omega
    have hne2end : (p.getVert 2).val ≠ d2 := by
      intro h
      have := remain_path_getVert_val_inj hpPath (by omega) le_rfl (h.trans hend.symm)
      omega
    have hadj_d1p1 : G.Adj d1 (p.getVert 1).val := by
      have := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : (0 : ℕ) < p.length)
      simpa [induce_adj, h0] using this
    have hadj_p1p2 : G.Adj (p.getVert 1).val (p.getVert 2).val := by
      have := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : (1 : ℕ) < p.length)
      simpa [induce_adj] using this
    have nAdj_t1p1 : ¬ G.Adj t1 (p.getVert 1).val := by
      intro h
      have : d1 = (p.getVert 1).val :=
        B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht1 (by simpa [h0] using hd1) h1c hadj1 h
      exact hne01 (h0.trans this)
    have nAdj_t1p2 : ¬ G.Adj t1 (p.getVert 2).val := by
      intro h
      have : d1 = (p.getVert 2).val :=
        B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht1 (by simpa [h0] using hd1) h2c hadj1 h
      exact hne02 (h0.trans this)
    have nAdj_d1p2 : ¬ G.Adj d1 (p.getVert 2).val := by
      have := not_adj_getVert_of_length_eq_dist (H := Remain G B.S B.T)
        hpDist (by omega : (0 : ℕ) ≤ p.length)
        (by omega : (2 : ℕ) ≤ p.length) (by decide : (0 : ℕ) + 2 ≤ 2)
      simpa [induce_adj, h0] using this
    have hne_t1p1 : t1 ≠ (p.getVert 1).val := by
      intro h; subst h; exact (mem_componentVerts_not_ST (G := G) h1c)
        (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht1))
    have hne_t1p2 : t1 ≠ (p.getVert 2).val := by
      intro h; subst h; exact (mem_componentVerts_not_ST (G := G) h2c)
        (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht1))
    have hne_t2d1 : t2 ≠ d1 := by
      intro h; subst h; exact hd1T ht2
    have hne_t2p1 : t2 ≠ (p.getVert 1).val := by
      intro h; subst h; exact (mem_componentVerts_not_ST (G := G) h1c)
        (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht2))
    have hne_t2p2 : t2 ≠ (p.getVert 2).val := by
      intro h; subst h; exact (mem_componentVerts_not_ST (G := G) h2c)
        (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht2))
    have nAdj_t2d1 : ¬ G.Adj t2 d1 := by
      intro h
      have : d2 = d1 :=
        B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht2 hd2 hd1 hadj2 h
      exact hneD12 this.symm
    have nAdj_t2p1 : ¬ G.Adj t2 (p.getVert 1).val := by
      intro h
      have : d2 = (p.getVert 1).val :=
        B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht2 hd2 h1c hadj2 h
      exact hne1end this.symm
    have nAdj_t2p2 : ¬ G.Adj t2 (p.getVert 2).val := by
      intro h
      have : d2 = (p.getVert 2).val :=
        B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht2 hd2 h2c hadj2 h
      exact hne2end this.symm
    have hne_d1p1 : d1 ≠ (p.getVert 1).val := by
      intro h; exact hne01 (h0.trans h)
    have hne_d1p2 : d1 ≠ (p.getVert 2).val := by
      intro h; exact hne02 (h0.trans h)
    have hp4 : InducedP4 G t1 d1 (p.getVert 1).val (p.getVert 2).val :=
      ⟨hne_t1d1, hne_t1p1, hne_t1p2, hne_d1p1, hne_d1p2, hne12,
        hadj1, hadj_d1p1, hadj_p1p2,
        nAdj_t1p1, nAdj_t1p2, nAdj_d1p2⟩
    have hiso := hpat hp4 hneT12.symm hne_t2d1 hne_t2p1 hne_t2p2
    rcases hiso with h21 | h2d1 | h2p1 | h2p2
    · exact B.T_independent ht2 ht1 h21
    · exact nAdj_t2d1 h2d1
    · exact nAdj_t2p1 h2p1
    · exact nAdj_t2p2 h2p2
  · have hle2 : p.length ≤ 2 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (lt_of_not_ge hge3)
    have hpos : 0 < p.length := by
      have hneUV :
          (⟨d1, (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hd1 |>.1⟩ :
            RemainVert B.S B.T) ≠
          ⟨d2, (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hd2 |>.1⟩ := by
        intro h
        exact hneD12 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
      have : 0 < (Remain G B.S B.T).dist
          ⟨d1, (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hd1 |>.1⟩
          ⟨d2, (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hd2 |>.1⟩ :=
        hreach.pos_dist_of_ne hneUV
      simpa [hpDist] using this
    have hlen12 : p.length = 1 ∨ p.length = 2 := by omega
    rcases hlen12 with hlen1 | hlen2
    · 
      have hadjD : G.Adj d1 d2 := by
        have := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
        have h0' : (p.getVert 0).val = d1 := by simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
        have h1' : (p.getVert 1).val = d2 := by
          have hlen := Walk.getVert_length p
          rw [hlen1] at hlen
          simp [hlen]
        simpa [induce_adj, h0', h1'] using this
      exact B.matching_attachments_not_adj hpat ht1 ht2 ht3 hneT12 hneT13 hneT23
        hd1 hd2 hd3 hneD12 hneD13 hneD23 hadj1 hadj2 hadj3 hadjD
    · 
      have hw : (p.getVert 1).val ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c :=
        remain_getVert_mem_component p hd1 1
      have h0' : (p.getVert 0).val = d1 := by simp [Walk.getVert_zero]
      have h2' : (p.getVert 2).val = d2 := by
        have hlen := Walk.getVert_length p
        rw [hlen2] at hlen
        simp [hlen]
      have hlen2' : p.length = 2 := hlen2
      have hne_dw : d1 ≠ (p.getVert 1).val := by
        intro h
        exact (by decide : (0 : ℕ) ≠ 1)
          (remain_path_getVert_val_inj hpPath (by simp [hlen2']) (by simp [hlen2'])
            (h0'.trans h))
      have hne_wd : (p.getVert 1).val ≠ d2 := by
        intro h
        exact (by decide : (1 : ℕ) ≠ 2)
          (remain_path_getVert_val_inj hpPath (by simp [hlen2']) (by simp [hlen2'])
            (h.trans h2'.symm))
      have hadj_d1w : G.Adj d1 (p.getVert 1).val := by
        have := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : (0 : ℕ) < p.length)
        simpa [induce_adj, h0'] using this
      have hadj_wd2 : G.Adj (p.getVert 1).val d2 := by
        have := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega : (1 : ℕ) < p.length)
        simpa [induce_adj, h2'] using this
      have nAdj_d1d2 : ¬ G.Adj d1 d2 :=
        B.matching_attachments_not_adj hpat ht1 ht2 ht3 hneT12 hneT13 hneT23
          hd1 hd2 hd3 hneD12 hneD13 hneD23 hadj1 hadj2 hadj3
      have nAdj_t1w : ¬ G.Adj t1 (p.getVert 1).val := by
        intro h
        have : d1 = (p.getVert 1).val :=
          B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht1 hd1 hw hadj1 h
        exact hne_dw this
      have nAdj_t1d2 : ¬ G.Adj t1 d2 := by
        intro h
        have : d1 = d2 :=
          B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht1 hd1 hd2 hadj1 h
        exact hneD12 this
      have hne_t1w : t1 ≠ (p.getVert 1).val := by
        intro h; subst h
        exact (mem_componentVerts_not_ST (G := G) hw) (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht1))
      have hne_t1d2 : t1 ≠ d2 := by
        intro h; subst h; exact hd2T ht1
      have hp4 : InducedP4 G t1 d1 (p.getVert 1).val d2 :=
        ⟨hne_t1d1, hne_t1w, hne_t1d2, hne_dw, hneD12, hne_wd,
          hadj1, hadj_d1w, hadj_wd2,
          nAdj_t1w, nAdj_t1d2, nAdj_d1d2⟩
      have hne_t3d1 : t3 ≠ d1 := by
        intro h; subst h; exact hd1T ht3
      have hne_t3w : t3 ≠ (p.getVert 1).val := by
        intro h; subst h
        exact (mem_componentVerts_not_ST (G := G) hw) (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht3))
      have hne_t3d2 : t3 ≠ d2 := by
        intro h; subst h; exact hd2T ht3
      have hiso := hpat hp4 hneT13.symm hne_t3d1 hne_t3w hne_t3d2
      rcases hiso with h31 | h3d1 | h3w | h32
      · exact B.T_independent ht3 ht1 h31
      · exact (B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht3 hd3 hd1 hadj3 h3d1 ▸ hneD13) rfl
      · have : d3 = (p.getVert 1).val :=
          B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht3 hd3 hw hadj3 h3w
        have hadj_d1d3 : G.Adj d1 d3 := by simpa [this] using hadj_d1w
        exact B.matching_attachments_not_adj hpat ht1 ht3 ht2 hneT13 hneT12 hneT23.symm
          hd1 hd3 hd2 hneD13 hneD12 hneD23.symm hadj1 hadj3 hadj2 hadj_d1d3
      · have : d3 = d2 :=
          B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors ht3 hd3 hd2 hadj3 h32
        exact hneD23 this.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.odd_attach_le_two
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.odd_attach_le_two
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (c : (Remain G B.S B.T).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentAttach G B.S B.T c ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h3 : 3 ≤ componentAttach G B.S B.T c := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h)
  obtain ⟨t1, t2, t3, d1, d2, d3, ht1, ht2, ht3, hneT12, hneT13, hneT23,
      hd1, hd2, hd3, hneD12, hneD13, hneD23, hadj1, hadj2, hadj3⟩ :=
    B.exists_three_matching h3
  exact B.matching_three_edges_false hpat ht1 ht2 ht3 hneT12 hneT13 hneT23
    hd1 hd2 hd3 hneD12 hneD13 hneD23 hadj1 hadj2 hadj3

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.componentAttach_le_one
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.componentAttach_le_one
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (c : (Remain G B.S B.T).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentAttach G B.S B.T c ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hodd : Odd (componentAttach G B.S B.T c)
  · have hle := B.odd_attach_le_two hpat c
    have hne2 : componentAttach G B.S B.T c ≠ 2 := by
      intro h2
      have : Even 2 := by decide
      exact Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 (h2 ▸ this) hodd
    omega
  · have heven : Even (componentAttach G B.S B.T c) :=
      Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mp hodd
    simpa [B.even_attach_eq_zero c heven]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.odd_attach_eq_one
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.odd_attach_eq_one
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {c : (Remain G B.S B.T).ConnectedComponent}
    (hodd : Odd (componentAttach G B.S B.T c)) :
    componentAttach G B.S B.T c = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := B.componentAttach_le_one hpat c
  have hpos : 0 < componentAttach G B.S B.T c :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 =>
      Nat.not_odd_zero (by simpa [h0] using hodd)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.internalEdgeCount_eq_zero
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.internalEdgeCount_eq_zero (B : ExtremalBarrier G) :
    internalEdgeCount G B.T = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hord : orderedEdgeCount G B.T B.T = 0 := by
    rw [orderedEdgeCount, card_eq_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff]
    intro p hp
    have hprod := mem_product.mp hp
    exact B.T_independent hprod.1 hprod.2
  have htwo := two_mul_internalEdgeCount (G := G) B.T
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.sum_attach_div_two_eq_zero
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.sum_attach_div_two_eq_zero
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    (∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G B.S B.T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G B.S B.T c / 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine sum_eq_zero fun c _ => Nat.div_eq_of_lt ?_
  exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (B.componentAttach_le_one hpat c)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.delta_eq_two_sub
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.delta_eq_two_sub
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    delta G B.S B.T = 2 * ((B.S.card : ℤ) - (B.T.card : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hΔ := delta_eq_two_mul (G := G) B.disjoint
  have hinter := B.internalEdgeCount_eq_zero
  have hsum := B.sum_attach_div_two_eq_zero hpat
  simp [hΔ, hinter, hsum]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.card_T_gt_card_S
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.card_T_gt_card_S
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    B.S.card < B.T.card
proof:
:= by
  have hΔ := B.delta_eq_two_sub hpat
  have : 2 * ((B.S.card : ℤ) - (B.T.card : ℤ)) ≤ -2 := by
    simpa [hΔ] using B.neg
  have hZ : (B.S.card : ℤ) < (B.T.card : ℤ) := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast hZ

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.T_nonempty
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.T_nonempty (B : ExtremalBarrier G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) : B.T.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  card_pos.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) (B.card_T_gt_card_S hpat))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.eq_T_of_meet
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.eq_T_of_meet
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {c : (Remain G B.S B.T).ConnectedComponent} {t t' x : V}
    (ht : t ∈ B.T) (hmeet : MeetsVertex B.S B.T c t)
    (ht' : t' ∈ B.T) (hx : x ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c)
    (hadj : G.Adj x t') : t' = t
proof:
:= by
  have hle := B.componentAttach_le_one hpat c
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyadj⟩ := hmeet
  by_contra hne
  have hs :
      ({(y, t), (x, t')} : Finset (V × V)) ⊆
        (componentVerts G B.S B.T c ×ˢ B.T).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    rcases mem_insert.mp hp with rfl | hp'
    · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hy, ht⟩, hyadj⟩
    · have : p = (x, t') := mem_singleton.mp hp'
      subst this
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hx, ht'⟩, hadj⟩
  have hneP : (y, t) ≠ (x, t') := by
    intro h
    exact hne (congrArg Prod.snd h).symm
  have h2 : 2 ≤ ({(y, t), (x, t')} : Finset (V × V)).card := by
    simp [card_insert_of_notMem, hneP]
  have : 2 ≤ componentAttach G B.S B.T c :=
    le_trans h2 (card_le_card hs)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.coe_univ_sdiff_eq_compl
statement:
lemma coe_univ_sdiff_eq_compl (S : Finset V) :
    ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V) = (S : Set V)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_compl_of_mem_T
statement:
lemma mem_compl_of_mem_T {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) {t : V}
    (ht : t ∈ T) : t ∈ (S : Set V)ᶜ
proof:
:=
  fun hS => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdis hS ht

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_to_remain
proof:
:=
  (Set.mem_compl_iff _ _).2 (by
    simpa using (mem_remainderVerts_iff (G := G)).1 hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.adj_preserves_meetsStar
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.adj_preserves_meetsStar
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {t : V} (ht : t ∈ B.T)
    {u w : {x : V // x ∈ (B.S : Set V)ᶜ}}
    (hadj : (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).Adj u w)
    (hu : meetsStar (G := G) B.S B.T t u) :
    meetsStar (G := G) B.S B.T t w
proof:
:= by
  have hadjG : G.Adj u.val w.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
  rcases hu with hu | ⟨huU, hmeet⟩
  · 
    have hwT : w.val ∉ B.T := by
      intro hwT
      have : G.Adj t w.val := by simpa [hu] using hadjG
      exact B.T_independent ht hwT this
    have hwU : w.val ∈ remainderVerts G B.S B.T := by
      refine (mem_remainderVerts_iff (G := G)).2 ?_
      intro hST
      rcases mem_union.mp hST with hS | hT
      · exact w.property hS
      · exact hwT hT
    refine Or.inr ⟨hwU, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨w.val, remain_mk_mem (G := G) hwU, ?_⟩
    simpa [hu] using hadjG.symm
  · 
    let c := (Remain G B.S B.T).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨u.val, remainderVerts_to_remain (G := G) huU⟩
    have huC : u.val ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c := remain_mk_mem (G := G) huU
    by_cases hwT : w.val ∈ B.T
    · have : w.val = t :=
        B.eq_T_of_meet hpat ht hmeet hwT huC hadjG
      exact Or.inl this
    · have hwU : w.val ∈ remainderVerts G B.S B.T := by
        refine (mem_remainderVerts_iff (G := G)).2 ?_
        intro hST
        rcases mem_union.mp hST with hS | hT
        · exact w.property hS
        · exact hwT hT
      have hadjR : (Remain G B.S B.T).Adj
          ⟨u.val, remainderVerts_to_remain (G := G) huU⟩
          ⟨w.val, remainderVerts_to_remain (G := G) hwU⟩ := by
        simpa [induce_adj] using hadjG
      have hwC : w.val ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T c :=
        remain_adj_mem_component huC hadjR
      have hmk : (Remain G B.S B.T).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨w.val, remainderVerts_to_remain (G := G) hwU⟩ = c :=
        (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hwC |>.2
      refine Or.inr ⟨hwU, ?_⟩
      simpa [c, hmk] using hmeet

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.walk_preserves_meetsStar
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.walk_preserves_meetsStar
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {t : V} (ht : t ∈ B.T)
    {u w : {x : V // x ∈ (B.S : Set V)ᶜ}}
    (p : (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).Walk u w)
    (hu : meetsStar (G := G) B.S B.T t u) :
    meetsStar (G := G) B.S B.T t w
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact hu
  | cons hadj q ih =>
    exact ih (B.adj_preserves_meetsStar hpat ht hadj hu)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.T_eq_of_reachable
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.T_eq_of_reachable
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {t1 t2 : V} (ht1 : t1 ∈ B.T) (ht2 : t2 ∈ B.T)
    (hr : (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).Reachable
      ⟨t1, mem_compl_of_mem_T B.disjoint ht1⟩
      ⟨t2, mem_compl_of_mem_T B.disjoint ht2⟩) :
    t1 = t2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hr
  have hstar := B.walk_preserves_meetsStar hpat ht1 p (Or.inl rfl)
  rcases hstar with h | ⟨hU, _⟩
  · exact h.symm
  · exact ((mem_remainderVerts_iff (G := G)).1 hU
      (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ht2))).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.componentCount_sdiff_ge_T
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.componentCount_sdiff_ge_T
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    B.T.card ≤ componentCount G (univ \ B.S)
proof:
:= by
  let f : {t // t ∈ B.T} → (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent :=
    fun t => (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨t.val, mem_compl_of_mem_T B.disjoint t.property⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b h
    exact Subtype.ext
      (B.T_eq_of_reachable hpat a.property b.property (ConnectedComponent.exact h))
  have hle : Fintype.card {t // t ∈ B.T} ≤
      Fintype.card (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj
  have hcoe : Fintype.card {t // t ∈ B.T} = B.T.card := Fintype.card_coe B.T
  have hcc : componentCount G (univ \ B.S) =
      Fintype.card (G.induce (B.S : Set V)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent := by
    rw [componentCount, coe_univ_sdiff_eq_compl, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simpa [hcoe, hcc] using hle

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.false_of_card_T_ge_two
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.false_of_card_T_ge_two
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (htough : OneTough G) (hT : 2 ≤ B.T.card) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hge := B.componentCount_sdiff_ge_T hpat
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ B.S) := le_trans hT hge
  have hle := htough B.S h2
  have hlt := B.card_T_gt_card_S hpat
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.false_of_card_T_eq_one
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.false_of_card_T_eq_one
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) (htough : OneTough G)
    (hT : B.T.card = 1) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hTeq⟩ := card_eq_one.mp hT
  have hS : B.S = ∅ := by
    have hlt := B.card_T_gt_card_S hpat
    have : B.S.card = 0 := by omega
    exact card_eq_zero.mp this
  have ht : t ∈ B.T := by simp [hTeq]
  have hdeg : 2 ≤ (G.neighborFinset t).card := by
    have := OneTough.two_le_ncard_neighborSet (G := G) htough hord t
    simpa [ncard_neighborSet, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using this
  obtain ⟨N, hNsub, hNcard⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq hdeg
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := card_eq_two.mp hNcard
  have hxN : x ∈ G.neighborFinset t := hNsub (mem_insert_self x {y})
  have hyN : y ∈ G.neighborFinset t :=
    hNsub (mem_insert_of_mem (mem_singleton_self y))
  have hxadj : G.Adj t x := by simpa [mem_neighborFinset] using hxN
  have hyadj : G.Adj t y := by simpa [mem_neighborFinset] using hyN
  have hxU : x ∈ remainderVerts G B.S B.T := by
    have hne : x ≠ t := hxadj.ne.symm
    simp [remainderVerts, hS, hTeq, hne]
  have hyU : y ∈ remainderVerts G B.S B.T := by
    have hne : y ≠ t := hyadj.ne.symm
    simp [remainderVerts, hS, hTeq, hne]
  let cx := (Remain G B.S B.T).connectedComponentMk
    ⟨x, remainderVerts_to_remain (G := G) hxU⟩
  let cy := (Remain G B.S B.T).connectedComponentMk
    ⟨y, remainderVerts_to_remain (G := G) hyU⟩
  have hxC : x ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T cx := remain_mk_mem (G := G) hxU
  have hyC : y ∈ componentVerts G B.S B.T cy := remain_mk_mem (G := G) hyU
  have hcxcy : cx ≠ cy := by
    intro h
    have : x = y :=
      B.eq_of_two_D_neighbors (c := cx) ht hxC (by simpa [h] using hyC) hxadj hyadj
    exact hxy this
  have hxDel : x ∈ (univ \ {t} : Finset V) :=
    mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ x, by simp [hxadj.ne.symm]⟩
  have hyDel : y ∈ (univ \ {t} : Finset V) :=
    mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ y, by simp [hyadj.ne.symm]⟩
  have hxDelS : x ∈ ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V) := by simpa using hxDel
  have hyDelS : y ∈ ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V) := by simpa using hyDel
  let Dx := (G.induce ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxDelS⟩
  let Dy := (G.induce ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hyDelS⟩
  have hsub : ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V) ⊆
      ((B.S ∪ B.T : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∈ univ \ {t} := by simpa using hz
    simpa [hS, hTeq] using hz'
  have hDxDy : Dx ≠ Dy := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := ConnectedComponent.exact (show Dx = Dy from h)
    let φ := (G.induceHomOfLE hsub).toHom
    have hR : (Remain G B.S B.T).Reachable (φ ⟨x, hxDelS⟩) (φ ⟨y, hyDelS⟩) :=
      (p.map φ).reachable
    have hcx : cx = (Remain G B.S B.T).connectedComponentMk (φ ⟨x, hxDelS⟩) :=
      eq_of_mem_componentVerts (x := x) hxC (remain_mk_mem (G := G) hxU)
    have hcy : cy = (Remain G B.S B.T).connectedComponentMk (φ ⟨y, hyDelS⟩) :=
      eq_of_mem_componentVerts (x := y) hyC (remain_mk_mem (G := G) hyU)
    exact hcxcy (hcx.trans ((ConnectedComponent.sound hR).trans hcy.symm))
  have hnt : Nontrivial
      (G.induce ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨⟨Dx, Dy, hDxDy⟩⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ {t}) := by
    have : 1 < Fintype.card
        (G.induce ((univ \ {t} : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
      Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mpr hnt
    simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr this
  have hle := htough {t} (by simpa using h2)
  have : componentCount G (univ \ {t}) ≤ 1 := by simpa using hle
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ExtremalBarrier.false_of_oneTough
statement:
lemma ExtremalBarrier.false_of_oneTough
    (B : ExtremalBarrier G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (htough : OneTough G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hTpos : 1 ≤ B.T.card :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (card_pos.mpr (B.T_nonempty hpat))
  cases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hTpos with
  | inl h1 => exact B.false_of_card_T_eq_one hpat hord htough h1.symm
  | inr h2 =>
    exact B.false_of_card_T_ge_two hpat htough (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h2)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_cycleFactor_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
statement:
theorem exists_cycleFactor_of_oneTough_noInducedP4UnionP1
    (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (htough : OneTough G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    Nonempty (CycleFactor G)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := exists_extremalBarrier_of_not_cycleFactor (G := G) h
  exact B.false_of_oneTough hord htough hpat

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.usedColors_eq_empty_of_not_adj
statement:
lemma usedColors_eq_empty_of_not_adj (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (h : ∀ u v : V, ¬ G.Adj u v) : c.usedColors = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext α
  constructor
  · intro hα
    rw [EdgeColoring.usedColors, mem_biUnion] at hα
    obtain ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := hα
    rw [mem_biUnion] at hu
    obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := hu
    split_ifs at hv with hadj
    · exact (h u v hadj).elim
    · exact (notMem_empty α hv).elim
  · intro hα
    exact (notMem_empty α hα).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_adj_of_usedColors_eq_empty
statement:
lemma not_adj_of_usedColors_eq_empty (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (h : c.usedColors = ∅) {u v : V} : ¬ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  have : c.color hadj ∈ c.usedColors := c.mem_usedColors_color hadj
  simpa [h] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_splittingVertex_of_edgeless
statement:
theorem exists_splittingVertex_of_edgeless (c : EdgeColoring G C) [Nonempty V]
    (h : ∀ u v : V, ¬ G.Adj u v) :
    ∃ v : V, SplittingVertex c v
proof:
:=
  ⟨Classical.arbitrary V, SplittingVertex.of_not_adj c _
    (fun w => h _ w)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.CuspFreeReach.of_strict
statement:
lemma CuspFreeReach.of_strict {c : EdgeColoring G C} {v u : V} {α β : C}
    (h : StrictCuspFreeReach c v u α β) : CuspFreeReach c v u α β
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hnil, hinter, hstart, hend, _⟩ := h
  exact ⟨p, hp, hnil, hinter, hstart, hend⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.isPath_nil_of_eq
statement: lemma isPath_nil_of_eq {u : V} {p : G.Walk u u} (hp : p.IsPath) : p.Nil
proof:
:=
  (Walk.isPath_iff_nil).1 hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_CuspFreeReach_self
statement:
lemma not_CuspFreeReach_self (c : EdgeColoring G C) (v : V) (α β : C) :
    ¬ CuspFreeReach c v v α β
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hnil, _⟩ := h
  exact hnil (isPath_nil_of_eq hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_StrictCuspFreeReach_self
statement:
lemma not_StrictCuspFreeReach_self (c : EdgeColoring G C) (v : V) (α β : C) :
    ¬ StrictCuspFreeReach c v v α β
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact not_CuspFreeReach_self c v α β (CuspFreeReach.of_strict h)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.UsedPair.nonempty
statement:
lemma UsedPair.nonempty (c : EdgeColoring G C) [Nonempty V]
    (h : c.usedColors.Nonempty) : Nonempty (UsedPair c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := h
  exact ⟨(Classical.arbitrary V, ⟨α, hα⟩)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.usedLt_irrefl
statement:
lemma usedLt_irrefl (c : EdgeColoring G C) (p : UsedPair c) :
    ¬ usedLt c p p
proof:
:=
  not_StrictCuspFreeReach_self c p.1 p.2.1 p.2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.yeo_separator_of_usedColors_empty
statement:
theorem yeo_separator_of_usedColors_empty (c : EdgeColoring G C) [Nonempty V]
    (h : c.usedColors = ∅) :
    ∃ v : V, SplittingVertex c v
proof:
:=
  exists_splittingVertex_of_edgeless c
    (fun u v => not_adj_of_usedColors_eq_empty (u := u) (v := v) c h)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.IsCycle.length_le_card
statement:
lemma IsCycle.length_le_card {u : V} {w : G.Walk u u} (h : w.IsCycle) :
    w.length ≤ Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 3 ≤ w.length := h.three_le_length
  let f : Fin w.length → V := fun i => w.getVert i.1
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    have hi : i.1 ≤ w.length - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt i.2
    have hj : j.1 ≤ w.length - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt j.2
    exact h.getVert_injOn' hi hj hij
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.yeo_separator_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem yeo_separator_of_card_le_two (c : EdgeColoring G C) [Nonempty V]
    (hV : Fintype.card V ≤ 2) :
    ∃ v : V, SplittingVertex c v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Classical.arbitrary V, ?_⟩
  rw [splittingVertex_iff_cycleSplittingVertex]
  intro u w hcyc _hv
  have : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    le_trans hcyc.three_le_length (IsCycle.length_le_card hcyc)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_remainderVerts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_remainderVerts_iff {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :
    v ∈ remainderVerts G S T ↔ v ∉ S ∪ T
proof:
:= by
  simp [remainderVerts]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_remainderVerts_iff'
statement:
lemma mem_remainderVerts_iff' {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :
    v ∈ remainderVerts G S T ↔ v ∉ S ∧ v ∉ T
proof:
:= by
  simp [remainderVerts, mem_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_eq_compl
statement:
lemma remainderVerts_eq_compl {S T : Finset V} :
    (remainderVerts G S T : Set V) = ((S ∪ T : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [remainderVerts]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_componentVerts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_componentVerts_iff {S T : Finset V}
    {c : (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent} {v : V} :
    v ∈ componentVerts G S T c ↔
      ∃ hv : v ∈ ((S ∪ T : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ,
        (Remain G S T).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩ = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hv with ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hmem, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hw, ?_⟩
    simpa using (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff _ _).mp (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hmem)
  · rintro ⟨hv, h⟩
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa using (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff _ _).mpr h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.componentVerts_subset_remainder
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have ⟨hv', _⟩ := (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hv
  simpa [remainderVerts] using hv'

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_componentVerts
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvc hvd
  have ⟨hv, hc⟩ := (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := c)).mp hvc
  have ⟨_, hd⟩ := (mem_componentVerts_iff (c := d)).mp hvd
  exact h (hc.symm.trans hd)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.pairwiseDisjoint_componentVerts
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_componentVerts (S T : Finset V) :
    ((univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent) : Set _).PairwiseDisjoint
      (componentVerts G S T)
proof:
:= by
  intro c _hc d _hd hcd
  change Disjoint (componentVerts G S T c) (componentVerts G S T d)
  exact disjoint_componentVerts hcd

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_eq_biUnion
statement:
lemma remainderVerts_eq_biUnion (S T : Finset V) :
    remainderVerts G S T =
      (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent).biUnion
        (componentVerts G S T)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hv' : v ∈ ((S ∪ T : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ := by
      simpa [remainderVerts] using hv
    refine mem_biUnion.mpr
      ⟨(Remain G S T).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv'⟩, mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    exact (mem_componentVerts_iff).mpr ⟨hv', rfl⟩
  · intro hv
    rcases mem_biUnion.mp hv with ⟨c, _, hvc⟩
    exact componentVerts_subset_remainder c hvc

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum_parity
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum_parity (A B : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A B = ∑ a ∈ A, (G.neighborFinset a ∩ B).card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedEdgeCount, neighborFinset_inter]
  rw [Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ha => ?_
  exact (Finset.card_filter (G.Adj a) B).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_comm_parity
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_comm_parity (A B : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A B = orderedEdgeCount G B A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedEdgeCount]
  let e : Equiv {p // p ∈ (A ×ˢ B).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2}
      {p // p ∈ (B ×ˢ A).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2} :=
    { toFun := fun p =>
        ⟨(p.1.2, p.1.1), by
          have hp := p.2
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
          exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩⟩
      invFun := fun p =>
        ⟨(p.1.2, p.1.1), by
          have hp := p.2
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
          exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩⟩
      left_inv := fun p => Subtype.ext rfl
      right_inv := fun p => Subtype.ext rfl }
  simpa [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr e

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_two_mul_parity
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_two_mul_parity (A : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A A = 2 * (G.induce (A : Set V)).edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (A : Set V)
  let e : {p : V × V // p ∈ (A ×ˢ A).filter fun q => G.Adj q.1 q.2} ≃
      {xy : (↥(A : Set V)) × (↥(A : Set V)) // H.Adj xy.1 xy.2} :=
    { toFun := fun p =>
        ⟨(⟨p.1.1, (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).1).1⟩,
          ⟨p.1.2, (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).1).2⟩),
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).2⟩
      invFun := fun q =>
        ⟨(q.1.1.val, q.1.2.val),
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨q.1.1.property, q.1.2.property⟩, q.2⟩⟩
      left_inv := fun p => Subtype.ext rfl
      right_inv := fun q =>
        Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (Subtype.ext rfl) (Subtype.ext rfl)) }
  have hP : ((A ×ˢ A).filter fun q => G.Adj q.1 q.2).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun xy : (↥(A : Set V)) × (↥(A : Set V)) =>
        H.Adj xy.1 xy.2).card := by
    simpa [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr e
  exact hP.trans H.two_mul_card_edgeFinset.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.even_orderedEdgeCount_self_parity
statement:
lemma even_orderedEdgeCount_self_parity (A : Finset V) :
    Even (orderedEdgeCount G A A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_two_mul_parity]
  exact even_two_mul _

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.two_mul_internalEdgeCount
statement:
lemma two_mul_internalEdgeCount (T : Finset V) :
    2 * internalEdgeCount G T = orderedEdgeCount G T T
proof:
:= by
  simpa [internalEdgeCount] using
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' (even_iff_two_dvd.mp (even_orderedEdgeCount_self_parity (G := G) T))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_biUnion
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_biUnion {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Finset V) (B : Finset V)
    (hd : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) :
    orderedEdgeCount G (s.biUnion f) B =
      ∑ i ∈ s, orderedEdgeCount G (f i) B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedEdgeCount]
  let t : ι → Finset (V × V) :=
    fun i => (f i ×ˢ B).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2
  have hdis : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint t := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    change Disjoint (t i) (t j)
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro p hp hq
    have hiB : p.1 ∈ f i := (mem_product.mp (mem_filter.mp hp).1).1
    have hjB : p.1 ∈ f j := (mem_product.mp (mem_filter.mp hq).1).1
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hd hi hj hij) hiB hjB).elim
  have hunion :
      ((s.biUnion f) ×ˢ B).filter (fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2) = s.biUnion t := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      have hp' := mem_filter.mp hp
      have hprod := mem_product.mp hp'.1
      rcases mem_biUnion.mp hprod.1 with ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩
      exact mem_biUnion.mpr
        ⟨i, hi, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hfi, hprod.2⟩, hp'.2⟩⟩
    · intro hp
      rcases mem_biUnion.mp hp with ⟨i, hi, hpi⟩
      have hpi' := mem_filter.mp hpi
      have hprod := mem_product.mp hpi'.1
      exact mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi, hprod.1⟩, hprod.2⟩, hpi'.2⟩
  rw [hunion, card_biUnion hdis]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_remainder_eq_sum
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_remainder_eq_sum (S T : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G (remainderVerts G S T) T =
      ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G S T c
proof:
:= by
  rw [remainderVerts_eq_biUnion, orderedEdgeCount_biUnion]
  · simp [componentAttach]
  · exact pairwiseDisjoint_componentVerts S T

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_disjoint_S
statement:
lemma remainderVerts_disjoint_S (S T : Finset V) :
    Disjoint (remainderVerts G S T) S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxU hxS
  have : x ∉ S ∪ T := by simpa [remainderVerts] using hxU
  exact this (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hxS))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_disjoint_T
statement:
lemma remainderVerts_disjoint_T (S T : Finset V) :
    Disjoint (remainderVerts G S T) T
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxU hxT
  have : x ∉ S ∪ T := by simpa [remainderVerts] using hxU
  exact this (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hxT))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighbor_sdiff_eq_union
statement:
lemma neighbor_sdiff_eq_union {S T : Finset V} {t : V}
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) (_ht : t ∈ T) :
    G.neighborFinset t \ S =
      (G.neighborFinset t ∩ T) ∪
        (G.neighborFinset t ∩ remainderVerts G S T)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_inter, mem_neighborFinset, remainderVerts,
    mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨hadj, hxS⟩
    by_cases hxT : x ∈ T
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hadj, hxT⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hadj, by
        simp [hxS, hxT]⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hadj, hxT⟩ | ⟨hadj, hxU⟩
    · exact ⟨hadj, fun hxS => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdis hxS hxT⟩
    · exact ⟨hadj, by
        have : x ∉ S ∪ T := by
          simpa [remainderVerts] using hxU
        exact fun hxS => this (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hxS))⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_neighbor_T_remainder
statement:
lemma disjoint_neighbor_T_remainder {S T : Finset V} {t : V} :
    Disjoint (G.neighborFinset t ∩ T)
      (G.neighborFinset t ∩ remainderVerts G S T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxT hxU
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (remainderVerts_disjoint_T (G := G) S T)
    (mem_inter.mp hxU).2 (mem_inter.mp hxT).2

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.degDelete_split
statement:
lemma degDelete_split {S T : Finset V} {t : V}
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) (ht : t ∈ T) :
    degDelete G S t =
      (G.neighborFinset t ∩ T).card +
        (G.neighborFinset t ∩ remainderVerts G S T).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [degDelete, neighbor_sdiff_eq_union (G := G) hdis ht,
    card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_neighbor_T_remainder (G := G))]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_degDelete
statement:
lemma sum_degDelete {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    ∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t =
      orderedEdgeCount G T T +
        orderedEdgeCount G (remainderVerts G S T) T
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      ∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t =
        ∑ t ∈ T, (G.neighborFinset t ∩ T).card +
          ∑ t ∈ T, (G.neighborFinset t ∩ remainderVerts G S T).card := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun t ht => ?_
    exact degDelete_split (G := G) hdis ht
  have hT : ∑ t ∈ T, (G.neighborFinset t ∩ T).card = orderedEdgeCount G T T :=
    (orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum_parity (G := G) T T).symm
  have hU :
      ∑ t ∈ T, (G.neighborFinset t ∩ remainderVerts G S T).card =
        orderedEdgeCount G T (remainderVerts G S T) :=
    (orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum_parity (G := G) T (remainderVerts G S T)).symm
  rw [hsplit, hT, hU, orderedEdgeCount_comm_parity (G := G) T (remainderVerts G S T)]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_degDelete_eq_internal_add_attach
statement:
theorem sum_degDelete_eq_internal_add_attach {S T : Finset V}
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    ∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t =
      2 * internalEdgeCount G T +
        ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
          componentAttach G S T c
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_degDelete (G := G) hdis, two_mul_internalEdgeCount (G := G) T,
    orderedEdgeCount_remainder_eq_sum]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.componentAttach_decompose
statement:
lemma componentAttach_decompose (S T : Finset V)
    (c : (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentAttach G S T c =
      2 * (componentAttach G S T c / 2) + componentAttach G S T c % 2
proof:
:=
  (Nat.div_add_mod (componentAttach G S T c) 2).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.attach_mod_two_eq
statement:
lemma attach_mod_two_eq (S T : Finset V)
    (c : (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentAttach G S T c % 2 =
      if Odd (componentAttach G S T c) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Odd (componentAttach G S T c)
  · simp [h, Nat.odd_iff.mp h]
  · have he : Even (componentAttach G S T c) := Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mp h
    simp [h, Nat.even_iff.mp he]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.hCount_eq_sum_odd_indicators
statement:
lemma hCount_eq_sum_odd_indicators (S T : Finset V) :
    hCount G S T =
      ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        (if Odd (componentAttach G S T c) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hCount, sum_boole]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.hCount_eq_sum_mod
statement:
theorem hCount_eq_sum_mod (S T : Finset V) :
    hCount G S T =
      ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G S T c % 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hCount_eq_sum_odd_indicators]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun c _ => (attach_mod_two_eq (G := G) S T c).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_componentAttach_decompose
statement:
lemma sum_componentAttach_decompose (S T : Finset V) :
    ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G S T c =
      2 * ∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
            componentAttach G S T c / 2 +
        hCount G S T
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun c _ => componentAttach_decompose (G := G) S T c,
    sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, hCount_eq_sum_mod]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.natCast_sum_degDelete
statement:
lemma natCast_sum_degDelete {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    ((∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      2 * (internalEdgeCount G T : ℤ) +
        ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
            componentAttach G S T c : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_degDelete_eq_internal_add_attach (G := G) hdis]
  simp [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.natCast_sum_attach_decompose
statement:
lemma natCast_sum_attach_decompose (S T : Finset V) :
    ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
        componentAttach G S T c : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      2 * ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
              componentAttach G S T c / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) +
        (hCount G S T : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_componentAttach_decompose (G := G) S T]
  simp [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem delta_eq_two_mul {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    delta G S T =
      2 * ((S.card : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) + (internalEdgeCount G T : ℤ) +
        ((∑ c ∈ (univ : Finset (Remain G S T).ConnectedComponent),
            componentAttach G S T c / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold delta
  have hdeg := natCast_sum_degDelete (G := G) hdis
  have hatt := natCast_sum_attach_decompose (G := G) S T
  have hsum :
      (∑ t ∈ T, (degDelete G S t : ℤ)) = ((∑ t ∈ T, degDelete G S t : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    simp
  rw [hsum, hdeg, hatt]
  ring

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.even_delta
statement:
theorem even_delta {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    Even (delta G S T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta_eq_two_mul (G := G) hdis]
  exact even_two_mul _

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_neg_le_neg_two
statement:
theorem delta_neg_le_neg_two {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T)
    (hneg : delta G S T < 0) : delta G S T ≤ -2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := even_delta (G := G) hdis
  have hk' : delta G S T = 2 * k := by
    simpa [two_mul] using hk
  have hkneg : k < 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℤ) * k < 0 := by simpa [hk'] using hneg
    nlinarith
  have hk1 : k ≤ -1 := Int.le_sub_one_of_lt hkneg
  have : (2 : ℤ) * k ≤ 2 * (-1) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 (by decide)
  simpa [hk'] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_neg_iff_le_neg_two
statement:
theorem delta_neg_iff_le_neg_two {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    delta G S T < 0 ↔ delta G S T ≤ -2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact delta_neg_le_neg_two (G := G) hdis
  · intro h
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (by decide : (-2 : ℤ) < 0)

name: Nikoghosyan.TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.of_repaired
proof:
:= by
  subst ht
  exact TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.of_terminalHypothesis h

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_repaired_card
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_of_repaired_card :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K B : Finset V),
      K.card = n →
      RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B →
      B.Nonempty →
      ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    intro K B hKn hrep hBne
    rcases hrep with ⟨hcog, hBK, hInd, hTH, hN⟩
    by_cases hKB : K ⊆ B
    · exact exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B hKB hInd
    · have hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty := by
        refine nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 ?_
        intro hempty
        exact hKB (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.1 hempty)
      by_cases hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected
      · by_cases hp1 : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ 1
        · have hpos := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) (hBne.mono hBK)
          have hp : pathCoverNumber G K = 1 := by omega
          by_cases h2 : 2 ≤ K.card
          · exact exists_min_terminalCover_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
              h2 hcog hconn hp hBK hBne hTH
          · have hcard1 : K.card = 1 := by
              have : 1 ≤ K.card := card_pos.2 (hBne.mono hBK)
              omega
            obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hcard1
            have hxB : x ∈ B := by
              obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
              have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hb
              have : b = x := by simpa [hx] using hbK
              simpa [this] using hb
            refine exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B ?_ hInd
            simpa [hx] using singleton_subset_iff.2 hxB
        · have hp2 : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K := by omega
          have h2card : 2 ≤ K.card :=
            hp2.trans (pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) K)
          obtain ⟨Praw, Qraw, hPrawsub, hQrawsub, hPrawne, hQrawne, hdisjraw,
              hcoverraw, hABraw, hPrawcard, hQrawcard⟩ :=
            Cograph.exists_complete_join_on (G := G) (Cograph.isCograph_iff.2 hcog)
              hconn h2card
          have hBside : B ⊆ Praw ∨ B ⊆ Qraw :=
            Independent.subset_join_side hABraw hInd (by simpa [hcoverraw] using hBK)
          obtain ⟨P0, Q0, hPsub, hQsub, hPne, hQne, hdisj, hcover, hAB,
              hPcard, hQcard, hBP⟩ :
              ∃ P Q : Finset V, P ⊆ K ∧ Q ⊆ K ∧ P.Nonempty ∧ Q.Nonempty ∧
                Disjoint P Q ∧ P ∪ Q = K ∧
                  G.IsCompleteBetween (P : Set V) (Q : Set V) ∧
                    P.card < K.card ∧ Q.card < K.card ∧ B ⊆ P := by
            rcases hBside with hP | hQ
            · exact ⟨Praw, Qraw, hPrawsub, hQrawsub, hPrawne, hQrawne, hdisjraw,
                hcoverraw, hABraw, hPrawcard, hQrawcard, hP⟩
            · exact ⟨Qraw, Praw, hQrawsub, hPrawsub, hQrawne, hPrawne, hdisjraw.symm,
                by rw [union_comm, hcoverraw],
                fun {q} hq {p} hp => (hABraw hp hq).symm,
                hQrawcard, hPrawcard, hQ⟩
          have hjoin : P0 ∪ Q0 = K := hcover
          have hPcog : IsCograph G P0 := isCograph_subset hcog hPsub
          have hN_P : NeighborCondition (G := G) P0 B := NeighborCondition.mono hN hPsub
          have hTHK : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (P0 ∪ Q0) B := by
            simpa [hjoin] using hTH
          have hTH_P : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) P0 B Q0.card :=
            terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child_of_terminal hQne hdisj hBP hTHK
          have htP : 1 ≤ Q0.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hQne)
          have hQnotdom : ¬ P0.card < pathCoverNumber G Q0 :=
            not_dominant_B_free_join_side hPne hQne hAB
              (by simpa [hjoin] using hcog) hBP hBne hTHK
          have hPdom : Q0.card < pathCoverNumber G P0 := by
            have hpjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hPne hQne hAB
            have hnot1 : pathCoverNumber G (P0 ∪ Q0) ≠ 1 := by
              simpa [hjoin] using (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hp2))
            have hQle : pathCoverNumber G Q0 ≤ P0.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hQnotdom
            by_contra hPle
            have hP0sub : pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card = 0 :=
              Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_gt hPle)
            have hQ0sub : pathCoverNumber G Q0 - P0.card = 0 :=
              Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hQle
            have : pathCoverNumber G (P0 ∪ Q0) = 1 := by
              rw [hpjoin, hP0sub, hQ0sub]; simp
            exact hnot1 this
          have hPcover :
              ∃ pc : PathCover G P0,
                pc.card = pathCoverNumber G P0 ∧
                  pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * Q0.card - 1 := by
            by_cases hPconn : (G.induce (P0 : Set V)).Connected
            · exact exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong
                hPcog hPconn hBP hBne hInd hN_P htP hTH_P
            · by_cases hBV : ∃ b v, b ∈ B ∧ v ∈ P0 \ B ∧ G.Adj b v
              · obtain ⟨b, v, hb, hv, hadj⟩ := hBV
                obtain ⟨s⟩ :=
                  exists_mixedSplit_of_BV (K := P0) (B := B) hBP hN_P hb hv hadj
                have hIeq : s.I = P0 \ s.D := s.I_eq
                have hI : P0 \ s.D ⊆ B := by simpa [hIeq] using s.hI
                have hDlt : s.D.card < n := by
                  have : s.D.card ≤ P0.card := card_le_card s.hDsub
                  omega
                have hDcog : IsCograph G s.D := isCograph_subset hPcog s.hDsub
                have hN_D : NeighborCondition (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D) :=
                  NeighborCondition.restrict_inter hN_P s.hDsub
                have hTH_D : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D)
                    Q0.card :=
                  TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.restrict_mixed hBP s.hDsub hI
                    (by simpa [hIeq] using s.hnocross) hTH_P
                have hIndD : Independent (G := G) (B ∩ s.D) :=
                  hInd.mono inter_subset_left
                obtain ⟨pcD, hDcard', hDdef⟩ :=
                  exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong
                    hDcog s.hconn inter_subset_right s.hBd hIndD hN_D htP hTH_D
                have hDdefB : pcD.endpointDeficit B ≤ pcD.endpointDeficit (B ∩ s.D) :=
                  PathCover.endpointDeficit_anti inter_subset_left pcD
                obtain ⟨pcI, hIcard, hIterm⟩ :=
                  exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B (K := s.I) (B := B) s.hI hInd
                have hIdef : pcI.endpointDeficit B = 0 :=
                  PathCover.deficit_eq_zero_of_terminal pcI hIterm
                let pcP := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint s.hdisj pcD pcI
                refine ⟨pcP.cast s.hDU, ?_, ?_⟩
                · have hsum := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint_card s.hdisj pcD pcI
                  have hpU :=
                    Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) s.hdisj s.hnocross
                  have hpP :
                      pathCoverNumber G P0 =
                        pathCoverNumber G s.D + pathCoverNumber G s.I := by
                    convert hpU
                    exact s.hDU.symm
                  rw [PathCover.cast_card, hsum, hDcard', hIcard, hpP]
                · have hdefU :=
                    PathCover.endpointDeficit_unionDisjoint (B := B) s.hdisj pcD pcI
                  rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack, hdefU, hIdef]
                  exact hDdefB.trans hDdef
              · let W := P0 \ B
                have hPW : P0 = B ∪ W := (union_sdiff_of_subset hBP).symm
                have hanti : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj b w := by
                  intro b hb w hw hadj
                  exact hBV ⟨b, w, hb, hw, hadj⟩
                obtain ⟨pcP, hPcard', hPdef⟩ :=
                  exists_min_cover_of_noBV hPW disjoint_sdiff hanti hInd
                have hpW : pathCoverNumber G W ≤ Q0.card - 1 :=
                  pathCoverNumber_W_le_of_noBV hPW disjoint_sdiff hanti hPcog htP hTH_P
                refine ⟨pcP, hPcard', ?_⟩
                have : 2 * pathCoverNumber G W ≤ 2 * Q0.card - 2 := by omega
                omega
          obtain ⟨pcP, hPmin, hPdef⟩ := hPcover
          have hendP : ∀ p ∈ pcP.paths, p.start ∈ P0 ∧ p.finish ∈ P0 :=
            fun p hp => pcP.ends_subset_of_support hp
          obtain ⟨pcK, hKcard, _, hKdef⟩ :=
            exists_merge_all_connectors (A := P0) (Q := Q0) (B := B) (t := 0)
              hAB hPdom pcP hPmin hendP (by simpa using hPdef)
          refine ⟨pcK.cast hjoin, ?_, ?_⟩
          · have hpjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hPne hQne hAB
            have hQle : pathCoverNumber G Q0 ≤ P0.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hQnotdom
            have hpKeq : pathCoverNumber G K = pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card := by
              have hpPsub : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card :=
                Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hPdom)
              have hpjoin' := hpjoin
              rw [← hjoin, hpjoin', Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hQle,
                Nat.max_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _), Nat.max_eq_right hpPsub]
            rw [PathCover.cast_card, hKcard, hpKeq]
          · have h0 : (pcK.cast hjoin).endpointDeficit B = 0 := by
              rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack]
              have : 2 * (0 : ℕ) - 1 = 0 := rfl
              have : pcK.endpointDeficit B ≤ 0 := by simpa [this] using hKdef
              omega
            exact PathCover.terminalCover_of_deficit_eq_zero _ h0
      · obtain ⟨s⟩ :=
          exists_mixedSplit (G := G) hBK hN hTH.1 hVne
        have hIeq : s.I = K \ s.D := s.I_eq
        have hI : K \ s.D ⊆ B := by simpa [hIeq] using s.hI
        have hrepD : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D) :=
          repairedTerminalHypothesis_mixed ⟨hcog, hBK, hInd, hTH, hN⟩
            s.hDsub hI (by simpa [hIeq] using s.hnocross) s.hconn s.hBd
        have hDlt : s.D.card < n := by
          have hss : s.D ⊂ K := by
            refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.2 ⟨s.hDsub, ?_⟩
            intro hDeq
            have : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected := by
              rw [← hDeq]
              exact s.hconn
            exact hconn this
          have : s.D.card < K.card := card_lt_card hss
          omega
        obtain ⟨pcD, hDcard, hDterm⟩ :=
          ih s.D.card hDlt s.D (B ∩ s.D) rfl hrepD s.hBd
        have hDtermB : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pcD :=
          IsTerminalCover.of_subset hDterm inter_subset_left
        obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ :=
          exists_min_terminalCover_mixed_union_isolates
            s.hdisj s.hI hInd s.hnocross ⟨pcD, hDcard, hDtermB⟩
        refine ⟨pc.cast s.hDU, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard]
          exact congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) s.hDU
        · intro p hp
          rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc s.hDU] at hp
          exact hterm p hp

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_general_min_terminalCover
statement:
theorem exists_general_min_terminalCover {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:=
  exists_min_terminalCover_of_repaired_card K.card K B rfl hrep hBne

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.liftDeleteWalk_isPath
proof:
:=
  hp.map (Embedding.induce (G := G) (deleteSet v)).injective

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_mem_support_liftDeleteWalk
statement:
lemma not_mem_support_liftDeleteWalk {v : V} {x y : {w : V // w ≠ v}}
    (p : (deleteGraph G v).Walk x y) : v ∉ (liftDeleteWalk p).support
proof:
:= by
  intro hv
  change v ∈
      (p.map (Embedding.induce (G := G) (deleteSet v)).toHom).support at hv
  rw [Walk.support_map, List.mem_map] at hv
  obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := hv
  exact z.property hz

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_nil_concat
statement:
lemma not_nil_concat {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (h : G.Adj v w) :
    ¬ (p.concat h).Nil
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> simp [Walk.concat]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.penultimate_concat
statement:
lemma penultimate_concat {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (h : G.Adj v w) :
    (p.concat h).penultimate = v
proof:
:= by
  simp [Walk.penultimate, Walk.concat_eq_append, Walk.getVert_append']

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cycleThroughVertex_isCycle
statement:
lemma cycleThroughVertex_isCycle {v : V} {x y : {w : V // w ≠ v}}
    (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1)
    {p : G.Walk x.1 y.1} (hp : p.IsPath) (hv : v ∉ p.support) (hne : x.1 ≠ y.1) :
    (cycleThroughVertex hx hy p).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleThroughVertex, Walk.cons_isCycle_iff]
  refine ⟨hp.concat hv hy.symm, ?_⟩
  intro he
  rw [Walk.edges_concat, List.concat_eq_append, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at he
  rcases he with hp' | heq
  · exact hv (p.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges hp')
  · rcases (Sym2.eq_iff).1 heq with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
    · exact x.property h2
    · exact hne h2

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cycleThroughVertex_firstDart
statement:
lemma cycleThroughVertex_firstDart {v : V} {x y : {w : V // w ≠ v}}
    (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1) (p : G.Walk x.1 y.1)
    (h : ¬ (cycleThroughVertex hx hy p).Nil) :
    (cycleThroughVertex hx hy p).firstDart h = ⟨(v, x.1), hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Dart.ext
  simp [Walk.firstDart, cycleThroughVertex]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cycleThroughVertex_lastDart
statement:
lemma cycleThroughVertex_lastDart {v : V} {x y : {w : V // w ≠ v}}
    (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1) (p : G.Walk x.1 y.1)
    (h : ¬ (cycleThroughVertex hx hy p).Nil) :
    (cycleThroughVertex hx hy p).lastDart h = ⟨(y.1, v), hy.symm⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ¬ (p.concat hy.symm).Nil := not_nil_concat p hy.symm
  have hpen : (cycleThroughVertex hx hy p).penultimate = y.1 := by
    rw [cycleThroughVertex, Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil hx _ hq, penultimate_concat]
  apply Dart.ext
  simp [Walk.lastDart, hpen]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_cycle_of_bichromatic_component
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_bichromatic_component (c : EdgeColoring G C) (v : V)
    (x y : {w : V // w ≠ v}) (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1)
    (hreach : (deleteGraph G v).Reachable x y)
    (hcol : c.color hx ≠ c.color hy) :
    ∃ (w : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : w.IsCycle),
      c.dartColor (w.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) = c.color hx ∧
      c.dartColor (w.lastDart hcyc.not_nil) = c.color hy
proof:
:= by
  have hne : x.1 ≠ y.1 := by
    intro hxy
    have : x = y := Subtype.ext hxy
    subst this
    exact hcol (c.color_proof hx hy)
  obtain ⟨p0, hp0, _⟩ := hreach.exists_path_of_dist
  have hp : (liftDeleteWalk p0).IsPath := liftDeleteWalk_isPath hp0
  have hv : v ∉ (liftDeleteWalk p0).support := not_mem_support_liftDeleteWalk p0
  refine ⟨cycleThroughVertex hx hy (liftDeleteWalk p0),
    cycleThroughVertex_isCycle hx hy hp hv hne, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rw [cycleThroughVertex_firstDart]
    rfl
  · rw [cycleThroughVertex_lastDart]
    exact (c.color_symm hy).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_mem_dropLast_end
statement:
lemma not_mem_dropLast_end {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hnil : ¬ p.Nil) : v ∉ p.dropLast.support
proof:
:= by
  intro hv
  have happ : p.dropLast.support ++ [v] = p.support :=
    Walk.support_dropLast_concat hnil
  have hnodup : p.support.Nodup := hp.support_nodup
  have hcount : List.count v p.support =
      List.count v p.dropLast.support + 1 := by
    rw [← happ, List.count_append]
    simp
  have : List.count v p.support ≤ 1 :=
    (List.nodup_iff_count_le_one.1 hnodup) v
  have : 0 < List.count v p.dropLast.support := List.count_pos_iff.2 hv
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.reachable_in_delete_of_cycle
statement:
theorem reachable_in_delete_of_cycle {v : V} {w : G.Walk v v}
    (hcyc : w.IsCycle) :
    ∃ (x y : {z : V // z ≠ v}),
      G.Adj v x.1 ∧ G.Adj v y.1 ∧
        x.1 = w.snd ∧ y.1 = w.penultimate ∧
          (deleteGraph G v).Reachable x y
proof:
:= by
  match w, hcyc with
  | .cons (v := x0) h p, hcyc =>
    have hp : p.IsPath := ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff p h).1 hcyc).1
    have hlen : 2 ≤ p.length := by
      have : 3 ≤ (Walk.cons h p).length := hcyc.three_le_length
      simp at this
      omega
    have hpnil : ¬ p.Nil := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.2 (by omega)
    have hxne : x0 ≠ v := h.ne.symm
    have hpen_eq : (Walk.cons h p).penultimate = p.penultimate :=
      Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil h p hpnil
    have hyne : p.penultimate ≠ v := (p.adj_penultimate hpnil).ne
    refine ⟨⟨x0, hxne⟩, ⟨p.penultimate, hyne⟩, h, (p.adj_penultimate hpnil).symm,
      by simp, hpen_eq.symm, ?_⟩
    have hv : v ∉ p.dropLast.support := not_mem_dropLast_end hp hpnil
    have hmem : ∀ z ∈ p.dropLast.support, z ∈ deleteSet v := by
      intro z hz heq
      exact hv (heq ▸ hz)
    let qind := (p.dropLast).induce (deleteSet v) hmem
    exact qind.reachable

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_bichromatic_component_of_cycle
statement:
theorem exists_bichromatic_component_of_cycle (c : EdgeColoring G C) {v : V}
    (w : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : w.IsCycle)
    (hcol : c.dartColor (w.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
      c.dartColor (w.lastDart hcyc.not_nil)) :
    ∃ (x y : {z : V // z ≠ v}) (hx : G.Adj v x.1) (hy : G.Adj v y.1),
      (deleteGraph G v).Reachable x y ∧ c.color hx ≠ c.color hy
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxeq, hyeq, hreach⟩ := reachable_in_delete_of_cycle hcyc
  refine ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hreach, ?_⟩
  have hfirst : c.dartColor (w.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) = c.color hx := by
    simp only [Walk.firstDart, EdgeColoring.dartColor, hxeq]
  have hlast : c.dartColor (w.lastDart hcyc.not_nil) = c.color hy := by
    simp only [Walk.lastDart, EdgeColoring.dartColor, hyeq]
    exact (c.color_symm _).trans (c.color_proof _ _)
  exact fun h => hcol (hfirst.trans (h.trans hlast.symm))

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.splittingVertex_iff_cycleSplittingVertex
statement:
theorem splittingVertex_iff_cycleSplittingVertex (c : EdgeColoring G C) (v : V) :
    SplittingVertex c v ↔ CycleSplittingVertex c v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsplit u w hcyc hv
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hreach, hcol⟩ :=
      exists_bichromatic_component_of_cycle (c := c)
        (w := w.rotate v hv) (hcyc := hcyc.rotate hv) (hcol := hne)
    exact hcol (hsplit x y hx hy hreach)
  · intro hcycle x y hx hy hreach
    by_contra hcol
    obtain ⟨w, hcyc, hfirst, hlast⟩ :=
      exists_cycle_of_bichromatic_component c v x y hx hy hreach hcol
    have hv : v ∈ w.support := Walk.start_mem_support w
    have hrot : w.rotate v hv = w := by
      simp [Walk.rotate, Walk.takeUntil_first, Walk.dropUntil_first]
    have hagree := hcycle w hcyc hv
    simp [hrot] at hagree
    rw [hfirst, hlast] at hagree
    exact hcol hagree

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalCover_card_add_pathCoverNumber_le
statement:
lemma terminalCover_card_add_pathCoverNumber_le {K B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    {pc : PathCover G K} (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    pc.card + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_add_le_card_B hBK hInd hterm

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_le_card_B_sub
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_le_card_B_sub {K B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hmin : ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    pathCoverNumber G K + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := hmin
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_add_le_card_B hBK hInd hterm
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_card_pathCoverNumber
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_card_pathCoverNumber {K B : Finset V}
    (hmin : ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:=
  hmin

name: Nikoghosyan.q_max_mem_interval_of_sides
statement:
lemma q_max_mem_interval_of_sides (P : AllCographSides G)
    (htough : OneTough G)
    (hmin : ∃ pc : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pc) :
    let q := max (pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) (P.m - P.U.card)
    pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ q ∧
      q + pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.B.card
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  have hKW : (P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B = P.W := P.K_sdiff_B
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le_card_B_sub (G := G)
    P.B_subset_K P.hBind hmin
  have hpW : pathCoverNumber G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B) = pathCoverNumber G P.W := by
    simp [hKW]
  have hcapU : pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.U.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_W_le_card_U_of_sides P htough
  have hm : P.B.card = P.m := P.hBcard
  constructor
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · have h1 :
        pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) + pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.B.card := by
      simpa [hpW] using hle
    have h2 : P.m - P.U.card + pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.B.card := by
      by_cases hUm : P.U.card ≤ P.m
      · have hcancel : P.m - P.U.card + P.U.card = P.m := Nat.sub_add_cancel hUm
        omega
      · have : P.m - P.U.card = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_ge hUm)
        omega
    have hmax :
        max (pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) (P.m - P.U.card) +
            pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.B.card := by
      by_cases hcmp :
          pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ P.m - P.U.card
      · have : max (pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) (P.m - P.U.card) =
            P.m - P.U.card := max_eq_right hcmp
        simpa [this] using h2
      · have : max (pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) (P.m - P.U.card) =
            pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) :=
          max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hcmp)
        simpa [this] using h1
    simpa [q] using hmax

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.startColor_ne_or_reverse
statement:
theorem startColor_ne_or_reverse {u : V} (ω : G.Walk u u) (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (hω : ¬ ω.Nil)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hω) ≠ c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hω))
    (α : C) :
    c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hω) ≠ α ∨
      c.dartColor (ω.reverse.firstDart (not_nil_reverse hω)) ≠ α
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hfirst : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hω) = α := h.1
  have hrev : c.dartColor (ω.reverse.firstDart (not_nil_reverse hω)) = α := h.2
  rw [firstDart_reverse hω (not_nil_reverse hω), EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm] at hrev
  exact hnocusp (hfirst.trans hrev.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.end_mem_support_tail
statement:
lemma end_mem_support_tail {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (_hp : ¬ p.Nil)
    (hne : u ≠ v) : v ∈ p.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  have : v ∈ p.support := Walk.end_mem_support p
  rw [Walk.mem_support_iff] at this
  exact this.resolve_left hne.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_first_reentry_vertex
statement:
theorem exists_first_reentry_vertex {u w : V} {q : G.Walk u w}
    (hq : q.IsPath) (hqnil : ¬ q.Nil) (hne : u ≠ w)
    {S : List V} (hw : w ∈ S) :
    ∃ (x : V) (hx : x ∈ q.support),
      x ∈ S ∧ ¬ (q.takeUntil x hx).Nil ∧ x ∈ q.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  have hwtail : w ∈ q.support.tail := end_mem_support_tail hqnil hne
  let p : V → Bool := fun a => decide (a ∈ S)
  have hi : q.support.tail.findIdx p < q.support.tail.length := by
    refine List.findIdx_lt_length_of_exists ?_
    exact ⟨w, hwtail, by simp [p, hw]⟩
  set x := q.support.tail[q.support.tail.findIdx p]
  have hxtail : x ∈ q.support.tail := List.getElem_mem _
  have hxsup : x ∈ q.support := List.mem_of_mem_tail hxtail
  have hxS : x ∈ S := by
    have hget := List.findIdx_getElem (xs := q.support.tail) (w := hi)
    simpa [x, p] using hget
  exact ⟨x, hxsup, hxS, not_nil_takeUntil_of_mem_tail hq hxtail, hxtail⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.mem_support_reverse_iff
statement:
lemma mem_support_reverse_iff {u v x : V} {p : G.Walk u v} :
    x ∈ p.reverse.support ↔ x ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [Walk.support_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cusp_at_reverse
statement:
lemma cusp_at_reverse {v u : V} {ω : G.Walk v v} {α : C}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle)
    (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne : u ≠ v)
    (hcusp :
      c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).lastDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm)) = α ∧
        c.dartColor ((ω.dropUntil u hu).firstDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne)) = α) :
    c.dartColor
        ((ω.reverse.takeUntil u (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu])).lastDart
          (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm)) = α ∧
      c.dartColor
        ((ω.reverse.dropUntil u (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu])).firstDart
          (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne)) = α
proof:
:= by
  have huR : u ∈ ω.reverse.support := by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]
  have htake := takeUntil_reverse_eq (ω := ω) hcyc hu hne
  have hdrop := dropUntil_reverse_eq (ω := ω) hcyc hu hne
  have hUVnil : ¬ (ω.dropUntil u hu).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
  have hVUnil : ¬ (ω.takeUntil u hu).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm
  have hUVrev : ¬ (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.Nil := not_nil_reverse hUVnil
  have hVUrev : ¬ (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse.Nil := not_nil_reverse hVUnil
  constructor
  · have hcol :
        c.dartColor ((ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.lastDart hUVrev) = α := by
      rw [lastDart_reverse hUVnil hUVrev, EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm]
      exact hcusp.2
    convert hcol
  · have hcol :
        c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse.firstDart hVUrev) = α := by
      rw [firstDart_reverse hVUnil hVUrev, EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm]
      exact hcusp.1
    convert hcol

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.or_min_of_eq_count
statement:
lemma or_min_of_eq_count {v : V} {ω ωor : G.Walk v v} (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (hcount : closedCuspCount ωor c = closedCuspCount ω c)
    (h : HasProperlyColoredCycle c ∨
      ∃ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) ∧
          closedCuspCount ω' c < closedCuspCount ωor c) :
    HasProperlyColoredCycle c ∨
      ∃ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) ∧
          closedCuspCount ω' c < closedCuspCount ω c
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨ω', hcyc', hn', hlt⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨ω', hcyc', hn', hcount ▸ hlt⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.mem_takeUntil_of_mem_support_not_dropUntil
statement:
lemma mem_takeUntil_of_mem_support_not_dropUntil {v u x : V} {ω : G.Walk v v}
    (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hx : x ∈ ω.support)
    (hxD : x ∉ (ω.dropUntil u hu).support) :
    x ∈ (ω.takeUntil u hu).support
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ ((ω.takeUntil u hu).append (ω.dropUntil u hu)).support := by
    simpa [Walk.take_spec ω hu] using hx
  rw [Walk.mem_support_append_iff] at hx'
  exact hx'.resolve_right hxD

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.firstDart_takeUntil_color
statement:
lemma firstDart_takeUntil_color {u v w : V} {q : G.Walk u v} {α : C}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hw : w ∈ q.support)
    (hnil : ¬ (q.takeUntil w hw).Nil)
    (hqnil : ¬ q.Nil)
    (hqfirst : c.dartColor (q.firstDart hqnil) ≠ α) :
    c.dartColor ((q.takeUntil w hw).firstDart hnil) ≠ α
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstDart_takeUntil hw hnil, firstDart_proof]
  exact hqfirst

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cusp_minimization
statement:
theorem cusp_minimization {v u w : V} {α : C}
    (ω : G.Walk v v) (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (hcyc : ω.IsCycle)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
      c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil))
    (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne_uv : u ≠ v)
    (hcusp :
      c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).lastDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uv.symm)) = α ∧
        c.dartColor ((ω.dropUntil u hu).firstDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uv)) = α)
    {q : G.Walk u w}
    (hq : q.IsPath) (hqnil : ¬ q.Nil)
    (hq0 : internalCuspCount q c = 0)
    (hqfirst : c.dartColor (q.firstDart hqnil) ≠ α)
    (hw : w ∈ ω.support) :
    HasProperlyColoredCycle c ∨
      ∃ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) ∧
          closedCuspCount ω' c < closedCuspCount ω c
proof:
:= by
  have hne_uw : u ≠ w := mt (Walk.IsPath.nil_iff_eq hq).2 hqnil
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxS, hnil, hxtail, hinter⟩ :=
    first_reentry_spec (q := q) hq hqnil hne_uw (S := ω.support) hw
  set q' := q.takeUntil x hx
  have hq' : q'.IsPath := hq.takeUntil hx
  have hq'0 : internalCuspCount q' c = 0 := internalCuspCount_takeUntil c hx hq0
  have hq'first : c.dartColor (q'.firstDart hnil) ≠ α :=
    firstDart_takeUntil_color c hx hnil hqnil hqfirst
  set β : C := c.dartColor (q'.lastDart hnil)
  have hinterω : ∀ y ∈ q'.support.tail, y ∈ ω.support → y = x := hinter
  have hne_xu : x ≠ u := by
    intro hxu
    subst hxu
    exact not_mem_support_tail_of_isPath hq hxtail
  have hcountR : closedCuspCount ω.reverse c = closedCuspCount ω c :=
    closedCuspCount_reverse ω c
  by_cases hxv : x = v
  · subst x
    rcases startColor_ne_or_reverse (ω := ω) c hcyc.not_nil hnocusp β with hstart | hstartR
    · have hwUV : v ∈ (ω.dropUntil u hu).support := Walk.end_mem_support _
      exact cusp_minimization_oriented (w := v) (β := β) ω c hcyc hnocusp hu hne_uv
        hcusp hq' hnil hq'0 hq'first rfl hwUV hinterω (fun _ => hstart.symm)
    · have hcycR : ω.reverse.IsCycle := hcyc.reverse
      have hnocuspR := nocusp_reverse (ω := ω) c hcyc.not_nil hnocusp
      have huR : u ∈ ω.reverse.support := by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]
      have hcuspR := cusp_at_reverse (ω := ω) (α := α) c hcyc hu hne_uv hcusp
      have hwUV : v ∈ (ω.reverse.dropUntil u huR).support := Walk.end_mem_support _
      have hinterR : ∀ y ∈ q'.support.tail, y ∈ ω.reverse.support → y = v := by
        intro y hy hyR
        exact hinterω y hy (mem_support_reverse_iff.1 hyR)
      refine or_min_of_eq_count (ωor := ω.reverse) c hcountR ?_
      exact cusp_minimization_oriented (w := v) (β := β) ω.reverse c hcycR hnocuspR
        huR hne_uv hcuspR hq' hnil hq'0 hq'first rfl hwUV hinterR (fun _ => hstartR.symm)
  · have hinterω' : ∀ y ∈ q'.support.tail, y ∈ ω.support → y = x := hinterω
    by_cases hxUV : x ∈ (ω.dropUntil u hu).support
    · refine cusp_minimization_oriented (w := x) (β := β) ω c hcyc hnocusp hu hne_uv
        hcusp hq' hnil hq'0 hq'first rfl hxUV hinterω' ?_
      intro hxeq
      exact (hxv hxeq).elim
    · have hxVU : x ∈ (ω.takeUntil u hu).support :=
        mem_takeUntil_of_mem_support_not_dropUntil hu hxS hxUV
      have hcycR : ω.reverse.IsCycle := hcyc.reverse
      have hnocuspR := nocusp_reverse (ω := ω) c hcyc.not_nil hnocusp
      have huR : u ∈ ω.reverse.support := by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]
      have hcuspR := cusp_at_reverse (ω := ω) (α := α) c hcyc hu hne_uv hcusp
      have hwUV : x ∈ (ω.reverse.dropUntil u huR).support := by
        have hdrop := dropUntil_reverse_eq (ω := ω) hcyc hu hne_uv
        simpa [hdrop, Walk.support_reverse] using hxVU
      have hinterR : ∀ y ∈ q'.support.tail, y ∈ ω.reverse.support → y = x := by
        intro y hy hyR
        exact hinterω' y hy (mem_support_reverse_iff.1 hyR)
      refine or_min_of_eq_count (ωor := ω.reverse) c hcountR ?_
      refine cusp_minimization_oriented (w := x) (β := β) ω.reverse c hcycR hnocuspR
        huR hne_uv hcuspR hq' hnil hq'0 hq'first rfl hwUV hinterR ?_
      intro hxeq
      exact (hxv hxeq).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.darts_takeUntil_getElem
statement:
lemma darts_takeUntil_getElem {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hw : w ∈ p.support) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < (p.takeUntil w hw).length) :
    (p.takeUntil w hw).darts[n]'(by simpa [Walk.length_darts] using hn) =
      p.darts[n]'(by
        have := Walk.length_takeUntil_le_length p hw
        simpa [Walk.length_darts] using lt_of_lt_of_le hn this)
proof:
:= by
  have hpref := Walk.darts_takeUntil_prefix_darts p hw
  exact List.IsPrefix.getElem hpref (by simpa [Walk.length_darts] using hn)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.length_take_drop
statement:
lemma length_take_drop {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hw : w ∈ p.support) :
    (p.takeUntil w hw).length + (p.dropUntil w hw).length = p.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Walk.length_append]
  exact congrArg Walk.length (Walk.take_spec p hw)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.zip_pair_eq
statement:
lemma zip_pair_eq {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j + 1 < p.darts.length) :
    (p.darts.zip p.darts.tail)[j]'(by
        have := Walk.length_darts p
        simp [List.length_zip, List.length_tail, this]; omega) =
      (p.darts[j]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hj), p.darts[j + 1]'hj)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := Walk.length_darts p
  have hz :
      (p.darts.zip p.darts.tail)[j]'(by
          simp [List.length_zip, List.length_tail, hL]; omega) =
        (p.darts[j]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hj),
          p.darts.tail[j]'(by simp [List.length_tail, hL]; omega)) := by
    rw [List.getElem_zip]
  have htail :
      p.darts.tail[j]'(by simp [List.length_tail, hL]; omega) =
        p.darts[j + 1]'hj :=
    getElem_tail_eq p.darts j hj
  rw [hz, htail]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_first_internal_cusp
statement:
theorem exists_first_internal_cusp {v : V} {ω : G.Walk v v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
      c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil))
    (hpos : 0 < closedCuspCount ω c) :
    ∃ (u : V) (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne : u ≠ v) (α : C),
      ¬ (ω.takeUntil u hu).Nil ∧
        internalCuspCount (ω.takeUntil u hu) c = 0 ∧
          c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).firstDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm)) =
            c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ∧
            c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).lastDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm)) = α ∧
              c.dartColor ((ω.dropUntil u hu).firstDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne)) = α ∧
                α ∈ c.usedColors
proof:
:= by
  have hinterpos : 0 < internalCuspCount ω c := by
    rwa [closedCuspCount_eq_internal_of_nocusp c hcyc.not_nil hnocusp] at hpos
  let pred : G.Dart × G.Dart → Bool :=
    fun p => decide (c.dartColor p.1 = c.dartColor p.2)
  have hex : ∃ pair ∈ ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail, pred pair = true := by
    have hne : ¬ ((ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail).filter
        (fun p => c.dartColor p.1 = c.dartColor p.2)).length = 0 :=
      Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hinterpos
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff, List.filter_eq_nil_iff] at hne
    push Not at hne
    obtain ⟨pair, hp, hcol⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨pair, hp, by simp [pred, hcol]⟩
  have hi : (ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail).findIdx pred <
      (ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail).length :=
    List.findIdx_lt_length_of_exists hex
  set i := (ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail).findIdx pred
  have hlenω : 3 ≤ ω.length := hcyc.three_le_length
  have hzip_len : (ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail).length = ω.length - 1 := by
    simp [List.length_zip, Walk.length_darts, List.length_tail]
  have hi_lt : i + 1 < ω.length := by
    have : i < ω.length - 1 := by
      simpa [hzip_len] using hi
    omega
  have hi_le : i + 1 ≤ ω.length := Nat.le_of_lt hi_lt
  have hpair :
      c.dartColor (ω.darts[i]'(by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega)) =
        c.dartColor (ω.darts[i + 1]'(by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega)) := by
    have hget := List.findIdx_getElem (xs := ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail) (w := hi)
    have hz := zip_pair_eq (p := ω) (hj := by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega)
    simpa [pred, hz, i] using of_decide_eq_true hget
  set u := ω.getVert (i + 1)
  have hu : u ∈ ω.support := Walk.getVert_mem_support ω (i + 1)
  have hne : u ≠ v := by
    intro heq
    have := (hcyc.getVert_endpoint_iff (i := i + 1) hi_le).1 heq
    omega
  have hidx : ω.support.idxOf u = i + 1 := by
    have hltS : i + 1 < ω.support.length := by
      simp [Walk.length_support]; omega
    have hgetS : ω.support[i + 1]'hltS = u :=
      Walk.support_getElem_eq_getVert ω hltS
    have huω : u ∈ ω.support := hu
    refine Nat.le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · have hlen_take : i + 1 < (ω.support.take (i + 2)).length := by
        simp [List.length_take]; omega
      have hget_take : (ω.support.take (i + 2))[i + 1]'hlen_take = u := by
        rw [List.getElem_take, hgetS]
      have hmem_take : u ∈ ω.support.take (i + 2) := hget_take ▸ List.getElem_mem _
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp ((List.mem_take_iff_idxOf_lt huω).1 hmem_take)
    · by_contra hlt'
      have : ω.support.idxOf u < i + 1 := Nat.not_le.mp hlt'
      have hmem := (List.mem_take_iff_idxOf_lt huω).2 this
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hjget⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hmem
      have hj_lt : j < i + 1 := by
        have : (ω.support.take (i + 1)).length = i + 1 := by
          simp [List.length_take, Walk.length_support]; omega
        simpa [this] using hj
      have hjS : j < ω.support.length := lt_trans hj_lt hltS
      have hju : ω.support[j]'hjS = u := by
        rwa [List.getElem_take] at hjget
      have hjle : j ≤ ω.length := by
        simp [Walk.length_support] at hjS; omega
      have hgetj : ω.getVert j = u := by
        rw [Walk.getVert_eq_support_getElem ω hjle, hju]
      have hj_eq : j = i + 1 :=
        hcyc.getVert_injOn' (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega) hgetj
      omega
  have hlen : (ω.takeUntil u hu).length = i + 1 := by
    rw [Walk.length_takeUntil, hidx]
  have hVUnil : ¬ (ω.takeUntil u hu).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm
  have hUVnil : ¬ (ω.dropUntil u hu).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
  have h0 : internalCuspCount (ω.takeUntil u hu) c = 0 := by
    rw [← isAlternating_iff_internalCuspCount_eq_zero]
    intro j hj
    have hj_lt : j < i := by
      simp [Walk.length_darts, hlen] at hj
      omega
    have hdj := darts_takeUntil_getElem (p := ω) hu
      (n := j) (by simp [Walk.length_darts, hlen] at hj ⊢; omega)
    have hdj1 := darts_takeUntil_getElem (p := ω) hu
      (n := j + 1) (by simp [Walk.length_darts, hlen] at hj ⊢; omega)
    have hfalse := List.not_of_lt_findIdx (p := pred)
      (xs := ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail) hj_lt
    have hz := zip_pair_eq (p := ω) (hj := by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega)
    rw [hdj, hdj1]
    have : pred ((ω.darts.zip ω.darts.tail)[j]'(by
        simp [List.length_zip, List.length_tail, Walk.length_darts]; omega)) = false :=
      hfalse
    simpa [pred, hz] using of_decide_eq_false this
  let αdef := c.dartColor (ω.darts[i]'(by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega))
  refine ⟨u, hu, hne, αdef, hVUnil, h0, ?_, ?_, ?_,
