    c.mem_usedColors_dartColor (ω.darts[i]'(by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega))⟩
  · rw [firstDart_takeUntil hu (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm)]
  · apply c.dartColor_eq_of_edge
    have hpen : (ω.takeUntil u hu).penultimate = ω.getVert i := by
      simp [Walk.penultimate, hlen]
      exact Walk.getVert_takeUntil hu (by omega)
    simp [Walk.edge_lastDart, hpen, Walk.darts_getElem_eq_getVert]
    simp [u, Walk.getVert_length_takeUntil]
  · trans c.dartColor (ω.darts[i + 1]'(by simp [Walk.length_darts]; omega))
    · apply c.dartColor_eq_of_edge
      have hsnd : (ω.dropUntil u hu).snd = ω.getVert (i + 2) := by
        have hlt : ¬ i + 2 < (ω.takeUntil u hu).length := by omega
        have hget := Walk.getVert_append (ω.takeUntil u hu) (ω.dropUntil u hu) (i + 2)
        simp [hlt, hlen, Walk.take_spec] at hget
        simpa [Walk.snd] using hget.symm
      simp [Walk.edge_firstDart, hsnd, Walk.darts_getElem_eq_getVert]
      simp [u]
    · exact hpair.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_nocusp_cycle_of_not_splitting
statement:
lemma exists_nocusp_cycle_of_not_splitting (c : EdgeColoring G C) {v : V}
    (h : ¬ SplittingVertex c v) :
    ∃ (ω : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle),
      c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
        c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil)
proof:
:= by
  have hcs : ¬ CycleSplittingVertex c v := by
    rwa [splittingVertex_iff_cycleSplittingVertex] at h
  have : ∃ (u : V) (w : G.Walk u u) (hcyc : w.IsCycle) (hv : v ∈ w.support),
      c.dartColor ((w.rotate v hv).firstDart (hcyc.rotate hv).not_nil) ≠
        c.dartColor ((w.rotate v hv).lastDart (hcyc.rotate hv).not_nil) := by
    by_contra hnone
    refine hcs ?_
    intro u w hcyc hv
    by_contra hne
    exact hnone ⟨u, w, hcyc, hv, hne⟩
  obtain ⟨_, w, hcyc, hv, hne⟩ := this
  exact ⟨w.rotate v hv, hcyc.rotate hv, hne⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_min_nocusp_cycle
statement:
lemma exists_min_nocusp_cycle (c : EdgeColoring G C) {v : V}
    (h : ∃ (ω : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle),
      c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
        c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil)) :
    ∃ (ω : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle),
      c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
          c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil) ∧
        ∀ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
          c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
              c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) →
            closedCuspCount ω c ≤ closedCuspCount ω' c
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
    ∃ (ω : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle),
      c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
          c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil) ∧
        closedCuspCount ω c = n
  have hP : ∃ n, P n := by
    obtain ⟨ω, hcyc, hn⟩ := h
    exact ⟨closedCuspCount ω c, ω, hcyc, hn, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ω, hcyc, hnocusp, hcount⟩ := Nat.find_spec hP
  refine ⟨ω, hcyc, hnocusp, ?_⟩
  intro ω' hcyc' hnocusp'
  have hnotlt : ¬ closedCuspCount ω' c < Nat.find hP := by
    intro hlt
    exact Nat.find_min hP hlt ⟨ω', hcyc', hnocusp', rfl⟩
  rw [hcount]
  exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hnotlt

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.closedCuspCount_pos_of_noprop
statement:
lemma closedCuspCount_pos_of_noprop {v : V} {ω : G.Walk v v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
      c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil))
    (hnoprop : ¬ HasProperlyColoredCycle c) :
    0 < closedCuspCount ω c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  have h0 : closedCuspCount ω c = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.not_lt.mp hle)
  exact hnoprop ⟨v, ω,
    (isProperlyColored_iff_isCycle_closedCuspCount_eq_zero c).2 ⟨hcyc, h0⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.exists_strict_of_nonsplitting
statement:
theorem exists_strict_of_nonsplitting (c : EdgeColoring G C) (v : V) (α : C)
    (hnoprop : ¬ HasProperlyColoredCycle c)
    (hns : ¬ SplittingVertex c v) :
    ∃ (u : V) (β : C), StrictCuspFreeReach c v u α β ∧ β ∈ c.usedColors
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω0, hcyc0, hn0⟩ := exists_nocusp_cycle_of_not_splitting c hns
  obtain ⟨ω1, hcyc1, hn1, hmin⟩ :=
    exists_min_nocusp_cycle c ⟨ω0, hcyc0, hn0⟩
  have growth (ω : G.Walk v v) (hcyc : ω.IsCycle)
      (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
        c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil))
      (hstart : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠ α)
      (hminω : ∀ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) →
          closedCuspCount ω c ≤ closedCuspCount ω' c) :
      ∃ (u : V) (β : C), StrictCuspFreeReach c v u α β ∧ β ∈ c.usedColors := by
    have hpos := closedCuspCount_pos_of_noprop c hcyc hnocusp hnoprop
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hne, β, hVUnil, h0, hfirst, hlast, hdrop, hβused⟩ :=
      exists_first_internal_cusp c hcyc hnocusp hpos
    have hpfirst :
        c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).firstDart hVUnil) ≠ α := by
      rw [hfirst]; exact hstart
    refine ⟨u, β,
      ⟨ω.takeUntil u hu, hcyc.isPath_takeUntil hu, hVUnil, h0, hpfirst, hlast, ?_⟩,
      hβused⟩
    intro w q hq hqnil hq0 hqfirst hw
    have hwω : w ∈ ω.support := mem_support_of_mem_takeUntil hu hw
    have halt := cusp_minimization (v := v) (u := u) (w := w) (α := β) ω c
      hcyc hnocusp hu hne ⟨hlast, hdrop⟩ hq hqnil hq0 hqfirst hwω
    rcases halt with hprop | ⟨ω', hcyc', hn', hlt⟩
    · exact hnoprop hprop
    · exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) (hminω ω' hcyc' hn')
  rcases startColor_ne_or_reverse (ω := ω1) c hcyc1.not_nil hn1 α with hα | hαR
  · exact growth ω1 hcyc1 hn1 hα hmin
  · have hcycR : ω1.reverse.IsCycle := hcyc1.reverse
    have hnR := nocusp_reverse (ω := ω1) c hcyc1.not_nil hn1
    have hminR : ∀ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) →
          closedCuspCount ω1.reverse c ≤ closedCuspCount ω' c := by
      intro ω' hcyc' hn'
      simpa [closedCuspCount_reverse] using hmin ω' hcyc' hn'
    exact growth ω1.reverse hcycR hnR hαR hminR

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.yeo_separator
statement:
theorem yeo_separator (c : EdgeColoring G C) [Nonempty V]
    (h : ¬ HasProperlyColoredCycle c) :
    ∃ v : V, SplittingVertex c v
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.usedColors.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hempty | hne
  · exact yeo_separator_of_usedColors_empty c hempty
  · obtain ⟨m, hmax⟩ := exists_usedLt_maximal c hne
    refine ⟨m.1, ?_⟩
    by_contra hns
    obtain ⟨u, β, hstrict, hβ⟩ :=
      exists_strict_of_nonsplitting c m.1 m.2.1 h hns
    exact hmax (u, ⟨β, hβ⟩) hstrict

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.deleteVertsCoeIsoInduce_val
statement:
lemma deleteVertsCoeIsoInduce_val (H : SimpleGraph α) (Z : Set α)
    (x : ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts Z).verts) :
    (deleteVertsCoeIsoInduce H Z x : α) = (x : α)
proof:
:= by
  simp [deleteVertsCoeIsoInduce, isoInduce, Subgraph.coeDeleteVertsIso,
    Subgraph.topIso]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_supp_iso
proof:
:=
  ncard_congr' (ConnectedComponent.isoEquivSupp φ c)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_oddComponents_iso
statement:
lemma mem_oddComponents_iso {H : SimpleGraph α} {H' : SimpleGraph β}
    (φ : H ≃g H') (c : H.ConnectedComponent) :
    c ∈ H.oddComponents ↔
      φ.connectedComponentEquiv c ∈ H'.oddComponents
proof:
:= by
  simp [oddComponents, ncard_supp_iso φ c]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_oddComponents_iso
statement:
lemma ncard_oddComponents_iso [Finite α] [Finite β]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {H' : SimpleGraph β} (φ : H ≃g H') :
    H.oddComponents.ncard = H'.oddComponents.ncard
proof:
:=
  ncard_congr' (φ.connectedComponentEquiv.subtypeEquiv fun c =>
    mem_oddComponents_iso φ c)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_oddComponents_deleteVerts
statement:
lemma ncard_oddComponents_deleteVerts [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (Z : Set α) :
    ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts Z).coe.oddComponents.ncard =
      (H.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents.ncard
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts Z).verts :=
    inferInstanceAs (Finite (↑((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts Z).verts))
  haveI : Finite (Zᶜ : Set α) := inferInstance
  exact ncard_oddComponents_iso (deleteVertsCoeIsoInduce H Z)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.isTutteViolator_iff_signedDeficiency_pos
statement:
lemma isTutteViolator_iff_signedDeficiency_pos [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (Z : Set α) :
    H.IsTutteViolator Z ↔ 0 < signedDeficiency H Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsTutteViolator signedDeficiency oddComponentCount
  rw [ncard_oddComponents_deleteVerts H Z]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact sub_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_lt.mpr h)
  · intro h
    exact Nat.cast_lt.mp (sub_pos.mp h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_nonpos_iff_not_violator
statement:
lemma signedDeficiency_nonpos_iff_not_violator [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (Z : Set α) :
    signedDeficiency H Z ≤ 0 ↔ ¬ H.IsTutteViolator Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [isTutteViolator_iff_signedDeficiency_pos]
  exact not_lt.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_le_neg_delta
statement:
lemma signedDeficiency_le_neg_delta (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) Z ≤
      -delta G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := gadget_normalize_cut (G := G) Z
  have hid := signedDeficiency_canonicalCut_eq_neg_delta (G := G) Z
  exact hnorm.2.2.2.trans hid.le

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_canonical_nonneg_of_all
statement:
lemma delta_canonical_nonneg_of_all
    (hΔ : ∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T)
    (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    0 ≤ delta G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:=
  hΔ _ _ (disjoint_originalS_originalT Z)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_nonpos_of_delta_nonneg
statement:
lemma signedDeficiency_nonpos_of_delta_nonneg
    (hΔ : ∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T)
    (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) Z ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle := signedDeficiency_le_neg_delta (G := G) Z
  have hΔZ := delta_canonical_nonneg_of_all (G := G) hΔ Z
  have : -delta G (originalS Z) (originalT Z) ≤ 0 := neg_nonpos.mpr hΔZ
  exact hle.trans this

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_isTutteViolator_gadget_of_delta_nonneg
statement:
lemma not_isTutteViolator_gadget_of_delta_nonneg
    (hΔ : ∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T)
    (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ¬ (gadget G).IsTutteViolator Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← signedDeficiency_nonpos_iff_not_violator (gadget G) Z]
  exact signedDeficiency_nonpos_of_delta_nonneg (G := G) hΔ Z

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_delta_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_delta_nonneg
    (hΔ : ∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T) :
    ∃ F : G.Subgraph, IsSpanningDegreeTwo F
proof:
:= by
  have hPM : ∃ M : Subgraph (gadget G), M.IsPerfectMatching := by
    rw [tutte]
    intro Z
    exact not_isTutteViolator_gadget_of_delta_nonneg (G := G) hΔ Z
  exact gadget_perfectMatching_iff_spanningDegreeTwo.mp hPM

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.isSpanningDegreeTwo_common
statement:
lemma isSpanningDegreeTwo_common {F : G.Subgraph}
    (hF : IsSpanningDegreeTwo F) : Nikoghosyan.IsSpanningDegreeTwo F
proof:
:=
  hF

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_cycleFactor_of_delta_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_cycleFactor_of_delta_nonneg
    (hΔ : ∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T) :
    Nonempty (CycleFactor G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_delta_nonneg (G := G) hΔ
  exact exists_cycleFactor_of_spanningDegreeTwo (isSpanningDegreeTwo_common hF)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.clone_mem_pairCut_iff
statement:
lemma clone_mem_pairCut_iff {S T : Finset V} {v : V} {b : Fin 2} :
    (GadgetVert.clone (G := G) v b ∈ pairCut (G := G) S T) ↔ v ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨v', hv', b', heq⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, _, heq⟩
    · injection heq with hv _
      cases hv
      exact hv'
    · cases heq
  · intro hv
    exact .inl ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.port_mem_pairCut_iff
statement:
lemma port_mem_pairCut_iff {S T : Finset V} {v w : V} {h : G.Adj v w} :
    (GadgetVert.port (G := G) v w h ∈ pairCut (G := G) S T) ↔ v ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨_, _, _, heq⟩ | ⟨v', hv', w', h', heq⟩
    · cases heq
    · injection heq with hv _
      cases hv
      exact hv'
  · intro hv
    exact .inr ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.hasSurvivingClone_pairCut
statement:
lemma hasSurvivingClone_pairCut {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :
    hasSurvivingClone (pairCut (G := G) S T) v ↔ v ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩ hv
    exact hb ((clone_mem_pairCut_iff (G := G) (T := T)).mpr hv)
  · intro hv
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro hmem
    exact hv ((clone_mem_pairCut_iff (G := G) (T := T)).mp hmem)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.hasSurvivingPort_pairCut
statement:
lemma hasSurvivingPort_pairCut {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :
    hasSurvivingPort (pairCut (G := G) S T) v ↔ v ∉ T ∧ ∃ w, G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, h, hp⟩
    exact ⟨fun hv => hp ((port_mem_pairCut_iff (G := G) (S := S)).mpr hv),
      ⟨w, h⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hvT, w, hadj⟩
    exact ⟨w, hadj,
      fun hp => hvT ((port_mem_pairCut_iff (G := G) (S := S)).mp hp)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classS_pairCut
statement:
lemma classS_pairCut {S T : Finset V} {v : V} :
    classS (pairCut (G := G) S T) v ↔ v ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  unfold classS
  rw [hasSurvivingClone_pairCut (G := G) (T := T)]
  exact not_not

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classT_pairCut_of_nonisolated
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hn v
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hP : ¬ (v ∉ T ∧ ∃ w', G.Adj v w') := by
      simpa [hasSurvivingPort_pairCut (G := G) (S := S)] using h.2
    by_contra hvT
    exact hP ⟨hvT, w, hw⟩
  · intro hvT
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hasSurvivingClone_pairCut (G := G) (T := T)]
      intro hvS
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdis hvS hvT
    · intro hP
      exact (hasSurvivingPort_pairCut (G := G) (S := S)).1 hP |>.1 hvT

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classU_pairCut_of_nonisolated
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hn v
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(hasSurvivingClone_pairCut (G := G) (T := T)).mp h.1,
      ((hasSurvivingPort_pairCut (G := G) (S := S)).mp h.2).1⟩
  · intro ⟨hvS, hvT⟩
    exact ⟨(hasSurvivingClone_pairCut (G := G) (T := T)).mpr hvS,
      (hasSurvivingPort_pairCut (G := G) (S := S)).mpr ⟨hvT, w, hw⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.originalS_pairCut
statement:
lemma originalS_pairCut (S T : Finset V) :
    originalS (pairCut (G := G) S T) = S
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.ext fun v => ?_
  simp [mem_originalS_iff, classS_pairCut (G := G) (T := T)]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.originalT_pairCut
statement:
lemma originalT_pairCut (S T : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) (hn : ∀ x : V, ∃ w, G.Adj x w) :
    originalT (pairCut (G := G) S T) = T
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.ext fun v => ?_
  simp [mem_originalT_iff,
    classT_pairCut_of_nonisolated (G := G) hdis hn]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.canonicalCut_pairCut
statement:
lemma canonicalCut_pairCut (S T : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) (hn : ∀ x : V, ∃ w, G.Adj x w) :
    canonicalCut (pairCut (G := G) S T) = pairCut (G := G) S T
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalCut_eq_pair (G := G), originalS_pairCut (G := G),
    originalT_pairCut (G := G) S T hdis hn]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_pairCut
statement:
lemma signedDeficiency_pairCut (S T : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint S T) (hn : ∀ x : V, ∃ w, G.Adj x w) :
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) (pairCut (G := G) S T) = -delta G S T
proof:
:= by
  have hcut := canonicalCut_pairCut (G := G) S T hdis hn
  have hid :=
    signedDeficiency_canonicalCut_eq_neg_delta (G := G)
      (pairCut (G := G) S T)
  rw [hcut] at hid
  simpa [originalS_pairCut (G := G),
    originalT_pairCut (G := G) S T hdis hn] using hid

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_adj_of_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
lemma exists_adj_of_spanningDegreeTwo {F : G.Subgraph}
    (hF : IsSpanningDegreeTwo F) (v : V) : ∃ w, G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (F.neighborSet v).ncard := by
    rw [hF.2 v]
    exact two_pos
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (ncard_pos (Set.toFinite (F.neighborSet v))).1 hpos
  exact ⟨w, F.adj_sub hw⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.nonisolated_of_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
theorem nonisolated_of_spanningDegreeTwo {F : G.Subgraph}
    (hF : IsSpanningDegreeTwo F) : ∀ v : V, ∃ w, G.Adj v w
proof:
:=
  exists_adj_of_spanningDegreeTwo (G := G) hF

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_nonneg_of_spanningDegreeTwo
proof:
:= by
  have hn := nonisolated_of_spanningDegreeTwo (G := G) hF
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    exists_gadget_perfectMatching_of_spanningDegreeTwo (G := G) hF
  have hnv : ¬ (gadget G).IsTutteViolator (pairCut (G := G) S T) :=
    not_isTutteViolator_of_isPerfectMatching hM _
  have hdef : signedDeficiency (gadget G) (pairCut (G := G) S T) ≤ 0 :=
    (signedDeficiency_nonpos_iff_not_violator (gadget G) _).2 hnv
  have hid := signedDeficiency_pairCut (G := G) S T hdis hn
  have : -delta G S T ≤ 0 := by simpa [hid] using hdef
  exact neg_nonpos.mp this

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_nonneg_of_exists_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
theorem delta_nonneg_of_exists_spanningDegreeTwo
    (hF : ∃ F : G.Subgraph, IsSpanningDegreeTwo F)
    {S T : Finset V} (hdis : Disjoint S T) :
    0 ≤ delta G S T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hF
  exact delta_nonneg_of_spanningDegreeTwo (G := G) hF hdis

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_nonneg_iff_exists_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
theorem delta_nonneg_iff_exists_spanningDegreeTwo :
    (∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T) ↔
      ∃ F : G.Subgraph, IsSpanningDegreeTwo F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_delta_nonneg (G := G)
  · intro hF S T hdis
    exact delta_nonneg_of_exists_spanningDegreeTwo (G := G) hF hdis

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_nonneg_iff_exists_cycleFactor
statement:
theorem delta_nonneg_iff_exists_cycleFactor :
    (∀ S T : Finset V, Disjoint S T → 0 ≤ delta G S T) ↔
      Nonempty (CycleFactor G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta_nonneg_iff_exists_spanningDegreeTwo (G := G),
    exists_cycleFactor_iff_spanningDegreeTwo]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact ⟨F, isSpanningDegreeTwo_common (G := G) hF⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact ⟨F, hF⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadgetAdj_symm
statement: lemma gadgetAdj_symm {x y : GadgetVert G} : GadgetAdj G x y → GadgetAdj G y x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> intro h <;> simp_all [GadgetAdj]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadgetAdj_irrefl
statement: lemma gadgetAdj_irrefl (x : GadgetVert G) : ¬ GadgetAdj G x x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone => simp [GadgetAdj]
  | port v w h =>
      intro h'
      exact h.ne (by simp [GadgetAdj] at h'; exact h'.1)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_adj_clone_port
statement:
@[simp] lemma gadget_adj_clone_port {v v' w : V} {b : Fin 2} {h : G.Adj v' w} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.clone v b) (.port v' w h) ↔ v = v'
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_adj_port_clone
statement:
@[simp] lemma gadget_adj_port_clone {v v' w : V} {b : Fin 2} {h : G.Adj v' w} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.port v' w h) (.clone v b) ↔ v = v'
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_adj_port_port
statement:
@[simp] lemma gadget_adj_port_port {v w v' w' : V} {h : G.Adj v w} {h' : G.Adj v' w'} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.port v w h) (.port v' w' h') ↔ v = w' ∧ w = v'
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_gadget_adj_clone_clone
statement:
@[simp] lemma not_gadget_adj_clone_clone {v v' : V} {b b' : Fin 2} :
    ¬ (gadget G).Adj (.clone v b) (.clone v' b')
proof:
:= by
  simp [gadget, GadgetAdj]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_adj_mate
statement:
lemma gadget_adj_mate {v w : V} (h : G.Adj v w) :
    (gadget G).Adj (.port v w h) (.port w v h.symm)
proof: := by simp

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.clone_adj_iff
statement:
lemma clone_adj_iff {v : V} {b : Fin 2} {x : GadgetVert G} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.clone v b) x ↔ ∃ w, ∃ h : G.Adj v w, x = .port v w h
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone => simp
  | port v' w h =>
      constructor
      · intro hv
        cases hv
        exact ⟨w, h, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨w', h', hport⟩
        injection hport with hv hw
        cases hv
        exact rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.port_adj_iff
statement:
lemma port_adj_iff {v w : V} {h : G.Adj v w} {x : GadgetVert G} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.port v w h) x ↔
      (∃ b : Fin 2, x = .clone v b) ∨ ∃ h' : G.Adj w v, x = .port w v h'
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v' b =>
      constructor
      · intro hv
        exact .inl ⟨b, by cases hv; rfl⟩
      · intro hx
        rcases hx with ⟨b', hb'⟩ | ⟨_, hport⟩
        · cases hb'; simp
        · cases hport
  | port v' w' h' =>
      constructor
      · intro hv
        rcases hv with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        exact .inr ⟨h.symm, rfl⟩
      · intro hx
        rcases hx with ⟨_, hb⟩ | ⟨_, hport⟩
        · cases hb
        · injection hport with hv hw
          cases hv
          cases hw
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.twoNbr_apply_mem
statement:
lemma twoNbr_apply_mem (F : G.Subgraph) (v : V)
    (h : (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) (b : Fin 2) :
    (twoNbr F v h b : V) ∈ F.neighborSet v
proof:
:=
  (twoNbr F v h b).property

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.twoNbr_apply_symm
statement:
lemma twoNbr_apply_symm (F : G.Subgraph) (v : V)
    (h : (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) (w : F.neighborSet v) :
    twoNbr F v h ((twoNbr F v h).symm w) = w
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.twoNbr_symm_apply
statement:
lemma twoNbr_symm_apply (F : G.Subgraph) (v : V)
    (h : (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) (b : Fin 2) :
    (twoNbr F v h).symm (twoNbr F v h b) = b
proof:
:=
  Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.factorPartner_adj
statement:
lemma factorPartner_adj (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) (x : GadgetVert G) :
    (gadget G).Adj x (factorPartner F hdeg x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v b => simp [factorPartner]
  | port v w hvw =>
      by_cases hF : w ∈ F.neighborSet v
      · simp [factorPartner, hF]
      · simp [factorPartner, hF]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.factorPartner_clone
statement:
lemma factorPartner_clone (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) (v : V) (b : Fin 2) :
    factorPartner F hdeg (.clone v b) =
      .port v (twoNbr F v (hdeg v) b : V)
        (F.adj_sub (twoNbr_apply_mem F v (hdeg v) b))
proof: := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.factorPartner_port_of_mem
statement:
lemma factorPartner_port_of_mem (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w)
    (hF : w ∈ F.neighborSet v) :
    factorPartner F hdeg (.port v w hvw) =
      .clone v ((twoNbr F v (hdeg v)).symm ⟨w, hF⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorPartner, hF]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.factorPartner_port_of_notMem
statement:
lemma factorPartner_port_of_notMem (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w)
    (hF : w ∉ F.neighborSet v) :
    factorPartner F hdeg (.port v w hvw) = .port w v hvw.symm
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorPartner, hF]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.factorPartner_involutive
statement:
lemma factorPartner_involutive (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) :
    Function.Involutive (factorPartner F hdeg)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | clone v b =>
      rw [factorPartner_clone, factorPartner_port_of_mem F hdeg _
        (twoNbr_apply_mem F v (hdeg v) b)]
      simp
  | port v w hvw =>
      by_cases hF : w ∈ F.neighborSet v
      · rw [factorPartner_port_of_mem F hdeg hvw hF, factorPartner_clone]
        simp
      · have hF' : v ∉ F.neighborSet w := by
          intro hv
          exact hF (by
            simpa [Subgraph.mem_neighborSet] using (hv : F.Adj w v).symm)
        rw [factorPartner_port_of_notMem F hdeg hvw hF,
            factorPartner_port_of_notMem F hdeg hvw.symm hF']

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.matchingFromDegreeTwo_isPerfectMatching
statement:
theorem matchingFromDegreeTwo_isPerfectMatching (F : G.Subgraph)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (F.neighborSet v).ncard = 2) :
    (matchingFromDegreeTwo F hdeg).IsPerfectMatching
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff]
  intro x
  refine ⟨factorPartner F hdeg x, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact hy

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_gadget_perfectMatching_of_spanningDegreeTwo
proof:
:=
  ⟨matchingFromDegreeTwo F hF.2, matchingFromDegreeTwo_isPerfectMatching F hF.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.clone_matched_to_own_port
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (.clone v b)
  obtain ⟨w, h, rfl⟩ := clone_adj_iff.mp (M.adj_sub hx)
  exact ⟨w, h, hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.port_partner_cases
statement:
lemma port_partner_cases {M : Subgraph (gadget G)} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching)
    {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w) :
    (∃ b : Fin 2, M.Adj (.port v w hvw) (.clone v b)) ∨
      ∃ h' : G.Adj w v, M.Adj (.port v w hvw) (.port w v h')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (.port v w hvw)
  rcases port_adj_iff.mp (M.adj_sub hx) with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨h', rfl⟩
  · exact .inl ⟨b, hx⟩
  · exact .inr ⟨h', hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm
statement:
lemma gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm {M : Subgraph (gadget G)} {x y : GadgetVert G}
    (h : M.Adj x y) : M.Adj y x
proof:
:=
  M.symm.symm x y h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_clone_eq_port
statement:
lemma not_clone_eq_port {v w w' : V} {b : Fin 2} {h : G.Adj w w'} :
    (GadgetVert.clone v b : GadgetVert G) ≠ .port w w' h
proof:
:= by
  intro h'; cases h'

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.locally_matched_of_not_mate
statement:
lemma locally_matched_of_not_mate {M : Subgraph (gadget G)}
    (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching) {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w)
    (hne : ∀ h' : G.Adj w v, ¬ M.Adj (.port v w hvw) (.port w v h')) :
    ∃ b : Fin 2, M.Adj (.port v w hvw) (.clone v b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases port_partner_cases hM hvw with h | ⟨h', hm⟩
  · exact h
  · exact (hne h' hm).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.locally_matched_symm
statement:
lemma locally_matched_symm {M : Subgraph (gadget G)} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching)
    {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w) :
    (∃ b : Fin 2, M.Adj (.port v w hvw) (.clone v b)) ↔
      ∃ b : Fin 2, M.Adj (.port w v hvw.symm) (.clone w b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine locally_matched_of_not_mate hM hvw.symm ?_
    intro h'' hm
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hu⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (.port v w hvw)
    have h1 := hu _ hb
    have h2 := hu _ (gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hm)
    exact not_clone_eq_port (h1.trans h2.symm)
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine locally_matched_of_not_mate hM hvw ?_
    intro h'' hm
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hu⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (.port w v hvw.symm)
    have h1 := hu _ hb
    have h2 := hu _ (gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hm)
    exact not_clone_eq_port (h1.trans h2.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.clones_match_distinct_ports
statement:
lemma clones_match_distinct_ports {M : Subgraph (gadget G)}
    (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching) (v : V) :
    ∀ {w0 w1 : V} {h0 : G.Adj v w0} {h1 : G.Adj v w1},
      M.Adj (.clone v 0) (.port v w0 h0) →
      M.Adj (.clone v 1) (.port v w1 h1) → w0 ≠ w1
proof:
:= by
  intro w0 w1 h0 h1 hM0 hM1 hw
  cases hw
  cases Subsingleton.elim h1 h0
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hu⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (.port v w0 h0)
  have hx0 := hu (.clone v 0) (gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hM0)
  have hx1 := hu (.clone v 1) (gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hM1)
  injection (hx0.trans hx1.symm) with _ hbit
  exact (Fin.zero_ne_one hbit).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_gadget_perfectMatching
statement:
theorem exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_gadget_perfectMatching
    {M : Subgraph (gadget G)} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    IsSpanningDegreeTwo (degreeTwoFromMatching M hM)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun v => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w0, h0, hM0⟩ := clone_matched_to_own_port hM v 0
  obtain ⟨w1, h1, hM1⟩ := clone_matched_to_own_port hM v 1
  have hne : w0 ≠ w1 := clones_match_distinct_ports hM v hM0 hM1
  have loc0 : (degreeTwoFromMatching M hM).Adj v w0 := ⟨h0, ⟨0, gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hM0⟩⟩
  have loc1 : (degreeTwoFromMatching M hM).Adj v w1 := ⟨h1, ⟨1, gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hM1⟩⟩
  have hsup : ({w0, w1} : Set V) ⊆ (degreeTwoFromMatching M hM).neighborSet v := by
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl
    · exact loc0
    · exact loc1
  have hsub : (degreeTwoFromMatching M hM).neighborSet v ⊆ ({w0, w1} : Set V) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hvw, b, hb⟩ := hw
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hu⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (.clone v b)
    have hxport := hu (.port v w hvw) (gadgetSubgraph_adj_comm hb)
    have : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by
      revert b; intro b; fin_cases b <;> simp
    rcases this with rfl | rfl
    · have heq := hu (.port v w0 h0) hM0
      have hports : (.port v w hvw : GadgetVert G) = .port v w0 h0 :=
        hxport.trans heq.symm
      injection hports with _ hw
      exact .inl hw
    · have heq := hu (.port v w1 h1) hM1
      have hports : (.port v w hvw : GadgetVert G) = .port v w1 h1 :=
        hxport.trans heq.symm
      injection hports with _ hw
      exact .inr hw
  have hcard : ({w0, w1} : Set V).ncard = 2 := Set.ncard_pair hne
  exact le_antisymm
    ((Set.ncard_le_ncard hsub).trans_eq hcard)
    (hcard.symm.trans_le (Set.ncard_le_ncard hsup))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_perfectMatching_iff_spanningDegreeTwo
statement:
theorem gadget_perfectMatching_iff_spanningDegreeTwo :
    (∃ M : Subgraph (gadget G), M.IsPerfectMatching) ↔
      ∃ F : G.Subgraph, IsSpanningDegreeTwo F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    exact ⟨degreeTwoFromMatching M hM,
      exists_spanningDegreeTwo_of_gadget_perfectMatching hM⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact exists_gadget_perfectMatching_of_spanningDegreeTwo hF

name: Nikoghosyan.augGraph_adj_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma augGraph_adj_inl_inl {a b : V} :
    (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inl a) (.inl b) ↔ G.Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [augGraph, augRel, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨_, h⟩
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact h.symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun hij => (SimpleGraph.Adj.ne h) (Sum.inl_injective hij), Or.inl h⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.augGraph_adj_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma augGraph_adj_inl_inr {a : V} {i : Fin q} :
    (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inl a) (.inr i) ↔ a ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  simp [augGraph, augRel, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, Sum.inl_ne_inr]

name: Nikoghosyan.augGraph_adj_inr_inl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma augGraph_adj_inr_inl {b : V} {i : Fin q} :
    (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inr i) (.inl b) ↔ b ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  simp [augGraph, augRel, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, Sum.inr_ne_inl]

name: Nikoghosyan.augGraph_not_adj_inr_inr
statement:
lemma augGraph_not_adj_inr_inr {i j : Fin q} :
    ¬ (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inr i) (.inr j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [augGraph, augRel, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]

name: Nikoghosyan.augOldHom_injective
statement:
lemma augOldHom_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (augOldHom (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) : V → V ⊕ Fin q)
proof:
:=
  Sum.inl_injective

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_augOldImage
statement:
lemma mem_augOldImage {U : Finset V} {x : V ⊕ Fin q} :
    x ∈ augOldImage (q := q) U ↔ ∃ a ∈ U, x = .inl a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hx
    exact ⟨a, ha, hfa.symm⟩
  · intro ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, hxa.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_augFresh
statement:
lemma mem_augFresh {x : V ⊕ Fin q} :
    x ∈ augFresh (V := V) (q := q) ↔ ∃ i : Fin q, x = .inr i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, hfi⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hx
    exact ⟨i, hfi.symm⟩
  · intro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ i, hxi.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_augA
statement:
lemma mem_augA {x : V ⊕ Fin q} :
    x ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q) ↔ ∃ a ∈ B, x = .inl a
proof:
:=
  mem_augOldImage (q := q)

name: Nikoghosyan.card_augOldImage
statement:
@[simp]
lemma card_augOldImage (U : Finset V) :
    (augOldImage (q := q) U).card = U.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_map ⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.card_augFresh
statement:
@[simp]
lemma card_augFresh : (augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).card = q
proof:
:= by
  change ((univ : Finset (Fin q)).map
      (⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩ : Fin q ↪ V ⊕ Fin q)).card = q
  rw [Finset.card_map, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_augOldImage_fresh
statement:
lemma disjoint_augOldImage_fresh (U : Finset V) :
    Disjoint (augOldImage (q := q) U) (augFresh (V := V) (q := q))
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hx hy
  obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hy
  exact Sum.inl_ne_inr hi

name: Nikoghosyan.card_augCarrier
statement:
lemma card_augCarrier (K : Finset V) :
    (augCarrier (q := q) K).card = K.card + q
proof:
:= by
  simp [augCarrier, card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_augOldImage_fresh (q := q) K)]

name: Nikoghosyan.three_le_card_augCarrier
statement:
lemma three_le_card_augCarrier {K : Finset V} (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + q < B.card) :
    3 ≤ (augCarrier (q := q) K).card
proof:
:= by
  have hB : q + 1 ≤ B.card := by
    have : q ≤ pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + q := Nat.le_add_left _ _
    omega
  have hK : B.card ≤ K.card := card_le_card hBK
  have hcard := card_augCarrier (q := q) K
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_augMap
statement:
lemma GraphPath.support_augMap (p : GraphPath G) :
    (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).support =
      augOldImage (q := q) p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GraphPath.augMap, GraphPath.support, augOldImage]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxL : x ∈ (p.walk.map (augOldHom (G := G) (B := B) (q := q))).support :=
      List.mem_toFinset.mp hx
    rw [Walk.support_map (f := augOldHom (G := G) (B := B) (q := q))
      (p := p.walk)] at hxL
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hxL
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, List.mem_toFinset.mpr ha, hax⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hx
    apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
    rw [Walk.support_map (f := augOldHom (G := G) (B := B) (q := q))
      (p := p.walk)]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, List.mem_toFinset.mp ha, hax⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_augMap
statement:
lemma GraphPath.start_augMap (p : GraphPath G) :
    (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).start = .inl p.start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.finish_augMap
statement:
lemma GraphPath.finish_augMap (p : GraphPath G) :
    (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).finish = .inl p.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.augMap_not_mem_fresh
statement:
lemma GraphPath.augMap_not_mem_fresh (p : GraphPath G) {i : Fin q} :
    Sum.inr i ∉ (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).support
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [GraphPath.support_augMap] at h
  obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 h
  exact Sum.inr_ne_inl ha

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_augExtend
statement:
lemma GraphPath.support_augExtend (p : GraphPath G) (i : Fin q)
    (hf : p.finish ∈ B) :
    (p.augExtend (B := B) i hf).support =
      insert (.inr i) (augOldImage (q := q) p.support)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  unfold GraphPath.augExtend GraphPath.concatAdj GraphPath.support
  erw [Walk.support_concat (p := (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).walk)]
  simp [List.mem_toFinset, mem_insert]
  apply or_congr Iff.rfl
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : x ∈ (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).support := List.mem_toFinset.mpr h
    rwa [GraphPath.support_augMap] at this
  · intro h
    have : x ∈ (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).support := by
      rwa [GraphPath.support_augMap]
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mp this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_augExtend
statement:
lemma GraphPath.start_augExtend (p : GraphPath G) (i : Fin q)
    (hf : p.finish ∈ B) :
    (p.augExtend (B := B) i hf).start = .inl p.start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.finish_augExtend
statement:
lemma GraphPath.finish_augExtend (p : GraphPath G) (i : Fin q)
    (hf : p.finish ∈ B) :
    (p.augExtend (B := B) i hf).finish = .inr i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_eq_paths_length
statement:
lemma PathCover.card_eq_paths_length {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    pc.card = pc.paths.length
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.paths_length_eq_q
statement:
lemma PathCover.paths_length_eq_q {U : Finset V} {pc : PathCover G U}
    (hq : pc.card = q) : pc.paths.length = q
proof:
:=
  pc.card_eq_paths_length.symm.trans hq

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.getPath_mem
statement:
lemma PathCover.getPath_mem {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (i : Fin pc.paths.length) : pc.getPath i ∈ pc.paths
proof:
:=
  List.get_mem pc.paths i

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.get_mem
statement:
lemma PathCover.get_mem {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (i : Fin pc.card) : pc.getPath (Fin.cast pc.card_eq_paths_length i) ∈ pc.paths
proof:
:=
  pc.getPath_mem _

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.get_terminal
proof:
:=
  hterm _ (pc.get_mem i)

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augExtended_length
statement:
lemma PathCover.augExtended_length {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q) :
    (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length = q
proof:
:= by
  simp [PathCover.augExtended]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augExtended_get
statement:
lemma PathCover.augExtended_get {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q)
    (i : Fin q) :
    (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get
        (Fin.cast (pc.augExtended_length (B := B) hterm hq).symm i) =
      (pc.getPath (Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i)).augExtend
        (B := B) i (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm i)).2
proof:
:= by
  simp [PathCover.augExtended, Fin.cast, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map,
    List.getElem_finRange]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augExtended_ne_nil
statement:
lemma PathCover.augExtended_ne_nil {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q) (hqpos : 1 ≤ q) :
    pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlen := congrArg List.length h
  have : q = 0 := by
    simpa [pc.augExtended_length hterm hq] using hlen
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_augExtend_of_ne
statement:
lemma disjoint_augExtend_of_ne {p r : GraphPath G} {i j : Fin q}
    (hp : p.finish ∈ B) (hr : r.finish ∈ B) (hne : i ≠ j)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support r.support) :
    Disjoint (p.augExtend (B := B) i hp).support
      (r.augExtend (B := B) j hr).support
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hx hy
  rw [GraphPath.support_augExtend] at hx hy
  rcases mem_insert.mp hx with hxi | hxold
  · subst hxi
    rcases mem_insert.mp hy with hyi | hyold
    · exact hne (Sum.inr_injective hyi)
    · obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hyold
      exact Sum.inr_ne_inl ha
  · rcases mem_insert.mp hy with hyi | hyold
    · subst hyi
      obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hxold
      exact Sum.inr_ne_inl ha
    · obtain ⟨a, haP, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hxold
      obtain ⟨b, hbR, hba⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hyold
      have hba' : a = b := Sum.inl_injective hba
      subst hba'
      exact disjoint_left.1 hd haP hbR

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.pairwise_support
statement:
lemma PathCover.pairwise_support {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {i j : Fin pc.paths.length} (hne : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (pc.getPath i).support (pc.getPath j).support
proof:
:= by
  have h := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp pc.disjoint
  have hij : i.val ≠ j.val := fun hval => hne (Fin.ext hval)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · exact h i.val j.val i.isLt j.isLt hlt
  · exact (h j.val i.val j.isLt i.isLt hgt).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augExtended_pairwise
statement:
lemma PathCover.augExtended_pairwise {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q) :
    (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).Pairwise
      fun p r => Disjoint p.support r.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [PathCover.augExtended, List.pairwise_map]
  refine (List.nodup_iff_pairwise_ne.1 (List.nodup_finRange q)).imp ?_
  intro i j hne
  have hd :=
    pc.pairwise_support
      (i := Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i)
      (j := Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) j)
      (by
        intro h
        exact hne (Fin.ext (by
          have := congrArg Fin.val h
          simpa using this)))
  exact disjoint_augExtend_of_ne (B := B) (q := q)
    (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm i)).2
    (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm j)).2 hne hd

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augExtended_edges
statement:
lemma PathCover.augExtended_edges {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length) :
    (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start
proof:
:= by
  have hlenE : (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length = q :=
    pc.augExtended_length hterm hq
  have hiq : i + 1 < q := by omega
  have i_lt : i < q := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hiq
  let i0 : Fin q := ⟨i, i_lt⟩
  let i1 : Fin q := ⟨i + 1, hiq⟩
  have h0 := pc.augExtended_get hterm hq i0
  have h1 := pc.augExtended_get hterm hq i1
  have hidx0 :
      (⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩ : Fin (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length) =
        Fin.cast hlenE.symm i0 := Fin.ext rfl
  have hidx1 :
      (⟨i + 1, hi⟩ : Fin (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length) =
        Fin.cast hlenE.symm i1 := Fin.ext rfl
  have hfin :
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish =
        .inr i0 := by
    rw [hidx0]
    simpa [GraphPath.finish_augExtend] using congrArg GraphPath.finish h0
  have hst :
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start =
        .inl (pc.getPath (Fin.cast pc.card_eq_paths_length (Fin.cast hq.symm i1))).start := by
    have hcast :
        Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i1 =
          Fin.cast pc.card_eq_paths_length (Fin.cast hq.symm i1) :=
      Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hidx1, h1, GraphPath.start_augExtend, hcast]
  rw [hfin, hst]
  exact (augGraph_adj_inr_inl (B := B) (q := q)).2
    (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm i1)).1

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augExtended_close
statement:
lemma PathCover.augExtended_close {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q)
    (hne : pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq ≠ []) :
    (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).getLast hne).finish
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).head hne).start
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : 0 < (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length :=
    List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by
    simpa [pc.augExtended_length hterm hq] using hlen
  have hlenE : (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length = q :=
    pc.augExtended_length hterm hq
  have hlastIdx : q - 1 < (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length := by
    have : q - 1 < q := Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hqpos
    omega
  have hlast :
      (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).getLast hne =
        (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨q - 1, hlastIdx⟩ := by
    rw [List.getLast_eq_getElem]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hhead :
      (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).head hne =
        (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨0, hlen⟩ :=
    List.head_eq_getElem hne
  rw [hlast, hhead]
  let iLast : Fin q := ⟨q - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hqpos⟩
  let i0 : Fin q := ⟨0, hqpos⟩
  have hf := pc.augExtended_get hterm hq iLast
  have hs := pc.augExtended_get hterm hq i0
  have hidxL :
      (⟨q - 1, hlastIdx⟩ : Fin (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length) =
        Fin.cast hlenE.symm iLast := Fin.ext rfl
  have hidx0 :
      (⟨0, hlen⟩ : Fin (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).length) =
        Fin.cast hlenE.symm i0 := Fin.ext rfl
  have hfin :
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨q - 1, hlastIdx⟩).finish =
        Sum.inr iLast := by
    rw [hidxL]
    simpa [GraphPath.finish_augExtend] using congrArg GraphPath.finish hf
  have hst :
      ((pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq).get ⟨0, hlen⟩).start =
        Sum.inl (pc.getPath (Fin.cast pc.card_eq_paths_length (Fin.cast hq.symm i0))).start := by
    have hcast :
        Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i0 =
          Fin.cast pc.card_eq_paths_length (Fin.cast hq.symm i0) :=
      Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hidx0, hs, GraphPath.start_augExtend, hcast]
  rw [hfin, hst]
  exact (augGraph_adj_inr_inl (B := B) (q := q)).2
    (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm i0)).1

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.mem_supportUnion_augExtended
statement:
lemma PathCover.mem_supportUnion_augExtended {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q)
    {x : V ⊕ Fin q} :
    x ∈ GraphPath.supportUnion (pc.augExtended (B := B) hterm hq) ↔
      x ∈ augCarrier (q := q) K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.1 hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
    rw [GraphPath.support_augExtend] at hxr
    rcases mem_insert.mp hxr with hxi | hxold
    · cases hxi
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr ((mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).2 ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    · obtain ⟨a, haP, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hxold
      have haK : a ∈ K :=
        (pc.mem_iff a).2
          ⟨pc.getPath (Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i),
            pc.getPath_mem _, haP⟩
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((mem_augOldImage (q := q)).2 ⟨a, haK, rfl⟩))
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxK | hxF
    · obtain ⟨a, haK, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hxK
      obtain ⟨p, hp, haP⟩ := (pc.mem_iff a).1 haK
      obtain ⟨n, hn, hpn⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hp
      have hlenP : pc.paths.length = q := pc.paths_length_eq_q hq
      have nq : n < q := by omega
      let i : Fin q := ⟨n, nq⟩
      refine GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2
        ⟨(pc.getPath (Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i)).augExtend
          (B := B) i (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm i)).2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, rfl⟩
      · rw [GraphPath.support_augExtend]
        have hpget : p = pc.getPath ⟨n, hn⟩ := hpn.symm
        have hidx :
            (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin pc.paths.length) =
              Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i := Fin.ext rfl
        have haP' : a ∈
            (pc.getPath (Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i)).support := by
          simpa [hpget, PathCover.getPath, hidx] using haP
        exact mem_insert_of_mem ((mem_augOldImage (q := q)).2 ⟨a, haP', rfl⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hxF
      refine GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.2
        ⟨(pc.getPath (Fin.cast (hq.symm.trans pc.card_eq_paths_length) i)).augExtend
          (B := B) i (pc.get_terminal (B := B) hterm (Fin.cast hq.symm i)).2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, rfl⟩
      · rw [GraphPath.support_augExtend]
        exact mem_insert_self _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.support_assembleCyclePos
statement:
lemma support_assembleCyclePos {W : Type u} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {H : SimpleGraph W} (ps : List (GraphPath H)) (hne : ps ≠ [])
    (hdisj : ps.Pairwise fun p r => Disjoint p.support r.support)
    (hedges : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < ps.length),
      H.Adj (ps.get ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi⟩).finish
        (ps.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩).start)
    (hclose : H.Adj (ps.getLast hne).finish (ps.head hne).start)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ (GraphPath.supportUnion ps).card) :
    (assembleCyclePos ps hne hdisj hedges hclose h3).support =
      GraphPath.supportUnion ps
proof:
:= by
  simp [assembleCyclePos, GraphPath.support_toCycle]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (GraphPath.exists_spliceChain ps hne hdisj hedges)).2.2

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.support_augCycle
statement:
lemma PathCover.support_augCycle {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q)
    (hqpos : 1 ≤ q)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ (augCarrier (q := q) K).card) :
    (pc.augCycle (B := B) hterm hq hqpos h3).support = augCarrier (q := q) K
proof:
:= by
  simp [PathCover.augCycle, support_assembleCyclePos]
  ext x
  exact pc.mem_supportUnion_augExtended (B := B) hterm hq

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_augCycle
statement:
lemma PathCover.exists_augCycle {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) (hq : pc.card = q)
    (hqpos : 1 ≤ q)
    (hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + q < B.card) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle (augGraph (G := G) B q),
      c.support = augCarrier (q := q) K
proof:
:=
  ⟨pc.augCycle (B := B) hterm hq hqpos
      (three_le_card_augCarrier (B := B) (q := q) hBK hqpos hstrict),
    pc.support_augCycle (B := B) hterm hq hqpos _⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.augRemainder_eq
statement:
lemma augRemainder_eq {K : Finset V} (_hBK : B ⊆ K) :
    augCarrier (q := q) K \ augA (B := B) (q := q) =
      augOldImage (q := q) (K \ B) ∪ augFresh (V := V) (q := q)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxC := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxA := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    rcases mem_union.1 hxC with hxK | hxF
    · obtain ⟨a, haK, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hxK
      have haB : a ∉ B := fun haB =>
        hxA ((mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).2 ⟨a, haB, rfl⟩)
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((mem_augOldImage (q := q)).2 ⟨a, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨haK, haB⟩, rfl⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxF)
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxL | hxF
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hxL
      have haK : a ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1
      have haB : a ∉ B := (mem_sdiff.1 ha).2
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((mem_augOldImage (q := q)).2 ⟨a, haK, rfl⟩)), ?_⟩
      intro hA
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hA
      exact haB (by cases hba; exact hb)
    · refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxF), ?_⟩
      intro hA
      obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hA
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hxF
      exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (ha.symm.trans hi)

name: Nikoghosyan.no_cross_oldRemainder_fresh
statement:
lemma no_cross_oldRemainder_fresh {K : Finset V} :
    ∀ a ∈ augOldImage (q := q) (K \ B),
      ∀ b ∈ augFresh (V := V) (q := q),
        ¬ (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hadj
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 ha
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hb
  have hvB : v ∈ B := by simpa using hadj
  exact (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2 hvB

name: Nikoghosyan.Independent.augFresh
statement:
lemma Independent.augFresh :
    Independent (G := augGraph (G := G) B q) (augFresh (V := V) (q := q))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hx
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hy
  exact (augGraph_not_adj_inr_inr (B := B) (q := q)) hxy

name: Nikoghosyan.Independent.augA
statement:
lemma Independent.augA (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) :
    Independent (G := augGraph (G := G) B q) (augA (B := B) (q := q))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hy
  exact hInd ha hb (by simpa using hxy)

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_fresh_iff
statement:
lemma adj_fresh_iff {i : Fin q} {x : V ⊕ Fin q} :
    (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inr i) x ↔ ∃ a ∈ B, x = .inl a
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl a =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨a, by simpa using h, rfl⟩
    · intro ⟨b, hb, hba⟩
      cases hba
      simpa using hb
  | inr j =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (augGraph_not_adj_inr_inr (B := B) (q := q) h).elim
    · intro ⟨_, _, h⟩
      cases h

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.supportUnion_eq_aug
statement:
lemma PathCover.supportUnion_eq_aug {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    GraphPath.supportUnion pc.paths = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.trans (pc.mem_iff x).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.card_supportUnion_of_pairwise
statement:
lemma card_supportUnion_of_pairwise {W : Type u} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (ps : List (GraphPath H))
    (h : ps.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (GraphPath.supportUnion ps).card = (ps.map fun p => p.support.card).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp [GraphPath.supportUnion]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hd : Disjoint p.support (GraphPath.supportUnion ps) := by
      refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro x hx hxU
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := GraphPath.mem_supportUnion.1 hxU
      exact disjoint_left.1 ((List.pairwise_cons.1 h).1 r hr) hx hxr
    rw [GraphPath.supportUnion_cons, card_union_of_disjoint hd, List.map_cons,
      List.sum_cons, ih (List.pairwise_cons.1 h).2]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.nil_of_independent
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnil
  have hadj := GraphPath.adj_start_trimStart p hnil
  have hs : p.start ∈ U := hsub p.start_mem_support
  have ht : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∈ U := by
    apply hsub
    have hmem : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).support :=
      GraphPath.start_mem_support _
    have hsub' : (p.trimStart hnil).support ⊆ p.support := by
      rw [GraphPath.support_trimStart]
      exact erase_subset _ _
    exact hsub' hmem
  exact hInd hs ht hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_eq_card_of_independent_aug
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_antisymm (pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) U) ?_
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
  have h1 : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.support.card = 1 := fun p hp => by
    have hnil := GraphPath.nil_of_independent hInd p (pc.support_subset hp)
    simp [GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil]
  have hsum := card_supportUnion_of_pairwise pc.paths pc.disjoint
  have hU : GraphPath.supportUnion pc.paths = U := pc.supportUnion_eq_aug
  have hmap : (pc.paths.map fun p => p.support.card).sum = pc.paths.length := by
    have : pc.paths.map (fun p => p.support.card) = pc.paths.map (fun _ => 1) :=
      List.map_congr_left fun p hp => h1 p hp
    simp [this]
  have : pc.card = U.card := by
    simp [PathCover.card, ← hmap, ← hsum, hU]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.augMap_card
statement:
lemma PathCover.augMap_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    (pc.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).card = pc.card
proof:
:= by
  simp [PathCover.augMap, PathCover.card]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_augOldImage_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_augOldImage_le (U : Finset V) :
    pathCoverNumber (augGraph (G := G) B q) (augOldImage (q := q) U) ≤
      pathCoverNumber G U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := augGraph (G := G) B q)
    (pc.augMap (B := B) (q := q))
  simpa [PathCover.augMap_card, hpc] using hle

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_augFresh
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_augFresh :
    pathCoverNumber (augGraph (G := G) B q) (augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) = q
proof:
:= by
  simpa [card_augFresh] using
    pathCoverNumber_eq_card_of_independent_aug
      (U := augFresh (V := V) (q := q))
      (Independent.augFresh (G := G) (B := B) (q := q))

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_augRemainder_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_augRemainder_le {K : Finset V} :
    pathCoverNumber (augGraph (G := G) B q)
        (augOldImage (q := q) (K \ B) ∪ augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) ≤
      pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + q
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_augOldImage_fresh (q := q) (K \ B)
  have hnc := no_cross_oldRemainder_fresh (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) (K := K)
  have hadd := Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := augGraph (G := G) B q)
    hdisj hnc
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_augOldImage_le (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) (K \ B)
  have hf := pathCoverNumber_augFresh (G := G) (B := B) (q := q)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.augOldImage_eq_image
statement:
lemma augOldImage_eq_image (U : Finset V) :
    augOldImage (q := q) U = U.image (Sum.inl : V → V ⊕ Fin q)
proof:
:=
  Finset.map_eq_image _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_subset_range_of_oldImage
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 (hsub hx)
  exact ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_subset_range_inl
statement:
lemma GraphPath.support_subset_range_inl (p : GraphPath G) :
    (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).support ⊆
      augOldImage (q := q) (univ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [GraphPath.support_augMap] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hx
  exact (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).2 ⟨a, mem_univ a, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_augMap_subset_range
statement:
lemma GraphPath.support_augMap_subset_range (p : GraphPath G) :
    ∀ x ∈ (p.augMap (B := B) (q := q)).support,
      x ∈ Set.range (Sum.inl : V → V ⊕ Fin q)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx =>
    GraphPath.support_subset_range_of_oldImage
      (p.support_subset_range_inl (B := B) (q := q)) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.ofAugOldImage_card
proof:
:= by
  simp [PathCover.ofAugOldImage, PathCover.ofCarrierImage_inl,
    PathCover.ofCarrierImage, PathCover.card]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_augOldImage
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_augOldImage (U : Finset V) :
    pathCoverNumber (augGraph (G := G) B q) (augOldImage (q := q) U) =
      pathCoverNumber G U
proof:
:= by
  simpa [augOldImage_eq_image] using
    pathCoverNumber_mapCarrier_inl
      (G := G) (H := augGraph (G := G) B q)
      (fun u v => augGraph_adj_inl_inl (B := B) (q := q)) U

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_augOldImage_canonical
statement:
lemma isCograph_augOldImage_canonical {U : Finset V} :
    IsCograph (augGraph (G := G) B q) (augOldImage (q := q) U) ↔
      IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  simpa [augOldImage_eq_image] using
    IsCograph_mapCarrier_inl
      (G := G) (H := augGraph (G := G) B q)
      (fun u v => augGraph_adj_inl_inl (B := B) (q := q)) U

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_augRemainder
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_augRemainder {K : Finset V} :
    pathCoverNumber (augGraph (G := G) B q)
        (augOldImage (q := q) (K \ B) ∪ augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) =
      pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + q
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_augOldImage_fresh (q := q) (K \ B)
  have hnc := no_cross_oldRemainder_fresh (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) (K := K)
  have hadd := Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := augGraph (G := G) B q)
    hdisj hnc
  have hold := pathCoverNumber_augOldImage (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) (K \ B)
  have hf := pathCoverNumber_augFresh (G := G) (B := B) (q := q)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_augRemainder_eq
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_augRemainder_eq {K : Finset V} (hBK : B ⊆ K) :
    pathCoverNumber (augGraph (G := G) B q)
        (augCarrier (q := q) K \ augA (B := B) (q := q)) =
      pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + q
proof:
:= by
  simpa [augRemainder_eq hBK] using
    pathCoverNumber_augRemainder (K := K)

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_augOldImage
statement:
lemma isCograph_augOldImage {U : Finset V} (h : Cograph.IsCograph G U) :
    Cograph.IsCograph (augGraph (G := G) B q) (augOldImage (q := q) U)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  obtain ⟨a0, ha0, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 ha
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hb
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hc
  obtain ⟨d0, hd0, rfl⟩ := (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 hd
  refine h ha0 hb0 hc0 hd0 ?_
  exact
    { ne_ab := mt (congrArg Sum.inl) hp.ne_ab
      ne_ac := mt (congrArg Sum.inl) hp.ne_ac
      ne_ad := mt (congrArg Sum.inl) hp.ne_ad
      ne_bc := mt (congrArg Sum.inl) hp.ne_bc
      ne_bd := mt (congrArg Sum.inl) hp.ne_bd
      ne_cd := mt (congrArg Sum.inl) hp.ne_cd
      adj_ab := by simpa using hp.adj_ab
      adj_bc := by simpa using hp.adj_bc
      adj_cd := by simpa using hp.adj_cd
      not_ac := by simpa using hp.not_ac
      not_ad := by simpa using hp.not_ad
      not_bd := by simpa using hp.not_bd }

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_augFresh

  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 ha
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hb
  exact (augGraph_not_adj_inr_inr (B := B) (q := q)) hp.adj_ab

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_augRemainder
statement:
lemma isCograph_augRemainder {K : Finset V} (hK : Cograph.IsCograph G K) :
    Cograph.IsCograph (augGraph (G := G) B q)
      (augOldImage (q := q) (K \ B) ∪ augFresh (V := V) (q := q))
proof:
:=
  Cograph.isCograph_union_of_no_cross
    (no_cross_oldRemainder_fresh (K := K))
    (isCograph_augOldImage (Cograph.isCograph_mono hK sdiff_subset))
    isCograph_augFresh

name: Nikoghosyan.list_sum_map_erase_one
statement:
lemma list_sum_map_erase_one {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (f : α → ℕ)
    {a : α} {l : List α} (ha : a ∈ l) (hn : l.Nodup) :
    (l.map f).sum =
      ((l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)).map f).sum + f a
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hnxs : xs.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.1 hn).2
    have hnx : x ∉ xs := (List.nodup_cons.1 hn).1
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with hxa | hxs
    · subst hxa
      have hfilt : ((a :: xs).filter fun y => decide (y ≠ a)) = xs := by
        have hfalse : decide (a ≠ a) = false := decide_eq_false (by simp)
        rw [List.filter_cons, hfalse]
        refine List.filter_eq_self.2 ?_
        intro y hy
        exact decide_eq_true (fun h => hnx (h ▸ hy))
      rw [hfilt, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.add_comm]
    · have hne : x ≠ a := fun h => hnx (h ▸ hxs)
      have hfilt : ((x :: xs).filter fun y => decide (y ≠ a)) =
          x :: xs.filter fun y => decide (y ≠ a) :=
        List.filter_cons_of_pos (decide_eq_true hne)
      rw [hfilt, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
        ih hxs hnxs]
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.list_sum_map_erase_two
statement:
lemma list_sum_map_erase_two {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (f : α → ℕ)
    {a b : α} {l : List α} (ha : a ∈ l) (hb : b ∈ l) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hn : l.Nodup) :
    (l.map f).sum =
      (((l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)).filter fun x => decide (x ≠ b)).map f).sum
        + f a + f b
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := list_sum_map_erase_one f ha hn
  have hb' : b ∈ l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a) :=
    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hb, decide_eq_true hne.symm⟩
  have hn' : (l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)).Nodup := List.Nodup.filter _ hn
  have h2 := list_sum_map_erase_one f (a := b)
    (l := l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)) hb' hn'
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.endpointDeficit_spliceTwoInsert
statement:
lemma PathCover.endpointDeficit_spliceTwoInsert {U B : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (b : V) (hb : b ∉ U) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support) :
    (pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne b hb r hr).endpointDeficit B +
        p.endpointDeficit B + q.endpointDeficit B =
      pc.endpointDeficit B + r.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  unfold PathCover.endpointDeficit PathCover.spliceTwoInsert
  have hsum :=
    list_sum_map_erase_two (fun s : GraphPath G => s.endpointDeficit B)
      hp hq hne pc.nodup_paths
  simp [List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
    List.map_nil, List.sum_nil] at hsum ⊢
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.endpointDeficit_pos_iff
statement:
lemma GraphPath.endpointDeficit_pos_iff (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G) :
    0 < p.endpointDeficit B ↔ p.start ∉ B ∨ p.finish ∉ B
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Nikoghosyan.list_endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul
statement:
lemma list_endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul (B : Finset V) :
    ∀ (ps : List (GraphPath G)),
      (∀ p ∈ ps, p.start ∉ B ∧ p.finish ∉ B) →
        (ps.map (fun p => p.endpointDeficit B)).sum = 2 * ps.length
proof:
| [], _ => by simp
  | p :: ps, h => by
    have hp := h p (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
    have hps : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.start ∉ B ∧ q.finish ∉ B := fun q hq =>
      h q (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hq))
    have hpdef : p.endpointDeficit B = 2 := by
      unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
      simp [hp.1, hp.2]
    simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, hpdef,
      list_endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul B ps hps, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul_of_ends_outside
statement:
lemma PathCover.endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul_of_ends_outside {K B : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G K)
    (h : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∉ B ∧ p.finish ∉ B) :
    pc.endpointDeficit B = 2 * pc.card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PathCover.endpointDeficit, PathCover.card] using
    list_endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul (G := G) B pc.paths h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.endpointDeficit_anti
statement:
lemma GraphPath.endpointDeficit_anti {B C : Finset V} (h : B ⊆ C)
    (p : GraphPath G) :
    p.endpointDeficit C ≤ p.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
  have hs : (if p.start ∈ C then 0 else 1) ≤ (if p.start ∈ B then 0 else 1) := by
    by_cases hC : p.start ∈ C
    · simp [hC]
    · have hB : p.start ∉ B := fun hB => hC (h hB)
      simp [hC, hB]
  have hf : (if p.finish ∈ C then 0 else 1) ≤ (if p.finish ∈ B then 0 else 1) := by
    by_cases hC : p.finish ∈ C
    · simp [hC]
    · have hB : p.finish ∉ B := fun hB => hC (h hB)
      simp [hC, hB]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.list_endpointDeficit_anti
statement:
lemma list_endpointDeficit_anti {B C : Finset V} (hBC : B ⊆ C) :
    ∀ (ps : List (GraphPath G)),
      (ps.map (fun p => p.endpointDeficit C)).sum ≤
        (ps.map (fun p => p.endpointDeficit B)).sum
proof:
| [] => by simp
  | p :: ps => by
    simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    exact Nat.add_le_add (GraphPath.endpointDeficit_anti hBC p)
      (list_endpointDeficit_anti hBC ps)

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.endpointDeficit_anti
statement:
lemma PathCover.endpointDeficit_anti {K B C : Finset V} (hBC : B ⊆ C)
    (pc : PathCover G K) :

proof:
:=
  list_endpointDeficit_anti (G := G) hBC pc.paths

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.endpointDeficit_unionDisjoint
statement:
lemma PathCover.endpointDeficit_unionDisjoint {A C B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A C)
    (pcA : PathCover G A) (pcC : PathCover G C) :
    (Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcA pcC).endpointDeficit B =
      pcA.endpointDeficit B + pcC.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  unfold PathCover.endpointDeficit Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint

name: Nikoghosyan.list_exists_pos_deficit
statement:
lemma list_exists_pos_deficit (B : Finset V) :
    ∀ (ps : List (GraphPath G)),
      1 ≤ (ps.map (fun p => p.endpointDeficit B)).sum →
        ∃ p ∈ ps, 0 < p.endpointDeficit B
proof:
| [], h => by simp at h
  | p :: ps, h => by
    simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at h
    by_cases hp : 0 < p.endpointDeficit B
    · exact ⟨p, List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl), hp⟩
    · have hps : 1 ≤ (ps.map (fun q => q.endpointDeficit B)).sum := by omega
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqpos⟩ := list_exists_pos_deficit B ps hps
      exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hq), hqpos⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_pos_deficit_path
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PathCover.endpointDeficit] using
    list_exists_pos_deficit (G := G) B pc.paths h

name: Nikoghosyan.list_sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open
statement:
lemma list_sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open (B : Finset V) :
    ∀ (ps : List (GraphPath G)),
      ps.Nodup →
      (∀ p ∈ ps, ∀ q ∈ ps,
        0 < p.endpointDeficit B → 0 < q.endpointDeficit B → p = q) →
      (ps.map (fun p => p.endpointDeficit B)).sum ≤ 2
proof:
| [], _, _ => by simp
  | p :: ps, hn, huniq => by
    have hnxs := (List.nodup_cons.1 hn).2
    have hnx := (List.nodup_cons.1 hn).1
    have huniq' : ∀ x ∈ ps, ∀ y ∈ ps,
        0 < x.endpointDeficit B → 0 < y.endpointDeficit B → x = y :=
      fun x hx y hy hxpos hypos =>
        huniq x (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hx)) y (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hy))
          hxpos hypos
    simp [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    by_cases hp : 0 < p.endpointDeficit B
    · have hps0 : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.endpointDeficit B = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        by_contra hqpos
        have hqpos' : 0 < q.endpointDeficit B := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hqpos
        have heq :=
          huniq p (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl)) q (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hq))
            hp hqpos'
        exact hnx (heq ▸ hq)
      have hsum0 : (ps.map (fun q => q.endpointDeficit B)).sum = 0 :=
        List.sum_eq_zero fun n hn' => by
          obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hn'
          exact hps0 q hq
      have hple : p.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 := GraphPath.endpointDeficit_le_two B p
      omega
    · have := list_sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open B ps hnxs huniq'
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open
statement:
lemma PathCover.sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open {K B : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G K)
    (huniq : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, ∀ q ∈ pc.paths,
      0 < p.endpointDeficit B → 0 < q.endpointDeficit B → p = q) :
    pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PathCover.endpointDeficit] using
    list_sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open (G := G) B pc.paths pc.nodup_paths huniq

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_two_open_paths
statement:
lemma PathCover.exists_two_open_paths {K B : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G K) (hdef : 3 ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B) :
    ∃ p q, p ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ∈ pc.paths ∧ p ≠ q ∧
      (p.start ∉ B ∨ p.finish ∉ B) ∧
      (q.start ∉ B ∨ q.finish ∉ B)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 1 ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B := by omega
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hppos⟩ := pc.exists_pos_deficit_path hpos
  by_contra h
  have huniq : ∀ x ∈ pc.paths, ∀ y ∈ pc.paths,
      0 < x.endpointDeficit B → 0 < y.endpointDeficit B → x = y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxpos hypos
    by_contra hne
    have hxopen : x.start ∉ B ∨ x.finish ∉ B :=
      (GraphPath.endpointDeficit_pos_iff (G := G) B x).1 hxpos
    have hyopen : y.start ∉ B ∨ y.finish ∉ B :=
      (GraphPath.endpointDeficit_pos_iff (G := G) B y).1 hypos
    exact h ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hne, hxopen, hyopen⟩
  have hle := pc.sum_deficit_le_two_of_unique_open huniq
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_insert_connector_reduce2
statement:
lemma exists_insert_connector_reduce2 {U A Q B : Finset V}
    (hAQ : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (Q : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
    (hdef : 3 ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B)
    {b : V} (hb : b ∈ Q) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (insert b U),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) ∧
          pc'.endpointDeficit B + 2 ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hne, hpopen, hqopen⟩ := pc.exists_two_open_paths hdef
  let p' := p.orientFinishOpen B
  let q' := q.orientStartOpen B
  have hpA : p'.start ∈ A ∧ p'.finish ∈ A :=
    GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_mem_X (X := A) (B := B) p (hend p hp).1 (hend p hp).2
  have hqA : q'.start ∈ A ∧ q'.finish ∈ A :=
    GraphPath.orientStartOpen_mem_X (X := A) (B := B) q (hend q hq).1 (hend q hq).2
  have hp'supp : p'.support = p.support := GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_support B p
  have hq'supp : q'.support = q.support := GraphPath.orientStartOpen_support B q
  have hpb : b ∉ p'.support := by
    rw [hp'supp]
    exact fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hqb : b ∉ q'.support := by
    rw [hq'supp]
    exact fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hq h)
  have hd : Disjoint p'.support q'.support := by
    rw [hp'supp, hq'supp]
    exact PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAQ p' b q' hpA.2 hb hqA.1 hpb hqb hd
  have hr' : r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support := by
    simpa [hp'supp, hq'supp] using hr
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne b hbU r hr',
    pc.spliceTwoInsert_card hp hq hne b hbU r hr', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hsmem
    rcases pc.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths hp hq hne b hbU r hr' hsmem with
      hseq | ⟨hspc, _, _⟩
    · subst hseq
      rw [hs, hf]
      exact ⟨hpA.1, hqA.2⟩
    · exact hend s hspc
  · have hsum :=
      PathCover.endpointDeficit_spliceTwoInsert (B := B) pc hp hq hne b hbU r hr'
    have hpfin : p'.finish ∉ B :=
      GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_finish_open B p hpopen
    have hqst : q'.start ∉ B :=
      GraphPath.orientStartOpen_start_open B q hqopen
    have hrdef :
        r.endpointDeficit B + 2 =
          p.endpointDeficit B + q.endpointDeficit B := by
      rw [← GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_deficit B p,
        ← GraphPath.orientStartOpen_deficit B q]
      unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
      rw [hs, hf]
      have hfin1 : (if p'.finish ∈ B then 0 else 1) = 1 := by simp [hpfin]
      have hst1 : (if q'.start ∈ B then 0 else 1) = 1 := by simp [hqst]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_insert_connector_reduce1
statement:
lemma exists_insert_connector_reduce1 {U A Q B : Finset V}
    (hAQ : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (Q : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
    (hdef : 1 ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B)
    {b : V} (hb : b ∈ Q) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (insert b U),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) ∧
          pc'.endpointDeficit B + 1 ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hppos⟩ := pc.exists_pos_deficit_path hdef
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hne⟩ : ∃ q, q ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ≠ p := by
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy⟩ := pc.exists_two_distinct h2
    by_cases hxp : x = p
    · exact ⟨y, hy, fun h => hxy (hxp.trans h.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩
  have hne' : p ≠ q := hne.symm
  have hpopen : p.start ∉ B ∨ p.finish ∉ B :=
    (GraphPath.endpointDeficit_pos_iff (G := G) B p).1 hppos
  let p' := p.orientFinishOpen B
  have hpA : p'.start ∈ A ∧ p'.finish ∈ A :=
    GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_mem_X (X := A) (B := B) p (hend p hp).1 (hend p hp).2
  have hqA := hend q hq
  have hp'supp : p'.support = p.support := GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_support B p
  have hpb : b ∉ p'.support := by
    rw [hp'supp]
    exact fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hqb : b ∉ q.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hq h)
  have hd : Disjoint p'.support q.support := by
    rw [hp'supp]
    exact PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne'
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAQ p' b q hpA.2 hb hqA.1 hpb hqb hd
  have hr' : r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support := by
    simpa [hp'supp] using hr
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne' b hbU r hr',
    pc.spliceTwoInsert_card hp hq hne' b hbU r hr', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hsmem
    rcases pc.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths hp hq hne' b hbU r hr' hsmem with
      hseq | ⟨hspc, _, _⟩
    · subst hseq
      rw [hs, hf]
      exact ⟨hpA.1, hqA.2⟩
    · exact hend s hspc
  · have hsum :=
      PathCover.endpointDeficit_spliceTwoInsert (B := B) pc hp hq hne' b hbU r hr'
    have hpfin : p'.finish ∉ B :=
      GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_finish_open B p hpopen
    have hred : r.endpointDeficit B + 1 ≤ p.endpointDeficit B + q.endpointDeficit B := by
      rw [← GraphPath.orientFinishOpen_deficit B p]
      unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
      rw [hs, hf]
      have hfin1 : (if p'.finish ∈ B then 0 else 1) = 1 := by simp [hpfin]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_insert_connector_mono
statement:
lemma exists_insert_connector_mono {U A Q B : Finset V}
    (hAQ : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (Q : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
    {b : V} (hb : b ∈ Q) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (insert b U),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) ∧
          pc'.endpointDeficit B ≤ pc.endpointDeficit B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hne⟩ := pc.exists_two_distinct h2
  have hpA := hend p hp
  have hqA := hend q hq
  have hpb : b ∉ p.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hqb : b ∉ q.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hq h)
  have hd := PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAQ p b q hpA.2 hb hqA.1 hpb hqb hd
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne b hbU r hr,
    pc.spliceTwoInsert_card hp hq hne b hbU r hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hsmem
    rcases pc.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths hp hq hne b hbU r hr hsmem with
      hseq | ⟨hspc, _, _⟩
    · subst hseq
      rw [hs, hf]
      exact ⟨hpA.1, hqA.2⟩
    · exact hend s hspc
  · have hsum :=
      PathCover.endpointDeficit_spliceTwoInsert (B := B) pc hp hq hne b hbU r hr
    have hred : r.endpointDeficit B ≤ p.endpointDeficit B + q.endpointDeficit B := by
      unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
      rw [hs, hf]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_merge_all_connectors
statement:
lemma exists_merge_all_connectors {A Q B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hAQ : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (Q : Set V))
    (hdom : Q.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (pc : PathCover G A)
    (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
    (hdef : pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * (t + Q.card) - 1) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (A ∪ Q),
      pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - Q.card ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) ∧
          pc'.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * t - 1
proof:
:= by
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (pcS : PathCover G (A ∪ S)),
        S ⊆ Q → (Q \ S).card = k →
          pcS.card = pathCoverNumber G A - S.card →
            (∀ p ∈ pcS.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) →
              pcS.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * (t + k) - 1 →
                ∃ pc' : PathCover G (A ∪ Q),
                  pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - Q.card ∧
                    (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) ∧
                      pc'.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * t - 1 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro S pcS hS hk hcard hendS hdefS
      have hQS : Q \ S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hk
      have hBeq : S = Q := subset_antisymm hS (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mp hQS)
      subst hBeq
      exact ⟨pcS, hcard, hendS, by simpa using hdefS⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro S pcS hS hk hcard hendS hdefS
      have hne : (Q \ S).Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (Q \ S).card)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hne
      have hbQ : b ∈ Q := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
      have hbS : b ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      have hdisjAQ := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAQ
      have hbU : b ∉ A ∪ S := by
        intro h
        rcases mem_union.1 h with hA | hS'
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAQ hA hbQ
        · exact hbS hS'
      have h2 : 2 ≤ pcS.card := by
        have hsum : S.card + (Q \ S).card = Q.card := by
          rw [← card_union_of_disjoint, union_sdiff_of_subset hS]
          exact disjoint_sdiff
        omega
      have hnew :
          ∃ pc1 : PathCover G (insert b (A ∪ S)),
            pc1.card = pcS.card - 1 ∧
              (∀ p ∈ pc1.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) ∧
                pc1.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * (t + k) - 1 := by
        by_cases h3 : 3 ≤ pcS.endpointDeficit B
        · obtain ⟨pc1, hc1, he1, hr⟩ :=
            exists_insert_connector_reduce2 (B := B) hAQ pcS h2 hendS h3 hbQ hbU
          refine ⟨pc1, hc1, he1, ?_⟩
          omega
        · by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ pcS.endpointDeficit B
          · obtain ⟨pc1, hc1, he1, hr⟩ :=
