              exists_insert_connector_reduce1 (B := B) hAQ pcS h2 hendS h1 hbQ hbU
            refine ⟨pc1, hc1, he1, ?_⟩
            have : pcS.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 := by omega
            omega
          · obtain ⟨pc1, hc1, he1, hr⟩ :=
              exists_insert_connector_mono (B := B) hAQ pcS h2 hendS hbQ hbU
            refine ⟨pc1, hc1, he1, ?_⟩
            omega
      obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hend1, hred⟩ := hnew
      have hU : insert b (A ∪ S) = A ∪ insert b S := by
        ext x
        simp [mem_insert, mem_union]
      let pc1' : PathCover G (A ∪ insert b S) := pc1.cast hU
      have hS' : insert b S ⊆ Q := insert_subset hbQ hS
      have hrem : Q \ insert b S = (Q \ S).erase b := sdiff_insert Q S b
      have hk' : (Q \ insert b S).card = k := by
        rw [hrem, card_erase_of_mem hb, hk]
        omega
      have hcard' : pc1'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (insert b S).card := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard1, hcard, card_insert_of_notMem hbS]
        omega
      have hend1' : ∀ p ∈ pc1'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A := by
        intro p hp
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU] at hp
        exact hend1 p hp
      have hdef' : pc1'.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * (t + k) - 1 := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack]
        exact hred
      exact ih (insert b S) pc1' hS' hk' hcard' hend1' hdef'
  have hA : A ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = A := union_empty A
  let pc0 : PathCover G (A ∪ ∅) := pc.cast hA.symm
  have hcard0 : pc0.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (∅ : Finset V).card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hpc, card_empty, Nat.sub_zero]
  have hend0 : ∀ p ∈ pc0.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A := by
    intro p hp
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc hA.symm] at hp
    exact hend p hp
  have hdef0 : pc0.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * (t + Q.card) - 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack]
    exact hdef
  exact aux Q.card ∅ pc0 (empty_subset Q) (by simp) hcard0 hend0 hdef0

name: Nikoghosyan.not_B_subset_ineligible_of_slack_t_one
statement:
lemma not_B_subset_ineligible_of_slack_t_one {K B : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G K) (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G K = 1)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B 1) :
    ¬ B ⊆ ineligibleSet G K
proof:
:= by
  intro hBF
  have hFsub : ineligibleSet G K ⊆ K := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K
  by_cases hFne : (ineligibleSet G K).Nonempty
  · have hz := hTH.2 (ineligibleSet G K) hFsub hFne
    have hz' :
        terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B (ineligibleSet G K) =
          componentCount G (K \ ineligibleSet G K) :=
      terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) (K := K) hBF
    have hcut :=
      Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) hcog
    omega
  · have hF0 : ineligibleSet G K = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hFne
    have hB0 : B = ∅ := subset_empty.mp (hF0 ▸ hBF)
    exact hBne.ne_empty hB0

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_p_eq_one
statement:
lemma exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_p_eq_one {K B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hcog : IsCograph G K) (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G K = 1) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B t) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧
        pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * t - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc0, hpc0⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) K
  have hcard1 : pc0.card = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨p, hpths⟩ := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pc0 hcard1
  have hpdef : p.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 := GraphPath.endpointDeficit_le_two B p
  have hpc0def : pc0.endpointDeficit B = p.endpointDeficit B := by
    simp [PathCover.endpointDeficit, hpths]
  by_cases ht1 : t = 1
  · subst ht1
    have hnot : ¬ B ⊆ ineligibleSet G K :=
      not_B_subset_ineligible_of_slack_t_one hcog hBK hBne hp hTH
    obtain ⟨b, hbB, hbE⟩ : ∃ b ∈ B, Eligible G K b := by
      by_contra h
      apply hnot
      intro x hx
      have hxK : x ∈ K := hBK hx
      have hnotE : ¬ Eligible G K x := fun hE => h ⟨x, hx, hE⟩
      exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hxK, hnotE⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqU, hqend⟩ :=
      Cograph.exists_spanning_path_of_eligible_eq_one (G := G) hp hbE
    let q' : GraphPath G :=
      if q.start = b then q else q.reverse
    have hq'supp : q'.support = K := by
      unfold q'
      split_ifs <;> simp [hqU]
    have hq'end : q'.start = b ∨ q'.finish = b := by
      unfold q'
      split_ifs with hs
      · exact Or.inl hs
      · rcases hqend with hst | hfin
        · exact (hs hst).elim
        · simp [GraphPath.reverse, hfin]
    have hbdef : q'.endpointDeficit B ≤ 1 := by
      unfold GraphPath.endpointDeficit
      rcases hq'end with hs | hf
      · simp [hs, hbB]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      · simp [hf, hbB]
        split_ifs <;> simp
    refine ⟨PathCover.ofSupport q' hq'supp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [PathCover.ofSupport_card q' hq'supp] using hp.symm
    · have : (PathCover.ofSupport q' hq'supp).endpointDeficit B =
          q'.endpointDeficit B := by
        simp [PathCover.ofSupport, PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack,
          PathCover.endpointDeficit_ofPath]
      omega
  · have : 2 ≤ t := by omega
    refine ⟨pc0, hpc0, ?_⟩
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_empty_eq_zero_of_BV
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_empty_eq_zero_of_BV {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    {b v : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hvK : v ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hb
  let Cmix := (G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvK⟩
  have hno : ∀ C : (G.induce (K : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
      componentFinset G K C ∩ B ≠ ∅ := by
    intro C he
    obtain ⟨x, hxC⟩ := componentFinset_nonempty (G := G) C
    have hxK : x ∈ K := (mem_filter.1 hxC).1
    have hxB : x ∉ B := fun hxB =>
      (notMem_empty x (he ▸ mem_inter.2 ⟨hxC, hxB⟩))
    have hxmix : x ∈ componentFinset G K Cmix :=
      sdiff_subset_mixed_component hN hBK hb hv hadj (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxK, hxB⟩)
    have hCeq : C = Cmix :=
      (connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hxC).symm.trans
        (connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hxmix)
    have hbC : b ∈ componentFinset G K C := by
      simpa [hCeq] using mem_componentFinset_of_adj_B (G := G) hbK hvK hadj
    exact (notMem_empty b (he ▸ mem_inter.2 ⟨hbC, hb⟩))
  have hz :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ =
        Nat.card { C : (G.induce (K : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
          componentFinset G K C ∩ B = ∅ } := by
    unfold terminalComponentCount IsFreeComponent
    rw [sdiff_empty, sdiff_empty]
  rw [hz]
  haveI : IsEmpty { C : (G.induce (K : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
      componentFinset G K C ∩ B = ∅ } :=
    ⟨fun C => hno C.1 C.2⟩
  simpa [Nat.card_eq_zero] using Or.inl this

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_mixedSplit_of_BV
statement:
lemma exists_mixedSplit_of_BV {K B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {b v : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    Nonempty (MixedSplit (G := G) K B)
proof:
:=
  exists_mixedSplit (G := G) hBK hN
    (terminalComponentCount_empty_eq_zero_of_BV hN hBK hb hv hadj)
    ⟨v, hv⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.restrict_mixed
statement:
lemma TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.restrict_mixed {K D B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hD : D ⊆ K) (hI : K \ D ⊆ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ K \ D, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B t) :
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) D (B ∩ D) t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hz := hTH.1
    simpa [terminalComponentCount_mixed (S := (∅ : Finset V)) hBK hD
      (empty_subset D) hI hnocross] using hz
  · intro S hS hSne
    have hz := hTH.2 S (hS.trans hD) hSne
    simpa [terminalComponentCount_mixed hBK hD hS hI hnocross] using hz

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_union_eq_union_sdiff_right
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx.1 with hB | hW
    · exact Or.inl hB
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hW, hx.2⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with hB | hW
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hB, fun hF' => Finset.disjoint_left.1
        (disjoint_of_subset_right hF hdisj) hB hF'⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr hW.1, hW.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.B_sdiff_eq_of_disjoint_right
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · exact And.left
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨hx, fun hF' => Finset.disjoint_left.1
      (disjoint_of_subset_right hF hdisj) hx hF'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_noBV
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_noBV {K B W F : Finset V}
    (hKW : K = B ∪ W) (hdisj : Disjoint B W)
    (hanti : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj b w) (hF : F ⊆ W) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B F = componentCount G (W \ F)
proof:
:= by
  have hrem : K \ F = (W \ F) ∪ B := by
    rw [hKW, sdiff_union_eq_union_sdiff_right hdisj hF, union_comm]
  have hBeq : B \ F = B := B_sdiff_eq_of_disjoint_right hdisj hF
  have hnc : ∀ a ∈ W \ F, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
    fun a ha b hb hab => hanti b hb a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 hab.symm
  have h1 :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B F =
        Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce (((W \ F) ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G ((W \ F) ∪ B) C ∩ B = ∅ } := by
    unfold terminalComponentCount IsFreeComponent
    rw [hrem, hBeq]
  have h2 :=
    ncard_free_union_isolates (G := G) (A := W \ F) (J := B) (T := B)
      hnc (subset_refl B)
  have h3 :
      Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce ((W \ F : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G (W \ F) C ∩ B = ∅ } =
        componentCount G (W \ F) := by
    unfold componentCount
    refine Nat.card_congr ?_
    refine Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv ?_
    intro C
    apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2
    intro x hx
    have hsub : componentFinset G (W \ F) C ⊆ W \ F :=
      componentFinset_subset (G := G) C
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
      (disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset hdisj.symm)
      (hsub (mem_inter.1 hx).1) (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_W_le_of_noBV
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_W_le_of_noBV {K B W : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hKW : K = B ∪ W) (hdisj : Disjoint B W)
    (hanti : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj b w)
    (hcog : IsCograph G K) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B t) :
    pathCoverNumber G W ≤ t - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hWsub : W ⊆ K := by
    intro w hw
    simpa [hKW] using mem_union.2 (Or.inr hw)
  have hWcog : IsCograph G W := isCograph_subset hcog hWsub
  set FW := ineligibleSet G W
  have hFsub : FW ⊆ W := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) W
  have hFsubK : FW ⊆ K := hFsub.trans hWsub
  have hcut :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) hWcog
  have hident :=
    terminalComponentCount_noBV (G := G) hKW hdisj hanti hFsub
  have hcanon : componentCount G (W \ FW) = FW.card + pathCoverNumber G W := by
    simpa [FW] using hcut
  by_cases hFne : FW.Nonempty
  · have hz := hTH.2 FW hFsubK hFne
    have hle : FW.card + pathCoverNumber G W ≤ FW.card + t - 1 := by
      rw [← hcanon, ← hident]
      exact hz
    omega
  · have hF0 : FW = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hFne
    have hz := hTH.1
    have hz' : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ = componentCount G W := by
      simpa [hF0] using hident
    have hcW : componentCount G W = pathCoverNumber G W := by
      simpa [hF0] using hcanon
    have hpred : Nat.pred t = t - 1 := rfl
    calc pathCoverNumber G W
        = componentCount G W := hcW.symm
      _ = terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ := hz'.symm
      _ ≤ Nat.pred t := hz
      _ = t - 1 := hpred

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cover_of_noBV
statement:
lemma exists_min_cover_of_noBV {K B W : Finset V}
    (hKW : K = B ∪ W) (hdisj : Disjoint B W)
    (hanti : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj b w)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧
        pc.endpointDeficit B = 2 * pathCoverNumber G W
proof:
:= by
  have hnc : ∀ a ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj a w := hanti
  have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B = B.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_card_of_independent (G := G) hInd
  have hpU := Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnc
  obtain ⟨pcW, hWcard⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) W
  let pcB := PathCover.singletons (G := G) B
  have hBcard : pcB.card = B.card := PathCover.singletons_card (G := G) B
  have hBterm : pcB.endpointDeficit B = 0 :=
    PathCover.deficit_eq_zero_of_terminal pcB
      (PathCover.singletons_terminal (U := B) (subset_refl B))
  have hWout : ∀ p ∈ pcW.paths, p.start ∉ B ∧ p.finish ∉ B := by
    intro p hp
    have hs : p.start ∈ W := pcW.support_subset hp p.start_mem_support
    have hf : p.finish ∈ W := pcW.support_subset hp p.finish_mem_support
    exact ⟨fun hB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hB hs,
      fun hB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hB hf⟩
  have hWdef : pcW.endpointDeficit B = 2 * pcW.card :=
    PathCover.endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul_of_ends_outside pcW hWout
  let pc := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcB pcW
  refine ⟨pc.cast (hKW.symm), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsum := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisj pcB pcW
    have hpK : pathCoverNumber G K = B.card + pathCoverNumber G W := by
      rw [hKW, hpU, hpB]
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hsum, hBcard, hWcard, hpK]
  · have hdef := PathCover.endpointDeficit_unionDisjoint (B := B) hdisj pcB pcW
    rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack, hdef, hBterm, hWdef, hWcard, Nat.zero_add]

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cover_Q_dominant
statement:
lemma exists_min_cover_Q_dominant {P Q B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hPne : P.Nonempty) (hQne : Q.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (P : Set V) (Q : Set V))
    (hB : B ⊆ P)
    (hdom : P.card < pathCoverNumber G Q)
    (hpQle : pathCoverNumber G Q ≤ P.card + t - 1) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (P ∪ Q),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P ∪ Q) ∧
        pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * t - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (Q : Set V) (P : Set V) :=
    fun {q} hq {p} hp => (hAB hp hq).symm
  have hdom' : P.card < pathCoverNumber G Q := hdom
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hend⟩ :=
    exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant (A := Q) (B := P) hBA hdom'
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hout : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∉ B ∧ p.finish ∉ B := by
    intro p hp
    have hsQ : p.start ∈ Q := (hend p hp).1
    have hfQ : p.finish ∈ Q := (hend p hp).2
    exact ⟨fun hsB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hB hsB) hsQ,
      fun hfB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hB hfB) hfQ⟩
  have hdef : pc.endpointDeficit B = 2 * pc.card :=
    PathCover.endpointDeficit_eq_two_mul_of_ends_outside pc hout
  have hpjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hPne hQne hAB
  have hPnot : pathCoverNumber G P ≤ Q.card := by
    by_contra h
    exact not_both_dominant (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h) hdom
  have hunion : Q ∪ P = P ∪ Q := union_comm _ _
  have hpcard : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P ∪ Q) := by
    have hpQsub : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G Q - P.card :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hdom)
    have : pathCoverNumber G (P ∪ Q) = pathCoverNumber G Q - P.card := by
      have hpjoin' := hpjoin
      rw [hpjoin', Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hPnot]
      simp [Nat.max_eq_right hpQsub]
    have hcard' : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G Q - P.card := hcard
    omega
  refine ⟨pc.cast hunion, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [PathCover.cast_card] using hpcard
  · rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack]
    have : pc.card ≤ t - 1 := by omega
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.ends_subset_of_support
statement:
lemma PathCover.ends_subset_of_support {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) :
    p.start ∈ K ∧ p.finish ∈ K
proof:
:=
  ⟨pc.support_subset hp p.start_mem_support,
    pc.support_subset hp p.finish_mem_support⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong_card
statement:
lemma exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong_card :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K B : Finset V) (t : ℕ),
      K.card = n →
      IsCograph G K →
      (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected →
      B ⊆ K → B.Nonempty → Independent (G := G) B →
      NeighborCondition (G := G) K B →
      1 ≤ t →
      TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B t →
      ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧
          pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * t - 1
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    intro K B t hKn hcog hconn hBK hBne hInd hN ht hTH
    by_cases hp1 : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ 1
    · have hpos := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) (hBne.mono hBK)
      have hp : pathCoverNumber G K = 1 := by omega
      exact exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_p_eq_one hcog hBK hBne hp ht hTH
    · have hp2 : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K := by omega
      have h2card : 2 ≤ K.card :=
        hp2.trans (pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) K)
      obtain ⟨Praw, Qraw, hPrawsub, hQrawsub, hPrawne, hQrawne, hdisjraw, hcoverraw,
          hABraw, hPrawcard, hQrawcard⟩ :=
        Cograph.exists_complete_join_on (G := G) (Cograph.isCograph_iff.2 hcog)
          hconn h2card
      have hBside : B ⊆ Praw ∨ B ⊆ Qraw :=
        Independent.subset_join_side hABraw hInd (by simpa [hcoverraw] using hBK)
      obtain ⟨P0, Q0, hPsub, hQsub, hPne, hQne, hdisj, hcover, hAB, hPcard, hQcard, hBP⟩ :
          ∃ P Q : Finset V, P ⊆ K ∧ Q ⊆ K ∧ P.Nonempty ∧ Q.Nonempty ∧
            Disjoint P Q ∧ P ∪ Q = K ∧
              G.IsCompleteBetween (P : Set V) (Q : Set V) ∧
                P.card < K.card ∧ Q.card < K.card ∧ B ⊆ P := by
        rcases hBside with hP | hQ
        · exact ⟨Praw, Qraw, hPrawsub, hQrawsub, hPrawne, hQrawne, hdisjraw, hcoverraw,
            hABraw, hPrawcard, hQrawcard, hP⟩
        · exact ⟨Qraw, Praw, hQrawsub, hPrawsub, hQrawne, hPrawne, hdisjraw.symm,
            by rw [union_comm, hcoverraw],
            fun {q} hq {p} hp => (hABraw hp hq).symm,
            hQrawcard, hPrawcard, hQ⟩
      have hjoin : P0 ∪ Q0 = K := hcover
      have hPcog : IsCograph G P0 := isCograph_subset hcog hPsub
      have hQcog : IsCograph G Q0 := isCograph_subset hcog hQsub
      have hN_P : NeighborCondition (G := G) P0 B := NeighborCondition.mono hN hPsub
      have hTH_P : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) P0 B (t + Q0.card) :=
        terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child hQne hdisj hBP
          (by simpa [hjoin] using hTH)
      have htP : 1 ≤ t + Q0.card := by omega
      have hpQle : pathCoverNumber G Q0 ≤ P0.card + t - 1 :=
        pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_le_slack hPne hQne hAB
          (by simpa [hjoin] using hcog) hBP
          (by simpa [hjoin] using hTH)
      by_cases hQdom : P0.card < pathCoverNumber G Q0
      · obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hdef⟩ :=
          exists_min_cover_Q_dominant (B := B) (t := t) hPne hQne hAB hBP hQdom hpQle
        refine ⟨pc.cast hjoin, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [PathCover.cast_card, hjoin] using hcard
        · have : (pc.cast hjoin).endpointDeficit B = pc.endpointDeficit B := by
            subst hjoin
            rfl
          omega
      · have hPdom : Q0.card < pathCoverNumber G P0 := by
          have hpjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hPne hQne hAB
          have hnot1 : pathCoverNumber G (P0 ∪ Q0) ≠ 1 := by
            simpa [hjoin] using (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hp2))
          have hQle : pathCoverNumber G Q0 ≤ P0.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hQdom
          have hQ0sub : pathCoverNumber G Q0 - P0.card = 0 :=
            Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hQle
          by_contra hPle
          have hP0sub : pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card = 0 :=
            Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_gt hPle)
          have : pathCoverNumber G (P0 ∪ Q0) = 1 := by
            rw [hpjoin, hP0sub, hQ0sub]
            simp
          exact hnot1 this
        
        have hPcover :
            ∃ pc : PathCover G P0,
              pc.card = pathCoverNumber G P0 ∧
                pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * (t + Q0.card) - 1 := by
          by_cases hBV : ∃ b v, b ∈ B ∧ v ∈ P0 \ B ∧ G.Adj b v
          · obtain ⟨b, v, hb, hv, hadj⟩ := hBV
            obtain ⟨s⟩ :=
              exists_mixedSplit_of_BV (K := P0) (B := B) hBP hN_P hb hv hadj
            have hIeq : s.I = P0 \ s.D := s.I_eq
            have hI : P0 \ s.D ⊆ B := by simpa [hIeq] using s.hI
            have hDsubK : s.D ⊆ K := s.hDsub.trans hPsub
            have hDlt : s.D.card < n := by
              have : s.D.card ≤ P0.card := card_le_card s.hDsub
              omega
            have hDcog : IsCograph G s.D := isCograph_subset hPcog s.hDsub
            have hBd : B ∩ s.D ⊆ s.D := inter_subset_right
            have hBdne : (B ∩ s.D).Nonempty := s.hBd
            have hN_D : NeighborCondition (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D) :=
              NeighborCondition.restrict_inter hN_P s.hDsub
            have hTH_D : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D)
                (t + Q0.card) :=
              TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.restrict_mixed hBP s.hDsub hI
                (by simpa [hIeq] using s.hnocross) hTH_P
            have hIndD : Independent (G := G) (B ∩ s.D) :=
              hInd.mono inter_subset_left
            obtain ⟨pcD, hDcard', hDdef⟩ :=
              ih s.D.card hDlt s.D (B ∩ s.D) (t + Q0.card) rfl hDcog s.hconn
                hBd hBdne hIndD hN_D htP hTH_D
            have hDdefB : pcD.endpointDeficit B ≤ pcD.endpointDeficit (B ∩ s.D) :=
              PathCover.endpointDeficit_anti inter_subset_left pcD
            have hdisjDI : Disjoint s.D s.I := s.hdisj
            obtain ⟨pcI, hIcard, hIterm⟩ :=
              exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B (K := s.I) (B := B)
                s.hI hInd
            have hIdef : pcI.endpointDeficit B = 0 :=
              PathCover.deficit_eq_zero_of_terminal pcI hIterm
            let pcP := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisjDI pcD pcI
            have hunionDI : s.D ∪ s.I = P0 := s.hDU
            refine ⟨pcP.cast hunionDI, ?_, ?_⟩
            · have hsum := Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisjDI pcD pcI
              have hpU :=
                Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisjDI s.hnocross
              have hpP : pathCoverNumber G P0 = pathCoverNumber G s.D + pathCoverNumber G s.I := by
                convert hpU
                exact s.hDU.symm
              rw [PathCover.cast_card, hsum, hDcard', hIcard, hpP]
            · have hdefU :=
                PathCover.endpointDeficit_unionDisjoint (B := B) hdisjDI pcD pcI
              rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack, hdefU, hIdef]
              exact hDdefB.trans hDdef
          · 
            let W := P0 \ B
            have hPW : P0 = B ∪ W := (union_sdiff_of_subset hBP).symm
            have hdisjBW : Disjoint B W := disjoint_sdiff
            have hanti : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ W, ¬ G.Adj b w := by
              intro b hb w hw hadj
              exact hBV ⟨b, w, hb, hw, hadj⟩
            obtain ⟨pcP, hPcard', hPdef⟩ :=
              exists_min_cover_of_noBV (K := P0) (B := B) (W := W)
                hPW hdisjBW hanti hInd
            have hpW : pathCoverNumber G W ≤ t + Q0.card - 1 :=
              pathCoverNumber_W_le_of_noBV hPW hdisjBW hanti hPcog htP hTH_P
            refine ⟨pcP, hPcard', ?_⟩
            have : 2 * pathCoverNumber G W ≤ 2 * (t + Q0.card) - 2 := by
              have : pathCoverNumber G W ≤ t + Q0.card - 1 := by
                simpa [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one] using hpW
              omega
            omega
        obtain ⟨pcP, hPmin, hPdef⟩ := hPcover
        have hendP : ∀ p ∈ pcP.paths, p.start ∈ P0 ∧ p.finish ∈ P0 :=
          fun p hp => pcP.ends_subset_of_support hp
        obtain ⟨pcK, hKcard, _, hKdef⟩ :=
          exists_merge_all_connectors (A := P0) (Q := Q0) (B := B) (t := t)
            hAB hPdom pcP hPmin hendP hPdef
        refine ⟨pcK.cast hjoin, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hpjoin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hPne hQne hAB
          have hQle : pathCoverNumber G Q0 ≤ P0.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hQdom
          have hpKeq : pathCoverNumber G K = pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card := by
            have hpPsub : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card :=
              Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hPdom)
            have hpjoin' : pathCoverNumber G (P0 ∪ Q0) =
                max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G P0 - Q0.card)
                  (pathCoverNumber G Q0 - P0.card)) := hpjoin
            rw [← hjoin, hpjoin', Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hQle,
              Nat.max_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _), Nat.max_eq_right hpPsub]
          rw [PathCover.cast_card, hKcard, hpKeq]
        · rw [PathCover.cast_endpointDeficit_slack]
          exact hKdef

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong
statement:
theorem exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong {K B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hcog : IsCograph G K)
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B t) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧
        pc.endpointDeficit B ≤ 2 * t - 1
proof:
:=
  exists_min_cover_deficit_le_of_slackStrong_card K.card K B t rfl
    hcog hconn hBK hBne hInd hN ht hTH

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cap_one_end
statement:
lemma exists_cap_one_end {A B : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (p : GraphPath G) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    {b : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (h1 : b ∉ p.support) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = b ∧ r.finish = p.finish ∧
        r.support = insert b p.support
proof:
:= by
  have hadj : G.Adj b p.start := (hAB hs hb).symm
  refine ⟨p.consAdj hadj h1, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  simp [GraphPath.support_consAdj]

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_one_cap_path_of_W_ended_cover
statement:
lemma exists_one_cap_path_of_W_ended_cover {W T U : Finset V}
    (hWT : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (T : Set V))
    (hdisj : Disjoint T U)
    (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ W ∧ p.finish ∈ W)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ pc.card)
    (hT : T.card = pc.card) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start ∈ T ∧ r.finish ∈ W ∧ r.support = U ∪ T
proof:
:= by
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (U T : Finset V) (pc : PathCover G U),
        pc.card = k →
        1 ≤ k →
        Disjoint T U →
        (∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ W ∧ p.finish ∈ W) →
        T.card = k →
        G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (T : Set V) →
        ∃ r : GraphPath G,
          r.start ∈ T ∧ r.finish ∈ W ∧ r.support = U ∪ T := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro U T pc hcard hpos hdisj hend hT hWT
      omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro U T pc hcard hpos hdisj hend hT hWT
      by_cases hk1 : k = 0
      · have hcard1 : pc.card = 1 := by omega
        obtain ⟨p, hpseq⟩ := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pc hcard1
        have hp : p ∈ pc.paths := by simp [hpseq]
        have hs : p.start ∈ W := (hend p hp).1
        have hf : p.finish ∈ W := (hend p hp).2
        have hTpos : T.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by omega)
        obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hTpos
        have hbU : b ∉ p.support := fun h =>
          (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hb) ((pc.mem_iff b).2 ⟨p, hp, h⟩)
        obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hrsup⟩ :=
          exists_cap_one_end hWT p hs hb hbU
        have hU : p.support = U := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            exact (pc.mem_iff x).2 ⟨p, hp, hx⟩
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
            have : q = p := by simpa [hpseq] using hq
            subst this
            exact hxq
        have hTeq : T = ({b} : Finset V) := by
          have hsub : ({b} : Finset V) ⊆ T := singleton_subset_iff.2 hb
          have : T.card = 1 := by omega
          exact (eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by simp [this])).symm
        refine ⟨r, by simpa [hrs] using hb, by simpa [hrf] using hf, ?_⟩
        rw [hrsup, hU, hTeq]
        ext x
        simp [mem_union, mem_insert, mem_singleton, or_comm]
      · have h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card := by omega
        have hTne : T.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by omega)
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hTne
        have htU : t ∉ U := Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj ht
        obtain ⟨pc', hcard', hend'⟩ :=
          exists_splice_two_through hWT pc h2 hend ht htU
        let T' := T.erase t
        have hdisj' : Disjoint T' (insert t U) := by
          refine disjoint_insert_right.2 ⟨notMem_erase t T, ?_⟩
          exact disjoint_of_subset_left (erase_subset t T) hdisj
        have hWT' : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (T' : Set V) :=
          IsCompleteBetween.mono hWT subset_rfl (erase_subset t T)
        have hck : pc'.card = k := by omega
        have hposk : 1 ≤ k := by omega
        have hTk : T'.card = k := by
          rw [card_erase_of_mem ht]
          omega
        obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hrsup⟩ :=
          ih (insert t U) T' pc' hck hposk hdisj' hend' hTk hWT'
        refine ⟨r, mem_of_mem_erase hrs, hrf, ?_⟩
        rw [hrsup]
        ext x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          have hx' : x ∈ insert t U ∪ T.erase t := by simpa [T'] using hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx' with hxL | hxR
          · rcases mem_insert.1 hxL with rfl | hxU
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr ht)
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxU)
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_of_mem_erase hxR))
        · intro hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxU | hxT
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_insert.2 (Or.inr hxU)))
          · by_cases hxt : x = t
            · subst hxt
              exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_insert_self _ _))
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_erase.2 ⟨hxt, hxT⟩))
  exact aux pc.card U T pc rfl hpos hdisj hend hT hWT

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_Bd_W_spanning_path_of_balanced
statement:
lemma exists_Bd_W_spanning_path_of_balanced {Bd W : Finset V}
    (hBdne : Bd.Nonempty) (hWne : W.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : Disjoint Bd W)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (Bd : Set V) (W : Set V))
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G W = Bd.card) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start ∈ Bd ∧ r.finish ∈ W ∧ r.support = Bd ∪ W
proof:
:= by
  have hpWpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G W :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hWne
  obtain ⟨pcW, hWcard⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) W
  have hendW : ∀ p ∈ pcW.paths, p.start ∈ W ∧ p.finish ∈ W := by
    intro p hpW
    exact ⟨pcW.support_subset hpW p.start_mem_support,
      pcW.support_subset hpW p.finish_mem_support⟩
  have hT : Bd.card = pcW.card := by omega
  have hpos : 1 ≤ pcW.card := by omega
  have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (Bd : Set V) :=
    IsCompleteBetween.symm hAB
  obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hrsup⟩ :=
    exists_one_cap_path_of_W_ended_cover hBA hdisj pcW hendW hpos hT
  refine ⟨r, hrs, hrf, ?_⟩
  rw [hrsup, union_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.NoConsecutive_of_independent
proof:
:= by
  intro e he hb
  have hedge : e ∈ G.edgeSet := p.edges_subset_edgeSet e he
  revert hb hedge
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e ?_
  intro u v hb hedge
  have hadj : G.Adj u v := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using hedge
  have ⟨hu, hv⟩ := bothEndsIn_iff.1 hb
  exact hInd hu hv hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_ends_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
  | none =>
    have hlist : leftoverPieces B p = [p] :=
      leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hs hfind
    have hemp : p.support ∩ B = ∅ := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hyW : y ∈ p.walk.support :=
          (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 (mem_inter.1 hy).1
        have hnot : ¬ decide (y ∈ B) :=
          (List.find?_eq_none (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 hfind y hyW
        exact (hnot (decide_eq_true (mem_inter.1 hy).2)).elim
      · intro hy
        exact (notMem_empty y hy).elim
    simp [hlist, hemp]
  | some _ =>
    have hnone :
        p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
      simp [hfind]
    rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
    simp only [hs, hnone, dite_false]
    have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
    have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
    have hbB : firstB B p hnone ∈ B := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2
    have hstartD : (p.dropUntil hx).start ∈ B := by
      simpa [dropUntil] using hbB
    have hfinD : (p.dropUntil hx).finish ∉ B := by
      simpa [dropUntil] using hf
    have hnoD : NoConsecutive B (p.dropUntil hx) :=
      NoConsecutive_of_edges_subset (edges_dropUntil_subset p hx) hno
    have hlenD :=
      leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_start_mem_finish_not hstartD hfinD hnoD
    have htakeB :
        (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ B = {firstB B p hnone} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy1 := (mem_inter.1 hy).1
        have hy2 := (mem_inter.1 hy).2
        by_cases hEq : y = firstB B p hnone
        · simp [hEq]
        · exact (takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B hfind' hx hy1 hEq hy2).elim
      · intro hy
        have : y = firstB B p hnone := mem_singleton.1 hy
        subst this
        exact mem_inter.2 ⟨(p.takeUntil hx).finish_mem_support, hbB⟩
    have hunion := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hx
    have hTD : p.support ∩ B = (p.dropUntil hx).support ∩ B := by
      have h1 :
          p.support ∩ B =
            ((p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support) ∩ B := by
        rw [hunion]
      rw [h1, union_inter_distrib_right, htakeB, singleton_union]
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        rcases mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy'
        · exact mem_inter.2 ⟨(p.dropUntil hx).start_mem_support, hbB⟩
        · exact hy'
      · intro hy
        exact mem_insert.2 (Or.inr hy)
    simp [List.length_cons, hlenD, hTD]

name: Nikoghosyan.augCarrier_sdiff_fresh
statement:
lemma augCarrier_sdiff_fresh (K : Finset V) :
    augCarrier (q := q) K \ augFresh (V := V) (q := q) =
      augOldImage (q := q) K
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxU := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxF := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxK | hxFr
    · exact hxK
    · exact (hxF hxFr).elim
  · intro hx
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hx), ?_⟩
    exact disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_augOldImage_fresh (q := q) K) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_augA_not_fresh
proof:
:=
  disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_augOldImage_fresh (q := q) B) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverPieces_ends_mem_augA
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_ends_mem_augA
    {p : GraphPath (augGraph (G := G) B q)}
    (hs : p.start ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q))
    (hf : p.finish ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q))
    {Q : GraphPath (augGraph (G := G) B q)}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces (augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) p) :
    Q.start ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q) ∧
      Q.finish ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, _heq, hruB, hrvB⟩ :=
    leftoverPieces_factor (B := augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) p Q hQ
  constructor
  · by_cases hnil : ru.Nil
    · have hst : Q.start = p.start := (Walk.Nil.eq hnil).symm
      exact hst ▸ hs
    · have hpen : ru.penultimate ∈ augFresh (V := V) (q := q) :=
        hruB.resolve_left hnil
      have hadj :
          (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj ru.penultimate Q.start :=
        ru.adj_penultimate hnil
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hpen
      have hadj' : (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inr i) Q.start := by
        simpa [hi] using hadj
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ :=
        (adj_fresh_iff (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) (i := i) (x := Q.start)).1
          hadj'
      exact (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).2 ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩
  · by_cases hnil : rv.Nil
    · have hfin : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hnil
      exact hfin ▸ hf
    · have hsnd : rv.snd ∈ augFresh (V := V) (q := q) :=
        hrvB.resolve_left hnil
      have hadj : (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj Q.finish rv.snd :=
        rv.adj_snd hnil
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_augFresh (V := V) (q := q)).1 hsnd
      have hadj' : (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj Q.finish (.inr i) := by
        simpa [hi] using hadj
      have hadj'' : (augGraph (G := G) B q).Adj (.inr i) Q.finish :=
        hadj'.symm
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ :=
        (adj_fresh_iff (G := G) (B := B) (q := q) (i := i) (x := Q.finish)).1
          hadj''
      exact (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).2 ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_eq_oldImage
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp, augCarrier_sdiff_fresh]

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_card
proof:
:= by
  have hno :
      NoConsecutive (augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) p :=
    NoConsecutive_of_independent
      (Independent.augFresh (G := G) (B := B) (q := q)) p
  have hlen :=
    leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_ends_not_mem
      (mem_augA_not_fresh (B := B) (q := q) hs)
      (mem_augA_not_fresh (B := B) (q := q) hf) hno
  have hFsub : augFresh (V := V) (q := q) ⊆ p.support := by
    rw [hp]
    exact subset_union_right
  have hinter :
      p.support ∩ augFresh (V := V) (q := q) =
        augFresh (V := V) (q := q) :=
    inter_eq_right.2 hFsub
  rw [leftoverCoverOfPath_card, hlen, hinter, card_augFresh]

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_terminal
statement:
lemma leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_terminal {K : Finset V}
    {p : GraphPath (augGraph (G := G) B q)}
    (hp : p.support = augCarrier (q := q) K)
    (hs : p.start ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q))
    (hf : p.finish ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q)) :
    IsTerminalCover (G := augGraph (G := G) B q)
      (augA (B := B) (q := q))
      ((leftoverCoverOfPath p (augFresh (V := V) (q := q))).cast
        (leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_eq_oldImage (K := K) hp))
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  have hQ' : Q ∈ leftoverPieces (augFresh (V := V) (q := q)) p := by
    rwa [PathCover.cast_paths, leftoverCoverOfPath_paths] at hQ
  exact leftoverPieces_ends_mem_augA (B := B) (q := q) hs hf hQ'

name: Nikoghosyan.ofAugOldImage_exists_path
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [PathCover.ofAugOldImage, PathCover.ofCarrierImage_inl,
    PathCover.ofCarrierImage, GraphPath.ofCarrierRange] at hp
  rcases List.mem_map.1 hp with ⟨x, _hx, rfl⟩
  have hrange : ∀ y ∈ x.1.support,
      y ∈ Set.range (Sum.inl : V → V ⊕ Fin q) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ :=
      (mem_augOldImage (q := q)).1 (pc.support_subset x.property hy)
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    nonempty_of_mem_range (f := (Embedding.inl : V ↪ V ⊕ Fin q))
      (hrange _ x.1.start_mem_support)
  refine ⟨x.1, x.property, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Sum.inl (invFun (Sum.inl : V → V ⊕ Fin q) x.1.start) = x.1.start
    exact Function.invFun_eq (hrange _ x.1.start_mem_support)
  · change Sum.inl (invFun (Sum.inl : V → V ⊕ Fin q) x.1.finish) = x.1.finish
    exact Function.invFun_eq (hrange _ x.1.finish_mem_support)

name: Nikoghosyan.ofAugOldImage_terminal
statement:
lemma ofAugOldImage_terminal {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover (augGraph (G := G) B q) (augOldImage (q := q) U))
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := augGraph (G := G) B q)
      (augA (B := B) (q := q)) pc) :
    IsTerminalCover (G := G) B (pc.ofAugOldImage (B := B) (q := q))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨qth, hq, hst, hfin⟩ :=
    ofAugOldImage_exists_path (B := B) (q := q) pc hp
  have ⟨hsA, hfA⟩ := hterm qth hq
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hsa⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hsA
    have : Sum.inl p.start = Sum.inl a := hst.trans hsa
    exact (Sum.inl_injective this) ▸ ha
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hsa⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hfA
    have : Sum.inl p.finish = Sum.inl a := hfin.trans hsa
    exact (Sum.inl_injective this) ▸ ha

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverCoverOfAugPath_card
statement:
lemma leftoverCoverOfAugPath_card {K : Finset V}
    (p : GraphPath (augGraph (G := G) B q))
    (hp : p.support = augCarrier (q := q) K)
    (hs : p.start ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q))
    (hf : p.finish ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q)) :
    (leftoverCoverOfAugPath (B := B) (q := q) p hp).card = q + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftoverCoverOfAugPath, PathCover.ofAugOldImage_card, PathCover.cast_card,
    leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_card (K := K) hp hs hf]

name: Nikoghosyan.leftoverCoverOfAugPath_terminal
statement:
lemma leftoverCoverOfAugPath_terminal {K : Finset V}
    (p : GraphPath (augGraph (G := G) B q))
    (hp : p.support = augCarrier (q := q) K)
    (hs : p.start ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q))
    (hf : p.finish ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q)) :
    IsTerminalCover (G := G) B
      (leftoverCoverOfAugPath (B := B) (q := q) p hp)
proof:
:=
  ofAugOldImage_terminal _
    (leftoverCoverOfPath_fresh_terminal (K := K) hp hs hf)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_of_augPath
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_of_augPath {K : Finset V}
    (p : GraphPath (augGraph (G := G) B q))
    (hp : p.support = augCarrier (q := q) K)
    (hs : p.start ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q))
    (hf : p.finish ∈ augA (B := B) (q := q)) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = q + 1 ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:=
  ⟨leftoverCoverOfAugPath (B := B) (q := q) p hp,
    leftoverCoverOfAugPath_card (B := B) (q := q) p hp hs hf,
    leftoverCoverOfAugPath_terminal (B := B) (q := q) p hp hs hf⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_A_not_mem_K
statement: lemma mem_A_not_mem_K {x : V} (hx : x ∈ P.A) : x ∉ P.B ∪ P.W
proof:
:=
  disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_A_K hx

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_U_not_mem_K
statement: lemma mem_U_not_mem_K {x : V} (hx : x ∈ P.U) : x ∉ P.B ∪ P.W
proof:
:=
  disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_U_K hx

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.univ_sdiff_eq
statement:
lemma univ_sdiff_eq {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W) :
    univ \ S = P.A ∪ P.U ∪ ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxuniv : x ∈ univ := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxS : x ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have hxAll : x ∈ P.A ∪ P.B ∪ P.U ∪ P.W := P.hcover ▸ hxuniv
    rcases mem_union.1 hxAll with hABU | hW
    · rcases mem_union.1 hABU with hAB | hU
      · rcases mem_union.1 hAB with hA | hB
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hA)))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hB), hxS⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hU)))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hW), hxS⟩))
  · intro hx
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ x, ?_⟩
    intro hS'
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hAU | hK
    · rcases mem_union.1 hAU with hA | hU
      · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_A_K hA (hS hS')).elim
      · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_U_K hU (hS hS')).elim
    · exact (mem_sdiff.1 hK).2 hS'

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff
statement:
lemma subset_AU_union_Ksdiff {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W) :
    P.A ∪ P.U ⊆ univ \ S
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [P.univ_sdiff_eq hS]
  exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.connected_AU
statement:
lemma connected_AU :
    (G.induce ((P.A ∪ P.U : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected
proof:
:=
  Cograph.induce_connected_of_completeJoin P.A_nonempty P.hUne P.hAU

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.reachable_AU
statement:
lemma reachable_AU {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ P.A ∪ P.U) (hy : y ∈ P.A ∪ P.U) :
    (G.induce ((P.A ∪ P.U : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
      ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
proof:
:=
  P.connected_AU.preconnected ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.adj_A_surviving_B
statement:
lemma adj_A_surviving_B {S : Finset V} {a b : V}
    (ha : a ∈ P.A) (hb : b ∈ P.B) (hbS : b ∉ S) : G.Adj a b
proof:
:=
  P.hAB ha hb

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.W_anti_AU
statement: lemma W_anti_AU {w x : V} (hw : w ∈ P.W) (hx : x ∈ P.A ∪ P.U) : ¬ G.Adj w x
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_union.1 hx with hA | hU
  · exact P.hWantiA w hw x hA
  · exact fun h => P.hUantiW x hU w hw h.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.connected_AU_in_remainder
statement:
lemma connected_AU_in_remainder {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W) :
    (G.induce ((P.A ∪ P.U : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected
proof:
:=
  P.connected_AU

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_mixedComponent_of_AU
statement:
lemma mem_mixedComponent_of_AU {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ P.A ∪ P.U) :
    (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS hx⟩ =
      P.mixedComponent hS
proof:
:= by
  let a := P.A_nonempty.choose
  have haAU : a ∈ P.A ∪ P.U := mem_union.2 (Or.inl P.A_nonempty.choose_spec)
  have hxEq : (P.induceIncl_AU_remainder hS) ⟨x, hx⟩ =
      ⟨x, P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS hx⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
  have haEq : (P.induceIncl_AU_remainder hS) ⟨a, haAU⟩ =
      ⟨a, P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS haAU⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
  have hR := (P.reachable_AU hx haAU).map (P.induceIncl_AU_remainder hS)
  apply ConnectedComponent.sound
  rw [← hxEq, ← haEq]
  exact hR

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_mixedComponent_of_surviving_B
statement:
lemma mem_mixedComponent_of_surviving_B {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {b : V} (hb : b ∈ P.B) (hbS : b ∉ S) :
    (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨b, by
          rw [P.univ_sdiff_eq hS]
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hb), hbS⟩))⟩ =
      P.mixedComponent hS
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := P.A_nonempty
  have haRem : a ∈ univ \ S :=
    P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS (mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha))
  have hbRem : b ∈ univ \ S := by
    rw [P.univ_sdiff_eq hS]
    exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hb), hbS⟩))
  have hadj : (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Adj
      ⟨b, hbRem⟩ ⟨a, haRem⟩ := by
    simpa [induce_adj] using (P.hAB ha hb).symm
  have hA : (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨a, haRem⟩ = P.mixedComponent hS :=
    P.mem_mixedComponent_of_AU hS (mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha))
  convert (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj).trans hA

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff
statement:
lemma mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) : x ∈ univ \ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.univ_sdiff_eq hS]
  exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.not_mem_Ksdiff_of_AU
statement:
lemma not_mem_Ksdiff_of_AU {S : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ P.A ∪ P.U) : x ∉ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S
proof:
:= by
  intro hxK
  have hxK' : x ∈ P.B ∪ P.W := (mem_sdiff.1 hxK).1
  rcases mem_union.1 hx with hA | hU
  · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_A_K hA hxK').elim
  · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_U_K hU hxK').elim

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.free_component_subset_W
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxKS : x ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S := (mem_filter.1 hx).1
  have hxK : x ∈ P.B ∪ P.W := (mem_sdiff.1 hxKS).1
  have hxS : x ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hxKS).2
  have hxB : x ∉ P.B := by
    intro hB
    have : x ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C ∩ (P.B \ S) :=
      mem_inter.2 ⟨hx, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hB, hxS⟩⟩
    rw [hC] at this
    exact absurd this (notMem_empty x)
  rcases mem_union.1 hxK with hB | hW
  · exact (hxB hB).elim
  · exact hW

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.not_adj_free_AU
proof:
:=
  P.W_anti_AU (P.free_component_subset_W hC hx) hy

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.adj_mem_componentFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hxU : x ∈ U := (mem_filter.1 hx).1
  obtain ⟨_, hxC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hadj' : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Adj ⟨x, hxU⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
    simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
  have hyC :
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hy⟩ = C :=
    (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj').symm.trans hxC
  exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hy, ⟨hy, hyC⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.free_walk_stays
statement:
lemma free_walk_stays {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {C : (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent}
    (hC : IsFreeComponent (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S C)
    {x y : ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)}
    (hx : x.val ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C)
    (p : (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Walk x y) :
    y.val ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C
proof:
:= by
  revert hx
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro hx
    exact hx
  | @cons u v w hadj q ih =>
    intro hx
    have hadjG : G.Adj u.val v.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
    have hv' : v.val ∈ P.A ∪ P.U ∪ ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) :=
      (P.univ_sdiff_eq hS) ▸ v.property
    have hvKS : v.val ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S := by
      rcases mem_union.1 hv' with hAU | hKS
      · exact (P.not_adj_free_AU hC hx hAU hadjG).elim
      · exact hKS
    have hvC :=
      adj_mem_componentFinset (G := G) (U := (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) hx hvKS hadjG
    exact ih hvC

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.free_reachable_stays
statement:
lemma free_reachable_stays {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {C : (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent}
    (hC : IsFreeComponent (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S C)
    {x y : ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)}
    (hx : x.val ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C)
    (hR : (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable x y) :
    y.val ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C
proof:
:=
  P.free_walk_stays hS hC hx (Classical.choice hR)

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.exists_mem_connectedComponent
statement:
lemma exists_mem_connectedComponent {U : Finset V}
    (C : (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    ∃ (x : V) (hx : x ∈ U),
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx⟩ = C
proof:
:=
  C.ind fun z => ⟨z.1, z.2, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_componentFinset_mk
statement:
lemma mem_componentFinset_mk {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    x ∈ componentFinset G U
      ((G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:=
  mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  exact hC

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_mixedComponent_of_not_free
statement:
lemma mem_mixedComponent_of_not_free {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S)
    (hnot : ¬ IsFreeComponent (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S
      ((G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, hx⟩)) :
    (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hx⟩ =
      P.mixedComponent hS
proof:
:= by
  set C :=
    (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hne : (componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C ∩ (P.B \ S)).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hnot
  obtain ⟨b, hbint⟩ := hne
  have hbC : b ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C := (mem_inter.1 hbint).1
  have hbB : b ∈ P.B \ S := (mem_inter.1 hbint).2
  have hbKS : b ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S := (mem_filter.1 hbC).1
  have hxC : C =
      (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, hx⟩ := rfl
  have hbMk := connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset hbC
  have hreachKS :
      (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨b, hbKS⟩ :=
    ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (hxC ▸ hbMk.symm)
  have hreachRem := hreachKS.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS)
  have hbRem : b ∈ univ \ S := P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hbKS
  have hxRem : x ∈ univ \ S := P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hx
  have hinclx :
      (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) ⟨x, hx⟩ = ⟨x, hxRem⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
  have hinclb :
      (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) ⟨b, hbKS⟩ = ⟨b, hbRem⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
  have hmx :
      (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨x, hxRem⟩ =
        (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨b, hbRem⟩ := by
    apply ConnectedComponent.sound
    simpa [hinclx, hinclb] using hreachRem
  have hmb :=
    P.mem_mixedComponent_of_surviving_B hS (mem_sdiff.1 hbB).1 (mem_sdiff.1 hbB).2
  exact hmx.trans hmb

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.remainderSum_inl
statement:
lemma remainderSum_inl {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W) (u : Unit) :
    P.remainderSum hS (.inl u) = P.mixedComponent hS
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.remainderSum_inr
statement:
lemma remainderSum_inr {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    (C : { C : (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
      IsFreeComponent (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S C }) :
    P.remainderSum hS (.inr C) =
      C.1.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.map_free_eq_mk
statement:
lemma map_free_eq_mk {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W)
    {C : (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent}
    {x : V} (hxKS : x ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ S)
    (hxC : (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, hxKS⟩ = C) :
    C.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) =
      (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hxKS⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst hxC
  rw [ConnectedComponent.map_mk]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_componentFinset_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hxC] using (mem_componentFinset_mk (G := G) hxKS)

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.remainderSum_bijective
statement:
lemma remainderSum_bijective {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W) :
    Function.Bijective (P.remainderSum hS)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?inj, ?surj⟩
  · intro a b hab
    match a, b with
    | .inl _, .inl _ =>
      rfl
    | .inr C, .inr D =>
      have hmap : C.1.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) =
          D.1.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) := by
        simpa [P.remainderSum_inr hS] using hab
      obtain ⟨x, hxKS, hxC⟩ := exists_mem_connectedComponent C.1
      have hxCfin := P.mem_componentFinset_of_eq hxKS hxC
      have hmapC := P.map_free_eq_mk hS hxKS hxC
      obtain ⟨y, hyKS, hyD⟩ := exists_mem_connectedComponent D.1
      have hyCfin := P.mem_componentFinset_of_eq hyKS hyD
      have hmapD := P.map_free_eq_mk hS hyKS hyD
      have hR :
          (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
            ⟨x, P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hxKS⟩
            ⟨y, P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hyKS⟩ :=
        ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (hmapC.symm.trans (hmap.trans hmapD))
      have hyC : y ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C.1 :=
        P.free_reachable_stays hS C.2 hxCfin hR
      have hCD : C.1 = D.1 :=
        (connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset hyC).symm.trans
          (connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset hyCfin)
      exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext hCD)
    | .inl _, .inr C =>
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨x, hxKS, hxC⟩ := exists_mem_connectedComponent C.1
      have hxCfin := P.mem_componentFinset_of_eq hxKS hxC
      have hmapC := P.map_free_eq_mk hS hxKS hxC
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := P.A_nonempty
      have haAU : a ∈ P.A ∪ P.U := mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)
      have haRem : a ∈ univ \ S := P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS haAU
      have hmixed :
          P.mixedComponent hS =
            (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
              ⟨a, haRem⟩ :=
        (P.mem_mixedComponent_of_AU hS haAU).symm
      have heq : P.mixedComponent hS =
          C.1.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) := by
        simpa [P.remainderSum_inl hS, P.remainderSum_inr hS] using hab
      have hR :
          (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
            ⟨x, P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hxKS⟩ ⟨a, haRem⟩ :=
        ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (hmapC.symm.trans (heq.symm.trans hmixed))
      have haC : a ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C.1 :=
        P.free_reachable_stays hS C.2 hxCfin hR
      exact P.not_mem_Ksdiff_of_AU haAU (mem_filter.1 haC).1
    | .inr C, .inl _ =>
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨x, hxKS, hxC⟩ := exists_mem_connectedComponent C.1
      have hxCfin := P.mem_componentFinset_of_eq hxKS hxC
      have hmapC := P.map_free_eq_mk hS hxKS hxC
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := P.A_nonempty
      have haAU : a ∈ P.A ∪ P.U := mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)
      have haRem : a ∈ univ \ S := P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS haAU
      have hmixed :
          P.mixedComponent hS =
            (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
              ⟨a, haRem⟩ :=
        (P.mem_mixedComponent_of_AU hS haAU).symm
      have heq : C.1.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) =
          P.mixedComponent hS := by
        simpa [P.remainderSum_inl hS, P.remainderSum_inr hS] using hab
      have hR :
          (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
            ⟨x, P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hxKS⟩ ⟨a, haRem⟩ :=
        ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (hmapC.symm.trans (heq.trans hmixed))
      have haC : a ∈ componentFinset G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) C.1 :=
        P.free_reachable_stays hS C.2 hxCfin hR
      exact P.not_mem_Ksdiff_of_AU haAU (mem_filter.1 haC).1
  · intro D
    refine D.ind fun x => ?_
    have hx' : x.val ∈ P.A ∪ P.U ∪ ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S) :=
      (P.univ_sdiff_eq hS) ▸ x.property
    rcases mem_union.1 hx' with hAU | hKS
    · refine ⟨Sum.inl (), ?_⟩
      change P.mixedComponent hS =
        (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk x
      have hxeq : x = ⟨x.val, P.subset_AU_union_Ksdiff hS hAU⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
      exact hxeq ▸ (P.mem_mixedComponent_of_AU hS hAU).symm
    · set C :=
        (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨x.val, hKS⟩
      by_cases hfree : IsFreeComponent (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S C
      · refine ⟨Sum.inr ⟨C, hfree⟩, ?_⟩
        change C.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) =
          (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk x
        have hxRem : x.val ∈ univ \ S := P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hKS
        have hxeq : x = ⟨x.val, hxRem⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
        have hmap :
            C.map (P.induceIncl_Ksdiff_remainder hS) =
              (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
                ⟨x.val, hxRem⟩ := by
          rw [ConnectedComponent.map_mk]
          rfl
        exact hxeq ▸ hmap
      · refine ⟨Sum.inl (), ?_⟩
        change P.mixedComponent hS =
          (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk x
        have hxRem : x.val ∈ univ \ S := P.mem_remainder_of_Ksdiff hS hKS
        have hxeq : x = ⟨x.val, hxRem⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
        exact hxeq ▸ (P.mem_mixedComponent_of_not_free hS hKS hfree).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.componentCount_remainder_eq
statement:
lemma componentCount_remainder_eq {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W) :
    componentCount G (univ \ S) =
      1 + terminalComponentCount (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fintype
      (G.induce ((univ \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype
      (G.induce (((P.B ∪ P.W) \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hcard := Nat.card_congr (P.remainderComponentEquiv hS)
  have hunit : Nat.card Unit = 1 := Nat.card_unique
  simpa [componentCount, terminalComponentCount, Nat.card_sum, hunit,
    Nat.add_comm] using hcard

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.componentCount_univ_of_connected
statement:
lemma componentCount_univ_of_connected [Nonempty V] (h : G.Connected) :
    componentCount G univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hss : Subsingleton G.ConnectedComponent :=
    h.preconnected.subsingleton_connectedComponent
  have hne : Nonempty G.ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  have : Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent = 1 :=
    Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨hss, hne⟩
  rw [componentCount_univ, this]

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.terminalHypothesis_of_oneTough
statement:
lemma terminalHypothesis_of_oneTough (htough : OneTough G) :
    TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨P.A_nonempty.choose⟩
  refine ⟨?empty, ?cut⟩
  · have hconn := OneTough.connected (G := G) htough
    have hc1 : componentCount G univ = 1 :=
      componentCount_univ_of_connected hconn
    have hid := P.componentCount_remainder_eq (S := ∅) (empty_subset _)
    have : 1 + terminalComponentCount (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B ∅ = 1 := by
      rw [← hid, sdiff_empty, hc1]
    exact (Nat.add_eq_left.mp this)
  · intro S hS hSne
    have hid := P.componentCount_remainder_eq hS
    by_cases hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S = 0
    · have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.mpr hSne)
      omega
    · have hzpos : 1 ≤ terminalComponentCount (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B S :=
        Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
      have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ S) := by omega
      have ht := htough S h2
      omega

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_oneTough
statement:
lemma repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_oneTough
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (htough : OneTough G) :
    RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B
proof:
:=
  repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_sides P hpat (P.terminalHypothesis_of_oneTough htough)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_ne_finish_of_two_le_card
statement:
lemma GraphPath.start_ne_finish_of_two_le_card (p : GraphPath G)
    (h : 2 ≤ p.support.card) : p.start ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hnil : p.walk.Nil := (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).2 heq
  have hs := GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
  have : p.support.card = 1 := by rw [hs, card_singleton]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_of_spanningPathCompatible
statement:
lemma mem_of_spanningPathCompatible {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (h : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y) : x ∈ U ∧ y ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, p, hp, hends⟩ := h
  constructor
  · rcases hends with ⟨hs, _⟩ | ⟨_, hf⟩
    · simpa [hs, hp] using p.start_mem_support
    · simpa [hf, hp] using p.finish_mem_support
  · rcases hends with ⟨_, hf⟩ | ⟨hs, _⟩
    · simpa [hf, hp] using p.finish_mem_support
    · simpa [hs, hp] using p.start_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_spanningPathCompatible_of_eligible
statement:
lemma exists_spanningPathCompatible_of_eligible {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ U.card) (hp : pathCoverNumber G U = 1)
    (hE : Eligible G U x) :
    ∃ y, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpU, hy⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_spanning_path_of_eligible_eq_one (G := G) hp hE
  have hcard : 2 ≤ p.support.card := by simpa [hpU] using h2
  have hne := GraphPath.start_ne_finish_of_two_le_card p hcard
  rcases hy with hs | hf
  · refine ⟨p.finish, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_, p, hpU, Or.inl ⟨hs, rfl⟩⟩
    simpa [hs] using hne
  · refine ⟨p.start, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_, p, hpU, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hf⟩⟩
    simpa [hf] using hne.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.IsFreeComponent_of_B_subset
statement:
lemma IsFreeComponent_of_B_subset {K B S : Finset V}
    (hB : B ⊆ S)
    (C : (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B S C
proof:
:= by
  have hBS : B \ S = ∅ := sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.2 hB
  simp [IsFreeComponent, hBS]

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset
proof:
:= by
  unfold terminalComponentCount componentCount
  refine Nat.card_congr ?_
  exact Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv (fun C => IsFreeComponent_of_B_subset (G := G) hB C)

name: Nikoghosyan.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  exact hC

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_ge_pred_of_inOne
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_ge_pred_of_inOne {K B S W : Finset V}
    (hIn : Cograph.InOneComponent (G := G) (K \ S) W)
    (hB : B \ S ⊆ W) :
    componentCount G (K \ S) - 1 ≤
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsurv : (B \ S).Nonempty
  · have hWne : W.Nonempty := hsurv.mono hB
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ :=
      Cograph.exists_component_of_inOneComponent (G := G) hWne hIn
    have huniq :
        ∀ C : (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
          ¬ IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B S C → C = C0 := by
      intro C hnf
      have hne : (componentFinset G (K \ S) C ∩ (B \ S)).Nonempty :=
        nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hnf
      obtain ⟨b, hbint⟩ := hne
      have hbC : b ∈ componentFinset G (K \ S) C := (mem_inter.1 hbint).1
      have hbB : b ∈ B \ S := (mem_inter.1 hbint).2
      have hbW : b ∈ W := hB hbB
      obtain ⟨hbU, hbC0⟩ := hC0 b hbW
      have hbMk := connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hbC
      have hUeq : (mem_filter.1 hbC).1 = hbU := rfl
      exact hbMk.symm.trans hbC0
    haveI : Fintype
        (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
      inferInstance
    let α := (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent
    let p : α → Prop := fun C => IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B S C
    have hsub : Subsingleton { C : α // ¬ p C } :=
      ⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext ((huniq a.1 a.2).trans (huniq b.1 b.2).symm)⟩
    have hnf : Fintype.card { C : α // ¬ p C } ≤ 1 :=
      Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.2 hsub
    have hle : Fintype.card { C : α // p C } ≤ Fintype.card α :=
      Fintype.card_subtype_le _
    have hsum :
        Fintype.card { C : α // p C } + Fintype.card { C : α // ¬ p C } =
          Fintype.card α := by
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
      exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hle
    have hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S =
        Fintype.card { C : α // p C } := by
      rw [terminalComponentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    have hc : componentCount G (K \ S) = Fintype.card α := by
      rw [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    omega
  · have hBsub : B ⊆ S := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxS
      exact hsurv ⟨x, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx, hxS⟩⟩
    have hz :=
      terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) (K := K) hBsub
    have hcpos : componentCount G (K \ S) - 1 ≤ componentCount G (K \ S) :=
      Nat.sub_le _ _
    simpa [hz] using hcpos

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_B_ended_spanning_path
statement:
lemma exists_B_ended_spanning_path {K B : Finset V}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ K.card) (hcog : IsCograph G K)
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G K = 1) (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = K ∧ p.start ∈ B ∧ p.finish ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hnoR : ∀ {x y : V}, x ∈ B → y ∈ B →
      ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) K x y := by
    intro x y hx hy hR
    obtain ⟨_, p, hpU, hends⟩ := hR
    apply hnone
    rcases hends with ⟨hs, hf⟩ | ⟨hs, hf⟩
    · exact ⟨p, hpU, hs ▸ hx, hf ▸ hy⟩
    · exact ⟨p, hpU, hs ▸ hy, hf ▸ hx⟩
  have hdata :=
    Cograph.hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph_canonical
      (G := G) h2 hcog hconn hp
  rcases hdata with hcrit | hbal
  · obtain ⟨A, Y, hAne, hYne, hunion, hAY, hcritAY, hA, hEeq, hFeq, hRiff, hpart⟩ :=
      hcrit
    obtain ⟨p0, hp0⟩ :=
      Cograph.exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hp
    have hE0 := (Cograph.Eligible_of_support_ends p0 hp0).1
    have h0K : p0.start ∈ K := Eligible.mem (G := G) hE0
    have h0A : p0.start ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
      have : p0.start ∈ eligibleSet G K :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨h0K, hE0⟩
      rwa [← hEeq]
    let EB := B ∩ eligibleSet G A
    obtain ⟨x, hxEA, hxBof⟩ :
        ∃ x, x ∈ eligibleSet G A ∧ (EB.Nonempty → x ∈ B) := by
      by_cases hEB : EB.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hEB
        exact ⟨x, (mem_inter.1 hx).2, fun _ => (mem_inter.1 hx).1⟩
      · exact ⟨p0.start, h0A, fun h => (hEB h).elim⟩
    obtain ⟨S, hSsub, hSne, hScut, hScomp⟩ := hpart x hxEA
    have hBsub :
        B ⊆ ineligibleSet G K ∪ Cograph.dNonadjClass (G := G) A x := by
      intro z hz
      by_cases hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G K
      · have hzEA : z ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rwa [← hEeq]
        by_cases hzP : z ∈ Cograph.dNonadjClass (G := G) A x
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzP)
        · have hzD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x z := by
            have hiff := Cograph.mem_dNonadjClass_iff (G := G) (U := A) (x := x) (y := z)
            have : ¬ (z ∈ eligibleSet G A ∧
                ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x z) := by
              simpa [hiff] using hzP
            tauto
          have hxB : x ∈ B :=
            hxBof ⟨z, mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hzEA⟩⟩
          exact (hnoR hxB hz ((hRiff x z).2 hzD)).elim
      · have hzK : z ∈ K := hBK hz
        have hnotE : ¬ Eligible G K z := by
          intro hE
          exact hzE ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzK, hE⟩)
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzK, hnotE⟩))
    have hBrem :
        B \ S ⊆
          (ineligibleSet G K ∪ Cograph.dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ S :=
      fun z hz =>
        mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hBsub (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2⟩
    have hSsubK : S ⊆ K :=
      hSsub.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K)
    have hzge :=
      terminalComponentCount_ge_pred_of_inOne (G := G) (K := K) (B := B)
        (S := S) hScomp hBrem
    have hTHS := hTH.2 S hSsubK hSne
    have hc : componentCount G (K \ S) = S.card + 1 := hScut
    have hge : S.card ≤ terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S := by
      have hpred : (S.card + 1) - 1 ≤ terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S := by
        simpa [hc] using hzge
      simpa using hpred
    have hle : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S ≤ S.card - 1 := hTHS
    have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.mpr hSne)
    omega
  · obtain ⟨hEall, hcut, _hclass⟩ := hbal
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
    have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hb
    have hBsub : B ⊆ Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) K b := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra hzP
      have hzK : z ∈ K := hBK hz
      have hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) K b z := by
        have hiff :=
          Cograph.mem_rNonadjClass_iff (G := G) (U := K) (x := b) (y := z)
        have : ¬ (z ∈ K ∧ ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) K b z) := by
          simpa [hiff] using hzP
        tauto
      exact hnoR hb hz hR
    set P := Cograph.rNonadjClass (G := G) K b
    have hPsub : P ⊆ K := Cograph.rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) K b
    have hPne : P.Nonempty := ⟨b, Cograph.mem_rNonadjClass_self hbK⟩
    have hcutP : componentCount G (K \ P) = P.card := hcut b hbK
    have hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B P = P.card :=
      (terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) (K := K) hBsub).trans hcutP
    have hTHP : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B P ≤ P.card - 1 :=
      hTH.2 P hPsub hPne
    have hpos : 1 ≤ P.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.mpr hPne)
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_B_ended_spanning_path_of_sides
statement:
lemma exists_B_ended_spanning_path_of_sides (P : AllCographSides G)
    (htough : OneTough G)
    (hconn : (G.induce ((P.B ∪ P.W : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) = 1) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = P.B ∪ P.W ∧ p.start ∈ P.B ∧ p.finish ∈ P.B
proof:
:= by
  have hBge : 2 ≤ P.B.card := by simpa [P.hBcard] using P.hm
  have h2 : 2 ≤ (P.B ∪ P.W).card :=
    hBge.trans (card_le_card (subset_union_left (s₁ := P.B)))
  have hBne : P.B.Nonempty :=
    card_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hBge)
  exact exists_B_ended_spanning_path h2 P.hKcog hconn hp P.B_subset_K hBne
    (P.terminalHypothesis_of_oneTough htough)

proof:
