    Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) H.hdisjBW H.hanti
  simpa [NoBVJoinBase.X, H.pathCoverNumber_B] using hsum

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.sdiff_cut_YF
statement:
lemma sdiff_cut_YF : H.K \ (H.Y ∪ ineligibleSet G H.W) =
    H.B ∪ (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [NoBVJoinBase.K, mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hK, hnot⟩
    have hxY : x ∉ H.Y := fun hY => hnot (Or.inl hY)
    have hxF : x ∉ ineligibleSet G H.W := fun hF => hnot (Or.inr hF)
    rcases hK with (hB | hW) | hY
    · exact Or.inl hB
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hW, hxF⟩
    · exact (hxY hY).elim
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with hB | hWF
    · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hB), ?_⟩
      intro h
      rcases h with hY | hF
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBY hB hY
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBW hB
          (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) H.W hF)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hWF.1), ?_⟩
      intro h
      rcases h with hY | hF
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjWY hWF.1 hY
      · exact hWF.2 hF

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.nocross_Wrem_B
statement:
lemma nocross_Wrem_B :
    ∀ a ∈ H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W, ∀ b ∈ H.B, ¬ G.Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  exact H.hanti b hb a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 hab.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.all_free_of_disjoint_T
statement:
lemma all_free_of_disjoint_T {A T : Finset V} (h : Disjoint A T)
    (C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentFinset G A C ∩ T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro x hx
  have hxA : x ∈ A := componentFinset_subset (G := G) C (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 h hxA (mem_inter.1 hx).2

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.terminalComponentCount_cut_YF
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_cut_YF :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K H.B (H.Y ∪ ineligibleSet G H.W) =
      componentCount G (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq := H.sdiff_cut_YF
  have hnc := H.nocross_Wrem_B
  have hJ : H.B ⊆ H.B := subset_rfl
  
  have h1 :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K H.B (H.Y ∪ ineligibleSet G H.W) =
        Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce
              ((H.B ∪ (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G (H.B ∪ (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W)) C ∩
              (H.B \ (H.Y ∪ ineligibleSet G H.W)) = ∅ } := by
    unfold terminalComponentCount IsFreeComponent
    rw [hEq]
  have hBsurv : H.B \ (H.Y ∪ ineligibleSet G H.W) = H.B := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
    constructor
    · exact And.left
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      intro h
      rcases h with hY | hF
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBY hx hY
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBW hx
          (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) H.W hF)
  have h2 :=
    ncard_free_union_isolates (G := G)
      (A := H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) (J := H.B) (T := H.B)
      (fun a ha b hb => H.nocross_Wrem_B a ha b hb) subset_rfl
  have h3 :
      Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce ((H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) C ∩ H.B = ∅ } =
        componentCount G (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) := by
    unfold componentCount
    refine Nat.card_congr ?_
    exact Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv fun C =>
      all_free_of_disjoint_T (G := G)
        (disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset H.hdisjBW.symm) C
  
  have hcomm :
      H.B ∪ (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) =
        (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) ∪ H.B := union_comm _ _
  have h1' :
      Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce
              ((H.B ∪ (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G (H.B ∪ (H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W)) C ∩
              (H.B \ (H.Y ∪ ineligibleSet G H.W)) = ∅ } =
        Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce
              (((H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) ∪ H.B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G ((H.W \ ineligibleSet G H.W) ∪ H.B) C ∩ H.B = ∅ } := by
    rw [hcomm, hBsurv]
  rw [h1, h1', h2, h3]

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.pathCoverNumber_W_lt
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_W_lt :
    pathCoverNumber G H.W + 1 ≤ H.Y.card
proof:
:= by
  set FW := ineligibleSet G H.W
  have hFsub : FW ⊆ H.W := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) H.W
  have hS : H.Y ∪ FW ⊆ H.K :=
    union_subset H.Y_subset_K (hFsub.trans H.W_subset_K)
  have hSne : (H.Y ∪ FW).Nonempty := H.hYne.mono subset_union_left
  have hz := H.hTH.2 (H.Y ∪ FW) hS hSne
  have hz' := H.terminalComponentCount_cut_YF
  have hcanon :
      componentCount G (H.W \ FW) = FW.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) H.W_cograph
  have hcard : (H.Y ∪ FW).card = H.Y.card + FW.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_of_subset_right hFsub H.hdisjWY.symm)
  have hle : componentCount G (H.W \ FW) ≤ (H.Y ∪ FW).card - 1 := by
    have hz0 := hz
    have hz1 : terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K H.B (H.Y ∪ FW) ≤
        (H.Y ∪ FW).card - 1 := by
      simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K] using hz0
    rw [hz'] at hz1
    exact hz1
  have hYpos : 1 ≤ H.Y.card := card_pos.2 H.hYne
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.K_eq_join
statement: lemma K_eq_join : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.B ∪ H.W ∪ H.Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [NoBVJoinBase.X]

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.pathCoverNumber_Y_lt_X
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_Y_lt_X :
    pathCoverNumber G H.Y + 1 ≤ H.X.card
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_lt (G := G) H.X_nonempty H.hYne
    H.hXYcomplete (by simpa [H.K_eq_join] using H.hKcog) H.B_subset_X
    (by simpa [H.K_eq_join] using H.hTH)

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.dominant_X
statement:
lemma dominant_X :
    H.Y.card < pathCoverNumber G H.X
proof:
:=
  dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero (G := G) H.X_nonempty H.hYne
    H.hXYcomplete (by simpa [H.K_eq_join] using H.hKcog) H.B_subset_X
    (by simpa [H.K_eq_join] using H.hTH) (by simpa [H.K_eq_join] using H.hpK)

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.pathCoverNumber_K
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_K :
    pathCoverNumber G H.K = H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have hdom := H.dominant_X
  have hj :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant H.X_nonempty H.hYne H.hXYcomplete hdom
  have hX := H.pathCoverNumber_X
  simpa [H.K_eq, hX] using hj

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.pathCoverNumber_KsdiffB
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_KsdiffB :
    pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) =
      max 1 (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : H.K \ H.B = H.W ∪ H.Y := by
    ext x
    simp only [NoBVJoinBase.K, mem_sdiff, mem_union]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with ⟨(hB | hW) | hY, hnB⟩
      · exact (hnB hB).elim
      · exact Or.inl hW
      · exact Or.inr hY
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with hW | hY
      · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hW), fun hB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBW hB hW⟩
      · exact ⟨Or.inr hY, fun hB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBY hB hY⟩
  rw [hEq]
  by_cases hWne : H.W.Nonempty
  · have hj := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hWne H.hYne H.hWYcomplete
    have hpW : pathCoverNumber G H.W ≤ H.Y.card := by
      have := H.pathCoverNumber_W_lt
      omega
    have hWsub : pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card = 0 :=
      Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpW
    simpa [hj, hWsub, max_comm] using rfl
  · have hW0 : H.W = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hWne
    have : H.W ∪ H.Y = H.Y := by simp [hW0]
    have hpY : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.Y :=
      one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) H.hYne
    simp [this, hW0, Nat.sub_zero, max_eq_right hpY]

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.interval_nonempty
statement:
lemma interval_nonempty :
    pathCoverNumber G H.K + pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hpK := H.pathCoverNumber_K
  have hpKB := H.pathCoverNumber_KsdiffB
  have hpW : pathCoverNumber G H.W + 1 ≤ H.Y.card := H.pathCoverNumber_W_lt
  have hpWle : pathCoverNumber G H.W ≤ H.W.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) H.W
  have hpYle : pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.Y.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) H.Y
  have hpKge : 2 ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card := by
    have h2 : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K := by
      simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K] using H.hpK
    rwa [hpK] at h2
  rw [hpK, hpKB]
  by_cases h : pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.W.card
  · have h0 : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h
    have hmax : max 1 (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card) = 1 := by
      simp [h0]
    rw [hmax]
    have hYbd : pathCoverNumber G H.W + 1 ≤ H.Y.card := H.pathCoverNumber_W_lt
    have hBpos : 1 ≤ H.B.card := card_pos.2 H.hBne
    by_cases hge : H.Y.card ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W
    · omega
    · have hz0 : H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card = 0 :=
        Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_ge hge)
      omega
  · have hgt : H.W.card < pathCoverNumber G H.Y := Nat.lt_of_not_ge h
    have hmax : max 1 (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card) =
        pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card :=
      max_eq_right (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hgt))
    rw [hmax]
    have hYbd : pathCoverNumber G H.W + 1 ≤ H.Y.card := H.pathCoverNumber_W_lt
    have hpYle := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) H.Y
    have hpWle := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) H.W
    have hge : H.Y.card ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W := by omega
    have hrestore :
        H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card + H.Y.card =
          H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W :=
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hge
    have hgeW : H.W.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.Y := Nat.le_of_lt hgt
    have hrestoreY :
        pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card + H.W.card =
          pathCoverNumber G H.Y :=
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hgeW
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.spectrum_params
statement:
lemma spectrum_params {q : ℕ}
    (hlo : pathCoverNumber G H.K ≤ q)
    (hhi : q + pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.B.card) :
    1 ≤ H.d q ∧
      pathCoverNumber G H.W ≤ H.a q ∧
        H.a q ≤ H.W.card ∧
          pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.k q ∧
            H.k q ≤ H.Y.card ∧
              H.a q + 1 ≤ H.k q ∧
                H.d q + 2 ≤ H.B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hpK := H.pathCoverNumber_K
  have hpKB := H.pathCoverNumber_KsdiffB
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q :=
    le_trans (by simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K, NoBVJoinBase.X] using H.hpK) hlo
  have hneKB : (H.K \ H.B).Nonempty :=
    H.hYne.mono fun y hy =>
      mem_sdiff.2 ⟨H.Y_subset_K hy, fun hB =>
        Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBY hB hy⟩
  have hpKBpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hneKB
  have hdge : 1 ≤ H.d q := by
    change 1 ≤ H.B.card - q
    omega
  have hq2' : 2 ≤ q := hq2
  have hBge : H.d q + 2 ≤ H.B.card := by
    change H.B.card - q + 2 ≤ H.B.card
    omega
  have haW : pathCoverNumber G H.W ≤ H.a q := le_max_left _ _
  have hkge : H.a q + 1 ≤ H.k q := by
    change H.a q + 1 ≤ H.a q + H.d q
    omega
  have hpWle := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) H.W
  have hpYle := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) H.Y
  have hpWbd := H.pathCoverNumber_W_lt
  have hd_from_hi : pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.d q := by
    change pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.B.card - q
    omega
  have ha_le_W : H.a q ≤ H.W.card := by
    refine max_le hpWle ?_
    have hle : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card ≤ H.d q := by
      have : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card ≤
          max 1 (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card) := le_max_right _ _
      have hkb : max 1 (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.W.card) ≤ H.d q := by
        simpa [hpKB] using hd_from_hi
      exact this.trans hkb
    omega
  have hadd :
      H.a q + H.d q =
        max (pathCoverNumber G H.W + H.d q)
          (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.d q + H.d q) := by
    simp [NoBVJoinBase.a, max_add_add_right]
  have hk_le_Y : H.k q ≤ H.Y.card := by
    change H.a q + H.d q ≤ H.Y.card
    rw [hadd]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · have hqlo : H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card ≤ q := by
        simpa [hpK] using hlo
      have hqB : q ≤ H.B.card := by omega
      have hYle : H.Y.card ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W := by
        have h2 : 2 ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card := by
          have h2' : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K := by
            simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K] using H.hpK
          rwa [hpK] at h2'
        omega
      have : pathCoverNumber G H.W + H.d q ≤ H.Y.card := by
        change pathCoverNumber G H.W + (H.B.card - q) ≤ H.Y.card
        have hcancel : H.B.card - q + q = H.B.card := Nat.sub_add_cancel hqB
        have hcancelY :
            H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card + H.Y.card =
              H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W :=
          Nat.sub_add_cancel hYle
        omega
      exact this
    · by_cases hle : H.d q ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.Y
      · have : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.d q + H.d q =
            pathCoverNumber G H.Y := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle
        simpa [this] using hpYle
      · have h0 : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.d q = 0 :=
          Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (le_of_not_ge hle)
        have hqlo : H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card ≤ q := by
          simpa [hpK] using hlo
        have hqB : q ≤ H.B.card := by omega
        have hYle : H.Y.card ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W := by
          have h2 : 2 ≤ H.B.card + pathCoverNumber G H.W - H.Y.card := by
            have h2' : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K := by
              simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K] using H.hpK
            rwa [hpK] at h2'
          omega
        have hdY : H.d q ≤ H.Y.card := by
          change H.B.card - q ≤ H.Y.card
          omega
        simpa [h0] using hdY
  have hkY : pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.k q := by
    change pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.a q + H.d q
    rw [hadd]
    by_cases hle : H.d q ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.Y
    · have : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.d q + H.d q =
          pathCoverNumber G H.Y := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle
      simpa [this] using le_max_right _ _
    · have h0 : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.d q = 0 :=
        Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (le_of_not_ge hle)
      have : pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.d q := le_of_not_ge hle
      have : pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤
          pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.d q + H.d q := by
        simpa [h0] using this
      exact this.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  exact ⟨hdge, haW, ha_le_W, hkY, hk_le_Y, hkge, hBge⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.chain_start_mem_Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [hs]
  exact pathAt_support_subset pcY _ (pathAt pcY ⟨0, (Nat.succ_pos a).trans_le haY⟩).start_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.chain_finish_mem_Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf]
  exact pathAt_support_subset pcY _ (pathAt pcY ⟨a, Nat.succ_le_iff.mp haY⟩).finish_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.chain_support_subset
statement:
lemma chain_support_subset {pcY : PathCover G H.Y} {pcW : PathCover G H.W} {a : ℕ}
    (haY : a + 1 ≤ pcY.card) (haW : pcW.card = a)
    {r : GraphPath G}
    (hrmem : ∀ x, x ∈ r.support ↔
      (∃ i : Fin (a + 1), x ∈ (pathAt pcY ⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 haY⟩).support) ∨
        ∃ j : Fin a, x ∈ (pathAt pcW ⟨j.1, haW ▸ j.2⟩).support) :
    r.support ⊆ H.W ∪ H.Y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' := (hrmem x).1 hx
  rcases hx' with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, hxj⟩
  · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (pathAt_support_subset pcY _ hxi))
  · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (pathAt_support_subset pcW _ hxj))

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.exists_terminalCover_noBV_of_card
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_noBV_of_card {q : ℕ}
    (hlo : pathCoverNumber G H.K ≤ q)
    (hhi : q + pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.B.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = q ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdge, haW, ha_le_W, hkY, hk_le_Y, hkge, hBge⟩ :=
    H.spectrum_params hlo hhi
  obtain ⟨pcW, hWcard⟩ :=
    exists_pathCover_card (G := G) H.W haW ha_le_W
  obtain ⟨pcY, hYcard⟩ :=
    exists_pathCover_card (G := G) H.Y hkY hk_le_Y
  have haY : H.a q + 1 ≤ pcY.card := by omega
  have haWc : pcW.card = H.a q := hWcard
  obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hrmem⟩ :=
    exists_YV_chain H.hWYcomplete H.hdisjWY.symm pcY pcW (H.a q) haY haWc
  have hsY := H.chain_start_mem_Y haY haWc hrs
  have hfY := H.chain_finish_mem_Y haY haWc hrf
  have hrsub := H.chain_support_subset haY haWc hrmem
  have hB2 : 2 ≤ H.B.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨b1, b2, hb1, hb2, hne⟩ := exists_two_mem_of_two_le_card hB2
  obtain ⟨p, hps, hpf, hpsupp⟩ :=
    exists_anchor_B_ended H.hBYcomplete hb1 hb2 hne r hsY hfY
      H.hdisjBW H.hdisjBY hrsub
  
  let remB : Finset V := (H.B.erase b1).erase b2
  have hremB : remB ⊆ H.B := (erase_subset _ _).trans (erase_subset _ _)
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint remB p.support := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxrem hxp
    have hxB : x ∈ H.B := hremB hxrem
    have hxne2 : x ≠ b2 := (mem_erase.mp hxrem).1
    have hxne1 : x ≠ b1 := (mem_erase.mp (mem_erase.mp hxrem).2).1
    have hxps : x ∈ {b1} ∪ r.support ∪ {b2} := by rwa [hpsupp] at hxp
    rcases mem_union.1 hxps with hxL | hxR
    · rcases mem_union.1 hxL with hx1 | hxr
      · exact hxne1 (mem_singleton.1 hx1)
      · have : x ∈ H.W ∪ H.Y := hrsub hxr
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hW | hY
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBW hxB hW
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBY hxB hY
    · exact hxne2 (mem_singleton.1 hxR)
  have hpc0supp : p.support ∪ remB = H.B ∪ r.support := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxp | hxrem
      · have : x ∈ {b1} ∪ r.support ∪ {b2} := by rwa [hpsupp] at hxp
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hxL | hxR
        · rcases mem_union.1 hxL with hx1 | hxr
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by simpa [mem_singleton.1 hx1] using hb1))
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxr)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by simpa [mem_singleton.1 hxR] using hb2))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hremB hxrem))
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxB | hxr
      · by_cases h1 : x = b1
        · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
          have : x ∈ {b1} ∪ r.support ∪ {b2} := by
            simp [h1]
          rwa [← hpsupp] at this
        · by_cases h2 : x = b2
          · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
            have : x ∈ {b1} ∪ r.support ∪ {b2} := by
              simp [h2]
            rwa [← hpsupp] at this
          · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)
            exact mem_erase.2 ⟨h2, mem_erase.2 ⟨h1, hxB⟩⟩
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl ?_)
        have : x ∈ {b1} ∪ r.support ∪ {b2} :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxr)))
        rwa [← hpsupp] at this
  let pcAnchor : PathCover G p.support := PathCover.ofSupport p rfl
  let pcRem : PathCover G remB := PathCover.singletons (G := G) remB
  have htermA : IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pcAnchor :=
    PathCover.ofSupport_terminal p rfl (by simpa [hps]) (by simpa [hpf])
  have htermR : IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pcRem :=
    PathCover.singletons_terminal hremB
  let pc0' := PathCover.appendDisjoint hdisjRem pcRem pcAnchor
  have hU0 : remB ∪ p.support = H.B ∪ r.support := by
    simpa [union_comm] using hpc0supp
  let pc0 : PathCover G (H.B ∪ r.support) := pc0'.cast hU0
  have hcard0 : pc0.card = H.B.card - 1 := by
    have h2le : 2 ≤ H.B.card := hB2
    have hb2e : b2 ∈ H.B.erase b1 := mem_erase.2 ⟨hne.symm, hb2⟩
    have hremc : remB.card = H.B.card - 2 := by
      simp [remB, card_erase_of_mem hb2e, card_erase_of_mem hb1]
      omega
    have := PathCover.appendDisjoint_card hdisjRem pcRem pcAnchor
    have hA : pcAnchor.card = 1 := PathCover.ofSupport_card p rfl
    have hR : pcRem.card = remB.card := PathCover.singletons_card remB
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, this, hA, hR, hremc]
    omega
  have hterm0 : IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hs
    have : s ∈ pcRem.paths ∨ s ∈ pcAnchor.paths :=
      (PathCover.appendDisjoint_mem_iff hdisjRem pcRem pcAnchor).1 hs
    rcases this with h | h
    · exact htermR s h
    · exact htermA s h

  have hidxY : ∀ j : ℕ, j < H.d q - 1 → H.a q + 1 + j < pcY.card := by
    intro j hj
    have hck : pcY.card = H.k q := hYcard
    change pcY.card = H.a q + H.d q at hck
    omega
  let extra : ℕ → Finset V := fun t =>
    (Finset.range t).biUnion fun j =>
      if hj : j < H.d q - 1 then
        (pathAt pcY ⟨H.a q + 1 + j, hidxY j hj⟩).support
      else
        ∅
  have extra_zero : extra 0 = ∅ := by
    simp [extra]
  have extra_succ : ∀ t, extra (t + 1) =
      extra t ∪
        (if ht : t < H.d q - 1 then
          (pathAt pcY ⟨H.a q + 1 + t, hidxY t ht⟩).support
        else ∅) := by
    intro t
    ext x
    simp only [extra, mem_union, mem_biUnion, mem_range]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := hx
      have hsplit : j < t ∨ j = t := Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj
      rcases hsplit with hlt | rfl
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, hlt, hxj⟩
      · exact Or.inr hxj
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with ⟨j, hjt, hxj⟩ | hxj
      · exact ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hjt, hxj⟩
      · exact ⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_self t, hxj⟩
  have go :
      ∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ H.d q - 1),
        ∃ pc : PathCover G (H.B ∪ r.support ∪ extra t),
          pc.card = H.B.card - 1 - t ∧
            IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      intro _ht
      have hU : H.B ∪ r.support ∪ extra 0 = H.B ∪ r.support := by
        simp [extra_zero]
      refine ⟨pc0.cast hU.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [PathCover.cast_card]
        simpa only [Nat.sub_zero] using hcard0
      · intro s hs
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hs
        exact hterm0 s hs
    | succ t ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht)
      have htlt : t < H.d q - 1 := by omega
      have h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card := by
        have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := le_trans (by simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K] using H.hpK) hlo
        omega
      let block := pathAt pcY ⟨H.a q + 1 + t, hidxY t htlt⟩
      have hblockY : block.support ⊆ H.Y := pathAt_support_subset pcY _
      have hdisjU : Disjoint block.support (H.B ∪ r.support ∪ extra t) := by
        refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
        intro x hxb hxU
        have hxY : x ∈ H.Y := hblockY hxb
        rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxL | hxE
        · rcases mem_union.1 hxL with hxB | hxr
          · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjBY hxB hxY
          · rcases (hrmem x).1 hxr with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, hxj⟩
            · have hne : (⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 haY⟩ : Fin pcY.card) ≠
                  ⟨H.a q + 1 + t, hidxY t htlt⟩ := by
                intro h
                have : i.1 = H.a q + 1 + t := congrArg Fin.val h
                omega
              exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (pathAt_disjoint pcY hne) hxi hxb
            · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 H.hdisjWY
                (pathAt_support_subset pcW _ hxj) hxY
        · obtain ⟨j, hjrange, hxj⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 hxE
          have hjt : j < t := mem_range.mp hjrange
          have hjlt : j < H.d q - 1 := by omega
          have hxj' : x ∈ (pathAt pcY ⟨H.a q + 1 + j, hidxY j hjlt⟩).support := by
            simpa [extra, hjlt] using hxj
          have hne : (⟨H.a q + 1 + j, hidxY j hjlt⟩ : Fin pcY.card) ≠
              ⟨H.a q + 1 + t, hidxY t htlt⟩ := by
            intro h
            have : H.a q + 1 + j = H.a q + 1 + t := congrArg Fin.val h
            omega
          exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (pathAt_disjoint pcY hne) hxj' hxb
      obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hend1⟩ :=
        exists_splice_two_through_block H.hBYcomplete pc h2 hterm block hblockY hdisjU
      have hUeq : (H.B ∪ r.support ∪ extra t) ∪ block.support =
          H.B ∪ r.support ∪ extra (t + 1) := by
        have hif : (if ht' : t < H.d q - 1 then
            (pathAt pcY ⟨H.a q + 1 + t, hidxY t ht'⟩).support else ∅) =
            block.support := by
          simp [block, htlt]
        rw [extra_succ, hif, union_assoc]
      exact ⟨pc1.cast hUeq, by rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard1]; omega, by
        intro s hs
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hs
        exact hend1 s hs⟩
  obtain ⟨pcFin, hcardFin, htermFin⟩ := go (H.d q - 1) le_rfl
  have hUeqK : H.B ∪ r.support ∪ extra (H.d q - 1) = H.K := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxL | hxE
      · rcases mem_union.1 hxL with hxB | hxr
        · exact H.B_subset_K hxB
        · have : x ∈ H.W ∪ H.Y := hrsub hxr
          rcases mem_union.1 this with hW | hY
          · exact H.W_subset_K hW
          · exact H.Y_subset_K hY
      · obtain ⟨j, hjrange, hxj⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 hxE
        have hj : j < H.d q - 1 := mem_range.mp hjrange
        have hjlt : j < H.d q - 1 := hj
        have : x ∈ H.Y := pathAt_support_subset pcY _ (by
          simpa [extra, hjlt] using hxj)
        exact H.Y_subset_K this
    · intro hx
      have hx' : x ∈ H.B ∨ x ∈ H.W ∨ x ∈ H.Y := by
        simpa [NoBVJoinBase.K, mem_union, or_assoc] using hx
      rcases hx' with hxB | hxW | hxY
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxB)))
      · obtain ⟨pw, hpw, hxw⟩ := (pcW.mem_iff x).1 hxW
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := exists_pathAt pcW hpw
        have : x ∈ r.support :=
          (hrmem x).2 (Or.inr ⟨⟨j.1, by simpa [hWcard] using j.2⟩, by simpa using hxw⟩)
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr this)))
      · obtain ⟨py, hpy, hxy⟩ := (pcY.mem_iff x).1 hxY
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := exists_pathAt pcY hpy
        by_cases hi : i.1 < H.a q + 1
        · have : x ∈ r.support :=
            (hrmem x).2 (Or.inl ⟨⟨i.1, hi⟩, by simpa using hxy⟩)
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr this)))
        · have hge : H.a q + 1 ≤ i.1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hi
          have hj : i.1 - (H.a q + 1) < H.d q := by
            have : i.1 < pcY.card := i.2
            have : pcY.card = H.a q + H.d q := by
              simpa [NoBVJoinBase.k] using hYcard
            omega
          have hje : i.1 - (H.a q + 1) < H.d q - 1 ∨
              i.1 - (H.a q + 1) = H.d q - 1 := by omega
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          have hjlt : i.1 - (H.a q + 1) < H.d q - 1 := by
            have : i.1 < pcY.card := i.2
            have : pcY.card = H.a q + H.d q := by
              simpa [NoBVJoinBase.k] using hYcard
            have : i.1 ≤ H.a q + H.d q - 1 := by omega
            omega
          refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)
          refine mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i.1 - (H.a q + 1), mem_range.2 hjlt, ?_⟩
          have hjlt' : i.1 - (H.a q + 1) < H.d q - 1 := hjlt
          have hidx : H.a q + 1 + (i.1 - (H.a q + 1)) = i.1 := by omega
          have hfin : (⟨H.a q + 1 + (i.1 - (H.a q + 1)), hidxY _ hjlt'⟩ : Fin pcY.card) = i :=
            Fin.ext hidx
          have hxif : x ∈
              (if h : i.1 - (H.a q + 1) < H.d q - 1 then
                (pathAt pcY ⟨H.a q + 1 + (i.1 - (H.a q + 1)), hidxY _ h⟩).support
              else ∅) := by
            simp [hjlt', hfin]
            exact hxy
          simpa [extra] using hxif
  let pcK : PathCover G H.K := pcFin.cast hUeqK
  refine ⟨pcK, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcd : pcFin.card = q := by
      have : H.B.card - 1 - (H.d q - 1) = H.B.card - H.d q := by omega
      have : H.B.card - H.d q = q := by
        change H.B.card - (H.B.card - q) = q
        have hqB : q ≤ H.B.card := by omega
        omega
      omega
    change (pcFin.cast hUeqK).card = q
    rw [PathCover.cast_card]
    exact hcd
  · intro s hs
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hs
    exact htermFin s hs

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.exists_min_terminalCover_noBV
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_noBV :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G H.K ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:=
  H.exists_terminalCover_noBV_of_card le_rfl H.interval_nonempty

name: Nikoghosyan.NoBVJoinBase.exists_terminalCover_noBV_spectrum
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_noBV_spectrum {q : ℕ}
    (hlo : pathCoverNumber G H.K ≤ q)
    (hhi : q + pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.B.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = q ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:=
  H.exists_terminalCover_noBV_of_card hlo hhi

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_neighborRow
statement:
lemma mem_neighborRow {K B : Finset V} {b x : V} :
    x ∈ neighborRow (G := G) K B b ↔ x ∈ K \ B ∧ G.Adj b x
proof:
:=
  mem_filter

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_commonNeighborLayer
statement:
lemma mem_commonNeighborLayer {K B : Finset V} {v : V} :
    v ∈ commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B ↔
      v ∈ K \ B ∧ ∀ b ∈ B, G.Adj b v
proof:

name: Nikoghosyan.neighborRow_eq_filter
statement:
lemma neighborRow_eq_filter {K B : Finset V} {b : V} :

proof:
:=

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_nonterminal_adj
statement:
lemma exists_nonterminal_adj {K B : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hb : b ∈ B) (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty) :
    ∃ v ∈ K \ B, G.Adj b v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ := hVne
  have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hb
  have hv0K : v0 ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hv0).1
  have hne : b ≠ v0 := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 hv0).2 (h ▸ hb)
  have hpre : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Preconnected :=
    ((connected_iff _).1 hconn).1
  have hreach : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Reachable ⟨b, hbK⟩ ⟨v0, hv0K⟩ :=
    hpre ⟨b, hbK⟩ ⟨v0, hv0K⟩
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hreach
  cases p with
  | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
  | cons hadj q =>
      rename_i mid
      have hadjG : G.Adj b mid.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
      refine ⟨mid.val, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mid.property, ?_⟩, hadjG⟩
      exact hInd.not_mem_of_adj hb hadjG.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.neighborRow_nonempty
statement:
lemma neighborRow_nonempty {K B : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hb : b ∈ B) (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty) :
    (neighborRow (G := G) K B b).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hadj⟩ := exists_nonterminal_adj hconn hInd hBK hb hVne
  exact ⟨v, mem_filter.2 ⟨hv, hadj⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_neighborRow
statement:
lemma exists_min_neighborRow {K B : Finset V}
    (hK : IsCograph G K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hBne : B.Nonempty) :
    ∃ b0 ∈ B, ∀ b ∈ B,
      neighborRow (G := G) K B b0 ⊆ neighborRow (G := G) K B b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, hmin⟩ :=
    B.exists_min_image (fun b => (neighborRow (G := G) K B b).card) hBne
  refine ⟨b0, hb0, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  have hnest :=
    neighborSet_nested (G := G) hK hInd hBK hN hb0 hb
  rcases hnest with hle | hge
  · simpa [neighborRow] using hle
  · have hge' : neighborRow (G := G) K B b ⊆ neighborRow (G := G) K B b0 := by
      simpa [neighborRow] using hge
    have hcard := hmin b hb
    have heq := eq_of_subset_of_card_le hge' hcard
    exact heq.symm.subset

name: Nikoghosyan.commonNeighborLayer_nonempty
statement:
lemma commonNeighborLayer_nonempty {K B : Finset V}
    (hK : IsCograph G K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty) :
    (commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, hmin⟩ :=
    exists_min_neighborRow (G := G) hK hInd hBK hN hBne
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := neighborRow_nonempty (G := G) hconn hInd hBK hb0 hVne
  have hvKB : v ∈ K \ B := (mem_filter.1 hv).1
  have hall : ∀ b ∈ B, G.Adj b v := by
    intro b hb
    have hvb : v ∈ neighborRow (G := G) K B b := hmin b hb hv
    exact (mem_filter.1 hvb).2
  exact ⟨v, mem_filter.2 ⟨hvKB, hall⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.two_le_card_of_mixed
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hVne
  have hne : b ≠ v := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2 (h ▸ hb)
  have hpair : ({b, v} : Finset V) ⊆ K :=
    insert_subset (hBK hb) (singleton_subset_iff.2 (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1)
  have hcard2 : ({b, v} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem, card_singleton]
    simp [mem_singleton, hne]
  exact hcard2.symm.le.trans (card_le_card hpair)

:=

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.X_nonempty

proof: := H.hBne.mono H.B_subset_X

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.mem_Y
statement: lemma mem_Y {y : V} : y ∈ H.Y ↔ y ∈ H.K \ H.B ∧ ∀ b ∈ H.B, G.Adj b y

:=

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.adj_B_Y
statement: lemma adj_B_Y {b y : V} (hb : b ∈ H.B) (hy : y ∈ H.Y) : G.Adj b y

:=

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.complete_X_Y
statement: lemma complete_X_Y : G.IsCompleteBetween (H.X : Set V) (H.Y : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  have hyY : y ∈ H.K \ H.B := (H.mem_Y.1 hy).1
  have hall : ∀ b ∈ H.B, G.Adj b y := (H.mem_Y.1 hy).2
  have hxK : x ∈ H.K := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
  have hxnotY : x ∉ H.Y := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
  by_cases hxB : x ∈ H.B
  · exact hall x hxB
  · have hxKB : x ∈ H.K \ H.B := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxK, hxB⟩
    have hnotall : ¬ ∀ b ∈ H.B, G.Adj b x := by
      intro hallx
      exact hxnotY (mem_filter.2 ⟨hxKB, hallx⟩)
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hnbx⟩ : ∃ b ∈ H.B, ¬ G.Adj b x := by
      by_contra hnone
      refine hnotall ?_
      intro b hb
      by_contra hnb
      exact hnone ⟨b, hb, hnb⟩
    have hyb : G.Adj b y := hall b hb
    exact (H.hN hb hyY hxKB hyb hnbx).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.W_eq
statement: lemma W_eq : H.X \ H.B = (H.K \ H.B) \ H.Y
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have hwX := mem_sdiff.1 hw
    have hwK := mem_sdiff.1 hwX.1
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hwK.1, hwX.2⟩, hwK.2⟩
  · intro hw
    have hwKB := mem_sdiff.1 hw
    have hwK := mem_sdiff.1 hwKB.1
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hwK.1, hwKB.2⟩, hwK.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.two_le_card
statement: lemma two_le_card : 2 ≤ H.K.card
proof:
:=
  two_le_card_of_mixed H.hBK H.hBne H.hVne

:=
  IsCograph.subset (G := G) H.hcog sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.Y_cograph

proof:
:=

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.card_X_lt
statement: lemma card_X_lt : H.X.card < H.K.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H.hYne
  have hyK : y ∈ H.K := H.Y_subset_K hy
  have hyX : y ∉ H.X := fun hX => (mem_sdiff.1 hX).2 hy
  have hlt : (H.K.erase y).card < H.K.card := card_erase_lt_of_mem hyK
  have hsub : H.X ⊆ H.K.erase y := by
    intro x hx
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => hyX (h ▸ hx), (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1⟩
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans_lt hlt

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.slack_X
statement:
lemma slack_X :
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) H.X H.B H.Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have hunion : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.K := H.union_X_Y
  simpa [hunion] using
    terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child_of_terminal
      (G := G) H.hYne H.disjoint_X_Y H.B_subset_X
      (by simpa [hunion] using H.hTH)

name: Nikoghosyan.NeighborCondition.restrict_of_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro b v w hb hv hw hbv hbw
  have hvK : v ∈ K \ B :=
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hX (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2⟩
  have hwK : w ∈ K \ B :=
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hX (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hw).2⟩
  exact hN hb hvK hwK hbv hbw

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.hN_X
statement: lemma hN_X : NeighborCondition (G := G) H.X H.B
proof:
:=
  NeighborCondition.restrict_of_subset H.hN sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.union_B_W_Y

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.toNoBVJoinBase_K
statement:
lemma toNoBVJoinBase_K
    (hanti : ∀ b ∈ H.B, ∀ w ∈ H.X \ H.B, ¬ G.Adj b w)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K) :
    (H.toNoBVJoinBase hanti hpK).K = H.K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [NoBVJoinBase.K, CanonicalJoinSplit.toNoBVJoinBase]
  exact H.union_B_W_Y

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.exists_min_terminalCover_noBV
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_noBV
    (hanti : ∀ b ∈ H.B, ∀ w ∈ H.X \ H.B, ¬ G.Adj b w)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G H.K ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:= by
  let H0 := H.toNoBVJoinBase hanti hpK
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := H0.exists_min_terminalCover_noBV
  have hKeq : H0.K = H.K := H.toNoBVJoinBase_K hanti hpK
  refine ⟨pc.cast hKeq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard]
    exact congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hKeq
  · intro p hp
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc hKeq] at hp
    exact hterm p hp

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.exists_terminalCover_noBV_spectrum
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_noBV_spectrum {q : ℕ}
    (hanti : ∀ b ∈ H.B, ∀ w ∈ H.X \ H.B, ¬ G.Adj b w)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hlo : pathCoverNumber G H.K ≤ q)
    (hhi : q + pathCoverNumber G (H.K \ H.B) ≤ H.B.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = q ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:= by
  let H0 := H.toNoBVJoinBase hanti hpK
  have hKeq : H0.K = H.K := H.toNoBVJoinBase_K hanti hpK
  have hBeq : H0.B = H.B := by
    dsimp [H0]
    rfl
  have hKsdiff : H0.K \ H0.B = H.K \ H.B := by
    rw [hKeq, hBeq]
  have hlo' : pathCoverNumber G H0.K ≤ q := by
    rwa [hKeq]
  have hhi' : q + pathCoverNumber G (H0.K \ H0.B) ≤ H0.B.card := by
    rw [hKsdiff]
    exact hhi
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := H0.exists_terminalCover_noBV_spectrum hlo' hhi'
  refine ⟨pc.cast hKeq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_card]
    exact hcard
  · intro p hp
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc hKeq] at hp
    exact hterm p hp

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_empty_eq_zero_of_BV
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_empty_eq_zero_of_BV
    {b w : V} (hb : b ∈ H.B) (hw : w ∈ H.X \ H.B) (hadj : G.Adj b w) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.X H.B ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hBKX : H.B ⊆ H.X := H.B_subset_X
  have hwX : w ∈ H.X := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
  have hwX0 : w ∈ H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simp [hwX]
  have hbX0 : b ∈ H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simp [hBKX hb]
  have hsub : H.X ⊆ H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simp
  haveI : Fintype
      { C : (G.induce ((H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        IsFreeComponent (G := G) H.X H.B ∅ C } := inferInstance
  unfold terminalComponentCount
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  refine Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.2 ⟨fun C => ?_⟩
  have hfree : IsFreeComponent (G := G) H.X H.B ∅ C.1 := C.2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := componentFinset_nonempty (G := G) C.1
  have hxX0 : x ∈ H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) := (mem_filter.1 hx).1
  have hxX : x ∈ H.X := by simpa using hxX0
  have hxnotB : x ∉ H.B := by
    intro hB
    have : x ∈ componentFinset G (H.X \ (∅ : Finset V)) C.1 ∩
        (H.B \ (∅ : Finset V)) :=
      mem_inter.2 ⟨hx, by simpa using hB⟩
    exact (notMem_empty x (hfree ▸ this))
  have hxXB : x ∈ H.X \ H.B := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxX, hxnotB⟩
  have hreachX :
      (G.induce (H.X : Set V)).Reachable ⟨w, hwX⟩ ⟨x, hxX⟩ :=
    reachable_all_nonterminals_of_neighbor (G := G) H.hN_X hBKX hb hw hxXB hadj
  have hreach :
      (G.induce ((H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨w, hwX0⟩ ⟨x, hxX0⟩ :=
    hreachX.map (induceIncl G hsub)
  have hxC := connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hx
  have hCw :
      (G.induce ((H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨w, hwX0⟩ = C.1 :=
    (ConnectedComponent.eq.2 hreach).trans hxC
  have hadj' :
      (G.induce ((H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).Adj
        ⟨b, hbX0⟩ ⟨w, hwX0⟩ := by
    simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
  have hbMk :
      (G.induce ((H.X \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨b, hbX0⟩ = C.1 :=
    (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj').trans hCw
  have hbC : b ∈ componentFinset G (H.X \ (∅ : Finset V)) C.1 :=
    mem_filter.2 ⟨hbX0, ⟨hbX0, hbMk⟩⟩
  have hbB0 : b ∈ H.B \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simpa using hb
  exact (notMem_empty b (hfree ▸ mem_inter.2 ⟨hbC, hbB0⟩))

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.exists_mixedSplit_child
statement:
lemma exists_mixedSplit_child
    (hBV : ∃ b ∈ H.B, ∃ w ∈ H.X \ H.B, G.Adj b w) :
    Nonempty (MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, w, hw, hadj⟩ := hBV
  have hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.X H.B ∅ = 0 :=
    H.terminalComponentCount_empty_eq_zero_of_BV hb hw hadj
  have hVne : (H.X \ H.B).Nonempty := ⟨w, hw⟩
  exact exists_mixedSplit (G := G) H.B_subset_X H.hN_X hz hVne

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.slack_restrict_mixed
statement:
lemma slack_restrict_mixed
    {D : Finset V} (hD : D ⊆ H.X) (hI : H.X \ D ⊆ H.B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ i ∈ H.X \ D, ¬ G.Adj a i) :
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) D (H.B ∩ D) H.Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have hslack := H.slack_X
  constructor
  · have h := hslack.1
    simpa [terminalComponentCount_mixed (G := G) (S := (∅ : Finset V))
      H.B_subset_X hD (empty_subset D) hI hnocross] using h
  · intro S hS hSne
    have hz := hslack.2 S (hS.trans hD) hSne
    simpa [terminalComponentCount_mixed (G := G) H.B_subset_X hD hS hI hnocross]
      using hz

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.slack_mixed_component
statement:
lemma slack_mixed_component (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) s.D (H.B ∩ s.D) H.Y.card
proof:
:=
  H.slack_restrict_mixed s.hDsub
    (by simpa [s.I_eq] using s.hI)
    (by simpa [s.I_eq] using s.hnocross)

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.complete_D_Y
statement:
lemma complete_D_Y (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween (s.D : Set V) (H.Y : Set V)
proof:
:=
  IsCompleteBetween.mono H.complete_X_Y s.hDsub subset_rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.I_subset_X
statement: lemma I_subset_X (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) : s.I ⊆ H.X
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have : i ∈ s.D ∪ s.I := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hi)
  rwa [s.hDU] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.complete_I_Y
statement:
lemma complete_I_Y (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween (s.I : Set V) (H.Y : Set V)
proof:
:=
  IsCompleteBetween.mono H.complete_X_Y (H.I_subset_X s) subset_rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_Bprofile
statement:
lemma mem_Bprofile {B : Finset V} {b v : V} :
    b ∈ Bprofile (G := G) B v ↔ b ∈ B ∧ G.Adj b v
proof:
:=
  mem_filter

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_of_Bprofile_ne
statement:
lemma adj_of_Bprofile_ne {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {v w : V} (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hw : w ∈ K \ B)
    (hne : Bprofile (G := G) B v ≠ Bprofile (G := G) B w) :
    G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsub : Bprofile (G := G) B v ⊆ Bprofile (G := G) B w
  · have hnot : ¬ Bprofile (G := G) B w ⊆ Bprofile (G := G) B v := by
      intro hge
      exact hne (Subset.antisymm hsub hge)
    obtain ⟨b, hbw, hbv⟩ := not_subset.1 hnot
    have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_filter.1 hbw).1
    have hadj : G.Adj b w := (mem_filter.1 hbw).2
    have hnbv : ¬ G.Adj b v := fun h => hbv (mem_filter.2 ⟨hbB, h⟩)
    exact (hN hbB hw hv hadj hnbv).symm
  · obtain ⟨b, hbv, hbw⟩ := not_subset.1 hsub
    have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_filter.1 hbv).1
    have hadj : G.Adj b v := (mem_filter.1 hbv).2
    have hnbw : ¬ G.Adj b w := fun h => hbw (mem_filter.2 ⟨hbB, h⟩)
    exact hN hbB hv hw hadj hnbw

name: Nikoghosyan.Bprofile_nested
statement:
lemma Bprofile_nested {K B : Finset V}
    (hK : IsCograph G K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {v w : V} (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hw : w ∈ K \ B) :
    Bprofile (G := G) B v ⊆ Bprofile (G := G) B w ∨
      Bprofile (G := G) B w ⊆ Bprofile (G := G) B v
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h1 : ¬ Bprofile (G := G) B v ⊆ Bprofile (G := G) B w :=
    fun hst => h (Or.inl hst)
  have h2 : ¬ Bprofile (G := G) B w ⊆ Bprofile (G := G) B v :=
    fun hts => h (Or.inr hts)
  obtain ⟨b, hbv, hbw⟩ := not_subset.1 h1
  obtain ⟨b', hbw', hbv'⟩ := not_subset.1 h2
  have hb : b ∈ B := (mem_filter.1 hbv).1
  have hb' : b' ∈ B := (mem_filter.1 hbw').1
  have hbvA : G.Adj b v := (mem_filter.1 hbv).2
  have hnbw : ¬ G.Adj b w := fun h => hbw (mem_filter.2 ⟨hb, h⟩)
  have hb'wA : G.Adj b' w := (mem_filter.1 hbw').2
  have hnb'v : ¬ G.Adj b' v := fun h => hbv' (mem_filter.2 ⟨hb', h⟩)
  exact not_incomparable_B_neighbors (G := G) hK hInd hBK hN hb hb'
    hv hw hbvA hnb'v hb'wA hnbw

name: Nikoghosyan.isCompleteBetween_of_Bprofile_ne
statement:
lemma isCompleteBetween_of_Bprofile_ne {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {P Q : Finset V} (hne : P ≠ Q) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween
      (((K \ B).filter (fun v => Bprofile (G := G) B v = P) : Finset V) : Set V)
      (((K \ B).filter (fun v => Bprofile (G := G) B v = Q) : Finset V) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv w hw
  have hvKB : v ∈ K \ B := (mem_filter.1 hv).1
  have hwKB : w ∈ K \ B := (mem_filter.1 hw).1
  have hPv : Bprofile (G := G) B v = P := (mem_filter.1 hv).2
  have hQw : Bprofile (G := G) B w = Q := (mem_filter.1 hw).2
  have hne' : Bprofile (G := G) B v ≠ Bprofile (G := G) B w := by
    simpa [hPv, hQw] using hne
  exact adj_of_Bprofile_ne (G := G) hN hvKB hwKB hne'

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_canonicalJoinSplit
statement:
lemma exists_canonicalJoinSplit {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty) :
    Nonempty (CanonicalJoinSplit (G := G))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨K, B, hrep, hconn, hBne, hVne⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_canonical_noBV
statement:
theorem exists_min_terminalCover_of_canonical_noBV {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty)
    (hnoBV : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ (K \ commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B) \ B,
      ¬ G.Adj b w) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  let H : CanonicalJoinSplit (G := G) := ⟨K, B, hrep, hconn, hBne, hVne⟩
  have hanti : ∀ b ∈ H.B, ∀ w ∈ H.X \ H.B, ¬ G.Adj b w := by
    intro b hb w hw
    have : H.X = K \ commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B := rfl
    simpa [this] using hnoBV b hb w hw
  by_cases hp : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K
  · exact H.exists_min_terminalCover_noBV hanti hp
  · have hp1 : pathCoverNumber G K = 1 := by
      have hpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K :=
        one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G)
          (hBne.mono hrep.2.1)
      omega
    exact exists_min_terminalCover_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
      (two_le_card_of_mixed hrep.2.1 hBne hVne) hrep.1 hconn hp1
      hrep.2.1 hBne hrep.2.2.2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_of_canonical_noBV_spectrum
statement:
theorem exists_terminalCover_of_canonical_noBV_spectrum {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hconn : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty)
    (hnoBV : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ w ∈ (K \ commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B) \ B,
      ¬ G.Adj b w)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K)
    {q : ℕ} (hlo : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ q)
    (hhi : q + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = q ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  let H : CanonicalJoinSplit (G := G) := ⟨K, B, hrep, hconn, hBne, hVne⟩
  have hanti : ∀ b ∈ H.B, ∀ w ∈ H.X \ H.B, ¬ G.Adj b w := by
    intro b hb w hw
    have : H.X = K \ commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B := rfl
    simpa [this] using hnoBV b hb w hw
  exact H.exists_terminalCover_noBV_spectrum hanti hpK hlo hhi

name: Nikoghosyan.componentFinset_subset
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_componentFinset_self
statement:
lemma mem_componentFinset_self {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    x ∈ componentFinset G U
      ((G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:=
  mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.componentFinset_nonempty
proof:
:=
  C.ind fun z => ⟨z.1, mem_filter.2 ⟨z.2, ⟨z.2, rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.induce_walk_mem_componentFinset
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact hx
  | cons hadj q =>
      rename_i mid
      have hadjG : G.Adj x.val mid.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
      have hmid := adj_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hx mid.property hadjG
      exact induce_walk_mem_componentFinset q hmid

name: Nikoghosyan.induce_reachable_of_mem_componentFinset_walk
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact Reachable.rfl
  | cons hadj q =>
      rename_i mid
      have hadjG : G.Adj x.val mid.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
      have hmidD := adj_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hxD mid.property hadjG
      have hfirst :
          (G.induce (componentFinset G U C : Set V)).Adj
            ⟨x.val, hxD⟩ ⟨mid.val, hmidD⟩ := by
        simpa [induce_adj] using hadjG
      exact (Adj.reachable hfirst).trans
        (induce_reachable_of_mem_componentFinset_walk hmidD hyD q)

name: Nikoghosyan.connected_componentFinset
proof:
:= by
  let D := componentFinset G U C
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := componentFinset_nonempty (G := G) C
  have hpre : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Preconnected := by
    intro x y
    have hxU : x.val ∈ U := (componentFinset_subset (G := G) C) x.property
    have hyU : y.val ∈ U := (componentFinset_subset (G := G) C) y.property
    have hxC :=
      connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) x.property
    have hyC :=
      connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) y.property
    have hreach :
        (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x.val, hxU⟩ ⟨y.val, hyU⟩ :=
      ConnectedComponent.exact (hxC.trans hyC.symm)
    exact induce_reachable_of_mem_componentFinset_walk
      (G := G) x.property y.property (Classical.choice hreach)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hDne
  exact (connected_iff _).2 ⟨hpre, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_free_of_terminalComponentCount_empty
statement:
lemma not_free_of_terminalComponentCount_empty {K B : Finset V}
    (hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ = 0)
    (C : (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    ¬ IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B ∅ C
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fintype
      { C : (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B ∅ C } := inferInstance
  have hcard : Fintype.card
      { C : (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B ∅ C } = 0 := by
    simpa [terminalComponentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hz
  have hE : IsEmpty
      { C : (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B ∅ C } :=
    Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.1 hcard
  intro hC
  exact hE.false ⟨C, hC⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_BV_edge_of_induce_walk
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact (hxB hyB).elim
  | cons hadj q =>
      rename_i mid
      by_cases hm : mid.val ∈ B
      · refine ⟨mid.val, x.val, hm, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨x.property, hxB⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa [induce_adj] using hadj.symm
      · exact exists_BV_edge_of_induce_walk q hm hyB

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_BV_edge_of_z_zero
statement:
lemma exists_BV_edge_of_z_zero {K B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ = 0)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ K \ B) :
    ∃ b w, b ∈ B ∧ w ∈ K \ B ∧ G.Adj b w
proof:
:= by
  have hvK : v ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hvB : v ∉ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2
  have hvKS : v ∈ K \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simp [hvK]
  let C := (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
    ⟨v, hvKS⟩
  have hnot := not_free_of_terminalComponentCount_empty hz C
  obtain ⟨b, hbint⟩ := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hnot
  have hbC : b ∈ componentFinset G (K \ (∅ : Finset V)) C :=
    (mem_inter.1 hbint).1
  have hbB : b ∈ B := by
    have : b ∈ B \ (∅ : Finset V) := (mem_inter.1 hbint).2
    simpa using this
  have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hbB
  have hbKS : b ∈ K \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simp [hbK]
  have hvMk :
      (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨v, hvKS⟩ = C := rfl
  have hbMk :=
    connectedComponentMk_eq_of_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hbC
  have hreach0 :
      (G.induce ((K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨v, hvKS⟩ ⟨b, hbKS⟩ :=
    ConnectedComponent.exact (hvMk.trans hbMk.symm)
  have hsub : K \ (∅ : Finset V) ⊆ K := sdiff_subset
  have hreach :
      (G.induce (K : Set V)).Reachable ⟨v, hvK⟩ ⟨b, hbK⟩ :=
    hreach0.map (induceIncl G hsub)
  exact exists_BV_edge_of_induce_walk (Classical.choice hreach) hvB hbB

name: Nikoghosyan.MixedSplit.I_eq
statement: lemma I_eq : s.I = K \ s.D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := by
      have : x ∈ s.D ∪ s.I := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hx)
      rwa [s.hDU] at this
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxK, fun hD => Finset.disjoint_left.1 s.hdisj hD hx⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxD : x ∉ s.D := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have hxDI : x ∈ s.D ∪ s.I := by
      rw [s.hDU]
      exact hxK
    rcases mem_union.1 hxDI with hD | hI
    · exact (hxD hD).elim
    · exact hI

name: Nikoghosyan.MixedSplit.D_sdiff_Bd
statement: lemma D_sdiff_Bd : s.D \ (B ∩ s.D) = s.D \ B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxD := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxBd := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxD, fun hB => hxBd (mem_inter.2 ⟨hB, hxD⟩)⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxD := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxB := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxD, fun hBd => hxB (mem_inter.1 hBd).1⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.MixedSplit.two_le_card_D
statement: lemma two_le_card_D : 2 ≤ s.D.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := s.hBd
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := s.hnonterm
  have hbD : b ∈ s.D := (mem_inter.1 hb).2
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_inter.1 hb).1
  have hvD : v ∈ s.D := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hvB : v ∉ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2
  have hne : b ≠ v := fun h => hvB (h ▸ hbB)
  have hpair : ({b, v} : Finset V) ⊆ s.D :=
    insert_subset hbD (singleton_subset_iff.2 hvD)
  have hcard2 : ({b, v} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem, card_singleton]
    simp [mem_singleton, hne]
  exact hcard2.symm.le.trans (card_le_card hpair)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_mixedSplit
statement:
lemma exists_mixedSplit {K B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    (hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B ∅ = 0)
    (hVne : (K \ B).Nonempty) :
    Nonempty (MixedSplit (G := G) K B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ := hVne
  obtain ⟨b, w, hb, hw, hadj⟩ :=
    exists_BV_edge_of_z_zero (G := G) hBK hz hv0
  have hwK : w ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
  let C := (G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨w, hwK⟩
  let D := componentFinset G K C
  let I := K \ D
  have hDsub : D ⊆ K := componentFinset_subset (G := G) C
  have hDU : D ∪ I = K := union_sdiff_of_subset hDsub
  have hdisj : Disjoint D I := disjoint_sdiff
  have hV : K \ B ⊆ D := sdiff_subset_mixed_component hN hBK hb hw hadj
  have hI : I ⊆ B := sdiff_mixed_component_subset_B hN hBK hb hw hadj
  have hbD : b ∈ D :=
    mem_componentFinset_of_adj_B (G := G) (hBK hb) hwK hadj
  have hBd : (B ∩ D).Nonempty := ⟨b, mem_inter.2 ⟨hb, hbD⟩⟩
  have hwD : w ∈ D := mem_componentFinset_self (G := G) hwK
  have hnonterm : (D \ B).Nonempty :=
    ⟨w, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hwD, (mem_sdiff.1 hw).2⟩⟩
  have hconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected :=
    connected_componentFinset (G := G) C
  have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ G.Adj a i := by
    intro a ha i hi
    have hiK : i ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hi).1
    have hiD : i ∉ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hi).2
    exact no_cross_mixed_component (G := G) ha hiK hiD
  exact ⟨⟨D, I, hDU, hdisj, hI, hV, hDsub, hnonterm, hBd, hconn, hnocross⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.NeighborCondition.restrict_inter
proof:
:= by
  intro b v w hb hv hw hbv hbw
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_inter.1 hb).1
  have hvK : v ∈ K \ B := by
    have hvD := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
    have hvBd := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2
    have hvB : v ∉ B := fun hB => hvBd (mem_inter.2 ⟨hB, hvD⟩)
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hD hvD, hvB⟩
  have hwK : w ∈ K \ B := by
    have hwD := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
    have hwBd := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).2
    have hwB : w ∉ B := fun hB => hwBd (mem_inter.2 ⟨hB, hwD⟩)
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hD hwD, hwB⟩
  exact hN hbB hvK hwK hbv hbw

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_eq_sdiff_union_compl
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    by_cases hDx : x ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hDx, hx.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx.1, hDx⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with h | h
    · exact ⟨hD h.1, h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨h.1, fun hS' => h.2 (hS hS')⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.B_sdiff_eq_inter_union_compl
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_inter]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hBK hx.1
    by_cases hDx : x ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hx.1, hDx⟩, hx.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxK, hDx⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with h | h
    · exact ⟨h.1.1, h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hI (mem_sdiff.2 h), fun hS' => h.2 (hS hS')⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.no_cross_sdiff_compl
statement:
lemma no_cross_sdiff_compl {K D S : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ K \ D, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hS : S ⊆ D) :
    ∀ a ∈ D \ S, ∀ b ∈ K \ D, ¬ G.Adj a b
proof:
:=
  fun a ha b hb => hnocross a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 b hb

name: Nikoghosyan.induceIncl_union_left_apply
statement:
lemma induceIncl_union_left_apply {A J : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hxA : x ∈ A) :
    induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J)) ⟨x, hxA⟩ =
      ⟨x, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.mixMap_eq_mk
statement:
lemma mixMap_eq_mk {A J : Finset V} {x : V} (hxA : x ∈ A) :
    ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxA⟩).map
        (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J))) =
      (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConnectedComponent.map_mk, induceIncl_union_left_apply]

name: Nikoghosyan.mixMap_injective
statement:
lemma mixMap_injective {A J : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ J, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent =>
        C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J))))
proof:
:= by
  intro C D hCD
  revert hCD
  refine C.ind fun u => ?_
  refine D.ind fun v => ?_
  intro hCD
  have hCD' :
      (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J)) u) =
        (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J)) v) := by
    simpa [ConnectedComponent.map_mk] using hCD
  have hreach := ConnectedComponent.eq.mp hCD'
  exact ConnectedComponent.sound
    (Cograph.induce_reachable_of_mem_left (G := G) hnocross
      u.property v.property hreach)

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_componentFinset_map_iff
statement:
lemma mem_componentFinset_map_iff {A J : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ J, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) {x : V}
    (hxA : x ∈ A) :
    x ∈ componentFinset G (A ∪ J)
        (C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J)))) ↔
      x ∈ componentFinset G A C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hxU0, hxC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
    have hL :
        ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxA⟩).map
            (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J))) =
          C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J))) := by
      rw [mixMap_eq_mk]
      have : (⟨x, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)⟩ :
          ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)) = ⟨x, hxU0⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
      simpa [this] using hxC
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hxA, ⟨hxA, mixMap_injective (G := G) hnocross hL⟩⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨_, hxC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
    have hxU : x ∈ A ∪ J := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨hxU, ⟨hxU, ?_⟩⟩
    have hmap := mixMap_eq_mk (G := G) (J := J) hxA
    rw [hxC] at hmap
    have : (⟨x, hxU⟩ : ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)) =
        ⟨x, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
    exact this ▸ hmap.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.componentFinset_map_subset_left
statement:
lemma componentFinset_map_subset_left {A J : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ J, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentFinset G (A ∪ J)
        (C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))) ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxU : x ∈ A ∪ J := (mem_filter.1 hx).1
  obtain ⟨z, hzA, hzC⟩ :
      ∃ (z : V) (hzA : z ∈ A),
        (G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z, hzA⟩ = C :=
    C.ind fun t => ⟨t.1, t.2, rfl⟩
  have hzU : z ∈ A ∪ J := mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA)
  obtain ⟨_, hxC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hzMk :
      (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨z, hzU⟩ =
        C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J))) := by
    have hmap := mixMap_eq_mk (G := G) (J := J) hzA
    rw [hzC] at hmap
    have : (⟨z, hzU⟩ : ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)) =
        ⟨z, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA)⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
    exact this ▸ hmap.symm
  have hreach :
      (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable ⟨z, hzU⟩ ⟨x, hxU⟩ :=
    ConnectedComponent.exact (hzMk.trans hxC.symm)
  exact Cograph.mem_left_of_induce_reachable (G := G) hnocross hzA hreach

name: Nikoghosyan.componentFinset_map_inter_left
statement:
lemma componentFinset_map_inter_left {A J T : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ J, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentFinset G (A ∪ J)
        (C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))) ∩ T =
      componentFinset G A C ∩ T
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxC := (mem_inter.1 hx).1
    have hxT := (mem_inter.1 hx).2
    have hxA : x ∈ A := componentFinset_map_subset_left (G := G) hnocross C hxC
    have hxCA : x ∈ componentFinset G A C :=
      (mem_componentFinset_map_iff (G := G) hnocross C hxA).1 hxC
    exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hxCA, hxT⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxCA := (mem_inter.1 hx).1
    have hxT := (mem_inter.1 hx).2
    have hxA : x ∈ A := (mem_filter.1 hxCA).1
    have hxC : x ∈ componentFinset G (A ∪ J)
        (C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))) :=
      (mem_componentFinset_map_iff (G := G) hnocross C hxA).2 hxCA
    exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hxC, hxT⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_mem_A_of_free_union
statement:
lemma exists_mem_A_of_free_union {A J T : Finset V}
    (hJ : J ⊆ T)
    (C' : (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent)
    (hfree : componentFinset G (A ∪ J) C' ∩ T = ∅) :
    ∃ (x : V) (hxA : x ∈ A),
      (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨x, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)⟩ = C'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxMk⟩ :
      ∃ (x : V) (hxU : x ∈ A ∪ J),
        (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨x, hxU⟩ = C' :=
    C'.ind fun t => ⟨t.1, t.2, rfl⟩
  have hxT : x ∉ T := by
    intro hxT
    have : x ∈ componentFinset G (A ∪ J) C' ∩ T :=
      mem_inter.2 ⟨mem_filter.2 ⟨hxU, ⟨hxU, hxMk⟩⟩, hxT⟩
    exact (notMem_empty x (hfree ▸ this))
  have hxJ : x ∉ J := fun hJ' => hxT (hJ hJ')
  have hxA : x ∈ A := (mem_union.1 hxU).resolve_right hxJ
  refine ⟨x, hxA, ?_⟩
  have : (⟨x, hxU⟩ : ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)) =
      ⟨x, mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
  simpa [this] using hxMk

name: Nikoghosyan.ncard_free_union_isolates
statement:
lemma ncard_free_union_isolates {A J T : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ J, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hJ : J ⊆ T) :
    Nat.card { C : (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        componentFinset G (A ∪ J) C ∩ T = ∅ } =
      Nat.card { C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        componentFinset G A C ∩ T = ∅ }
proof:
:= by
  let f : { C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        componentFinset G A C ∩ T = ∅ } →
      { C : (G.induce ((A ∪ J : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        componentFinset G (A ∪ J) C ∩ T = ∅ } :=
    fun C =>
      ⟨C.1.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A))), by
        have h := componentFinset_map_inter_left (G := G) (T := T) hnocross C.1
        simpa [h] using C.2⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro C D hCD
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact mixMap_injective (G := G) hnocross (Subtype.ext_iff.1 hCD)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro C'
    obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxMk⟩ :=
      exists_mem_A_of_free_union (G := G) hJ C'.1 C'.2
    let C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
      (G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hxA⟩
    have hmapEq :
        C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J))) = C'.1 :=
      (mixMap_eq_mk (G := G) (J := J) hxA).trans hxMk
    have hfree : componentFinset G A C ∩ T = ∅ := by
      apply eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
      intro y hy
      have hyA := (mem_filter.1 (mem_inter.1 hy).1).1
      have hyT := (mem_inter.1 hy).2
      have hyMap :
          y ∈ componentFinset G (A ∪ J)
            (C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := J)))) :=
        (mem_componentFinset_map_iff (G := G) hnocross C hyA).2
          (mem_inter.1 hy).1
      have : y ∈ componentFinset G (A ∪ J) C'.1 ∩ T := by
        rw [hmapEq] at hyMap
        exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hyMap, hyT⟩
      exact (notMem_empty y (C'.2 ▸ this))
    refine ⟨⟨C, hfree⟩, Subtype.ext hmapEq⟩
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.T_inter_A_of_sdiff
statement:
lemma T_inter_A_of_sdiff {D B S : Finset V} :
    ((B \ S) ∩ (D \ S)) = (B ∩ D) \ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_sdiff, mem_inter]
  tauto

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_mixed
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_mixed {K D B S : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hD : D ⊆ K) (hS : S ⊆ D)
    (hI : K \ D ⊆ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ K \ D, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S =
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) D (B ∩ D) S
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : K \ S = (D \ S) ∪ (K \ D) := sdiff_eq_sdiff_union_compl hD hS
  have hnc := no_cross_sdiff_compl hnocross hS
  have hJ : K \ D ⊆ B \ S := by
    intro x hx
    have hxKD := mem_sdiff.1 hx
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hI hx, fun hSx => hxKD.2 (hS hSx)⟩
  unfold terminalComponentCount IsFreeComponent
  
  have h1 :
      Nat.card { C : (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
          componentFinset G (K \ S) C ∩ (B \ S) = ∅ } =
        Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce (((D \ S) ∪ (K \ D) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G ((D \ S) ∪ (K \ D)) C ∩ (B \ S) = ∅ } := by
    rw [hEq]
  have h2 :=
    ncard_free_union_isolates (G := G) (A := D \ S) (J := K \ D)
      (T := B \ S) hnc hJ
  have h3 :
      Nat.card { C : (G.induce ((D \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
          componentFinset G (D \ S) C ∩ (B \ S) = ∅ } =
        Nat.card { C : (G.induce ((D \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
          componentFinset G (D \ S) C ∩ ((B ∩ D) \ S) = ∅ } := by
    have hinter : ∀ C,
        componentFinset G (D \ S) C ∩ (B \ S) =
          componentFinset G (D \ S) C ∩ ((B ∩ D) \ S) := by
      intro C
      have hsub : componentFinset G (D \ S) C ⊆ D \ S :=
        componentFinset_subset (G := G) C
      ext x
      simp only [mem_inter]
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hxC := hx.1
        have hxB := hx.2
        have hxDS : x ∈ D \ S := hsub hxC
        have hxBd : x ∈ (B ∩ D) \ S := by
          have : x ∈ (B \ S) ∩ (D \ S) := mem_inter.2 ⟨hxB, hxDS⟩
          simpa [T_inter_A_of_sdiff] using this
        exact ⟨hxC, hxBd⟩
      · intro hx
        have hxC := hx.1
        have hxBd := hx.2
        have hxB : x ∈ B \ S :=
          mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_inter.1 (mem_sdiff.1 hxBd).1).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hxBd).2⟩
        exact ⟨hxC, hxB⟩
    refine Nat.card_congr ?_
    refine Equiv.subtypeEquiv (Equiv.refl _) ?_
    intro C
    simp [hinter C]
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: Nikoghosyan.TerminalHypothesis.restrict_mixed
statement:
lemma TerminalHypothesis.restrict_mixed {K D B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hD : D ⊆ K) (hI : K \ D ⊆ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ K \ D, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B) :
    TerminalHypothesis (G := G) D (B ∩ D)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := hTH.1
    simpa [terminalComponentCount_mixed (S := (∅ : Finset V)) hBK hD
      (empty_subset D) hI hnocross] using h
  · intro S hS hSne
    have hz := hTH.2 S (hS.trans hD) hSne
    simpa [terminalComponentCount_mixed hBK hD hS hI hnocross] using hz

name: Nikoghosyan.repairedTerminalHypothesis_mixed
statement:
lemma repairedTerminalHypothesis_mixed {K D B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hD : D ⊆ K) (hI : K \ D ⊆ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ K \ D, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBd : (B ∩ D).Nonempty) :
    RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) D (B ∩ D)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrep with ⟨hcog, hBK, hInd, hTH, hN⟩
  refine ⟨fun a b c d ha hb hc hd => hcog (hD ha) (hD hb) (hD hc) (hD hd),
    inter_subset_right, hInd.mono inter_subset_left,
    TerminalHypothesis.restrict_mixed hBK hD hI hnocross hTH,
    NeighborCondition.restrict_inter hN hD⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_mixed_traceable
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_of_mixed_traceable {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) K B)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D = 1) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrep with ⟨hcog, hBK, hInd, hTH, hN⟩
  have hIeq : s.I = K \ s.D := s.I_eq
  have hI : K \ s.D ⊆ B := by simpa [hIeq] using s.hI
  have hrepD :
      RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D) :=
    repairedTerminalHypothesis_mixed ⟨hcog, hBK, hInd, hTH, hN⟩
      s.hDsub hI (by simpa [hIeq] using s.hnocross) s.hconn s.hBd
  have h2 : 2 ≤ s.D.card := s.two_le_card_D
  have hDcover :
      ∃ pc : PathCover G s.D,
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G s.D ∧
          IsTerminalCover (G := G) (B ∩ s.D) pc :=
    exists_min_terminalCover_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
      h2 hrepD.1 s.hconn hpD inter_subset_right s.hBd hrepD.2.2.2.1
  have hDcoverB :
      ∃ pc : PathCover G s.D,
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G s.D ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc := by
    obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := hDcover
    exact ⟨pc, hcard, IsTerminalCover.of_subset hterm inter_subset_left⟩
  have hunion : s.D ∪ s.I = K := s.hDU
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ :=
    exists_min_terminalCover_mixed_union_isolates s.hdisj s.hI hInd
      s.hnocross hDcoverB
  refine ⟨pc.cast hunion, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard, hunion]
  · intro p hp
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc hunion] at hp
    exact hterm p hp

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_sides_of_mixed_component_traceable
statement:
theorem exists_min_terminalCover_of_sides_of_mixed_component_traceable
    (P : AllCographSides G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (htough : OneTough G)
    (hpD : ∀ s : MixedSplit (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B,
      pathCoverNumber G s.D = 1) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := P.repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_oneTough hpat htough
  have hV : ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := P.hWne
    exact ⟨w, (P.mem_W_iff_mem_K_sdiff_B).1 hw⟩
  have hz : terminalComponentCount (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B ∅ = 0 :=
    hrep.2.2.2.1.1
  obtain ⟨s⟩ :=
    exists_mixedSplit (G := G) P.B_subset_K hrep.2.2.2.2 hz hV
  exact exists_min_terminalCover_of_mixed_traceable hrep s (hpD s)

name: Nikoghosyan.minEndpointDeficit_mem
statement:
lemma minEndpointDeficit_mem (K B : Finset V) :
    minEndpointDeficit (G := G) K B ∈
      {n | ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ pc.endpointDeficit B = n}
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.sInf_mem ?_
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) K
  exact ⟨pc.endpointDeficit B, pc, hpc, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_pathCover_min_deficit
statement:
lemma exists_min_pathCover_min_deficit (K B : Finset V) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧
        pc.endpointDeficit B = minEndpointDeficit (G := G) K B
proof:
:=
  minEndpointDeficit_mem (G := G) K B

name: Nikoghosyan.minEndpointDeficit_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma minEndpointDeficit_eq_zero_iff (K B : Finset V) :
    minEndpointDeficit (G := G) K B = 0 ↔
      ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hdef⟩ := exists_min_pathCover_min_deficit (G := G) K B
    exact ⟨pc, hcard, PathCover.terminalCover_of_deficit_eq_zero pc (h ▸ hdef)⟩
  · intro ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩
    have h0 := PathCover.deficit_eq_zero_of_terminal pc hterm
    have hle : minEndpointDeficit (G := G) K B ≤ 0 :=
      Nat.sInf_le ⟨pc, hcard, h0⟩
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalHypothesis_not_swallowed_class
statement:
lemma terminalHypothesis_not_swallowed_class {K B : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G K)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hp : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G K)
    (hBsub : B ⊆ ineligibleSet G K ∪ Cograph.dNonadjClass (G := G) K x) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSsub, hScut, hScomp⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_partCut_of_canonical (G := G) hcog hx
  have hBrem :
      B \ S ⊆
        (ineligibleSet G K ∪ Cograph.dNonadjClass (G := G) K x) \ S :=
    fun z hz => mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hBsub (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2⟩
  have hSsubK : S ⊆ K := hSsub.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K)
  have hzge :=
    terminalComponentCount_ge_pred_of_inOne (G := G) (K := K) (B := B)
      (S := S) hScomp hBrem
  have hc : componentCount G (K \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G K := hScut
  have hge : S.card + pathCoverNumber G K - 1 ≤
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S := by
    simpa [hc] using hzge
  by_cases hSne : S.Nonempty
  · have hle := hTH.2 S hSsubK hSne
    omega
  · have hS0 : S = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hSne
    have hz0 := hTH.1
    subst hS0
    simp at hge hz0 hc
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_repaired
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_of_repaired {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hKB : K ⊆ B) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:=
  exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B hKB hrep.2.2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_join_terminals_in_child
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_join_terminals_in_child {X Y B : Finset V}
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hKcog : IsCograph G (X ∪ Y))
    (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y))
    (hXB : X ⊆ B) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (X ∪ Y),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X :=
    dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero hXne hYne hAB hKcog hB hTH hpK
  have hXcover :=
    exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B (K := X) (B := B) hXB hInd
  exact exists_min_terminalCover_complete_join hXne hYne hAB hB hdom hXcover

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_join_split_of_mixed_p_ge_two
statement:
lemma exists_join_split_of_mixed_p_ge_two {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) K B)
    (hp : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G s.D) :
    ∃ X Y : Finset V,
      X ∪ Y = s.D ∧ Disjoint X Y ∧ X.Nonempty ∧ Y.Nonempty ∧
        G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V) ∧
          B ∩ s.D ⊆ X ∧ Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X
proof:
:= by
  have hcogD : IsCograph G s.D :=
    fun a b c d ha hb hc hd => hrep.1 (s.hDsub ha) (s.hDsub hb) (s.hDsub hc) (s.hDsub hd)
  have h2 : 2 ≤ s.D.card := s.two_le_card_D
  obtain ⟨X0, Y0, hX0sub, hY0sub, hX0ne, hY0ne, hdisj0, hcover0, hAB0, -, -⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_complete_join_on (G := G) (Cograph.isCograph_iff.2 hcogD)
      s.hconn h2
  have hBd : B ∩ s.D ⊆ X0 ∪ Y0 := by
    intro x hx
    have : x ∈ s.D := (mem_inter.1 hx).2
    rwa [← hcover0] at this
  have hside :=
    Independent.subset_join_side (G := G) hAB0
      (hrep.2.2.1.mono inter_subset_left) hBd
  have hIeq : s.I = K \ s.D := s.I_eq
  have hTHD : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) s.D (B ∩ s.D) :=
    (repairedTerminalHypothesis_mixed hrep s.hDsub
      (by simpa [hIeq] using s.hI)
      (by simpa [hIeq] using s.hnocross) s.hconn s.hBd).2.2.2.1
  rcases hside with hX | hY
  · refine ⟨X0, Y0, hcover0, hdisj0, hX0ne, hY0ne, hAB0, hX, ?_⟩
    have hunion : X0 ∪ Y0 = s.D := hcover0
    simpa [hunion] using
      dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero (G := G) hX0ne hY0ne hAB0
        (by simpa [hunion] using hcogD) hX (by simpa [hunion] using hTHD)
        (by simpa [hunion] using hp)
  · have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (Y0 : Set V) (X0 : Set V) :=
      fun {a} ha {b} hb => (hAB0 hb ha).symm
    have hcover1 : Y0 ∪ X0 = s.D := by
      rw [union_comm, hcover0]
    refine ⟨Y0, X0, hcover1, hdisj0.symm, hY0ne, hX0ne, hBA, hY, ?_⟩
    simpa [hcover1] using
      dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero (G := G) hY0ne hX0ne hBA
        (by simpa [hcover1] using hcogD) hY (by simpa [hcover1] using hTHD)
        (by simpa [hcover1] using hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCompleteBetween.mono
statement:
lemma IsCompleteBetween.mono {A A' B B' : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween (A' : Set V) (B' : Set V)
proof:
:=
  fun {a} ha {b} hb => hAB (hA ha) (hB hb)

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCompleteBetween.symm
proof:
:=
  fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_two_mem_of_two_le_card
statement:
lemma exists_two_mem_of_two_le_card {s : Finset V} (h : 2 ≤ s.card) :
    ∃ a b, a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s ∧ a ≠ b
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < s.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := card_pos.mp hpos
  have herase : 0 < (s.erase a).card := by
    rw [card_erase_of_mem ha]
    omega
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := card_pos.mp herase
  have hb' := mem_erase.mp hb
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb'.2, hb'.1.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_splice_through_block
statement:
lemma exists_splice_through_block {A Y : Finset V}
    (hAY : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (p block q : GraphPath G)
    (hpA : p.finish ∈ A) (hqA : q.start ∈ A)
    (hblock : block.support ⊆ Y)
    (hpb : Disjoint p.support block.support)
    (hqb : Disjoint q.support block.support)
    (hpq : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = p.support ∪ block.support ∪ q.support ∧
        r.start = p.start ∧ r.finish = q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hadj1 : G.Adj p.finish block.start :=
    hAY hpA (hblock block.start_mem_support)
  let mid := p.splice block hadj1 hpb
  have hqs : Disjoint mid.support q.support := by
    unfold mid
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨hpq, hqb.symm⟩
  have hadj2 : G.Adj mid.finish q.start := by
    have hf : mid.finish = block.finish :=
      GraphPath.finish_splice p block hadj1 hpb
    rw [hf]
    exact (hAY hqA (hblock block.finish_mem_support)).symm
  refine ⟨mid.splice q hadj2 hqs, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  ext x
  simp [mid, GraphPath.support_splice, mem_union, or_assoc, or_left_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.spliceTwoInsertBlock_card
statement:
lemma PathCover.spliceTwoInsertBlock_card {U W : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hWU : Disjoint W U) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support ∪ W ∪ q.support) :
    (pc.spliceTwoInsertBlock hp hq hne hWU r hr).card = pc.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := length_filter_ne_two (a := p) (b := q) hp hq hne pc.nodup_paths
  have hfilt :=
    length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := p) (l := pc.paths) hp pc.nodup_paths
  have hb' : q ∈ pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p) :=
