    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, decide_eq_true hne.symm⟩
  have hpos : 2 ≤ pc.paths.length := by
    have : 1 ≤ (pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p)).length :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.length_pos_of_mem hb')
    omega
  change
      ((pc.paths.filter fun s => decide (s ≠ p)).filter (fun s => decide (s ≠ q))
          ++ [r]).length =
        pc.paths.length - 1
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, hlen]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.spliceTwoInsertBlock_mem_paths
statement:
lemma PathCover.spliceTwoInsertBlock_mem_paths {U W : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hWU : Disjoint W U) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support ∪ W ∪ q.support)
    {s : GraphPath G}
    (hs : s ∈ (pc.spliceTwoInsertBlock hp hq hne hWU r hr).paths) :
    s = r ∨ s ∈ pc.paths ∧ s ≠ p ∧ s ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  have hs' := List.mem_append.1 hs
  rcases hs' with hsL | hsR
  · have hs1 := List.mem_filter.1 hsL
    have hs0 := List.mem_filter.1 hs1.1
    exact Or.inr ⟨hs0.1, of_decide_eq_true hs0.2, of_decide_eq_true hs1.2⟩
  · exact Or.inl (List.mem_singleton.1 hsR)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_splice_two_through_block
statement:
lemma exists_splice_two_through_block {A Y U : Finset V}
    (hAY : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
    (block : GraphPath G) (hblock : block.support ⊆ Y)
    (hdisj : Disjoint block.support U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (U ∪ block.support),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hne⟩ := pc.exists_two_distinct h2
  have hpb : Disjoint p.support block.support :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left (pc.support_subset hp) hdisj.symm
  have hqb : Disjoint q.support block.support :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left (pc.support_subset hq) hdisj.symm
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_splice_through_block hAY p block q (hend p hp).2 (hend q hq).1
      hblock hpb hqb
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne)
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsertBlock hp hq hne hdisj r hr,
    pc.spliceTwoInsertBlock_card hp hq hne hdisj r hr, ?_⟩
  intro s hsmem
  rcases pc.spliceTwoInsertBlock_mem_paths hp hq hne hdisj r hr hsmem with
    hseq | ⟨hspc, _, _⟩
  · subst hseq
    rw [hs, hf]
    exact ⟨(hend p hp).1, (hend q hq).2⟩
  · exact hend s hspc

name: Nikoghosyan.pathAt_support_subset_carrier
statement:
lemma pathAt_support_subset_carrier {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (i : Fin pc.card) : (pathAt pc i).support ⊆ K
proof:
:=
  pathAt_support_subset pc i

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_YV_chain
statement:
lemma exists_YV_chain {Y W : Finset V}
    (hWY : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hdisjYW : Disjoint Y W)
    (pcY : PathCover G Y) (pcW : PathCover G W) (a : ℕ)
    (haY : a + 1 ≤ pcY.card) (haW : pcW.card = a) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = (pathAt pcY ⟨0, (Nat.succ_pos a).trans_le haY⟩).start ∧
        r.finish = (pathAt pcY ⟨a, Nat.succ_le_iff.mp haY⟩).finish ∧
          ∀ x, x ∈ r.support ↔
            (∃ i : Fin (a + 1),
                x ∈ (pathAt pcY ⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 haY⟩).support) ∨
              ∃ j : Fin a,
                x ∈ (pathAt pcW ⟨j.1, haW ▸ j.2⟩).support
proof:
:= by
  have hY0 : 0 < pcY.card := (Nat.succ_pos a).trans_le haY
  have haYlt : a < pcY.card := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp haY
  have go :
      ∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ a),
        ∃ r : GraphPath G,
          r.start = (pathAt pcY ⟨0, hY0⟩).start ∧
            r.finish = (pathAt pcY ⟨t, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ht haYlt⟩).finish ∧
              ∀ x, x ∈ r.support ↔
                (∃ i : Fin (t + 1),
                    x ∈ (pathAt pcY
                      ⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2
                        (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ht haYlt))⟩).support) ∨
                  ∃ j : Fin t,
                    x ∈ (pathAt pcW
                      ⟨j.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 (ht.trans (le_of_eq haW.symm))⟩).support := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      intro _ht
      refine ⟨pathAt pcY ⟨0, hY0⟩, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        refine Or.inl ⟨⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_one⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa using hx
      · intro hx
        rcases hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, _⟩
        · have hi0 : i.1 = 0 := Nat.lt_one_iff.mp i.2
          have : (⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2
                (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hY0)⟩ : Fin pcY.card) =
              ⟨0, hY0⟩ := Fin.ext hi0
          simpa [this] using hxi
        · exact Fin.elim0 j
    | succ t ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hrmem⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht)
      have htW : t < pcW.card := by omega
      have htY : t + 1 < pcY.card := by omega
      let wp := pathAt pcW ⟨t, htW⟩
      let yp := pathAt pcY ⟨t + 1, htY⟩
      have hrW : Disjoint r.support wp.support := by
        refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
        intro x hxr hxw
        have hx := (hrmem x).1 hxr
        rcases hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, hxj⟩
        · have hxY : x ∈ Y := pathAt_support_subset pcY _ hxi
          have hxW : x ∈ W := pathAt_support_subset pcW ⟨t, htW⟩ hxw
          exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjYW hxY hxW
        · have hne : (⟨j.1, by omega⟩ : Fin pcW.card) ≠ ⟨t, htW⟩ := by
            intro h
            have : j.1 = t := congrArg Fin.val h
            exact (Nat.ne_of_lt j.2) this
          exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (pathAt_disjoint pcW hne) hxj hxw
      have hadj1 : G.Adj r.finish wp.start := by
        have hfY : r.finish ∈ Y := by
          have : r.finish = (pathAt pcY ⟨t, by omega⟩).finish := hrf
          rw [this]
          exact pathAt_support_subset pcY _ (pathAt pcY ⟨t, by omega⟩).finish_mem_support
        have hsW : wp.start ∈ W := pathAt_support_subset pcW ⟨t, htW⟩ wp.start_mem_support
        exact (hWY hsW hfY).symm
      let mid := r.splice wp hadj1 hrW
      have hmidY : Disjoint mid.support yp.support := by
        unfold mid
        rw [GraphPath.support_splice, disjoint_union_left]
        constructor
        · refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
          intro x hxr hxy
          have hx := (hrmem x).1 hxr
          rcases hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, hxj⟩
          · have hne : (⟨i.1, by omega⟩ : Fin pcY.card) ≠ ⟨t + 1, htY⟩ := by
              intro h
              have : i.1 = t + 1 := congrArg Fin.val h
              exact (Nat.ne_of_lt i.2) this
            exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (pathAt_disjoint pcY hne) hxi hxy
          · have hxW : x ∈ W := pathAt_support_subset pcW _ hxj
            have hxY : x ∈ Y := pathAt_support_subset pcY ⟨t + 1, htY⟩ hxy
            exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjYW hxY hxW
        · have hxW : wp.support ⊆ W := pathAt_support_subset pcW ⟨t, htW⟩
          have hxY : yp.support ⊆ Y := pathAt_support_subset pcY ⟨t + 1, htY⟩
          exact disjoint_of_subset_left hxW (disjoint_of_subset_right hxY hdisjYW.symm)
      have hadj2 : G.Adj mid.finish yp.start := by
        have hf : mid.finish = wp.finish := GraphPath.finish_splice r wp hadj1 hrW
        rw [hf]
        have hsY : yp.start ∈ Y := pathAt_support_subset pcY ⟨t + 1, htY⟩ yp.start_mem_support
        have hfW : wp.finish ∈ W := pathAt_support_subset pcW ⟨t, htW⟩ wp.finish_mem_support
        exact hWY hfW hsY
      refine ⟨mid.splice yp hadj2 hmidY, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hs0 : (mid.splice yp hadj2 hmidY).start = r.start := by
          rw [GraphPath.start_splice]
          unfold mid
          rw [GraphPath.start_splice]
        exact hs0.trans hrs
      · have hfin : (mid.splice yp hadj2 hmidY).finish = yp.finish :=
          GraphPath.finish_splice mid yp hadj2 hmidY
        have hidx : (⟨t + 1, htY⟩ : Fin pcY.card) =
            ⟨t.succ, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ht haYlt⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
        have hyp : yp.finish =
            (pathAt pcY ⟨t.succ, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ht haYlt⟩).finish := by
          simp [yp, hidx]
        exact hfin.trans hyp
      · intro x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          have hx' : x ∈ mid.support ∪ yp.support := by
            simpa [GraphPath.support_splice] using hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx' with hxm | hxy
          · have hxm' : x ∈ r.support ∪ wp.support := by
              simpa [mid, GraphPath.support_splice] using hxm
            rcases mem_union.1 hxm' with hxr | hxw
            · have hx := (hrmem x).1 hxr
              rcases hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, hxj⟩
              · refine Or.inl ⟨⟨i.1, Nat.lt_trans i.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩, ?_⟩
                simpa using hxi
              · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨j.1, Nat.lt_trans j.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩, ?_⟩
                simpa using hxj
            · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨t, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩, ?_⟩
              simpa [wp] using hxw
          · refine Or.inl ⟨⟨t + 1, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩, ?_⟩
            simpa [yp] using hxy
        · intro hx
          have hxmidyp : x ∈ mid.support ∪ yp.support →
              x ∈ (mid.splice yp hadj2 hmidY).support := by
            intro h
            simpa [GraphPath.support_splice] using h
          rcases hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩ | ⟨j, hxj⟩
          · have hi : i.1 < t + 2 := i.2
            have hsplit : i.1 < t + 1 ∨ i.1 = t + 1 :=
              Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi
            rcases hsplit with hlt | heq
            · have hxr : x ∈ r.support :=
                (hrmem x).2 (Or.inl ⟨⟨i.1, hlt⟩, by simpa using hxi⟩)
              exact hxmidyp (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by
                simpa [mid, GraphPath.support_splice] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxr))))
            · have : (⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 (by omega)⟩ : Fin pcY.card) =
                  ⟨t + 1, htY⟩ := Fin.ext heq
              have hxy : x ∈ yp.support := by simpa [this, yp] using hxi
              exact hxmidyp (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxy))
          · have hj : j.1 < t + 1 := j.2
            have hsplit : j.1 < t ∨ j.1 = t :=
              Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj
            rcases hsplit with hlt | heq
            · have hxr : x ∈ r.support :=
                (hrmem x).2 (Or.inr ⟨⟨j.1, hlt⟩, by simpa using hxj⟩)
              exact hxmidyp (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by
                simpa [mid, GraphPath.support_splice] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxr))))
            · have : (⟨j.1, by omega⟩ : Fin pcW.card) = ⟨t, htW⟩ := Fin.ext heq
              have hxw : x ∈ wp.support := by simpa [this, wp] using hxj
              exact hxmidyp (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by
                simpa [mid, GraphPath.support_splice] using mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxw))))
  exact go a le_rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_anchor_B_ended
statement:
lemma exists_anchor_B_ended {B Y W : Finset V}
    (hBY : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    {b1 b2 : V} (hb1 : b1 ∈ B) (hb2 : b2 ∈ B) (hne : b1 ≠ b2)
    (r : GraphPath G) (hs : r.start ∈ Y) (hf : r.finish ∈ Y)
    (hBW : Disjoint B W) (hBY' : Disjoint B Y)
    (hr : r.support ⊆ W ∪ Y) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.start = b1 ∧ p.finish = b2 ∧
        p.support = {b1} ∪ r.support ∪ {b2}
proof:
:= by
  have hb1r : b1 ∉ r.support := by
    intro h
    have : b1 ∈ W ∪ Y := hr h
    rcases mem_union.1 this with hW | hY
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hBW hb1 hW
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hBY' hb1 hY
  have hb2r : b2 ∉ r.support := by
    intro h
    have : b2 ∈ W ∪ Y := hr h
    rcases mem_union.1 this with hW | hY
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hBW hb2 hW
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hBY' hb2 hY
  let sb1 := GraphPath.singleton (G := G) b1
  let sb2 := GraphPath.singleton (G := G) b2
  have hsb1 : sb1.support = {b1} := GraphPath.support_singleton b1
  have hsb2 : sb2.support = {b2} := GraphPath.support_singleton b2
  have h1 : Disjoint sb1.support r.support := by
    rw [hsb1]
    exact disjoint_singleton_left.2 hb1r
  have hadj1 : G.Adj sb1.finish r.start := by
    change G.Adj b1 r.start
    exact hBY hb1 hs
  let mid := sb1.splice r hadj1 h1
  have h2 : Disjoint mid.support sb2.support := by
    unfold mid
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, hsb1, hsb2, disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by simp [hne], disjoint_singleton_right.2 hb2r⟩
  have hadj2 : G.Adj mid.finish sb2.start := by
    have : mid.finish = r.finish := GraphPath.finish_splice sb1 r hadj1 h1
    rw [this]
    change G.Adj r.finish b2
    exact (hBY hb2 hf).symm
  refine ⟨mid.splice sb2 hadj2 h2, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp [mid, GraphPath.support_splice, hsb1, hsb2, mem_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.subset_return_compl
statement: lemma subset_return_compl {Z : Set V} {z : V} : Zᶜ ⊆ (Z \ {z})ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff] at hx ⊢
  exact fun h => hx h.1

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.z_mem_return_compl
statement: lemma z_mem_return_compl {Z : Set V} {z : V} : z ∈ (Z \ {z})ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_compl_iff, mem_diff]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_compl_of_mem_return_compl_ne
statement:
lemma mem_compl_of_mem_return_compl_ne {Z : Set V} {z x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ (Z \ {z})ᶜ) (hne : x ≠ z) : x ∈ Zᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro hxz
  exact hx ⟨hxz, hne⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainIncl_injective
statement:
lemma remainIncl_injective (Z : Set V) (z : V) :
    Function.Injective (remainIncl Z z)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun t : {x // x ∈ (Z \ {z})ᶜ} => (t : V)) h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainIncl_ne_returned
statement:
lemma remainIncl_ne_returned {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) (v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}) :
    remainIncl Z z v ≠ returnedVert Z z
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact v.property (congrArg Subtype.val h ▸ hz)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_remainIncl
statement:
lemma reachable_remainIncl {Z : Set V} {z : V} {u v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}}
    (h : (G.induce Zᶜ).Reachable u v) :
    (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
      (remainIncl Z z u) (remainIncl Z z v)
proof:
:=
  h.map (remainHom G Z z)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_neighborComponentSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_neighborComponentSet_iff {Z : Set V} {z : V}
    {c : (G.induce Zᶜ).ConnectedComponent} :
    c ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z ↔
      ∃ v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}, v ∈ c.supp ∧ G.Adj z v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hadj, hv⟩
    exact ⟨v, by simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, hv], hadj⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hadj⟩
    exact ⟨v, hadj, by simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hv⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mapRemainComp_mk
statement:
lemma mapRemainComp_mk {Z : Set V} {z : V} (v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}) :
    mapRemainComp G Z z ((G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v) =
      (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        (remainIncl Z z v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.adj_returned_remainIncl
statement:
lemma adj_returned_remainIncl {Z : Set V} {z : V} {v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}} (h : G.Adj z v) :
    (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Adj
      (returnedVert Z z) (remainIncl Z z v)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.eq_remainIncl_of_ne_z
statement:
lemma eq_remainIncl_of_ne_z {Z : Set V} {z : V} (x : {w // w ∈ (Z \ {z})ᶜ})
    (hx : (x : V) ≠ z) :
    ∃ hx' : (x : V) ∈ Zᶜ,
      x = remainIncl Z z ⟨x, hx'⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_compl_of_mem_return_compl_ne x.property hx, ?_⟩
  ext
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_of_avoid_returned
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil =>
      have : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {t // t ∈ Zᶜ}) = ⟨x, hy⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
      exact this ▸ Reachable.rfl
  | @cons _ w _ hadj q =>
      have hwz : (w : V) ≠ z := hp w (by
        simp [Walk.support_cons, Walk.start_mem_support])
      have hw' : (w : V) ∈ Zᶜ :=
        mem_compl_of_mem_return_compl_ne w.property hwz
      have hadj0 : (G.induce Zᶜ).Adj ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨w, hw'⟩ := hadj
      have hq : ∀ t ∈ q.support, (t : V) ≠ z := by
        intro t ht
        exact hp t (by simp [Walk.support_cons, ht])
      exact hadj0.reachable.trans
        (reachable_of_avoid_returned (Z := Z) (z := z) q hq hw' hy)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_of_avoid_remainIncl
statement:
lemma reachable_of_avoid_remainIncl {Z : Set V} {z : V} {u v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}}
    (p : (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Walk
      (remainIncl Z z u) (remainIncl Z z v))
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ p.support, (x : V) ≠ z) :
    (G.induce Zᶜ).Reachable u v
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    reachable_of_avoid_returned (G := G) (Z := Z) (z := z) p hp
      u.property v.property
  have hu : (⟨(remainIncl Z z u : V), u.property⟩ : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}) = u :=
    Subtype.ext rfl
  have hv : (⟨(remainIncl Z z v : V), v.property⟩ : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}) = v :=
    Subtype.ext rfl
  exact hu ▸ hv ▸ h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_mem_tail_of_isPath_cons
statement:
lemma not_mem_tail_of_isPath_cons {α : Type*} {a : α} {l : List α}
    (h : (a :: l).Nodup) : a ∉ l
proof:
:=
  (List.nodup_cons.mp h).1

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_returned_iff
statement:
lemma reachable_returned_iff {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) (u : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}) :
    (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
        (returnedVert Z z)
        (remainIncl Z z u) ↔
      (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk u ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h.exists_isPath
    cases p with
    | nil =>
        exact (remainIncl_ne_returned hz u rfl).elim
    | @cons _ w _ hadj q =>
        have hwz : (w : V) ≠ z := by
          intro hweq
          exact hadj.ne (Subtype.ext hweq).symm
        obtain ⟨hw', hweq⟩ := eq_remainIncl_of_ne_z w hwz
        have hadjG : G.Adj z (w : V) := hadj
        have hnodup : (returnedVert Z z :: q.support).Nodup := by
          simpa [Walk.support_cons] using hp.support_nodup
        have hqsupp : ∀ t ∈ q.support, (t : V) ≠ z := by
          intro t ht htz
          have ht' : t = returnedVert Z z := Subtype.ext htz
          exact not_mem_tail_of_isPath_cons hnodup (ht' ▸ ht)
        refine ⟨⟨w, hw'⟩, hadjG, ConnectedComponent.sound ?_⟩
        exact reachable_of_avoid_remainIncl (G := G) (q.copy hweq rfl) (by
          intro t ht htz
          have : t ∈ q.support := by
            cases hweq
            exact ht
          exact hqsupp t this htz)
  · rintro ⟨w, hadj, hw⟩
    have h1 :
        (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
          (returnedVert Z z)
          (remainIncl Z z w) :=
      (adj_returned_remainIncl (G := G) hadj).reachable
    have h2 := reachable_remainIncl (G := G) (z := z) (ConnectedComponent.exact hw)
    exact h1.trans h2

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_returned_of_mem_neighbor
statement:
lemma reachable_returned_of_mem_neighbor {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z)
    {u : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}}
    (h : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk u ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z) :
    (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
      (returnedVert Z z)
      (remainIncl Z z u)
proof:
:=
  (reachable_returned_iff (G := G) hz u).mpr h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_remainIncl_iff
statement:
lemma reachable_remainIncl_iff {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) (u v : {x // x ∈ Zᶜ}) :
    (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
        (remainIncl Z z u)
        (remainIncl Z z v) ↔
      (G.induce Zᶜ).Reachable u v ∨
        ((G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk u ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z ∧
          (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h.exists_isPath
    by_cases hzmem : returnedVert Z z ∈ p.support
    · refine .inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (reachable_returned_iff (G := G) hz u).mp
          (p.takeUntil (returnedVert Z z) hzmem).reachable.symm
      · exact (reachable_returned_iff (G := G) hz v).mp
          (p.dropUntil (returnedVert Z z) hzmem).reachable
    · refine .inl (reachable_of_avoid_remainIncl (G := G) p ?_)
      intro x hx hxz
      exact hzmem <| by
        have : x = returnedVert Z z := Subtype.ext hxz
        exact this ▸ hx
  · rintro (h | ⟨hu, hv⟩)
    · exact reachable_remainIncl (G := G) h
    · exact (reachable_returned_of_mem_neighbor (G := G) hz hu).symm.trans
        (reachable_returned_of_mem_neighbor (G := G) hz hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mapRemainComp_eq_returned_iff
statement:
lemma mapRemainComp_eq_returned_iff {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z)
    (c : (G.induce Zᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :
    mapRemainComp G Z z c = returnedComp G Z z ↔
      c ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := c.nonempty_supp
  have hc : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv
  rw [← hc, mapRemainComp_mk, returnedComp, ConnectedComponent.eq, reachable_comm]
  exact reachable_returned_iff G hz v

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mapRemainComp_supp_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma mapRemainComp_supp_of_not_mem {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z)
    {c : (G.induce Zᶜ).ConnectedComponent}
    (hc : c ∉ neighborComponentSet G Z z) :
    (mapRemainComp G Z z c).supp =
      remainIncl Z z '' c.supp
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hx
    by_cases hxz : (x : V) = z
    · have : x = returnedVert Z z := Subtype.ext hxz
      have heq : mapRemainComp G Z z c = returnedComp G Z z := by
        rw [this] at hx
        exact hx.symm
      exact (hc ((mapRemainComp_eq_returned_iff (G := G) hz c).mp heq)).elim
    · obtain ⟨hx', hxe⟩ := eq_remainIncl_of_ne_z (Z := Z) (z := z) x hxz
      refine ⟨⟨x, hx'⟩, ?_, hxe.symm⟩
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := c.nonempty_supp
      have hc' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv
      have hreach :
          (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
            (remainIncl Z z v)
            (remainIncl Z z ⟨x, hx'⟩) := by
        apply ConnectedComponent.exact
        calc
          (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk (remainIncl Z z v)
              = mapRemainComp G Z z ((G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v) :=
            (mapRemainComp_mk G v).symm
          _ = mapRemainComp G Z z c := by rw [hc']
          _ = (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk x := hx.symm
          _ = (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
                (remainIncl Z z ⟨x, hx'⟩) := congrArg _ hxe
      have hiff := (reachable_remainIncl_iff (G := G) hz v ⟨x, hx'⟩).mp hreach
      rcases hiff with h0 | ⟨hmet, _⟩
      · have : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx'⟩ = c :=
          (ConnectedComponent.sound h0).symm.trans hc'
        simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using this
      · exact (hc (by simpa [hc'] using hmet)).elim
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    have hc' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv
    rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, ← hc', mapRemainComp_mk]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mapRemainComp_ncard_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma mapRemainComp_ncard_of_not_mem {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z)
    {c : (G.induce Zᶜ).ConnectedComponent}
    (hc : c ∉ neighborComponentSet G Z z) :
    (mapRemainComp G Z z c).supp.ncard = c.supp.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapRemainComp_supp_of_not_mem (G := G) hz hc,
      ncard_image_of_injective _ (remainIncl_injective Z z)]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mapRemainComp_injOn_not_mem
statement:
lemma mapRemainComp_injOn_not_mem {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    InjOn (mapRemainComp G Z z) (neighborComponentSet G Z z)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc d hd hcd
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := c.nonempty_supp
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := d.nonempty_supp
  have hreach :
      (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
        (remainIncl Z z v)
        (remainIncl Z z w) := by
    have hc' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv
    have hd' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk w = d := hw
    apply ConnectedComponent.exact
    calc
      (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk (remainIncl Z z v)
          = mapRemainComp G Z z c := by
            rw [← hc', mapRemainComp_mk]
      _ = mapRemainComp G Z z d := hcd
      _ = (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk (remainIncl Z z w) := by
            rw [← hd', mapRemainComp_mk]
  have hiff := (reachable_remainIncl_iff (G := G) hz v w).mp hreach
  rcases hiff with h0 | ⟨hmet, _⟩
  · have hc' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv
    have hd' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk w = d := hw
    exact hc'.symm.trans (ConnectedComponent.sound h0 |>.trans hd')
  · have hc' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv
    exact (hc (by simpa [hc'] using hmet)).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.returnedComp_supp
statement:
lemma returnedComp_supp {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    (returnedComp G Z z).supp =
      insert (returnedVert Z z)
        (remainIncl Z z ''
          (⋃ c ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z, c.supp))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, returnedComp] at hx
    by_cases hxz : (x : V) = z
    · left
      exact Subtype.ext hxz
    · obtain ⟨hx', hxe⟩ := eq_remainIncl_of_ne_z (Z := Z) (z := z) x hxz
      refine .inr ⟨⟨x, hx'⟩, ?_, hxe.symm⟩
      rw [mem_iUnion₂]
      refine ⟨(G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hx'⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (reachable_returned_iff (G := G) hz ⟨x, hx'⟩).mp (by
          have hreach : (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).Reachable
              (returnedVert Z z) x := ConnectedComponent.exact hx.symm
          exact hxe ▸ hreach)
      · simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_insert_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    · simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, returnedComp]
    · rw [mem_iUnion₂] at hv
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hv'⟩ := hv
      have hc' : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v = c := hv'
      have hmet : (G.induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk v ∈
          neighborComponentSet G Z z := by simpa [hc'] using hc
      rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, returnedComp, ConnectedComponent.eq]
      exact (reachable_returned_of_mem_neighbor (G := G) hz hmet).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_iUnion_supp
statement:
lemma ncard_iUnion_supp {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {H : SimpleGraph W} [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (s : Finset H.ConnectedComponent) :
    (⋃ c ∈ s, c.supp).ncard = ∑ c ∈ s, c.supp.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hunion :
      (⋃ c ∈ s, c.supp).toFinset = s.biUnion fun c => c.supp.toFinset := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card', hunion, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · simp [ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    exact disjoint_toFinset.mpr (pairwise_disjoint_supp_connectedComponent _ hab)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.returnedComp_ncard
statement:
lemma returnedComp_ncard {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard =
      1 + ∑ c ∈ (neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset, c.supp.ncard
proof:
:= by
  have himage :
      remainIncl Z z '' (⋃ c ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z, c.supp) =
        remainIncl Z z ''
          (⋃ c ∈ (neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset, c.supp) := by
    simp
  have hnot :
      returnedVert Z z ∉
        remainIncl Z z '' (⋃ c ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z, c.supp) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := (mem_image _ _ _).mp h
    exact v.property (congrArg Subtype.val hv ▸ hz)
  rw [returnedComp_supp (G := G) hz, ncard_insert_of_notMem hnot,
      ncard_image_of_injective _ (remainIncl_injective Z z)]
  have hunion :
      (⋃ c ∈ neighborComponentSet G Z z, c.supp) =
        ⋃ c ∈ (neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset, c.supp := by
    simp
  rw [hunion, ncard_iUnion_supp, add_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.returnedComp_odd_iff
statement:
lemma returnedComp_odd_iff {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    Odd (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard ↔
      Even (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := returnedComp_ncard (G := G) hz
  have hodd :
      Odd (∑ c ∈ (neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset, c.supp.ncard) ↔
        Odd ((neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset.filter
          fun c => Odd c.supp.ncard).card :=
    Finset.odd_sum_iff_odd_card_odd _
  have hcard :
      ((neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset.filter
          fun c => Odd c.supp.ncard).card =
        (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard := by
    rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    congr 1
    ext c
    simp [oddComponents, Finset.mem_filter, Set.mem_toFinset]
  have hparity : Odd (1 + ∑ c ∈ (neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset, c.supp.ncard) ↔
      Even (∑ c ∈ (neighborComponentSet G Z z).toFinset, c.supp.ncard) := by
    rw [add_comm, Nat.odd_add_one, Nat.not_odd_iff_even]
  rw [hsum, hparity, ← Nat.not_odd_iff_even, hodd, hcard, Nat.not_odd_iff_even]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.oddComponentCount_return_eq
statement:
lemma oddComponentCount_return_eq {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    oddComponentCount G (Z \ {z}) =
      oddComponentCount G Z -
          (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard +
        (if Even (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard
          then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G0 := G.induce Zᶜ
  set G1 := G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ
  set met := neighborComponentSet G Z z
  set k := (met ∩ G0.oddComponents).ncard
  set untouched := (metᶜ : Set G0.ConnectedComponent)
  have hpart :
      G0.oddComponents =
        (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents) ∪ (met ∩ G0.oddComponents) := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · intro hc
      by_cases hmet : c ∈ met
      · exact .inr ⟨hmet, hc⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨hmet, hc⟩
    · intro hc
      rcases hc with ⟨_, hodd⟩ | ⟨_, hodd⟩ <;> exact hodd
  have hdisj :
      Disjoint (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents) (met ∩ G0.oddComponents) := by
    rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    ext c
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (h.1.1 h.2.1).elim
    · intro h
      exact h.elim
  have h0 :
      oddComponentCount G Z =
        (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents).ncard + k := by
    have hn := congrArg ncard hpart
    rw [ncard_union_eq hdisj] at hn
    simpa [oddComponentCount, k] using hn
  have himg_inj : InjOn (mapRemainComp G Z z) (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents) :=
    (mapRemainComp_injOn_not_mem (G := G) hz).mono inter_subset_left
  have hncard_img :
      (mapRemainComp G Z z '' (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents)).ncard =
        (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents).ncard :=
    himg_inj.ncard_image
  have hnot_ret :
      returnedComp G Z z ∉ mapRemainComp G Z z '' (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨c, hc, heq⟩ := h
    have : c ∈ met := (mapRemainComp_eq_returned_iff (G := G) hz c).mp heq
    exact hc.1 this
  have hodd_img :
      mapRemainComp G Z z '' (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents) ⊆ G1.oddComponents := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hd
    have : Odd (mapRemainComp G Z z c).supp.ncard := by
      rw [mapRemainComp_ncard_of_not_mem (G := G) hz hc.1]
      exact hc.2
    exact this
  have hcover :
      G1.oddComponents =
        (mapRemainComp G Z z '' (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents)) ∪
          {c | c = returnedComp G Z z ∧ Odd c.supp.ncard} := by
    ext d
    constructor
    · intro hd
      by_cases hret : d = returnedComp G Z z
      · exact .inr ⟨hret, hret ▸ hd⟩
      · left
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := d.nonempty_supp
        have hxz : (x : V) ≠ z := by
          intro hxz
          have hxret : x = returnedVert Z z := Subtype.ext hxz
          have : d = returnedComp G Z z := by
            rw [hxret, ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hx
            exact hx.symm
          exact hret this
        obtain ⟨hx', hxe⟩ := eq_remainIncl_of_ne_z x hxz
        set u : {v // v ∈ Zᶜ} := ⟨x, hx'⟩
        set c := G0.connectedComponentMk u
        have hdc : mapRemainComp G Z z c = d := by
          have hxmk : (G.induce (Z \ {z})ᶜ).connectedComponentMk x = d := hx
          rw [hxe] at hxmk
          exact (mapRemainComp_mk G u).symm.trans hxmk
        have hc_un : c ∉ met := by
          intro hmet
          have : d = returnedComp G Z z := by
            rw [← hdc]
            exact (mapRemainComp_eq_returned_iff (G := G) hz c).mpr hmet
          exact hret this
        have hc_odd : c ∈ G0.oddComponents := by
          have : Odd (mapRemainComp G Z z c).supp.ncard := by
            simpa [hdc] using hd
          rw [mapRemainComp_ncard_of_not_mem (G := G) hz hc_un] at this
          exact this
        exact ⟨c, ⟨hc_un, hc_odd⟩, hdc⟩
    · intro hd
      rcases hd with h | ⟨rfl, hodd⟩
      · exact hodd_img h
      · exact hodd
  have hdisj2 :
      Disjoint (mapRemainComp G Z z '' (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents))
        {c | c = returnedComp G Z z ∧ Odd c.supp.ncard} := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro d hd hd'
    exact hnot_ret (by
      have : d = returnedComp G Z z := hd'.1
      simpa [this] using hd)
  have hret_ncard :
      {c : G1.ConnectedComponent |
          c = returnedComp G Z z ∧ Odd c.supp.ncard}.ncard =
        if Odd (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hodd : Odd (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard
    · have : {c : G1.ConnectedComponent |
          c = returnedComp G Z z ∧ Odd c.supp.ncard} =
          {returnedComp G Z z} := by
        ext c
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact h.1
        · intro h
          exact ⟨h, h ▸ hodd⟩
      rw [this, ncard_singleton, if_pos hodd]
    · have : {c : G1.ConnectedComponent |
          c = returnedComp G Z z ∧ Odd c.supp.ncard} = ∅ := by
        ext c
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact (hodd (h.1 ▸ h.2)).elim
        · intro h
          exact h.elim
      rw [this, ncard_empty, if_neg hodd]
  have h1 :
      oddComponentCount G (Z \ {z}) =
        (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents).ncard +
          (if Odd (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard then 1 else 0) := by
    simp only [oddComponentCount, G1]
    rw [hcover, ncard_union_eq hdisj2, hncard_img, hret_ncard]
  have hk_le : k ≤ oddComponentCount G Z := by
    simp only [oddComponentCount, k, met, G0]
    exact ncard_le_ncard inter_subset_right
  have hsub : (untouched ∩ G0.oddComponents).ncard = oddComponentCount G Z - k := by
    omega
  have hite : (if Odd (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard then 1 else 0) =
      if Even k then 1 else 0 := by
    have hiff := returnedComp_odd_iff (G := G) hz
    by_cases hodd : Odd (returnedComp G Z z).supp.ncard
    · have hkEven : Even k := hiff.mp hodd
      simp [hodd, hkEven]
    · have hkOdd : ¬ Even k := fun hkEven => hodd (hiff.mpr hkEven)
      simp [hodd, hkOdd]
  rw [h1, hsub, hite]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.oddComponentCount_return_le
statement:
theorem oddComponentCount_return_le {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z)
    (hmeet : (neighborComponentSet G Z z).ncard ≤ 2) :
    oddComponentCount G (Z \ {z}) + 1 ≥ oddComponentCount G Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set k := (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard
    with hkdef
  have hk : (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard ≤
      (neighborComponentSet G Z z).ncard := ncard_le_ncard inter_subset_left
  have hk2 : k ≤ 2 := hk.trans hmeet
  have hk_le : (neighborComponentSet G Z z ∩ (G.induce Zᶜ).oddComponents).ncard ≤
      oddComponentCount G Z := ncard_le_ncard inter_subset_right
  have heq := oddComponentCount_return_eq (G := G) hz
  rw [← hkdef] at heq hk_le
  have hcases : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · rw [h0] at heq
    simp at heq
    omega
  · rw [h1] at heq hk_le
    have : ¬ Even (1 : ℕ) := by decide
    simp [this] at heq
    omega
  · rw [h2] at heq hk_le
    have : Even (2 : ℕ) := even_two
    simp [this] at heq
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_return_mono
statement:
theorem signedDeficiency_return_mono {Z : Set V} {z : V} (hz : z ∈ Z)
    (hmeet : (neighborComponentSet G Z z).ncard ≤ 2) :
    signedDeficiency G Z ≤ signedDeficiency G (Z \ {z})
proof:
:= by
  have hodd := oddComponentCount_return_le (G := G) hz hmeet
  have hpos : 1 ≤ Z.ncard :=
    Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ncard_ne_zero_of_mem hz)
  have hZ : ((Z \ {z}).ncard : ℤ) = (Z.ncard : ℤ) - 1 := by
    rw [ncard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hz, Nat.cast_sub hpos, Nat.cast_one]
  simp only [signedDeficiency, hZ]
  have hoddZ : (oddComponentCount G (Z \ {z}) : ℤ) + 1 ≥
      (oddComponentCount G Z : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hodd
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classS_of_not_clone
statement:
lemma classS_of_not_clone (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) {v : V}
    (h : ∀ b : Fin 2, GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ Z) : classS Z v
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact hb (h b)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_adj_port_cases
statement:
lemma gadget_adj_port_cases {v w : V} {hvw : G.Adj v w} {x : GadgetVert G} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.port v w hvw) x ↔
      (∃ b : Fin 2, x = .clone v b) ∨ ∃ h' : G.Adj w v, x = .port w v h'
proof:
:=
  port_adj_iff

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_adj_clone_cases
statement:
lemma gadget_adj_clone_cases {v : V} {b : Fin 2} {x : GadgetVert G} :
    (gadget G).Adj (.clone v b) x ↔
      ∃ w, ∃ h : G.Adj v w, x = .port v w h
proof:
:=
  clone_adj_iff

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_clone_of_no_port
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_clone_of_no_port
    {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hZ : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ Z)
    (hports : ∀ w, ∀ h : G.Adj v w, GadgetVert.port v w h ∈ Z) :
    neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.clone v b) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · intro hc
    rcases (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mp hc with ⟨x, hx, hadj⟩
    obtain ⟨w, h, hxval⟩ := (clone_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj
    exact (x.property (hxval ▸ hports w h)).elim
  · intro h
    exact h.elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.port_eq_of_same_ends
statement:
lemma port_eq_of_same_ends {v w : V} {h h' : G.Adj v w} :
    GadgetVert.port v w h = GadgetVert.port v w h'
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_clone_of_classT
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_clone_of_classT
    {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hZ : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ Z) (hT : classT Z v) :
    neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.clone v b) = ∅
proof:
:=
  neighborComponentSet_clone_of_no_port hZ (fun w h => by
    by_contra hop
    exact hT.2 ⟨w, h, hop⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_ncard_port_of_classS
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_ncard_port_of_classS
    {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v w : V} {hvw : G.Adj v w}
    (hZ : GadgetVert.port v w hvw ∈ Z)
    (hS : classS Z v) :
    (neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.port v w hvw)).ncard ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hclones : ∀ b : Fin 2, GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ Z := by
    intro b
    by_contra hb
    exact hS ⟨b, hb⟩
  by_cases hopp : GadgetVert.port w v hvw.symm ∈ Z
  · have hempty : neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.port v w hvw) = ∅ := by
      ext c
      constructor
      · intro hc
        rcases (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mp hc with ⟨x, _, hadj⟩
        rcases (port_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj with ⟨b, hxval⟩ | ⟨h', hxval⟩
        · exact (x.property (hxval ▸ hclones b)).elim
        · have : (x : GadgetVert G) = .port w v hvw.symm :=
            hxval.trans port_eq_of_same_ends
          exact x.property (this ▸ hopp)
      · intro h
        exact h.elim
    simp [hempty]
  · let opp : {x // x ∈ (Zᶜ : Set (GadgetVert G))} := ⟨.port w v hvw.symm, hopp⟩
    let c0 := ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk opp
    have heq : neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.port v w hvw) = {c0} := by
      ext c
      constructor
      · intro hc
        rcases (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mp hc with ⟨x, hxsupp, hadj⟩
        rcases (port_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj with ⟨b, hxval⟩ | ⟨h', hxval⟩
        · exact (x.property (hxval ▸ hclones b)).elim
        · have hxval' : (x : GadgetVert G) = .port w v hvw.symm :=
            hxval.trans port_eq_of_same_ends
          have hxeq : x = opp := Subtype.ext hxval'
          rw [mem_singleton_iff]
          have hxmk : ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk x = c := hxsupp
          rw [hxeq] at hxmk
          exact hxmk.symm
      · intro hc
        rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hc
        subst c
        refine (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mpr ⟨opp, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [c0, ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]
        · exact gadget_adj_mate hvw
    simpa [heq]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_ncard_clone_of_classU
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_ncard_clone_of_classU
    {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hZ : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ Z) (hU : classU Z v) :
    (neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.clone v b)).ncard ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hU.1
  let cl : {x // x ∈ (Zᶜ : Set (GadgetVert G))} := ⟨.clone v b', hb'⟩
  let c0 := ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk cl
  have hsub : neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.clone v b) ⊆ {c0} := by
    intro c hc
    rcases (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mp hc with ⟨x, hxsupp, hadj⟩
    obtain ⟨w, h, hxval⟩ := (clone_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj
    have hadj' : (gadget G).Adj (.clone v b') (x : GadgetVert G) := by
      rw [hxval]
      exact (rfl : v = v)
    have hadjI : ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).Adj cl x := hadj'
    have : c0 = c :=
      (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadjI).trans
        (by simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hxsupp)
    exact this ▸ mem_singleton c0
  exact (ncard_le_ncard hsub).trans_eq (ncard_singleton _)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classSTU
statement:
lemma classSTU (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) (v : V) :
    classS Z v ∨ classT Z v ∨ classU Z v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : hasSurvivingClone Z v
  · by_cases hp : hasSurvivingPort Z v
    · exact .inr (.inr ⟨hc, hp⟩)
    · exact .inr (.inl ⟨hc, hp⟩)
  · exact .inl hc

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_classS_of_TU
statement:
lemma not_classS_of_TU {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (h : classT Z v ∨ classU Z v) : ¬ classS Z v
proof:
:= by
  intro hS
  rcases h with hT | hU
  · exact hS hT.1
  · exact hS hU.1

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_classT_of_SU
statement:
lemma not_classT_of_SU {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (h : classS Z v ∨ classU Z v) : ¬ classT Z v
proof:
:= by
  intro hT
  rcases h with hS | hU
  · exact hS hT.1
  · exact hT.2 hU.2

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classS_clone_mem
statement:
lemma classS_clone_mem {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (hS : classS Z v) (b : Fin 2) : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ Z
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hb
  exact hS ⟨b, hb⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classT_port_mem
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hp
  exact hT.2 ⟨w, hvw, hp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exists_adj_of_classU
statement:
lemma exists_adj_of_classU {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (hU : classU Z v) : ∃ w, G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, h, _⟩ := hU.2
  exact ⟨w, h⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_classS_classT
statement:
lemma disjoint_classS_classT (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint {v | classS Z v} {v | classT Z v}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro v hS hT
  exact hS hT.1

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_surviving_clones_of_classU
statement:
lemma reachable_surviving_clones_of_classU
    {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} (hU : classU Z v)
    {b b' : Fin 2}
    (hb : GadgetVert.clone v b ∉ Z) (hb' : GadgetVert.clone v b' ∉ Z) :
    ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).Reachable
      ⟨.clone v b, hb⟩ ⟨.clone v b', hb'⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w0, h0, hp0⟩ := hU.2
  have h1 : ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.clone v b, hb⟩ ⟨.port v w0 h0, hp0⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]
    simp
  have h2 : ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.port v w0 h0, hp0⟩ ⟨.clone v b', hb'⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]
    simp
  exact h1.reachable.trans h2.reachable

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_ncard_port_of_classU
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_ncard_port_of_classU
    {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v w : V} {hvw : G.Adj v w}
    (_hZ : GadgetVert.port v w hvw ∈ Z) (hU : classU Z v) :
    (neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.port v w hvw)).ncard ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hU.1
  let cl : {x // x ∈ (Zᶜ : Set (GadgetVert G))} := ⟨.clone v b, hb⟩
  let cLoc := ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk cl
  have hclone :
      ∀ b' : Fin 2, ∀ hb' : GadgetVert.clone v b' ∉ Z,
        ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk ⟨.clone v b', hb'⟩ = cLoc := by
    intro b' hb'
    exact ConnectedComponent.sound
      (reachable_surviving_clones_of_classU hU hb' hb)
  by_cases hopp : GadgetVert.port w v hvw.symm ∈ Z
  · have hsub : neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.port v w hvw) ⊆ {cLoc} := by
      intro c hc
      rcases (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mp hc with ⟨x, hxsupp, hadj⟩
      have hxmk : ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk x = c := by
        simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hxsupp
      rcases (port_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj with ⟨b', hxval⟩ | ⟨h', hxval⟩
      · have hb' : GadgetVert.clone v b' ∉ Z := by
          simpa [hxval] using x.property
        have hxeq : x = ⟨.clone v b', hb'⟩ := Subtype.ext hxval
        have : c = cLoc := by
          rw [hxeq] at hxmk
          exact hxmk.symm.trans (hclone b' hb')
        exact this ▸ mem_singleton cLoc
      · have hxval' : (x : GadgetVert G) = .port w v hvw.symm :=
          hxval.trans port_eq_of_same_ends
        exact (x.property (hxval' ▸ hopp)).elim
    exact (ncard_le_ncard hsub).trans (by simp [ncard_singleton])
  · let opp : {x // x ∈ (Zᶜ : Set (GadgetVert G))} := ⟨.port w v hvw.symm, hopp⟩
    let cOpp := ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk opp
    have hsub :
        neighborComponentSet (gadget G) Z (.port v w hvw) ⊆ ({cLoc, cOpp} : Set _) := by
      intro c hc
      rcases (mem_neighborComponentSet_iff (G := gadget G)).mp hc with ⟨x, hxsupp, hadj⟩
      have hxmk : ((gadget G).induce Zᶜ).connectedComponentMk x = c := by
        simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hxsupp
      rcases (port_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj with ⟨b', hxval⟩ | ⟨h', hxval⟩
      · have hb' : GadgetVert.clone v b' ∉ Z := by
          simpa [hxval] using x.property
        have hxeq : x = ⟨.clone v b', hb'⟩ := Subtype.ext hxval
        have : c = cLoc := by
          rw [hxeq] at hxmk
          exact hxmk.symm.trans (hclone b' hb')
        simp [this]
      · have hxval' : (x : GadgetVert G) = .port w v hvw.symm :=
          hxval.trans port_eq_of_same_ends
        have hxeq : x = opp := Subtype.ext hxval'
        have : c = cOpp := by
          rw [hxeq] at hxmk
          exact hxmk.symm
        simp [this]
    have hpair : ({cLoc, cOpp} : Set _).ncard ≤ 2 :=
      (ncard_insert_le cLoc {cOpp}).trans (by simp [ncard_singleton])
    exact (ncard_le_ncard hsub).trans hpair

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.CutInv.refl
statement:
lemma CutInv.refl (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) : CutInv Z Z where
  subset
proof:
:= fun _ hx => hx
  keep_S_clones := fun v hS b => classS_clone_mem hS b
  keep_T_ports := fun v hT _ hvw => classT_port_mem hT hvw

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classS_of_inv
statement:
lemma classS_of_inv {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (h : CutInv Z0 W) (hS : classS Z0 v) : classS W v
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact hb (h.keep_S_clones v hS b)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classT_of_inv
statement:
lemma classT_of_inv {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (h : CutInv Z0 W) (hT : classT Z0 v) : classT W v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hT.1
    exact ⟨b, fun hW => hb (h.subset hW)⟩
  · intro ⟨w, hvw, hp⟩
    exact hp (h.keep_T_ports v hT hvw)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classU_of_inv
statement:
lemma classU_of_inv {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (h : CutInv Z0 W) (hU : classU Z0 v) : classU W v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hU.1
    exact ⟨b, fun hW => hb (h.subset hW)⟩
  · obtain ⟨w, hvw, hp⟩ := hU.2
    exact ⟨w, hvw, fun hW => hp (h.subset hW)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.pendingTUClones_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [pendingTUClones, mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff, mem_setOf]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨hxW, hne⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hxW, h⟩, hne⟩
  · intro ⟨⟨hxW, h⟩, hne⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hxW, hne⟩, h⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.pendingSUPorts_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [pendingSUPorts, mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff, mem_setOf]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨hxW, hne⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hxW, h⟩, hne⟩
  · intro ⟨⟨hxW, h⟩, hne⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hxW, hne⟩, h⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sdiff_pending_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨hxW, hxz⟩, hnot⟩
    exact ⟨hxW, fun hxP => hnot ⟨hxP, hxz⟩⟩
  · intro ⟨hxW, hxP⟩
    have hxz : x ≠ z := fun h => hxP (h ▸ hzP)
    exact ⟨⟨hxW, hxz⟩, fun h => hxP h.1⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.CutInv.return_TU_clone
statement:
lemma CutInv.return_TU_clone {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {z : GadgetVert G}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W) (hz : z ∈ pendingTUClones Z0 W) :
    CutInv Z0 (W \ {z}) where
  subset
proof:
:= fun x hx => hinv.subset hx.1
  keep_S_clones := by
    intro v hS b
    have hin : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ W := hinv.keep_S_clones v hS b
    refine ⟨hin, ?_⟩
    intro h
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨_, v', b', rfl, hTU⟩ := hz
    injection h with hv _
    cases hv
    exact not_classS_of_TU hTU hS
  keep_T_ports := by
    intro v hT w hvw
    have hin : GadgetVert.port v w hvw ∈ W := hinv.keep_T_ports v hT hvw
    refine ⟨hin, ?_⟩
    intro h
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨_, v', b', rfl, _⟩ := hz
    cases h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.CutInv.return_SU_port
statement:
lemma CutInv.return_SU_port {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {z : GadgetVert G}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W) (hz : z ∈ pendingSUPorts Z0 W) :
    CutInv Z0 (W \ {z}) where
  subset
proof:
:= fun x hx => hinv.subset hx.1
  keep_S_clones := by
    intro v hS b
    have hin : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ W := hinv.keep_S_clones v hS b
    refine ⟨hin, ?_⟩
    intro h
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨_, v', w', h', rfl, _⟩ := hz
    cases h
  keep_T_ports := by
    intro v hT w hvw
    have hin : GadgetVert.port v w hvw ∈ W := hinv.keep_T_ports v hT hvw
    refine ⟨hin, ?_⟩
    intro h
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨_, v', w', h', rfl, hSU⟩ := hz
    injection h with hv hw
    cases hv
    exact not_classT_of_SU hSU hT

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_ncard_pending_TU_clone
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_ncard_pending_TU_clone
    {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {z : GadgetVert G}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W) (hz : z ∈ pendingTUClones Z0 W) :
    (neighborComponentSet (gadget G) W z).ncard ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hzW, v, b, rfl, hTU⟩ := hz
  rcases hTU with hT | hU
  · have hempty :=
      neighborComponentSet_clone_of_classT (Z := W) hzW (classT_of_inv hinv hT)
    simp [hempty]
  · exact (neighborComponentSet_ncard_clone_of_classU (Z := W) hzW
      (classU_of_inv hinv hU)).trans (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborComponentSet_ncard_pending_SU_port
statement:
lemma neighborComponentSet_ncard_pending_SU_port
    {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {z : GadgetVert G}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W) (hz : z ∈ pendingSUPorts Z0 W) :
    (neighborComponentSet (gadget G) W z).ncard ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hzW, v, w, hvw, rfl, hSU⟩ := hz
  rcases hSU with hS | hU
  · exact (neighborComponentSet_ncard_port_of_classS (Z := W) hzW
      (classS_of_inv hinv hS)).trans (by omega)
  · exact neighborComponentSet_ncard_port_of_classU (Z := W) hzW
      (classU_of_inv hinv hU)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_return_pending_TU_clone
statement:
lemma signedDeficiency_return_pending_TU_clone
    {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {z : GadgetVert G}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W) (hz : z ∈ pendingTUClones Z0 W) :
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) W ≤ signedDeficiency (gadget G) (W \ {z})
proof:
:=
  signedDeficiency_return_mono (G := gadget G) hz.1
    (neighborComponentSet_ncard_pending_TU_clone hinv hz)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_return_pending_SU_port
statement:
lemma signedDeficiency_return_pending_SU_port
    {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)} {z : GadgetVert G}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W) (hz : z ∈ pendingSUPorts Z0 W) :
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) W ≤ signedDeficiency (gadget G) (W \ {z})
proof:
:=
  signedDeficiency_return_mono (G := gadget G) hz.1
    (neighborComponentSet_ncard_pending_SU_port hinv hz)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.stage_return_clones
statement:
lemma stage_return_clones (Z0 : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ∀ W, CutInv Z0 W →
      signedDeficiency (gadget G) W ≤
        signedDeficiency (gadget G) (W \ pendingTUClones Z0 W) ∧
      CutInv Z0 (W \ pendingTUClones Z0 W) ∧
      pendingTUClones Z0 (W \ pendingTUClones Z0 W) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro W hinv0
  generalize hn : (pendingTUClones Z0 W).ncard = n
  induction n generalizing W with
  | zero =>
      have hempty : pendingTUClones Z0 W = ∅ := by
        exact (ncard_eq_zero (s := pendingTUClones Z0 W)).mp hn
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [hempty]
      · simpa [hempty] using hinv0
      · simp [hempty]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < (pendingTUClones Z0 W).ncard := by omega
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (ncard_pos (s := pendingTUClones Z0 W)).mp hpos
      have hinv1 : CutInv Z0 (W \ {z}) := hinv0.return_TU_clone hz
      have hPeq : pendingTUClones Z0 (W \ {z}) = pendingTUClones Z0 W \ {z} :=
        pendingTUClones_sdiff hz
      have hcard : (pendingTUClones Z0 (W \ {z})).ncard = n := by
        rw [hPeq, ncard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hz]
        omega
      obtain ⟨hdef1, hinv2, hempty⟩ := ih (W \ {z}) hinv1 hcard
      have hset :
          (W \ {z}) \ pendingTUClones Z0 (W \ {z}) =
            W \ pendingTUClones Z0 W := by
        rw [hPeq]
        exact sdiff_pending_eq hz (fun x hx => hx.1)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (signedDeficiency_return_pending_TU_clone hinv0 hz).trans
          (hset ▸ hdef1)
      · simpa [hset] using hinv2
      · simpa [hset] using hempty

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.stage_return_ports
statement:
lemma stage_return_ports (Z0 : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ∀ W, CutInv Z0 W →
      signedDeficiency (gadget G) W ≤
        signedDeficiency (gadget G) (W \ pendingSUPorts Z0 W) ∧
      CutInv Z0 (W \ pendingSUPorts Z0 W) ∧
      pendingSUPorts Z0 (W \ pendingSUPorts Z0 W) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro W hinv0
  generalize hn : (pendingSUPorts Z0 W).ncard = n
  induction n generalizing W with
  | zero =>
      have hempty : pendingSUPorts Z0 W = ∅ := by
        exact (ncard_eq_zero (s := pendingSUPorts Z0 W)).mp hn
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [hempty]
      · simpa [hempty] using hinv0
      · simp [hempty]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < (pendingSUPorts Z0 W).ncard := by omega
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (ncard_pos (s := pendingSUPorts Z0 W)).mp hpos
      have hinv1 : CutInv Z0 (W \ {z}) := hinv0.return_SU_port hz
      have hPeq : pendingSUPorts Z0 (W \ {z}) = pendingSUPorts Z0 W \ {z} :=
        pendingSUPorts_sdiff hz
      have hcard : (pendingSUPorts Z0 (W \ {z})).ncard = n := by
        rw [hPeq, ncard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hz]
        omega
      obtain ⟨hdef1, hinv2, hempty⟩ := ih (W \ {z}) hinv1 hcard
      have hset :
          (W \ {z}) \ pendingSUPorts Z0 (W \ {z}) =
            W \ pendingSUPorts Z0 W := by
        rw [hPeq]
        exact sdiff_pending_eq hz (fun x hx => hx.1)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (signedDeficiency_return_pending_SU_port hinv0 hz).trans
          (hset ▸ hdef1)
      · simpa [hset] using hinv2
      · simpa [hset] using hempty

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.canonicalCut_subset
statement: lemma canonicalCut_subset (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) : canonicalCut Z ⊆ Z
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨v, b, rfl, hS⟩ | ⟨v, w, h, rfl, hT⟩
  · exact classS_clone_mem hS b
  · exact classT_port_mem hT h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.pendingTUClones_empty_of_return_port
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ pendingTUClones Z0 W := by
      refine ⟨hx.1.1, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨v, b, rfl, hTU⟩ := hx.2
      exact ⟨v, b, rfl, hTU⟩
    exact (hempty ▸ this).elim
  · intro h
    exact h.elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.pendingTUClones_empty_after_ports
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ pendingTUClones Z0 W := ⟨(W.sdiff_subset hx.1), hx.2⟩
    exact (hempty ▸ this).elim
  · intro h
    exact h.elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.eq_canonical_of_pending_empty
statement:
lemma eq_canonical_of_pending_empty {Z0 W : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    (hinv : CutInv Z0 W)
    (hcl : pendingTUClones Z0 W = ∅)
    (hpo : pendingSUPorts Z0 W = ∅) :
    W = canonicalCut Z0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    cases x with
    | clone v b =>
        have hS : classS Z0 v := by
          by_contra hS
          have hTU : classT Z0 v ∨ classU Z0 v := by
            rcases classSTU Z0 v with hS' | hT | hU
            · exact (hS hS').elim
            · exact .inl hT
            · exact .inr hU
          have : GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ pendingTUClones Z0 W :=
            ⟨hx, v, b, rfl, hTU⟩
          exact (hcl ▸ this).elim
        exact .inl ⟨v, b, rfl, hS⟩
    | port v w h =>
        have hT : classT Z0 v := by
          by_contra hT
          have hSU : classS Z0 v ∨ classU Z0 v := by
            rcases classSTU Z0 v with hS | hT' | hU
            · exact .inl hS
            · exact (hT hT').elim
            · exact .inr hU
          have : GadgetVert.port v w h ∈ pendingSUPorts Z0 W :=
            ⟨hx, v, w, h, rfl, hSU⟩
          exact (hpo ▸ this).elim
        exact .inr ⟨v, w, h, rfl, hT⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨v, b, rfl, hS⟩ | ⟨v, w, h, rfl, hT⟩
    · exact hinv.keep_S_clones v hS b
    · exact hinv.keep_T_ports v hT h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.gadget_normalize_cut
statement:
theorem gadget_normalize_cut (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint {v | classS Z v} {v | classT Z v} ∧
    (∀ v, classU Z v → ∃ w, G.Adj v w) ∧
    canonicalCut Z ⊆ Z ∧
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) Z ≤
      signedDeficiency (gadget G) (canonicalCut Z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨disjoint_classS_classT Z, fun v => exists_adj_of_classU, canonicalCut_subset Z, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hdefC, hinvC, hemptyC⟩ := stage_return_clones Z Z (CutInv.refl Z)
  obtain ⟨hdefP, hinvP, hemptyP⟩ := stage_return_ports Z
    (Z \ pendingTUClones Z Z) hinvC
  have hemptyC' :
      pendingTUClones Z ((Z \ pendingTUClones Z Z) \ pendingSUPorts Z
        (Z \ pendingTUClones Z Z)) = ∅ :=
    pendingTUClones_empty_after_ports hemptyC
  have hW :
      ((Z \ pendingTUClones Z Z) \ pendingSUPorts Z
        (Z \ pendingTUClones Z Z)) =
        canonicalCut Z :=
    eq_canonical_of_pending_empty hinvP hemptyC' hemptyP
  exact hdefC.trans (hW ▸ hdefP)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff
statement:
lemma clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2} :
    GadgetVert.clone v b ∈ canonicalCut Z ↔ classS Z v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨v', b', heq, hS⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, heq, _⟩
    · injection heq with hv _
      cases hv
      exact hS
    · cases heq
  · intro hS
    exact .inl ⟨v, b, rfl, hS⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.port_mem_canonicalCut_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨_, _, heq, _⟩ | ⟨v', w', h', heq, hT⟩
    · cases heq
    · injection heq with hv hw
      cases hv
      exact hT
  · intro hT
    exact .inr ⟨v, w, hvw, rfl, hT⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_adj_remain_T_clone
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  obtain ⟨w, hvw, rfl⟩ := (clone_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj
  exact hx ((port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hT)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.reachable_isolated_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  cases p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hadj _ => exact (hiso _ hadj).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.T_clone_component_singleton
statement:
lemma T_clone_component_singleton {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hT : classT Z v) :
    (((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.clone v b, by
          intro h
          exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩).supp =
      {⟨.clone v b, by
          intro h
          exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩}
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hy' : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable
        ⟨.clone v b, by
          intro h
          exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩ y := by
      have hy' : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable y
          ⟨.clone v b, by
            intro h
            exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩ := by
        simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hy
      exact hy'.symm
    have hiso :
        ∀ z : {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ},
          ¬ (gadget G).Adj (.clone v b) z := by
      intro z hadj
      exact not_adj_remain_T_clone hT z.property hadj
    have : (⟨.clone v b, by
          intro h
          exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩ :
            {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ}) = y :=
      reachable_isolated_eq (H := gadget G) (s := (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ)
        (x := ⟨.clone v b, by
          intro h
          exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩) hiso hy'
    simp [this]
  · intro hy
    simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.T_clone_component_odd
statement:
lemma T_clone_component_odd {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hT : classT Z v) :
    Odd ((((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.clone v b, by
          intro h
          exact ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h) hT.1⟩).supp.ncard)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_clone_component_singleton hT, ncard_singleton]
  exact odd_one

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.T_clones_ne
statement:
lemma T_clones_ne {v : V} {b b' : Fin 2} (h : b ≠ b') :
    GadgetVert.clone (G := G) v b ≠ .clone v b'
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy
  injection hxy with _ hb
  exact h hb

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_sClones
statement:
lemma ncard_sClones (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ({x : GadgetVert G | ∃ v : V, ∃ b : Fin 2, x = .clone v b ∧ classS Z v}).ncard =
      2 * {v | classS Z v}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : {v // classS Z v} × Fin 2 → GadgetVert G :=
    fun p => .clone p.1.1 p.2
  have himage :
      f '' (Set.univ : Set ({v // classS Z v} × Fin 2)) =
        {x | ∃ v b, x = .clone v b ∧ classS Z v} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p.1.1, p.2, rfl, p.1.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, b, rfl, hS⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨v, hS⟩, b⟩, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b h
    injection h with hv hb
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact Subtype.ext hv
    · exact hb
  rw [← himage, ncard_image_of_injective _ hinj, ncard_univ,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, mul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card', Fintype.card_subtype]
  simp [Set.toFinset_setOf]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_ports_of_vertex
statement:
lemma ncard_ports_of_vertex (v : V) :
    ({x : GadgetVert G | ∃ w : V, ∃ h : G.Adj v w, x = .port v w h}).ncard =
      G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : G.neighborSet v → GadgetVert G :=
    fun w => .port v w.1 w.property
  have himage :
      f '' (Set.univ : Set (G.neighborSet v)) =
        {x | ∃ w h, x = .port v w h} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, by simpa [mem_neighborSet] using hw, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, h, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨w, by simpa [mem_neighborSet] using h⟩, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b h
    injection h with _ hw
    exact Subtype.ext hw
  rw [← himage, ncard_image_of_injective _ hinj, ncard_univ,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simp [SimpleGraph.degree, neighborFinset, Fintype.card_coe]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_tPorts
statement:
lemma ncard_tPorts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ({x : GadgetVert G | ∃ v w : V, ∃ h : G.Adj v w,
        x = .port v w h ∧ classT Z v}).ncard =
      ∑ v ∈ {v | classT Z v}.toFinset, G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := {v | classT Z v}
  let P : V → Set (GadgetVert G) :=
    fun v => {x | ∃ w h, x = .port v w h}
  have hunion :
      {x | ∃ v w h, x = .port v w h ∧ classT Z v} =
        ⋃ v ∈ T.toFinset, P v := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_toFinset, T, P, mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, w, h, rfl, hT⟩
      exact ⟨v, hT, ⟨w, h, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hT, ⟨w, h, rfl⟩⟩
      exact ⟨v, w, h, rfl, hT⟩
  have hdisj : ∀ a ∈ T.toFinset, ∀ b ∈ T.toFinset, a ≠ b →
      Disjoint (P a) (P b) := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxa hxb
    obtain ⟨w, h, rfl⟩ := hxa
    obtain ⟨w', h', heq⟩ := hxb
    injection heq with hv _
    exact hab hv
  rw [hunion, ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  have hTF :
      (⋃ v ∈ T.toFinset, P v).toFinset =
        T.toFinset.biUnion fun v => (P v).toFinset := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hTF, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro v hv
    have : (P v).toFinset.card = G.degree v := by
      rw [← ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ncard_ports_of_vertex]
    simpa [P] using this
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    exact disjoint_toFinset.mpr (hdisj a ha b hb hab)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_sClones_tPorts
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hx'
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl, _⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hport, _⟩ := hx'
  cases hport

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_canonicalCut
statement:
lemma ncard_canonicalCut (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    (canonicalCut Z).ncard =
      2 * {v | classS Z v}.ncard +
        ∑ v ∈ {v | classT Z v}.toFinset, G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalCut]
  rw [ncard_union_eq (disjoint_sClones_tPorts Z), ncard_sClones, ncard_tPorts]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ST_port_not_mem_canonical
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact not_classT_of_SU (.inl hS) ((port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_adj_remain_ST_port
statement:
lemma not_adj_remain_ST_port {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V}
    {hst : G.Adj s t} (hS : classS Z s) (hT : classT Z t)
    {x : GadgetVert G} (hx : x ∉ canonicalCut Z) :
    ¬ (gadget G).Adj (.port s t hst) x
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  rcases (port_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨h', rfl⟩
  · exact hx ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hS)
  · have : GadgetVert.port t s h' ∈ canonicalCut Z :=
      (port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hT
    exact hx this

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ST_port_component_singleton
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hy' : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable y
        ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ := by
      simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hy
    have hiso :
        ∀ z : {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ},
          ¬ (gadget G).Adj (.port s t hst) z := by
      intro z hadj
      exact not_adj_remain_ST_port hS hT z.property hadj
    have : (⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ :
        {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ}) = y :=
      reachable_isolated_eq (H := gadget G) (s := (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ)
        (x := ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩) hiso hy'.symm
    simp [this]
  · intro hy
    simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ST_port_component_odd
statement:
lemma ST_port_component_odd {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V}
    {hst : G.Adj s t} (hS : classS Z s) (hT : classT Z t) :
    Odd ((((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩).supp.ncard)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ST_port_component_singleton hS hT, ncard_singleton]
  exact odd_one

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.SS_port_only_remain_nbr
proof:
:= by
  rcases (port_adj_iff (G := G)).mp hadj with ⟨b, hy⟩ | ⟨h', hy⟩
  · have : GadgetVert.clone s b ∈ canonicalCut Z :=
      (clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hS
    exact (y.property (hy ▸ this)).elim
  · exact hy.trans port_eq_of_same_ends

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.SS_ports_remain_adj
statement:
lemma SS_ports_remain_adj {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V}
    {hst : G.Adj s t} (hS : classS Z s) (hS' : classS Z t) :
    ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩
      ⟨.port t s hst.symm, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS'⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [induce_adj]
  exact gadget_adj_mate hst

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.SS_port_component_pair
statement:
lemma SS_port_component_pair {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V}
    {hst : G.Adj s t} (hS : classS Z s) (hS' : classS Z t) :
    (((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩).supp =
      ({⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩,
        ⟨.port t s hst.symm, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS'⟩} :
          Set _)
proof:
:= by
  set pst := (⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ :
      {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ})
  set pts := (⟨.port t s hst.symm, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS'⟩ :
      {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ})
  have hne : pst ≠ pts := by
    intro h
    injection (congrArg Subtype.val h) with hv _
    exact hst.ne hv
  have hadj := SS_ports_remain_adj (hst := hst) hS hS'
  have honly_st : ∀ y, ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj pst y → y = pts := by
    intro y hy
    exact Subtype.ext (SS_port_only_remain_nbr hS hS' (by simpa [induce_adj] using hy))
  have honly_ts : ∀ y, ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj pts y → y = pst := by
    intro y hy
    have : (y : GadgetVert G) = .port s t hst :=
      SS_port_only_remain_nbr hS' hS (by
        have : (pts : GadgetVert G) = .port t s hst.symm := rfl
        simpa [induce_adj, this, port_eq_of_same_ends] using hy)
    exact Subtype.ext (this.trans port_eq_of_same_ends.symm)
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hreach : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable y pst := by
      simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hy
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hreach.symm.exists_isPath
    cases p with
    | nil =>
        simp
    | @cons _ w _ hadj' q =>
        have hw : w = pts := honly_st w hadj'
        have hnodup : (pst :: q.support).Nodup := by
          simpa [Walk.support_cons] using hp.support_nodup
        cases q with
        | nil =>
            simp [hw]
        | @cons _ w2 _ hadj2 q2 =>
            have hw2 : w2 = pst := honly_ts w2 (by
              cases hw
              exact hadj2)
            have hw2mem : w2 ∈ (Walk.cons hadj2 q2).support := by
              simp [Walk.support_cons]
            exact (not_mem_tail_of_isPath_cons hnodup (hw2 ▸ hw2mem)).elim
  · intro hy
    simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with h | h
    · subst y
      simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]
    · subst y
      rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, ConnectedComponent.eq]
      exact hadj.reachable.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.SS_port_component_even
statement:
lemma SS_port_component_even {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V}
    {hst : G.Adj s t} (hS : classS Z s) (hS' : classS Z t) :
    Even ((((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩).supp.ncard)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SS_port_component_pair hS hS']
  set pst := (⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ :
      {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ})
  set pts := (⟨.port t s hst.symm, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS'⟩ :
      {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ})
  have hne : pst ≠ pts := by
    intro h
    injection (congrArg Subtype.val h) with hv _
    exact hst.ne hv
  have : ({pst, pts} : Set _).ncard = 2 := by
    rw [ncard_insert_of_notMem, ncard_singleton]
    simpa using hne
  rw [this]
  exact even_two

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.U_clone_not_mem_canonical
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact not_classS_of_TU (.inr hU) ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.U_surviving_port_not_mem_canonical
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, h, hp⟩ := hU.2
  refine ⟨w, h, fun hmem => hp (canonicalCut_subset Z hmem)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.U_clones_remain_reachable
statement:
lemma U_clones_remain_reachable {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (hU : classU Z v) {b b' : Fin 2} :
    ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable
      ⟨.clone v b, U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hU⟩
      ⟨.clone v b', U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b') hU⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w0, h0, hp0⟩ := U_surviving_port_not_mem_canonical hU
  have h1 : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.clone v b, U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hU⟩
      ⟨.port v w0 h0, hp0⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]
    simp
  have h2 : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.port v w0 h0, hp0⟩
      ⟨.clone v b', U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b') hU⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]
    simp
  exact h1.reachable.trans h2.reachable

name: Nikoghosyan.Independent.anti
statement:
lemma Independent.anti {B : Finset V} (h : Independent (G := G) B)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ B) (hy : y ∈ B) : ¬ G.Adj x y
proof:
:=
  h hx hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Independent.mono
statement:
lemma Independent.mono {B C : Finset V} (h : Independent (G := G) C)
    (hBC : B ⊆ C) : Independent (G := G) B
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hx hy => h (hBC hx) (hBC hy)

name: Nikoghosyan.Independent.not_mem_of_adj
statement:
lemma Independent.not_mem_of_adj {B : Finset V} (h : Independent (G := G) B)
    {x y : V} (hy : y ∈ B) (hadj : G.Adj x y) : x ∉ B
proof:
:=
  fun hx => h hx hy hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.IsTerminalCover.of_subset
proof:
:=
  fun p hp =>
    have ⟨hs, hf⟩ := h p hp
    ⟨hBC hs, hBC hf⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.IsTerminalPath.inter_nonempty
statement:
lemma IsTerminalPath.inter_nonempty {B : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (h : IsTerminalPath (G := G) B p) : (B ∩ p.support).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨p.start, mem_inter.2 ⟨h.1, p.start_mem_support⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.adj_start_trimStart
statement:
lemma adj_start_trimStart (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    G.Adj p.start (p.trimStart h).start
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v, walk, isPath⟩
  cases walk with
  | nil => exact (h Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons hadj q => simpa [trimStart] using hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_support_subset
statement:
lemma takeUntil_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.takeUntil hx).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_union.2 (Or.inl hy)
  rwa [support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_support_subset
statement:
lemma dropUntil_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.dropUntil hx).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_union.2 (Or.inr hy)
  rwa [support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimStart_support_card_lt
statement:
lemma trimStart_support_card_lt (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).support.card < p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_trimStart]
  exact card_erase_lt_of_mem p.start_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimFinish_support_card_lt
statement:
lemma trimFinish_support_card_lt (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimFinish h).support.card < p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_trimFinish]
  exact card_erase_lt_of_mem p.finish_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimFinish_takeUntil_support_card_lt
statement:
lemma trimFinish_takeUntil_support_card_lt (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hs : x ≠ p.start) :
    ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish
        (fun hn => hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn))).support.card <
      p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
    hs ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
  exact (trimFinish_support_card_lt (p.takeUntil hx) hnil).trans_le
    (card_le_card (takeUntil_support_subset p hx))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimStart_dropUntil_support_card_lt
statement:
lemma trimStart_dropUntil_support_card_lt (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hf : x ≠ p.finish) :
    ((p.dropUntil hx).trimStart
        (fun hn => hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn))).support.card <
      p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ (p.dropUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
    hf ((dropUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
  exact (trimStart_support_card_lt (p.dropUntil hx) hnil).trans_le
    (card_le_card (dropUntil_support_subset p hx))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.trimStart_start_not_mem
statement:
lemma trimStart_start_not_mem {B : Finset V} (hB : Independent (G := G) B)
    (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) (hs : p.start ∈ B) :
    (p.trimStart h).start ∉ B
proof:
:=
  hB.not_mem_of_adj hs (adj_start_trimStart p h).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.disjoint_A_B
statement: lemma disjoint_A_B : Disjoint P.A P.B
proof:
:=
  disjoint_of_completeBetween (G := G) P.hAB

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.K_card_pos
statement: lemma K_card_pos : (P.B ∪ P.W).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine union_nonempty.2 (Or.inl (card_pos.mp ?_))
  have hm := P.hm
  have hcard := P.hBcard
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.A_nonempty
statement: lemma A_nonempty : P.A.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine card_pos.mp ?_
  have hm := P.hm
  have hcard := P.hAcard
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.U_anti_K
statement: lemma U_anti_K : ∀ u ∈ P.U, ∀ x ∈ P.B ∪ P.W, ¬ G.Adj u x
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu x hx
  rcases mem_union.1 hx with hB | hW
  · exact P.hUantiB u hu x hB
  · exact P.hUantiW u hu x hW

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.disjoint_U_K
statement: lemma disjoint_U_K : Disjoint P.U (P.B ∪ P.W)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨P.hdisjBU.symm, P.hdisjUW⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.disjoint_A_K
statement: lemma disjoint_A_K : Disjoint P.A (P.B ∪ P.W)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨P.disjoint_A_B, P.hdisjAW⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_of_independent
statement:
lemma componentCount_of_independent {A : Finset V}
    (h : Independent (G := G) A) : componentCount G A = A.card
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.induction
    (motive := fun A => Independent (G := G) A → componentCount G A = A.card)
    ?empty ?insert A h
  · intro _h
    simp [componentCount_empty]
  · intro a s ha ih h
    have hs : Independent (G := G) s := h.mono (subset_insert a s)
    have hnocross : ∀ x ∈ ({a} : Finset V), ∀ b ∈ s, ¬ G.Adj x b := by
      intro x hx b hb
      obtain rfl := mem_singleton.1 hx
      exact h (mem_insert_self x s) (mem_insert_of_mem hb)
    have hdisj : Disjoint ({a} : Finset V) s :=
      disjoint_singleton_left.2 ha
    have hunion :=
      Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisj hnocross
    have ha1 := componentCount_singleton (G := G) a
    have hins : (insert a s : Finset V) = {a} ∪ s := insert_eq a s
    rw [hins, hunion, ha1, ih hs, card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, card_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_add_le_m
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_add_le_m (P : AllCographSides G)
    (htough : OneTough G) :
    pathCoverNumber G P.U + pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ P.m
proof:
:= by
  set K : Finset V := P.B ∪ P.W with hKdef
  set FU := ineligibleSet G P.U with hFUdef
  set FK := ineligibleSet G K with hFKdef
  set S : Finset V := P.A ∪ FU ∪ FK
  have hFU : FU ⊆ P.U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) P.U
  have hFK : FK ⊆ K := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K
  have hdisjAFU : Disjoint P.A FU :=
    disjoint_of_subset_right hFU P.hdisjAU
  have hdisjAFK : Disjoint P.A FK :=
    disjoint_of_subset_right hFK P.disjoint_A_K
  have hdisjFUFK : Disjoint FU FK :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left hFU
      (disjoint_of_subset_right hFK P.disjoint_U_K)
  have hSU : univ \ S = (P.U \ FU) ∪ (K \ FK) := by
    have hcover : P.A ∪ K ∪ P.U = univ := by
      simpa [K, union_assoc, union_left_comm, union_comm] using P.hcover
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxuniv : x ∈ univ := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
      have hxS : x ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
      have hxAUK : x ∈ P.A ∪ K ∪ P.U := hcover ▸ hxuniv
      rcases mem_union.1 hxAUK with hAK | hU
      · rcases mem_union.1 hAK with hA | hK
        · exact (hxS (by exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hA))))).elim
