        · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hK, fun hF =>
            hxS (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hF))⟩))
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hU, fun hF =>
          hxS (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hF))))⟩))
    · intro hx
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ x, ?_⟩
      intro hS
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxU | hxK
      · have hxU' : x ∈ P.U := (mem_sdiff.1 hxU).1
        have hxFU : x ∉ FU := (mem_sdiff.1 hxU).2
        rcases mem_union.1 hS with hAF | hFK'
        · rcases mem_union.1 hAF with hA | hFU'
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjAU hA hxU').elim
          · exact hxFU hFU'
        · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_U_K hxU' (hFK hFK')).elim
      · have hxK' : x ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hxK).1
        have hxFK : x ∉ FK := (mem_sdiff.1 hxK).2
        rcases mem_union.1 hS with hAF | hFK'
        · rcases mem_union.1 hAF with hA | hFU'
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_A_K hA hxK').elim
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_U_K (hFU hFU') hxK').elim
        · exact hxFK hFK'
  have hnocross :
      ∀ a ∈ P.U \ FU, ∀ b ∈ K \ FK, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    exact P.U_anti_K a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 b (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint (P.U \ FU) (K \ FK) :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset
      (disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset P.disjoint_U_K)
  have hadd :=
    Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisjRem hnocross
  have hcU :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) P.hUcog
  have hcK :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) P.hKcog
  have hc : componentCount G (univ \ S) =
      FU.card + pathCoverNumber G P.U + FK.card + pathCoverNumber G K := by
    calc componentCount G (univ \ S)
        = componentCount G ((P.U \ FU) ∪ (K \ FK)) := by rw [hSU]
      _ = componentCount G (P.U \ FU) + componentCount G (K \ FK) := hadd
      _ = componentCount G (P.U \ ineligibleSet G P.U) +
            componentCount G (K \ ineligibleSet G K) := by
              simp [hFUdef, hFKdef]
      _ = (ineligibleSet G P.U).card + pathCoverNumber G P.U +
            ((ineligibleSet G K).card + pathCoverNumber G K) := by
              simpa [hKdef] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hcU hcK
      _ = FU.card + pathCoverNumber G P.U + FK.card + pathCoverNumber G K := by
            simp [hFUdef, hFKdef, add_assoc]
  have hUpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G P.U :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) P.hUne
  have hKpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) P.K_card_pos
  have hge : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ S) := by
    have : 2 ≤ FU.card + pathCoverNumber G P.U + FK.card + pathCoverNumber G K := by
      omega
    simpa [hc] using this
  have ht := htough S hge
  have hScard : S.card = P.m + FU.card + FK.card := by
    have h2 : Disjoint (P.A ∪ FU) FK :=
      disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjAFK, hdisjFUFK⟩
    calc S.card
        = (P.A ∪ FU).card + FK.card := card_union_of_disjoint h2
      _ = P.A.card + FU.card + FK.card := by rw [card_union_of_disjoint hdisjAFU]
      _ = P.m + FU.card + FK.card := by rw [P.hAcard]
  have : componentCount G (univ \ S) ≤ S.card := ht
  have : FU.card + pathCoverNumber G P.U + FK.card + pathCoverNumber G K ≤
      P.m + FU.card + FK.card := by
    simpa [hc, hScard] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_W_le_card_U
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_W_le_card_U (P : AllCographSides G)
    (htough : OneTough G) (hWcog : IsCograph G P.W) :
    pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.U.card
proof:
:= by
  set FW := ineligibleSet G P.W with hFWdef
  set S : Finset V := P.B ∪ P.U ∪ FW
  have hFW : FW ⊆ P.W := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) P.W
  have hdisjBU : Disjoint P.B P.U := P.hdisjBU
  have hdisjBFW : Disjoint P.B FW :=
    disjoint_of_subset_right hFW P.hdisjBW
  have hdisjUFW : Disjoint P.U FW :=
    disjoint_of_subset_right hFW P.hdisjUW
  have hSU : univ \ S = P.A ∪ (P.W \ FW) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxuniv : x ∈ univ := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
      have hxS : x ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
      have hxAll : x ∈ P.A ∪ P.B ∪ P.U ∪ P.W := P.hcover ▸ hxuniv
      rcases mem_union.1 hxAll with hABU | hW
      · rcases mem_union.1 hABU with hAB | hU
        · rcases mem_union.1 hAB with hA | hB
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hA)
          · exact (hxS (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hB))))).elim
        · exact (hxS (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hU))))).elim
      · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hW, fun hF =>
          hxS (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hF))⟩))
    · intro hx
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ x, ?_⟩
      intro hS
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with hA | hW
      · rcases mem_union.1 hS with hBU | hFW'
        · rcases mem_union.1 hBU with hB | hU
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_A_B hA hB).elim
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjAU hA hU).elim
        · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjAW hA (hFW hFW')).elim
      · have hxW : x ∈ P.W := (mem_sdiff.1 hW).1
        have hxFW : x ∉ FW := (mem_sdiff.1 hW).2
        rcases mem_union.1 hS with hBU | hFW'
        · rcases mem_union.1 hBU with hB | hU
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjBW hB hxW).elim
          · exact (disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjUW hU hxW).elim
        · exact hxFW hFW'
  have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ P.A, ∀ b ∈ P.W \ FW, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    exact P.hWantiA b (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1 a ha hadj.symm
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint P.A (P.W \ FW) :=
    disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset P.hdisjAW
  have hadd :=
    Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisjRem hnocross
  have hcA := componentCount_of_independent (G := G) P.hAind
  have hcW :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) hWcog
  have hc : componentCount G (univ \ S) =
      P.m + FW.card + pathCoverNumber G P.W := by
    calc componentCount G (univ \ S)
        = componentCount G (P.A ∪ (P.W \ FW)) := by rw [hSU]
      _ = componentCount G P.A + componentCount G (P.W \ FW) := hadd
      _ = P.A.card + componentCount G (P.W \ ineligibleSet G P.W) := by
            simp [hcA, hFWdef]
      _ = P.m + ((ineligibleSet G P.W).card + pathCoverNumber G P.W) := by
            rw [P.hAcard, hcW]
      _ = P.m + FW.card + pathCoverNumber G P.W := by
            simp [hFWdef, add_assoc]
  have hge : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ S) := by
    have : 2 ≤ P.m + FW.card + pathCoverNumber G P.W := by
      have hm := P.hm
      have hpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G P.W :=
        one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) P.hWne
      omega
    simpa [hc] using this
  have ht := htough S hge
  have hScard : S.card = P.m + P.U.card + FW.card := by
    have h2 : Disjoint (P.B ∪ P.U) FW :=
      disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨hdisjBFW, hdisjUFW⟩
    calc S.card
        = (P.B ∪ P.U).card + FW.card := card_union_of_disjoint h2
      _ = P.B.card + P.U.card + FW.card := by rw [card_union_of_disjoint hdisjBU]
      _ = P.m + P.U.card + FW.card := by rw [P.hBcard]
  have : P.m + FW.card + pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.m + P.U.card + FW.card := by
    simpa [hc, hScard] using ht
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_W
statement: lemma isCograph_W (P : AllCographSides G) : IsCograph G P.W
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd hp =>
    P.hKcog (mem_union.2 (Or.inr ha)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb))
      (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hc)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hd)) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_W_le_card_U_of_sides
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_W_le_card_U_of_sides (P : AllCographSides G)
    (htough : OneTough G) :
    pathCoverNumber G P.W ≤ P.U.card
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_W_le_card_U P htough (isCograph_W P)

name: Nikoghosyan.isTerminalCover_empty
statement:
lemma isTerminalCover_empty (B : Finset V) :
    IsTerminalCover (G := G) B (PathCover.singletons (G := G) (∅ : Finset V))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have : p ∈ (∅ : Finset V).toList.map (GraphPath.singleton (G := G)) := hp
  simp at this

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_empty_terminal
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_empty_terminal (B : Finset V) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (∅ : Finset V),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (∅ : Finset V) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PathCover.singletons (G := G) ∅, ?_, isTerminalCover_empty B⟩
  simp [pathCoverNumber_empty, PathCover.singletons_card]

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_singleton
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_singleton {B : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hb : b ∈ B) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G ({b} : Finset V),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G ({b} : Finset V) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  let pc := PathCover.singletons (G := G) ({b} : Finset V)
  refine ⟨pc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcard : pc.card = 1 := by
      simp [pc, PathCover.singletons_card]
    have hmin : pathCoverNumber G ({b} : Finset V) = 1 :=
      Cograph.pathCoverNumber_singleton (G := G) b
    exact hcard.trans hmin.symm
  · intro p hp
    have : p ∈ ({b} : Finset V).toList.map (GraphPath.singleton (G := G)) := hp
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 this
    have hx' : x = b := mem_singleton.1 (mem_toList.1 hx)
    subst hx'
    exact ⟨hb, hb⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalCover_card_le
statement:
lemma terminalCover_card_le {K B : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) : pc.card ≤ B.card
proof:
:= by
  let starts := pc.paths.map GraphPath.start
  have hlen : starts.length = pc.card := by
    simp [starts, PathCover.card]
  have hnodup : starts.Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on pc.nodup_paths]
    intro p hp q hq heq
    by_contra hne
    have hdisj := PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem_refinement pc.disjoint hp hq hne
    exact (disjoint_left.1 hdisj p.start_mem_support (heq ▸ q.start_mem_support)).elim
  have hsub : starts.toFinset ⊆ B := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 (List.mem_toFinset.1 hx)
    exact (hterm p hp).1
  have hcard : starts.toFinset.card = starts.length :=
    List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have : starts.toFinset.card ≤ B.card := card_le_card hsub
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.isTerminalCover_unionDisjoint
statement:
lemma isTerminalCover_unionDisjoint {A C B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A C)
    (pcA : PathCover G A) (pcC : PathCover G C)
    (hA : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pcA)
    (hC : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pcC) :
    IsTerminalCover (G := G) B
      (Cograph.PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcA pcC)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hp' : p ∈ pcA.paths ++ pcC.paths := hp
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hp' with h | h
  · exact hA p h
  · exact hC p h

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_profileModule
statement:
lemma mem_profileModule {K B P : Finset V} {v : V} :
    v ∈ profileModule (G := G) K B P ↔
      v ∈ K \ B ∧ Bprofile (G := G) B v = P
proof:
:=
  mem_filter

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_realizedProfiles
statement:
lemma mem_realizedProfiles {K B P : Finset V} :
    P ∈ realizedProfiles (G := G) K B ↔
      ∃ v ∈ K \ B, Bprofile (G := G) B v = P
proof:
:=
  mem_image

name: Nikoghosyan.profileModule_subset_sdiff
statement:
lemma profileModule_subset_sdiff {K B P : Finset V} :
    profileModule (G := G) K B P ⊆ K \ B
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.Bprofile_subset
statement:
lemma Bprofile_subset (B : Finset V) (v : V) :
    Bprofile (G := G) B v ⊆ B
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.commonNeighborLayer_eq_profileModule
statement:
lemma commonNeighborLayer_eq_profileModule {K B : Finset V} :
    commonNeighborLayer (G := G) K B = profileModule (G := G) K B B
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hvKB : v ∈ K \ B := (mem_filter.1 hv).1
    have hall : ∀ b ∈ B, G.Adj b v := (mem_filter.1 hv).2
    have hP : Bprofile (G := G) B v = B := by
      ext b
      constructor
      · intro hb
        exact (mem_filter.1 hb).1
      · intro hb
        exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hb, hall b hb⟩
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hvKB, hP⟩
  · intro hv
    have hvKB : v ∈ K \ B := (mem_filter.1 hv).1
    have hP : Bprofile (G := G) B v = B := (mem_filter.1 hv).2
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨hvKB, ?_⟩
    intro b hb
    have : b ∈ Bprofile (G := G) B v := by simpa [hP] using hb
    exact (mem_filter.1 this).2

name: Nikoghosyan.realizedProfiles_nested
statement:
lemma realizedProfiles_nested {K B : Finset V}
    (hK : IsCograph G K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {P Q : Finset V}
    (hP : P ∈ realizedProfiles (G := G) K B)
    (hQ : Q ∈ realizedProfiles (G := G) K B) :
    P ⊆ Q ∨ Q ⊆ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hPv⟩ := mem_image.1 hP
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hQw⟩ := mem_image.1 hQ
  have hnest := Bprofile_nested (G := G) hK hInd hBK hN hv hw
  simpa [hPv, hQw] using hnest

name: Nikoghosyan.isCompleteBetween_profileModules
statement:
lemma isCompleteBetween_profileModules {K B P Q : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hne : P ≠ Q) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween
      (profileModule (G := G) K B P : Set V)
      (profileModule (G := G) K B Q : Set V)
proof:
:=
  isCompleteBetween_of_Bprofile_ne (G := G) hN hne

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_profileModule_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hPv : Bprofile (G := G) B v = P := (mem_filter.1 hv).2
  constructor
  · intro hadj
    have : b ∈ Bprofile (G := G) B v := mem_filter.2 ⟨hb, hadj⟩
    simpa [hPv] using this
  · intro hbP
    have : b ∈ Bprofile (G := G) B v := by simpa [hPv] using hbP
    exact (mem_filter.1 this).2

name: Nikoghosyan.profileModule_cograph
statement:
lemma profileModule_cograph {K B P : Finset V} (hK : IsCograph G K) :
    IsCograph G (profileModule (G := G) K B P)
proof:
:=
  IsCograph.subset (G := G) hK
    ((profileModule_subset_sdiff (G := G)).trans sdiff_subset)

name: Nikoghosyan.Bprofile_subset_inter_of_nocross
statement:
lemma Bprofile_subset_inter_of_nocross {D B : Finset V} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ D \ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ i ∈ B \ D, ¬ G.Adj a i) :
    Bprofile (G := G) B v ⊆ B ∩ D
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_filter.1 hb).1
  have hadj : G.Adj b v := (mem_filter.1 hb).2
  have hvD : v ∈ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hbD : b ∈ D := by
    by_contra hbD
    exact hnocross v hvD b (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hbB, hbD⟩) hadj.symm
  exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hbB, hbD⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.D_sdiff_inter_eq
statement: lemma D_sdiff_inter_eq (D B : Finset V) : D \ (B ∩ D) = D \ B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxD : x ∈ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxBd : x ∉ B ∩ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxD, fun hB => hxBd (mem_inter.2 ⟨hB, hxD⟩)⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxD : x ∈ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxB : x ∉ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxD, fun hBd => hxB (mem_inter.1 hBd).1⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.unique_Bprofile_eq_Bd
statement:
lemma unique_Bprofile_eq_Bd {D B : Finset V}
    (hconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hBd : (B ∩ D).Nonempty) (hWne : (D \ B).Nonempty)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ i ∈ B \ D, ¬ G.Adj a i)
    (huniq : ∀ v ∈ D \ B, ∀ w ∈ D \ B,
      Bprofile (G := G) B v = Bprofile (G := G) B w) :
    ∀ v ∈ D \ B, Bprofile (G := G) B v = B ∩ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ := hWne
  let P := Bprofile (G := G) B v0
  have hPsub : P ⊆ B ∩ D :=
    Bprofile_subset_inter_of_nocross (G := G) hv0 hnocross
  have halleq : ∀ v ∈ D \ B, Bprofile (G := G) B v = P :=
    fun v hv => huniq v hv v0 hv0
  have hW' : (D \ (B ∩ D)).Nonempty := by
    rw [D_sdiff_inter_eq]
    exact ⟨v0, hv0⟩
  have hBdP : B ∩ D ⊆ P := by
    intro b hb
    have hIndD : Independent (G := G) (B ∩ D) := hInd.mono inter_subset_left
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hadj⟩ :=
      exists_nonterminal_adj (G := G) (K := D) (B := B ∩ D)
        hconn hIndD inter_subset_right hb hW'
    have hwDB : w ∈ D \ B := by
      rwa [← D_sdiff_inter_eq D B]
    have hPw : Bprofile (G := G) B w = P := halleq w hwDB
    have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_inter.1 hb).1
    have hbP : b ∈ Bprofile (G := G) B w := mem_filter.2 ⟨hbB, hadj⟩
    simpa [hPw] using hbP
  intro v hv
  exact (halleq v hv).trans (Subset.antisymm hPsub hBdP)

name: Nikoghosyan.complete_Bd_of_unique_profile
statement:
lemma complete_Bd_of_unique_profile {D B : Finset V}
    (huniq : ∀ v ∈ D \ B, Bprofile (G := G) B v = B ∩ D) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween ((B ∩ D : Finset V) : Set V)
      ((D \ B : Finset V) : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb w hw
  have hP : Bprofile (G := G) B w = B ∩ D := huniq w hw
  have hbP : b ∈ Bprofile (G := G) B w := by simpa [hP] using hb
  exact (mem_filter.1 hbP).2

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_W_le_of_slack
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_W_le_of_slack {D Bd Y : Finset V}
    (hBd : Bd ⊆ D) (hBdne : Bd.Nonempty)
    (_hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hcogW : IsCograph G (D \ Bd))
    (hslack : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) D Bd Y.card) :
    pathCoverNumber G (D \ Bd) ≤ Bd.card + Y.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  set W := D \ Bd
  set FW := ineligibleSet G W
  have hFWsub : FW ⊆ W := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) W
  have hS : Bd ∪ FW ⊆ D :=
    union_subset hBd (hFWsub.trans sdiff_subset)
  have hSne : (Bd ∪ FW).Nonempty := hBdne.mono subset_union_left
  have hBdS : Bd ⊆ Bd ∪ FW := subset_union_left
  have hz := hslack.2 (Bd ∪ FW) hS hSne
  have hz' :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) D Bd (Bd ∪ FW) =
        componentCount G (D \ (Bd ∪ FW)) :=
    terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) hBdS
  have hdiff : D \ (Bd ∪ FW) = W \ FW := by
    have hDW : Bd ∪ W = D := union_sdiff_of_subset hBd
    simpa [W, hDW] using
      union_sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_right (X := Bd) (Y := W) (F := FW)
        disjoint_sdiff hFWsub
  have hcut :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) hcogW
  have hcard : (Bd ∪ FW).card = Bd.card + FW.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_of_subset_right hFWsub disjoint_sdiff)
  have hle : componentCount G (W \ FW) ≤ (Bd ∪ FW).card + Y.card - 1 := by
    simpa [hz', hdiff] using hz
  have hcanon : componentCount G (W \ FW) = FW.card + pathCoverNumber G W := by
    simpa [FW, W] using hcut
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_cap_both_ends
statement:
lemma exists_cap_both_ends {A B : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (p : GraphPath G) (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hf : p.finish ∈ A)
    {b1 b2 : V} (hb1 : b1 ∈ B) (hb2 : b2 ∈ B) (hne : b1 ≠ b2)
    (h1 : b1 ∉ p.support) (h2 : b2 ∉ p.support) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start = b1 ∧ r.finish = b2 ∧
        r.support = insert b2 (insert b1 p.support)
proof:
:= by
  have hadj1 : G.Adj b1 p.start := (hAB hs hb1).symm
  let q := p.consAdj hadj1 h1
  have hfq : q.finish = p.finish := rfl
  have hadj2 : G.Adj q.finish b2 := by
    rw [hfq]
    exact hAB hf hb2
  have h2q : b2 ∉ q.support := by
    intro hb2q
    have : b2 ∈ insert b1 p.support := by
      simpa [q, GraphPath.support_consAdj] using hb2q
    rcases mem_insert.1 this with hbs | hbp
    · exact hne.symm hbs
    · exact h2 hbp
  refine ⟨q.concatAdj hadj2 h2q, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  simp [q, GraphPath.support_concatAdj, GraphPath.support_consAdj]

name: Nikoghosyan.eq_pair_of_card_two
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ({b1, b2} : Finset V) ⊆ T :=
    insert_subset hb1 (singleton_subset_iff.2 hb2)
  have hcard2 : ({b1, b2} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem, card_singleton]
    simp [mem_singleton, hne]
  exact (eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_T_ended_path_of_W_ended_cover
statement:
lemma exists_T_ended_path_of_W_ended_cover {W T U : Finset V}
    (hWT : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (T : Set V))
    (hdisj : Disjoint T U)
    (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ W ∧ p.finish ∈ W)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ pc.card)
    (hT : T.card = pc.card + 1) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.start ∈ T ∧ r.finish ∈ T ∧ r.start ≠ r.finish ∧
        r.support = U ∪ T
proof:
:= by
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (U T : Finset V) (pc : PathCover G U),
        pc.card = k →
        1 ≤ k →
        Disjoint T U →
        (∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ W ∧ p.finish ∈ W) →
        T.card = k + 1 →
        G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (T : Set V) →
        ∃ r : GraphPath G,
          r.start ∈ T ∧ r.finish ∈ T ∧ r.start ≠ r.finish ∧
            r.support = U ∪ T := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro U T pc hcard hpos hdisj hend hT hWT
      omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro U T pc hcard hpos hdisj hend hT hWT
      by_cases hk1 : k = 0
      · have hcard1 : pc.card = 1 := by omega
        obtain ⟨p, hpseq⟩ := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pc hcard1
        have hp : p ∈ pc.paths := by simp [hpseq]
        have hs : p.start ∈ W := (hend p hp).1
        have hf : p.finish ∈ W := (hend p hp).2
        have hT2 : 2 ≤ T.card := by omega
        obtain ⟨b1, b2, hb1, hb2, hne⟩ := exists_two_mem_of_two_le_card hT2
        have h1p : b1 ∉ p.support := fun h =>
          (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hb1) ((pc.mem_iff b1).2 ⟨p, hp, h⟩)
        have h2p : b2 ∉ p.support := fun h =>
          (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hb2) ((pc.mem_iff b2).2 ⟨p, hp, h⟩)
        obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hrsup⟩ :=
          exists_cap_both_ends hWT p hs hf hb1 hb2 hne h1p h2p
        have hU : p.support = U := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            exact (pc.mem_iff x).2 ⟨p, hp, hx⟩
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
            have : q = p := by simpa [hpseq] using hq
            subst this
            exact hxq
        have hTpair : T = ({b1, b2} : Finset V) :=
          eq_pair_of_card_two hb1 hb2 hne (by omega)
        refine ⟨r, by simpa [hrs] using hb1, by simpa [hrf] using hb2, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [hrs, hrf] using hne
        · rw [hrsup, hU, hTpair]
          ext x
          simp [mem_union, mem_insert, mem_singleton, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
      · have h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card := by omega
        have hTne : T.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by omega)
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hTne
        have htU : t ∉ U := Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj ht
        obtain ⟨pc', hcard', hend'⟩ :=
          exists_splice_two_through hWT pc h2 hend ht htU
        let T' := T.erase t
        have hdisj' : Disjoint T' (insert t U) := by
          refine disjoint_insert_right.2 ⟨notMem_erase t T, ?_⟩
          exact disjoint_of_subset_left (erase_subset t T) hdisj
        have hT' : T'.card = pc'.card + 1 := by
          rw [card_erase_of_mem ht, hcard']
          omega
        have hWT' : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (T' : Set V) :=
          IsCompleteBetween.mono hWT subset_rfl (erase_subset t T)
        have hpos' : 1 ≤ pc'.card := by omega
        have hck : pc'.card = k := by omega
        have hposk : 1 ≤ k := by omega
        have hTk : T'.card = k + 1 := by omega
        obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, hne, hrsup⟩ :=
          ih (insert t U) T' pc' hck hposk hdisj' hend' hTk hWT'
        refine ⟨r, mem_of_mem_erase hrs, mem_of_mem_erase hrf, hne, ?_⟩
        rw [hrsup]
        ext x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          have hx' : x ∈ insert t U ∪ T.erase t := by simpa [T'] using hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx' with hxL | hxR
          · rcases mem_insert.1 hxL with rfl | hxU
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr ht)
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxU)
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_of_mem_erase hxR))
        · intro hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxU | hxT
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_insert.2 (Or.inr hxU)))
          · by_cases hxt : x = t
            · subst hxt
              exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_insert_self _ _))
            · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_erase.2 ⟨hxt, hxT⟩))
  exact aux pc.card U T pc rfl hpos hdisj hend hT hWT

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_Bd_ended_cover_of_join_excess_one
statement:
lemma exists_min_Bd_ended_cover_of_join_excess_one {Bd W : Finset V}
    (hBdne : Bd.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : Disjoint Bd W)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (Bd : Set V) (W : Set V))
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) Bd)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G W + 1 = Bd.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (Bd ∪ W),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (Bd ∪ W) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) Bd pc
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hW : W.Nonempty
  · have hpWpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G W :=
      one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hW
    obtain ⟨pcW, hWcard⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) W
    have hendW : ∀ p ∈ pcW.paths, p.start ∈ W ∧ p.finish ∈ W := by
      intro p hpW
      exact ⟨pcW.support_subset hpW p.start_mem_support,
        pcW.support_subset hpW p.finish_mem_support⟩
    have hT : Bd.card = pcW.card + 1 := by omega
    have hpos : 1 ≤ pcW.card := by omega
    have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (W : Set V) (Bd : Set V) :=
      IsCompleteBetween.symm hAB
    obtain ⟨r, hrs, hrf, _hne, hrsup⟩ :=
      exists_T_ended_path_of_W_ended_cover hBA hdisj pcW hendW hpos hT
    have hsupp : r.support = Bd ∪ W := by
      rw [hrsup, union_comm]
    refine ⟨PathCover.ofSupport r hsupp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcard1 : (PathCover.ofSupport r hsupp).card = 1 :=
        PathCover.ofSupport_card r hsupp
      have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (PathCover.ofSupport r hsupp)
      have hU : (Bd ∪ W).Nonempty := hBdne.mono subset_union_left
      have hge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hU
      omega
    · exact PathCover.ofSupport_terminal r hsupp hrs hrf
  · have hW0 : W = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hW
    subst hW0
    have heq : Bd ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = Bd := union_empty Bd
    obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ :=
      exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B (K := Bd) (B := Bd) subset_rfl hInd
    refine ⟨pc.cast heq.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard, heq]
    · intro p hp
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc heq.symm] at hp
      exact hterm p hp

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_unique_profile_child
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_of_unique_profile_child {D I B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint D I) (hI : I ⊆ B)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ G.Adj a i)
    (_hconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)).Connected)
    (hBd : (B ∩ D).Nonempty) (_hWne : (D \ B).Nonempty)
    (huniq : ∀ v ∈ D \ B, Bprofile (G := G) B v = B ∩ D)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (D \ B) + 1 = (B ∩ D).card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (D ∪ I),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (D ∪ I) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween ((B ∩ D : Finset V) : Set V)
      ((D \ B : Finset V) : Set V) :=
    complete_Bd_of_unique_profile (G := G) huniq
  have hIndBd : Independent (G := G) (B ∩ D) := hInd.mono inter_subset_left
  have hdisjDW : Disjoint (B ∩ D) (D \ B) := by
    refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxBd hxW
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hxW).2 (mem_inter.1 hxBd).1
  have hDU : (B ∩ D) ∪ (D \ B) = D := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_union.1 hx with h | h
      · exact (mem_inter.1 h).2
      · exact (mem_sdiff.1 h).1
    · intro hx
      by_cases hB : x ∈ B
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hB, hx⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx, hB⟩))
  obtain ⟨pcD0, hcard0, hterm0⟩ :=
    exists_min_Bd_ended_cover_of_join_excess_one
      hBd hdisjDW hAB hIndBd hp
  refine exists_min_terminalCover_mixed_union_isolates hdisj hI hInd hnocross
    ⟨pcD0.cast hDU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard0]
    exact congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hDU
  · intro p hpD
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pcD0 hDU] at hpD
    exact IsTerminalCover.of_subset hterm0 inter_subset_left p hpD

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_canonical_unique_profile
statement:
theorem exists_min_terminalCover_of_canonical_unique_profile
    (H : CanonicalJoinSplit (G := G))
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (huniq : ∀ v ∈ s.D \ H.B, ∀ w ∈ s.D \ H.B,
      Bprofile (G := G) H.B v = Bprofile (G := G) H.B w)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (s.D \ H.B) + 1 = (H.B ∩ s.D).card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G H.K ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hIeq : s.I = H.X \ s.D := s.I_eq
  have hnocrossB : ∀ a ∈ s.D, ∀ i ∈ H.B \ s.D, ¬ G.Adj a i := by
    intro a ha i hi
    have hiB : i ∈ H.B := (mem_sdiff.1 hi).1
    have hiD : i ∉ s.D := (mem_sdiff.1 hi).2
    have hiX : i ∈ H.X := H.B_subset_X hiB
    have hiI : i ∈ s.I := by
      have : i ∈ H.X \ s.D := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hiX, hiD⟩
      simpa [hIeq] using this
    exact s.hnocross a ha i hiI
  have hprof : ∀ v ∈ s.D \ H.B, Bprofile (G := G) H.B v = H.B ∩ s.D :=
    unique_Bprofile_eq_Bd (G := G) s.hconn H.hInd s.hBd s.hnonterm
      hnocrossB huniq
  obtain ⟨pcX, hcardX, htermX⟩ :=
    exists_min_terminalCover_of_unique_profile_child
      s.hdisj s.hI H.hInd s.hnocross s.hconn s.hBd s.hnonterm hprof hp
  have hXeq : s.D ∪ s.I = H.X := s.hDU
  have hcardX' : (pcX.cast hXeq).card = pathCoverNumber G H.X := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcardX]
    exact congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hXeq
  have htermX' : IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B (pcX.cast hXeq) := by
    intro p hpX
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pcX hXeq] at hpX
    exact htermX p hpX
  by_cases hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K
  · have hTH' : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (H.X ∪ H.Y) H.B := by
      simpa [H.union_X_Y] using H.hTH
    have hcog' : IsCograph G (H.X ∪ H.Y) := by
      simpa [H.union_X_Y] using H.hcog
    have hpK' : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (H.X ∪ H.Y) := by
      simpa [H.union_X_Y] using hpK
    have hdom : H.Y.card < pathCoverNumber G H.X :=
      dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero H.X_nonempty H.hYne H.complete_X_Y
        hcog' H.B_subset_X hTH' hpK'
    have hjoin :=
      exists_min_terminalCover_complete_join H.X_nonempty H.hYne H.complete_X_Y
        H.B_subset_X hdom ⟨pcX.cast hXeq, hcardX', htermX'⟩
    have hKeq : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.K := H.union_X_Y
    obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := hjoin
    refine ⟨pc.cast hKeq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard]
      exact congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hKeq
    · intro p hpKs
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc hKeq] at hpKs
      exact hterm p hpKs
  · have hp1 : pathCoverNumber G H.K = 1 := by
      have hpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K :=
        one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) (H.hBne.mono H.hBK)
      omega
    exact exists_min_terminalCover_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
      H.two_le_card H.hcog H.hconn hp1 H.hBK H.hBne H.hTH

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalHypothesis_iff_slackStrong_zero
statement:
lemma terminalHypothesis_iff_slackStrong_zero {K B : Finset V} :
    TerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B ↔
      TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) K B 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨by simpa [Nat.pred] using (h.1 : _ = 0), ?_⟩
    intro S hS hne
    simpa using h.2 S hS hne
  · intro h
    refine ⟨Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (by simpa [Nat.pred] using h.1), ?_⟩
    intro S hS hne
    simpa using h.2 S hS hne

name: Nikoghosyan.TerminalHypothesisSlack.of_strong
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1.trans (Nat.pred_le t), h.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.of_terminalHypothesis
proof:
:=
  (terminalHypothesis_iff_slackStrong_zero (G := G) (K := K) (B := B)).1 h

name: Nikoghosyan.pred_add_card_eq
statement:
lemma pred_add_card_eq {t : ℕ} {Y : Finset V} (_hYne : Y.Nonempty) :
    Nat.pred (t + Y.card) = Y.card + t - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, Nat.add_comm t]

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child
statement:
lemma terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child {X Y B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hYne : Y.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y) (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B t) :
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) X B (t + Y.card)
proof:
:= by
  have hYsub : Y ⊆ X ∪ Y := subset_union_right
  have hempty :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) X B ∅ ≤ Nat.pred (t + Y.card) := by
    have hz := hTH.2 Y hYsub hYne
    have hEq :
        terminalComponentCount (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B Y =
          terminalComponentCount (G := G) X B ∅ := by
      simpa using
        terminalComponentCount_join_delete_right (G := G) (B := B)
          (S := (∅ : Finset V)) hdisj hB (empty_subset X)
    have hpred := pred_add_card_eq (t := t) hYne
    have : terminalComponentCount (G := G) X B ∅ ≤ Y.card + t - 1 := by
      rwa [hEq] at hz
    rwa [hpred]
  refine ⟨hempty, ?_⟩
  intro S hS _hSne
  have hcut : S ∪ Y ⊆ X ∪ Y :=
    union_subset (hS.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right
  have hne : (S ∪ Y).Nonempty := hYne.mono subset_union_right
  have hz := hTH.2 (S ∪ Y) hcut hne
  have hEq :=
    terminalComponentCount_join_delete_right (G := G) (B := B) hdisj hB hS
  have hcard : (S ∪ Y).card = S.card + Y.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_of_subset_left hS hdisj)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child_of_terminal
statement:
lemma terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child_of_terminal {X Y B : Finset V}
    (hYne : Y.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y) (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B) :
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) X B Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B 0 :=
    TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong.of_terminalHypothesis hTH
  simpa using
    terminalHypothesisSlackStrong_join_child (t := 0) hYne hdisj hB h0

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_join_child_empty_strong
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_join_child_empty_strong {X Y B : Finset V}
    (hYne : Y.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y) (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) X B ∅ ≤ Y.card - 1
proof:
:=
  terminalComponentCount_join_child_empty_le hYne hdisj hB hTH

name: Nikoghosyan.union_sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_right
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hxXY, hxnot⟩
    have hxX : x ∉ X := fun hX => hxnot (Or.inl hX)
    have hxF : x ∉ F := fun hF' => hxnot (Or.inr hF')
    rcases hxXY with hxX' | hxY
    · exact (hxX hxX').elim
    · exact ⟨hxY, hxF⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxX : x ∉ X := fun hX => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hX hx.1
    exact ⟨Or.inr hx.1, fun h => h.elim hxX hx.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_lt
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_lt {X Y B : Finset V}
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (_hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hKcog : IsCograph G (X ∪ Y))
    (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B) :
    pathCoverNumber G Y + 1 ≤ X.card
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hYcog : IsCograph G Y :=
    fun a b c d ha hb hc hd hp =>
      hKcog (mem_union.2 (Or.inr ha)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb))
        (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hc)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hd)) hp
  set FY := ineligibleSet G Y
  have hFYsub : FY ⊆ Y := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) Y
  have hS : X ∪ FY ⊆ X ∪ Y :=
    union_subset subset_union_left (hFYsub.trans subset_union_right)
  have hSne : (X ∪ FY).Nonempty := hXne.mono subset_union_left
  have hBS : B ⊆ X ∪ FY := hB.trans subset_union_left
  have hz := hTH.2 (X ∪ FY) hS hSne
  have hz' :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B (X ∪ FY) =
        componentCount G ((X ∪ Y) \ (X ∪ FY)) :=
    terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) hBS
  have hdiff := union_sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_right hdisj hFYsub
  have hcut :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) hYcog
  have hcard : (X ∪ FY).card = X.card + FY.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_of_subset_right hFYsub hdisj)
  have hle : componentCount G (Y \ FY) ≤ (X ∪ FY).card - 1 := by
    simpa [hz', hdiff] using hz
  have hle' : componentCount G (Y \ FY) ≤ X.card + FY.card - 1 := by
    rwa [hcard] at hle
  have hcanon : componentCount G (Y \ FY) = FY.card + pathCoverNumber G Y := by
    simpa [FY] using hcut
  have hXpos : 1 ≤ X.card := card_pos.2 hXne
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_le_slack
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_le_slack {X Y B : Finset V} {t : ℕ}
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (_hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hKcog : IsCograph G (X ∪ Y))
    (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesisSlackStrong (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B t) :
    pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ X.card + t - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hYcog : IsCograph G Y :=
    fun a b c d ha hb hc hd hp =>
      hKcog (mem_union.2 (Or.inr ha)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb))
        (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hc)) (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hd)) hp
  set FY := ineligibleSet G Y
  have hFYsub : FY ⊆ Y := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) Y
  have hS : X ∪ FY ⊆ X ∪ Y :=
    union_subset subset_union_left (hFYsub.trans subset_union_right)
  have hSne : (X ∪ FY).Nonempty := hXne.mono subset_union_left
  have hBS : B ⊆ X ∪ FY := hB.trans subset_union_left
  have hz := hTH.2 (X ∪ FY) hS hSne
  have hz' :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B (X ∪ FY) =
        componentCount G ((X ∪ Y) \ (X ∪ FY)) :=
    terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) hBS
  have hdiff := union_sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_right hdisj hFYsub
  have hcut :=
    Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_canonical (G := G) hYcog
  have hcard : (X ∪ FY).card = X.card + FY.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_of_subset_right hFYsub hdisj)
  have hle : componentCount G (Y \ FY) ≤ (X ∪ FY).card + t - 1 := by
    simpa [hz', hdiff] using hz
  have hcanon : componentCount G (Y \ FY) = FY.card + pathCoverNumber G Y := by
    simpa [FY] using hcut
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero
statement:
lemma dominant_mixed_child_of_slack_zero {X Y B : Finset V}
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hKcog : IsCograph G (X ∪ Y))
    (hB : B ⊆ X)
    (hTH : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (X ∪ Y) B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y)) :
    Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X
proof:
:= by
  have hpY : pathCoverNumber G Y + 1 ≤ X.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_lt hXne hYne hAB hKcog hB hTH
  have hj := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hXne hYne hAB
  have hYsub : pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ X.card := by omega
  have hY0 : pathCoverNumber G Y - X.card = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hYsub
  have hnot1 : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hpX : ¬ pathCoverNumber G X ≤ Y.card := by
    intro hle
    have hxsub : pathCoverNumber G X - Y.card = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hle
    have : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) = 1 := by
      rw [hj, hxsub, hY0]
      simp
    exact hnot1 this
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge hpX

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.deficit_eq_zero_of_terminal
proof:
:= by
  unfold PathCover.endpointDeficit
  refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hn
  have ht := h p hp
  simp [GraphPath.endpointDeficit, ht.1, ht.2]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.terminalCover_of_deficit_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hmem :
      p.endpointDeficit B ∈ pc.paths.map (fun q => q.endpointDeficit B) :=
    List.mem_map.2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hle :
      p.endpointDeficit B ≤
        (pc.paths.map (fun q => q.endpointDeficit B)).sum :=
    List.le_sum_of_mem hmem
  have hp0 : p.endpointDeficit B = 0 := by
    unfold PathCover.endpointDeficit at h
    omega
  exact (GraphPath.endpointDeficit_eq_zero_iff (G := G) B p).1 hp0

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.singletons_terminal
statement:
lemma PathCover.singletons_terminal {B U : Finset V} (hUB : U ⊆ B) :
    IsTerminalCover (G := G) B (PathCover.singletons (G := G) U)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hp
  have hvB : v ∈ B := hUB (mem_toList.1 hv)
  exact ⟨hvB, hvB⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_eq_card_of_independent
proof:
:= by
  have hc := componentCount_of_independent (G := G) h
  have hle := componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber (G := G) U
  have hge := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) U
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B {K B : Finset V}
    (hKB : K ⊆ B) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G K ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hIndK : Independent (G := G) K := hInd.mono hKB
  refine ⟨PathCover.singletons (G := G) K, ?_, PathCover.singletons_terminal hKB⟩
  simp [pathCoverNumber_eq_card_of_independent (G := G) hIndK]

name: Nikoghosyan.all_nonterminals_mem_component_of_BV_edge
statement:
lemma all_nonterminals_mem_component_of_BV_edge {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    {b v w : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hw : w ∈ K \ B)
    (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    w ∈ componentFinset G K
      ((G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hR :=
    reachable_all_nonterminals_of_neighbor (G := G) hN hBK hb hv hw hadj
  have hvK : v ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hwK : w ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
  have hC :
      (G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨w, hwK⟩ =
        (G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvK⟩ :=
    (Quot.sound hR).symm
  exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hwK, ⟨hwK, hC⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.adj_mem_componentFinset'
proof:
:= by
  have hxU : x ∈ U := (mem_filter.1 hx).1
  obtain ⟨_, hxC⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hadj' : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Adj ⟨x, hxU⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
    simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
  have hyC :
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hy⟩ = C :=
    (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj').symm.trans hxC
  exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hy, ⟨hy, hyC⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.mem_componentFinset_of_adj_B
statement:
lemma mem_componentFinset_of_adj_B {K : Finset V}
    {b v : V} (hbK : b ∈ K) (hvK : v ∈ K) (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    b ∈ componentFinset G K
      ((G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvK⟩)
proof:
:=
  adj_mem_componentFinset' (G := G)
    (mem_filter.2 ⟨hvK, ⟨hvK, rfl⟩⟩) hbK hadj.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_subset_mixed_component
statement:
lemma sdiff_subset_mixed_component {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    {b v : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    K \ B ⊆
      componentFinset G K
        ((G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  exact all_nonterminals_mem_component_of_BV_edge hN hBK hb hv hw hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_mixed_component_subset_B
statement:
lemma sdiff_mixed_component_subset_B {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    {b v : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    K \
        componentFinset G K
          ((G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1⟩) ⊆
      B
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxK : x ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
  have hxC : x ∉
      componentFinset G K
        ((G.induce (K : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1⟩) :=
    (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
  by_contra hxB
  have hxV : x ∈ K \ B := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxK, hxB⟩
  exact hxC (all_nonterminals_mem_component_of_BV_edge hN hBK hb hv hxV hadj)

name: Nikoghosyan.no_cross_mixed_component
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  exact hyC (adj_mem_componentFinset' (G := G) hx hy hadj)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_mixed_union_isolates
statement:
lemma exists_min_terminalCover_mixed_union_isolates {D I B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint D I) (hI : I ⊆ B)
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ I, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hD : ∃ pc : PathCover G D,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G D ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (D ∪ I),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (D ∪ I) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pcI, hIcard, hIterm⟩ :=
    exists_min_terminalCover_subset_B (K := I) (B := B) hI hInd
  exact exists_min_terminalCover_disjoint_union hdisj hnocross hD
    ⟨pcI, hIcard, hIterm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_sides_of_mixed_traceable
statement:
theorem exists_min_terminalCover_of_sides_of_mixed_traceable
    (P : AllCographSides G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (htough : OneTough G)
    (hconn : (G.induce ((P.B ∪ P.W : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) = 1) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := P.repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_oneTough hpat htough
  have h2 : 2 ≤ (P.B ∪ P.W).card := by
    have hB2 : 2 ≤ P.B.card := by
      have hm := P.hm
      have hBc := P.hBcard
      omega
    exact hB2.trans (card_le_card subset_union_left)
  have hBne : P.B.Nonempty := by
    refine card_pos.mp ?_
    have hm := P.hm
    have hBc := P.hBcard
    omega
  exact exists_min_terminalCover_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
    h2 hrep.1 hconn hp P.B_subset_K hBne hrep.2.2.2.1

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_univ_cycle_of_sides_of_min_eq_chosenQ
statement:
theorem exists_univ_cycle_of_sides_of_min_eq_chosenQ
    (P : AllCographSides G) (htough : OneTough G)
    (hmin : ∃ pc : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pc)
    (hchoice : P.chosenQ = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = (univ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := hmin
  exact P.exists_univ_cycle_of_chosen_terminal_cover htough pc
    (hchoice ▸ hcard) hterm

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_univ_cycle_of_sides_of_traceable_chosenQ
statement:
theorem exists_univ_cycle_of_sides_of_traceable_chosenQ
    (P : AllCographSides G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (htough : OneTough G)
    (hconn : (G.induce ((P.B ∪ P.W : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) = 1)
    (hchoice : P.chosenQ = pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W)) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = (univ : Finset V)
proof:
:=
  exists_univ_cycle_of_sides_of_min_eq_chosenQ P htough
    (exists_min_terminalCover_of_sides_of_mixed_traceable P hpat htough hconn hp)
    hchoice

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.B_nonempty
statement: lemma B_nonempty : P.B.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine card_pos.mp ?_
  have hm := P.hm
  have hcard := P.hBcard
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.chosenQ_mem_full_interval
statement:
lemma chosenQ_mem_full_interval (hT : OneTough G) (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    pathCoverNumber G (P.B ∪ P.W) ≤ P.chosenQ ∧
      P.chosenQ + pathCoverNumber G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B) ≤ P.B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := P.repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_oneTough hpat hT
  have hmin := exists_general_min_terminalCover hrep P.B_nonempty
  have hmem := q_max_mem_interval_of_sides P hT hmin
  have hpW :
      pathCoverNumber G ((P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B) = pathCoverNumber G P.W := by
    simp [P.K_sdiff_B]
  refine ⟨hmem.1, ?_⟩
  simpa [AllCographSides.chosenQ, hpW] using hmem.2

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.exists_terminalCover_chosenQ
statement:
theorem exists_terminalCover_chosenQ (hT : OneTough G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    ∃ pcK : PathCover G (P.B ∪ P.W),
      pcK.card = P.chosenQ ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) P.B pcK
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := P.repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_oneTough hpat hT
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := P.chosenQ_mem_full_interval hT hpat
  exact exists_terminalCover_of_card hrep P.B_nonempty P.chosenQ hlo hhi

name: Nikoghosyan.all_cograph_hamiltonian
statement:
theorem all_cograph_hamiltonian
    (hT : OneTough G) (hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hcog : ∀ i : Fin F.card, IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = univ
proof:
:=
  min_all_cograph_hamiltonian_of_chosen_terminal_cover hT hord hpat F hmin hcog
    (fun P => P.exists_terminalCover_chosenQ hT hpat)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_originalS_iff
statement:
lemma mem_originalS_iff {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} :
    v ∈ originalS Z ↔ classS Z v
proof:
:= by
  simp [originalS]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_originalT_iff
statement:
lemma mem_originalT_iff {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} :
    v ∈ originalT Z ↔ classT Z v
proof:
:= by
  simp [originalT]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_originalU_iff
statement:
lemma mem_originalU_iff {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} :
    v ∈ originalU Z ↔ classU Z v
proof:
:= by
  simp [originalU]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classU_of_not_ST
statement:
lemma classU_of_not_ST {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (hS : ¬ classS Z v) (hT : ¬ classT Z v) : classU Z v
proof:
:= by
  rcases classSTU Z v with h | h | h
  · exact (hS h).elim
  · exact (hT h).elim
  · exact h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_classS_classU
statement:
lemma disjoint_classS_classU (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint {v | classS Z v} {v | classU Z v}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro v hS hU
  exact not_classS_of_TU (.inr hU) hS

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_classT_classU
statement:
lemma disjoint_classT_classU (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint {v | classT Z v} {v | classU Z v}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro v hT hU
  exact not_classT_of_SU (.inr hU) hT

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_originalS_originalT
statement:
lemma disjoint_originalS_originalT (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hS hT
  exact (disjoint_classS_classT Z).le_bot
    ⟨mem_originalS_iff.mp hS, mem_originalT_iff.mp hT⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_originalS_originalU
statement:
lemma disjoint_originalS_originalU (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint (originalS Z) (originalU Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hS hU
  exact (disjoint_classS_classU Z).le_bot
    ⟨mem_originalS_iff.mp hS, mem_originalU_iff.mp hU⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_originalT_originalU
statement:
lemma disjoint_originalT_originalU (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint (originalT Z) (originalU Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hT hU
  exact (disjoint_classT_classU Z).le_bot
    ⟨mem_originalT_iff.mp hT, mem_originalU_iff.mp hU⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.originalSTU_union
statement:
lemma originalSTU_union (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    originalS Z ∪ originalT Z ∪ originalU Z = (Finset.univ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  refine ⟨fun _ => Finset.mem_univ v, fun _ => ?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_originalS_iff, mem_originalT_iff, mem_originalU_iff]
  rcases classSTU Z v with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)
  · exact Or.inr h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classUSet_eq_remainder
statement:
lemma classUSet_eq_remainder (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ({v | classU Z v} : Set V) =
      ((originalS Z ∪ originalT Z : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [mem_originalS_iff, mem_originalT_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hU
    exact ⟨fun hS => not_classS_of_TU (.inr hU) hS,
      fun hT => not_classT_of_SU (.inr hU) hT⟩
  · intro ⟨hS, hT⟩
    exact classU_of_not_ST hS hT

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.originalU_eq_remainder
statement:
lemma originalU_eq_remainder (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    originalU Z = remainderVerts G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [originalU, remainderVerts, classUSet_eq_remainder (Z := Z)]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.canonicalCut_eq_pair
statement:
lemma canonicalCut_eq_pair (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    canonicalCut Z =
      {x | ∃ v ∈ originalS Z, ∃ b : Fin 2, x = .clone v b} ∪
        {x | ∃ v ∈ originalT Z, ∃ w, ∃ h : G.Adj v w, x = .port v w h}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨v, b, rfl, hS⟩ | ⟨v, w, h, rfl, hT⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨v, mem_originalS_iff.mpr hS, b, rfl⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨v, mem_originalT_iff.mpr hT, w, h, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨v, b, rfl, mem_originalS_iff.mp hv⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨v, w, h, rfl, mem_originalT_iff.mp hv⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.originalU_nonisolated
statement:
lemma originalU_nonisolated {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ originalU Z) : ∃ w, G.Adj v w
proof:
:=
  exists_adj_of_classU (mem_originalU_iff.mp hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_canonicalCut_original
statement:
lemma ncard_canonicalCut_original (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    (canonicalCut Z).ncard =
      2 * (originalS Z).card + ∑ t ∈ originalT Z, G.degree t
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_canonicalCut]
  simp [originalS, originalT, ncard_eq_toFinset_card']

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classTU_of_clone_remain
proof:
:= by
  have hS : ¬ classS Z v := fun hS =>
    hx ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hS)
  rcases classSTU Z v with h | h | h
  · exact (hS h).elim
  · exact .inl h
  · exact .inr h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classSU_of_port_remain
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ¬ classT Z v := fun hT =>
    hx ((port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hT)
  rcases classSTU Z v with hS | hT' | hU
  · exact .inl hS
  · exact (hT hT').elim
  · exact .inr hU

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classU_of_clone_remain_not_T
proof:
:=
  (classTU_of_clone_remain hx).elim (fun h => (hT h).elim) id

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classU_of_port_remain_not_S
proof:
:=
  (classSU_of_port_remain hx).elim (fun h => (hS h).elim) id

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_clone_of_T
proof:
:=
  dif_pos hT

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_clone_of_U
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ¬ classT Z v := not_classT_of_SU (.inr hU)
  simp [remainLabel, hT]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_port_of_U
proof:
:= by
  have hS : ¬ classS Z v := not_classS_of_TU (.inr hU)
  simp [remainLabel, hS]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_port_of_ST
statement:
lemma remainLabel_port_of_ST {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V} {h : G.Adj s t}
    (hS : classS Z s) (hT : classT Z t)
    (hx : GadgetVert.port s t h ∉ canonicalCut Z) :
    remainLabel Z (.port s t h) hx = .stPort s t
proof:
:= by
  simp [remainLabel, hS, hT]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_port_of_SS
statement:
lemma remainLabel_port_of_SS {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V} {h : G.Adj s t}
    (hS : classS Z s) (hS' : classS Z t)
    (hx : GadgetVert.port s t h ∉ canonicalCut Z) :
    remainLabel Z (.port s t h) hx = .ssEdge s(s, t)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ¬ classT Z t := not_classT_of_SU (.inl hS')
  simp [remainLabel, hS, hT, hS']

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_port_of_SU
statement:
lemma remainLabel_port_of_SU {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s u : V} {h : G.Adj s u}
    (hS : classS Z s) (hU : classU Z u)
    (hx : GadgetVert.port s u h ∉ canonicalCut Z) :
    remainLabel Z (.port s u h) hx = .uComp (uComponent Z u hU)
proof:
:= by
  have hTt : ¬ classT Z u := not_classT_of_SU (.inr hU)
  have hSt : ¬ classS Z u := not_classS_of_TU (.inr hU)
  simp [remainLabel, hS, hTt, hSt]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_port_of_not_T
statement:
lemma remain_port_of_not_T {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v w : V} {h : G.Adj v w}
    (hT : ¬ classT Z v) : GadgetVert.port v w h ∉ canonicalCut Z
proof:
:=
  fun hx => hT ((port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_port_of_U
statement:
lemma remain_port_of_U {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v w : V} {h : G.Adj v w}
    (hU : classU Z v) : GadgetVert.port v w h ∉ canonicalCut Z
proof:
:=
  remain_port_of_not_T (not_classT_of_SU (.inr hU))

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uComponent_eq_of_adj
proof:
:=
  ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
    (show (G.induce {x | classU Z x}).Adj ⟨v, hUv⟩ ⟨w, hUw⟩ from h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_eq_of_gadget_adj
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v b =>
      cases y with
      | clone =>
          exact (not_gadget_adj_clone_clone hadj).elim
      | port v' w h =>
          have hv : v = v' := gadget_adj_clone_port.mp hadj
          cases hv
          rcases classTU_of_clone_remain hx with hT | hU
          · exact (hy ((port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hT)).elim
          · rw [remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hx, remainLabel_port_of_U hU hy]
  | port v w h =>
      cases y with
      | clone v' b =>
          have hv : v' = v := by simpa using hadj
          cases hv
          rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hS | hU
          · exact (hy ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hS)).elim
          · rw [remainLabel_port_of_U hU hx, remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hy]
      | port v' w' h' =>
          have hvw : v = w' ∧ w = v' := gadget_adj_port_port.mp hadj
          rcases hvw with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hSv | hUv
          · rcases classSTU Z w with hSw | hTw | hUw
            · rw [remainLabel_port_of_SS hSv hSw hx,
                remainLabel_port_of_SS hSw hSv hy]
              exact congrArg CanonicalLabel.ssEdge (Sym2.eq_swap)
            · exact (hy ((port_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mpr hTw)).elim
            · rw [remainLabel_port_of_SU hSv hUw hx,
                remainLabel_port_of_U hUw hy]
          · rcases classSU_of_port_remain hy with hSw | hUw
            · rw [remainLabel_port_of_U hUv hx,
                remainLabel_port_of_SU hSw hUv hy]
            · rw [remainLabel_port_of_U hUv hx, remainLabel_port_of_U hUw hy]
              exact congrArg CanonicalLabel.uComp (uComponent_eq_of_adj hUv hUw h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_eq_of_reachable
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | @cons u v w hadj q ih =>
      have hadj' : (gadget G).Adj u v := hadj
      exact (remainLabel_eq_of_gadget_adj u.property v.property hadj').trans ih

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.UU_three_step
statement:
lemma UU_three_step {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {u w : V} {b b' : Fin 2}
    (hU : classU Z u) (hU' : classU Z w) (h : G.Adj u w) :
    ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable
      ⟨.clone u b, U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hU⟩
      ⟨.clone w b', U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b') hU'⟩
proof:
:= by
  have a1 : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.clone u b, U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hU⟩
      ⟨.port u w h, remain_port_of_U hU⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]; simp
  have a2 : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.port u w h, remain_port_of_U hU⟩
      ⟨.port w u h.symm, remain_port_of_U hU'⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]; simp
  have a3 : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.port w u h.symm, remain_port_of_U hU'⟩
      ⟨.clone w b', U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b') hU'⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]; simp
  exact a1.reachable.trans (a2.reachable.trans a3.reachable)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.Ugraph_reachable_to_clones
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  induction p generalizing b b' with
  | @nil u =>
      exact U_clones_remain_reachable (b := b) (b' := b') u.property
  | @cons x y z hadj q ih =>
      have hadjG : G.Adj x.val y.val := hadj
      exact (UU_three_step (b := b) (b' := 0) x.property y.property hadjG).trans
        (ih 0 b')

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_clone_reachable_own_port
proof:
:= by
  refine Adj.reachable ?_
  rw [induce_adj]
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_clone_reachable_S_port
proof:
:= by
  have hown : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable
      ⟨.clone u b, U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hU⟩
      ⟨.port u s h.symm, remain_port_of_U hU⟩ :=
    remain_clone_reachable_own_port (b := b) hU
  have hadj : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Adj
      ⟨.port u s h.symm, remain_port_of_U hU⟩
      ⟨.port s u h, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ := by
    rw [induce_adj]
    exact gadget_adj_mate h.symm
  exact hown.trans hadj.reachable

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.exist_U_of_uComp_label
statement:
lemma exist_U_of_uComp_label {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {x : GadgetVert G} (hx : x ∉ canonicalCut Z)
    {c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent}
    (hL : remainLabel Z x hx = .uComp c) :
    ∃ v, ∃ hv : classU Z v, ∃ b : Fin 2,
      uComponent Z v hv = c ∧
        ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable
          ⟨.clone v b, U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hv⟩
          ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v b =>
      rcases classTU_of_clone_remain hx with hT | hU
      · have : remainLabel Z (.clone v b) hx = .tClone v b :=
          remainLabel_clone_of_T hT hx
        cases this.symm.trans hL
      · refine ⟨v, hU, b, ?_, Reachable.rfl⟩
        simpa [remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hx] using hL
  | port v w h =>
      rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hS | hU
      · rcases classSTU Z w with hSw | hTw | hUw
        · have : remainLabel Z (.port v w h) hx = .ssEdge s(v, w) :=
            remainLabel_port_of_SS hS hSw hx
          cases this.symm.trans hL
        · have : remainLabel Z (.port v w h) hx = .stPort v w :=
            remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hTw hx
          cases this.symm.trans hL
        · refine ⟨w, hUw, 0, ?_, remain_clone_reachable_S_port (b := 0) hS hUw⟩
          simpa [remainLabel_port_of_SU hS hUw hx] using hL
      · refine ⟨v, hU, 0, ?_, remain_clone_reachable_own_port (b := 0) hU⟩
        simpa [remainLabel_port_of_U hU hx] using hL

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uComp_fiber_reachable
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, b, hvC, hvx⟩ := exist_U_of_uComp_label hx hxL
  obtain ⟨w, hw, b', hwC, hwy⟩ := exist_U_of_uComp_label hy hyL
  have hUreach : (G.induce {z | classU Z z}).Reachable ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨w, hw⟩ := by
    have : uComponent Z v hv = uComponent Z w hw := hvC.trans hwC.symm
    exact ConnectedComponent.exact this
  have hclones :=
    Ugraph_reachable_to_clones (u0 := ⟨v, hv⟩) (w0 := ⟨w, hw⟩) hUreach (b := b) (b' := b')
  exact hvx.symm.trans (hclones.trans hwy)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_eq_tClone
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v' b' =>
      rcases classTU_of_clone_remain hx with hT | hU
      · have h' := remainLabel_clone_of_T hT hx
        cases h'.symm.trans h
        exact ⟨rfl, hT⟩
      · have h' := remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hx
        cases h'.symm.trans h
  | port v' w hw =>
      rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hS | hU
      · rcases classSTU Z w with hSw | hTw | hUw
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_SS hS hSw hx).symm.trans h
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hTw hx).symm.trans h
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_SU hS hUw hx).symm.trans h
      · cases (remainLabel_port_of_U hU hx).symm.trans h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_eq_stPort
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v b =>
      rcases classTU_of_clone_remain hx with hT | hU
      · cases (remainLabel_clone_of_T hT hx).symm.trans h
      · cases (remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hx).symm.trans h
  | port v w hw =>
      rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hS | hU
      · rcases classSTU Z w with hSw | hTw | hUw
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_SS hS hSw hx).symm.trans h
        · have h' := remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hTw hx
          cases h'.symm.trans h
          exact ⟨hw, rfl, hS, hTw⟩
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_SU hS hUw hx).symm.trans h
      · cases (remainLabel_port_of_U hU hx).symm.trans h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_eq_ssEdge
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | clone v b =>
      rcases classTU_of_clone_remain hx with hT | hU
      · cases (remainLabel_clone_of_T hT hx).symm.trans h
      · cases (remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hx).symm.trans h
  | port v w hw =>
      rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hS | hU
      · rcases classSTU Z w with hSw | hTw | hUw
        · have h' := remainLabel_port_of_SS hS hSw hx
          cases h'.symm.trans h
          exact ⟨v, w, hw, rfl, hS, hSw, rfl⟩
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hTw hx).symm.trans h
        · cases (remainLabel_port_of_SU hS hUw hx).symm.trans h
      · cases (remainLabel_port_of_U hU hx).symm.trans h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_eq_uComp
Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.same_label_reachable
statement:
lemma same_label_reachable {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {x y : GadgetVert G} (hx : x ∉ canonicalCut Z) (hy : y ∉ canonicalCut Z)
    (hL : remainLabel Z x hx = remainLabel Z y hy) :
    ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases hLbl : remainLabel Z x hx with
  | tClone v b =>
      have hxT := remainLabel_eq_tClone hx (hLbl)
      have hyT := remainLabel_eq_tClone hy (hL.symm.trans hLbl)
      rcases hxT with ⟨rfl, _⟩
      rcases hyT with ⟨rfl, _⟩
      exact Reachable.rfl
  | stPort s t =>
      obtain ⟨h1, rfl, _, _⟩ := remainLabel_eq_stPort hx (hLbl)
      obtain ⟨h2, rfl, _, _⟩ := remainLabel_eq_stPort hy (hL.symm.trans hLbl)
      exact Reachable.rfl
  | ssEdge e =>
      obtain ⟨s, t, hs, rfl, hSs, hSt, rfl⟩ := remainLabel_eq_ssEdge hx hLbl
      obtain ⟨s', t', hs', heq, hSs', hSt', rfl⟩ :=
        remainLabel_eq_ssEdge hy (hL.symm.trans hLbl)
      rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq) with hsame | hswap
      · rcases hsame with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        have : (⟨GadgetVert.port s t hs, hx⟩ :
            {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ}) =
          ⟨GadgetVert.port s t hs', hy⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
        exact this ▸ Reachable.rfl
      · rcases hswap with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        have : (⟨GadgetVert.port t s hs', hy⟩ :
            {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ}) =
          ⟨GadgetVert.port t s hs.symm, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hSt⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext rfl
        exact this ▸ (SS_ports_remain_adj (hst := hs) hSs hSt).reachable
  | uComp c =>
      exact uComp_fiber_reachable hx hy hLbl (hL.symm.trans hLbl)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_component_supp_eq_fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hreach : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).Reachable y x := by
      simpa [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] using hy
    exact remainLabel_eq_of_reachable hreach
  · intro hy
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at hy
    simp [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, ConnectedComponent.eq]
    exact same_label_reachable y.property x.property hy

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.clone_remain_of_T
statement:
lemma clone_remain_of_T {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hT : classT Z v) : GadgetVert.clone v b ∉ canonicalCut Z
proof:
:=
  fun h => not_classS_of_TU (.inl hT) ((clone_mem_canonicalCut_iff (Z := Z)).mp h)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.tClone_label
proof:
:=
  remainLabel_clone_of_T hT _

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.tClone_comp_injective
statement:
lemma tClone_comp_injective {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {v v' : V} {b b' : Fin 2}
    (hT : classT Z v) (hT' : classT Z v')
    (h : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨.clone v b, clone_remain_of_T hT⟩ =
        ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨.clone v' b', clone_remain_of_T hT'⟩) :
    v = v' ∧ b = b'
proof:
:= by
  have hR := ConnectedComponent.exact h
  have hL := remainLabel_eq_of_reachable hR
  rw [remainLabel_clone_of_T hT, remainLabel_clone_of_T hT'] at hL
  cases hL
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.stPort_comp_injective
statement:
lemma stPort_comp_injective {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {s s' t t' : V} {hst : G.Adj s t} {hst' : G.Adj s' t'}
    (hS : classS Z s) (hT : classT Z t)
    (hS' : classS Z s') (hT' : classT Z t')
    (h : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ =
        ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨.port s' t' hst', ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS'⟩) :
    s = s' ∧ t = t'
proof:
:= by
  have hR := ConnectedComponent.exact h
  have hL := remainLabel_eq_of_reachable hR
  rw [remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hT, remainLabel_port_of_ST hS' hT'] at hL
  cases hL
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_comm
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_comm (A B : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A B = orderedEdgeCount G B A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedEdgeCount]
  let e : Equiv {p // p ∈ (A ×ˢ B).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2}
      {p // p ∈ (B ×ˢ A).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2} :=
    { toFun := fun p =>
        ⟨(p.1.2, p.1.1), by
          have hp := p.2
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
          exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩⟩
      invFun := fun p =>
        ⟨(p.1.2, p.1.1), by
          have hp := p.2
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
          exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩⟩
      left_inv := fun p => Subtype.ext rfl
      right_inv := fun p => Subtype.ext rfl }
  simpa [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr e

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.T_clone_component_odd'
statement:
lemma T_clone_component_odd' {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} {b : Fin 2}
    (hT : classT Z v) :
    Odd ((((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.clone v b, clone_remain_of_T hT⟩).supp.ncard)

:=
  T_clone_component_odd hT

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ST_port_component_odd'
statement:
lemma ST_port_component_odd' {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {s t : V}

    Odd ((((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk

statement:

    Even ((((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
