  SS_port_component_even hS hS'

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_tCloneCompSet
statement:
lemma ncard_tCloneCompSet (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    (tCloneCompSet Z).ncard = 2 * (originalT Z).card
proof:
:= by
  let f : {v // classT Z v} × Fin 2 →
      ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent :=
    fun p => ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨.clone p.1.1 p.2, clone_remain_of_T p.1.2⟩
  have himg : tCloneCompSet Z = Set.range f := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · intro hc
      rcases hc with ⟨v, hT, b, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨v, hT⟩, b⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro ⟨⟨⟨v, hT⟩, b⟩, h⟩
      exact ⟨v, hT, b, h.symm⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro p q h
    have hvt := tClone_comp_injective p.1.2 q.1.2 h
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hvt.1) hvt.2
  rw [himg, ncard_range_of_injective hinj, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Fin 2), Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [mul_comm (Fintype.card {v // classT Z v})]
  simp [originalT, Fintype.card_subtype, Set.toFinset]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_stPortCompSet
statement:
lemma ncard_stPortCompSet (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    (stPortCompSet Z).ncard =
      orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  let S := originalS Z
  let T := originalT Z
  let P := (S ×ˢ T).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2
  let f : {p : V × V // p ∈ P} →
      ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent :=
    fun p =>
      have hS : classS Z p.1.1 := mem_originalS_iff.mp (by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
        exact this.1.1)
      have hT : classT Z p.1.2 := mem_originalT_iff.mp (by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
        exact this.1.2)
      have hst : G.Adj p.1.1 p.1.2 := by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
        exact this.2
      ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨.port p.1.1 p.1.2 hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩
  have himg : stPortCompSet Z = Set.range f := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · intro hc
      rcases hc with ⟨s, t, hst, hS, hT, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨(s, t), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨mem_originalS_iff.mpr hS, mem_originalT_iff.mpr hT⟩, hst⟩
      · rfl
    · intro ⟨p, hp⟩
      subst hp
      exact ⟨p.1.1, p.1.2, by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter] at this
        exact this.2, mem_originalS_iff.mp (by
          have := p.2
          simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
          exact this.1.1), mem_originalT_iff.mp (by
          have := p.2
          simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
          exact this.1.2), rfl⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro p q h
    have hS : classS Z p.1.1 := mem_originalS_iff.mp (by
      have := p.2
      simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
      exact this.1.1)
    have hT : classT Z p.1.2 := mem_originalT_iff.mp (by
      have := p.2
      simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
      exact this.1.2)
    have hS' : classS Z q.1.1 := mem_originalS_iff.mp (by
      have := q.2
      simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
      exact this.1.1)
    have hT' : classT Z q.1.2 := mem_originalT_iff.mp (by
      have := q.2
      simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
      exact this.1.2)
    have := stPort_comp_injective hS hT hS' hT' h
    ext <;> simp [this]
  rw [himg, ncard_range_of_injective hinj, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_uCompVerts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_uCompVerts_iff {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent} {v : V} :
    v ∈ uCompVerts Z c ↔
      ∃ hv : classU Z v, uComponent Z v hv = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hv with ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hmem, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hw, ?_⟩
    simpa [uComponent] using
      (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff _ _).mp (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hmem)
  · rintro ⟨hv, h⟩
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa [uComponent] using (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff _ _).mpr h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.classU_of_mem_uCompVerts
proof:
:=
  (mem_uCompVerts_iff.mp hv).1

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uCompVerts_subset_originalU
statement:
lemma uCompVerts_subset_originalU (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    uCompVerts Z c ⊆ originalU Z
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  exact mem_originalU_iff.mpr (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uComponent_eq_of_mem_uCompVerts
proof:
:=
  (mem_uCompVerts_iff.mp hv).2

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uComponent_rep
statement:
lemma uComponent_rep (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    uComponent Z (uCompRep Z c).1 (uCompRep Z c).2 = c
proof:
:= by
  unfold uComponent uCompRep connectedComponentMk
  exact Quot.out_eq c

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uCompRep_mem_verts
statement:
lemma uCompRep_mem_verts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (uCompRep Z c).1 ∈ uCompVerts Z c
proof:
:=
  mem_uCompVerts_iff.mpr ⟨(uCompRep Z c).2, uComponent_rep Z c⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_uCompRep_clone
statement:
lemma remainLabel_uCompRep_clone {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent} {b : Fin 2} :
    remainLabel Z (.clone (uCompRep Z c).1 b)
      (U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) (uCompRep Z c).2) = .uComp c
proof:
:= by
  rw [remainLabel_clone_of_U (uCompRep Z c).2]
  exact congrArg CanonicalLabel.uComp (uComponent_rep Z c)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uCompRemain_eq_clone
proof:
:= by
  apply ConnectedComponent.sound
  have hx : remainLabel Z (.clone (uCompRep Z c).1 0)
      (U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := 0) (uCompRep Z c).2) = .uComp c :=
    remainLabel_uCompRep_clone
  have hy : remainLabel Z (.clone v b) (U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) hv) =
      .uComp c := by
    rw [remainLabel_clone_of_U hv, hc]
  exact same_label_reachable _ _ (hx.trans hy.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uCompRemain_eq_of_label
proof:
:= by
  apply ConnectedComponent.sound
  have hy : remainLabel Z (.clone (uCompRep Z c).1 0)
      (U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := 0) (uCompRep Z c).2) = .uComp c :=
    remainLabel_uCompRep_clone
  exact same_label_reachable _ _ (hL.trans hy.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uCompRemain_injective
statement:
lemma uCompRemain_injective (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Function.Injective (uCompRemain Z)
proof:
:= by
  intro c c' h
  have hR := ConnectedComponent.exact h
  have hL := remainLabel_eq_of_reachable hR
  simpa [remainLabel_uCompRep_clone] using hL

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.mem_uCompCompSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_uCompCompSet_iff {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {C : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent} :
    C ∈ uCompCompSet Z ↔
      ∃ c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent, C = uCompRemain Z c
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_range.trans ⟨fun ⟨c, h⟩ => ⟨c, h.symm⟩, fun ⟨c, h⟩ => ⟨c, h.symm⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_uComp_mem_image
proof:
:=
  ⟨c, (uCompRemain_eq_of_label hx hL).symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uFiberClones_not_mem_cut
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩
  exact U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := b) (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uFiberOwnPorts_not_mem_cut
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩
  exact remain_port_of_U (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uFiberSPorts_not_mem_cut
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨s, hS, v, hv, h, rfl⟩
  exact ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_uFiberClones
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩
  rw [remainLabel_clone_of_U (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)]
  exact congrArg CanonicalLabel.uComp (uComponent_eq_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_uFiberOwnPorts
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩
  rw [remainLabel_port_of_U (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)]
  exact congrArg CanonicalLabel.uComp (uComponent_eq_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainLabel_uFiberSPorts
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨s, hS, v, hv, h, rfl⟩
  rw [remainLabel_port_of_SU hS (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)]
  exact congrArg CanonicalLabel.uComp (uComponent_eq_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_uFiberClones_ownPorts
statement:
lemma disjoint_uFiberClones_ownPorts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    Disjoint (uFiberClones Z c) (uFiberOwnPorts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hy
  rcases hx with ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨_, _, _, _, h⟩
  cases h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_uFiberClones_sPorts
statement:
lemma disjoint_uFiberClones_sPorts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    Disjoint (uFiberClones Z c) (uFiberSPorts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hy
  rcases hx with ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨_, _, _, _, _, h⟩
  cases h

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_uFiberOwnPorts_sPorts
statement:
lemma disjoint_uFiberOwnPorts_sPorts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    Disjoint (uFiberOwnPorts Z c) (uFiberSPorts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hy
  rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨s, hS, v', hv', h', heq⟩
  injection heq with hs _
  cases hs
  exact not_classS_of_TU (.inr (classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)) hS

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uFiberVerts_eq_union
statement:
lemma uFiberVerts_eq_union {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    uFiberVerts Z c =
      uFiberClones Z c ∪ uFiberOwnPorts Z c ∪ uFiberSPorts Z c
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hL⟩
    cases x with
    | clone v b =>
        rcases classTU_of_clone_remain hx with hT | hU
        · cases (remainLabel_clone_of_T hT hx).symm.trans hL
        · have hv : v ∈ uCompVerts Z c :=
            mem_uCompVerts_iff.mpr ⟨hU, by
              simpa [remainLabel_clone_of_U hU hx] using hL⟩
          exact .inl (.inl ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩)
    | port v w h =>
        rcases classSU_of_port_remain hx with hS | hU
        · rcases classSTU Z w with hSw | hTw | hUw
          · cases (remainLabel_port_of_SS hS hSw hx).symm.trans hL
          · cases (remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hTw hx).symm.trans hL
          · have hw : w ∈ uCompVerts Z c :=
              mem_uCompVerts_iff.mpr ⟨hUw, by
                simpa [remainLabel_port_of_SU hS hUw hx] using hL⟩
            exact .inr ⟨v, hS, w, hw, h, rfl⟩
        · have hv : v ∈ uCompVerts Z c :=
            mem_uCompVerts_iff.mpr ⟨hU, by
              simpa [remainLabel_port_of_U hU hx] using hL⟩
          exact .inl (.inr ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩)
  · intro hx
    rcases (show x ∈ (uFiberClones Z c ∪ uFiberOwnPorts Z c) ∪ uFiberSPorts Z c from hx)
      with hAB | hC
    · rcases hAB with hA | hB
      · exact ⟨uFiberClones_not_mem_cut hA, remainLabel_uFiberClones hA⟩
      · exact ⟨uFiberOwnPorts_not_mem_cut hB, remainLabel_uFiberOwnPorts hB⟩
    · exact ⟨uFiberSPorts_not_mem_cut hC, remainLabel_uFiberSPorts hC⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_uFiberClones
statement:
lemma ncard_uFiberClones (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (uFiberClones Z c).ncard = 2 * (uCompVerts Z c).card
proof:
:= by
  let f : {v // v ∈ uCompVerts Z c} × Fin 2 → GadgetVert G :=
    fun p => .clone p.1.1 p.2
  have himg : uFiberClones Z c = Set.range f := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨v, hv⟩, b⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨⟨v, hv⟩, b⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v, hv, b, rfl⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro p q h
    injection h with hv hb
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hv) hb
  rw [himg, ncard_range_of_injective hinj]
  simp [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_coe]
  ring

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_uFiberOwnPorts
statement:
lemma ncard_uFiberOwnPorts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (uFiberOwnPorts Z c).ncard = ∑ v ∈ uCompVerts Z c, G.degree v
proof:
:= by
  let D := uCompVerts Z c
  let P := (D ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset V)).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2
  let f : {p : V × V // p ∈ P} → GadgetVert G :=
    fun p =>
      have hst : G.Adj p.1.1 p.1.2 := by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter] at this
        exact this.2
      .port p.1.1 p.1.2 hst
  have himg : uFiberOwnPorts Z c = Set.range f := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, w, h, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨(v, w), ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv, Finset.mem_univ w⟩, h⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨p.1.1, ?_, p.1.2, ?_, rfl⟩
      · have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
        exact this.1.1
      · have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter] at this
        exact this.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro p q h
    injection h with hv hw
    exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hv hw)
  have hcardP : P.card = ∑ v ∈ D, G.degree v := by
    simp only [P, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _hv => ?_
    simp [SimpleGraph.degree, neighborFinset, mem_neighborSet, Fintype.card_subtype]
  rw [himg, ncard_range_of_injective hinj, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe]
  exact hcardP

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_uFiberSPorts
statement:
lemma ncard_uFiberSPorts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (uFiberSPorts Z c).ncard =
      orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  let S := originalS Z
  let D := uCompVerts Z c
  let P := (S ×ˢ D).filter fun p => G.Adj p.1 p.2
  let f : {p : V × V // p ∈ P} → GadgetVert G :=
    fun p =>
      have hst : G.Adj p.1.1 p.1.2 := by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter] at this
        exact this.2
      .port p.1.1 p.1.2 hst
  have himg : uFiberSPorts Z c = Set.range f := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hS, v, hv, h, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨(s, v), ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨mem_originalS_iff.mpr hS, hv⟩, h⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨p.1.1, mem_originalS_iff.mp (by
        have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
        exact this.1.1), p.1.2, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at this
        exact this.1.2
      · have := p.2
        simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter] at this
        exact this.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro p q h
    injection h with hv hw
    exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hv hw)
  rw [himg, ncard_range_of_injective hinj, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_uFiberVerts
statement:
lemma ncard_uFiberVerts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (uFiberVerts Z c).ncard =
      2 * (uCompVerts Z c).card + ∑ v ∈ uCompVerts Z c, G.degree v +
        orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uFiberVerts_eq_union]
  have d1 := disjoint_uFiberClones_ownPorts Z c
  have d2 := disjoint_uFiberClones_sPorts Z c
  have d3 := disjoint_uFiberOwnPorts_sPorts Z c
  have dU : Disjoint (uFiberClones Z c ∪ uFiberOwnPorts Z c) (uFiberSPorts Z c) :=
    disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨d2, d3⟩
  rw [ncard_union_eq dU, ncard_union_eq d1, ncard_uFiberClones, ncard_uFiberOwnPorts,
    ncard_uFiberSPorts]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_uCompRemain_supp
statement:
lemma ncard_uCompRemain_supp (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    (uCompRemain Z c).supp.ncard = (uFiberVerts Z c).ncard
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp := remain_component_supp_eq_fiber
    (Z := Z)
    ⟨.clone (uCompRep Z c).1 0,
      U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := 0) (uCompRep Z c).2⟩
  have hL : remainLabel Z (.clone (uCompRep Z c).1 0)
      (U_clone_not_mem_canonical (b := 0) (uCompRep Z c).2) = .uComp c :=
    remainLabel_uCompRep_clone
  have hs : (uCompRemain Z c).supp =
      {y : {z // z ∈ (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ} |
        remainLabel Z y y.property = .uComp c} := by
    simpa [uCompRemain, hL] using hsupp
  have himg : Subtype.val '' (uCompRemain Z c).supp = uFiberVerts Z c := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rw [hs] at hy
      exact ⟨y.property, hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨hx, hLx⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, by simpa [hs] using hLx, rfl⟩
  rw [← himg, ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum (A B : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A B = ∑ a ∈ A, (G.neighborFinset a ∩ B).card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedEdgeCount, neighborFinset_inter]
  rw [Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ha => ?_
  exact (Finset.card_filter (G.Adj a) B).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_two_mul
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_two_mul (A : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A A = 2 * (G.induce (A : Set V)).edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := G.induce (A : Set V)
  let e : {p : V × V // p ∈ (A ×ˢ A).filter fun q => G.Adj q.1 q.2} ≃
      {xy : (↥(A : Set V)) × (↥(A : Set V)) // H.Adj xy.1 xy.2} :=
    { toFun := fun p =>
        ⟨(⟨p.1.1, (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).1).1⟩,
          ⟨p.1.2, (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).1).2⟩),
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).2⟩
      invFun := fun q =>
        ⟨(q.1.1.val, q.1.2.val),
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨q.1.1.property, q.1.2.property⟩, q.2⟩⟩
      left_inv := fun p => Subtype.ext rfl
      right_inv := fun q =>
        Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (Subtype.ext rfl) (Subtype.ext rfl)) }
  have hP : ((A ×ˢ A).filter fun q => G.Adj q.1 q.2).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun xy : (↥(A : Set V)) × (↥(A : Set V)) =>
        H.Adj xy.1 xy.2).card := by
    simpa [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr e
  exact hP.trans H.two_mul_card_edgeFinset.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.even_orderedEdgeCount_self
statement:
lemma even_orderedEdgeCount_self (A : Finset V) :
    Even (orderedEdgeCount G A A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_two_mul]
  exact even_two_mul _

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.not_adj_uComp_outside
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  have hvU := classU_of_mem_uCompVerts hv
  have hadj' : (G.induce {x | classU Z x}).Adj ⟨v, hvU⟩ ⟨w, hwU⟩ := hadj
  have hc : uComponent Z w hwU = uComponent Z v hvU :=
    (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj.symm)
  exact hwD (mem_uCompVerts_iff.mpr ⟨hwU, hc.trans (uComponent_eq_of_mem_uCompVerts hv)⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborFinset_uComp_inter_outside
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_inter, mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.notMem_empty,
    iff_false]
  intro ⟨hadj, hwU, hwD⟩
  exact not_adj_uComp_outside hv (mem_originalU_iff.mp hwU) hwD hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborFinset_split_of_mem_uComp
statement:
lemma neighborFinset_split_of_mem_uComp {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ uCompVerts Z c) :
    G.neighborFinset v =
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z) ∪
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z) ∪
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ uCompVerts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, mem_neighborFinset]
  constructor
  · intro hadj
    have hmem : w ∈ originalS Z ∪ originalT Z ∪ originalU Z := by
      rw [originalSTU_union]; exact Finset.mem_univ w
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_union] at hmem
    rcases hmem with hST | hU
    · rcases hST with hS | hT
      · exact .inl (.inl ⟨hadj, hS⟩)
      · exact .inl (.inr ⟨hadj, hT⟩)
    · by_cases hwD : w ∈ uCompVerts Z c
      · exact .inr ⟨hadj, hwD⟩
      · exact (not_adj_uComp_outside hv (mem_originalU_iff.mp hU) hwD hadj).elim
  · intro h
    rcases h with hST | hD
    · rcases hST with hS | hT
      · exact hS.1
      · exact hT.1
    · exact hD.1

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_neighbor_STU
statement:
lemma disjoint_neighbor_STU {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)} {v : V} :
    Disjoint (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z) (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro w hwS hwT
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_originalS_originalT Z)
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp hwS).2 (Finset.mem_inter.mp hwT).2

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_neighbor_S_D
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro w hwS hwD
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_originalS_originalU Z)
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp hwS).2
    (uCompVerts_subset_originalU Z c (Finset.mem_inter.mp hwD).2)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_neighbor_T_D
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro w hwT hwD
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_originalT_originalU Z)
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp hwT).2
    (uCompVerts_subset_originalU Z c (Finset.mem_inter.mp hwD).2)

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.degree_split_of_mem_uComp
statement:
lemma degree_split_of_mem_uComp {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ uCompVerts Z c) :
    G.degree v =
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z).card +
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z).card +
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ uCompVerts Z c).card
proof:
:= by
  have dST := disjoint_neighbor_STU (Z := Z) (v := v)
  have dSD := disjoint_neighbor_S_D (Z := Z) (c := c) (v := v)
  have dTD := disjoint_neighbor_T_D (Z := Z) (c := c) (v := v)
  have dU : Disjoint
      ((G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z) ∪ (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z))
      (G.neighborFinset v ∩ uCompVerts Z c) :=
    Finset.disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨dSD, dTD⟩
  calc G.degree v
      = ((G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z ∪ G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z) ∪
          G.neighborFinset v ∩ uCompVerts Z c).card := by
            rw [SimpleGraph.degree]
            conv_lhs => rw [neighborFinset_split_of_mem_uComp hv]
    _ = (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z ∪ G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z).card +
          (G.neighborFinset v ∩ uCompVerts Z c).card :=
            Finset.card_union_of_disjoint dU
    _ = (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalS Z).card +
          (G.neighborFinset v ∩ originalT Z).card +
          (G.neighborFinset v ∩ uCompVerts Z c).card := by
            rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint dST]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_degree_uCompVerts
statement:
lemma sum_degree_uCompVerts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    ∑ v ∈ uCompVerts Z c, G.degree v =
      orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalS Z) +
      orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z) +
      orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (uCompVerts Z c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v hv => degree_split_of_mem_uComp hv,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum,
    orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum, orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.odd_uFiber_iff_attach
statement:
lemma odd_uFiber_iff_attach {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    Odd (uFiberVerts Z c).ncard ↔
      Odd (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_uFiberVerts, sum_degree_uCompVerts]
  have h2 : Even (2 * (uCompVerts Z c).card) := even_two_mul _
  have hDD : Even (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (uCompVerts Z c)) :=
    even_orderedEdgeCount_self _
  have hSS : Even
      (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalS Z) +
        orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c)) := by
    rw [orderedEdgeCount_comm (uCompVerts Z c)]
    simpa [two_mul] using even_two_mul
      (orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c))
  have : (2 * (uCompVerts Z c).card +
        (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalS Z) +
          orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z) +
          orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (uCompVerts Z c)) +
        orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c)) =
      (2 * (uCompVerts Z c).card) +
        (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalS Z) +
          orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c)) +
        orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (uCompVerts Z c) +
        orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z) := by
    ac_rfl
  rw [this, Nat.odd_add']
  have heven : Even
      (2 * (uCompVerts Z c).card +
        (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalS Z) +
          orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (uCompVerts Z c)) +
        orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (uCompVerts Z c)) :=
    (h2.add hSS).add hDD
  simp [heven]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.odd_uCompRemain_iff_attach
statement:
lemma odd_uCompRemain_iff_attach {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    Odd (uCompRemain Z c).supp.ncard ↔
      Odd (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_uCompRemain_supp]
  exact odd_uFiber_iff_attach c

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remain_component_classified
statement:
lemma remain_component_classified {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    (C : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :
    C ∈ tCloneCompSet Z ∨ C ∈ stPortCompSet Z ∨
      C ∈ ssEdgeCompSet Z ∨ C ∈ uCompCompSet Z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Quot.exists_rep C
  have hxC : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk x = C := hx
  cases hL : remainLabel Z x.val x.property with
  | tClone v b =>
      obtain ⟨heq, hT⟩ := remainLabel_eq_tClone x.property hL
      refine .inl ⟨v, hT, b, ?_⟩
      have : x = ⟨.clone v b, clone_remain_of_T hT⟩ := Subtype.ext heq
      rw [this] at hxC
      exact hxC.symm
  | stPort s t =>
      obtain ⟨hst, heq, hS, hT⟩ := remainLabel_eq_stPort x.property hL
      refine .inr (.inl ⟨s, t, hst, hS, hT, ?_⟩)
      have : x = ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ := Subtype.ext heq
      rw [this] at hxC
      exact hxC.symm
  | ssEdge e =>
      obtain ⟨s, t, hst, rfl, hS, hS', heq⟩ := remainLabel_eq_ssEdge x.property hL
      refine .inr (.inr (.inl ⟨s, t, hst, hS, hS', ?_⟩))
      have : x = ⟨.port s t hst, ST_port_not_mem_canonical hS⟩ := Subtype.ext heq
      rw [this] at hxC
      exact hxC.symm
  | uComp c =>
      refine .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨c, ?_⟩))
      exact (uCompRemain_eq_of_label x.property hL).symm.trans hxC

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.tCloneCompSet_label
statement:
lemma tCloneCompSet_label {Z : Set (GadgetVert G)}
    {C : ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent}
    (hC : C ∈ tCloneCompSet Z) :
    ∃ v b, ∃ hT : classT Z v,
      remainLabel Z (.clone v b) (clone_remain_of_T hT) = .tClone v b ∧
        C = ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨.clone v b, clone_remain_of_T hT⟩
proof:
:= by
  rcases hC with ⟨v, hT, b, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨v, b, hT, tClone_label hT, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.disjoint_tClone_stPort
statement:
lemma disjoint_tClone_stPort (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    Disjoint (tCloneCompSet Z) (stPortCompSet Z)
proof:
:= by

  rcases hT with ⟨v, hTv, b, rfl⟩

  have hL := remainLabel_eq_of_reachable hR
  rw [remainLabel_clone_of_T hTv, remainLabel_port_of_ST hS hTt] at hL
  cases hL

      ((Finset.univ : Finset ((G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent)).filter

proof:

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.oddComponents_eq_union
statement:
lemma oddComponents_eq_union (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).oddComponents =
      tCloneCompSet Z ∪ stPortCompSet Z ∪ oddUCompSet Z
proof:
:= by
  ext C
  constructor
  · intro hOdd
    rcases remain_component_classified C with hT | hST | hSS | hU
    · exact .inl (.inl hT)
    · exact .inl (.inr hST)
    · exact (ssEdgeCompSet_disjoint_odd Z).le_bot ⟨hSS, hOdd⟩ |>.elim
    · rcases hU with ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact .inr (uComp_odd_mem_oddU hOdd)
  · intro h
    rcases h with hAB | hU
    · rcases hAB with hT | hST
      · exact tCloneCompSet_subset_odd Z hT
      · exact stPortCompSet_subset_odd Z hST
    · exact oddUCompSet_subset_odd Z hU

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.uCompVerts_eq_componentVerts
statement:
lemma uCompVerts_eq_componentVerts (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    uCompVerts Z c =
      componentVerts G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
        ((classUIso Z).connectedComponentEquiv c)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨hvU, hc⟩ := mem_uCompVerts_iff.mp hv
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨classUIso Z ⟨v, hvU⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [Set.mem_toFinset, ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, Iso.connectedComponentEquiv_apply]
    have hc' : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvU⟩ = c := by
      simpa [uComponent] using hc
    rw [← hc', ConnectedComponent.map_mk]
    rfl
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hv with ⟨w, hmem, rfl⟩
    have hw := (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff _ _).mp (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hmem)
    have hvU : classU Z w.val :=
      (Set.ext_iff.mp (classUSet_eq_remainder Z) w.val).mpr w.property
    have : uComponent Z w.val hvU = c := by
      apply (classUIso Z).connectedComponentEquiv.injective
      rw [Iso.connectedComponentEquiv_apply, uComponent, ConnectedComponent.map_mk]
      exact hw
    exact mem_uCompVerts_iff.mpr ⟨hvU, this⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.componentAttach_uComp
statement:
lemma componentAttach_uComp (Z : Set (GadgetVert G))
    (c : (G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentAttach G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
        ((classUIso Z).connectedComponentEquiv c) =
      orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [componentAttach, uCompVerts_eq_componentVerts]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_oddUCompSet_eq_hCount
statement:
lemma ncard_oddUCompSet_eq_hCount (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    (oddUCompSet Z).ncard = hCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_oddUCompSet, hCount]
  let e := (classUIso Z).connectedComponentEquiv
  let P := (Finset.univ : Finset ((G.induce {w | classU Z w}).ConnectedComponent)).filter
    fun c => Odd (orderedEdgeCount G (uCompVerts Z c) (originalT Z))
  let Q := (Finset.univ : Finset
      ((G.induce ((originalS Z ∪ originalT Z : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent)).filter
    fun c => Odd (componentAttach G (originalS Z) (originalT Z) c)
  have himg : P.map e.toEmbedding = Q := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · intro hc
      rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hc with ⟨c', hc', rfl⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hc' ⊢
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      simpa using (componentAttach_uComp Z c').symm ▸ hc'.2
    · intro hc
      refine Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨e.symm c, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply c⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hc ⊢
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have hA := componentAttach_uComp Z (e.symm c)
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply] at hA
      exact hA.symm ▸ hc.2
  rw [← Finset.card_map e.toEmbedding, himg]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.ncard_oddComponents_canonical
statement:
lemma ncard_oddComponents_canonical (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ((gadget G).induce (canonicalCut Z)ᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
      2 * (originalT Z).card +
        orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z) +
        hCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddComponents_eq_union]
  have d1 := disjoint_tClone_stPort Z
  have d2 := disjoint_tClone_oddU Z
  have d3 := disjoint_stPort_oddU Z
  have dU : Disjoint (tCloneCompSet Z ∪ stPortCompSet Z) (oddUCompSet Z) :=
    disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨d2, d3⟩
  rw [ncard_union_eq dU, ncard_union_eq d1, ncard_tCloneCompSet, ncard_stPortCompSet,
    ncard_oddUCompSet_eq_hCount]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.oddComponentCount_canonicalCut
statement:
theorem oddComponentCount_canonicalCut (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    oddComponentCount (gadget G) (canonicalCut Z) =
      2 * (originalT Z).card +
        orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z) +
        hCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [oddComponentCount] using ncard_oddComponents_canonical Z

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.degree_eq_degDelete_add_toS
statement:
lemma degree_eq_degDelete_add_toS (S : Finset V) (t : V) :
    G.degree t = degDelete G S t + (G.neighborFinset t ∩ S).card
proof:
:= by
  have hun : G.neighborFinset t =
      G.neighborFinset t \ S ∪ G.neighborFinset t ∩ S := by
    ext w; simp; tauto
  have hd : Disjoint (G.neighborFinset t \ S) (G.neighborFinset t ∩ S) :=
    Finset.disjoint_sdiff_inter _ _
  calc G.degree t
      = (G.neighborFinset t \ S ∪ G.neighborFinset t ∩ S).card := by
          rw [SimpleGraph.degree]
          conv_lhs => rw [hun]
    _ = (G.neighborFinset t \ S).card + (G.neighborFinset t ∩ S).card :=
          Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd
    _ = degDelete G S t + (G.neighborFinset t ∩ S).card := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.sum_degree_originalT
statement:
lemma sum_degree_originalT (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    ∑ t ∈ originalT Z, G.degree t =
      ∑ t ∈ originalT Z, degDelete G (originalS Z) t +
        orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => degree_eq_degDelete_add_toS (originalS Z) t,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← orderedEdgeCount_eq_sum (originalT Z) (originalS Z),
    orderedEdgeCount_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.signedDeficiency_canonicalCut_eq_neg_delta
statement:
theorem signedDeficiency_canonicalCut_eq_neg_delta (Z : Set (GadgetVert G)) :
    signedDeficiency (gadget G) (canonicalCut Z) =
      -delta G (originalS Z) (originalT Z)
proof:
:= by
  have hodd := oddComponentCount_canonicalCut Z
  have hcut := ncard_canonicalCut_original Z
  have hdeg := sum_degree_originalT Z
  simp only [signedDeficiency, delta, hodd, hcut]
  push_cast
  have hdegZ :
      (∑ t ∈ originalT Z, (G.degree t : ℤ)) =
        (∑ t ∈ originalT Z, (degDelete G (originalS Z) t : ℤ)) +
          (orderedEdgeCount G (originalS Z) (originalT Z) : ℤ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, ← Nat.cast_sum, ← Nat.cast_add, hdeg]
  rw [hdegZ]
  ring

name: Nikoghosyan.augA_subset_augCarrier
statement:
lemma augA_subset_augCarrier {K B : Finset V} {q : ℕ} (hBK : B ⊆ K) :

proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_augA (B := B) (q := q)).1 hx
  exact mem_union_left _ ((mem_augOldImage (q := q)).2 ⟨a, hBK ha, rfl⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.augA_nonempty

lemma augA_nonempty {B : Finset V} {q : ℕ} (hBne : B.Nonempty) :

proof:

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_succ
statement:
lemma exists_terminalCover_succ {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    {pc : PathCover G K} (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc)
    (hqpos : 1 ≤ pc.card)
    (hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + pc.card < B.card) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G K,
      pc'.card = pc.card + 1 ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc'
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrep with ⟨hcog, hBK, _hInd, _hTH, _hN⟩
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
    refine card_pos.mp ?_
    have : 1 ≤ B.card := by
      have hle : pc.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + pc.card := Nat.le_add_left _ _
      omega
    exact this
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    PathCover.exists_augCycle (B := B) (q := pc.card) pc hBK hterm rfl hqpos hstrict
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hf, _hne, _hprot⟩ :=
    Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_strict
      (G := augGraph (G := G) B pc.card) (U := augCarrier (q := pc.card) K)
      (A := augA (B := B) (q := pc.card)) c hc
      (augA_subset_augCarrier (q := pc.card) hBK)
      (augA_nonempty (q := pc.card) hBne)
      (isCograph_augRemainder_carrier (B := B) (q := pc.card) hBK
        (Cograph.isCograph_iff.2 hcog))
      (pathCoverNumber_augRemainder_lt_A (B := B) (q := pc.card) hBK hstrict)
  obtain ⟨pc', hcard, hterm'⟩ :=
    exists_terminalCover_of_augPath (B := B) (q := pc.card) p hp hs hf
  exact ⟨pc', hcard, hterm'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_of_card
statement:
theorem exists_terminalCover_of_card {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (targetq : ℕ)
    (hlo : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ targetq)
    (hhi : targetq + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
      pc.card = targetq ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:= by
  have hBK : B ⊆ K := hrep.2.1
  have hppos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G K :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (hBne.mono hBK)
  refine Nat.strongRecOn
      (motive := fun n =>
        pathCoverNumber G K ≤ n →
          n + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card →
            ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
              pc.card = n ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc)
      targetq ?_ hlo hhi
  intro n ih hlo' hhi'
  by_cases heq : n = pathCoverNumber G K
  · obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := exists_general_min_terminalCover hrep hBne
    exact ⟨pc, hcard.trans heq.symm, hterm⟩
  · have hnlt : pathCoverNumber G K < n := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hlo' (Ne.symm heq)
    have npos : 1 ≤ n := hppos.trans hlo'
    have hnpred : n - 1 < n := Nat.sub_lt (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp npos) (by decide)
    have hloPred : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ n - 1 := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hnlt
    have hhiPred : n - 1 + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card := by omega
    obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := ih (n - 1) hnpred hloPred hhiPred
    have hqpos : 1 ≤ pc.card := by
      have : 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
      omega
    have hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) + pc.card < B.card := by omega
    obtain ⟨pc', hcard', hterm'⟩ :=
      exists_terminalCover_succ hrep hterm (by simpa [hcard] using hqpos)
        (by simpa [hcard] using hstrict)
    refine ⟨pc', ?_, hterm'⟩
    have : n - 1 + 1 = n := Nat.sub_add_cancel npos
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_terminalCover_interval
statement:
theorem exists_terminalCover_interval {K B : Finset V}
    (hrep : RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) K B)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) :
    ∀ targetq : ℕ,
      pathCoverNumber G K ≤ targetq →
      targetq + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card →
      ∃ pc : PathCover G K,
        pc.card = targetq ∧ IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc
proof:
:=
  fun targetq => exists_terminalCover_of_card hrep hBne targetq

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.B_subset_K
statement: lemma B_subset_K : P.B ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W
proof: := subset_union_left

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.W_subset_K
statement: lemma W_subset_K : P.W ⊆ P.B ∪ P.W
proof: := subset_union_right

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.K_sdiff_B
statement: lemma K_sdiff_B : (P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B = P.W
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxUW := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxB := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    rcases mem_union.1 hxUW with hB | hW
    · exact (hxB hB).elim
    · exact hW
  · intro hx
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hx), ?_⟩
    intro hB
    exact disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjBW hB hx

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.mem_W_iff_mem_K_sdiff_B
statement:
lemma mem_W_iff_mem_K_sdiff_B {x : V} :
    x ∈ P.W ↔ x ∈ (P.B ∪ P.W) \ P.B
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_sdiff_B]

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.inducedP4_uabv
statement:
lemma inducedP4_uabv
    {u a b v : V} (hu : u ∈ P.U) (ha : a ∈ P.A) (hb : b ∈ P.B) (hv : v ∈ P.W)
    (hbv : G.Adj b v) : InducedP4 G u a b v
proof:
:= by
  have hUA : u ≠ a := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjAU ha (h ▸ hu)
  have hUB : u ≠ b := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjBU hb (h ▸ hu)
  have hUV : u ≠ v := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjUW hu (h ▸ hv)
  have hAB : a ≠ b := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.disjoint_A_B ha (h ▸ hb)
  have hAV : a ≠ v := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjAW ha (h ▸ hv)
  have hBV : b ≠ v := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjBW hb (h ▸ hv)
  have hadj_ua : G.Adj u a := (P.hAU ha hu).symm
  have hadj_ab : G.Adj a b := P.hAB ha hb
  have nadj_ub : ¬ G.Adj u b := P.hUantiB u hu b hb
  have nadj_uv : ¬ G.Adj u v := P.hUantiW u hu v hv
  have nadj_av : ¬ G.Adj a v := fun h => P.hWantiA v hv a ha h.symm
  exact ⟨hUA, hUB, hUV, hAB, hAV, hBV, hadj_ua, hadj_ab, hbv,
    nadj_ub, nadj_uv, nadj_av⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.adj_of_missing_B_neighbor
statement:
lemma adj_of_missing_B_neighbor (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {b v w : V} (hb : b ∈ P.B) (hv : v ∈ P.W) (hw : w ∈ P.W)
    (hbv : G.Adj b v) (hbw : ¬ G.Adj b w) : G.Adj v w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := P.hUne
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := P.A_nonempty
  have hp4 : InducedP4 G u a b v := P.inducedP4_uabv hu ha hb hv hbv
  have hwU : w ≠ u := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjUW hu (h ▸ hw)
  have hwA : w ≠ a := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjAW ha (h ▸ hw)
  have hwB : w ≠ b := fun h => disjoint_left.1 P.hdisjBW hb (h ▸ hw)
  have hwV : w ≠ v := fun h => hbw (h ▸ hbv)
  have nadj_wu : ¬ G.Adj w u := fun h => P.hUantiW u hu w hw h.symm
  have nadj_wa : ¬ G.Adj w a := P.hWantiA w hw a ha
  have nadj_wb : ¬ G.Adj w b := fun h => hbw h.symm
  have hmeet := hpat hp4 hwU hwA hwB hwV
  rcases hmeet with hwu | hwa | hwb | hwv
  · exact (nadj_wu hwu).elim
  · exact (nadj_wa hwa).elim
  · exact (nadj_wb hwb).elim
  · exact hwv.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.AllCographSides.neighborCondition_K
statement:
lemma neighborCondition_K (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) :
    NeighborCondition (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B
proof:
:= by
  intro b v w hb hv hw hbv hbw
  have hvW : v ∈ P.W := (P.mem_W_iff_mem_K_sdiff_B).2 hv
  have hwW : w ∈ P.W := (P.mem_W_iff_mem_K_sdiff_B).2 hw
  exact P.adj_of_missing_B_neighbor hpat hb hvW hwW hbv hbw

name: Nikoghosyan.not_incomparable_B_neighbors
statement:
lemma not_incomparable_B_neighbors {K B : Finset V}
    (hK : IsCograph G K) (hB : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {b b' v w : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hb' : b' ∈ B)
    (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hw : w ∈ K \ B)
    (hbv : G.Adj b v) (hnb'v : ¬ G.Adj b' v)
    (hb'w : G.Adj b' w) (hnbw : ¬ G.Adj b w) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hvw : G.Adj v w := hN hb hv hw hbv hnbw
  have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hb
  have hb'K : b' ∈ K := hBK hb'
  have hvK : v ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hwK : w ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
  have hne_bv : b ≠ v := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2 (h ▸ hb)
  have hne_bw : b ≠ w := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 hw).2 (h ▸ hb)
  have hne_bb' : b ≠ b' := fun h => hnb'v (h ▸ hbv)
  have hne_vw : v ≠ w := fun h => hnbw (h ▸ hbv)
  have hne_vb' : v ≠ b' := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 hv).2 (h ▸ hb')
  have hne_wb' : w ≠ b' := fun h => (mem_sdiff.1 hw).2 (h ▸ hb')
  have nadj_bb' : ¬ G.Adj b b' := hB hb hb'
  have nadj_vb' : ¬ G.Adj v b' := fun h => hnb'v h.symm
  have hp4 : InducedP4 G b v w b' :=
    ⟨hne_bv, hne_bw, hne_bb', hne_vw, hne_vb', hne_wb',
      hbv, hvw, hb'w.symm, hnbw, nadj_bb', nadj_vb'⟩
  exact hK hbK hvK hwK hb'K hp4

name: Nikoghosyan.neighborSet_nested
statement:
lemma neighborSet_nested {K B : Finset V}
    (hK : IsCograph G K) (hB : Independent (G := G) B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B)
    {b b' : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hb' : b' ∈ B) :
    (K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b x) ⊆ (K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b' x) ∨
      (K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b' x) ⊆
        (K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b x)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h1 : ¬ ((K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b x) ⊆
      (K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b' x)) := fun hst => h (Or.inl hst)
  have h2 : ¬ ((K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b' x) ⊆
      (K \ B).filter (fun x => G.Adj b x)) := fun hts => h (Or.inr hts)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩ := not_subset.1 h1
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩ := not_subset.1 h2
  have hv1 := mem_filter.1 hv
  have hw1 := mem_filter.1 hw
  have hnb'v : ¬ G.Adj b' v := fun hadj =>
    hv' (mem_filter.2 ⟨hv1.1, hadj⟩)
  have hnbw : ¬ G.Adj b w := fun hadj =>
    hw' (mem_filter.2 ⟨hw1.1, hadj⟩)
  exact not_incomparable_B_neighbors (G := G) hK hB hBK hN hb hb'
    hv1.1 hw1.1 hv1.2 hnb'v hw1.2 hnbw

name: Nikoghosyan.reachable_all_nonterminals_of_neighbor
statement:
lemma reachable_all_nonterminals_of_neighbor {K B : Finset V}
    (hN : NeighborCondition (G := G) K B) (hBK : B ⊆ K)
    {b v w : V} (hb : b ∈ B) (hv : v ∈ K \ B) (hw : w ∈ K \ B)
    (hadj : G.Adj b v) :
    (G.induce (K : Set V)).Reachable ⟨v, (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1⟩
      ⟨w, (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hbK : b ∈ K := hBK hb
  have hvK : v ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hv).1
  have hwK : w ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hw).1
  by_cases hbw : G.Adj b w
  · have hvb : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Adj ⟨v, hvK⟩ ⟨b, hbK⟩ := by
      simpa [induce_adj] using hadj.symm
    have hbw' : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Adj ⟨b, hbK⟩ ⟨w, hwK⟩ := by
      simpa [induce_adj] using hbw
    exact (Adj.reachable hvb).trans (Adj.reachable hbw')
  · have hvw : G.Adj v w := hN hb hv hw hadj hbw
    have : (G.induce (K : Set V)).Adj ⟨v, hvK⟩ ⟨w, hwK⟩ := by
      simpa [induce_adj] using hvw
    exact Adj.reachable this

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.biUnion_support_inter_eq
statement:
lemma PathCover.biUnion_support_inter_eq {K B : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) :
    (pc.paths.toFinset.biUnion fun p => p.support ∩ B) = B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, _hp, hxp⟩ := mem_biUnion.1 hx
    exact (mem_inter.1 hxp).2
  · intro hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hBK hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hxK
    exact mem_biUnion.2 ⟨p, List.mem_toFinset.2 hp, mem_inter.2 ⟨hxp, hx⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.pairwiseDisjoint_support_inter
statement:
lemma PathCover.pairwiseDisjoint_support_inter {K B : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G K) :
    (pc.paths.toFinset : Set (GraphPath G)).PairwiseDisjoint
      fun p => p.support ∩ B
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hne
  have hp' : p ∈ pc.paths := List.mem_toFinset.1 hp
  have hq' : q ∈ pc.paths := List.mem_toFinset.1 hq
  have hd :=
    PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem_refinement pc.disjoint hp' hq' hne
  exact disjoint_of_subset_left inter_subset_left
    (disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_left hd)

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.sum_support_inter_card
statement:
lemma PathCover.sum_support_inter_card {K B : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) :
    ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, (p.support ∩ B).card = B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := pc.pairwiseDisjoint_support_inter (B := B)
  rw [← card_biUnion hdisj, pc.biUnion_support_inter_eq hBK]

name: Nikoghosyan.IsTerminalPath.one_le_support_inter_card
statement:
lemma IsTerminalPath.one_le_support_inter_card {B : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (h : IsTerminalPath (G := G) B p) : 1 ≤ (p.support ∩ B).card
proof:
:=
  card_pos.mpr ⟨p.start, mem_inter.2 ⟨p.start_mem_support, h.1⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.paths_toFinset_card
statement:
lemma PathCover.paths_toFinset_card {K : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K) :
    pc.paths.toFinset.card = pc.card
proof:
:=
  List.toFinset_card_of_nodup pc.nodup_paths

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.terminal_excess_add
statement:
lemma PathCover.terminal_excess_add {K B : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, ((p.support ∩ B).card - 1) + pc.card =
      B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hge : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, 1 ≤ (p.support ∩ B).card := by
    intro p hp
    have hp' : p ∈ pc.paths := List.mem_toFinset.1 hp
    exact (hterm p hp').one_le_support_inter_card
  have hsum := pc.sum_support_inter_card hBK
  have hsub :
      ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, ((p.support ∩ B).card - 1) =
        ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, (p.support ∩ B).card -
          ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, 1 :=
    Finset.sum_tsub_distrib pc.paths.toFinset hge
  have hone : ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, 1 = pc.card := by
    simp [sum_const, pc.paths_toFinset_card]
  have hle : pc.card ≤ B.card := terminalCover_card_le (G := G) pc hterm
  have hex :
      ∑ p ∈ pc.paths.toFinset, ((p.support ∩ B).card - 1) =
        B.card - pc.card := by
    rw [hsub, hsum, hone]
  rw [hex]
  exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hle

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_eq_componentCount_sdiff_B
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_eq_componentCount_sdiff_B {K B : Finset V} :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B B = componentCount G (K \ B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold terminalComponentCount componentCount
  refine Nat.card_congr ?_
  refine Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv ?_
  intro C
  unfold IsFreeComponent
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_sdiff_B_le_of_terminalHypothesis
proof:
:= by
  have := h.2 B hBK hne
  rwa [terminalComponentCount_eq_componentCount_sdiff_B] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_sides
statement:
lemma repairedTerminalHypothesis_of_sides (P : AllCographSides G)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hterm : TerminalHypothesis (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B) :
    RepairedTerminalHypothesis (G := G) (P.B ∪ P.W) P.B
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.hKcog, P.B_subset_K, P.hBind, hterm, P.neighborCondition_K hpat⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.not_nil_append_left
statement:
lemma not_nil_append_left {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    (hp : ¬ p.Nil) : ¬ (p.append q).Nil
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact (hp Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons h p' => simp

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.closedCuspCount_eq_internal_of_nocusp
statement:
lemma closedCuspCount_eq_internal_of_nocusp {u : V} {ω : G.Walk u u}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hω : ¬ ω.Nil)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hω) ≠ c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hω)) :
    closedCuspCount ω c = internalCuspCount ω c
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedCuspCount
  simp [hω, hnocusp]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.closedCuspCount_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma closedCuspCount_eq_zero_iff {u : V} {ω : G.Walk u u}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hω : ¬ ω.Nil) :
    closedCuspCount ω c = 0 ↔
      internalCuspCount ω c = 0 ∧
        c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hω) ≠ c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hω)
proof:
:= by
  simp [closedCuspCount, hω]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.isProperlyColored_iff_isCycle_closedCuspCount_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    have hω : ¬ ω.Nil := h.1.not_nil
    rw [closedCuspCount_eq_zero_iff c hω]
    exact ⟨(isAlternating_iff_internalCuspCount_eq_zero ω c).1 h.2.1, h.2.2 hω⟩
  · intro ⟨hcyc, h0⟩
    have hω : ¬ ω.Nil := hcyc.not_nil
    rw [closedCuspCount_eq_zero_iff c hω] at h0
    exact ⟨hcyc, (isAlternating_iff_internalCuspCount_eq_zero ω c).2 h0.1, fun _ => h0.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.Walk_append_left_cancel
statement:
lemma Walk_append_left_cancel {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    {q₁ q₂ : G.Walk v w} (h : p.append q₁ = p.append q₂) : q₁ = q₂
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simpa using h
  | cons hadj p ih =>
    apply ih
    simpa using h

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.isCycle_append_of_paths
statement:
lemma isCycle_append_of_paths {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v u}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (hpnil : ¬ p.Nil) (_hqnil : ¬ q.Nil)
    (hdisj : ∀ x ∈ q.support.tail, x = u ∨ x ∉ p.support)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ p.length + q.length) :
    (p.append q).IsCycle
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length]
  constructor
  · cases p with
    | nil => exact (hpnil Walk.nil_nil).elim
    | cons hadj p' =>
      simp only [Walk.cons_append, Walk.tail_cons]
      have hp' : p'.IsPath := hp.of_cons
      have hu_not : u ∉ p'.support := (Walk.cons_isPath_iff _ _).1 hp |>.2
      have hdisj' : ∀ x ∈ q.support.tail, x ∉ p'.support := by
        intro x hx hxP'
        rcases hdisj x hx with rfl | hnot
        · exact hu_not hxP'
        · exact hnot (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hxP')
      convert isPath_append hp' hq hdisj'
      simp [Walk.isPath_copy]
  · simpa [Walk.length_append] using h3

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.isPath_dropUntil_of_cycle
proof:
:= by
  have htake : ¬ (ω.takeUntil w hw).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne.symm
  have hcyc' : ((ω.takeUntil w hw).append (ω.dropUntil w hw)).IsCycle := by
    convert hcyc
    exact Walk.take_spec ω hw
  exact hcyc'.isPath_of_append_right htake

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.takeUntil_end_of_isPath
statement:
lemma takeUntil_end_of_isPath {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (hp : p.IsPath) :
    p.takeUntil v p.end_mem_support = p
proof:
:= by
  have hdrop : (p.dropUntil v p.end_mem_support).Nil :=
    (Walk.isPath_iff_nil).1 (hp.dropUntil p.end_mem_support)
  have happ := Walk.take_spec p p.end_mem_support
  cases hnil : p.dropUntil v p.end_mem_support with
  | nil => simpa [hnil] using happ
  | cons h q =>
    have : ¬ (p.dropUntil v p.end_mem_support).Nil := by simp [hnil]
    exact (this hdrop).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.dropUntil_reverse_eq
statement:
lemma dropUntil_reverse_eq {v u : V} {ω : G.Walk v v}
    (hcyc : ω.IsCycle) (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne : u ≠ v) :
    ω.reverse.dropUntil u (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]) =
      (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse
proof:
:= by
  have hdropPath : (ω.dropUntil u hu).IsPath :=
    isPath_dropUntil_of_cycle hcyc hu hne
  have hrev : ω.reverse =
      (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.append (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse := by
    rw [← Walk.reverse_append, Walk.take_spec]
  have huL : u ∈ (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.support := by
    simp [Walk.support_reverse]
  have htake_eq :
      ω.reverse.takeUntil u (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]) =
        (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse := by
    have hmem :
        u ∈ ((ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.append
          (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse).support := by
      rw [← hrev]; simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]
    have h := Walk.takeUntil_append_of_mem_left
      (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse huL
    convert h.trans (takeUntil_end_of_isPath hdropPath.reverse)
  have happ := Walk.take_spec ω.reverse
    (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu] : u ∈ ω.reverse.support)
  have hcomp :
      (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.append
        (ω.reverse.dropUntil u (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu])) =
      (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.append (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse := by
    calc
      _ = ω.reverse := by
        rw [← htake_eq]
        exact happ
      _ = _ := hrev
  exact Walk_append_left_cancel hcomp

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.takeUntil_reverse_eq
statement:
lemma takeUntil_reverse_eq {v u : V} {ω : G.Walk v v}
    (hcyc : ω.IsCycle) (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne : u ≠ v) :
    ω.reverse.takeUntil u (by simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]) =
      (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse
proof:
:= by
  have hdropPath : (ω.dropUntil u hu).IsPath :=
    isPath_dropUntil_of_cycle hcyc hu hne
  have hrev : ω.reverse =
      (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.append (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse := by
    rw [← Walk.reverse_append, Walk.take_spec]
  have huL : u ∈ (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.support := by
    simp [Walk.support_reverse]
  have hmem :
      u ∈ ((ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse.append
        (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse).support := by
    rw [← hrev]; simp [Walk.support_reverse, hu]
  have h := Walk.takeUntil_append_of_mem_left
    (ω.dropUntil u hu).reverse (ω.takeUntil u hu).reverse huL
  convert h.trans (takeUntil_end_of_isPath hdropPath.reverse)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.mem_support_takeUntil_or_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  have happ := Walk.take_spec p hu
  rw [← happ, Walk.mem_support_append_iff] at hx
  exact hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.support_tail_takeUntil_prefix
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Walk.support_takeUntil_prefix_support q hx
  have hcons_take :
      (q.takeUntil x hx).support =
        u :: (q.takeUntil x hx).support.tail := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.cons_head_tail (Walk.support_ne_nil _)]
    rw [Walk.head_support]
  have hcons_q : q.support = u :: q.support.tail := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.cons_head_tail (Walk.support_ne_nil _)]
    rw [Walk.head_support]
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  have ht' : (u :: (q.takeUntil x hx).support.tail) ++ t = u :: q.support.tail := by
    rwa [← hcons_take, ← hcons_q]
  simp only [List.cons_append] at ht'
  exact (List.cons_inj_right u).mp ht'

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.first_reentry_spec
statement:
theorem first_reentry_spec {u w : V} {q : G.Walk u w}
    (hq : q.IsPath) (hqnil : ¬ q.Nil) (hne : u ≠ w)
    {S : List V} (hw : w ∈ S) :
    ∃ (x : V) (hx : x ∈ q.support),
      x ∈ S ∧ ¬ (q.takeUntil x hx).Nil ∧ x ∈ q.support.tail ∧
        (∀ y ∈ (q.takeUntil x hx).support.tail, y ∈ S → y = x)
proof:
:= by
  have hwtail : w ∈ q.support.tail := end_mem_support_tail hqnil hne
  let p : V → Bool := fun a => decide (a ∈ S)
  have hi : q.support.tail.findIdx p < q.support.tail.length := by
    refine List.findIdx_lt_length_of_exists ?_
    exact ⟨w, hwtail, by simp [p, hw]⟩
  set x := q.support.tail[q.support.tail.findIdx p]
  have hxtail : x ∈ q.support.tail := List.getElem_mem _
  have hxsup : x ∈ q.support := List.mem_of_mem_tail hxtail
  have hxS : x ∈ S := by
    have hget := List.findIdx_getElem (xs := q.support.tail) (w := hi)
    simpa [x, p] using hget
  have hnil : ¬ (q.takeUntil x hxsup).Nil := not_nil_takeUntil_of_mem_tail hq hxtail
  refine ⟨x, hxsup, hxS, hnil, hxtail, ?_⟩
  intro y hy hyS
  have hpref := support_tail_takeUntil_prefix hxsup hnil
  have hy_tail : y ∈ q.support.tail := hpref.subset hy
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjy⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hy_tail
  have hnodup : q.support.tail.Nodup := hq.support_nodup.tail
  have hx_idx : q.support.idxOf x = q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1 := by
    have hlt : q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1 < q.support.length := by
      have := hi
      simp [List.length_tail] at this ⊢
      omega
    have hxget : q.support[q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1] = x := by
      have := List.getElem_tail (l := q.support) (i := q.support.tail.findIdx p)
        (h := by simpa [List.length_tail] using hi)
      simpa [x] using this.symm
    have := hq.support_nodup.idxOf_getElem (i := q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1) hlt
    simpa [hxget] using this
  have hlen_take : (q.takeUntil x hxsup).length = q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1 := by
    rw [Walk.length_takeUntil, hx_idx]
  have hlen_tail :
      (q.takeUntil x hxsup).support.tail.length =
        q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1 := by
    simp [List.length_tail, Walk.length_support, hlen_take]
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hky⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hy
  have hk_lt : k < q.support.tail.findIdx p + 1 :=
    hlen_tail ▸ hk
  have hpre_get :
      (q.takeUntil x hxsup).support.tail[k] = q.support.tail[k] := by
    have hpf := List.IsPrefix.getElem hpref hk
    exact hpf
  have : q.support.tail[k] = y := by
    rw [← hpre_get, hky]
  have hklen : k < q.support.tail.length :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hk_lt (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  have hjk : j = k := by
    apply (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnodup (hi := hj) (hj := hklen)).mp
    rw [hjy, this]
  have hj_le : j ≤ q.support.tail.findIdx p := by
    omega
  have hj_not_lt : ¬ j < q.support.tail.findIdx p := by
    intro hjlt
    have hfalse := List.not_of_lt_findIdx (p := p) hjlt
    have : p (q.support.tail[j]) = true := by
      simp [p, hjy, hyS]
    exact of_decide_eq_false hfalse (by simpa [p, hjy] using hyS)
  have : j = q.support.tail.findIdx p := le_antisymm hj_le (Nat.le_of_not_gt hj_not_lt)
  subst this
  simp [x, hjy]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.nocusp_reverse
statement:
lemma nocusp_reverse {v : V} {ω : G.Walk v v} (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (hω : ¬ ω.Nil)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hω) ≠ c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hω)) :
    c.dartColor (ω.reverse.firstDart (not_nil_reverse hω)) ≠
      c.dartColor (ω.reverse.lastDart (not_nil_reverse hω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstDart_reverse hω, lastDart_reverse hω, EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm,
    EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm]
  exact hnocusp.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.internalCuspCount_take_drop
statement:
lemma internalCuspCount_take_drop {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hw : w ∈ p.support)
    (ht : ¬ (p.takeUntil w hw).Nil) (hd : ¬ (p.dropUntil w hw).Nil) :
    internalCuspCount p c =
      internalCuspCount (p.takeUntil w hw) c +
        internalCuspCount (p.dropUntil w hw) c +
          seamCusp c (p.takeUntil w hw) (p.dropUntil w hw) ht hd
proof:
:= by
  have happ := Walk.take_spec p hw
  have h := internalCuspCount_append (p := p.takeUntil w hw)
    (q := p.dropUntil w hw) c ht hd
  simpa [happ] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.CuspFreeReach.of_takeUntil
statement:
lemma CuspFreeReach.of_takeUntil {u v w : V} {α : C} {q : G.Walk u v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hq : q.IsPath) (hqnil : ¬ q.Nil)
    (hq0 : internalCuspCount q c = 0)
    (hqfirst : c.dartColor (q.firstDart hqnil) ≠ α)
    (hw : w ∈ q.support) (hnil : ¬ (q.takeUntil w hw).Nil) :
    CuspFreeReach c u w α (c.dartColor ((q.takeUntil w hw).lastDart hnil))
proof:
:=
  ⟨q.takeUntil w hw, hq.takeUntil hw, hnil,
    internalCuspCount_takeUntil c hw hq0,
    by rw [firstDart_takeUntil hw hnil]; exact hqfirst, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cycle_take_drop_inter
statement:
lemma cycle_take_drop_inter {v u x : V} {ω : G.Walk v v}
    (hcyc : ω.IsCycle) (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne : u ≠ v)
    (hxT : x ∈ (ω.takeUntil u hu).support)
    (hxD : x ∈ (ω.dropUntil u hu).support) :
    x = u ∨ x = v
proof:
:= by
  have happ : (ω.takeUntil u hu).append (ω.dropUntil u hu) = ω := Walk.take_spec ω hu
  have hdis :
      (ω.takeUntil u hu).support.tail.Disjoint (ω.dropUntil u hu).support.tail := by
    have : ((ω.takeUntil u hu).support.tail ++
        (ω.dropUntil u hu).support.tail).Nodup := by
      rw [← Walk.tail_support_append, happ]
      exact hcyc.support_nodup
    exact List.disjoint_of_nodup_append this
  rw [Walk.mem_support_iff] at hxT hxD
  rcases hxT with rfl | hxT
  · exact Or.inr rfl
  rcases hxD with rfl | hxD
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  exact (hdis hxT hxD).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.seamCusp_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma seamCusp_eq_one_iff {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (hq : ¬ q.Nil) :
    seamCusp c p q hp hq = 1 ↔
      c.dartColor (p.lastDart hp) = c.dartColor (q.firstDart hq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold seamCusp
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.seamCusp_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma seamCusp_eq_zero_iff {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (hq : ¬ q.Nil) :
    seamCusp c p q hp hq = 0 ↔
      c.dartColor (p.lastDart hp) ≠ c.dartColor (q.firstDart hq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold seamCusp
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.seamCusp_le_one
proof:
:= by
  unfold seamCusp
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.mem_support_of_mem_takeUntil
proof:
:=
  (Walk.support_takeUntil_subset_support p hw) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.mem_support_of_mem_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  have happ := Walk.take_spec p hw
  have : x ∈ ((p.takeUntil w hw).append (p.dropUntil w hw)).support :=
    Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hx
  simpa [happ] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.path_start_not_mem_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have htake : ¬ (p.takeUntil w hw).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
  have happ := Walk.take_spec p hw
  have hsup :
      p.support =
        (p.takeUntil w hw).support.dropLast ++ (p.dropUntil w hw).support := by
    have h := Walk.support_append_eq_support_dropLast_append
      (p.takeUntil w hw) (p.dropUntil w hw)
    rwa [happ] at h
  have hlen : 2 ≤ (p.takeUntil w hw).support.length := by
    have hs := Walk.length_support (p.takeUntil w hw)
    have : 1 ≤ (p.takeUntil w hw).length :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 htake)
    omega
  have hdl : (p.takeUntil w hw).support.dropLast ≠ [] := by
    intro hnil
    have : (p.takeUntil w hw).support.length ≤ 1 :=
      (List.dropLast_eq_nil_iff).1 hnil
    omega
  have hu_left : u ∈ (p.takeUntil w hw).support.dropLast := by
    cases hs : (p.takeUntil w hw).support with
    | nil =>
      exact (Walk.support_ne_nil (p.takeUntil w hw) hs).elim
    | cons a as =>
      have ha : a = u := by
        have := Walk.head_support (p.takeUntil w hw)
        simp [hs] at this
        exact this
      have has : as ≠ [] := by
        intro hnil
        simp [hs, hnil] at hlen
      subst ha
      simp [hs, List.dropLast_cons_of_ne_nil has]
  have hnod : p.support.Nodup := hp.support_nodup
  have hdis :
      (p.takeUntil w hw).support.dropLast.Disjoint (p.dropUntil w hw).support := by
    have hnod' : ((p.takeUntil w hw).support.dropLast ++
        (p.dropUntil w hw).support).Nodup := by
      simpa [hsup] using hnod
    exact List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnod'
  exact hdis hu_left hmem

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.eq_cons_nil_of_length_one
statement:
lemma eq_cons_nil_of_length_one {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (h1 : p.length = 1) : ∃ h : G.Adj u v, p = Walk.cons h Walk.nil
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h1
  | cons h p' =>
    cases p' with
    | nil => exact ⟨h, rfl⟩
    | cons h2 p'' =>
      simp [Walk.length_cons] at h1

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.dartColor_length_one_symm
statement:
lemma dartColor_length_one_symm {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v u}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (hq : ¬ q.Nil)
    (h1 : p.length = 1) (h2 : q.length = 1) :
    c.dartColor (p.lastDart hp) = c.dartColor (q.firstDart hq)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpadj, rfl⟩ := eq_cons_nil_of_length_one h1
  obtain ⟨hqadj, rfl⟩ := eq_cons_nil_of_length_one h2
  simp [Walk.lastDart, Walk.firstDart, Walk.penultimate, EdgeColoring.dartColor]
  exact (c.color_symm hpadj).trans (c.color_proof _ _)

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.dartColor_length_one_same
statement:
lemma dartColor_length_one_same {u v : V} {p q : G.Walk u v}
    (c : EdgeColoring G C) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (hq : ¬ q.Nil)
    (h1 : p.length = 1) (h2 : q.length = 1) :
    c.dartColor (p.firstDart hp) = c.dartColor (q.firstDart hq)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpadj, rfl⟩ := eq_cons_nil_of_length_one h1
  obtain ⟨hqadj, rfl⟩ := eq_cons_nil_of_length_one h2
  simp [Walk.firstDart, EdgeColoring.dartColor, EdgeColoring.color_proof]

name: Nikoghosyan.Yeo.cusp_minimization_oriented
statement:
theorem cusp_minimization_oriented {v u w : V} {α β : C}
    (ω : G.Walk v v) (c : EdgeColoring G C)
    (hcyc : ω.IsCycle)
    (hnocusp : c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) ≠
      c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil))
    (hu : u ∈ ω.support) (hne_uv : u ≠ v)
    (hcusp :
      c.dartColor ((ω.takeUntil u hu).lastDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uv.symm)) = α ∧
        c.dartColor ((ω.dropUntil u hu).firstDart (Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uv)) = α)
    {q : G.Walk u w}
    (hq : q.IsPath) (hqnil : ¬ q.Nil)
    (hq0 : internalCuspCount q c = 0)
    (hqfirst : c.dartColor (q.firstDart hqnil) ≠ α)
    (hqlast : c.dartColor (q.lastDart hqnil) = β)
    (hw : w ∈ (ω.dropUntil u hu).support)
    (hinter : ∀ x ∈ q.support.tail, x ∈ ω.support → x = w)
    (hstart : w = v → β ≠ c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil)) :
    HasProperlyColoredCycle c ∨
      ∃ (ω' : G.Walk v v) (hcyc' : ω'.IsCycle),
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) ∧
          closedCuspCount ω' c < closedCuspCount ω c
proof:
:= by
  set VU := ω.takeUntil u hu
  set UV := ω.dropUntil u hu
  have hVU : VU.IsPath := hcyc.isPath_takeUntil hu
  have hUV : UV.IsPath := isPath_dropUntil_of_cycle hcyc hu hne_uv
  have hVUnil : ¬ VU.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uv.symm
  have hUVnil : ¬ UV.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uv
  have hne_uw : u ≠ w := mt (Walk.IsPath.nil_iff_eq hq).2 hqnil
  have hωint0 : closedCuspCount ω c = internalCuspCount ω c :=
    closedCuspCount_eq_internal_of_nocusp c hcyc.not_nil hnocusp
  have hseamU : seamCusp c VU UV hVUnil hUVnil = 1 :=
    (seamCusp_eq_one_iff c hVUnil hUVnil).2 (hcusp.1.trans hcusp.2.symm)
  have hinterω := internalCuspCount_take_drop c hu hVUnil hUVnil
  have hVUpos : 1 ≤ VU.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hVUnil)
  have hqpos : 1 ≤ q.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hqnil)
  by_cases hwv : w = v
  · subst w
    have hdisj : ∀ x ∈ q.support.tail, x = v ∨ x ∉ VU.support := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxv : x = v
      · exact Or.inl hxv
      · exact Or.inr fun hxVU =>
          hxv (hinter x hx (mem_support_of_mem_takeUntil hu hxVU))
    have h3 : 3 ≤ VU.length + q.length := by
      refine le_of_not_gt fun hlt => ?_
      have hsum : VU.length + q.length = 2 := by omega
      have hVU1 : VU.length = 1 := by omega
      have hq1 : q.length = 1 := by omega
      have hse := dartColor_length_one_symm c hVUnil hqnil hVU1 hq1
      exact hqfirst (hse.symm.trans hcusp.1)
    have hcyc' : (VU.append q).IsCycle :=
      isCycle_append_of_paths hVU hq hVUnil hqnil hdisj h3
    have hfirst :
        c.dartColor ((VU.append q).firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) =
          c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) := by
      rw [firstDart_append_of_not_nil_left hVUnil]
      simp [VU, firstDart_takeUntil hu hVUnil, firstDart_proof]
    have hlast :
        c.dartColor ((VU.append q).lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) = β := by
      rw [lastDart_append_of_not_nil_right hqnil, hqlast]
    have hn' :
        c.dartColor ((VU.append q).firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
          c.dartColor ((VU.append q).lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) := by
      rw [hfirst, hlast]; exact (hstart rfl).symm
    have hω'int : internalCuspCount (VU.append q) c = internalCuspCount VU c := by
      rw [internalCuspCount_append c hVUnil hqnil, hq0]
      have : seamCusp c VU q hVUnil hqnil = 0 :=
        (seamCusp_eq_zero_iff c hVUnil hqnil).2 (fun hcol => hqfirst (hcusp.1 ▸ hcol.symm))
      omega
    refine Or.inr ⟨VU.append q, hcyc', hn', ?_⟩
    rw [hωint0, closedCuspCount_eq_internal_of_nocusp c hcyc'.not_nil hn',
      hω'int]
    have : internalCuspCount ω c =
        internalCuspCount VU c + internalCuspCount UV c + 1 := by
      simpa [VU, UV, hseamU] using hinterω
    omega
  · have hWUnil : ¬ (UV.takeUntil w hw).Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne_uw
    have hWVnil : ¬ (UV.dropUntil w hw).Nil :=
      Walk.not_nil_of_ne (fun h => hwv h)
    set UW := UV.takeUntil w hw
    set WV := UV.dropUntil w hw
    have hUW : UW.IsPath := hUV.takeUntil hw
    have hWV : WV.IsPath := hUV.dropUntil hw
    have hWVpos : 1 ≤ WV.length :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hWVnil)
    have hAdisj : ∀ x ∈ q.support.tail, x ∉ VU.support := by
      intro x hx hxVU
      have hxω := mem_support_of_mem_takeUntil hu hxVU
      have hxw : x = w := hinter x hx hxω
      subst hxw
      rcases cycle_take_drop_inter hcyc hu hne_uv hxVU hw with rfl | rfl
      · exact hne_uw rfl
      · exact hwv rfl
    have hA : (VU.append q).IsPath := isPath_append hVU hq hAdisj
    have hAnil : ¬ (VU.append q).Nil := not_nil_append_right hqnil
    have hdisjC : ∀ x ∈ WV.support.tail, x = v ∨ x ∉ (VU.append q).support := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxv : x = v
      · exact Or.inl hxv
      · right
        intro hxA
        have hxWV : x ∈ WV.support := List.mem_of_mem_tail hx
        have hxUV := mem_support_of_mem_dropUntil hw hxWV
        have hxω := mem_support_of_mem_dropUntil hu hxUV
        rw [Walk.mem_support_append_iff] at hxA
        rcases hxA with hxVU | hxq
        · rcases cycle_take_drop_inter hcyc hu hne_uv hxVU hxUV with huEq | hvEq
          · exact path_start_not_mem_dropUntil hUV hw hne_uw (by
              have : u ∈ WV.support := huEq ▸ hxWV
              convert this)
          · exact hxv hvEq
        · rw [Walk.mem_support_iff] at hxq
          rcases hxq with hxu | hxqt
          · exact path_start_not_mem_dropUntil hUV hw hne_uw (by
              have : u ∈ WV.support := hxu ▸ hxWV
              convert this)
          · have hxw : x = w := hinter x hxqt hxω
            subst hxw
            exact not_mem_support_tail_of_isPath hWV hx
    have h3 : 3 ≤ (VU.append q).length + WV.length := by
      simp [Walk.length_append]; omega
    have hcyc' : ((VU.append q).append WV).IsCycle :=
      isCycle_append_of_paths hA hWV hAnil hWVnil hdisjC h3
    set ω' := (VU.append q).append WV
    have hfirst' :
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) =
          c.dartColor (ω.firstDart hcyc.not_nil) := by
      rw [firstDart_append_of_not_nil_left hAnil,
        firstDart_append_of_not_nil_left hVUnil]
      simp [VU, firstDart_takeUntil hu hVUnil, firstDart_proof]
    have hlast' :
        c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) =
          c.dartColor (ω.lastDart hcyc.not_nil) := by
      rw [lastDart_append_of_not_nil_right hWVnil, lastDart_dropUntil hw hWVnil,
        lastDart_dropUntil hu hUVnil]
      try simp [lastDart_proof]
    have hn' :
        c.dartColor (ω'.firstDart hcyc'.not_nil) ≠
          c.dartColor (ω'.lastDart hcyc'.not_nil) := by
      rw [hfirst', hlast']; exact hnocusp
    have hinterUV := internalCuspCount_take_drop (p := UV) c hw hWUnil hWVnil
    let n1 := internalCuspCount VU c
    let n2 := internalCuspCount UW c
    let n3 := internalCuspCount WV c
    let bω := seamCusp c UW WV hWUnil hWVnil
    let b' := seamCusp c q WV hqnil hWVnil
    have hωint : internalCuspCount ω c = n1 + 1 + n2 + bω + n3 := by
      have h1 : internalCuspCount ω c =
          internalCuspCount VU c + internalCuspCount UV c + 1 := by
        simpa [VU, UV, hseamU] using hinterω
      have h2 : internalCuspCount UV c = n2 + n3 + bω := hinterUV
      omega
    have hω'int : internalCuspCount ω' c = n1 + b' + n3 := by
      have hAq := internalCuspCount_append (p := VU) (q := q) c hVUnil hqnil
      have hse0 : seamCusp c VU q hVUnil hqnil = 0 :=
        (seamCusp_eq_zero_iff c hVUnil hqnil).2
          (fun hcol => hqfirst (hcusp.1 ▸ hcol.symm))
      have hrest := internalCuspCount_append (p := VU.append q) (q := WV)
        c hAnil hWVnil
      have hseb : seamCusp c (VU.append q) WV hAnil hWVnil = b' := by
        simp only [b', seamCusp]
        rw [lastDart_append_of_not_nil_right hqnil]
      simp [ω', hrest, hAq, hse0, hq0, hseb]
      omega
    rw [hωint0]
    have hω'c := closedCuspCount_eq_internal_of_nocusp c hcyc'.not_nil hn'
    by_cases hlt : n1 + b' + n3 < n1 + 1 + n2 + bω + n3
    · refine Or.inr ⟨ω', hcyc', hn', ?_⟩
      rw [hω'c, hωint, hω'int]; exact hlt
    · have hb'le : b' ≤ 1 := seamCusp_le_one c hqnil hWVnil
      have hbωle : bω ≤ 1 := seamCusp_le_one c hWUnil hWVnil
      have hn2 : n2 = 0 := by omega
      have hbω : bω = 0 := by omega
      have hb' : b' = 1 := by omega
      have hUWrev : UW.reverse.IsPath := hUW.reverse
      have hUWrevnil : ¬ UW.reverse.Nil := not_nil_reverse hWUnil
      have hDdisj : ∀ x ∈ UW.reverse.support.tail, x = u ∨ x ∉ q.support := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases hxu : x = u
        · exact Or.inl hxu
        · right
          intro hxq
          have hxUW : x ∈ UW.support := by
            simpa [Walk.support_reverse] using List.mem_of_mem_tail hx
          have hxω := mem_support_of_mem_dropUntil hu
            (mem_support_of_mem_takeUntil hw hxUW)
          rw [Walk.mem_support_iff] at hxq
          rcases hxq with rfl | hxqt
          · exact hxu rfl
          · have : x = w := hinter x hxqt hxω
            subst this
            exact not_mem_support_tail_of_isPath hUWrev hx
      have h3d : 3 ≤ q.length + UW.reverse.length := by
        refine le_of_not_gt fun hlt => ?_
        have hUWpos : 1 ≤ UW.length :=
          Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hWUnil)
        have hUW1 : UW.length = 1 := by simp [Walk.length_reverse] at hlt; omega
        have hq1 : q.length = 1 := by simp [Walk.length_reverse] at hlt; omega
        have hse := dartColor_length_one_same c hqnil hWUnil hq1 hUW1
        have hfirstUW : c.dartColor (UW.firstDart hWUnil) = α := by
          rw [firstDart_takeUntil hw hWUnil]; exact hcusp.2
        exact hqfirst (hse.trans hfirstUW)
      have hcycd : (q.append UW.reverse).IsCycle :=
        isCycle_append_of_paths hq hUWrev hqnil hUWrevnil hDdisj h3d
      have hnocuspd :
          c.dartColor ((q.append UW.reverse).firstDart hcycd.not_nil) ≠
            c.dartColor ((q.append UW.reverse).lastDart hcycd.not_nil) := by
        rw [firstDart_append_of_not_nil_left hqnil,
          lastDart_append_of_not_nil_right hUWrevnil,
          lastDart_reverse hWUnil hUWrevnil, EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm,
          firstDart_takeUntil hw hWUnil]
        exact fun hcol => hqfirst (hcol.trans hcusp.2)
      have hinterd : internalCuspCount (q.append UW.reverse) c = 0 := by
        rw [internalCuspCount_append c hqnil hUWrevnil, hq0,
          internalCuspCount_reverse]
        have hse0 : seamCusp c q UW.reverse hqnil hUWrevnil = 0 := by
          rw [seamCusp_eq_zero_iff]
          rw [firstDart_reverse hWUnil hUWrevnil, EdgeColoring.dartColor_symm, hqlast]
          have hb'1 := (seamCusp_eq_one_iff c hqnil hWVnil).1 hb'
          have hbω0 := (seamCusp_eq_zero_iff c hWUnil hWVnil).1 hbω
          rw [hqlast] at hb'1
          exact fun hcol => hbω0 (hcol.symm.trans hb'1)
        omega
      refine Or.inl ⟨u, q.append UW.reverse, ?_⟩
      exact (isProperlyColored_iff_isCycle_closedCuspCount_eq_zero c).2
        ⟨hcycd, (closedCuspCount_eq_zero_iff c hcycd.not_nil).2 ⟨hinterd, hnocuspd⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_right
statement:
lemma sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_right {A B S : Finset V}
    (hB : B ⊆ S) : (A ∪ B) \ S = A \ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx.1 with hA | hB'
    · exact ⟨hA, hx.2⟩
    · exact (hx.2 (hB hB')).elim
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨Or.inl hx.1, hx.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_left
statement:
lemma sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_left {A B S : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ S) : (A ∪ B) \ S = B \ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_comm]
  exact sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_right hA

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_union_distrib
statement:
lemma sdiff_union_distrib (A B S : Finset V) :
    (A ∪ B) \ S = (A \ S) ∪ (B \ S)
proof:
:=
  union_sdiff_distrib A B S

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter
statement: lemma sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter {A B : Finset V} : A \ B = A \ (B ∩ A)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_inter]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.1, fun hBA => h.2 hBA.1⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.1, fun hB => h.2 ⟨hB, h.1⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.IsCompleteBetween.mono_sdiff
statement:
lemma IsCompleteBetween.mono_sdiff {A B S : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween ((A \ S : Finset V) : Set V)
      ((B \ S : Finset V) : Set V)
proof:
:=
  IsCompleteBetween.mono hAB sdiff_subset sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.ncard_free_eq_componentCount_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma ncard_free_eq_componentCount_of_disjoint {A T : Finset V}
    (h : Disjoint A T) :
    Nat.card
        { C : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
          componentFinset G A C ∩ T = ∅ } =
      componentCount G A
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentCount
  refine Nat.card_congr ?_
  exact Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv fun C => by
    apply eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
    intro x hx
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 h
      (componentFinset_subset (G := G) C (mem_inter.1 hx).1)
      (mem_inter.1 hx).2

name: Nikoghosyan.terminalComponentCount_eq_zero_of_connected_meets
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_eq_zero_of_connected_meets
    {K B S : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hbKS : b ∈ K \ S) (hbBS : b ∈ B \ S)
    (hconn : (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) K B S = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fintype
      { C : (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
        IsFreeComponent (G := G) K B S C } := inferInstance
  unfold terminalComponentCount
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  refine Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.2 ⟨fun C => ?_⟩
  have hss : Subsingleton
      (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    hconn.preconnected.subsingleton_connectedComponent
  have hCeq :
      C.1 =
        (G.induce ((K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
          ⟨b, hbKS⟩ :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hbC : b ∈ componentFinset G (K \ S) C.1 := by
    rw [hCeq]
