    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hbKS, ⟨hbKS, rfl⟩⟩
  exact notMem_empty b (C.2 ▸ mem_inter.2 ⟨hbC, hbBS⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_sdiff_sideChange
statement:
lemma disjoint_sdiff_sideChange {A B S : Finset V} (h : Disjoint A B) :
    Disjoint (A \ S) (B \ S)
proof:
:=
  h.mono sdiff_subset sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.nocross_sdiff
proof:
:=
  fun a ha b hb => hnocross a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 b (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.union_I_D_Y
statement:
lemma union_I_D_Y (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    s.I ∪ s.D ∪ H.Y = H.K
proof:
:= by
  have hX : s.D ∪ s.I = H.X := s.hDU
  calc
    s.I ∪ s.D ∪ H.Y = (s.D ∪ s.I) ∪ H.Y := by
      rw [union_comm s.I s.D]
    _ = H.X ∪ H.Y := by rw [hX]
    _ = H.K := H.union_X_Y

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.D_subset_X
statement: lemma D_subset_X (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) : s.D ⊆ H.X
proof: := s.hDsub

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.D_subset_K
statement: lemma D_subset_K (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) : s.D ⊆ H.K
proof:
:=
  (H.D_subset_X s).trans sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.I_subset_K
statement: lemma I_subset_K (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) : s.I ⊆ H.K
proof:
:=
  (H.I_subset_X s).trans sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.disjoint_D_Y
statement: lemma disjoint_D_Y (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) : Disjoint s.D H.Y
proof:
:=
  disjoint_of_subset_left (H.D_subset_X s) H.disjoint_X_Y

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.disjoint_I_Y
statement: lemma disjoint_I_Y (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) : Disjoint s.I H.Y
proof:
:=
  disjoint_of_subset_left (H.I_subset_X s) H.disjoint_X_Y

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.Independent_I
statement:
lemma Independent_I (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    Independent (G := G) s.I
proof:
:=
  H.hInd.mono s.hI

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.pathCoverNumber_I
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_I (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    pathCoverNumber G s.I = s.I.card
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_eq_card_of_independent (G := G) (H.Independent_I s)

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.pathCoverNumber_X_of_mixed
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_X_of_mixed (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) :
    pathCoverNumber G H.X =
      pathCoverNumber G s.D + s.I.card
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :=
    Cograph.pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) s.hdisj s.hnocross
  have hX : s.D ∪ s.I = H.X := s.hDU
  simpa [hX, H.pathCoverNumber_I s] using hsum

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.pathCoverNumber_Y_lt_X
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_Y_lt_X :
    pathCoverNumber G H.Y + 1 ≤ H.X.card
proof:
:=
  pathCoverNumber_B_free_join_side_lt (G := G) H.X_nonempty H.hYne
    H.complete_X_Y (by simpa [H.union_X_Y] using H.hcog) H.B_subset_X
    (by simpa [H.union_X_Y] using H.hTH)

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.pathCoverNumber_K_eq_X_sub_Y
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_K_eq_X_sub_Y
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K) :
    pathCoverNumber G H.K = pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card
proof:
:= by
  have hj :=
    pathCoverNumber_complete_join H.X_nonempty H.hYne H.complete_X_Y
  have hunion : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.K := H.union_X_Y
  rw [hunion] at hj
  have hpYle : pathCoverNumber G H.Y ≤ H.X.card := by
    have := H.pathCoverNumber_Y_lt_X
    omega
  have hY0 : pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.X.card = 0 :=
    Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpYle
  have hnot1 : pathCoverNumber G H.K ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hmax :
      max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card)
        (pathCoverNumber G H.Y - H.X.card)) =
        pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card := by
    have hpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card := by
      have : pathCoverNumber G H.K =
          max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card) 0) := by
        simpa [hY0] using hj
      have hne1 :
          max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card) 0) ≠ 1 := by
        simpa [this] using hnot1
      have :
          ¬ pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card ≤ 1 ∨
            1 < pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card := by
        omega
      omega
    simp [hY0, max_eq_right hpos]
  exact hj.trans hmax

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.pathCoverNumber_K_eq_mixed
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_K_eq_mixed
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K) :
    pathCoverNumber G H.K =
      pathCoverNumber G s.D + s.I.card - H.Y.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.pathCoverNumber_K_eq_X_sub_Y hpK, H.pathCoverNumber_X_of_mixed s]

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.I_card_ge_three
statement:
lemma I_card_ge_three
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    3 ≤ s.I.card
proof:
:= by
  have hXeq : pathCoverNumber G H.X =
      pathCoverNumber G s.D + s.I.card := H.pathCoverNumber_X_of_mixed s
  have hKeq : pathCoverNumber G H.K =
      pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card := H.pathCoverNumber_K_eq_X_sub_Y hpK
  have hYle : H.Y.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.X := by
    have : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card := by
      have hne1 : pathCoverNumber G H.K ≠ 1 := by omega
      have : pathCoverNumber G H.K = pathCoverNumber G H.X - H.Y.card := hKeq
      omega
    omega
  have hsum : s.I.card + pathCoverNumber G s.D =
      pathCoverNumber G H.K + H.Y.card := by
    have : pathCoverNumber G H.X =
        pathCoverNumber G H.K + H.Y.card := by
      have := Nat.sub_add_cancel hYle
      omega
    omega
  have hge : 3 + pathCoverNumber G s.D ≤
      pathCoverNumber G H.K + H.Y.card := by omega
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.I_nonempty_of_small_pD
statement:
lemma I_nonempty_of_small_pD
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    s.I.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < s.I.card :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) (H.I_card_ge_three s hpK hpD)
  exact card_pos.mp hpos

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_empty
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_empty
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := H.I_nonempty_of_small_pD s hpK hpD
  have hiK : i ∈ H.K \ (∅ : Finset V) := by
    simpa [sdiff_empty] using H.I_subset_K s hi
  have hiI : i ∈ s.I \ (∅ : Finset V) := by simpa [sdiff_empty] using hi
  have hconn : (G.induce ((H.K \ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected := by
    have hEq : H.K \ (∅ : Finset V) = H.K := sdiff_empty
    rw [hEq]
    exact H.hconn
  exact terminalComponentCount_eq_zero_of_connected_meets (G := G)
    hiK hiI hconn

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_of_Y_subset
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_of_Y_subset
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    (_hS : S ⊆ H.K) (hY : H.Y ⊆ S) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S =
      componentCount G (s.D \ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hKeq : H.K \ S = H.X \ S := by
    have hunion : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.K := H.union_X_Y
    rw [← hunion]
    exact sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_right hY
  have hXeq : H.X \ S = (s.D \ S) ∪ (s.I \ S) :=
    (congrArg (fun t => t \ S) s.hDU.symm).trans
      (union_sdiff_distrib s.D s.I S)
  have hRem : H.K \ S = (s.D \ S) ∪ (s.I \ S) := by
    rw [hKeq, hXeq]
  have hIeq : s.I \ S = s.I \ S := rfl
  have hnc := nocross_sdiff (G := G) s.hnocross (S := S)
  have hJ : s.I \ S ⊆ s.I \ S := subset_rfl
  unfold terminalComponentCount IsFreeComponent
  have h1 :
      Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce ((H.K \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G (H.K \ S) C ∩ (s.I \ S) = ∅ } =
        Nat.card
          { C : (G.induce
              (((s.D \ S) ∪ (s.I \ S) : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent //
            componentFinset G ((s.D \ S) ∪ (s.I \ S)) C ∩ (s.I \ S) = ∅ } := by
    rw [hRem]
  have h2 :=
    ncard_free_union_isolates (G := G) (A := s.D \ S) (J := s.I \ S)
      (T := s.I \ S) hnc hJ
  have hdisj : Disjoint (s.D \ S) (s.I \ S) :=
    disjoint_sdiff_sideChange s.hdisj
  have h3 :=
    ncard_free_eq_componentCount_of_disjoint (G := G) (A := s.D \ S)
      (T := s.I \ S) hdisj
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_Y_deleted_le
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_Y_deleted_le
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : S ⊆ H.K) (hY : H.Y ⊆ S)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S ≤ S.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S =
        componentCount G (s.D \ S) :=
    H.terminalComponentCount_I_of_Y_subset s hS hY
  have hSD : S ∩ s.D ⊆ s.D := inter_subset_right
  have hDs : s.D \ S = s.D \ (S ∩ s.D) := sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter
  have hcle :
      componentCount G (s.D \ S) ≤
        pathCoverNumber G s.D + (S ∩ s.D).card := by
    rw [hDs]
    exact componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G) s.D (S ∩ s.D) hSD
  have hdisjYD : Disjoint H.Y (S ∩ s.D) :=
    (H.disjoint_D_Y s).symm.mono_right inter_subset_right
  have hsub : H.Y ∪ (S ∩ s.D) ⊆ S :=
    union_subset hY inter_subset_left
  have hcard : H.Y.card + (S ∩ s.D).card ≤ S.card := by
    have hcu : (H.Y ∪ (S ∩ s.D)).card = H.Y.card + (S ∩ s.D).card :=
      card_union_of_disjoint hdisjYD
    have hle := card_le_card hsub
    omega
  have hYpos : 1 ≤ H.Y.card := card_pos.2 H.hYne
  have : componentCount G (s.D \ S) + 1 ≤ S.card := by omega
  have hz' :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S + 1 ≤ S.card := by
    simpa [hz] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.remainder_eq_X_union_Y_sdiff
statement:
lemma remainder_eq_X_union_Y_sdiff (S : Finset V) :
    H.K \ S = (H.X \ S) ∪ (H.Y \ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hunion : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.K := H.union_X_Y
  rw [← hunion, union_sdiff_distrib]

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.complete_remaining
statement:
lemma complete_remaining (S : Finset V) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween ((H.X \ S : Finset V) : Set V)
      ((H.Y \ S : Finset V) : Set V)
proof:
:=
  IsCompleteBetween.mono_sdiff (S := S) H.complete_X_Y

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.connected_remaining_join
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.remainder_eq_X_union_Y_sdiff S]
  exact Cograph.induce_connected_of_completeJoin (G := G) hX hY
    (H.complete_remaining S)

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.X_sdiff_eq_D_union_I
statement:
lemma X_sdiff_eq_D_union_I (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) (S : Finset V) :
    H.X \ S = (s.D \ S) ∪ (s.I \ S)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun t => t \ S) s.hDU.symm).trans
    (union_sdiff_distrib s.D s.I S)

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.I_sdiff_subset_K_sdiff
statement:
lemma I_sdiff_subset_K_sdiff (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    {i : V} (hi : i ∈ s.I \ S) : i ∈ H.K \ S
proof:
:=
  mem_sdiff.2 ⟨H.I_subset_K s (mem_sdiff.1 hi).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hi).2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.I_sdiff_subset_X_sdiff
statement:
lemma I_sdiff_subset_X_sdiff (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    {i : V} (hi : i ∈ s.I \ S) : i ∈ H.X \ S
proof:
:=
  mem_sdiff.2 ⟨H.I_subset_X s (mem_sdiff.1 hi).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hi).2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.D_sdiff_subset_X_sdiff
statement:
lemma D_sdiff_subset_X_sdiff (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    {d : V} (hd : d ∈ s.D \ S) : d ∈ H.X \ S
proof:
:=
  mem_sdiff.2 ⟨H.D_subset_X s (mem_sdiff.1 hd).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hd).2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_Y_I_survive
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_Y_I_survive
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    (hY : (H.Y \ S).Nonempty) (hI : (s.I \ S).Nonempty) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hI
  have hXne : (H.X \ S).Nonempty := ⟨i, H.I_sdiff_subset_X_sdiff s hi⟩
  have hconn := H.connected_remaining_join hXne hY
  exact terminalComponentCount_eq_zero_of_connected_meets (G := G)
    (H.I_sdiff_subset_K_sdiff s hi) hi hconn

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_Y_survive_I_deleted_D_survive
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_Y_survive_I_deleted_D_survive
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    (hY : (H.Y \ S).Nonempty) (hI : s.I ⊆ S) (hD : (s.D \ S).Nonempty) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hD
  have hXne : (H.X \ S).Nonempty := ⟨d, H.D_sdiff_subset_X_sdiff s hd⟩
  have hconn := H.connected_remaining_join hXne hY
  have hUne : (H.K \ S).Nonempty := ⟨d, mem_sdiff.2
    ⟨H.D_subset_K s (mem_sdiff.1 hd).1, (mem_sdiff.1 hd).2⟩⟩
  have hc1 :=
    Cograph.componentCount_eq_one_of_connected (G := G) hUne hconn
  have hIsub : s.I ⊆ S := hI
  have hz :=
    terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) (K := H.K) (B := s.I)
      (S := S) hIsub
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_X_deleted
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_X_deleted
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    (_hS : S ⊆ H.K) (hX : H.X ⊆ S) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S =
      componentCount G (H.Y \ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hKeq : H.K \ S = H.Y \ S := by
    have hunion : H.X ∪ H.Y = H.K := H.union_X_Y
    rw [← hunion]
    exact sdiff_union_eq_sdiff_of_subset_left hX
  have hIsub : s.I ⊆ S := (H.I_subset_X s).trans hX
  have hz :=
    terminalComponentCount_eq_of_B_subset (G := G) (K := H.K) (B := s.I)
      (S := S) hIsub
  simpa [hKeq] using hz

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalComponentCount_I_X_deleted_le
statement:
lemma terminalComponentCount_I_X_deleted_le
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B) {S : Finset V}
    (hS : S ⊆ H.K) (hX : H.X ⊆ S) :
    terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S ≤ S.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S =
        componentCount G (H.Y \ S) :=
    H.terminalComponentCount_I_X_deleted s hS hX
  have hSY : S ∩ H.Y ⊆ H.Y := inter_subset_right
  have hYs : H.Y \ S = H.Y \ (S ∩ H.Y) := sdiff_eq_sdiff_inter
  have hcle :
      componentCount G (H.Y \ S) ≤
        pathCoverNumber G H.Y + (S ∩ H.Y).card := by
    rw [hYs]
    exact componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G) H.Y (S ∩ H.Y) hSY
  have hpY := H.pathCoverNumber_Y_lt_X
  have hdisjXY : Disjoint H.X (S ∩ H.Y) :=
    disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_right H.disjoint_X_Y
  have hsub : H.X ∪ (S ∩ H.Y) ⊆ S :=
    union_subset hX inter_subset_left
  have hcard : H.X.card + (S ∩ H.Y).card ≤ S.card := by
    have hcu : (H.X ∪ (S ∩ H.Y)).card = H.X.card + (S ∩ H.Y).card :=
      card_union_of_disjoint hdisjXY
    have hle := card_le_card hsub
    omega
  have hXpos : 1 ≤ H.X.card := card_pos.2 H.X_nonempty
  have : componentCount G (H.Y \ S) + 1 ≤ S.card := by omega
  have hz' :
      terminalComponentCount (G := G) H.K s.I S + 1 ≤ S.card := by
    simpa [hz] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.terminalHypothesis_I_of_small_pD
statement:
lemma terminalHypothesis_I_of_small_pD
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    TerminalHypothesis (G := G) H.K s.I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨H.terminalComponentCount_I_empty s hpK hpD, ?_⟩
  intro S hS hSne
  by_cases hYdel : H.Y ⊆ S
  · exact H.terminalComponentCount_I_Y_deleted_le s hS hYdel hpD
  · have hYsurv : (H.Y \ S).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyS⟩ := not_subset.1 hYdel
      exact ⟨y, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hy, hyS⟩⟩
    by_cases hIsurv : (s.I \ S).Nonempty
    · have hz := H.terminalComponentCount_I_Y_I_survive s hYsurv hIsurv
      have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := card_pos.2 hSne
      omega
    · have hIdel : s.I ⊆ S := by
        intro i hi
        by_contra hiS
        exact hIsurv ⟨i, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hi, hiS⟩⟩
      by_cases hDsurv : (s.D \ S).Nonempty
      · have hz :=
          H.terminalComponentCount_I_Y_survive_I_deleted_D_survive s
            hYsurv hIdel hDsurv
        have hIcard : 3 ≤ s.I.card := H.I_card_ge_three s hpK hpD
        have hScard : 3 ≤ S.card :=
          hIcard.trans (card_le_card hIdel)
        omega
      · have hDdel : s.D ⊆ S := by
          intro d hd
          by_contra hdS
          exact hDsurv ⟨d, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hd, hdS⟩⟩
        have hXdel : H.X ⊆ S := by
          have hX : s.D ∪ s.I = H.X := s.hDU
          rw [← hX]
          exact union_subset hDdel hIdel
        exact H.terminalComponentCount_I_X_deleted_le s hS hXdel

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.toNoBVJoinBase_I_K
statement:
lemma toNoBVJoinBase_I_K
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    (H.toNoBVJoinBase_I s hpK hpD).K = H.K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [NoBVJoinBase.K, CanonicalJoinSplit.toNoBVJoinBase_I]
  exact H.union_I_D_Y s

name: Nikoghosyan.CanonicalJoinSplit.exists_min_terminalCover_of_small_pD
statement:
theorem exists_min_terminalCover_of_small_pD
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G H.K ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:= by
  let H0 := H.toNoBVJoinBase_I s hpK hpD
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hterm⟩ := H0.exists_min_terminalCover_noBV
  have hKeq : H0.K = H.K := H.toNoBVJoinBase_I_K s hpK hpD
  refine ⟨pc.cast hKeq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard]
    exact congrArg (pathCoverNumber G) hKeq
  · intro p hp
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc hKeq] at hp
    have ht := hterm p hp
    exact ⟨s.hI ht.1, s.hI ht.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_terminalCover_of_canonical_small_pD
statement:
theorem exists_min_terminalCover_of_canonical_small_pD
    (H : CanonicalJoinSplit (G := G))
    (s : MixedSplit (G := G) H.X H.B)
    (hpK : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G H.K)
    (hpD : pathCoverNumber G s.D + 1 ≤ H.Y.card) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G H.K,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G H.K ∧
        IsTerminalCover (G := G) H.B pc
proof:
:=
  H.exists_min_terminalCover_of_small_pD s hpK hpD

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.remainderVerts_eq
statement:
lemma remainderVerts_eq (S T : Finset V) :
    remainderVerts G S T = (Finset.univ : Finset V) \ (S ∪ T)
proof: := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.degDelete_eq
statement:
lemma degDelete_eq (S : Finset V) (t : V) :
    degDelete G S t = (G.neighborFinset t \ S).card
proof: := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_empty_right
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_empty_right (A : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedEdgeCount]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_empty_left
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_empty_left (B : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G ∅ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedEdgeCount]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.componentAttach_empty_T
statement:
lemma componentAttach_empty_T (S : Finset V)
    (c : (G.induce ((S ∪ (∅ : Finset V) : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentAttach G S ∅ c = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [componentAttach, orderedEdgeCount]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.hCount_empty_T
statement: lemma hCount_empty_T (S : Finset V) : hCount G S ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hCount, componentAttach, orderedEdgeCount]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.delta_empty_T
statement:
lemma delta_empty_T (S : Finset V) :
    delta G S ∅ = 2 * (S.card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [delta, hCount_empty_T, degDelete]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.neighborFinset_inter
statement:
lemma neighborFinset_inter (A : Finset V) (a : V) :
    G.neighborFinset a ∩ A = A.filter (G.Adj a)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp [mem_neighborFinset, and_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.TwoFactor.orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_sum
statement:
lemma orderedEdgeCount_self_eq_sum (A : Finset V) :
    orderedEdgeCount G A A = ∑ a ∈ A, (G.neighborFinset a ∩ A).card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedEdgeCount, neighborFinset_inter]
  rw [Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ha => ?_
  exact (Finset.card_filter (G.Adj a) A).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_mem_takeUntil
statement:
lemma start_mem_takeUntil (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    p.start ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support
proof:
:=
  start_mem_support (p.takeUntil hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_not_mem_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  intro hst
  have hinter := inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset p hx
  have : p.start ∈ ({x} : Finset V) :=
    hinter (mem_inter.2 ⟨start_mem_takeUntil p hx, hst⟩)
  exact hne (mem_singleton.1 this).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.dropUntil_support_card_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : (p.dropUntil hx).support ⊆ p.support :=
    dropUntil_support_subset p hx
  have hne' : (p.dropUntil hx).support ≠ p.support := by
    intro heq
    exact start_not_mem_dropUntil p hx hne (heq ▸ p.start_mem_support)
  exact card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, hne'⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_find?_B
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : b ∈ p.walk.support := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h
  have hb : b ∈ B := of_decide_eq_true (List.find?_some (p := inB B) h)
  exact ⟨(mem_walk_support (p := p)).2 hmem, hb⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.find?_B_ne_start
statement:
lemma find?_B_ne_start {B : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G} {b : V}
    (hs : p.start ∉ B)
    (h : p.walk.support.find? (inB B) = some b) :
    b ≠ p.start
proof:
:=
  fun hbs => hs (hbs ▸ (mem_find?_B (B := B) h).2)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.find?_B_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hxW : x ∈ p.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 hx
  have hne : p.walk.support.find? (inB B) ≠ none := by
    intro hnone
    have hnot : ¬ inB B x := (List.find?_eq_none (p := inB B)).1 hnone x hxW
    exact hnot (decide_eq_true hxB)
  exact Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.firstB_spec
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
  simp [hsB, hnil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
  simp [hsB, hnil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none {B : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∉ B)
    (h : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) = none) :
    leftoverPieces B p = [p]
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
  simp [hs, h]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_support_subset
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_support_subset {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) :
    ∀ q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        ∀ q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, q.support ⊆ p.support)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl
  intro n ih p hn q hq
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hsB hnil] at hq
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil] at hq
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      have hsub := ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl q hq
      exact hsub.trans (by
        rw [support_trimStart]
        exact erase_subset _ _)
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      rw [leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind] at hq
      simp at hq
      subst hq
      exact subset_rfl
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def] at hq
      simp [hsB, hnone] at hq
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      rcases hq with hq | hq
      · subst hq
        have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
          hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
        rw [support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hnn]
        exact (erase_subset _ _).trans (takeUntil_support_subset p hx)
      · have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
          simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hne
        have hsub := ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl q hq
        exact hsub.trans (dropUntil_support_subset p hx)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B
statement:
lemma takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B {B : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G} {b y : V}
    (h : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) = some b)
    (hx : b ∈ p.support) (hy : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support) (hne : y ≠ b) :
    y ∉ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbB, as, bs, happ, hpre⟩ :=
    (List.find?_eq_some_iff_append (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 h
  have hx' := (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Walk.support_takeUntil_prefix_support p.walk hx'
  have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := by
    intro hn
    have hsing := support_eq_singleton_of_nil (p.takeUntil hx) hn
    have hyb : y = b := by
      have hsf : (p.takeUntil hx).start = b :=
        (nil_iff_start_eq_finish (p.takeUntil hx)).1 hn
      simpa [hsing, hsf] using hy
    exact hne hyb
  have hcat :=
    Walk.support_dropLast_concat (p := p.walk.takeUntil b hx')
      (by simpa [takeUntil] using hnn)
  have hyL : y ∈ (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').support := by
    simpa [takeUntil, support, List.mem_toFinset] using hy
  have hyDL : y ∈ (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support := by
    have : y ∈ (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support ++ [b] := by
      simpa [hcat] using hyL
    exact (List.mem_append.1 this).resolve_right (by simp [hne])
  have hb_as : b ∉ as := by
    intro hba
    have hfalse : decide (b ∈ B) = false := by simpa using hpre b hba
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (hfalse.symm.trans hbB)
  have hdrop_not : b ∉ (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support := by
    intro hbdl
    have hnodT : (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').support.Nodup :=
      (p.takeUntil hx).support_nodup
    rw [← hcat] at hnodT
    have hcnt : ((p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support ++ [b]).count b = 1 :=
      List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnodT (by simp)
    have : 2 ≤ ((p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support ++ [b]).count b := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support.count b :=
        List.count_pos_iff.mpr hbdl
      simp [List.count_append, h1]
    omega
  have hsplit2 : p.walk.support =
      (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support ++ b :: t := by
    calc p.walk.support
        = (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').support ++ t := ht.symm
      _ = ((p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support ++ [b]) ++ t := by rw [hcat]
      _ = (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support ++ b :: t := by simp
  have hidx1 : p.walk.support.idxOf b = as.length := by
    rw [happ, List.idxOf_append]
    simp [hb_as, List.idxOf_cons_self]
  have hidx2 : p.walk.support.idxOf b =
      (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support.length := by
    rw [hsplit2, List.idxOf_append]
    simp [hdrop_not, List.idxOf_cons_self]
  have hlen : as.length = (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support.length := by
    omega
  have has_eq : as = (p.walk.takeUntil b hx').dropLast.support :=
    List.append_inj_left (t₁ := b :: bs) (t₂ := b :: t)
      (by rw [← happ, hsplit2]) hlen
  have hy_as : y ∈ as := by simpa [has_eq] using hyDL
  intro hyB
  have hfalse : decide (y ∈ B) = false := by simpa using hpre y hy_as
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (hfalse.symm.trans (decide_eq_true hyB))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_disjoint_B
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_disjoint_B {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) :
    ∀ q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, Disjoint q.support B
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        ∀ q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, Disjoint q.support B)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl
  intro n ih p hn q hq
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hsB hnil] at hq
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil] at hq
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      exact ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl q hq
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      have hlist : leftoverPieces B p = [p] :=
        leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind
      have hq' : q = p := List.mem_singleton.1 (hlist ▸ hq)
      cases hq'
      refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro y hy hyB
      have hyW : y ∈ p.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 hy
      have hnot : ¬ decide (y ∈ B) :=
        (List.find?_eq_none (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 hfind y hyW
      exact hnot (decide_eq_true hyB)
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def] at hq
      simp [hsB, hnone] at hq
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      rcases hq with hq | hq
      · subst hq
        have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
          hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
        rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hnn]
        rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro y hy
        have hyE := mem_inter.1 hy
        have hyT : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support := (mem_erase.1 hyE.1).2
        have hyne : y ≠ firstB B p hnone := (mem_erase.1 hyE.1).1
        exact takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B (B := B) hfind' hx hyT hyne hyE.2
      · have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
          simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hne
        exact ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl q hq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_exists_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n → y ∈ p.support → y ∉ B →
        ∃ q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, y ∈ q.support)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl hy hyB
  intro n ih p hn hy hyB
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · have : p.support = {p.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
      have : y = p.start := by simpa [this] using hy
      exact (hyB (this ▸ hsB)).elim
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil]
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      have hy' : y ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
        rw [support_trimStart, mem_erase]
        exact ⟨fun hys => hyB (hys ▸ hsB), hy⟩
      exact ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl hy' hyB
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      rw [leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind]
      exact ⟨p, by simp, hy⟩
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hneS : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      have hneY : y ≠ firstB B p hnone := fun h => hyB (h ▸ (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2)
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
      simp [hsB, hnone]
      have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
        hneS ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
      have hyU : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support := by
        simpa [support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil] using hy
      rcases mem_union.1 hyU with hyT | hyD
      · refine Or.inl ?_
        rw [support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hnn, mem_erase]
        exact ⟨hneY, hyT⟩
      · have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
          simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hneS
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩ := ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl hyD hyB
        exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_mem_iff
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_mem_iff {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) (y : V) :
    (∃ q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, y ∈ q.support) ↔ y ∈ p.support ∧ y ∉ B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨q, hq, hy⟩
    exact ⟨leftoverPieces_support_subset p q hq hy,
      disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p q hq) hy⟩
  · intro ⟨hy, hyB⟩
    exact leftoverPieces_exists_of_mem p hy hyB

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_pairwise
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_pairwise {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) :
    (leftoverPieces B p).Pairwise fun q r => Disjoint q.support r.support
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        (leftoverPieces B p).Pairwise fun q r => Disjoint q.support r.support)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl
  intro n ih p hn
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hsB hnil]
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil]
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      exact ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      simp [leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind]
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
      simp [hsB, hnone]
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
        hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
      have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hne
      refine ⟨?_, ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl⟩
      intro r hr
      have hrsub : r.support ⊆ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
        leftoverPieces_support_subset (p.dropUntil hx) r hr
      rw [support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hnn]
      refine disjoint_of_subset_right hrsub ?_
      rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      intro y hy
      have hyE := mem_inter.1 hy
      have hyne : y ≠ firstB B p hnone := (mem_erase.1 hyE.1).1
      have hyT : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support := (mem_erase.1 hyE.1).2
      have hinter := inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset p hx
      have : y ∈ ({firstB B p hnone} : Finset V) :=
        hinter (mem_inter.2 ⟨hyT, hyE.2⟩)
      exact hyne (mem_singleton.1 this)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_of_terminal
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_length_of_terminal {B : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hs : p.start ∈ B) (hf : p.finish ∈ B) :
    (leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card - 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n → p.start ∈ B → p.finish ∈ B →
        (leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card - 1)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl hs hf
  intro n ih p hn hs hf
  by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
  · have hsing : p.support = {p.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
    have hfin : p.finish = p.start := ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 hnil).symm
    simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hs hnil, hsing, hs]
  · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hs hnil]
    have hstart' : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∉ B :=
      trimStart_start_not_mem hInd p hnil hs
    have hfin' : (p.trimStart hnil).finish ∈ B := by
      simpa [trimStart_finish] using hf
    have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
      simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
    have hfind_some : ∃ b, (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support.find?
        (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) = some b :=
      find?_B_of_mem (p := p.trimStart hnil) (p.trimStart hnil).finish_mem_support hfin'
    obtain ⟨b, hfind⟩ := hfind_some
    have hnone : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support.find?
        (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by simp [hfind]
    rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
    simp [hstart', hnone]
    have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p.trimStart hnil) hnone
    have hx : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).support :=
      (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
    have hne : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ≠ (p.trimStart hnil).start :=
      find?_B_ne_start hstart' hfind'
    have hterm : IsTerminalPath (G := G) B ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx) :=
      ⟨by
          simpa [dropUntil] using (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2,
        by simpa [dropUntil] using hfin'⟩
    have hltD : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support.card < n :=
      Nat.lt_trans (dropUntil_support_card_lt (p.trimStart hnil) hx hne) hlt
    have ihD := ih _ hltD ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx) rfl hterm.1 hterm.2
    have hcard_trim : (p.support ∩ B).card =
        ((p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B).card + 1 := by
      have hps : p.support = insert p.start (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
        rw [support_trimStart, insert_erase p.start_mem_support]
      have hstart_not : p.start ∉ (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
        rw [support_trimStart]; exact notMem_erase _ _
      rw [hps, insert_inter_of_mem hs, card_insert_of_notMem]
      exact fun hz => hstart_not (mem_inter.1 hz).1
    have hinter :
        ((p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B).card =
          (((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support ∩ B).card := by
      have hunion := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil (p.trimStart hnil) hx
      have hinters := inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset (p.trimStart hnil) hx
      have hb : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ∈
          ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support := by
        simpa [dropUntil] using
          ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).start_mem_support
      have hT : ((p.trimStart hnil).takeUntil hx).support ∩ B ⊆
          {firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone} := by
        intro z hz
        have hzT := (mem_inter.1 hz).1
        have hzB := (mem_inter.1 hz).2
        by_cases hzb : z = firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone
        · simp [hzb]
        · exact (takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B (B := B) hfind' hx hzT hzb hzB).elim
      have : (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B =
          ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support ∩ B := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          have hzU : z ∈ ((p.trimStart hnil).takeUntil hx).support ∪
              ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support := by
            simpa [hunion] using (mem_inter.1 hz).1
          rcases mem_union.1 hzU with hzT | hzD
          · have : z = firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone :=
              mem_singleton.1 (hT (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzT, (mem_inter.1 hz).2⟩))
            simpa [this] using mem_inter.2 ⟨hb, (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2⟩
          · exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hzD, (mem_inter.1 hz).2⟩
        · intro hz
          exact mem_inter.2
            ⟨(dropUntil_support_subset (p.trimStart hnil) hx) (mem_inter.1 hz).1,
              (mem_inter.1 hz).2⟩
      rw [this]
    simp [ihD, hcard_trim, hinter]
    have hpos : 1 ≤ (((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support ∩ B).card :=
      card_pos.mpr ⟨_, mem_inter.2 ⟨((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).start_mem_support,
        (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2⟩⟩
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.sum_map_eq_sum_toFinset
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have hn' := List.nodup_cons.1 hn
    have ha : a ∉ l.toFinset := by simpa using hn'.1
    simp [sum_insert ha, ih hn'.2]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.pairwise_flatMap_leftoverPieces
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rw [List.flatMap_cons]
    refine List.pairwise_append.mpr
      ⟨GraphPath.leftoverPieces_pairwise (B := B) p, ih h'.2, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hbq⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hb
    have da := GraphPath.leftoverPieces_support_subset (B := B) p a ha
    have db := GraphPath.leftoverPieces_support_subset (B := B) q b hbq
    exact (h'.1 q hq).mono da db

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.leftoverCover_card
statement:
lemma leftoverCover_card {K B : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G K)
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    (pc.leftoverCover (B := B)).card + pc.card = B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hlenp : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths,
      (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card - 1 := by
    intro p hp
    exact GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_of_terminal hInd (hterm p hp).1 (hterm p hp).2
  have hflat : (pc.leftoverCover (B := B)).card =
      (pc.paths.map fun p => (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length).sum := by
    simp [leftoverCover, PathCover.card, List.length_flatMap]
  have hmap :
      ∀ {l : List (GraphPath G)},
        (∀ p ∈ l, (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card - 1) →
          (l.map fun p => (GraphPath.leftoverPieces B p).length).sum =
            (l.map fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card - 1).sum := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro; simp
    | cons p ps ih =>
      intro h
      simp [h p List.mem_cons_self,
        ih (fun q hq => h q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))]
  have hsum :=
    sum_map_eq_sum_toFinset pc.nodup_paths fun p => (p.support ∩ B).card - 1
  have hex := pc.terminal_excess_add hBK hterm
  simp [hflat, hmap hlenp, hsum, hex]

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_add_le_card_B
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_add_le_card_B {K B : Finset V}
    (hBK : B ⊆ K) (hInd : Independent (G := G) B)
    {pc : PathCover G K} (hterm : IsTerminalCover (G := G) B pc) :
    pc.card + pathCoverNumber G (K \ B) ≤ B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (PathCover.leftoverCover (B := B) pc)
  have hcard := PathCover.leftoverCover_card pc hBK hInd hterm
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftoverCountIn_eq_card
statement:
lemma leftoverCountIn_eq_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    leftoverCountIn pc U = pc.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftoverCountIn
  have : pc.paths.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U) = pc.paths :=
    List.filter_eq_self.2 fun Q hQ =>
      decide_eq_true (pc.support_subset hQ Q.start_mem_support)
  simpa [PathCover.card] using congrArg List.length this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.noCross_of_union_child
statement:
lemma noCross_of_union_child {U0 A B : Finset V}
    (hU0A : U0 ⊆ A)
    (hnocrossAB : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hnocrossU0 : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ A \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (A ∪ B) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb
  have hb' : b ∈ A ∪ B ∧ b ∉ U0 := mem_sdiff.1 hb
  rcases mem_union.1 hb'.1 with hA | hB
  · exact hnocrossU0 a ha b (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hA, hb'.2⟩)
  · exact hnocrossAB a (hU0A ha) b hB

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.actualFilteredCover_paths
statement:
lemma actualFilteredCover_paths {W U0 : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ W)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (pc : PathCover G W) :
    (actualFilteredCover hU0 hnocross pc).paths =
      pc.paths.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [actualFilteredCover, PathCover.splitLeft, PathCover.cast_paths]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.actualFilteredCover_card
statement:
lemma actualFilteredCover_card {W U0 : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ W)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (pc : PathCover G W) :
    (actualFilteredCover hU0 hnocross pc).card = leftoverCountIn pc U0
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftoverCountIn, PathCover.card, actualFilteredCover_paths hU0 hnocross pc]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_le_of_pathCover
statement:
lemma card_le_of_pathCover {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) :
    pc.card ≤ U.card
proof:
:= by
  let starts := pc.paths.map (fun p => p.start)
  have hsub : starts.toFinset ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 (List.mem_toFinset.1 hx)
    exact pc.support_subset hp p.start_mem_support
  have hnodup : starts.Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on (PathCover.nodup_paths pc)]
    intro p hp q hq heq
    by_contra hne
    exact (disjoint_left.1
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem_refinement pc.disjoint hp hq hne)
      p.start_mem_support (heq ▸ q.start_mem_support)).elim
  have hlen : starts.toFinset.card = starts.length :=
    List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hle : starts.toFinset.card ≤ U.card := card_le_card hsub
  simpa [PathCover.card, starts, List.length_map, hlen] using hle

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.two_le_card_of_filtered
statement:
lemma two_le_card_of_filtered {W U0 : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ W)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (pc : PathCover G W)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ leftoverCountIn pc U0) :
    2 ≤ U0.card
proof:
:=
  h2.trans <| by
    simpa [actualFilteredCover_card hU0 hnocross pc] using
      card_le_of_pathCover (actualFilteredCover hU0 hnocross pc)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_saving_of_cover
statement:
lemma exists_saving_of_cover {W : Finset V} (hne : W.Nonempty)
    (pc : PathCover G W) (hp : pathCoverNumber G W < pc.card) :
    ∃ U0 : Finset V,
      U0 ⊆ W ∧ U0.Nonempty ∧
        (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected ∧
          (∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
            2 ≤ leftoverCountIn pc U0 ∧
              pathCoverNumber G U0 < leftoverCountIn pc U0 ∧
                ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (W : Finset V), W.card = n → W.Nonempty →
        ∀ pc : PathCover G W, pathCoverNumber G W < pc.card →
          ∃ U0 : Finset V,
            U0 ⊆ W ∧ U0.Nonempty ∧
              (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected ∧
                (∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ W \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
                  2 ≤ leftoverCountIn pc U0 ∧
                    pathCoverNumber G U0 < leftoverCountIn pc U0 ∧
                      ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    W.card ?_ W rfl hne pc hp
  intro n ih W hn hWne pc hp
  by_cases hconn : (G.induce (W : Set V)).Connected
  · refine ⟨W, subset_rfl, hWne, hconn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a ha b hb
      rw [sdiff_self] at hb
      exact (notMem_empty b hb).elim
    · have hpos : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G W :=
        one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hWne
      have : 2 ≤ pc.card := by omega
      simpa [leftoverCountIn_eq_card] using this
    · simpa [leftoverCountIn_eq_card] using hp
    · intro Q hQ _
      exact pc.support_subset hQ
  · obtain ⟨A, B, hAsub, hBsub, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hcover, hnocross,
        hAcard, hBcard⟩ :=
      exists_disjoint_union_on (G := G) (U := W) hconn hWne
    have hEq : A ∪ B = W := hcover
    let pcW : PathCover G (A ∪ B) := pc.cast hEq.symm
    let pcA := PathCover.splitLeft (G := G) hdisj hnocross pcW
    let pcB := PathCover.splitRight (G := G) hdisj hnocross pcW
    have hadd := PathCover.card_split_add (G := G) hdisj hnocross pcW
    have hsum := pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
    have hpcW : pcW.card = pc.card := PathCover.cast_card pc hEq.symm
    have hpW : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) < pcW.card := by
      simpa [hEq, hpcW] using hp
    have hltA : A.card < n := by simpa [hn] using hAcard
    have hltB : B.card < n := by simpa [hn] using hBcard
    have : pathCoverNumber G A < pcA.card ∨
        pathCoverNumber G B < pcB.card := by
      have hleA := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcA
      have hleB := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcB
      have hsum' : pathCoverNumber G A + pathCoverNumber G B =
          pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := hsum.symm
      have hadd' : pcA.card + pcB.card = pcW.card := by
        change (PathCover.splitLeft (G := G) hdisj hnocross pcW).card +
            (PathCover.splitRight (G := G) hdisj hnocross pcW).card = pcW.card
        exact hadd
      omega
    have hpathsA : pcA.paths = pc.paths.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ A) := by
      simp [pcA, pcW, PathCover.splitLeft, PathCover.cast_paths]
    have hpathsB : pcB.paths = pc.paths.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ B) := by
      simp [pcB, pcW, PathCover.splitRight, PathCover.cast_paths]
    have hcountA (U0 : Finset V) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ A) :
        leftoverCountIn pc U0 = leftoverCountIn pcA U0 := by
      unfold leftoverCountIn
      rw [hpathsA, List.filter_filter]
      refine congrArg List.length (List.filter_congr ?_)
      intro Q _
      by_cases hQ : Q.start ∈ U0
      · simp [hQ, hU0 hQ]
      · simp [hQ]
    have hcountB (U0 : Finset V) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ B) :
        leftoverCountIn pc U0 = leftoverCountIn pcB U0 := by
      unfold leftoverCountIn
      rw [hpathsB, List.filter_filter]
      refine congrArg List.length (List.filter_congr ?_)
      intro Q _
      by_cases hQ : Q.start ∈ U0
      · simp [hQ, hU0 hQ]
      · simp [hQ]
    rcases this with hAstrict | hBstrict
    · obtain ⟨U0, hU0A, hU0ne, hU0conn, hU0nc, hq0, hpU0, hstay⟩ :=
        ih A.card hltA A rfl hAne pcA hAstrict
      refine ⟨U0, hU0A.trans hAsub, hU0ne, hU0conn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a ha b hb
        have hb' : b ∈ (A ∪ B) \ U0 := by simpa [hEq] using hb
        exact noCross_of_union_child hU0A hnocross hU0nc a ha b hb'
      · simpa [hcountA U0 hU0A] using hq0
      · simpa [hcountA U0 hU0A] using hpU0
      · intro Q hQ hsU0
        have hsA : Q.start ∈ A := hU0A hsU0
        have hQA : Q ∈ pcA.paths := by
          simpa [hpathsA, List.mem_filter, hsA] using hQ
        exact hstay Q hQA hsU0
    · obtain ⟨U0, hU0B, hU0ne, hU0conn, hU0nc, hq0, hpU0, hstay⟩ :=
        ih B.card hltB B rfl hBne pcB hBstrict
      have hnocrossBA : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj b a :=
        fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm
      refine ⟨U0, hU0B.trans hBsub, hU0ne, hU0conn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a ha b hb
        have hb' : b ∈ (B ∪ A) \ U0 := by
          simpa [hEq, union_comm] using hb
        exact noCross_of_union_child hU0B hnocrossBA hU0nc a ha b hb'
      · simpa [hcountB U0 hU0B] using hq0
      · simpa [hcountB U0 hU0B] using hpU0
      · intro Q hQ hsU0
        have hsB : Q.start ∈ B := hU0B hsU0
        have hQB : Q ∈ pcB.paths := by
          simpa [hpathsB, List.mem_filter, hsB] using hQ
        exact hstay Q hQB hsU0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_saving_component
statement:
lemma exists_saving_component {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) < A.card)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hf : p.finish ∉ A) (hno : NoConsecutive A p) :
    ∃ (U0 : Finset V) (pcU0 : PathCover G U0),
      U0 ⊆ U \ A ∧ U0.Nonempty ∧
        (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected ∧
          IsCograph G U0 ∧
            (∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
              pcU0.paths =
                List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p) ∧
                2 ≤ pcU0.card ∧
                  pathCoverNumber G U0 < pcU0.card ∧
                    2 ≤ U0.card ∧
                      ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hcard, hpaths, _hsub⟩ :=
    exists_cycle_leftover_card_eq (c := c) hc hA hAne hp hs hf hno
  have hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨p.finish, ?_⟩
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨by simpa [hp] using p.finish_mem_support, hf⟩
  have hp' : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) < pc.card := by
    simpa [hcard] using hstrict
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0, hU0ne, hconn, hnocross, hq0, hpU0, hstay⟩ :=
    exists_saving_of_cover hKne pc hp'
  let pcU0 := actualFilteredCover hU0 hnocross pc
  have hpcU0paths : pcU0.paths =
      pc.paths.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) :=
    actualFilteredCover_paths hU0 hnocross pc
  have hpcU0card : pcU0.card = leftoverCountIn pc U0 :=
    actualFilteredCover_card hU0 hnocross pc
  refine ⟨U0, pcU0, hU0, hU0ne, hconn, hK.subset hU0, hnocross, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpcU0paths, hpaths]
  · simpa [hpcU0card] using hq0
  · simpa [hpcU0card] using hpU0
  · exact two_le_card_of_filtered hU0 hnocross pc hq0
  · intro Q hQ hsU0
    have hQpc : Q ∈ pc.paths := by simpa [hpaths] using hQ
    exact hstay Q hQpc hsU0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complete_join_of_saving
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_of_saving {U0 : Finset V}
    (hU0 : IsCograph G U0)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U0 : Set V)).Connected)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ U0.card) :
    ∃ X Y : Finset V, X ⊆ U0 ∧ Y ⊆ U0 ∧ X.Nonempty ∧ Y.Nonempty ∧
      Disjoint X Y ∧ X ∪ Y = U0 ∧
        G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V) ∧
          X.card < U0.card ∧ Y.card < U0.card
proof:
:=
  exists_complete_join_on hU0 hconn h2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_A_of_saving_child
statement:
lemma disjoint_A_of_saving_child {U A U0 Y : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0) : Disjoint A Y
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxA hxY
  exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 (hY hxY))).2 hxA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_sdiff_eq_sdiff_union
statement:
lemma sdiff_sdiff_eq_sdiff_union (U A Y : Finset V) :
    (U \ A) \ Y = U \ (A ∪ Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  tauto

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_lt_of_delete_Y
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_lt_of_delete_Y {U A U0 Y : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hstrict : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) < A.card) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U \ (A ∪ Y)) < (A ∪ Y).card
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint A Y := disjoint_A_of_saving_child hU0 hY
  have hcard : (A ∪ Y).card = A.card + Y.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
  have hYsub : Y ⊆ U \ A := hY.trans hU0
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le (G := G) (U \ A) Y hYsub
  have hEq : (U \ A) \ Y = U \ (A ∪ Y) := sdiff_sdiff_eq_sdiff_union U A Y
  have : pathCoverNumber G (U \ (A ∪ Y)) ≤
      pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) + Y.card := by
    simpa [hEq] using hle
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCograph_sdiff_union_Y
proof:
:=
  hK.subset <| by
    rw [← sdiff_sdiff_eq_sdiff_union U A Y]
    exact sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.support_subset_of_sdiff
statement:
lemma support_subset_of_sdiff {U A : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G (U \ A))
    {Q : GraphPath G} (hQ : Q ∈ pc.paths) :
    Q.support ⊆ U
proof:
:=
  (pc.support_subset hQ).trans sdiff_subset

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_of_complement
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxQ hxR
  have hx' : x ∈ U \ Q.support := by simpa [hr] using hxR
  exact (mem_sdiff.1 hx').2 hxQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.union_of_complement
proof:
:= by
  rw [hr]
  exact union_sdiff_of_subset hQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ne_complement_start
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hbR : b ∈ r.support := by simpa [heq] using r.start_mem_support
  have hb' : b ∈ U \ Q.support := by simpa [hr] using hbR
  exact (mem_sdiff.1 hb').2 hbQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ne_complement_finish
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hbR : b ∈ r.support := by simpa [heq] using r.finish_mem_support
  have hb' : b ∈ U \ Q.support := by simpa [hr] using hbR
  exact (mem_sdiff.1 hb').2 hbQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.support_card_eq_one_of_not_two
statement:
lemma support_card_eq_one_of_not_two {Q : GraphPath G}
    (h2 : ¬ 2 ≤ Q.support.card) : Q.support.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 1 ≤ Q.support.card := by
    rw [GraphPath.card_support]
    exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.nil_of_support_card_eq_one
statement:
lemma nil_of_support_card_eq_one {Q : GraphPath G}
    (h1 : Q.support.card = 1) : Q.walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : Q.walk.length = 0 := by
    have := GraphPath.card_support Q
    omega
  exact Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.1 hlen

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanning_of_singleton_leftover
statement:
lemma spanning_of_singleton_leftover {U A : Finset V} {Q r : GraphPath G} {b : V}
    (h1 : Q.support.card = 1) (hbQ : b ∈ Q.support)
    (hr : r.support = U \ Q.support) (hQU : Q.support ⊆ U)
    (hpred : G.Adj r.finish Q.start) (rstartA : r.start ∈ A) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b a
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : Q.walk.Nil := nil_of_support_card_eq_one h1
  have hsing : Q.support = {Q.start} :=
    GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil Q hnil
  have hbEq : b = Q.start := by
    have : b ∈ ({Q.start} : Finset V) := by simpa [hsing] using hbQ
    exact mem_singleton.1 this
  have hfin : Q.finish = Q.start :=
    ((GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish Q).1 hnil).symm
  have hd : Disjoint Q.support r.reverse.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using disjoint_of_complement hr
  have hadj : G.Adj Q.finish r.reverse.start := by
    have h2 : r.reverse.start = r.finish := rfl
    rw [hfin, h2]
    exact hpred.symm
  let s := Q.splice r.reverse hadj hd
  have hst : s.start = b := by
    change Q.start = b
    exact hbEq.symm
  have hfn : s.finish = r.start := rfl
  have hsup : s.support = U := by
    rw [show s.support = Q.support ∪ r.reverse.support from
        support_splice Q r.reverse hadj hd,
      GraphPath.support_reverse]
    exact union_of_complement hr hQU
  have hne : s.start ≠ s.finish := by
    rw [hst, hfn]
    exact ne_complement_start hr hbQ
  refine ⟨r.start, rstartA, ?_⟩
  have hR0 := spanningPathCompatible_of_path s hne
  rw [← hsup, ← hst, ← hfn]
  exact hR0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanning_of_pred_seam
statement:
lemma spanning_of_pred_seam {U A : Finset V} {Q r q : GraphPath G} {b : V}
    (hq : q.support = Q.support) (hstq : q.start = b)
    (hfinq : q.finish = Q.start)
    (hr : r.support = U \ Q.support) (hQU : Q.support ⊆ U)
    (hpred : G.Adj r.finish Q.start) (rstartA : r.start ∈ A) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b a
proof:
:= by
  have hbQ : b ∈ Q.support := by
    have : q.start ∈ q.support := q.start_mem_support
    simpa [hstq, hq] using this
  have hd : Disjoint q.support r.reverse.support := by
    simpa [hq, GraphPath.support_reverse] using disjoint_of_complement hr
  have hadj : G.Adj q.finish r.reverse.start := by
    have h2 : r.reverse.start = r.finish := rfl
    rw [hfinq, h2]
    exact hpred.symm
  let s := q.splice r.reverse hadj hd
  have hst : s.start = b := by
    change q.start = b
    exact hstq
  have hfn : s.finish = r.start := rfl
  have hsup : s.support = U := by
    rw [show s.support = q.support ∪ r.reverse.support from
        support_splice q r.reverse hadj hd,
      hq, GraphPath.support_reverse]
    exact union_of_complement hr hQU
  have hne : s.start ≠ s.finish := by
    rw [hst, hfn]
    exact ne_complement_start hr hbQ
  refine ⟨r.start, rstartA, ?_⟩
  have hR0 := spanningPathCompatible_of_path s hne
  rw [← hsup, ← hst, ← hfn]
  exact hR0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanning_of_succ_seam
statement:
lemma spanning_of_succ_seam {U A : Finset V} {Q r q : GraphPath G} {b : V}
    (hq : q.support = Q.support) (hstq : q.start = b)
    (hfinq : q.finish = Q.finish)
    (hr : r.support = U \ Q.support) (hQU : Q.support ⊆ U)
    (hsucc : G.Adj Q.finish r.start) (rfinishA : r.finish ∈ A) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b a
proof:
:= by
  have hbQ : b ∈ Q.support := by
    have : q.start ∈ q.support := q.start_mem_support
    simpa [hstq, hq] using this
  have hd : Disjoint q.support r.support := by
    simpa [hq] using disjoint_of_complement hr
  have hadj : G.Adj q.finish r.start := by
    simpa [hfinq] using hsucc
  let s := q.splice r hadj hd
  have hst : s.start = b := by
    change q.start = b
    exact hstq
  have hfn : s.finish = r.finish := rfl
  have hsup : s.support = U := by
    rw [show s.support = q.support ∪ r.support from
        support_splice q r hadj hd, hq]
    exact union_of_complement hr hQU
  have hne : s.start ≠ s.finish := by
    rw [hst, hfn]
    exact ne_complement_finish hr hbQ
  refine ⟨r.finish, rfinishA, ?_⟩
  have hR0 := spanningPathCompatible_of_path s hne
  rw [← hsup, ← hst, ← hfn]
  exact hR0

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_from_sdiff_container
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_from_sdiff_container {U A : Finset V} {b : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A)
    (hb : b ∈ U \ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, pc, hp, hsA, hclose, _hedges, hmin, hpaths, _hsub⟩ :=
    cycle_leftover_cover_min_of_saturated c hc hA hAne hSat
  have hbE := eligible_of_mem_sdiff_container (G := G) (U := U) (A := A) hb
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hbQ⟩ := exists_path_of_mem_cover pc hbE.1
  have hK' : IsCograph G (U \ A) := isCograph_iff.2 hK
  have hEloc : Eligible G Q.support b :=
    restriction_eligible_on_selected_path hK' pc hmin hQ hbE.2 hbQ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rstartA, rfinishA, hpred, hsucc⟩ :=
    exists_complement_arc_of_mem_leftover c hc hA hAne hp hsA hclose hpaths hQ
  have hQU : Q.support ⊆ U := support_subset_of_sdiff pc hQ
  by_cases h2 : 2 ≤ Q.support.card
  · have hQcog : IsCograph G Q.support :=
      hK'.subset (pc.support_subset hQ)
    rcases exists_compatible_old_end h2 hQcog hEloc hbQ with hRu | hRv
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, qst, qfin⟩ := exists_oriented_path_from hRu
      exact spanning_of_pred_seam (A := A) hq qst qfin hr hQU hpred rstartA
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, qst, qfin⟩ := exists_oriented_path_from hRv
      exact spanning_of_succ_seam (A := A) hq qst qfin hr hQU hsucc rfinishA
  · have h1 : Q.support.card = 1 := support_card_eq_one_of_not_two h2
    exact spanning_of_singleton_leftover (A := A) h1 hbQ hr hQU hpred rstartA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_container_subset_spanningPathNeighbors
statement:
lemma sdiff_container_subset_spanningPathNeighbors {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    U \ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A ⊆
      spanningPathNeighbors (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  have hbU : b ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
  obtain ⟨a, haA, hR⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_from_sdiff_container c hc hA hAne hK hSat hb
  exact mem_spanningPathNeighbors_iff.2
    ⟨hbU, a, haA, spanningPathCompatible_symm hR⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanningPathNeighbors_eq_sdiff_container
statement:
lemma spanningPathNeighbors_eq_sdiff_container {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    spanningPathNeighbors (G := G) U A =
      U \ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · exact spanningPathNeighbors_subset_sdiff_container hA
      (isCograph_iff.2 hK) hAne hSat
  · exact sdiff_container_subset_spanningPathNeighbors c hc hA hAne hK hSat

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.subset_canonicalContainer_of_no_spanning
statement:
lemma subset_canonicalContainer_of_no_spanning {U A B : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hB : B ⊆ U)
    (hSatA : Saturated (G := G) U A)
    (hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U a b) :
    B ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  intro b hbB
  have hbU : b ∈ U := hB hbB
  by_contra hbS
  have hbN : b ∈ U \ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A :=
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hbU, hbS⟩
  have hbN' : b ∈ spanningPathNeighbors (G := G) U A := by
    rw [spanningPathNeighbors_eq_sdiff_container c hc hA hAne hK hSatA]
    exact hbN
  obtain ⟨_, a, haA, hR⟩ := mem_spanningPathNeighbors_iff.1 hbN'
  exact hno a haA b hbB hR

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.incompatible_saturated_profiles
statement:
lemma incompatible_saturated_profiles {U A B : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hKA : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hB : B ⊆ U) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hKB : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ B))
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A ∨ Saturated (G := G) U B)
    (hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U a b) :
    B ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A ∧
      Saturated (G := G) U A ∧ Saturated (G := G) U B ∧
        canonicalContainer (G := G) U A =
          canonicalContainer (G := G) U B
proof:
:= by
  have hno' : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b a := by
    intro b hbB a haA hR
    exact hno a haA b hbB (spanningPathCompatible_symm hR)
  rcases hSat with hSatA | hSatB
  · have hBA : B ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A :=
      subset_canonicalContainer_of_no_spanning c hc hA hAne hKA hB hSatA hno
    have hTA :=
      (canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical hA hAne hKA hSatA).1
    have hSatB : Saturated (G := G) U B :=
      Saturated_of_tight_container c hc hB hBne hBA hTA
    have heq :=
      coincidence_canonical_containers_of_canonical hA hAne hKA hB hBne hKB
        hSatA hSatB hBA
    exact ⟨hBA, hSatA, hSatB, heq⟩
  · have hAB : A ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U B :=
      subset_canonicalContainer_of_no_spanning c hc hB hBne hKB hA hSatB hno'
    have hTB :=
      (canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical hB hBne hKB hSatB).1
    have hSatA : Saturated (G := G) U A :=
      Saturated_of_tight_container c hc hA hAne hAB hTB
    have heqBA :=
      coincidence_canonical_containers_of_canonical hB hBne hKB hA hAne hKA
        hSatB hSatA hAB
    have hBA : B ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A := by
      intro x hx
      have hxB : x ∈ canonicalContainer (G := G) U B :=
        mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A hx
      simpa [heqBA] using hxB
    exact ⟨hBA, hSatA, hSatB, heqBA.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint {A B : Finset V} (h : Disjoint A B) :
    (A ∪ B) \ B = A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hA | hB, hnB⟩
    · exact hA
    · exact (hnB hB).elim
  · intro hxA
    exact ⟨Or.inl hxA, fun hxB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 h hxA hxB⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hj := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hAne hBne hAB
  have hBnot : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := by
    by_contra h
    exact not_both_dominant hdom (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hq : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by omega
  have hmax :
      max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
        (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) =
      pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by
    simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hBnot, max_eq_right hq]
  exact hj.trans hmax

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    pathCoverNumber G A =
      pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) + B.card
proof:
:= by
  have h := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.not_eligible_mem_B_of_dominant
statement:
lemma not_eligible_mem_B_of_dominant {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hxB : x ∈ B) (hE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hsub : B ⊆ A ∪ B := subset_union_right
  have hle :=
    pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_of_eligible (G := G) (U := A ∪ B) (X := B)
      hsub hxB hE
  have hEq : (A ∪ B) \ B = A := union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint hdisj
  have hsat := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  have hpos : 1 ≤ B.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hBne)
  rw [hEq] at hle
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.eligible_mem_left_of_dominant
statement:
lemma eligible_mem_left_of_dominant {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x) : x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  have hxU : x ∈ A ∪ B := hE.mem
  rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxA | hxB
  · exact hxA
  · exact (not_eligible_mem_B_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hxB hE).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.cast_IsEndpoint
statement:
lemma cast_IsEndpoint {U W : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) (h : U = W) {x : V} :
    (pc.cast h).IsEndpoint x ↔ pc.IsEndpoint x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.replacePath_sat_card
statement:
lemma replacePath_sat_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support) :
    (pc.replacePath_sat hp r hr).card = pc.card
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := p) (l := pc.paths) hp pc.nodup_paths
  have hpos : 1 ≤ pc.paths.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.length_pos_of_mem hp)
  simp only [replacePath_sat, PathCover.card, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
    List.length_nil]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.replacePath_sat_mem_paths
statement:
lemma replacePath_sat_mem_paths {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support) {s : GraphPath G}
    (hs : s ∈ (pc.replacePath_sat hp r hr).paths) :
    s = r ∨ s ∈ pc.paths ∧ s ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hs with hL | hR
  · have hs0 := List.mem_filter.1 hL
    exact Or.inr ⟨hs0.1, of_decide_eq_true hs0.2⟩
  · exact Or.inl (List.mem_singleton.1 hR)

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.replacePath_sat_self_mem
statement:
lemma replacePath_sat_self_mem {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support) :
    r ∈ (pc.replacePath_sat hp r hr).paths
proof:
:=
  List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.2 rfl))

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse
statement: lemma GraphPath.start_reverse (p : GraphPath G) : p.reverse.start = p.finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.GraphPath.finish_reverse
statement: lemma GraphPath.finish_reverse (p : GraphPath G) : p.reverse.finish = p.start
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_deleteFinset_keepEndpoint
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction generalizing U pc with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨pc.cast (by simp), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [PathCover.cast_card]
    · exact (cast_IsEndpoint pc (by simp)).2 hx
  | insert b S hb ih =>
    have hbU : b ∈ U := hS (mem_insert_self b S)
    have hSsub : S ⊆ U.erase b := by
      intro y hy
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hby => hb (hby ▸ hy), hS (mem_insert_of_mem hy)⟩
    have hxne : x ≠ b := fun hxb => hxS (by simp [hxb])
    have hx' : (pc.deleteVertex b).IsEndpoint x :=
      IsEndpoint_deleteVertex pc hx hxne
    have hxS' : x ∉ S := fun h => hxS (mem_insert_of_mem h)
    obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hend1⟩ :=
      ih (U := U.erase b) (pc.deleteVertex b) hSsub hx' hxS'
    have hEq : U.erase b \ S = U \ insert b S := by
      rw [sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_distrib, erase_eq_of_notMem hb]
    refine ⟨pc1.cast hEq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hdv := pc.card_deleteVertex_le b
      have hcard := card_insert_of_notMem (s := S) hb
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      omega
    · exact (cast_IsEndpoint pc1 hEq).2 hend1

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_other_path_sat
statement:
lemma exists_other_path_sat {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (_hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card) :
    ∃ q, q ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p0, q0, hp0, hq0, hne⟩ := pc.exists_two_distinct h2
  by_cases h : p = p0
  · refine ⟨q0, hq0, ?_⟩
    intro h'
    exact hne (h.symm.trans h'.symm)
  · exact ⟨p0, hp0, fun hp0p => h hp0p.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_marked_splice_two_through
statement:
lemma exists_marked_splice_two_through {A B U : Finset V} {b x : V}
    {p : GraphPath G}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hstart : p.start = x)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A)
    (hb : b ∈ B) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ (pc' : PathCover G (insert b U)) (p' : GraphPath G),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p'.start = x ∧
          (∀ q ∈ pc'.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hne⟩ := pc.exists_other_path_sat hp h2
  have hpb : b ∉ p.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hqb : b ∉ q.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hq h)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAB p b q (hend p hp).2 hb (hend q hq).1 hpb hqb
      (pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne.symm)
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne.symm b hbU r hr,
    r, pc.spliceTwoInsert_card hp hq hne.symm b hbU r hr, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.2 rfl))
  · exact hs.trans hstart
  · intro s hsmem
    rcases pc.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths hp hq hne.symm b hbU r hr hsmem with hseq | ⟨hspc, _, _⟩
    · subst hseq
      rw [hs, hf]
      exact ⟨(hend p hp).1, (hend q hq).2⟩
    · exact hend s hspc

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_min_cover_left_of_dominant_endpoint
statement:
lemma exists_min_cover_left_of_dominant_endpoint {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G A,
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A ∧ pc.IsEndpoint x
proof:
:= by
  have hEkeep := hE
  obtain ⟨pcU, hU, p, hp, hxend⟩ := hE
  have hxA := eligible_mem_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hEkeep
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hxB : x ∉ B := fun hxB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA hxB
  have hBsub : B ⊆ A ∪ B := subset_union_right
  obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hend1⟩ :=
    PathCover.exists_deleteFinset_keepEndpoint (U := A ∪ B) (S := B)
      pcU hBsub ⟨p, hp, hxend⟩ hxB
  have hEq : (A ∪ B) \ B = A := union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint hdisj
  let pcA : PathCover G A := pc1.cast hEq
  have hsat := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  have hcard : pcA.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G A := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card]
    omega
  have hmin : pcA.card = pathCoverNumber G A := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcA
    omega
  exact ⟨pcA, hmin, (PathCover.cast_IsEndpoint pc1 hEq).2 hend1⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.eligible_left_of_dominant
statement:
lemma eligible_left_of_dominant {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x) : Eligible G A x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, hend⟩ :=
    exists_min_cover_left_of_dominant_endpoint hAne hBne hAB hdom hE
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hx⟩ := hend
  exact ⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_orientStart_marked
statement:
lemma exists_orientStart_marked {A U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths)
    (hx : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish)
    (hend : ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A) :
    ∃ (pc' : PathCover G U) (p' : GraphPath G),
      pc'.card = pc.card ∧
        p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p'.start = x ∧ p'.support = p.support ∧
          (∀ q ∈ pc'.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : x = p.start
  · exact ⟨pc, p, rfl, hp, hs.symm, rfl, hend⟩
  · have hf : x = p.finish := hx.resolve_left hs
    let r := p.reverse
    have hr : r.support = p.support := GraphPath.support_reverse p
    refine ⟨pc.replacePath_sat hp r hr, r, pc.replacePath_sat_card hp r hr,
      pc.replacePath_sat_self_mem hp r hr, ?_, hr, ?_⟩
    · simp [r, PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse, hf]
    · intro q hq
      rcases pc.replacePath_sat_mem_paths hp r hr hq with hqr | ⟨hspc, _⟩
      · subst hqr
        rw [PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse, PathCover.GraphPath.finish_reverse]
        exact ⟨(hend p hp).2, (hend p hp).1⟩
      · exact hend q hspc

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant_marked
statement:
lemma exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant_marked {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hE : Eligible G A x) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card ∧ pc.IsEndpoint x ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc0, h0, p0, hp0, hxend⟩ := hE
  have hend0 : ∀ q ∈ pc0.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A := by
    intro q hq
    exact ⟨pc0.support_subset hq q.start_mem_support,
      pc0.support_subset hq q.finish_mem_support⟩
  obtain ⟨pc0o, p0o, hcard0o, hp0o, hstart0, _, hend0o⟩ :=
    exists_orientStart_marked (A := A) pc0 hp0 hxend hend0
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (pc : PathCover G (A ∪ S)) (p : GraphPath G),
        S ⊆ B → (B \ S).card = k →
          pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - S.card →
            p ∈ pc.paths → p.start = x →
              (∀ q ∈ pc.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A) →
                ∃ (pc' : PathCover G (A ∪ B)),
                  pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card ∧
                    pc'.IsEndpoint x ∧
                      (∀ q ∈ pc'.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro S pc p hS hk hcard hp hstart hend
      have hBS : B \ S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hk
      have hBeq : S = B :=
        subset_antisymm hS (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mp hBS)
      subst hBeq
      exact ⟨pc, hcard, ⟨p, hp, Or.inl hstart.symm⟩, hend⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro S pc p hS hk hcard hp hstart hend
      have hne : (B \ S).Nonempty :=
        card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (B \ S).card)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hne
      have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
      have hbS : b ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      have hdisjAB := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
      have hbU : b ∉ A ∪ S := by
        intro h
        rcases mem_union.1 h with hA | hS'
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB hA hbB
        · exact hbS hS'
      have hsum : S.card + (B \ S).card = B.card := by
        rw [← card_union_of_disjoint, union_sdiff_of_subset hS]
        exact disjoint_sdiff
      have h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card := by omega
      obtain ⟨pc1, p1, hcard1, hp1, hstart1, hend1⟩ :=
        PathCover.exists_marked_splice_two_through (x := x) (p := p)
          hAB pc hp hstart h2 hend hbB hbU
      have hU : insert b (A ∪ S) = A ∪ insert b S := by
        ext z
        simp [mem_insert, mem_union]
      let pc1' : PathCover G (A ∪ insert b S) := pc1.cast hU
      have hS' : insert b S ⊆ B := insert_subset hbB hS
      have hrem : B \ insert b S = (B \ S).erase b := sdiff_insert B S b
      have hk' : (B \ insert b S).card = k := by
        rw [hrem, card_erase_of_mem hb, hk]
        omega
      have hcard' : pc1'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (insert b S).card := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard1, hcard, card_insert_of_notMem hbS]
        omega
      have hp1' : p1 ∈ pc1'.paths := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU]
        exact hp1
      have hend1' : ∀ q ∈ pc1'.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A := by
        intro q hq
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU] at hq
        exact hend1 q hq
      exact ih (insert b S) pc1' p1 hS' hk' hcard' hp1' hstart1 hend1'
  have hA : A ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = A := union_empty A
  let pc0' : PathCover G (A ∪ ∅) := pc0o.cast hA.symm
  have hcard0 : pc0'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (∅ : Finset V).card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard0o, h0, card_empty, Nat.sub_zero]
  have hp0' : p0o ∈ pc0'.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm]
    exact hp0o
