  have hend0' : ∀ q ∈ pc0'.paths, q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A := by
    intro q hq
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm] at hq
    exact hend0o q hq
  exact aux B.card ∅ pc0' p0o (empty_subset B) (by simp) hcard0 hp0' hstart0 hend0'

name: Nikoghosyan.eligible_of_dominant_left
statement:
lemma eligible_of_dominant_left {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hE : Eligible G A x) : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, hend, _⟩ :=
    exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant_marked hAB hdom hE
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    have hj := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
    omega
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hx⟩ := hend
  exact ⟨pc, hmin, p, hp, hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.eligible_complete_join_dominant_iff
statement:
lemma eligible_complete_join_dominant_iff {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    Eligible G (A ∪ B) x ↔ Eligible G A x
proof:
:=
  ⟨eligible_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom,
    eligible_of_dominant_left hAne hBne hAB hdom⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = eligibleSet G A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_eligibleSet_iff] at hx
    have hEA := eligible_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hx.2
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hEA.mem, hEA⟩
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_eligibleSet_iff] at hx
    have hEU := eligible_of_dominant_left hAne hBne hAB hdom hx.2
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hEU.mem, hEU⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = B ∪ ineligibleSet G A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff] at hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx.1 with hxA | hxB
    · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr ?_)
      rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff]
      refine ⟨hxA, ?_⟩
      intro hEA
      exact hx.2 (eligible_of_dominant_left hAne hBne hAB hdom hEA)
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxB)
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff]
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxB | hxA
    · refine ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxB), ?_⟩
      intro hEU
      exact not_eligible_mem_B_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hxB hEU
    · rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff] at hxA
      refine ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA.1), ?_⟩
      intro hEU
      exact hxA.2 (eligible_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hEU)

name: Nikoghosyan.sdiff_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma sdiff_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    (A ∪ B) \ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = A \ ineligibleSet G A
proof:
:= by
  have hF := ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxAB : x ∈ A ∪ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hnot : x ∉ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have hnot' : x ∉ B ∪ ineligibleSet G A := by rwa [hF] at hnot
    have hxA : x ∈ A := by
      rcases mem_union.1 hxAB with hxA | hxB
      · exact hxA
      · exact (hnot' (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxB))).elim
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxA, ?_⟩
    intro hxF
    exact hnot' (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxF))
  · intro hx
    have hxA : x ∈ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxF : x ∉ ineligibleSet G A := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA), ?_⟩
    intro hmem
    have hmem' : x ∈ B ∪ ineligibleSet G A := by rwa [hF] at hmem
    rcases mem_union.1 hmem' with hxB | hxFA
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA hxB
    · exact hxF hxFA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.Walk.exists_leaving_edge
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact (hw hu).elim
  | cons hadj p ih =>
    rename_i u v w
    by_cases hv : v ∈ T
    · exact ih hv hw
    · exact ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hadj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_nonneighbors
statement:
lemma mem_nonneighbors {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V} :
    w ∈ nonneighbors G v ↔ w ≠ v ∧ ¬ G.Adj v w
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_mem_nonneighbors_of_adj
statement:
lemma not_mem_nonneighbors_of_adj {G : SimpleGraph V} {v a : V} (ha : G.Adj v a) :
    a ∉ nonneighbors G v
proof: := fun h => h.2 ha

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_completeToBlock
statement:
lemma mem_completeToBlock {G : SimpleGraph V} {v a : V}
    {C : (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).ConnectedComponent} :
    a ∈ completeToBlock G v C ↔
      G.Adj v a ∧ ∀ b ∈ componentVerts C, G.Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [completeToBlock]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.completeToBlock_of_meets
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_completeToBlock.2 ⟨ha, ?_⟩
  intro b' hb'
  by_contra hnab
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := hmeet
  obtain ⟨hbS, hbC⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hb
  obtain ⟨hb'S, hb'C⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hb'
  let T : Set (nonneighbors G v) := {x | G.Adj a x.1}
  have hu : (⟨b, hbS⟩ : nonneighbors G v) ∈ T := hab
  have hw : (⟨b', hb'S⟩ : nonneighbors G v) ∉ T := hnab
  have hreach : (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).Reachable ⟨b, hbS⟩ ⟨b', hb'S⟩ :=
    ConnectedComponent.exact (by
      rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hbC hb'C
      rw [hbC, hb'C])
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hreach
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxT, hyT, hxy⟩ := Walk.exists_leaving_edge p hu hw
  have hxyG : G.Adj x.1 y.1 := by simpa [induce_adj] using hxy
  have hadj_ax : G.Adj a x.1 := hxT
  have ha_ne_x : a ≠ x.1 := hadj_ax.ne
  have ha_ne_y : a ≠ y.1 := fun h => not_mem_nonneighbors_of_adj ha (h ▸ y.2)
  have hp4 : InducedP4 G v a x.1 y.1 :=
    { ne_ab := ha.ne
      ne_ac := x.2.1.symm
      ne_ad := y.2.1.symm
      ne_bc := ha_ne_x
      ne_bd := ha_ne_y
      ne_cd := fun h => hxy.ne (Subtype.ext h)
      adj_ab := ha
      adj_bc := hxT
      adj_cd := hxyG
      not_ac := x.2.2
      not_ad := y.2.2
      not_bd := hyT }
  exact hC _ _ _ _ hp4

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complete_join_of_universal
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_of_universal {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V}
    (_hG : G.Connected) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) (hv : G.IsUniversal v) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V, A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = Finset.univ ∧
      G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) ∧
      A.card < Fintype.card V ∧ B.card < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial V :=
    Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : ℕ) < 2) hcard)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne v
  refine ⟨{v}, Finset.univ.erase v, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Finset.singleton_nonempty v
  · exact ⟨w, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hw, Finset.mem_univ w⟩⟩
  · exact Finset.disjoint_singleton_left.2 (Finset.notMem_erase v _)
  · ext x
    by_cases hx : x = v <;> simp [hx]
  · intro x hx y hy
    have hx' : x = v := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
    have hy' : y ≠ v := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1
    subst hx'
    exact hv hy'.symm
  · have : ({v} : Finset V).card = 1 := Finset.card_singleton v
    omega
  · have : (Finset.univ.erase v).card = Fintype.card V - 1 := by
      simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v)]
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentVerts_nonempty
statement:
lemma componentVerts_nonempty {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : Set V}
    (C : (G.induce s).ConnectedComponent) : (componentVerts C).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := C.nonempty_supp
  exact ⟨x.1, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_adj_to_block_of_not_mem_completeToBlock
proof:
:= by
  intro hbx
  have : b ∈ completeToBlock G v C :=
    completeToBlock_of_meets hC hbN ⟨x, hx, hbx⟩
  exact hb this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.adj_of_mem_completeToBlock_of_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := componentVerts_nonempty C
  have haN : G.Adj v a := (mem_completeToBlock.1 ha).1
  have hax : G.Adj a x := (mem_completeToBlock.1 ha).2 x hx
  by_contra hnab
  have hxN := componentVerts_subset C hx
  have hbx : ¬ G.Adj b x :=
    not_adj_to_block_of_not_mem_completeToBlock hC hbN hb hx
  have hp4 : InducedP4 G x a v b :=
    { ne_ab := hax.ne.symm
      ne_ac := hxN.1
      ne_ad := fun h => hxN.2 (h ▸ hbN)
      ne_bc := haN.ne.symm
      ne_bd := fun h => hb (h ▸ ha)
      ne_cd := hbN.ne
      adj_ab := hax.symm
      adj_bc := haN.symm
      adj_cd := hbN
      not_ac := fun h => hxN.2 h.symm
      not_ad := fun h => hbx h.symm
      not_bd := hnab }
  exact hC _ _ _ _ hp4

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.completeToBlock_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hempty
  have hAempty : completeToBlock G v C = ∅ :=
    Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hempty
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := componentVerts_nonempty C
  have hvT : v ∉ componentVerts C := fun h =>
    (componentVerts_subset C h).1 rfl
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hG x v
  obtain ⟨y, z, hyT, hzT, hyz⟩ :=
    Walk.exists_leaving_edge (T := componentVerts C) p hx hvT
  
  have hyN := componentVerts_subset C hyT
  have hz_cases : z ∈ G.neighborSet v ∨ z = v ∨ z ∈ nonneighbors G v := by
    by_cases hzn : z = v
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hzn)
    · by_cases hzadj : G.Adj v z
      · exact Or.inl hzadj
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hzn, hzadj⟩)
  rcases hz_cases with hzN | hzv | hzB
  · 
    have hzA : z ∈ completeToBlock G v C :=
      completeToBlock_of_meets hC hzN ⟨y, hyT, hyz.symm⟩
    have : z ∈ (∅ : Finset V) := hAempty ▸ hzA
    exact Finset.notMem_empty z this
  · 
    subst hzv
    exact hyN.2 hyz.symm
  · 
    have hyS : y ∈ nonneighbors G v := hyN
    have : (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).Adj ⟨y, hyS⟩ ⟨z, hzB⟩ := by
      simpa [induce_adj] using hyz
    have hzC : z ∈ componentVerts C := by
      refine (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).2 ⟨hzB, ?_⟩
      have hyC : (⟨y, hyS⟩ : nonneighbors G v) ∈ C.supp :=
        (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hyT |>.2
      exact (C.mem_supp_congr_adj this).mp hyC
    exact hzT hzC

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_isUniversal_iff
statement:
lemma not_isUniversal_iff {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V} :
    ¬ G.IsUniversal v ↔ (nonneighbors G v).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    unfold SimpleGraph.IsUniversal at hv
    push_neg at hv
    obtain ⟨w, hwne, hwadj⟩ := hv
    exact ⟨w, hwne.symm, hwadj⟩
  · intro ⟨w, hw⟩
    intro hU
    exact hw.2 (hU hw.1.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_nonneighbors_of_mem_componentVerts
proof:
:=
  componentVerts_subset C hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_mem_completeToBlock_self
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact (mem_completeToBlock.1 h).1.ne rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_adj_of_ne_component
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxS, hxC⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hx
  have hxD : (⟨x, hxS⟩ : s) ∉ D.supp := by
    intro hmem
    apply hCD
    rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hxC hmem
    exact hxC.symm.trans hmem
  exact not_adj_of_mem_other_component hxS hxD hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.connectedComponent_eq_of_mem_componentVerts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxS, hC⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hxC
  obtain ⟨_, hD⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := D)).1 hxD
  rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hC hD
  exact hC.symm.trans hD

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.completeToBlock_nested
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  obtain ⟨a, haC, haD⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp h.1
  obtain ⟨b, hbD, hbC⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp h.2
  have hCneD : C ≠ D := by
    intro hCD
    subst hCD
    exact haD haC
  have hbN : G.Adj v b := (mem_completeToBlock.1 hbD).1
  have hab : G.Adj a b :=
    adj_of_mem_completeToBlock_of_not_mem hCograph haC hbN hbC
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := componentVerts_nonempty C
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := componentVerts_nonempty D
  have hxN := mem_nonneighbors_of_mem_componentVerts hx
  have hyN := mem_nonneighbors_of_mem_componentVerts hy
  have hax : G.Adj a x := (mem_completeToBlock.1 haC).2 x hx
  have hby : G.Adj b y := (mem_completeToBlock.1 hbD).2 y hy
  have hbx : ¬ G.Adj b x :=
    not_adj_to_block_of_not_mem_completeToBlock hCograph hbN hbC hx
  have hay : ¬ G.Adj a y :=
    not_adj_to_block_of_not_mem_completeToBlock hCograph
      (mem_completeToBlock.1 haC).1 haD hy
  have hxy : ¬ G.Adj x y := not_adj_of_ne_component hCneD hx hy
  have hx_ne_y : x ≠ y := by
    intro hxy'
    exact hCneD (connectedComponent_eq_of_mem_componentVerts (hxy' ▸ hx) hy)
  have hp4 : InducedP4 G x a b y :=
    { ne_ab := hax.ne.symm
      ne_ac := fun h => hxN.2 (h ▸ hbN)
      ne_ad := hx_ne_y
      ne_bc := hab.ne
      ne_bd := fun h => hyN.2 (h ▸ (mem_completeToBlock.1 haC).1)
      ne_cd := hby.ne
      adj_ab := hax.symm
      adj_bc := hab
      adj_cd := hby
      not_ac := fun h => hbx h.symm
      not_ad := hxy
      not_bd := hay }
  exact hCograph _ _ _ _ hp4

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_min_completeToBlock
statement:
lemma exists_min_completeToBlock {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V}
    (hv : ¬ G.IsUniversal v) (hCograph : IsCographGraph G) :
    ∃ C : (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).ConnectedComponent,
      ∀ D, completeToBlock G v C ⊆ completeToBlock G v D
proof:
:= by
  haveI : DecidableRel G.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  haveI : Fintype (nonneighbors G v) := inferInstance
  haveI : DecidableRel (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).Adj := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Nonempty (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).ConnectedComponent := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (not_isUniversal_iff (v := v)).1 hv
    exact ⟨(G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).connectedComponentMk ⟨w, hw⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hmin⟩ :=
    Finite.exists_min (fun D : (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).ConnectedComponent =>
      (completeToBlock G v D).card)
  refine ⟨C, fun D => ?_⟩
  rcases completeToBlock_nested (C := C) (D := D) hCograph with hCD | hDC
  · exact hCD
  · have hcard : (completeToBlock G v D).card = (completeToBlock G v C).card :=
      le_antisymm (Finset.card_mono hDC) (hmin D)
    have : completeToBlock G v D = completeToBlock G v C :=
      Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hDC (by omega)
    simpa [this]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complete_join_of_not_universal
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_of_not_universal {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V}
    (hG : G.Connected) (hCograph : IsCographGraph G) (hv : ¬ G.IsUniversal v) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V, A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = Finset.univ ∧
      G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) ∧
      A.card < Fintype.card V ∧ B.card < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hmin⟩ := exists_min_completeToBlock (v := v) hv hCograph
  let A := completeToBlock G v C
  let B := Finset.univ \ A
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := completeToBlock_nonempty (C := C) hG hCograph
  have hvB : v ∈ B := by
    simp [B, A, not_mem_completeToBlock_self (C := C)]
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := ⟨v, hvB⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint A B := Finset.disjoint_sdiff
  have hcover : A ∪ B = Finset.univ := Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ A)
  have hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) := by
    intro a ha b hb
    have haN : G.Adj v a := (mem_completeToBlock.1 (by simpa [A] using ha)).1
    have hbA : b ∉ A := by
      have : b ∈ B := hb
      simp [B] at this
      exact this
    by_cases hbv : b = v
    · subst hbv
      exact haN.symm
    · by_cases hbN : G.Adj v b
      · exact adj_of_mem_completeToBlock_of_not_mem hCograph
          (by simpa [A] using ha) hbN hbA
      · have hbnn : b ∈ nonneighbors G v := ⟨hbv, hbN⟩
        let D := (G.induce (nonneighbors G v)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hbnn⟩
        have hbD : b ∈ componentVerts D :=
          (mem_componentVerts (C := D)).2 ⟨hbnn, by
            simp [D, ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]⟩
        have hsub : A ⊆ completeToBlock G v D := by
          simpa [A] using hmin D
        have haD : a ∈ completeToBlock G v D := hsub (by simpa [A] using ha)
        exact (mem_completeToBlock.1 haD).2 b hbD
  have hsum : A.card + B.card = Fintype.card V := by
    have := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
    simpa [hcover, Finset.card_univ] using this.symm
  have hAcard : A.card < Fintype.card V := by
    have : 1 ≤ B.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hBne
    omega
  have hBcard : B.card < Fintype.card V := by
    have : 1 ≤ A.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hAne
    omega
  exact ⟨A, B, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hcover, hAB, hAcard, hBcard⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complete_join_of_connected_cograph
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_of_connected_cograph {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.Connected) (hCograph : IsCographGraph G) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V, A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = Finset.univ ∧
      G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) ∧
      A.card < Fintype.card V ∧ B.card < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hcard)
  let v : V := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty V›
  by_cases hv : G.IsUniversal v
  · exact exists_complete_join_of_universal hG hcard hv
  · exact exists_complete_join_of_not_universal hG hCograph hv

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_disjoint_union_of_not_connected
statement:
lemma exists_disjoint_union_of_not_connected {G : SimpleGraph V} [Nonempty V]
    (hG : ¬ G.Connected) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V, A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = Finset.univ ∧
      (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
      A.card < Fintype.card V ∧ B.card < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : ¬ G.Preconnected := fun hp =>
    hG ((connected_iff G).2 ⟨hp, ‹Nonempty V›⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ : ∃ x y, ¬ G.Reachable x y := by
    unfold SimpleGraph.Preconnected at hpre
    push_neg at hpre
    exact hpre
  let u : V := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty V›
  have hz : ∃ z, ¬ G.Reachable u z := by
    by_cases hux : G.Reachable u x
    · by_cases huy : G.Reachable u y
      · exact (hxy (hux.symm.trans huy)).elim
      · exact ⟨y, huy⟩
    · exact ⟨x, hux⟩
  obtain ⟨z, huz⟩ := hz
  let C := G.connectedComponentMk u
  let A : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter (fun w => G.connectedComponentMk w = C)
  have huA : u ∈ A := by simp [A, C]
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := ⟨u, huA⟩
  let B := Finset.univ \ A
  have hzB : z ∈ B := by
    simp [B, A, C]
    intro h
    exact huz h.symm
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := ⟨z, hzB⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint A B := Finset.disjoint_sdiff
  have hcover : A ∪ B = Finset.univ := Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ A)
  have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have hbA : b ∉ A := by
      have : b ∈ B := hb
      simp [B] at this
      exact this
    have hmk :
        G.connectedComponentMk a = G.connectedComponentMk b :=
      ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj
    have haC : G.connectedComponentMk a = C := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have hbC : G.connectedComponentMk b = C := hmk.symm.trans haC
    exact hbA (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ b, hbC⟩)
  have hsum : A.card + B.card = Fintype.card V := by
    have := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
    simpa [hcover, Finset.card_univ] using this.symm
  have hAcard : A.card < Fintype.card V := by
    have : 1 ≤ B.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hBne
    omega
  have hBcard : B.card < Fintype.card V := by
    have : 1 ≤ A.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hAne
    omega
  exact ⟨A, B, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hcover, hnocross, hAcard, hBcard⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_finsetOfSubtype
statement:
lemma card_finsetOfSubtype {s : Set V} (A : Finset s) :
    (finsetOfSubtype A).card = A.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.finsetOfSubtype_univ
statement:
lemma finsetOfSubtype_univ (U : Finset V) :
    finsetOfSubtype (Finset.univ : Finset (U : Set V)) = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact hy
  · intro hx
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.finsetOfSubtype_union
statement:
lemma finsetOfSubtype_union {s : Set V} (A B : Finset s) :
    finsetOfSubtype (A ∪ B) = finsetOfSubtype A ∪ finsetOfSubtype B
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsetOfSubtype, Finset.image_union]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_finsetOfSubtype
statement:
lemma disjoint_finsetOfSubtype {s : Set V} {A B : Finset s} (h : Disjoint A B) :
    Disjoint (finsetOfSubtype A) (finsetOfSubtype B)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro x hxA hxB
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxA
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxB
  have : a = b := Subtype.ext hba.symm
  subst this
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 h ha hb

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.subset_finsetOfSubtype
statement:
lemma subset_finsetOfSubtype {s : Set V} (A : Finset s) :
    finsetOfSubtype A ⊆ (s.toFinset)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
  simpa [Set.mem_toFinset] using hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.finsetOfSubtype_subset_of_coe
statement:
lemma finsetOfSubtype_subset_of_coe (U : Finset V) (A : Finset (U : Set V)) :
    finsetOfSubtype A ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
  exact hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complete_join_on
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_on {G : SimpleGraph V} {U : Finset V}
    (hU : IsCograph G U) (hconn : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ U.card) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V, A ⊆ U ∧ B ⊆ U ∧ A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧
      Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = U ∧
      G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) ∧
      A.card < U.card ∧ B.card < U.card
proof:
:= by
  have hCograph : IsCographGraph (G.induce (U : Set V)) :=
    (isCographOn_iff_isCographGraph_induce (s := (U : Set V))).1 hU
  have hcard' : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (U : Set V) := by
    simpa [Fintype.card_coe] using hcard
  obtain ⟨A0, B0, hA0ne, hB0ne, hdisj0, hcover0, hAB0, hA0card, hB0card⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_of_connected_cograph (G := G.induce (U : Set V))
      hconn hCograph hcard'
  refine ⟨finsetOfSubtype A0, finsetOfSubtype B0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact finsetOfSubtype_subset_of_coe U A0
  · exact finsetOfSubtype_subset_of_coe U B0
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA0ne
    exact ⟨a.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hB0ne
    exact ⟨b.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩
  · exact disjoint_finsetOfSubtype hdisj0
  · rw [← finsetOfSubtype_union]
    exact (congrArg finsetOfSubtype hcover0).trans (finsetOfSubtype_univ U)
  · intro a ha b hb
    obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    have : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Adj a' b' :=
      hAB0 (by exact ha') (by exact hb')
    simpa [induce_adj] using this
  · simpa [card_finsetOfSubtype, Fintype.card_coe] using hA0card
  · simpa [card_finsetOfSubtype, Fintype.card_coe] using hB0card

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_disjoint_union_on
statement:
lemma exists_disjoint_union_on {G : SimpleGraph V} {U : Finset V}
    (hdisc : ¬ (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected) (hne : U.Nonempty) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V, A ⊆ U ∧ B ⊆ U ∧ A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧
      Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = U ∧
      (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
      A.card < U.card ∧ B.card < U.card
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (U : Set V) := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨A0, B0, hA0ne, hB0ne, hdisj0, hcover0, hnocross0, hA0card, hB0card⟩ :=
    exists_disjoint_union_of_not_connected (G := G.induce (U : Set V)) hdisc
  refine ⟨finsetOfSubtype A0, finsetOfSubtype B0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact finsetOfSubtype_subset_of_coe U A0
  · exact finsetOfSubtype_subset_of_coe U B0
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA0ne
    exact ⟨a.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hB0ne
    exact ⟨b.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩
  · exact disjoint_finsetOfSubtype hdisj0
  · rw [← finsetOfSubtype_union]
    exact (congrArg finsetOfSubtype hcover0).trans (finsetOfSubtype_univ U)
  · intro a ha b hb hadj
    obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    have : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Adj a' b' := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
    exact hnocross0 a' ha' b' hb' this
  · simpa [card_finsetOfSubtype, Fintype.card_coe] using hA0card
  · simpa [card_finsetOfSubtype, Fintype.card_coe] using hB0card

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible (U : Finset V) :
    eligibleSet G U = U \ ineligibleSet G U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_eligibleSet_iff] at hx
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
    intro hF
    exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hF |>.2 hx.2
  · intro hx
    have hxU : x ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hnotF : x ∉ ineligibleSet G U := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have hE : Eligible G U x := by
      have h := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G) (U := U) (x := x)).not
      simp only [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
      exact h.mp hnotF hxU
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hxU, hE⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_erase_eq_sdiff_of_mem
statement:
lemma sdiff_erase_eq_sdiff_of_mem {s t : Finset V} {a : V} (ha : a ∈ t) :
    s.erase a \ t.erase a = s \ t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxL := mem_sdiff.1 hx
    have hxse := mem_erase.1 hxL.1
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxse.2, ?_⟩
    intro hxt
    exact hxL.2 (mem_erase.2 ⟨hxse.1, hxt⟩)
  · intro hx
    have hxs : x ∈ s := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxt : x ∉ t := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have hne : x ≠ a := fun h => hxt (h ▸ ha)
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, hxs⟩, fun h => hxt (mem_erase.1 h).2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.erase_sdiff_comm
statement:
lemma erase_sdiff_comm (s t : Finset V) (a : V) :
    s.erase a \ t = (s \ t).erase a
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxL := mem_sdiff.1 hx
    have hxse := mem_erase.1 hxL.1
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨hxse.1, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxse.2, hxL.2⟩⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxL := mem_erase.1 hx
    have hxs := mem_sdiff.1 hxL.2
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hxL.1, hxs.1⟩, hxs.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.subset_erase_ineligible
statement:
lemma subset_erase_ineligible {U : Finset V} {f : V} :
    (ineligibleSet G U).erase f ⊆ U.erase f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxF := mem_erase.1 hx
  exact mem_erase.2 ⟨hxF.1, ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hxF.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_erase
statement:
lemma ineligible_deletion_erase {U : Finset V} {f : V}
    (hf : f ∈ ineligibleSet G U)
    (hfcut : componentCount G (U \ ineligibleSet G U) =
      (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f) = pathCoverNumber G U + 1 ∧
    eligibleSet G (U.erase f) = eligibleSet G U ∧
    ineligibleSet G (U.erase f) = (ineligibleSet G U).erase f ∧
    componentCount G ((U.erase f) \ ineligibleSet G (U.erase f)) =
      (ineligibleSet G (U.erase f)).card + pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f)
proof:
:= by
  have hfU : f ∈ U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hf
  have hnotE : ¬ Eligible G U f := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hf |>.2
  have hXsub : (ineligibleSet G U).erase f ⊆ U.erase f :=
    subset_erase_ineligible (U := U) (f := f)
  have hrem :
      U.erase f \ (ineligibleSet G U).erase f = U \ ineligibleSet G U :=
    sdiff_erase_eq_sdiff_of_mem hf
  have hcardX :
      ((ineligibleSet G U).erase f).card = (ineligibleSet G U).card - 1 :=
    card_erase_of_mem hf
  have hposF : 1 ≤ (ineligibleSet G U).card :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨f, hf⟩)
  have hcut' :=
    componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G) (U.erase f)
      ((ineligibleSet G U).erase f) hXsub
  have hp_ge : pathCoverNumber G U + 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f) := by
    have : componentCount G (U.erase f \ (ineligibleSet G U).erase f) =
        (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U := by
      simpa [hrem] using hfcut
    omega
  have hp_le := pathCoverNumber_erase_le (G := G) U f
  have hp : pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f) = pathCoverNumber G U + 1 :=
    le_antisymm hp_le hp_ge
  have hEsub : eligibleSet G U ⊆ eligibleSet G (U.erase f) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_eligibleSet_iff] at hx
    have hxf : x ≠ f := fun h => hnotE (h ▸ hx.2)
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc, p, hpP, hxend⟩ := hx.2
    have hend : pc.IsEndpoint x := ⟨p, hpP, hxend⟩
    have hend' : (pc.deleteVertex f).IsEndpoint x :=
      PathCover.IsEndpoint_deleteVertex pc hend hxf
    have hcard := pc.card_deleteVertex_le f
    have hmin : (pc.deleteVertex f).card = pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f) := by
      have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (pc.deleteVertex f)
      omega
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := hend'
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
      ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hxf, hx.1⟩, ⟨pc.deleteVertex f, hmin, q, hq, hxq⟩⟩
  have hXatt :
      componentCount G (U.erase f \ (ineligibleSet G U).erase f) =
        pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f) + ((ineligibleSet G U).erase f).card := by
    have : componentCount G (U.erase f \ (ineligibleSet G U).erase f) =
        (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U := by
      simpa [hrem] using hfcut
    omega
  have hXinc :
      (ineligibleSet G U).erase f ⊆ ineligibleSet G (U.erase f) :=
    eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible hXsub hXatt
  have hErev : eligibleSet G (U.erase f) ⊆ eligibleSet G U := by
    intro x hx
    have hxU' : x ∈ U.erase f := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) (U.erase f) hx
    have hnotF' : x ∉ ineligibleSet G (U.erase f) :=
      disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) (U.erase f)) hx
    have hx_notX : x ∉ (ineligibleSet G U).erase f := fun h => hnotF' (hXinc h)
    have hxE : x ∈ U.erase f \ (ineligibleSet G U).erase f :=
      mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxU', hx_notX⟩
    have hxold : x ∈ U \ ineligibleSet G U := by rwa [hrem] at hxE
    rw [eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible]
    exact hxold
  have hE : eligibleSet G (U.erase f) = eligibleSet G U :=
    Subset.antisymm hErev hEsub
  have hF : ineligibleSet G (U.erase f) = (ineligibleSet G U).erase f := by
    have hEerase : f ∉ eligibleSet G U := by
      intro h
      exact hnotE ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 h).2
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff] at hx
      have hxU' := hx.1
      have hxne : x ≠ f := (mem_erase.1 hxU').1
      have hxU : x ∈ U := (mem_erase.1 hxU').2
      refine mem_erase.2 ⟨hxne, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff]
      refine ⟨hxU, ?_⟩
      intro hEU
      have hxEold : x ∈ eligibleSet G U :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hxU, hEU⟩
      have hxEnew : x ∈ eligibleSet G (U.erase f) := by rwa [← hE] at hxEold
      exact hx.2 ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hxEnew).2
    · intro hx
      have hxF := mem_erase.1 hx
      rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff]
      refine ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hxF.1, ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hxF.2⟩, ?_⟩
      intro hE'
      have : x ∈ eligibleSet G (U.erase f) :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hxF.1,
          ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hxF.2⟩, hE'⟩
      have : x ∈ eligibleSet G U := by rwa [hE] at this
      exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hxF.2 |>.2
        ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this).2
  have hfcut' :
      componentCount G ((U.erase f) \ ineligibleSet G (U.erase f)) =
        (ineligibleSet G (U.erase f)).card + pathCoverNumber G (U.erase f) := by
    have hrem' :
        (U.erase f) \ ineligibleSet G (U.erase f) = U \ ineligibleSet G U := by
      rw [hF, hrem]
    have hcard' :
        (ineligibleSet G (U.erase f)).card = (ineligibleSet G U).card - 1 := by
      rw [hF, hcardX]
    rw [hrem', hfcut, hcard', hp]
    omega
  exact ⟨hp, hE, hF, hfcut'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_sdiff
statement:
lemma ineligible_deletion_sdiff {U C : Finset V}
    (hC : C ⊆ ineligibleSet G U)
    (hfcut : componentCount G (U \ ineligibleSet G U) =
      (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U \ C) = pathCoverNumber G U + C.card ∧
    eligibleSet G (U \ C) = eligibleSet G U ∧
    ineligibleSet G (U \ C) = ineligibleSet G U \ C ∧
    componentCount G ((U \ C) \ ineligibleSet G (U \ C)) =
      (ineligibleSet G (U \ C)).card + pathCoverNumber G (U \ C)
proof:
:= by
  induction C using Finset.induction generalizing U with
  | empty =>
    simp [hfcut]
  | insert f C hfC ih =>
    have hf : f ∈ ineligibleSet G U := hC (mem_insert_self f C)
    have hCsub : C ⊆ ineligibleSet G U := fun x hx =>
      hC (mem_insert_of_mem hx)
    have hsingle := ineligible_deletion_erase hf hfcut
    have hCnew : C ⊆ ineligibleSet G (U.erase f) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxne : x ≠ f := fun h => hfC (h ▸ hx)
      have hxF : x ∈ ineligibleSet G U := hCsub hx
      rw [hsingle.2.2.1]
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨hxne, hxF⟩
    obtain ⟨hpC, hEC, hFC, hfcutC⟩ :=
      ih (U := U.erase f) hCnew hsingle.2.2.2
    have hEq : U \ insert f C = U.erase f \ C := by
      rw [sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_comm]
    have hcard : (insert f C).card = C.card + 1 := card_insert_of_notMem hfC
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hEq, hpC, hsingle.1, hcard]
      omega
    · rw [hEq, hEC, hsingle.2.1]
    · rw [hEq, hFC, hsingle.2.2.1, sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_comm]
    · rw [hEq]
      simpa using hfcutC

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_erase_of_cotreeOn
statement:
lemma ineligible_deletion_erase_of_cotreeOn {U : Finset V} {f : V}

    eligibleSet G (U.erase f) = eligibleSet G U ∧

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_cotreeOn
statement:
lemma ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_cotreeOn {U C : Finset V}
    (hU : CotreeOn G U) (hC : C ⊆ ineligibleSet G U) :

statement:

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_isCograph
statement:
lemma ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_isCograph {U C : Finset V}

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_erase_of_canonical
statement:
lemma ineligible_deletion_erase_of_canonical {U : Finset V} {f : V}

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_canonical

lemma ineligible_deletion_sdiff_of_canonical {U C : Finset V}

name: Nikoghosyan.getVert_mem_cycle_support
statement:
lemma getVert_mem_cycle_support (c : GraphCycle G) (i : ℕ) :
    c.walk.getVert i ∈ c.support
proof:
:=
  List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)

name: Nikoghosyan.cycle_length_pos
statement: lemma cycle_length_pos (c : GraphCycle G) : 0 < c.walk.length
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 3) c.three_le_length

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_getVert_lt_length_of_mem_support
proof:
:= by
  have hxW : x ∈ c.walk.support := GraphCycle.mem_walk_support_of_mem hx
  obtain ⟨i, hiEq, hiLe⟩ := (Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert).1 hxW
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hiLe with rfl | hlt
  · refine ⟨0, cycle_length_pos c, ?_⟩
    have hxstart : x = c.start := by
      simpa [Walk.getVert_length] using hiEq.symm
    simpa [Walk.getVert_zero] using hxstart.symm
  · exact ⟨i, hlt, hiEq⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.takeUntil_length_eq_getVert_index
statement:
lemma takeUntil_length_eq_getVert_index (c : GraphCycle G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < c.walk.length) :
    (c.walk.takeUntil (c.walk.getVert i)
        (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)).length = i
proof:
:= by
  set u := c.walk.getVert i
  set p := c.walk.takeUntil u (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)
  have hi' : i ≤ c.walk.length := hi.le
  have hpu : c.walk.getVert p.length = u :=
    Walk.getVert_length_takeUntil (p := c.walk)
      (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)
  have hne : p.length ≠ c.walk.length := by
    intro heq
    have huStart : u = c.start := by
      simpa [heq, Walk.getVert_length] using hpu.symm
    have hi0 : i = 0 := by
      have := (c.isCycle.getVert_endpoint_iff hi').1 huStart
      omega
    have hp0 : p.length = 0 := by
      subst hi0
      simp [p, u, Walk.getVert_zero, Walk.takeUntil_first]
    have h3 := c.three_le_length
    omega
  have hplt : p.length < c.walk.length := lt_of_le_of_ne
    (Walk.length_takeUntil_le_length c.walk
      (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)) hne
  have hp_le : p.length ≤ c.walk.length - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt hplt
  have hi_le : i ≤ c.walk.length - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt hi
  exact c.isCycle.getVert_injOn' hp_le hi_le (hpu.trans rfl)

name: Nikoghosyan.idxOf_getVert_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := takeUntil_length_eq_getVert_index c hi
  simpa [Walk.length_takeUntil] using hlen

name: Nikoghosyan.getVert_copy
statement:
lemma getVert_copy {u u' v v' : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (hu : u = u') (hv : v = v') (n : ℕ) :
    (p.copy hu hv).getVert n = p.getVert n
proof:
:= by
  subst hu
  subst hv
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.dropUntil_getVert_succ
statement:
lemma dropUntil_getVert_succ (c : GraphCycle G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < c.walk.length) :
    (c.walk.dropUntil (c.walk.getVert i)
        (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)).getVert 1 =
      c.walk.getVert (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set u := c.walk.getVert i
  have huW : u ∈ c.walk.support := Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i
  have hidx := idxOf_getVert_eq c hi
  rw [Walk.dropUntil_eq_drop c.walk huW, getVert_copy, Walk.drop_getVert, hidx]

name: Nikoghosyan.succAt_eq_getVert_succ
proof:
:= by
  set u := c.walk.getVert i
  set hu := getVert_mem_cycle_support c i
  have huW : u ∈ c.walk.support := Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i
  have hidx := idxOf_getVert_eq c hi
  have hdrop_len :
      (c.walk.dropUntil u huW).length = c.walk.length - i := by
    rw [Walk.length_dropUntil, hidx]
  have hstart : (c.rotateTo hu).start = u := c.start_rotateTo hu
  
  have hrot :
      (c.walk.rotate u (GraphCycle.mem_walk_support_of_mem hu)).getVert 1 =
        ((c.walk.dropUntil u huW).append (c.walk.takeUntil u huW)).getVert 1 :=
    rfl
  have hsucc : c.succAt hu =
      (c.walk.rotate u (GraphCycle.mem_walk_support_of_mem hu)).getVert 1 :=
    rfl
  rw [hsucc, hrot, Walk.getVert_append]
  split_ifs with hlt
  · exact dropUntil_getVert_succ c hi
  · have h1 : (c.walk.dropUntil u huW).length = 1 := by omega
    have hi1 : i + 1 = c.walk.length := by omega
    have hL : (c.walk.takeUntil u huW).getVert
        (1 - (c.walk.dropUntil u huW).length) = c.start := by
      simp [h1, Walk.getVert_zero]
    have hrhs : c.walk.getVert (i + 1) = c.start := by
      simpa [hi1] using Walk.getVert_length c.walk
    simpa [h1] using hL.trans hrhs.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_path_open_succ
statement:
lemma exists_path_open_succ (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = c.support ∧
        p.start = c.succAt hu ∧
          p.finish = u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rest, hadj, hw, hcons, hpath⟩ := c.rotateTo_eq_cons hu
  have hfin : (c.rotateTo hu).start = u := c.start_rotateTo hu
  let p : GraphPath G := ⟨w, (c.rotateTo hu).start, rest, hpath⟩
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have huRest : (c.rotateTo hu).start ∈ rest.support :=
      Walk.end_mem_support rest
    have hrot : p.support = (c.rotateTo hu).support := by
      simp [p, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hcons, Walk.support_cons,
        insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 huRest)]
    simpa [hrot, GraphCycle.support_rotateTo]
  · simpa [p] using hw
  · simpa [p, hfin]

name: Nikoghosyan.three_le_union_card
statement:
lemma three_le_union_card (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support) :
    3 ≤ (cH.support ∪ cD.support).card
proof:
:= by
  have hH := cH.three_le_card_support
  have hD := cD.three_le_card_support
  have hcup :
      (cH.support ∪ cD.support).card = cH.support.card + cD.support.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_inducedP4_of_not_isCograph
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsCograph at h
  push Not at h
  exact h

name: Nikoghosyan.ne_of_mem_disjoint
statement:
lemma ne_of_mem_disjoint {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hx : x ∈ A) (hy : y ∈ B) : x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  subst h
  exact disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx hy

name: Nikoghosyan.rowProfile_nonempty_of_not_cograph
statement:
lemma rowProfile_nonempty_of_not_cograph
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ cD.support) :
    (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, ha, hb, hc, hd, hp⟩ :=
    exists_inducedP4_of_not_isCograph hH
  by_contra hempty
  have hAempty : rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v = ∅ :=
    not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
  have hnone : ∀ x ∈ cH.support, ¬ G.Adj v x := by
    intro x hx hadj
    have hxA : x ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v :=
      (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hx, hadj⟩
    simpa [hAempty] using hxA
  have hva := ne_of_mem_disjoint hdisj ha hv
  have hvb := ne_of_mem_disjoint hdisj hb hv
  have hvc := ne_of_mem_disjoint hdisj hc hv
  have hvd := ne_of_mem_disjoint hdisj hd hv
  have hdom := hpat hp hva.symm hvb.symm hvc.symm hvd.symm
  rcases hdom with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
  · exact hnone a ha h1
  · exact hnone b hb h2
  · exact hnone c hc h3
  · exact hnone d hd h4

name: Nikoghosyan.isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_of_pair
statement:
lemma isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_of_pair
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ cD.support) :
    IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v)
proof:
:=
  isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile (H := cH.support) (R := cD.support) hdisj hv
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp hxa hxb hxc hxd =>
      hpat hp hxa hxb hxc hxd)

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_row_le
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_row_le
    (cH : GraphCycle G) {v : V}
    (hAne : (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty) :
    pathCoverNumber G
        (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ≤
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card
proof:
:=
  Cograph.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_card_of_cycle (G := G) cH rfl
    (rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support v) hAne

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_of_not_saturated
statement:
lemma strict_of_not_saturated
    (cH : GraphCycle G) {v : V}
    (hAne : (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty)
    (hnot : ¬ Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v)) :
    pathCoverNumber G
        (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card
proof:
:= by
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_row_le cH hAne
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hle (by
    intro heq
    exact hnot heq)

name: Nikoghosyan.not_spanningPathCompatible_of_no_union_cycle
statement:
lemma not_spanningPathCompatible_of_no_union_cycle
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    {u : V} (hu : u ∈ cD.support)
    {a b : V}
    (ha : a ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u)
    (hb : b ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu)) :
    ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) cH.support a b
proof:
:= by
  intro hR
  obtain ⟨hne, p, hp, hends⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨q, hq, qst, qfin⟩ := exists_path_open_succ cD hu
  have ha' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 ha
  have hb' := (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).1 hb
  have hd : Disjoint p.support q.support := by
    rw [hp, hq]
    exact hdisj
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (p.support ∪ q.support).card := by
    rw [hp, hq]
    exact three_le_union_card cH cD hdisj
  let p' : GraphPath G :=
    if hdir : p.start = a ∧ p.finish = b then p else p.reverse
  have hp' : p'.support = cH.support := by
    dsimp [p']
    split_ifs
    · exact hp
    · simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp
  have hp'start : p'.start = a := by
    dsimp [p']
    split_ifs with hdir
    · exact hdir.1
    · have : p.start = b ∧ p.finish = a := by
        rcases hends with h | h
        · exact (hdir h).elim
        · exact h
      simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using this.2
  have hp'finish : p'.finish = b := by
    dsimp [p']
    split_ifs with hdir
    · exact hdir.2
    · have : p.start = b ∧ p.finish = a := by
        rcases hends with h | h
        · exact (hdir h).elim
        · exact h
      simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using this.1
  have hd' : Disjoint p'.support q.support := by
    rw [hp', hq]
    exact hdisj
  have hfwd : G.Adj p'.finish q.start := by
    rw [hp'finish, qst]
    exact hb'.2.symm
  have hback : G.Adj q.finish p'.start := by
    rw [qfin, hp'start]
    exact ha'.2
  have h3' : 3 ≤ (p'.support ∪ q.support).card := by
    rw [hp', hq]
    exact three_le_union_card cH cD hdisj
  have hspan :
      (GraphPath.assembleTwo p' q hd' hfwd hback h3').support =
        cH.support ∪ cD.support := by
    simp [GraphPath.support_assembleTwo, hp', hq]
  exact hnoC _ hspan

name: Nikoghosyan.no_spanning_of_succAt
statement:
lemma no_spanning_of_succAt
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    {u : V} (hu : u ∈ cD.support) :
    ∀ a ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u,
      ∀ b ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu),
        ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) cH.support a b
proof:
:=
  fun a ha b hb =>
    not_spanningPathCompatible_of_no_union_cycle cH cD hdisj hnoC hu ha hb

name: Nikoghosyan.adjacent_rows_incompatible
statement:
lemma adjacent_rows_incompatible
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    {u : V} (hu : u ∈ cD.support)
    (hSat : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u) ∨
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu))) :
    Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u) ∧
      Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu)) ∧
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u) =
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu))
proof:
:= by
  set A := rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u
  set B := rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu)
  have hAne := rowProfile_nonempty_of_not_cograph cH cD hdisj hH hpat hu
  have hBne :=
    rowProfile_nonempty_of_not_cograph cH cD hdisj hH hpat
      (cD.succAt_mem_support hu)
  have hKA := isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_of_pair cH cD hdisj hpat hu
  have hKB := isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_of_pair cH cD hdisj hpat
    (cD.succAt_mem_support hu)
  have hno := no_spanning_of_succAt cH cD hdisj hnoC hu
  have hinc :=
    Cograph.incompatible_saturated_profiles (G := G) cH rfl
      (rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support u) hAne hKA
      (rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support (cD.succAt hu)) hBne hKB
      hSat hno
  exact ⟨hinc.2.1, hinc.2.2.1, hinc.2.2.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.saturated_getVert_of_start
statement:
lemma saturated_getVert_of_start
    (cH c0 : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support c0.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ c0.support)
    (hSat0 : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support c0.start))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ c0.walk.length) :
    Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (c0.walk.getVert i)) ∧
      Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (c0.walk.getVert i)) =
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support c0.start)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [Walk.getVert_zero] using
      (And.intro hSat0 (rfl :
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support c0.start) =
          Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support c0.start)))
  | succ i ih =>
    have hi0 : i ≤ c0.walk.length := Nat.le_of_succ_le hi
    have hi0lt : i < c0.walk.length := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi
    obtain ⟨hSati, hconti⟩ := ih hi0
    have hu_i : c0.walk.getVert i ∈ c0.support :=
      getVert_mem_cycle_support c0 i
    have hinc :=
      adjacent_rows_incompatible cH c0 hdisj hH hpat hnoC hu_i (Or.inl hSati)
    have hsucc := succAt_eq_getVert_succ c0 hi0lt
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [hsucc] using hinc.2.1
    · simpa [hsucc, hconti] using hinc.2.2.symm.trans hconti

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_common_canonical_container
statement:
lemma exists_common_canonical_container
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    {u : V} (hu : u ∈ cD.support)
    (hSat0 : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u)) :
    ∃ S : Finset V,
      Cograph.Tight (G := G) cH.support S ∧
        S ⊂ cH.support ∧
          (∀ v ∈ cD.support,
            Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
                (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
              Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                  (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) = S ∧
                rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v ⊆ S) ∧
            (∀ x ∈ cH.support, ∀ y ∈ cD.support, G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  set A0 := rowProfile (G := G) cH.support u
  have hA0ne := rowProfile_nonempty_of_not_cograph cH cD hdisj hH hpat hu
  have hK0 := isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_of_pair cH cD hdisj hpat hu
  have hspec :=
    Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical (G := G)
      (rowProfile_subset (G := G) cH.support u) hA0ne hK0 hSat0
  set S := Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support A0
  let c0 := cD.rotateTo hu
  have hdisj0 : Disjoint cH.support c0.support := by
    simpa [c0, GraphCycle.support_rotateTo] using hdisj
  have hnoC0 : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ c0.support := by
    simpa [c0, GraphCycle.support_rotateTo] using hnoC
  have hSat00 : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support c0.start) := by
    simpa [c0, GraphCycle.start_rotateTo] using hSat0
  refine ⟨S, hspec.1, hspec.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hvi⟩ := exists_getVert_lt_length_of_mem_support (x := v)
      (cD.rotateTo hu) (by simpa [GraphCycle.support_rotateTo] using hv)
    have hiLe : i ≤ (cD.rotateTo hu).walk.length := hi.le
    have hprop :=
      saturated_getVert_of_start cH c0 hdisj0 hH hpat hnoC0 hSat00 i hiLe
    have hSatv : Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) := by
      simpa [c0, hvi] using hprop.1
    have hcont : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) = S := by
      have heq := hprop.2
      change Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support ((cD.rotateTo hu).walk.getVert i)) =
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.rotateTo hu).start) at heq
      rw [hvi, GraphCycle.start_rotateTo] at heq
      exact heq
    refine ⟨hSatv, hcont, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hxS : x ∈ Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) :=
      Cograph.mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A hx
    simpa [hcont] using hxS
  · intro x hx y hy hadj
    have hxA : x ∈ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y :=
      (mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hx, hadj.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hvi⟩ := exists_getVert_lt_length_of_mem_support (x := y)
      (cD.rotateTo hu) (by simpa [GraphCycle.support_rotateTo] using hy)
    have hiLe : i ≤ (cD.rotateTo hu).walk.length := hi.le
    have hprop :=
      saturated_getVert_of_start cH c0 hdisj0 hH hpat hnoC0 hSat00 i hiLe
    have hcont : Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) = S := by
      have heq := hprop.2
      change Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support ((cD.rotateTo hu).walk.getVert i)) =
        Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support (cD.rotateTo hu).start) at heq
      rw [hvi, GraphCycle.start_rotateTo] at heq
      exact heq
    have hxS : x ∈ Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support y) :=
      Cograph.mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A hxA
    simpa [hcont] using hxS

name: Nikoghosyan.pair_profile_dichotomy
statement:
theorem pair_profile_dichotomy
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support) :
    (∀ v ∈ cD.support,
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
          IsCograph G
              (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
            pathCoverNumber G
                (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card) ∨
      ∃ S : Finset V,
        Cograph.Tight (G := G) cH.support S ∧
          S ⊂ cH.support ∧
            (∀ v ∈ cD.support,
              (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
                IsCograph G
                    (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
                  Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
                    (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
                    Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G) cH.support
                        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) = S ∧
                      rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v ⊆ S) ∧
              (∀ x ∈ cH.support, ∀ y ∈ cD.support, G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : ∀ v ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) :=
    fun v hv =>
      ⟨rowProfile_nonempty_of_not_cograph cH cD hdisj hH hpat hv,
        isCograph_sdiff_rowProfile_of_pair cH cD hdisj hpat hv⟩
  by_cases hsome :
      ∃ v ∈ cD.support,
        Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v)
  · obtain ⟨u, hu, hSatu⟩ := hsome
    obtain ⟨S, hT, hproper, hrows, hatt⟩ :=
      exists_common_canonical_container cH cD hdisj hH hpat hnoC hu hSatu
    refine Or.inr ⟨S, hT, hproper, ?_, hatt⟩
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hSatv, hcont, hsub⟩ := hrows v hv
    exact ⟨(hrow v hv).1, (hrow v hv).2, hSatv, hcont, hsub⟩
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    intro v hv
    have hnot : ¬ Cograph.Saturated (G := G) cH.support
        (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) := fun hSat => hsome ⟨v, hv, hSat⟩
    exact ⟨(hrow v hv).1, (hrow v hv).2,
      strict_of_not_saturated cH (hrow v hv).1 hnot⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.not_exists_union_cycle_of_min
statement:
lemma not_exists_union_cycle_of_min (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (C : GraphCycle G)
    (hspan : C.support =
      (F.getCycle i).support ∪ (F.getCycle j).support) : False
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 ≤ ({i, j} : Finset (Fin F.card)).card := by
    simp [card_pair hij]
  have hsel := F.selectedSupport_pair (i := i) (j := j)
  exact F.not_exists_merge_of_min hmin {i, j} h2 C (hspan.trans hsel.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.pair_profile_dichotomy_of_min
statement:
theorem pair_profile_dichotomy_of_min (F : CycleFactor G)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : CycleFactor G, F.card ≤ F'.card)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {i j : Fin F.card} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G (F.getCycle i).support) :
    (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
          IsCograph G
              ((F.getCycle i).support \
                rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
            pathCoverNumber G
                ((F.getCycle i).support \
                  rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) <
              (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).card) ∨
      ∃ S : Finset V,
        Cograph.Tight (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support S ∧
          S ⊂ (F.getCycle i).support ∧
            (∀ v ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
              (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v).Nonempty ∧
                IsCograph G
                    ((F.getCycle i).support \
                      rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                  Cograph.Saturated (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support
                    (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) ∧
                    Cograph.canonicalContainer (G := G)
                        (F.getCycle i).support
                        (rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v) =
                      S ∧
                      rowProfile (G := G) (F.getCycle i).support v ⊆ S) ∧
              (∀ x ∈ (F.getCycle i).support, ∀ y ∈ (F.getCycle j).support,
                G.Adj x y → x ∈ S)
proof:
:=
  pair_profile_dichotomy (F.getCycle i) (F.getCycle j)
    (F.disjoint_getCycle hij) hH hpat
    (fun C hC => not_exists_union_cycle_of_min F hmin hij C hC)

name: Nikoghosyan.univ_sdiff_eq_union_of_spanning
proof:
:= by
  have hDS : Disjoint D S := hdisj.symm.mono_right hS
  have hD : D \ S = D := sdiff_eq_self_iff_disjoint.2 hDS
  calc
    univ \ S = (H ∪ D) \ S := by rw [hHD]
    _ = (H \ S) ∪ (D \ S) := union_sdiff_distrib _ _ _
    _ = (H \ S) ∪ D := by rw [hD]

name: Nikoghosyan.componentCount_host_delete_eq_add_one
statement:
lemma componentCount_host_delete_eq_add_one
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    {S : Finset V} (hS : S ⊆ cH.support)
    (hnocross : ∀ x ∈ cH.support \ S, ∀ y ∈ cD.support, ¬ G.Adj x y) :
    componentCount G ((cH.support \ S) ∪ cD.support) =
      componentCount G (cH.support \ S) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj' : Disjoint (cH.support \ S) cD.support :=
    hdisj.mono_left sdiff_subset
  have hnc : ∀ a ∈ cH.support \ S, ∀ b ∈ cD.support, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
    hnocross
  rw [Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross (G := G) hdisj' hnc,
    componentCount_cycle_eq_one cD]

name: Nikoghosyan.not_common_container_of_spanning_oneTough
statement:
theorem not_common_container_of_spanning_oneTough
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHD : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ)
    (hT : OneTough G)
    {S : Finset V}
    (hS : S ⊆ cH.support)
    (hTight : componentCount G (cH.support \ S) = S.card)
    (hproper : S ⊂ cH.support)
    (hrows : ∀ v ∈ cD.support, rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v ⊆ S) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hnocross : ∀ x ∈ cH.support \ S, ∀ y ∈ cD.support, ¬ G.Adj x y := by
    intro x hx y hy hadj
    have hxS : x ∈ S := hrows y hy
      ((mem_rowProfile_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨(mem_sdiff.1 hx).1, hadj.symm⟩)
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2 hxS
  have hrem := univ_sdiff_eq_union_of_spanning hHD hS hdisj
  have hcount :=
    componentCount_host_delete_eq_add_one cH cD hdisj hS hnocross
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hempty
    have hSempty : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
    simp [hSempty, componentCount_cycle_eq_one cH] at hTight
  have h2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (univ \ S) := by
    have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hSne)
    simpa [hrem, hcount, hTight] using Nat.succ_le_succ hpos
  have hle := hT S (by simpa [hrem] using h2)
  have hEq : componentCount G (univ \ S) = S.card + 1 := by
    simpa [hrem, hcount, hTight]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.all_rows_strict_of_spanning_oneTough
statement:
theorem all_rows_strict_of_spanning_oneTough
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support)
    (hHD : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ)
    (hT : OneTough G) :
    ∀ v ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G
            (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
          pathCoverNumber G
              (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card
proof:
:= by
  rcases pair_profile_dichotomy cH cD hdisj hH hpat hnoC with hstrict | hsat
  · exact hstrict
  · obtain ⟨S, hTgt, hproper, hrows, _hatt⟩ := hsat
    have hsub : ∀ v ∈ cD.support,
        rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v ⊆ S :=
      fun v hv => (hrows v hv).2.2.2.2
    exact (not_common_container_of_spanning_oneTough cH cD hdisj hHD hT
      hTgt.1 hTgt.2 hproper hsub).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_of_all_rows_strict
statement:
theorem oneToughOn_of_all_rows_strict
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hstrict : ∀ v ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        pathCoverNumber G
            (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card) :
    OneToughOn G (cH.support ∪ cD.support)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _⟩ := exists_path_open_succ cD cD.start_mem_support
  have hrow : ∀ v ∈ r.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        NoTightContainer G cH.support
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hvD : v ∈ cD.support := by simpa [hr] using hv
    have hAne := (hstrict v hvD).1
    have hlt := (hstrict v hvD).2
    refine ⟨hAne, ?_⟩
    exact (noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover_of_host cH r
      (by simpa [hr] using hdisj) (by simpa [hr] using hvD) hAne hpat).2 hlt
  simpa [hr] using
    oneToughOn_of_traceable_extension cH r (by simpa [hr] using hdisj) hrow

name: Nikoghosyan.oneToughOn_of_traceable_subset_of_strict_rows
statement:
theorem oneToughOn_of_traceable_subset_of_strict_rows
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    (hstrict : ∀ v ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        pathCoverNumber G
            (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
          (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card)
    (r : GraphPath G) (hR : r.support ⊆ cD.support) :
    OneToughOn G (cH.support ∪ r.support)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Disjoint cH.support r.support := hdisj.mono_right hR
  apply oneToughOn_of_traceable_extension cH r hd
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hAne, hlt⟩ := hstrict v (hR hv)
  exact ⟨hAne,
    (noTightContainer_iff_strict_pathCover_of_host cH r hd hv hAne hpat).2 hlt⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.strict_profiles_of_spanning_two_cycles
statement:
theorem strict_profiles_of_spanning_two_cycles
    (cH cD : GraphCycle G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint cH.support cD.support)
    (hHD : cH.support ∪ cD.support = univ)
    (hH : ¬ IsCograph G cH.support)
    (hpat : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (hT : OneTough G)
    (hNonHam : ¬ G.IsHamiltonian) :
    (∀ v ∈ cD.support,
      (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).Nonempty ∧
        IsCograph G (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) ∧
          pathCoverNumber G
              (cH.support \ rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v) <
            (rowProfile (G := G) cH.support v).card) ∧
      ∀ r : GraphPath G, r.support ⊆ cD.support →
        OneToughOn G (cH.support ∪ r.support)
proof:
:= by
  have hord : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V := cH.three_le_card_support.trans
    (by simpa using card_le_card (subset_univ cH.support))
  have hnoC : ∀ C : GraphCycle G,
      C.support ≠ cH.support ∪ cD.support := by
    intro C hC
    exact hNonHam ((isHamiltonian_iff_exists_spanning_graphCycle hord).2
      ⟨C, hC.trans hHD⟩)
  have hs := all_rows_strict_of_spanning_oneTough cH cD hdisj hH hpat hnoC hHD hT
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  intro r hR
  exact oneToughOn_of_traceable_subset_of_strict_rows cH cD hdisj hpat
    (fun v hv => ⟨(hs v hv).1, (hs v hv).2.2⟩) r hR

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_dNonadjClass_iff
statement:
lemma mem_dNonadjClass_iff {U : Finset V} {x y : V} :
    y ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x ↔
      y ∈ eligibleSet G U ∧ ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) U x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [dNonadjClass]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_subset_eligible
statement:
lemma dNonadjClass_subset_eligible (U : Finset V) (x : V) :
    dNonadjClass (G := G) U x ⊆ eligibleSet G U
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_DistinctPathCompatible_self
statement:
lemma not_DistinctPathCompatible_self (U : Finset V) (x : V) :
    ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) U x x
proof: := fun h => h.1 rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_dNonadjClass_self
proof:
:=
  mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hx, not_DistinctPathCompatible_self (G := G) U x⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_symm
statement:
lemma dNonadjClass_symm {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U)
    (h : y ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) :
    x ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) U y
proof:
:= by
  have hy := mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 h
  exact mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hx, fun hD => hy.2 (DistinctPathCompatible.symm hD)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_trans
statement:
lemma dNonadjClass_trans {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U) {x y z : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) (hy : y ∈ eligibleSet G U)
    (hz : z ∈ eligibleSet G U)
    (hxy : y ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x)
    (hyz : z ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) U y) :
    z ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x
proof:
:= by
  have hxy' := (mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hxy).2
  have hyz' := (mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hyz).2
  exact mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2
    ⟨hz, not_DistinctPathCompatible_trans_of_cotreeOn hU hx hy hz hxy' hyz'⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_eq_eligible_of_le_one
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact (mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hy).1
  · intro hy
    exact mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2
      ⟨hy, not_DistinctPathCompatible_of_le_one (G := G) hp⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_disjoint_union_left
statement:
lemma dNonadjClass_disjoint_union_left {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G A) :
    dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x = dNonadjClass (G := G) A x
proof:
:= by
  have hEU := eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hyU := mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hy
    have hyE : y ∈ eligibleSet G A ∪ eligibleSet G B := by
      rw [← hEU]; exact hyU.1
    rcases mem_union.1 hyE with hyA | hyB
    · refine mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hyA, ?_⟩
      intro hD
      exact hyU.2 (DistinctPathCompatible_union_left hdisj hnocross hD)
    · exact (hyU.2 (DistinctPathCompatible_union_cross hdisj hnocross
        (eligible_mem_of_mem_eligibleSet hx)
        (eligible_mem_of_mem_eligibleSet hyB))).elim
  · intro hy
    have hyA := mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hy
    have hyU : y ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
      rw [hEU]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hyA.1)
    refine mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hyU, ?_⟩
    intro hD
    exact hyA.2 (DistinctPathCompatible_union_of_left hdisj hnocross
      (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hx)
      (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hyA.1) hD)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_disjoint_union_right
statement:
lemma dNonadjClass_disjoint_union_right {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G B) :
    dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x = dNonadjClass (G := G) B x
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj' : Disjoint B A := hdisj.symm
  have hnocross' : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj b a := fun b hb a ha hab =>
    hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm
  have h := dNonadjClass_disjoint_union_left (G := G) hdisj' hnocross' hx
  simpa [union_comm] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dNonadjClass_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma dNonadjClass_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B))
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G A) :
    dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x = dNonadjClass (G := G) A x
proof:
:= by
  have hE := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hyU := mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hy
    have hyA : y ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rw [← hE]; exact hyU.1
    refine mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hyA, ?_⟩
    intro hD
    exact hyU.2
      ((DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
        hAne hBne hAB hdom hq).2 hD)
  · intro hy
    have hyA := mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hy
    have hyU : y ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by rw [hE]; exact hyA.1
    refine mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hyU, ?_⟩
    intro hD
    exact hyA.2
      ((DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
        hAne hBne hAB hdom hq).1 hD)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inOneComponent_mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hW, hreach⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hW.trans hAB, ?_⟩
  intro a b ha hb
  exact (hreach ha hb).map (induceIncl G hAB)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.reachable_of_mem_graphPath
statement:
lemma reachable_of_mem_graphPath {U : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G)
    (hsub : p.support ⊆ U) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hy : y ∈ p.support) :
    (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x, hsub hx⟩ ⟨y, hsub hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hxw : x ∈ p.walk.support := GraphPath.mem_walk_support.1 hx
  have hyw : y ∈ p.walk.support := GraphPath.mem_walk_support.1 hy
  have hstartx :
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨p.start, hsub p.start_mem_support⟩ ⟨x, hsub hx⟩ := by
    let w := p.walk.takeUntil x hxw
    have hwU : ∀ a ∈ w.support, a ∈ (U : Set V) := fun a ha =>
      hsub (List.mem_toFinset.2
        (Walk.support_takeUntil_subset_support p.walk hxw ha))
    exact ⟨w.induce (U : Set V) hwU⟩
  have hstarty :
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨p.start, hsub p.start_mem_support⟩ ⟨y, hsub hy⟩ := by
    let w := p.walk.takeUntil y hyw
    have hwU : ∀ a ∈ w.support, a ∈ (U : Set V) := fun a ha =>
      hsub (List.mem_toFinset.2
        (Walk.support_takeUntil_subset_support p.walk hyw ha))
    exact ⟨w.induce (U : Set V) hwU⟩
  exact hstartx.symm.trans hstarty

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
  have hlen : pc.paths.length = 1 := by
    simpa [PathCover.card] using hpc.trans h
  match hps : pc.paths with
  | [] =>
    simp [hps] at hlen
  | [p] =>
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact pc.support_subset (by simp [hps]) hx
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
      simp [hps] at hq
      simpa [hq] using hxq
  | _ :: _ :: _ =>
    have : 2 ≤ pc.paths.length := by simp [hps]
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.connected_of_spanning_path
proof:
:= by
  have hne : U.Nonempty := by
    rw [← hp]; exact p.support_nonempty
  haveI : Nonempty (U : Set V) := hne.to_subtype
  refine (connected_iff _).2 ⟨?_, inferInstance⟩
  intro a b
  have ha : a.val ∈ p.support := by simpa [hp] using a.property
  have hb : b.val ∈ p.support := by simpa [hp] using b.property
  have hsub : p.support ⊆ U := by simp [hp]
  have hR := reachable_of_mem_graphPath (U := U) p hsub ha hb
  have ha' : (⟨a.val, hsub ha⟩ : (U : Set V)) = a := Subtype.ext rfl
  have hb' : (⟨b.val, hsub hb⟩ : (U : Set V)) = b := Subtype.ext rfl
  simpa [ha', hb'] using hR

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inOneComponent_of_connected
statement:
lemma inOneComponent_of_connected {U W : Finset V}
    (hW : W ⊆ U) (hU : U.Nonempty)
    (hc : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected) :
    InOneComponent (G := G) U W
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hW, ?_⟩
  intro a b ha hb
  haveI : Nonempty (U : Set V) := hU.to_subtype
  have hpre : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Preconnected :=
    ((connected_iff (G.induce (U : Set V))).1 hc).1
  exact hpre ⟨a, hW ha⟩ ⟨b, hW hb⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_mem_eligible
proof:
:=
  one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G)
    ⟨x, eligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_union_right_ineligible
statement:
lemma sdiff_union_right_ineligible {A B S : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hS : S ⊆ A) :
    (A ∪ B) \ (S ∪ ineligibleSet G B) =
      (A \ S) ∪ (B \ ineligibleSet G B)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzU : z ∈ A ∪ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzN : z ∉ S ∪ ineligibleSet G B := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    rcases mem_union.1 hzU with hzA | hzB
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzA, fun hS' =>
        hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hS'))⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzB, fun hF =>
        hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hF))⟩))
  · intro hz
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzA | hzB
    · have hzA' : z ∈ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hzA).1
      have hzS : z ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hzA).2
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA'), ?_⟩
      intro h
      rcases mem_union.1 h with hS | hF
      · exact hzS hS
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzA'
          (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hF)
    · have hzB' : z ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hzB).1
      have hzF : z ∉ ineligibleSet G B := (mem_sdiff.1 hzB).2
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzB'), ?_⟩
      intro h
      rcases mem_union.1 h with hSz | hF
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hS hSz) hzB'
      · exact hzF hF

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.part_remainder_union_left
statement:
lemma part_remainder_union_left {A B S : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hS : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G A)
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G A) :
    (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x) \
        (S ∪ ineligibleSet G B) =
      (ineligibleSet G A ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ S
proof:
:= by
  have hF := ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
  have hP := dNonadjClass_disjoint_union_left (G := G) hdisj hnocross hx
  have hPA : dNonadjClass (G := G) A x ⊆ A :=
    (dNonadjClass_subset_eligible (G := G) A x).trans
      (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A)
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzL := mem_sdiff.1 hz
    have hzN : z ∉ S ∪ ineligibleSet G B := hzL.2
    have hzS : z ∉ S := fun h => hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inl h))
    have hzFB : z ∉ ineligibleSet G B := fun h => hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inr h))
    rcases mem_union.1 hzL.1 with hzF | hzP
    · have hzF' : z ∈ ineligibleSet G A ∪ ineligibleSet G B := by rwa [hF] at hzF
      rcases mem_union.1 hzF' with hzA | hzB
      · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA), hzS⟩
      · exact (hzFB hzB).elim
    · have hzP' : z ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x := by rwa [hP] at hzP
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzP'), hzS⟩
  · intro hz
    have hzL := mem_sdiff.1 hz
    have hzS : z ∉ S := hzL.2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases mem_union.1 hzL.1 with hzA | hzP
      · rw [hF]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA)))
      · rw [hP]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzP)
    · intro h
      rcases mem_union.1 h with hS | hF
      · exact hzS hS
      · rcases mem_union.1 hzL.1 with hzA | hzP
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
            (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hzA)
            (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hF)
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hPA hzP)
            (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hF)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_union_dominant
statement:
lemma sdiff_union_dominant {A B S : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hS : S ⊆ A) :
    (A ∪ B) \ (B ∪ S) = A \ S
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzU : z ∈ A ∪ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzN : z ∉ B ∪ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    have hzB : z ∉ B := fun h => hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inl h))
    have hzS : z ∉ S := fun h => hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inr h))
    have hzA : z ∈ A := (mem_union.1 hzU).resolve_right hzB
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzA, hzS⟩
  · intro hz
    have hzA : z ∈ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzS : z ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA), ?_⟩
    intro h
    rcases mem_union.1 h with hzB | hS
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzA hzB
    · exact hzS hS

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.part_remainder_dominant
statement:
lemma part_remainder_dominant {A B S : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B))
    (hS : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G A)
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G A) :
    (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x) \ (B ∪ S) =
      (ineligibleSet G A ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ S
proof:
:= by
  have hF := ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  have hP := dNonadjClass_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hq hx
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hPA : dNonadjClass (G := G) A x ⊆ A :=
    (dNonadjClass_subset_eligible (G := G) A x).trans
      (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A)
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzL := mem_sdiff.1 hz
    have hzN : z ∉ B ∪ S := hzL.2
    have hzB : z ∉ B := fun h => hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inl h))
    have hzS : z ∉ S := fun h => hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inr h))
    rcases mem_union.1 hzL.1 with hzF | hzP
    · have hzF' : z ∈ B ∪ ineligibleSet G A := by rwa [hF] at hzF
      rcases mem_union.1 hzF' with hzB' | hzA
      · exact (hzB hzB').elim
      · exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA), hzS⟩
    · have hzP' : z ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x := by rwa [hP] at hzP
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzP'), hzS⟩
  · intro hz
    have hzL := mem_sdiff.1 hz
    have hzS : z ∉ S := hzL.2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases mem_union.1 hzL.1 with hzA | hzP
      · rw [hF]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzA)))
      · rw [hP]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzP)
    · intro h
      rcases mem_union.1 h with hzB | hS
      · rcases mem_union.1 hzL.1 with hzA | hzP
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
            (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hzA) hzB
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hPA hzP) hzB
      · exact hzS hS

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_partCut_of_eq_one
statement:
lemma exists_partCut_of_eq_one {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) (hp : pathCoverNumber G U = 1) :
    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G U ∧
      componentCount G (U \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G U ∧
      InOneComponent (G := G) (U \ S)
        ((ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∅, empty_subset _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [hp]
    obtain ⟨p, hpU⟩ := exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hp
    have hc := connected_of_spanning_path p hpU
    have hne : U.Nonempty := ⟨x, eligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hx⟩
    exact componentCount_eq_one_of_connected hne hc
  · obtain ⟨p, hpU⟩ := exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hp
    have hW :
        (ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ ∅ = U := by
      have hP := dNonadjClass_eq_eligible_of_le_one (G := G)
        (by omega : pathCoverNumber G U ≤ 1) hx
      rw [sdiff_empty, hP, union_comm, eligibleSet_union_ineligibleSet]
    simpa [hW] using
      inOneComponent_of_connected (W := U) (subset_refl _)
        ⟨x, eligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hx⟩
        (connected_of_spanning_path p hpU)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_partCut_of_cotreeOn
statement:
lemma exists_partCut_of_cotreeOn {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) :
