    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G U ∧
      componentCount G (U \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G U ∧
      InOneComponent (G := G) (U \ S)
        ((ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S)
proof:
:= by
  induction hU generalizing x with
  | empty =>
    exact (notMem_empty x (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) ∅ hx)).elim
  | singleton v =>
    have hx' : x = v :=
      mem_singleton.1 ((eligibleSet_subset (G := G) {v}) hx)
    refine ⟨∅, empty_subset _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [ineligibleSet_singleton, pathCoverNumber_singleton,
        componentCount_singleton]
    · have hP : dNonadjClass (G := G) {v} x = {v} := by
        have : pathCoverNumber G {v} ≤ 1 := by
          simp [pathCoverNumber_singleton]
        simpa [hx', eligibleSet_singleton] using
          dNonadjClass_eq_eligible_of_le_one (G := G) this
            (by simpa [hx'] using hx)
      have hW :
          (ineligibleSet G {v} ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) {v} x) \ ∅ = {v} := by
        simp [ineligibleSet_singleton, hP]
      refine ⟨by simp [hW], ?_⟩
      intro a b ha hb
      simp [hW] at ha hb
      subst ha; subst hb
      exact Reachable.rfl
  | disjointUnion hdisj hnocross hA hB ihA ihB =>
    rename_i A B
    have hpU := pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
    by_cases hp1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ 1
    · have hp : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 :=
        le_antisymm hp1 (one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_mem_eligible hx)
      exact exists_partCut_of_eq_one hx hp
    · have hEU := eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
      have hxU : x ∈ eligibleSet G A ∪ eligibleSet G B := by rwa [← hEU]
      rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxA | hxB
      · obtain ⟨SA, hSA, hcutA, hcompA⟩ := ihA hxA
        let S := SA ∪ ineligibleSet G B
        have hS : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
          intro z hz
          have hF := ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzA | hzB
          · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hSA hzA))
          · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzB)
        have hrem := sdiff_union_right_ineligible (G := G) hdisj
          (hSA.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A))
        have hdisjRem :
            Disjoint (A \ SA) (B \ ineligibleSet G B) :=
          disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset
            (disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset hdisj)
        have hnocrossRem :
            ∀ a ∈ A \ SA, ∀ b ∈ B \ ineligibleSet G B, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
          fun a ha b hb =>
            hnocross a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 b (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
        have hadd :=
          componentCount_union_of_no_cross hdisjRem hnocrossRem
        have hFB := componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq hB
        have hcard : S.card = SA.card + (ineligibleSet G B).card := by
          have hdisjS :
              Disjoint SA (ineligibleSet G B) :=
            disjoint_of_subset_left (hSA.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A))
              (disjoint_of_subset_right (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B) hdisj)
          exact card_union_of_disjoint hdisjS
        refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hrem, hadd, hcutA, hFB, hcard, hpU]
          omega
        · have hW :=
            part_remainder_union_left (G := G) hdisj hnocross hSA hxA
          have hmono := inOneComponent_mono
            (A := A \ SA) (B := (A ∪ B) \ S)
            (by intro z hz; rw [hrem]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz))
            hcompA
          exact hW ▸ hmono
      · obtain ⟨SB, hSB, hcutB, hcompB⟩ := ihB hxB
        let S := SB ∪ ineligibleSet G A
        have hdisj' : Disjoint B A := hdisj.symm
        have hnocross' : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj b a :=
          fun b hb a ha hab => hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm
        have hS : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
          intro z hz
          have hF := ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzB | hzA
          · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inr (hSB hzB))
          · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA)
        have hrem : (A ∪ B) \ S =
            (B \ SB) ∪ (A \ ineligibleSet G A) := by
          have h := sdiff_union_right_ineligible (G := G) hdisj'
            (hSB.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B))
          simpa [union_comm, S] using h
        have hdisjRem :
            Disjoint (B \ SB) (A \ ineligibleSet G A) :=
          disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset
            (disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset hdisj')
        have hnocrossRem :
            ∀ b ∈ B \ SB, ∀ a ∈ A \ ineligibleSet G A, ¬ G.Adj b a :=
          fun b hb a ha =>
            hnocross' b (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1 a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1
        have hadd :=
          componentCount_union_of_no_cross hdisjRem hnocrossRem
        have hFA := componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq hA
        have hcard : S.card = SB.card + (ineligibleSet G A).card := by
          have hdisjS :
              Disjoint SB (ineligibleSet G A) :=
            disjoint_of_subset_left (hSB.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B))
              (disjoint_of_subset_right (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A) hdisj')
          exact card_union_of_disjoint hdisjS
        refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hrem, hadd, hcutB, hFA, hcard, hpU]
          omega
        · have hW :
              (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x) \ S =
                (ineligibleSet G B ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) B x) \ SB := by
            have h := part_remainder_union_left (G := G) hdisj' hnocross'
              hSB hxB
            simpa [union_comm, S] using h
          have hmono := inOneComponent_mono
            (A := B \ SB) (B := (A ∪ B) \ S)
            (by intro z hz; rw [hrem]; exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz))
            hcompB
          exact hW ▸ hmono
  | completeJoin hAne hBne hAB hA hB ihA ihB =>
    rename_i A B
    by_cases hp1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ 1
    · have hp : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 :=
        le_antisymm hp1 (one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_mem_eligible hx)
      exact exists_partCut_of_eq_one hx hp
    · have hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by omega
      by_cases hAdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A
      · have hE := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
        have hxA : x ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rwa [← hE]
        obtain ⟨SA, hSA, hcutA, hcompA⟩ := ihA hxA
        let S := B ∪ SA
        have hS : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
          intro z hz
          have hF := ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzB | hzA
          · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzB)
          · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inr (hSA hzA))
        have hrem := sdiff_union_dominant hAB
          (hSA.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A))
        have hcard : S.card = B.card + SA.card := by
          have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
          have hdisjS : Disjoint B SA :=
            disjoint_of_subset_right
              (hSA.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A)) hdisj.symm
          exact card_union_of_disjoint hdisjS
        have hpadd := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
        refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hrem, hcutA, hcard, hpadd]
          omega
        · have hW :=
            part_remainder_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom hq hSA hxA
          have hmono := inOneComponent_mono
            (A := A \ SA) (B := (A ∪ B) \ S)
            (by intro z hz; rw [hrem]; exact hz)
            hcompA
          exact hW ▸ hmono
      · by_cases hBdom : A.card < pathCoverNumber G B
        · have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (A : Set V) :=
            fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
          have hqB : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (B ∪ A) := by
            simpa [union_comm] using hq
          have hE : eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = eligibleSet G B := by
            simpa [union_comm] using
              eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
          have hxB : x ∈ eligibleSet G B := by rwa [← hE]
          obtain ⟨SB, hSB, hcutB, hcompB⟩ := ihB hxB
          let S := A ∪ SB
          have hS : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
            intro z hz
            have hF : ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = A ∪ ineligibleSet G B := by
              simpa [union_comm] using
                ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
            rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzA | hzB
            · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzA)
            · exact hF ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inr (hSB hzB))
          have hrem : (A ∪ B) \ S = B \ SB := by
            have h := sdiff_union_dominant hBA
              (hSB.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B))
            simpa [union_comm, S] using h
          have hcard : S.card = A.card + SB.card := by
            have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hBA
            have hdisjS : Disjoint A SB :=
              disjoint_of_subset_right
                (hSB.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B)) hdisj.symm
            exact card_union_of_disjoint hdisjS
          have hpadd : pathCoverNumber G B =
              pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) + A.card := by
            simpa [union_comm] using
              pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
          refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hrem, hcutB, hcard, hpadd]
            omega
          · have hW :
                (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪
                    dNonadjClass (G := G) (A ∪ B) x) \ S =
                  (ineligibleSet G B ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) B x) \ SB := by
              have h := part_remainder_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom hqB hSB hxB
              simpa [union_comm, S] using h
            have hmono := inOneComponent_mono
              (A := B \ SB) (B := (A ∪ B) \ S)
              (by intro z hz; rw [hrem]; exact hz)
              hcompB
            exact hW ▸ hmono
        · have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hAdom
          have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hBdom
          have hp := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hAne hBne hAB
          have hmax :
              max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
                (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) = 1 := by
            simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpA, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpB]
          have hp1' : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 := hp.trans hmax
          exact (hp1 (by omega)).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_partCut_of_isCograph
statement:
lemma exists_partCut_of_isCograph {U : Finset V} (hU : IsCograph G U) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) :
    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G U ∧
      componentCount G (U \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G U ∧
      InOneComponent (G := G) (U \ S)
        ((ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S)
proof:
:=
  exists_partCut_of_cotreeOn (cotreeOn_of_isCograph hU) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_partCut_of_canonical
statement:
lemma exists_partCut_of_canonical {U : Finset V}
    (hU : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G U) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) :
    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G U ∧
      componentCount G (U \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G U ∧
      InOneComponent (G := G) (U \ S)
        ((ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S)
proof:
:=
  exists_partCut_of_isCograph (isCograph_iff.2 hU) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_component_of_inOneComponent
statement:
lemma exists_component_of_inOneComponent {U W : Finset V}
    (hWne : W.Nonempty) (h : InOneComponent (G := G) U W) :
    ∃ C : (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
      ∀ y ∈ W, ∃ hy : y ∈ U,
        (G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨y, hy⟩ = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hW, hreach⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hWne
  refine ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x, hW hx⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨hW hy, ConnectedComponent.sound (hreach hy hx)⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_partCut_component_of_canonical
statement:
lemma exists_partCut_component_of_canonical {U : Finset V}
    (hU : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G U) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) :
    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G U ∧
      componentCount G (U \ S) = S.card + pathCoverNumber G U ∧
      ∃ C : (G.induce ((U \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
        ∀ y ∈ (ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S,
          ∃ hy : y ∈ U \ S,
            (G.induce ((U \ S : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
              ⟨y, hy⟩ = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcut, hcomp⟩ := exists_partCut_of_canonical hU hx
  have hWne :
      ((ineligibleSet G U ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) U x) \ S).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨x, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_dNonadjClass_self hx)), ?_⟩⟩
    intro hxS
    have hxF := hS hxS
    exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) U) hx) hxF
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_component_of_inOneComponent hWne hcomp
  exact ⟨S, hS, hcut, C, hC⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCograph_of_cotreeOn
statement: lemma isCograph_of_cotreeOn {U : Finset V} (h : CotreeOn G U) : IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | empty =>
    intro a _ _ _ ha
    exact (Finset.notMem_empty a ha).elim
  | singleton v =>
    intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    have ha' : a = v := Finset.mem_singleton.mp ha
    have hb' : b = v := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hb
    subst ha'
    subst hb'
    exact hp.ne_ab rfl
  | disjointUnion hdisj hnocross hA hB ihA ihB =>
    exact isCograph_union_of_no_cross hnocross ihA ihB
  | completeJoin hAne hBne hAB hA hB ihA ihB =>
    exact isCograph_union_of_complete_join hAB ihA ihB

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cotreeOn_of_isCograph
statement: lemma cotreeOn_of_isCograph {U : Finset V} (hU : IsCograph G U) : CotreeOn G U
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n (W : Finset V), W.card = n → IsCograph G W → CotreeOn G W from
    this U.card U rfl hU
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    intro W hWcard hW
    match n with
    | 0 =>
      have : W = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hWcard
      subst this
      exact CotreeOn.empty
    | 1 =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hWcard
      subst hv
      exact CotreeOn.singleton v
    | n + 2 =>
      have h2 : 2 ≤ W.card := by omega
      by_cases hconn : (G.induce (W : Set V)).Connected
      · obtain ⟨A, B, hAU, hBU, hAne, hBne, -, hcover, hAB, hAcard, hBcard⟩ :=
          exists_complete_join_on (U := W) hW hconn h2
        have hA : CotreeOn G A :=
          ih A.card (by omega) A rfl (isCograph_mono hW hAU)
        have hB : CotreeOn G B :=
          ih B.card (by omega) B rfl (isCograph_mono hW hBU)
        have : CotreeOn G (A ∪ B) :=
          CotreeOn.completeJoin hAne hBne hAB hA hB
        simpa [hcover] using this
      · have hWne : W.Nonempty :=
          Finset.card_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) h2)
        obtain ⟨A, B, hAU, hBU, -, -, hdisj, hcover, hnocross, hAcard, hBcard⟩ :=
          exists_disjoint_union_on (U := W) hconn hWne
        have hA : CotreeOn G A :=
          ih A.card (by omega) A rfl (isCograph_mono hW hAU)
        have hB : CotreeOn G B :=
          ih B.card (by omega) B rfl (isCograph_mono hW hBU)
        have : CotreeOn G (A ∪ B) :=
          CotreeOn.disjointUnion hdisj hnocross hA hB
        simpa [hcover] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cotreeOn_iff_isCograph
statement: lemma cotreeOn_iff_isCograph {U : Finset V} : CotreeOn G U ↔ IsCograph G U
proof:
:=
  ⟨isCograph_of_cotreeOn, cotreeOn_of_isCograph⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cotreeConstructible_iff_isCographGraph
statement:
lemma cotreeConstructible_iff_isCographGraph :
    CotreeConstructible G ↔ IsCographGraph G
proof:
:= by
  rw [CotreeConstructible, cotreeOn_iff_isCograph, isCographGraph_iff_univ]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_critical
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_critical {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1) :
    pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A := by omega
  have h := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_complete_join_critical
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_complete_join_critical {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1) :
    eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = eligibleSet G A
proof:
:=
  eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_complete_join_critical
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_complete_join_critical {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1) :
    ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = B ∪ ineligibleSet G A
proof:
:=
  ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_orientFinish_keepStart
statement:
lemma exists_orientFinish_keepStart {A U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hstart : p.start = x)
    (hy : y = q.start ∨ y = q.finish)
    (hend : ∀ s ∈ pc.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A) :
    ∃ (pc' : PathCover G U) (p' q' : GraphPath G),
      pc'.card = pc.card ∧
        p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ q' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p' ≠ q' ∧
          p'.start = x ∧ q'.finish = y ∧
            (∀ s ∈ pc'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : y = q.finish
  · exact ⟨pc, p, q, rfl, hp, hq, hne, hstart, hf.symm, hend⟩
  · have hs : y = q.start := hy.resolve_right hf
    let r := q.reverse
    have hr : r.support = q.support := GraphPath.support_reverse q
    have hrne : p ≠ r := by
      intro heq
      have hsup : p.support = q.support := by
        simpa [r, hr] using congrArg GraphPath.support heq
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := p.support_nonempty
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
        (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne) hz
        (hsup ▸ hz)
    have hp' : p ∈ (pc.replacePath_sat hq r hr).paths := by
      refine List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, ?_⟩))
      exact decide_eq_true hne
    refine ⟨pc.replacePath_sat hq r hr, p, r,
      pc.replacePath_sat_card hq r hr, hp',
      pc.replacePath_sat_self_mem hq r hr, hrne, hstart, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [r, PathCover.GraphPath.finish_reverse, hs]
    · intro s hs'
      rcases pc.replacePath_sat_mem_paths hq r hr hs' with hsr | ⟨hspc, _⟩
      · subst hsr
        rw [PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse, PathCover.GraphPath.finish_reverse]
        exact ⟨(hend q hq).2, (hend q hq).1⟩
      · exact hend s hspc

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.insert_eq_of_sdiff_singleton
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rcases mem_insert.1 hz with rfl | hzS
    · exact (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
    · exact hS hzS
  · intro hzB
    by_cases hzS : z ∈ S
    · exact mem_insert_of_mem hzS
    · have hzBS : z ∈ B \ S := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzB, hzS⟩
      have huniq := (card_eq_one.1 hcard)
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := huniq
      have hb' : b = w := mem_singleton.1 (hw ▸ hb)
      have hz' : z = w := mem_singleton.1 (hw ▸ hzBS)
      simpa [hz'.trans hb'.symm] using mem_insert_self b S

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.support_union_of_two
statement:
lemma support_union_of_two {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hcard : pc.card = 2) :
    p.support ∪ q.support = U
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : pc.paths.length = 2 := by simpa [PathCover.card] using hcard
  match hps : pc.paths with
  | [] =>
    simp [hps] at hlen
  | [_] =>
    simp [hps] at hlen
  | a :: b :: rest =>
    have hrest : rest = [] := by
      have : rest.length + 2 = 2 := by
        simpa [hps, List.length_cons] using hlen
      exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
    subst hrest
    have hp' : p = a ∨ p = b := by simpa [hps] using hp
    have hq' : q = a ∨ q = b := by simpa [hps] using hq
    have hpair : (p = a ∧ q = b) ∨ (p = b ∧ q = a) := by
      rcases hp' with hp' | hp' <;> rcases hq' with hq' | hq'
      · exact (hne (hp'.trans hq'.symm)).elim
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hp', hq'⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hp', hq'⟩
      · exact (hne (hp'.trans hq'.symm)).elim
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzp | hzq
      · exact pc.support_subset hp hzp
      · exact pc.support_subset hq hzq
    · intro hzU
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hzs⟩ := (pc.mem_iff z).1 hzU
      have hs' : s = a ∨ s = b := by simpa [hps] using hs
      rcases hpair with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rcases hs' with rfl | rfl
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzs)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzs)
      · rcases hs' with rfl | rfl
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzs)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzs)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_last_splice_through
statement:
lemma exists_last_splice_through {A B U : Finset V} {b x y : V}
    {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hstart : p.start = x) (hfinish : q.finish = y)
    (hend : ∀ s ∈ pc.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A)
    (hb : b ∈ B) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support ∧
        r.start = x ∧ r.finish = y
proof:
:= by
  have hpb : b ∉ p.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hqb : b ∉ q.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hq h)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hss, hsf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAB p b q (hend p hp).2 hb (hend q hq).1 hpb hqb
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne)
  exact ⟨s, hs, hss.trans hstart, hsf.trans hfinish⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_of_critical_D
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_path_of_critical_D {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1)
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G, r.support = A ∪ B ∧ r.start = x ∧ r.finish = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne0, pc0, h0, p0, hp0, q0, hq0, hpq0, hxend, hyend⟩ := hD
  have hend0 : ∀ s ∈ pc0.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A := by
    intro s hs
    exact ⟨pc0.support_subset hs s.start_mem_support,
      pc0.support_subset hs s.finish_mem_support⟩
  obtain ⟨pc0o, p0o, q0o, hcard0o, hp0o, hq0o, hne0o, hstart0, hy0, hend0o⟩ :=
    exists_orientStart_marked_keepOther (A := A) pc0 hp0 hq0 hpq0 hxend hyend hend0
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (pc : PathCover G (A ∪ S))
        (p qy : GraphPath G),
        S ⊆ B → (B \ S).card = k →
          pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - S.card →
            p ∈ pc.paths → qy ∈ pc.paths → p ≠ qy →
              p.start = x → (y = qy.start ∨ y = qy.finish) →
                (∀ s ∈ pc.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A) →
                  ∃ r : GraphPath G,
                    r.support = A ∪ B ∧ r.start = x ∧ r.finish = y := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro S pc p qy hS hk hcard hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' hend
      have hBS : B \ S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hk
      have hBeq : S = B := subset_antisymm hS (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mp hBS)
      subst hBeq
      have hcard1 : pc.card = 1 := by
        simpa [hcrit] using hcard
      exact (hne (by
        have := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pc hcard1
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := this
        have hp' : p = r := by simpa [hr] using hp
        have hq' : qy = r := by simpa [hr] using hqy
        exact hp'.trans hq'.symm)).elim
    | succ k ih =>
      intro S pc p qy hS hk hcard hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' hend
      have hneS : (B \ S).Nonempty :=
        card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (B \ S).card)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hneS
      have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
      have hbS : b ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      have hdisjAB := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
      have hbU : b ∉ A ∪ S := by
        intro h
        rcases mem_union.1 h with hA | hS'
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB hA hbB
        · exact hbS hS'
      have hsum : S.card + (B \ S).card = B.card := by
        rw [← card_union_of_disjoint, union_sdiff_of_subset hS]
        exact disjoint_sdiff
      by_cases hk0 : k = 0
      · subst hk0
        have hcard2 : pc.card = 2 := by omega
        obtain ⟨pc1, p1, q1, hcard1, hp1, hq1, hne1, hstart1, hfin1, hend1⟩ :=
          exists_orientFinish_keepStart (A := A) pc hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' hend
        have hcard2' : pc1.card = 2 := by omega
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
          exists_last_splice_through (x := x) (y := y) hAB pc1 hp1 hq1 hne1
            hstart1 hfin1 hend1 hbB hbU
        have hBeq : insert b S = B :=
          insert_eq_of_sdiff_singleton hS hb (by omega)
        have hcov : p1.support ∪ q1.support = A ∪ S :=
          support_union_of_two pc1 hp1 hq1 hne1 hcard2'
        have hsupp : r.support = A ∪ B := by
          calc
            r.support = p1.support ∪ {b} ∪ q1.support := hr
            _ = (p1.support ∪ q1.support) ∪ {b} := by
              ext z; simp [mem_union, or_assoc]
            _ = (A ∪ S) ∪ {b} := by rw [hcov]
            _ = A ∪ insert b S := by
              ext z; simp [mem_union, mem_insert, or_left_comm]
            _ = A ∪ B := by rw [hBeq]
        exact ⟨r, hsupp, hs, hf⟩
      · have h3 : 3 ≤ pc.card := by omega
        obtain ⟨pc1, p1, q1, hcard1, hp1, hq1, hne1, hstart1, hy1, hend1⟩ :=
          exists_marked_splice_two_through_avoid (x := x) (y := y) (p := p)
            (qy := qy) hAB pc hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' h3 hend hbB hbU
        have hU : insert b (A ∪ S) = A ∪ insert b S := by
          ext z; simp [mem_insert, mem_union]
        let pc1' : PathCover G (A ∪ insert b S) := pc1.cast hU
        have hS' : insert b S ⊆ B := insert_subset hbB hS
        have hrem : B \ insert b S = (B \ S).erase b := sdiff_insert B S b
        have hk' : (B \ insert b S).card = k := by
          rw [hrem, card_erase_of_mem hb, hk]; omega
        have hcard' : pc1'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (insert b S).card := by
          rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard1, hcard, card_insert_of_notMem hbS]
          omega
        have hp1' : p1 ∈ pc1'.paths := by
          rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU]; exact hp1
        have hq1' : q1 ∈ pc1'.paths := by
          rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU]; exact hq1
        have hend1' : ∀ s ∈ pc1'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A := by
          intro s hs
          rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU] at hs
          exact hend1 s hs
        exact ih (insert b S) pc1' p1 q1 hS' hk' hcard' hp1' hq1' hne1
          hstart1 hy1 hend1'
  have hA : A ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = A := union_empty A
  let pc0' : PathCover G (A ∪ ∅) := pc0o.cast hA.symm
  have hcard0 : pc0'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (∅ : Finset V).card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard0o, h0, card_empty, Nat.sub_zero]
  have hp0' : p0o ∈ pc0'.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm]; exact hp0o
  have hq0' : q0o ∈ pc0'.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm]; exact hq0o
  have hend0' : ∀ s ∈ pc0'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A := by
    intro s hs
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm] at hs
    exact hend0o s hs
  exact aux B.card ∅ pc0' p0o q0o (empty_subset B) (by simp) hcard0
    hp0' hq0' hne0o hstart0 hy0 hend0'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.erase_union_sdiff_erase
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_erase, mem_union]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨hzne, hzAB⟩, hnot⟩
    rcases hzAB with hzA | hzB
    · exact hzA
    · exact (hnot ⟨hzne, hzB⟩).elim
  · intro hzA
    refine ⟨⟨fun hzb => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzA (hzb ▸ hb), Or.inl hzA⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hBe
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzA hBe.2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_of_critical_spanning
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_of_critical_spanning {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1)
    (hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, p0, hpU, hends⟩ := hR
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  let p : GraphPath G :=
    if h : p0.start = x ∧ p0.finish = y then p0 else p0.reverse
  have hpU' : p.support = A ∪ B := by
    by_cases h : p0.start = x ∧ p0.finish = y
    · simpa [p, h] using hpU
    · simpa [p, h, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hpU
  have hxy : p.start = x ∧ p.finish = y := by
    by_cases h : p0.start = x ∧ p0.finish = y
    · simpa [p, h]
    · have h' : p0.start = y ∧ p0.finish = x := by
        rcases hends with h1 | h2
        · exact (h h1).elim
        · exact h2
      have hp : p = p0.reverse := dif_neg h
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [hp, PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse] using h'.2
      · simpa [hp, PathCover.GraphPath.finish_reverse] using h'.1
  have ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
  have hbU : b ∈ p.support := by simpa [hpU'] using mem_union.2 (Or.inr hbB)
  have hp1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_critical hAne hBne hAB hcrit
  let pcU : PathCover G (A ∪ B) := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hpU'
  have hminU : pcU.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card, hp1]
  have hxE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x :=
    ⟨pcU, hminU, p, by rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl,
      Or.inl hxy.1.symm⟩
  have hyE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) y :=
    ⟨pcU, hminU, p, by rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl,
      Or.inr hxy.2.symm⟩
  have hxA : x ∈ A := eligible_mem_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB (by omega) hxE
  have hyA : y ∈ A := eligible_mem_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB (by omega) hyE
  have hxb : x ≠ b := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA (h ▸ hbB)
  have hyb : y ≠ b := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyA (h ▸ hbB)
  have hs : b ≠ p.start := fun h => hxb (hxy.1 ▸ h.symm)
  have hf : b ≠ p.finish := fun h => hyb (hxy.2 ▸ h.symm)
  have hnil : ¬ p.walk.Nil := GraphPath.not_nil_of_internal hbU hs
  let left := (p.takeUntil hbU).trimFinish
    (fun hnil' => hs ((GraphPath.takeUntil_nil_iff p hbU).1 hnil'))
  let right := (p.dropUntil hbU).trimStart
    (fun hnil' => hf ((GraphPath.dropUntil_nil_iff p hbU).1 hnil'))
  have hdel : p.deleteVertex b = [left, right] := by
    unfold GraphPath.deleteVertex
    rw [dif_pos hbU, dif_neg hnil, dif_neg hs, dif_neg hf]
  have hpc1paths : (pcU.deleteVertex b).paths = [left, right] := by
    change ((pcU.paths).flatMap fun q => q.deleteVertex b) = [left, right]
    have hpaths : pcU.paths = [p] := by
      simp [pcU, PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
    simp [hpaths, hdel]
  have hL : left ∈ (pcU.deleteVertex b).paths := by simp [hpc1paths]
  have hR : right ∈ (pcU.deleteVertex b).paths := by simp [hpc1paths]
  have hneLR : left ≠ right := by
    intro heq
    have hd := GraphPath.disjoint_internal_pieces p hbU hs hf
    have hxL : x ∈ left.support := by
      have : left.start = p.start := by
        simp [left, GraphPath.trimFinish_start, GraphPath.takeUntil]
      simpa [this, hxy.1] using left.start_mem_support
    have hyR : y ∈ right.support := by
      have : right.finish = p.finish := by
        simp [right, GraphPath.trimStart_finish, GraphPath.dropUntil]
      simpa [this, hxy.2] using right.finish_mem_support
    have hxR : x ∈ right.support := by
      have hsup : left.support = right.support := congrArg GraphPath.support heq
      rwa [← hsup]
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hd hxL hxR
  have hxLend : x = left.start ∨ x = left.finish := by
    have : left.start = p.start := by
      simp [left, GraphPath.trimFinish_start, GraphPath.takeUntil]
    exact Or.inl (hxy.1.symm.trans this.symm)
  have hyRend : y = right.start ∨ y = right.finish := by
    have : right.finish = p.finish := by
      simp [right, GraphPath.trimStart_finish, GraphPath.dropUntil]
    exact Or.inr (hxy.2.symm.trans this.symm)
  have hBsub : B.erase b ⊆ (A ∪ B).erase b := by
    intro z hz
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hz).1, mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_erase.1 hz).2)⟩
  have hxS : x ∉ B.erase b := fun h =>
    Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA (mem_of_mem_erase h)
  have hyS : y ∉ B.erase b := fun h =>
    Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyA (mem_of_mem_erase h)
  obtain ⟨pcA0, p', q', hcardA, hp', hq', hne', hx', hy'⟩ :=
    exists_deleteFinset_keepDistinct (pcU.deleteVertex b) hBsub hL hR hneLR
      hxLend hyRend hxS hyS
  have hEq : (A ∪ B).erase b \ B.erase b = A :=
    erase_union_sdiff_erase hdisj hbB
  let pcA : PathCover G A := pcA0.cast hEq
  have hmin : pcA.card = pathCoverNumber G A := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcA
    have hdv : (pcU.deleteVertex b).card = pcU.card + 1 := by
      refine PathCover.card_deleteVertex_eq_add_one_of_internal pcU
        (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hbB)) ?_
      intro q hq
      have : q = p := by
        have hpaths : pcU.paths = [p] := by
          simp [pcU, PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
        have hq' : q ∈ pcU.paths := hq
        rw [hpaths] at hq'
        exact List.mem_singleton.1 hq'
      subst this
      exact ⟨hs, hf⟩
    have hcard0 : pcA0.card ≤ (pcU.deleteVertex b).card + (B.erase b).card := hcardA
    have : pcA.card ≤ B.card + 1 := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      have : (B.erase b).card = B.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hbB
      have : 1 ≤ B.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hBne)
      omega
    omega
  refine ⟨hne, pcA, hmin, p', ?_, q', ?_, hne', hx', hy'⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hp'
  · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hq'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.SpanningPathCompatible_critical_iff
statement:
lemma SpanningPathCompatible_critical_iff {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y ↔
      DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact DistinctPathCompatible_of_critical_spanning hAne hBne hAB hcrit
  · intro hD
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
      exists_spanning_path_of_critical_D hAB hcrit hD
    exact ⟨hD.1, r, hr, Or.inl ⟨hs, hf⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_critical_partCut
statement:
lemma exists_critical_partCut {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1)
    (hA : IsCograph G A) (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G A) :
    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∧ S.Nonempty ∧
      componentCount G ((A ∪ B) \ S) = S.card + 1 ∧
      InOneComponent (G := G) ((A ∪ B) \ S)
        ((ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨SX, hSX, hcut, hcomp⟩ := exists_partCut_of_isCograph hA hx
  let S := B ∪ SX
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hFU := ineligibleSet_complete_join_critical hAne hBne hAB hcrit
  have hSsub : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hFU]
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzB | hzX
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzB)
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (hSX hzX))
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := hBne.mono subset_union_left
  have hrem : (A ∪ B) \ S = A \ SX := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union, S]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hzAB, hzS⟩
      rcases hzAB with hzA | hzB
      · exact ⟨hzA, fun hX => hzS (Or.inr hX)⟩
      · exact (hzS (Or.inl hzB)).elim
    · intro ⟨hzA, hzX⟩
      exact ⟨Or.inl hzA, fun h => h.elim
        (fun hzB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzA hzB) hzX⟩
  have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1 := hcrit
  have hcut' : componentCount G ((A ∪ B) \ S) = S.card + 1 := by
    have hdisjS : Disjoint B SX := by
      refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro z hzB hzX
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
        (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A (hSX hzX)) hzB
    have hScard : S.card = B.card + SX.card :=
      card_union_of_disjoint hdisjS
    simpa [hrem, hScard, hpA, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hcut
  have hW :
      (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ S =
        (ineligibleSet G A ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ SX := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union, hFU, S]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hz, hzS⟩
      rcases hz with (hzB | hzF) | hzP
      · exact (hzS (Or.inl hzB)).elim
      · exact ⟨Or.inl hzF, fun hX => hzS (Or.inr hX)⟩
      · exact ⟨Or.inr hzP, fun hX => hzS (Or.inr hX)⟩
    · intro ⟨hz, hzX⟩
      rcases hz with hzF | hzP
      · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hzF), fun h => h.elim
          (fun hzB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
            (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hzF) hzB) hzX⟩
      · exact ⟨Or.inr hzP, fun h => h.elim
          (fun hzB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
            (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A
              ((dNonadjClass_subset_eligible (G := G) A x) hzP)) hzB) hzX⟩
  have hmono := inOneComponent_mono (A := A \ SX) (B := (A ∪ B) \ S)
    (by simp [hrem]) hcomp
  refine ⟨S, hSsub, hSne, hcut', ?_⟩
  simpa [hW, hrem] using hmono

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_critical_partCut_of_canonical
statement:
lemma exists_critical_partCut_of_canonical {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1)
    (hA : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G A) (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G A) :
    ∃ S, S ⊆ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∧ S.Nonempty ∧
      componentCount G ((A ∪ B) \ S) = S.card + 1 ∧
      InOneComponent (G := G) ((A ∪ B) \ S)
        ((ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) ∪ dNonadjClass (G := G) A x) \ S)
proof:
:=
  exists_critical_partCut hAne hBne hAB hcrit (isCograph_iff.2 hA) hx

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_succ_le_of_both_ends
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        p.start ∈ B → p.finish ∈ B →
          (leftoverPieces B p).length + 1 ≤ (p.support ∩ B).card)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl hs hf
  intro n ih p hn hs' hf'
  by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
  · have hlist : leftoverPieces B p = [] :=
      leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hs' hnil
    have hsing : p.support = {p.start} :=
      support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
    simp [hlist, hsing, hs']
  · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hs' hnil]
    have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
      simpa [hn, support_trimStart] using
        card_erase_lt_of_mem p.start_mem_support
    have hfT : (p.trimStart hnil).finish ∈ B := hf'
    have hps : p.support = insert p.start (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
      rw [support_trimStart, insert_erase p.start_mem_support]
    have hstart_not : p.start ∉ (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
      rw [support_trimStart]; exact notMem_erase _ _
    have hcard : (p.support ∩ B).card =
        ((p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B).card + 1 := by
      rw [hps, insert_inter_of_mem hs', card_insert_of_notMem]
      exact fun hz => hstart_not (mem_inter.1 hz).1
    by_cases hsT : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∈ B
    · have ih' := ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl hsT hfT
      omega
    · cases hfind :
        (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
      | none =>
        have hemp : (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B = ∅ := by
          ext y
          constructor
          · intro hy
            have hyW : y ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support :=
              (mem_walk_support (p := p.trimStart hnil)).1 (mem_inter.1 hy).1
            have hnot : ¬ decide (y ∈ B) :=
              (List.find?_eq_none
                (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 hfind y hyW
            exact (hnot (decide_eq_true (mem_inter.1 hy).2)).elim
          · intro hy
            exact (notMem_empty y hy).elim
        have hfW : (p.trimStart hnil).finish ∈
            (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B :=
          mem_inter.2 ⟨(p.trimStart hnil).finish_mem_support, hfT⟩
        rw [hemp] at hfW
        exact (notMem_empty _ hfW).elim
      | some _ =>
        have hnone :
            (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support.find?
              (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
          simp [hfind]
        rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
        simp [hsT, hnone]
        have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p.trimStart hnil) hnone
        have hx : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ∈
            (p.trimStart hnil).support :=
          (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
        have hbB : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ∈ B :=
          (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2
        have hne : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ≠
            (p.trimStart hnil).start :=
          find?_B_ne_start hsT hfind'
        have hltD :
            ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support.card <
              (p.trimStart hnil).support.card :=
          dropUntil_support_card_lt (p.trimStart hnil) hx hne
        have hltD' : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support.card < n :=
          lt_trans hltD hlt
        have hstartD : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).start ∈ B := by
          simpa [dropUntil] using hbB
        have hfinD : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).finish ∈ B := hfT
        have ihD :=
          ih _ hltD' ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx) rfl hstartD hfinD
        have hsub :
            ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support ∩ B ⊆
              (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B :=
          inter_subset_inter
            (dropUntil_support_subset (p.trimStart hnil) hx) subset_rfl
        have hle := card_le_card hsub
        omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_lt_of_spanning_AA
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_lt_of_spanning_AA {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U)
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hf : p.finish ∈ A) :
    pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) < A.card
proof:
:= by
  have hAU : A ⊆ p.support := by simpa [hp] using hA
  have hinter : p.support ∩ A = A := inter_eq_right.2 hAU
  have hlen := leftoverPieces_length_succ_le_of_both_ends (B := A) p hs hf
  have hcard : (leftoverCoverOfPath p A).card + 1 ≤ A.card := by
    simpa [leftoverCoverOfPath_card, hinter] using hlen
  have hEq : p.support \ A = U \ A := by rw [hp]
  have hle :=
    pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) ((leftoverCoverOfPath p A).cast hEq)
  have : PathCover.card ((leftoverCoverOfPath p A).cast hEq) + 1 ≤ A.card := by
    simpa [PathCover.cast_card] using hcard
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_lt_of_spanningPathCompatible_AA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, qst, qfin⟩ := exists_oriented_path_from hR
  exact pathCoverNumber_lt_of_spanning_AA hA hAne hq
    (by simpa [qst] using hx) (by simpa [qfin] using hy)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_open_at_succ
statement:
lemma exists_open_at_succ (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = c.support ∧ p.start = x ∧
        p.finish = cycleSucc (rotateTo c hx) ∧ G.Adj p.finish x ∧
          (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, x)}) =
            c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  let c' := rotateTo c hx
  have hnil : ¬ c'.walk.Nil := c'.isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil
  have hq : q.IsPath :=
    ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hadj).1 (by simpa [hwalk] using c'.isCycle)).1
  let p0 : GraphPath G := ⟨w, c'.start, q, hq⟩
  have hp0 : p0.support = c'.support := by
    have hstart : c'.start ∈ q.support := Walk.end_mem_support q
    simp [p0, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hwalk, Walk.support_cons,
      insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart)]
  have hx' : c'.start = x := start_rotateTo c hx
  have hw : w = cycleSucc c' := by
    simp [cycleSucc, hwalk]
  refine ⟨p0.reverse, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [GraphPath.support_reverse, hp0, support_rotateTo]
  · simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hx']
  · simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hw, c']
  · simpa [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hx'] using hadj.symm
  · have hqE : p0.reverse.walk.edges.toFinset = q.edges.toFinset := by
      simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
    have hcE : c'.walk.edges.toFinset =
        insert s(c'.start, w) q.edges.toFinset := by
      simp [hwalk, Walk.edges_cons]
    have hfin : p0.reverse.finish = w := by simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse]
    have hedges :
        p0.reverse.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p0.reverse.finish, x)} =
          c'.walk.edges.toFinset := by
      rw [hqE, hcE, hfin]
      have : s(w, x) = s(c'.start, w) := by
        rw [hx']
        exact Sym2.eq_swap
      rw [this]
      simp [singleton_union]
    have hperm : c'.walk.edges.Perm c.walk.edges :=
      (Walk.rotate_edges c.walk x (mem_walk_support_of_mem_cycle hx)).perm
    rw [hedges]
    simpa [rotateTo] using toFinset_eq_of_perm hperm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protected_of_succ_mem_A
statement:
lemma exists_protected_of_succ_mem_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hsucc : cycleSucc (rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hA haA)) ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧
          (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) =
            c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  have haU : a ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA haA
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hfin, _hadj, hedges⟩ := exists_open_at_succ c haU
  refine ⟨p, hp.trans hc, by simpa [hs] using haA, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hfin] using hsucc
  · rw [hs, hfin]
    intro h
    exact cycleSucc_ne_start (rotateTo c haU)
      (h.symm.trans (start_rotateTo c haU).symm)
  · simpa [hs] using hedges

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protected_of_pred_mem_A
statement:
lemma exists_protected_of_pred_mem_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hpred : cycleSucc (rotateTo c.reverse
        (by simpa [hc, GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hA haA)) ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧
          (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) =
            c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  have haU : a ∈ c.reverse.support := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.support_reverse, hc] using hA haA
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hfin, _hadj, hedges⟩ :=
    exists_open_at_succ c.reverse haU
  have hperm : c.reverse.walk.edges.Perm c.walk.edges := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.reverse, Walk.edges_reverse] using
      (List.reverse_perm c.walk.edges)
  refine ⟨p, ?_, by simpa [hs] using haA, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [GraphCycle.support_reverse, hc] using hp
  · simpa [hfin] using hpred
  · rw [hs, hfin]
    intro h
    exact cycleSucc_ne_start (rotateTo c.reverse haU)
      (h.symm.trans (start_rotateTo c.reverse haU).symm)
  · have : p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} =
        c.reverse.walk.edges.toFinset := by
      simpa [hs] using hedges
    rw [this]
    exact toFinset_eq_of_perm hperm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protected_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A
statement:
lemma exists_protected_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hn : cycleSucc (rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hA haA)) ∈ A ∨
      cycleSucc (rotateTo c.reverse
        (by simpa [hc, GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hA haA)) ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧
          (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) =
            c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn with h | h
  · exact exists_protected_of_succ_mem_A c hc hA haA h
  · exact exists_protected_of_pred_mem_A c hc hA haA h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hn : cycleSucc (rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hA haA)) ∈ A ∨
      cycleSucc (rotateTo c.reverse
        (by simpa [hc, GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hA haA)) ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt c A ∧
          (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) =
            c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hf, hne, hedges⟩ :=
    exists_protected_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A c hc hA haA hn
  refine ⟨p, hp, hs, hf, hne, ?_, hedges⟩
  intro e he
  have heP : e ∈ p.edges := (mem_AIncident_iff.1 he).1
  have : e ∈ p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} :=
    mem_union.2 (Or.inl heP)
  simpa [hedges] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_starts
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_starts {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.start ≠ R.start) (hadj : G.Adj Q.start R.start) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:=
  exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_starts c hc hp hs hclose hedges
    hQ hR hneQR hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_ends
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_ends {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.finish ≠ R.finish) (hadj : G.Adj Q.finish R.finish) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:=
  exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends c hc hp hs hclose hedges
    hQ hR hneQR hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_start_or_end
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_start_or_end {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hor : (Q.start ≠ R.start ∧ G.Adj Q.start R.start) ∨
      (Q.finish ≠ R.finish ∧ G.Adj Q.finish R.finish)) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  rcases hor with ⟨hne, hadj⟩ | ⟨hne, hadj⟩
  · exact exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_starts c hc hp hs hclose hedges
      hQ hR hne hadj
  · exact exists_protectedAt_of_adj_leftover_ends c hc hp hs hclose hedges
      hQ hR hne hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces
statement:
lemma takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces {p : GraphPath G} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support)
    (hne : x ≠ p.start) : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.takeUntil_dropUntil_length_add
statement:
lemma takeUntil_dropUntil_length_add (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length + (p.dropUntil hx).walk.length =
      p.walk.length
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := mem_walk_support.1 hx
  have hT : (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length = p.walk.support.idxOf x := by
    simpa [takeUntil] using Walk.length_takeUntil p.walk hx'
  have hD : (p.dropUntil hx).walk.length =
      p.walk.length - p.walk.support.idxOf x := by
    simpa [dropUntil] using Walk.length_dropUntil p.walk hx'
  have hidx : p.walk.support.idxOf x ≤ p.walk.length := by
    have hlt : p.walk.support.idxOf x < p.walk.support.length :=
      List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hx'
    have hlen : p.walk.support.length = p.walk.length + 1 :=
      Walk.length_support p.walk
    omega
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_eq_of_mem_takeUntil_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  have hU := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hx
  have hinter_mem :
      x ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_inter.2 ⟨(p.takeUntil hx).finish_mem_support,
      (p.dropUntil hx).start_mem_support⟩
  have hlen := takeUntil_dropUntil_length_add p hx
  have hcardT := card_support (p.takeUntil hx)
  have hcardD := card_support (p.dropUntil hx)
  have hcardP := card_support p
  have hunion := card_union_add_card_inter (p.takeUntil hx).support
    (p.dropUntil hx).support
  have hinter_card :
      ((p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support).card = 1 := by
    have : ((p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support).card =
        p.support.card := by rw [hU]
    omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hinter_card
  have hzx : z = x := (mem_singleton.1 (by simpa [hz] using hinter_mem)).symm
  have hyI : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∩ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_inter.2 ⟨hyT, hyD⟩
  simpa [hz, hzx] using hyI

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil
statement:
lemma disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hne : x ≠ p.start) :
    Disjoint
      ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish (takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hx hne)).support
      (p.dropUntil hx).support
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 ?_
  intro y hyT hyD
  have hyT' : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support.erase x := by
    simpa [support_trimFinish, takeUntil] using hyT
  have hyTsup : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support := (mem_erase.1 hyT').2
  have hyne : y ≠ x := (mem_erase.1 hyT').1
  exact hyne (mem_eq_of_mem_takeUntil_dropUntil p hx hyTsup hyD)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_trimFinish_takeUntil_union_dropUntil
statement:
lemma support_trimFinish_takeUntil_union_dropUntil (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hne : x ≠ p.start) :
    ((p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish (takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hx hne)).support ∪
      (p.dropUntil hx).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  have hU := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hx
  have hxD : x ∈ (p.dropUntil hx).support := by
    simpa [dropUntil] using (p.dropUntil hx).start_mem_support
  rw [support_trimFinish, takeUntil]
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support := by
      rcases mem_union.1 hy with h | h
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_erase.1 h).2)
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr h)
    simpa [hU] using this
  · intro hy
    have hy' : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support := by
      simpa [hU] using hy
    rcases mem_union.1 hy' with hT | hD
    · by_cases hxy : y = x
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (hxy ▸ hxD))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_erase.2 ⟨hxy, hT⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hD)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.openAtStart_start
statement:
lemma openAtStart_start (p : GraphPath G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start) :
    (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).start = u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.openAtStart_finish
statement:
lemma openAtStart_finish (p : GraphPath G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start) :
    (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).finish =
      (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.openAtStart_support
statement:
lemma openAtStart_support (p : GraphPath G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start) :
    (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [openAtStart, support_splice, union_comm]
  exact support_trimFinish_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hu hne

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.last_edge_mem_cyclePieces
statement:
lemma last_edge_mem_cyclePieces (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    s(p.walk.penultimate, p.finish) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:=
  mem_edges_iff.2 (p.walk.mk_penultimate_end_mem_edges h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incomingSeam_mem_takeUntil
statement:
lemma incomingSeam_mem_takeUntil (p : GraphPath G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) :
    incomingSeam p hu hne ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).edges
proof:
:= by
  simpa [incomingSeam, takeUntil] using
    last_edge_mem_cyclePieces (p.takeUntil hu) (takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hu hne)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.penultimate_ne_finish
statement:
lemma penultimate_ne_finish (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.walk.penultimate ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < p.walk.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 h
  have hlt : p.walk.length - 1 < p.walk.length := by omega
  simpa [Walk.penultimate] using p.getVert_ne_finish_of_lt hlt

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.incomingSeam_not_mem_dropUntil
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hu hne
  have hpred :
      (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).support :=
    List.mem_toFinset.2
      ((p.dropUntil hu).walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (mem_edges_iff.1 he)
        (by simp [incomingSeam]))
  have hpredT :
      (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).support :=
    List.mem_toFinset.2
      (Walk.getVert_mem_support (p.takeUntil hu).walk
        ((p.takeUntil hu).walk.length - 1))
  have heq :=
    mem_eq_of_mem_takeUntil_dropUntil p hu hpredT hpred
  exact (penultimate_ne_finish (p.takeUntil hu) hnn) (heq.trans (by simp [takeUntil]))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.openAtStart_edges_subset
statement:
lemma openAtStart_edges_subset (p : GraphPath G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start) :
    (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).edges ⊆
      p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}
proof:
:= by
  have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hu hne
  have hspl :=
    edges_splice (p.dropUntil hu)
      ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn)
      (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
      (disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil p hu hne).symm
  intro e he
  have he' :
      e ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).edges ∪ ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).edges ∪
        {s((p.dropUntil hu).finish, ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).start)} := by
    simpa [openAtStart, hspl] using he
  have hcloseE :
      s((p.dropUntil hu).finish, ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).start) =
        s(p.finish, p.start) := by
    simp [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish]
  have hsubD : (p.dropUntil hu).edges ⊆ p.edges :=
    edges_dropUntil_subset p hu
  have hsubT : ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).edges ⊆ p.edges :=
    (edges_trimFinish_subset (p.takeUntil hu) hnn).trans (by
      intro e he
      have hsub : (p.takeUntil hu).walk.IsSubwalk p.walk := by
        simpa [takeUntil] using
          Walk.isSubwalk_takeUntil p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hu)
      exact mem_edges_iff.2 (hsub.edges_subset (mem_edges_iff.1 he)))
  rcases mem_union.1 he' with h | hs0
  · rcases mem_union.1 h with hD | hT
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hsubD hD))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hsubT hT))
  · simpa [hcloseE] using mem_union.2 (Or.inr hs0)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.openAtStart_edges_subset_cycle
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have : e ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} :=
    openAtStart_edges_subset p hu hclose hne he
  simpa [hedges] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieceBefore_start
statement:
lemma pieceBefore_start (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).start = u
proof:
:= by
  simp [pieceBefore, trimFinish, takeUntil, openAtStart_start]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieceAfter_start
statement:
lemma pieceAfter_start (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) :
    (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).start = v
proof:
:= by
  simp [pieceAfter, dropUntil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieceAfter_finish
statement:
lemma pieceAfter_finish (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) :
    (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).finish =
      (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  simp [pieceAfter, dropUntil, openAtStart_finish]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieceBefore_finish
statement:
lemma pieceBefore_finish (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).finish =
      ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  simp [pieceBefore, trimFinish]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_pieces
statement:
lemma disjoint_pieces (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    Disjoint (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support
      (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pieceBefore, pieceAfter, openAtStart_start p hu hclose hne] using
    disjoint_trimFinish_takeUntil_dropUntil (openAtStart p hu hclose hne) hv
      (by simpa [openAtStart_start p hu hclose hne] using hnv)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_pieces_union
statement:
lemma support_pieces_union (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).support ∪
      (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    support_trimFinish_takeUntil_union_dropUntil (openAtStart p hu hclose hne)
      hv (by simpa [openAtStart_start p hu hclose hne] using hnv)
  simpa [pieceBefore, pieceAfter, openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_takeUntil_subset_cyclePieces
statement:
lemma edges_takeUntil_subset_cyclePieces (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.takeUntil hx).edges ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have hsub : (p.takeUntil hx).walk.IsSubwalk p.walk := by
    simpa [takeUntil] using Walk.isSubwalk_takeUntil p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hx)
  exact mem_edges_iff.2 (hsub.edges_subset (mem_edges_iff.1 he))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.pieces_edges_subset_open
statement:
lemma pieces_edges_subset_open (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u) :
    (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).edges ⊆
      (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).edges ∧
        (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).edges ⊆
          (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).edges
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro e he
    have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces (p := openAtStart p hu hclose hne) hv
      (by simpa [openAtStart_start p hu hclose hne] using hnv)
    have hsub :=
      (edges_trimFinish_subset ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil hv) hnn).trans
        (edges_takeUntil_subset_cyclePieces (openAtStart p hu hclose hne) hv)
    exact hsub (by simpa [pieceBefore] using he)
  · intro e he
    have hsub :=
      edges_dropUntil_subset (openAtStart p hu hclose hne) hv
    exact hsub (by simpa [pieceAfter] using he)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_straddle_edge
statement:
lemma exists_straddle_edge {S : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G)
    (hmeet : (p.support ∩ S).Nonempty) (hmiss : (p.support \ S).Nonempty) :
    ∃ e ∈ p.edges, endsStraddle e S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmeet
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hmiss
  have hxS : x ∈ p.support ∧ x ∈ S := mem_inter.1 hx
  have hyS : y ∈ p.support ∧ y ∉ S := mem_sdiff.1 hy
  by_cases hs : p.start ∈ S
  · let B : Finset V := univ.filter fun z => z ∉ S
    have hyB : y ∈ B := by simp [B, hyS.2]
    obtain ⟨_, hb⟩ := find?_B_of_mem (B := B) hyS.1 hyB
    have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (inB B) ≠ none := by simp [hb]
    have hsB : p.start ∉ B := by simp [B, hs]
    have hfind := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
    have hb0 : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind).1
    have hbB : firstB B p hnone ∈ B := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind).2
    have hv : firstB B p hnone ∉ S := by simpa [B] using hbB
    have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind
    have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hb0).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
      hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hb0).1 hn)
    let pre := (p.takeUntil hb0).trimFinish hnn
    have hu : pre.finish ∈ S := by
      have hpen : pre.finish ∈ (p.takeUntil hb0).support := by
        have : pre.support ⊆ (p.takeUntil hb0).support := by
          rw [support_trimFinish]; exact erase_subset _ _
        exact this pre.finish_mem_support
      have hneP : pre.finish ≠ firstB B p hnone := by
        have hmem : pre.finish ∈
            (p.takeUntil hb0).support.erase (p.takeUntil hb0).finish := by
          rw [← support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hb0) hnn]
          exact pre.finish_mem_support
        have : (p.takeUntil hb0).finish = firstB B p hnone := by simp [takeUntil]
        exact this ▸ (mem_erase.1 hmem).1
      have hnotB : pre.finish ∉ B :=
        takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B (B := B) hfind hb0 hpen hneP
      simpa [B] using hnotB
    have hePre : s(pre.finish, (p.takeUntil hb0).finish) ∈
        (p.takeUntil hb0).edges :=
      last_edge_mem (p.takeUntil hb0) hnn
    refine ⟨s(pre.finish, firstB B p hnone),
      edges_takeUntil_subset p hb0 (by simpa [takeUntil] using hePre),
      endsStraddle_iff.2 (fun heq => hv ((iff_of_eq heq).mp hu))⟩
  · obtain ⟨_, hb⟩ := find?_B_of_mem (B := S) hxS.1 hxS.2
    have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (inB S) ≠ none := by simp [hb]
    have hfind := firstB_spec (B := S) (p := p) hnone
    have hb0 : firstB S p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := S) hfind).1
    have hbS : firstB S p hnone ∈ S := (mem_find?_B (B := S) hfind).2
    have hne : firstB S p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hs hfind
    have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hb0).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
      hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hb0).1 hn)
    let pre := (p.takeUntil hb0).trimFinish hnn
    have hu : pre.finish ∉ S := by
      have hpen : pre.finish ∈ (p.takeUntil hb0).support := by
        have : pre.support ⊆ (p.takeUntil hb0).support := by
          rw [support_trimFinish]; exact erase_subset _ _
        exact this pre.finish_mem_support
      have hneP : pre.finish ≠ firstB S p hnone := by
        have hmem : pre.finish ∈
            (p.takeUntil hb0).support.erase (p.takeUntil hb0).finish := by
          rw [← support_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hb0) hnn]
          exact pre.finish_mem_support
        have : (p.takeUntil hb0).finish = firstB S p hnone := by simp [takeUntil]
        exact this ▸ (mem_erase.1 hmem).1
      exact takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B (B := S) hfind hb0 hpen hneP
    have hePre : s(pre.finish, (p.takeUntil hb0).finish) ∈
        (p.takeUntil hb0).edges :=
      last_edge_mem (p.takeUntil hb0) hnn
    refine ⟨s(pre.finish, firstB S p hnone),
      edges_takeUntil_subset p hb0 (by simpa [takeUntil] using hePre),
      endsStraddle_iff.2 (fun heq => hu ((iff_of_eq heq).mpr hbS))⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt.mono_set
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨heE, b, hbA, hb⟩ := mem_AIncident_iff.1 he
  exact h (mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨heE, b, hsub hbA, hb⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.ProtectedAt.of_cycle_edges_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  simpa [h] using hP he

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_leftover_containing
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hxQ⟩ := (leftoverCoverOfPath p A |>.mem_iff x).1 hx
  exact ⟨Q, by simpa [leftoverCoverOfPath_paths] using hQ, hxQ⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_support_tail_of_ne_start
statement:
lemma mem_support_tail_of_ne_start {p : GraphPath G} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hne : x ≠ p.start) : x ∈ p.walk.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  have hxL : x ∈ p.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 hx
  have hnn : ¬ p.walk.Nil := by
    intro h
    have : p.support = {p.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil p h
    exact hne (by simpa [this] using hx)
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnn
  have hcons : p.walk.support = p.start :: q.support := by simp [hwalk]
  have := List.mem_cons.1 (by simpa [hcons] using hxL)
  rcases this with h | h
  · exact (hne h).elim
  · simpa [hcons] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftover_factor_edges_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, _, _⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  have heW : s(u, v) ∈ ((ru.append Q.walk).append rv).edges := by
    simpa [heq] using mem_edges_iff.1 he
  rw [Walk.edges_append, List.mem_append] at heW
  rcases heW with hmid | hrv
  · rw [Walk.edges_append, List.mem_append] at hmid
    rcases hmid with hru | hQe
    · have huR : u ∈ ru.support := Walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges hru (by simp)
      have hvR : v ∈ ru.support := Walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges hru (by simp)
      have hpathAQ : (ru.append Q.walk).IsPath :=
        Walk.IsPath.of_append_left (by simpa [heq] using p.isPath)
      have hnodAQ := hpathAQ.support_nodup
      rw [Walk.support_append] at hnodAQ
      have hdis := (List.nodup_append.1 hnodAQ).2.2
      have hu_eq : u = Q.start := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hdis u huR u (mem_support_tail_of_ne_start hu hne) rfl
      have hv_eq : v = Q.start := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hdis v hvR v (mem_support_tail_of_ne_start hv hne) rfl
      have hadj : G.Adj u v := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using p.edges_subset_edgeSet _ he
      exact (hadj.ne (hu_eq.trans hv_eq.symm)).elim
    · exact mem_edges_iff.2 hQe
  · have heq' : p.walk = ru.append (Q.walk.append rv) := by
      simpa [Walk.append_assoc] using heq
    have hpathQR : (Q.walk.append rv).IsPath :=
      Walk.IsPath.of_append_right (by simpa [heq'] using p.isPath)
    have hnod := hpathQR.support_nodup
    rw [Walk.support_append] at hnod
    have hdis := (List.nodup_append.1 hnod).2.2
    have hvW : v ∈ Q.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := Q)).1 hv
    have hvR : v ∈ rv.support := Walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges hrv (by simp)
    have hv_ne : v ≠ Q.finish := by
      intro hvQ
      have hadj : G.Adj u v := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using p.edges_subset_edgeSet _ he
      have huR : u ∈ rv.support := Walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges hrv (by simp)
      have huW : u ∈ Q.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := Q)).1 hu
      by_cases hu_eq : u = Q.finish
      · exact hadj.ne (hu_eq.trans hvQ.symm)
      · exact hdis u huW u
          (mem_support_tail_of_ne_start (p := ofWalk rv
            (Walk.IsPath.of_append_right hpathQR))
            (List.mem_toFinset.2 huR) hu_eq) rfl
    exact (hdis v hvW v
      (mem_support_tail_of_ne_start (p := ofWalk rv
        (Walk.IsPath.of_append_right hpathQR))
        (List.mem_toFinset.2 hvR) hv_ne) rfl).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftover_finish_eq_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, _, _⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  by_cases hnil : rv.Nil
  · exact Walk.Nil.eq hnil
  · have heq' : p.walk = ru.append (Q.walk.append rv) := by
      simpa [Walk.append_assoc] using heq
    have hpathQR : (Q.walk.append rv).IsPath :=
      Walk.IsPath.of_append_right (by simpa [heq'] using p.isPath)
    have hpathR : rv.IsPath := Walk.IsPath.of_append_right hpathQR
    have hnod := hpathQR.support_nodup
    rw [Walk.support_append] at hnod
    have hdis := (List.nodup_append.1 hnod).2.2
    have hfQ : p.finish ∈ Q.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := Q)).1 hf
    have hne : (ofWalk rv hpathR).start ≠ (ofWalk rv hpathR).finish :=
      (nil_iff_start_eq_finish (ofWalk rv hpathR)).not.mp
        (by simpa [ofWalk] using hnil)
    have hfR : p.finish ∈ (ofWalk rv hpathR).walk.support.tail :=
      mem_support_tail_of_ne_start (p := ofWalk rv hpathR)
        (by simpa [ofWalk] using ofWalk rv hpathR |>.finish_mem_support)
        (by simpa [ofWalk] using hne.symm)
    exact (hdis p.finish hfQ p.finish hfR rfl).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftover_endpoint_of_leaving_edge
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, _, _⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  have heW : s(a, y) ∈ ((ru.append Q.walk).append rv).edges := by
    simpa [heq] using mem_edges_iff.1 he
  rw [Walk.edges_append, List.mem_append] at heW
  rcases heW with hmid | hrv
  · rw [Walk.edges_append, List.mem_append] at hmid
    rcases hmid with hru | hQe
    · have hyR : y ∈ ru.support := Walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges hru (by simp)
      have hpath : (ru.append Q.walk).IsPath :=
        Walk.IsPath.of_append_left (by simpa [heq] using p.isPath)
      have hnod := hpath.support_nodup
      rw [Walk.support_append] at hnod
      have hdis := (List.nodup_append.1 hnod).2.2
      refine Or.inl ?_
      by_contra hne
      exact hdis y hyR y (mem_support_tail_of_ne_start hy hne) rfl
    · have haQ : a ∈ Q.support :=
        mem_support_of_mem_edge (mem_edges_iff.2 hQe) (by simp)
      exact (ha haQ).elim
  · have heq' : p.walk = ru.append (Q.walk.append rv) := by
      simpa [Walk.append_assoc] using heq
    have hpath : (Q.walk.append rv).IsPath :=
      Walk.IsPath.of_append_right (by simpa [heq'] using p.isPath)
    have hnod := hpath.support_nodup
    rw [Walk.support_append] at hnod
    have hdis := (List.nodup_append.1 hnod).2.2
    have hyQ : y ∈ Q.walk.support := (mem_walk_support (p := Q)).1 hy
    refine Or.inr ?_
    by_cases hst : y = Q.finish
    · exact hst
    · have hyR : y ∈ rv.support := Walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges hrv (by simp)
      exact (hdis y hyQ y
        (mem_support_tail_of_ne_start (p := ofWalk rv
          (Walk.IsPath.of_append_right hpath))
          (List.mem_toFinset.2 hyR) hst) rfl).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.mem_incident_imp_succ_or_pred
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : s(u, v) ∈ c.incidentEdges u :=
    mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨he, by simp⟩
  have : s(u, v) ∈
      ({s(u, c.succAt hu), s((c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate, u)} :
        Finset (Sym2 V)) := by
    simpa [c.incidentEdges_eq hu] using hmem
  rcases mem_insert.1 this with h | h
  · rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp h) with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv'⟩
    · exact Or.inl hv
    · exact (hne hv'.symm).elim
  · rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp (mem_singleton.1 h)) with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
    · exact (hne h2.symm).elim
    · exact Or.inr h2

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff
statement:
lemma mem_boundaryEdges_iff {c : GraphCycle G} {U0 : Finset V} {e : Sym2 V} :
    e ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 ↔ e ∈ c.edges ∧ endsStraddle e U0
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundaryEdges]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftover_support_subset_K
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨by simpa [hp] using leftoverPieces_support_subset p Q hQ hx,
    disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p Q hQ) hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftover_in_U0_or_disjoint
statement:
lemma leftover_in_U0_or_disjoint {U A U0 : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p.support = U) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    Q.support ⊆ U0 ∨ Disjoint Q.support U0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmeet : (Q.support ∩ U0).Nonempty
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    by_contra hnot
    have hmiss : (Q.support \ U0).Nonempty := by
      by_contra hmiss
      have hsub : Q.support ⊆ U0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_contra hxU
        exact hmiss ⟨x, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx, hxU⟩⟩
      exact hnot hsub
    obtain ⟨e, he, hstr⟩ := exists_straddle_edge (S := U0) Q hmeet hmiss
    refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun a b he hstr => ?_) he hstr
    have haQ : a ∈ Q.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp)
    have hbQ : b ∈ Q.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge he (by simp)
    have hK : Q.support ⊆ U \ A := leftover_support_subset_K hp hQ
    have hadj : G.Adj a b := by
      simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using Q.edges_subset_edgeSet _ he
    have hxor := endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr
    by_cases haU : a ∈ U0
    · have hbU : b ∉ U0 := fun hbU =>
        hxor (propext ⟨fun _ => hbU, fun _ => haU⟩)
      exact hnocross a haU b (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hK hbQ, hbU⟩) hadj
    · have hbU : b ∈ U0 := by
        by_contra hbU
        exact hxor (propext ⟨fun h => (haU h).elim, fun h => (hbU h).elim⟩)
      exact hnocross b hbU a (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hK haQ, haU⟩) hadj.symm
  · refine Or.inr (disjoint_left.2 ?_)
    intro x hxQ hxU
    exact hmeet ⟨x, mem_inter.2 ⟨hxQ, hxU⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftover_start_of_meet_U0
statement:
lemma leftover_start_of_meet_U0 {U A U0 : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p.support = U) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hmeet : (Q.support ∩ U0).Nonempty) : Q.start ∈ U0
proof:
:= by
  rcases leftover_in_U0_or_disjoint (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) hp hQ hnocross
    with hsub | hdisj
  · exact hsub Q.start_mem_support
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmeet
    exact (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (mem_inter.1 hx).1 (mem_inter.1 hx).2).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_leftover_start_seam
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, hru, _⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  have hnn : ¬ ru.Nil := leftoverPieces_factor_ru_not_nil hs hQ heq
  have ha : ru.penultimate ∈ A := hru.resolve_left hnn
  have heRu : s(ru.penultimate, Q.start) ∈ ru.edges :=
    Walk.mk_penultimate_end_mem_edges hnn
  have heP : s(ru.penultimate, Q.start) ∈ p.walk.edges := by
    have : s(ru.penultimate, Q.start) ∈ (ru.append Q.walk).edges :=
      mem_edges_append_left heRu
    simpa [heq] using mem_edges_append_left (q := rv) this
  have hadj : G.Adj ru.penultimate Q.start := by
    have : s(ru.penultimate, Q.start) ∈ G.edgeSet :=
      ru.edges_subset_edgeSet heRu
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using this
  exact ⟨ru.penultimate, ha, hadj, mem_edges_iff.2 heP⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_leftover_finish_seam
statement:
lemma exists_leftover_finish_seam {A : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    ∃ a, a ∈ A ∧ G.Adj Q.finish a ∧
      (s(Q.finish, a) ∈ p.edges ∨ s(Q.finish, a) = s(p.finish, p.start))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, _, hrv⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  by_cases hnil : rv.Nil
  · have hfin : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hnil
    refine ⟨p.start, hs, by simpa [hfin] using hclose, Or.inr ?_⟩
    simp [hfin]
  · have hsnd : rv.snd ∈ A := hrv.resolve_left hnil
    obtain ⟨w, hadj, rest, hwalk⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil
    have hw : w = rv.snd := by simp [hwalk]
    have heRv : s(Q.finish, w) ∈ rv.edges := by simp [hwalk, Walk.edges_cons]
    have heP : s(Q.finish, w) ∈ p.walk.edges := by
      have : s(Q.finish, w) ∈ ((ru.append Q.walk).append rv).edges :=
        mem_edges_append_right heRv
      simpa [heq] using this
    refine ⟨w, by simpa [hw] using hsnd, by simpa [hw] using hadj, Or.inl ?_⟩
    exact mem_edges_iff.2 heP

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.NoConsecutive_of_no_AA_cycle
statement:
lemma NoConsecutive_of_no_AA_cycle {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) (hA : A ⊆ U)
    {p : GraphPath G}
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hno : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ hu : a ∈ c.support,
      c.succAt hu ∉ A ∧ (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∉ A) :
    NoConsecutive A p
proof:
:= by
  intro e he hboth
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun u v he hboth => ?_) he hboth
  obtain ⟨huA, hvA⟩ := bothEndsIn_iff.1 hboth
  have heC : s(u, v) ∈ c.edges := by
    have : s(u, v) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} :=
      mem_union.2 (Or.inl he)
    simpa [hedges, GraphCycle.edges] using this
