  have hu : u ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA huA
  have hne : u ≠ v := by
    have hadj : G.Adj u v := by
      simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using
        c.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (GraphCycle.mem_edges_iff.1 heC)
    exact hadj.ne
  rcases mem_incident_imp_succ_or_pred c hu heC hne with h | h
  · exact (hno u huA hu).1 (by simpa [h] using hvA)
  · exact (hno u huA hu).2 (by simpa [h] using hvA)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_edgeSet_suppressInternal_of_not_both
proof:
:= by
  have hAdj : (suppressInternal G A').Adj u v :=
    (adj_suppressInternal_iff (G := G) (A' := A')).2 ⟨hadj, hnot⟩
  simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using hAdj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.opened_edges_subset_cycle
statement:
lemma opened_edges_subset_cycle {p : GraphPath G}
    (c : GraphCycle G)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset) :
    p.edges ⊆ c.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have : e ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := mem_union.2 (Or.inl he)
  simpa [hedges, GraphCycle.edges] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_mem_support_of_mem_edge
statement:
lemma cycle_mem_support_of_mem_edge (c : GraphCycle G) {e : Sym2 V} {v : V}
    (he : e ∈ c.edges) (hv : v ∈ e) : v ∈ c.support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [GraphCycle.support] using
    List.mem_toFinset.2 (c.walk.mem_support_of_mem_edges (mem_edges_iff.1 he) hv)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.existsUnique_U0_end
proof:
:= by
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun a b h => ?_) h
  have hxor := endsStraddle_iff.1 h
  by_cases ha : a ∈ U0
  · have hb : b ∉ U0 := fun hb =>
      hxor (propext ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩)
    refine ⟨a, by simp, ha, ?_⟩
    intro y hy hyU
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hy with rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · exact (hb hyU).elim
  · have hb : b ∈ U0 := by
      by_contra hb
      exact hxor (propext ⟨fun h => (ha h).elim, fun h => (hb h).elim⟩)
    refine ⟨b, by simp, hb, ?_⟩
    intro y hy hyU
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hy with rfl | rfl
    · exact (ha hyU).elim
    · rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_mem_AunionY_of_mem_X
proof:
:= by
  intro hx'
  rcases mem_union.1 hx' with hA | hY
  · exact (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 (hX hx))).2 hA
  · exact (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx hY)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftover_U0_run_of_mem
statement:
lemma leftover_U0_run_of_mem {U A U0 : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G} {y : V}
    (hp : p.support = U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hyU0 : y ∈ U0) :
    ∃ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, y ∈ Q.support ∧ Q.start ∈ U0 ∧ Q.support ⊆ U0
proof:
:= by
  have hyK : y ∈ p.support \ A := by
    have hyU : y ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 hyU0)).1
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨by simpa [hp] using hyU, (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 hyU0)).2⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hyQ⟩ := exists_leftover_containing (p := p) (A := A) hyK
  have hmeet : (Q.support ∩ U0).Nonempty := ⟨y, mem_inter.2 ⟨hyQ, hyU0⟩⟩
  have hsU0 : Q.start ∈ U0 :=
    leftover_start_of_meet_U0 (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) hp hQ hnocross hmeet
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, hyQ, hsU0, hstay Q hQ hsU0⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_Y_is_internal_U0_run
statement:
lemma mem_Y_is_internal_U0_run {U A U0 X Y : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    {y : V} (hyY : y ∈ Y) (hyU0 : y ∈ U0) :
    ∃ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p,
      y ∈ Q.support ∧ Q.start ∈ U0 ∧ Q.start ∈ X ∧ Q.finish ∈ X ∧
        y ≠ Q.start ∧ y ≠ Q.finish ∧ y ≠ p.start ∧ y ≠ p.finish
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hyQ, hsU0, _hQsup⟩ :=
    leftover_U0_run_of_mem (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) hp hU0 hnocross hstay hyU0
  have hsX : Q.start ∈ X := hstartX Q hQ hsU0
  have hfX : Q.finish ∈ X := hfinX Q hQ hsU0
  have hyA : y ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 hyU0)).2
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, hyQ, hsU0, hsX, hfX, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro heq
    exact (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (heq ▸ hsX) hyY)
  · intro heq
    exact (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (heq ▸ hfX) hyY)
  · intro heq
    exact hyA (heq ▸ hs)
  · intro hyf
    have hfinQ : Q.finish = p.finish :=
      leftover_finish_eq_of_mem (A := A) hQ (by simpa [hyf] using hyQ)
    exact (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hfinQ ▸ hfX) (hyf ▸ hyY))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_neighbor_of_internal_on_leftover
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hvQ
  have hends := leftover_endpoint_of_leaving_edge (A := A) hQ
    (by simpa [Sym2.eq_swap] using he) hyQ hvQ
  exact hends.elim hns hnf

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_opened
statement:
lemma incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_opened
    {p : GraphPath G} (c : GraphCycle G)
    (hsup : p.support = c.support) (hedges : p.edges ⊆ c.edges)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ p.support) (hs : v ≠ p.start) (hf : v ≠ p.finish) :
    p.incidentEdges v = c.incidentEdges v
proof:
:= by
  have hP : p.ProtectedAt c {v} := by
    intro e he
    exact hedges (mem_AIncident_iff.1 he).1
  exact incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected p c hsup
    (singleton_subset_iff.2 hv) hP (mem_singleton_self v) hs hf

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_AA_of_no_cycle_neighbor
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_incident_imp_succ_or_pred c huC he hne with h | h
  · exact (hnoAA u huA huC).1 (by simpa [h] using hvA)
  · exact (hnoAA u huA huC).2 (by simpa [h] using hvA)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_neighbor_of_Y_on_leftover
statement:
lemma cycle_neighbor_of_Y_on_leftover {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    {y v : V} (hyY : y ∈ Y) (hyU0 : y ∈ U0)
    (he : s(y, v) ∈ c.edges) (heP : s(y, v) ∈ p.edges) :
    ∃ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p,
      y ∈ Q.support ∧ Q.start ∈ U0 ∧ v ∈ Q.support ∧ s(y, v) ∈ Q.edges
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hyQ, hsU0, _, _, hns, hnf, hnps, hnpf⟩ :=
    mem_Y_is_internal_U0_run (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) (X := X) (Y := Y)
      hU0 hdisj hp hs hnocross hstay hstartX hfinX hyY hyU0
  have hyP : y ∈ p.support := leftoverPieces_support_subset p Q hQ hyQ
  have hsubP : p.edges ⊆ c.edges := opened_edges_subset_cycle c hedges
  have hinc :=
    incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_opened (p := p) c (hp.trans hc.symm)
      hsubP hyP hnps hnpf
  have hePy : s(y, v) ∈ p.incidentEdges y :=
    mem_incidentEdges_iff.2 ⟨heP, by simp⟩
  have hvQ : v ∈ Q.support :=
    cycle_neighbor_of_internal_on_leftover (A := A) hQ hyQ hns hnf heP
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, hyQ, hsU0, hvQ,
    leftover_factor_edges_mem (A := A) hQ heP hyQ hvQ⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_edge_survives_suppressInternal_noYY
statement:
lemma cycle_edge_survives_suppressInternal_noYY {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hnoAA : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ hu : a ∈ c.support,
      c.succAt hu ∉ A ∧ (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∉ A)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (hnoYY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 →
      ∀ u ∈ Y, ∀ v ∈ Y, s(u, v) ∉ Q.edges)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ c.edges) :
    e ∈ (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)).edgeSet
proof:
:= by
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun u v he => ?_) he
  have hadj : G.Adj u v := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using
      c.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (mem_edges_iff.1 he)
  have hnot : ¬ (u ∈ A ∪ Y ∧ v ∈ A ∪ Y) := by
    intro ⟨huAY, hvAY⟩
    have huC : u ∈ c.support := cycle_mem_support_of_mem_edge c he (by simp)
    have hvC : v ∈ c.support := cycle_mem_support_of_mem_edge c he (by simp)
    have hne : u ≠ v := hadj.ne
    have hclosing : s(u, v) ≠ s(p.finish, p.start) := by
      intro heq
      have hfinAY : p.finish ∈ A ∪ Y := by
        rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq) with ⟨hu', hv'⟩ | ⟨hu', hv'⟩
        · simpa [hu'] using huAY
        · simpa [hv'] using hvAY
      rcases mem_union.1 hfinAY with hfinA | hfinY
      · have hstC : p.start ∈ c.support :=
          by simpa [hc, hp] using p.start_mem_support
        have heClose : s(p.start, p.finish) ∈ c.edges := by
          simpa [heq, Sym2.eq_swap] using he
        have hneSF : p.start ≠ p.finish := by
          have : G.Adj p.start p.finish := by
            simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using
              c.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (mem_edges_iff.1 heClose)
          exact this.ne
        exact not_AA_of_no_cycle_neighbor (c := c) hnoAA hstC heClose hneSF hs hfinA
      · obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hnpf⟩ :=
          mem_Y_is_internal_U0_run (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) (X := X)
            (Y := Y) hU0 hdisj hp hs hnocross hstay hstartX hfinX hfinY (hY hfinY)
        exact hnpf rfl
    have heP : s(u, v) ∈ p.edges := by
      have : s(u, v) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := by
        simpa [hedges, GraphCycle.edges] using he
      exact (mem_union.1 this).resolve_right fun h =>
        hclosing (mem_singleton.1 h)
    rcases mem_union.1 huAY with huA | huY
    · rcases mem_union.1 hvAY with hvA | hvY
      · exact not_AA_of_no_cycle_neighbor (c := c) hnoAA huC he hne huA hvA
      · have he' : s(v, u) ∈ c.edges := by simpa [Sym2.eq_swap] using he
        have heP' : s(v, u) ∈ p.edges := by simpa [Sym2.eq_swap] using heP
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ, _, _, huQ, _⟩ :=
          cycle_neighbor_of_Y_on_leftover (c := c) hc hU0 hdisj hp hs hedges
            hnocross hstay hstartX hfinX hvY (hY hvY) he' heP'
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B (B := A) p Q hQ) huQ huA)
    · rcases mem_union.1 hvAY with hvA | hvY
      · obtain ⟨Q, hQ, _, _, hvQ, _⟩ :=
          cycle_neighbor_of_Y_on_leftover (c := c) hc hU0 hdisj hp hs hedges
            hnocross hstay hstartX hfinX huY (hY huY) he heP
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B (B := A) p Q hQ) hvQ hvA)
      · obtain ⟨Q, hQ, _, hsU0, _, heQ⟩ :=
          cycle_neighbor_of_Y_on_leftover (c := c) hc hU0 hdisj hp hs hedges
            hnocross hstay hstartX hfinX huY (hY huY) he heP
        exact hnoYY Q hQ hsU0 u huY v hvY heQ
  exact mem_edgeSet_suppressInternal_of_not_both hadj hnot

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_edges_mem_suppressInternal_noYY
statement:
lemma cycle_edges_mem_suppressInternal_noYY {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hnoAA : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ hu : a ∈ c.support,
      c.succAt hu ∉ A ∧ (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∉ A)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (hnoYY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 →
      ∀ u ∈ Y, ∀ v ∈ Y, s(u, v) ∉ Q.edges) :
    ∀ e ∈ c.edges, e ∈ (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)).edgeSet
proof:
:=
  fun e he =>
    cycle_edge_survives_suppressInternal_noYY (c := c) hc hU0 hY hdisj hp hs
      hedges hnoAA hnocross hstay hstartX hfinX hnoYY he

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_A_U0
statement: lemma disjoint_A_U0 {U A U0 : Finset V} (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) : Disjoint A U0

  disjoint_A_of_saving_child (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) (Y := U0) hU0 subset_rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_path_edges
statement: lemma card_path_edges (p : GraphPath G) : p.edges.card = p.walk.length
proof:
:= by
  have hnod := p.isPath.isTrail.edges_nodup
  simpa [GraphPath.edges, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnod, Walk.length_edges]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_cycle_edges
statement: lemma card_cycle_edges (c : GraphCycle G) : c.edges.card = c.walk.length
proof:
:= by
  have hnod := c.isCycle.edges_nodup
  simpa [GraphCycle.edges, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnod, Walk.length_edges]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.closing_not_mem_opened_edges
statement:
lemma closing_not_mem_opened_edges {p : GraphPath G} (c : GraphCycle G)
    (hp : p.support = c.support)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset) :
    s(p.finish, p.start) ∉ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hEq : p.edges = c.edges := by
    have : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = p.edges :=
      union_eq_left.2 (singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem)
    simpa [this, GraphCycle.edges] using hedges
  have hlen : p.walk.length + 1 = c.walk.length := by
    have hpc := GraphPath.card_support p
    have hcc := c.card_support
    rw [← hp] at hcc
    exact hpc.symm.trans hcc
  have hlen' : p.walk.length = c.walk.length := by
    have := congrArg Finset.card hEq
    simpa [card_path_edges p, card_cycle_edges c] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.snd_mem_tail_of_not_nil
statement:
lemma snd_mem_tail_of_not_nil {u v : V} {w : G.Walk u v} (h : ¬ w.Nil) :
    w.snd ∈ w.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hadj, rest, hwalk⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 h
  simp [hwalk]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_two_seams_of_U0_leftover
statement:
lemma exists_two_seams_of_U0_leftover {U A U0 : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hQsup : Q.support ⊆ U0) :
    ∃ e1 e2, e1 ≠ e2 ∧
      e1 ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 ∧ e2 ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 ∧
        (∃ x ∈ Q.support, x ∈ e1 ∧ x ∈ U0) ∧
          (∃ x ∈ Q.support, x ∈ e2 ∧ x ∈ U0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, hfact, hru, hrv⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  have hnnRu : ¬ ru.Nil := leftoverPieces_factor_ru_not_nil hs hQ hfact
  have haA : ru.penultimate ∈ A := hru.resolve_left hnnRu
  let e1 : Sym2 V := s(ru.penultimate, Q.start)
  have he1Ru : e1 ∈ ru.edges := Walk.mk_penultimate_end_mem_edges hnnRu
  have he1P : e1 ∈ p.edges := by
    have : e1 ∈ (ru.append Q.walk).edges := mem_edges_append_left he1Ru
    exact mem_edges_iff.2 (by simpa [hfact] using mem_edges_append_left (q := rv) this)
  have hsU0 : Q.start ∈ U0 := hQsup Q.start_mem_support
  have hfU0 : Q.finish ∈ U0 := hQsup Q.finish_mem_support
  have haU0 : ru.penultimate ∉ U0 := disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_A_U0 hU0) haA
  have he1C : e1 ∈ c.edges := opened_edges_subset_cycle c hedges he1P
  have hstr1 : endsStraddle e1 U0 := endsStraddle_of_outside_inside haU0 hsU0
  have hbd1 : e1 ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 := mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he1C, hstr1⟩
  by_cases hnilRv : rv.Nil
  · have hfin : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hnilRv
    let e2 : Sym2 V := s(p.finish, p.start)
    have he2C : e2 ∈ c.edges := by
      have : e2 ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} :=
        mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton.2 rfl))
      simpa [hedges, GraphCycle.edges] using this
    have hbU0 : p.start ∉ U0 := disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_A_U0 hU0) hs
    have hstr2 : endsStraddle e2 U0 := by
      simpa [e2, hfin, Sym2.eq_swap] using
        (endsStraddle_of_outside_inside hbU0 hfU0)
    have hbd2 : e2 ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 := mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he2C, hstr2⟩
    have hne12 : e1 ≠ e2 := by
      intro heq
      have : s(p.finish, p.start) ∈ p.edges := by simpa [← heq, e2] using he1P
      exact closing_not_mem_opened_edges c (hp.trans hc.symm) hedges this
    refine ⟨e1, e2, hne12, hbd1, hbd2,
      ⟨Q.start, Q.start_mem_support, by simp [e1], hsU0⟩,
      ⟨Q.finish, Q.finish_mem_support, by simp [e2, hfin], hfU0⟩⟩
  · have hsndA : rv.snd ∈ A := hrv.resolve_left hnilRv
    let e2 : Sym2 V := s(Q.finish, rv.snd)
    have he2Rv : e2 ∈ rv.edges := by
      obtain ⟨w, hadj, rest, hwalk⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnilRv
      simp [e2, hwalk, Walk.edges_cons]
    have he2P : e2 ∈ p.edges := by
      have : e2 ∈ ((ru.append Q.walk).append rv).edges :=
        mem_edges_append_right he2Rv
      exact mem_edges_iff.2 (by simpa [hfact] using this)
    have hbU0 : rv.snd ∉ U0 := disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_A_U0 hU0) hsndA
    have he2C : e2 ∈ c.edges := opened_edges_subset_cycle c hedges he2P
    have hstr2 : endsStraddle e2 U0 := by
      simpa [e2, Sym2.eq_swap] using endsStraddle_of_outside_inside hbU0 hfU0
    have hbd2 : e2 ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0 := mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he2C, hstr2⟩
    have hne12 : e1 ≠ e2 := by
      intro heq
      have hnod := p.isPath.isTrail.edges_nodup
      have hedgesW : p.walk.edges = (ru.append Q.walk).edges ++ rv.edges := by
        simp [hfact, Walk.edges_append]
      have hleft : e1 ∈ (ru.append Q.walk).edges := mem_edges_append_left he1Ru
      have hnod' : ((ru.append Q.walk).edges ++ rv.edges).Nodup := by
        simpa [hedgesW] using hnod
      exact hnod'.disjoint hleft (by simpa [heq] using he2Rv)
    refine ⟨e1, e2, hne12, hbd1, hbd2,
      ⟨Q.start, Q.start_mem_support, by simp [e1], hsU0⟩,
      ⟨Q.finish, Q.finish_mem_support, by simp [e2], hfU0⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ne_seams_of_disjoint_runs
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  obtain ⟨z, hze, hzU, huniq⟩ := existsUnique_U0_end (mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he).2
  have hx' : x = z := huniq x hx.1 hx.2.1
  have hy' : y = z := by
    have hye : y ∈ e := by simpa [heq] using hy.1
    exact huniq y hye hy.2.1
  have hxy : x = y := hx'.trans hy'.symm
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hxy ▸ hx.2.2) hy.2.2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.four_le_card_cycle_boundary_U0
statement:
lemma four_le_card_cycle_boundary_U0 {U A U0 : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).length) :
    4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, R, hQ, hR, hsQ, hsR, hneQR⟩ := exists_two_leftover_in h2
  have hQsup := hstay Q hQ hsQ
  have hRsup := hstay R hR hsR
  obtain ⟨e1, e2, h12, hb1, hb2, ⟨x1, hx1Q, hx1e, hx1U⟩, ⟨x2, hx2Q, hx2e, hx2U⟩⟩ :=
    exists_two_seams_of_U0_leftover (c := c) hc hU0 hp hs hedges hQ hQsup
  obtain ⟨e3, e4, h34, hb3, hb4, ⟨x3, hx3R, hx3e, hx3U⟩, ⟨x4, hx4R, hx4e, hx4U⟩⟩ :=
    exists_two_seams_of_U0_leftover (c := c) hc hU0 hp hs hedges hR hRsup
  have hdisjQR : Disjoint Q.support R.support :=
    PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem (leftoverPieces_pairwise (B := A) p)
      hQ hR hneQR
  have h13 : e1 ≠ e3 :=
    ne_seams_of_disjoint_runs c hb1 hb3 ⟨hx1e, hx1U, hx1Q⟩ ⟨hx3e, hx3U, hx3R⟩ hdisjQR
  have h14 : e1 ≠ e4 :=
    ne_seams_of_disjoint_runs c hb1 hb4 ⟨hx1e, hx1U, hx1Q⟩ ⟨hx4e, hx4U, hx4R⟩ hdisjQR
  have h23 : e2 ≠ e3 :=
    ne_seams_of_disjoint_runs c hb2 hb3 ⟨hx2e, hx2U, hx2Q⟩ ⟨hx3e, hx3U, hx3R⟩ hdisjQR
  have h24 : e2 ≠ e4 :=
    ne_seams_of_disjoint_runs c hb2 hb4 ⟨hx2e, hx2U, hx2Q⟩ ⟨hx4e, hx4U, hx4R⟩ hdisjQR
  have hsub : ({e1, e2, e3, e4} : Finset (Sym2 V)) ⊆ c.boundaryEdges U0 := by
    intro e he
    simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at he
    rcases he with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hb1
    · exact hb2
    · exact hb3
    · exact hb4
  have hcard : ({e1, e2, e3, e4} : Finset (Sym2 V)).card = 4 := by
    repeat' rw [card_insert_of_notMem]
    · simp
    · simp [h34]
    · simp [h23, h24, h34]
    · simp [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24]
  have := card_le_card hsub
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.completeJoin_adj_suppressInternal
statement:
lemma completeJoin_adj_suppressInternal {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    {y x : V} (hy : y ∈ Y) (hx : x ∈ X) :
    (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)).Adj y x
proof:
:=
  (adj_suppressInternal_iff (G := G) (A' := A ∪ Y)).2
    ⟨(hjoin hx hy).symm, fun hboth => (not_mem_AunionY_of_mem_X hU0 hX hdisj hx) hboth.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.boundary_outside_end_mem_A
statement:
lemma boundary_outside_end_mem_A {U A U0 : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, a ∈ e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨heC, hstr⟩ := mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he
  obtain ⟨x, hxe, hxU, huniq⟩ := existsUnique_U0_end hstr
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun u v heC hstr hxe hxU huniq => ?_) heC hstr hxe hxU huniq
  have hadj : G.Adj u v := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using
      c.walk.edges_subset_edgeSet (mem_edges_iff.1 heC)
  have huC : u ∈ c.support := cycle_mem_support_of_mem_edge c heC (by simp)
  have hvC : v ∈ c.support := cycle_mem_support_of_mem_edge c heC (by simp)
  rcases (show u = x ∨ v = x from by
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hxe with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl) with rfl | rfl
  · have hvU : v ∉ U0 := fun hvU => (endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr)
      (propext ⟨fun _ => hvU, fun _ => hxU⟩)
    have hvUset : v ∈ U := by simpa [hc] using hvC
    by_cases hvA : v ∈ A
    · exact ⟨v, hvA, by simp⟩
    · have hvK : v ∈ (U \ A) \ U0 := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvUset, hvA⟩, hvU⟩
      exact (hnocross u hxU v hvK hadj).elim
  · have huU : u ∉ U0 := fun huU => (endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr)
      (propext ⟨fun _ => hxU, fun _ => huU⟩)
    have huUset : u ∈ U := by simpa [hc] using huC
    by_cases huA : u ∈ A
    · exact ⟨u, huA, by simp⟩
    · have huK : u ∈ (U \ A) \ U0 := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨huUset, huA⟩, huU⟩
      exact (hnocross v hxU u huK hadj.symm).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.three_le_path_boundary_of_start_Y
statement:
lemma three_le_path_boundary_of_start_Y {U A U0 Y : Finset V}
    {G' : SimpleGraph V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hdisjAY : Disjoint A Y)
    {p' : GraphPath G'} {c' : GraphCycle G'}
    (hp' : p'.support = U) (hc' : c'.support = U)
    (hP : p'.ProtectedAt c' A) (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges)
    (hsY : p'.start ∈ Y)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card) :
    3 ≤ (p'.boundaryEdges U0).card
proof:
:= by
  let S := c.boundaryEdges U0
  change 4 ≤ S.card at h4
  have hSsub : S ∩ p'.edges ⊆ p'.boundaryEdges U0 := by
    intro e he
    have ⟨heS, heP⟩ := mem_inter.1 he
    exact GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2
      ⟨heP, ((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).2⟩
  have hmiss : (S \ p'.edges).card ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hfA : p'.finish ∈ A
    · have hfP : p'.finish ∈ p'.support := p'.finish_mem_support
      have hfC : p'.finish ∈ c'.support := by simpa [hc', hp'] using hfP
      have h2c : (c'.incidentEdges p'.finish).card = 2 := c'.incidentEdges_card hfC
      have h3 : 3 ≤ p'.support.card := by simpa [hp', hc] using c.three_le_card_support
      have h2 : 2 ≤ p'.support.card := le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3
      have h1p : (p'.incidentEdges p'.finish).card = 1 :=
        p'.incidentEdges_card_finish h2
      have hsubI : p'.incidentEdges p'.finish ⊆ c'.incidentEdges p'.finish :=
        hP.incidentEdges_subset_cycle hfA
      have hmissF :
          (c'.incidentEdges p'.finish \ p'.incidentEdges p'.finish).card ≤ 1 := by
        have : (p'.incidentEdges p'.finish ∪
            (c'.incidentEdges p'.finish \ p'.incidentEdges p'.finish)).card =
            (c'.incidentEdges p'.finish).card := by
          rw [union_sdiff_of_subset hsubI]
        have hdisj :
            Disjoint (p'.incidentEdges p'.finish)
              (c'.incidentEdges p'.finish \ p'.incidentEdges p'.finish) :=
          disjoint_sdiff
        have := card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
        omega
      have hsubMiss : S \ p'.edges ⊆
          c'.incidentEdges p'.finish \ p'.incidentEdges p'.finish := by
        intro e he
        have ⟨heS, hneP⟩ := mem_sdiff.1 he
        obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
          boundary_outside_end_mem_A (c := c) hc hU0 hnocross heS
        have haP : a ∈ p'.support := by simpa [hp'] using hA haA
        have hsA : a ≠ p'.start := fun h =>
          (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAY (h ▸ haA) hsY)
        have haFin : a = p'.finish := by
          by_contra hne
          have heqI :=
            incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected p' c' (hp'.trans hc'.symm)
              (fun x hx => by simpa [hp'] using hA hx) hP haA hsA hne
          have heC' : e ∈ c'.incidentEdges a := by
            have heC : e ∈ c.edges := ((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).1
            exact (GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff (c := c') (v := a)).2 ⟨by simpa [hedges'] using heC, hae⟩
          have : e ∈ p'.incidentEdges a := by simpa [heqI] using heC'
          exact hneP (GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 this).1
        have heC' : e ∈ c'.incidentEdges p'.finish := by
          have heC : e ∈ c.edges := ((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).1
          exact (GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff (c := c') (v := p'.finish)).2
            ⟨by rw [hedges']; exact heC, by simpa [haFin] using hae⟩
        have hnotP : e ∉ p'.incidentEdges p'.finish := fun hin =>
          hneP (GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 hin).1
        exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨heC', hnotP⟩
      exact (card_le_card hsubMiss).trans hmissF
    · have hnone : S \ p'.edges = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
        intro e he
        obtain ⟨heS, hneP⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 he
        obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
          boundary_outside_end_mem_A (c := c) hc hU0 hnocross heS
        have hsA : a ≠ p'.start := fun h =>
          (disjoint_left.1 hdisjAY (h ▸ haA) hsY)
        have hfA' : a ≠ p'.finish := fun h => hfA (by simpa [h] using haA)
        have heqI :=
          incidentEdges_eq_cycle_of_internal_protected p' c' (hp'.trans hc'.symm)
            (fun x hx => by simpa [hp'] using hA hx) hP haA hsA hfA'
        have heC' : e ∈ c'.incidentEdges a :=
          (GraphCycle.mem_incidentEdges_iff (c := c') (v := a)).2
            ⟨by simpa [hedges'] using ((GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff (c := c) (U0 := U0)).1 heS).1, hae⟩
        have : e ∈ p'.incidentEdges a := by simpa [heqI] using heC'
        exact hneP (GraphPath.mem_incidentEdges_iff.1 this).1
      simp [hnone]
  have hinter : 3 ≤ (S ∩ p'.edges).card := by
    have hd : Disjoint (S ∩ p'.edges) (S \ p'.edges) := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.2
      intro e heI heD
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 heD).2 (Finset.mem_inter.1 heI).2
    have hdecomp : S = (S ∩ p'.edges) ∪ (S \ p'.edges) := by
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
      tauto
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hdecomp
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd] at hcard
    omega
  exact le_trans hinter (card_le_card hSsub)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_supportUnion_iff
statement:
lemma mem_supportUnion_iff {l : List (GraphPath G)} {x : V} :
    x ∈ supportUnion l ↔ ∃ p ∈ l, x ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [supportUnion]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hfold :
        supportUnion (p :: ps) = p.support ∪ supportUnion ps := by
      simp [supportUnion]
    rw [hfold, mem_union, ih]
    simp [List.mem_cons, or_comm, or_left_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.supportUnion_subset_of_covers
statement:
lemma supportUnion_subset_of_covers {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (l : List (GraphPath G)) (hl : ∀ p ∈ l, p ∈ pc.paths) :
    supportUnion l ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (mem_supportUnion_iff).1 hx
  exact pc.support_subset (hl p hp) hxp

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pairwise_filter
statement:
lemma pairwise_filter {l : List (GraphPath G)} (P : GraphPath G → Bool)
    (h : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    (l.filter P).Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support
proof:
:=
  List.Pairwise.filter _ h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ofPathList_card
statement:
lemma ofPathList_card {U : Finset V} (l : List (GraphPath G))
    (hdisj : l.Pairwise fun p q => Disjoint p.support q.support)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U ↔ ∃ p ∈ l, x ∈ p.support) :
    (ofPathList l hdisj hU).card = l.length
proof: := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.selCover_card
statement:
lemma selCover_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    (selCover pc P).card = (pc.paths.filter P).length
proof: := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.supportUnion_filter_union
statement:
lemma supportUnion_filter_union {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ∪
      supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p) = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hL | hR
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := mem_supportUnion_iff.1 hL
      exact pc.support_subset (List.mem_of_mem_filter hp) hxp
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := mem_supportUnion_iff.1 hR
      exact pc.support_subset (List.mem_of_mem_filter hp) hxp
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx
    by_cases hP : P p = true
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_supportUnion_iff.2
        ⟨p, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, hP⟩, hxp⟩))
    · have hP' : (!P p) = true := by
        cases hpP : P p <;> simp_all
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_supportUnion_iff.2
        ⟨p, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, hP'⟩, hxp⟩))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.supportUnion_filter_disjoint
statement:
lemma supportUnion_filter_disjoint {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    Disjoint (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
      (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := mem_supportUnion_iff.1 (mem_inter.1 hx).1
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := mem_supportUnion_iff.1 (mem_inter.1 hx).2
    have hp' := List.mem_filter.1 hp
    have hq' := List.mem_filter.1 hq
    have hPp : P p = true := hp'.2
    have hPq : P q = false := by
      have : (!P q) = true := hq'.2
      simp at this
      exact this
    have hne : p ≠ q := fun heq => by
      subst heq
      simp [hPp] at hPq
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp'.1 hq'.1 hne) hxp hxq).elim
  · intro hx
    exact (notMem_empty x hx).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.supportUnion_filter_sdiff
statement:
lemma supportUnion_filter_sdiff {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p) =
      U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := supportUnion_filter_union pc P
  have hdisj := supportUnion_filter_disjoint pc P
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(hU ▸ mem_union.2 (Or.inr hx)), fun hL =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hL hx⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxU : x ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hxL : x ∉ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have : x ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ∪
        supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p) := by
      rwa [hU]
    exact (mem_union.1 this).resolve_left hxL

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.replaceSel_paths
statement:
lemma replaceSel_paths {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) (pcL : PathCover G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))) :
    (replaceSel pc P pcL).paths =
      (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p) ++ pcL.paths
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.replaceSel_card
statement:
lemma replaceSel_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) (pcL : PathCover G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))) :
    (replaceSel pc P pcL).card =
      (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p).length + pcL.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [PathCover.card, replaceSel_paths, List.length_append]
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_selected
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_selected {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U) (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    pathCoverNumber G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) =
      (pc.paths.filter P).length
proof:
:= by
  have hle : pathCoverNumber G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ≤
      (pc.paths.filter P).length := by
    simpa [selCover_card] using
      pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (selCover pc P)
  refine le_antisymm hle ?_
  by_contra hlt
  obtain ⟨pcL, hL⟩ :=
    exists_min_pathCover (G := G) (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
  have hsum := length_filter_add_not P pc.paths
  have hrep := replaceSel_card pc P pcL
  have hlen : pc.card = pc.paths.length := rfl
  have hpc' : (replaceSel pc P pcL).card < pc.card := by omega
  have : pathCoverNumber G U ≤ (replaceSel pc P pcL).card :=
    pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) (replaceSel pc P pcL)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_selected_subset
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_selected_subset {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U) (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ⊆
      eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxL : x ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) :=
    eligibleSet_subset (G := G) _ hx
  have hxE := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hx
  obtain ⟨pcL, hL, p, hp, hxend⟩ := hxE.2
  have hm := pathCoverNumber_selected pc hpc P
  have hrep := replaceSel_card pc P pcL
  have hsum := length_filter_add_not P pc.paths
  have hlen : pc.card = pc.paths.length := rfl
  have hcard : (replaceSel pc P pcL).card = pathCoverNumber G U := by omega
  have hp' : p ∈ (replaceSel pc P pcL).paths := by
    rw [replaceSel_paths]
    exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hp)
  have hEl : Eligible G U x := ⟨replaceSel pc P pcL, hcard, p, hp', hxend⟩
  exact mem_inter.2 ⟨(mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hEl.mem, hEl⟩, hxL⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_selected_supset
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_selected_supset {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U) (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ⊆
      ineligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxF := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  have hxL : x ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  refine (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hxL, ?_⟩
  intro hE
  have hxE : x ∈ eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) :=
    (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hxL, hE⟩
  have hxU := eligibleSet_selected_subset pc hpc P hxE
  exact hxF.2 ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (mem_inter.1 hxU).1).2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_pathCover_sdiff
statement:
lemma exists_pathCover_sdiff {U S : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hS : S ⊆ U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (U \ S),
      pc'.card ≤ pc.card + S.card ∧
      ∀ q ∈ pc'.paths, ∃ p ∈ pc.paths, q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction generalizing U pc with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨pc.cast (by simp), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [PathCover.cast_card]
    · intro q hq
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
      exact ⟨q, hq, subset_rfl⟩
  | insert b S hb ih =>
    have hSsub : S ⊆ U.erase b := by
      intro y hy
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hby => hb (hby ▸ hy), hS (mem_insert_of_mem hy)⟩
    obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hsup1⟩ :=
      ih (U := U.erase b) (pc.deleteVertex b) hSsub
    have hEq : U.erase b \ S = U \ insert b S := by
      rw [sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_distrib, erase_eq_of_notMem hb]
    refine ⟨pc1.cast hEq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hdv := pc.card_deleteVertex_le b
      have hins : (insert b S).card = S.card + 1 := card_insert_of_notMem hb
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      omega
    · intro q hq
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := hsup1 q hq
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hr'⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 (show r ∈
          (pc.paths.flatMap fun t => GraphPath.deleteVertex t b) from by
        simpa [PathCover.deleteVertex] using hr)
      exact ⟨p, hp, hqr.trans (GraphPath.support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex hr')⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_filter_bool_or
statement:
lemma mem_filter_bool_or {α : Type*} (P : α → Bool) {a : α} {l : List α}
    (ha : a ∈ l) : a ∈ l.filter P ∨ a ∈ l.filter fun x => !P x
proof:
:= by
  cases hP : P a
  · exact Or.inr (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨ha, by simp [hP]⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨ha, hP⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.L_sdiff_F0_eq_eligible_inter
statement:
lemma L_sdiff_F0_eq_eligible_inter {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) \
        (ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) =
      eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzL : z ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzF : z ∉ ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) :=
      (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    have hzU : z ∈ U := supportUnion_subset_of_covers pc (pc.paths.filter P)
      (fun p hp => List.mem_of_mem_filter hp) hzL
    have hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G U := by
      by_contra hnot
      have : z ∈ ineligibleSet G U :=
        (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzU, fun hE =>
          hnot ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzU, hE⟩)⟩
      exact hzF (mem_inter.2 ⟨this, hzL⟩)
    exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hzE, hzL⟩
  · intro hz
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_inter.1 hz).2, ?_⟩
    intro hF
    exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) U)
      (mem_inter.1 hz).1) (mem_inter.1 hF).1

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_sdiff_eq_unselected_remainder
statement:
lemma eligible_sdiff_eq_unselected_remainder {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) =
      (U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) \
        (ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzE := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzL : z ∉ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzE.1, hzL⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hF
    exact ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (mem_sdiff.1 hF).1).2 hzE.2
  · intro hz
    have hzUL := mem_sdiff.1 (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
    have hzF : z ∉ ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) :=
      (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
    have hnotF : z ∉ ineligibleSet G U := fun h =>
      hzF (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨h, hzUL.2⟩)
    have hE : Eligible G U z := by
      have h := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G) (U := U) (x := z)).not
      simp only [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
      exact h.mp hnotF hzUL.1
    exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzUL.1, hE⟩, hzUL.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_remainder_cover_of_ineligible
statement:
lemma exists_remainder_cover_of_ineligible {U : Finset V}
    (hU : CotreeOn G U) (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (eligibleSet G U),
      pc'.card = componentCount G (eligibleSet G U) ∧
      pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G U + (ineligibleSet G U).card ∧
      ∀ q ∈ pc'.paths, ∃ p ∈ pc.paths, q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  have hFsub : ineligibleSet G U ⊆ U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U
  obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hsup1⟩ := exists_pathCover_sdiff pc hFsub
  have hE : U \ ineligibleSet G U = eligibleSet G U :=
    (eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible (G := G) U).symm
  let pc' : PathCover G (eligibleSet G U) := pc1.cast hE
  have hcut := componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq hU
  have hCE : componentCount G (eligibleSet G U) =
      (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U := by
    simpa [eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible (G := G) U] using hcut
  have hple := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc'
  have hcle := componentCount_le_pathCoverNumber (G := G) (eligibleSet G U)
  have hcard' : pc'.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G U + (ineligibleSet G U).card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card]; omega
  have hpcard : pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G U + (ineligibleSet G U).card := by
    omega
  refine ⟨pc', ?_, hpcard, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · intro q hq
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
    exact hsup1 q hq

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_lt_of_adj_between_paths
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin pc.paths.length → (G.induce (W : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    fun i =>
      (G.induce (W : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨(pc.paths.get i).start,
          pc.support_subset (List.mem_iff_get.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
            (pc.paths.get i).start_mem_support⟩
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := (pc.mem_iff x.1).1 x.2
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.1 hr
    refine ⟨k, ConnectedComponent.sound ?_⟩
    have hsub : r.support ⊆ W := pc.support_subset hr
    have hR :=
      reachable_of_mem_graphPath (U := W) r hsub r.start_mem_support hxr
    have heq :
        (⟨(pc.paths.get k).start,
            pc.support_subset (List.mem_iff_get.2 ⟨k, rfl⟩)
              (pc.paths.get k).start_mem_support⟩ : (W : Set V)) =
          ⟨r.start, hsub r.start_mem_support⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (congrArg GraphPath.start hk)
    rw [heq]; exact hR
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.1 hp
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.1 hq
  have hij : i ≠ j := fun heq => hne (hi.symm.trans (heq ▸ hj))
  have hsubp : p.support ⊆ W := pc.support_subset hp
  have hsubq : q.support ⊆ W := pc.support_subset hq
  have hsame : f i = f j := by
    apply ConnectedComponent.sound
    have hpa :=
      reachable_of_mem_graphPath (U := W) p hsubp p.start_mem_support ha
    have hqb :=
      reachable_of_mem_graphPath (U := W) q hsubq hb q.start_mem_support
    have hab : (G.induce (W : Set V)).Reachable
        ⟨a, hsubp ha⟩ ⟨b, hsubq hb⟩ :=
      Adj.reachable (by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj)
    have hi' :
        (⟨(pc.paths.get i).start,
            pc.support_subset (List.mem_iff_get.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
              (pc.paths.get i).start_mem_support⟩ : (W : Set V)) =
          ⟨p.start, hsubp p.start_mem_support⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (congrArg GraphPath.start hi)
    have hj' :
        (⟨(pc.paths.get j).start,
            pc.support_subset (List.mem_iff_get.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩)
              (pc.paths.get j).start_mem_support⟩ : (W : Set V)) =
          ⟨q.start, hsubq q.start_mem_support⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (congrArg GraphPath.start hj)
    rw [hi', hj']
    exact hpa.trans (hab.trans hqb)
  have hnInj : ¬ Function.Injective f := fun hinj => hij (hinj hsame)
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (W : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  have hlt : Fintype.card (G.induce (W : Set V)).ConnectedComponent <
      Fintype.card (Fin pc.paths.length) :=
    Fintype.card_lt_of_surjective_not_injective f hf hnInj
  simpa [componentCount, PathCover.card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    Fintype.card_fin] using hlt

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.no_adj_of_card_eq_componentCount
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  have := componentCount_lt_of_adj_between_paths pc hp hq hne ha hb hadj
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.no_cross_selected_remainder
statement:
lemma no_cross_selected_remainder {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U)
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) {a b : V}
    (ha : a ∈ eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
    (hb : b ∈ eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) :
    ¬ G.Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc', hcomp, _, hsup⟩ :=
    exists_remainder_cover_of_ineligible hU pc hpc
  have haE : a ∈ eligibleSet G U := (mem_inter.1 ha).1
  have haL : a ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_inter.1 ha).2
  have hbE : b ∈ eligibleSet G U := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
  have hbL : b ∉ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
  obtain ⟨qa, hqa, haq⟩ := (pc'.mem_iff a).1 haE
  obtain ⟨qb, hqb, hbq⟩ := (pc'.mem_iff b).1 hbE
  obtain ⟨pa, hpa, hqaP⟩ := hsup qa hqa
  have hne : qa ≠ qb := by
    intro heq
    have hbqa : b ∈ qa.support := by
      have : b ∈ qb.support := hbq
      rwa [heq]
    rcases mem_filter_bool_or P hpa with hP | hR
    · exact hbL (mem_supportUnion_iff.2 ⟨pa, hP, hqaP hbqa⟩)
    · have haR : a ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r => !P r) :=
        mem_supportUnion_iff.2 ⟨pa, hR, hqaP haq⟩
      have : a ∈ U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := by
        rwa [supportUnion_filter_sdiff pc P] at haR
      exact (mem_sdiff.1 this).2 haL
  exact no_adj_of_card_eq_componentCount pc' hcomp hqa hqb hne haq hbq

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_eligible_split
statement:
lemma componentCount_eligible_split {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U)
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    componentCount G (eligibleSet G U) =
      componentCount G (eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) +
        componentCount G (eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : eligibleSet G U =
      (eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ∪
        (eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      by_cases hL : z ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hL⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz, hL⟩))
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with h | h
      · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
      · exact (mem_sdiff.1 h).1
  have hdisj :
      Disjoint (eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
        (eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) := by
    rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact ((mem_sdiff.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).2).2 (mem_inter.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).1).2).elim
    · intro hz
      exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
  have hnocross :
      ∀ a ∈ eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P),
        ∀ b ∈ eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P), ¬ G.Adj a b :=
    fun a ha b hb => no_cross_selected_remainder hU pc hpc P ha hb
  have h := componentCount_union_of_no_cross hdisj hnocross
  rwa [← hsplit] at h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_selected_remainder
statement:
lemma componentCount_selected_remainder {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U)
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    componentCount G
        (eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) =
      (ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)).card +
        (pc.paths.filter P).length
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit := componentCount_eligible_split hU pc hpc P
  have hCE : componentCount G (eligibleSet G U) =
      (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U := by
    simpa [eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible (G := G) U] using
      componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq hU
  have hrest := eligible_sdiff_eq_unselected_remainder pc P
  have hsub :
      ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ⊆
        U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) :=
    sdiff_subset_sdiff (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U) subset_rfl
  have hcle :
      componentCount G (eligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ≤
        pathCoverNumber G (U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) +
          (ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)).card := by
    simpa [hrest] using
      componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G)
        (U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
        (ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) hsub
  have hcov :
      pathCoverNumber G (U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ≤
        (pc.paths.filter fun p => !P p).length := by
    have hrem := supportUnion_filter_sdiff pc P
    simpa [selCover_card, PathCover.cast_card] using
      pathCoverNumber_le (G := G)
        ((selCover pc (fun p => !P p)).cast hrem)
  have hsum := length_filter_add_not P pc.paths
  have hlen : pc.card = pc.paths.length := rfl
  have hFsplit :
      (ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)).card +
        (ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)).card =
      (ineligibleSet G U).card := by
    have hun : ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ∪
        ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) =
        ineligibleSet G U := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        rcases mem_union.1 hz with h | h
        · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
        · exact (mem_sdiff.1 h).1
      · intro hz
        by_cases hL : z ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hL⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz, hL⟩))
    have hdisj :
        Disjoint (ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
          (ineligibleSet G U \ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) := by
      rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        exact ((mem_sdiff.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).2).2 (mem_inter.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).1).2).elim
      · intro hz
        exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
    rw [← card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hun]
  have hm := pathCoverNumber_selected pc hpc P
  have hLF0 := L_sdiff_F0_eq_eligible_inter pc P
  have hle :
      componentCount G (eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ≤
        pathCoverNumber G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) +
          (ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)).card := by
    have hsubL : ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ⊆
        supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := inter_subset_right
    have := componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G)
      (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
      (ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) hsubL
    simpa [hLF0] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.restriction_of_min_cover
statement:
lemma restriction_of_min_cover {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U)
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    pathCoverNumber G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) =
      (pc.paths.filter P).length ∧
    eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) ⊆
      eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ∧
    ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) ⊆
      ineligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P))
proof:
:=
  ⟨pathCoverNumber_selected pc hpc P,
    eligibleSet_selected_subset pc hpc P,
    ineligibleSet_selected_supset pc hpc P⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_selected_eq
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_selected_eq {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U)
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    ineligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) =
      ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
proof:
:= by
  set L := supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
  set m := (pc.paths.filter P).length
  set F := ineligibleSet G U
  set F0 := F ∩ L
  set FL := ineligibleSet G L
  have hm := pathCoverNumber_selected pc hpc P
  have hF0sub := ineligibleSet_selected_supset pc hpc P
  have hLsub : L ⊆ U := supportUnion_subset_of_covers pc (pc.paths.filter P)
    (fun p hp => List.mem_of_mem_filter hp)
  have hLc : IsCograph G L :=
    isCograph_mono (isCograph_of_cotreeOn hU) hLsub
  have hcutL :=
    componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq (cotreeOn_of_isCograph hLc)
  have hEsub := eligibleSet_selected_subset pc hpc P
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ hF0sub
  intro v hvFL
  by_contra hvF0
  have hvL : v ∈ L := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) L hvFL
  have hvnotF : v ∉ F := fun h => hvF0 (mem_inter.2 ⟨h, hvL⟩)
  let S := (F \ L) ∪ FL
  have hFLsub : FL ⊆ L := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) L
  have hdisjS : Disjoint (F \ L) FL := by
    rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact ((mem_sdiff.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).1).2 (hFLsub (mem_inter.1 hz).2)).elim
    · intro hz
      exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
  have hSsub : S ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with h | h
    · exact ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U (mem_sdiff.1 h).1
    · exact hLsub (hFLsub h)
  have hUrem : U \ S = (eligibleSet G U \ L) ∪ (L \ FL) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hzU : z ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hzN : z ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      by_cases hzL : z ∈ L
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzL, fun hFL =>
          hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hFL))⟩))
      · have hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G U := by
          have hnotF : z ∉ F := fun h =>
            hzN (mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨h, hzL⟩)))
          have h := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G) (U := U) (x := z)).not
          simp only [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
          exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzU, h.mp hnotF hzU⟩
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzE, hzL⟩))
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hE | hL
      · have hzE := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (mem_sdiff.1 hE).1
        have hzL : z ∉ L := (mem_sdiff.1 hE).2
        refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzE.1, ?_⟩
        intro hS
        rcases mem_union.1 hS with hzF | hzFL
        · exact ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (mem_sdiff.1 hzF).1).2 hzE.2
        · exact hzL (hFLsub hzFL)
      · have hzL : z ∈ L := (mem_sdiff.1 hL).1
        have hzFL : z ∉ FL := (mem_sdiff.1 hL).2
        refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hLsub hzL, ?_⟩
        intro hS
        rcases mem_union.1 hS with hzF | hzFL'
        · exact (mem_sdiff.1 hzF).2 hzL
        · exact hzFL hzFL'
  have hdisjRem : Disjoint (eligibleSet G U \ L) (L \ FL) := by
    rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact ((mem_sdiff.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).1).2 (mem_sdiff.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).2).1).elim
    · intro hz
      exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
  have hnocross :
      ∀ a ∈ eligibleSet G U \ L, ∀ b ∈ L \ FL, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
    intro a ha b hb hadj
    have hbL : b ∈ L := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
    have hbnotFL : b ∉ FL := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
    have hbEL : Eligible G L b := by
      have h := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G) (U := L) (x := b)).not
      simp only [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
      exact h.mp hbnotFL hbL
    have hbE := hEsub ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hbL, hbEL⟩)
    exact no_cross_selected_remainder hU pc hpc P hbE ha hadj.symm
  have hadd := componentCount_union_of_no_cross hdisjRem hnocross
  have hUS : componentCount G (U \ S) =
      componentCount G (eligibleSet G U \ L) + componentCount G (L \ FL) := by
    have h := hadd
    rwa [← hUrem] at h
  have hCFL : componentCount G (L \ FL) = FL.card + m := by
    have h := hcutL
    rw [hm] at h
    exact h
  have hsplit := componentCount_eligible_split hU pc hpc P
  have hCE : componentCount G (eligibleSet G U) =
      F.card + pathCoverNumber G U := by
    simpa [eligibleSet_eq_sdiff_ineligible (G := G) U] using
      componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq hU
  have hCEL := componentCount_selected_remainder hU pc hpc P
  have hCun :
      componentCount G (eligibleSet G U ∩ L) +
        componentCount G (eligibleSet G U \ L) =
      F.card + pathCoverNumber G U := by
    have h1 : componentCount G (eligibleSet G U) =
        componentCount G (eligibleSet G U ∩ L) +
          componentCount G (eligibleSet G U \ L) := by
      convert hsplit
    exact h1.symm.trans hCE
  have hFsplit :
      F0.card + (F \ L).card = F.card := by
    have hun : F0 ∪ (F \ L) = F := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        rcases mem_union.1 hz with h | h
        · exact (mem_inter.1 h).1
        · exact (mem_sdiff.1 h).1
      · intro hz
        by_cases hL : z ∈ L
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hL⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz, hL⟩))
    have hdisj : Disjoint F0 (F \ L) := by
      rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        exact ((mem_sdiff.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).2).2 (mem_inter.1 (mem_inter.1 hz).1).2).elim
      · intro hz
        exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
    rw [← card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hun]
  have hScard : S.card = (F \ L).card + FL.card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint hdisjS
  have hatt : componentCount G (U \ S) = pathCoverNumber G U + S.card := by
    have h1 := hUS
    have h2 := hCFL
    have h3 := hCun
    have h4 := hCEL
    have h5 := hFsplit
    have h6 := hScard
    have h7 := hpc
    have h8 := hm
    dsimp [L, m, F, F0, FL, S] at h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 ⊢
    omega
  have hSinc := eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible hSsub hatt
  have hvS : v ∈ S := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hvFL)
  have hvF : v ∈ F := hSinc hvS
  exact hvnotF hvF

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_selected_eq
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_selected_eq {U : Finset V} (hU : CotreeOn G U)
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U)
    (P : GraphPath G → Bool) :
    eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) =
      eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (eligibleSet_selected_subset pc hpc P) ?_
  intro x hx
  have hxU : x ∈ eligibleSet G U := (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  have hxL : x ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  have hFeq := ineligibleSet_selected_eq hU pc hpc P
  have hxnotF : x ∉ ineligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) := by
    intro hxF
    have : x ∈ ineligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P) := by
      rwa [← hFeq]
    exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) U)
      hxU) (mem_inter.1 this).1
  have hE : Eligible G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) x := by
    have h := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)
      (U := supportUnion (pc.paths.filter P)) (x := x)).not
    simp only [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
    exact h.mp hxnotF hxL
  exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hxL, hE⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_le
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_length_le (B : Finset V) (p : GraphPath G) :
    (leftoverPieces B p).length ≤
      (p.support ∩ B).card + if p.start ∈ B then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        (leftoverPieces B p).length ≤
          (p.support ∩ B).card + if p.start ∈ B then 0 else 1)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl
  intro n ih p hn
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · have hsing : p.support = {p.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
      simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hsB hnil, hsing, hsB]
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil]
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      have ih' := ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl
      have hps : p.support = insert p.start (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
        rw [support_trimStart, insert_erase p.start_mem_support]
      have hstart_not : p.start ∉ (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
        rw [support_trimStart]; exact notMem_erase _ _
      have hcard : (p.support ∩ B).card =
          ((p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B).card + 1 := by
        rw [hps, insert_inter_of_mem hsB, card_insert_of_notMem]
        exact fun hz => hstart_not (mem_inter.1 hz).1
      have hbound :
          ((p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B).card +
            (if (p.trimStart hnil).start ∈ B then 0 else 1) ≤
            (p.support ∩ B).card := by
        rw [hcard]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      simpa [hsB] using ih'.trans hbound
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      have hlist : leftoverPieces B p = [p] :=
        leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind
      have hemp : p.support ∩ B = ∅ := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          have hyW : y ∈ p.walk.support :=
            (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 (mem_inter.1 hy).1
          have hnot : ¬ decide (y ∈ B) :=
            (List.find?_eq_none (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 hfind y hyW
          exact (hnot (decide_eq_true (mem_inter.1 hy).2)).elim
        · intro hy
          exact (notMem_empty y hy).elim
      simp [hlist, hemp, hsB]
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
      simp [hsB, hnone]
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hne
      have ih' := ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl
      have hstartD : (p.dropUntil hx).start ∈ B := by
        simpa [dropUntil] using (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2
      have hlenD : (leftoverPieces B (p.dropUntil hx)).length ≤
          ((p.dropUntil hx).support ∩ B).card := by
        simpa [hstartD] using ih'
      have hsub : (p.dropUntil hx).support ∩ B ⊆ p.support ∩ B :=
        inter_subset_inter (dropUntil_support_subset p hx) subset_rfl
      have : (leftoverPieces B (p.dropUntil hx)).length + 1 ≤
          (p.support ∩ B).card + 1 := by
        have := card_le_card hsub
        omega
      simpa [hsB] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_le_of_start_mem
proof:
:= by
  have h := leftoverPieces_length_le B p
  simpa [hs] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_start_mem
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_start_mem {B : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p) : Q.start ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  leftoverPieces_support_subset p Q hQ Q.start_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_finish_mem
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_finish_mem {B : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p) : Q.finish ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  leftoverPieces_support_subset p Q hQ Q.finish_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_start_ne
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_start_ne {B : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∈ B) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p) : Q.start ≠ p.start
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p Q hQ)
    Q.start_mem_support (h ▸ hs)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isPath_of_isSubwalk
statement:
lemma isPath_of_isSubwalk {u v u' v' : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk u' v'}
    (hq : q.IsPath) (h : p.IsSubwalk q) : p.IsPath
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isPath_def] at hq ⊢
  exact hq.sublist (Walk.isSubwalk_iff_support_isInfix.1 h).sublist

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isSubwalk_trimStart
statement:
lemma isSubwalk_trimStart (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).walk.IsSubwalk p.walk
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isSubwalk_iff_support_isInfix]
  have ht : (p.trimStart h).walk.support = p.walk.support.tail := by
    simp [trimStart, Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil p.walk h]
  rw [ht]
  exact (List.tail_suffix p.walk.support).isInfix

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isSubwalk_trimFinish
statement:
lemma isSubwalk_trimFinish (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimFinish h).walk.IsSubwalk p.walk
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.isSubwalk_iff_support_isInfix]
  have hdl : (p.trimFinish h).walk.support = p.walk.support.dropLast :=
    Walk.support_dropLast (p := p.walk) h
  rw [hdl]
  exact (List.dropLast_prefix p.walk.support).isInfix

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_isSubwalk
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_isSubwalk {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) :
    ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl
  intro n ih p hn Q hQ
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hsB hnil] at hQ
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil] at hQ
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      exact (ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl Q hQ).trans (isSubwalk_trimStart p hnil)
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      have hlist : leftoverPieces B p = [p] :=
        leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind
      have : Q = p := List.mem_singleton.1 (hlist ▸ hQ)
      subst this
      exact Walk.isSubwalk_rfl _
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def] at hQ
      simp [hsB, hnone] at hQ
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
        hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
      rcases hQ with hQ | hQ
      · subst hQ
        exact (isSubwalk_trimFinish (p.takeUntil hx) hnn).trans
          (Walk.isSubwalk_takeUntil p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hx))
      · have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
          simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hne
        exact (ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl Q hQ).trans
          (Walk.isSubwalk_dropUntil p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hx))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.walk_eq_take_append_drop
statement:
lemma walk_eq_take_append_drop (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    p.walk = (p.takeUntil hx).walk.append (p.dropUntil hx).walk
proof:
:= by
  simp [takeUntil, dropUntil, Walk.take_spec]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.penultimate_append_of_not_nil
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < q.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hq
  have hlen : (p.append q).length = p.length + q.length := Walk.length_append p q
  have hnot : ¬ p.length + q.length - 1 < p.length := by omega
  have hsub : p.length + q.length - 1 - p.length = q.length - 1 := by omega
  simp only [Walk.penultimate, Walk.getVert_append, hlen]
  rw [if_neg hnot, hsub]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.snd_append_of_not_nil
proof:
:= by
  have hppos : 0 < p.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hp
  simp only [Walk.snd, Walk.getVert_append]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · have hlen : p.length = 1 := by omega
    have hv : p.getVert 1 = v := by simpa [hlen] using p.getVert_length
    simp [hlen, Walk.getVert_zero, hv]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.nil_copy
statement:
lemma nil_copy {u v u' v' : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hu : u = u') (hv : v = v') :
    (p.copy hu hv).Nil ↔ p.Nil
proof:
:= by
  subst hu
  subst hv
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.penultimate_copy
statement:
lemma penultimate_copy {u v u' v' : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hu : u = u') (hv : v = v') :
    (p.copy hu hv).penultimate = p.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  subst hu
  subst hv
  simp

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.tail_copy_eq_of_eq_cons
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  simp [Walk.tail_cons]
  cases r <;> rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_factor
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_factor {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) :
    ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p,
      ∃ (ru : G.Walk p.start Q.start) (rv : G.Walk Q.finish p.finish),
        p.walk = (ru.append Q.walk).append rv ∧
          (ru.Nil ∨ ru.penultimate ∈ B) ∧
            (rv.Nil ∨ rv.snd ∈ B)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p,
          ∃ (ru : G.Walk p.start Q.start) (rv : G.Walk Q.finish p.finish),
            p.walk = (ru.append Q.walk).append rv ∧
              (ru.Nil ∨ ru.penultimate ∈ B) ∧
                (rv.Nil ∨ rv.snd ∈ B))
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl
  intro n ih p hn Q hQ
  by_cases hsB : p.start ∈ B
  · by_cases hnil : p.walk.Nil
    · simp [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_nil hsB hnil] at hQ
    · rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hsB hnil] at hQ
      have hlt : (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
        simpa [hn] using trimStart_support_card_lt p hnil
      obtain ⟨ru', rv', heq', hru', hrv'⟩ :=
        ih _ hlt (p.trimStart hnil) rfl Q hQ
      obtain ⟨w, hadj, tail, hpw⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil
      have htrimS : (p.trimStart hnil).start = w := by
        simp [trimStart, hpw]
      have htrimW : (p.trimStart hnil).walk.copy htrimS rfl = tail := by
        simpa [trimStart] using
          tail_copy_eq_of_eq_cons (q := p.walk) (h := hadj) (r := tail) hpw
            (by simp [hpw, Walk.snd_cons])
      let ruC : G.Walk w Q.start := ru'.copy htrimS rfl
      have htail : tail = (ruC.append Q.walk).append rv' := by
        have hcopy :=
          congrArg
            (fun t : G.Walk (p.trimStart hnil).start (p.trimStart hnil).finish =>
              t.copy htrimS rfl)
            heq'
        have hR :
            ((ru'.append Q.walk).append rv').copy htrimS rfl =
              (ruC.append Q.walk).append rv' := by
          change ((ru'.append Q.walk).append rv').copy htrimS rfl =
            ((ru'.copy htrimS rfl).append Q.walk).append rv'
          rw [← Walk.append_copy_copy (ru'.append Q.walk) rv' htrimS rfl rfl]
          rw [← Walk.append_copy_copy ru' Q.walk htrimS rfl rfl]
          simp
        rw [← hR, ← hcopy, htrimW]
      refine ⟨Walk.cons hadj ruC, rv', ?_, ?_, hrv'⟩
      · rw [hpw, htail]
        exact (Walk.cons_append hadj (ruC.append Q.walk) rv').symm
      · refine Or.inr ?_
        by_cases hnil' : ru'.Nil
        · have hnilC : ruC.Nil := (nil_copy ru' htrimS rfl).2 hnil'
          have hlen0 : ruC.length = 0 := Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.2 hnilC
          have hlen1 : (Walk.cons hadj ruC).length = 1 := by
            simp [Walk.length_cons, hlen0]
          change (Walk.cons hadj ruC).getVert ((Walk.cons hadj ruC).length - 1) ∈ B
          simp [hlen1, hsB]
        · have hnilC : ¬ ruC.Nil := fun h => hnil' ((nil_copy ru' htrimS rfl).1 h)
          have hpen : (Walk.cons hadj ruC).penultimate = ruC.penultimate :=
            Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil hadj ruC hnilC
          rw [hpen, penultimate_copy ru' htrimS rfl]
          exact hru'.resolve_left hnil'
  · cases hfind : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
    | none =>
      have hlist : leftoverPieces B p = [p] :=
        leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsB hfind
      have : Q = p := List.mem_singleton.1 (hlist ▸ hQ)
      subst this
      exact ⟨Walk.nil, Walk.nil, by simp, Or.inl Walk.nil_nil, Or.inl Walk.nil_nil⟩
    | some _ =>
      have hnone : p.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
        simp [hfind]
      rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def] at hQ
      simp [hsB, hnone] at hQ
      have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p) hnone
      have hx : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
      have hbB : firstB B p hnone ∈ B := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2
      have hne : firstB B p hnone ≠ p.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind'
      have hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
        hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff p hx).1 hn)
      have hspec := walk_eq_take_append_drop p hx
      rcases hQ with hQ | hQ
      · have hQeq : Q = (p.takeUntil hx).trimFinish hnn := hQ
        have hmem : Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p := by
          rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]; simp [hsB, hnone, hQeq]
        obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq⟩ := leftoverPieces_isSubwalk p Q hmem
        have hsQ : Q.start = p.start := by simp [hQeq, trimFinish, takeUntil]
        have hru : ru.Nil := by
          have hp : ru.IsPath := by
            have h := p.isPath
            rw [heq] at h
            exact (Walk.IsPath.of_append_left h).of_append_left
          exact hp.nil_iff_eq.2 hsQ.symm
        refine ⟨ru, rv, heq, Or.inl hru, Or.inr ?_⟩
        have hlenQ : Q.walk.length + 1 = (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length := by
          have hQlen : Q.walk.length = (p.takeUntil hx).walk.dropLast.length := by
            rw [hQeq]; rfl
          have hdl := Walk.length_dropLast (p.takeUntil hx).walk
          have hpos : 1 ≤ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length :=
            Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hnn)
          omega
        have hnnRv : ¬ rv.Nil := by
          intro hrv
          have hxW : firstB B p hnone ∈ p.walk.support :=
            (mem_walk_support (p := p)).1 hx
          have hxCat : firstB B p hnone ∈
              ru.support ++ Q.walk.support.tail ++ rv.support.tail := by
            simpa [heq, Walk.support_append] using hxW
          have hruL : ru.support = [p.start] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hru
          have hrvL : rv.support = [Q.finish] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hrv
          have : firstB B p hnone ∈ Q.walk.support.tail := by
            have hxOr : firstB B p hnone = p.start ∨
                firstB B p hnone ∈ Q.walk.support.tail := by
              simpa [hruL, hrvL, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] using hxCat
            rcases hxOr with hst | htail
            · exact (hne hst).elim
            · exact htail
          have hxQ : firstB B p hnone ∈ Q.support := by
            simp [GraphPath.support]
            exact List.mem_of_mem_tail this
          exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p Q hmem) hxQ hbB
        have hru0 : ru.length = 0 := Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.2 hru
        have hgetR : p.walk.getVert (Q.walk.length + 1) = rv.snd := by
          rw [heq]
          simp [Walk.getVert_append, hru0, Walk.snd]
        have hgetB : p.walk.getVert (Q.walk.length + 1) = firstB B p hnone := by
          rw [hspec, hlenQ]
          have hga :=
            Walk.getVert_append (p.takeUntil hx).walk (p.dropUntil hx).walk
              (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length
          have hlt : ¬ (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length < (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length :=
            Nat.lt_irrefl _
          have hga0 :
              ((p.takeUntil hx).walk.append (p.dropUntil hx).walk).getVert
                  (p.takeUntil hx).walk.length =
                (p.dropUntil hx).walk.getVert 0 := by
            rw [hga, if_neg hlt, Nat.sub_self]
            rfl
          have hstart : (p.dropUntil hx).start = firstB B p hnone := by
            simp [dropUntil]
          exact
            (hga0.trans (Walk.getVert_zero (p.dropUntil hx).walk)).trans hstart
        rw [← hgetR, hgetB]
        exact hbB
      · have hlt : (p.dropUntil hx).support.card < n := by
          simpa [hn] using dropUntil_support_card_lt p hx hne
        obtain ⟨ru', rv', heq', hru', hrv'⟩ :=
          ih _ hlt (p.dropUntil hx) rfl Q hQ
        have hstartD : (p.dropUntil hx).start ∈ B := by
          simpa [dropUntil] using hbB
        have hru_nn : ¬ ru'.Nil := by
          intro hnil'
          have : Q.start = (p.dropUntil hx).start := (Walk.Nil.eq hnil').symm
          exact leftoverPieces_start_ne hstartD hQ this
        refine ⟨(p.takeUntil hx).walk.append ru', rv', ?_, Or.inr ?_, hrv'⟩
        · conv_lhs => rw [hspec]
          rw [heq']
          refine (Walk.append_assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
          exact congrArg (fun t => t.append rv')
            (Walk.append_assoc (p.takeUntil hx).walk ru' Q.walk)
        · have hpen :=
            penultimate_append_of_not_nil (p.takeUntil hx).walk ru' hru_nn
          exact hpen ▸ hru'.resolve_left hru_nn

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_factor_ru_not_nil
proof:
:= by
  intro hnil
  exact leftoverPieces_start_ne hs hQ (Walk.Nil.eq hnil).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isPath_of_factor_left
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.isPath
  rw [heq] at h
  exact (Walk.IsPath.of_append_left h).of_append_left

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.isPath_of_factor_right
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.isPath
  rw [heq] at h
  exact Walk.IsPath.of_append_right h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_ofWalk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_ofWalk {u v : V} (w : G.Walk u v) (hw : w.IsPath) :
    (ofWalk w hw).support = w.support.toFinset
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.adj_trimFinish_finish

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil
statement:
lemma walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil {u v : V} {w : G.Walk u v}
    (h : w.Nil) : w.support = [u]
