:=
  (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil
statement:
lemma walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil {u v : V} {w : G.Walk u v}
    (h : ¬ w.Nil) : w.support = u :: w.support.tail
proof:
:= by
  have ht := Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil w h
  simpa [ht] using (Walk.cons_support_tail (p := w) h).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_walk_concat_of_subwalk
proof:
:= by
  rw [heq, Walk.support_append, Walk.support_append]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnil : Q.walk.Nil
  · have : x = Q.start := by
      have : Q.walk.support = [Q.start] := walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil hnil
      simpa [this] using hx
    subst this
    exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (Walk.end_mem_support ru))))
  · have hcons : Q.walk.support = Q.start :: Q.walk.support.tail :=
      walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil hnil
    have : x = Q.start ∨ x ∈ Q.walk.support.tail := by
      rw [hcons] at hx
      exact List.mem_cons.1 hx
    rcases this with rfl | htail
    · exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (Walk.end_mem_support ru))))
    · exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr htail)))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_union_of_subwalk
proof:
:= by
  have hcat := mem_walk_concat_of_subwalk heq
  ext x
  simp only [GraphPath.support, mem_union, List.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x ∈ ru.support ++ Q.walk.support.tail ++ rv.support.tail := by
      simpa [hcat] using hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx' with h | hrv
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 h with hru | hQt
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hru)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (List.mem_of_mem_tail hQt))
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_of_mem_tail hrv)
  · intro hx
    have hcat' : x ∈ ru.support ++ Q.walk.support.tail ++ rv.support.tail →
        x ∈ p.walk.support := fun h => by simpa [hcat] using h
    rcases hx with h | hrv
    · rcases h with hru | hQ
      · exact hcat' (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hru))))
      · exact hcat' (mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support (by simpa [GraphPath.support] using hQ))
    · have hxR : x ∈ rv.support := hrv
      by_cases hnilR : rv.Nil
      · have : x = Q.finish := by
          have : rv.support = [Q.finish] := walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil hnilR
          simpa [this] using hxR
        subst this
        exact hcat' (mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support (Walk.end_mem_support Q.walk))
      · have hcons : rv.support = Q.finish :: rv.support.tail :=
          walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil hnilR
        have : x = Q.finish ∨ x ∈ rv.support.tail := by
          rw [hcons] at hxR
          exact List.mem_cons.1 hxR
        rcases this with rfl | htail
        · exact hcat' (mem_concat_of_mem_Q_support (Walk.end_mem_support Q.walk))
        · exact hcat' (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr htail))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.inter_ru_Q
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hru : x ∈ ru.support := by simpa [List.mem_toFinset] using (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  have hQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support] using (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  by_cases hxe : x = Q.start
  · simp [hxe]
  · have hnod := p.support_nodup
    have hcat := mem_walk_concat_of_subwalk heq
    have hnilQ : ¬ Q.walk.Nil := by
      intro hnil
      have : x = Q.start := by
        have : Q.walk.support = [Q.start] := walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil hnil
        simpa [this] using hQ
      exact hxe this
    have hcons : Q.walk.support = Q.start :: Q.walk.support.tail :=
      walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil hnilQ
    have htail : x ∈ Q.walk.support.tail := by
      rw [hcons] at hQ
      exact (List.mem_cons.1 hQ).resolve_left hxe
    have hxP : x ∈ p.walk.support := by
      simpa [hcat] using List.mem_append.2
        (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hru)))
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ p.walk.support.count x := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ ru.support.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hru
      have h2 : 1 ≤ Q.walk.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htail
      rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
      omega
    have : p.walk.support.count x = 1 := List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnod hxP
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.inter_rv_Q
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hrv : x ∈ rv.support := by simpa [List.mem_toFinset] using (mem_inter.1 hx).1
  have hQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support := by
    simpa [GraphPath.support] using (mem_inter.1 hx).2
  by_cases hxe : x = Q.finish
  · simp [hxe]
  · have hnod := p.support_nodup
    have hcat := mem_walk_concat_of_subwalk heq
    have hnilR : ¬ rv.Nil := by
      intro hnil
      have : x = Q.finish := by
        have : rv.support = [Q.finish] := walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil hnil
        simpa [this] using hrv
      exact hxe this
    have hconsR : rv.support = Q.finish :: rv.support.tail :=
      walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil hnilR
    have htailR : x ∈ rv.support.tail :=
      (List.mem_cons.1 (by rwa [hconsR] at hrv)).resolve_left hxe
    have hxP : x ∈ p.walk.support := by
      rw [hcat]
      exact List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr htailR)
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ p.walk.support.count x := by
      have h2 : 1 ≤ rv.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htailR
      by_cases hxs : x = Q.start
      · subst hxs
        have h1 : 1 ≤ ru.support.count Q.start :=
          List.count_pos_iff.mpr (Walk.end_mem_support ru)
        rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
        omega
      · have hnilQ : ¬ Q.walk.Nil := by
          intro hnil
          have : x = Q.start := by
            have : Q.walk.support = [Q.start] :=
              walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil hnil
            simpa [this] using hQ
          exact hxs this
        have hconsQ : Q.walk.support = Q.start :: Q.walk.support.tail :=
          walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil hnilQ
        have htailQ : x ∈ Q.walk.support.tail :=
          (List.mem_cons.1 (by rwa [hconsQ] at hQ)).resolve_left hxs
        have h1 : 1 ≤ Q.walk.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htailQ
        rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
        omega
    have : p.walk.support.count x = 1 := List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnod hxP
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.sdiff_eq_prefix_suffix
proof:
:= by
  have hU := support_union_of_subwalk heq
  have hruQ := inter_ru_Q heq
  have hrvQ := inter_rv_Q heq
  have hstart : Q.start ∈ ru.support.toFinset :=
    List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.end_mem_support ru)
  have hfinish : Q.finish ∈ rv.support.toFinset :=
    List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.start_mem_support rv)
  ext x
  simp only [hU, mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨hx, hxQ⟩
    rcases hx with h | hrv
    · rcases h with hru | hQ
      · exact Or.inl ⟨fun hxe => hxQ (hxe ▸ Q.start_mem_support), hru⟩
      · exact (hxQ hQ).elim
    · exact Or.inr ⟨fun hxe => hxQ (hxe ▸ Q.finish_mem_support), hrv⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hne, hru⟩ | ⟨hne, hrv⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hru), ?_⟩
      intro hQ
      have : x ∈ ({Q.start} : Finset V) :=
        hruQ (mem_inter.2 ⟨hru, hQ⟩)
      exact hne (mem_singleton.1 this)
    · refine ⟨Or.inr hrv, ?_⟩
      intro hQ
      have : x ∈ ({Q.finish} : Finset V) :=
        hrvQ (mem_inter.2 ⟨hrv, hQ⟩)
      exact hne (mem_singleton.1 this)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_trim_prefix_suffix
statement:
lemma disjoint_trim_prefix_suffix {p Q : GraphPath G}
    {ru : G.Walk p.start Q.start} {rv : G.Walk Q.finish p.finish}
    (heq : p.walk = (ru.append Q.walk).append rv)
    (hru : ¬ ru.Nil) (hrv : ¬ rv.Nil) :
    Disjoint
      ((ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)).trimFinish hru).support
      ((ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)).trimStart hrv).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hpre := mem_inter.1 hx
    have hruS : x ∈ ru.support.toFinset.erase Q.start := by
      have hsup := support_trimFinish
        (ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)) hru
      simpa [hsup, support_ofWalk, ofWalk_finish] using hpre.1
    have hrvS : x ∈ rv.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish := by
      have hsup := support_trimStart
        (ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)) hrv
      simpa [hsup, support_ofWalk, ofWalk_start] using hpre.2
    have hxru : x ∈ ru.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 (mem_erase.1 hruS).2
    have hxrv : x ∈ rv.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 (mem_erase.1 hrvS).2
    have hxneF : x ≠ Q.finish := (mem_erase.1 hrvS).1
    have hcat := mem_walk_concat_of_subwalk heq
    have hconsR : rv.support = Q.finish :: rv.support.tail :=
      walk_support_eq_cons_of_not_nil hrv
    have htailR : x ∈ rv.support.tail :=
      (List.mem_cons.1 (by rwa [hconsR] at hxrv)).resolve_left hxneF
    have hxP : x ∈ p.walk.support := by
      simpa [hcat] using List.mem_append.2
        (Or.inl (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hxru)))
    have hcnt : 2 ≤ p.walk.support.count x := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ ru.support.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hxru
      have h2 : 1 ≤ rv.support.tail.count x := List.count_pos_iff.mpr htailR
      rw [hcat, List.count_append, List.count_append]
      omega
    have : p.walk.support.count x = 1 :=
      List.count_eq_one_of_mem p.support_nodup hxP
    omega
  · intro hx
    exact (notMem_empty x hx).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_trimFinish_ofWalk
proof:
:= by
  simpa [support_ofWalk, ofWalk_finish] using
    support_trimFinish (ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)) hru

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_trimStart_ofWalk
proof:
:= by
  simpa [support_ofWalk, ofWalk_start] using
    support_trimStart (ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)) hrv

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.erase_eq_empty_of_nil
statement:
lemma erase_eq_empty_of_nil {u v : V} {w : G.Walk u v} (h : w.Nil) :
    w.support.toFinset.erase v = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have : w.support = [u] := walk_support_eq_singleton_of_nil h
  have hv : v = u := (Walk.Nil.eq h).symm
  simp [this, hv]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_complement_of_leftover
statement:
lemma exists_complement_of_leftover {A : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = p.support \ Q.support ∧
        r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ A ∧
          G.Adj r.finish Q.start ∧ G.Adj Q.finish r.start
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, hruB, hrvB⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  have hru : ¬ ru.Nil := leftoverPieces_factor_ru_not_nil hs hQ heq
  have hpreA : ru.penultimate ∈ A := hruB.resolve_left hru
  let prefixR := (ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)).trimFinish hru
  have hpreStart : prefixR.start = p.start := rfl
  have hpreFin : prefixR.finish = ru.penultimate := rfl
  have hadjPre : G.Adj prefixR.finish Q.start := ru.adj_penultimate hru
  have hsd := sdiff_eq_prefix_suffix heq
  by_cases hrv : rv.Nil
  · refine ⟨prefixR, ?_, ?_, ?_, hadjPre, ?_⟩
    · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hrv
      have hR : rv.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish = ∅ := by
        simpa [hf] using erase_eq_empty_of_nil hrv
      have hsd' : p.support \ Q.support = ru.support.toFinset.erase Q.start := by
        rw [hsd, hR, union_empty]
      rw [support_trimFinish_ofWalk heq hru]
      exact hsd'.symm
    · simpa [prefixR, hpreStart] using hs
    · simpa [prefixR, hpreFin] using hpreA
    · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hrv
      simpa [prefixR, hpreStart, hf] using hclose
  · have hsucA : rv.snd ∈ A := hrvB.resolve_left hrv
    let suffixR := (ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)).trimStart hrv
    have hdisj : Disjoint suffixR.support prefixR.support := by
      dsimp [suffixR, prefixR]
      exact (disjoint_trim_prefix_suffix heq hru hrv).symm
    have hclose' : G.Adj suffixR.finish prefixR.start := by
      change G.Adj p.finish p.start
      exact hclose
    refine ⟨suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsup :
          (suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj).support =
            suffixR.support ∪ prefixR.support :=
        support_splice suffixR prefixR hclose' hdisj
      rw [hsup, support_trimStart_ofWalk heq hrv,
        support_trimFinish_ofWalk heq hru, union_comm]
      exact hsd.symm
    · have hst : (suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj).start = suffixR.start := rfl
      have : suffixR.start = rv.snd := rfl
      simpa [hst, this] using hsucA
    · have hf : (suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj).finish = prefixR.finish := rfl
      have : prefixR.finish = ru.penultimate := rfl
      simpa [hf, this] using hpreA
    · have hf : (suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj).finish = prefixR.finish := rfl
      simpa [hf] using hadjPre
    · have hst : (suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj).start = suffixR.start := rfl
      have : suffixR.start = rv.snd := rfl
      simpa [hst, this] using rv.adj_snd hrv

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverCoverOfPath_card
statement:
lemma leftoverCoverOfPath_card (p : GraphPath G) (A : Finset V) :
    (leftoverCoverOfPath p A).card = (leftoverPieces A p).length
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftoverCoverOfPath, PathCover.leftoverCover, PathCover.ofPath,
    PathCover.card, List.length_flatMap]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverCoverOfPath_card_le
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := leftoverPieces_length_le_of_start_mem (B := A) hs
  have hinter : p.support ∩ A = A := inter_eq_right.2 hA
  simpa [leftoverCoverOfPath_card, hinter] using hlen

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverCoverOfPath_paths
statement:
lemma leftoverCoverOfPath_paths (p : GraphPath G) (A : Finset V) :
    (leftoverCoverOfPath p A).paths = leftoverPieces A p
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftoverCoverOfPath, PathCover.leftoverCover, PathCover.ofPath]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.toFinset_eq_of_perm
statement:
lemma toFinset_eq_of_perm {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α}
    (h : l₁.Perm l₂) : l₁.toFinset = l₂.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [List.mem_toFinset, h.mem_iff]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_from_with_edges
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_path_from_with_edges (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = c.support ∧ p.start = x ∧ G.Adj p.finish x ∧
        (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, x)}) = c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  let c' := rotateTo c hx
  have hnil : ¬ c'.walk.Nil := c'.isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
  have hq : q.IsPath :=
    ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hadj).1 (by simpa [hwalk] using c'.isCycle)).1
  let p0 : GraphPath G := ⟨w, c'.start, q, hq⟩
  have hp0 : p0.support = c'.support := by
    have hstart : c'.start ∈ q.support := Walk.end_mem_support q
    simp [p0, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hwalk, Walk.support_cons,
      insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart)]
  have hx' : c'.start = x := start_rotateTo c hx
  refine ⟨p0.reverse, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [GraphPath.support_reverse, hp0, support_rotateTo]
  · simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hx']
  · simpa [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hx'] using hadj.symm
  · have hqE : p0.reverse.walk.edges.toFinset = q.edges.toFinset := by
      simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]
    have hcE : c'.walk.edges.toFinset =
        insert s(c'.start, w) q.edges.toFinset := by
      simp [hwalk, Walk.edges_cons]
    have hfin : p0.reverse.finish = w := by simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse]
    have hedges :
        p0.reverse.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p0.reverse.finish, x)} =
          c'.walk.edges.toFinset := by
      rw [hqE, hcE, hfin]
      have : s(w, x) = s(c'.start, w) := by
        rw [hx']
        exact Sym2.eq_swap
      rw [this]
      simp [singleton_union]
    have hperm : c'.walk.edges.Perm c.walk.edges :=
      (Walk.rotate_edges c.walk x (mem_walk_support_of_mem_cycle hx)).perm
    rw [hedges]
    simpa [rotateTo] using toFinset_eq_of_perm hperm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_cycle_leftover_cover
statement:
lemma exists_cycle_leftover_cover {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) = c.walk.edges.toFinset ∧
          pc.card ≤ A.card ∧
            pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p ∧
              ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAne
  have hx : a ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA haA
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hadj, hedges⟩ := exists_spanning_path_from_with_edges c hx
  have hpU : p.support = U := hp.trans hc
  have hstartA : p.start ∈ A := by simpa [hs] using haA
  have hAU : A ⊆ p.support := by simpa [hpU] using hA
  let pc0 := leftoverCoverOfPath p A
  have hEq : p.support \ A = U \ A := by rw [hpU]
  refine ⟨p, pc0.cast hEq, hpU, hstartA, by simpa [hs] using hadj, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hs] using hedges
  · have := leftoverCoverOfPath_card_le hstartA hAU
    simpa [PathCover.cast_card] using this
  · rw [PathCover.cast_paths, leftoverCoverOfPath_paths]
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ' : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p := by
      rwa [PathCover.cast_paths, leftoverCoverOfPath_paths] at hQ
    exact leftoverPieces_isSubwalk p Q hQ'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_leftover_cover_min_of_saturated
statement:
lemma cycle_leftover_cover_min_of_saturated {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        (p.walk.edges.toFinset ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}) = c.walk.edges.toFinset ∧
          pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) ∧
            pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p ∧
              ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, pc, hp, hs, hadj, hedges, hcard, hpaths, hsub⟩ :=
    exists_cycle_leftover_cover c hc hA hAne
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
    have hSat' : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) = A.card := hSat
    exact le_antisymm (hcard.trans (le_of_eq hSat'.symm)) hle
  exact ⟨p, pc, hp, hs, hadj, hedges, hmin, hpaths, hsub⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_complement_arc_of_mem_leftover
statement:
lemma exists_complement_arc_of_mem_leftover {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    {p : GraphPath G} {pc : PathCover G (U \ A)} {Q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hpaths : pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p) (hQ : Q ∈ pc.paths) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = U \ Q.support ∧
        r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ A ∧
          G.Adj r.finish Q.start ∧ G.Adj Q.finish r.start
proof:
:= by
  have hQ' : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p := by simpa [hpaths] using hQ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs, hrf, hpred, hsucc⟩ :=
    exists_complement_of_leftover (A := A) hs hQ' hclose
  exact ⟨r, by simpa [hp] using hr, hrs, hrf, hpred, hsucc⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.pairwise_ne
statement:
lemma pairwise_ne (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) :
    a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.ne_ab, h.ne_ac, h.ne_ad, h.ne_bc, h.ne_bd, h.ne_cd⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.reverse
statement:
lemma reverse (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) : InducedP4 G d c b a where
  ne_ab
proof:
:= h.ne_cd.symm
  ne_ac := h.ne_bd.symm
  ne_ad := h.ne_ad.symm
  ne_bc := h.ne_bc.symm
  ne_bd := h.ne_ac.symm
  ne_cd := h.ne_ab.symm
  adj_ab := h.adj_cd.symm
  adj_bc := h.adj_bc.symm
  adj_cd := h.adj_ab.symm
  not_ac := (h.not_bd <| ·.symm)
  not_ad := (h.not_ad <| ·.symm)
  not_bd := (h.not_ac <| ·.symm)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.card_four
statement:
lemma card_four [DecidableEq V] (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) :
    ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V).card = 4
proof:
:= by
  have had : a ∉ ({b, c, d} : Finset V) := by simp [h.ne_ab, h.ne_ac, h.ne_ad]
  have hbd : b ∉ ({c, d} : Finset V) := by simp [h.ne_bc, h.ne_bd]
  have hcd : c ∉ ({d} : Finset V) := by simp [h.ne_cd]
  simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, had, hbd, hcd]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.adj_ab_of
statement: lemma adj_ab_of (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) : G.Adj a b
proof: := h.adj_ab

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.adj_bc_of
statement: lemma adj_bc_of (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) : G.Adj b c
proof: := h.adj_bc

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.adj_cd_of
statement: lemma adj_cd_of (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) : G.Adj c d
proof: := h.adj_cd

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.InducedP4.not_adj_other_three
statement:
lemma not_adj_other_three (h : InducedP4 G a b c d) {x : V}
    (hx : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d) :
    ¬ ((x ≠ a → G.Adj x a) ∧ (x ≠ b → G.Adj x b) ∧
        (x ≠ c → G.Adj x c) ∧ (x ≠ d → G.Adj x d))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩
  rcases hx with hx | hx | hx | hx
  · exact h.not_ac <| hx ▸ hc (hx ▸ h.ne_ac)
  · exact h.not_bd <| hx ▸ hd (hx ▸ h.ne_bd)
  · exact h.not_ac <| hx ▸ (ha (hx ▸ h.ne_ac.symm)).symm
  · exact h.not_bd <| hx ▸ (hb (hx ▸ h.ne_bd.symm)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_iff_isCograph
statement:
lemma isCographOn_iff_isCograph {G : SimpleGraph V} {U : Finset V} :
    IsCographOn G U ↔ IsCograph G U
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_iff_univ
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_iff_univ [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} :
    IsCographGraph G ↔ IsCograph G Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d _ _ _ _ hp
    exact h a b c d hp
  · intro h a b c d hp
    exact h (Finset.mem_univ a) (Finset.mem_univ b) (Finset.mem_univ c) (Finset.mem_univ d) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_iff_univ_set
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_iff_univ_set {G : SimpleGraph V} :
    IsCographGraph G ↔ IsCographOn G Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d _ _ _ _ hp
    exact h a b c d hp
  · intro h a b c d hp
    exact h (Set.mem_univ a) (Set.mem_univ b) (Set.mem_univ c) (Set.mem_univ d) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCograph_mono
statement:
lemma isCograph_mono {G : SimpleGraph V} {U W : Finset V}
    (hW : IsCograph G W) (hUW : U ⊆ W) : IsCograph G U
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd hp =>
    hW (hUW ha) (hUW hb) (hUW hc) (hUW hd) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_mono
statement:
lemma isCographOn_mono {G : SimpleGraph V} {U W : Set V}
    (hW : IsCographOn G W) (hUW : U ⊆ W) : IsCographOn G U
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd hp =>
    hW (hUW ha) (hUW hb) (hUW hc) (hUW hd) hp

statement:
lemma isCographOn_of_isCographGraph {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : IsCographGraph G) (U : Set V) :

statement:
lemma isCograph_of_isCographGraph {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : IsCographGraph G) (U : Finset V) :

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_induce
proof:
:= by intro h'; exact h.ne_ab (Subtype.ext h')
  ne_ac := by intro h'; exact h.ne_ac (Subtype.ext h')
  ne_ad := by intro h'; exact h.ne_ad (Subtype.ext h')
  ne_bc := by intro h'; exact h.ne_bc (Subtype.ext h')
  ne_bd := by intro h'; exact h.ne_bd (Subtype.ext h')
  ne_cd := by intro h'; exact h.ne_cd (Subtype.ext h')
  adj_ab := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.adj_ab
  adj_bc := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.adj_bc
  adj_cd := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.adj_cd
  not_ac := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.not_ac
  not_ad := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.not_ad
  not_bd := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.not_bd

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_of_coe
proof:
:= fun h' => h.ne_ab (congrArg Subtype.val h')
  ne_ac := fun h' => h.ne_ac (congrArg Subtype.val h')
  ne_ad := fun h' => h.ne_ad (congrArg Subtype.val h')
  ne_bc := fun h' => h.ne_bc (congrArg Subtype.val h')
  ne_bd := fun h' => h.ne_bd (congrArg Subtype.val h')
  ne_cd := fun h' => h.ne_cd (congrArg Subtype.val h')
  adj_ab := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.adj_ab
  adj_bc := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.adj_bc
  adj_cd := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.adj_cd
  not_ac := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.not_ac
  not_ad := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.not_ad
  not_bd := by simpa [induce_adj] using h.not_bd

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_induce
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_induce {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : Set V}
    (h : IsCographGraph G) : IsCographGraph (G.induce s)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d hp
  exact h a.1 b.1 c.1 d.1 (inducedP4_induce hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_iff_isCographGraph_induce
statement:
lemma isCographOn_iff_isCographGraph_induce {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : Set V} :
    IsCographOn G s ↔ IsCographGraph (G.induce s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d hp
    exact h a.2 b.2 c.2 d.2 (inducedP4_induce hp)
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact h ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ ⟨d, hd⟩ (inducedP4_of_coe hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_inducedP4_of_card_lt
statement:
lemma not_inducedP4_of_card_lt [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hV : Fintype.card V < 4) (a b c d : V) : ¬ InducedP4 G a b c d
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  classical
  have : 4 ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    have hsubset : ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V) ⊆ Finset.univ := by simp
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    simpa [hp.card_four] using this
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_of_card_lt_four
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_of_card_lt_four [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hV : Fintype.card V < 4) : IsCographGraph G
proof:
:=
  fun a b c d => not_inducedP4_of_card_lt hV a b c d

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_of_card_le_one
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_of_card_le_one [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hV : Fintype.card V ≤ 1) : IsCographGraph G
proof:
:=
  isCographGraph_of_card_lt_four (lt_of_le_of_lt hV (by decide : (1 : ℕ) < 4))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_adj_getVert_of_length_eq_dist
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  let q : G.Walk u w :=
    ((p.take i).append hadj.toWalk).append (p.drop j)
  have hlen : q.length = i + 1 + (p.length - j) := by
    simp [q, Walk.length_append, Walk.take_length, Walk.drop_length, Adj.toWalk,
      Walk.length_cons, hi]
  have hlt : q.length < p.length := by
    have hj' : j ≤ p.length := hj
    have : i + 1 + (p.length - j) < p.length := by
      have : i + 1 < j := Nat.lt_of_succ_le (by omega)
      have hsub : p.length - j + j = p.length := Nat.sub_add_cancel hj'
      omega
    simpa [hlen] using this
  have : G.dist u w ≤ q.length := dist_le q
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_of_shortest_path
proof:
:= by
  have hpath : p.IsPath := p.isPath_of_length_eq_dist hp
  have hle3 : 3 ≤ p.length := h3
  have hle i (hi : i ≤ 3) : i ≤ p.length := le_trans hi hle3
  have hne {i j : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ 3) (hj : j ≤ 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      p.getVert i ≠ p.getVert j := by
    intro h
    have := hpath.getVert_injOn (by simp [hle i hi]) (by simp [hle j hj]) h
    exact hij this
  refine
    { ne_ab := hne (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      ne_ac := hne (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      ne_ad := hne (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      ne_bc := hne (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      ne_bd := hne (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      ne_cd := hne (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      adj_ab := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
      adj_bc := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
      adj_cd := p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
      not_ac := not_adj_getVert_of_length_eq_dist hp (hle 0 (by decide)) (hle 2 (by decide))
                  (by decide)
      not_ad := not_adj_getVert_of_length_eq_dist hp (hle 0 (by decide)) (hle 3 (by decide))
                  (by decide)
      not_bd := not_adj_getVert_of_length_eq_dist hp (hle 1 (by decide)) (hle 3 (by decide))
                  (by decide) }

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.dist_le_two_of_connected_cograph
statement:
lemma dist_le_two_of_connected_cograph (hG : G.Connected) (hC : IsCographGraph G)
    (u v : V) : G.dist u v ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h3 : 3 ≤ G.dist u v := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.not_le.mp h)
  obtain ⟨p, -, hp⟩ := hG.exists_path_of_dist u v
  have : InducedP4 G (p.getVert 0) (p.getVert 1) (p.getVert 2) (p.getVert 3) :=
    inducedP4_of_shortest_path hp (by omega)
  exact hC _ _ _ _ this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ediam_le_two_of_connected_cograph
statement:
lemma ediam_le_two_of_connected_cograph (hG : G.Connected) (hC : IsCographGraph G) :
    G.ediam ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ediam_le_of_edist_le ?_
  intro u v
  have hr : G.Reachable u v := hG u v
  have hdist : G.dist u v ≤ 2 := dist_le_two_of_connected_cograph hG hC u v
  have : (G.dist u v : ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := Nat.cast_le.mpr hdist
  rwa [hr.coe_dist_eq_edist] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.diam_le_two_of_connected_cograph
statement:
lemma diam_le_two_of_connected_cograph (hG : G.Connected) (hC : IsCographGraph G) :
    G.diam ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : G.ediam ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by decide : (2 : ℕ∞) ≠ ⊤)
    (ediam_le_two_of_connected_cograph hG hC)
  have : (G.diam : ℕ∞) = G.ediam := (natCast_diam_eq_ediam_iff).mpr hne
  have hle : G.ediam ≤ 2 := ediam_le_two_of_connected_cograph hG hC
  have : (G.diam : ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := this ▸ hle
  exact Nat.cast_le.mp this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_dominates_of_no_p4_union_p1
statement:
lemma inducedP4_dominates_of_no_p4_union_p1 (h : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G)
    {a b c d x : V} (hp : InducedP4 G a b c d)
    (hx : x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b ∧ x ≠ c ∧ x ≠ d) :
    G.Adj x a ∨ G.Adj x b ∨ G.Adj x c ∨ G.Adj x d

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_antineighborhood
statement:
lemma mem_antineighborhood {v w : V} :
    w ∈ antineighborhood G v ↔ w ≠ v ∧ ¬ G.Adj v w
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_antineighborhood_of_no_p4_union_p1
statement:
lemma isCographOn_antineighborhood_of_no_p4_union_p1
    (h : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) (v : V) :
    IsCographOn G (antineighborhood G v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have hv : v ≠ a ∧ v ≠ b ∧ v ≠ c ∧ v ≠ d := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ha.1.symm
    · exact hb.1.symm
    · exact hc.1.symm
    · exact hd.1.symm
  have hmeet := h hp hv.1 hv.2.1 hv.2.2.1 hv.2.2.2
  rcases hmeet with hva | hvb | hvc | hvd
  · exact ha.2 hva
  · exact hb.2 hvb
  · exact hc.2 hvc
  · exact hd.2 hvd

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_componentVerts
statement:
lemma mem_componentVerts {s : Set V} {C : (G.induce s).ConnectedComponent} {x : V} :
    x ∈ componentVerts C ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ s, (⟨x, hx⟩ : s) ∈ C.supp
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨⟨x', hx'⟩, hmem, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨hx', hmem⟩
  · intro ⟨hx, hmem⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hmem, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentVerts_subset
statement:
lemma componentVerts_subset {s : Set V} (C : (G.induce s).ConnectedComponent) :
    componentVerts C ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hx', _⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hx
  exact hx'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_adj_of_mem_other_component
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  obtain ⟨hy', hyC⟩ := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hy
  have : (G.induce s).Adj ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy'⟩ := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
  have : (⟨x, hx⟩ : s) ∈ C.supp := (C.mem_supp_congr_adj this).mpr hyC
  exact hxC this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ne_of_mem_other_component
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy
  subst hxy
  have : (⟨x, hx⟩ : s) ∈ C.supp := (mem_componentVerts (C := C)).1 hy |>.2
  exact hxC this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_componentVerts_of_outside_vertex
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have hxa : x ≠ a := ne_of_mem_other_component hx hxC ha
  have hxb : x ≠ b := ne_of_mem_other_component hx hxC hb
  have hxc : x ≠ c := ne_of_mem_other_component hx hxC hc
  have hxd : x ≠ d := ne_of_mem_other_component hx hxC hd
  have hmeet := h hp hxa hxb hxc hxd
  rcases hmeet with hxa' | hxb' | hxc' | hxd'
  · exact not_adj_of_mem_other_component hx hxC ha hxa'
  · exact not_adj_of_mem_other_component hx hxC hb hxb'
  · exact not_adj_of_mem_other_component hx hxC hc hxc'
  · exact not_adj_of_mem_other_component hx hxC hd hxd'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_componentVerts_of_not_preconnected
statement:
lemma isCographOn_componentVerts_of_not_preconnected
    (h : NoInducedP4UnionP1 G) {s : Set V}
    (hdisc : ¬ (G.induce s).Preconnected)
    (C : (G.induce s).ConnectedComponent) :
    IsCographOn G (componentVerts C)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ z : s, z ∉ C.supp := by
    by_contra hz
    push Not at hz
    have : (G.induce s).Preconnected := by
      intro u v
      have hu : u ∈ C.supp := hz u
      have hv : v ∈ C.supp := hz v
      exact ConnectedComponent.exact <| by
        rw [ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff] at hu hv
        rw [hu, hv]
    exact hdisc this
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := this
  exact isCographOn_componentVerts_of_outside_vertex h C z.2 hz

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_of_adj_of_no_cross
proof:
:= by
  have : b ∈ A ∨ b ∈ B := by
    have : b ∈ A ∪ B := by simp [hcover]
    simpa [Set.mem_union] using this
  rcases this with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact (hnocross a ha b h hadj).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_of_adj_of_no_cross'
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj x y := fun x hx y hy hxy =>
    hnocross y hy x hx hxy.symm
  simpa [Set.union_comm] using
    mem_of_adj_of_no_cross (A := B) (B := A) (by simpa [Set.union_comm] using hcover)
      hsym ha hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_subset_of_disjoint_union
proof:
:= by
  have hab : G.Adj a b := hp.adj_ab
  have hbc : G.Adj b c := hp.adj_bc
  have hcd : G.Adj c d := hp.adj_cd
  have haAB : a ∈ A ∨ a ∈ B := by
    have : a ∈ A ∪ B := by simp [hcover]
    simpa [Set.mem_union] using this
  rcases haAB with haA | haB
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    have hbA : b ∈ A := mem_of_adj_of_no_cross hcover hnocross haA hab
    have hcA : c ∈ A := mem_of_adj_of_no_cross hcover hnocross hbA hbc
    have hdA : d ∈ A := mem_of_adj_of_no_cross hcover hnocross hcA hcd
    rcases hx' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    have hbB : b ∈ B := mem_of_adj_of_no_cross' hcover hnocross haB hab
    have hcB : c ∈ B := mem_of_adj_of_no_cross' hcover hnocross hbB hbc
    have hdB : d ∈ B := mem_of_adj_of_no_cross' hcover hnocross hcB hcd
    rcases hx' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_disjoint_union
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d hp
  rcases inducedP4_subset_of_disjoint_union hcover hnocross hp with hA' | hB'
  · exact hA (hA' (by simp)) (hA' (by simp)) (hA' (by simp)) (hA' (by simp)) hp
  · exact hB (hB' (by simp)) (hB' (by simp)) (hB' (by simp)) (hB' (by simp)) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_disjoint_union
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_disjoint_union [Fintype V] {A B : Finset V} [DecidableEq V]
    (_hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hcover : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hA : IsCograph G A) (hB : IsCograph G B) : IsCographGraph G
proof:
:= by
  refine isCographOn_disjoint_union (A := (A : Set V)) (B := (B : Set V)) ?_ ?_ hA hB
  · ext x
    constructor
    · intro
      simp
    · intro
      have : x ∈ A ∪ B := by simp [hcover]
      simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
  · intro a ha b hb
    exact hnocross a ha b hb

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_adj_mem_path_edges
statement:
lemma inducedP4_adj_mem_path_edges [DecidableEq V] {a b c d x y : V}
    (hp : InducedP4 G a b c d)
    (hx : x ∈ ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V)) (hy : y ∈ ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V))
    (hne : x ≠ y) (hadj : G.Adj x y) :
    s(x, y) = s(a, b) ∨ s(x, y) = s(b, c) ∨ s(x, y) = s(c, d)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
    simpa [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hx
  have hy' : y = a ∨ y = b ∨ y = c ∨ y = d := by
    simpa [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hy
  rcases hx' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rcases hy' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact (hp.not_ac hadj).elim
    · exact (hp.not_ad hadj).elim
  · rcases hy' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl (Sym2.eq_swap)
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact (hp.not_bd hadj).elim
  · rcases hy' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (hp.not_ac hadj.symm).elim
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Sym2.eq_swap))
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
  · rcases hy' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (hp.not_ad hadj.symm).elim
    · exact (hp.not_bd hadj.symm).elim
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Sym2.eq_swap))
    · exact (hne rfl).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_p4_path_edges
statement:
lemma card_p4_path_edges [DecidableEq V] {a b c d : V} (hp : InducedP4 G a b c d) :
    ({s(a, b), s(b, c), s(c, d)} : Finset (Sym2 V)).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : s(a, b) ≠ s(b, c) := by
    intro h
    have : a = c ∨ a = b ∧ b = c := by
      simpa [Sym2.eq_iff, hp.ne_ab, hp.ne_bc] using h
    rcases this with h' | ⟨_, h'⟩
    · exact hp.ne_ac h'
    · exact hp.ne_bc h'
  have h2 : s(a, b) ≠ s(c, d) := by
    intro h
    have : a = c ∧ b = d ∨ a = d ∧ b = c := by
      simpa [Sym2.eq_iff] using h
    rcases this with ⟨h', _⟩ | ⟨_, h'⟩
    · exact hp.ne_ac h'
    · exact hp.ne_bc h'
  have h3 : s(b, c) ≠ s(c, d) := by
    intro h
    have : b = c ∧ c = d ∨ b = d ∧ c = c := by
      simpa [Sym2.eq_iff] using h
    rcases this with ⟨h', _⟩ | ⟨h', _⟩
    · exact hp.ne_bc h'
    · exact hp.ne_bd h'
  simp [h1, h2, h3]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_complete_join
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d hp
  classical
  let S : Finset V := {a, b, c, d}
  have hScard : S.card = 4 := hp.card_four
  have hdisjAB : Disjoint A B := hAB.disjoint
  let SA := S.filter (· ∈ A)
  let SB := S.filter (· ∈ B)
  have hunion : SA ∪ SB = S := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      simp only [SA, SB, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      rcases hx with ⟨hxS, _⟩ | ⟨hxS, _⟩ <;> exact hxS
    · intro hx
      have hxAB : x ∈ A ∨ x ∈ B := by
        have : x ∈ A ∪ B := by simp [hcover]
        simpa [Set.mem_union] using this
      simp only [SA, SB, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact hxAB.elim (fun h => Or.inl ⟨hx, h⟩) (fun h => Or.inr ⟨hx, h⟩)
  have hdisjSA : Disjoint SA SB := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxA hxB
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxA).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxB).2
  have hsum : SA.card + SB.card = 4 := by
    have hcard := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjSA
    rw [hunion, hScard] at hcard
    exact hcard.symm
  have hnotA : ¬ S ⊆ SA := by
    intro hS
    have hSA : ∀ z ∈ S, z ∈ A := fun z hz => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hS hz)).2
    exact hA (hSA a (by simp [S])) (hSA b (by simp [S]))
      (hSA c (by simp [S])) (hSA d (by simp [S])) hp
  have hnotB : ¬ S ⊆ SB := by
    intro hS
    have hSB : ∀ z ∈ S, z ∈ B := fun z hz => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hS hz)).2
    exact hB (hSB a (by simp [S])) (hSB b (by simp [S]))
      (hSB c (by simp [S])) (hSB d (by simp [S])) hp
  have hSA_ne : SA.card ≠ 4 := by
    intro h4
    have : SA = S := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (by omega)
    exact hnotA (by simp [this])
  have hSB_ne : SB.card ≠ 4 := by
    intro h4
    have : SB = S := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (by omega)
    exact hnotB (by simp [this])
  have hSA_pos : SA.card ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have : SB.card = 4 := by omega
    exact hSB_ne this
  have hSB_pos : SB.card ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have : SA.card = 4 := by omega
    exact hSA_ne this
  have hsplit : SA.card = 1 ∨ SA.card = 2 ∨ SA.card = 3 := by omega
  have hcross {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ SA) (hy : y ∈ SB) : G.Adj x y :=
    hAB (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  rcases hsplit with h1 | h2 | h3
  · obtain ⟨x, hxeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp h1
    have hxSA : x ∈ SA := by simp [hxeq]
    have hxS : x ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxSA).1
    have hxquad : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [S, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hxS
    have hother : (x ≠ a → G.Adj x a) ∧ (x ≠ b → G.Adj x b) ∧
        (x ≠ c → G.Adj x c) ∧ (x ≠ d → G.Adj x d) := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hxa
        have haS : a ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : a ∈ SA ∨ a ∈ SB := by
          have : a ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using haS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with haA | haB
        · have : a = x := by
            have : a ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using haA
            simpa using this
          exact (hxa this.symm).elim
        · exact hcross hxSA haB
      · intro hxb
        have hbS : b ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : b ∈ SA ∨ b ∈ SB := by
          have : b ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using hbS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with hbA | hbB
        · have : b = x := by
            have : b ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using hbA
            simpa using this
          exact (hxb this.symm).elim
        · exact hcross hxSA hbB
      · intro hxc
        have hcS : c ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : c ∈ SA ∨ c ∈ SB := by
          have : c ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using hcS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with hcA | hcB
        · have : c = x := by
            have : c ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using hcA
            simpa using this
          exact (hxc this.symm).elim
        · exact hcross hxSA hcB
      · intro hxd
        have hdS : d ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : d ∈ SA ∨ d ∈ SB := by
          have : d ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using hdS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with hdA | hdB
        · have : d = x := by
            have : d ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using hdA
            simpa using this
          exact (hxd this.symm).elim
        · exact hcross hxSA hdB
    exact hp.not_adj_other_three hxquad hother
  · 
    have hSB2 : SB.card = 2 := by omega
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hSA2⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp h2
    obtain ⟨z, w, hzw, hSB2eq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hSB2
    have hxA : x ∈ SA := by simp [hSA2]
    have hyA : y ∈ SA := by simp [hSA2]
    have hzB : z ∈ SB := by simp [hSB2eq]
    have hwB : w ∈ SB := by simp [hSB2eq]
    have hxS : x ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxA).1
    have hyS : y ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hyA).1
    have hzS : z ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzB).1
    have hwS : w ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwB).1
    have hx_ne_z : x ≠ z := fun h =>
      Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxA).2
        (by simpa [h] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzB).2)
    have hx_ne_w : x ≠ w := fun h =>
      Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxA).2
        (by simpa [h] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwB).2)
    have hy_ne_z : y ≠ z := fun h =>
      Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB (Finset.mem_filter.mp hyA).2
        (by simpa [h] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzB).2)
    have hy_ne_w : y ≠ w := fun h =>
      Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB (Finset.mem_filter.mp hyA).2
        (by simpa [h] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hwB).2)
    let E : Finset (Sym2 V) := {s(x, z), s(x, w), s(y, z), s(y, w)}
    have hEcard : E.card = 4 := by
      have hxz_xw : s(x, z) ≠ s(x, w) := by
        intro h
        have : z = w := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff, hx_ne_z, hx_ne_w, hxy] using h
        exact hzw this
      have hxz_yz : s(x, z) ≠ s(y, z) := by
        intro h
        have : x = y := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff, hx_ne_z, hy_ne_z, hzw] using h
        exact hxy this
      have hxz_yw : s(x, z) ≠ s(y, w) := by
        intro h
        have : x = y ∧ z = w ∨ x = w ∧ z = y := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff] using h
        rcases this with ⟨h', _⟩ | ⟨h', _⟩
        · exact hxy h'
        · exact hx_ne_w h'
      have hxw_yz : s(x, w) ≠ s(y, z) := by
        intro h
        have : x = y ∧ w = z ∨ x = z ∧ w = y := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff] using h
        rcases this with ⟨h', _⟩ | ⟨h', _⟩
        · exact hxy h'
        · exact hx_ne_z h'
      have hxw_yw : s(x, w) ≠ s(y, w) := by
        intro h
        have : x = y := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff, hx_ne_w, hy_ne_w, hzw] using h
        exact hxy this
      have hyz_yw : s(y, z) ≠ s(y, w) := by
        intro h
        have : z = w := by
          simpa [Sym2.eq_iff, hy_ne_z, hy_ne_w, hxy] using h
        exact hzw this
      simp [E, hxz_xw, hxz_yz, hxz_yw, hxw_yz, hxw_yw, hyz_yw]
    have hEsub : E ⊆ ({s(a, b), s(b, c), s(c, d)} : Finset (Sym2 V)) := by
      intro e he
      have he' : e = s(x, z) ∨ e = s(x, w) ∨ e = s(y, z) ∨ e = s(y, w) := by
        simpa [E, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using he
      have hmem {p q : V} (hpq : p ∈ S) (hqp : q ∈ S) (hpqne : p ≠ q)
          (hadj : G.Adj p q) :
          s(p, q) ∈ ({s(a, b), s(b, c), s(c, d)} : Finset (Sym2 V)) := by
        have := inducedP4_adj_mem_path_edges hp hpq hqp hpqne hadj
        simpa [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using this
      rcases he' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hmem hxS hzS hx_ne_z (hcross hxA hzB)
      · exact hmem hxS hwS hx_ne_w (hcross hxA hwB)
      · exact hmem hyS hzS hy_ne_z (hcross hyA hzB)
      · exact hmem hyS hwS hy_ne_w (hcross hyA hwB)
    have : E.card ≤ ({s(a, b), s(b, c), s(c, d)} : Finset (Sym2 V)).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card hEsub
    have : 4 ≤ 3 := by simpa [hEcard, card_p4_path_edges hp] using this
    omega
  · obtain ⟨x, hxeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp (show SB.card = 1 by omega)
    have hxSB : x ∈ SB := by simp [hxeq]
    have hxS : x ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxSB).1
    have hxquad : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [S, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hxS
    have hother : (x ≠ a → G.Adj x a) ∧ (x ≠ b → G.Adj x b) ∧
        (x ≠ c → G.Adj x c) ∧ (x ≠ d → G.Adj x d) := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hxa
        have haS : a ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : a ∈ SA ∨ a ∈ SB := by
          have : a ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using haS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with haA | haB
        · exact (hcross haA hxSB).symm
        · have : a = x := by
            have : a ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using haB
            simpa using this
          exact (hxa this.symm).elim
      · intro hxb
        have hbS : b ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : b ∈ SA ∨ b ∈ SB := by
          have : b ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using hbS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with hbA | hbB
        · exact (hcross hbA hxSB).symm
        · have : b = x := by
            have : b ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using hbB
            simpa using this
          exact (hxb this.symm).elim
      · intro hxc
        have hcS : c ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : c ∈ SA ∨ c ∈ SB := by
          have : c ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using hcS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with hcA | hcB
        · exact (hcross hcA hxSB).symm
        · have : c = x := by
            have : c ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using hcB
            simpa using this
          exact (hxc this.symm).elim
      · intro hxd
        have hdS : d ∈ S := by simp [S]
        have : d ∈ SA ∨ d ∈ SB := by
          have : d ∈ SA ∪ SB := by simpa [hunion] using hdS
          simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this
        rcases this with hdA | hdB
        · exact (hcross hdA hxSB).symm
        · have : d = x := by
            have : d ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hxeq] using hdB
            simpa using this
          exact (hxd this.symm).elim
    exact hp.not_adj_other_three hxquad hother

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_complete_join_finset
proof:
:=
  isCographGraph_complete_join (A := (A : Set V)) (B := (B : Set V))
    (by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro; simp
      · intro
        have : x ∈ A ∪ B := by simp [hcover]
        simpa [Finset.mem_union] using this) hAB hA hB

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rcases hbAB with hbA | hbB
  · exact hbA
  · exact (hnocross a ha b hbB hadj).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem'
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj x y := fun x hx y hy hxy =>
    hnocross y hy x hx hxy.symm
  have hbBA : b ∈ B ∨ b ∈ A := hbAB.symm
  exact mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem (A := B) (B := A) hsym ha hbBA hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_subset_of_no_cross
statement:
lemma inducedP4_subset_of_no_cross {A B : Set V} {a b c d : V}
    (hmem : ({a, b, c, d} : Set V) ⊆ A ∪ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hp : InducedP4 G a b c d) :
    ({a, b, c, d} : Set V) ⊆ A ∨ ({a, b, c, d} : Set V) ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  have hab : G.Adj a b := hp.adj_ab
  have hbc : G.Adj b c := hp.adj_bc
  have hcd : G.Adj c d := hp.adj_cd
  have mem4 {x : V} (hx : x ∈ ({a, b, c, d} : Set V)) : x ∈ A ∨ x ∈ B := by
    have : x ∈ A ∪ B := hmem hx
    simpa [Set.mem_union] using this
  have haAB : a ∈ A ∨ a ∈ B := mem4 (by simp)
  rcases haAB with haA | haB
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    have hbA : b ∈ A :=
      mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem hnocross haA (mem4 (by simp)) hab
    have hcA : c ∈ A :=
      mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem hnocross hbA (mem4 (by simp)) hbc
    have hdA : d ∈ A :=
      mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem hnocross hcA (mem4 (by simp)) hcd
    rcases hx' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    have hbB : b ∈ B :=
      mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem' hnocross haB (mem4 (by simp)) hab
    have hcB : c ∈ B :=
      mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem' hnocross hbB (mem4 (by simp)) hbc
    have hdB : d ∈ B :=
      mem_of_adj_of_no_cross_of_mem' hnocross hcB (mem4 (by simp)) hcd
    rcases hx' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_union_of_no_cross
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
  have hmem : ({a, b, c, d} : Set V) ⊆ A ∪ B := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c ∨ x = d := by
      simpa [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    rcases hx' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [ha, hb, hc, hd]
  rcases inducedP4_subset_of_no_cross hmem hnocross hp with hA' | hB'
  · exact hA (hA' (by simp)) (hA' (by simp)) (hA' (by simp)) (hA' (by simp)) hp
  · exact hB (hB' (by simp)) (hB' (by simp)) (hB' (by simp)) (hB' (by simp)) hp

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCograph_union_of_no_cross
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isCographOn_iff_isCograph, Finset.coe_union]
  exact isCographOn_union_of_no_cross (A := (A : Set V)) (B := (B : Set V))
    (fun a ha b hb => hnocross a ha b hb) hA hB

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographOn_union_of_complete_join
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCographOn_iff_isCographGraph_induce]
  let s : Set V := A ∪ B
  let A' : Set s := Subtype.val ⁻¹' A
  let B' : Set s := Subtype.val ⁻¹' B
  have hcover : A' ∪ B' = (Set.univ : Set s) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro
      trivial
    · intro
      have hx : x.1 ∈ A ∨ x.1 ∈ B := by
        have : x.1 ∈ A ∪ B := x.property
        exact (Set.mem_union (x := x.1) (a := A) (b := B)).mp this
      refine (Set.mem_union (x := x) (a := A') (b := B')).mpr ?_
      rcases hx with hxA | hxB
      · exact Or.inl hxA
      · exact Or.inr hxB
  have hABon : (G.induce s).IsCompleteBetween A' B' := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have : G.Adj x.1 y.1 :=
      hAB (by simpa [A', Set.mem_preimage] using hx)
        (by simpa [B', Set.mem_preimage] using hy)
    simpa [induce_adj] using this
  have hA' : IsCographOn (G.induce s) A' := by
    intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact hA (by simpa [A', Set.mem_preimage] using ha)
      (by simpa [A', Set.mem_preimage] using hb)
      (by simpa [A', Set.mem_preimage] using hc)
      (by simpa [A', Set.mem_preimage] using hd) (inducedP4_induce hp)
  have hB' : IsCographOn (G.induce s) B' := by
    intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact hB (by simpa [B', Set.mem_preimage] using ha)
      (by simpa [B', Set.mem_preimage] using hb)
      (by simpa [B', Set.mem_preimage] using hc)
      (by simpa [B', Set.mem_preimage] using hd) (inducedP4_induce hp)
  exact isCographGraph_complete_join (A := A') (B := B') hcover hABon hA' hB'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCograph_union_of_complete_join
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isCographOn_iff_isCograph, Finset.coe_union]
  exact isCographOn_union_of_complete_join (A := (A : Set V)) (B := (B : Set V)) hAB hA hB

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftover_start_not_mem
statement:
lemma leftover_start_not_mem {A : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) : Q.start ∉ A
proof:
:=
  Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p Q hQ) Q.start_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftover_finish_not_mem
statement:
lemma leftover_finish_not_mem {A : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) : Q.finish ∉ A
proof:
:=
  Finset.disjoint_left.1 (leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p Q hQ) Q.finish_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStarts_start
statement:
lemma switchOpenStarts_start (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u)
    (hadj : G.Adj u v) :
    (switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hv hnv hadj).start =
      (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).finish
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStarts_finish
statement:
lemma switchOpenStarts_finish (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u)
    (hadj : G.Adj u v) :
    (switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hv hnv hadj).finish =
      (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  simpa [switchOpenStarts, switchStarts_finish, pieceAfter_finish]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStarts_support
statement:
lemma switchOpenStarts_support (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u)
    (hadj : G.Adj u v) :
    (switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hv hnv hadj).support = p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [switchOpenStarts, switchStarts_support]
  exact support_pieces_union p hu hclose hne hv hnv

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStarts_ProtectedAt
statement:
lemma switchOpenStarts_ProtectedAt (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u)
    (hadj : G.Adj u v) {A : Finset V} (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A)
    {c : GraphCycle G}
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset) :
    (switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hv hnv hadj).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have hAI :=
    switchStarts_AIncident (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv)
      (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv)
      (by simpa [pieceBefore_start p hu hclose hne hv hnv,
        pieceAfter_start p hu hclose hne hv] using hadj)
      (disjoint_pieces p hu hclose hne hv hnv) huA hvA
  have he' : e ∈
      (pieceBefore p hu hclose hne hv hnv).AIncident A ∪
        (pieceAfter p hu hclose hne hv).AIncident A := by
    simpa [switchOpenStarts, hAI] using he
  have hsub := pieces_edges_subset_open p hu hclose hne hv hnv
  have hopen := openAtStart_edges_subset_cycle p hu hclose hne hedges
  rcases mem_union.1 he' with h | h
  · exact hopen (hsub.1 (mem_AIncident_iff.1 h).1)
  · exact hopen (hsub.2 (mem_AIncident_iff.1 h).1)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.switchOpenStarts_start_eq
statement:
lemma switchOpenStarts_start_eq (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hv : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support) (hnv : v ≠ u)
    (hadj : G.Adj u v) :
    (switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hv hnv hadj).start =
      ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  simpa [switchOpenStarts_start p hu hclose hne hv hnv hadj] using
    pieceBefore_finish p hu hclose hne hv hnv

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_self
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_self {u v : V} (w : G.Walk u v)
    (hw : w.IsPath) :
    w.takeUntil v w.end_mem_support = w
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (w.dropUntil v w.end_mem_support).Nil :=
    Walk.isPath_iff_nil.mp (hw.dropUntil w.end_mem_support)
  have heq := Walk.take_spec w w.end_mem_support
  rw [hn.eq_nil, Walk.append_nil] at heq
  exact heq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_factor_prefix
proof:
:= by
  have htake :=
    Walk.takeUntil_append_of_mem_left ru (Q.walk.append rv) ru.end_mem_support
  have hend := leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_self ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)
  simpa only [takeUntil, heq, Walk.append_assoc] using htake.trans hend

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_start_predecessor_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, hruA, _⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor p Q hQ
  have hru := leftoverPieces_factor_ru_not_nil hs hQ heq
  rw [leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_factor_prefix heq]
  exact hruA.resolve_left hru

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_support_subset
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_takeUntil_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) : (p.takeUntil hx).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : y ∈ (p.takeUntil hx).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hx).support :=
    mem_union.2 (Or.inl hy)
  rwa [support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil] at this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_append_of_notMem_left
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_takeUntil_append_of_notMem_left {u v w x : V}
    (p : G.Walk u v) (q : G.Walk v w) (hxq : x ∈ q.support)
    (hxp : x ∉ p.support) :
    (p.append q).takeUntil x ((Walk.mem_support_append_iff p q).2 (Or.inr hxq)) =
      p.append (q.takeUntil x hxq)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    simp
  | cons =>
    grind [Walk.cons_append, Walk.takeUntil]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_of_dropLast
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_takeUntil_of_dropLast {u v x : V} (w : G.Walk u v)
    (hnn : ¬ w.Nil) (hx : x ∈ w.dropLast.support) :
    w.dropLast.takeUntil x hx =
      w.takeUntil x (by
        have hcat := Walk.support_dropLast_concat hnn
        exact (hcat.symm ▸ List.mem_append_left _ hx))
proof:
:= by
  refine Walk.ext_support ?_
  have hcat := Walk.support_dropLast_concat (p := w) hnn
  have hidx : w.dropLast.support.idxOf x = w.support.idxOf x := by
    rw [← hcat, List.idxOf_append_of_mem hx]
  simp only [Walk.takeUntil_eq_take, Walk.support_copy, Walk.support_take, hidx]
  have hk : w.support.idxOf x + 1 ≤ w.dropLast.support.length := by
    rw [← hidx]
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hx)
  conv =>
    rhs
    arg 2
    rw [show w.support = w.dropLast.support ++ [v] from hcat.symm]
  exact (List.take_append_of_le_length hk).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil
    (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hvD : v ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).support) :
    ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
        (by
          rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]
          exact dropUntil_support_subset p hu hvD)).walk =
      ((p.dropUntil hu).takeUntil hvD).walk
proof:
:= by
  have hvW : v ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).walk.support := mem_walk_support.1 hvD
  have htake :=
    Walk.takeUntil_append_of_mem_left (p.dropUntil hu).walk
      (Walk.cons
        (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
        ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish
          (takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hu hne)).walk)
      hvW
  simpa [takeUntil, openAtStart, splice] using htake

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_penultimate_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_penultimate_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil
    (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hvD : v ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).support)
    (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    (p.takeUntil (dropUntil_support_subset p hu hvD)).walk.penultimate =
      ((p.dropUntil hu).takeUntil hvD).walk.penultimate
proof:
:= by
  have hvT : v ∉ (p.takeUntil hu).support := by
    intro hvT
    exact hvu (mem_eq_of_mem_takeUntil_dropUntil p hu hvT hvD)
  have hvW : v ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).walk.support := mem_walk_support.1 hvD
  have hxp : v ∉ (p.takeUntil hu).walk.support := by
    simpa [takeUntil, support, List.mem_toFinset] using hvT
  have happend :=
    leftoverPred_takeUntil_append_of_notMem_left (p.takeUntil hu).walk
      (p.dropUntil hu).walk hvW hxp
  have hspec := walk_eq_take_append_drop p hu
  have hnn : ¬ ((p.dropUntil hu).takeUntil hvD).walk.Nil := by
    intro hn
    exact hvu ((takeUntil_nil_iff (p.dropUntil hu) hvD).1 hn)
  have hpen :=
    penultimate_append_of_not_nil (p.takeUntil hu).walk
      ((p.dropUntil hu).takeUntil hvD).walk hnn
  change (p.walk.takeUntil v
      (mem_walk_support.1 (dropUntil_support_subset p hu hvD))).penultimate = _
  simp_rw [hspec]
  exact (congrArg Walk.penultimate happend).trans hpen

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_eq_trimFinish_takeUntil
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_takeUntil_eq_trimFinish_takeUntil
    (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hu).walk.Nil)
    (hvT : v ∈ ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).support) :
    (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvT).walk =
      (p.takeUntil (leftoverPred_takeUntil_support_subset p hu
        ((mem_erase.1 (by
          simpa [support_trimFinish, takeUntil] using hvT)).2))).walk
proof:
:= by
  have hvU : v ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).support :=
    (mem_erase.1 (by simpa [support_trimFinish, takeUntil] using hvT)).2
  have hdl : v ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).walk.dropLast.support := by
    simpa [trimFinish, support, List.mem_toFinset] using hvT
  have hdrop :=
    leftoverPred_takeUntil_of_dropLast (p.takeUntil hu).walk hnn hdl
  have htake :=
    Walk.takeUntil_takeUntil p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hu)
      (mem_walk_support.1 hvU)
  simpa [takeUntil, trimFinish] using hdrop.trans htake

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_trimFinish
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_trimFinish
    (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start)
    (hnn : ¬ (p.takeUntil hu).walk.Nil)
    (hvT : v ∈ ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).support) :
    ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
        (by
          rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]
          exact leftoverPred_takeUntil_support_subset p hu
            ((mem_erase.1 (by
              simpa [support_trimFinish, takeUntil] using hvT)).2))).walk =
      (p.dropUntil hu).walk.append
        (Walk.cons
          (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
          (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvT).walk)
proof:
:= by
  have hvU : v ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).support :=
    (mem_erase.1 (by simpa [support_trimFinish, takeUntil] using hvT)).2
  have hvu : v ≠ u := by
    have := (mem_erase.1 (by simpa [support_trimFinish, takeUntil] using hvT)).1
    simpa [takeUntil] using this
  have hvD : v ∉ (p.dropUntil hu).support := by
    intro hvD
    exact hvu (mem_eq_of_mem_takeUntil_dropUntil p hu hvU hvD)
  have hvf : v ≠ p.finish := by
    intro hvf
    exact hvD (by
      simpa [dropUntil, hvf] using (p.dropUntil hu).finish_mem_support)
  have hvW : v ∈
      (Walk.cons
        (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
        ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk).support := by
    simp [Walk.support_cons]
    exact Or.inr (mem_walk_support.1 hvT)
  have hxp : v ∉ (p.dropUntil hu).walk.support := by
    simpa [dropUntil, support, List.mem_toFinset] using hvD
  have happend :=
    leftoverPred_takeUntil_append_of_notMem_left (p.dropUntil hu).walk
      (Walk.cons
        (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
        ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk)
      hvW hxp
  have htrimW : v ∈ ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk.support :=
    mem_walk_support.1 hvT
  have hcons :
      (Walk.cons
          (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
          ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk).takeUntil v hvW =
        Walk.cons
          (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
          (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk.takeUntil v htrimW) := by
    simp [Walk.takeUntil]
    split_ifs with hf
    · exact (hvf hf.symm).elim
    · rfl
  have happend' :
      ((p.dropUntil hu).walk.append
          (Walk.cons
            (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
            ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk)).takeUntil v
          ((Walk.mem_support_append_iff _ _).2 (Or.inr hvW)) =
        (p.dropUntil hu).walk.append
          (Walk.cons
            (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
            (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).walk.takeUntil v htrimW)) := by
    exact (happend.trans (congrArg _ hcons))
  simpa [takeUntil, openAtStart, splice] using happend'

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem {A : Finset V}
    {p Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hneQR : Q.start ≠ R.start) :
    ((openAtStart p (leftoverPieces_start_mem hQ) hclose
        (leftoverPieces_start_ne hs hQ)).takeUntil
      (by
        rw [openAtStart_support]
        exact leftoverPieces_start_mem hR)).walk.penultimate ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Q.start ∈ p.support := leftoverPieces_start_mem hQ
  have hne : Q.start ≠ p.start := leftoverPieces_start_ne hs hQ
  have hv : R.start ∈ p.support := leftoverPieces_start_mem hR
  have hvs : R.start ≠ p.start := leftoverPieces_start_ne hs hR
  have hpredR := leftoverPred_start_predecessor_mem hs hR
  have hU := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hu
  have hvUD : R.start ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hu).support := by
    simpa [hU] using hv
  rcases mem_union.1 hvUD with hvT | hvD
  · have hvu : R.start ≠ Q.start := hneQR.symm
    have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hu hne
    have hvTrim : R.start ∈ ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).support := by
      have hneFin : R.start ≠ (p.takeUntil hu).finish := by
        simpa [takeUntil] using hvu
      simpa [support_trimFinish] using mem_erase.2 ⟨hneFin, hvT⟩
    have hopen :=
      leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_trimFinish p hu hclose hne hnn
        hvTrim
    have hnnC :
        ¬ (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk.Nil := by
      intro hn
      exact hvs
        ((takeUntil_nil_iff ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn) hvTrim).1 hn)
    have hpenCons :=
      Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil
        (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
        (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk hnnC
    have hpenApp :=
      penultimate_append_of_not_nil (p.dropUntil hu).walk
        (Walk.cons
          (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
          (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk)
        Walk.not_nil_cons
    have htrim :=
      leftoverPred_takeUntil_eq_trimFinish_takeUntil p hu hnn hvTrim
    have hpen :
        ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
            (by
              rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]
              exact hv)).walk.penultimate =
          (p.takeUntil (leftoverPieces_start_mem hR)).walk.penultimate := by
      rw [hopen]
      exact hpenApp.trans (hpenCons.trans (congrArg Walk.penultimate htrim))
    simpa [hpen] using hpredR
  · have hvu : R.start ≠ Q.start := hneQR.symm
    have hopen :=
      leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil p hu hclose hne hvD
    have hpenD :=
      leftoverPred_penultimate_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil p hu hvD hvu
    have hpen :
        ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
            (by
              rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]
              exact hv)).walk.penultimate =
          (p.takeUntil (leftoverPieces_start_mem hR)).walk.penultimate := by
      rw [hopen]
      exact hpenD.symm
    simpa [hpen] using hpredR

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_reverse_edges
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_reverse_edges (p : GraphPath G) :
    p.reverse.edges = p.edges
proof:
:= by
  simp [edges, reverse, Walk.edges_reverse, List.toFinset_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_penultimate_reverse_eq_snd
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_penultimate_reverse_eq_snd {u v : V} (w : G.Walk u v)
    (h : ¬ w.Nil) : w.reverse.penultimate = w.snd
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < w.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 h
  have hlen : w.reverse.length = w.length := Walk.length_reverse w
  have hsub : w.length - (w.length - 1) = 1 := by omega
  simp only [Walk.penultimate, Walk.snd, Walk.getVert_reverse, hlen, hsub]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_takeUntil_reverse_eq
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_takeUntil_reverse_eq (p : GraphPath G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.reverse.takeUntil (by simpa [support_reverse] using hx)).walk =
      (p.dropUntil hx).walk.reverse
proof:
:= by
  have hxW := mem_walk_support.1 hx
  have hspec := Walk.take_spec p.walk hxW
  have hrev : p.walk.reverse =
      (p.walk.dropUntil x hxW).reverse.append
        (p.walk.takeUntil x hxW).reverse := by
    rw [← Walk.reverse_append, hspec]
  have hxL : x ∈ (p.walk.dropUntil x hxW).reverse.support := by
    simp [Walk.support_reverse]
  have htake :=
    Walk.takeUntil_append_of_mem_left
      (p.walk.dropUntil x hxW).reverse
      (p.walk.takeUntil x hxW).reverse
      hxL
  have hend := leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_self
      (p.walk.dropUntil x hxW).reverse
      ((p.dropUntil hx).isPath.reverse)
  simp only [takeUntil, dropUntil, reverse]
  convert htake.trans hend

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_factor_rv_not_nil
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hne (Walk.Nil.eq h)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_reverse_finish_predecessor_mem
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_reverse_finish_predecessor_mem {A : Finset V}
    {p Q : GraphPath G} (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneFin : Q.finish ≠ p.finish) :
    (p.reverse.takeUntil
        (by simpa [support_reverse] using leftoverPieces_finish_mem hQ)).walk.penultimate ∈
      A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, _hruA, hrvA⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor p Q hQ
  have hrv : ¬ rv.Nil := leftoverPred_factor_rv_not_nil heq hneFin
  have hsuc : rv.snd ∈ A := hrvA.resolve_left hrv
  have hx : Q.finish ∈ p.support := leftoverPieces_finish_mem hQ
  have hxW := mem_walk_support.1 hx
  have hrev : p.walk.reverse =
      rv.reverse.append (Q.walk.reverse.append ru.reverse) := by
    rw [heq, Walk.reverse_append, Walk.reverse_append]
  have hxL : Q.finish ∈ rv.reverse.support := by
    simp [Walk.support_reverse]
  have htake :=
    Walk.takeUntil_append_of_mem_left rv.reverse
      (Q.walk.reverse.append ru.reverse) hxL
  have hend := leftoverPred_takeUntil_walk_eq_self rv.reverse
      ((isPath_of_factor_right heq).reverse)
  have hwalk :
      (p.reverse.takeUntil
          (by simpa [support_reverse] using hx)).walk = rv.reverse := by
    simp only [reverse, takeUntil]
    convert htake.trans hend
  have hpen :
      (p.reverse.takeUntil
          (by simpa [support_reverse] using hx)).walk.penultimate = rv.snd := by
    rw [hwalk]
    exact leftoverPred_penultimate_reverse_eq_snd rv hrv
  simpa [hpen] using hsuc

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem_of_pred
statement:
lemma leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem_of_pred {A : Finset V}
    (p : GraphPath G) {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hv : v ∈ p.support)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hneuv : u ≠ v)
    (hpredV : v ≠ p.start → (p.takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate ∈ A)
    (hcloseA : v = p.start → p.finish ∈ A) :
    ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
        (by rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate ∈
      A
proof:
:= by
  have hU := support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil p hu
  have hvUD : v ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).support ∪ (p.dropUntil hu).support := by
    simpa [hU] using hv
  rcases mem_union.1 hvUD with hvT | hvD
  · have hvu : v ≠ u := hneuv.symm
    have hnn := takeUntil_not_nil_cyclePieces hu hne
    have hvTrim : v ∈ ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).support := by
      have hneFin : v ≠ (p.takeUntil hu).finish := by
        simpa [takeUntil] using hvu
      simpa [support_trimFinish] using mem_erase.2 ⟨hneFin, hvT⟩
    by_cases hvs : v = p.start
    · have hfinA : p.finish ∈ A := hcloseA hvs
      have hopen :=
        leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_trimFinish p hu hclose hne hnn
          hvTrim
      have hnil :
          (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk.Nil :=
        (takeUntil_nil_iff ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn) hvTrim).2
          (by simpa [trimFinish, takeUntil] using hvs)
      have hpenApp :=
        penultimate_append_of_not_nil (p.dropUntil hu).walk
          (Walk.cons
            (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
            (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk)
          Walk.not_nil_cons
      have hpenCons :
          (Walk.cons
              (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
              (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk).penultimate =
            p.finish := by
        have hlen0 :
            (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk.length = 0 :=
          Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.2 hnil
        simp [Walk.penultimate, Walk.length_cons, hlen0]
      have hpen :
          ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
              (by rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate =
            p.finish := by
        rw [hopen]
        exact hpenApp.trans hpenCons
      simpa [hpen] using hfinA
    · have hpred := hpredV hvs
      have hopen :=
        leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_trimFinish p hu hclose hne hnn
          hvTrim
      have hnnC :
          ¬ (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk.Nil := by
        intro hn
        exact hvs
          ((takeUntil_nil_iff ((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn) hvTrim).1 hn)
      have hpenCons :=
        Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil
          (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
          (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk hnnC
      have hpenApp :=
        penultimate_append_of_not_nil (p.dropUntil hu).walk
          (Walk.cons
            (by simpa [dropUntil, takeUntil, trimFinish] using hclose)
            (((p.takeUntil hu).trimFinish hnn).takeUntil hvTrim).walk)
          Walk.not_nil_cons
      have htrim :=
        leftoverPred_takeUntil_eq_trimFinish_takeUntil p hu hnn hvTrim
      have hpen :
          ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
              (by rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate =
            (p.takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate := by
        rw [hopen]
        exact hpenApp.trans (hpenCons.trans (congrArg Walk.penultimate htrim))
      simpa [hpen] using hpred
  · have hvu : v ≠ u := hneuv.symm
    have hvs : v ≠ p.start := by
      intro hvs
      have hst : p.start ∈ (p.takeUntil hu).support := by
        simpa [takeUntil] using (p.takeUntil hu).start_mem_support
      have hvD' : p.start ∈ (p.dropUntil hu).support := by
        simpa [hvs] using hvD
      exact hne (mem_eq_of_mem_takeUntil_dropUntil p hu hst hvD').symm
    have hpred := hpredV hvs
    have hopen :=
      leftoverPred_openAtStart_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil p hu hclose hne hvD
    have hpenD :=
      leftoverPred_penultimate_takeUntil_of_mem_dropUntil p hu hvD hvu
    have hpen :
        ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
            (by rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate =
          (p.takeUntil hv).walk.penultimate := by
      rw [hopen]
      exact hpenD.symm
    simpa [hpen] using hpred

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_starts
statement:
lemma exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_starts {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.start ≠ R.start) (hadj : G.Adj Q.start R.start) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Q.start ∈ p.support := leftoverPieces_start_mem hQ
  have hne : Q.start ≠ p.start := leftoverPieces_start_ne hs hQ
  have huA : Q.start ∉ A := leftover_start_not_mem hQ
  have hvA : R.start ∉ A := leftover_start_not_mem hR
  have hvOpen : R.start ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support := by
    rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]
    exact leftoverPieces_start_mem hR
  let q := switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hadj
  have hqU : q.support = U := by
    simpa [q, hp] using
      switchOpenStarts_support p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hadj
  refine ⟨q, hqU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact switchOpenStarts_ProtectedAt p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hadj
      huA hvA hedges
  · have hst := switchOpenStarts_start_eq p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hadj
    have hpred :=
      leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem hs hQ hR hclose hneQR
    simpa [q, hst] using hpred
  · have hfin := switchOpenStarts_finish p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneQR.symm hadj
    have hpred := leftoverPred_start_predecessor_mem hs hQ
    simpa [q, hfin] using hpred
  · intro hst
    have hnil : q.walk.Nil := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish q).2 hst
    have hsing : q.support = {q.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil q hnil
    have hcard : q.support.card = 1 := by simp [hsing]
    have h3 : 3 ≤ q.support.card := by
      simpa [hqU, hc] using c.three_le_card_support
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchOpenStarts_AA_of_preds
statement:
lemma exists_switchOpenStarts_AA_of_preds {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ p.support) (hv : v ∈ p.support)
    (hne : u ≠ p.start) (hneuv : u ≠ v) (hadj : G.Adj u v)
    (huA : u ∉ A) (hvA : v ∉ A)
    (hfinA : (p.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate ∈ A)
    (hstartA :
      ((openAtStart p hu hclose hne).takeUntil
        (by rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate ∈ A) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hvOpen : v ∈ (openAtStart p hu hclose hne).support := by
    rw [openAtStart_support p hu hclose hne]; exact hv
  let q := switchOpenStarts p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hadj
  have hqU : q.support = U := by
    simpa [q, hp] using
      switchOpenStarts_support p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hadj
  refine ⟨q, hqU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact switchOpenStarts_ProtectedAt p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hadj
      huA hvA hedges
