  · have hst := switchOpenStarts_start_eq p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hadj
    simpa [q, hst] using hstartA
  · have hfin := switchOpenStarts_finish p hu hclose hne hvOpen hneuv.symm hadj
    simpa [q, hfin] using hfinA
  · intro hst
    have hnil : q.walk.Nil := (nil_iff_start_eq_finish q).2 hst
    have hsing : q.support = {q.start} := support_eq_singleton_of_nil q hnil
    have hcard : q.support.card = 1 := by simp [hsing]
    have h3 : 3 ≤ q.support.card := by
      simpa [hqU, hc] using c.three_le_card_support
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends_of_ne_finish
statement:
lemma exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends_of_ne_finish {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.finish ≠ R.finish) (hadj : G.Adj Q.finish R.finish)
    (hneFin : Q.finish ≠ p.finish) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  let pr := p.reverse
  have hpR : pr.support = U := by simpa [pr, support_reverse] using hp
  have hcloseR : G.Adj pr.finish pr.start := by
    simpa [pr, reverse] using hclose.symm
  have hedgesR : pr.edges ∪ {s(pr.finish, pr.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset := by
    rw [leftoverPred_reverse_edges p]
    change p.edges ∪ {s(p.start, p.finish)} = _
    rw [show s(p.start, p.finish) = s(p.finish, p.start) from Sym2.eq_swap]
    exact hedges
  have hu : Q.finish ∈ pr.support := by
    simpa [pr, support_reverse] using leftoverPieces_finish_mem hQ
  have hv : R.finish ∈ pr.support := by
    simpa [pr, support_reverse] using leftoverPieces_finish_mem hR
  have hne : Q.finish ≠ pr.start := by simpa [pr, reverse] using hneFin
  have huA : Q.finish ∉ A := leftover_finish_not_mem hQ
  have hvA : R.finish ∉ A := leftover_finish_not_mem hR
  have hfinA :
      (pr.takeUntil hu).walk.penultimate ∈ A := by
    simpa [pr] using leftoverPred_reverse_finish_predecessor_mem hQ hneFin
  have hstartA :
      ((openAtStart pr hu hcloseR hne).takeUntil
        (by rw [openAtStart_support pr hu hcloseR hne]; exact hv)).walk.penultimate ∈
        A :=
    leftoverPred_openAtStart_predecessor_mem_of_pred (A := A) pr hu hv
      hcloseR hne hneQR
      (fun hvs =>
        leftoverPred_reverse_finish_predecessor_mem hR
          (by simpa [pr, reverse] using hvs))
      (fun _ => by simpa [pr, reverse] using hs)
  exact exists_switchOpenStarts_AA_of_preds c hc hpR hcloseR hedgesR
    hu hv hne hneQR hadj huA hvA hfinA hstartA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends
statement:
lemma exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q.finish ≠ R.finish) (hadj : G.Adj Q.finish R.finish) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hneFin : Q.finish = p.finish
  · have hRfin : R.finish ≠ p.finish := by
      intro h
      exact hneQR (hneFin.trans h.symm)
    exact exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends_of_ne_finish c hc hp hs
      hclose hedges hR hQ hneQR.symm hadj.symm hRfin
  · exact exists_switchOpenStarts_of_adj_leftover_ends_of_ne_finish c hc hp hs
      hclose hedges hQ hR hneQR hadj hneFin

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.IsCograph.subset
statement:
lemma IsCograph.subset {U W : Finset V}
    (hW : IsCograph G W) (hUW : U ⊆ W) : IsCograph G U
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd => hW (hUW ha) (hUW hb) (hUW hc) (hUW hd)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_rNonadjClass_iff
statement:
lemma mem_rNonadjClass_iff {U : Finset V} {x y : V} :
    y ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ↔
      y ∈ U ∧ ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [rNonadjClass]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.rNonadjClass_subset
statement:
lemma rNonadjClass_subset (U : Finset V) (x : V) :
    rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ⊆ U
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_SpanningPathCompatible_self
statement:
lemma not_SpanningPathCompatible_self (U : Finset V) (x : V) :
    ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x x
proof: := fun h => h.1 rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_rNonadjClass_self
statement:
lemma mem_rNonadjClass_self {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    x ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x
proof:
:=
  mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hx, not_SpanningPathCompatible_self (G := G) U x⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_qxSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_qxSet_iff {U : Finset V} {x y : V} :
    y ∈ qxSet (G := G) U x ↔
      y = x ∨ y ∈ ineligibleSet G (U.erase x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qxSet]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support
proof:
:= by
  have hne : U.Nonempty := by rw [← hp]; exact p.support_nonempty
  let pc : PathCover G U := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hp
  have hcard : pc.card = 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
  have hge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hne
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.Eligible_of_support_ends
statement:
lemma Eligible_of_support_ends {U : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G)
    (hp : p.support = U) :
    Eligible G U p.start ∧ Eligible G U p.finish
proof:
:= by
  let pc : PathCover G U := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hp
  have hcard : pc.card = 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U :=
    hcard.trans (pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p hp).symm
  have hmem : p ∈ pc.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
  exact Eligible.of_min_cover_endpoint pc hmin hmem

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_of_eligible_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, p, hpmem, hy⟩ := hE
  have hlen : pc.card = 1 := hpc.trans hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pc hlen
  have hpq : p = q := by simpa [hq] using hpmem
  subst hpq
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hy.imp Eq.symm Eq.symm⟩
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact pc.support_subset (by simp [hq]) hz
  · intro hzU
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hzr⟩ := (pc.mem_iff z).1 hzU
    have : r = p := by simpa [hq] using hr
    simpa [this] using hzr

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_erase_endpoint_path
statement:
lemma exists_erase_endpoint_path {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (p : GraphPath G) (hp : p.support = U) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hends : (p.start = x ∧ p.finish = y) ∨ (p.start = y ∧ p.finish = x)) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G, q.support = U.erase x ∧
      (q.start = y ∨ q.finish = y)
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ p.walk.Nil := by
    intro h
    have heq := (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 h
    rcases hends with ⟨hs, hf⟩ | ⟨hs, hf⟩
    · exact hxy (hs.symm.trans (heq.trans hf))
    · exact hxy (hf.symm.trans (heq.symm.trans hs))
  rcases hends with ⟨hs, hf⟩ | ⟨hs, hf⟩
  · refine ⟨p.trimStart hnil, ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.support_trimStart, hs, hp]
    · simp [GraphPath.trimStart, hf]
  · refine ⟨p.trimFinish hnil, ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.support_trimFinish, hf, hp]
    · simp [GraphPath.trimFinish, hs]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.Eligible_erase_of_spanning
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxy, p, hp, hends⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hy⟩ := exists_erase_endpoint_path p hp hxy hends
  have hE := Eligible_of_support_ends q hq
  rcases hy with hs | hf
  · simpa [hs] using hE.1
  · simpa [hf] using hE.2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_eq_erase_sdiff_erase
statement:
lemma sdiff_eq_erase_sdiff_erase {U S : Finset V} {x : V} (hxS : x ∈ S) :
    U \ S = U.erase x \ S.erase x
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨hzU, hzS⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun hzx => hzS (hzx ▸ hxS), hzU⟩, fun h => hzS h.2⟩
  · intro ⟨⟨hzx, hzU⟩, hzSe⟩
    refine ⟨hzU, fun hzS => hzSe ⟨hzx, hzS⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_le_of_both_endpoints
statement:
lemma componentCount_sdiff_le_of_both_endpoints {U S : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hS : S ⊆ U) (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y) :
    componentCount G (U \ S) ≤ S.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, p, hp, hends⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hyend⟩ := exists_erase_endpoint_path p hp hxy hends
  have hEy : Eligible G (U.erase x) y := by
    have hE := Eligible_of_support_ends q hq
    rcases hyend with hs | hf
    · simpa [hs] using hE.1
    · simpa [hf] using hE.2
  have hpK : pathCoverNumber G (U.erase x) = 1 :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support q hq
  have hEq : U \ S = U.erase x \ S.erase x := sdiff_eq_erase_sdiff_erase hx
  have hsub : S.erase x ⊆ U.erase x := by
    intro z hz
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hz).1, hS (mem_of_mem_erase hz)⟩
  have hySe : y ∈ S.erase x := mem_erase.2 ⟨hxy.symm, hy⟩
  have hle :=
    componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible (G := G) hsub hySe hEy
  have hcard : (S.erase x).card = S.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hx
  have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hx⟩)
  rw [hEq]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.SpanningPathCompatible_extend
statement:
lemma SpanningPathCompatible_extend {K : Finset V} {x y z : V}
    (hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) K z y)
    (hadj : G.Adj x z) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (insert x K) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, p0, hp0, hends⟩ := hR
  let p : GraphPath G :=
    if h : p0.start = z ∧ p0.finish = y then p0 else p0.reverse
  have hp : p.support = K := by
    by_cases h : p0.start = z ∧ p0.finish = y
    · simpa [p, h] using hp0
    · simpa [p, h, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp0
  have hzy : p.start = z ∧ p.finish = y := by
    by_cases h : p0.start = z ∧ p0.finish = y
    · simpa [p, h]
    · have h' : p0.start = y ∧ p0.finish = z := by
        rcases hends with h1 | h2
        · exact (h h1).elim
        · exact h2
      have hp' : p = p0.reverse := dif_neg h
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [hp', GraphPath.reverse] using h'.2
      · simpa [hp', GraphPath.reverse] using h'.1
  have hx' : x ∉ p.support := by simpa [hp] using hx
  have hadj' : G.Adj x p.start := by simpa [hzy.1] using hadj
  let r := p.consAdj hadj' hx'
  have hxny : x ≠ y := fun hxy => hx (by
    have : y ∈ p0.support := by
      rcases hends with h1 | h2
      · simpa [h1.2] using p0.finish_mem_support
      · simpa [h2.1] using p0.start_mem_support
    simpa [hxy, hp0] using this)
  refine ⟨hxny, r, ?_, Or.inl ⟨rfl, ?_⟩⟩
  · simpa [r, GraphPath.support_consAdj, hp]
  · simp [r, GraphPath.consAdj, hzy.2]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_child_le_succ
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_child_le_succ {A B : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1) :
    pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub hAB
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_child_le_of_not_crit
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_child_le_of_not_crit {A B : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1)
    (hnot : pathCoverNumber G A ≠ B.card + 1) :
    pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_child_le_succ hAB hp
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_le_card_of_eligible_all
statement:
lemma componentCount_sdiff_le_card_of_eligible_all {U S : Finset V}
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G U = 1)
    (hE : eligibleSet G U = U)
    (hS : S ⊆ U) (hSne : S.Nonempty) :
    componentCount G (U \ S) ≤ S.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxS⟩ := hSne
  have hxE : Eligible G U x := by
    have : x ∈ eligibleSet G U := by simpa [hE] using hS hxS
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this |>.2
  have hle := componentCount_sdiff_le_of_eligible (G := G) hS hxS hxE
  have hpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hxS⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.insert_erase_eq
statement:
lemma insert_erase_eq {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    insert x (U.erase x) = U
proof:
:=
  insert_erase hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.qxSet_sdiff
statement:
lemma qxSet_sdiff {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    U \ qxSet (G := G) U x = U.erase x \ ineligibleSet G (U.erase x)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_sdiff, qxSet, mem_insert]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨hzU, hzQ⟩
    have hzx : z ≠ x := fun h => hzQ (Or.inl h)
    exact ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hzx, hzU⟩, fun hF => hzQ (Or.inr hF)⟩
  · intro ⟨hzK, hzF⟩
    exact ⟨(mem_erase.1 hzK).2, fun h => h.elim
      (fun hzx => (mem_erase.1 hzK).1 hzx) hzF⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_qxSet
statement:
lemma card_qxSet {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (qxSet (G := G) U x).card = (ineligibleSet G (U.erase x)).card + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hxF : x ∉ ineligibleSet G (U.erase x) := fun h =>
    (mem_erase.1 ((ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) (U.erase x)) h)).1 rfl
  simp [qxSet, card_insert_of_notMem hxF]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_qxSet_eq
statement:
lemma componentCount_sdiff_qxSet_eq {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hK : IsCograph G (U.erase x))
    (hpK : pathCoverNumber G (U.erase x) = 1) :
    componentCount G (U \ qxSet (G := G) U x) =
      (qxSet (G := G) U x).card
proof:
:= by
  have hcut :=
    componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq_of_isCograph (G := G) hK
  have hrew := qxSet_sdiff (G := G) hx
  have hcard := card_qxSet (G := G) hx
  rw [hrew, hcut, hcard, hpK, add_comm]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_insert_ge_of_neighbors_in_one
statement:
lemma componentCount_insert_ge_of_neighbors_in_one {Rem W : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ Rem) (hW : W ⊆ Rem) (hWne : W.Nonempty)
    (hcomp : InOneComponent (G := G) Rem W)
    (hN : ∀ z ∈ Rem, G.Adj x z → z ∈ W) :
    componentCount G Rem ≤ componentCount G (insert x Rem)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := exists_component_of_inOneComponent hWne hcomp
  let oldLabel : ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V) →
      (G.induce (Rem : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := fun v =>
    if hvx : v.val = x then C0
    else
      (G.induce (Rem : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨v.val, (mem_insert.1 v.property).resolve_left hvx⟩
  have hAdj : ∀ {a b : ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)},
      (G.induce ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)).Adj a b →
        oldLabel a = oldLabel b := by
    intro a b hadj
    have hadjG : G.Adj a.val b.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
    by_cases ha : a.val = x
    · by_cases hb : b.val = x
      · simp [oldLabel, ha, hb]
      · have hbR : b.val ∈ Rem := (mem_insert.1 b.property).resolve_left hb
        have hbW : b.val ∈ W := hN b.val hbR (by simpa [ha] using hadjG)
        obtain ⟨hbU, hbeq⟩ := hC0 b.val hbW
        simp [oldLabel, ha, hb]
        have : (G.induce (Rem : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b.val, hbU⟩ = C0 := hbeq
        exact this.symm
    · by_cases hb : b.val = x
      · have haR : a.val ∈ Rem := (mem_insert.1 a.property).resolve_left ha
        have haW : a.val ∈ W := hN a.val haR (by simpa [hb] using hadjG.symm)
        obtain ⟨haU, hAeq⟩ := hC0 a.val haW
        simp [oldLabel, ha, hb]
        exact hAeq
      · have haR : a.val ∈ Rem := (mem_insert.1 a.property).resolve_left ha
        have hbR : b.val ∈ Rem := (mem_insert.1 b.property).resolve_left hb
        simp [oldLabel, ha, hb]
        exact Adj.reachable (by simpa [induce_adj] using hadjG)
  have hwalk : ∀ {a b : ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)}
      (p : (G.induce ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)).Walk a b),
      oldLabel a = oldLabel b := by
    intro a b p
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons hadj q ih => exact (hAdj hadj).trans ih
  have hreach : ∀ {a b : ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)},
      (G.induce ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable a b →
        oldLabel a = oldLabel b := fun h =>
    hwalk (Classical.choice h)
  let f : (G.induce ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce (Rem : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ConnectedComponent.lift oldLabel fun a b p _hp => hreach ⟨p⟩
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun v => ?_
    have hvR : v.val ∈ Rem := v.property
    have hvI : v.val ∈ insert x Rem := mem_insert_of_mem hvR
    refine ⟨(G.induce ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨v.val, hvI⟩, ?_⟩
    change oldLabel ⟨v.val, hvI⟩ = (G.induce (Rem : Set V)).connectedComponentMk v
    have hvx : v.val ≠ x := fun h => hx (h ▸ hvR)
    simp [oldLabel, hvx]
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (Rem : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype
      (G.induce ((insert x Rem : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path
statement:
lemma GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path (c : GraphCycle G) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = c.support ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ c.walk.Nil := c.isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
  have hq : q.IsPath :=
    ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hadj).1 (by simpa [hwalk] using c.isCycle)).1
  let p : GraphPath G := ⟨w, c.start, q, hq⟩
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hadj⟩
  have hstart : c.start ∈ q.support := Walk.end_mem_support q
  simp [p, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hwalk, Walk.support_cons,
    insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart)]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_of_cycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hadj⟩ := GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path c
  have hrU : r.support = U := hr.trans hc
  have hmin_of (p : GraphPath G) (hp : p.support = U) :
      Eligible G U p.start ∧ Eligible G U p.finish :=
    Eligible_of_support_ends p hp
  by_cases hxs : x = r.start
  · simpa [hxs] using (hmin_of r hrU).1
  by_cases hxf : x = r.finish
  · simpa [hxf] using (hmin_of r hrU).2
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hstart⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_path_start_of_internal (U := U) r hrU hadj hx hxs hxf
  simpa [hstart] using (hmin_of p hp).1

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_eq_of_cycle
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact eligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hx
  · intro hx
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hx, eligible_of_cycle c hc hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.critical_endpoints_of_join
statement:
lemma critical_endpoints_of_join {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1)
    (hA : IsCograph G A) :
    IsCriticalEndpoints (G := G) (A ∪ B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A, B, hAne, hBne, rfl, hAB, hcrit, hA,
    eligibleSet_complete_join_critical hAne hBne hAB hcrit,
    ineligibleSet_complete_join_critical hAne hBne hAB hcrit, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    simpa using
      (SpanningPathCompatible_critical_iff (G := G) hAne hBne hAB hcrit
        (x := x) (y := y))
  · intro x hx
    exact exists_critical_partCut hAne hBne hAB hcrit hA hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanningPathCompatible_symm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, p, hp, hends⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hne.symm, p, hp, hends.symm⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCompleteBetween_symm
proof:
:=
  fun {_} hb {_} ha => (h ha hb).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.insert_erase_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_insert, mem_sdiff, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with rfl | ⟨⟨_, hzU⟩, hzS⟩
    · exact ⟨hx, hxS⟩
    · exact ⟨hzU, hzS⟩
  · intro ⟨hzU, hzS⟩
    by_cases hzx : z = x
    · exact Or.inl hzx
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hzx, hzU⟩, hzS⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_eligibleSet_of_mem_not_ineligible
proof:
:= by
  have : z ∈ eligibleSet G U ∪ ineligibleSet G U := by
    simpa [eligibleSet_union_ineligibleSet] using hzU
  exact (mem_union.1 this).resolve_right hzF

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_extension
statement:
lemma rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_extension {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hiff : ∀ y ∈ U.erase x,
      SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y ↔ Eligible G (U.erase x) y) :
    rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = qxSet (G := G) U x
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hyQ
    have hyU : y ∈ U := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x hyQ
    have hnotR : ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y :=
      (mem_rNonadjClass_iff.1 hyQ).2
    by_cases hyx : y = x
    · simp [qxSet, hyx]
    · have hyK : y ∈ U.erase x := mem_erase.2 ⟨hyx, hyU⟩
      have hnotE : ¬ Eligible G (U.erase x) y := fun hE => hnotR ((hiff y hyK).2 hE)
      exact mem_qxSet_iff.2 (Or.inr ((mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
        ⟨hyK, hnotE⟩))
  · intro hyQ
    rcases mem_qxSet_iff.1 hyQ with rfl | hyF
    · exact mem_rNonadjClass_self hx
    · have hyK : y ∈ U.erase x := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) (U.erase x) hyF
      have hnotE : ¬ Eligible G (U.erase x) y :=
        (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hyF |>.2
      have hnotR : ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y := fun hR =>
        hnotE ((hiff y hyK).1 hR)
      exact mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hyK).2, hnotR⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.false_of_eligible_not_extend
statement:
lemma false_of_eligible_not_extend {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hEy : Eligible G (U.erase x) y)
    (hnot : ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y)
    (hKdata : HamiltonEndpointsData (G := G) (U.erase x))
    (hpK : pathCoverNumber G (U.erase x) = 1)
    (hEall : eligibleSet G U = U)
    (hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  set K := U.erase x
  have hyK : y ∈ K := Eligible.mem (G := G) hEy
  have hxK : x ∉ K := notMem_erase x U
  have hUK : insert x K = U := insert_erase hx
  rcases hKdata with hcrit | hbal
  · obtain ⟨A, B, hAne, hBne, hunion, hAB, hcritAB, hA, hEeq, hFeq, hRiff, hpart⟩ :=
      hcrit
    have hyE : y ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
      have : y ∈ eligibleSet G K := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hyK, hEy⟩
      rwa [← hEeq]
    let P := dNonadjClass (G := G) A y
    have hyP : y ∈ P := mem_dNonadjClass_self hyE
    have hN : ∀ z ∈ K, G.Adj x z → z ∈ ineligibleSet G K ∪ P := by
      intro z hzK hadj
      by_cases hzF : z ∈ ineligibleSet G K
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzF)
      · have hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G K :=
          mem_eligibleSet_of_mem_not_ineligible hzK hzF
        by_cases hzP : z ∈ P
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzP)
        · have hzEA : z ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rwa [hEeq] at hzE
          have hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A y z := by
            by_contra hnotD
            exact hzP (mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hzEA, hnotD⟩)
          have hRKyz : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) K y z :=
            (hRiff y z).2 hD
          have hRU : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (insert x K) x y :=
            SpanningPathCompatible_extend (spanningPathCompatible_symm hRKyz) hadj hxK
          exact (hnot (by simpa [hUK] using hRU)).elim
    obtain ⟨S, hSsub, hSne, hScut, hScomp⟩ := hpart y hyE
    have hSF : S ⊆ ineligibleSet G K := hSsub
    have hxS : x ∉ S := fun h => hxK (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K (hSF h))
    have hWU :
        ((ineligibleSet G K ∪ P) \ S) ⊆ K \ S := by
      intro z hz
      have hzKP : z ∈ ineligibleSet G K ∪ P := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hzS : z ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      have hzK : z ∈ K := by
        rcases mem_union.1 hzKP with hzF | hzP'
        · exact ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K hzF
        · have hsub : eligibleSet G A ⊆ K := by
            simpa [hEeq] using eligibleSet_subset (G := G) K
          exact hsub (dNonadjClass_subset_eligible (G := G) A y hzP')
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzK, hzS⟩
    have hWne : ((ineligibleSet G K ∪ P) \ S).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨y, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hyP), ?_⟩⟩
      intro hyS
      have hyF := hSF hyS
      have hyE' : y ∈ eligibleSet G K := (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hyK, hEy⟩
      exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) K)
        hyE') hyF
    have hNRem : ∀ z ∈ K \ S, G.Adj x z → z ∈ (ineligibleSet G K ∪ P) \ S := by
      intro z hzRem hadj
      have hzK : z ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hzRem).1
      have hzS : z ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hzRem).2
      have hzFP := hN z hzK hadj
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzFP, hzS⟩
    have hge :=
      componentCount_insert_ge_of_neighbors_in_one (Rem := K \ S)
        (W := (ineligibleSet G K ∪ P) \ S) (x := x)
        (fun h => hxK (mem_sdiff.1 h).1) hWU hWne hScomp hNRem
    have hinsert : insert x (K \ S) = U \ S :=
      insert_erase_sdiff hx hxS
    have hge' : S.card + 1 ≤ componentCount G (U \ S) := by
      simpa [hScut, hinsert] using hge
    have hSsubU : S ⊆ U :=
      (hSF.trans (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K)).trans (erase_subset x U)
    have hle :=
      componentCount_sdiff_le_card_of_eligible_all hpU hEall hSsubU hSne
    omega
  · obtain ⟨hEK, hcutK, _hclass⟩ := hbal
    have hF : ineligibleSet G K = ∅ := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have hzK : z ∈ K := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) K hz
        have hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G K := by simpa [hEK] using hzK
        exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) K)
          hzE hz).elim
      · intro hz
        exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
    let P := rNonadjClass (G := G) K y
    have hyP : y ∈ P := mem_rNonadjClass_self hyK
    have hN : ∀ z ∈ K, G.Adj x z → z ∈ P := by
      intro z hzK hadj
      by_cases hzP : z ∈ P
      · exact hzP
      · have hRKyz : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) K y z := by
          by_contra hnotR
          exact hzP (mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hzK, hnotR⟩)
        have hRU : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (insert x K) x y :=
          SpanningPathCompatible_extend (spanningPathCompatible_symm hRKyz) hadj hxK
        exact (hnot (by simpa [hUK] using hRU)).elim
    have hxP : x ∉ P := fun h => hxK (rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) K y h)
    have hnocross : ∀ a ∈ ({x} : Finset V), ∀ b ∈ K \ P, ¬ G.Adj a b := by
      intro a ha b hb hadj
      have : a = x := mem_singleton.1 ha
      subst this
      have hbK : b ∈ K := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
      have hbP : b ∉ P := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      exact hbP (hN b hbK hadj)
    have hdisj : Disjoint ({x} : Finset V) (K \ P) := by
      rw [disjoint_singleton_left]
      intro h
      exact hxK (mem_sdiff.1 h).1
    have hunion : ({x} : Finset V) ∪ (K \ P) = U \ P := by
      have : P ⊆ K := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) K y
      have hxS : x ∉ P := hxP
      simpa [singleton_union] using insert_erase_sdiff (S := P) hx hxS
    have hadd :=
      componentCount_union_of_no_cross (A := ({x} : Finset V)) (B := K \ P)
        hdisj hnocross
    have hPx : componentCount G ({x} : Finset V) = 1 :=
      componentCount_singleton (G := G) x
    have hPK : componentCount G (K \ P) = P.card := hcutK y hyK
    have hPsub : P ⊆ U :=
      (rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) K y).trans (erase_subset x U)
    have hPne : P.Nonempty := ⟨y, hyP⟩
    have hle :=
      componentCount_sdiff_le_card_of_eligible_all hpU hEall hPsub hPne
    have : componentCount G (U \ P) = P.card + 1 := by
      rw [← hunion, hadd, hPx, hPK, add_comm]
    omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.extension_iff_of_IH
statement:
lemma extension_iff_of_IH {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U.erase x)
    (hKdata : HamiltonEndpointsData (G := G) (U.erase x))
    (hpK : pathCoverNumber G (U.erase x) = 1)
    (hEall : eligibleSet G U = U)
    (hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y ↔ Eligible G (U.erase x) y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun hR => Eligible_erase_of_spanning hR
  · intro hEy
    by_contra hnot
    exact false_of_eligible_not_extend hx hEy hnot hKdata hpK hEall hpU

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.class_coincidence_of_qx
statement:
lemma class_coincidence_of_qx {U : Finset V}
    (hEall : eligibleSet G U = U)
    (hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1)
    (hcut : ∀ x ∈ U,
      componentCount G (U \ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x) =
        (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x).card) :
    ∀ {x y : V}, x ∈ U → y ∈ U →
      (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = rNonadjClass (G := G) U y ↔
        y ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  constructor
  · intro heq
    simpa [heq] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hy
  · intro hyQ
    have hsub : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ⊆ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y := by
      intro z hz
      by_cases hzy : z = y
      · simpa [hzy] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hy
      · have hne : y ≠ z := fun h => hzy h.symm
        have hRfalse : ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U y z := by
          intro hR
          have hle :=
            componentCount_sdiff_le_of_both_endpoints
              (rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x)
              hyQ hz hne hR
          have heq := hcut x hx
          have hpos : 1 ≤ (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x).card :=
            Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨y, hyQ⟩)
          omega
        exact mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2
          ⟨rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x hz, hRfalse⟩
    have hxQy : x ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y := hsub (mem_rNonadjClass_self hx)
    have hsub' : rNonadjClass (G := G) U y ⊆ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x := by
      intro z hz
      by_cases hzx : z = x
      · simpa [hzx] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hx
      · have hRfalse : ¬ SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x z := by
          intro hR
          have hle :=
            componentCount_sdiff_le_of_both_endpoints
              (rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U y)
              hxQy hz (Ne.symm hzx) hR
          have heq := hcut y hy
          have hpos : 1 ≤ (rNonadjClass (G := G) U y).card :=
            Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨x, hxQy⟩)
          omega
        exact mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2
          ⟨rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U y hz, hRfalse⟩
    exact subset_antisymm hsub hsub'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.support_eq_pair_of_card_two
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V) ⊆ p.support :=
    insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨p.start_mem_support, singleton_subset_iff.2 p.finish_mem_support⟩
  have hpair : ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hne])]
    simp
  have hsc : p.support.card = 2 := by simpa [hp] using h2
  exact (eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.balanced_endpoints_of_card_two
statement:
lemma balanced_endpoints_of_card_two {U : Finset V}
    (hU : IsCograph G U)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G U = 1)
    (h2 : U.card = 2) :
    IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U
proof:
:= by
  have h2le : 2 ≤ U.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAU, hBU, hAne, hBne, _, hcover, hAB, hAcard, hBcard⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_on hU hconn h2le
  have hApos : 1 ≤ A.card := card_pos.2 hAne
  have hBpos : 1 ≤ B.card := card_pos.2 hBne
  have hA1 : A.card = 1 := by omega
  have hB1 : B.card = 1 := by omega
  have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card :=
    (pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) A).trans (by omega)
  have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card :=
    (pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) B).trans (by omega)
  have hE : eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = A ∪ B :=
    eligibleSet_complete_join_balanced hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
  have hEU : eligibleSet G U = U := by simpa [hcover] using hE
  obtain ⟨p, hpU, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_spanning_path hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
  have hsupU : p.support = U := by simpa [hcover] using hpU
  have hsf : p.start ≠ p.finish := by
    intro heq
    have hnil : p.walk.Nil := (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).2 heq
    have hs1 : p.support = {p.start} := GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
    have : U.card = 1 := by
      rw [← hsupU, hs1, card_singleton]
    omega
  have hRAB : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U p.start p.finish :=
    ⟨hsf, p, hsupU, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have hpairEnds : p.support = {p.start, p.finish} :=
    support_eq_pair_of_card_two p hsupU h2 hsf
  have hpair : ∀ {u v : V}, u ∈ U → v ∈ U → u ≠ v →
      SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U u v := by
    intro u v hu hv hne
    have hu' : u = p.start ∨ u = p.finish := by
      have : u ∈ p.support := by simpa [hsupU] using hu
      have : u ∈ ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V) := by simpa [hpairEnds] using this
      simpa [mem_insert, mem_singleton] using this
    have hv' : v = p.start ∨ v = p.finish := by
      have : v ∈ p.support := by simpa [hsupU] using hv
      have : v ∈ ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V) := by simpa [hpairEnds] using this
      simpa [mem_insert, mem_singleton] using this
    rcases hu' with hu' | hu' <;> rcases hv' with hv' | hv'
    · exact (hne (hu'.trans hv'.symm)).elim
    · simpa [hu', hv'] using hRAB
    · simpa [hu', hv'] using spanningPathCompatible_symm hRAB
    · exact (hne (hu'.trans hv'.symm)).elim
  refine ⟨hEU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hQ : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = {x} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have hzU : z ∈ U := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x hz
        by_cases hzx : z = x
        · simp [hzx]
        · have hR := hpair hx hzU (fun h => hzx h.symm)
          exact ((mem_rNonadjClass_iff.1 hz).2 hR).elim
      · intro hz
        have : z = x := mem_singleton.1 hz
        simpa [this] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hx
    have hrem : U \ {x} = U.erase x := sdiff_singleton_eq_erase x U
    have hK : (U.erase x).card = 1 := by
      have := card_erase_of_mem hx
      omega
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hK
    rw [hQ, hrem, hw, componentCount_singleton, card_singleton]
  · intro x y hx hy
    constructor
    · intro heq
      simpa [heq] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hy
    · intro hyQ
      have hQx : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = {x} := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          have hzU : z ∈ U := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x hz
          by_cases hzx : z = x
          · simp [hzx]
          · exact ((mem_rNonadjClass_iff.1 hz).2 (hpair hx hzU (fun h => hzx h.symm))).elim
        · intro hz
          simpa [mem_singleton.1 hz] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hx
      have : y = x := by
        have : y ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hQx] using hyQ
        exact mem_singleton.1 this
      subst this
      rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.hamilton_endpoints_of_card
statement:
lemma hamilton_endpoints_of_card (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (U : Finset V), U.card = n →
      2 ≤ U.card →
      IsCograph G U →
      (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected →
      pathCoverNumber G U = 1 →
      HamiltonEndpointsData (G := G) U
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    intro U hcard h2 hcog hconn hpU
    obtain ⟨A, B, hAU, hBU, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hcover, hAB, hAcard, hBcard⟩ :=
      exists_complete_join_on hcog hconn h2
    have hpAB : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 := by simpa [hcover] using hpU
    have hpA_le := pathCoverNumber_child_le_succ hAB hpAB
    have hpB_le :=
      pathCoverNumber_child_le_succ (isCompleteBetween_symm hAB)
        (by simpa [union_comm] using hpAB)
    by_cases hAcrit : pathCoverNumber G A = B.card + 1
    · have hA : IsCograph G A := hcog.subset hAU
      have hcert := critical_endpoints_of_join hAne hBne hAB hAcrit hA
      exact Or.inl (hcover ▸ hcert)
    · by_cases hBcrit : pathCoverNumber G B = A.card + 1
      · have hB : IsCograph G B := hcog.subset hBU
        have hcert :=
          critical_endpoints_of_join hBne hAne (isCompleteBetween_symm hAB)
            hBcrit hB
        exact Or.inl (by simpa [union_comm, hcover] using hcert)
      · have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card := by omega
        have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := by omega
        have hEAB :=
          eligibleSet_complete_join_balanced hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
        have hEall : eligibleSet G U = U := by simpa [hcover] using hEAB
        by_cases h3 : 3 ≤ U.card
        · have hcut : ∀ x ∈ U,
              componentCount G (U \ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x) =
                (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x).card := by
            intro x hx
            have hxE : Eligible G U x :=
              ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 (by simpa [hEall] using hx)).2
            set K := U.erase x
            have hKcard : K.card = U.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hx
            have hK2 : 2 ≤ K.card := by omega
            have hKlt : K.card < n := by omega
            have hKcog : IsCograph G K :=
              hcog.subset (erase_subset x U)
            have hpKle : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ pathCoverNumber G U :=
              pathCoverNumber_erase_le_of_eligible (G := G) hxE
            have hKne : K.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hK2)
            have hpKge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hKne
            have hpK : pathCoverNumber G K = 1 := by omega
            obtain ⟨pK, hpKsup⟩ :=
              exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hpK
            have hKconn := connected_of_spanning_path pK hpKsup
            have hKdata :=
              ih K.card hKlt K rfl hK2 hKcog hKconn hpK
            have hiff : ∀ y ∈ K,
                SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y ↔ Eligible G K y :=
              fun y hy =>
                extension_iff_of_IH (U := U) hx hy hKdata hpK hEall hpU
            have hQ : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = qxSet (G := G) U x :=
              rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_extension hx hiff
            have hKcog' : IsCograph G (U.erase x) := hKcog
            have hqx :=
              componentCount_sdiff_qxSet_eq (G := G) hx hKcog' hpK
            simpa [hQ] using hqx
          refine Or.inr ⟨hEall, hcut,
            class_coincidence_of_qx hEall hpU hcut⟩
        · have hcard2 : U.card = 2 := by omega
          exact Or.inr (balanced_endpoints_of_card_two hcog hconn hpU hcard2)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph
statement:
lemma hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph {U : Finset V}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ U.card)
    (hcog : IsCograph G U)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1) :
    HamiltonEndpointsData (G := G) U
proof:
:=
  hamilton_endpoints_of_card U.card U rfl h2 hcog hconn hpU

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph_canonical
statement:
lemma hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph_canonical {U : Finset V}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ U.card)
    (hcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G U)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1) :
    HamiltonEndpointsData (G := G) U
proof:
:=
  hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph h2 (isCograph_iff.2 hcog) hconn hpU

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanning_iff_distinct_classes_of_balanced
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hclass⟩ := h
  constructor
  · intro hR heq
    have hyQ : y ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x := by
      simpa [heq] using mem_rNonadjClass_self hy
    exact (mem_rNonadjClass_iff.1 hyQ).2 hR
  · intro hneQ
    by_contra hnot
    have hyQ : y ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x :=
      mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hy, hnot⟩
    exact hneQ ((hclass hx hy).2 hyQ)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.hamiltonian_cograph_port
statement:
lemma hamiltonian_cograph_port {U : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G U) (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) :
    eligibleSet G U = U ∧
      IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U ∧
        (∀ (x y : V), x ∈ U → y ∈ U → x ≠ y →
          (SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y ↔
            rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ≠ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y))
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 3 ≤ U.card := by
    simpa [hc] using c.three_le_card_support
  have h2 : 2 ≤ U.card := le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hadj⟩ := GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path c
  have hpUsup : p.support = U := hp.trans hc
  have hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1 :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p hpUsup
  have hconn := connected_of_spanning_path p hpUsup
  have hE : eligibleSet G U = U := eligibleSet_eq_of_cycle c hc
  have hdata :=
    hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph h2 hcog hconn hpU
  have hbal : IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U := by
    rcases hdata with hcrit | hbal
    · obtain ⟨A, B, hAne, hBne, hunion, hAB, hcritAB, _, hEeq, hFeq, _, _⟩ :=
        hcrit
      have hEU : eligibleSet G U = eligibleSet G A := by simpa [hunion] using hEeq
      have hF : ineligibleSet G U = B ∪ ineligibleSet G A := by
        simpa [hunion] using hFeq
      have hBne' : (ineligibleSet G U).Nonempty := by
        refine hBne.mono ?_
        intro z hz
        simpa [hF] using mem_union.2 (Or.inl hz)
      have : eligibleSet G U ≠ U := by
        intro hEq
        have : ineligibleSet G U = ∅ := by
          ext z
          constructor
          · intro hz
            have hzU : z ∈ U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hz
            have hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G U := by simpa [hEq] using hzU
            exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) U)
              hzE hz).elim
          · intro hz
            exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
        exact hBne'.ne_empty this
      exact (this hE).elim
    · exact hbal
  exact ⟨hE, hbal, fun (x y : V) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (_ : x ≠ y) =>
    spanning_iff_distinct_classes_of_balanced (x := x) (y := y) hbal hx hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.hamiltonian_cograph_port_canonical
statement:
lemma hamiltonian_cograph_port_canonical {U : Finset V}
    (hcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G U) (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) :
    eligibleSet G U = U ∧
      IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U ∧
        (∀ (x y : V), x ∈ U → y ∈ U → x ≠ y →
          (SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y ↔
            rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ≠ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y))
proof:
:=
  hamiltonian_cograph_port (isCograph_iff.2 hcog) c hc

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanningPath_of_distinct_classes
statement:
lemma spanningPath_of_distinct_classes {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (h : IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hne : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ≠ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hclass⟩ := h
  by_contra hnot
  have hyQ : y ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x :=
    mem_rNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hy, hnot⟩
  exact hne ((hclass hx hy).2 hyQ)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.partCut_of_balanced
statement:
lemma partCut_of_balanced {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (h : IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    componentCount G (U \ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x) =
      (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x).card
proof:
:=
  h.2.1 x hx

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.nodup_support
statement: private lemma nodup_support (p : GraphPath G) : p.walk.support.Nodup
proof:
:=
  (Walk.isPath_def _).1 p.isPath

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.path_support_card
statement:
private lemma path_support_card (p : GraphPath G) :
    p.support.card = p.walk.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [support, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup p.nodup_support, Walk.length_support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.not_nil_of_two_le_card
statement:
lemma not_nil_of_two_le_card (p : GraphPath G) (h : 2 ≤ p.support.card) :
    ¬ p.walk.Nil
proof:
:= by
  intro hn
  have hlen : p.walk.length = 0 := Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.2 hn
  have hcard : p.support.card = 1 := by rw [path_support_card p, hlen]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.support_eq_insert_start_tail
statement:
lemma support_eq_insert_start_tail (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.support = insert p.start (p.tail h).support
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v, walk, isPath⟩
  cases walk with
  | nil => exact (h Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons hadj q =>
    simp [tail, tailOfWalk, support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.start_not_mem_tail_support
statement:
lemma start_not_mem_tail_support (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    p.start ∉ (p.tail h).support
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v, walk, isPath⟩
  cases walk with
  | nil => exact (h Walk.nil_nil).elim
  | cons hadj q =>
    have hq : u ∉ q.support := ((Walk.cons_isPath_iff hadj q).1 isPath).2
    simpa [tail, tailOfWalk, support] using hq

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.disjoint_singleton_start_tail
statement:
lemma disjoint_singleton_start_tail (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    Disjoint (GraphPath.singleton (G := G) p.start).support (p.tail h).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_singleton, disjoint_singleton_left]
  exact start_not_mem_tail_support p h

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.tail_support_subset
statement:
lemma tail_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.tail h).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_eq_insert_start_tail p h]
  exact subset_insert _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.singleton_start_support_subset
statement:
lemma singleton_start_support_subset (p : GraphPath G) :
    (GraphPath.singleton (G := G) p.start).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [support_singleton, start_mem_support]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_support_iff_start_or_tail
statement:
lemma mem_support_iff_start_or_tail (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) {x : V} :
    x ∈ p.support ↔ x = p.start ∨ x ∈ (p.tail h).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_eq_insert_start_tail p h, mem_insert]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.nodup_paths
statement: lemma nodup_paths {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) : pc.paths.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Pairwise.imp ?_ pc.disjoint
  intro a b hdisj hab
  subst hab
  have : a.support ∩ a.support = ∅ := disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 hdisj
  simp only [inter_self] at this
  exact (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.1 a.support_nonempty) this

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem_refinement
statement:
lemma pairwise_disjoint_of_mem_refinement {l : List (GraphPath G)}
    (h : l.Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint a.support b.support)
    {a b : GraphPath G} (ha : a ∈ l) (hb : b ∈ l) (hne : a ≠ b) :
    Disjoint a.support b.support
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a b with
  | nil => cases ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h' := List.pairwise_cons.1 h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha' <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb'
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · exact h'.1 b hb'
    · exact (h'.1 a ha').symm
    · exact ih h'.2 ha' hb' hne

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_filter_add_not
statement:
lemma length_filter_add_not {α : Type*} (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
    (l.filter p).length + (l.filter fun x => !p x).length = l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases ha : p a
    · simp [ha]; omega
    · simp [ha]; omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.filter_eq_singleton_of_nodup
statement:
lemma filter_eq_singleton_of_nodup {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {a : α} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, a ∈ l → l.Nodup → l.filter (fun x => decide (x = a)) = [a]
proof:
| [], h, _ => by cases h
  | b :: l, h, hn => by
    have hn' := List.nodup_cons.1 hn
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | ha
    · have hnone : l.filter (fun x => decide (x = a)) = [] := by
        refine List.filter_eq_nil_iff.2 ?_
        intro x hx hxeq
        have : x = a := of_decide_eq_true hxeq
        exact hn'.1 (this ▸ hx)
      simp [hnone]
    · have hne : b ≠ a := fun hba => hn'.1 (hba ▸ ha)
      simp [hne, filter_eq_singleton_of_nodup ha hn'.2]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := length_filter_add_not (fun x : α => decide (x = a)) l
  have heq : l.filter (fun x => decide (x = a)) = [a] :=
    filter_eq_singleton_of_nodup ha hn
  have hne :
      l.filter (fun x => !decide (x = a)) =
        l.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ a)) := by
    apply List.filter_congr
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x = a <;> simp [hx]
  have hpos : 1 ≤ l.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.length_pos_of_mem ha)
  simp [heq, hne] at hsum
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.splitOne_card
proof:
:= by
  have hlen :=
    length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := p) (l := pc.paths) hp pc.nodup_paths
  have hfilter :
      pc.paths.filter (fun q => decide (q ≠ p)) =
        pc.paths.filter (fun q => !decide (q = p)) := by
    apply List.filter_congr
    intro q _
    by_cases hq : q = p <;> simp [hq]
  have hpos : 1 ≤ pc.paths.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.length_pos_of_mem hp)
  simp [splitOne, PathCover.card, List.length_append]
  rw [← hfilter, hlen]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.card_eq_of_all_singleton
statement:
lemma card_eq_of_all_singleton {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (h : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.support.card = 1) : pc.card = U.card
proof:
:= by
  let rec
    go : ∀ (l : List (GraphPath G)),
        l.Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.support b.support) →
        (∀ p ∈ l, p.support.card = 1) →
        ∀ (W : Finset V), (∀ x, x ∈ W ↔ ∃ p ∈ l, x ∈ p.support) →
          l.length = W.card
    | [], _, _, W, hW => by
      have : W = ∅ := by
        ext x
        simp [hW]
      simp [this]
    | p :: l, hdisj, hcard, W, hW => by
      have hdisj' := List.pairwise_cons.1 hdisj
      have hp1 : p.support.card = 1 :=
        hcard p (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
      let W' : Finset V := W \ p.support
      have hW' : ∀ x, x ∈ W' ↔ ∃ q ∈ l, x ∈ q.support := by
        intro x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          have hxW : x ∈ W := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
          have hxP : x ∉ p.support := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
          obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := (hW x).1 hxW
          rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hql
          · exact (hxP hxq).elim
          · exact ⟨q, hql, hxq⟩
        · intro ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
          have hxW : x ∈ W :=
            (hW x).2 ⟨q, List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hq), hxq⟩
          have hxP : x ∉ p.support := by
            intro hxp
            have : Disjoint p.support q.support := hdisj'.1 q hq
            exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 this hxp hxq
          exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxW, hxP⟩
      have hrest :=
        go l hdisj'.2 (fun q hq => hcard q (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hq))) W' hW'
      have hcover : W = p.support ∪ W' := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          by_cases hxp : x ∈ p.support
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxp)
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx, hxp⟩))
        · intro hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxp | hx'
          · exact (hW x).2 ⟨p, List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl), hxp⟩
          · exact (mem_sdiff.1 hx').1
      have hdisjW : Disjoint p.support W' := by
        rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
        exact inter_sdiff_self _ _
      have hWcard : W.card = p.support.card + W'.card := by
        rw [hcover, card_union_of_disjoint hdisjW]
      rw [List.length_cons, hWcard, hp1, hrest]
      omega
  simpa [PathCover.card] using go pc.paths pc.disjoint h U pc.mem_iff

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_two_le_support_of_card_lt
statement:
lemma exists_two_le_support_of_card_lt {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (h : pc.card < U.card) : ∃ p ∈ pc.paths, 2 ≤ p.support.card
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hall : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.support.card = 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have : ¬ 2 ≤ p.support.card := fun h2 => hnone ⟨p, hp, h2⟩
    have hlt : p.support.card < 2 := Nat.not_le.1 this
    have hpos : 1 ≤ p.support.card :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 p.support_nonempty)
    omega
  have := pc.card_eq_of_all_singleton hall
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_succ_of_card_lt
statement:
lemma exists_succ_of_card_lt {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (h : pc.card < U.card) : ∃ pc' : PathCover G U, pc'.card = pc.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h2⟩ := pc.exists_two_le_support_of_card_lt h
  exact ⟨pc.splitOne hp h2, pc.splitOne_card hp h2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_pathCover_card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc0, h0⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
  have hge : pc0.card ≤ n := by omega
  have : ∀ k, k ≤ n - pc0.card → ∃ pc : PathCover G U, pc.card = pc0.card + k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      exact ⟨pc0, by simp⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk)
      have hlt : pc.card < U.card := by omega
      obtain ⟨pc', hpc'⟩ := pc.exists_succ_of_card_lt hlt
      refine ⟨pc', ?_⟩
      omega
  have hn : pc0.card + (n - pc0.card) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hge
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := this (n - pc0.card) le_rfl
  exact ⟨pc, hpc.trans hn⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff_refinement
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff_refinement (U : Finset V) :
    pathCoverNumber G U = 0 ↔ U = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
    have hlen : pc.paths.length = 0 := by
      simpa [PathCover.card, h] using hpc
    have : pc.paths = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hlen
    ext x
    simp [pc.mem_iff, this]
  · intro h
    subst h
    exact pathCoverNumber_empty (G := G)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.three_le_card_of_mem_ineligible
proof:
:= by
  have hxU : x ∈ U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hx
  have hpos : 1 ≤ U.card := card_pos.2 ⟨x, hxU⟩
  by_contra hlt
  have hle : U.card ≤ 2 := by omega
  have h12 : U.card = 1 ∨ U.card = 2 := by omega
  rcases h12 with h1 | h2
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := card_eq_one.1 h1
    have hxy : x = y := mem_singleton.1 (hy ▸ hxU)
    subst hxy
    have hxF : x ∈ ineligibleSet G ({x} : Finset V) := by simpa [hy] using hx
    exact (notMem_empty x
      ((ineligibleSet_singleton (G := G) x) ▸ hxF)).elim
  · obtain ⟨p, hpU⟩ := exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hp
    have hE := Eligible_of_support_ends p hpU
    have hneSF : p.start ≠ p.finish := by
      intro heq
      have hnil : p.walk.Nil := (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).2 heq
      have hsing : p.support = {p.start} :=
        GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil
      have : U.card = 1 := by
        calc
          U.card = p.support.card := by rw [hpU]
          _ = ({p.start} : Finset V).card := by rw [hsing]
          _ = 1 := Finset.card_singleton _
      omega
    have hpair : p.support = {p.start, p.finish} :=
      support_eq_pair_of_card_two p hpU (by simpa [hpU] using h2) hneSF
    have hy : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish := by
      have : x ∈ ({p.start, p.finish} : Finset V) := by
        have : x ∈ p.support := by simpa [hpU] using hxU
        simpa [hpair] using this
      simpa [mem_insert, mem_singleton] using this
    have hEx : Eligible G U x := by
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · simpa [hpU] using hE.1
      · simpa [hpU] using hE.2
    exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hx |>.2 hEx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_oriented_spanning
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, p, hp, hends⟩ := hR
  rcases hends with ⟨hs, hf⟩ | ⟨hs, hf⟩
  · exact ⟨p, hp, hs, hf⟩
  · refine ⟨p.reverse, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hf
    · simpa [GraphPath.reverse] using hs

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.connected_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpU⟩ := exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hp
  exact connected_of_spanning_path p hpU

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.two_le_card_of_union_cycle
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 3 ≤ D.card := by simpa [hc] using c.three_le_card_support
  have : D ⊆ L ∪ D := subset_union_right
  exact le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3)
    (h3.trans (card_le_card this))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.one_le_pathCoverNumber_iff_nonempty
statement:
lemma one_le_pathCoverNumber_iff_nonempty (U : Finset V) :
    1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G U ↔ U.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hempty
    have : U = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
    have : pathCoverNumber G U = 0 := by
      simpa [this] using pathCoverNumber_empty (G := G)
    omega
  · exact one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.false_of_cycle_meets_nondominant_of_eq_one
statement:
lemma false_of_cycle_meets_nondominant_of_eq_one {L D X Y : Finset V} {h : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G)
    (hLD : Disjoint L D) (hc : c.support = D)
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = L ∪ D)
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hdom : Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X)
    (hXcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G X)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G L = pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D))
    (hp1 : pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) = 1)
    (hhF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G L)
    (hhE : h ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∪ D))
    (hDY : (D ∩ Y).Nonempty) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hdisjXY := disjoint_of_completeBetween hXY
  have hpX : pathCoverNumber G X =
      pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) + Y.card := by
    have := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hXne hYne hXY hdom
    have hJ : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) = pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) := by
      rw [hcover]
    omega
  let LX := L ∩ X
  let LY := L ∩ Y
  let DX := D ∩ X
  let DY := D ∩ Y
  have hXsplit : LX ∪ DX = X := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzL | hzD
      · exact (mem_inter.1 hzL).2
      · exact (mem_inter.1 hzD).2
    · intro hzX
      have hzJ : z ∈ L ∪ D := by
        rw [← hcover]
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzX)
      rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzL | hzD
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzX⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzD, hzX⟩))
  have hYsplit : LY ∪ DY = Y := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzL | hzD
      · exact (mem_inter.1 hzL).2
      · exact (mem_inter.1 hzD).2
    · intro hzY
      have hzJ : z ∈ L ∪ D := by
        rw [← hcover]
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzY)
      rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzL | hzD
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzY⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzD, hzY⟩))
  have hdisjLXDX : Disjoint LX DX :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left (inter_subset_left (s₂ := X))
      (disjoint_of_subset_right (inter_subset_left (s₂ := X)) hLD)
  have hdisjLYDY : Disjoint LY DY :=
    disjoint_of_subset_left (inter_subset_left (s₂ := Y))
      (disjoint_of_subset_right (inter_subset_left (s₂ := Y)) hLD)
  have hLXsdiff : LX = L \ LY := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_inter.1 hz).1, fun hzLY =>
        Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY (mem_inter.1 hz).2 (mem_inter.1 hzLY).2⟩
    · intro hz
      have hzL : z ∈ L := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hznotLY : z ∉ LY := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      have hzX : z ∈ X := by
        have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
          rw [hcover]
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
        rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
        · exact hzX
        · exact (hznotLY (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzY⟩)).elim
      exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzX⟩
  have hDXsdiff : DX = D \ DY := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(mem_inter.1 hz).1, fun hzDY =>
        Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY (mem_inter.1 hz).2 (mem_inter.1 hzDY).2⟩
    · intro hz
      have hzD : z ∈ D := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hznotDY : z ∉ DY := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      have hzX : z ∈ X := by
        have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
          rw [hcover]
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzD)
        rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
        · exact hzX
        · exact (hznotDY (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzD, hzY⟩)).elim
      exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hzD, hzX⟩
  have hpXle :=
    pathCoverNumber_union_le_of_disjoint (G := G) (A := LX) (B := DX) hdisjLXDX
  have hpXle' : pathCoverNumber G X ≤ pathCoverNumber G LX + pathCoverNumber G DX := by
    simpa [hXsplit] using hpXle
  have hLYsub : LY ⊆ L := inter_subset_left
  have hpLX : pathCoverNumber G LX ≤ pathCoverNumber G L + LY.card := by
    simpa [hLXsdiff] using pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le (G := G) L LY hLYsub
  have hDYsub : DY ⊆ D := inter_subset_left
  have hpDX : pathCoverNumber G DX ≤ DY.card := by
    have hdel :=
      pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_card_of_cycle (U := D) (A := DY) c hc hDYsub hDY
    simpa [hDXsdiff] using hdel
  have hYcard : Y.card = LY.card + DY.card := by
    have := card_union_of_disjoint hdisjLYDY
    simpa [hYsplit] using this
  have hpLXeq : pathCoverNumber G LX = pathCoverNumber G L + LY.card := by
    omega
  have hEjoin := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hXne hYne hXY hdom
  have hEJ : eligibleSet G (L ∪ D) = eligibleSet G X := by
    simpa [hcover] using hEjoin
  have hhX : h ∈ X := (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) X) (by
    have : h ∈ eligibleSet G X := by simpa [hEJ] using hhE
    exact this)
  have hhL : h ∈ L := (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) L) hhF
  have hhLX : h ∈ LX := mem_inter.2 ⟨hhL, hhX⟩
  obtain ⟨pcLX, hpcLX⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) LX
  obtain ⟨pcDX, hpcDX⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) DX
  let pcX := PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisjLXDX pcLX pcDX
  have hminX : pcX.card = pathCoverNumber G X := by
    have hsum := PathCover.unionDisjoint_card (G := G) hdisjLXDX pcLX pcDX
    have hpcX : pcX.card = pcLX.card + pcDX.card := hsum
    have heq : pathCoverNumber G LX + pathCoverNumber G DX = pathCoverNumber G X := by
      have hle := hpXle'
      omega
    omega
  have hErest :=
    eligibleSet_unionDisjoint_left hdisjLXDX (by simpa [hXsplit] using hXcog)
      pcLX pcDX (by simpa [hXsplit] using hminX)
  have hhELX : h ∈ eligibleSet G LX := by
    have hhEX : h ∈ eligibleSet G X := by simpa [hEJ] using hhE
    have hErest' : eligibleSet G LX = eligibleSet G X ∩ LX := by
      simpa [hXsplit] using hErest
    have : h ∈ eligibleSet G X ∩ LX := mem_inter.2 ⟨hhEX, hhLX⟩
    simpa [hErest'] using this
  by_cases hLYne : LY.Nonempty
  · have hLXne : LX.Nonempty := ⟨h, hhLX⟩
    have hLXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (LX : Set V) (LY : Set V) :=
      isCompleteBetween_mono hXY inter_subset_right inter_subset_right
    have hLXdom : LY.card < pathCoverNumber G LX := by omega
    have hEL := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hLXne hLYne hLXY hLXdom
    have hLsplit : LX ∪ LY = L := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzX | hzY
        · exact (mem_inter.1 hzX).1
        · exact (mem_inter.1 hzY).1
      · intro hzL
        have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
          rw [hcover]
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
        rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzX⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzY⟩))
    have : h ∈ eligibleSet G L := by
      have : eligibleSet G L = eligibleSet G LX := by simpa [hLsplit] using hEL
      simpa [this] using hhELX
    exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hhF |>.2
      ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this).2
  · have hLYempty : LY = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hLYne
    have hLeq : LX = L := by
      have : L ∩ Y = ∅ := hLYempty
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        exact (mem_inter.1 hz).1
      · intro hzL
        refine mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, ?_⟩
        have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
          rw [hcover]
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
        rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
        · exact hzX
        · have hzLY : z ∈ LY := mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzY⟩
          have : z ∈ (∅ : Finset V) := by simpa [hLYempty] using hzLY
          exact (notMem_empty z this).elim
    have : h ∈ eligibleSet G L := by simpa [hLeq] using hhELX
    exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hhF |>.2
      ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this).2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.connectedComponent_map_induceIncl_left
statement:
lemma connectedComponent_map_induceIncl_left {A B : Finset V} {a : V}
    (ha : a ∈ A) :
    ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨a, ha⟩).map
      (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A) (s₂ := B))) =
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨a, mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.connectedComponent_map_induceIncl_right
statement:
lemma connectedComponent_map_induceIncl_right {A B : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hb : b ∈ B) :
    ((G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hb⟩).map
      (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A) (s₂ := B))) =
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨b, mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb)⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_adj
statement:
lemma componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_adj {A B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    {a b : V} (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hadj : G.Adj a b) :
    componentCount G (A ∪ B) ≤ componentCount G A + componentCount G B - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := componentCount_union_le (G := G) A B
  let f : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
        (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent
    | .inl C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))
    | .inr C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A)))
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro C
    refine C.ind fun x => ?_
    rcases mem_union.mp x.property with hA | hB
    · refine ⟨.inl ((G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x.val, hA⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
    · refine ⟨.inr ((G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨x.val, hB⟩), ?_⟩
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound Reachable.rfl
  have hnotinj : ¬ Function.Injective f := by
    intro hinj
    let hCa := (G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨a, ha⟩
    let hCb := (G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hmap : f (.inl hCa) = f (.inr hCb) := by
      change hCa.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A))) =
        hCb.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A)))
      rw [connectedComponent_map_induceIncl_left ha,
        connectedComponent_map_induceIncl_right hb]
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound
        (Adj.reachable (by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj))
    have hsum : (Sum.inl hCa :
        (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
          (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) =
      Sum.inr hCb := hinj hmap
    exact Sum.inl_ne_inr hsum
  haveI : Fintype (A : Set V) := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (B : Set V) := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V) := inferInstance
  haveI : DecidableRel (G.induce (A : Set V)).Adj := inferInstance
  haveI : DecidableRel (G.induce (B : Set V)).Adj := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hlt :
      Fintype.card (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent <
        Fintype.card
          ((G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
            (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :=
    Fintype.card_lt_of_surjective_not_injective f hf hnotinj
  have hposA : 0 < componentCount G A := by
    simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.2
        ⟨(G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨a, ha⟩⟩
  have hposB : 0 < componentCount G B := by
    simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.2
        ⟨(G.induce (B : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
  have hsum :
      Fintype.card
        ((G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
          (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) =
        componentCount G A + componentCount G B := by
    simp [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_sum]
  have hlt' :
      componentCount G (A ∪ B) <
        Fintype.card
          ((G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
            (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) := by
    simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hlt
  have hlt'' :
      componentCount G (A ∪ B) < componentCount G A + componentCount G B := by
    simpa [hsum] using hlt'
  have hpos : 1 ≤ componentCount G A + componentCount G B := by omega
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.no_cross_of_componentCount_add
statement:
lemma no_cross_of_componentCount_add {A B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (heq : componentCount G (A ∪ B) = componentCount G A + componentCount G B) :
    ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hadj
  have hle' :=
    componentCount_union_le_sub_one_of_adj hdisj hAne hBne ha hb hadj
  have hpos : 0 < componentCount G A := by
    simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.2
        ⟨(G.induce (A : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨a, ha⟩⟩
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.traceable_release_of_critical
statement:
lemma traceable_release_of_critical {L D X Y : Finset V} {h u v : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G)
    (P : GraphPath G)
    (hLD : Disjoint L D) (hc : c.support = D)
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = L ∪ D)
    (hXne : X.Nonempty) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcrit : pathCoverNumber G X = Y.card + 1)
    (hJcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (L ∪ D))
    (hLcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G L)
    (hXcog : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G X)
    (hp : pathCoverNumber G L = pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D))
    (hpL : pathCoverNumber G L = 1)
    (hhF : h ∈ ineligibleSet G L)
    (hhE : h ∈ eligibleSet G (L ∪ D))
    (hP : P.support = L) (hs : P.start = u) (hf : P.finish = v) :
    (∃ Q : GraphPath G, Q.support = L ∪ D ∧ Q.start = h ∧ Q.finish = u) ∨
      (∃ Q : GraphPath G, Q.support = L ∪ D ∧ Q.start = h ∧ Q.finish = v)
proof:
:= by
  have hpJ : pathCoverNumber G (L ∪ D) = 1 := by omega
  have hdom : Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X := by omega
  have hdisjXY := disjoint_of_completeBetween hXY
  by_cases hDY : (D ∩ Y).Nonempty
  · exact (false_of_cycle_meets_nondominant_of_eq_one c hLD hc hcover
      hXne hYne hXY hdom hXcog hp hpJ hhF hhE hDY).elim
  · have hDYempty : D ∩ Y = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hDY
    have hDX : D ⊆ X := by
      intro z hz
      have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
        rw [hcover]
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hz)
      rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
      · exact hzX
      · have : z ∈ D ∩ Y := mem_inter.2 ⟨hz, hzY⟩
        exact (notMem_empty z (by simpa [hDYempty] using this)).elim
    obtain ⟨hXeq, hYsub, hdisjLXY⟩ :=
      union_inter_eq_of_cycle_subset_left hcover hLD hdisjXY hDX
    let LX := L ∩ X
    have hXeq' : LX ∪ D = X := by
      simpa [LX] using hXeq
    have hdisjLXD : Disjoint LX D :=
      disjoint_of_subset_left inter_subset_left hLD
    have hLXcan : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G LX :=
      isCograph_canonical_subset hLcog inter_subset_left
    have hpD : pathCoverNumber G D = 1 := pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_cycle c hc
    have hpXadd : pathCoverNumber G X = 1 + Y.card := by
      have hadd := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hXne hYne hXY hdom
      have hJeq : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) = 1 := by simpa [hcover] using hpJ
      omega
    have hpXle : pathCoverNumber G X ≤ pathCoverNumber G LX + 1 := by
      have hle : pathCoverNumber G (LX ∪ D) ≤
          pathCoverNumber G LX + pathCoverNumber G D :=
        pathCoverNumber_union_le_of_disjoint hdisjLXD
      have hle' : pathCoverNumber G (LX ∪ D) ≤ pathCoverNumber G LX + 1 := by
        simpa [hpD] using hle
      simpa [hXeq'] using hle'
    have hpLXge : Y.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G LX := by omega
    have hpLXle : pathCoverNumber G LX ≤ Y.card + 1 := by
      have hLsplit : LX ∪ Y = L := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzX | hzY
          · exact (mem_inter.1 hzX).1
          · exact hYsub hzY
        · intro hzL
          have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
            rw [hcover]
            exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
          rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzX⟩))
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzY)
      have hLXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (LX : Set V) (Y : Set V) :=
        isCompleteBetween_mono (A := X) (A' := LX) (B := Y) (B' := Y)
          hXY inter_subset_right (fun _ hy => hy)
      have hge := pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub (A := LX) (B := Y) hLXY
      have : pathCoverNumber G (LX ∪ Y) = 1 := by simpa [hLsplit] using hpL
      omega
    have hpLXeq : pathCoverNumber G LX = Y.card + 1 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hpLXr : pathCoverNumber G LX = Y.card := by omega
      have hLXne : LX.Nonempty := by
        by_contra hempty
        have hLXempty : LX = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hempty
        have hpempty : pathCoverNumber G (∅ : Finset V) = 0 :=
          pathCoverNumber_empty (G := G)
        have hY0 : Y.card = 0 := by
          have this := hpLXr
          rw [hLXempty, hpempty] at this
          exact this.symm
        exact hYne.ne_empty (card_eq_zero.1 hY0)
      have hLsplit : LX ∪ Y = L := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzX | hzY
          · exact (mem_inter.1 hzX).1
          · exact hYsub hzY
        · intro hzL
          have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
            rw [hcover]
            exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
          rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzX⟩))
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzY)
      have hLXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (LX : Set V) (Y : Set V) :=
        isCompleteBetween_mono (A := X) (A' := LX) (B := Y) (B' := Y)
          hXY inter_subset_right (fun _ hy => hy)
      have hpYle : pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ LX.card := by
        have hpYcard := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) Y
        have hpLXcard := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) LX
        have : Y.card ≤ LX.card := by
          have : pathCoverNumber G LX ≤ LX.card := hpLXcard
          omega
        exact hpYcard.trans this
      have hEL :=
        eligibleSet_complete_join_balanced hLXne hYne hLXY
          (by omega : pathCoverNumber G LX ≤ Y.card) hpYle
      have : h ∈ eligibleSet G L := by
        have hhL : h ∈ L := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) L hhF
        have : eligibleSet G L = L := by simpa [hLsplit] using hEL
        simpa [this] using hhL
      exact (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 hhF |>.2
        ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this).2
    have hLXne : LX.Nonempty :=
      (one_le_pathCoverNumber_iff_nonempty (G := G) LX).1 (by omega)
    have hLsplit : LX ∪ Y = L := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzX | hzY
        · exact (mem_inter.1 hzX).1
        · exact hYsub hzY
      · intro hzL
        have hzJ : z ∈ X ∪ Y := by
          rw [hcover]
          exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzL)
        rcases mem_union.1 hzJ with hzX | hzY
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzL, hzX⟩))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzY)
    have hLXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (LX : Set V) (Y : Set V) :=
      isCompleteBetween_mono (A := X) (A' := LX) (B := Y) (B' := Y)
        hXY inter_subset_right (fun _ hy => hy)
    have hune : u ≠ v := by
      intro heq
      have hnil : P.walk.Nil :=
        (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish P).2 (by simp [hs, hf, heq])
      have hsing : P.support = {P.start} :=
        GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil P hnil
      have hLcard : L.card = 1 := by
        calc
          L.card = P.support.card := by rw [hP]
          _ = ({P.start} : Finset V).card := by rw [hsing]
          _ = 1 := by rw [hs, Finset.card_singleton]
      have : 3 ≤ L.card := three_le_card_of_mem_ineligible hhF hpL
      omega
    have hRL : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) L u v :=
      ⟨hune, P, hP, Or.inl ⟨hs, hf⟩⟩
    have hDuv : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) LX u v :=
      (SpanningPathCompatible_critical_iff hLXne hYne hLXY hpLXeq).1
        (by simpa [hLsplit] using hRL)
    have hFjoin := ineligibleSet_complete_join_critical hLXne hYne hLXY hpLXeq
    have hEjoinL := eligibleSet_complete_join_critical hLXne hYne hLXY hpLXeq
    have hhFLX : h ∈ ineligibleSet G LX := by
      have hhL : h ∈ L := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) L hhF
      have : h ∈ Y ∪ ineligibleSet G LX := by
        have : ineligibleSet G L = Y ∪ ineligibleSet G LX := by
          simpa [hLsplit] using hFjoin
        simpa [this] using hhF
      rcases mem_union.1 this with hhY | hhX
      · have hEJ := eligibleSet_complete_join_critical hXne hYne hXY hcrit
        have hhX' : h ∈ X := by
          have : eligibleSet G (L ∪ D) = eligibleSet G X := by
            simpa [hcover] using hEJ
          exact eligibleSet_subset (G := G) X (by simpa [this] using hhE)
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY hhX' hhY).elim
      · exact hhX
    have hhEX : h ∈ eligibleSet G X := by
      have hEJ := eligibleSet_complete_join_critical hXne hYne hXY hcrit
      have : eligibleSet G (L ∪ D) = eligibleSet G X := by
        simpa [hcover] using hEJ
      simpa [this] using hhE
    have hpLXpX : pathCoverNumber G LX = pathCoverNumber G (LX ∪ D) := by
      rw [hXeq']; omega
    have hXcan' : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (LX ∪ D) := by
      rw [hXeq']; exact hXcog
    have hhEX' : h ∈ eligibleSet G (LX ∪ D) := by
      rw [hXeq']; exact hhEX
    have hrel :=
      distinct_release (L := LX) (D := D) (h := h) (u := u) (v := v)
        c hdisjLXD hc hXcan' hLXcan hpLXpX hhFLX hhEX' hDuv
    have hiff_hu :=
      SpanningPathCompatible_critical_iff (x := h) (y := u) hXne hYne hXY hcrit
    have hiff_hv :=
      SpanningPathCompatible_critical_iff (x := h) (y := v) hXne hYne hXY hcrit
    rcases hrel with hhu | hhv
    · have hhuX : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) X h u := by
        simpa [hXeq'] using hhu
      have hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (X ∪ Y) h u := hiff_hu.2 hhuX
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hsQ, hfQ⟩ := exists_oriented_spanning hR
      refine Or.inl ⟨Q, ?_, hsQ, hfQ⟩
      simpa [hcover] using hQ
    · have hhvX : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) X h v := by
        simpa [hXeq'] using hhv
      have hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (X ∪ Y) h v := hiff_hv.2 hhvX
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hsQ, hfQ⟩ := exists_oriented_spanning hR
      refine Or.inr ⟨Q, ?_, hsQ, hfQ⟩
      simpa [hcover] using hQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_union_sdiff_eq
statement:
lemma mem_union_sdiff_eq {L D P : Finset V} :
    (L ∪ D) \ P = (L \ P) ∪ (D \ P)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
  tauto

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_eligibleSet_eq
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_eligibleSet_eq {U : Finset V}
    (h : eligibleSet G U = U) : ineligibleSet G U = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzU : z ∈ U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hz
    have hzE : z ∈ eligibleSet G U := by simpa [h] using hzU
    exact (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) U)
      hzE hz).elim
  · intro hz
    exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_supportUnion_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [supportUnion]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hpw := List.pairwise_cons.1 h
    have hfold : supportUnion (p :: ps) = p.support ∪ supportUnion ps := by
      simp [supportUnion]
    have hd : Disjoint p.support (supportUnion ps) := by
      rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ :=
          (mem_supportUnion_iff (l := ps) (x := x)).1 (mem_inter.1 hx).2
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hpw.1 q hq) (mem_inter.1 hx).1 hxq).elim
      · intro hx
        exact (notMem_empty x hx).elim
    rw [hfold, card_union_of_disjoint hd, ih hpw.2, List.map_cons]
    simp [List.sum_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_eq_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_eq_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card {U : Finset V}
    (h : pathCoverNumber G U = U.card) : eligibleSet G U = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact eligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hx
  · intro hxU
    obtain ⟨pc, hpc⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) U
    have hlen : pc.card = U.card := by simpa [h] using hpc
    have hnodStarts : (pc.paths.map (fun q => q.start)).Nodup := by
