        profileDelta (G := G) U A
proof:
:=
  profileContainer_attains hA (isCograph_iff.2 hK) hKne

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.profile_maximizer_subset_container
statement:
lemma profile_maximizer_subset_container {U A T : Finset V}
    (hAT : A ⊆ T) (hTU : T ⊆ U) (_hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hatt :
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) :
    T ⊆ profileContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : U \ T = (U \ A) \ (T \ A) := sdiff_eq_nested_sdiff hAT hTU
  have hXsub : T \ A ⊆ U \ A := sdiff_subset_sdiff hTU (subset_refl _)
  have hcard := card_eq_add_sdiff hAT
  have hcle := componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G) (U \ A) (T \ A) hXsub
  have heqNat :
      componentCount G ((U \ A) \ (T \ A)) =
        pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) + (T \ A).card := by
    simp only [profileDelta, hEq] at hatt
    omega
  have hXinc :=
    eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible (G := G) (U := U \ A) (X := T \ A)
      hXsub heqNat
  intro x hxT
  by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
  · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA)
  · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (hXinc (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxT, hxA⟩)))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.profile_maximizer_subset_container_of_canonical
statement:
lemma profile_maximizer_subset_container_of_canonical {U A T : Finset V}
    (hAT : A ⊆ T) (hTU : T ⊆ U) (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hatt :
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) :
    T ⊆ profileContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:=
  profile_maximizer_subset_container hAT hTU (isCograph_iff.2 hK) hatt

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.profile_scattering_maximum
statement:
lemma profile_scattering_maximum {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A)) (hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty) :
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) ≤
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    ((componentCount G (U \ profileContainer (G := G) U A) : ℤ) -
      ((profileContainer (G := G) U A).card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T ⊆ profileContainer (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T.card ≤ (profileContainer (G := G) U A).card)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, profileContainer_attains hA hK hKne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro T hAT hTU
    exact profileDelta_le_of_nested hAT hTU
  · intro T hAT hTU hatt
    exact profile_maximizer_subset_container hAT hTU hK hatt
  · intro T hAT hTU hatt
    exact card_le_card
      (profile_maximizer_subset_container hAT hTU hK hatt)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.profile_scattering_maximum_of_canonical
statement:
lemma profile_scattering_maximum_of_canonical {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty) :
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) ≤
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    ((componentCount G (U \ profileContainer (G := G) U A) : ℤ) -
      ((profileContainer (G := G) U A).card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T ⊆ profileContainer (G := G) U A) ∧
    (∀ T, A ⊆ T → T ⊆ U →
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
          profileDelta (G := G) U A →
        T.card ≤ (profileContainer (G := G) U A).card)
proof:
:=
  profile_scattering_maximum hA (isCograph_iff.2 hK) hKne

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.endpoint_mem_support
statement:
lemma endpoint_mem_support {p : GraphPath G} {x : V}
    (hx : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish) : x ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · rw [hx]; exact p.start_mem_support
  · rw [hx]; exact p.finish_mem_support

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_third_path
statement:
lemma exists_third_path {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths)
    (hne : p ≠ q) (h3 : 3 ≤ pc.card) :
    ∃ r, r ∈ pc.paths ∧ r ≠ p ∧ r ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  have hlen :=
    PathCover.length_filter_ne_two (a := p) (b := q) hp hq hne pc.nodup_paths
  have hpos :
      0 < ((pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p)).filter
        fun x => decide (x ≠ q)).length := by
    have : 3 ≤ pc.paths.length := by simpa [PathCover.card] using h3
    omega
  rw [List.length_pos_iff_exists_mem] at hpos
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hpos
  have hr1 := List.mem_filter.1 hr
  have hr0 := List.mem_filter.1 hr1.1
  exact ⟨r, hr0.1, of_decide_eq_true hr0.2, of_decide_eq_true hr1.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_deleteVertex_keepDistinct
statement:
lemma exists_deleteVertex_keepDistinct {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) {x y f : V} {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hx : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish)
    (hy : y = q.start ∨ y = q.finish)
    (hxf : x ≠ f) (hyf : y ≠ f) :
    ∃ p' q', p' ∈ (pc.deleteVertex f).paths ∧ q' ∈ (pc.deleteVertex f).paths ∧
      p' ≠ q' ∧ (x = p'.start ∨ x = p'.finish) ∧
        (y = q'.start ∨ y = q'.finish)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p', hp', hxp'⟩ := GraphPath.exists_mem_deleteVertex_endpoint p hx hxf
  obtain ⟨q', hq', hyq'⟩ := GraphPath.exists_mem_deleteVertex_endpoint q hy hyf
  refine ⟨p', q', List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩,
    List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩, ?_, hxp', hyq'⟩
  intro heq
  have hps : p'.support ⊆ p.support :=
    GraphPath.support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex hp'
  have hxsup : x ∈ p'.support := endpoint_mem_support hxp'
  have hysup : y ∈ q'.support := endpoint_mem_support hyq'
  have hyP : y ∈ p.support := by
    have : y ∈ p'.support := by rwa [heq]
    exact hps this
  have hyQ : y ∈ q.support := endpoint_mem_support hy
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
    (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne) hyP hyQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_deleteFinset_keepDistinct
statement:
lemma exists_deleteFinset_keepDistinct {U S : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hS : S ⊆ U) {x y : V} {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hx : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish)
    (hy : y = q.start ∨ y = q.finish)
    (hxS : x ∉ S) (hyS : y ∉ S) :
    ∃ (pc' : PathCover G (U \ S)) (p' q' : GraphPath G),
      pc'.card ≤ pc.card + S.card ∧
        p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ q' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p' ≠ q' ∧
          (x = p'.start ∨ x = p'.finish) ∧
            (y = q'.start ∨ y = q'.finish)
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction generalizing U pc p q with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨pc.cast (by simp), p, q, ?_, ?_, ?_, hne, hx, hy⟩
    · simp [PathCover.cast_card]
    · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hp
    · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hq
  | insert b S hb ih =>
    have hbU : b ∈ U := hS (mem_insert_self b S)
    have hSsub : S ⊆ U.erase b := by
      intro z hz
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hzb => hb (hzb ▸ hz), hS (mem_insert_of_mem hz)⟩
    have hxb : x ≠ b := fun h => hxS (by simp [h])
    have hyb : y ≠ b := fun h => hyS (by simp [h])
    obtain ⟨p1, q1, hp1, hq1, hne1, hx1, hy1⟩ :=
      exists_deleteVertex_keepDistinct pc hp hq hne hx hy hxb hyb
    have hxS' : x ∉ S := fun h => hxS (mem_insert_of_mem h)
    have hyS' : y ∉ S := fun h => hyS (mem_insert_of_mem h)
    obtain ⟨pc1, p2, q2, hcard1, hp2, hq2, hne2, hx2, hy2⟩ :=
      ih (U := U.erase b) (pc.deleteVertex b) hSsub hp1 hq1 hne1 hx1 hy1 hxS' hyS'
    have hEq : U.erase b \ S = U \ insert b S := by
      rw [sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_comm]
    refine ⟨pc1.cast hEq, p2, q2, ?_, ?_, ?_, hne2, hx2, hy2⟩
    · have hdv := pc.card_deleteVertex_le b
      have hcard := card_insert_of_notMem (s := S) hb
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      omega
    · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hp2
    · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hq2

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_of_dominant
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_of_dominant {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, pcU, hU, p, hp, q, hq, hpq, hx, hy⟩ := hD
  have hxE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x := ⟨pcU, hU, p, hp, hx⟩
  have hyE : Eligible G (A ∪ B) y := ⟨pcU, hU, q, hq, hy⟩
  have hxA := eligible_mem_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hxE
  have hyA := eligible_mem_left_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom hyE
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hxB : x ∉ B := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA h
  have hyB : y ∉ B := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyA h
  obtain ⟨pc1, p', q', hcard1, hp', hq', hne', hx', hy'⟩ :=
    exists_deleteFinset_keepDistinct (U := A ∪ B) (S := B)
      pcU subset_union_right hp hq hpq hx hy hxB hyB
  have hEq : (A ∪ B) \ B = A := union_sdiff_eq_left_of_disjoint hdisj
  let pcA : PathCover G A := pc1.cast hEq
  have hsat := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  have hmin : pcA.card = pathCoverNumber G A := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pcA
    have hcard : pcA.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G A := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]; omega
    omega
  refine ⟨hne, pcA, hmin, p', ?_, q', ?_, hne', hx', hy'⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hp'
  · rw [PathCover.cast_paths]; exact hq'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_orientStart_marked_keepOther
statement:
lemma exists_orientStart_marked_keepOther {A U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) {p q : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (hx : x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish)
    (hy : y = q.start ∨ y = q.finish)
    (hend : ∀ s ∈ pc.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A) :
    ∃ (pc' : PathCover G U) (p' q' : GraphPath G),
      pc'.card = pc.card ∧
        p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ q' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p' ≠ q' ∧
          p'.start = x ∧ (y = q'.start ∨ y = q'.finish) ∧
            (∀ s ∈ pc'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : x = p.start
  · exact ⟨pc, p, q, rfl, hp, hq, hne, hs.symm, hy, hend⟩
  · have hf : x = p.finish := hx.resolve_left hs
    let r := p.reverse
    have hr : r.support = p.support := GraphPath.support_reverse p
    have hrne : r ≠ q := by
      intro heq
      have hxsup : x ∈ p.support := endpoint_mem_support hx
      have hxq : x ∈ q.support := by
        have : x ∈ r.support := by rwa [hr]
        rwa [heq] at this
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
        (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne) hxsup hxq
    have hq' : q ∈ (pc.replacePath_sat hp r hr).paths := by
      refine List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, ?_⟩))
      exact decide_eq_true hne.symm
    refine ⟨pc.replacePath_sat hp r hr, r, q,
      pc.replacePath_sat_card hp r hr,
      pc.replacePath_sat_self_mem hp r hr, hq', hrne, ?_, hy, ?_⟩
    · simp [r, PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse, hf]
    · intro s hs'
      rcases pc.replacePath_sat_mem_paths hp r hr hs' with hsr | ⟨hspc, _⟩
      · subst hsr
        rw [PathCover.GraphPath.start_reverse, PathCover.GraphPath.finish_reverse]
        exact ⟨(hend p hp).2, (hend p hp).1⟩
      · exact hend s hspc

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_marked_splice_two_through_avoid
statement:
lemma exists_marked_splice_two_through_avoid {A B U : Finset V} {b x y : V}
    {p qy : GraphPath G}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hqy : qy ∈ pc.paths)
    (hne : p ≠ qy) (hstart : p.start = x)
    (hy : y = qy.start ∨ y = qy.finish)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ s ∈ pc.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A)
    (hb : b ∈ B) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ (pc' : PathCover G (insert b U)) (p' qy' : GraphPath G),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ qy' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p' ≠ qy' ∧
          p'.start = x ∧ (y = qy'.start ∨ y = qy'.finish) ∧
            (∀ s ∈ pc'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrp, hrq⟩ := exists_third_path pc hp hqy hne h3
  have hpb : b ∉ p.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hrb : b ∉ r.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hr h)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hss, hsf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAB p b r (hend p hp).2 hb (hend r hr).1 hpb hrb
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hr hrp.symm)
  have hqyKeep : qy ∈
      (pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hr hrp.symm b hbU s hs).paths := by
    refine List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl ?_)
    exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hqy, decide_eq_true hne.symm⟩,
      decide_eq_true hrq.symm⟩
  have hsne : s ≠ qy := by
    intro heq
    have hbq : b ∈ qy.support := by
      have : b ∈ s.support := by
        rw [hs]
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton_self b))))
      rwa [heq] at this
    exact hbU (pc.support_subset hqy hbq)
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hr hrp.symm b hbU s hs, s, qy,
    pc.spliceTwoInsert_card hp hr hrp.symm b hbU s hs,
    List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.2 rfl)),
    hqyKeep, hsne, hss.trans hstart, hy, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  rcases pc.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths hp hr hrp.symm b hbU s hs ht with hts | ⟨htpc, _, _⟩
  · subst hts
    rw [hss, hsf]
    exact ⟨(hend p hp).1, (hend r hr).2⟩
  · exact hend t htpc

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant_twoMarked
statement:
lemma exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant_twoMarked {A B : Finset V}
    {x y : V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y) :
    ∃ (pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B)) (p q : GraphPath G),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card ∧
        p ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ∈ pc.paths ∧ p ≠ q ∧
          (x = p.start ∨ x = p.finish) ∧
            (y = q.start ∨ y = q.finish)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, pc0, h0, p0, hp0, q0, hq0, hpq0, hxend, hyend⟩ := hD
  have hend0 : ∀ s ∈ pc0.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A := by
    intro s hs
    exact ⟨pc0.support_subset hs s.start_mem_support,
      pc0.support_subset hs s.finish_mem_support⟩
  obtain ⟨pc0o, p0o, q0o, hcard0o, hp0o, hq0o, hne0o, hstart0, hy0, hend0o⟩ :=
    exists_orientStart_marked_keepOther (A := A) pc0 hp0 hq0 hpq0 hxend hyend hend0
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (pc : PathCover G (A ∪ S))
        (p qy : GraphPath G),
        S ⊆ B → (B \ S).card = k →
          pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - S.card →
            p ∈ pc.paths → qy ∈ pc.paths → p ≠ qy →
              p.start = x → (y = qy.start ∨ y = qy.finish) →
                (∀ s ∈ pc.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A) →
                  ∃ (pc' : PathCover G (A ∪ B)) (p' q' : GraphPath G),
                    pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card ∧
                      p' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ q' ∈ pc'.paths ∧ p' ≠ q' ∧
                        (x = p'.start ∨ x = p'.finish) ∧
                          (y = q'.start ∨ y = q'.finish) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro S pc p qy hS hk hcard hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' hend
      have hBS : B \ S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hk
      have hBeq : S = B :=
        subset_antisymm hS (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mp hBS)
      subst hBeq
      exact ⟨pc, p, qy, hcard, hp, hqy, hne, Or.inl pqstart.symm, hyend'⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro S pc p qy hS hk hcard hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' hend
      have hneS : (B \ S).Nonempty :=
        card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (B \ S).card)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hneS
      have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
      have hbS : b ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      have hdisjAB := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
      have hbU : b ∉ A ∪ S := by
        intro h
        rcases mem_union.1 h with hA | hS'
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB hA hbB
        · exact hbS hS'
      have hsum : S.card + (B \ S).card = B.card := by
        rw [← card_union_of_disjoint, union_sdiff_of_subset hS]
        exact disjoint_sdiff
      have h3 : 3 ≤ pc.card := by omega
      obtain ⟨pc1, p1, q1, hcard1, hp1, hq1, hne1, hstart1, hy1, hend1⟩ :=
        exists_marked_splice_two_through_avoid (x := x) (y := y) (p := p)
          (qy := qy) hAB pc hp hqy hne pqstart hyend' h3 hend hbB hbU
      have hU : insert b (A ∪ S) = A ∪ insert b S := by
        ext z
        simp [mem_insert, mem_union]
      let pc1' : PathCover G (A ∪ insert b S) := pc1.cast hU
      have hS' : insert b S ⊆ B := insert_subset hbB hS
      have hrem : B \ insert b S = (B \ S).erase b := sdiff_insert B S b
      have hk' : (B \ insert b S).card = k := by
        rw [hrem, card_erase_of_mem hb, hk]
        omega
      have hcard' : pc1'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (insert b S).card := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard1, hcard, card_insert_of_notMem hbS]
        omega
      have hp1' : p1 ∈ pc1'.paths := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU]; exact hp1
      have hq1' : q1 ∈ pc1'.paths := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU]; exact hq1
      have hend1' : ∀ s ∈ pc1'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A := by
        intro s hs
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU] at hs
        exact hend1 s hs
      exact ih (insert b S) pc1' p1 q1 hS' hk' hcard' hp1' hq1' hne1
        hstart1 hy1 hend1'
  have hA : A ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = A := union_empty A
  let pc0' : PathCover G (A ∪ ∅) := pc0o.cast hA.symm
  have hcard0 : pc0'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (∅ : Finset V).card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard0o, h0, card_empty, Nat.sub_zero]
  have hp0' : p0o ∈ pc0'.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm]; exact hp0o
  have hq0' : q0o ∈ pc0'.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm]; exact hq0o
  have hend0' : ∀ s ∈ pc0'.paths, s.start ∈ A ∧ s.finish ∈ A := by
    intro s hs
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0o hA.symm] at hs
    exact hend0o s hs
  exact aux B.card ∅ pc0' p0o q0o (empty_subset B) (by simp) hcard0
    hp0' hq0' hne0o hstart0 hy0 hend0'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_of_dominant_left
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_of_dominant_left {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B))
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by
    have h := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
    omega
  obtain ⟨pc, p, q, hpc, hp, hqP, hne, hx, hy⟩ :=
    exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant_twoMarked hAB hdom hq' hD
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    have hj := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
    omega
  exact ⟨hD.1, pc, hmin, p, hp, q, hqP, hne, hx, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff {A B : Finset V}
    {x y : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A)
    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B)) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y ↔
      DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨DistinctPathCompatible_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom,
    DistinctPathCompatible_of_dominant_left hAne hBne hAB hdom hq⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.distinctPathGraph_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma distinctPathGraph_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V}

    (hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B)) :

proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  exact DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
    hAne hBne hAB hdom hq

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_union_left
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_union_left {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, pcA, hA, p, hp, q, hq, hpq, hx, hy⟩ := hD
  obtain ⟨pcB, hB⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) B
  let pc := PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcA pcB
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    rw [PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisj, hA, hB,
      pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross]
  refine ⟨hne, pc, hmin, p, List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hp),
    q, List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hq), hpq, hx, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_union_right
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_union_right {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}

    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) B x y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, pcB, hB, p, hp, q, hq, hpq, hx, hy⟩ := hD
  obtain ⟨pcA, hA⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) A
  let pc := PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcA pcB
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    rw [PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisj, hA, hB,
      pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross]
  refine ⟨hne, pc, hmin, p, List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hp),
    q, List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hq), hpq, hx, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_union_cross
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_union_cross {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hx : Eligible G A x) (hy : Eligible G B y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hxA : x ∈ A := Eligible.mem (G := G) hx
  have hyB : y ∈ B := Eligible.mem (G := G) hy
  have hne : x ≠ y := fun hxy =>
    Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA (hxy ▸ hyB)
  obtain ⟨pcA, hA, p, hp, hxend⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨pcB, hB, q, hq, hyend⟩ := hy
  have hpq : p ≠ q := by
    intro heq
    have hxP : x ∈ p.support := endpoint_mem_support hxend
    have hyQ : y ∈ q.support := endpoint_mem_support hyend
    have hxA : x ∈ A := pcA.support_subset hp hxP
    have hyB : y ∈ B := pcB.support_subset hq hyQ
    have : x ∈ q.support := by rwa [heq] at hxP
    have hxB : x ∈ B := pcB.support_subset hq this
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA hxB
  let pc := PathCover.unionDisjoint hdisj pcA pcB
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    rw [PathCover.unionDisjoint_card hdisj, hA, hB,
      pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross]
  exact ⟨hne, pc, hmin, p, List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hp),
    q, List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hq), hpq, hxend, hyend⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible_union_of_left
statement:
lemma DistinctPathCompatible_union_of_left {A B : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hxA : x ∈ A) (hyA : y ∈ A)
    (hD : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) x y) :
    DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, pc, hpc, p, hp, q, hq, hpq, hx, hy⟩ := hD
  have hminA := splitLeft_card_eq_of_min hdisj hnocross pc hpc
  have hpL : p ∈ (PathCover.splitLeft hdisj hnocross pc).paths := by
    have hstartA : p.start ∈ A := by
      have hsupp : p.support ⊆ A ∪ B := pc.support_subset hp
      have hxP : x ∈ p.support := endpoint_mem_support hx
      have : p.support ⊆ A := by
        have hstartAB : p.start ∈ A ∨ p.start ∈ B := by
          simpa [mem_union] using hsupp p.start_mem_support
        rcases hstartAB with hA | hB
        · exact GraphPath.support_subset_of_no_cross hnocross p hA hsupp
        · have hBsup := GraphPath.support_subset_of_no_cross' hnocross p hB hsupp
          exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA (hBsup hxP)).elim
      exact this p.start_mem_support
    exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, decide_eq_true hstartA⟩
  have hqL : q ∈ (PathCover.splitLeft hdisj hnocross pc).paths := by
    have hstartA : q.start ∈ A := by
      have hsupp : q.support ⊆ A ∪ B := pc.support_subset hq
      have hyQ : y ∈ q.support := endpoint_mem_support hy
      have : q.support ⊆ A := by
        have hstartAB : q.start ∈ A ∨ q.start ∈ B := by
          simpa [mem_union] using hsupp q.start_mem_support
        rcases hstartAB with hA | hB
        · exact GraphPath.support_subset_of_no_cross hnocross q hA hsupp
        · have hBsup := GraphPath.support_subset_of_no_cross' hnocross q hB hsupp
          exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyA (hBsup hyQ)).elim
      exact this q.start_mem_support
    exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, decide_eq_true hstartA⟩
  exact ⟨hne, PathCover.splitLeft hdisj hnocross pc, hminA, p, hpL, q, hqL,
    hpq, hx, hy⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.DistinctPathCompatible.symm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, pc, hpc, p, hp, q, hq, hpq, hx, hy⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hne.symm, pc, hpc, q, hq, p, hp, hpq.symm, hy, hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_DistinctPathCompatible_of_le_one
proof:
:= by
  intro hD
  have hadj : (distinctPathGraph (G := G) U).Adj x y := hD
  have hbot := distinctPathGraph_eq_bot_of_pathCoverNumber_le_one (G := G) h
  rw [hbot] at hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_mem_of_mem_eligibleSet

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_DistinctPathCompatible_trans_of_cotreeOn
statement:
lemma not_DistinctPathCompatible_trans_of_cotreeOn {U : Finset V}
    (hU : CotreeOn G U) {x y z : V}
    (hx : x ∈ eligibleSet G U) (hy : y ∈ eligibleSet G U)
    (hz : z ∈ eligibleSet G U)
    (hxy : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) U x y)
    (hyz : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) U y z) :
    ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) U x z
proof:
:= by
  induction hU generalizing x y z with
  | empty =>
    exact (notMem_empty x ((eligibleSet_subset (G := G) ∅) hx)).elim
  | singleton v =>
    have hx' : x = v := mem_singleton.1 ((eligibleSet_subset (G := G) {v}) hx)
    have hz' : z = v := mem_singleton.1 ((eligibleSet_subset (G := G) {v}) hz)
    intro hD
    exact hD.1 (hx'.trans hz'.symm)
  | disjointUnion hdisj hnocross hA hB ihA ihB =>
    rename_i A B
    have hEU := eligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
    have hxU : x ∈ A ∪ B := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) (A ∪ B) hx
    have hyU : y ∈ A ∪ B := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) (A ∪ B) hy
    have hzU : z ∈ A ∪ B := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) (A ∪ B) hz
    have side (w : V) (hw : w ∈ eligibleSet G (A ∪ B)) :
        w ∈ eligibleSet G A ∨ w ∈ eligibleSet G B := by
      rw [hEU] at hw
      exact mem_union.1 hw
    have crossD {u w : V}
        (huA : u ∈ eligibleSet G A) (hwB : w ∈ eligibleSet G B) :
        DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (A ∪ B) u w :=
      DistinctPathCompatible_union_cross hdisj hnocross
        (eligible_mem_of_mem_eligibleSet huA)
        (eligible_mem_of_mem_eligibleSet hwB)
    rcases side x hx with hxA | hxB
    · rcases side y hy with hyA | hyB
      · rcases side z hz with hzA | hzB
        · have hxyA : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y := by
            intro hD
            exact hxy (DistinctPathCompatible_union_left hdisj hnocross hD)
          have hyzA : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A y z := by
            intro hD
            exact hyz (DistinctPathCompatible_union_left hdisj hnocross hD)
          have hxzA := ihA hxA hyA hzA hxyA hyzA
          intro hD
          exact hxzA (DistinctPathCompatible_union_of_left hdisj hnocross
            (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hxA)
            (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hzA) hD)
        · exact (hyz (crossD hyA hzB)).elim
      · exact (hxy (crossD hxA hyB)).elim
    · rcases side y hy with hyA | hyB
      · exact (hxy (DistinctPathCompatible.symm (crossD hyA hxB))).elim
      · rcases side z hz with hzA | hzB
        · exact (hyz (DistinctPathCompatible.symm (crossD hzA hyB))).elim
        · have hxyB : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) B x y := by
            intro hD
            exact hxy (DistinctPathCompatible_union_right hdisj hnocross hD)
          have hyzB : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) B y z := by
            intro hD
            exact hyz (DistinctPathCompatible_union_right hdisj hnocross hD)
          have hxzB := ihB hxB hyB hzB hxyB hyzB
          intro hD
          have hxB' : x ∈ B := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hxB
          have hzB' : z ∈ B := eligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hzB
          have hdisj' : Disjoint B A := hdisj.symm
          have hnocross' : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj b a := fun b hb a ha hab =>
            hnocross a ha b hb hab.symm
          have hD' : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (B ∪ A) x z := by
            simpa [union_comm] using hD
          exact hxzB (DistinctPathCompatible_union_of_left hdisj' hnocross'
            hxB' hzB' hD')
  | completeJoin hAne hBne hAB hA hB ihA ihB =>
    rename_i A B
    by_cases hAdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A
    · have hpU := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
      by_cases hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B)
      · have hE := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
        have hxA : x ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rwa [← hE]
        have hyA : y ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rwa [← hE]
        have hzA : z ∈ eligibleSet G A := by rwa [← hE]
        have hiff :=
          DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
            (x := x) (y := y) hAne hBne hAB hAdom hq
        have hiffyz :=
          DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
            (x := y) (y := z) hAne hBne hAB hAdom hq
        have hiffxz :=
          DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
            (x := x) (y := z) hAne hBne hAB hAdom hq
        have hxyA : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A x y := by
          intro hD; exact hxy (hiff.2 hD)
        have hyzA : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A y z := by
          intro hD; exact hyz (hiffyz.2 hD)
        have hxzA := ihA hxA hyA hzA hxyA hyzA
        intro hD
        exact hxzA (hiffxz.1 hD)
      · have hq1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ 1 := by omega
        exact not_DistinctPathCompatible_of_le_one hq1
    · by_cases hBdom : A.card < pathCoverNumber G B
      · have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (A : Set V) :=
          fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
        have hpU := pathCoverNumber_eq_sub_of_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
        by_cases hq : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B)
        · have hqB : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (B ∪ A) := by simpa [union_comm] using hq
          have hE : eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = eligibleSet G B := by
            simpa [union_comm] using
              eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
          have hxB : x ∈ eligibleSet G B := by rwa [← hE]
          have hyB : y ∈ eligibleSet G B := by rwa [← hE]
          have hzB : z ∈ eligibleSet G B := by rwa [← hE]
          have hiff :=
            DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
              (x := x) (y := y) hBne hAne hBA hBdom hqB
          have hiffyz :=
            DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
              (x := y) (y := z) hBne hAne hBA hBdom hqB
          have hiffxz :=
            DistinctPathCompatible_complete_join_dominant_iff
              (x := x) (y := z) hBne hAne hBA hBdom hqB
          have hxyB : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) B x y := by
            intro hD
            have hD' : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (B ∪ A) x y := hiff.2 hD
            exact hxy (by simpa [union_comm] using hD')
          have hyzB : ¬ DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) B y z := by
            intro hD
            have hD' : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (B ∪ A) y z := hiffyz.2 hD
            exact hyz (by simpa [union_comm] using hD')
          have hxzB := ihB hxB hyB hzB hxyB hyzB
          intro hD
          have hD' : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) (B ∪ A) x z := by
            simpa [union_comm] using hD
          exact hxzB (hiffxz.1 hD')
        · have hq1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ 1 := by omega
          exact not_DistinctPathCompatible_of_le_one hq1
      · have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hAdom
        have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hBdom
        have hp := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hAne hBne hAB
        have hmax :
            max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
              (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) = 1 := by
          simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpA, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpB]
        have hp1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 := hp.trans hmax
        exact not_DistinctPathCompatible_of_le_one (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_DistinctPathCompatible_trans_of_canonical

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.aligned_join_profile_of_eligible
statement:
theorem aligned_join_profile_of_eligible {X Y : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hX : X.Nonempty) (hY : Y.Nonempty)
    (hXY : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (h2 : 2 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y))
    (hxE : x ∈ eligibleSet G (X ∪ Y)) (hxX : x ∈ X) :
    pathCoverNumber G X = pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) + Y.card ∧
      eligibleSet G (X ∪ Y) = eligibleSet G X ∧
      pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) + Y.card ≤ X.card
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hXY
  have hYX : G.IsCompleteBetween (Y : Set V) (X : Set V) :=
    fun {_} hy {_} hx => (hXY hx hy).symm
  have hYle : pathCoverNumber G Y ≤ X.card := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hYdom : X.card < pathCoverNumber G Y := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hE := eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hY hX hYX hYdom
    have hxEY : x ∈ eligibleSet G Y := by
      have hxRev : x ∈ eligibleSet G (Y ∪ X) := by
        simpa [union_comm] using hxE
      rw [hE] at hxRev
      exact hxRev
    exact disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxX (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) Y hxEY)
  have hXdom : Y.card < pathCoverNumber G X := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hXle : pathCoverNumber G X ≤ Y.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hformula := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hX hY hXY
    have hone : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) = 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hXle, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hYle] using hformula
    omega
  have hp := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hX hY hXY hXdom
  refine ⟨hp, eligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hX hY hXY hXdom, ?_⟩
  rw [← hp]
  exact pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) X

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_first_departure
proof:
:= by
  let B : Finset V := univ.filter (fun x => x ∉ X)
  have hfB : Q.finish ∈ B := by simp [B, hf]
  have hsB : Q.start ∉ B := by simp [B, hs]
  have hnone : Q.walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
    intro hnone
    have hnot : ¬ decide (Q.finish ∈ B) :=
      (List.find?_eq_none (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 hnone Q.finish
        ((mem_walk_support (p := Q)).1 Q.finish_mem_support)
    exact hnot (decide_eq_true hfB)
  have hfind := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := Q) hnone
  have hx : firstB B Q hnone ∈ Q.support := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind).1
  have hbB : firstB B Q hnone ∈ B := (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind).2
  have hv : firstB B Q hnone ∉ X := by simpa [B] using hbB
  have hne : firstB B Q hnone ≠ Q.start := find?_B_ne_start hsB hfind
  have hnn : ¬ (Q.takeUntil hx).walk.Nil := fun hn =>
    hne ((takeUntil_nil_iff Q hx).1 hn)
  let pre := (Q.takeUntil hx).trimFinish hnn
  have hu : pre.finish ∈ X := by
    have hpen : pre.finish ∈ (Q.takeUntil hx).support := by
      have : pre.support ⊆ (Q.takeUntil hx).support := by
        rw [support_trimFinish]
        exact erase_subset _ _
      exact this pre.finish_mem_support
    have hneP : pre.finish ≠ firstB B Q hnone := by
      have hmem : pre.finish ∈ (Q.takeUntil hx).support.erase (Q.takeUntil hx).finish := by
        rw [← support_trimFinish (Q.takeUntil hx) hnn]
        exact pre.finish_mem_support
      have : (Q.takeUntil hx).finish = firstB B Q hnone := by simp [takeUntil]
      exact this ▸ (mem_erase.1 hmem).1
    have hnotB : pre.finish ∉ B :=
      takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B (B := B) hfind hx hpen hneP
    simpa [B] using hnotB
  have hadj : G.Adj pre.finish (Q.takeUntil hx).finish :=
    adj_trimFinish_finish (Q.takeUntil hx) hnn
  have hePre : s(pre.finish, (Q.takeUntil hx).finish) ∈ (Q.takeUntil hx).edges :=
    last_edge_mem (Q.takeUntil hx) hnn
  refine ⟨pre.finish, firstB B Q hnone, hu, hv, by simpa [takeUntil] using hadj, ?_⟩
  exact edges_takeUntil_subset Q hx (by simpa [takeUntil] using hePre)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftoverPieces_nodup
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_nodup {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) :
    (leftoverPieces B p).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Pairwise.imp ?_ (leftoverPieces_pairwise (B := B) p)
  intro a b hdisj hab
  subst hab
  have : a.support ∩ a.support = ∅ := disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 hdisj
  simp only [inter_self] at this
  exact (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.1 a.support_nonempty) this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_two_leftover_in
statement:
lemma exists_two_leftover_in {A U0 : Finset V} {p : GraphPath G}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).length) :
    ∃ Q R, Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p ∧ R ∈ leftoverPieces A p ∧
      Q.start ∈ U0 ∧ R.start ∈ U0 ∧ Q ≠ R
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).Nodup :=
    (leftoverPieces_nodup (B := A) p).filter _
  match hl : List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p) with
  | [] => simp [hl] at h2
  | [_] => simp [hl] at h2
  | Q :: R :: rest =>
    have hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p ∧ Q.start ∈ U0 := by
      have : Q ∈ List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p) := by
        simp [hl]
      obtain ⟨hmem, hdec⟩ := List.mem_filter.1 this
      exact ⟨hmem, of_decide_eq_true hdec⟩
    have hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p ∧ R.start ∈ U0 := by
      have : R ∈ List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p) := by
        simp [hl]
      obtain ⟨hmem, hdec⟩ := List.mem_filter.1 this
      exact ⟨hmem, of_decide_eq_true hdec⟩
    refine ⟨Q, R, hQ.1, hR.1, hQ.2, hR.2, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    subst heq
    have hn' : (Q :: Q :: rest).Nodup := by simpa [hl] using hn
    exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hn').1 (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftover_starts_in_one_join_side
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hjoin
  have hsXY : Q0.start ∈ X ∨ Q0.start ∈ Y := by
    have : Q0.start ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hs0
    simpa [mem_union] using this
  rcases hsXY with hsX | hsY
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    intro Q hQ hsU
    have hsXY' : Q.start ∈ X ∨ Q.start ∈ Y := by
      have : Q.start ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hsU
      simpa [mem_union] using this
    rcases hsXY' with hX | hY
    · exact hX
    · have hne : Q0.start ≠ Q.start := fun heq =>
        (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (heq ▸ hsX) hY).elim
      exact (hInd Q0 hQ0 Q hQ hs0 hsU hne (hjoin hsX hY)).elim
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    intro Q hQ hsU
    have hsXY' : Q.start ∈ X ∨ Q.start ∈ Y := by
      have : Q.start ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hsU
      simpa [mem_union] using this
    rcases hsXY' with hX | hY
    · have hne : Q0.start ≠ Q.start := fun heq =>
        (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hX (heq ▸ hsY)).elim
      exact (hInd Q0 hQ0 Q hQ hs0 hsU hne (hjoin hX hsY).symm).elim
    · exact hY

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.leftover_finishes_in_one_join_side
statement:
lemma leftover_finishes_in_one_join_side {A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    {p : GraphPath G}
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    (hInd : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, ∀ R ∈ leftoverPieces A p,
      Q.finish ∈ U0 → R.finish ∈ U0 → Q.finish ≠ R.finish →
        ¬ G.Adj Q.finish R.finish)
    {Q0 : GraphPath G}
    (hQ0 : Q0 ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hf0 : Q0.finish ∈ U0) :
    (∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.finish ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X) ∨
      (∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.finish ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hjoin
  have hfXY : Q0.finish ∈ X ∨ Q0.finish ∈ Y := by
    have : Q0.finish ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hf0
    simpa [mem_union] using this
  rcases hfXY with hfX | hfY
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    intro Q hQ hfU
    have hfXY' : Q.finish ∈ X ∨ Q.finish ∈ Y := by
      have : Q.finish ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hfU
      simpa [mem_union] using this
    rcases hfXY' with hX | hY
    · exact hX
    · have hne : Q0.finish ≠ Q.finish := fun heq =>
        (disjoint_left.1 hdisj (heq ▸ hfX) hY).elim
      exact (hInd Q0 hQ0 Q hQ hf0 hfU hne (hjoin hfX hY)).elim
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    intro Q hQ hfU
    have hfXY' : Q.finish ∈ X ∨ Q.finish ∈ Y := by
      have : Q.finish ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hfU
      simpa [mem_union] using this
    rcases hfXY' with hX | hY
    · have hne : Q0.finish ≠ Q.finish := fun heq =>
        (disjoint_left.1 hdisj hX (heq ▸ hfY)).elim
      exact (hInd Q0 hQ0 Q hQ hf0 hfU hne (hjoin hX hfY).symm).elim
    · exact hY

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XZ
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XZ {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (_hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q ≠ R)
    (hQsup : Q.support ⊆ U0) (_hRsup : R.support ⊆ U0)
    (hQs : Q.start ∈ X) (hQf : Q.finish ∈ Y)
    (hRs : R.start ∈ X) (hRf : R.finish ∈ Y) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hRA : Disjoint R.support A := leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p R hR
  have hQe : Q.edges ⊆ p.edges :=
    edges_of_isSubwalk (leftoverPieces_isSubwalk p Q hQ)
  have hdisjQR : Disjoint Q.support R.support :=
    PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem (leftoverPieces_pairwise (B := A) p)
      hQ hR hneQR
  have hXf : Q.finish ∉ X := fun hX =>
    (disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_of_completeBetween hjoin) hX hQf).elim
  obtain ⟨u, v, huX, hvX, hadjuv, huvQ⟩ :=
    exists_first_departure (Q := Q) (X := X) hQs hXf
  have hvQ : v ∈ Q.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge huvQ (by simp)
  have hvY : v ∈ Y := by
    have hvU0 : v ∈ U0 := hQsup hvQ
    have : v ∈ X ∪ Y := by simpa [hcover] using hvU0
    rcases mem_union.1 this with hX | hY
    · exact (hvX hX).elim
    · exact hY
  have huA : u ∉ A :=
    (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 (hQsup (mem_support_of_mem_edge huvQ (by simp))))).2
  have hvA : v ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 (hQsup hvQ))).2
  let F := originalSubwalkFactor_of_leftover (B := A) hR
  have hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil :=
    originalSubwalkFactor_of_leftover_pre_not_nil (B := A) hs hR
  have hseams := originalSubwalkFactor_of_leftover_seams (B := A) hR
  have hstA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start ∈ A :=
    F.omitRunComplement_start_mem_A hpre hclose hs hseams.2
  have hfinA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).finish ∈ A :=
    F.omitRunComplement_finish_mem_A hpre hclose (hseams.1.resolve_left hpre)
  have hrProt : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).ProtectedAt c A := by
    intro e he
    have heE : e ∈ (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges :=
      (mem_AIncident_iff.1 he).1
    have hsub := F.omitRunComplement_edges_subset_closed hpre hclose heE
    have : e ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := by
      simpa [OriginalSubwalkFactor.closedEdges] using hsub
    simpa [hedges] using this
  have hdBlock : Disjoint R.support (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support :=
    F.omitRunComplement_disjoint_block hpre hclose
  have hsupEq : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support ∪ R.support =
      p.support := by
    rw [F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose, sdiff_union_self_eq_union,
      union_eq_left.2 (leftoverPieces_support_subset p R hR)]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hpair, hFac⟩ :=
    F.exists_PrefixEdgeFactor_of_retained_run_edge hpre hclose Q hdisjQR hQe huvQ
  obtain ⟨Fac⟩ := hFac
  have huv : u ≠ v := hadjuv.ne
  have hdir : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i = u ∧
      (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1) = v ∨
      (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i = v ∧
        (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1) = u := by
    exact (Sym2.eq_iff.mp hpair)
  have hcloseU (qBlk : GraphPath G)
      (hEq : qBlk.support = R.support)
      (hd : Disjoint qBlk.support (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support)
      (hsu : G.Adj ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i) qBlk.start)
      (hfv : G.Adj qBlk.finish
        ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1))) :
      ∃ q : GraphPath G,
        q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
          q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish := by
    have htiA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i ∉ A := by
      rcases hdir with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
      · simpa [h] using huA
      · simpa [h] using hvA
    have hhiA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ A := by
      rcases hdir with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
      · simpa [h] using hvA
      · simpa [h] using huA
    have hAq : Disjoint qBlk.support A := by simpa [hEq] using hRA
    let q := insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv
    refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : q.support =
          (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support ∪ qBlk.support :=
        insertOmittedBlock_support Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv
      rw [this, hEq, hsupEq, hp]
    · exact protectedAt_insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv htiA hhiA hAq
        hrProt
    · simpa [q, insertOmittedBlock_start] using hstA
    · simpa [q, insertOmittedBlock_finish] using hfinA
    · change (insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv).start ≠
          (insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv).finish
      simpa [insertOmittedBlock] using
        Fac.insertBlock_start_ne_finish qBlk hd hsu hfv
  rcases hdir with ⟨hiU, hiV⟩ | ⟨hiV, hiU⟩
  · have hd : Disjoint R.reverse.support
        (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support := by
      simpa [support_reverse] using hdBlock
    have hsu : G.Adj ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i)
        R.reverse.start := by
      simpa [hiU, GraphPath.reverse] using hjoin huX hRf
    have hfv : G.Adj R.reverse.finish
        ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by
      simpa [hiV, GraphPath.reverse] using hjoin hRs hvY
    exact hcloseU R.reverse (by simp) hd hsu hfv
  · have hd : Disjoint R.support
        (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support := hdBlock
    have hsu : G.Adj ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i)
        R.start := by
      simpa [hiV] using (hjoin hRs hvY).symm
    have hfv : G.Adj R.finish
        ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by
      simpa [hiU] using (hjoin huX hRf).symm
    exact hcloseU R rfl hd hsu hfv

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XZ_of_saving
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XZ_of_saving {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).length)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ Y) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, R, hQ, hR, hQs, hRs, hneQR⟩ := exists_two_leftover_in h2
  exact exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XZ (c := c) hc hU0 hjoin hcover
    hp hs hclose hedges hQ hR hneQR (hstay Q hQ hQs) (hstay R hR hRs)
    (hstartX Q hQ hQs) (hfinY Q hQ hQs) (hstartX R hR hRs) (hfinY R hR hRs)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (_hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    {Q R : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hR : R ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hneQR : Q ≠ R)
    (_hQsup : Q.support ⊆ U0) (_hRsup : R.support ⊆ U0)
    (hRs : R.start ∈ X) (hRf : R.finish ∈ X)
    {u v : V} (huY : u ∈ Y) (hvY : v ∈ Y)
    (_hadjuv : G.Adj u v) (huvQ : s(u, v) ∈ Q.edges) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hRA : Disjoint R.support A := leftoverPieces_disjoint_B p R hR
  have hQe : Q.edges ⊆ p.edges :=
    edges_of_isSubwalk (leftoverPieces_isSubwalk p Q hQ)
  have hdisjQR : Disjoint Q.support R.support :=
    PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem (leftoverPieces_pairwise (B := A) p)
      hQ hR hneQR
  have hYsub : Y ⊆ U0 := by
    intro y hy
    have : y ∈ X ∪ Y := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hy)
    simpa [hcover] using this
  have huU0 : u ∈ U0 := hYsub huY
  have hvU0 : v ∈ U0 := hYsub hvY
  have huA : u ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 huU0)).2
  have hvA : v ∉ A := (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 hvU0)).2
  let F := originalSubwalkFactor_of_leftover (B := A) hR
  have hpre : ¬ F.preWalk.Nil :=
    originalSubwalkFactor_of_leftover_pre_not_nil (B := A) hs hR
  have hseams := originalSubwalkFactor_of_leftover_seams (B := A) hR
  have hstA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).start ∈ A :=
    F.omitRunComplement_start_mem_A hpre hclose hs hseams.2
  have hfinA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).finish ∈ A :=
    F.omitRunComplement_finish_mem_A hpre hclose (hseams.1.resolve_left hpre)
  have hrProt : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).ProtectedAt c A := by
    intro e he
    have heE : e ∈ (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).edges :=
      (mem_AIncident_iff.1 he).1
    have hsub := F.omitRunComplement_edges_subset_closed hpre hclose heE
    have : e ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := by
      simpa [OriginalSubwalkFactor.closedEdges] using hsub
    simpa [hedges] using this
  have hdBlock : Disjoint R.support (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support :=
    F.omitRunComplement_disjoint_block hpre hclose
  have hsupEq : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support ∪ R.support =
      p.support := by
    rw [F.omitRunComplement_support hpre hclose, sdiff_union_self_eq_union,
      union_eq_left.2 (leftoverPieces_support_subset p R hR)]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hpair, hFac⟩ :=
    F.exists_PrefixEdgeFactor_of_retained_run_edge hpre hclose Q hdisjQR hQe huvQ
  obtain ⟨Fac⟩ := hFac
  have hdir : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i = u ∧
      (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1) = v ∨
      (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i = v ∧
        (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1) = u := by
    exact (Sym2.eq_iff.mp hpair)
  have hcloseU (qBlk : GraphPath G)
      (hEq : qBlk.support = R.support)
      (hd : Disjoint qBlk.support (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support)
      (hsu : G.Adj ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i) qBlk.start)
      (hfv : G.Adj qBlk.finish
        ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1))) :
      ∃ q : GraphPath G,
        q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
          q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish := by
    have htiA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i ∉ A := by
      rcases hdir with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
      · simpa [h] using huA
      · simpa [h] using hvA
    have hhiA : (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1) ∉ A := by
      rcases hdir with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
      · simpa [h] using hvA
      · simpa [h] using huA
    have hAq : Disjoint qBlk.support A := by simpa [hEq] using hRA
    let q := insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv
    refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : q.support =
          (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support ∪ qBlk.support :=
        insertOmittedBlock_support Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv
      rw [this, hEq, hsupEq, hp]
    · exact protectedAt_insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv htiA hhiA hAq
        hrProt
    · simpa [q, insertOmittedBlock_start] using hstA
    · simpa [q, insertOmittedBlock_finish] using hfinA
    · change (insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv).start ≠
          (insertOmittedBlock Fac qBlk hd hsu hfv).finish
      simpa [insertOmittedBlock] using
        Fac.insertBlock_start_ne_finish qBlk hd hsu hfv
  
  
  
  rcases hdir with ⟨hiU, hiV⟩ | ⟨hiV, hiU⟩
  · have hd : Disjoint R.support
        (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support := hdBlock
    have hsu : G.Adj ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i)
        R.start := by
      simpa [hiU] using (hjoin hRs huY).symm
    have hfv : G.Adj R.finish
        ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by
      simpa [hiV] using hjoin hRf hvY
    exact hcloseU R rfl hd hsu hfv
  · have hd : Disjoint R.reverse.support
        (F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).support := by
      simpa [support_reverse] using hdBlock
    have hsu : G.Adj ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert i)
        R.reverse.start := by
      simpa [hiV, GraphPath.reverse] using (hjoin hRf hvY).symm
    have hfv : G.Adj R.reverse.finish
        ((F.omitRunComplement hpre hclose).walk.getVert (i + 1)) := by
      simpa [hiU, GraphPath.reverse] using hjoin hRs huY
    exact hcloseU R.reverse (by simp) hd hsu hfv

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY_of_saving
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY_of_saving {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).length)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    {Q : GraphPath G} (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hQs : Q.start ∈ U0)
    {u v : V} (huY : u ∈ Y) (hvY : v ∈ Y)
    (hadjuv : G.Adj u v) (huvQ : s(u, v) ∈ Q.edges) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q1, Q2, hQ1, hQ2, hs1, hs2, hne12⟩ := exists_two_leftover_in h2
  have hpick : ∃ R, R ∈ leftoverPieces A p ∧ R.start ∈ U0 ∧ R ≠ Q := by
    by_cases h : Q1 = Q
    · exact ⟨Q2, hQ2, hs2, fun heq => hne12 (h.trans heq.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨Q1, hQ1, hs1, h⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRsU0, hneQR⟩ := hpick
  exact exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY (c := c) hc hU0 hjoin hcover
    hp hs hclose hedges hQ hR hneQR.symm (hstay Q hQ hQs) (hstay R hR hRsU0)
    (hstartX R hR hRsU0) (hfinX R hR hRsU0) huY hvY hadjuv huvQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YX_of_saving
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YX_of_saving {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).length)
    (hstartY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ Y)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hjoinYX : G.IsCompleteBetween (Y : Set V) (X : Set V) :=
    fun {y} hy {x} hx => (hjoin hx hy).symm
  have hcoverYX : Y ∪ X = U0 := by rw [union_comm, hcover]
  exact exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XZ_of_saving (c := c) hc hU0 hjoinYX
    hcoverYX hp hs hclose hedges hstay h2 hstartY hfinX

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XX_of_saving
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_XX_of_saving {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hcover : X ∪ Y = U0)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ (List.filter (fun Q => Q.start ∈ U0) (leftoverPieces A p)).length)
    (hfinY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ Y)
    (hstartY : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ Y)
    {Q : GraphPath G} (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p) (hQs : Q.start ∈ U0)
    {u v : V} (huX : u ∈ X) (hvX : v ∈ X)
    (hadjuv : G.Adj u v) (huvQ : s(u, v) ∈ Q.edges) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath G,
      q.support = U ∧ q.ProtectedAt c A ∧
        q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧ q.start ≠ q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hjoinYX : G.IsCompleteBetween (Y : Set V) (X : Set V) :=
    fun {y} hy {x} hx => (hjoin hx hy).symm
  have hcoverYX : Y ∪ X = U0 := by rw [union_comm, hcover]
  exact exists_protectedAt_of_join_insert_YY_of_saving (c := c) hc hU0 hjoinYX
    hcoverYX hp hs hclose hedges hstay h2 hfinY hstartY hQ hQs huX hvX hadjuv huvQ

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.openAt_support
statement:
lemma openAt_support (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).support = c.support
proof:
:= by
  have hnn := c.rotateTo_not_nil hu
  have hcons := (c.rotateTo hu).walk.cons_tail_eq hnn
  have hsup : (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support =
      (c.rotateTo hu).start :: (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail.support := by
    rw [← hcons]; simp [Walk.support_cons]
  have hwalk : (c.openAt hu).walk = (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail := rfl
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxL : x ∈ (c.openAt hu).walk.support :=
      (mem_walk_support (p := c.openAt hu)).1 hx
    have hxT : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support.tail :=
      (Walk.support_tail_of_not_nil (c.rotateTo hu).walk hnn) ▸ hxL
    have hxR : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support := List.mem_of_mem_tail hxT
    have : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).support := List.mem_toFinset.2 hxR
    simpa [c.support_rotateTo hu] using this
  · intro hx
    have hx0 : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).support := by
      simpa [c.support_rotateTo hu] using hx
    have hxW : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support := List.mem_toFinset.1 hx0
    have hxL : x ∈ (c.rotateTo hu).start :: (c.rotateTo hu).walk.tail.support := by
      simpa [hsup] using hxW
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hxL with h | h
    · have hxu : x = u := h.trans (start_rotateTo c hu)
      simpa [hxu, c.openAt_finish hu] using (c.openAt hu).finish_mem_support
    · exact (mem_walk_support (p := c.openAt hu)).2 (hwalk ▸ h)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ProtectedAt_openAt
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt_openAt (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support)
    {A : Finset V} : (c.openAt hu).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have heE : e ∈ (c.openAt hu).edges := (mem_AIncident_iff.1 he).1
  have : e ∈ c.edges := by
    rw [c.edges_eq_insert_openAt hu]
    exact mem_insert_of_mem heE
  simpa [GraphCycle.edges] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.opened_reverse_start
statement:
lemma opened_reverse_start (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).reverse.start = u
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphPath.reverse, c.openAt_finish hu]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.opened_reverse_finish
statement:
lemma opened_reverse_finish (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).reverse.finish = c.succAt hu
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphPath.reverse, c.openAt_start hu]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.opened_reverse_support
statement:
lemma opened_reverse_support (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).reverse.support = c.support
proof:
:= by
  simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse] using openAt_support c hu

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.opened_reverse_close
statement:
lemma opened_reverse_close (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    G.Adj (c.openAt hu).reverse.finish (c.openAt hu).reverse.start
proof:
:= by
  simpa [opened_reverse_finish c hu, opened_reverse_start c hu] using
    (c.adj_succAt hu).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.opened_reverse_edges
statement:
lemma opened_reverse_edges (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.openAt hu).reverse.edges ∪ {s((c.openAt hu).reverse.finish,
      (c.openAt hu).reverse.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hedges : (c.openAt hu).reverse.edges = (c.openAt hu).edges :=
    (c.openAt hu).edges_reverse
  have hclose : s((c.openAt hu).reverse.finish, (c.openAt hu).reverse.start) =
      s(u, c.succAt hu) := by
    simp [opened_reverse_finish c hu, opened_reverse_start c hu, Sym2.eq_swap]
  rw [hedges, hclose]
  simpa [GraphCycle.edges, union_comm, singleton_union] using
    (c.edges_eq_insert_openAt hu).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ProtectedAt_opened_reverse
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt_opened_reverse (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support)
    {A : Finset V} : (c.openAt hu).reverse.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:=
  (ProtectedAt_reverse (c.openAt hu) c A).2 (ProtectedAt_openAt c hu)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_support_penultimate_rotateTo
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : ¬ (c.rotateTo hu).walk.Nil := (c.rotateTo hu).isCycle.not_nil
  have hpos : 0 < (c.rotateTo hu).walk.length :=
    Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.1 hnn
  have : (c.rotateTo hu).walk.getVert ((c.rotateTo hu).walk.length - 1) ∈
      (c.rotateTo hu).walk.support :=
    Walk.getVert_mem_support _ _
  simpa [GraphCycle.support, Walk.penultimate] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_takeUntil_length_eq
statement:
lemma cycle_takeUntil_length_eq (c : GraphCycle G) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < c.walk.length) :
    (c.walk.takeUntil (c.walk.getVert i)
        (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)).length = i
proof:
:= by
  set u := c.walk.getVert i
  set p := c.walk.takeUntil u (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)
  have hi' : i ≤ c.walk.length := hi.le
  have hpu : c.walk.getVert p.length = u :=
    Walk.getVert_length_takeUntil (p := c.walk)
      (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)
  have hne : p.length ≠ c.walk.length := by
    intro heq
    have huStart : u = c.start := by
      simpa [heq, Walk.getVert_length] using hpu.symm
    have hi0 : i = 0 := by
      have := (c.isCycle.getVert_endpoint_iff hi').1 huStart
      omega
    have hp0 : p.length = 0 := by
      subst hi0
      simp [p, u, Walk.getVert_zero, Walk.takeUntil_first]
    have h3 := c.three_le_length
    omega
  have hplt : p.length < c.walk.length := lt_of_le_of_ne
    (Walk.length_takeUntil_le_length c.walk
      (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk i)) hne
  have hp_le : p.length ≤ c.walk.length - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt hplt
  have hi_le : i ≤ c.walk.length - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt hi
  exact c.isCycle.getVert_injOn' hp_le hi_le (hpu.trans rfl)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_idxOf_getVert
statement:
lemma cycle_idxOf_getVert (c : GraphCycle G) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < c.walk.length) :
    c.walk.support.idxOf (c.walk.getVert i) = i
proof:
:= by
  have := cycle_takeUntil_length_eq c hi
  simpa [Walk.length_takeUntil] using this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.succAt_penultimate_rotateTo
statement:
lemma succAt_penultimate_rotateTo (c : GraphCycle G) {u : V} (hu : u ∈ c.support) :
    (c.rotateTo hu).succAt (mem_support_penultimate_rotateTo c hu) = u
proof:
:= by
  set c0 := c.rotateTo hu
  set b := c0.walk.penultimate
  have hb : b ∈ c0.support := mem_support_penultimate_rotateTo c hu
  have hst : c0.start = u := start_rotateTo c hu
  have h3 : 3 ≤ c0.walk.length := c0.three_le_length
  have hlt : c0.walk.length - 1 < c0.walk.length := by omega
  have hbW : b ∈ c0.walk.support := by simpa [GraphCycle.support] using hb
  have hidx : c0.walk.support.idxOf b = c0.walk.length - 1 := by
    simpa [b, Walk.penultimate] using cycle_idxOf_getVert c0 hlt
  have hdropLen : (c0.walk.dropUntil b hbW).length = 1 := by
    rw [Walk.length_dropUntil, hidx]
    omega
  have hsnd : (c0.rotateTo hb).walk.getVert 1 =
      (c0.walk.dropUntil b hbW).getVert 1 := by
    simp only [GraphCycle.rotateTo, Walk.rotate]
    rw [Walk.getVert_append']
    have : 1 ≤ (c0.walk.dropUntil b hbW).length := by omega
    simp [this]
  have hfinDrop : (c0.walk.dropUntil b hbW).getVert
      (c0.walk.dropUntil b hbW).length = u := by
    simp [Walk.getVert_length, hst]
  have hdrop1 : (c0.walk.dropUntil b hbW).getVert 1 = u := by
    simpa [hdropLen] using hfinDrop
  rw [GraphCycle.succAt]
  exact hsnd.trans hdrop1

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_succAt_mem_A
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_succAt_mem_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hu : a ∈ c.support) (hsucc : c.succAt hu ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨c.openAt hu, ?_, ?_, ?_, c.openAt_start_ne_finish hu,
    ProtectedAt_openAt c hu⟩
  · simpa [openAt_support c hu] using hc
  · simpa [c.openAt_start hu] using hsucc
  · simpa [c.openAt_finish hu] using haA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_pred_mem_A
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_pred_mem_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hu : a ∈ c.support)
    (hpred : (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  set c0 := c.rotateTo hu
  set b := c0.walk.penultimate
  have hb : b ∈ c0.support := mem_support_penultimate_rotateTo c hu
  have hbA : b ∈ A := by
    have : b = (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate := c.penultimate_rotateTo hu
    simpa [this] using hpred
  have hst : c0.succAt hb = a := by
    have := succAt_penultimate_rotateTo c hu
    simpa [c0] using this
  have hP0 : (c0.openAt hb).ProtectedAt c0 A := ProtectedAt_openAt c0 hb
  have hedges : c0.walk.edges.toFinset = c.walk.edges.toFinset := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.edges] using c.edges_rotateTo_eq hu
  refine ⟨c0.openAt hb, ?_, ?_, ?_, c0.openAt_start_ne_finish hb,
    ProtectedAt.of_cycle_edges_eq hedges hP0⟩
  · rw [openAt_support c0 hb, c.support_rotateTo hu, hc]
  · simpa [c0.openAt_start hb, hst] using haA
  · simpa [c0.openAt_finish hb] using hbA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_protectedAt_of_cycle_neighbour_A
statement:
lemma exists_protectedAt_of_cycle_neighbour_A {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) {a : V} (haA : a ∈ A)
    (hu : a ∈ c.support)
    (hn : c.succAt hu ∈ A ∨ (c.openAt hu).walk.penultimate ∈ A) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G,
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A ∧
        p.start ≠ p.finish ∧ p.ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn with h | h
  · exact exists_protectedAt_of_succAt_mem_A c hc haA hu h
  · exact exists_protectedAt_of_pred_mem_A c hc haA hu h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_boundary_eq_ax
proof:
:= by
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun u v hstr hae haU hxe hxU => ?_) hstr hae haU hxe hxU
  rcases (Sym2.mem_iff.mp hae) with rfl | rfl
  · rcases (Sym2.mem_iff.mp hxe) with rfl | rfl
    · exact (haU hxU).elim
    · rfl
  · rcases (Sym2.mem_iff.mp hxe) with rfl | rfl
    · simp [Sym2.eq_swap]
    · exact (haU hxU).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_boundary_U0_end_mem_X
statement:
lemma cycle_boundary_U0_end_mem_X {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0) {x : V}
    (hxe : x ∈ e) (hxU : x ∈ U0) : x ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hxQ, hsU0, hQsup⟩ :=
    leftover_U0_run_of_mem (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) hp hU0 hnocross hstay hxU
  have hsX : Q.start ∈ X := hstartX Q hQ hsU0
  have hfX : Q.finish ∈ X := hfinX Q hQ hsU0
  obtain ⟨heC, hstr⟩ := GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he
  obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
    boundary_outside_end_mem_A (c := c) hc hU0 hnocross he
  have haU : a ∉ U0 := disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_A_U0 hU0) haA
  have heq : e = s(a, x) := cycle_boundary_eq_ax hstr hae haU hxe hxU
  have haQ : a ∉ Q.support := fun hmem =>
    (mem_sdiff.1 (hU0 (hQsup hmem))).2 haA
  by_cases heP : s(a, x) ∈ p.edges
  · have hends := leftover_endpoint_of_leaving_edge (A := A) hQ heP hxQ haQ
    rcases hends with h | h
    · simpa [h] using hsX
    · simpa [h] using hfX
  · have hmem : s(a, x) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} := by
      simpa [hedges, GraphCycle.edges, heq] using heC
    have hclose : s(a, x) = s(p.finish, p.start) :=
      mem_singleton.1 ((mem_union.1 hmem).resolve_left heP)
    have hxfin : x = p.finish := by
      have hsU : p.start ∉ U0 := disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_A_U0 hU0) hs
      rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp hclose) with ⟨_, hx'⟩ | ⟨_, hx'⟩
      · exact (hsU (by simpa [hx'] using hxU)).elim
      · exact hx'
    have : Q.finish = p.finish :=
      leftover_finish_eq_of_mem (A := A) hQ (by simpa [hxfin] using hxQ)
    simpa [hxfin, this] using hfX

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.path_boundary_outside_end_mem_A
statement:
lemma path_boundary_outside_end_mem_A {U A U0 Y : Finset V}
    {G' : SimpleGraph V} (hLE : G' ≤ G)
    (_hA : A ⊆ U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (_hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {p' : GraphPath G'} (hp' : p'.support = U)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ p'.boundaryEdges U0) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, a ∈ e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨heP, hstr⟩ := GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he
  obtain ⟨x, hxe, hxU, huniq⟩ := existsUnique_U0_end hstr
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e (fun u v heP hstr hxe hxU huniq => ?_) heP hstr hxe hxU huniq
  have hadj' : G'.Adj u v := by
    simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] using p'.edges_subset_edgeSet _ heP
  have hadj : G.Adj u v := hLE hadj'
  have huP : u ∈ p'.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge heP (by simp)
  have hvP : v ∈ p'.support := mem_support_of_mem_edge heP (by simp)
  have huU : u ∈ U := by simpa [hp'] using huP
  have hvU : v ∈ U := by simpa [hp'] using hvP
  rcases (show u = x ∨ v = x from by
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hxe with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl) with rfl | rfl
  · have hvU0 : v ∉ U0 := fun hvU0 =>
      (endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr) (propext ⟨fun _ => hvU0, fun _ => hxU⟩)
    by_cases hvA : v ∈ A
    · exact ⟨v, hvA, by simp⟩
    · have hvK : v ∈ (U \ A) \ U0 := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hvU, hvA⟩, hvU0⟩
      exact (hnocross u hxU v hvK hadj).elim
  · have huU0 : u ∉ U0 := fun huU0 =>
      (endsStraddle_iff.1 hstr) (propext ⟨fun _ => hxU, fun _ => huU0⟩)
    by_cases huA : u ∈ A
    · exact ⟨u, huA, by simp⟩
    · have huK : u ∈ (U \ A) \ U0 := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_sdiff.2 ⟨huU, huA⟩, huU0⟩
      exact (hnocross v hxU u huK hadj.symm).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.path_boundary_mem_cycle_boundary
statement:
lemma path_boundary_mem_cycle_boundary {U A U0 Y : Finset V}
    {G' : SimpleGraph V} (hLE : G' ≤ G)
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {p' : GraphPath G'} {c' : GraphCycle G'}
    (hp' : p'.support = U)
    (hP : p'.ProtectedAt c' A) (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges)
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ p'.boundaryEdges U0) :
    e ∈ c.boundaryEdges U0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨heP, hstr⟩ := GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.1 he
  obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
    path_boundary_outside_end_mem_A (G := G) hLE hA hU0 hY hnocross hp' he
  have heA : e ∈ p'.AIncident A := mem_AIncident_iff.2 ⟨heP, a, haA, hae⟩
  have heC' : e ∈ c'.edges := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.edges] using hP heA
  exact GraphCycle.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨by simpa [hedges'] using heC', hstr⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.boundaryEdges_reverse
statement:
lemma boundaryEdges_reverse (p : GraphPath G) (U0 : Finset V) :
    p.reverse.boundaryEdges U0 = p.boundaryEdges U0
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphPath.boundaryEdges, p.edges_reverse]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ProtectedAt_ofLE_edges
statement:
lemma ProtectedAt_ofLE_edges {G G' : SimpleGraph V} (hLE : G' ≤ G)
    {p : GraphPath G'} {c : GraphCycle G} {c' : GraphCycle G'} {A : Finset V}
    (hedges : c'.edges = c.edges) (hP : p.ProtectedAt c' A) :
    (p.ofLE hLE).ProtectedAt c A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have he' : e ∈ p.AIncident A := by
    simpa [AIncident, GraphPath.ofLE_edges] using he
  change e ∈ c.edges
  have heC' : e ∈ c'.edges := hP he'
  exact hedges ▸ heC'

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_one_return_rotate
statement:
lemma exists_one_return_rotate {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hdisjXY : Disjoint X Y)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {p' : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    {c' : GraphCycle (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    (hp' : p'.support = U) (hc' : c'.support = U)
    (hP : p'.ProtectedAt c' A) (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges)
    (hsY : p'.start ∈ Y) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)),
      q.support = U ∧ q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish = p'.finish ∧
        q.start ≠ q.finish ∧ q.ProtectedAt c' A
proof:
:= by
  let G' := suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)
  have hLE : G' ≤ G := suppressInternal_le G (A ∪ Y)
  have hdisjAY : Disjoint A Y := disjoint_A_of_saving_child hU0 hY
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (p'.boundaryEdges U0).card :=
    three_le_path_boundary_of_start_Y (G := G) (G' := G') c hc hA hU0 hY
      hnocross hdisjAY hp' hc' hP hedges' hsY h4
  have h2 : 2 ≤ (p'.boundaryEdges U0).card := le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3
  have hsU0 : p'.start ∈ U0 := hY hsY
  have hAout : Disjoint A U0 := disjoint_A_U0 hU0
  have hjoin' : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ X, G'.Adj y z := fun y hy z hx =>
    completeJoin_adj_suppressInternal (U := U) (A := A) (U0 := U0) (X := X)
      (Y := Y) hU0 hX hdisjXY hjoin hy hx
  have henterX : ∀ i, i < p'.walk.length → p'.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 →
      p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 → p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ X := by
    intro i hi h0 h1
    have he : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ p'.edges :=
      p'.crossingEdge_mem_edges hi
    have hbd : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈
        p'.boundaryEdges U0 :=
      GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he, endsStraddle_of_outside_inside h0 h1⟩
    have heC : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈
        c.boundaryEdges U0 :=
      path_boundary_mem_cycle_boundary (G := G) hLE c hc hA hU0 hY hnocross
        hp' hP hedges' hbd
    exact cycle_boundary_U0_end_mem_X (Y := Y) c hc hU0 hp hs hedges hnocross
      hstay hstartX hfinX heC (by simp) h1
  have henterA : ∀ i, i < p'.walk.length → p'.walk.getVert i ∉ U0 →
      p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 → p'.walk.getVert i ∈ A := by
    intro i hi h0 h1
    have he : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈ p'.edges :=
      p'.crossingEdge_mem_edges hi
    have hbd : s(p'.walk.getVert i, p'.walk.getVert (i + 1)) ∈
        p'.boundaryEdges U0 :=
      GraphPath.mem_boundaryEdges_iff.2 ⟨he, endsStraddle_of_outside_inside h0 h1⟩
    obtain ⟨a, haA, hae⟩ :=
      path_boundary_outside_end_mem_A (G := G) hLE hA hU0 hY hnocross hp' hbd
    have hxU : p'.walk.getVert (i + 1) ∈ U0 := h1
    have haU : a ∉ U0 := disjoint_left.1 hAout haA
    have heq := cycle_boundary_eq_ax
      (endsStraddle_of_outside_inside (U0 := U0) h0 h1) hae haU
      (by simp) hxU
    rcases (Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq) with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨hvu, _⟩
    · exact haA
    · exact (h0 (by simpa [hvu] using hxU)).elim
  obtain ⟨i, F, hyx, hi, h0, h1, haA, hxX, hst, hsup, hProt⟩ :=
    exists_returnRotate (p := p') (U0 := U0) hsU0 h2 (A := A) (X := X) (Y := Y)
      (c := c') hjoin' hsY hP hAout hY hX henterX henterA
  have hne : (F.rotate hyx).start ≠ (F.rotate hyx).finish :=
    F.rotate_start_ne_finish hyx
  refine ⟨F.rotate hyx, by simpa [hsup] using hp', ?_, ?_, hne, hProt⟩
  · simpa [hst] using haA
  · simpa [F.rotate_finish hyx]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_restore_originalA_ends
statement:
lemma exists_restore_originalA_ends {U A U0 X Y : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hU0 : U0 ⊆ U \ A) (hX : X ⊆ U0) (hY : Y ⊆ U0)
    (hdisjXY : Disjoint X Y) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (hjoin : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V))
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ U0, ∀ b ∈ (U \ A) \ U0, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {p : GraphPath G} (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A)
    (hedges : p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} = c.walk.edges.toFinset)
    (hstay : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.support ⊆ U0)
    (hstartX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.start ∈ X)
    (hfinX : ∀ Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p, Q.start ∈ U0 → Q.finish ∈ X)
    (h4 : 4 ≤ (c.boundaryEdges U0).card)
    {p' : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    {c' : GraphCycle (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y))}
    (hp' : p'.support = U) (hc' : c'.support = U)
    (hs' : p'.start ∈ A ∪ Y) (hf' : p'.finish ∈ A ∪ Y)
    (hne' : p'.start ≠ p'.finish)
    (hP' : p'.ProtectedAt c' (A ∪ Y))
    (hedges' : c'.edges = c.edges) :
    ∃ q : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)),
      q.support = U ∧ q.start ∈ A ∧ q.finish ∈ A ∧
        q.start ≠ q.finish ∧ q.ProtectedAt c' A
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : A ⊆ A ∪ Y := subset_union_left
  have hP : p'.ProtectedAt c' A := hP'.mono_set hsub
  have hdisjAY : Disjoint A Y := disjoint_A_of_saving_child hU0 hY
  by_cases hboth : p'.start ∈ A ∧ p'.finish ∈ A
  · exact ⟨p', hp', hboth.1, hboth.2, hne', hP⟩
  have hYend : p'.start ∈ Y ∨ p'.finish ∈ Y := by
    have hst : p'.start ∈ A ∨ p'.start ∈ Y := mem_union.1 hs'
    have hfn : p'.finish ∈ A ∨ p'.finish ∈ Y := mem_union.1 hf'
    rcases hst with hstA | hstY
    · rcases hfn with hfnA | hfnY
      · exact (hboth ⟨hstA, hfnA⟩).elim
      · exact Or.inr hfnY
    · exact Or.inl hstY
  
  let q0 : GraphPath (suppressInternal G (A ∪ Y)) :=
    if h : p'.start ∈ Y then p' else p'.reverse
  have hq0sup : q0.support = U := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h] using hp'
    · simpa [q0, h, GraphPath.support_reverse] using hp'
  have hq0stY : q0.start ∈ Y := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h]
    · have hfY : p'.finish ∈ Y := hYend.resolve_left h
      simpa [q0, h, GraphPath.reverse] using hfY
  have hq0P : q0.ProtectedAt c' A := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h] using hP
    · simpa [q0, h, ProtectedAt_reverse] using hP
  have hq0fin_mem : q0.finish ∈ A ∪ Y := by
    by_cases h : p'.start ∈ Y
    · simpa [q0, h] using hf'
    · simpa [q0, h, GraphPath.reverse] using hs'
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1sup, hq1st, hq1fin, hq1ne, hq1P⟩ :=
