name: Nikoghosyan.singleton_support_subset
statement:
lemma singleton_support_subset {b : V} {B : Finset V} (hb : b ∈ B) :
    (GraphPath.singleton (G := G) b).support ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  simp [GraphPath.support_singleton, hb]

name: Nikoghosyan.disjoint_support_of_subset_disjoint
proof:
:=
  disjoint_of_subset_left hp (disjoint_of_subset_right hq hdisj)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_spliceABA
statement:
lemma exists_spliceABA {A B : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (p : GraphPath G) (b : V) (q : GraphPath G)
    (hp : p.finish ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hq : q.start ∈ A)
    (hpb : b ∉ p.support) (hqB : b ∉ q.support)
    (hd : Disjoint p.support q.support) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support ∧
        r.start = p.start ∧ r.finish = q.finish
proof:
:= by
  let sb := GraphPath.singleton (G := G) b
  have hps : Disjoint p.support sb.support := by
    rw [GraphPath.support_singleton]
    exact disjoint_singleton_right.2 hpb
  have hadj1 : G.Adj p.finish sb.start := hAB hp hb
  let mid := p.splice sb hadj1 hps
  have hqs : Disjoint mid.support q.support := by
    unfold mid
    rw [GraphPath.support_splice, GraphPath.support_singleton, disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨hd, disjoint_singleton_left.2 hqB⟩
  have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (A : Set V) :=
    fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
  have hadj2 : G.Adj mid.finish q.start := hBA hb hq
  refine ⟨mid.splice q hadj2 hqs, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  ext x
  simp [mid, GraphPath.support_splice, sb, GraphPath.support_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one
statement:
lemma PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one {U : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) (h : pc.card = 1) : ∃ p, pc.paths = [p]
proof:
:= by
  match hps : pc.paths with
  | [] =>
    simp [PathCover.card, hps] at h
  | [p] =>
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  | _ :: _ :: _ =>
    simp [PathCover.card, hps] at h

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_complete_join_le_one
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_complete_join_le_one {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ 1) (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ 1) :
    pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pcA, hAcard⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) A
  obtain ⟨pcB, hBcard⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) B
  have hA0 : pathCoverNumber G A ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hAne.ne_empty ((pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff_refinement (G := G) A).mp h)
  have hB0 : pathCoverNumber G B ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hBne.ne_empty ((pathCoverNumber_eq_zero_iff_refinement (G := G) B).mp h)
  have hA1 : pcA.card = 1 := by omega
  have hB1 : pcB.card = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨p, hpApaths⟩ := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pcA hA1
  obtain ⟨q, hqBpaths⟩ := PathCover.exists_singleton_of_card_one pcB hB1
  have hp : p ∈ pcA.paths := by simp [hpApaths]
  have hq : q ∈ pcB.paths := by simp [hqBpaths]
  have hpAsupp : p.support ⊆ A := pcA.support_subset hp
  have hqBsupp : q.support ⊆ B := pcB.support_subset hq
  have hd := disjoint_support_of_subset_disjoint
    (disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB) hpAsupp hqBsupp
  let r := spliceJoin hAB p q hpAsupp hqBsupp hd
  have hr : r.support = p.support ∪ q.support :=
    support_spliceJoin hAB p q hpAsupp hqBsupp hd
  let pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B) :=
    { paths := [r]
      disjoint := List.pairwise_singleton _ _
      mem_iff := by
        intro x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxA | hxB
          · obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (pcA.mem_iff x).1 hxA
            have : t = p := by simpa [hpApaths] using ht
            subst this
            refine ⟨r, List.mem_singleton.2 rfl, ?_⟩
            rw [hr]
            exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxt)
          · obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (pcB.mem_iff x).1 hxB
            have : t = q := by simpa [hqBpaths] using ht
            subst this
            refine ⟨r, List.mem_singleton.2 rfl, ?_⟩
            rw [hr]
            exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxt)
        · intro ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩
          have : t = r := List.mem_singleton.1 ht
          subst this
          have hxt' : x ∈ p.support ∪ q.support := by
            rwa [hr] at hxt
          rcases mem_union.1 hxt' with hxP | hxQ
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl ((pcA.mem_iff x).2 ⟨p, hp, hxP⟩))
          · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr ((pcB.mem_iff x).2 ⟨q, hq, hxQ⟩)) }
  have hpc1 : pc.card = 1 := rfl
  exact (pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc).trans_eq hpc1

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.cast_card
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cast_card {U W : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) (h : U = W) :
    (pc.cast h).card = pc.card
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.cast_paths
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cast_paths {U W : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) (h : U = W) :
    (pc.cast h).paths = pc.paths
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.exists_two_distinct
statement:
lemma exists_two_distinct {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (h : 2 ≤ pc.card) :
    ∃ p q, p ∈ pc.paths ∧ q ∈ pc.paths ∧ p ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  match hps : pc.paths with
  | [] =>
    simp [PathCover.card, hps] at h
  | [_] =>
    simp [PathCover.card, hps] at h
  | p :: q :: rest =>
    refine ⟨p, q, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
    have hn := pc.nodup_paths
    rw [hps] at hn
    intro hpq
    subst hpq
    exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hn).1 (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.length_filter_ne_two
statement:
lemma length_filter_ne_two {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {l : List α}
    (ha : a ∈ l) (hb : b ∈ l) (hne : a ≠ b) (hn : l.Nodup) :
    ((l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)).filter fun x => decide (x ≠ b)).length
      = l.length - 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := a) (l := l) ha hn
  have hb' : b ∈ l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a) :=
    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hb, decide_eq_true hne.symm⟩
  have hn' : (l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)).Nodup := List.Nodup.filter _ hn
  have h2 := length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := b)
    (l := l.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ a)) hb' hn'
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.erasePath_card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [erasePath, PathCover.card] using
    length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := p) (l := pc.paths) hp pc.nodup_paths

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.spliceTwoInsert_card
statement:
lemma spliceTwoInsert_card {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (b : V) (hb : b ∉ U) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support) :
    (pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne b hb r hr).card = pc.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := length_filter_ne_two (a := p) (b := q) hp hq hne pc.nodup_paths
  have hfilt :=
    length_filter_ne_of_mem_nodup (a := p) (l := pc.paths) hp pc.nodup_paths
  have hb' : q ∈ pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p) :=
    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, decide_eq_true hne.symm⟩
  have hpos : 2 ≤ pc.paths.length := by
    have : 1 ≤ (pc.paths.filter fun x => decide (x ≠ p)).length :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (List.length_pos_of_mem hb')
    omega
  simp only [spliceTwoInsert, PathCover.card, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
    List.length_nil]
  rw [hlen]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.PathCover.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths
statement:
lemma spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    {p q : GraphPath G} (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) (hq : q ∈ pc.paths) (hne : p ≠ q)
    (b : V) (hb : b ∉ U) (r : GraphPath G)
    (hr : r.support = p.support ∪ {b} ∪ q.support)
    {s : GraphPath G}
    (hs : s ∈ (pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne b hb r hr).paths) :
    s = r ∨
      s ∈ pc.paths ∧ s ≠ p ∧ s ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  have hs' := List.mem_append.1 hs
  rcases hs' with hsL | hsR
  · have hs1 := List.mem_filter.1 hsL
    have hs0 := List.mem_filter.1 hs1.1
    exact Or.inr ⟨hs0.1, of_decide_eq_true hs0.2, of_decide_eq_true hs1.2⟩
  · exact Or.inl (List.mem_singleton.1 hsR)

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_splice_two_through
statement:
lemma exists_splice_two_through {A B U : Finset V} {b : V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (pc : PathCover G U) (h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card)
    (hend : ∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
    (hb : b ∈ B) (hbU : b ∉ U) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (insert b U),
      pc'.card = pc.card - 1 ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hne⟩ := pc.exists_two_distinct h2
  have hpb : b ∉ p.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hp h)
  have hqb : b ∉ q.support := fun h => hbU (pc.support_subset hq h)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_spliceABA hAB p b q (hend p hp).2 hb (hend q hq).1 hpb hqb
      (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hp hq hne)
  refine ⟨pc.spliceTwoInsert hp hq hne b hbU r hr, pc.spliceTwoInsert_card hp hq hne b hbU r hr, ?_⟩
  intro s hsmem
  rcases pc.spliceTwoInsert_mem_paths hp hq hne b hbU r hr hsmem with hseq | ⟨hspc, _, _⟩
  · subst hseq
    rw [hs, hf]
    exact ⟨(hend p hp).1, (hend q hq).2⟩
  · exact hend s hspc

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc0, h0⟩ := exists_min_pathCover (G := G) A
  have hend0 : ∀ p ∈ pc0.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨pc0.support_subset hp p.start_mem_support,
      pc0.support_subset hp p.finish_mem_support⟩
  have aux :
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (pc : PathCover G (A ∪ S)),
        S ⊆ B → (B \ S).card = k →
          pc.card = pathCoverNumber G A - S.card →
            (∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) →
              ∃ pc' : PathCover G (A ∪ B),
                pc'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - B.card ∧
                  (∀ p ∈ pc'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro S pc hS hk hcard hend
      have hBS : B \ S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hk
      have hBeq : S = B :=
        subset_antisymm hS (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mp hBS)
      subst hBeq
      exact ⟨pc, hcard, hend⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro S pc hS hk hcard hend
      have hne : (B \ S).Nonempty :=
        card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (B \ S).card)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hne
      have hbB : b ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
      have hbS : b ∉ S := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
      have hdisjAB := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
      have hbU : b ∉ A ∪ S := by
        intro h
        rcases mem_union.1 h with hA | hS'
        · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjAB hA hbB
        · exact hbS hS'
      have hsum : S.card + (B \ S).card = B.card := by
        rw [← card_union_of_disjoint, union_sdiff_of_subset hS]
        exact disjoint_sdiff
      have h2 : 2 ≤ pc.card := by omega
      obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hend1⟩ :=
        exists_splice_two_through hAB pc h2 hend hbB hbU
      have hU : insert b (A ∪ S) = A ∪ insert b S := by
        ext x
        simp [mem_insert, mem_union]
      let pc1' : PathCover G (A ∪ insert b S) := pc1.cast hU
      have hS' : insert b S ⊆ B := insert_subset hbB hS
      have hrem : B \ insert b S = (B \ S).erase b := sdiff_insert B S b
      have hk' : (B \ insert b S).card = k := by
        rw [hrem, card_erase_of_mem hb, hk]
        omega
      have hcard' : pc1'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (insert b S).card := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_card, hcard1, hcard, card_insert_of_notMem hbS]
        omega
      have hend1' : ∀ p ∈ pc1'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A := by
        intro p hp
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc1 hU] at hp
        exact hend1 p hp
      exact ih (insert b S) pc1' hS' hk' hcard' hend1'
  have hA : A ∪ (∅ : Finset V) = A := union_empty A
  let pc0' : PathCover G (A ∪ ∅) := pc0.cast hA.symm
  have hcard0 : pc0'.card = pathCoverNumber G A - (∅ : Finset V).card := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, h0, card_empty, Nat.sub_zero]
  have hend0' : ∀ p ∈ pc0'.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A := by
    intro p hp
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths pc0 hA.symm] at hp
    exact hend0 p hp
  exact aux B.card ∅ pc0' (empty_subset B) (by simp) hcard0 hend0'

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_alternating_path
statement:
lemma exists_alternating_path :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (A B : Finset V)
      (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
      (pcA : PathCover G A) (pcB : PathCover G B),
      pcA.card = n → pcB.card = n → 1 ≤ n →
        ∃ r : GraphPath G, r.support = A ∪ B ∧ r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro A B hAB pcA pcB hAn hBn hpos
    match hA : pcA.paths, hB : pcB.paths with
    | [], _ =>
      simp [PathCover.card, hA] at hAn
      omega
    | _, [] =>
      simp [PathCover.card, hB] at hBn
      omega
    | p :: _ps, q :: _qs =>
      have hp : p ∈ pcA.paths := by simp [hA]
      have hq : q ∈ pcB.paths := by simp [hB]
      have hpAsupp : p.support ⊆ A := pcA.support_subset hp
      have hqBsupp : q.support ⊆ B := pcB.support_subset hq
      have hd :=
        disjoint_support_of_subset_disjoint
          (disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB) hpAsupp hqBsupp
      by_cases h1 : n = 1
      · have hps : pcA.paths = [p] := by
          have hlen : pcA.paths.length = 1 := by
            simpa [PathCover.card, hA] using hAn.trans h1
          simpa [hA] using List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
        have hqs : pcB.paths = [q] := by
          have hlen : pcB.paths.length = 1 := by
            simpa [PathCover.card, hB] using hBn.trans h1
          simpa [hB] using List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
        have hAeq : p.support = A := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            exact hpAsupp hx
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (pcA.mem_iff x).1 hx
            have : t = p := by simpa [hps] using ht
            subst this
            exact hxt
        have hBeq : q.support = B := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            exact hqBsupp hx
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := (pcB.mem_iff x).1 hx
            have : t = q := by simpa [hqs] using ht
            subst this
            exact hxt
        refine ⟨spliceJoin hAB p q hpAsupp hqBsupp hd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [support_spliceJoin, hAeq, hBeq]
        · simpa [start_spliceJoin] using hpAsupp p.start_mem_support
        · simpa [finish_spliceJoin] using hqBsupp q.finish_mem_support
      · have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
        let pcA' := pcA.erasePath hp
        let pcB' := pcB.erasePath hq
        have hAcard : pcA'.card = n - 1 := by
          rw [PathCover.erasePath_card, hAn]
        have hBcard : pcB'.card = n - 1 := by
          rw [PathCover.erasePath_card, hBn]
        have hpos' : 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
        have hAB' :
            G.IsCompleteBetween (↑(A \ p.support) : Set V)
              (↑(B \ q.support) : Set V) := by
          intro a ha b hb
          have haF : a ∈ A \ p.support := by exact_mod_cast ha
          have hbF : b ∈ B \ q.support := by exact_mod_cast hb
          exact hAB (mem_sdiff.1 haF).1 (mem_sdiff.1 hbF).1
        obtain ⟨r', hr', hs', hf'⟩ :=
          ih (n - 1) (Nat.sub_lt (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hpos) Nat.zero_lt_one)
            (A \ p.support) (B \ q.support) hAB' pcA' pcB' hAcard hBcard hpos'
        let r0 := spliceJoin hAB p q hpAsupp hqBsupp hd
        have hr0 : r0.support = p.support ∪ q.support :=
          support_spliceJoin hAB p q hpAsupp hqBsupp hd
        have hf0 : r0.finish = q.finish :=
          finish_spliceJoin hAB p q hpAsupp hqBsupp hd
        have hadj : G.Adj r0.finish r'.start := by
          have hfinB : r0.finish ∈ B := by
            simpa [hf0] using hqBsupp q.finish_mem_support
          have hstA : r'.start ∈ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hs').1
          exact (hAB hstA hfinB).symm
        have hd' : Disjoint r0.support r'.support := by
          rw [hr0, hr']
          refine disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · refine disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨disjoint_sdiff, ?_⟩
            exact disjoint_of_subset_left hpAsupp
              (disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset
                (disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB))
          · refine disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨?_, disjoint_sdiff⟩
            exact disjoint_of_subset_left hqBsupp
              (disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset
                (disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB).symm)
        let r := r0.splice r' hadj hd'
        refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [GraphPath.support_splice, hr0, hr']
          have hAeq : p.support ∪ (A \ p.support) = A :=
            union_sdiff_of_subset hpAsupp
          have hBeq : q.support ∪ (B \ q.support) = B :=
            union_sdiff_of_subset hqBsupp
          have hrearr :
              p.support ∪ q.support ∪ ((A \ p.support) ∪ (B \ q.support)) =
                (p.support ∪ (A \ p.support)) ∪
                  (q.support ∪ (B \ q.support)) := by
            ext x
            simp only [Finset.mem_union]
            tauto
          rw [hrearr, hAeq, hBeq]
        · change r0.start ∈ A
          rw [start_spliceJoin]
          exact hpAsupp p.start_mem_support
        · change r'.finish ∈ B
          exact sdiff_subset hf'

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_complete_join_spanning_path
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_spanning_path {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (_hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G, r.support = A ∪ B ∧ r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  let M := max (pathCoverNumber G A) (pathCoverNumber G B)
  have hMpos : 1 ≤ M := by
    have : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A :=
      one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hAne
    omega
  have hMA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ M := Nat.le_max_left _ _
  have hMB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ M := Nat.le_max_right _ _
  have hMAcard : M ≤ A.card := by
    have := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) A
    omega
  have hMBcard : M ≤ B.card := by
    have := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) B
    omega
  obtain ⟨pcA, hA⟩ := exists_pathCover_card (G := G) A hMA hMAcard
  obtain ⟨pcB, hB⟩ := exists_pathCover_card (G := G) B hMB hMBcard
  exact exists_alternating_path M A B hAB pcA pcB hA hB hMpos

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_complete_join_le_of_balanced
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_complete_join_le_of_balanced {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card) :
    pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_spanning_path hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
  let pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B) := (PathCover.ofPath r).cast hr
  have hpc : pc.card = 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
  exact (pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc).trans_eq hpc

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_complete_join_cycle
statement:
lemma exists_complete_join_cycle {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ (A ∪ B).card) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = A ∪ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_spanning_path hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
  have hadj : G.Adj r.finish r.start := (hAB hs hf).symm
  have h3' : 3 ≤ r.support.card := by simpa [hr]
  refine ⟨r.toCycle hadj h3', ?_⟩
  simpa [GraphPath.support_toCycle] using hr

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hsub : B ⊆ A ∪ B := subset_union_right
  have h := pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le (G := G) (A ∪ B) B hsub
  have hEq : (A ∪ B) \ B = A := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with ⟨hA | hB, hnB⟩
      · exact hA
      · exact (hnB hB).elim
    · intro hxA
      exact ⟨Or.inl hxA, fun hxB => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA hxB⟩
  simpa [hEq] using h

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub_symm
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (A : Set V) :=
    fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
  simpa [union_comm] using pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub hBA

name: Nikoghosyan.not_both_dominant
proof:
:= by
  have hpA := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) A
  have hpB := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) B
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.pathCoverNumber_complete_join
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_complete_join {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :
    pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) =
      max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
        (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_cases hAdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A
    · obtain ⟨pc, hpc, _⟩ :=
        exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant hAB hAdom
      have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
      have hpB := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) B
      have hpA := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) A
      have hBnot : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := by
        by_contra h
        exact not_both_dominant hAdom (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
      have hq : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by omega
      have hmax :
          max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
            (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) =
          pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by
        simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hBnot, max_eq_right hq]
      exact hle.trans_eq (hpc.trans hmax.symm)
    · by_cases hBdom : A.card < pathCoverNumber G B
      · have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (A : Set V) :=
          fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
        obtain ⟨pc, hpc, _⟩ :=
          exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant hBA hBdom
        have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
        have hAnot : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hAdom
        have hq : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G B - A.card := by omega
        have hmax :
            max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
              (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) =
            pathCoverNumber G B - A.card := by
          simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hAnot, max_eq_right hq]
        have : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G B - A.card := by
          simpa [union_comm] using hpc
        have hle' : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ≤ pc.card := by
          simpa [union_comm] using hle
        exact hle'.trans_eq (this.trans hmax.symm)
      · have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hAdom
        have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hBdom
        have hle :=
          pathCoverNumber_complete_join_le_of_balanced hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
        have hmax :
            max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
              (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) = 1 := by
          simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpA, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpB]
        exact hle.trans_eq hmax.symm
  · have h1 : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) :=
      one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) (hAne.mono subset_union_left)
    have hA := pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub hAB
    have hB := pathCoverNumber_complete_join_ge_sub_symm hAB
    exact max_le h1
      (max_le (Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.2 hA) (Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.2 hB))

name: Nikoghosyan.Eligible.of_min_cover_endpoint
statement:
lemma Eligible.of_min_cover_endpoint {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U)
    (hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G U) {p : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p ∈ pc.paths) :
    Eligible G U p.start ∧ Eligible G U p.finish
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, Or.inl rfl⟩, ⟨pc, hpc, p, hp, Or.inr rfl⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_eligible_complete_join_of_balanced
statement:
lemma exists_eligible_complete_join_of_balanced {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card) :
    ∃ x y, x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ B ∧ Eligible G (A ∪ B) x ∧ Eligible G (A ∪ B) y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_spanning_path hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
  let pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B) := (PathCover.ofPath r).cast hr
  have hcard : pc.card = 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAne
    have hU : (A ∪ B).Nonempty := ⟨a, mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)⟩
    have hge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hU
    omega
  have hp : r ∈ pc.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
  have hends := Eligible.of_min_cover_endpoint pc hmin hp
  exact ⟨r.start, r.finish, hs, hf, hends.1, hends.2⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.exists_A_ended_min_cover_of_dominant
statement:
lemma exists_A_ended_min_cover_of_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B),
      pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ pc.paths, p.start ∈ A ∧ p.finish ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pc, hpc, hend⟩ := exists_pathCover_complete_join_dominant hAB hdom
  have heq : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
    have hj := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hAne hBne hAB
    have hBnot : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := by
      by_contra h
      exact not_both_dominant hdom (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hq : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by omega
    have hmax :
        max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
          (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) =
        pathCoverNumber G A - B.card := by
      simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hBnot, max_eq_right hq]
    omega
  exact ⟨pc, heq, hend⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_singleton
statement: lemma pathCoverNumber_singleton (v : V) : pathCoverNumber G {v} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) {v}
  have hge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) (singleton_nonempty v)
  simpa [card_singleton] using (le_antisymm hle hge)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_singleton
statement: lemma eligible_singleton (v : V) : Eligible G {v} v
proof:
:= by
  let p := GraphPath.singleton (G := G) v
  have hp : p.support = {v} := GraphPath.support_singleton v
  let pc : PathCover G {v} := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hp
  have hcard : pc.card = 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G {v} := by
    rw [hcard, pathCoverNumber_singleton]
  have hmem : p ∈ pc.paths := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
  exact ⟨pc, hmin, p, hmem, Or.inl rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_singleton
statement: lemma eligibleSet_singleton (v : V) : eligibleSet G {v} = {v}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) {v}) hx
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x = v := mem_singleton.1 hx
    rw [hx']
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨mem_singleton_self v, eligible_singleton v⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_empty
statement: lemma ineligibleSet_empty : ineligibleSet G (∅ : Finset V) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [ineligibleSet]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_singleton
statement: lemma ineligibleSet_singleton (v : V) : ineligibleSet G {v} = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff] at hx
    have hx' : x = v := mem_singleton.1 hx.1
    rw [hx'] at hx
    exact (hx.2 (eligible_singleton v)).elim
  · intro hx
    exact (notMem_empty x hx).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_eq_one_of_connected
proof:
:= by
  have hneU : Nonempty (U : Set V) := hU.to_subtype
  have hne : Nonempty (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨(G.induce (U : Set V)).connectedComponentMk ⟨hU.choose, hU.choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hss : Subsingleton (G.induce (U : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    hc.preconnected.subsingleton_connectedComponent
  exact Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨hss, hne⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.induce_connected_of_completeJoin
statement:
lemma induce_connected_of_completeJoin {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :
    (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V) :=
    (hAne.mono subset_union_left).to_subtype
  refine (connected_iff _).2 ⟨?_, inferInstance⟩
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAne
  have hbU : b ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hb)
  have haU : a ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union.2 (Or.inl ha)
  let b' : ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V) := ⟨b, hbU⟩
  let a' : ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V) := ⟨a, haU⟩
  have reach (z : ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)) :
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable z b' := by
    rcases mem_union.1 z.property with hzA | hzB
    · exact Adj.reachable <| by simpa [induce_adj] using hAB hzA hb
    · by_cases hzb : z.val = b
      · have : z = b' := Subtype.ext hzb
        simpa [this] using
          Reachable.rfl (G := G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)) (x := z)
      · have hz_to_a : (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Adj z a' := by
          simpa [induce_adj] using (hAB ha hzB).symm
        have ha_to_b : (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Adj a' b' := by
          simpa [induce_adj] using hAB ha hb
        exact (Adj.reachable hz_to_a).trans ha_to_b.reachable
  exact (reach x).trans (reach y).symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_complete_join
statement:
lemma componentCount_complete_join {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :
    componentCount G (A ∪ B) = 1
proof:
:=
  componentCount_eq_one_of_connected (hAne.mono subset_union_left)
    (induce_connected_of_completeJoin hAne hBne hAB)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_left_of_induce_walk
statement:
lemma mem_left_of_induce_walk {A B : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)} (hx : x.val ∈ A) :
    (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Walk x y → y.val ∈ A
proof:
| .nil => hx
  | .cons (v := mid) hadj p => by
      have hadjG : G.Adj x.val mid.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
      have hvA : mid.val ∈ A := by
        rcases mem_union.1 mid.property with hA | hB
        · exact hA
        · exact (hnocross x.val hx mid.val hB hadjG).elim
      exact mem_left_of_induce_walk hnocross hvA p

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_left_of_induce_reachable
statement:
lemma mem_left_of_induce_reachable {A B : Finset V}

    {x y : ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)} (hx : x.val ∈ A)
    (hreach : (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Reachable x y) :
    y.val ∈ A
proof:
:=
  mem_left_of_induce_walk hnocross hx (Classical.choice hreach)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.induce_reachable_of_mem_left_walk
statement:
lemma induce_reachable_of_mem_left_walk {A B : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)
    {x y : ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)} (hx : x.val ∈ A) (hy : y.val ∈ A)
    (p : (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).Walk x y) :
    (G.induce (A : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x.val, hx⟩ ⟨y.val, hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact Reachable.rfl
  | cons hadj q =>
      rename_i mid
      have hadjG : G.Adj x.val mid.val := by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj
      have hvA : mid.val ∈ A := by
        rcases mem_union.1 mid.property with hA | hB
        · exact hA
        · exact (hnocross x.val hx mid.val hB hadjG).elim
      have hfirst : (G.induce (A : Set V)).Reachable ⟨x.val, hx⟩ ⟨mid.val, hvA⟩ :=
        Adj.reachable (by simpa [induce_adj] using hadjG)
      have hrest := induce_reachable_of_mem_left_walk hnocross hvA hy q
      exact hfirst.trans hrest

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.induce_reachable_of_mem_left
statement:
lemma induce_reachable_of_mem_left {A B : Finset V}
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b)

statement:
lemma mem_right_of_induce_walk {A B : Finset V}

lemma mem_right_of_induce_reachable {A B : Finset V}

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_union_of_no_cross
statement:
lemma componentCount_union_of_no_cross {A B : Finset V}
    (_hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    componentCount G (A ∪ B) = componentCount G A + componentCount G B
proof:
:= by
  have hle := componentCount_union_le (G := G) A B
  let g : (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ⊕
        (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent →
      (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent
    | .inl C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_left (s₁ := A)))
    | .inr C => C.map (induceIncl G (subset_union_right (s₁ := A)))
  have hg : Function.Injective g := by
    intro x y hxy
    match x, y with
    | .inl C, .inl D =>
      apply congrArg Sum.inl
      revert hxy
      refine C.ind fun u => ?_
      refine D.ind fun v => ?_
      intro hxy
      have hreach := ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (by
        simpa [g, ConnectedComponent.map_mk] using hxy)
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound
        (induce_reachable_of_mem_left hnocross
          (by exact u.property) (by exact v.property) hreach)
    | .inr C, .inr D =>
      apply congrArg Sum.inr
      revert hxy
      refine C.ind fun u => ?_
      refine D.ind fun v => ?_
      intro hxy
      have hreach := ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (by
        simpa [g, ConnectedComponent.map_mk] using hxy)
      exact ConnectedComponent.sound
        (induce_reachable_of_mem_right hnocross
          (by exact u.property) (by exact v.property) hreach)
    | .inl C, .inr D =>
      exfalso
      revert hxy
      refine C.ind fun u => ?_
      refine D.ind fun v => ?_
      intro hxy
      have hreach := ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (by
        simpa [g, ConnectedComponent.map_mk] using hxy)
      have hvA := mem_left_of_induce_reachable hnocross
        (by exact u.property) hreach
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 _hdisj hvA v.property
    | .inr C, .inl D =>
      exfalso
      revert hxy
      refine C.ind fun u => ?_
      refine D.ind fun v => ?_
      intro hxy
      have hreach := ConnectedComponent.eq.mp (by
        simpa [g, ConnectedComponent.map_mk] using hxy)
      have hvA := mem_left_of_induce_reachable hnocross
        (by exact v.property) hreach.symm
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 _hdisj hvA u.property
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (A : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent := inferInstance
  haveI : Fintype (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent :=
    inferInstance
  have hge : componentCount G A + componentCount G B ≤ componentCount G (A ∪ B) := by
    simpa [componentCount, Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      Nat.card_le_card_of_injective g hg
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_start_of_internal
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_path_start_of_internal {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (r : GraphPath G) (hr : r.support = U)
    (hadj : G.Adj r.finish r.start)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hs : x ≠ r.start) (hf : x ≠ r.finish) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = U ∧ p.start = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ r.support := by simpa [hr] using hx
  have hnilT : ¬ (r.takeUntil hx').walk.Nil := by
    intro hnil
    exact hs ((GraphPath.takeUntil_nil_iff r hx').1 hnil)
  let left := r.dropUntil hx'
  let right := (r.takeUntil hx').trimFinish hnilT
  have hdisj : Disjoint left.support right.support := by
    rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hyL : y ∈ (r.dropUntil hx').support := (mem_inter.1 hy).1
      have hyR : y ∈ right.support := (mem_inter.1 hy).2
      have hyR' : y ∈ (r.takeUntil hx').support.erase (r.takeUntil hx').finish := by
        simpa [right, GraphPath.support_trimFinish] using hyR
      have hinter := GraphPath.inter_support_takeUntil_dropUntil_subset r hx'
      have hyx : y ∈ ({x} : Finset V) := by
        have : y ∈ (r.takeUntil hx').support ∩ (r.dropUntil hx').support :=
          mem_inter.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hyR').2, hyL⟩
        simpa [GraphPath.takeUntil] using hinter this
      have hyne : y ≠ x := by
        have : y ≠ (r.takeUntil hx').finish := (mem_erase.1 hyR').1
        simpa [GraphPath.takeUntil] using this
      exact (hyne (mem_singleton.1 hyx)).elim
    · intro hy
      exact (notMem_empty y hy).elim
  have hadj' : G.Adj left.finish right.start := by
    have : right.start = r.start := by
      simp [right, GraphPath.trimFinish_start, GraphPath.takeUntil]
    have : left.finish = r.finish := by
      simp [left, GraphPath.dropUntil]
    simpa [left, right, GraphPath.trimFinish_start, GraphPath.takeUntil,
      GraphPath.dropUntil] using hadj
  let p := left.splice right hadj' hdisj
  have hstart : p.start = x := by
    change left.start = x
    simp [left, GraphPath.dropUntil]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hstart⟩
  have hxD : x ∈ left.support := by
    have : left.start = x := by simp [left, GraphPath.dropUntil]
    simpa [this] using left.start_mem_support
  have hR : right.support = (r.takeUntil hx').support.erase x := by
    simp [right, GraphPath.support_trimFinish, GraphPath.takeUntil]
  have hTD := GraphPath.support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil r hx'
  have hunion : left.support ∪ right.support = r.support := by
    rw [hR]
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      rcases mem_union.1 hy with hyL | hyR
      · have : y ∈ (r.takeUntil hx').support ∪ (r.dropUntil hx').support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inr (by simpa [left] using hyL))
        rwa [hTD] at this
      · have hyT : y ∈ (r.takeUntil hx').support := (mem_erase.1 hyR).2
        have : y ∈ (r.takeUntil hx').support ∪ (r.dropUntil hx').support :=
          mem_union.2 (Or.inl hyT)
        rwa [hTD] at this
    · intro hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (r.takeUntil hx').support ∪ (r.dropUntil hx').support := by
        rw [hTD]
        simpa [hr] using hy
      rcases mem_union.1 hy' with hyT | hyD
      · by_cases hyx : y = x
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by simpa [hyx] using hxD))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_erase.2 ⟨hyx, hyT⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (by simpa [left] using hyD))
  simpa [p, GraphPath.support_splice, hr] using hunion

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_of_complete_join_balanced
statement:
lemma eligible_of_complete_join_balanced {A B : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card)
    (hx : x ∈ A ∪ B) : Eligible G (A ∪ B) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_spanning_path hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
  have hmin_of (p : GraphPath G) (hp : p.support = A ∪ B) :
      Eligible G (A ∪ B) p.start ∧ Eligible G (A ∪ B) p.finish := by
    let pc : PathCover G (A ∪ B) := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hp
    have hcard : pc.card = 1 := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
    have hpc : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) := by
      have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
      have hge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) (U := A ∪ B)
        (hAne.mono (subset_union_left (s₂ := B)))
      omega
    have hmem : p ∈ pc.paths := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
      exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
    exact Eligible.of_min_cover_endpoint pc hpc hmem
  by_cases hxs : x = r.start
  · simpa [hxs] using (hmin_of r hr).1
  by_cases hxf : x = r.finish
  · simpa [hxf] using (hmin_of r hr).2
  have hadj : G.Adj r.finish r.start := (hAB hs hf).symm
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hstart⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_path_start_of_internal (U := A ∪ B) r hr hadj hx hxs hxf
  simpa [hstart] using (hmin_of p hp).1

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligibleSet_complete_join_balanced
statement:
lemma eligibleSet_complete_join_balanced {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card) :
    eligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = A ∪ B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) (A ∪ B)) hx
  · intro hx
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2
      ⟨hx, eligible_of_complete_join_balanced hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB hx⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_complete_join_balanced
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_complete_join_balanced {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card)
    (hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card) :
    ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_ineligibleSet_iff] at hx
    exact (hx.2 (eligible_of_complete_join_balanced hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB hx.1)).elim
  · intro hx
    exact (notMem_empty x hx).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant
statement:
lemma card_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant {A B : Finset V}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A) :
    (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B)).card =
      B.card + (ineligibleSet G A).card
proof:
:= by
  have hF := ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hdom
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_completeBetween hAB
  have hdisjF : Disjoint B (ineligibleSet G A) := by
    rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
        (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A (mem_inter.1 hx).2)
        (mem_inter.1 hx).1).elim
    · intro hx
      exact (notMem_empty x hx).elim
  rw [hF, card_union_of_disjoint hdisjF]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_ineligible_disjoint_union
statement:
lemma sdiff_ineligible_disjoint_union {A B : Finset V}
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    (hnocross : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    (A ∪ B) \ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) =
      (A \ ineligibleSet G A) ∪ (B \ ineligibleSet G B)
proof:
:= by
  have hF := ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxU : x ∈ A ∪ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1
    have hnot : x ∉ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) := (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2
    have hnot' : x ∉ ineligibleSet G A ∪ ineligibleSet G B := by rwa [hF] at hnot
    rcases mem_union.1 hxU with hxA | hxB
    · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxA, ?_⟩))
      intro hFA
      exact hnot' (mem_union.2 (Or.inl hFA))
    · refine mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hxB, ?_⟩))
      intro hFB
      exact hnot' (mem_union.2 (Or.inr hFB))
  · intro hx
    rcases mem_union.1 hx with hxA | hxB
    · have hxA' : x ∈ A := (mem_sdiff.1 hxA).1
      have hxFA : x ∉ ineligibleSet G A := (mem_sdiff.1 hxA).2
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inl hxA'), ?_⟩
      intro hF
      have hF' : x ∈ ineligibleSet G A ∪ ineligibleSet G B := by rwa
        [ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross] at hF
      rcases mem_union.1 hF' with hA | hB
      · exact hxFA hA
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxA'
          (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B hB)
    · have hxB' : x ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 hxB).1
      have hxFB : x ∉ ineligibleSet G B := (mem_sdiff.1 hxB).2
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_union.2 (Or.inr hxB'), ?_⟩
      intro hF
      have hF' : x ∈ ineligibleSet G A ∪ ineligibleSet G B := by rwa
        [ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross] at hF
      rcases mem_union.1 hF' with hA | hB
      · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj
          (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A hA) hxB'
      · exact hxFB hB

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq
statement:
lemma componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq {U : Finset V}
    (h : CotreeOn G U) :
    componentCount G (U \ ineligibleSet G U) =
      (ineligibleSet G U).card + pathCoverNumber G U
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | empty =>
    simp [ineligibleSet_empty, pathCoverNumber_empty, componentCount_empty]
  | singleton v =>
    simp [ineligibleSet_singleton, pathCoverNumber_singleton,
      componentCount_singleton]
  | disjointUnion hdisj hnocross hA hB ihA ihB =>
    rename_i A B
    have hF := ineligibleSet_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
    have hp := pathCoverNumber_disjoint_union (G := G) hdisj hnocross
    have hrem := sdiff_ineligible_disjoint_union hdisj hnocross
    have hdisjRem :
        Disjoint (A \ ineligibleSet G A) (B \ ineligibleSet G B) :=
      disjoint_of_subset_left sdiff_subset
        (disjoint_of_subset_right sdiff_subset hdisj)
    have hnocrossRem :
        ∀ a ∈ A \ ineligibleSet G A, ∀ b ∈ B \ ineligibleSet G B, ¬ G.Adj a b :=
      fun a ha b hb =>
        hnocross a (mem_sdiff.1 ha).1 b (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
    have hadd :=
      componentCount_union_of_no_cross hdisjRem hnocrossRem
    have hcardF :
        (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B)).card =
          (ineligibleSet G A).card + (ineligibleSet G B).card := by
      have hdisjF :
          Disjoint (ineligibleSet G A) (ineligibleSet G B) :=
        disjoint_of_subset_left (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) A)
          (disjoint_of_subset_right (ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) B) hdisj)
      rw [hF, card_union_of_disjoint hdisjF]
    rw [hrem, hadd, ihA, ihB, hcardF, hp]
    omega
  | completeJoin hAne hBne hAB hA hB ihA ihB =>
    rename_i A B
    by_cases hAdom : B.card < pathCoverNumber G A
    · have hrem := sdiff_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
      have hcard :=
        card_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
      have hp := pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hAne hBne hAB hAdom
      rw [hrem, ihA, hcard, hp]
      omega
    · by_cases hBdom : A.card < pathCoverNumber G B
      · have hBA : G.IsCompleteBetween (B : Set V) (A : Set V) :=
          fun {b} hb {a} ha => (hAB ha hb).symm
        have hrem : (A ∪ B) \ ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B) =
            B \ ineligibleSet G B := by
          simpa [union_comm] using
            sdiff_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
        have hcard : (ineligibleSet G (A ∪ B)).card =
            A.card + (ineligibleSet G B).card := by
          simpa [union_comm] using
            card_ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
        have hp : pathCoverNumber G B =
            pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) + A.card := by
          simpa [union_comm] using
            pathCoverNumber_add_card_of_dominant hBne hAne hBA hBdom
        rw [hrem, ihB, hcard, hp]
        omega
      · have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ B.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hAdom
        have hpB : pathCoverNumber G B ≤ A.card := Nat.le_of_not_gt hBdom
        have hF := ineligibleSet_complete_join_balanced hAne hBne hAB hpA hpB
        have hp := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hAne hBne hAB
        have hmax :
            max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - B.card)
              (pathCoverNumber G B - A.card)) = 1 := by
          simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpA, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hpB]
        have hp1 : pathCoverNumber G (A ∪ B) = 1 := hp.trans hmax
        rw [hF, sdiff_empty, hp1, card_empty,
          componentCount_complete_join hAne hBne hAB]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_is_largest_attaining_cut
statement:
lemma ineligibleSet_is_largest_attaining_cut {U : Finset V}
    (h : CotreeOn G U) :
    componentCount G (U \ ineligibleSet G U) =
      pathCoverNumber G U + (ineligibleSet G U).card ∧
    (∀ X, X ⊆ U →
      componentCount G (U \ X) = pathCoverNumber G U + X.card →
        X ⊆ ineligibleSet G U) ∧
    (∀ X, X ⊆ U →
      componentCount G (U \ X) = pathCoverNumber G U + X.card →
        X.card ≤ (ineligibleSet G U).card)
proof:
:= by
  have hid := componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq h
  refine ⟨by rw [hid, add_comm], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X hX heq
    exact eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible hX heq
  · intro X hX heq
    exact card_le_card (eq_cut_bound_imp_subset_ineligible hX heq)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.fcut_int_eq_zero

lemma fcut_int_eq_zero {U : Finset V} (h : CotreeOn G U) :

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.unionList_cons
statement:
lemma unionList_cons (a : Finset V) (t : List (Finset V)) :
    unionList (a :: t) = a ∪ unionList t
proof: := rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.subset_unionList_of_mem
statement:
lemma subset_unionList_of_mem {xs : List (Finset V)} {A : Finset V}
    (h : A ∈ xs) : A ⊆ unionList xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons b t ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
    · exact subset_union_left
    · exact (ih h).trans subset_union_right

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_unionList_of_pairwise
statement:
lemma disjoint_unionList_of_pairwise {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (h : ∀ B ∈ t, Disjoint A B) : Disjoint A (unionList t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp [unionList]
  | cons B t ih =>
    rw [unionList_cons, disjoint_union_right]
    exact ⟨h B (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl)),
      ih fun C hC => h C (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hC))⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_unionList_iff
statement:
lemma mem_unionList_iff {xs : List (Finset V)} {x : V} :
    x ∈ unionList xs ↔ ∃ A ∈ xs, x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [unionList]
  | cons A t ih =>
    simp only [unionList_cons, mem_union, ih, List.mem_cons]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases h with hxA | ⟨B, hB, hxB⟩
      · exact ⟨A, Or.inl rfl, hxA⟩
      · exact ⟨B, Or.inr hB, hxB⟩
    · intro ⟨B, hB, hxB⟩
      rcases hB with rfl | hB
      · exact Or.inl hxB
      · exact Or.inr ⟨B, hB, hxB⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pairwiseDisjoint_cons
proof:
:=
  List.pairwise_cons.1 h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.completeJoin_unionList
statement:
lemma completeJoin_unionList {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : ∀ B ∈ t, Disjoint A B)
    (hcomp : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) (A :: t))
    (hne : ∀ B ∈ t, B.Nonempty) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (unionList t : Set V)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbB⟩ := mem_unionList_iff.1 (show b ∈ unionList t from hb)
  have hAB : A ≠ B := by
    intro hEq
    have : Disjoint A B := hdisj B hB
    have hA0 : A = ∅ := disjoint_self.1 (by simpa [hEq] using this)
    exact hAne.ne_empty hA0
  exact hcomp A (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl)) B (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hB))
    hAB ha hbB

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.card_unionList_cons
proof:
:= by
  rw [unionList_cons, card_union_of_disjoint (disjoint_unionList_of_pairwise hdisj)]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.unionList_nonempty_of
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | nil => exact (htne rfl).elim
  | cons B rest =>
    exact (hne B (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))).mono
      (subset_unionList_of_mem (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl)))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.maxChildExcess_cons
statement:
lemma maxChildExcess_cons (U A : Finset V) (t : List (Finset V)) :
    maxChildExcess (G := G) U (A :: t) =
      max (pathCoverNumber G A - (U.card - A.card))
        (maxChildExcess (G := G) U t)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.max_tsub_distrib
statement: lemma max_tsub_distrib (a b c : ℕ) : max a b - c = max (a - c) (b - c)
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.maxChildExcess_of_add_card
statement:
lemma maxChildExcess_of_add_card {U W : Finset V} (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ xs : List (Finset V),
      (∀ X ∈ xs, U.card - X.card = (W.card - X.card) + k) →
        maxChildExcess (G := G) U xs = maxChildExcess (G := G) W xs - k
proof:
| [], _ => by simp [maxChildExcess]
  | X :: t, h => by
    have hX := h X (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
    have ht : ∀ Y ∈ t, U.card - Y.card = (W.card - Y.card) + k :=
      fun Y hY => h Y (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hY))
    have hcell :
        pathCoverNumber G X - (U.card - X.card) =
          (pathCoverNumber G X - (W.card - X.card)) - k := by omega
    simp only [maxChildExcess_cons, hcell,
      maxChildExcess_of_add_card k t ht, max_tsub_distrib]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.maxChildExcess_scale_union
statement:
lemma maxChildExcess_scale_union {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hdisj : ∀ B ∈ t, Disjoint A B) :
    maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList (A :: t)) t =
      maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList t) t - A.card
proof:
:= by
  refine maxChildExcess_of_add_card A.card t ?_
  intro X hX
  have hXsub : X ⊆ unionList t := subset_unionList_of_mem hX
  have hU := card_unionList_cons hdisj
  have hle : X.card ≤ (unionList t).card := card_le_card hXsub
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_nary_singleton
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_nary_singleton {A : Finset V} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    pathCoverNumber G A =
      max 1 (maxChildExcess (G := G) A [A])
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G A :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hA
  simp [maxChildExcess, hp]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_nary_cons
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_nary_cons {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (htne : t ≠ [])
    (hne : ∀ B ∈ t, B.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : PairwiseDisjointBlocks (A :: t))
    (hcomp : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) (A :: t))
    (hIH : pathCoverNumber G (unionList t) =
      max 1 (maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList t) t)) :
    pathCoverNumber G (unionList (A :: t)) =
      max 1 (maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList (A :: t)) (A :: t))
proof:
:= by
  have htpair := pairwiseDisjoint_cons hdisj
  have hBne : (unionList t).Nonempty := unionList_nonempty_of htne hne
  have hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (unionList t : Set V) :=
    completeJoin_unionList hA htpair.1 hcomp hne
  have hbin := pathCoverNumber_complete_join hA hBne hAB
  have hU : unionList (A :: t) = A ∪ unionList t := unionList_cons A t
  have hscale := maxChildExcess_scale_union (G := G) (A := A) (t := t) htpair.1
  have hAex :
      pathCoverNumber G A - ((unionList (A :: t)).card - A.card) =
        pathCoverNumber G A - (unionList t).card := by
    have := card_unionList_cons htpair.1
    omega
  have ha1 : 1 - A.card = 0 := by
    have : 1 ≤ A.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hA)
    omega
  have hpBsub :
      pathCoverNumber G (unionList t) - A.card =
        maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList t) t - A.card := by
    rw [hIH, max_tsub_distrib, ha1]
    omega
  have hmax :
      max 1 (max (pathCoverNumber G A - (unionList t).card)
        (pathCoverNumber G (unionList t) - A.card)) =
      max 1 (maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList (A :: t)) (A :: t)) := by
    simp only [maxChildExcess_cons, hAex, hpBsub, hscale]
  simpa [hU] using hbin.trans hmax

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_nary
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_nary :
    ∀ (xs : List (Finset V)),
      xs ≠ [] →
      (∀ A ∈ xs, A.Nonempty) →
      PairwiseDisjointBlocks xs →
      PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) xs →
        pathCoverNumber G (unionList xs) =
          max 1 (maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList xs) xs)
proof:
| [A], _, hne, _, _ => by
    simpa [unionList] using pathCoverNumber_nary_singleton (hne A (by simp))
  | A :: B :: t, _, hne, hdisj, hcomp => by
    have hrest_ne : (B :: t : List (Finset V)) ≠ [] := by simp
    have hne_rest : ∀ C ∈ B :: t, C.Nonempty := fun C hC =>
      hne C (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hC))
    have hdisj_rest : PairwiseDisjointBlocks (B :: t) :=
      (pairwiseDisjoint_cons hdisj).2
    have hcomp_rest : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) (B :: t) := by
      intro C hC D hD hCD
      exact hcomp C (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hC)) D (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hD)) hCD
    have hIH :=
      pathCoverNumber_nary (B :: t) hrest_ne hne_rest hdisj_rest hcomp_rest
    exact pathCoverNumber_nary_cons (hne A (by simp)) hrest_ne hne_rest
      hdisj hcomp hIH

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.maxChildExcess_le_of_balanced
statement:
lemma maxChildExcess_le_of_balanced {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hdisj : ∀ B ∈ t, Disjoint A B)
    (hbal : ∀ X ∈ t,
      pathCoverNumber G X ≤ (unionList (A :: t)).card - X.card) :
    maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList t) t ≤ A.card
proof:
:= by
  have hgen :
      ∀ zs : List (Finset V),
        (∀ Z ∈ zs, Z ∈ t) →
          maxChildExcess (G := G) (unionList t) zs ≤ A.card := by
    intro zs
    induction zs with
    | nil => intro; simp [maxChildExcess]
    | cons Z zs ih =>
      intro hmem
      simp only [maxChildExcess_cons]
      have hZ : Z ∈ t := hmem Z (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
      have hpZ := hbal Z hZ
      have hZsub : Z ⊆ unionList t := subset_unionList_of_mem hZ
      have hleZ : Z.card ≤ (unionList t).card := card_le_card hZsub
      have hU := card_unionList_cons hdisj
      have hcell : pathCoverNumber G Z - ((unionList t).card - Z.card) ≤ A.card := by
        omega
      exact max_le hcell (ih fun W hW => hmem W (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hW)))
  exact hgen t (fun Z hZ => hZ)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_grouped_balanced
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_grouped_balanced {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (htne : t ≠ [])
    (hne : ∀ B ∈ t, B.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : PairwiseDisjointBlocks (A :: t))
    (hcomp : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) (A :: t))
    (hbal : ∀ X ∈ A :: t,
      pathCoverNumber G X ≤ (unionList (A :: t)).card - X.card) :
    pathCoverNumber G A ≤ (unionList t).card ∧
      pathCoverNumber G (unionList t) ≤ A.card
proof:
:= by
  have htpair := pairwiseDisjoint_cons hdisj
  have hUcard := card_unionList_cons htpair.1
  have hpA : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ (unionList (A :: t)).card - A.card :=
    hbal A (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl))
  have hpA' : pathCoverNumber G A ≤ (unionList t).card := by omega
  have hdisj_rest : PairwiseDisjointBlocks t := htpair.2
  have hcomp_rest : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) t := by
    intro C hC D hD hCD
    exact hcomp C (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hC)) D (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hD)) hCD
  have hIH := pathCoverNumber_nary t htne hne hdisj_rest hcomp_rest
  have hmaxB :=
    maxChildExcess_le_of_balanced htpair.1
      (fun X hX => hbal X (List.mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hX)))
  have hpB : pathCoverNumber G (unionList t) ≤ A.card := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ A.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 hA)
    rw [hIH]
    exact max_le h1 hmaxB
  exact ⟨hpA', hpB⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_nary_complete_join_cycle
statement:
lemma exists_nary_complete_join_cycle {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (htne : t ≠ [])
    (hne : ∀ B ∈ t, B.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : PairwiseDisjointBlocks (A :: t))
    (hcomp : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) (A :: t))
    (hbal : ∀ X ∈ A :: t,
      pathCoverNumber G X ≤ (unionList (A :: t)).card - X.card)
    (h3 : 3 ≤ (unionList (A :: t)).card) :
    ∃ c : GraphCycle G, c.support = unionList (A :: t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpA, hpB⟩ :=
    pathCoverNumber_grouped_balanced hA htne hne hdisj hcomp hbal
  have htpair := pairwiseDisjoint_cons hdisj
  have hBne : (unionList t).Nonempty := unionList_nonempty_of htne hne
  have hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (unionList t : Set V) :=
    completeJoin_unionList hA htpair.1 hcomp hne
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_cycle hA hBne hAB hpA hpB
      (by simpa [unionList_cons] using h3)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  simpa [unionList_cons] using hc

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_nary_complete_join_spanning_path
statement:
lemma exists_nary_complete_join_spanning_path {A : Finset V} {t : List (Finset V)}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (htne : t ≠ [])
    (hne : ∀ B ∈ t, B.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : PairwiseDisjointBlocks (A :: t))
    (hcomp : PairwiseCompleteJoin (G := G) (A :: t))
    (hbal : ∀ X ∈ A :: t,
      pathCoverNumber G X ≤ (unionList (A :: t)).card - X.card) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = unionList (A :: t) ∧ r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ unionList t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpA, hpB⟩ :=
    pathCoverNumber_grouped_balanced hA htne hne hdisj hcomp hbal
  have htpair := pairwiseDisjoint_cons hdisj
  have hBne : (unionList t).Nonempty := unionList_nonempty_of htne hne
  have hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (unionList t : Set V) :=
    completeJoin_unionList hA htpair.1 hcomp hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs, hf⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_spanning_path hA hBne hAB hpA hpB
  refine ⟨r, ?_, hs, hf⟩
  simpa [unionList_cons] using hr

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_spanningPathNeighbors_iff
statement:
lemma mem_spanningPathNeighbors_iff {U A : Finset V} {b : V} :
    b ∈ spanningPathNeighbors (G := G) U A ↔

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.adj_start_cycleSucc
statement: lemma adj_start_cycleSucc (c : GraphCycle G) : G.Adj c.start (cycleSucc c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cycleSucc, Walk.getVert_zero] using
    c.walk.adj_getVert_succ (cycle_length_pos c)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycleSucc_mem_support
statement: lemma cycleSucc_mem_support (c : GraphCycle G) : cycleSucc c ∈ c.support
proof:
:=
  List.mem_toFinset.2 (Walk.getVert_mem_support c.walk 1)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycleSucc_ne_start
statement: lemma cycleSucc_ne_start (c : GraphCycle G) : cycleSucc c ≠ c.start
proof:
:=
  (adj_start_cycleSucc c).ne.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_from
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_path_from (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = c.support ∧ p.start = x ∧
      G.Adj p.finish x
proof:
:= by
  let c' := rotateTo c hx
  have hnil : ¬ c'.walk.Nil := c'.isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
  have hq : q.IsPath :=
    ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hadj).1 (by simpa [hwalk] using c'.isCycle)).1
  let p0 : GraphPath G := ⟨w, c'.start, q, hq⟩
  have hp0 : p0.support = c'.support := by
    have hstart : c'.start ∈ q.support := Walk.end_mem_support q
    simp [p0, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hwalk, Walk.support_cons,
      insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart)]
  have hx' : c'.start = x := start_rotateTo c hx
  refine ⟨p0.reverse, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [GraphPath.support_reverse, hp0, support_rotateTo]
  · simp [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hx']
  · simpa [p0, GraphPath.reverse, hx'] using hadj.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_to
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_path_to (c : GraphCycle G) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ c.support) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = c.support ∧ p.finish = x ∧
      G.Adj x p.start
proof:
:= by
  let c' := rotateTo c hx
  have hnil : ¬ c'.walk.Nil := c'.isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
  have hq : q.IsPath :=
    ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hadj).1 (by simpa [hwalk] using c'.isCycle)).1
  let p0 : GraphPath G := ⟨w, c'.start, q, hq⟩
  have hp0 : p0.support = c'.support := by
    have hstart : c'.start ∈ q.support := Walk.end_mem_support q
    simp [p0, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hwalk, Walk.support_cons,
      insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart)]
  have hx' : c'.start = x := start_rotateTo c hx
  refine ⟨p0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hp0, support_rotateTo]
  · simp [p0, hx']
  · simpa [p0, hx'] using hadj

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_cycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path c
  exact pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p (hp.trans hc)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_card_of_cycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAne
  have hE : Eligible G U a := eligible_of_cycle c hc (hA haA)
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_of_eligible (G := G) hA haA hE
  have hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1 := pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_cycle c hc
  have hpos : 1 ≤ A.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨a, haA⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.Saturated_of_tight_container
statement:
lemma Saturated_of_tight_container {U A T : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hAT : A ⊆ T)
    (hT : Tight (G := G) U T) :
    Saturated (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) ≤
      profileDelta (G := G) U A :=
    profileDelta_le_of_nested hAT hT.1
  have hpK : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) ≤ A.card :=
    pathCoverNumber_sdiff_le_card_of_cycle c hc hA hAne
  simp only [profileDelta, hT.2] at hle
  exact le_antisymm hpK (by omega)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.tight_container_subset_canonical
statement:
lemma tight_container_subset_canonical {U A T : Finset V}
    (hAT : A ⊆ T) (hT : Tight (G := G) U T)
    (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A)) (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    T ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  have hSat' : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) = A.card := hSat
  have hatt :
      (componentCount G (U \ T) : ℤ) - (T.card : ℤ) =
        profileDelta (G := G) U A := by
    simp [profileDelta, hSat', hT.2]
  exact profile_maximizer_subset_container hAT hT.1 hK hatt

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.canonicalContainer_tight_of_saturated
statement:
lemma canonicalContainer_tight_of_saturated {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty) (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    Tight (G := G) U (canonicalContainer (G := G) U A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨canonicalContainer_subset (G := G) hA, ?_⟩
  have hatt := profileContainer_attains (G := G) hA hK hKne
  have hSat' : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) = A.card := hSat
  simp only [canonicalContainer, profileDelta, hSat'] at hatt ⊢
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.canonicalContainer_proper_of_saturated
statement:
lemma canonicalContainer_proper_of_saturated {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty) (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    canonicalContainer (G := G) U A ⊂ U
proof:
:= by
  refine (ssubset_iff_subset_ne).2 ⟨canonicalContainer_subset (G := G) hA, ?_⟩
  intro hEq
  have hrem := sdiff_profileContainer (G := G) hA
  have hF := componentCount_sdiff_ineligibleSet_eq (cotreeOn_of_isCograph hK)
  have hp : 1 ≤ pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) :=
    one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hKne
  have : U \ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A = ∅ := by
    rw [hEq]; simp
  have hempty : (U \ A) \ ineligibleSet G (U \ A) = ∅ := by
    simpa [canonicalContainer] using hrem.symm.trans this
  have : componentCount G ((U \ A) \ ineligibleSet G (U \ A)) = 0 := by
    simpa [hempty] using componentCount_empty (G := G)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eq_univ_of_sdiff_not_nonempty
statement:
lemma eq_univ_of_sdiff_not_nonempty {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (h : ¬ (U \ A).Nonempty) : A = U
proof:
:=
  hA.antisymm (sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.1 (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 h))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.canonical_saturated_container
statement:
lemma canonical_saturated_container {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A)) :
    (∃ T, Tight (G := G) U T ∧ A ⊆ T) ↔ Saturated (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨T, hT, hAT⟩
    exact Saturated_of_tight_container c hc hA hAne hAT hT
  · intro hSat
    by_cases hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty
    · exact ⟨canonicalContainer (G := G) U A,
        canonicalContainer_tight_of_saturated hA hK hKne hSat, subset_union_left⟩
    · have hAU := eq_univ_of_sdiff_not_nonempty hA hKne
      have : A.card = 0 := by
        have hp0 : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) = 0 := by
          simpa [hAU] using pathCoverNumber_empty (G := G)
        simpa [Saturated, hp0] using hSat.symm
      exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (card_pos.2 hAne) this).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_spec
statement:
lemma canonical_saturated_container_spec {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    Tight (G := G) U (canonicalContainer (G := G) U A) ∧
      canonicalContainer (G := G) U A ⊂ U ∧
        ∀ T, Tight (G := G) U T → A ⊆ T →
          T ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  have hKne : (U \ A).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have hAU := eq_univ_of_sdiff_not_nonempty hA h
    have : A.card = 0 := by
      have hp0 : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) = 0 := by
        simpa [hAU] using pathCoverNumber_empty (G := G)
      simpa [Saturated, hp0] using hSat.symm
    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (card_pos.2 hAne) this
  exact ⟨canonicalContainer_tight_of_saturated hA hK hKne hSat,
    canonicalContainer_proper_of_saturated hA hK hKne hSat,
    fun T hT hAT => tight_container_subset_canonical hAT hT hK hSat⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_of_canonical
statement:
lemma canonical_saturated_container_of_canonical {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A)) :
    (∃ T, Tight (G := G) U T ∧ A ⊆ T) ↔ Saturated (G := G) U A
proof:
:=
  canonical_saturated_container c hc hA hAne (isCograph_iff.2 hK)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical
statement:
lemma canonical_saturated_container_spec_of_canonical {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hK : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    Tight (G := G) U (canonicalContainer (G := G) U A) ∧
      canonicalContainer (G := G) U A ⊂ U ∧
        ∀ T, Tight (G := G) U T → A ⊆ T →
          T ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:=
  canonical_saturated_container_spec hA hAne (isCograph_iff.2 hK) hSat

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_cycle_delete_cover
statement:
lemma exists_cycle_delete_cover {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        pc.card ≤ A.card ∧
          ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAne
  have hx : a ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA haA
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hadj⟩ := exists_spanning_path_from c hx
  have hpU : p.support = U := hp.trans hc
  have hstartA : p.start ∈ A := by simpa [hs] using haA
  let pc0 : PathCover G U := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hpU
  have hend : pc0.IsEndpoint p.start := by
    refine ⟨p, ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
  have hArest : A.erase p.start ⊆ U.erase p.start := by
    intro x hx
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hx).1, hA (mem_of_mem_erase hx)⟩
  obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hsup1⟩ :=
    exists_pathCover_sdiff (pc0.deleteVertex p.start) hArest
  have hEq : U.erase p.start \ A.erase p.start = U \ A := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨⟨hxne, hxU⟩, hxA⟩
      exact ⟨hxU, fun hA' => hxA ⟨hxne, hA'⟩⟩
    · intro ⟨hxU, hxA⟩
      exact ⟨⟨fun h => hxA (by simpa [h] using hstartA), hxU⟩,
        fun h => hxA h.2⟩
  refine ⟨p, pc1.cast hEq, hpU, hstartA, by simpa [hs] using hadj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hdv := pc0.card_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint hend
    have hcard0 : pc0.card = 1 := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
    have herase : (A.erase p.start).card = A.card - 1 :=
      card_erase_of_mem hstartA
    have hpos : 1 ≤ A.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨p.start, hstartA⟩)
    rw [PathCover.cast_card]
    omega
  · intro q hq
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := hsup1 q hq
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hrt⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1
      (show r ∈ pc0.paths.flatMap fun s => GraphPath.deleteVertex s p.start from
        by simpa [PathCover.deleteVertex] using hr)
    have htP : t = p := by
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath] at ht
      simpa using ht
    exact hqr.trans (by
      simpa [htP] using GraphPath.support_subset_of_mem_deleteVertex hrt)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_delete_cover_min_of_saturated
statement:
lemma cycle_delete_cover_min_of_saturated {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) ∧
          ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, q.support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, pc, hp, hs, hadj, hcard, hsub⟩ :=
    exists_cycle_delete_cover c hc hA hAne
  have hmin : pc.card = pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) := by
    have hle := pathCoverNumber_le (G := G) pc
    have hSat' : pathCoverNumber G (U \ A) = A.card := hSat
    exact le_antisymm (hcard.trans (le_of_eq hSat'.symm)) hle
  exact ⟨p, pc, hp, hs, hadj, hmin, hsub⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanningPathCompatible_of_path
statement:
lemma spanningPathCompatible_of_path (p : GraphPath G)
    (hne : p.start ≠ p.finish) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) p.support p.start p.finish
proof:
:=
  ⟨hne, p, rfl, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_compatible_old_end
statement:
lemma exists_compatible_old_end {Q : GraphPath G} {b : V}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ Q.support.card) (hcog : IsCograph G Q.support)
    (hbE : Eligible G Q.support b) (hb : b ∈ Q.support) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) Q.support b Q.start ∨
      SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) Q.support b Q.finish
proof:
:= by
  have hneSF : Q.start ≠ Q.finish := by
    intro h
    have hnil : Q.walk.Nil := (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish Q).2 h
    have : Q.support.card = 1 := by
      simpa using
        (congrArg Finset.card (GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil Q hnil))
    omega
  have hpQ : pathCoverNumber G Q.support = 1 :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support Q rfl
  have hconn := connected_of_spanning_path Q rfl
  have hdata :=
    hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph (G := G) h2 hcog hconn hpQ
  have hRuv := spanningPathCompatible_of_path Q hneSF
  by_cases hbs : b = Q.start
  · exact Or.inr (by simpa [hbs] using hRuv)
  by_cases hbf : b = Q.finish
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa [hbf] using spanningPathCompatible_symm hRuv)
  rcases hdata with hcrit | hbal
  · obtain ⟨A, B, _, _, hunion, _, _, hA, hEeq, _, hRiff, _⟩ := hcrit
    have hbEA : b ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
      have : b ∈ eligibleSet G Q.support :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hb, hbE⟩
      simpa [hunion] using (hEeq ▸ this)
    have huE := (Eligible_of_support_ends Q rfl).1
    have hvE := (Eligible_of_support_ends Q rfl).2
    have huEA : Q.start ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
      have : Q.start ∈ eligibleSet G Q.support :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨Q.start_mem_support, huE⟩
      simpa [hunion] using (hEeq ▸ this)
    have hvEA : Q.finish ∈ eligibleSet G A := by
      have : Q.finish ∈ eligibleSet G Q.support :=
        (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨Q.finish_mem_support, hvE⟩
      simpa [hunion] using (hEeq ▸ this)
    have hDuv : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A Q.start Q.finish :=
      (hRiff Q.start Q.finish).1 (by simpa [hunion] using hRuv)
    by_cases hDu : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A b Q.start
    · exact Or.inl ((hRiff b Q.start).2 hDu)
    · by_cases hDv : DistinctPathCompatible (G := G) A b Q.finish
      · exact Or.inr ((hRiff b Q.finish).2 hDv)
      · have hyb : Q.start ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) A b :=
          mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨huEA, hDu⟩
        have hzb : Q.finish ∈ dNonadjClass (G := G) A b :=
          mem_dNonadjClass_iff.2 ⟨hvEA, hDv⟩
        have hb_in_u := dNonadjClass_symm hbEA hyb
        have hcontra :=
          dNonadjClass_trans (cotreeOn_of_isCograph hA)
            huEA hbEA hvEA hb_in_u hzb
        exact ((mem_dNonadjClass_iff.1 hcontra).2 hDuv).elim
  · have hQu : rNonadjClass (G := G) Q.support Q.start ≠
        rNonadjClass (G := G) Q.support Q.finish := by
      intro heq
      have hvQ : Q.finish ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) Q.support Q.start := by
        simpa [heq] using mem_rNonadjClass_self Q.finish_mem_support
      exact (mem_rNonadjClass_iff.1 hvQ).2 hRuv
    by_cases hbu :
        rNonadjClass (G := G) Q.support b =
          rNonadjClass (G := G) Q.support Q.start
    · exact Or.inr (spanningPath_of_distinct_classes hbal hb
        Q.finish_mem_support (by intro h; exact hQu (hbu.symm.trans h)))
    · exact Or.inl (spanningPath_of_distinct_classes hbal hb
        Q.start_mem_support hbu)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.spanningPathNeighbors_subset_sdiff_container
statement:
lemma spanningPathNeighbors_subset_sdiff_container {U A : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hK : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hSat : Saturated (G := G) U A) :
    spanningPathNeighbors (G := G) U A ⊆
      U \ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨hbU, a, haA, hR⟩ := mem_spanningPathNeighbors_iff.1 hb
  have hspec := canonical_saturated_container_spec hA hAne hK hSat
  have hT := hspec.1
  have haS : a ∈ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A :=
    mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A haA
  refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hbU, ?_⟩
  intro hbS
  have hle :=
    componentCount_sdiff_le_of_both_endpoints (G := G)
      (U := U) (S := canonicalContainer (G := G) U A)
      (x := a) (y := b) hT.1 haS hbS hR.1 hR
  have heq := hT.2
  have hpos : 1 ≤ (canonicalContainer (G := G) U A).card :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨a, haS⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_path_succ
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_path_succ (c : GraphCycle G) :
    ∃ p : GraphPath G, p.support = c.support ∧ p.start = cycleSucc c ∧
      p.finish = c.start ∧ G.Adj c.start (cycleSucc c)
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : ¬ c.walk.Nil := c.isCycle.not_nil
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
  have hq : q.IsPath :=
    ((Walk.cons_isCycle_iff q hadj).1 (by simpa [hwalk] using c.isCycle)).1
  let p : GraphPath G := ⟨w, c.start, q, hq⟩
  have hw : w = cycleSucc c := by
    simp [cycleSucc, hwalk]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hw, rfl, by simpa [hw] using hadj⟩
  have hstart : c.start ∈ q.support := Walk.end_mem_support q
  simp [p, GraphPath.support, GraphCycle.support, hwalk, Walk.support_cons,
    insert_eq_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.2 hstart)]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_path_of_mem_cover
statement:
lemma exists_path_of_mem_cover {U : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ U) : ∃ p ∈ pc.paths, x ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  (pc.mem_iff x).1 hx

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_from_cycle_succ
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_from_cycle_succ {U : Finset V} {b : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) (hbU : b ∈ U) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b
      (cycleSucc (rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hbU)))
proof:
:= by
  set c' := rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hbU)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hf, _hadj⟩ := exists_spanning_path_succ c'
  have hstart : c'.start = b := start_rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hbU)
  have hne : b ≠ cycleSucc c' := by
    intro h
    exact cycleSucc_ne_start c' (h.symm.trans hstart.symm)
  refine ⟨hne, p, ?_, Or.inr ⟨hs, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [hp, support_rotateTo, hc]
  · rw [hf, hstart]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_from_cycle_pred
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_from_cycle_pred {U : Finset V} {b : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) (hbU : b ∈ U) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b
      (cycleSucc (rotateTo c.reverse
        (by simpa [hc, GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hbU)))
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : b ∈ c.reverse.support := by
    simpa [GraphCycle.support_reverse, hc] using hbU
  simpa [GraphCycle.support_reverse, hc] using
    (exists_spanning_from_cycle_succ c.reverse
      (by simpa [GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hc) hb')

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_of_mem_sdiff_container
proof:
:= by
  have hbU : b ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).1
  have hbS : b ∉ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A := (mem_sdiff.1 hb).2
  have hbA : b ∉ A := fun h => hbS (mem_canonicalContainer_of_mem_A h)
  have hbF : b ∉ ineligibleSet G (U \ A) := fun h =>
    hbS (mem_union.2 (Or.inr h))
  have hbK : b ∈ U \ A := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hbU, hbA⟩
  have hE : Eligible G (U \ A) b := by
