    have h := (mem_ineligibleSet_iff (G := G) (U := U \ A) (x := b)).not
    simp only [not_and, Classical.not_not] at h
    exact h.mp hbF hbK
  exact ⟨hbK, hE⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.restriction_eligible_on_selected_path
proof:
:= by
  have hrest :=
    restriction_eq_of_min_cover_of_isCograph (G := G) hU pc hpc
      (fun r => decide (b ∈ r.support))
  have hbL : b ∈ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r =>
      decide (b ∈ r.support)) :=
    mem_supportUnion_iff.2 ⟨Q, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hQ, by simp [hbQ]⟩, hbQ⟩
  have hEQ : eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r =>
      decide (b ∈ r.support))) =
    eligibleSet G U ∩ supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r =>
      decide (b ∈ r.support)) := hrest.2.1
  have hbEU : b ∈ eligibleSet G U :=
    (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨Eligible.mem (G := G) hbE, hbE⟩
  have : b ∈ eligibleSet G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r =>
      decide (b ∈ r.support))) := by
    rw [hEQ]
    exact mem_inter.2 ⟨hbEU, hbL⟩
  have hQE : Eligible G (supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r =>
      decide (b ∈ r.support))) b :=
    (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this |>.2
  have hQeq : supportUnion (pc.paths.filter fun r =>
      decide (b ∈ r.support)) = Q.support := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hzr⟩ := mem_supportUnion_iff.1 hz
      have hr' := List.mem_filter.1 hr
      have hbR : b ∈ r.support := of_decide_eq_true hr'.2
      have : r = Q := by
        by_contra hne
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.1
          (PathCover.pairwise_disjoint_of_mem pc.disjoint hr'.1 hQ hne)
          hbR hbQ
      simpa [this] using hzr
    · intro hz
      exact mem_supportUnion_iff.2
        ⟨Q, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hQ, by simp [hbQ]⟩, hz⟩
  simpa [hQeq] using hQE

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_spanning_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A
statement:
lemma exists_spanning_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A {U A : Finset V} {b : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hbU : b ∈ U)
    (hA : cycleSucc (rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hbU)) ∈ A ∨
      cycleSucc (rotateTo c.reverse
        (by simpa [hc, GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hbU)) ∈ A) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) U b a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with h | h
  · exact ⟨_, h, exists_spanning_from_cycle_succ c hc hbU⟩
  · exact ⟨_, h, exists_spanning_from_cycle_pred c hc hbU⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_oriented_path_from
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, p, hp, hends⟩ := hR
  rcases hends with h | h
  · exact ⟨p, hp, h.1, h.2⟩
  · exact ⟨p.reverse, by simpa [GraphPath.support_reverse, hp],
      by simp [GraphPath.reverse, h.2], by simp [GraphPath.reverse, h.1]⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.SpanningPathCompatible_attach_A
statement:
lemma SpanningPathCompatible_attach_A {L : Finset V} {b w a : V}
    (hR : SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) L b w)
    (hadj : G.Adj w a) (haL : a ∉ L) :
    SpanningPathCompatible (G := G) (insert a L) b a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hs, hf⟩ := exists_oriented_path_from hR
  have hbL : b ∈ L := by
    have : q.start ∈ L := by simpa [hq] using q.start_mem_support
    simpa [hs] using this
  have hne : b ≠ a := fun hba => haL (by simpa [hba] using hbL)
  have haq : a ∉ q.support := by simpa [hq] using haL
  have hadj' : G.Adj q.finish a := by simpa [hf] using hadj
  let r := q.concatAdj hadj' haq
  refine ⟨hne, r, ?_, Or.inl ⟨by simp [r, GraphPath.concatAdj, hs],
    by simp [r, GraphPath.concatAdj]⟩⟩
  simpa [r, GraphPath.support_concatAdj, hq]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.insert_sdiff_eq_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    simp only [mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro hxL
      exact ⟨fun hxa => haL (by simpa [hxa] using hxL), hLU hxL⟩
    · intro ⟨hxne, hxU⟩
      have : x ∈ insert a L := by simpa [h] using hxU
      exact (mem_insert.1 this).resolve_left hxne
  · intro h
    ext x
    simp only [mem_insert]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | hxL
      · exact haU
      · exact hLU hxL
    · intro hxU
      by_cases hxa : x = a
      · exact Or.inl hxa
      · have : x ∈ U.erase a := mem_erase.2 ⟨hxa, hxU⟩
        exact Or.inr (by simpa [h] using this)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.deleteVertex_start_adj
statement:
lemma deleteVertex_start_adj {U A : Finset V} (pc : PathCover G U) {f : V}
    (hfA : f ∈ A)
    (h : ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, ∃ a ∈ A, G.Adj a q.start) :
    ∀ q ∈ (pc.deleteVertex f).paths, ∃ a ∈ A, G.Adj a q.start
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hq'⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1
    (show q ∈ pc.paths.flatMap fun r => GraphPath.deleteVertex r f from by
      simpa [PathCover.deleteVertex] using hq)
  obtain ⟨a, haA, hadj⟩ := h p hp
  unfold GraphPath.deleteVertex at hq'
  split_ifs at hq' with hx hnil hs hf
  · cases hq'
  · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq'
    subst hq'
    refine ⟨f, hfA, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hadj', rest, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
    simpa [GraphPath.trimStart, hs, hwalk] using hadj'
  · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq'
    subst hq'
    exact ⟨a, haA, by simpa [GraphPath.trimFinish] using hadj⟩
  · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq' with h | h
    · subst h
      exact ⟨a, haA, hadj⟩
    · have : q = (p.dropUntil hx).trimStart (fun hnil' =>
          hf ((GraphPath.dropUntil_nil_iff (p := p) (x := f) hx).1
            (by simpa [GraphPath.dropUntil] using hnil'))) :=
        List.mem_singleton.mp h
      subst this
      refine ⟨f, hfA, ?_⟩
      have hnilD : ¬ (p.dropUntil hx).walk.Nil := by
        intro hnil'
        exact hf ((GraphPath.dropUntil_nil_iff (p := p) (x := f) hx).1
          (by simpa [GraphPath.dropUntil] using hnil'))
      obtain ⟨w, hadj', rest, hwalk⟩ :=
        (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 (by simpa [GraphPath.dropUntil] using hnilD))
      have hst : (p.dropUntil hx).start = f := by simp [GraphPath.dropUntil]
      simpa [GraphPath.trimStart, GraphPath.dropUntil, hst, hwalk] using hadj'
  · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq'
    subst hq'
    exact ⟨a, haA, hadj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_delete_sdiff_start_adj
statement:
lemma exists_delete_sdiff_start_adj {U S A : Finset V}
    (pc : PathCover G U) (hS : S ⊆ U)
    (h : ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, ∃ a ∈ A, G.Adj a q.start)
    (hSA : S ⊆ A) :
    ∃ pc' : PathCover G (U \ S),
      pc'.card ≤ pc.card + S.card ∧
        ∀ q ∈ pc'.paths, ∃ a ∈ A, G.Adj a q.start
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction generalizing U pc with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨pc.cast (by simp), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [PathCover.cast_card]
    · intro q hq
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
      exact h q hq
  | insert f S hf ih =>
    have hfU : f ∈ U := hS (mem_insert_self f S)
    have hfA : f ∈ A := hSA (mem_insert_self f S)
    have hSsub : S ⊆ U.erase f := by
      intro y hy
      exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hfy => hf (hfy ▸ hy), hS (mem_insert_of_mem hy)⟩
    have hSA' : S ⊆ A := fun y hy => hSA (mem_insert_of_mem hy)
    have hdel := deleteVertex_start_adj (A := A) pc hfA h
    obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hinv1⟩ :=
      ih (U := U.erase f) (pc.deleteVertex f) hSsub hdel hSA'
    have hEq : U.erase f \ S = U \ insert f S := by
      rw [sdiff_insert, erase_sdiff_distrib, erase_eq_of_notMem hf]
    refine ⟨pc1.cast hEq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hdv := pc.card_deleteVertex_le f
      have hins : (insert f S).card = S.card + 1 := card_insert_of_notMem hf
      rw [PathCover.cast_card]
      omega
    · intro q hq
      rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
      exact hinv1 q hq

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.cycle_delete_cover_start_adj
statement:
lemma cycle_delete_cover_start_adj {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (p : GraphPath G) (pc : PathCover G (U \ A)),
      p.support = U ∧ p.start ∈ A ∧ G.Adj p.finish p.start ∧
        pc.card ≤ A.card ∧
          ∀ q ∈ pc.paths, ∃ a ∈ A, G.Adj a q.start
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0A⟩ := hAne
  have hx : x0 ∈ c.support := by simpa [hc] using hA hx0A
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hs, hadj⟩ := exists_spanning_path_from c hx
  have hpU : p.support = U := hp.trans hc
  have hstartA : p.start ∈ A := by simpa [hs] using hx0A
  let pc0 : PathCover G U := (PathCover.ofPath p).cast hpU
  have hend : pc0.IsEndpoint p.start := by
    refine ⟨p, ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
  have hinv0 : ∀ q ∈ (pc0.deleteVertex p.start).paths,
      ∃ a ∈ A, G.Adj a q.start := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : q ∈ (GraphPath.deleteVertex p p.start) := by
      have : (pc0.deleteVertex p.start).paths =
          pc0.paths.flatMap fun r => GraphPath.deleteVertex r p.start := rfl
      have hmem : p ∈ pc0.paths := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath]
        exact List.mem_singleton.2 rfl
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 (by simpa [this] using hq)
      have : r = p := by
        rw [PathCover.cast_paths, PathCover.ofPath] at hr
        simpa using hr
      simpa [this] using hqr
    have hnil : ¬ p.walk.Nil := by
      intro hnil
      have : p.start = p.finish := (GraphPath.nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 hnil
      have hcard : p.support.card = 1 := by
        simpa using congrArg Finset.card
          (GraphPath.support_eq_singleton_of_nil p hnil)
      have h3 : 3 ≤ U.card := by simpa [hc] using c.three_le_card_support
      have : U.card = 1 := by simpa [hpU] using hcard
      omega
    have hsdel : p.start ∈ p.support := p.start_mem_support
    have hdv : GraphPath.deleteVertex p p.start = [p.trimStart hnil] := by
      unfold GraphPath.deleteVertex
      simp [hsdel, hnil]
    have : q = p.trimStart hnil := by
      simpa [hdv] using hq'
    subst this
    refine ⟨p.start, hstartA, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hadj', rest, hwalk⟩ := (Walk.not_nil_iff.1 hnil)
    simpa [GraphPath.trimStart, hwalk] using hadj'
  have hArest : A.erase p.start ⊆ U.erase p.start := by
    intro y hy
    exact mem_erase.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hy).1, hA (mem_of_mem_erase hy)⟩
  obtain ⟨pc1, hcard1, hinv1⟩ :=
    exists_delete_sdiff_start_adj (A := A) (pc0.deleteVertex p.start)
      hArest hinv0 (erase_subset _ _)
  have hEq : U.erase p.start \ A.erase p.start = U \ A := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨⟨hyne, hyU⟩, hyA⟩
      exact ⟨hyU, fun hA' => hyA ⟨hyne, hA'⟩⟩
    · intro ⟨hyU, hyA⟩
      exact ⟨⟨fun h => hyA (by simpa [h] using hstartA), hyU⟩,
        fun h => hyA h.2⟩
  have hcard0 : pc0.card = 1 := by
    rw [PathCover.cast_card, PathCover.ofPath_card]
  have hdv := pc0.card_deleteVertex_le_of_endpoint hend
  have herase : (A.erase p.start).card = A.card - 1 :=
    card_erase_of_mem hstartA
  have hpos : 1 ≤ A.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨p.start, hstartA⟩)
  refine ⟨p, pc1.cast hEq, hpU, hstartA, by simpa [hs] using hadj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [PathCover.cast_card]
    omega
  · intro q hq
    rw [PathCover.cast_paths] at hq
    exact hinv1 q hq

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.sdiff_container_subset_spanningPathNeighbors_of_cycle_neighbor
statement:
lemma sdiff_container_subset_spanningPathNeighbors_of_cycle_neighbor
    {U A : Finset V} {b : V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (hc : c.support = U) (hbU : b ∈ U)
    (hn : cycleSucc (rotateTo c (by simpa [hc] using hbU)) ∈ A ∨
      cycleSucc (rotateTo c.reverse
        (by simpa [hc, GraphCycle.support_reverse] using hbU)) ∈ A) :
    b ∈ spanningPathNeighbors (G := G) U A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, haA, hR⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_of_cycle_neighbor_in_A c hc hbU hn
  exact mem_spanningPathNeighbors_iff.2
    ⟨hbU, a, haA, spanningPathCompatible_symm hR⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.coincidence_canonical_containers
statement:
lemma coincidence_canonical_containers {U A B : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hKA : IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hB : B ⊆ U) (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hKB : IsCograph G (U \ B))
    (hSatA : Saturated (G := G) U A) (hSatB : Saturated (G := G) U B)
    (hBA : B ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A) :
    canonicalContainer (G := G) U A = canonicalContainer (G := G) U B
proof:
:= by
  have hTA := canonical_saturated_container_spec hA hAne hKA hSatA
  have hTB := canonical_saturated_container_spec hB hBne hKB hSatB
  have hAin : A ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A := subset_union_left
  have hSAsubSB : canonicalContainer (G := G) U A ⊆
      canonicalContainer (G := G) U B :=
    hTB.2.2 _ hTA.1 hBA
  have hSBsubSA : canonicalContainer (G := G) U B ⊆
      canonicalContainer (G := G) U A :=
    hTA.2.2 _ hTB.1 (hAin.trans hSAsubSB)
  exact subset_antisymm hSAsubSB hSBsubSA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.coincidence_canonical_containers_of_canonical
statement:
lemma coincidence_canonical_containers_of_canonical {U A B : Finset V}
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (hAne : A.Nonempty)
    (hKA : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ A))
    (hB : B ⊆ U) (hBne : B.Nonempty)
    (hKB : Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G (U \ B))
    (hSatA : Saturated (G := G) U A) (hSatB : Saturated (G := G) U B)
    (hBA : B ⊆ canonicalContainer (G := G) U A) :
    canonicalContainer (G := G) U A = canonicalContainer (G := G) U B
proof:
:=
  coincidence_canonical_containers hA hAne (isCograph_iff.2 hKA)
    hB hBne (isCograph_iff.2 hKB) hSatA hSatB hBA

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.inducedP4_iff
statement:
lemma inducedP4_iff {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b c d : V} :
    InducedP4 G a b c d ↔ Nikoghosyan.InducedP4 G a b c d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.ne_ab, h.ne_ac, h.ne_ad, h.ne_bc, h.ne_bd, h.ne_cd,
      h.adj_ab, h.adj_bc, h.adj_cd, h.not_ac, h.not_ad, h.not_bd⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨nab, nac, nad, nbc, nbd, ncd, eab, ebc, ecd, nac', nad', nbd'⟩
    exact
      { ne_ab := nab
        ne_ac := nac
        ne_ad := nad
        ne_bc := nbc
        ne_bd := nbd
        ne_cd := ncd
        adj_ab := eab
        adj_bc := ebc
        adj_cd := ecd
        not_ac := nac'
        not_ad := nad'
        not_bd := nbd' }

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCograph_iff
statement:
lemma isCograph_iff {G : SimpleGraph V} {U : Finset V} :
    IsCograph G U ↔ Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact h ha hb hc hd (inducedP4_iff.2 hp)
  · intro h a b c d ha hb hc hd hp
    exact h ha hb hc hd (inducedP4_iff.1 hp)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.noInducedP4UnionP1_iff
statement:
lemma noInducedP4UnionP1_iff {G : SimpleGraph V} :
    NoInducedP4UnionP1 G ↔ Nikoghosyan.NoInducedP4UnionP1 G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d x hp hxa hxb hxc hxd
    exact h (inducedP4_iff.2 hp) hxa hxb hxc hxd
  · intro h a b c d x hp hxa hxb hxc hxd
    exact h (inducedP4_iff.1 hp) hxa hxb hxc hxd

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCographGraph_iff_isCograph_univ
statement:
lemma isCographGraph_iff_isCograph_univ {G : SimpleGraph V} :
    IsCographGraph G ↔ Nikoghosyan.IsCograph G Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCographGraph_iff_univ, isCograph_iff]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.antineighbors_coe
statement:
lemma antineighbors_coe (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) :
    (Nikoghosyan.antineighbors G v : Set V) = antineighborhood G v
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [Nikoghosyan.antineighbors, antineighborhood]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.support_edgePath
statement:
lemma support_edgePath {a b : V} (h : G.Adj a b) :
    (edgePath h).support = {a, b}
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgePath, GraphPath.support_consAdj, GraphPath.support_singleton]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.edgeSingletonsCover_card
proof:
:= by
  have hne : a ≠ b := hadj.ne
  have hb' : b ∈ U.erase a := mem_erase.2 ⟨hne.symm, hb⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ U.card := by
    have hsub : ({a, b} : Finset V) ⊆ U :=
      insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨ha, singleton_subset_iff.2 hb⟩
    have hcard : ({a, b} : Finset V).card = 2 := by
      rw [card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hne])]
      simp
    have := card_le_card hsub
    omega
  simp [edgeSingletonsCover, PathCover.card, card_erase_of_mem hb',
    card_erase_of_mem ha]
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_le_card_sub_one_of_adj
proof:
:=
  (pathCoverNumber_le (G := G)
    (edgeSingletonsCover (G := G) ha hb hadj)).trans_eq
    (edgeSingletonsCover_card (G := G) ha hb hadj)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.not_adj_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  intro hadj
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_le_card_sub_one_of_adj (G := G) ha hb hadj
  have hpos : 1 ≤ U.card := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (card_pos.2 ⟨a, ha⟩)
  omega

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eligible_of_singletons_min
statement:
lemma eligible_of_singletons_min {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hmin : (PathCover.singletons (G := G) U).card = pathCoverNumber G U) :
    Eligible G U x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PathCover.singletons (G := G) U, hmin, GraphPath.singleton x, ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
  exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, mem_toList.2 hx, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : (PathCover.singletons (G := G) U).card = pathCoverNumber G U := by
    simpa [PathCover.singletons_card] using h.symm
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzU : z ∈ U := ineligibleSet_subset (G := G) U hz
    have hE : Eligible G U z := eligible_of_singletons_min hzU hmin
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_eligibleSet_ineligibleSet (G := G) U)
      ((mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).2 ⟨hzU, hE⟩) hz).elim
  · intro hz
    exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.nonempty_of_two_le_componentCount
statement:
lemma nonempty_of_two_le_componentCount {U : Finset V}
    (h : 2 ≤ componentCount G U) : U.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have : U = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne
  subst this
  simp [componentCount_empty] at h

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.rootComp_eq
statement:
lemma rootComp_eq {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx hy : x ∈ U) :
    rootComp (G := G) U hx = rootComp (G := G) U hy
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootComp]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_rootChild_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (mem_filter.1 hx).2
  · intro ⟨hx, hC⟩
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, ⟨hx, hC⟩⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.rootChild_subset
statement:
lemma rootChild_subset (U : Finset V)
    (C : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent) :
    rootChild (G := G) U C ⊆ U
proof:
:=
  filter_subset _ _

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_rootChild_self
statement:
lemma mem_rootChild_self {U : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    x ∈ rootChild (G := G) U (rootComp (G := G) U hx)
proof:
:=
  mem_rootChild_iff.2 ⟨hx, rfl⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.rootChild_nonempty
statement:
lemma rootChild_nonempty (U : Finset V)
    (C : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent) :
    (rootChild (G := G) U C).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨C.out.val, mem_rootChild_iff.2 ⟨C.out.property, ?_⟩⟩
  simp [rootComp]
  exact Quot.out_eq C

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.disjoint_rootChild
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxC hxD
  obtain ⟨hx, hC⟩ := mem_rootChild_iff.1 hxC
  obtain ⟨hx', hD⟩ := mem_rootChild_iff.1 hxD
  have : C = D := hC.symm.trans ((rootComp_eq (G := G) hx hx').trans hD)
  exact hCD this

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.adj_of_mem_distinct_rootChild
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxU, hC⟩ := mem_rootChild_iff.1 hx
  obtain ⟨hyU, hD⟩ := mem_rootChild_iff.1 hy
  have hne : x ≠ y := by
    intro hxy
    subst hxy
    exact hCD (hC.symm.trans ((rootComp_eq (G := G) hxU hyU).trans hD))
  by_contra hna
  have hadj : (complInduce (G := G) U).Adj ⟨x, hxU⟩ ⟨y, hyU⟩ := by
    simp [complInduce, compl_adj, induce_adj, hne, hna]
  have heq : rootComp (G := G) U hxU = rootComp (G := G) U hyU :=
    ConnectedComponent.sound (Adj.reachable hadj)
  exact hCD (hC.symm.trans (heq.trans hD))

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.adj_mem_rootChild_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hCy := mem_rootChild_self (G := G) hy
  have hCD : C ≠ rootComp (G := G) U hy := by
    intro heq
    exact hyC (by simpa [heq] using hCy)
  exact adj_of_mem_distinct_rootChild (G := G)
    (C := C) (D := rootComp (G := G) U hy) hCD hx hCy

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.isCompleteBetween_rootChildren
statement:
lemma isCompleteBetween_rootChildren {U : Finset V}
    {C D : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent} (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    G.IsCompleteBetween
      (rootChild (G := G) U C : Set V)
      (rootChild (G := G) U D : Set V)
proof:
:=
  fun {_} hx {_} hy => adj_of_mem_distinct_rootChild (G := G) hCD hx hy

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_left_of_compl_walk
statement:
lemma mem_left_of_compl_walk {U A B : Finset V}
    (hunion : A ∪ B = U)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    {x y : (U : Set V)} (hx : x.val ∈ A) :
    (complInduce (G := G) U).Walk x y → y.val ∈ A
proof:
| .nil => hx
  | .cons (v := mid) hadj p => by
      have hcompl : x.val ≠ mid.val ∧ ¬ G.Adj x.val mid.val := by
        simpa [complInduce, compl_adj, induce_adj] using hadj
      have hmidU : mid.val ∈ U := mid.property
      have hmidA : mid.val ∈ A := by
        have : mid.val ∈ A ∪ B := by simpa [hunion] using hmidU
        rcases mem_union.1 this with hA | hB
        · exact hA
        · exact (hcompl.2 (hAB hx hB)).elim
      exact mem_left_of_compl_walk hunion hAB hmidA p

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.mem_left_of_compl_reachable
statement:
lemma mem_left_of_compl_reachable {U A B : Finset V}
    (hunion : A ∪ B = U)
    (hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    {x y : (U : Set V)} (hx : x.val ∈ A)
    (hreach : (complInduce (G := G) U).Reachable x y) :
    y.val ∈ A
proof:
:=
  mem_left_of_compl_walk hunion hAB hx (Classical.choice hreach)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_two_rootChildren
statement:
lemma exists_two_rootChildren {U : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G U)
    (hconn : (G.induce (U : Set V)).Connected)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ U.card) :
    ∃ (C D : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent), C ≠ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAU, hBU, hAne, hBne, hdisj, hcover, hAB, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_complete_join_on hcog hconn h2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAne
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
  have haU : a ∈ U := hAU ha
  have hbU : b ∈ U := hBU hb
  refine ⟨rootComp (G := G) U haU, rootComp (G := G) U hbU, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  have hreach :
      (complInduce (G := G) U).Reachable ⟨a, haU⟩ ⟨b, hbU⟩ :=
    ConnectedComponent.exact heq
  have hbA : b ∈ A :=
    mem_left_of_compl_reachable (G := G) hcover hAB ha hreach
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj) hbA hb

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.induce_connected_of_meets_two_rootChildren
statement:
lemma induce_connected_of_meets_two_rootChildren {U W : Finset V}
    (hW : W ⊆ U) (hWne : W.Nonempty)
    {C D : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent} (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {a b : V} (ha : a ∈ W) (hb : b ∈ W)
    (haC : a ∈ rootChild (G := G) U C)
    (hbD : b ∈ rootChild (G := G) U D) :
    (G.induce (W : Set V)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (W : Set V) := hWne.to_subtype
  refine (connected_iff _).2 ⟨?_, inferInstance⟩
  intro x y
  have hxU : x.val ∈ U := hW x.property
  have hyU : y.val ∈ U := hW y.property
  let Cx := rootComp (G := G) U hxU
  let Cy := rootComp (G := G) U hyU
  have hxC : x.val ∈ rootChild (G := G) U Cx := mem_rootChild_self hxU
  have hyC : y.val ∈ rootChild (G := G) U Cy := mem_rootChild_self hyU
  by_cases hxy : Cx = Cy
  · have hbridge :
        ∃ w : V, w ∈ W ∧ w ∉ rootChild (G := G) U Cx := by
      by_cases hCa : Cx = C
      · refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
        intro hbC
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_rootChild (G := G) hCD))
          (by simpa [hCa] using hbC) hbD
      · refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
        intro haCx
        have : Cx = C := by
          obtain ⟨ha1, hC'⟩ := mem_rootChild_iff.1 haC
          obtain ⟨ha2, hCx⟩ := mem_rootChild_iff.1 haCx
          exact hCx.symm.trans ((rootComp_eq (G := G) ha2 ha1).trans hC')
        exact hCa this
    obtain ⟨w, hwW, hwnot⟩ := hbridge
    have hwU : w ∈ U := hW hwW
    have hwC : w ∈ rootChild (G := G) U (rootComp (G := G) U hwU) :=
      mem_rootChild_self hwU
    have hneC : rootComp (G := G) U hwU ≠ Cx := by
      intro heq
      exact hwnot (by simpa [heq] using hwC)
    have hadj_xw : G.Adj x.val w :=
      adj_mem_rootChild_not_mem hxC hwU hwnot
    have hadj_yw : G.Adj y.val w := by
      have hyCx : y.val ∈ rootChild (G := G) U Cx := by
        simpa [hxy] using hyC
      exact adj_mem_rootChild_not_mem hyCx hwU hwnot
    let w' : (W : Set V) := ⟨w, hwW⟩
    have hxw : (G.induce (W : Set V)).Adj x w' := by
      simpa [induce_adj] using hadj_xw
    have hyw : (G.induce (W : Set V)).Adj y w' := by
      simpa [induce_adj] using hadj_yw
    exact (Adj.reachable hxw).trans hyw.reachable.symm
  · have hadj : G.Adj x.val y.val :=
      adj_of_mem_distinct_rootChild (G := G) hxy hxC hyC
    exact Adj.reachable (by simpa [induce_adj] using hadj)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_rootChild_superset
statement:
lemma exists_rootChild_superset {U W : Finset V}
    (hW : W ⊆ U) (hWne : W.Nonempty)
    (hcut : 2 ≤ componentCount G W) :
    ∃ C : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent,
      W ⊆ rootChild (G := G) U C
proof:
:= by
  let a := hWne.choose
  have ha : a ∈ W := hWne.choose_spec
  have haU : a ∈ U := hW ha
  refine ⟨rootComp (G := G) U haU, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  have hbU : b ∈ U := hW hb
  have hsame : rootComp (G := G) U hbU = rootComp (G := G) U haU := by
    by_contra hne
    have hconn :
        (G.induce (W : Set V)).Connected :=
      induce_connected_of_meets_two_rootChildren hW hWne hne hb ha
        (mem_rootChild_self hbU) (mem_rootChild_self haU)
    have hone := componentCount_eq_one_of_connected hWne hconn
    omega
  simpa [hsame] using mem_rootChild_self (G := G) hbU

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_assigned_rootChild
statement:
lemma exists_assigned_rootChild {U P : Finset V}
    (hPsub : P ⊆ U)
    (hcut : 2 ≤ componentCount G (U \ P))
    {C0 D0 : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent} (hCD : C0 ≠ D0) :
    ∃ (X : Finset V)
      (C : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent),
      X = rootChild (G := G) U C ∧
        (U \ P) ⊆ X ∧
          X ⊆ U ∧ X.Nonempty ∧
            (U \ X).Nonempty ∧
              (U \ X) ⊆ P ∧
                  U \ P = X \ (P ∩ X) ∧
                    P = (U \ X) ∪ (P ∩ X) ∧
                      Disjoint (U \ X) (P ∩ X)
proof:
:= by
  have hWne := nonempty_of_two_le_componentCount (G := G) hcut
  obtain ⟨C, hsup⟩ :=
    exists_rootChild_superset (G := G) (sdiff_subset (s := U) (t := P)) hWne hcut
  set X := rootChild (G := G) U C
  have hXU : X ⊆ U := rootChild_subset (G := G) U C
  have hXne : X.Nonempty := rootChild_nonempty (G := G) U C
  have hYne : (U \ X).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ := rootChild_nonempty (G := G) U C0
    obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ := rootChild_nonempty (G := G) U D0
    by_cases hC0 : C0 = C
    · refine ⟨v0, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨rootChild_subset (G := G) U D0 hv0, ?_⟩⟩
      intro hvX
      have hCD' : C ≠ D0 := by simpa [hC0] using hCD
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_rootChild (G := G) hCD'))
        (by simpa [X] using hvX) hv0
    · refine ⟨u0, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨rootChild_subset (G := G) U C0 hu0, ?_⟩⟩
      intro huX
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_rootChild (G := G) hC0))
        hu0 (by simpa [X] using huX)
  have hYsub : U \ X ⊆ P := by
    intro y hy
    have hyU : y ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).1
    have hyX : y ∉ X := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2
    by_contra hyP
    have : y ∈ U \ P := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hyU, hyP⟩
    exact hyX (hsup this)
  have hdisj : Disjoint (U \ X) (P ∩ X) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzY hzZ
    exact (mem_sdiff.1 hzY).2 (mem_of_mem_inter_right hzZ)
  have hPeq : P = (U \ X) ∪ (P ∩ X) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hzP
      have hzU : z ∈ U := hPsub hzP
      by_cases hzX : z ∈ X
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzP, hzX⟩))
      · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzU, hzX⟩))
    · intro hz
      rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzY | hzZ
      · exact hYsub hzY
      · exact mem_of_mem_inter_left hzZ
  have hWeq : U \ P = X \ (P ∩ X) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hzP : z ∉ P := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      have hzX : z ∈ X := hsup hz
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzX, ?_⟩
      intro hzPX
      exact hzP (mem_of_mem_inter_left hzPX)
    · intro hz
      have hzX : z ∈ X := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).1
      have hzPX : z ∉ P ∩ X := (mem_sdiff.1 hz).2
      have hzU : z ∈ U := hXU hzX
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzU, ?_⟩
      intro hzP
      exact hzPX (mem_inter.2 ⟨hzP, hzX⟩)
  exact ⟨X, C, rfl, hsup, hXU, hXne, hYne, hYsub, hWeq, hPeq, hdisj⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_hamiltonian
statement:
lemma rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_hamiltonian {U : Finset V} {x : V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G U) (cyc : GraphCycle G) (hc : cyc.support = U)
    (hx : x ∈ U) :
    rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = qxSet (G := G) U x
proof:
:= by
  have hport := hamiltonian_cograph_port hcog cyc hc
  have hEall := hport.1
  have h3 : 3 ≤ U.card := by simpa [hc] using cyc.three_le_card_support
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path cyc
  have hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1 :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p (hp.trans hc)
  set K := U.erase x
  have hxE : Eligible G U x := by
    have : x ∈ eligibleSet G U := by simpa [hEall] using hx
    exact (mem_eligibleSet_iff (G := G)).1 this |>.2
  have hK2 : 2 ≤ K.card := by
    have : K.card = U.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hx
    omega
  have hKcog : IsCograph G K := hcog.subset (erase_subset x U)
  have hpKle : pathCoverNumber G K ≤ pathCoverNumber G U := by
    simpa [K] using pathCoverNumber_erase_le_of_eligible (G := G) hxE
  have hKne : K.Nonempty :=
    card_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hK2)
  have hpKge := one_le_pathCoverNumber_of_nonempty (G := G) hKne
  have hpK : pathCoverNumber G K = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨pK, hpKsup⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_path_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_one (G := G) hpK
  have hKconn := connected_of_spanning_path pK hpKsup
  have hKdata :=
    hamilton_endpoints_of_traceable_cograph hK2 hKcog hKconn hpK
  exact rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_extension hx fun y hy =>
    extension_iff_of_IH hx hy hKdata hpK hEall hpU

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.pathCoverNumber_eq_of_assigned
statement:
lemma pathCoverNumber_eq_of_assigned {U P : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G U) (cyc : GraphCycle G) (hc : cyc.support = U)
    (hPsub : P ⊆ U)
    (hPcut : componentCount G (U \ P) = P.card)
    (hP2 : 2 ≤ P.card)
    {C0 D0 : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent} (hCD : C0 ≠ D0)
    {X : Finset V} {C : (complInduce (G := G) U).ConnectedComponent}
    (hX : X = rootChild (G := G) U C)
    (hWP : U \ P ⊆ X)
    (hXU : X ⊆ U) (hXne : X.Nonempty)
    (hYne : (U \ X).Nonempty)
    (hYsub : U \ X ⊆ P)
    (hWeq : U \ P = X \ (P ∩ X))
    (hPeq : P = (U \ X) ∪ (P ∩ X))
    (hdisj : Disjoint (U \ X) (P ∩ X)) :
    pathCoverNumber G X = (U \ X).card
proof:
:= by
  set Y := U \ X
  set Z := P ∩ X
  have hunion : X ∪ Y = U := union_sdiff_of_subset hXU
  have hAB : G.IsCompleteBetween (X : Set V) (Y : Set V) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hxC : x ∈ rootChild (G := G) U C := by simpa [hX] using hx
    have hyU : y ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).1
    have hyX : y ∉ X := (mem_sdiff.1 hy).2
    have hyC : y ∉ rootChild (G := G) U C := by
      intro hyC
      have : y ∈ X := by simpa [hX] using hyC
      exact hyX this
    exact adj_mem_rootChild_not_mem hxC hyU hyC
  have hr : Y.card = (U \ X).card := rfl
  have hge : Y.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G X := by
    have hZsub : Z ⊆ X := inter_subset_right
    have hcutZ : componentCount G (X \ Z) = Y.card + Z.card := by
      have hPc : P.card = Y.card + Z.card := by
        rw [hPeq, card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
      have : componentCount G (U \ P) = P.card := hPcut
      simpa [hWeq, hPc] using this
    have hle := componentCount_sdiff_le (G := G) X Z hZsub
    have : Y.card + Z.card ≤ pathCoverNumber G X + Z.card := by
      simpa [hcutZ] using hle
    omega
  have hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path cyc
    exact pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p (hp.trans hc)
  have hpU' : pathCoverNumber G (X ∪ Y) = 1 := by simpa [hunion] using hpU
  have hle := pathCoverNumber_child_le_succ (G := G) hAB hpU'
  have hnotcrit : pathCoverNumber G X ≠ Y.card + 1 := by
    intro hcrit
    have hE :=
      eligibleSet_complete_join_critical hXne hYne hAB hcrit
    have hEall : eligibleSet G U = U :=
      (hamiltonian_cograph_port hcog cyc hc).1
    obtain ⟨y, hyY⟩ := hYne
    have hyU : y ∈ U := (mem_sdiff.1 hyY).1
    have hyX : y ∉ X := (mem_sdiff.1 hyY).2
    have hyE : y ∈ eligibleSet G U := by simpa [hEall] using hyU
    have hyEX : y ∈ eligibleSet G X := by
      have hyU' : y ∈ eligibleSet G (X ∪ Y) := by simpa [hunion] using hyE
      simpa [hE] using hyU'
    exact hyX (eligibleSet_subset (G := G) X hyEX)
  have hle' : pathCoverNumber G X ≤ Y.card := by omega
  exact le_antisymm hle' hge

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.union_erase_eq_erase
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rcases mem_union.1 hz with hzB | hzA
    · exact mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hzx => hxB (hzx ▸ hzB), by
        have : z ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union.2 (Or.inr hzB)
        simpa [hunion] using this⟩
    · exact mem_erase.2 ⟨(mem_erase.1 hzA).1, by
        have : z ∈ A ∪ B := mem_union.2 (Or.inl (mem_erase.1 hzA).2)
        simpa [hunion] using this⟩
  · intro hz
    have hzx : z ≠ x := (mem_erase.1 hz).1
    have hzU : z ∈ U := (mem_erase.1 hz).2
    have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := by simpa [hunion] using hzU
    rcases mem_union.1 hzAB with hzA | hzB
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_erase.2 ⟨hzx, hzA⟩))
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hzB)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.eq_of_same_assigned_child
statement:
lemma eq_of_same_assigned_child {U : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hbal : IsBalancedEndpoints (G := G) U)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    {Xx Xy : Finset V}
    (hYx : U \ Xx ⊆ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x)
    (hYy : U \ Xy ⊆ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y)
    (hYxne : (U \ Xx).Nonempty)
    (hEq : Xx = Xy) :
    rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = rNonadjClass (G := G) U y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hYxne
  have hzPx : z ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U x := hYx hz
  have hzPy : z ∈ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y := by
    have : z ∈ U \ Xy := by simpa [hEq] using hz
    exact hYy this
  have hzU : z ∈ U := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x hzPx
  have heqx : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = rNonadjClass (G := G) U z :=
    (hbal.2.2 (x := x) (y := z) hx hzU).2 hzPx
  have heqy : rNonadjClass (G := G) U y = rNonadjClass (G := G) U z :=
    (hbal.2.2 (x := y) (y := z) hy hzU).2 hzPy
  exact heqx.trans heqy.symm

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.large_port_classification
statement:
lemma large_port_classification {U : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G U) (cyc : GraphCycle G) (hc : cyc.support = U)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hPx : 2 ≤ (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x).card)
    (hPy : 2 ≤ (rNonadjClass (G := G) U y).card)
    (hne : rNonadjClass (G := G) U x ≠ rNonadjClass (G := G) U y) :
    ∃ (A B : Finset V),
      A ∪ B = U ∧ Disjoint A B ∧
        A.card = B.card ∧ 2 ≤ A.card ∧
          (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj a a') ∧
            (∀ b ∈ B, ∀ b' ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj b b') ∧
              G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) ∧
                rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = A ∧
                  rNonadjClass (G := G) U y = B ∧
                    (∀ z ∈ U,
                      rNonadjClass (G := G) U z = A ∨
                        rNonadjClass (G := G) U z = B)
proof:
:= by
  have hport := hamiltonian_cograph_port hcog cyc hc
  have hbal := hport.2.1
  have hEall := hport.1
  have h3 : 3 ≤ U.card := by simpa [hc] using cyc.three_le_card_support
  have h2 : 2 ≤ U.card := le_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) h3
  obtain ⟨p0, hp0, _⟩ := GraphCycle.exists_spanning_path cyc
  have hpU : pathCoverNumber G U = 1 :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_one_of_support p0 (hp0.trans hc)
  have hconn := connected_of_spanning_path p0 (hp0.trans hc)
  obtain ⟨C0, D0, hCD⟩ := exists_two_rootChildren hcog hconn h2
  set Px := rNonadjClass (G := G) U x
  set Py := rNonadjClass (G := G) U y
  have hPxsub : Px ⊆ U := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U x
  have hPysub : Py ⊆ U := rNonadjClass_subset (G := G) U y
  have hPxcut : componentCount G (U \ Px) = Px.card :=
    partCut_of_balanced hbal hx
  have hPycut : componentCount G (U \ Py) = Py.card :=
    partCut_of_balanced hbal hy
  have hPx2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (U \ Px) := by simpa [hPxcut] using hPx
  have hPy2 : 2 ≤ componentCount G (U \ Py) := by simpa [hPycut] using hPy
  obtain ⟨Xx, Cx, hXx, hWPx, hXxU, hXxne, hYxne, hYxsub, hWeqx, hPeqx, hdisjx⟩ :=
    exists_assigned_rootChild (P := Px) hPxsub hPx2 hCD
  obtain ⟨Xy, Cy, hXy, hWPy, hXyU, hXyne, hYyne, hYysub, hWeqy, hPeqy, hdisjy⟩ :=
    exists_assigned_rootChild (P := Py) hPysub hPy2 hCD
  have hpXx :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_of_assigned hcog cyc hc hPxsub hPxcut hPx hCD
      hXx hWPx hXxU hXxne hYxne hYxsub hWeqx hPeqx hdisjx
  have hpXy :=
    pathCoverNumber_eq_of_assigned hcog cyc hc hPysub hPycut hPy hCD
      hXy hWPy hXyU hXyne hYyne hYysub hWeqy hPeqy hdisjy
  have hXne : Xx ≠ Xy := by
    intro hEq
    exact hne (eq_of_same_assigned_child hbal hx hy hYxsub hYysub hYxne hEq)
  have hXxcard : (U \ Xx).card = pathCoverNumber G Xx := hpXx.symm
  have hXycard : (U \ Xy).card = pathCoverNumber G Xy := hpXy.symm
  have hleX : pathCoverNumber G Xx ≤ Xx.card := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) Xx
  have hleY : pathCoverNumber G Xy ≤ Xy.card := pathCoverNumber_le_card (G := G) Xy
  have hnX : (U \ Xx).card + Xx.card = U.card := by
    have : Xx ⊆ U := hXxU
    exact (card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card this)
  have hnY : (U \ Xy).card + Xy.card = U.card :=
    card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hXyU
  have hhalfX : U.card ≤ 2 * Xx.card := by omega
  have hhalfY : U.card ≤ 2 * Xy.card := by omega
  have hdisjXY : Disjoint Xx Xy := by
    have hCxy : Cx ≠ Cy := by
      intro hCeq
      apply hXne
      simp [hXx, hXy, hCeq]
    simpa [hXx, hXy] using disjoint_rootChild (G := G) hCxy
  have hsum : Xx.card + Xy.card ≤ U.card := by
    have hsub : Xx ∪ Xy ⊆ U := union_subset hXxU hXyU
    have := card_union_of_disjoint hdisjXY
    have hle := card_le_card hsub
    omega
  have hXeq : Xx.card = Xy.card := by omega
  have hpart : Xx ∪ Xy = U := by
    have hle' : U.card ≤ (Xx ∪ Xy).card := by
      have : (Xx ∪ Xy).card = Xx.card + Xy.card := card_union_of_disjoint hdisjXY
      omega
    have hsub : Xx ∪ Xy ⊆ U := union_subset hXxU hXyU
    exact eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)
  have hYy0 : U \ Xy = Xx := by
    have h1 : U \ Xy = (Xx ∪ Xy) \ Xy := by rw [hpart]
    have h2 : (Xx ∪ Xy) \ Xy = Xx \ Xy := union_sdiff_right Xx Xy
    have h3 : Xx \ Xy = Xx := sdiff_eq_self_iff_disjoint.2 hdisjXY
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)
  have hm : 2 ≤ Xx.card := by
    have : (U \ Xy).card = Xx.card := by simpa [hYy0] using hpXy.symm
    omega
  have hnoX : ∀ a ∈ Xx, ∀ a' ∈ Xx, ¬ G.Adj a a' :=
    fun a ha a' ha' => not_adj_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card (by omega) ha ha'
  have hnoY : ∀ b ∈ Xy, ∀ b' ∈ Xy, ¬ G.Adj b b' :=
    fun b hb b' hb' => not_adj_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card (by omega) hb hb'
  have hCxy : Cx ≠ Cy := by
    intro hCeq
    apply hXne
    simp [hXx, hXy, hCeq]
  have hABxy : G.IsCompleteBetween (Xy : Set V) (Xx : Set V) := by
    simpa [hXy, hXx] using
      isCompleteBetween_rootChildren (G := G) hCxy.symm
  
  have hYx : U \ Xx = Xy := by
    have h1 : U \ Xx = (Xx ∪ Xy) \ Xx := by rw [hpart]
    have h2 : (Xx ∪ Xy) \ Xx = Xy \ Xx := union_sdiff_left Xx Xy
    have h3 : Xy \ Xx = Xy := sdiff_eq_self_iff_disjoint.2 hdisjXY.symm
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)
  have hYy : U \ Xy = Xx := hYy0
  have hpXx' : pathCoverNumber G Xx = Xx.card := by omega
  have hpXy' : pathCoverNumber G Xy = Xy.card := by omega
  have hxSide : x ∈ Xy := by
    have hxPx : x ∈ Px := mem_rNonadjClass_self hx
    have hYsub' : Xy ⊆ Px := by simpa [hYx] using hYxsub
    
    by_contra hxX
    have hxA : x ∈ Xx := by
      have : x ∈ Xx ∪ Xy := by simpa [hpart] using hx
      exact (mem_union.1 this).resolve_right hxX
    have hQx :
        rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = Xx := by
      
      have hAex : (Xx.erase x).Nonempty := by
        have : (Xx.erase x).card = Xx.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hxA
        have : 1 ≤ (Xx.erase x).card := by omega
        exact card_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 1) this)
      have hK : Xy ∪ Xx.erase x = U.erase x :=
        union_erase_eq_erase (U := U) (A := Xx) (B := Xy)
          (by simpa [union_comm] using hpart) hxA hxX
      have hAB' : G.IsCompleteBetween (Xy : Set V) ((Xx.erase x) : Set V) :=
        fun {_} hb {_} ha => hABxy hb (mem_of_mem_erase ha)
      have hdom : (Xx.erase x).card < pathCoverNumber G Xy := by
        have : (Xx.erase x).card = Xx.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hxA
        omega
      have hQ := rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_hamiltonian hcog cyc hc hx
      have hF :
          ineligibleSet G (U.erase x) = Xx.erase x := by
        have hFdom :=
          ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hXyne hAex hAB' hdom
        have hFB : ineligibleSet G Xy = ∅ :=
          ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card hpXy'
        have : ineligibleSet G (Xy ∪ Xx.erase x) = Xx.erase x ∪ ineligibleSet G Xy :=
          hFdom
        simpa [hK, hFB] using this
      have hqx : qxSet (G := G) U x = Xx := by
        simp [qxSet, hF, insert_erase hxA]
      exact hQ.trans hqx
    have : Xy ⊆ Xx := by
      simpa [hQx, Px] using hYsub'
    have hYne' : Xy.Nonempty := hXyne
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hYne'
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY) (this hz) hz
  have hPxA : Px = Xy := by
    have hQ := rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_hamiltonian hcog cyc hc hx
    have hAex : (Xy.erase x).Nonempty := by
      have : (Xy.erase x).card = Xy.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hxSide
      have : 1 ≤ (Xy.erase x).card := by omega
      exact card_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 1) this)
    have hK : Xx ∪ Xy.erase x = U.erase x :=
      union_erase_eq_erase (U := U) (A := Xy) (B := Xx)
        (by rw [union_comm]; exact hpart) hxSide
        (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY.symm hxSide)
    have hAB' : G.IsCompleteBetween (Xx : Set V) ((Xy.erase x) : Set V) :=
      fun {_} ha {_} hb =>
        (hABxy (mem_of_mem_erase hb) ha).symm
    have hdom : (Xy.erase x).card < pathCoverNumber G Xx := by
      have : (Xy.erase x).card = Xy.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hxSide
      omega
    have hF :
        ineligibleSet G (U.erase x) = Xy.erase x := by
      have hFdom :=
        ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hXxne hAex hAB' hdom
      have hFA : ineligibleSet G Xx = ∅ :=
        ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card hpXx'
      have : ineligibleSet G (Xx ∪ Xy.erase x) =
          Xy.erase x ∪ ineligibleSet G Xx := hFdom
      simpa [hK, hFA] using this
    have hqx : qxSet (G := G) U x = Xy := by
      simp [qxSet, hF, insert_erase hxSide]
    simpa [Px] using hQ.trans hqx
  have hySide : y ∈ Xx := by
    have hyPy : y ∈ Py := mem_rNonadjClass_self hy
    have hYsub' : Xx ⊆ Py := by simpa [hYy] using hYysub
    by_contra hyY
    have hyB : y ∈ Xy := by
      have : y ∈ Xx ∪ Xy := by simpa [hpart] using hy
      exact (mem_union.1 this).resolve_left hyY
    have hQy :
        rNonadjClass (G := G) U y = Xy := by
      have hAex : (Xy.erase y).Nonempty := by
        have : (Xy.erase y).card = Xy.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hyB
        have : 1 ≤ (Xy.erase y).card := by omega
        exact card_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 1) this)
      have hK : Xx ∪ Xy.erase y = U.erase y :=
        union_erase_eq_erase (U := U) (A := Xy) (B := Xx)
          (by rw [union_comm]; exact hpart) hyB hyY
      have hAB' : G.IsCompleteBetween (Xx : Set V) ((Xy.erase y) : Set V) :=
        fun {_} ha {_} hb =>
          (hABxy (mem_of_mem_erase hb) ha).symm
      have hdom : (Xy.erase y).card < pathCoverNumber G Xx := by
        have : (Xy.erase y).card = Xy.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hyB
        omega
      have hQ := rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_hamiltonian hcog cyc hc hy
      have hF :
          ineligibleSet G (U.erase y) = Xy.erase y := by
        have hFdom :=
          ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hXxne hAex hAB' hdom
        have hFA : ineligibleSet G Xx = ∅ :=
          ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card hpXx'
        have : ineligibleSet G (Xx ∪ Xy.erase y) =
            Xy.erase y ∪ ineligibleSet G Xx := hFdom
        simpa [hK, hFA] using this
      have hqx : qxSet (G := G) U y = Xy := by
        simp [qxSet, hF, insert_erase hyB]
      exact hQ.trans hqx
    have : Xx ⊆ Xy := by simpa [hQy, Py] using hYsub'
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hXxne
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY) hz (this hz)
  have hPyB : Py = Xx := by
    have hQ := rNonadjClass_eq_qxSet_of_hamiltonian hcog cyc hc hy
    have hAex : (Xx.erase y).Nonempty := by
      have : (Xx.erase y).card = Xx.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hySide
      have : 1 ≤ (Xx.erase y).card := by omega
      exact card_pos.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (0 : ℕ) < 1) this)
    have hK : Xy ∪ Xx.erase y = U.erase y :=
      union_erase_eq_erase (U := U) (A := Xx) (B := Xy)
        (by simpa [union_comm] using hpart) hySide
        (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisjXY hySide)
    have hAB' : G.IsCompleteBetween (Xy : Set V) ((Xx.erase y) : Set V) :=
      fun {_} hb {_} ha => hABxy hb (mem_of_mem_erase ha)
    have hdom : (Xx.erase y).card < pathCoverNumber G Xy := by
      have : (Xx.erase y).card = Xx.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hySide
      omega
    have hF :
        ineligibleSet G (U.erase y) = Xx.erase y := by
      have hFdom :=
        ineligibleSet_complete_join_dominant hXyne hAex hAB' hdom
      have hFB : ineligibleSet G Xy = ∅ :=
        ineligibleSet_eq_empty_of_pathCoverNumber_eq_card hpXy'
      have : ineligibleSet G (Xy ∪ Xx.erase y) =
          Xx.erase y ∪ ineligibleSet G Xy := hFdom
      simpa [hK, hFB] using this
    have hqx : qxSet (G := G) U y = Xx := by
      simp [qxSet, hF, insert_erase hySide]
    simpa [Py] using hQ.trans hqx
  refine ⟨Xy, Xx, by simpa [union_comm] using hpart, hdisjXY.symm, hXeq.symm, ?_,
    hnoY, hnoX, hABxy, hPxA, hPyB, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hXeq] using hm
  · intro z hz
    have : z ∈ Xy ∪ Xx := by simpa [hpart, union_comm] using hz
    rcases mem_union.1 this with hzA | hzB
    · have hzPx : z ∈ Px := hPxA.symm.subset hzA
      exact Or.inl
        (((hbal.2.2 (x := x) (y := z) hx hz).2 hzPx).symm.trans hPxA)
    · have hzPy : z ∈ Py := hPyB.symm.subset hzB
      exact Or.inr
        (((hbal.2.2 (x := y) (y := z) hy hz).2 hzPy).symm.trans hPyB)

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.at_most_one_nonsingleton_class
statement:
lemma at_most_one_nonsingleton_class {U : Finset V}
    (hcog : IsCograph G U) (cyc : GraphCycle G) (hc : cyc.support = U)
    (hnotK : ∀ (A B : Finset V),
      ¬ (A ∪ B = U ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A.card = B.card ∧ 2 ≤ A.card ∧
          (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj a a') ∧
            (∀ b ∈ B, ∀ b' ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj b b') ∧
              G.IsCompleteBetween (A : Set V) (B : Set V) ∧
                (∀ z ∈ U,
                  rNonadjClass (G := G) U z = A ∨
                    rNonadjClass (G := G) U z = B)))
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hPx : 2 ≤ (rNonadjClass (G := G) U x).card)
    (hPy : 2 ≤ (rNonadjClass (G := G) U y).card) :
    rNonadjClass (G := G) U x = rNonadjClass (G := G) U y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨A, B, hunion, hdisj, hcard, hm, hnoA, hnoB, hAB, hA, hB, hall⟩ :=
    large_port_classification hcog cyc hc hx hy hPx hPy hne
  exact hnotK A B ⟨hunion, hdisj, hcard, hm, hnoA, hnoB, hAB, hall⟩

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.bothEndsIn_iff
statement:
lemma bothEndsIn_iff {u v : V} {B : Finset V} :
    bothEndsIn s(u, v) B ↔ u ∈ B ∧ v ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h u (by simp), h v (by simp)⟩
  · intro ⟨hu, hv⟩ x hx
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact hu
    · exact hv

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_trimStart_subset
statement:
lemma edges_trimStart_subset (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimStart h).edges ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact mem_edges_iff.2
    ((isSubwalk_trimStart p h).edges_subset (mem_edges_iff.1 he))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_trimFinish_subset
statement:
lemma edges_trimFinish_subset (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    (p.trimFinish h).edges ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact mem_edges_iff.2
    ((isSubwalk_trimFinish p h).edges_subset (mem_edges_iff.1 he))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_dropUntil_subset
statement:
lemma edges_dropUntil_subset (p : GraphPath G) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    (p.dropUntil hx).edges ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact mem_edges_iff.2
    ((Walk.isSubwalk_dropUntil p.walk (mem_walk_support.1 hx)).edges_subset
      (mem_edges_iff.1 he))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.NoConsecutive_of_edges_subset
proof:
:=
  fun e he => hno e (hsub he)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.first_edge_mem
statement:
lemma first_edge_mem (p : GraphPath G) (h : ¬ p.walk.Nil) :
    s(p.start, p.walk.snd) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, hwalk⟩ := Walk.not_nil_iff.1 h
  rw [mem_edges_iff, hwalk, Walk.edges_cons, Walk.snd_cons]
  exact List.mem_cons_self

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.snd_not_mem_of_NoConsecutive
proof:
:= by
  intro hsnd
  exact hno _ (first_edge_mem p h) (bothEndsIn_iff.2 ⟨hs, hsnd⟩)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_concatAdj
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp [edges, concatAdj, Walk.edges_concat, List.concat_eq_append]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_consAdj
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp [edges, consAdj, Walk.edges_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.edges_splice
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp [edges, splice, Walk.edges_append, Walk.edges_cons]

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftover_edges_subset
statement:
lemma leftover_edges_subset {B : Finset V} (p : GraphPath G) {Q : GraphPath G}
    (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces B p) : Q.edges ⊆ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  exact mem_edges_iff.2
    ((leftoverPieces_isSubwalk p Q hQ).edges_subset (mem_edges_iff.1 he))

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.last_edge_mem_ofWalk
statement:
lemma last_edge_mem_ofWalk {u v : V} (w : G.Walk u v) (hw : w.IsPath)
    (h : ¬ w.Nil) :
    s((ofWalk w hw).trimFinish h |>.finish, v) ∈ (ofWalk w hw).edges
proof:
:= by
  have : s(w.penultimate, v) ∈ w.edges :=
    Walk.mk_penultimate_end_mem_edges h
  simpa [edges, ofWalk, trimFinish] using List.mem_toFinset.2 this

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_edges_append_left
statement:
lemma mem_edges_append_left {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ p.edges) : e ∈ (p.append q).edges
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.edges_append, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inl he

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.mem_edges_append_right
statement:
lemma mem_edges_append_right {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk v w}
    {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ q.edges) : e ∈ (p.append q).edges
proof:
:= by
  rw [Walk.edges_append, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr he

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.exists_complement_of_leftover_edges
statement:
lemma exists_complement_of_leftover_edges {A : Finset V} {p Q : GraphPath G}
    (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hQ : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p)
    (hclose : G.Adj p.finish p.start) :
    ∃ r : GraphPath G,
      r.support = p.support \ Q.support ∧
        r.start ∈ A ∧ r.finish ∈ A ∧
          G.Adj r.finish Q.start ∧ G.Adj Q.finish r.start ∧
            r.edges ⊆ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} ∧
              s(r.finish, Q.start) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)} ∧
                s(Q.finish, r.start) ∈ p.edges ∪ {s(p.finish, p.start)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ru, rv, heq, hruB, hrvB⟩ := leftoverPieces_factor (B := A) p Q hQ
  have hru : ¬ ru.Nil := leftoverPieces_factor_ru_not_nil hs hQ heq
  have hpreA : ru.penultimate ∈ A := hruB.resolve_left hru
  let prefixR := (ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)).trimFinish hru
  have hpreStart : prefixR.start = p.start := rfl
  have hpreFin : prefixR.finish = ru.penultimate := rfl
  have hadjPre : G.Adj prefixR.finish Q.start := ru.adj_penultimate hru
  have hruE : ru.edges.toFinset ⊆ p.edges := by
    intro e he
    apply mem_edges_iff.2
    rw [heq]
    exact mem_edges_append_left (mem_edges_append_left (List.mem_toFinset.1 he))
  have hpreE : prefixR.edges ⊆ p.edges :=
    (edges_trimFinish_subset (ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq)) hru).trans
      (by change ru.edges.toFinset ⊆ p.edges; exact hruE)
  have hlast : s(prefixR.finish, Q.start) ∈ p.edges :=
    hruE (last_edge_mem_ofWalk ru (isPath_of_factor_left heq) hru)
  have hsd := sdiff_eq_prefix_suffix heq
  by_cases hrv : rv.Nil
  · refine ⟨prefixR, ?_, ?_, ?_, hadjPre, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hrv
      have hR : rv.support.toFinset.erase Q.finish = ∅ := by
        simpa [hf] using erase_eq_empty_of_nil hrv
      have hsd' : p.support \ Q.support = ru.support.toFinset.erase Q.start := by
        rw [hsd, hR, union_empty]
      rw [support_trimFinish_ofWalk heq hru]
      exact hsd'.symm
    · exact hpreStart ▸ hs
    · exact hpreFin ▸ hpreA
    · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hrv
      rw [hpreStart, hf]
      exact hclose
    · exact hpreE.trans subset_union_left
    · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hlast)
    · have hf : Q.finish = p.finish := Walk.Nil.eq hrv
      rw [hpreStart, hf]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton.2 rfl))
  · have hsucA : rv.snd ∈ A := hrvB.resolve_left hrv
    let suffixR := (ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)).trimStart hrv
    have hsufStart : suffixR.start = rv.snd := rfl
    have hsufFin : suffixR.finish = p.finish := rfl
    have hdisj : Disjoint suffixR.support prefixR.support := by
      dsimp [suffixR, prefixR]
      exact (disjoint_trim_prefix_suffix heq hru hrv).symm
    have hclose' : G.Adj suffixR.finish prefixR.start := by
      rw [hsufFin, hpreStart]
      exact hclose
    have hrvE : rv.edges.toFinset ⊆ p.edges := by
      intro e he
      apply mem_edges_iff.2
      rw [heq]
      exact mem_edges_append_right (List.mem_toFinset.1 he)
    have hsufE : suffixR.edges ⊆ p.edges :=
      (edges_trimStart_subset (ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)) hrv).trans
        (by change rv.edges.toFinset ⊆ p.edges; exact hrvE)
    have hfirst : s(Q.finish, suffixR.start) ∈ p.edges := by
      have hf0 := first_edge_mem (ofWalk rv (isPath_of_factor_right heq)) hrv
      have : s(Q.finish, rv.snd) ∈ rv.edges.toFinset := by
        simpa [edges, ofWalk] using hf0
      exact hrvE (by simpa [hsufStart] using this)
    let r := suffixR.splice prefixR hclose' hdisj
    have hrStart : r.start = suffixR.start := rfl
    have hrFin : r.finish = prefixR.finish := rfl
    refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsup : r.support = suffixR.support ∪ prefixR.support :=
        support_splice suffixR prefixR hclose' hdisj
      rw [hsup, support_trimStart_ofWalk heq hrv,
        support_trimFinish_ofWalk heq hru, union_comm]
      exact hsd.symm
    · exact hrStart ▸ (hsufStart ▸ hsucA)
    · exact hrFin ▸ (hpreFin ▸ hpreA)
    · rw [hrFin]
      exact hadjPre
    · rw [hrStart, hsufStart]
      exact rv.adj_snd hrv
    · intro e he
      have he' : e ∈ suffixR.edges ∪ prefixR.edges ∪ {s(suffixR.finish, prefixR.start)} := by
        simpa [r, edges_splice] using he
      rcases mem_union.1 he' with h | hs0
      · rcases mem_union.1 h with h | h
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hsufE h))
        · exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl (hpreE h))
      · have : e = s(suffixR.finish, prefixR.start) := mem_singleton.1 hs0
        rw [this, hsufFin, hpreStart]
        exact mem_union.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton.2 rfl))
    · rw [hrFin]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hlast)
    · rw [hrStart]
      exact mem_union.2 (Or.inl hfirst)

name: Nikoghosyan.GraphPath.leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_start_mem_finish_not
statement:
lemma leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_start_mem_finish_not {B : Finset V}
    {p : GraphPath G} (hs : p.start ∈ B) (hf : p.finish ∉ B)
    (hno : NoConsecutive B p) :
    (leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun n =>
      ∀ (p : GraphPath G), p.support.card = n →
        p.start ∈ B → p.finish ∉ B → NoConsecutive B p →
          (leftoverPieces B p).length = (p.support ∩ B).card)
    p.support.card ?_ p rfl hs hf hno
  intro n ih p hn hs' hf' hno'
  have hnil : ¬ p.walk.Nil := by
    intro h
    have : p.finish = p.start := ((nil_iff_start_eq_finish p).1 h).symm
    exact hf' (this ▸ hs')
  rw [leftoverPieces_of_start_mem_cons hs' hnil]
  have hsT : (p.trimStart hnil).start ∉ B := by
    simpa [trimStart] using snd_not_mem_of_NoConsecutive hnil hs' hno'
  have hnoT : NoConsecutive B (p.trimStart hnil) :=
    NoConsecutive_of_edges_subset (edges_trimStart_subset p hnil) hno'
  have hps : p.support = insert p.start (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
    rw [support_trimStart, insert_erase p.start_mem_support]
  have hstart_not : p.start ∉ (p.trimStart hnil).support := by
    rw [support_trimStart]; exact notMem_erase _ _
  have hcard : (p.support ∩ B).card =
      ((p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B).card + 1 := by
    rw [hps, insert_inter_of_mem hs', card_insert_of_notMem]
    exact fun hz => hstart_not (mem_inter.1 hz).1
  cases hfind :
    (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support.find? (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) with
  | none =>
    have hlist : leftoverPieces B (p.trimStart hnil) = [p.trimStart hnil] :=
      leftoverPieces_of_not_mem_start_none hsT hfind
    have hemp : (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B = ∅ := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hyW : y ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support :=
          (mem_walk_support (p := p.trimStart hnil)).1 (mem_inter.1 hy).1
        have hnot : ¬ decide (y ∈ B) :=
          (List.find?_eq_none
            (p := fun x : V => decide (x ∈ B))).1 hfind y hyW
        exact (hnot (decide_eq_true (mem_inter.1 hy).2)).elim
      · intro hy
        exact (notMem_empty y hy).elim
    simp [hlist, hcard, hemp]
  | some _ =>
    have hnone :
        (p.trimStart hnil).walk.support.find?
          (fun x => decide (x ∈ B)) ≠ none := by
      simp [hfind]
    rw [leftoverPieces.eq_def]
    simp only [hsT, hnone, dite_false]
    have hfind' := firstB_spec (B := B) (p := p.trimStart hnil) hnone
    have hx : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ∈ (p.trimStart hnil).support :=
      (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').1
    have hbB : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ∈ B :=
      (mem_find?_B (B := B) hfind').2
    have hne : firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone ≠ (p.trimStart hnil).start :=
      find?_B_ne_start hsT hfind'
    have hlt :
        (p.trimStart hnil).support.card < n := by
      simpa [hn, support_trimStart] using
        card_erase_lt_of_mem p.start_mem_support
    have hltD :
        ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support.card <
          (p.trimStart hnil).support.card :=
      dropUntil_support_card_lt (p.trimStart hnil) hx hne
    have hltD' : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support.card < n :=
      lt_trans hltD hlt
    have hstartD : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).start ∈ B := by
      simpa [dropUntil] using hbB
    have hfinD : ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).finish ∉ B := hf'
    have hnoD : NoConsecutive B ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx) :=
      NoConsecutive_of_edges_subset
        (edges_dropUntil_subset (p.trimStart hnil) hx) hnoT
    have ihD :=
      ih _ hltD' ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx) rfl hstartD hfinD hnoD
    have htakeB :
        ((p.trimStart hnil).takeUntil hx).support ∩ B =
          {firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy1 := (mem_inter.1 hy).1
        have hy2 := (mem_inter.1 hy).2
        by_cases hEq : y = firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone
        · simp [hEq]
        · exact (takeUntil_ne_first_not_mem_B hfind' hx hy1 hEq hy2).elim
      · intro hy
        have : y = firstB B (p.trimStart hnil) hnone := mem_singleton.1 hy
        subst this
        exact mem_inter.2 ⟨((p.trimStart hnil).takeUntil hx).finish_mem_support, hbB⟩
    have hunion :=
      support_takeUntil_union_dropUntil (p.trimStart hnil) hx
    have hTD :
        (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B =
          ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support ∩ B := by
      have h1 :
          (p.trimStart hnil).support ∩ B =
            (((p.trimStart hnil).takeUntil hx).support ∪
              ((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).support) ∩ B := by
        rw [hunion]
      rw [h1, union_inter_distrib_right, htakeB, singleton_union]
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        rcases mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy'
        · exact mem_inter.2 ⟨((p.trimStart hnil).dropUntil hx).start_mem_support, hbB⟩
        · exact hy'
      · intro hy
        exact mem_insert.2 (Or.inr hy)
    simp [List.length_cons, ihD, hcard, hTD]

name: Nikoghosyan.Cograph.exists_cycle_leftover_card_eq
statement:
lemma exists_cycle_leftover_card_eq {U A : Finset V}
    (c : GraphCycle G) (_hc : c.support = U)
    (hA : A ⊆ U) (_hAne : A.Nonempty)
    {p : GraphPath G}
    (hp : p.support = U) (hs : p.start ∈ A) (hf : p.finish ∉ A)
    (hno : NoConsecutive A p) :
    ∃ pc : PathCover G (U \ A),
      pc.card = A.card ∧ pc.paths = leftoverPieces A p ∧
        ∀ Q ∈ pc.paths, Q.walk.IsSubwalk p.walk
proof:
:= by
  have hAU : A ⊆ p.support := by simpa [hp] using hA
  have hinter : p.support ∩ A = A := inter_eq_right.2 hAU
  have hlen := leftoverPieces_length_eq_of_start_mem_finish_not hs hf hno
  let pc0 := leftoverCoverOfPath p A
  have hEq : p.support \ A = U \ A := by rw [hp]
  refine ⟨pc0.cast hEq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : pc0.card = A.card := by
      rw [leftoverCoverOfPath_card, hlen, hinter]
    simpa [PathCover.cast_card] using this
  · rw [PathCover.cast_paths, leftoverCoverOfPath_paths]
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ' : Q ∈ leftoverPieces A p := by
      rwa [PathCover.cast_paths, leftoverCoverOfPath_paths] at hQ
    exact leftoverPieces_isSubwalk p Q hQ'
